This deacetylation enables efficient tyrosine phosphorylation of IRS-2 and downstream activation of the PI3K-Akt cascade, improving insulin signal transduction in peripheral tissues. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic activity sits upstream of enhanced insulin signaling. By reinforcing this pathway, SIRT1 helps counter insulin resistance and hyperglycemia in type 2 diabetes. The regulation illustrates how a single sirtuin can tune insulin sensitivity, and it positions SIRT1 activators as potential metabolic therapeutics alongside lifestyle interventions that raise NAD+.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1去乙醯化胰島素受體底物-2（IRS-2），這是胰島素和類胰島素生長因子訊號中的關鍵接頭蛋白。此去乙醯化使得IRS-2的高效酪氨酸磷酸化和下游PI3K-Akt級聯反應活化成為可能，改善周邊組織中的胰島素訊號轉導。方向上，SIRT1酵素活性位於增強胰島素訊號的上游。透過加強此通路，SIRT1有助於對抗第二型糖尿病中的胰島素阻抗和高血糖。此調節說明了一個sirtuin如何能調節胰島素敏感性，並將SIRT1活化劑定位為與提高NAD+的生活方式介入並列的潛在代謝治療藥物。

label: E2F1
description: The E2F1 transcription factor binds directly to the SIRT1 promoter and activates its transcription, particularly under proliferative or DNA-damage signals. This positions SIRT1 as a downstream effector of E2F1-driven programs that balance cell-cycle progression with survival. Directionally, E2F1 acts upstream of SIRT1 gene activation, linking growth signals to increased sirtuin abundance. Notably, the relationship is reciprocal, because SIRT1 then feeds back to deacetylate and inhibit E2F1's apoptotic function, creating a regulatory loop in which E2F1 both induces its own regulator and is constrained by it—a circuit relevant to tumor suppression and the DNA-damage response.
description_zh_TW: 轉錄因子 E2F1 直接結合 SIRT1 啟動子並活化其轉錄，特別是在增殖或 DNA 損傷信號下。這將 SIRT1 定位為 E2F1 驅動程序的下游效應因子，平衡細胞週期進展與存活。在方向性上，E2F1 位於 SIRT1 基因活化的上游，將生長信號與 sirtuin 表達量增加聯繫起來。值得注意的是，這種關係是互惠的，因為 SIRT1 然後回饋去乙醯化並抑制 E2F1 的凋亡功能，形成一個 E2F1 既誘導其自身調節因子又被其約束的調節迴路——這個電路與腫瘤抑制和 DNA 損傷反應相關。

label: Intrinsically Disordered Region
description: AlphaFold predicts SIRT1 with a global pLDDT of only 65.0, with 46.6% of residues in very-low-confidence (<50) regions — a mixture of confidently structured catalytic domain and extensive intrinsically disordered N- and C-terminal regions. This disorder complicates structure-based modeling of the STAC-binding N-terminal activation domain and helps explain the difficulty of resolving allosteric activation structurally.
description_zh_TW: AlphaFold 預測 SIRT1 的整體 pLDDT 僅 65.0，其中 46.6% 的殘基位於極低置信度（<50）區域——即確信結構的催化結構域與廣泛的內在無序 N 端、C 端區域混合。這種無序性使基於結構的 STAC 結合 N 端活化結構域建模變得困難，也有助於解釋從結構上解析別構活化的難度。

label: Dominant-negative Caspase-9
source_file: _document_ - Caspase-mediated changes in Sir2alpha during apoptosis.md
description: Co-expression of dominant-negative Caspase-9 or Bcl-xL blocked the cleavage and nuclear-to-cytoplasmic relocalization of Sir2alpha (SIRT1) during TNF-alpha-induced apoptosis. This established the translocation as downstream of apoptosome activation and mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization.
description_zh_TW: 共表達顯性失活型 Caspase-9 或 Bcl-xL 阻斷了 TNF-α 誘導凋亡期間 Sir2α（SIRT1）的裂解和從細胞核到細胞質的重新定位。這確立了此轉位位於凋亡小體活化和粒線體外膜通透化的下游。

label: CLOCK
source_file: _document_ - SIRT1 Protein roles at the nexus of health, disease, and therapeutics.md
description: In the liver, SIRT1 deacetylates PGC-1alpha and amplifies the expression of the circadian transcription factors BMAL1 and CLOCK in the suprachiasmatic nucleus of the hypothalamus. These core circadian regulators in turn drive NAMPT, generating circadian NAD+ oscillations and rhythmic SIRT1 activity.
description_zh_TW: 在肝臟中，SIRT1 去乙醯化 PGC-1α 並放大下視丘視交叉上核中晝夜節律轉錄因子 BMAL1 和 CLOCK 的表達。這些核心晝夜調節因子反過來驅動 NAMPT，產生晝夜 NAD+ 震盪和節律性的 SIRT1 活性。

label: Cellular Senescence markers
source_file: _document_ - Sirt1 Regulates Aging and Resistance to Oxidative Stress in the Heart.md
description: Moderate Sirt1 overexpression lowered the INK4/ARF family proteins p15INK4b, p19ARF, and p53 in the aging heart, while raising the anti-apoptotic molecules Bcl-2 and Bcl-xL. This anti-senescence effect contributes to retarding age-dependent cardiac decline.
description_zh_TW: 中度的 Sirt1 過表達降低了衰老心臟中的 INK4/ARF 家族蛋白 p15INK4b、p19ARF 和 p53，同時提高抗凋亡分子 Bcl-2 和 Bcl-xL。此抗衰老作用有助於延緩年齡相關的心臟衰退。

label: Glucose-6-phosphate
source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md
description: Pentose phosphate pathway flux toward NADPH/G6P promotes SIRT1 activity toward 14-3-3-zeta; G6P supplementation in Xenopus egg extract enhanced 14-3-3-zeta-directed sirtuin activity and caspase-2/14-3-3-zeta binding. Declining PPP activity leads to 14-3-3-zeta acetylation, its release, and caspase-2 activation.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸戊糖途徑朝向 NADPH/G6P 的通量促進 SIRT1 對 14-3-3ζ 的活性；在非洲爪蟾卵提取物中補充 G6P 增強了針對 14-3-3ζ 的 sirtuin 活性以及 caspase-2/14-3-3ζ 結合。PPP 活性下降導致 14-3-3ζ 乙醯化、其釋放和 caspase-2 活化。

label: Tumor suppressor inactivation
source_file: _document_ - SIRT1 Protein roles at the nexus of health, disease, and therapeutics.md
description: SIRT1 can also act as a tumor suppressor by inhibiting beta-catenin and NF-kB signaling, in contrast to its oncogenic role of deacetylating and inactivating p53. This context-dependent duality is why SIRT1 is described as a molecular 'shapeshifter' whose actions demand biomarker-guided strategies for clinical translation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 也可透過抑制 β-catenin 和 NF-kB 信號作為腫瘤抑制因子，與其去乙醯化並使 p53 失活的致癌角色形成對比。這種依賴情境的雙重性，是 SIRT1 被描述為分子「變形者」、其作用需要生物標記引導策略才能臨床轉化的原因。

label: Smad7
description: SIRT1 deacetylates Smad7 at Lys60/Lys70, promoting ubiquitin-dependent proteasomal degradation via Smurf1. This protects glomerular mesangial cells from TGF-beta-dependent apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 Lys60/Lys70 去乙醯化 Smad7，透過 Smurf1 促進依賴泛素的蛋白酶體降解。這保護腎小球系膜細胞免受依賴 TGF-β 的凋亡。

label: RelA/p65
description: SIRT1 deacetylates the RelA/p65 subunit of NF-kB, inhibiting NF-kB-dependent pro-inflammatory gene expression. Higher SIRT1 in caloric-restricted animals may explain their reduced inflammatory responses, and this action is both anti-inflammatory and tumor-suppressive.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 NF-kB 的 RelA/p65 亞基，抑制依賴 NF-kB 的促發炎基因表達。熱量限制動物中較高的 SIRT1 可能解釋其減少的發炎反應，此作用既抗發炎又具腫瘤抑制性。

label: Hes1
description: SIRT1 directly regulates BDNF transcription by deacetylating and repressing Hes1, a transcriptional repressor of BDNF, thereby relieving inhibition and promoting neuronal survival and neurogenesis. This is a key SIRT1-dependent mechanism linking metabolism to neurotrophic support.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並抑制 Hes1（BDNF 的轉錄抑制因子）直接調節 BDNF 轉錄，從而解除抑制並促進神經元存活和神經新生。這是將代謝與神經滋養支持聯繫起來的關鍵 SIRT1 依賴性機制。

label: DNA-damage-induced cell death
source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md
description: SIRT1 protects against damage-induced death on the ATM-TRIM28-SIRT1 axis: the SIRT1 activator resveratrol attenuated etoposide/camptothecin-induced death, while the inhibitor EX-527 enhanced it. In TRIM28-knockout cells, SIRT1 knockdown increased etoposide death, proving TRIM28-mediated degradation is what kills.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 ATM–TRIM28–SIRT1 軸上保護免受損傷誘導的死亡：SIRT1 活化劑白藜蘆醇減輕依托泊苷/喜樹鹼誘導的死亡，而抑制劑 EX-527 則增強之。在 TRIM28 敲除細胞中，SIRT1 敲低增加依托泊苷死亡，證明 TRIM28 介導的降解才是致死原因。

label: Paraquat-induced oxidative stress
source_file: _document_ - Sirt1 Regulates Aging and Resistance to Oxidative Stress in the Heart.md
description: Tg-Sirt1 line 40 (moderate 7.5-fold SIRT1) was protected against paraquat-induced oxidative stress: paraquat-induced apoptosis, 8-OHdG staining, and malondialdehyde content rises were abolished, while paraquat-induced catalase induction was greater. High-dose (12.5-fold) line 53 showed elevated oxidative stress even at baseline.
description_zh_TW: Tg-Sirt1 系 40（中度 7.5 倍 SIRT1）免受百草枯誘導的氧化壓力：百草枯誘導的凋亡、8-OHdG 染色和丙二醛含量升高被消除，而百草枯誘導的過氧化氫酶誘導更強。高劑量（12.5 倍）系 53 即使在基線也顯示氧化壓力升高。

label: DEPDVP motif
source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md
description: Under severe DNA damage, SIRT1 undergoes C-terminal cleavage by caspases at the DEPDVP(704-709) motif; the D707A mutant is cleavage-resistant and the DeltaC703 truncation reproduces the natural cleaved band. This cleavage is redundant and mediated by multiple caspases, as only pan-caspase inhibition blocks it.
description_zh_TW: 在嚴重 DNA 損傷下，SIRT1 在 DEPDVP(704–709) 基序被 caspase 進行 C 端裂解；D707A 突變體具有抗裂解性，而 ΔC703 截短可再現天然的裂解條帶。此裂解由多種 caspase 冗餘介導，只有廣譜 caspase 抑制才能阻斷它。

label: Sclerostin
description: SIRT1 deacetylates sclerostin (SOST) to activate Wnt/beta-catenin signaling and increase bone anabolism. SIRT1 knockout mice have a low bone-mass phenotype, and SIRT1 overexpression increases osteoblast osteogenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化硬骨素（sclerostin/SOST）以活化 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號並增加骨合成代謝。SIRT1 剔除小鼠具有低骨量表現型，SIRT1 過度表現增加成骨細胞成骨。

label: NBS1
description: SIRT1 interacts directly with NBS1 and maintains it in a hypoacetylated state, permitting NBS1 Ser343 phosphorylation required for an efficient DNA damage repair response. This couples sirtuin-dependent chromatin control to high-fidelity double-strand break repair.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 直接與 NBS1 交互作用並維持其低乙醯化狀態，允許高效 DNA 損傷修復反應所需的 NBS1 Ser343 磷酸化。這將 sirtuin 依賴的染色質控制與高保真雙股斷裂修復相耦合。

label: Pancreatitis
description: SIRT1 is protective in acute pancreatitis, with low expression associated with disease severity, and resveratrol protects against acute necrotizing pancreatitis via SIRT1-mediated p53/HSF1 deacetylation. SIRT1 modulation is a candidate strategy in pancreatic inflammation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 對急性胰臟炎具有保護作用，低表現與疾病嚴重度相關，而 resveratrol 透過 SIRT1 介導的 p53/HSF1 去乙醯化保護急性壞死性胰臟炎。SIRT1 調控是胰臟發炎的候選策略。

label: Coronary Artery Disease
description: SIRT1 is protective in coronary artery disease: genetic polymorphisms are associated with CAD risk, and expression is reduced in CAD patients. SIRT1 restoration is a candidate strategy for attenuating vascular remodeling and plaque progression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 對冠狀動脈疾病具有保護作用：基因多型性與 CAD 風險相關，且在 CAD 患者中表現降低。恢復 SIRT1 是減輕血管重塑與斑塊進展的候選策略。

label: 14-3-3ζ
description: SIRT1 deacetylates 14-3-3zeta, gating caspase-2-dependent death signaling (PMID 21884983). This sirtuin-caspase crosstalk edge constrains the pro-apoptotic adaptor.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 14-3-3zeta，門控 caspase-2 依賴的死亡訊號（PMID 21884983）。此 sirtuin-caspase 交互邊約束促凋亡銜接蛋白。

label: Hepatitis B Virus
description: SIRT3 is downregulated in HBV-positive patients and inhibits HBV replication via H3K9 deacetylation on cccDNA. This epigenetic silencing of the viral genome at the chromatin level provides a mitochondrial-to-nuclear link in antiviral defense. SIRT6 exerts an analogous H3K9-deacetylation-mediated suppression of HBV on cccDNA.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 HBV 陽性患者中下調，並經由 cccDNA 上的 H3K9 去乙醯化抑制 HBV 複製。這種在染色質層級對病毒基因體的表觀遺傳靜默，提供了抗病毒防禦中粒線體至核的連結。SIRT6 在 cccDNA 上施加類似的 H3K9 去乙醯化介導的 HBV 抑制。

label: lncRNA DACH1
description: A long noncoding RNA at the DACH1 locus interacts with SIRT3 to regulate mitochondrial oxidative damage and cell death in heart failure, representing a noncoding-RNA arm of SIRT3's cardioprotective network that couples nuclear gene regulation to mitochondrial integrity.
description_zh_TW: 位於 DACH1 位點的一種長非編碼 RNA 與 SIRT3 互動以調節心臟衰竭中的粒線體氧化損傷和細胞死亡，代表了 SIRT3 心臟保護網絡中的非編碼 RNA 臂，將核基因調節與粒線體完整性偶聯。

label: Metabolic Syndrome
description: A nonsynonymous SIRT3 SNP reducing recombinant catalytic activity by about 34% is associated with metabolic syndrome in NAFLD patients and the Finnish Metabolic Syndrome in Men cohort, implicating lowered SIRT3 activity in human metabolic disease susceptibility. Directionally, reduced SIRT3 catalytic activity is associated with metabolic syndrome. This genetic evidence connects impaired mitochondrial sirtuin function to human metabolic disease, and it complements the animal studies showing that SIRT3 loss causes metabolic dysfunction. These findings support SIRT3 as a therapeutic target for metabolic syndrome.
description_zh_TW: 一個使重組催化活性降低約34%的非同義SIRT3 SNP與NAFLD患者和芬蘭男性代謝症候群群組中的代謝症候群相關，暗示SIRT3活性降低與人類代謝疾病的易感性有關。方向上，降低的SIRT3催化活性與代謝症候群相關。此遺傳證據將粒線體sirtuin功能障礙與人類代謝疾病聯繫起來，並補充了SIRT3缺失導致代謝功能障礙的動物研究。這些發現支持SIRT3作為代謝症候群的治療靶點。

label: Histone Crotonylation eraser activity
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Beyond canonical deacetylase activity, SIRT3 possesses substantial lysine decrotonylase capacity, selectively removing crotonyl groups from specific histone substrates. This dynamic regulation of histone crotonylation adds a new dimension to SIRT3's epigenetic repertoire, modulating gene expression plasticity under both homeostatic and stress conditions. The review positions this decrotonylase activity alongside SIRT3's roles in heterochromatin maintenance and double-strand break repair as a nuclear epigenetic function of the mitochondrial deacetylase.
description_zh_TW: 除了典型的去乙醯酶活性外，SIRT3 還具有相當的離胺酸去巴豆醯基化能力，選擇性地從特定組蛋白受質上去除巴豆醯基。這種組蛋白巴豆醯基化的動態調節為 SIRT3 的表觀遺傳 repertoire 增添了新的維度，在恆定和壓力條件下調節基因表現可塑性。該綜述將此去巴豆醯基化活性與 SIRT3 在異染色質維護和雙股斷裂修復中的角色並列，作為粒線體去乙醯酶的核表觀遺傳功能。

label: Alpha-synuclein aggregates
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Beyond mitochondrial homeostasis, SIRT3 contributes to the clearance of misfolded alpha-synuclein aggregates, a pathological hallmark of Parkinson's disease, and mitigates neuroinflammation by suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome activation. These converging actions highlight the translational potential of targeting SIRT3 in PD therapy, though whether SIRT3 alterations precede dopaminergic neurodegeneration remains unclear.
description_zh_TW: 除了粒線體恆定外，SIRT3 還有助於清除錯誤摺疊的 α-synuclein 聚集體（巴金森氏症的病理特徵），並透過抑制 NLRP3 炎症小體活化減輕神經發炎。這些匯聚的作用凸顯了靶向 SIRT3 在 PD 治療中的轉化潛力，但 SIRT3 改變是否先於多巴胺ergic 神經退化仍不清楚。

label: Obese mouse BAT
description: Brown adipose tissue of obese mice shows reduced SIRT3 protein and decreased mitochondrial protein expression, linking obesity to impaired thermogenic capacity. Directionally, obesity sits upstream of lower SIRT3. This blunts cold-induced and basal mitochondrial function, and it connects metabolic disease to sirtuin attenuation. By reducing SIRT3, obesity impairs the mitochondrial biogenesis and oxidative capacity required for thermogenesis. This observation supports the concept that restoring SIRT3, through fasting or pharmacological activation, could improve the metabolic and thermogenic dysfunction associated with obesity.
description_zh_TW: 肥胖小鼠的棕色脂肪組織顯示 SIRT3 蛋白減少和粒線體蛋白表達降低，將肥胖與熱能能力受損聯繫起來。在方向性上，肥胖位於較低 SIRT3 的上游。這削弱了冷誘導和基礎粒線體功能，將代謝疾病與 sirtuin 減弱聯繫起來。透過減少 SIRT3，肥胖損害了熱能所需的粒線體生物合成和氧化能力。此觀察支持了恢復 SIRT3（透過禁食或藥理學活化）可能改善與肥胖相關的代謝和熱能功能障礙的概念。

label: COL1A1
description: COL1A1 encodes the alpha-1 chain of type I collagen, the principal ECM fibrillar collagen in myocardium. SIRT3 suppresses myocardial fibrosis through deacetylation of pro-fibrotic genes including COL1A1 and TGF-beta1, reducing ECM deposition in pressure-overloaded cardiomyocytes.
description_zh_TW: COL1A1 編碼 I 型膠原蛋白的 α-1 鏈，是心肌中的主要 ECM 纖維性膠原蛋白。SIRT3 透過去乙醯化促纖維化基因（包括 COL1A1 和 TGF-beta1），在壓力超負荷的心肌細胞中抑制心肌纖維化，減少 ECM 沉積。

label: caloric restriction protection in cochlea
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Caloric restriction alleviates age-related hearing loss by reducing oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protective effect is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice, highlighting SIRT3's indispensable role in CR-induced auditory resilience. Mechanistically, SIRT3 enhances IDH2 activity under CR, boosting mitochondrial NADPH production and ROS clearance, preserving cochlear hair cell integrity and delaying hearing loss progression.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制透過減少耳蝸細胞中的氧化損傷來緩解年齡相關性聽力損失，但此保護作用在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中被消除，凸顯 SIRT3 在 CR 誘導的聽覺韌性中不可或缺的角色。機制上 SIRT3 在 CR 下增強 IDH2 活性，促進粒線體 NADPH 產生和活性氧清除，維護耳蝸毛細胞完整性並延緩聽力損失進展。

label: VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Chronic hyperglycemia suppresses SIRT3 expression in the hippocampus, contributing to cognitive deficits through mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and neuronal apoptosis. SIRT3 overexpression mitigates neuronal injury by inhibiting the VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex, thereby reducing mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membrane (MAM) formation and protecting neurons from metabolic stress-induced apoptosis in diabetic encephalopathy.
description_zh_TW: 慢性高血糖抑制海馬體中的 SIRT3 表現，透過粒線體 Ca2+ 超載和神經元凋亡導致認知缺陷。SIRT3 的過量表現透過抑制 VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R 複合物減輕神經元損傷，從而減少粒線體相關內質網膜（MAM）形成，保護神經元免受代謝壓力誘導的凋亡，在糖尿病腦病變中發揮保護作用。

label: Cold exposure (brown adipose tissue)
description: Cold exposure induces SIRT3 in brown adipose tissue, where it promotes expression of mitochondrial genes and supports thermogenic programs. The induction enhances oxidative metabolism and uncoupled respiration needed for heat production, with SIRT3 acting upstream of UCP1-dependent thermogenesis. Directionally, a cold stimulus triggers SIRT3 upregulation, which in turn drives thermogenic mitochondrial biogenesis. This ties SIRT3 to adaptive thermogenesis and the metabolic benefits of cold exposure, and conversely SIRT3 is reduced in brown adipose tissue of obese mice, linking obesity to impaired thermogenic capacity and blunted cold-induced mitochondrial function.
description_zh_TW: 冷暴露在棕色脂肪組織中誘導 SIRT3，促進粒線體基因表達並支持產熱程序。這種誘導增強了產生熱量所需的氧化代謝和解偶聯呼吸，SIRT3 在 UCP1 依賴性產熱的上游作用。在方向性上，冷刺激觸發 SIRT3 上調，進而驅動產熱性粒線體生物合成。這將 SIRT3 與適應性產熱和冷暴露的代謝益處聯繫起來，相反，肥胖小鼠棕色脂肪組織中 SIRT3 減少，將肥胖與受損的產熱能力和遲鈍的冷誘導粒線體功能聯繫起來。

label: SUMOylation
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Epigenetic modifications can impair SIRT3 function, such as through SUMOylation-mediated inhibition, exacerbating mitochondrial dysfunction and cartilage degeneration in osteoarthritis. SENP1-mediated deSUMOylation of SIRT3 (promoted by AMPK activation with metformin) enhances its mitochondrial localization and functional activity, reducing tubular cell apoptosis under metabolic stress.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳修飾可以損害 SIRT3 功能，例如透過 SUMO 化介導的抑制，加劇骨關節炎中的粒線體功能障礙和軟骨退化。SENP1 介導的 SIRT3 去 SUMO 化（由 Metformin 透過 AMPK 活化促進）增強其粒線體定位和功能活性，減少代謝壓力下的腎小管細胞凋亡。

label: LCAD (fatty acid β-oxidation)
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: Fasting induces SIRT3 activation, which in turn enhances fatty acid oxidation through deacetylation and activation of long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (LCAD), a key enzyme of mitochondrial beta-oxidation. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatic activation of LCAD sits upstream of enhanced lipid catabolism. This promotes the harvest of energy from fat stores during fasting and caloric restriction, when glucose is scarce. By supporting efficient beta-oxidation, SIRT3 helps maintain ATP production while limiting the accumulation of damaging lipid intermediates.
description_zh_TW: 禁食誘導SIRT3活化，後者透過去乙醯化和活化長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（LCAD）——粒線體β-氧化的關鍵酶——來增強脂肪酸氧化。方向上，SIRT3對LCAD的酵素活化位於脂質分解代謝增強的上游。這促進了在禁食和熱量限制期間（葡萄糖稀缺時）從脂肪儲存中獲取能量。透過支持高效的β-氧化，SIRT3在限制有害脂質中間體積累的同時幫助維持ATP的產生。

label: Histone Crotonylation
description: Histone crotonylation (Kcr) is deposited from crotonyl-CoA and generally marks active transcription. SIRT3 possesses substantial lysine decrotonylase capacity, selectively removing crotonyl groups from specific histone substrates, and decreases H3K27 crotonylation at metastasis-associated loci such as ETS1 to constrain neoplastic dissemination.
description_zh_TW: 組蛋白巴豆醯基化（Kcr）由巴豆醯-CoA 沉積，通常標記活躍的轉錄。SIRT3 具有相當的離胺酸去巴豆醯基化能力，選擇性地從特定組蛋白受質上去除巴豆醯基，並降低轉移相關位點如 ETS1 的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化以限制腫瘤擴散。

label: Honokiol effects
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Honokiol (HKL), a bisphenolic lignan from Magnolia officinalis, upregulates SIRT3 while augmenting its enzymatic activity, and shRNA-induced SIRT3 knockdown significantly attenuates HKL's cytoprotective effects on mitochondrial biogenesis, OXPHOS capacity, and bioenergetic output. HKL protects the brain from ischemia-reperfusion injury, ameliorates intracerebral hemorrhage-induced apoptosis and mitochondrial fission, and inhibits ferroptosis, all via SIRT3 activation.
description_zh_TW: Honokiol（HKL）是來自厚朴的雙酚木脂素，上調 SIRT3 並增強其酵素活性，而 shRNA 誘導的 SIRT3 敲減顯著削弱 HKL 對粒線體生成、氧化磷酸化能力和生物能輸出的細胞保護作用。HKL 保護大腦免受缺血再灌注損傷，改善腦出血誘導的凋亡和粒線體分裂，並抑制鐵死亡，所有這些都透過 SIRT3 活化實現。

label: MnSOD (K68, K122)
description: Honokiol-activated SIRT3 deacetylates MnSOD at Lys68 and Lys122, markedly increasing its superoxide-scavenging activity in the mitochondrial matrix. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically activates MnSOD. Enhanced MnSOD lowers mitochondrial ROS and protects against oxidative injury in the heart, kidney, and brain. This is a principal mechanism for honokiol's cardiorenal and neuroprotective effects, and it parallels SIRT3's regulation of the same enzyme during caloric restriction and fasting. Because mitochondrial superoxide is a key trigger of damage and inflammasome activation, MnSOD activation by SIRT3 is central to mitochondrial stress resistance.
description_zh_TW: 被厚朴酚活化的 SIRT3 在 Lys68 和 Lys122 處去乙醯化 MnSOD，顯著增加其在粒線體基質中的超氧自由基清除活性。在方向性上，SIRT3 在酶學上活化 MnSOD。增強的 MnSOD 降低粒線體 ROS 並保護心臟、腎臟和大腦免受氧化損傷。這是厚朴酚心腎和神經保護效應的主要機制，與 SIRT3 在熱量限制和禁食期間對同一酶的調節平行。由於粒線體超氧自由基是損傷和炎症小體活化的關鍵觸發因子，SIRT3 對 MnSOD 的活化是粒線體壓力抗性的核心。

label: OSCP (ATP synthase subunit)
description: Honokiol-activated SIRT3 deacetylates OSCP, a subunit of the mitochondrial F1Fo-ATP synthase, optimizing coupling of proton flux to ATP synthesis. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically tunes ATP synthase function. Improved coupling boosts cellular energy output while limiting proton-leak-associated ROS, enhancing mitochondrial efficiency. This contributes to honokiol's metabolic and cardioprotective actions, and it shows that SIRT3 regulates not only antioxidant enzymes but also the core machinery of ATP production. By improving the efficiency and integrity of oxidative phosphorylation, SIRT3 supports the bioenergetic capacity that declines with age and metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: 被厚朴酚活化的 SIRT3 去乙醯化 OSCP（粒線體 F1Fo-ATP 合酶的一個亞基），優化質子流與 ATP 合成的偶聯。在方向性上，SIRT3 在酶學上調節 ATP 合酶功能。改善的偶聯在限制質子洩漏相關 ROS 的同時提升細胞能量輸出，增強粒線體效率。這有助於厚朴酚的代謝和心臟保護作用，並表明 SIRT3 不僅調節抗氧化酶，還調節 ATP 產生的核心機制。通過改善氧化磷酸化的效率和完整性，SIRT3 支持隨年齡和代謝疾病下降的生物能量能力。

label: p53 at Lys320
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In Alzheimer's disease, SIRT3 enhances mitochondrial bioenergetics disrupted by amyloid-beta toxicity, partially through deacetylation of mitochondrial p53 at Lys320, a modification crucial for maintaining energy homeostasis and neuronal survival. SIRT3 mRNA expression declines progressively in AD clinical specimens and rodent models, and SIRT3 levels inversely associate with tau protein deposition, supporting SIRT3 as a mitochondrial checkpoint and candidate biomarker in AD.
description_zh_TW: 在阿茲海默症中，SIRT3 增強被澱粉樣蛋白-beta 毒性破壞的粒線體生物能學，部分透過在 Lys320 處去乙醯化粒線體 p53，此修飾對於維持能量恆定和神經元存活至關重要。SIRT3 mRNA 表現在 AD 臨床標本和囓齒動物模型中進行性下降，且 SIRT3 水平與 tau 蛋白沉積呈負相關，支持 SIRT3 作為 AD 中的粒線體檢查點和候選生物標記。

label: DRP1/Fis1 mitochondrial fission
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In Huntington's disease, SIRT3 maintains mitochondrial dynamics by suppressing fission regulators such as Fis1 and Drp1, preserving mitochondrial morphology and promoting efficient axonal transport. In Drosophila HD models, transgenic expression of the SIRT3 ortholog dSirt2 significantly attenuates neuropil degeneration and prolongs organismal longevity, reinforcing conserved neuroprotective functions of SIRT3 across species.
description_zh_TW: 在亨丁頓氏症中，SIRT3 透過抑制分裂調節因子如 Fis1 和 Drp1 維護粒線體動態，保持粒線體形態並促進有效的軸突運輸。在果蠅 HD 模型中，SIRT3 直系同源物 dSirt2 的轉基因表達顯著減輕神經 neuropil 退化並延長生物體壽命，增強了 SIRT3 跨物種的保守性神經保護功能。

label: FOS/AP-1 and STAT3/NFATc2 signaling
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In cardiomyocytes, SIRT3 attenuates fibrosis by inhibiting the FOS/AP-1 and STAT3/NFATc2 signaling pathways, complementing its GSK3beta Lys15 deacetylation that blocks Smad3 complexes. Together these transcriptional suppressions reduce ECM gene expression and pathological cardiac remodeling, establishing SIRT3 as a master anti-fibrotic node acting on multiple pro-fibrotic pathways simultaneously.
description_zh_TW: 在心肌細胞中，SIRT3 透過抑制 FOS/AP-1 和 STAT3/NFATc2 訊號途徑減輕纖維化，與其阻斷 Smad3 複合物的 GSK3beta Lys15 去乙醯化互補。這些轉錄抑制共同減少 ECM 基因表達和病理性心臟重塑，確立 SIRT3 作為同時作用於多個促纖維化途徑的主要抗纖維化節點。

label: chemoresistance in CLL
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In chronic lymphocytic leukemia, SIRT3 enables metabolic adaptation that confers chemoresistance via ROS buffering. This tumor-supportive role contrasts with SIRT3's tumor-suppressive actions in other contexts (Warburg suppression via HIF-1alpha destabilization, OGG1-mediated DNA repair, H3K56 deacetylation for NHEJ fidelity), exemplifying the dualistic, context-dependent behavior of SIRT3 in cancer biology.
description_zh_TW: 在慢性淋巴性白血病中，SIRT3 實現代謝適應，透過活性氧緩衝賦予化療抗性。此腫瘤支持角色與 SIRT3 在其他情境中的腫瘤抑制作用形成對比（透過 HIF-1alpha 不穩定化抑制 Warburg 效應、OGG1 介導的 DNA 修復、H3K56 去乙醯化維持 NHEJ 精準度），體現了 SIRT3 在癌症生物學中的雙重性、情境依賴行為。

label: AGO2/cytochrome b axis
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In diabetic cardiomyopathy, SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity and suppresses oxidative stress primarily through modulation of the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway, uncoupling excessive glucose levels from electron transport chain dysfunction. SIRT3 downregulation leads to breakdown of this axis, resulting in impaired ETC activity and accelerated DCM progression.
description_zh_TW: 在糖尿病心肌病變中，SIRT3 活化主要透過調節 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力並抑制氧化壓力，將過高的血糖水平與電子傳遞鏈功能障礙解偶聯。SIRT3 的下調導致此軸線的崩解，造成 ETC 活性受損和 DCM 進展加速。

label: Irisin osteoprotection
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In diabetic periodontitis models, irisin exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects that are strictly dependent on SIRT3: lentivirus-mediated SIRT3 silencing abolishes irisin's osteoprotective efficacy against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction. SIRT3 is therefore the obligatory signaling node for irisin-mediated redox homeostasis and bone preservation in the diabetic periodontium.
description_zh_TW: 在糖尿病牙周炎模型中，Irisin 發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用嚴格依賴 SIRT3：慢病毒介導的 SIRT3 沉默消除 Irisin 對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的骨保護效果。因此 SIRT3 是 Irisin 介導的氧化還原恆定和糖尿病牙周組織骨保護的必要訊號節點。

label: Withaferin A anti-fibrotic effect
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In hepatic fibrosis models, SIRT3 has been implicated in mediating the anti-fibrotic effects of withaferin A, an effect that is abolished in SIRT3-knockout mice. This finding reinforces SIRT3's role as an indispensable molecular effector of pharmacological anti-fibrotic agents, consistent with its central suppressive function across hepatic, pulmonary, cardiac, and renal fibrosis models.
description_zh_TW: 在肝纖維化模型中，SIRT3 被認為參與介導 withaferin A 的抗纖維化作用，此效果在 SIRT3 基因敲除小鼠中被消除。此發現增強了 SIRT3 作為藥理學抗纖維化製劑不可或缺的分子效應器的角色，與其在肝、肺、心和腎纖維化模型中的核心抑制功能一致。

label: MAPK/ERK
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: MAPK/ERK signaling can oppose SIRT3-dependent metabolic and antioxidant outputs (e.g., ERK-driven proliferative/fibrotic signaling coupling with SIRT3 decrease); Table 3 lists MAPK/ERK among negative regulators of the SIRT3 pathway in aging.
description_zh_TW: MAPK/ERK 信號可以拮抗 SIRT3 依賴性的代謝和抗氧化輸出（例如 ERK 驅動的增殖/纖維化信號與 SIRT3 下降耦合）；表 3 將 MAPK/ERK 列為衰老中 SIRT3 通路的負向調節因子。

label: TFAM at Lys154
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Melatonin's orchestration of sequential mitophagy processes depends on SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of TFAM at Lys154, the pivotal molecular switch promoting mitophagic flux. In vascular calcification, SIRT3 also deacetylates proteins within the PGC-1alpha/TFAM pathway, promoting mitochondrial biogenesis while attenuating vascular smooth muscle cell calcification.
description_zh_TW: Melatonin 對連續粒線體自噬過程的編排依賴 SIRT3 介導的 TFAM 在 Lys154 處的去乙醯化，這是促進粒線體自噬通量的關鍵分子開關。在血管鈣化中，SIRT3 還去乙醯化 PGC-1alpha/TFAM 途徑中的蛋白，促進粒線體生成同時減輕血管平滑肌細胞鈣化。

label: pyruvate dehydrogenase E1α
description: Pyruvate dehydrogenase E1α (PDH E1α) becomes hyperacetylated at Lys385 in tubular epithelial cells after TGF-β1 stimulation and is deacetylated by SIRT3, modulating pyruvate entry into the TCA cycle. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically activates PDH. This links mitochondrial metabolism to TGF-β1-driven kidney injury, and loss of SIRT3 leads to PDH hyperacetylation, reduced glucose oxidation, and pyruvate/lactate accumulation. It shows SIRT3 buffering metabolic dysfunction during fibrosis, and connects the metabolic phenotype of injured kidneys to sirtuin-dependent control of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex.
description_zh_TW: 丙酮酸脫氫酶 E1α（PDH E1α）在 TGF-β1 刺激後在腎小管上皮細胞中 Lys385 處被超乙醯化，並被 SIRT3 去乙醯化，調節丙酮酸進入 TCA 循環。在方向性上，SIRT3 在酶學上活化 PDH。這將粒線體代謝與 TGF-β1 驅動的腎損傷聯繫起來，SIRT3 的缺失導致 PDH 超乙醯化、葡萄糖氧化減少和丙酮酸/乳酸累積。它表明 SIRT3 在纖維化期間緩衝代謝功能障礙，並將受損腎臟的代謝表型與丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體的 sirtuin 依賴性控制聯繫起來。

label: Centenarian-linked SNPs
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 G477T and other SNPs are associated with human longevity/healthy aging; the G477T variant (V208I/V184I alleles) improves SIRT3 function or expression and is enriched in centenarian populations in some cohorts (source review; Rose et al., 2003, Alì et al., 2015 reports).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 G477T 和其他 SNP 與人類長壽/健康衰老相關；G477T 變異（V208I/V184I 等位基因）改善 SIRT3 功能或表達，在某些族群中在百歲老人中富集（文獻綜述；Rose et al., 2003, Alì et al., 2015 報導）。

label: GDH (gluconeogenesis from amino acids)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 activates GDH to support gluconeogenesis from amino acids via deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化活化 GDH 以支持氨基酸的糖質新生。

label: AMPK/PGC-1α pathway
description: SIRT3 activates the AMPK/PGC-1α pathway, driving mitochondrial metabolic reprogramming toward oxidative phosphorylation and biogenesis. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of AMPK/PGC-1α activation. This enhances energy production and stress resistance while limiting glycolytic reliance, supporting the bioenergetic capacity of muscle, heart, and liver. It is a core mechanism for SIRT3's metabolic and cardioprotective benefits, and it reinforces the reciprocal relationship between sirtuins and AMPK. By promoting oxidative metabolism, SIRT3 helps maintain metabolic flexibility that declines with age and is impaired in obesity and diabetes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 活化 AMPK/PGC-1α 通路，驅動粒線體代謝重編程向氧化磷酸化和生物合成方向。在方向性上，SIRT3 位於 AMPK/PGC-1α 活化的上游。這增強能量產生和壓力抗性，同時限制對糖解的依賴，支持肌肉、心臟和肝臟的生物能量能力。這是 SIRT3 代謝和心臟保護益處的核心機制，強化了 sirtuin 與 AMPK 之間的互惠關係。通過促進氧化代謝，SIRT3 幫助維持隨年齡下降且在肥胖和糖尿病中受損的代謝靈活性。

label: MIP-2 expression
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 activation consistently correlates with reduced expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and MIP-2 (CXCL2), as well as diminished polymorphonuclear leukocyte infiltration in various preclinical models. These anti-inflammatory effects are sustained even after discontinuation of dietary interventions, indicating durable transcriptional reprogramming via NF-kappaB and STAT3 suppression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 活化與促發炎細胞因子如 TNF-alpha、IL-6 和 MIP-2（CXCL2）的表達減少以及各種臨床前模型中多形核白血球浸潤的減少一致相關。這些抗發炎效果在停止飲食介入後仍持續存在，表明透過 NF-kappaB 和 STAT3 抑制實現了持久的轉錄重編程。

label: OPA1 deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 contributes to maintaining mitochondrial morphology through optic atrophy 1 (OPA1) deacetylation, maintaining cristae structure and preventing inflammasome activation in cardiac fibroblasts. Matrine engages protective effects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway, combining antioxidant and anti-inflammatory mechanisms to preserve renal function.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過視神經萎縮蛋白 1（OPA1）去乙醯化有助於維護粒線體形態，維持嵴結構並防止心臟纖維母細胞中的炎症小體活化。Matrine 透過 SIRT3/OPA1 途徑調節粒線體膜動態，對抗 Cisplatin 誘導的 AKI 發揮保護作用，結合抗氧化和抗發炎機制以維護腎功能。

label: ACC1 upregulation-driven de novo lipogenesis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 contributes to the reprogramming of fatty acid synthesis by upregulating acetyl-coA carboxylase 1 to promote de novo lipogenesis through SIRT3 deacetylation, thereby promoting the invasion and metastasis of cervical cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of ACC1-driven de novo lipogenesis and metastatic behavior in cervical cancer. By enhancing lipid synthesis, SIRT3 supports the invasive and metastatic capabilities of cervical cancer cells, identifying SIRT3-ACC1 lipogenesis as a potential therapeutic target.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3透過上調乙醯CoA羧化酶1（ACC1）來重編程脂肪酸合成，透過SIRT3去乙醯化促進從頭脂肪生成，從而促進子宮頸癌細胞的侵襲和轉移。方向上，SIRT3位於子宮頸癌中ACC1驅動的從頭脂肪生成和轉移行為的上游。透過增強脂質合成，SIRT3支持子宮頸癌細胞的侵襲和轉移能力，將SIRT3-ACC1脂肪生成確定為潛在的治療靶點。

label: H4K14ac
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 deacetylates H4K14ac, part of its mitochondrial/cytonuclear deacetylase program.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化 H4K14ac，這是其粒線體/核質去乙醯酶程序的一部分。

label: OPA1 (at Lys926, Lys931)
description: SIRT3 deacetylates OPA1 at Lys926 and Lys931 within its GTPase domain, raising OPA1 GTPase activity and enhancing mitochondrial fusion during stress. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically activates OPA1. This preserves mitochondrial network integrity under damage, and it links SIRT3 to mitochondrial dynamics and quality control. By promoting fusion, SIRT3 helps mitochondria share membrane potential, dilute damage, and maintain respiratory function. This regulation is particularly important in the heart and during oxidative stress, where maintaining a connected mitochondrial network protects against fragmentation and bioenergetic collapse.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 OPA1 的 GTPase 域內的 Lys926 和 Lys931 位點去乙醯化 OPA1，提高 OPA1 GTPase 活性並在壓力下增強粒線體融合。在方向性上，SIRT3 以酶性方式活化 OPA1。這在損傷下維護粒線體網絡完整性，並將 SIRT3 與粒線體動態和品質控制聯繫起來。透過促進融合，SIRT3 幫助粒線體共享膜電位、稀釋損傷並維護呼吸功能。這種調控在心臟和氧化壓力期間特別重要，在這些情況下維護連接的粒線體網絡可防止碎片化和生物能崩潰。

label: ACC1
description: SIRT3 deacetylates acetyl-CoA carboxylase 1 (ACC1), upregulating its activity and promoting de novo lipogenesis that can fuel invasion and metastasis of cervical cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically activates ACC1, promoting lipid synthesis. This reveals a tumor-promoting facet of SIRT3 in certain cancers, contrasting with its usual protective role in mitochondrial metabolism and ROS suppression. It highlights that SIRT3's metabolic effects are context-dependent: the same enzyme that protects normal tissues by reducing oxidative stress can supply lipids that support aggressive tumor growth. This dual role must be considered in SIRT3-based therapeutic strategies.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化乙醯-CoA 羧化酶 1（ACC1），上調其活性並促進新生脂肪合成，可為宮頸癌細胞的侵襲和轉移提供燃料。在方向性上，SIRT3 在酶學上活化 ACC1，促進脂質合成。這揭示了 SIRT3 在某些癌症中的促腫瘤面向，與其在粒線體代謝和 ROS 抑制中通常的保護作用形成對比。它突顯了 SIRT3 代謝效應的情境依賴性：同一酶在減少氧化壓力時保護正常組織，卻可能提供支持侵襲性腫瘤生長的脂質。在基於 SIRT3 的治療策略中必須考慮這種雙重角色。

label: AceCS2 (mitochondrial acetyl-CoA synthetase)
description: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates acetyl-CoA synthetase 2 (AceCS2) in the mitochondrial matrix, enabling it to convert acetate into acetyl-CoA for the TCA cycle and lipogenesis. Deacetylation relieves autoinhibition, increasing AceCS2's catalytic efficiency and allowing mitochondria to use acetate as an alternative carbon source. Directionally, SIRT3 activates AceCS2 to drive mitochondrial acetyl-CoA production. This supports metabolic flexibility during fasting and alcohol metabolism, when acetate is abundant, and parallels SIRT1's activation of the cytoplasmic isoform AceCS1, demonstrating that sirtuins broadly license acetate salvage across both mitochondrial and cytosolic compartments.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化並活化粒線體基質中的乙醯-CoA 合酶 2（AceCS2），使其能夠將乙酸轉化為乙醯-CoA 用於 TCA 循環和脂肪合成。去乙醯化解除自體抑制，提高 AceCS2 的催化效率，使粒線體能夠利用乙酸作為替代碳源。在方向性上，SIRT3 活化 AceCS2 以驅動粒線體乙醯-CoA 產生。這在禁食和酒精代謝期間（乙酸豐富時）支持代謝靈活性，與 SIRT1 活化細胞質同工酶 AceCS1 平行，說明 sirtuin 在粒線體和細胞質區室中廣泛授權乙酸的回收利用。

label: IDH2
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates mitochondrial isocitrate dehydrogenase 2 (IDH2) at Lys413 (Yu 2012 PMID 22416140), boosting NADPH biosynthesis. Under caloric restriction and dietary restriction, SIRT3-mediated IDH2 deacetylation elevates NADPH, regenerating glutathione and lowering mitochondrial ROS; loss of SIRT3 abolishes this DR-dependent antioxidant response and exacerbates metabolic disease. The resulting NADPH fuels antioxidant regeneration and prevents electron transport chain overload, curbing ROS and potentiating mitochondrial antioxidant capacity. This SIRT3-IDH2-NADPH axis couples nutrient sensing to mitochondrial redox homeostasis and preserves cochlear hair cells under caloric restriction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 Lys413 處去乙醯化並活化粒線體異檸檬酸脫氫酶 2（IDH2）（Yu 2012 PMID 22416140），促進 NADPH 生合成。在熱量限制和飲食限制下，SIRT3 介導的 IDH2 去乙醯化提升 NADPH，再生穀胱甘肽並降低粒線體活性氧；SIRT3 的缺失消除此 CR 依賴的抗氧化反應並加劇代謝疾病。由此產生的 NADPH 為抗氧化再生提供燃料，防止電子傳遞鏈超載，抑制活性氧並增強粒線體抗氧化能力。此 SIRT3-IDH2-NADPH 軸線將營養感測與粒線體氧化還原恆定偶聯，並在熱量限制下保護耳蝸毛細胞。

label: DLD (dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 deacetylates dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase (DLD), supporting α-ketoacid dehydrogenase complex activity and mitochondrial metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化二硫辛醯胺脫氫酶（DLD），支持 α-酮酸脫氫酶複合體活性和粒線體代謝。

label: complex I/III
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 deacetylates subunits of respiratory-chain complexes I and III, maintaining basal ATP levels and electron-transport efficiency (Ahn et al., 2008, PNAS 105:14447-14452, PMID 18794531).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化呼吸鏈複合體 I 和 III 的次單元，維持基礎 ATP 水平和電子傳輸效率（Ahn et al., 2008, PNAS 105:14447-14452, PMID 18794531）。

label: H3K27 crotonylation at ETS1 loci
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at metastasis-associated loci such as the ETS1 promoter, effectively constraining neoplastic dissemination. Mechanistically, the long noncoding RNA LINC00922 can decoy SIRT3 away from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating local H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis. This places SIRT3's lysine decrotonylase activity at the interface of histone acylation state and oncogenic transcription.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 降低轉移相關位點如 ETS1 啟動子處的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化，有效限制腫瘤擴散。機制上，長非編碼 RNA LINC00922 可以將 SIRT3 誘離 ETS1 啟動子，上調局部 H3K27 巴豆醯基化並驅動大腸癌轉移。這將 SIRT3 的離胺酸去巴豆醯基化活性置於組蛋白醯基化狀態和致癌性轉錄的交界處。

label: PGC-1alpha transcriptional programs
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 governs mitochondrial biogenesis by activating PGC-1alpha transcriptional programs, which maintain mitochondrial DNA integrity in Parkinson's disease models, and promotes PGC-1alpha-dependent transcription to sustain redox homeostasis and neuronal energy metabolism in Huntington's disease. In diabetic nephropathy, the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis activated by meteorin-like protein stimulates AMPK at Thr172 and UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructure.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過活化 PGC-1alpha 轉錄程序掌控粒線體生成，在巴金森氏症模型中維護粒線體 DNA 完整性，並促進 PGC-1alpha 依賴的轉錄以維持亨丁頓氏症中的氧化還原恆定和神經元能量代謝。在糖尿病腎病變中，由 meteorin-like 蛋白活化的 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，維護粒線體超微結構完整性。

label: HIF1α (inhibits glycolysis)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 indirectly destabilizes HIF1α and subsequently inhibits glycolysis and glucose oxidation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 間接不穩定化 HIF1α，隨後抑制糖酵解和葡萄糖氧化。

label: Human aging (longevity)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 is associated with Human aging (longevity); mitochondrial sirtuin activity and SIRT3 variants are linked to human longevity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 與人類衰老（長壽）相關；粒線體 sirtuin 活性和 SIRT3 變異與人類長壽相關。

label: tumor suppressor (decreased in breast/ovarian cancers)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 is described as tumor suppressor (decreased in breast/ovarian cancers); it is a tumor suppressor frequently downregulated in breast/ovarian cancers (Massudi et al., 2012).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 被描述為腫瘤抑制因子（在乳腺癌/卵巢癌中降低）；它是在乳腺癌/卵巢癌中經常下調的腫瘤抑制因子（Massudi et al., 2012）。

label: mitochondrial enzyme deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 is the principal mitochondrial deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from the majority of the mitochondrial acetylome - including respiratory-chain (Complex I/III), TCA-cycle (IDH2, SDH), beta-oxidation (LCAD), and antioxidant (MnSOD) enzymes - to tune bioenergetics; its activity is NAD+-dependent and rises with caloric restriction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 是主要的粒線體去乙醯酶，從粒線體乙醯化組的大部分蛋白質上移除乙醯基團——包括呼吸鏈（複合體 I/III）、TCA 循環（IDH2、SDH）、β-氧化（LCAD）和抗氧化（MnSOD）酶——以調節生物能量學；其活性依賴 NAD+ 並在熱量限制時升高。

label: Reactive oxygen species production
description: SIRT3 lowers mitochondrial ROS by deacetylating and activating antioxidant enzymes such as MnSOD and components of the electron-transport chain, while also reducing mitochondrial membrane potential in a manner that limits superoxide leak. Higher SIRT3 activity therefore shifts the mitochondrial redox balance toward less oxidative damage. The directionality is SIRT3 activity upstream of reduced ROS. This antioxidant function is a major basis for SIRT3's protective roles in heart, liver, and aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 通過去乙醯化並活化抗氧化酶（如 MnSOD 和電子傳遞鏈的組分）來降低粒線體 ROS，同時以限制超氧自由基洩漏的方式降低粒線體膜電位。因此更高的 SIRT3 活性使粒線體氧化還原平衡向更少的氧化損傷傾斜。其方向性為 SIRT3 活性在減少 ROS 的上游。這種抗氧化功能是 SIRT3 在心臟、肝臟和衰老中保護作用的主要基礎。

label: Pyruvate Dehydrogenase (PDH)
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: SIRT3 maintains the activity of pyruvate dehydrogenase (PDH) by preventing its hyperacetylation, thereby coupling glycolysis-derived carbon to mitochondrial oxidation. Loss of SIRT3 leads to PDH hyperacetylation, reduced glucose oxidation, and accumulation of pyruvate and lactate, impairing metabolic flexibility in skeletal muscle. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of PDH-dependent glucose oxidation. By protecting PDH, SIRT3 ensures that glucose can be oxidized in mitochondria rather than being diverted to lactate, preserving energy efficiency during exercise and metabolic stress. This function is central to SIRT3's role in supporting muscle performance and whole-body glucose handling.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3透過防止丙酮酸脫氫酶（PDH）過度乙醯化來維持其活性，從而將糖解衍生的碳與粒線體氧化耦合。SIRT3的缺失導致PDH過度乙醯化、葡萄糖氧化減少以及丙酮酸和乳酸的積累，損害骨骼肌的代謝靈活性。方向上，SIRT3位於PDH依賴性葡萄糖氧化的上游。透過保護PDH，SIRT3確保葡萄糖可以在粒線體中氧化而非被分流到乳酸，在運動和代謝壓力期間維持能量效率。此功能是SIRT3支持肌肉表現和全身葡萄糖處理角色的核心。

label: ROS management
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 manages mitochondrial ROS by deacetylating and activating MnSOD and IDH2, boosting NADPH/glutathione antioxidant defense; this lowers mitochondrial superoxide and oxidative damage, protecting against cardiovascular, metabolic, and age-related injury.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化並活化 MnSOD 和 IDH2 來管理粒線體 ROS，增強 NADPH/穀胱甘肽抗氧化防禦；這降低了粒線體超氧化物和氧化損傷，保護免受心血管、代謝和年齡相關的損傷。

label: GSK3beta at Lys15
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 mediates its anti-fibrotic effect through targeted deacetylation of glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3beta) at Lys15, effectively preventing Smad3 transcriptional complex formation and subsequent fibrogenic programming. Genetic deletion of SIRT3 increases GSK3beta acetylation and hyperactivates TGF-beta signaling, culminating in enhanced transcription of ECM-related genes. This mechanism operates across peritoneal, cardiac, pulmonary, and hepatic fibrosis models.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過在 Lys15 處靶向去乙醯化糖原合成酶激酶 3 beta（GSK3beta），有效阻止 Smad3 轉錄複合物的形成及隨後的纖維化程序，從而發揮抗纖維化作用。SIRT3 的基因缺失增加 GSK3beta 乙醯化並過度活化 TGF-beta 訊號，最終增強 ECM 相關基因的轉錄。此機制在腹膜、心臟、肺部和肝纖維化模型中均運作。

label: Twist downregulation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 overexpression dramatically suppresses the metastatic capability of ovarian cancer cells by inhibiting epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition through downregulation of Twist, a key EMT transcription factor. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of Twist suppression and maintenance of an epithelial phenotype. By reducing Twist, SIRT3 blocks the switch that confers migratory and invasive behavior on tumor cells. This restrains the metastatic spread that is the main cause of ovarian cancer mortality. The finding positions SIRT3 as a suppressor of ovarian cancer metastasis and suggests that maintaining SIRT3 activity could help limit disease dissemination.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3過表達透過下調Twist（一種關鍵的EMT轉錄因子）抑制上皮-間質轉化，從而顯著抑制卵巢癌細胞的轉移能力。方向上，SIRT3位於Twist抑制和上皮表型維持的上游。透過降低Twist，SIRT3阻斷了賦予腫瘤細胞遷移和侵襲行為的轉換。這限制了作為卵巢癌死亡主要原因的轉移性擴散。此發現將SIRT3定位為卵巢癌轉移的抑制因子，並表明維持SIRT3活性可能有助於限制疾病擴散。

label: cardiac hypertrophy during ageing
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 prevents cardiac hypertrophy during ageing; its deacetylase activity protects against age-related cardiac hypertrophy.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在衰老過程中預防心臟肥大；其去乙醯酶活性保護免受年齡相關的心臟肥大。

label: ATM-Chk2 DNA damage repair
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 promotes DNA damage repair and radioresistance through the ataxia telangiectasia mutated (ATM)-Chk2 pathway in non-small-cell lung cancer cells. By supporting this DNA-damage-response branch, SIRT3 enables cancer cells to survive ionizing radiation more effectively. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of enhanced DNA repair and radiation resistance. This has therapeutic implications, because combining SIRT3 inhibition with radiotherapy could impair the repair of radiation-induced damage and thereby improve treatment efficacy.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3透過ataxia telangiectasia mutated（ATM）-Chk2通路在非小細胞肺癌細胞中促進DNA損傷修復和放射抗性。透過支持此DNA損傷反應分支，SIRT3使癌細胞能更有效地在電離輻射中存活。方向上，SIRT3位於DNA修復增強和輻射抗性的上游。這具有治療意義，因為將SIRT3抑制與放療結合可能損害輻射誘導損傷的修復，從而提高治療效果。

label: PINK1/Parkin mitophagy
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 promotes PINK1/Parkin-mediated mitophagy, which reduces mitochondrial ROS and restores hematopoietic stem cell repopulation efficiency through lysosomal clearance of damaged mitochondria. In the aging brain, the PINK1/Parkin pathway clears damaged mitochondria in Alzheimer's disease models, mitigating amyloidogenesis and tau pathology, and in osteoarthritis models SIRT3 promotes mitophagy to maintain chondrocyte health. Mitophagy is thus a core mitochondrial quality-control arm of SIRT3's cytoprotective program.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 促進 PINK1/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬，後者降低粒線體活性氧並透過溶酶體清除受損粒線體恢造血幹細胞重建效率。在老化的大腦中，PINK1/Parkin 途徑在阿茲海默症模型中清除受損粒線體，減輕澱粉樣蛋白生成和 tau 病理變化；在骨關節炎模型中 SIRT3 促進粒線體自噬以維護軟骨細胞健康。因此粒線體自噬是 SIRT3 細胞保護程序的核心粒線體品質控制臂。

label: fatty acid oxidation (FAO)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 promotes fatty-acid oxidation by deacetylating metabolic enzymes of β-oxidation and the TCA cycle.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化 β-氧化和 TCA 循環的代謝酶來促進脂肪酸氧化。

label: Hyperoxia-induced acute lung injury
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 promotes the expression of manganese superoxide dismutase (MnSOD), and this regulation is crucial for the protective effect of SIRT3 on hyperoxia-induced acute lung injury. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of MnSOD-dependent lung protection. By maintaining MnSOD, SIRT3 supports mitochondrial antioxidant defense against the oxidative stress generated by high oxygen exposure. This shields lung tissue from the reactive oxygen species that drive injury during hyperoxia. The finding highlights SIRT3 as a mitochondrial antioxidant guardian in the lung and suggests that strategies to enhance SIRT3 or MnSOD could protect against oxygen-induced lung damage in clinical settings.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3促進錳超氧化物歧化酶（MnSOD）的表達，此調節對SIRT3保護高氧誘導的急性肺損傷的效果至關重要。方向上，SIRT3位於MnSOD依賴性肺保護的上游。透過維持MnSOD，SIRT3支持粒線體抗氧化防禦，對抗高氧暴露產生的氧化壓力。這保護肺組織免受在高氧期間驅動損傷的活性氧。此發現突顯SIRT3作為肺部的粒線體抗氧化守護者，並表明增強SIRT3或MnSOD的策略可能在臨床環境中保護免受氧誘導的肺損傷。

label: cisplatin resistance in lung cancer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 reduces cisplatin resistance in lung cancer by modulating the FoxO3/Cdc10-dependent transcript 1 protein axis. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of restored platinum sensitivity in drug-resistant lung cancer cells. By acting through the FoxO3/CDT1 pathway, SIRT3 counteracts the survival adaptations that underlie cisplatin resistance, making SIRT3 activation a candidate strategy to re-sensitize resistant lung tumors to platinum-based chemotherapy.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3透過調節FoxO3/Cdc10-dependent transcript 1（CDT1）蛋白軸來降低肺癌中的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT3位於藥物耐藥肺癌細胞中鉑敏感性恢復的上游。透過透過FoxO3/CDT1通路发挥作用，SIRT3對抗構成順鉑耐藥基礎的存活適應，使SIRT3活化成為使耐藥肺癌腫瘤對鉑基化療重新敏感的候選策略。

label: AMPK/mTOR autophagy axis
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 regulates autophagic flux through the AMPK/mTOR and FOXO3a pathways, facilitating mitochondrial quality control via AMPK/ULK1 phosphorylation while antagonizing mTOR-mediated autophagic repression. Genetic ablation of SIRT3 impairs autophagic signaling with paradoxical activation of glutathione peroxidase 4 activity that suppresses autophagy initiation. A positive feedback loop exists in which autophagy induces SIRT3 via FOXO3a, restoring hematopoietic stem cell repopulation through enhanced clearance of damaged mitochondria.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過 AMPK/mTOR 和 FOXO3a 途徑調節自噬通量，透過 AMPK/ULK1 磷酸化促進粒線體品質控制，同時拮抗 mTOR 介導的自噬抑制。SIRT3 的基因敲除損害自噬訊號，伴隨穀胱甘肽過氧化酶 4 活性的矛盾活化，後者抑制自噬啟動。存在一個正回饋迴路，其中自噬透過 FOXO3a 誘導 SIRT3，透過增強受損粒線體的清除恢造血幹細胞重建能力。

label: cell death regulation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 regulates cell death in a context-dependent manner: it is predominantly anti-apoptotic under stress (via MnSOD activation, Bcl-2 deacetylation, and cyclophilin D modulation) yet pro-apoptotic in some malignancies; it also governs ferroptosis susceptibility through mitochondrial ROS and lipid-peroxidation control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 以環境依賴的方式調節細胞死亡：在壓力下主要為抗凋亡作用（透過 MnSOD 活化、Bcl-2 去乙醯化和親環素 D 調節），但在某些惡性腫瘤中為促凋亡作用；它還透過粒線體 ROS 和脂質過氧化控制來調節鐵死亡敏感性。

label: PDH E1alpha
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 regulates pyruvate dehydrogenase E1alpha deacetylation, bridging glycolysis and the TCA cycle in tubular epithelial cells during the progression of renal fibrosis. Honokiol-activated SIRT3 upregulates mitochondrial GPX4 and decreases its acetylation, inhibiting neuronal ferroptosis and mitigating perioperative neurocognitive disorders, illustrating SIRT3's metabolic-enzyme control across glycolysis-TCA coupling.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 調節丙酮酸脫氫酶 E1alpha 去乙醯化，在腎纖維化進展期間連接腎小管上皮細胞中的糖酵解和 TCA 循環。Honokiol 活化的 SIRT3 上調粒線體 GPX4 並降低其乙醯化，抑制神經元鐵死亡並減輕圍術期神經認知障礙，說明了 SIRT3 在糖酵解-TCA 偶聯中的代謝酵素控制。

label: Ku70-Bax
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 stabilizes the interaction between Ku70 and Bax to enhance the viability of glioma cells, representing an oncogenic function in this cancer type that contrasts with its tumor-suppressive roles elsewhere. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of enhanced glioma cell survival. By keeping Bax sequestered by Ku70, SIRT3 prevents the pro-apoptotic protein from triggering mitochondrial cell death, allowing glioma cells to evade apoptosis. This oncogenic facet complicates the picture of SIRT3 as a universal tumor suppressor and underscores that its net effect depends on cellular context. In gliomas, SIRT3 inhibition might be a strategy to promote tumor cell death.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3穩定Ku70和Bax之間的相互作用以增強膠質瘤細胞的存活能力，代表了在此癌症類型中與其在其他地方的腫瘤抑制角色形成對比的致癌功能。方向上，SIRT3位於膠質瘤細胞存活增強的上游。透過保持Bax被Ku70隔離，SIRT3防止促凋亡蛋白觸發粒線體細胞死亡，使膠質瘤細胞能夠逃避凋亡。這種致癌面向使SIRT3作為普遍腫瘤抑制因子的圖像變得複雜，並強調其淨效果取決於細胞環境。在膠質瘤中，SIRT3抑制可能是促進腫瘤細胞死亡的策略。

label: HIF-1α inhibition and ROS suppression
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT3 stops mitochondrial reactive oxygen species generation, which inhibits HIF-1α and tumour growth. When SIRT3 is overexpressed, it resists the growth of established cancer cell lines. SIRT3 also prevents cancer cell metabolic reprogramming by destabilising HIF1α. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced mitochondrial ROS and HIF-1α stabilisation, thereby opposing the hypoxic and metabolic adaptations that support tumour growth.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3阻止粒線體活性氧的產生，這抑制HIF-1α和腫瘤生長。當SIRT3過表達時，它抵抗已建立癌細胞系的生長。SIRT3也透過使HIF1α不穩定化來防止癌細胞代謝重編程。方向上，SIRT3位於粒線體ROS降低和HIF-1α穩定化抑制的上游，從而對抗支持腫瘤生長的缺氧和代謝適應。

label: ATP production
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 supports ATP production by deacetylating respiratory-chain complexes I and III and OSCP of the ATP synthase, optimizing electron transport and coupling proton flux to ATP synthesis; loss of SIRT3 impairs oxidative phosphorylation and lowers ATP output.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化呼吸鏈複合體 I 和 III 以及 ATP 合酶的 OSCP 來支持 ATP 產生，優化電子傳輸並將質子流與 ATP 合成耦合；SIRT3 的缺失損害氧化磷酸化並降低 ATP 產量。

label: ketogenesis
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 supports ketogenesis and energy balance during fasting by activating enzymes of fatty-acid oxidation and mitochondrial metabolism, providing ketone bodies as alternative fuel; SIRT3 is induced by caloric restriction and fasting.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過活化脂肪酸氧化和粒線體代謝的酶來支持禁食期間的生酮作用和能量平衡，提供酮體作為替代燃料；SIRT3 受熱量限制和禁食誘導。

label: healthspan outcomes
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: The conclusion of the review positions SIRT3 as a pleiotropic regulatory hub in cellular senescence and geropathology, a critical determinant across cardiovascular diseases, neurodegenerative conditions, metabolic syndrome, cancer, kidney diseases, COPD, and degenerative spine and joint diseases. It highlights SIRT3's regulation of the mitochondrial acetylome and its profound effect on chromatin remodeling and genome stability, making SIRT3 agonism a promising translational strategy in geroscience.
description_zh_TW: 該綜述的結論將 SIRT3 定位為細胞衰老和老年病理學中的多效性調控中樞，是心血管疾病、神經退化性疾病、代謝症候群、癌症、腎臟疾病、COPD 以及退化性脊柱和關節疾病的關鍵決定因子。它凸顯了 SIRT3 對粒線體乙醯酶組的調節及其對染色質重塑和基因組穩定性的深遠影響，使 SIRT3 激動成為老年科學中一個有前景的轉化策略。

label: N-terminal 101 residues by mitochondrial processing peptidase
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The full-length SIRT3 protein is enzymatically inactive and contains a mitochondrial targeting domain at its N-terminus. Mitochondrial matrix processing peptidase cleaves the N-terminal 101 residues, which then activates the enzyme. Directionally, proteolytic processing sits upstream of SIRT3 catalytic activity within the mitochondrial matrix. This maturation step ensures that SIRT3 functions only after import into mitochondria, where it deacetylates metabolic enzymes.
description_zh_TW: 全長SIRT3蛋白在酵素上是不活性的，其N端包含一個粒線體靶向結構域。粒線體基質加工肽酶切除N端101個殘基，從而活化該酶。方向上，蛋白水解加工位於粒線體基質中SIRT3催化活性的上游。此成熟步驟確保SIRT3僅在輸入粒線體後才發揮功能，在那裡它去乙醯化代謝酶。

label: Mitochondrial fusion (via OPA1)
description: Through OPA1 deacetylation, SIRT3 enhances mitochondrial fusion during stress, maintaining a connected, healthy mitochondrial network. Directionally, SIRT3 activates OPA1, which promotes fusion. Fused mitochondria better share membrane potential and dilute damage, and this protects against fragmentation and bioenergetic collapse. By supporting the fusion arm of mitochondrial dynamics, SIRT3 preserves respiratory efficiency and quality control under conditions that would otherwise fragment the network. This is a key mechanism by which SIRT3 maintains mitochondrial health and supports cardiac and neuronal function.
description_zh_TW: 透過 OPA1 去乙醯化，SIRT3 在壓力下增強粒線體融合，維護連接的、健康的粒線體網絡。在方向性上，SIRT3 活化 OPA1，後者促進融合。融合的粒線體更好地共享膜電位並稀釋損傷，保護免受碎片化和生物能崩潰。透過支持粒線體動態的融合臂，SIRT3 在原本會碎片化網絡的條件下維護呼吸效率和品質控制。這是 SIRT3 維護粒線體健康和支持心臟和神經元功能的關鍵機制。

label: p53 pathway
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Through the p53 pathway, SIRT3 prevents dysfunction and senescence caused by high glucose levels in endothelial cells by partially abrogating p53 activity. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of dampened p53 signalling and thereby of protection against glucose-induced endothelial senescence. This links mitochondrial sirtuin activity to vascular health and identifies SIRT3 as a potential target for preventing diabetic endothelial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: 透過p53通路，SIRT3透過部分消除p53活性來預防高葡萄糖水平在內皮細胞中引起的功能障礙和衰老。方向上，SIRT3位於p53訊號減弱的上游，從而保護免受葡萄糖誘導的內皮衰老。這將粒線體sirtuin活性與血管健康聯繫起來，並將SIRT3確定為預防糖尿病內皮功能障礙的潛在靶點。

label: 2-APQC
description: 2-APQC is a novel pharmacological agonist of SIRT3 that alleviates isoproterenol-induced pathological cardiac hypertrophy and fibrosis; efficacy is lost in SIRT3-knockout models and attenuated by nicotinamide, confirming SIRT3 as its primary target, via suppression of AKT/mTOR/p70S6K and JNK/TGF-beta/Smad3 signaling.
description_zh_TW: 2-APQC 是一種新型 SIRT3 藥理學激動劑，緩解異丙腎上腺素誘導的病理性心臟肥厚和纖維化；在 SIRT3 基因敲除模型中療效喪失，並被尼可醯胺削弱，確認 SIRT3 為其主要靶標，透過抑制 AKT/mTOR/p70S6K 和 JNK/TGF-beta/Smad3 訊號實現。

label: Ac2-26
description: Ac2-26, the annexin A1-derived tripeptide mimetic, transcriptionally upregulates SIRT3, concurrently reducing oxidative damage while promoting mitochondrial biogenesis and mitophagy, augmenting mitochondrial function to limit ischemic kidney injury (Suliman et al., Front Physiol 2021).
description_zh_TW: Ac2-26 是 annexin A1 衍生的三胜肽類似物，在轉錄水平上調 SIRT3，同時減少氧化損傷並促進粒線體生成和粒線體自噬，增強粒線體功能以限制缺血性腎損傷（Suliman et al., Front Physiol 2021）。

label: miR-494-3p
description: Oxidative stress-induced miR-494-3p downregulates SIRT3, establishing a senescence-exacerbating feedback loop; in COPD it directly targets SIRT3 in small airway epithelial cells, increasing p27 expression and accelerating cellular senescence.
description_zh_TW: 氧化壓力誘導的 miR-494-3p 下調 SIRT3，建立一個加劇衰老的回饋迴路；在 COPD 中它直接靶向小氣道上皮細胞中的 SIRT3，增加 p27 表現並加速細胞衰老。

label: Poricoic acid A
description: Poricoic acid A is a lanostane triterpenoid from Poria cocos. It upregulates SIRT3 and promotes beta-catenin K49 deacetylation, attenuating renal fibroblast activation and renal interstitial fibrosis in vivo and in vitro, a candidate disease-modifying agent for tubulointerstitial fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: Poricoic acid A 是來自茯苓的羊毛甾烷三萜類化合物。它上調 SIRT3 並促進 β-catenin K49 去乙醯化，減輕腎臟纖維母細胞活化和腎間質纖維化（體內和體外），是腎小管間質纖維化的候選疾病修飾劑。

label: SENP1
description: SENP1 is the SUMO-specific protease that removes SUMO from conjugated substrates. AMPK activation with metformin promotes SENP1-mediated deSUMOylation of SIRT3, enhancing its mitochondrial localization and functional activity, reducing tubular cell apoptosis under metabolic stress in AKI models.
description_zh_TW: SENP1 是 SUMO 特異性蛋白酶，去除偶聯受質上的 SUMO。利用 Metformin 進行 AMPK 活化促進 SENP1 介導的 SIRT3 去 SUMO 化，增強其粒線體定位和功能活性，在 AKI 模型中減少代謝壓力下的腎小管細胞凋亡。

label: Central nervous system
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Among the sirtuin family of proteins, SIRT3 is the most abundantly expressed in the central nervous system. This neuronal predominance positions SIRT3 as the primary mitochondrial deacetylase governing brain energy metabolism. However, its mRNA expression exhibits progressive decline from clinical Alzheimer's specimens to experimental rodent models, making SIRT3 loss a candidate early biomarker of neurodegenerative mitochondrial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: 在 Sirtuin 蛋白家族中，SIRT3 在中樞神經系統中表現最豐富。這種神經元優勢使 SIRT3 成為控制大腦能量代謝的主要粒線體去乙醯化酶。然而，从临床阿尔茨海默病标本到实验啮齿动物模型，其 mRNA 表达逐渐下降，这使得 SIRT3 的丧失成为神经退行性线粒体功能障碍的候选早期生物标志物。

label: Lys143 (suppressing ROS-mediated mutagenesis)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: By deacetylating IDH2 at K143, SIRT3 suppresses ROS-mediated mutagenesis and tumorigenesis. Distinct from the caloric-restriction-linked K413 activation that drives NADPH antioxidant regeneration, the K143 modification couples mitochondrial redox control directly to genomic protection. Directionally, SIRT3-IDH2 crosstalk sits upstream of reduced oxidative DNA damage in transformed cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過在 K143 處去乙醯 IDH2 來抑制 ROS 介導的突變和腫瘤發生。與驅動 NADPH 抗氧化劑再生的熱量限制相關的 K413 活化不同，K143 修飾將粒線體氧化還原控制直接與基因組保護結合。從方向上看，SIRT3-IDH2 串擾位於轉化細胞中減少氧化 DNA 損傷的上游。

label: Intracellular acetyl-CoA and NAD+ levels
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Emerging evidence indicates that SIRT3 acts as a key metabolic regulator that senses intracellular acetyl-coenzyme A (CoA) and NAD+ levels by transducing these cues through deacetylation of mitochondrial proteins. Directionally, acetyl-CoA and NAD+ abundance sits upstream of SIRT3 activity. This nutrient-sensing role lets SIRT3 tune mitochondrial enzymatic efficiency under fasting and caloric restriction, positioning it as the mitochondrial arm of cellular energy sensing.
description_zh_TW: 新出現的證據表明，SIRT3 是一種關鍵的代謝調節因子，可透過粒線體蛋白的去乙醯化轉導這些訊號來感知細胞內乙醯輔酶 A (CoA) 和 NAD+ 水平。從方向來看，乙醯輔酶A和NAD+豐度位於SIRT3活性的上游。這種營養感應作用讓 SIRT3 在禁食和熱量限制下調節粒線體酶效率，將其定位為細胞能量感應的粒線體臂。

label: ox-LDL-induced foam cell formation (via AMPK and UCP1 modulation)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In atherosclerosis, SIRT3 promotes AMPK activation and modulates the activity of uncoupling protein-1 (UCP1), thereby suppressing oxidized-LDL-induced foam cell formation. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced macrophage lipid loading. Gut microbiota-derived metabolites further influence the SIRT3/SOD2/FOXO3a axis that antagonizes lipogenic programming governed by the SREBP1c/FAS/DGAT2 cascade, indicating functional linkage between SIRT3 activity and host-microbiome interactions in vascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 在動脈粥狀硬化中，SIRT3 促進 AMPK 活化並調節解偶聯蛋白 1 (UCP1) 的活性，從而抑制氧化 LDL 誘導的泡沫細胞形成。從方向上看，SIRT3 位於巨噬細胞脂質負荷減少的上游。腸道微生物群衍生的代謝物進一步影響 SIRT3/SOD2/FOXO3a 軸，該軸拮抗由 SREBP1c/FAS/DGAT2 級聯控制的脂肪生成程序，顯示血管疾病中 SIRT3 活性與宿主微生物組相互作用之間的功能連結。

label: SHMT2 at Lys95 (serine metabolism)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In colorectal malignancies, SIRT3 optimizes serine metabolism via serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (SHMT2) deacetylation at Lys95, enhancing tumor aggressiveness. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated SHMT2 activation sits upstream of intensified one-carbon metabolism supporting colorectal cancer cell proliferation and survival.
description_zh_TW: 在結直腸惡性腫瘤中，SIRT3 透過絲胺酸羥甲基轉移酶 2 (SHMT2) 在 Lys95 處去乙醯化來優化絲胺酸代謝，從而增強腫瘤侵襲性。從方向上看，SIRT3 介導的 SHMT2 活化位於強化一碳代謝的上游，支持大腸直腸癌細胞增殖和存活。

label: GLDC at Lys514 (nucleotide biosynthesis)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In glioblastoma models, SIRT3 promotes nucleotide biosynthesis by deacetylating glycine decarboxylase (GLDC) at Lys514. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated GLDC activation sits upstream of expanded nucleotide pools fueling glioblastoma proliferation. Together with PYCR1 and SHMT2 regulation, this underscores how SIRT3's control of amino-acid metabolism can be co-opted to support aggressive tumor growth in specific contexts.
description_zh_TW: 在膠質母細胞瘤模型中，SIRT3 透過在 Lys514 處去乙醯甘氨酸脫羧酶 (GLDC) 來促進核苷酸生物合成。從方向上講，SIRT3 介導的 GLDC 活化位於擴大的核苷酸庫的上游，促進膠質母細胞瘤增殖。與 PYCR1 和 SHMT2 調節一起，這強調了 SIRT3 對氨基酸代謝的控制如何能夠在特定情況下支持侵襲性腫瘤生長。

label: Src kinase oxidation (mammary carcinoma metastasis)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In mammary carcinoma, SIRT3 inhibits Src kinase oxidation to suppress metastatic dissemination. Directionally, SIRT3-controlled redox state sits upstream of restrained Src-driven migratory signaling. This illustrates a tumor-suppressive facet of SIRT3's ROS management, whereby maintenance of mitochondrial redox homeostasis prevents oxidative activation of pro-metastatic kinases.
description_zh_TW: 在乳癌中，SIRT3 抑制 Src 激酶氧化以抑制轉移擴散。從方向上看，SIRT3 控制的氧化還原狀態位於受抑制的 Src 驅動的遷移訊號的上游。這說明了 SIRT3 ROS 管理的腫瘤抑制方面，即維持粒線體氧化還原穩態可防止促轉移激酶的氧化活化。

label: Histone methyltransferase complexes
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: In the context of viral infection, SIRT3 dynamically modulates the transcriptional output and replicative capacity of viral genomes by guiding histone methyltransferase complexes to viral episomes. Exogenous SIRT3 overexpression significantly attenuates viral gene expression, whereas deletion potentiates viral replication efficiency. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated chromatin targeting of episomal DNA sits upstream of suppressed viral transcription.
description_zh_TW: 在病毒感染的情況下，SIRT3 透過將組蛋白甲基轉移酶複合物引導至病毒附加體來動態調節病毒基因組的轉錄輸出和複製能力。外源SIRT3過度表達會顯著減弱病毒基因表達，而缺失會增強病毒複製效率。從方向上講，SIRT3 介導的附加型 DNA 染色質靶向位於受抑制的病毒轉錄的上游。

label: PYCR1 at Lys228 (proline biosynthesis)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 catalyzes Lys228 deacetylation on pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase 1 (PYCR1), facilitating proline biosynthesis, a critical process for tumor cell proliferation. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatic modification of PYCR1 sits upstream of enhanced proline-dependent anabolic support for tumor growth. This exemplifies the oncogenic facet of SIRT3's metabolic-enzyme control in certain genetic or microenvironmental contexts.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 催化吡咯啉 5 羧酸還原酶 1 (PYCR1) 上的 Lys228 去乙醯化，促進脯胺酸生物合成，這是腫瘤細胞增殖的關鍵過程。從方向上看，PYCR1 的 SIRT3 酶促修飾位於增強的脯氨酸依賴性合成代謝支持腫瘤生長的上游。這例證了 SIRT3 在某些遺傳或微環境背景下代謝酵素控制的致癌方面。

label: SASP (senescence-associated secretory phenotype)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 functions as a negative regulator of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype through its control over mitochondrial function. Loss of SIRT3 increases expression of SASP components including TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP9), whereas activation of SIRT3 ameliorates inflammatory tissue damage. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of restrained SASP output, linking mitochondrial quality control to the inflammatory dimension of cellular senescence during aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過控製粒線體功能，作為老化相關分泌表型的負調節因子。 SIRT3 的缺失會增加 SASP 成分的表達，包括 TNF-α、IL-1β 和基質金屬蛋白酶-9 (MMP9)，而 SIRT3 的活化可改善發炎組織損傷。從方向上看，SIRT3 位於受限制的 SASP 輸出的上游，將粒線體品質控制與老化過程中細胞老化的發炎維度聯繫起來。

label: Bcl-2 (preventing mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 regulates apoptotic commitment by deacetylating Bcl-2, thus preventing mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP). Additionally, SIRT3 delays cytochrome c release kinetics and subsequent caspase activation, modulating apoptotic signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT3-mediated Bcl-2 deacetylation sits upstream of preserved mitochondrial integrity and cell viability under stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過使 Bcl-2 去乙醯化來調節細胞凋亡，從而防止粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP)。此外，SIRT3 延遲細胞色素 c 釋放動力學和隨後的 caspase 激活，調節細胞凋亡信號通路。從方向上看，SIRT3 介導的 Bcl-2 去乙醯化位於壓力下線粒體完整性和細胞活力得以保留的上游。

label: p53/p21 axis (senescence initiation)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 regulates canonical senescence markers such as SA-beta-gal and inhibits the p53/p21 axis, thereby delaying senescence initiation. Directionally, SIRT3 activity sits upstream of suppressed p53-p21 checkpoint engagement. By restraining this axis alongside its antioxidant and metabolic programs, SIRT3 minimizes DNA damage accumulation and postpones entry into the senescent state during aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 調節經典老化標記物（例如 SA-β-gal）並抑制 p53/p21 軸，從而延遲老化起始。從方向上看，SIRT3 活性位於受抑制的 p53-p21 檢查點參與的上游。透過抑制此軸及其抗氧化和代謝程序，SIRT3 最大限度地減少 DNA 損傷積累，並在老化過程中推遲進入衰老狀態。

label: miR-297 and miR-421
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: The microRNAs miR-297 and miR-421 act as upstream modulators of SIRT3, repressing its expression and consequently influencing apoptosis-related pathways. Directionally, these microRNAs sit upstream of diminished SIRT3 output. Their dysregulation shifts the apoptotic balance in stressed cells and adds a noncoding-RNA regulatory layer to SIRT3's control of cell fate decisions in aging and malignancy.
description_zh_TW: microRNA miR-297 和 miR-421 作为 SIRT3 的上游调节剂，抑制其表达，从而影响细胞凋亡相关途径。从方向上看，这些 microRNA 位于 SIRT3 输出减少的上游。它們的失調改變了壓力細胞中的凋亡平衡，並為 SIRT3 對老化和惡性腫瘤中細胞命運決定的控制添加了非編碼 RNA 調節層。

label: SHMT2
description: In colorectal cancer, SIRT3 deacetylates SHMT2 (serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2) at Lys95, enhancing its activity and promoting serine metabolism. This increases serine consumption, NADPH levels, and nucleotide precursor availability, driving colorectal carcinogenesis in an oncogenic context.
description_zh_TW: 在結直腸癌中，SIRT3 在 Lys95 去乙醯化 SHMT2（絲胺酸羥甲基轉移酶 2），增強其活性並促進絲胺酸代謝。這增加絲胺酸消耗、NADPH 水平和核苷酸前體可用性，在致癌情境中驅動結直腸癌發生。

label: ATP5O
description: In healthy mitochondria a pool of SIRT3 is sequestered by ATP synthase via the ATP5O (OSCP) subunit. When matrix pH drops upon depolarization, SIRT3 dissociates from ATP5O (requiring H135 of ATP5O) and redistributes to matrix substrates, enabling rapid deacetylation of metabolic enzymes and recovery of membrane potential within minutes.
description_zh_TW: 在健康的粒線體中，一部分 SIRT3 被 ATP 合成酶透過 ATP5O（OSCP）亞基封存。當去極化導致基質 pH 下降時，SIRT3 從 ATP5O 解離（需要 ATP5O 的 H135），並重新分佈到基質受質上，實現對代謝酶的快速去乙醯化並在數分鐘內恢復膜電位。

label: PYCR1
description: SIRT3 catalyzes Lys228 deacetylation on PYCR1 (pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase 1), enhancing its enzymatic activity and facilitating proline biosynthesis, a critical process for tumor cell proliferation. This represents an oncogenic axis of SIRT3 in specific cancer contexts.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 對 PYCR1（吡咯啉-5-羧酸還原酶 1）催化 Lys228 去乙醯化，增強其酶活性並促進脯胺酸生物合成，這是腫瘤細胞增殖的關鍵過程。這代表 SIRT3 在特定癌症情境中的致癌軸。

label: SLC25A22
description: SIRT3 deacetylates and stabilizes the mitochondrial glutamate transporter SLC25A22 at K83, preventing its ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation and sustaining mitochondrial glutathione supply. This protects lung adenocarcinoma from ferroptosis, a microenvironment- and redox-dependent survival role.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 K83 去乙醯化並穩定粒線體穀氨酸轉運蛋白 SLC25A22，防止其泛素化和蛋白酶體降解，並維持粒線體麩胱甘肽供應。這保護肺腺癌免受鐵死亡，是一項依賴微環境和氧化還原的存活作用。

label: AceCS2
description: SIRT3 deacetylates and thereby activates AceCS2, the mitochondrial isoform of acetyl-CoA synthetase, regulating carbon entry into the TCA cycle for ATP production. Since SIRT3 is induced by caloric restriction, this couples fasting to the rate of fatty acid synthesis and TCA fueling.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化並從而活化 AceCS2（乙醯輔酶A合成酶的粒線體異構型），調節碳進入 TCA 循環以產生 ATP。由於 SIRT3 受熱量限制誘導，這將禁食與脂肪酸合成速率和 TCA 燃料供應偶聯起來。

label: ME2
description: SIRT3 removes K352 lactylation from the mitochondrial malic enzyme ME2, inhibiting ME2 and disrupting tumor redox balance by raising ROS and the NADP+/NADPH ratio, thereby suppressing colorectal cancer growth. This is a non-canonical delactylase action of SIRT3 on the metabolic-plasticity/redox interface.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 從粒線體蘋果酸酶 ME2 移除 K352 乳醯化，抑制 ME2 並透過提高 ROS 和 NADP+/NADPH 比值來破壞腫瘤氧化還原平衡，從而抑制結直腸癌生長。這是 SIRT3 在代謝可塑性/氧化還原界面上的一種非典型去乳醯化作用。

label: Circadian Rhythm
description: CLOCK/BMAL1-NAMPT-NAD+ oscillations gate daily SIRT3 activity rhythms. Circadian control of NAD+ availability thereby regulates SIRT3 activity over the day.
description_zh_TW: CLOCK/BMAL1-NAMPT-NAD+ 的振盪調控 SIRT3 活性的每日節律。因此 NAD+ 可用性的晝夜控制會在一天中調節 SIRT3 活性。

label: O-GlcNAcylation
description: O-GlcNAcylation of SIRT3 at Ser190 enhances its activity during ischemia-reperfusion, operating through the SIRT3-SOD2-MROS axis. This modification strengthens SIRT3's protective antioxidant function.
description_zh_TW: 缺血再灌注期間，SIRT3 於 Ser190 的 O-GlcNAc 修飾會增強其活性，經由 SIRT3-SOD2-MROS 軸運作。此修飾強化 SIRT3 的保護性抗氧化功能。

label: Metabolic Plasticity
description: SIRT3 couples the glycolysis-to-OXPHOS switch to the redox setpoint, conferring metabolic plasticity in a tumor-type-, stage- and microenvironment-dependent manner. This makes SIRT3 a context-dependent tumor suppressor or oncogene.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 將糖解作用至氧化磷酸化的轉換與氧化還原設定點相耦合，賦予代謝可塑性，且此作用依腫瘤類型、分期與微環境而定。這使 SIRT3 成為依情境而異的腫瘤抑制子或致癌基因。

label: Tumor-Associated Macrophage
description: The SENP1-SIRT3-cholesterol axis polarizes tumor-associated macrophages toward an immunosuppressive phenotype. SIRT3 thereby influences the tumor immune microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: SENP1-SIRT3-膽固醇軸會使腫瘤相關巨噬細胞極化為免疫抑制表型。因此 SIRT3 影響腫瘤免疫微環境。

label: Kidney Stones
description: SIRT3 is downregulated in patients with kidney stones and is protective via the Nrf2/heme oxygenase-1 pathway. SIRT3-dependent antioxidant defense protects tubular epithelium from crystal-induced injury.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在腎結石患者中表現降低，並經由 Nrf2/血基質加氧酶-1 途徑具有保護作用。SIRT3 依賴的抗氧化防禦保護腎小管上皮免受晶體誘導的損傷。

label: CypD
description: SIRT3 deacetylates cyclophilin D, preventing mitochondrial permeability-transition pore opening. This anti-apoptotic arm complements SIRT3's pro-autophagy roles in its context-dependent duality.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化 cyclophilin D，防止粒線體通透轉換孔開啟。此抗凋亡臂補充 SIRT3 在其情境依賴雙重性中的促自噬角色。

label: HDAC1
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin acts as a histone deacetylase inhibitor, directly targeting HDAC1 and HDAC3, which increases global histone acetylation and produces localized hyperacetylation of histone H3 on the p21/Waf1 promoter. In triple-negative breast cancer cells this drives histone H3 acetylation, decreasing cyclin A and cyclin B and increasing p21/Waf1/Cip1. Apigenin can additionally function as a dual epigenetic inhibitor that reverses both DNA methylation and trimethylation of lysine 27 on histone H3, qualifying it as an epigenetic modulator relevant to chemoprevention.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧作為組蛋白脫乙醯化酶抑制劑，直接靶向 HDAC1 和 HDAC3，從而增加全球組蛋白乙醯化程度，並在 p21/Waf1 促進子區域產生局部乙醯化程度增加，在三陰性乳癌細胞中，這會促進組蛋白 H3 的乙醯化，降低肌動素 A 和肌動素 B，並增加 p21/Waf1/Cip1。阿皮ゲ寧還可以作為雙重表觀遺傳修飾抑制劑，逆轉組蛋白 H3 上粒核苷酸 27 的 DNA 甲基化和三甲基化，使其成為與化療預防相關的表觀遺傳修飾劑。

label: Fatty Acid Synthase
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin inhibits fatty acid synthase (FASN), an enzyme that catalyzes long-chain fatty acid synthesis and is overexpressed in many cancers. Brusselmans and colleagues showed that plant flavonoids including apigenin induce apoptosis in prostate and breast carcinoma cells specifically through their ability to block fatty acid synthase activity, and this effect on lipogenesis was also observed in osteosarcoma cells where apigenin and luteolin downregulated FASN and acetyl-CoA carboxylase. By depriving cancer cells of de novo lipid synthesis, apigenin curbs cancer cell growth and survival through a metabolic route complementary to its effects on signaling kinases.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧抑制脂肪酸合成酶 (FASN)，一种催化长链脂肪酸合成的酶，并且在许多癌症中过度表达。布塞尔曼等人在研究中表明，包括阿皮ゲ寧在内的植物类黄酮类化合物诱导前列腺癌细胞和乳腺癌细胞凋亡，具体是通过阻断脂肪酸合成酶活性所致，并且这种对脂质生成的影响也被在骨肉瘤细胞中观察到，其中阿皮ゲ寧和卢特OLINA 下调了 FASN 和乙酰辅酶羧化酶。通过剥夺癌细胞的端粒脂质合成，阿皮ゲ寧通过与对信号转导激酶的影响相辅相成的代谢途径抑制癌细胞的生长和存活。

label: Parsley
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin is a major dietary flavone enriched in a range of fruits and vegetables, with parsley being the richest documented source. Dried parsley was reported to contain up to 45,035 ug/g apigenin, far exceeding dried chamomile flowers (3,000-5,000 ug/g), celery seeds (786.5 ug/g), vine spinach (622 ug/g), and Chinese celery (240.2 ug/g). It is also found in chamomile tea, red wine, and beer, and is a signature component of the Mediterranean diet, whose intake has been associated epidemiologically with lower rates of several human diseases including cancer.
description_zh_TW: 芹菜素是主要的膳食黃酮，富含於多種蔬果中，其中以歐芹（parsley）為文獻記載含量最豐富的來源。據報導，乾燥歐芹的芹菜素含量高達45,035 ug/g，遠超過乾燥洋甘菊花（3,000–5,000 ug/g）、芹菜籽（786.5 ug/g）、落葵（vine spinach，622 ug/g）與中國芹菜（240.2 ug/g）。它也存在於洋甘菊茶、紅酒與啤酒中，是地中海飲食的代表性成分；流行病學研究顯示，地中海飲食的攝取與包括癌症在內的多種人類疾病發生率較低有關。

label: UGT1A1
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: In the intestine and liver, apigenin is extensively conjugated by UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1A1 (UGT1A1), the key enzyme converting it into glucuronide and sulfate derivatives that are more readily transported in blood and excreted in bile or urine, and apigenin itself induces UGT1A1 transcription in colon cells. Combined treatment with sulforaphane synergistically increased UGT1A1 mRNA induction, although apigenin did not induce GSTA1. This phase II metabolism underlies apigenin's rapid clearance and low plasma bioavailability after oral dosing, while its slow systemic elimination may allow peripheral tissue accumulation that supports chemopreventive efficacy.
description_zh_TW: 在腸道與肝臟中，芹菜素會被UDP-葡萄糖醛酸轉移酶1A1（UGT1A1）廣泛結合，此關鍵酵素將其轉化為葡萄糖醛酸與硫酸衍生物，這些衍生物更易於在血液中運輸並經由膽汁或尿液排出；而芹菜素本身也會在結腸細胞中誘導UGT1A1的轉錄。與蘿蔔硫素（sulforaphane）合併處理可協同增強UGT1A1 mRNA的誘導，不過芹菜素不會誘導GSTA1。此第二相反應代謝是芹菜素口服後快速清除與低血漿生體可用率的原因，而其緩慢的全身性排除則可能使周邊組織累積，進而支持其化學預防功效。

label: Tenovin-1 and Tenovin-6
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Tenovins (tenovin-1 and tenovin-6) are sirtuin inhibitors that block SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation of p53, leading to p53 hyperacetylation and activation. Their strong anticancer activity is associated with this p53 activation, which reinstates tumor-suppressive transcription in cancer cells. Directionally, tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation and tumor suppression, a property shared with HDAC inhibitors and other p53-releasing strategies. Tenovins illustrate the direct link between sirtuin inhibition, p53 acetylation state, and cancer therapy.
