description_zh_TW: Tenovin（tenovin-1 和 tenovin-6）是 sirtuin 抑制劑，阻斷 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的 p53 去乙醯化，導致 p53 超乙醯化和活化。其強效抗癌活性與此 p53 活化相關，在癌細胞中恢復腫瘤抑制性轉錄。方向性上 tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化和腫瘤抑制的上游，此特性與 HDAC 抑制劑和其他 p53 釋放策略共享。Tenovin 展示了 sirtuin 抑制、p53 乙醯化狀態和癌症治療之間的直接聯繫。

label: HIC1 transcription
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: p53 directly activates transcription of HIC1, a tumor suppressor that in turn represses the SIRT1 promoter, forming a negative feedback loop that restrains SIRT1 abundance. This loop ensures that p53 activity is not indefinitely suppressed by SIRT1-mediated deacetylation, because sustained p53 signaling drives HIC1 to limit SIRT1 expression. Directionally, p53 is the transcription factor and HIC1 the induced target gene, with SIRT1 sitting downstream of both. The biological significance is genome protection: by inducing HIC1, p53 prevents SIRT1 from over-deacetylating and silencing p53 itself, preserving the capacity for apoptosis and senescence in response to damage.
description_zh_TW: p53 直接活化 HIC1 的轉錄，HIC1 是一種腫瘤抑制因子，反過來抑制 SIRT1 啟動子，形成一個負回饋迴路以限制 SIRT1 的表達量。這個迴路確保 p53 活性不會被 SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化無限期抑制，因為持續的 p53 信號驅動 HIC1 來限制 SIRT1 表達。在方向性上，p53 是轉錄因子，HIC1 是被誘導的靶基因，而 SIRT1 位於兩者的下游。其生物學意義在於基因組保護：通過誘導 HIC1，p53 防止 SIRT1 過度去乙醯化和沉默 p53 本身，維持對損傷的凋亡和衰老反應能力。

label: Protein Degradation
description: A ubiquitin ligase (E3) recognizes a specific protein substrate and catalyzes transfer of ubiquitin from an E2 enzyme, tagging proteins for proteasomal degradation, altered localization, or non-proteolytic signaling. With over 600 E3 ligases in humans, the E3 step confers substrate specificity.
description_zh_TW: 泛素連接酶（E3）識別特定蛋白質受質，並催化泛素從 E2 酶轉移，將蛋白質標記以進行蛋白酶體降解、改變定位或非蛋白水解訊號。人類有超過 600 種 E3 連接酶，E3 步驟賦予受質特異性。

label: p27
description: The CDK inhibitor p27 is co-induced with p21 to enforce cell cycle arrest. p27 inhibits G1 cyclin-CDK complexes, maintaining cells in a non-proliferative state. Together with p21 it represents a key effector of growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: CDK 抑制劑 p27 與 p21 共同被誘導以強制實施細胞週期停滯。p27 抑制 G1 cyclin–CDK 複合體，使細胞維持在非增殖狀態。它與 p21 共同構成生長停滯的關鍵效應因子。

label: Cancer Chemoprevention
description: Cancer chemoprevention aims to reduce cancer incidence by administering agents that prevent or reverse carcinogenesis, with dietary flavonoids such as apigenin as leading candidates. Apigenin exemplifies a multimodal chemopreventive flavone active across many human malignancies.
description_zh_TW: 癌症化學預防旨在透過給予可預防或逆轉致癌作用的藥物來降低癌症發生率，其中以 apigenin 等膳食黃酮類為主要候選。Apigenin 是橫跨多種人類惡性腫瘤的多模式化學預防黃酮典範。

label: Chrysin
description: Chrysin shares the flavone scaffold with apigenin and, when combined with apigenin, synergistically induces apoptosis and inhibits migration in breast and liver cancer cells by downregulating MMP-2 and MMP-9. Both are plant flavones with overlapping anticancer mechanisms.
description_zh_TW: Chrysin 與 apigenin 共享黃酮骨架，與 apigenin 合併使用時可透過下調 MMP-2 與 MMP-9，協同誘導乳癌與肝癌細胞凋亡並抑制其遷移。兩者皆為機制重疊的植物黃酮。

label: Matrix Metalloproteinase
description: Matrix metalloproteinases, notably MMP-2 and MMP-9, are zinc-dependent proteases that remodel the extracellular matrix and promote cancer invasion. Apigenin downregulates MMP-2 and MMP-9 expression and activity across multiple cancers, reducing migration and invasion.
description_zh_TW: 基質金屬蛋白酶（尤以 MMP-2 與 MMP-9）是重塑細胞外基質並促進癌症侵襲的鋅依賴蛋白酶。Apigenin 在多種癌症中下調 MMP-2 與 MMP-9 的表現與活性，減少遷移與侵襲。

label: SAT1
description: p53 transactivates SAT1, amplifying ALOX15-driven lipid peroxidation downstream. Together with SLC7A11 repression this gives p53 two complementary ferroptosis levers.
description_zh_TW: p53 轉活化 SAT1，在下游放大 ALOX15 驅動的脂質過氧化。與 SLC7A11 抑制一起，賦予 p53 兩個互補的鐵死亡槓桿。

label: ARF
description: ARF binds HUWE1, stabilizing p53 against ubiquitination.
description_zh_TW: ARF 結合 HUWE1，使 p53 免於泛素化而穩定。

label: BAI1
description: Pharmacologic BAX inhibitors BAI1 and eltrombopag block BAX translocation and oligomerization, reducing cytosolic mtDNA/mtRNA and SASP secretion in senescent fibroblasts; in aged mice BAI1 lowers circulating SASP factors and improves bone strength and frailty without altering p16/p21 arrest.
description_zh_TW: 藥理學 BAX 抑制劑 BAI1 與 eltrombopag 阻斷 BAX 轉位與寡聚，減少衰老纖維母細胞的胞質 mtDNA/mtRNA 與 SASP 分泌；在老齡小鼠中 BAI1 降低循環 SASP 因子並改善骨強度與衰弱，且不改變 p16/p21 停滯。

label: Chromosomal Instability
description: Persistent APC/C defects drive continuous chromosomal instability.
description_zh_TW: 持續的 APC/C 缺陷驅動連續的染色體不穩定。

label: Spindle Assembly Checkpoint
description: The APC/C is the ultimate effector restrained by the spindle assembly checkpoint via Mad2/BubR1.
description_zh_TW: APC/C 是經 Mad2/BubR1 受紡錘體組裝檢查點約束的最終效應器。

label: 26S Proteasome
description: Ubiquitinated APC/C substrates are degraded by the 26S proteasome.
description_zh_TW: 泛素化的 APC/C 受質被 26S 蛋白酶體降解。

label: microbial macromolecules
description: Hypochlorous acid (HOCl) is a potent antimicrobial oxidant produced by myeloperoxidase in the neutrophil halogenation cycle. It damages microbial proteins, lipids, and DNA, and it is central to the oxidative burst that kills pathogens in phagosomes. When HOCl is released in excess at sites of inflammation, it also oxidizes host biomolecules, generating markers such as 3-chlorotyrosine and 3-nitrotyrosine, and modifying lipids and lipoproteins, which links MPO activity to tissue injury, atherosclerosis, and chronic inflammatory disease.
description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid（HOCl）是myeloperoxidase在neutrophil halogenation cycle中產生的potent antimicrobial oxidant。它damages microbial proteins、lipids與DNA，並是kill pathogens in phagosomes的oxidative burst核心。當HOCl在inflammation部位excess released時，它亦oxidizes host biomolecules，generating markers such as 3-chlorotyrosine與3-nitrotyrosine，並modifying lipids與lipoproteins，這將MPO activity與tissue injury、atherosclerosis及chronic inflammatory disease聯繫起來。

label: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin
description: Hypochlorous acid inactivates alpha-1 antitrypsin by oxidizing critical residues, especially methionine, abolishing its ability to inhibit neutrophil elastase. In COPD and similar conditions this unleashes unopposed proteolysis that destroys lung matrix. The directionality is HOCl to serpin inactivation to tissue damage. A caveat is that cigarette smoke and other oxidants also inactivate alpha-1 antitrypsin, so HOCl is one of several mechanisms. The same oxidative inactivation contributes to emphysema in cigarette smokers, where neutrophil-derived HOCl meets a poorly protected lung interstitium.
description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 透過氧化關鍵殘基（尤其是蛋胺酸）使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失去活性，從而消除其抑制嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶的能力。在慢性阻塞性肺病和類似的情況下，這會釋放出不受對抗的蛋白質分解作用，從而破壞肺基質。方向性是 HOCl 至絲胺酸蛋白酶抑制劑失活至組織損傷。需要注意的是，cigarette smoke 和其他氧化劑也會使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失活，因此 HOCl 是多種機制之一。同樣的氧化失活會導致 cigarette smokers 中的肺氣腫，其中中性粒細胞衍生的次氯酸與保護不良的肺間質相遇。

label: neutrophil azurophilic granules
description: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) is a heme-containing enzyme stored primarily in the azurophilic granules of neutrophils, and to a lesser extent in monocytes and macrophages. It plays a central role in the oxidative burst during innate immune responses, producing hypochlorous acid and other oxidants that kill pathogens in phagosomes. On release during inflammation, MPO can also oxidize host biomolecules and catecholamines such as epinephrine, and its products contribute to both antimicrobial defense and, in excess, to tissue damage and cardiovascular pathology.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）是一種主要儲存於neutrophils azurophilic granules中、較少量存在於monocytes與macrophages的heme-containing enzyme。它在innate immune responses的oxidative burst中扮演central role，產生hypochlorous acid及其他oxidants以kill pathogens in phagosomes。在inflammation期間released時，MPO亦能oxidize host biomolecules及如epinephrine等catecholamines，其products既contribute to antimicrobial defense，在excess時也會導致tissue damage與cardiovascular pathology。

label: Metalloproteinases
description: Cysteine-switch oxidation by HOCl activates matrix metalloproteinases. Activation links neutrophil oxidants to matrix remodeling.
description_zh_TW: HOCl 的半胱胺酸開關氧化活化基質金屬蛋白酶。活化將嗜中性球氧化劑連結到基質重塑。

label: Chloride
description: Myeloperoxidase converts hydrogen peroxide plus chloride to hypochlorous acid through Compound I enzymology. This core reaction feeds all downstream HOCl oxidation chemistry.
description_zh_TW: 髓過氧化物酶經 Compound I 酶學將過氧化氫加氯化物轉為次氯酸。此核心反應供養下游所有 HOCl 氧化化學。

label: 3-Chlorotyrosine
description: Tyrosine chlorination by HOCl yields 3-chlorotyrosine, the established HOCl-specific footprint marker. Production is the biomarker reaction.
description_zh_TW: HOCl 氯化酪胺酸產生 3-氯酪胺酸，即既定的 HOCl 特異足跡標記。產生是生物標記反應。

label: Adenosine Kinase
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Adenosine kinase (ADK) acts as an NRH kinase in a recently discovered novel biosynthetic route of NAD+ from NRH (the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside) through the NMNH intermediate, providing a NMRK-independent pathway for the NRH-induced NAD+ increase. NRH is more stable than nicotinamide riboside (NR), which degrades to nicotinamide in the blood, and NRH increases NAD+ in both cultured cells (5-10-fold above the baseline) and mice, in a more potent and faster manner than NR. Endogenous NRH was detected in the liver of mouse models, establishing NRH as a valid natural precursor of NAD+.
description_zh_TW: adenosine kinase（ADK，腺苷激酶）在近期發現的從 NRH（nicotinamide riboside 的還原型）經由 NMNH 中間產物生成 NAD+ 的新穎生物合成路徑中作為 NRH 激酶，提供了 NRH 誘發 NAD+ 增加的 NMRK 非依賴性路徑。NRH 比 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）更穩定，後者在血液中降解為 nicotinamide，且 NRH 以比 NR 更強效且更快速的方式提升培養細胞（高於基線 5-10 倍）與小鼠中的 NAD+。小鼠模型肝臟中偵測到內源性 NRH，確立了 NRH 作為 NAD+ 的有效天然前驅物。

label: NMNH
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: NMNH (dihydronicotinamide mononucleotide) is the reduced form of nicotinamide mononucleotide and has been shown to promote NAD+ synthesis. Together with NRH, the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside, NMNH adds to the set of NAD+ precursors available for cellular salvage and NAD+ replenishment. These reduced precursors demonstrate that the NAD+ metabolic cycle is more flexible than initially recognized, providing alternative routes to boost NAD+ levels beyond the classic precursors tryptophan, nicotinamide, nicotinic acid, NMN, and NR, and supporting efforts to develop effective strategies for preventing NAD+ decline in aging and disease.
description_zh_TW: NMNH（二氫菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸）是菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸的還原形式，已被證實能促進 NAD+ 生合成。與 NRH（菸鹼醯胺核糖的還原形式）一起，NMNH 加入了可供細胞回收與 NAD+ 補充的 NAD+ 前驅物組合。這些還原型前驅物顯示 NAD+ 代謝循環比最初所認知的更具彈性，提供了超越經典前驅物色胺酸、菸鹼醯胺、菸鹼酸、NMN 和 NR 之外提升 NAD+ 水平的替代途徑，並支持開發有效策略以預防老化與疾病中的 NAD+ 衰退。

label: Creatine Kinase (CK)
description: Creatine kinase (CK) is the enzyme at the core of the creatine/phosphocreatine energy system. It catalyzes the reversible transfer of a phosphate group between creatine and ADP, using the free energy released from phosphocreatine breakdown (approximately 10.3 kcal) to resynthesize ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. This provides a rapid means of replenishing depleted ATP during high-energy-demand states such as intense exercise or conditions where energy production is impaired (ischemia, hypoxia) or insufficient due to increased demand (mental fatigue, disease states). Cytosolic, glycolytic, and mitochondrial CK isoforms cooperate to buffer ATP/ADP ratios and shuttle high-energy phosphate from mitochondria to sites of ATP consumption.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸激酶（CK）是肌酸/磷酸肌酸能量系統核心的酶。它催化磷酸基團在肌酸與 ADP 之間的可逆轉移，利用磷酸肌酸分解所釋放的自由能（約 10.3 千卡），從 ADP 與無機磷酸再合成 ATP。這提供了在高能量需求狀態下快速補充耗竭 ATP 的手段，例如劇烈運動，或能量產生受損（缺血、缺氧）或因需求增加而不足（精神疲勞、疾病狀態）的情況。細胞質、糖解與粒線體 CK 異構型協同作用，以緩衝 ATP/ADP 比值，並將高能磷酸從粒線體穿梭至 ATP 消耗的位置。

label: AMPK (activated)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Activated AMPK increases expression of NAMPT, the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway that converts nicotinamide to NMN. Directionally, AMPK sits upstream of NAMPT induction. More NAMPT elevates intracellular NAD+, the obligate co-substrate for sirtuins, and the AMPK-to-NAMPT-to-NAD+ axis is a major indirect route by which resveratrol, exercise, and caloric restriction activate SIRT1. Because NAMPT is rate-limiting, its induction is a decisive step in raising NAD+ availability, and AMPK and SIRT1 also induce each other, creating a self-reinforcing metabolic circuit that sustains NAD+-dependent processes.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 AMPK 增加 NAMPT 的表達，NAMPT 是 NAD+ 回收代謝通路的限速酶，將菸鹼醯胺轉化為 NMN。在方向性上，AMPK 位於 NAMPT 誘導的上游。更多的 NAMPT 提高細胞內 NAD+——sirtuin 的必需共同受質，AMPK-NAMPT-NAD+ 軸是白藜蘆醇、運動和熱量限制活化 SIRT1 的主要間接途徑。由於 NAMPT 是限速酶，其誘導是提高 NAD+ 可用性的決定性步驟，且 AMPK 和 SIRT1 也相互誘導，形成一個自我強化的代謝電路，維持 NAD+ 依賴性過程。

label: ADMA
description: ADMA inhibits eNOS by competitively occupying the L-arginine binding site of all NOS isoforms, reducing NO production and promoting uncoupling. Elevated ADMA (from reduced catabolism by dimethylarginine dimethylaminohydrolase) is a marker of endothelial risk. The directionality is endogenous inhibitor to NO deficiency. A caveat is that ADMA also inhibits other NOS isoforms and its effects are modulated by L-arginine availability and methyltransferase activity. Because ADMA is primarily cleared by DDAH, oxidative inactivation of DDAH raises ADMA and further suppresses NO, a self-reinforcing cycle in endothelial disease.
description_zh_TW: ADMA 透過競爭性佔據所有 NOS 亞型的 L-arginine 結合位點、減少 NO 產生並促進解偶聯來抑制 eNOS。 ADMA 升高（由於二甲基精氨酸二甲氨基水解酶分解代謝減少）是內皮風險的標誌。方向性是NO缺乏的內源性抑制劑。需要注意的是，ADMA 也抑制其他 NOS 亞型，其作用受到 L-arginine 可用性和甲基轉移酶活性的調節。由於 ADMA 主要由 DDAH 清除，DDAH 的氧化失活會升高 ADMA 並進一步抑制 NO（內皮疾病的自我強化循環）。

label: serum AGE levels
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Food is an important source of exogenous advanced glycation end products, since significant AGE generation occurs when sugars are cooked with proteins via the Maillard reaction. In a mouse model, feeding an AGE-rich diet for 16 weeks promoted a 53% increase in serum AGE levels. In renal failure patients, an AGE-rich diet produced a 29% increase in blood CML, while a low-AGE diet produced a 34% reduction. These findings suggest that a diet restricting AGEs is an effective way to reduce the AGE burden in the human body.
description_zh_TW: Food 是 exogenous advanced glycation end products 的重要來源，因為當 sugars 與 proteins 經由 Maillard reaction 一起 cooked 時，會產生顯著的 AGE。在 mouse model 中，餵食 AGE-rich diet 16 週使血清 AGE levels 增加 53%。在 renal failure patients 中，AGE-rich diet 使血液 CML 增加 29%，而 low-AGE diet 則使其降低 34%。這些 findings 顯示，限制 AGEs 的 diet 是降低人體 AGE burden 的有效方法。

label: Soluble VCAM-1
description: Soluble VCAM-1 is a biomarker for endothelial dysfunction, being elevated in cardiovascular disease, diabetes, hypertension, and rheumatoid arthritis as a shed fragment of the adhesion molecule. Its level reflects chronic endothelial activation. The directionality is endothelial activation to soluble marker release. A caveat is that soluble VCAM-1 lacks the membrane anchor and its biological activity differs from full-length VCAM-1, so it is an index rather than a direct effector. Serum sVCAM-1 is now used in risk stratification and to monitor endothelial health in research cohorts.
description_zh_TW: Soluble VCAM-1 是 endothelial dysfunction 的生物標記物，在 cardiovascular disease、糖尿病、高血壓和類風濕性關節炎中作為黏附分子的脫落片段而升高。其水平反映了慢性內皮活化。方向性是內皮活化至可溶性標記物釋放。需要注意的是，soluble VCAM-1 缺乏膜錨，其生物活性與全長 VCAM-1 不同，因此它是一個指標而不是直接效應子。血清 sVCAM-1 現在用於風險分層和監測研究隊列中的內皮健康。

label: SIRT1 (resveratrol-activated)
description: Resveratrol-activated endothelial SIRT1 increases eNOS expression and deacetylates and activates it, enhancing nitric-oxide production and promoting vasodilation. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of eNOS activation in the endothelium. Improved NO bioavailability lowers vascular tone, protects against endothelial dysfunction, and reduces platelet aggregation and smooth-muscle proliferation. This underlies resveratrol's cardiovascular and French-paradox associations, and SIRT1's regulation of eNOS is one of its best-established vascular mechanisms, linking sirtuin activity directly to blood-vessel health and blood-pressure control.
description_zh_TW: 被白藜蘆醇活化的內皮 SIRT1 增加 eNOS 表達並去乙醯化和活化它，增強一氧化氮產生並促進血管舒張。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於內皮中 eNOS 活化的上游。改善的 NO 生物利用度降低血管張力、保護對抗內皮功能障礙，並減少血小板聚集和平滑肌增殖。這是白藜蘆醇心血管益處和法國悖論關聯的基礎，SIRT1 對 eNOS 的調節是其最佳確立的血管機制之一，將 sirtuin 活性直接與血管健康和血壓控制聯繫起來。

label: CTP Synthetase
description: Cyclopentenyl cytosine (CPEC) is a synthetic cyclopentenyl-derived cytidine analog whose active triphosphate metabolite (CPEC-TP) acts as a potent, mechanism-based inhibitor of CTP Synthetase. By blocking the ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP, it collapses intracellular pyrimidine pools, especially CTP and dCTP, in rapidly dividing cells and pyrimidine-dependent viruses.
description_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine（CPEC）是一種合成的環戊烯基胞苷類似物，其活性三磷酸代謝物（CPEC-TP）是 CTP Synthetase 的強效機制型抑制劑。透過阻斷 UTP 依賴 ATP 轉化為 CTP，它使快速分裂細胞和依賴嘧啶的病毒細胞內嘧啶池（尤其 CTP 和 dCTP）崩潰。

label: Deoxycytidine kinase
description: Gemcitabine requires intracellular phosphorylation by deoxycytidine kinase (dCK) to generate its active diphosphate and triphosphate metabolites. Reduced dCK activity is a documented mechanism of resistance to the drug.
description_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 需要由 deoxycytidine kinase（dCK）進行細胞內磷酸化，才能產生有活性的二磷酸和三磷酸代謝物。dCK 活性降低是已記錄的藥物抗藥性機制。

label: Antimetabolite
description: Cyclopentenyl cytosine is a type of Antimetabolite: this synthetic cytidine nucleoside analog acts as a metabolic antagonist that depletes pyrimidine nucleotides, chiefly by inhibiting CTP synthetase, which underlies its candidate use in cancer chemotherapy and antiviral research.
description_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine 屬於 Antimetabolite（抗代謝物）的一種：此合成胞苷核苷類似物扮演代謝拮抗劑，主要透過抑制 CTP synthetase 耗竭嘧啶核苷酸，這是其在癌症化療與抗病毒研究中作為候選藥物的基礎。

label: Parasiticidal effect
description: Activation of GluCls in nematodes and arthropods drives Cl- influx, membrane hyperpolarization, flaccid paralysis and death.
description_zh_TW: 線蟲和節肢動物中 GluCl 的活化會導致 Cl 流入、膜超極化、弛緩性麻痺和死亡。

label: GABA-gated chloride channels
description: Avermectins also potentiate invertebrate GABA-gated chloride channels; vertebrate GABA_A receptors require roughly 100-fold higher concentrations, underpinning selective safety.
description_zh_TW: Avermectins 也能增強無脊椎動物 GABA-gated chloride channels；脊椎動物 GABA_A 受體需要約高出 100 倍的濃度，以確保選擇性安全。

label: Merck & Co. Inc
description: Campbell's avermectin-to-ivermectin development was carried out at Merck & Co.
description_zh_TW: 坎貝爾的阿維菌素到伊維菌素的開發是在默克公司進行的。

label: Humans
description: Humans and other vertebrates lack glutamate-gated chloride channels, which underpins the selective safety of avermectin/ivermectin at therapeutic doses.
description_zh_TW: Humans和其他脊椎動物缺乏穀氨酸門控氯離子通道，這支撐了阿維菌素/伊維菌素在治療劑量下的選擇性安全性。

label: Epacadostat
description: Epacadostat is a small-molecule inhibitor of IDO1 tested in clinical trials as an immuno-oncology strategy, often in combination with checkpoint inhibitors targeting PD-1/PD-L1. These combinations aim to relieve IDO1-mediated immunosuppression in the tumor microenvironment by blocking tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production, thereby restoring effector T cell function. However, results from such trials have been mixed, and challenges including isoform selectivity, compensatory pathways (TDO, IDO2), and context-specific effects have limited clinical success.
description_zh_TW: Epacadostat是一種IDO1的小分子抑制劑，已在臨床試驗中作為免疫腫瘤學策略進行測試，常與標靶PD-1/PD-L1的檢查點抑制劑合併使用。這些合併療法旨在透過阻斷色胺酸耗竭與犬尿胺酸（kynurenine）生成，來解除腫瘤微環境中IDO1介導的免疫抑制，從而恢復效應T細胞功能。然而，此類試驗的結果好壞參半，包括異構體選擇性、代償途徑（TDO、IDO2）與情境依賴性效應等挑戰，限制了臨床上的成功。

label: Branched-Chain Amino Acids
description: High circulating branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) levels - leucine, isoleucine, and valine - are associated with obesity, insulin resistance, and mortality in humans. High-BCAA diets promote obesity, insulin resistance, inflammation, and decreased lifespan in rodents, whereas dietary restriction of BCAAs promotes metabolic health, reduces frailty, and extends lifespan, recapitulating many benefits of protein restriction. BCAA restriction reduces mTORC1 signaling, induces Fgf21, reduces hepatic cellular senescence, and in human studies improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis while increasing circulating FGF21. Although BCAAs are often considered as a group, each individual BCAA plays distinct roles in aging.
description_zh_TW: 循環中高濃度的支鏈胺基酸（BCAA）——白胺酸（leucine）、異白胺酸（isoleucine）與纈胺酸（valine）——與人類的肥胖、胰島素阻抗及死亡率相關。高BCAA飲食會在囓齒類中促進肥胖、胰島素阻抗、發炎並縮短壽命；而膳食限制BCAA則可促進代謝健康、減少衰弱並延長壽命，重現蛋白質限制的許多益處。限制BCAA可降低mTORC1訊息傳導、誘導Fgf21、減少肝臟細胞衰老；在人體研究中則可改善胰島素敏感性與葡萄糖/胰島素恆定，同時提高循環中的FGF21。儘管BCAA常被視為一個群體，但每一種BCAA在衰老中都扮演著不同的角色。

label: Dioxygenase
description: IDO1 belongs to the family of heme-dependent dioxygenases (EC 1.13.11.52), distinct from but functionally related to tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase (TDO, mainly hepatic) and IDO2 (a less active paralog). It is a monomeric cytosolic protein of about 45 kDa encoded by the IDO1 gene on human chromosome 8p11.21. Crystal structures (e.g., PDB 2D0T, 5EK2) reveal a large domain with a deep heme-binding pocket and a smaller domain, and the active site shows plasticity that allows inhibitor and substrate binding. This structural information underpins the design of IDO1 inhibitors for immuno-oncology.
description_zh_TW: IDO1 屬於依賴血基質的雙加氧酶家族（EC 1.13.11.52），與色胺酸 2,3-雙加氧酶（TDO，主要位於肝臟）及 IDO2（活性較低的旁系同源物）有別但功能相關。它是由人類第 8 號染色體 8p11.21 上的 IDO1 基因編碼、約 45 kDa 的單體胞質蛋白。晶體結構（例如 PDB 2D0T、5EK2）顯示一個帶有深血基質結合口袋的大結構域與一個較小結構域，且活性位點展現容許抑制劑與受質結合的可塑性。此結構資訊支撐了用於免疫腫瘤學的 IDO1 抑制劑設計。

label: SOCS3
description: IDO1 is controlled post-translationally: phosphorylation of its ITIM motifs recruits SOCS3, leading to ubiquitination and degradation of IDO1 as a negative feedback mechanism. This degradation pathway limits IDO1 activity and terminates its immunosuppressive effects, representing a key regulatory checkpoint. IDO1 can also mediate non-enzymatic signaling such as PI3K activation. IDO2 may compete for heme and act as a negative regulator in some settings. These regulatory layers are important for therapeutic targeting of IDO1, as they influence the durability and magnitude of tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production in the tumor microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: IDO1在翻譯後被控制：其ITIM基序的磷酸化招募SOCS3，導致IDO1的泛素化和降解，作為負反饋機制。這種降解途徑限制IDO1活性並終止其免疫抑製作用，代表一個關鍵的調節檢查點。IDO1還可以介導非酶信號，如PI3K激活。IDO2可能在某些情況下競爭血紅素並作為負調節因子。這些調節層對於IDO1的治療靶向很重要，因為它們影響腫瘤微環境中色氨酸耗竭和犬尿氨酸產生的持久性和幅度。

label: Interferon-gamma
description: IDO1 is strongly induced by inflammatory cytokines, especially interferon-gamma (IFNγ) via JAK/STAT signaling, but also by IFNα/β, TNF-α, IL-1, LPS, and other signals in immune and other cells; glucocorticoids can synergize in some contexts. Expression is high in placenta, lymph nodes, lungs, small intestine, and certain immune cells including dendritic cells, macrophages and monocytes, and is inducible in many tissues during inflammation. Post-translational control involves phosphorylation of ITIM motifs that recruit SOCS3, leading to ubiquitination and degradation as a negative feedback mechanism, and IDO1 can also mediate non-enzymatic signaling such as PI3K activation.
description_zh_TW: IDO1 由發炎性細胞激素強烈誘導，尤其是透過 JAK/STAT 訊息傳導的干擾素-γ（IFNγ），但也可由 IFNα/β、TNF-α、IL-1、LPS 及其他訊號在免疫細胞與其他細胞中誘導；糖皮質激素在某些情境下可產生協同作用。其表現於胎盤、淋巴結、肺、小腸及樹突細胞、巨噬細胞與單核球等特定免疫細胞中很高，並可在發炎期間於許多組織中被誘導。轉譯後調控涉及 ITIM 基序的磷酸化，招募 SOCS3 導致泛素化與降解，作為負回饋機制，且 IDO1 也可媒介如 PI3K 活化等非酶促訊號。

label: IDO2
description: IDO2, a less active paralog of IDO1, may compete for heme and act as a negative regulator in some settings. Both are heme-dependent dioxygenases functionally related to TDO (tryptophan 2,3-dioxygenase, mainly hepatic). The existence of these compensatory pathways is a major challenge for IDO1-targeted therapy, as IDO2 and TDO can partially substitute for IDO1 in maintaining tryptophan catabolism and immunosuppression. This isospecificity issue, along with context-specific effects, has contributed to the mixed results of IDO1 inhibitor trials in immuno-oncology, where single-target blockade may be insufficient to relieve metabolic immunosuppression.
description_zh_TW: IDO2 是 IDO1 活性較低的旁系同源物，可能競爭血基質並在某些情境下作為負調節因子。兩者皆為與 TDO（色胺酸 2,3-雙加氧酶，主要位於肝臟）功能相關的依賴血基質雙加氧酶。這些代償途徑的存在是 IDO1 標靶治療的重大挑戰，因為 IDO2 與 TDO 可在維持色胺酸分解代謝與免疫抑制方面部分取代 IDO1。此同功酶特異性問題，加上情境特異性效應，導致免疫腫瘤學中 IDO1 抑制劑試驗結果好壞參半，因為單一標靶阻斷可能不足以解除代謝性免疫抑制。

label: Polycythemia Vera
description: Hydroxyurea is a first-line therapy for managing erythrocytosis in polycythemia vera. By inhibiting ribonucleotide reductase in erythroid progenitors it reduces total red blood cell mass and prevents thrombotic complications.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 是控制真性紅血球增多症紅血球增多症的一線治療。透過抑制紅血球前驅細胞中的 ribonucleotide reductase，它減少總紅血球質量並預防血栓併發症。

label: Sickle Cell Disease
description: Hydroxyurea is used to improve the clinical course of sickle cell disease by raising HbF levels. It reduces the frequency of vaso-occlusive crises and is a standard disease-modifying therapy.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 藉由提高 HbF 水平改善鐮刀型細胞疾病的臨床病程。它可減少血管阻塞性危象的發生頻率，是標準的疾病調整治療。

label: Fetal Hemoglobin
description: Hydroxyurea stimulates production of fetal hemoglobin (HbF) in red blood cells of sickle cell disease patients. Increased HbF interferes with polymerization of hemoglobin S, reducing vaso-occlusive crises.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 刺激鐮刀型細胞疾病患者的紅血球產生胎兒血紅蛋白（HbF）。HbF 增加會干擾血紅蛋白 S 的聚合，減少血管阻塞性危象。

label: Neurotoxin
description: Neurotoxin and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neurotoxin and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Neurotoxin 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neurotoxin 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Stem Cell Exhaustion
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Mitochondrial dysfunction is an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion across aging tissues. mtDNA mutations impair respiration and reshape metabolite availability, reprogramming epigenetic states that govern quiescence, lineage commitment, and regenerative output. Erosion of mitochondrial quality control (fission-fusion balance, mitophagy, UPRmt) permits persistence of ROS-producing organelles and lowers containment of mitochondrial danger signals. In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells, and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence, and diminished regenerative capacity.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dysfunction is an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion across aging tissues。mtDNA mutations impair respiration and reshape metabolite availability，reprogramming epigenetic states that govern quiescence, lineage commitment, and regenerative output。Erosion of mitochondrial quality control (fission-fusion balance, mitophagy, UPRmt) permits persistence of ROS-producing organelles and lowers containment of mitochondrial danger signals。In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells, and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence, and diminished regenerative capacity。

label: Mubritinib
source_file: _document_ - Complex I drives glutamine-dependent TCA cycle to support viability of MYChigh breast cancer cells (NAD+).md
description: Mubritinib inhibits the Complex I Q-site with high MYC selectivity.
description_zh_TW: Mubritinib 抑制 Complex I Q 位點，具高度 MYC 選擇性。

label: Haloperidol
description: Haloperidol is metabolically converted into the pyridinium neurotoxin HPP+, a charged MPP+ analog taken up by dopaminergic neurons where it inhibits mitochondrial complex I. This conversion underlies haloperidol-associated parkinsonism, which mimics but is distinct from Parkinson's Disease.
description_zh_TW: Haloperidol 在代謝上轉化為吡啶鎓神經毒素 HPP+，一種帶電荷的 MPP+ 類似物，被多巴胺神經元攝取並抑制粒線體複合體 I。此轉化是 haloperidol 相關帕金森症的基礎，其模仿但不同於 Parkinson's Disease。

label: CSNK1G2
description: Casein kinase 1G2 binds RIPK3 to inhibit its kinase activity and necroptosis signaling in male reproductive aging.
description_zh_TW: 酪蛋白激酶1G2結合RIPK3以抑制其激酶活性與下游necroptosis訊號，見於雄性生殖老化。

label: RSK3
description: RSK3 acts upstream of RIPK3 phosphorylation, promoting necroptosis in ischemic retinal injury.
description_zh_TW: RSK3作為RIPK3磷酸化的上游調控因子，促進necroptosis活化，見於缺血性視網膜損傷。

label: GSK872
description: GSK872 (GSK'872) is a selective RIPK3 kinase inhibitor used alongside RIPK1 (Necrostatin-1) and MLKL (necrosulfonamide) inhibitors to dissect and block necroptosis in preclinical models (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: GSK872（GSK'872）是選擇性 RIPK3 激酶抑制劑，常與 RIPK1（Necrostatin-1）及 MLKL（necrosulfonamide）抑制劑併用，以剖析並阻斷臨床前模型中的 necroptosis（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: GSK840
description: GSK840 (GSK'840) is an ATP-competitive RIPK3 kinase inhibitor used alongside GSK872 as a necroptosis-blocking tool; like other RIPK3 inhibitors, its rescue must be interpreted with kinase-dead-rerouting-to-apoptosis controls (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: GSK840（GSK'840）是 ATP 競爭性 RIPK3 激酶抑制劑，與 GSK872 併用作為阻斷 necroptosis 的工具；如同其他 RIPK3 抑制劑，其救援效果須以「激酶死亡型重導向凋亡」對照來解讀（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Zharp-99
description: Zharp-99 is a small-molecule RIPK3 kinase inhibitor in the same direct-inhibitor class as GSK872 and GSK840, blocking necrosome output by preventing MLKL phosphorylation (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: Zharp-99 是與 GSK872、GSK840 同屬直接抑制劑類別的小分子 RIPK3 激酶抑制劑，透過阻止 MLKL 磷酸化而阻斷 necrosome 輸出（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Hematopoietic stem cells
description: Leukemic clones derive from transformed hematopoietic stem or progenitor cells.
description_zh_TW: 白血病克隆源自於轉化的造血幹細胞或祖細胞。

label: MPC
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: The mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) links glycolysis-derived pyruvate to the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and its expression increases across multiple senescence models including irradiation-induced, doxorubicin-induced and replicative senescence. Pharmacological inhibition of MPC with UK5099 reduces TCA cycle intermediates and increases lactate levels, consistent with impaired mitochondrial pyruvate import, and suppresses SASP gene expression and secretion without affecting cell cycle arrest. CRISPR-Cas9-mediated deletion of MPC1 similarly reduces SASP factors such as IL6 and IL8, identifying pyruvate import as the entry node of the mitochondrial metabolic axis controlling the SASP.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體丙酮酸載體（MPC）將糖酵解產生的丙酮酸連結至三羧酸循環，其表達在多種衰老模型中增加，包括輻射誘導、doxorubicin誘導和複製性衰老。用UK5099對MPC進行藥理學抑制可降低三羧酸循環中間體並增加乳酸水平，符合粒線體丙酮酸輸入受損的特徵，並抑制SASP基因表達和分泌，而不影響細胞週期停滯。CRISPR-Cas9介導的MPC1缺失同樣減少SASP因子如IL6和IL8，確認丙酮酸輸入是控制SASP的粒線體代謝軸的進入節點。

label: Microtubule inhibitors
description: Tubulin is the target of microtubule-interfering agents including benzimidazoles, taxanes and vinca alkaloids.
description_zh_TW: 微管蛋白是微管干擾藥物的靶標，包括苯並咪唑、紫杉烷和長春花生物鹼。

label: Colchicine
description: Colchicine is a plant alkaloid that binds tubulin and inhibits microtubule polymerization. It is used for gout and familial Mediterranean fever and serves as a comparator microtubule-disrupting agent in fenbendazole-related anticancer research.
description_zh_TW: Colchicine 是結合 tubulin 並抑制微管聚合的植物生物鹼。它用於痛風與家族性地中海熱，並作為 fenbendazole 相關抗癌研究中的比較性微管破壞藥物。

label: Dimethyl Sulfoxide
description: Dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) is a pharmaceutical vehicle that enhances fenbendazole delivery by improving solubility and inhibiting CYP2C19/CYP3A4 metabolism. DMSO-mediated inhibition prolongs fenbendazole systemic exposure, enhancing its cytotoxicity even in paclitaxel-resistant cells.
description_zh_TW: 二甲基亞碸（DMSO）是藥品載體，透過改善溶解度並抑制 CYP2C19/CYP3A4 代謝來增進 fenbendazole 遞送。DMSO 介導的抑制延長 fenbendazole 的全身暴露，即使在 paclitaxel 抗藥細胞中也能增強其細胞毒性。

label: 5-Fluorouracil
description: Fenbendazole is evaluated alongside conventional chemotherapeutics such as 5-Fluorouracil as a candidate repurposed anticancer agent. Its proposed complementary mechanisms raise the question of additive or synergistic benefit when combined with 5-FU-based regimens. Direct interaction data are limited, so the relationship reflects shared anticancer-interest context rather than a proven biochemical synergy.
description_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 被視為候選的藥物再利用抗癌藥，與 5-Fluorouracil 等傳統化療藥物並列評估。其提出的互補機制引發與 5-FU 療法合併時是否具有加成或協同效益的問題。直接交互作用數據有限，故此關係反映的是共同的抗癌關注脈絡，而非經證實的生化協同。

label: Flubendazole
description: Flubendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic structurally related to fenbendazole. It inhibits microtubule function through a mechanism distinct from vinca alkaloids and displays preclinical activity in leukemia and myeloma models, with reported synergism with microtubule-targeting agents.
description_zh_TW: Flubendazole 是與 fenbendazole 結構相關的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥。它透過不同於長春花生物鹼的機制抑制微管功能，在白血病與骨髓瘤模型中表現臨床前活性，並有與微管靶向藥物協同的報導。

label: Methyl-beta-cyclodextrin
description: Methyl-beta-cyclodextrin (MbetaCD) forms inclusion complexes with hydrophobic drugs, dramatically increasing their aqueous solubility. Complexing fenbendazole with MbetaCD raises water solubility about 60,000-fold and boosts drug release, overcoming its poor bioavailability.
description_zh_TW: 甲基-β-環糊精（MβCD）與疏水性藥物形成包合物，大幅提高其水溶性。將 fenbendazole 與 MβCD 複合可將水溶性提高約 60,000 倍並增進藥物釋放，克服其不良生物可用性。

label: Nitroimidazole
description: Nitroimidazoles are investigated as hypoxic cell radiosensitizers that replace oxygen in the chemical reactions producing radiation-induced DNA damage. They increase cytotoxicity in hypoxic cells while having no effect on already-aerobic (maximally radiosensitive) cells.
description_zh_TW: 硝基咪唑被研究作為低氧細胞放射增敏劑，在產生輻射誘導 DNA 損傷的化學反應中取代氧氣。它們增加低氧細胞的細胞毒性，同時對已充氧（最大放射敏感）細胞無影響。

label: Pazopanib
description: Pazopanib is a multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibitor approved for renal cell carcinoma and soft-tissue sarcoma. It appears in fenbendazole literature within patient case reports where fenbendazole self-administration was reported alongside standard therapy.
description_zh_TW: Pazopanib 是用於腎細胞癌與軟組織肉瘤的多靶點酪氨酸激酶抑制劑。它出現在 fenbendazole 文獻中患者案例報告內，其中 fenbendazole 自服與標準療法並用。

label: Podophyllotoxin
description: Podophyllotoxin is a lignan that binds tubulin at the colchicine site and inhibits microtubule polymerization. It is listed among agents whose tubulin-microtubule effects could theoretically synergize with or be antagonized by fenbendazole.
description_zh_TW: 鬼臼毒素（podophyllotoxin）是結合 tubulin 秋水仙素位點並抑制微管聚合的木脂素。它被列為其微管效應理論上可能與 fenbendazole 協同或拮抗的藥物之一。

label: Radiation Therapy
description: Radiation therapy uses ionizing radiation to damage DNA, with molecular oxygen acting as a chemical radiosensitizer. Fenbendazole was tested for potential radiosensitizing properties given its structural resemblance to hypoxic-cell radiosensitizers, though results were negative.
description_zh_TW: 放射治療利用游離輻射損傷 DNA，分子氧作為化學放射增敏劑。由於 fenbendazole 結構與低氧細胞放射增敏劑相似，其潛在放射增敏特性被測試，但結果為陰性。

label: Salicylic acid
description: Salicylic acid is explored as a crystal-engineering vehicle in the fenbendazole literature. Fenbendazole-salicylic acid cocrystals achieved 100% drug release within one hour and improved solubility, serving as a leading strategy to overcome fenbendazole's poor release rate.
description_zh_TW: 水楊酸在 fenbendazole 文獻中被探索作為晶體工程載體。Fenbendazole-水楊酸共晶在一小時內達到 100% 藥物釋放並改善溶解度，是克服 fenbendazole 不良釋放速率的領先策略。

label: Soluplus
description: Soluplus is an amphiphilic graft copolymer used to formulate polymeric micelles that encapsulate poorly soluble drugs. Fenbendazole-loaded Soluplus micelles showed lower total clearance and volume of distribution, supporting improved delivery.
description_zh_TW: Soluplus 是兩親性接枝共聚物，用於配製包封難溶性藥物的聚合物微胞。裝載 fenbendazole 的 Soluplus 微胞表現較低的總清除率與分布體積，支持改善的遞送。

label: DNA Helicase
description: Some bis-benzimidazole compounds bind the minor groove of DNA at specific sequences and inhibit DNA helicase activity, thereby blocking cell proliferation. This mechanism is relevant to fenbendazole-family benzimidazoles as potential anticancer agents.
description_zh_TW: 某些雙苯並咪唑化合物結合 DNA 小溝的特定序列並抑制 DNA 解旋酶活性，從而阻斷細胞增殖。此機制與 fenbendazole 家族苯並咪唑作為潛在抗癌藥有關。

label: Vinblastine
description: Vinblastine is a vinca-alkaloid microtubule-targeting agent that binds tubulin and inhibits microtubule polymerization. Both vinblastine and fenbendazole are microtubule-depolymerizing agents that arrest cells in metaphase and induce apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Vinblastine 是結合 tubulin 並抑制微管聚合的長春花生物鹼微管靶向藥物。Vinblastine 與 fenbendazole 皆是使細胞停滯在中期並誘導凋亡的微管去聚合藥物。

label: Albendazole
description: Like other benzimidazoles, albendazole binds the colchicine site of beta-tubulin, blocking polymerization into microtubules.
description_zh_TW: 與其他苯並咪唑一樣，Albendazole 結合 β-tubulin 的秋水仙鹼位點，阻斷其聚合成 Microtubule。

label: cytarabine
description: Cytarabine is the nucleoside-analog backbone of leukemia therapy, synergizing with ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: cytarabine 是白血病治療的核苷類似物主幹，與 ivermectin 協同。

label: Daunorubicin
description: Daunorubicin is the anthracycline of the 7+3 leukemia backbone.
description_zh_TW: Daunorubicin 是白血病 7+3 主幹的蒽環類藥。

label: Vincristine
description: The vinca alkaloid vincristine destabilizes microtubules, mirroring the mebendazole edge.
description_zh_TW: 長春花生物鹼 Vincristine 去穩定微管，呼應 mebendazole 邊。

label: Damage-associated molecular pattern
description: HMGB1 is a chromatin protein released as a damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) from dying or stressed cells.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 是一種染色質蛋白，從死亡或受壓細胞中以損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）的形式釋放。

label: Immunogenic cell death
description: HMGB1 release is a hallmark DAMP of immunogenic cell death, necessary for anticancer immune priming.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 釋放是免疫原性細胞死亡的標誌性 DAMP，對抗癌免疫 priming 必不可少。

label: Training Versus Tolerance
description: Acute low-dose HMGB1 via RAGE/TLR2/TLR4 favors mTOR-driven glycolysis and weak TRIM, with splenocyte priming for enhanced LPS responses. Chronic or high-dose HMGB1-RAGE signaling instead raises SIRT1/AMPK activity, suppresses mTOR and FAO programs, and enforces tolerance. HMGB1 also represses CPT1a to tune the FAO/glycolysis balance in macrophages.
description_zh_TW: 急性低劑量 HMGB1 經由 RAGE/TLR2/TLR4 偏向 mTOR-driven glycolysis 與微弱 TRIM，並使 splenocyte priming 以增強 LPS 反應。慢性或高劑量 HMGB1-RAGE signaling 反而升高 SIRT1/AMPK activity，抑制 mTOR 與 FAO 程式，並強制進入 tolerance。HMGB1 還可抑制 CPT1a，以調節巨噬細胞中的 FAO/glycolysis 平衡。

label: Necroptosis-associated inflammation
description: MLKL-driven DAMP release and TRIF-RIPK3 co-activation couple the IFN arm to IL-6/TNF programs and necroptotic inflammation.
description_zh_TW: MLKL-driven DAMP release and TRIF-RIPK3 co-activation couple the IFN arm to IL-6/TNF programs and necroptotic inflammation.

label: Trichostatin A
description: Trichostatin A is a potent, broadly acting histone deacetylase inhibitor used extensively in epigenetics and senescence research. By blocking HDAC enzymes, trichostatin A increases histone acetylation, opening chromatin and reactivating genes silenced by deacetylation across the genome. In senescence studies it serves as a tool compound to probe how the balance between histone acetyltransferase and deacetylase activities influences the senescence phenotype, SASP regulation, and chromatin state. It is one of the most widely used tool compounds for manipulating the acetylome experimentally.
description_zh_TW: Trichostatin A 是一種有效、廣泛作用的組蛋白去乙醯化酶抑制劑，廣泛用於表觀遺傳學和老化研究。透過阻斷 HDAC 酶，曲古抑菌素 A 增加組蛋白乙醯化，打開染色質並重新活化整個基因組中因去乙醯化而沉默的基因。在老化研究中，它作為工具化合物來探討組蛋白乙醯轉移酶和去乙醯化酶活性之間的平衡如何影響老化表型、SASP 調節和染色質狀態。它是用於實驗操縱乙醯基組的最廣泛使用的工具化合物之一。

label: Histone Deacetylases
description: Sulforaphane from broccoli acts as a well-characterized inhibitor of histone deacetylase enzymes. By altering histone acetylation and chromatin structure, it durably reprograms expression of genes involved in stress resistance, inflammation, and longevity.
description_zh_TW: 來自青花菜的 Sulforaphane 是明確的 Histone Deacetylases 抑制劑。透過改變組蛋白乙醯化與染色質結構，它能持久重編與壓力抗性、發炎及長壽相關基因的表現。

label: MHC class I
description: Epidrugs synergize with immunotherapy via MHC-I/PD-L1 upregulation. Upregulation is the immune-visibility mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 表觀藥物經由 MHC-I/PD-L1 上調與免疫治療協同。上調是免疫可見性機制。

label: Hsp70
description: Hsp70 is the major transcriptional target of phenylbutyrate mediating cytoprotection and refolding. Upregulation is the chaperone output.
description_zh_TW: Hsp70 是 phenylbutyrate 介導細胞保護與重折疊的主要轉錄標的。上調是伴侶輸出。

label: Catalase deficiency
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: Catalase deficiency causes acatalasemia (Takahara's disease), a rare autosomal recessive disorder in which near-absent catalase activity leads to oral mucosal ulcers and periodontal destruction from accumulated H2O2. The pathology arises because bacterial metabolism in the mouth produces H2O2 that cannot be degraded, fostering gangrene-prone infections. The directionality is enzyme loss to local oxidative injury. A caveat is that many acatalasemic individuals are surprisingly asymptomatic, indicating redundancy from other peroxide-removing systems.
description_zh_TW: Catalase deficiency 會導致 acatalasemia（高原氏症），這是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，幾乎不存在 catalase 活性，導致口腔黏膜潰瘍和累積的 H2O2 造成牙周破壞。這種病理現象的產生是因為口腔中的細菌代謝產生無法降解的 H2O2，促進壞疽感染。方向性是酵素損失導致局部氧化損傷。需要注意的是，許多 acatalasemic 個體出乎意料地沒有症狀，這表明其他過氧化物去除系統存在冗餘。

label: Selenium deficiency
description: Selenium deficiency causes Keshan disease, an endemic cardiomyopathy found in selenium-poor regions, driven by insufficient cardiac glutathione peroxidase activity and consequent oxidant damage to myocardium. Affected hearts show necrosis and fibrosis with reduced antiviral and antioxidant defenses. The directionality is nutrient lack to enzyme failure to tissue injury. A caveat is that coxsackievirus infection interacts with the deficiency, so Keshan disease is not purely a selenium-deficiency disorder.
description_zh_TW: Selenium deficiency 會導致 Keshan disease，這是一種在 selenium 貧乏地區發現的地方性心肌病變，其原因是心臟 glutathione peroxidase 活性不足以及隨之而來的心肌氧化損傷。受影響的心臟顯示 necrosis 和 fibrosis 的抗病毒和抗氧化防禦能力降低。方向性是營養缺乏、酵素衰竭、組織損傷。需要注意的是，柯薩奇病毒感染與缺乏症相互作用，因此 Keshan disease 並不純粹是 selenium 缺乏症。

label: High-dose SIRT1
source_file: _document_ - Sirt1 Regulates Aging and Resistance to Oxidative Stress in the Heart.md
description: High (12.5-fold) cardiac SIRT1 overexpression induced cardiomyopathy with increased apoptosis, hypertrophy, and oxidative stress, reduced ATP, citrate synthase, and mitochondrial biogenesis (about 50% PGC-1alpha loss), and possible NAD+ depletion. This is the canonical example of a hormetic dose window for cardiac SIRT1.
description_zh_TW: 高（12.5 倍）心臟 SIRT1 過表達誘導心肌病，伴隨凋亡、肥大和氧化壓力增加，ATP、檸檬酸合成酶和粒線體生物合成減少（PGC-1α 損失約 50%），並可能消耗 NAD+。這是心臟 SIRT1 毒物興奮效應劑量窗口的典型例子。

label: Gingivitis
description: Necrotizing gingivitis and periodontal destruction are the classic presentation of acatalasemia from undegraded oral peroxide. Association records the mucosal hallmark.
description_zh_TW: 壞死性齦炎與牙周破壞是未降解口腔過氧化物導致 acatalasemia 的典型表現。關聯記錄黏膜標誌。

label: Allopurinol
description: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase, as allopurinol and its active metabolite oxypurinol competitively bind the molybdenum center and block purine oxidation. Clinically this lowers uric acid and also curbs XO-derived superoxide. The directionality is competitive inhibition to reduced urate and ROS. A caveat is that allopurinol inhibits the dehydrogenase and oxidase forms differently and can cause hypersensitivity in some patients, notably those with HLA-B*58:01. Beyond gout, allopurinol has been studied for cardiovascular protection, chronic kidney disease progression, and prevention of tumor lysis syndrome.
description_zh_TW: Allopurinol 抑制 xanthine oxidase，因为 allopurinol 及其活性代谢物奥昔嘌呤醇竞争性结合钼中心并阻止嘌呤氧化。临床上，这会降低 uric acid 并抑制 XO 衍生的超氧化物。方向性是对还原尿酸盐和ROS的竞争性抑制。需要注意的是，allopurinol 以不同的方式抑制脫氫酶和氧化酶的形成，並可能在某些患者中引起過敏，尤其是 HLA-B*58:01 患者。除了痛风之外，allopurinol 还被研究用于心血管保护、慢性肾病进展和预防肿瘤溶解综合征。

label: Iron accumulation in Substantia Nigra
description: Iron accumulation in the substantia nigra promotes the Fenton reaction because elevated redox-active iron there catalyzes conversion of H2O2 to hydroxyl radicals near dopaminergic neurons. The iron burden correlates with oxidative damage markers in Parkinson's disease. The directionality is iron accumulation to radical generation. A caveat is that iron accumulation may also be a downstream consequence of oxidative damage and impaired iron export, so the relationship is partly bidirectional. Iron chelation and restoration of ferritin expression are therefore investigated as strategies to protect dopaminergic neurons.
description_zh_TW: Iron 在黑質中的累積促進了 Fenton reaction，因為那裡的氧化還原活性 iron 升高會催化 dopaminergic 神經元附近的 H2O2 轉化為 hydroxyl radicals。 iron 負擔與 Parkinson's disease 中的氧化損傷標記有關。方向性是iron累積到激進生成。需要注意的是，iron 累積也可能是氧化損傷和 iron 輸出受損的下游結果，因此這種關係部分是雙向的。因此，研究了 Iron 螯合和 ferritin 表達的恢復，作為保護 dopaminergic 神經元的策略。

label: Uncoupled eNOS
description: Uncoupled eNOS produces superoxide radicals when BH4 or L-arginine becomes limiting, causing the enzyme to redirect electron flow from NO synthesis to oxygen reduction. This converts the principal vascular protective enzyme into a ROS source. The directionality is cofactor deficiency to superoxide generation. A caveat is that partial uncoupling may still yield some NO, and the transition is graded rather than binary. This uncoupling is a central mechanism of endothelial dysfunction in hypertension, diabetes, and atherosclerosis, and therapies that restore BH4 or arginine aim to re-couple the enzyme.
description_zh_TW: 當 BH4 或 L-arginine 受到限制時，Uncoupled eNOS 會產生 superoxide radicals，導致酵素將電子流從 NO 合成重新導向到氧還原。這將主要的血管保護酶轉化為 ROS 源。方向性是超氧化物生成的輔因子缺乏。需要注意的是，部分解耦仍可能產生一些 NO，而且轉變是分級的而不是二元的。這種解偶聯是 endothelial dysfunction 在高血壓、糖尿病和 atherosclerosis 中的核心機制，恢復 BH4 或精氨酸的療法旨在重新偶聯該酶。

label: Gout
description: Gout is the primary clinical indication of febuxostat urate-lowering therapy. Association records indication rather than mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 痛風是 febuxostat 降尿酸治療的主要臨床適應症。關聯記錄適應症而非機制。

label: Reference standard
description: Leuco-adrenochrome is synthesized in high-purity laboratory settings to serve as a reference standard in pharmaceutical quality control. Analysts use HPLC or LC-MS to compare the peaks in a commercial epinephrine sample against this standard to ensure the medication is pure and safe for clinical use. Because epinephrine is chemically unstable and prone to oxidation when exposed to light, heat, or air, manufacturers must carefully monitor degradation products, and reference standards are essential for verifying that batches meet purity specifications and for quantifying impurities in forced-degradation studies.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome is synthesized in high-purity laboratory settings to serve as a reference standard in pharmaceutical quality control。Analysts use HPLC or LC-MS to compare the peaks in a commercial epinephrine sample against this standard to ensure the medication is pure and safe for clinical use。Because epinephrine is chemically unstable and prone to oxidation when exposed to light, heat, or air，manufacturers must carefully monitor degradation products，and reference standards are essential for verifying that batches meet purity specifications and for quantifying impurities in forced-degradation studies。

label: Impurity marker
description: Leuco-adrenochrome serves as a key impurity marker in epinephrine quality control and forced degradation studies. HPLC methods monitor it alongside adrenochrome to ensure formulation stability, since leuco-adrenochrome is an intermediate in the oxidative degradation of epinephrine to adrenochrome and ultimately to melanin-like brown pigments. Tracking these oxidation products allows manufacturers to detect degradation before the drug becomes unsafe, and discolored epinephrine solutions (colorless to pink to brown) are a visible sign of impurity accumulation that signals the solution should not be used clinically.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome serves as a key impurity marker in epinephrine quality control and forced degradation studies。HPLC methods monitor it alongside adrenochrome to ensure formulation stability，since leuco-adrenochrome is an intermediate in the oxidative degradation of epinephrine to adrenochrome and ultimately to melanin-like brown pigments。Tracking these oxidation products allows manufacturers to detect degradation before the drug becomes unsafe，and discolored epinephrine solutions (colorless to pink to brown) are a visible sign of impurity accumulation that signals the solution should not be used clinically。

label: anti-inflammatory effects
description: Berberine exerts potent anti-inflammatory effects through multiple molecular pathways, including inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling, downregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha and IL-6, and activation of AMPK that improves metabolic and inflammatory status. These actions contribute to its benefits in metabolic syndrome, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, and gastrointestinal inflammation, and extend to modulation of the gut microbiota. Because its anti-inflammatory activity is independent of the methylation cycle, it does not add methyl burden or inhibit COMT. This makes it a versatile and relatively safe adjunct in inflammation management.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 透過多種分子途徑發揮有效的 anti-inflammatory effects 作用，包括抑制 NF-kappaB 訊號傳導、下調促發炎細胞因子（如 TNF-α 和 IL-6）以及活化 AMPK，進而改善代謝和發炎狀態。這些作用有助於其治療代謝症候群、胰島素抗性、2 型糖尿病和胃腸道炎症，並延伸至腸道微生物群的調節。由於其抗發炎活性獨立於 methylation cycle，因此不會增加甲基負荷或抑制 COMT。這使其成為發炎管理中多功能且相對安全的輔助手段。

label: colon cancer cell proliferation, invasion, and migration
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In colon cancer, SIRT3 deficiency reduces cell proliferation, invasion, and migration while increasing apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT3 loss sits upstream of restrained colon cancer aggressiveness and enhanced cell death. SIRT3 could also be used as a marker for colon cancer. These findings indicate that SIRT3 supports the aggressive behaviour of colon cancer cells, and its inhibition may represent an anti-tumour strategy.
description_zh_TW: 在結腸癌中，SIRT3 缺乏可減少細胞增殖、侵襲和遷移，同時增加細胞凋亡。從作用方向而言，SIRT3 的缺失位於抑制結腸癌侵襲性和增強細胞死亡的上游。SIRT3 也可作為結腸癌的標記物。這些發現表明 SIRT3 支持結腸癌細胞的侵襲性行為，其抑制可能代表一種抗腫瘤策略。

label: Cell transformation
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: In mice and cultured cells, SIRT3 deficiency favors cell transformation in response to oncogenic Ras or Myc, and the same loss stabilizes HIF-1α with consequent induction of the glycolytic program of the Warburg effect. Because SIRT3 normally governs mitochondrial metabolism, ROS production, and genome stability, its absence releases a permissive environment for oncogenic signaling and metabolic reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT3 acts upstream: reduced SIRT3 allows transformation and Warburg metabolism to proceed, defining its tumor-suppressive role in this context.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠和培養細胞中，SIRT3 缺乏有利於致癌性 Ras 或 Myc 引起的細胞轉化，且同一缺失穩定 HIF-1α 並導致 Warburg 效應的糖酵解程序誘導。由於 SIRT3 正常情況下掌控粒線體代謝、活性氧生成和基因組穩定性，其缺失釋放了一個允許致癌訊號和代謝重編程的環境。方向性上 SIRT3 位於上游：SIRT3 降低允許轉化和 Warburg 代謝進行，定義了其在此情境下的腫瘤抑制角色。

label: Lung fibrosis via TGF-β1
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 deficiency in the aging murine lung promotes a fibrotic response mediated by TGF-beta1 and augments mitochondrial DNA damage and apoptosis in alveolar epithelial cells. Conversely, SIRT3 overexpression can ameliorate asbestos-induced pulmonary fibrosis. Directionally, SIRT3 deficiency sits upstream of enhanced TGF-beta1-driven fibrosis, because by weakening mitochondrial antioxidant defenses it renders alveolar epithelial cells vulnerable to the damage that fuels the fibrotic program. Restoring SIRT3 could therefore protect against pulmonary fibrosis, making mitochondrial sirtuin activity an important determinant of lung resilience to environmental and aging-related fibrotic injury.
description_zh_TW: 老化小鼠肺部的SIRT3缺乏促進由TGF-beta1介導的纖維化反應，並增強肺泡上皮細胞的粒線體DNA損傷和凋亡。相反，SIRT3過表達可以改善石棉誘導的肺纖維化。方向上，SIRT3缺乏位於TGF-beta1驅動的纖維化增強的上游，因為透過削弱粒線體抗氧化防禦，它使肺泡上皮細胞容易受到推動纖維化程序的損傷。因此恢復SIRT3可能保護免受肺纖維化，使粒線體sirtuin活性成為肺部對環境和與年齡相關纖維化損傷韌性的重要決定因素。

label: cancer in fast COMT
description: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) increases cancer risk in fast COMT (Val/Val) individuals, as reported in subgroup analyses of supplementation trials where rapid COMT metabolism of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates was associated with adverse outcomes. The mechanism may involve altered handling of catecholestrogens or oxidative metabolites that differ by enzyme activity. This gene-nutrient interaction cautions against blanket vitamin E recommendation in fast genotypes. It underscores the importance of genotype-aware antioxidant guidance.
description_zh_TW: Vitamin E（α-生育醇）會增加快速 COMT（Val/Val）個體的癌症風險，正如補充試驗的亞組分析所報告的那樣，其中維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體的快速 COMT 代謝與不良後果相關。該機制可能涉及改變兒茶酚雌激素或氧化代謝物的處理方式，這些代謝物因酶活性而異。這種基因-營養素交互作用提醒我們不要在快速基因型中全面推薦維生素 E。它強調了基因型感知抗氧化指導的重要性。

label: cancer risk in slow COMT
description: Vitamin E reduces cancer risk in slow COMT individuals, with the protective effect concentrated in Met/Met genotypes in stratified trial data, likely reflecting more favorable metabolism of vitamin E and associated catechols when COMT activity is low. This contrasts with the increased risk observed in fast COMT genotypes, demonstrating a bidirectional gene-nutrient interaction. The mechanism is thought to involve COMT-dependent handling of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates and catecholestrogens. Genotype-stratified analysis is therefore essential for interpreting antioxidant trials.
description_zh_TW: Vitamin E 減少了 cancer risk in slow COMT 個體，分層試驗數據中的保護作用集中在 Met/Met 基因型上，這可能反映出當 COMT activity 較低時維生素 E 和相關兒茶酚的代謝更有利。這與快速 COMT 基因型中觀察到的風險增加形成鮮明對比，證明了基因與營養的雙向交互作用。此機制被認為涉及 COMT 依賴的維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體和兒茶酚雌激素的處理。因此，基因型分層分析對於解釋抗氧化試驗至關重要。

label: Anti-androgen
description: Enzalutamide is a nonsteroidal anti-androgen used in endocrine therapy of prostate cancer.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 是一種非甾體抗雄激素，用於前列腺癌的內分泌治療。

label: PtdIns(4,5)P2
description: Autophagic lysosome reformation (ALR) is the process by which spent autolysosomes tubulate and bud off new lysosomes to restore the lysosomal pool after autophagy. ALR requires the coordinated actions of phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PI(4,5)P2), clathrin, and adaptor proteins AP2 and AP4 to drive membrane scission and vesicle formation. This reformation step is essential to prevent lysosomal depletion during sustained autophagy. Defects in ALR cause accumulation of enlarged autolysosomes and impaired degradative capacity.
description_zh_TW: 自噬性溶酶體重組（ALR）是耗損的自體溶酶體經由小管形成並出芽產生新溶酶體，以在自噬後恢復溶酶體庫的過程。ALR 需要磷脂醯肌醇 4,5-二磷酸（PI(4,5)P2）、clathrin 以及接頭蛋白 AP2 與 AP4 的協調作用，以驅動膜分裂和囊泡形成。此重組步驟對防止持續自噬期間溶酶體耗竭至為必要。ALR 的缺陷導致腫大的自體溶酶體累積以及降解能力受損。

label: PIKfyve
description: PIKfyve is a phosphoinositide kinase that converts phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) into phosphatidylinositol 3,5-bisphosphate (PI(3,5)P2) on endolysosomal membranes. PI(3,5)P2 serves as a crucial lipid messenger that regulates membrane trafficking, vacuole homeostasis, and the activity of the lysosomal channel TRPML1. By generating PI(3,5)P2, PIKfyve controls lysosomal morphology and the calcium release that activates calcineurin-TFEB signaling. Its inhibition causes massive lysosomal vacuolation, underscoring its centrality to lysosomal function.
description_zh_TW: PIKfyve 是一種磷酸肌醇激酶，在內溶酶體膜上將磷脂醯肌醇 3-磷酸（PI3P）轉化為磷脂醯肌醇 3,5-二磷酸（PI(3,5)P2）。PI(3,5)P2 作為一種關鍵的脂質信使，調節膜運輸、液泡恆定性，以及溶酶體通道 TRPML1 的活性。透過生成 PI(3,5)P2，PIKfyve 控制溶酶體形態以及活化 calcineurin-TFEB 信號的鈣釋放。其抑制會導致大規模溶酶體液泡化，凸顯其對溶酶體功能的核心地位。

label: SLC-36.1
description: SLC-36.1 (a solute carrier) forms a complex with the PPK-3/PIKfyve kinase module to regulate phagocytic lysosome reformation (PLR), the process by which phagolysosomes regenerate new lysosomes after phagocytosis. By influencing PI(3,5)P2 generation and membrane dynamics, this complex ensures restoration of the lysosomal pool following immune or clearance challenges. Defects in PLR impair the ability of phagocytes to sustain repeated rounds of degradation. The pathway connects solute transport and phosphoinositide metabolism to innate immune function.
description_zh_TW: SLC-36.1（一種溶質載體）與 PPK-3/PIKfyve 激酶模組形成複合物，以調節吞噬性溶酶體重組（PLR）——即吞噬溶酶體在吞噬作用後再生新溶酶體的過程。透過影響 PI(3,5)P2 生成和膜動力學，此複合物確保在免疫或清除挑戰後溶酶體庫的恢復。PLR 的缺陷會損害吞噬細胞持續多輪降解的能力。此途徑將溶質運輸和磷酸肌醇代謝連結到先天免疫功能。

label: Ca2+ from lysosomes
description: TRPML1 (mucolipin-1) is a lysosomal cation channel that releases Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol in response to stimuli such as PI(3,5)P2 or lumenal cues. The resulting local calcium signal activates calcineurin, which dephosphorylates TFEB and promotes its nuclear translocation. Through this mechanism, TRPML1 functionally links lysosomal ion homeostasis to the transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. Loss of TRPML1 underlies the lysosomal storage disorder mucolipidosis type IV.
description_zh_TW: TRPML1（mucolipin-1）是一種溶酶體陽離子通道，回應 PI(3,5)P2 或腔內信號等刺激，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔釋放至細胞質。所產生的局部鈣信號活化 calcineurin，後者去磷酸化 TFEB 並促進其核轉運。透過此機制，TRPML1 在功能上將溶酶體離子恆定連結到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的轉錄活化。TRPML1 的缺失是溶酶體儲存障礙黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV）的基礎。

label: Lysosomal Ca2+ efflux
description: TRPML1 is the principal lysosomal Ca2+ release channel, activated by PI(3,5)P2 and other cues to efflux Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol. The released Ca2+ activates calcineurin, driving TFEB/TFE3 nuclear translocation and thereby coupling ion flux to transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis. TRPML1 also participates in lysosomal trafficking and autophagosome-lysosome fusion. Loss of TRPML1 causes mucolipidosis type IV, a lysosomal storage disorder, confirming its essential role in degradative homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: TRPML1 是主要的溶酶體 Ca2+ 釋放通道，由 PI(3,5)P2 及其他線索活化，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔流出至細胞質。釋出的 Ca2+ 活化 calcineurin，驅動 TFEB/TFE3 核轉運，從而將離子流與溶酶體生物發生的轉錄活化耦合起來。TRPML1 亦參與溶酶體運輸以及自噬體—溶酶體融合。TRPML1 的缺失導致黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV），一種溶酶體儲存障礙，確認了其在降解恆定性中的必要角色。

label: KIF5B
description: KIF5B motors extend reformation tubules during ALR. Regulation is the motility input.
description_zh_TW: KIF5B 馬達在 ALR 延伸重組小管。調節是運動輸入。

label: Peroxisomes
description: Catalase is localized predominantly in peroxisomes, organelles that host numerous H2O2-generating oxidases involved in lipid beta-oxidation and purine catabolism. Concentrating catalase here minimizes leakage of peroxide into the cytosol and nucleus. The directionality reflects compartmentalization of both source and sink of H2O2. A caveat is that a minority of catalase activity also exists in cytosol and mitochondria in some tissues, providing additional but lesser protection. This compartmentalization is functionally important: peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids generates substantial H2O2, and catalase prevents that peroxide from spilling into the cytosol.
description_zh_TW: Catalase 主要位於 peroxisomes 細胞器中，該細胞器含有大量參與脂質 β 氧化和嘌呤分解代謝的產生 H2O2 的氧化酶。在此濃縮 catalase 可最大程度地減少過氧化物洩漏到細胞質和細胞核。方向性反映了 H2O2 源和彙的劃分。需要注意的是，少數 catalase 活性也存在於某些組織的細胞質和 mitochondria 中，提供額外但較少的保護。這種區室化在功能上很重要：極長鏈脂肪酸的過氧化物酶體 β 氧化會產生大量 H2O2，而 catalase 可以防止過氧化物溢出到細胞質中。

label: NLRP3 inflammasome assembly
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: ROS trigger NLRP3 inflammasome assembly by promoting the conformational changes and ASC speck formation needed for caspase-1 activation. Mitochondrial ROS and oxidized mitochondrial DNA are particularly implicated as upstream signals. The directionality is oxidant to inflammasome activation. A caveat is that NLRP3 is also activated by non-ROS stimuli (ATP, nigericin, crystals), so ROS is a common but not exclusive trigger. ROS derived from both NOX enzymes and mitochondria converge on NLRP3, linking metabolic and inflammatory stress to IL-1beta production.
description_zh_TW: ROS 透過促進 caspase-1 活化所需的構象變化和 ASC 斑點形成來觸發 NLRP3 inflammasome assembly。 Mitochondrial ROS 和氧化的 mitochondrial DNA 作為上游訊號尤其受到牽連。方向性是發炎小體活化的氧化劑。需要注意的是，NLRP3 也會被非 ROS 刺激（ATP、尼日利亞黴素、晶體）激活，因此 ROS 是一種常見但非排他性的觸發器。源自 NOX 酶的 ROS 和 mitochondria 匯聚於 NLRP3，將代謝和發炎壓力與 IL-1beta 的產生連結起來。

label: Retinal Cell Viability
description: At 10 uM, Brosimine B raised mixed chicken-embryo retinal cell viability to 145.0% of control after 24 h in normoxia. Neither 1 uM nor 5 uM produced a significant increase. The effect defines the stimulatory peak of its hormetic window.
description_zh_TW: 10 uM 的 Brosimine B 在常氧下經 24 小時將混合雞胚視網膜細胞存活率提升至對照組的 145.0%。1 uM 與 5 uM 均無顯著增加。此效應界定了其 hormetic window 的刺激峰值。

label: Brosimum acutifolium
description: Brosimine B (4,7-dihydroxy-8-(3,3-dimethylallyl)flavan) was isolated from ethanolic bark extract of Brosimum acutifolium (Murure, Moraceae) collected in Para, Brazil. The species bark is traditionally used for analgesic and anti-inflammatory purposes. This botanical origin links Brosimine B to the antioxidant-rich Moraceae family.
description_zh_TW: Brosimine B（4,7-dihydroxy-8-(3,3-dimethylallyl)flavan）分離自巴西 Para 地區 Brosimum acutifolium（Murure，桑科）樹皮乙醇萃取物。該樹種樹皮傳統上用於鎮痛與抗發炎。此植物來源將 Brosimine B 連結至富含抗氧化物的 Moraceae 家族。

label: Flavonoid
description: Brosimine B is described as a prenylated flavan flavonoid (2(S)-7,4'-dihydroxy-8-(3,3-dimethylallyl)flavan, C20H22O3). Like other neuroprotective flavonoids such as hesperidin, it combines antioxidant and biphasic dose-response properties. Its flavonoid chemistry underpins the proposed ROS-scavenging and enzyme-modulating actions.
description_zh_TW: Brosimine B 被描述為異戊烯基黃烷類 Flavonoid（2(S)-7,4'-dihydroxy-8-(3,3-dimethylallyl)flavan，C20H22O3）。與 hesperidin 等神經保護類黃酮一樣，兼具抗氧化與雙相劑量反應特性。其黃酮化學結構是所提 ROS 清除與酶調節作用的基礎。

label: Cytotoxicity
description: Concentrations above 10 uM (25, 50, and 100 uM) drastically reduced retinal cell viability, demonstrating the descending toxic limb of the hormetic curve. This toxicity threshold mirrors related Moraceae compounds such as moracin P and mulberrofuran Q. It establishes a narrow therapeutic window for Brosimine B.
description_zh_TW: 高於 10 uM 的濃度（25、50、100 uM）大幅降低視網膜細胞存活率，呈現 hormetic 曲線的下降毒性支。此毒性閾值與 Moraceae 家族相關化合物如 moracin P 和 mulberrofuran Q 相似。這確立了 Brosimine B 狹窄的治療窗。

label: SIRT1 as CR mediator
description: David Sinclair identified SIRT1 as a mediator of caloric-restriction benefits and, in a landmark 2003 study, discovered resveratrol as a sirtuin-activating compound (STAC). Directionally, the discovery establishes SIRT1/STAC centrality to longevity research. This launched the modern sirtuin field, and it connects basic yeast findings to mammalian therapeutics. By showing that resveratrol extends yeast lifespan through Sir2, Sinclair bridged the caloric-restriction and sirtuin fields. This work catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development and made SIRT1 a central target in geroscience.
description_zh_TW: David Sinclair 鑑定 SIRT1 為限制熱量益處的介導因子，並在 2003 年的里程碑研究中發現 resveratrol 作為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC）。在方向性上，此發現確立了 SIRT1/STAC 在長壽研究中的核心地位。這啟動了現代 sirtuin 領域，並將基礎酵母發現與哺乳動物治療學聯繫起來。透過展示 resveratrol 透過 Sir2 延長酵母壽命，Sinclair 架起了限制熱量和 sirtuin 領域之間的橋樑。此工作催化了數十年的 sirtuin 藥物開發，使 SIRT1 成為老年科學的核心靶標。

label: Resveratrol as STAC
description: In 2003, Sinclair showed resveratrol extends yeast lifespan via Sir2 and later demonstrated parallel effects in higher organisms, discovering it as the first STAC. Directionally, the discovery sits upstream of the STAC concept. This catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development, and it remains a seminal finding in geroscience. By identifying a natural compound that activates sirtuins, Sinclair provided the prototype for pharmacologically engaging longevity pathways. The STAC concept has since driven the search for more potent and specific sirtuin activators for therapeutic use.
description_zh_TW: 2003 年，Sinclair 展示 resveratrol 透過 Sir2 延長酵母壽命，後來在高等生物中展示了類似效應，將其發現為第一個 STAC。在方向性上，此發現位於 STAC 概念的上游。這催化了數十年的 sirtuin 藥物開發，至今仍是老年科學的開創性發現。透過鑑定一種活化 sirtuin 的天然化合物，Sinclair 為藥理學地介入長壽途徑提供了原型。STAC 概念自那以後推動了尋找更強效和更具選擇性的 sirtuin 活化劑用於治療。

label: RCM-driven epigenetic aging
description: Induction of double-strand breaks in the ICE Mouse, followed by repair, produces accelerated epigenetic aging and physiological decline without mutagenesis, supporting the RCM hypothesis. Directionally, double-strand-break repair sits upstream of epigenetic aging. This argues that aging can arise from information loss rather than just genetic damage, and it is a cornerstone experiment for the Information Theory of Aging. Because the phenotype occurs without mutations, it is attributed to loss of epigenetic information during repair. These results reframe aging as a software problem and motivate NAD+/sirtuin-based interventions.
description_zh_TW: ICE 小鼠中雙鏈斷裂的誘導及隨後的修復產生加速的表觀遺傳衰老和生理退化，不伴隨突變，支持 RCM 假說。在方向性上，雙鏈斷裂修復位於表觀遺傳衰老的上游。這主張衰老可以源於資訊喪失而非僅僅基因損傷，是衰老資訊理論的基礎實驗。由於表型在沒有突變的情況下發生，被歸因於修復期間表觀遺傳資訊的喪失。這些結果將衰老重新定義為軟體問題，並推動基於 NAD+/sirtuin 的干預措施。

label: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals
description: Sinclair co-founded Sirtris Pharmaceuticals (later acquired by GlaxoSmithKline) to develop STACs such as SRT1720 and SRT2104 as therapeutics. Directionally, the academic discovery was translated into a company. This drove clinical translation of sirtuin activators, and it illustrates the bench-to-bedside path of sirtuin research. By commercializing STACs, Sirtris aimed to develop drugs that reproduce the metabolic benefits of caloric restriction. Although clinical outcomes were mixed, the company's formation validated sirtuins as a druggable target class and stimulated industrial interest in longevity biology.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 共同創辦了 Sirtris Pharmaceuticals（後被葛蘭素史克收購）以開發 SRT1720 和 SRT2104 等 STAC 作為治療藥物。在方向性上，學術發現被轉化為一家公司。這推動了 sirtuin 活化劑的臨床轉化，並說明了 sirtuin 研究從實驗室到床邊的路徑。透過商業化 STAC，Sirtris 旨在開發再現限制熱量代謝益處的藥物。儘管臨床結果不一，該公司的成立驗證了 sirtuin 作為可藥靶標類別的地位，並刺激了工業界對長壽生物學的興趣。

label: I-PpoI endonuclease
description: The ICE (Induced Changes in Epigenetics) Mouse uses inducible I-PpoI expression to introduce targeted double-strand breaks that are repaired without introducing mutations. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of controlled double-strand-break formation. This lets researchers trigger DNA damage alone, isolating epigenetic from mutational effects, and it is the experimental engine of the RCM model. By using sequence-specific breaks that are repaired faithfully, the ICE Mouse creates pure DNA-repair events. This design is central to testing whether DNA damage drives aging through epigenetic information loss.
description_zh_TW: ICE（表觀遺傳誘導變化）小鼠使用誘導型 I-PpoI 表達引入靶向的雙鏈斷裂，這些斷裂在不引入突變的情況下被修復。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於受控雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。這讓研究人員僅觸發 DNA 損傷，將表觀遺傳與突變效應分離，是 RCM 模型的實驗引擎。透過使用被忠實修復的序列特異性斷裂，ICE 小鼠創造純粹的 DNA 修復事件。此設計對於測試 DNA 損傷是否透過表觀遺傳資訊喪失驅動衰老至關重要。

label: ICE Mouse model
description: The Sinclair lab developed the ICE Mouse to test the RCM hypothesis using mutation-free double-strand breaks. Directionally, the model enables tests of epigenetic aging. This provided key evidence for the Information Theory of Aging, and it is a methodological contribution alongside the theoretical framework. By engineering a system to induce faithful DNA breaks, Sinclair created a tool to separate epigenetic from genetic contributions to aging. The ICE Mouse's results have made it a centerpiece of the argument that aging results from loss of epigenetic information.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 實驗室開發了 ICE 小鼠來使用無突變的雙鏈斷裂測試 RCM 假說。在方向性上，該模型使得表觀遺傳衰老的測試成為可能。這為衰老資訊理論提供了關鍵證據，是與理論框架並列的方法學貢獻。透過設計一個誘導忠實 DNA 斷裂的系統，Sinclair 創造了一個工具來分離表觀遺傳和遺傳對衰老的貢獻。ICE 小鼠的結果使其成為衰老源於表觀遺傳資訊喪失這一論點的核心。

label: Mutations
description: In the Information Theory of Aging, mutations represent irreversible 'hardware' damage distinct from the 'software' (epigenetic) information loss the theory emphasizes as the primary driver of aging. The RCM hypothesis and ICE mouse model induce double-strand breaks without mutations to isolate epigenetic consequences.
description_zh_TW: 在老化資訊理論中，突變代表不可逆的「硬體」損傷，有別於理論強調為老化主要驅動者的「軟體」（表觀遺傳）資訊喪失。RCM 假說與 ICE 小鼠模型在無突變下誘導雙股斷裂，以隔離表觀遺傳後果。

label: TFEB at K91/K103/K116/K430
description: Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1 (ACAT1) acetylates TFEB at multiple lysines (K91, K103, K116, K430), an enzymatic activity that, in this context, promotes TFEB nuclear translocation and DNA binding. These acetylations counteract repressive deacetylation cycles and enhance TFEB's ability to engage CLEAR elements, thereby boosting autophagy-lysosomal transcription. The observation that ACAT1-mediated acetylation can be activatory contrasts with the repressive acetylation by GCN5 at other sites. The net effect depends on the specific lysine and cellular context, underscoring the complexity of TFEB acetylation.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶 A 乙醯轉移酶 1（ACAT1）在多個離胺酸（K91、K103、K116、K430）乙醯化 TFEB，在此脈絡下此酵素活性促進 TFEB 核轉運和 DNA 結合。這些乙醯化對抗抑制性的去乙醯化循環，並增強 TFEB 接合 CLEAR 元件的能力，從而提升自噬—溶酶體轉錄。ACAT1 介導的乙醯化可為活化性的此一觀察，與 GCN5 在其他位點的抑制性乙醯化形成對比。淨效應取決於特定離胺酸和細胞背景，凸顯了 TFEB 乙醯化的複雜性。

label: Eltrombopag
description: Eltrombopag (EO), a small-molecule thrombopoietin receptor agonist, was identified as the first direct inhibitor of TFEB, disrupting TFEB-DNA interactions at CLEAR elements. By preventing TFEB from binding its target promoters, EO blocks transcriptional activation of the autophagy-lysosomal network. This tool compound has enabled dissection of TFEB-dependent versus independent autophagy and has therapeutic implications where TFEB hyperactivation is pathogenic. Its discovery established pharmacological feasibility of directly targeting the MiT/TFE family.
description_zh_TW: Eltrombopag（EO）是一種小分子 thrombopoietin 受體促效劑，被鑑定為第一個 TFEB 的直接抑制劑，破壞 TFEB 在 CLEAR 元件處的 TFEB-DNA 交互作用。透過阻止 TFEB 結合其標的啟動子，EO 阻斷自噬—溶酶體網絡的轉錄活化。此工具化合物使得剖析 TFEB 依賴與非依賴的自噬成為可能，並在 TFEB 過度活化為致病性的情況下具有治療意義。其發現確立了直接標靶 MiT/TFE 家族的藥理可行性。

label: TFEB at K274/K279
description: GCN5, a lysine acetyltransferase, acetylates TFEB at lysines 274 and 279 within its DNA-binding domain, an modification that hinders TFEB dimerization and its ability to bind CLEAR elements. Acetylation at these sites therefore represses TFEB transcriptional activity independently of its localization. This post-translational modification expands the regulatory vocabulary of TFEB beyond phosphorylation to include acetylation-dependent control of DNA engagement. The finding situates TFEB within the broader acetylome that governs transcription factor function.
description_zh_TW: GCN5 是一種離胺酸乙醯轉移酶，於 lysine 274 和 279 乙醯化 TFEB，這些位點位於其 DNA 結合域內，此修飾阻礙 TFEB 二聚化及其結合 CLEAR 元件的能力。因此這些位點的乙醯化獨立於其定位而抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。此轉譯後修飾將 TFEB 的調節詞彙從磷酸化擴展到包含依賴乙醯化的 DNA 接合控制。此發現將 TFEB 置於控制轉錄因子功能的更廣泛乙醯體中。

label: Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome
description: In Birt-Hogg-Dubé (BHD) syndrome, caused by Folliculin (FLCN) mutations, TFEB becomes hyperactivated and drives a renal cystic and tumor-prone phenotype. Loss of FLCN dysregulates mTOR and related signaling such that TFEB-mediated lysosomal and proliferative programs are inappropriately engaged in renal epithelial cells. This pathogenic role contrasts with TFEB's generally protective function in neurodegeneration and aging. The BHD example demonstrates that excessive or context-inappropriate TFEB activation can be deleterious.
description_zh_TW: 在由 Folliculin（FLCN）突變引起的 Birt-Hogg-Dubé（BHD）症候群中，TFEB 變得過度活化並驅動腎囊性和易長腫瘤的表型。FLCN 的缺失失調 mTOR 和相關信號，使得 TFEB 介導的溶酶體和增生程序在腎上皮細胞中不當地被啟動。此致病角色與 TFEB 在神經退化和老化中普遍保護性功能形成對比。BHD 例子證明了過度或背景不當的 TFEB 活化可能是有害的。

label: MALAT1 in renal carcinoma
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: In a subset of translocation renal cell carcinomas (t(6;11) RCC), the TFEB gene is fused with the long non-coding RNA locus MALAT1, producing a MALAT1-TFEB fusion that drives overexpression of intact TFEB. The fusion places TFEB under the strong promoter activity of MALAT1, leading to constitutive activation of the lysosomal-autophagic and proliferative programs. This genetic rearrangement defines a distinct clinicopathologic entity of RCC with characteristic biphasic histology. The finding established TFEB as an oncogene when deregulated by chromosomal translocation.
description_zh_TW: 在一部分轉位性腎細胞癌（t(6;11) RCC）中，TFEB 基因與長鏈非編碼 RNA 基因座 MALAT1 融合，產生 MALAT1-TFEB 融合體，驅動完整 TFEB 的過度表現。此融合將 TFEB 置於 MALAT1 強啟動子活性之下，導致溶酶體—自噬性和增生性程序的組成型活化。此基因重排定義了一種具有特徵性雙相組織學的獨特 RCC 臨床病理實體。此發現確立了 TFEB 在因染色體轉位而失調時是一種致癌基因。

label: Oxidation at C212
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: Oxidation of TFEB at cysteine 212—for example by reactive oxygen species or oxidants—impairs mTORC1-mediated phosphorylation at adjacent regulatory sites and thereby enhances TFEB activity. This redox-sensitive control links cellular oxidative status directly to activation of the lysosomal-autophagy program, functioning as a stress sensor. By relieving kinase repression under oxidative conditions, TFEB oxidation promotes clearance of damaged components that generate ROS. The C212 modification exemplifies how cysteine-based redox switches integrate stress signaling with degradative transcription.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的氧化——例如由活性氧物種或氧化劑引起——損害 mTORC1 介導的鄰近調節位點磷酸化，從而增強 TFEB 活性。這種對氧化還原敏感的控製將細胞氧化狀態直接連結到溶酶體—自噬程序的活化，作為一種壓力感測器。透過在氧化條件下解除激酶抑制，TFEB 氧化促進清除會產生 ROS 的受損組分。C212 修飾舉例說明了基於半胱胺酸的氧化還原方程序如何將壓力信號與降解轉錄整合。

label: PDCD4
description: Programmed cell death protein 4 (PDCD4) suppresses TFEB translation by binding eukaryotic initiation factor 4A (eIF4A) and inhibiting the RNA helicase activity required for ribosome scanning of the TFEB mRNA. This translational blockade limits TFEB protein synthesis independently of its transcriptional or degradative regulation. PDCD4 thereby acts as a brake on the autophagy-lysosomal program at the level of protein synthesis. Its own downregulation in cancer may contribute to the elevated TFEB activity observed in some malignancies.
description_zh_TW: 細胞程序性死亡蛋白 4（PDCD4）透過結合真核起始因子 4A（eIF4A）並抑制 TFEB mRNA 核糖體掃描所需的 RNA 解旋酶活性，抑制 TFEB 轉錄。此轉錄阻斷獨立於其轉錄或降解調節而限制 TFEB 蛋白合成。PDCD4 因此在蛋白質合成層次上充當自噬—溶酶體程序的制動。其在癌症中的自身下調可能促成某些惡性腫瘤中觀察到的 TFEB 活性升高。

label: TFEB independent of mTOR
description: Protein kinase C (PKC) activation induces TFEB nuclear translocation through an mTORC1-independent route, primarily by inactivating GSK3β, which otherwise phosphorylates TFEB at cytosolic-retention sites. This alternative regulatory input allows TFEB to be engaged by diacylglycerol and calcium signaling without requiring nutrient deprivation. The pathway diversifies the contexts—such as immune cell activation—in which the autophagy-lysosomal program can be turned on. It demonstrates that TFEB is controlled by parallel kinase networks rather than solely by mTOR.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C（PKC）的活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的途徑誘導 TFEB 核轉運，主要是透過使 GSK3β 失去活性，而後者本會在細胞質保留位點磷酸化 TFEB。這種替代性調節輸入使得 TFEB 能夠在不需要營養匱乏的情況下，被二醯甘油和鈣信號所啟動。此途徑使自噬—溶酶體程序可被開啟的脈絡多元化——例如免疫細胞活化。它證明了 TFEB 受平行激酶網絡而非僅由 mTOR 所控制。

label: S-sulfhydration at C212
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: S-sulfhydration of TFEB at cysteine 212, catalyzed by the cystathionine gamma-lyase (CTH)-derived hydrogen sulfide (H2S) system, promotes its nuclear translocation and activation. This post-translational modification, distinct from oxidation, converts C212 into a persulfide that alters TFEB interactions and favors a transcriptionally active state. The regulation ties sulfur metabolism and H2S signaling to the autophagy-lysosomal network, with implications for cardiovascular and neurodegenerative protection. It represents a gasotransmitter-based mechanism controlling cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的 S-硫化（S-sulfhydration），由 cystathionine gamma-lyase（CTH）衍生的硫化氫（H2S）系統催化，促進其核轉運和活化。此轉譯後修飾不同於氧化，將 C212 轉化為過硫化物，改變 TFEB 交互作用並有利於轉錄活化狀態。此調節將硫代謝和 H2S 信號聯繫到自噬—溶酶體網絡，對心血管和神經退化保護具有意義。它代表了一種控制細胞清除的氣體傳遞分子（gasotransmitter）基礎機制。

label: Phosphorylated TFEB
description: STUB1 (CHIP), an E3 ubiquitin ligase, recognizes and ubiquitinates phosphorylated TFEB, targeting the transcription factor for proteasomal degradation. This mechanism ensures that TFEB levels are coupled to its phosphorylation state, providing a negative-feedback brake on sustained activation. By eliminating phosphorylated, cytosolically retained TFEB, STUB1 limits the accumulation of inactive protein and fine-tunes the amplitude of the autophagic response. The pathway connects TFEB turnover to the ubiquitin-proteasome system rather than to lysosomal degradation.
description_zh_TW: STUB1（CHIP）是一種 E3 泛素連接酶，辨識並泛素化磷酸化的 TFEB，將此轉錄因子標定為蛋白酶體降解。此機制確保 TFEB 水平與其磷酸化狀態耦合，提供對持續活化的負回饋制動。透過清除磷酸化、細胞質保留的 TFEB，STUB1 限制非活性蛋白的累積並微調自噬反應的幅度。此途徑將 TFEB 更新連結到泛素—蛋白酶體系統，而非溶酶體降解。

label: PGC1-alpha
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB and the mitochondrial biogenesis coactivator PGC-1α form a positive feedback loop: PGC-1α modulates mitophagy by regulating TFEB expression, while TFEB induces PGC-1α transcription, reinforcing mitochondrial turnover and biogenesis. This reciprocal regulation couples lysosomal-autophagic clearance with mitochondrial network expansion under stress. The loop ensures coordinated enhancement of both degradative and biosynthetic mitochondrial programs. Its disruption impairs metabolic adaptation and is relevant to aging and myopathy.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 與粒線體生物發生共活化因子 PGC-1α 形成正向回饋環：PGC-1α 透過調節 TFEB 表現來調控粒線體自噬，而 TFEB 誘發 PGC-1α 轉錄，強化粒線體週轉與生物發生。此相互調節在壓力下將溶酶體—自噬性清除與粒線體網絡擴張耦合起來。此迴圈確保降解性和合成性粒線體程序的協調增強。其失調損害代謝適應，並與老化和肌病相關。

label: CLEAR Element
description: TFEB binds to Coordinated Lysosomal Expression and Regulation (CLEAR) elements—a conserved 10-base-pair motif (GTCACGTGAC) present in the promoters of numerous lysosomal and autophagy genes. Through this binding, TFEB drives the coordinated transcriptional upregulation of the entire autophagy-lysosomal network. CLEAR-mediated regulation allows cells to mount a unified response that expands degradative capacity in tandem with autophagic initiation. The CLEAR network is the molecular basis for TFEB's role as a master regulator of cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 結合至協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）元件——存在於眾多溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的保守 10 個鹼基對基序（GTCACGTGAC）。透過此結合，TFEB 驅動整個自噬—溶酶體網絡的協調轉錄上調。CLEAR 介導的調節使細胞能夠啟動統一的反應，在自噬起始的同時擴展降解能力。CLEAR 網絡是 TFEB 作為細胞清除主調控因子角色的分子的基礎。

label: Autophagy-lysosomal pathway
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB is a master transcriptional regulator of the autophagy-lysosomal pathway, coordinating the expression of genes required for autophagosome formation, cargo recognition, lysosomal biogenesis, and substrate degradation. Its activation simultaneously boosts both the supply of autophagosomes and the degradative capacity of lysosomes, ensuring coherent flux rather than unbalanced initiation. TFEB thereby couples the two halves of autophagy—sequestration and degradation—into a single coordinated program. Dysregulation of this axis contributes to lysosomal storage disorders, neurodegeneration, and cancer.
