Serum CML is therefore used as a biomarker of glycation burden and age-related vascular pathology.
description_zh_TW: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine（CML）是由 glycated proteins 形成的重要 advanced glycation end product。Elderly individuals 血清 CML concentration 與 vessel stiffness 之間存在顯著相關性，反映了 AGE accumulation 與 ECM cross-linking 在 arterial stiffening 中的作用。CML 也隨年齡堆積於 heart tissue，而 dietary CML-enriched protein 在 mice 中以 RAGE-dependent manner 誘發 functional arterial aging。因此，血清 CML 被用作 glycation burden 與 age-related vascular pathology 的 biomarker。

label: Troponin
description: Troponin is a heterotrimeric complex regulating striated muscle contraction, and cardiac troponin I and T are highly cardiac-specific gold-standard biomarkers of myocardial injury. Troponin release from the heart signals myocardial damage.
description_zh_TW: 肌鈣蛋白（troponin）是調控橫紋肌收縮的異三聚體複合體，而心肌肌鈣蛋白 I 與 T 是高度心臟特異的心肌損傷金標準生物標記。心臟釋放的肌鈣蛋白指示心肌損傷。

label: α-synuclein-mediated toxicity
description: AGK2-mediated SIRT2 inhibition prevents deacetylation of α-tubulin and microtubule elements, suppressing aggregation and protecting dopaminergic neuron viability in Parkinson's models. Directionally, AGK2/SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of neuronal rescue. This targets the microtubule instability underlying synuclein toxicity, and it is a leading SIRT2-inhibition neurodegenerative strategy. By maintaining the acetylated, stable state of tubulin, AGK2 helps neurons withstand α-synuclein aggregates. These results provided some of the strongest evidence that SIRT2 inhibition, rather than activation, is neuroprotective.
description_zh_TW: AGK2 介導的 SIRT2 抑制防止 α-微管蛋白和微管元件的去乙醯化，抑制聚集並在帕金森氏症模型中保護多巴胺能神經元活性。在方向性上，AGK2/SIRT2 抑制位於神經元拯救的上游。這靶向突觸核蛋白毒性底層的微管不穩定性，是領先的 SIRT2 抑制神經退行性策略。透過維護微管蛋白的乙醯化穩定狀態，AGK2 幫助神經元抵抗 α-突觸核蛋白聚集。這些結果提供了最強的證據之一，表明 SIRT2 抑制（而非活化）具有神經保護作用。

label: phospho-JNK
description: Administration of AGK2 confers significant neuroprotection under ischemic and hypoxic conditions by suppressing the apoptotic cascade, downregulating phosphorylated JNK (phospho-JNK) and FOXO3a, the direct downstream target of SIRT2. This ultimately prevents Bim activation and subsequent caspase-3 cleavage.
description_zh_TW: 在缺血和缺氧條件下，給予 AGK2 透過抑制凋亡級聯、下調磷酸化 JNK（phospho-JNK）和 FOXO3a（SIRT2 的直接下游靶標）來提供顯著的神經保護。這最終阻止 Bim 活化和隨後的 caspase-3 裂解。

label: Bone marrow-derived macrophages
description: Bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) are a standard model for studying inflammasome signaling, including AIM2. In these cells DROSHA deficiency suppresses AIM2-dependent caspase-1 activation and IL-1beta/IL-18 release, linking Microprocessor activity to AIM2 inflammasome function.
description_zh_TW: 骨髓衍生巨噬細胞（BMDM）是研究發炎體訊號（包括 AIM2）的標準模型。在此類細胞中，DROSHA 缺乏會抑制 AIM2 依賴的 caspase-1 活化與 IL-1β/IL-18 釋放，將 Microprocessor 活性與 AIM2 發炎體功能相連結。

label: Embryoid Bodies
description: Embryoid bodies are 3D aggregates formed when embryonic stem cells differentiate. DGCR8-deficient embryoid bodies failed to form cysts and showed abnormal lineage-marker expression, rescued by DGCR8 re-expression, confirming microRNAs are required for normal EB differentiation.
description_zh_TW: 類胚體（embryoid bodies）是胚胎幹細胞分化時形成的三維聚集體。缺乏 DGCR8 的類胚體無法形成囊泡並表現異常的譜系標記表現，可由 DGCR8 再表現挽救，證實 microRNA 為正常 EB 分化所需。

label: HeLa Cells
description: HeLa cells are routinely used in RNAi and reporter assays to study microRNA biogenesis. Knockdown of DGCR8 or Drosha in HeLa S3 reduced pre-miR-16 and mature miR-16 with pri-miRNA accumulation, confirming DGCR8 requirement for microRNA maturation.
description_zh_TW: HeLa 細胞常被用於 RNAi 與報導基因分析以研究 microRNA 生合成。在 HeLa S3 中敲低 DGCR8 或 Drosha 會降低 pre-miR-16 與成熟 miR-16 並累積 pri-miRNA，證實 DGCR8 為 microRNA 成熟所需。

label: DiGeorge Syndrome
description: The DGCR8 gene lies in the DiGeorge critical region. Association records the genomic disease link.
description_zh_TW: DGCR8 基因位於 DiGeorge 關鍵區域。關聯記錄基因組疾病連結。

label: Sirt4 knockout
description: Deletion of the Sirt4 gene in mice leads to hyper-activation of GDH in pancreatic islets, abnormally elevated insulin levels, and upregulation of amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion, particularly in response to glutamine. These mice are protected from diet-induced obesity, linking the SIRT4-GDH axis to systemic energy balance.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠中刪除 Sirt4 基因會導致胰腺胰島中 GDH 過度活化、胰島素水平異常升高，並上調胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌，尤其是對穀氨醯胺的反應。這些小鼠免受飲食誘導的肥胖，將 SIRT4–GDH 軸與全身能量平衡聯繫起來。

label: Hyperinsulinemic Hypoglycemia
description: Loss-of-function and activating mutations in the GLUD1 gene cause hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia (hyperinsulinism/hyperammonemia syndrome), illustrating the clinical impact of deregulated GDH. This underscores the importance of the SIRT4-GDH regulatory axis in whole-body glucose handling.
description_zh_TW: GLUD1 基因的功能喪失性和活化性突變會導致高胰島素性低血糖（高胰島素血症/高氨血症症候群），顯示 GDH 調節異常的臨床影響。這凸顯了 SIRT4–GDH 調節軸在全身葡萄糖處理中的重要性。

label: Alpha-Ketoglutarate
description: The oxidative deamination of glutamate by GDH yields alpha-ketoglutarate, which feeds the tricarboxylic acid cycle as an anaplerotic substrate. This conversion is central to coupling amino-acid catabolism to energy production in liver, kidney, and brain.
description_zh_TW: GDH 對穀氨酸的氧化脫氨產生 α-酮戊二酸，作為回補受質供應三羧酸循環。此轉化是將胺基酸分解代謝與肝、腎和腦中的能量產生偶聯的核心。

label: ER stress
description: TFE3 is activated in response to endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress through a pathway that is mTORC1-independent but requires the ER stress sensor PERK. Under unfolded protein accumulation, PERK signaling promotes TFE3 nuclear translocation, engaging lysosomal and autophagic genes to alleviate proteotoxic burden. This distinct trigger allows TFE3 to contribute to the integrated stress response without relying on nutrient sensing. The mechanism expands the repertoire of stressors that can recruit the MiT/TFE degradative program.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 在回應內質網（ER）壓力時透過一條不依賴 mTORC1、但需要 ER 壓力感測器 PERK 的途徑被活化。在未折疊蛋白累積時，PERK 信號促進 TFE3 核轉位，啟動溶酶體和自噬基因以減輕蛋白毒性負擔。此獨特觸發因子使 TFE3 能在不依賴營養感知的情況下，貢獻於整合性壓力反應。此機制擴展了能夠招募 MiT/TFE 降解程序的壓力因子 repertoire。

label: Antiangiogenic therapy
description: RCC is treated with VEGF-pathway inhibitors (e.g., sunitinib) and mTOR inhibitors; chemotherapy is largely ineffective.
description_zh_TW: RCC 使用 VEGF 途徑抑制劑（例如 sunitinib）和 mTOR 抑制劑治療；化療基本上無效。

label: Osteoclast development
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: TFE3 regulates osteoclast development by promoting the transition of mononucleated to multinucleated osteoclasts. This activation occurs downstream of the growth factors M-CSF and RANK and requires MAPK-dependent TFE3 phosphorylation. TFE3 thereby contributes to skeletal formation and remodeling through its control of osteoclast maturation. The role highlights TFE3's function in cell lineage decisions beyond lysosomal biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 透過促進單核細胞向多核破骨細胞的轉變，調節破骨細胞發育。此活化發生於生長因子 M-CSF 和 RANK 下游，並需要依賴 MAPK 的 TFE3 磷酸化。因此 TFE3 透過控制破骨細胞成熟，促成骨骼形成和重塑。此角色凸顯 TFE3 在細胞譜系決定中超越溶酶體生物發生的功能。

label: Antioxidant Enzymes
description: Hypoxia and related states such as estivation transiently upregulate endogenous antioxidant enzymes including Superoxide Dismutase, Catalase, Glutathione S-Transferase, and Glutathione Peroxidase. These activities rise by tens of percent during low-oxygen exposure and return to baseline upon reoxygenation or arousal.
description_zh_TW: Hypoxia 及相關狀態（如夏眠）會短暫上調內源性 Antioxidant Enzymes，包括 Superoxide Dismutase、Catalase、Glutathione S-Transferase 和 Glutathione Peroxidase。這些酵素活性在低氧暴露期間上升數十個百分點，並在再氧合或甦醒後回到基線。

label: NOAEL
description: The No-Observed-Adverse-Effect Level (NOAEL) is the dose where the hormetic curve intersects the control-response line. Doses left of NOAEL induce adaptive low-dose responses that maintain homeostasis and improve tolerance, while doses right of NOAEL cause toxicity, irreversible damage, or death. NOAEL therefore marks the boundary between the hormetic zone and toxicity.
description_zh_TW: No-Observed-Adverse-Effect Level (NOAEL) 是 hormetic 曲線與對照反應線相交的劑量。位於 NOAEL 左側的劑量誘發適應性低劑量反應，可維持恆定並提升耐受性，而右側劑量則導致毒性、不可逆損傷或死亡。因此 NOAEL 標誌著 hormetic zone 與毒性之間的界線。

label: Benzocaine
description: Benzocaine is a topical/local anesthetic that is a recognized trigger of acquired methemoglobinemia. Like other oxidizing drugs, it overwhelms the body's reducing systems, converting hemoglobin's ferrous iron to the ferric methemoglobin form. Acquired methemoglobinemia is much more common than congenital forms and can be acute and severe, especially with high-dose or combined exposures. Related local anesthetics prilocaine and lidocaine, along with antimalarials, dapsone, rasburicase and inhaled nitric oxide, are similarly implicated, and nitrite-based agents such as amyl and isobutyl nitrites and sodium nitrite are additional culprits.
description_zh_TW: Benzocaine is a topical/local anesthetic that is a recognized trigger of acquired methemoglobinemia。Like other oxidizing drugs, it overwhelms the body's reducing systems, converting hemoglobin's ferrous iron to the ferric methemoglobin form。Acquired methemoglobinemia is much more common than congenital forms and can be acute and severe, especially with high-dose or combined exposures。Related local anesthetics prilocaine and lidocaine, along with antimalarials, dapsone, rasburicase and inhaled nitric oxide, are similarly implicated, and nitrite-based agents such as amyl and isobutyl nitrites and sodium nitrite are additional culprits。

label: Dapsone
description: Dapsone is a medication that is a very common cause of acquired methemoglobinemia, especially with chronic use. Acquired methemoglobinemia is triggered when oxidizing agents overwhelm the body's reducing systems, and dapsone is among the most frequent offending drugs. Dapsone-related cases are often managed by dose reduction or discontinuation rather than always requiring methylene blue treatment. Other common drug triggers include topical and local anesthetics such as benzocaine, prilocaine and lidocaine, antimalarials such as chloroquine, rasburicase, and inhaled nitric oxide.
description_zh_TW: Dapsone is a medication that is a very common cause of acquired methemoglobinemia, especially with chronic use。Acquired methemoglobinemia is triggered when oxidizing agents overwhelm the body's reducing systems, and dapsone is among the most frequent offending drugs。Dapsone-related cases are often managed by dose reduction or discontinuation rather than always requiring methylene blue treatment。Other common drug triggers include topical and local anesthetics such as benzocaine, prilocaine and lidocaine, antimalarials such as chloroquine, rasburicase, and inhaled nitric oxide。

label: Sodium nitrite
description: Sodium nitrite is a chemical that can trigger acquired methemoglobinemia, seen in suicide attempts, contaminated food, and industrial exposures. Nitrites and nitrates oxidize hemoglobin's heme iron to the ferric state, overwhelming the body's reducing capacity. Related nitrite and nitrate sources include amyl nitrite and isobutyl nitrite ('poppers'), aniline dyes, nitrobenzene, and well-water nitrates that cause 'blue baby syndrome' in infants. Acquired methemoglobinemia from such agents can be acute and severe, particularly with high-dose or combined exposures, and recent trends show increases in nitrite-related cases from recreational use or intentional ingestion.
description_zh_TW: Sodium nitrite is a chemical that can trigger acquired methemoglobinemia, seen in suicide attempts, contaminated food, and industrial exposures。Nitrites and nitrates oxidize hemoglobin's heme iron to the ferric state, overwhelming the body's reducing capacity。Related nitrite and nitrate sources include amyl nitrite and isobutyl nitrite ('poppers'), aniline dyes, nitrobenzene, and well-water nitrates that cause 'blue baby syndrome' in infants。Acquired methemoglobinemia from such agents can be acute and severe, particularly with high-dose or combined exposures, and recent trends show increases in nitrite-related cases from recreational use or intentional ingestion。

label: Co-oximetry
description: During methemoglobinemia (and methylene blue infusion) pulse oximetry artifactually underestimates saturation, so arterial blood gas with co-oximetry is preferred. Co-oximetry directly resolves the methemoglobin fraction that pulse oximetry cannot distinguish.
description_zh_TW: 在變性血紅素血症（及 methylene blue 輸注）期間，脈搏血氧儀會人為地低估血氧飽和度，因此應改用動脈血氣分析與 co-oximetry。Co-oximetry 可直接解析脈搏血氧儀無法區分的變性血紅素比例。

label: Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A), a peripheral neuropathy, is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2, which encodes the outer mitochondrial membrane GTPase mitofusin 2. Mutations or deletions in MFN2 slow axonal transport in both directions and impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves. MFN2 also participates in mitochondrial transport by interacting with mitochondrial Rho small GTPase, and MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons reduces dopamine nerve terminals and striatal dopamine levels.
description_zh_TW: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A (CMT2A)，一種 peripheral neuropathy，直接由 mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2 的 heterozygous mutations 引起，MFN2 編碼外線粒體膜 GTPase mitofusin 2。MFN2 的突變或缺失減慢 axonal transport in both directions 並 impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves。MFN2 也通過與 mitochondrial Rho small GTPase 互動參與 mitochondrial transport，且 MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons 減少 dopamine nerve terminals 和 striatal dopamine levels。

label: Mitochondrial DNA Mutations
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Mitochondrial fusion dilutes mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) mutations by mixing the contents of healthy and damaged mitochondria, thereby enabling functional complementation between individual mitochondrial genomes. By exchanging mitochondrial DNA, proteins, lipids, and metabolites across a connected network, fusion allows a damaged genome to be complemented by the products of an intact genome. This content mixing is a principal functional rationale for the existence of the mitochondrial network and is experimentally demonstrated by the finding that fusion between a wild-type and a mutant mitochondrion restores oxidative phosphorylation function in heteroplasmic cells. Loss of fusion therefore accelerates the phenotypic manifestation of mtDNA mutations.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體融合透過混合健康和受損粒線體的內容物，稀釋粒線體 DNA（mtDNA）突變，從而實現個別粒線體基因體之間的功能互補。透過在互連網路中交換粒線體 DNA、蛋白質、脂質和代謝物，融合使得受損的基因體可由完整基因體的產物進行互補。這種內容混合是粒線體網路存在的主要功能原理，並透過實驗發現異質性細胞中野生型與突變粒線體的融合可恢復氧化磷酸化功能而得到證實。因此，融合的喪失會加速 mtDNA 突變的表型表現。

label: dopaminergic neurotransmission
description: Modafinil increases dopaminergic neurotransmission primarily by inhibiting the dopamine transporter (DAT), thereby elevating extracellular dopamine in the prefrontal cortex and striatum. It may also affect norepinephrine and orexin systems, contributing to its wakefulness-promoting effects. By raising dopamine tone, it interacts with the COMT-set baseline that differs by genotype, with fast COMT individuals showing greater improvement. It is approved for narcolepsy and used off-label for cognitive enhancement.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 主要透過抑制多巴胺轉運蛋白 (DAT) 來增加 dopaminergic neurotransmission，從而提高前額葉皮質和紋狀體中的細胞外多巴胺。它還可能影響 norepinephrine 和食慾素系統，從而有助於其促進覺醒的作用。透過提高多巴胺張力，它與因基因型而異的 COMT 設定基線相互作用，快速的 COMT 個體表現出更大的改善。它被批准用於 narcolepsy 並用於標籤外認知增強。

label: cognitive enhancer
description: A nootropic is by definition a cognitive-enhancing agent targeting alertness, attention or executive function. Classification covers prescription repurposing like modafinil as well as supplements.
description_zh_TW: nootropic 依定義是針對警覺、注意或執行功能的認知增強劑。歸類涵蓋如 modafinil 的處方再利用與補充劑。

label: sleep disorder
description: Narcolepsy is a chronic neurological sleep disorder of excessive daytime sleepiness with disrupted nocturnal sleep. Classification anchors it in sleep medicine rather than psychiatry.
description_zh_TW: narcolepsy 是以日間過度嗜睡與夜間睡眠中斷為特徵的慢性神經性睡眠疾患。歸類將它錨定於睡眠醫學而非精神科。

label: Orexin deficiency
description: Narcolepsy type 1 is driven by loss of orexin-producing hypothalamic neurons destabilizing sleep-wake boundaries. The association is the causal core of the disorder's pathophysiology.
description_zh_TW: 第一型 narcolepsy 由喪失下視丘食慾素神經元、破壞睡眠覺醒邊界所驅動。此關聯是疾病病理生理的因果核心。

label: G→T transversions
description: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine causes G to T transversions because the oxidized base pairs promiscuously with adenine during replication, so a G:C pair becomes an A:T pair after a round of replication and repair. These transversions are signature mutations in many cancers. The directionality is miscoding lesion to mutagenic outcome. A caveat is that accurate repair by OGG1 before replication averts most mutations, so only unrepaired lesions are mutagenic. G to T transversions are among the most frequent mutations found in oncogenes and tumor suppressors in human cancers, underscoring the relevance of this lesion.
description_zh_TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 會導致 G 到 T 顛換，因為複製過程中氧化鹼基與腺嘌呤混雜配對，因此 G:C 對經過一輪複製和修復後變成 A:T 對。這些顛換是許多 cancer 的特徵突變。方向性是將病變錯誤編碼為誘變結果。需要注意的是，複製前透過 OGG1 進行的精確修復可以避免大多數突變，因此只有未修復的損傷才具有突變性。 G 至 T 顛換是人類 cancer 癌基因和腫瘤抑制基因中最常見的突變之一，強調了這種病變的相關性。

label: PAANIB-1
source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md
description: PAANIB-1 is a brain-penetrant, selective inhibitor of the MIF (PAAN) nuclease function; it protects cells from parthanatos in a mouse model of parkinsonism, supporting MIF as a druggable terminal effector (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: PAANIB-1 是可穿透血腦屏障、選擇性抑制 MIF（PAAN）核酸酶功能的抑制劑；在帕金森氏症小鼠模型中保護細胞免於 parthanatos，支持 MIF 為可成藥的終端效應器（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: H2O2-induced cell death in cardiomyocytes
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: A finding suggests that in cardiomyocytes, SIRT5 is a key moderator in cell death induced by H2O2. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the cardiomyocyte response to oxidative stress, dampening or modulating hydrogen peroxide-induced cell death. This places SIRT5 in the cardiac stress response network and suggests that modulating SIRT5 activity could influence oxidative injury in the heart.
description_zh_TW: 一項發現表明，在心肌細胞中，SIRT5是H2O2誘導的細胞死亡的關鍵調節因子。方向上，SIRT5位於心肌細胞對氧化壓力反應的上游，抑制或調節過氧化氫誘導的細胞死亡。這將SIRT5置於心臟壓力反應網路中，並表明調節SIRT5活性可能影響心臟的氧化損傷。

label: HCC growth and metastasis via glycolysis reprogramming
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Activation of mitochondrial SIRT5 promotes the growth and metastasis of hepatocellular carcinoma cells via glucose metabolism reprogramming from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the glycolytic switch that fuels liver cancer progression. By favoring glycolysis, SIRT5 supplies the biosynthetic and bioenergetic demands of rapidly growing HCC cells, supporting tumor aggressiveness. This oncogenic role is opposed by SIRT5's bile-acid-metabolism-mediated suppression of HCC, underscoring the dual, context-dependent functions of SIRT5 in liver cancer.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體SIRT5的活化透過從氧化磷酸化到糖解作用的葡萄糖代謝重編程促進肝細胞癌細胞的生長和轉移。方向上，SIRT5位於驅動肝癌進展的糖解轉換的上游。透過有利於糖解作用，SIRT5為快速生長的HCC細胞提供生物合成和生物能量需求，支持腫瘤的侵襲性。此致癌角色與SIRT5透過膽汁酸代謝介導的HCC抑制相對抗，突顯了SIRT5在肝癌中的雙重、環境依賴性功能。

label: cellular energy metabolism and AMPK activity under energy stress
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: As a result of energy stress, SIRT5 modulates cellular energy metabolism and AMP-activated protein kinase activity. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of metabolic adaptation and AMPK activation during energy deprivation. By influencing energy metabolism and engaging AMPK signalling, SIRT5 helps cells maintain energy homeostasis under stress conditions, linking mitochondrial deacylation to the cellular energy sensing network.
description_zh_TW: 作為能量壓力的結果，SIRT5調節細胞能量代謝和AMP活化蛋白激酶活性。方向上，SIRT5位於能量剝奪期間代謝適應和AMPK活化的上游。透過影響能量代謝並參與AMPK訊號，SIRT5幫助細胞在壓力條件下維持能量恆定，將粒線體去醯基化與細胞能量感知網路聯繫起來。

label: FOXO3a in lung epithelial cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In lung epithelial cells, SIRT5-mediated deacetylation of Forkhead protein FOXO3a inhibits apoptosis induced by cigarette smoke extract. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of FOXO3a deacetylation and reduced apoptosis under cigarette smoke stress. By dampening FOXO3a-driven pro-apoptotic signalling, SIRT5 helps lung epithelial cells survive the toxic effects of cigarette smoke, with potential relevance to smoking-related lung pathology.
description_zh_TW: 在肺上皮細胞中，SIRT5介導的Foxhead蛋白FOXO3a的去乙醯化抑制香菸煙霧提取物誘導的凋亡。方向上，SIRT5位於香菸煙霧壓力下FOXO3a去乙醯化和凋亡減少的上游。透過抑制FOXO3a驅動的促凋亡訊號，SIRT5幫助肺上皮細胞在香菸煙霧的毒性作用下存活，可能與吸煙相關的肺部病理相關。

label: IDH2 (via desuccinylation)
description: SIRT5 activates IDH2 through desuccinylation, enhancing its NADPH-producing activity and thereby supporting glutathione reduction and ROS scavenging. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of IDH2-dependent redox buffering. This complements SOD1 activation in antioxidant defense, and it shows SIRT5's desuccinylation broadly strengthens reductive capacity. By boosting NADPH production, SIRT5 ensures sufficient reducing equivalents for glutathione and thioredoxin systems. This regulation links SIRT5 to both energy metabolism and redox homeostasis, particularly during fasting when oxidative stress rises.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯化活化 IDH2，增強其 NADPH 產生活性，從而支持穀胱甘肽還原和 ROS 清除。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於 IDH2 依賴性紅氧緩衝的上游。這與 SOD1 活化在抗氧化防禦中互補，並表明 SIRT5 的去琥珀醯化廣泛增強還原能力。透過增強 NADPH 產生，SIRT5 確保穀胱甘肽和硫氧還蛋白系統有足夠的還原當量。此調控將 SIRT5 與能量代謝和紅氧恆定性聯繫起來，特別是在禁食期間氧化壓力升高時。

label: VLCAD, LCAD, MCAD, ECHA (fatty acid oxidation)
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: SIRT5 activates multiple fatty acid beta-oxidation enzymes through desuccinylation, including very-long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (VLCAD), long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (LCAD), medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (MCAD), and the alpha subunit of enoyl-CoA hydratase (ECHA). Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatic activation of these enzymes sits upstream of enhanced lipid catabolism. Deficiency of SIRT5 compromises fatty acid metabolism, leading to acylcarnitine accumulation and decreased ATP production.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過去琥珀醯化作用活化多種脂肪酸β-氧化酶，包括極長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（VLCAD）、長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（LCAD）、中鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（MCAD）和烯醯CoA水合酶的α亞基（ECHA）。方向上，SIRT5對這些酶的酵素活化位於脂質分解代謝增強的上游。SIRT5的缺乏損害脂肪酸代謝，導致醯基肉鹼積累和ATP產量減少。

label: SOD1 (via desuccinylation)
description: SIRT5 activates superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) through desuccinylation, enhancing NADPH production and glutathione recycling for ROS detoxification. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates SOD1. This bolsters cytosolic antioxidant capacity, and it extends SIRT5's protective actions beyond the mitochondria's own enzymes. By promoting NADPH generation and glutathione recycling, SOD1 activation supports the detoxification of superoxide and the maintenance of redox balance. This antioxidant function complements SIRT5's metabolic roles and contributes to cellular protection against oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯化活化超氧化物歧化酶 1（SOD1），增強 NADPH 產生和穀胱甘肽回收以進行 ROS 解毒。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化 SOD1。這增強了細胞質抗氧化能力，並將 SIRT5 的保護作用延伸到粒線體自身酶之外。透過促進 NADPH 產生和穀胱甘肽回收，SOD1 活化支持超氧陰離子的解毒和紅氧平衡的維護。這種抗氧化功能與 SIRT5 的代謝角色互補，並有助於細胞對抗氧化壓力的保護。

label: Nrf2/HO-1-mediated ROS suppression
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 can promote cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner via regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of reduced ROS, diminished DNA damage, and enhanced survival of ovarian cancer cells treated with cisplatin. By activating Nrf2/HO-1-dependent antioxidant defense, SIRT5 protects ovarian cancer cells from platinum-induced damage, contributing to chemoresistance. This contrasts with SIRT2, whose overexpression enhances cisplatin sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5可以透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷來促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於接受順鉑治療的卵巢癌細胞中ROS降低、DNA損傷減少和存活增強的上游。透過活化Nrf2/HO-1依賴性抗氧化防禦，SIRT5保護卵巢癌細胞免受鉑誘導的損傷，促成化療耐藥性。這與過表達增強耐藥卵巢癌細胞順鉑敏感性的SIRT2形成對比。

label: CPS1 (Carbamoyl-phosphate synthetase 1)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 deacetylates (and desuccinylates) carbamoyl-phosphate synthetase 1 (CPS1), the rate-limiting urea-cycle enzyme, enhancing ammonia detoxification; SIRT5-KO mice show elevated blood ammonia under fasting (Nakagawa et al., 2009, Cell 137:560-570, PMID 19410549; Du et al., 2011, Science 334:806-809, PMID 22076378).
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去乙醯化（並去琥珀酰化）氨甲醯磷酸合成酶 1（CPS1）——尿素循環的限速酶——增強氨解毒；SIRT5-KO 小鼠在禁食時顯示血氨升高（Nakagawa et al., 2009, Cell 137:560-570, PMID 19410549; Du et al., 2011, Science 334:806-809, PMID 22076378）。

label: IDH2 and SDHA (TCA cycle)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates TCA-cycle enzymes IDH2 and SDHA, tuning their activity and coordinating mitochondrial energy metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically modulates TCA flux. This helps match oxidation to demand during fasting or stress, and it reinforces SIRT5's role as a central mitochondrial metabolic regulator. By adjusting the activity of key TCA-cycle enzymes, SIRT5 balances carbon entry, ATP production, and the supply of reducing equivalents. This regulation supports the metabolic flexibility that allows cells to adapt fuel utilization to nutrient availability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化 TCA 循環酶 IDH2 和 SDHA，調節其活性並協調粒線體能量代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式調節 TCA 通量。這有助於在禁食或壓力期間使氧化與需求匹配，並強化 SIRT5 作為核心粒線體代謝調節因子的角色。透過調整關鍵 TCA 循環酶的活性，SIRT5 平衡碳的進入、ATP 產生和還原當量的供應。此調控支持使細胞能根據營養可用性調整燃料利用的代謝靈活性。

label: urea cycle
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates CPS1, the rate-limiting urea-cycle enzyme, enhancing ammonia detoxification during fasting; SIRT5-knockout mice show elevated blood ammonia under nitrogen load.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀酰化並活化 CPS1——尿素循環的限速酶——增強禁食期間的氨解毒；SIRT5 敲除小鼠在氮負荷下顯示血氨升高。

label: HMGCS2 (ketogenesis)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates HMGCS2 (3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA synthase 2), the rate-limiting enzyme of ketone-body synthesis, supporting energy production during fasting. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates HMGCS2. This promotes ketogenesis when carbohydrate is scarce, and it is a fasting-adaptive function of SIRT5. By enabling ketone-body production from acetyl-CoA, SIRT5 supports the brain and other tissues during prolonged fasting. This regulation complements SIRT5's activation of urea-cycle and fatty-acid-oxidation enzymes, positioning SIRT5 as a coordinator of catabolic metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化並活化 HMGCS2（3-羥基-3-甲基戊二醯-CoA 合酶 2）——酮體合成的限速酶——在禁食期間支持能量產生。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化 HMGCS2。這在碳水化合物稀缺時促進酮體生成，是 SIRT5 的禁食適應性功能。透過使酮體能從乙醯-CoA 產生，SIRT5 在長期禁食期間支持大腦和其他組織。此調控與 SIRT5 對尿素循環和脂肪酸氧化酶的活化互補，將 SIRT5 定位為分解代謝的協調者。

label: CPS1 (carbamoyl phosphate synthase 1)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates carbamoyl phosphate synthase 1 (CPS1), the rate-limiting enzyme of the urea cycle, enhancing ammonia detoxification into urea. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates CPS1. This is especially important during fasting or high-protein load when nitrogen must be cleared, and SIRT5-deficient mice show elevated ammonia under such conditions. It exemplifies SIRT5's role as a regulator of mitochondrial acyl-metabolism and nitrogen homeostasis, and complements its activation of HMGCS2, fatty-acid oxidation enzymes, and TCA-cycle dehydrogenases, positioning SIRT5 as a coordinator of catabolic flux during nutrient scarcity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化並活化氨甲酰磷酸合成酶 1（CPS1），這是尿素循環的限速酶，增強氨解毒為尿素。在方向性上，SIRT5 在酶學上活化 CPS1。這在禁食或高蛋白負荷期間（需要清除氮時）尤為重要，SIRT5 缺乏的小鼠在這種條件下顯示升高的氨。它例示了 SIRT5 作為粒線體醯基代謝和氮穩態調節者的角色，並與其對 HMGCS2、脂肪酸氧化酶和 TCA 循環脫氫酶的活化互補，將 SIRT5 定位為營養匱乏期間分解代謝通量的協調者。

label: LCAD and ACADS (fatty acid β-oxidation)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates multiple fatty-acid β-oxidation enzymes including LCAD and ACADS, coordinating mitochondrial lipid catabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates these acyl-CoA dehydrogenases. This supports energy harvest from fat, and it exemplifies SIRT5's broad desuccinylase control of metabolism. By activating the enzymes of β-oxidation, SIRT5 promotes the use of fatty acids as fuel, particularly during fasting. This catabolic role aligns SIRT5 with SIRT3 in supporting lipid oxidation, in contrast to SIRT4's inhibition of the same pathways.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化多種脂肪酸 β-氧化酶，包括 LCAD 和 ACADS，協調粒線體脂質分解代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化這些醯基-CoA 脫氫酶。這支持從脂肪獲取能量，並體現了 SIRT5 對代謝的廣泛去琥醯化酶控制。透過活化 β-氧化酶，SIRT5 促進脂肪酸作為燃料的使用，特別是在禁食期間。這種分解代謝角色使 SIRT5 與 SIRT3 在支持脂質氧化方面一致，與 SIRT4 對相同途徑的抑制形成對比。

label: GLS (glutaminase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 inhibits glutaminase (GLS) via desuccinylation, suppressing glutaminolysis in cancer metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化抑制穀氨醯胺酶（GLS），抑制癌症代謝中的穀氨醯胺分解。

label: Preadipocyte differentiation
description: SIRT5 inhibits preadipocyte differentiation and lipid deposition by activating AMPK and repressing MAPK signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of suppressed adipogenesis. This keeps progenitors from becoming lipid-laden fat cells and positions mitochondrial SIRT5 as a negative regulator of fat accumulation. The AMPK arm likely raises NAD+ and reinforces catabolic metabolism, while MAPK repression blocks the mitogenic signaling required for adipocyte maturation. SIRT5's anti-adipogenic function is consistent with the sirtuin family's general opposition to lipid storage and its promotion of oxidative metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 通過活化 AMPK 並抑制 MAPK 信號通路來抑制前脂肪細胞分化和脂質沉積。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於被抑制的脂肪生成的上游。這防止前體細胞成為富含脂質的脂肪細胞，將粒線體 SIRT5 定位為脂肪累積的負調節因子。AMPK 分支可能提高 NAD+ 並強化分解代謝，而 MAPK 抑制阻斷脂肪細胞成熟所需的促有絲分裂信號。SIRT5 的抗脂肪生成功能與 sirtuin 家族對脂質儲存的一般反對和對氧化代謝的促進一致。

label: AMPK (preadipocyte differentiation)
description: SIRT5 inhibits preadipocyte differentiation by activating AMPK and repressing MAPK signaling, analogous to its broader adipogenesis-blocking role. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of AMPK activation in adipogenic progenitors. Activated AMPK shifts cells away from lipogenesis and toward catabolism, while MAPK repression blocks the proliferative signals needed for adipocyte maturation. It reaffirms SIRT5 as a negative regulator of fat formation, and it is consistent with the general anti-adipogenic theme across sirtuins. By restraining adipocyte differentiation, SIRT5 contributes to the maintenance of metabolic flexibility and the prevention of excessive fat accumulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過活化 AMPK 並抑制 MAPK 訊號來抑制前脂肪細胞分化，類似於其更廣泛的脂肪生成阻斷角色。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於脂肪生成前體細胞中 AMPK 活化的上游。活化的 AMPK 使細胞從脂肪生成轉向分解代謝，而 MAPK 抑制阻斷脂肪細胞成熟所需的增殖訊號。它再次確認 SIRT5 作為脂肪形成的負調節因子，與 sirtuin 整體的抗脂肪生成主題一致。透過抑制脂肪細胞分化，SIRT5 有助於維護代謝靈活性和預防過度脂肪積累。

label: breast tumor, HCC, and NSCLC cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5 is important in the growth of breast tumour cells, hepatocellular carcinoma, and human non-small cell lung cancer tissues. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of tumour growth in these cancer types, and its overexpression indicates a poor prognosis in human non-small cell lung cancer. SIRT5 thereby acts as a tumour-promoting factor in breast cancer, HCC, and lung cancer, making it a candidate therapeutic target.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5在乳腺腫瘤細胞、肝細胞癌和人類非小細胞肺癌組織的生長中很重要。方向上，SIRT5位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤生長的上游，其過表達在人類非小細胞肺癌中預示不良預後。因此SIRT5在乳腺癌、HCC和肺癌中作為促腫瘤因子，使其成為候選治療靶點。

label: Phylogenetic Class III (prokaryotic origin)
description: SIRT5 is the sole mammalian member of phylogenetic Class III, a group distributed widely across prokaryotes, marking it as one of the most ancient mammalian sirtuins. Directionally, this is an evolutionary classification. Its prokaryotic origin aligns with SIRT5's fundamental mitochondrial metabolic functions, and this situates SIRT5 at the root of sirtuin biology. Because Class III sirtuins predate the eukaryotic sirtuins, SIRT5's desuccinylase activity may represent an ancestral enzymatic function retained through evolution. SIRT5's phylogenetic position helps explain its resistance to nicotinamide inhibition and its distinct substrate preferences.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 是系統發育 III 類唯一的哺乳動物成員，該類群廣泛分布於原核生物中，標誌著它是最古老的哺乳動物 sirtuin 之一。在方向性上，這是演化分類。其原核生物起源與 SIRT5 基本的粒線體代謝功能一致，並將 SIRT5 置於 sirtuin 生物學的根源。由於 III 類 sirtuin 先於真核 sirtuin，SIRT5 的去琥珀醯酶活性可能代表一種通過演化保留的祖先酶功能。SIRT5 的系統發育位置有助於解釋其對菸鹼醯胺抑制的抗性和其獨特的底物偏好。

label: SHMT2 desuccinylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5 is upregulated during cellular transformation and is involved in cancer and its proliferation by desuccinylating serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (SHMT2). Directionally, SIRT5 desuccinylation of SHMT2 sits upstream of enhanced one-carbon metabolism and cancer cell proliferation. By activating SHMT2, SIRT5 supports the biosynthetic demands of proliferating cancer cells, contributing to tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5在細胞轉化期間上調，並透過去琥珀醯化絲氨酸羥甲基轉移酶2（SHMT2）參與癌症及其增殖。方向上，SIRT5對SHMT2的去琥珀醯化位於一碳代謝增強和癌細胞增殖的上游。透過活化SHMT2，SIRT5支持增殖癌細胞的生物合成需求，促成腫瘤發生。

label: ammonia detoxification
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 mediates ammonia detoxification by activating CPS1 in the urea cycle, converting ammonia to urea; this is critical during fasting and high-protein load when nitrogen must be cleared.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過在尿素循環中活化 CPS1 來調介氨解毒，將氨轉化為尿素；這在禁食和高蛋白負荷期間至關重要，因為此時必須清除氮。

label: intracellular signaling
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 participates in intracellular signaling by deacylating metabolic enzymes and transcription-linked targets (e.g., FOXO3a, SOD1) and by modulating AMPK, linking mitochondrial acylation state to cellular signaling and redox responses.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去酰基化代謝酶和轉錄相關靶點（例如 FOXO3a、SOD1）以及調節 AMPK 來參與細胞內信號傳導，將粒線體酰化狀態與細胞信號和氧化還原反應聯繫起來。

label: bile acid metabolism orchestration
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 prevents tumor immune evasion and suppresses the development of hepatocellular carcinoma by orchestrating bile acid metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of anti-tumor immunity and restrained HCC growth. By shaping the bile acid milieu, SIRT5 influences the immune microenvironment of the liver tumor, reducing the ability of HCC to evade immune destruction. This tumor-suppressive metabolic function contrasts with SIRT5's glycolysis-reprogramming role that can promote HCC growth, reflecting SIRT5's context-dependent effects in liver cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過協調膽汁酸代謝來預防腫瘤免疫逃逸並抑制肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT5位於抗腫瘤免疫和HCC生長抑制的上游。透過塑造膽汁酸環境，SIRT5影響肝腫瘤的免疫微環境，降低HCC逃避免疫破壞的能力。此腫瘤抑制性代謝功能與SIRT5促進HCC生長的糖解重編程角色形成對比，反映了SIRT5在肝癌中的環境依賴性效果。

label: Nrf2/HO-1 pathway (ovarian cancer)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 promotes cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner through regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of Nrf2-mediated chemoresistance. By activating this antioxidant program, SIRT5 helps cancer cells neutralize the reactive oxygen species that contribute to cisplatin-induced DNA damage. This reduces the genotoxic burden of the drug and blunts its cytotoxicity, allowing tumor cells to survive treatment. Inhibiting SIRT5, therefore, could re-sensitize ovarian cancer cells to cisplatin by dismantling their antioxidant defenses.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1（HO-1）通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷，從而促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於Nrf2介導的化療耐藥性的上游。透過活化此抗氧化程序，SIRT5幫助癌細胞中和促成順鉑誘導的DNA損傷的活性氧。這降低了藥物的基因毒性負荷並削弱其細胞毒性，使腫瘤細胞能够在治療中存活。因此抑制SIRT5可能透過瓦解其抗氧化防禦來使卵巢癌細胞對順鉑重新敏感。

label: ATP synthesis regulation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 supports ATP synthesis by desuccinylating electron-transport and TCA-cycle enzymes, maintaining mitochondrial function; its loss compromises energy production under metabolic stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化電子傳輸和 TCA 循環酶來支持 ATP 合成，維持粒線體功能；其缺失在代謝壓力下損害能量產生。

label: Tofersen
description: Tofersen (Qalsody) is an intrathecal antisense oligonucleotide against SOD1 mRNA, approved April 2023 on biomarker grounds (plasma NfL −55%) for SOD1-ALS and now tested presymptomatically in the ATLAS trial — the first precision neurodegenerative therapy.
description_zh_TW: Tofersen（Qalsody）是針對 SOD1 mRNA 的鞘內反義寡核苷酸，2023 年 4 月依生物標記（血漿 NfL −55%）獲准用於 SOD1-ALS，現於 ATLAS 試驗中做症狀前測試——是第一個精準神經退化療法。

label: CPT2
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates carnitine palmitoyltransferase 2 in diabetic cardiomyopathy (Wu 2024), regulating fatty-acid oxidation. The desuccinylates predicate matches existing SIRT5-LDHB usage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 在糖尿病心肌病中去琥珀醯化 carnitine palmitoyltransferase 2（Wu 2024），調節脂肪酸氧化。desuccinylates 謂詞沿用既有的 SIRT5-LDHB 用法。

label: TRAF6
source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md
description: The ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 axis drives ASAP signaling: ATM activates TRAF6, which undergoes auto-ubiquitination and recruits TAK1 to propagate stress and inflammatory signals. TAK1 in turn activates p38 MAPK and NF-kB downstream, linking DNA damage sensing to SASP transcription. This axis is a conserved scaffold connecting genotoxic stress to senescence inflammation and operates upstream of the established SASP regulatory network. The ATM-dependent TRAF6 activation illustrates how a DNA-damage kinase directly engages innate immune signaling machinery to initiate the senescent inflammatory program.
description_zh_TW: ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 軸驅動 ASAP 訊號：ATM 活化 TRAF6，TRAF6 經歷自動泛素化並招募 TAK1 以傳播壓力與發炎訊號。TAK1 反過來活化 p38 MAPK 與下游 NF-κB，將 DNA 損傷感知連結到 SASP 轉錄。此軸是連接基因毒性壓力到衰老發炎的保守支架，並作用於已建立 SASP 調節網絡上游。ATM 依賴的 TRAF6 活化說明 DNA 損傷激酶如何直接參與先天免疫訊號機器以啟動衰老發炎程序。

label: TXNDC5
description: TXNDC5 is an ER-localized thioredoxin-family chaperone that synergizes with HSPA8 (HSC70) to exacerbate the inflammatory phenotype of synovial fibroblasts via NF-kB signaling. Because HSPA8 is the bridge node apigenin disrupts, TXNDC5-HSPA8 cooperativity is relevant to SASP suppression.
description_zh_TW: TXNDC5 是 ER 定位的硫氧還蛋白家族伴護蛋白，與 HSPA8（HSC70）協同，經由 NF-κB 訊號加劇滑膜纖維母細胞的發炎表現型。由於 HSPA8 是 apigenin 破壞的橋接節點，TXNDC5-HSPA8 協同與 SASP 壓制相關。

label: Adenosine-binding site with SIRT2
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site with sirtuins such as SIRT2, an overlap exploited by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins as a drug-discovery strategy. This shared adenosine pocket allows scaffolds like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 and the indolinone GW5074 to engage both families, inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range while retaining kinase activity. Directionally, the enzyme superfamily of Kinase proteins and sirtuin deacetylases both rely on an adenosine-binding pocket, explaining the cross-reactivity between kinase-inhibitor scaffolds and sirtuins. This structural convergence frames interpretation of kinase-inhibitor effects in sirtuin biology.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶與 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點，這種重疊被利用來篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 的活性，作為一種藥物發現策略。這種共享的腺嘌呤口袋允許如雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮 GW5074 等骨架與兩個家族結合，在低微摩爾範圍內抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 的同時保留激酶活性。方向性上激酶蛋白的酶超家族和 sirtuin 去乙醯酶都依賴腺嘌呤結合口袋，解釋了激酶抑制劑骨架和 sirtuin 之間的交叉反應性。這種結構上的匯聚為詮釋激酶抑制劑在 sirtuin 生物學中的效應提供了框架。

label: Phosphatase
description: Phosphatases remove phosphate groups, reversing kinase action.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸酶移除磷酸基團，逆轉激酶作用。

label: SARS-CoV-2 Nsp3
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: The ADP-ribosylhydrolase macrodomain of the viral nonstructural protein nsp3 reverses the antiviral effect of PARPs, which is required for inhibition of viral replication during infection, and the activity of nsp3 is itself required for SARS-CoV-2 virulence. By removing mono-ADP-ribose (MARylation) marks deposited on viral proteins by IFN-induced PARP activation, nsp3 counteracts the host's antiviral ADP-ribosylation response. These events occur within the infected cell's NAD+ metabolome, and boosting NAD+ content through nicotinamide riboside and nicotinamide kinase pathways may restore antiviral PARP functions to support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2.
description_zh_TW: 病毒非結構蛋白 nsp3 的 ADP-ribosylhydrolase（ADP-核糖水解酶）macrodomain 逆轉了 PARPs 的抗病毒效果，而後者為感染期間抑制病毒複製所必需，且 nsp3 的活性本身為 SARS-CoV-2 毒力所必需。透過移除由 IFN 誘發的 PARP 活化沉積在病毒蛋白上的 mono-ADP-ribose（MARylation，單-ADP-核糖）標記，nsp3 抵銷了宿主的抗病毒 ADP-ribosylation（ADP-核糖基化）反應。這些事件發生在被感染細胞的 NAD+ 代謝組內，而透過 nicotinamide riboside 與 nicotinamide 激酶路徑提升 NAD+ 含量可能恢復抗病毒 PARP 功能，以支援對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫。

label: OAADPr
description: OAADPr (2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose) binds to the cytoplasmic N-terminal domain of the TRPM2 non-selective cation channel, promoting its opening and calcium influx into the cytosol. Because OAADPr is generated directly by sirtuin deacetylase activity, TRPM2 activation acts as a sensor of cellular sirtuin flux and NAD+ utilization. The directionality is unidirectional under basal conditions: sirtuin activity produces OAADPr, which then gates TRPM2, rather than TRPM2 regulating sirtuins. This coupling provides a mechanistic link between metabolic state, redox stress, and calcium-dependent processes such as insulin secretion and apoptotic signaling.
description_zh_TW: OAADPr（2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose）結合到 TRPM2 非選擇性陽離子通道的細胞質 N 端結構域，促進其開放和鈣離子流入細胞質。由於 OAADPr 是直接由 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性產生的，TRPM2 的活化充當了細胞 sirtuin 通量和 NAD+ 利用率的感測器。在基礎條件下，這種方向性是單向的：sirtuin 活性產生 OAADPr，然後開啟 TRPM2，而非 TRPM2 調節 sirtuin。這種偶聯提供了代謝狀態、氧化還原壓力與鈣離子依賴性過程（如胰島素分泌和細胞凋亡訊號傳導）之間的機制性聯繫。

label: High-AGE diet
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: In a study of three groups of mice fed a caloric restriction (CR) diet, a regular diet, or a CR diet high in AGEs, CR mice lived longer than regular or CR-high mice, with median and maximal survival increased by 13.2% and 6%, respectively. Survival in CR-high mice was shorter than in regular-fed mice, and the CR-high group showed significantly increased oxidative stress and accelerated aging-related cardiovascular and renal disease. High dietary AGEs thus compete with the benefits of caloric restriction, indicating that the AGE content of the diet modulates lifespan.
description_zh_TW: 在一項針對三組小鼠的研究中，分別餵食熱量限制（CR）飲食、一般飲食或高 AGE 的 CR 飲食，CR 小鼠比一般或 CR-高 AGE 小鼠活得更久，中位與最大存活分別增加 13.2% 與 6%。CR-高 AGE 小鼠的存活短於一般飲食小鼠，且 CR-高 AGE 組顯示氧化壓力顯著增加與加速老化的心血管及腎臟疾病。因此，高飲食性 AGE 與熱量限制的好處相抗衡，顯示飲食的 AGE 含量會調節壽命。

label: NAD+/NADH redox imbalance
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: The hallmark hyperglycemia of diabetes mellitus causes a redox imbalance between NAD+ and NADH that can lead to oxidative stress and a variety of metabolic syndromes. In cells whose glucose uptake is not insulin-dependent, glucose oversupply leads to NADH overproduction by both the conventional glucose combustion pathways (glycolysis and the Krebs cycle) and the polyol pathway. This NAD+/NADH imbalance, also known as pseudohypoxia, initially causes reductive stress and mitochondrial overload and dysfunction, which lead to oxidative stress and oxidative damage to DNA, lipids, and proteins. Additionally, PARP overactivation depletes NAD+, and this redox imbalance is a major factor contributing to the development of diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: 糖尿病的標誌性高血糖造成 NAD+ 與 NADH 之間的氧化還原失衡，可能導致氧化壓力與多種代謝症候群。在葡萄糖攝取不依賴胰島素的細胞中，葡萄糖過量供給透過傳統的葡萄糖燃燒路徑（糖解作用與克氏循環）以及多元醇路徑導致 NADH 過度生成。這種 NAD+/NADH 失衡，亦稱為假性缺氧，最初造成還原壓力與粒線體超載及功能障礙，進而導致氧化壓力以及對 DNA、脂質與蛋白質的氧化損傷。此外，PARP 過度活化耗竭 NAD+，而此氧化還原失衡是促成糖尿病併發症發展的主要因素。

label: AGE inhibition
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: The inhibition of AGE formation and accumulation in tissues can lead to an increase in lifespan, as concluded from extensive evidence that AGE accumulation accompanies aging and age-related diseases. Because there are no enzymes to remove glycated products, AGEs accumulate as metabolic waste and contribute to tissue senescence. Inhibiting the glycation process and removing existing glycation products may prolong lifespan, and dietary herbal supplements or physiological exercise are advantageous in reducing the AGE burden in the body.
description_zh_TW: 抑制組織中 AGE 的形成與堆積可導致壽命延長，此結論源自大量證據顯示 AGE 堆積伴隨老化與老化相關疾病。由於體內缺乏可移除糖化產物的酵素，AGEs 便作為代謝廢物堆積並促進組織衰老。抑制糖化過程並清除既有的糖化產物或可延長壽命，而飲食草本補充劑或生理性運動則有利於減輕體內的 AGE 負擔。

label: RUNX1-KMT2A Epigenetic Program
description: Transient hyperglycemia exacerbates immune training and alone induces low-level TRIM with glycolysis-gene transcription; inhibition of KMT2A histone writers curbs TNF training. Diabetic training is centrally imprinted and adoptively transferable through RUNX1-dependent myeloid reprogramming, promoting atherosclerosis. It underlies the concept of hyperglycemic memory.
description_zh_TW: 短暫 Hyperglycemia 可加劇 immune training，單獨即可誘導低程度 TRIM 並轉錄 glycolysis 基因；抑制 KMT2A histone writers 可減弱 TNF 訓練。糖尿病訓練是 centrally imprinted，可經由 RUNX1-dependent myeloid reprogramming 被 adoptively transfer，並促進 atherosclerosis。這是 hyperglycemic memory 概念的基礎。

label: Proline
description: At 25 mM NaCl, proline content rose modestly by 5.7% while catalase activity, lipid peroxidation, and H2O2 content did not change significantly. This indicates an adaptive osmoprotectant response without overt oxidative damage. Higher salt doses broke this balance and triggered marked oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: 25 mM NaCl 使 proline 含量適度上升 5.7%，而 catalase 活性、脂質過氧化與 H2O2 含量無顯著變化。這顯示滲透保護適應反應啟動，但尚未出現明顯氧化損傷。更高鹽劑量打破此平衡並引發顯著氧化壓力。

label: Antioxidant Capacity
description: At 25 mM NaCl, total antioxidant activity rose 38.1%, DPPH-scavenging 6.0%, total phenols 8.8%, ascorbic acid 37.5%, and carotenoids 11.5% in sunflower microgreens. Moderate and severe salt levels had opposite (suppressive) effects. Salt eustress thus functions as a cost-effective elicitor of antioxidant quality.
description_zh_TW: 25 mM NaCl 使向日葵苗菜總抗氧化活性上升 38.1%、DPPH 清除率 6.0%、總酚 8.8%、抗壞血酸 37.5%、類胡蘿蔔素 11.5%。中重度鹽濃度則有相反（抑制）效應。因此鹽 eustress 可作為提升抗氧化品質的簡便低成本誘導手段。

label: Nutritional Quality
description: Eustress at 25 mM NaCl increased total carbohydrates by 27.2%, total proteins by 27.6%, plus Ca, Mg, Mn, Zn (11.9-14.3%) and linoleic acid (5.0%) in sunflower microgreens. These gains co-occurred with yield increases rather than trading off against them. The authors conclude low-dose salt improves both yield and nutritional value.
description_zh_TW: 25 mM NaCl 的 eustress 使向日葵苗菜總碳水化合物增加 27.2%、總蛋白增加 27.6%，另有 Ca、Mg、Mn、Zn（11.9-14.3%）與亞麻油酸（5.0%）提升。這些增益與產量增加同時發生而非相互取捨。作者結論為低劑量鹽同時改善產量與營養價值。

label: Distress
description: Moderate and severe salt levels of 75 and 100 mM NaCl significantly reduced sunflower microgreen growth parameters. Higher salt levels also induced marked oxidative stress, opposite to the 25 mM eustress response. This marks the toxic limb of the salt dose-response curve.
description_zh_TW: 75 與 100 mM 的中重度鹽濃度顯著降低向日葵苗菜生長參數。較高鹽濃度亦引起明顯氧化壓力，與 25 mM eustress 反應相反。這標誌著鹽劑量反應曲線的毒性支。

label: ARNT
description: ARNT (HIF-1β) is the obligate heterodimerization partner of HIF-1α; together they form the active HIF-1 transcription factor complex that mediates the cellular response to hypoxia. ARNT provides the bHLH and PAS domains that pair with HIF-1α to drive hypoxic gene expression.
description_zh_TW: ARNT（HIF-1β）是 HIF-1α 的必需異源二聚化夥伴；兩者共同組成介導細胞低氧反應的活性 HIF-1 轉錄因子複合體。ARNT 提供與 HIF-1α 配對以驅動低氧基因表現的 bHLH 與 PAS 結構域。

label: Intermittent Hypoxia
description: Controlled intermittent mild hypoxia stabilizes HIF-1alpha driving EPO, antioxidant and BDNF programs (Li 2024). ASCII spelling matches the existing induces-HIF-1alpha edge.
description_zh_TW: 受控間歇輕度缺氧穩定 HIF-1alpha，驅動 EPO、抗氧化與 BDNF 程序（Li 2024）。ASCII 拼寫沿用既有的 induces-HIF-1alpha 邊。

label: p62/SQSTM1
description: The LIR motif (LC3-interacting region) is a short linear sequence found in autophagy receptors including p62/SQSTM1. It mediates direct binding to ATG8-family proteins such as LC3, tethering ubiquitinated cargo into the autophagosome.
description_zh_TW: LIR 模體（LC3 交互作用區）是存在於包括 p62/SQSTM1 在內之自噬受體的短線性序列。它介導與 LC3 等 ATG8 家族蛋白的直接結合，將泛素化貨物繫入自噬體。

label: Atg4
description: Atg4 cysteine protease cleaves the C-terminal extension of Atg8 to expose glycine, enabling phosphatidylethanolamine conjugation. Processing is the prerequisite for lipidation.
description_zh_TW: Atg4 半胱氨酸蛋白酶切割 Atg8 C 端延伸以暴露甘胺酸，使磷脂醯乙醇胺接合得以進行。加工是脂化的先決條件。

label: Inner Mitochondrial Membrane
description: Proton leak is the passive return of protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane, bypassing ATP synthase. Localization defines the chemiosmotic short-circuit.
description_zh_TW: 質子漏是質子跨內粒線體膜的被動回流，繞過 ATP 合酶。定位定義化學滲透短路。

label: UCP3
description: Muscle proton leak is partly set by UCP3 expression levels. Regulation tunes uncoupling to fiber-type energy demand.
description_zh_TW: 肌肉質子漏部分由 UCP3 表現水平設定。調節將去偶聯調至肌纖維能量需求。

label: methyl trap
description: Hydroxocobalamin avoids the methyl trap, the sequestration of folate as 5-methyl-THF when methionine synthase cannot remethylate homocysteine, because as a non-methylated B12 precursor it does not directly add methyl groups and supports conversion to active B12 cofactors as needed. It is converted intracellularly to methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin according to demand, providing flexible B12 repletion. This mitigates the mood swings sometimes attributed to direct methylcobalamin loading in sensitive individuals. It thus supports both methylation and mitochondrial pathways without forcing methyl donation.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 避免了 methyl trap，即當甲硫氨酸合成酶無法再甲基化同型半胱氨酸時，folate 被封存為 5-甲基-THF，因為作為非甲基化 B12 前體，它不會直接添加 methyl groups，並支持根據需要轉換為活性 B12 輔因子。它根據需要在細胞內轉化為甲基鈷胺素和腺苷鈷胺素，提供靈活的 B12 補充。這可以減輕敏感個體有時因直接服用甲鈷胺而引起的情緒波動。因此，它支持甲基化和粒線體途徑，而不強迫甲基捐贈。

label: non-methylated B12 form for slow COMT
description: Hydroxocobalamin is a non-methylated B12 form recommended for slow COMT individuals because it does not impose an immediate methyl load the way methylcobalamin does. By serving as a convertible precursor rather than a direct methyl donor, it allows physiological regulation of methylcobalamin generation according to cellular need. This reduces the risk of methyl-related mood sensitivity such as irritability or anxiety in slow COMT genotypes. It remains fully capable of supporting methylation once converted, but in a titrated manner.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是一種非甲基化 B12 形式，推薦用於慢速 COMT 個體，因為它不會像甲鈷胺那樣立即施加甲基負荷。透過充當可轉換的前體而不是直接的 methyl donor，它可以根據細胞需求對甲鈷胺生成進行生理調節。這降低了甲基相關情緒敏感性的風險，例如易怒或 anxiety in slow COMT 基因型。一旦轉化，它仍然完全能夠支持甲基化，但以滴定的方式。

label: precursor to active B12 forms
description: Hydroxocobalamin is a precursor to the two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12, methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin, being intracellularly reduced and alkylated to whichever coenzyme is required. This makes it a versatile B12 source that supports both the methylation cycle, via methylcobalamin for methionine synthase, and mitochondrial energy metabolism, via adenosylcobalamin for methylmalonyl-CoA mutase. Its precursor status distinguishes it from the directly active methyl-donating form, allowing physiological regulation of coenzyme production. This flexibility underlies its clinical use in B12 repletion.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是兩種活性輔酶形式維生素 B12（甲基鈷胺素和腺苷鈷胺素）的前體，在細胞內還原並烷基化為所需的輔酶。這使其成為多功能 B12 來源，可透過甲硫胺酸合成酶的甲基鈷胺素支持 methylation cycle，並透過甲基丙二酸單醯輔酶 A 變位酶的腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。其前驅狀態使其有別於直接活性的甲基供體形式，從而可以對輔酶產生進行生理調節。這種靈活性是其在補充 B12 方面的臨床應用的基礎。

label: Cyanide poisoning
description: Hydroxocobalamin is the antidote of choice for cyanide poisoning: its hydroxyl ligand exchanges for cyanide to form nontoxic cyanocobalamin, excreted renally. This is a distinct indication from B12 repletion.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是氰化物中毒的首選解毒劑：其羥基配體與氰化物交換形成無毒的 cyanocobalamin，經腎排出。這是與 B12 補充不同的適應症。

label: Pernicious anemia
description: Hydroxocobalamin is the parenteral B12 form used to treat deficiency states including pernicious anemia and malabsorption. Repletion corrects the megaloblastic anemia of B12 deficiency.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是用於治療包括惡性貧血與吸收不良在內缺乏狀態的注射 B12 形式。補充矯正 B12 缺乏的巨母紅血球貧血。

label: Environmental Oxygen Threshold
description: A species- and tissue-dependent oxygen concentration threshold determines whether POS is triggered; severe hypoxia induces GCL and GPX in Neohelice granulata while milder exposures do not. This threshold behavior parallels hormetic dose-response requirements.
description_zh_TW: 是否觸發 Preparation for Oxidative Stress 取決於物種與組織特異的氧氣濃度閾值；嚴重缺氧可在 Neohelice granulata 中誘導 GCL 與 GPX，而較輕微的暴露則無此效應。這種閾值行為與 hormesis 的劑量反應要求相呼應。

label: Lipid Peroxidation Products
description: Beyond oxygen-derived reactive species, aldehyde products of lipid peroxidation are proposed as primary mediators of the hormetic POS signal. They help link mild macromolecular oxidation during hypoxia to upregulation of redox defenses.
description_zh_TW: 除了氧衍生自由基之外，脂質過氧化的醛類產物被認為是 hormesis 型 POS 訊號的主要媒介。它們將缺氧期間的輕度大分子氧化與氧化還原防禦的上調連結起來。

label: Reoxygenation Injury
description: POS was originally framed as upregulating antioxidants during hypoxia specifically to cope with heightened oxidant formation during reoxygenation. Evidence from mussels, fish, frogs, and snails shows antioxidant induction during low oxygen followed by normalization after oxygen restoration.
description_zh_TW: POS 最初被描述為在缺氧期間上調抗氧化物，專門用以應對再氧合期間增加的氧化物生成。來自貽貝、魚類、蛙類與蝸牛的證據顯示，抗氧化物在低氧期間被誘導，並在氧氣恢復後回到正常值。

label: Multiple Animal Phyla
description: POS has been documented as an adaptive physiological mechanism in 83 animal species from 8 different phyla under low-oxygen stress and estivation, with 60-70% of analyzed species POS-positive. Antioxidant enzymes rise during hypoxia and return to baseline upon reoxygenation or arousal, showing POS is a widespread cross-phylum conditioning strategy rather than a species-specific quirk.
description_zh_TW: Preparation for Oxidative Stress 已被記錄為 8 個不同門共 83 種動物在低氧壓力與夏眠下的適應性生理機制，受分析物種中約 60-70% 為 POS-positive。抗氧化酶在缺氧期間上升，並在再氧合或甦醒後回到基線，顯示 POS 是跨門的 conditioning 策略，而非物種特異的偶發現象。

label: Chemokine
description: CCL20 (MIP-3alpha) is a CC chemokine that signals exclusively through the receptor CCR6, belonging to the broader chemokine family that directs leukocyte trafficking. Its classification as a chemokine situates it among the SASP components that recruit immune cells to senescent tissue. As a SASP factor, CCL20 extends the communicative reach of senescent cells to adaptive immunity, attracting CCR6-expressing cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and immature dendritic cells. Its restricted receptor usage gives it a focused recruitment profile distinct from broadly acting chemokines.
description_zh_TW: CCL20（MIP-3alpha）是一種專一透過受體 CCR6 訊號的 CC 趨化因子，屬於引導白血球遷移的更廣趨化因子家族。其歸類為趨化因子將它置於招募免疫細胞至衰老組織的 SASP 成分中。作為 SASP 因子，CCL20 擴展衰老細胞對適應性免疫的溝通觸及，吸引表達 CCR6 的細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與未成熟樹突細胞。其受限的受體使用賦予其不同於廣泛作用趨化因子的聚焦招募輪廓。

label: CCR6
description: CCL20 is the sole ligand for CCR6, a Gai-coupled GPCR that drives chemotaxis via PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK, and calcium flux in target cells. This exclusive pairing directs recruitment of CCR6-positive cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and dendritic cells to sites of ligand production. In the senescence context, CCL20-CCR6 links the SASP to adaptive immune infiltration, shaping the local immune landscape around senescent foci. The signaling mechanism is well characterized in lymphocyte biology and is a canonical chemokine-receptor interaction.
description_zh_TW: CCL20 是 CCR6 的唯一配體，CCR6 是一種經由 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK 與鈣流驅動趨化性的 Gai 耦合 GPCR。此專一配對引導 CCR6 陽性細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與樹突細胞招募至配體產生部位。在衰老脈絡中，CCL20-CCR6 將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫浸潤，塑造衰老灶周圍的局部免疫景觀。此訊號機制在淋巴球生物學中確立良好，且是典型的趨化因子—受體交互作用。

label: Caspase-11
description: Caspase-11 (mouse) is the noncanonical effector caspase that cleaves IL-1alpha and gasdermin D, paralleling human caspase-4/5. It is activated by cytosolic LPS and drives SASP establishment in murine senescence models, and it is required for SASP-driven immune clearance of senescent hepatocytes in vivo. The relationship establishes the species-specific executor of the noncanonical pathway in mice. It is a well-supported component of senescence inflammasome biology, with genetic deficiency of the enzyme blunting IL-1alpha processing and downstream secretome output.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-11（小鼠）是切割 IL-1alpha 與 gasdermin D 的非典型效應 caspase，平行於人類 caspase-4/5。它被胞質 LPS 活化並在小鼠衰老模型中驅動 SASP 建立，且為體內 SASP 驅動的衰老肝細胞免疫清除所需。其在小鼠中與 caspase-5 在人類中的功能對等，使非典型發炎體成為跨物種保守的衰老發炎機制。此切割產生活性 IL-1alpha 與 pyroptotic 孔洞。

label: IFITM3
description: IFITM3 is enriched in exosomes released from senescent cells and mediates paracrine senescence by transmitting senescence signals to recipient cells. As an exosomal cargo, it represents a vesicle-based, rather than soluble-factor, route of spread, and its inclusion highlights that paracrine senescence is not solely cytokine-driven. Exosomes allow protected, concentrated delivery of signals to recipient cells, and they can be detected in the circulation as potential biomarkers of senescence burden. The mechanism adds a non-classical communication modality to the SASP paradigm.
description_zh_TW: IFITM3 在衰老細胞釋放的胞外囊泡中富集，並透過將衰老訊號傳遞至受體細胞介導旁分泌衰老。作為胞外體貨物，它代表一種基於囊泡而非可溶因子的擴散途徑，其納入凸顯旁分泌衰老不只由細胞激素驅動。胞外體允許受保護、濃縮的訊號遞送至受體細胞，且可在循環中作為衰老負擔的潛在生物標記被偵測。此機制為 SASP 範式增添非典型溝通方式。

label: Biological Process
description: Paracrine reprogramming is the biological process by which SASP factors alter the differentiation status and fate of neighbouring cells, pushing them toward stemness, EMT, or altered lineage commitment. Distinct from paracrine senescence, which induces growth arrest, it remodels recipient identity and is dose- and time-dependent, with acute exposure promoting plasticity and chronic exposure driving fibrosis and cancer stemness. The process is mediated by cytokines such as IL-6, TGFbeta, and VEGF family members. It expands the non-cell-autonomous influence of senescent cells beyond growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: 旁分泌重編程是 SASP 因子改變鄰近細胞分化狀態與命運、將其推向幹性、EMT 或改變譜系承諾的生物學過程。不同於誘發生長停滯的旁分泌衰老，它重塑受體身分而非使其停滯。此過程將衰老分泌組定位為組織重塑的形態發生素來源，且其與旁分泌衰老的並存說明 SASP 具多重非細胞自主性後果。它是衰老相關組織重塑的核心機制。

label: LPS
description: The hexa-acylated lipid A of LPS binds directly to the CARD domain of caspase-4/5/11, inducing their dimerization and activation, the defining trigger of the noncanonical inflammasome. While classically microbial, this mechanism can be engaged in senescence-associated inflammatory contexts. The relationship is the canonical activation mode of the pathway and links Gram-negative sensing to caspase activation. Because the caspases themselves are the sensors, no upstream receptor is required for this pathway.
description_zh_TW: LPS 的六醯化 lipid A 直接結合 caspase-4/5/11 的 CARD 域，誘發其雙聚化與活化，是非典型發炎體的定義性觸發因子。雖典型為微生物性，此機制可在衰老相關發炎脈絡中被啟動。此關係將微生物產物感知連結到內源性發炎，且若胞質 LPS 或 LPS 樣配體在衰老中出現，可能貢獻非典型發炎體活化。它是該途徑的確立啟動機制。

label: IL-18
description: Canonical inflammasome-activated caspase-1 cleaves pro-IL-18 into its mature secreted form alongside IL-1β. This provides a second IL-1-family cytokine output linking DAMP sensing to senescence inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 典型發炎體活化的 caspase-1 將 pro-IL-18 切割為成熟分泌形式，與 IL-1β 並列。這提供第二種 IL-1 家族細胞激素輸出，將 DAMP 感知連結到衰老發炎。

label: Caspase-4
description: Human caspase-4 is a cytosolic-LPS sensor and noncanonical effector alongside caspase-5, paralleling murine caspase-11. It cleaves gasdermin D and IL-1α to drive SASP and pyroptotic signaling.
description_zh_TW: 人類 caspase-4 是胞質 LPS 感受器與非典型效應因子，與 caspase-5 並列，對應小鼠 caspase-11。它切割 gasdermin D 與 IL-1α 以驅動 SASP 與 pyroptotic 訊號。

label: Pinometostat
description: Pinometostat inhibits DOT1L targeting H3K79 methylation in MLL leukemias. Drug-target edge of the methyltransferase axis.
description_zh_TW: Pinometostat 抑制 DOT1L，標靶 MLL 白血病的 H3K79 甲基化。甲基轉移酶軸的藥物—標的邊。

label: ASC
description: ASC polymerizes into specks that recruit pro-Caspase-1 via CARD interactions, enabling proximity-induced activation that cleaves Gasdermin D and pro-IL-1β/IL-18.
description_zh_TW: ASC 聚合成 specks，透過 CARD 相互作用招募 pro-Caspase-1，促成鄰近誘導活化，進而切割 Gasdermin D 與 pro-IL-1β/IL-18。

label: Disulfiram
description: Disulfiram covalently modifies Gasdermin D to block its pore-forming activity, suppressing pyroptotic lysis and IL-1β release downstream of inflammasome activation.
description_zh_TW: Disulfiram 共價修飾 Gasdermin D 以阻斷其成孔活性，抑制 inflammasome 活化下游的 pyroptosis 裂解與 IL-1β 釋放。

label: RHIM
description: RHIM-RHIM contacts between RIPK1/RIPK3 (classical TNFR1 necrosome) and ZBP1/TRIF-RIPK3 (non-classical, RIPK1-independent) nucleate the amyloid-like necrosome; caspase-8 cleavage of RHIM carriers dissolves the scaffold.
description_zh_TW: RHIM-RHIM contacts between RIPK1/RIPK3 (classical TNFR1 necrosome) and ZBP1/TRIF-RIPK3 (non-classical, RIPK1-independent) nucleate the amyloid-like necrosome; caspase-8 cleavage of RHIM carriers dissolves the scaffold.

label: MAML1
source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md
description: MAML1 is the obligate transcriptional co-activator of Notch signalling. Its N-terminal domain binds the composite surface formed by the Notch intracellular domain (N1ICD) and the DNA-binding factor CSL/RBPJ, nucleating a ternary complex at Notch target promoters, while its C-terminal activation domain recruits p300/CBP to drive histone acetylation and transcriptional activation. Because Notch restrains the late pro-inflammatory SASP by repressing C/EBPbeta, MAML1 is the effector through which N1ICD executes that programme. The SASP-induction scheme groups MAML1 with N1ICD in the nuclear trafficking-gene control layer.
description_zh_TW: MAML1 是 Notch 訊號的必要轉錄共活化者。其 N 端結構域結合由 Notch 胞內結構域（N1ICD）與 DNA 結合因子 CSL/RBPJ 形成的複合表面，在 Notch 標的啟動子上成核三元複合體；其 C 端活化結構域則招募 p300/CBP 以驅動組蛋白乙醯化與轉錄活化。由於 Notch 藉抑制 C/EBPbeta 約束晚期促炎 SASP，MAML1 即為 N1ICD 執行該程序的效應者。SASP 誘導架構圖將 MAML1 與 N1ICD 同置於細胞核運輸基因調控層。

label: Oxygen
description: Methemoglobin is the oxidized form of hemoglobin in which heme iron is in the ferric (Fe3+) state rather than the ferrous (Fe2+) state. In this form, the affected subunit cannot bind or transport oxygen, which makes methemoglobin functionally useless for oxygen delivery even though total hemoglobin levels may appear normal. When methemoglobin accumulates, it also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin, further impairing oxygen release to tissues. This creates a functional anemia, and elevated levels lead to methemoglobinemia with consequent tissue hypoxia.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobin is the oxidized form of hemoglobin in which heme iron is in the ferric (Fe3+) state rather than the ferrous (Fe2+) state。In this form, the affected subunit cannot bind or transport oxygen, which makes methemoglobin functionally useless for oxygen delivery even though total hemoglobin levels may appear normal。When methemoglobin accumulates, it also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin, further impairing oxygen release to tissues。This creates a functional anemia, and elevated levels lead to methemoglobinemia with consequent tissue hypoxia。

label: Oxygen-dissociation curve
description: Methemoglobin, the ferric form of hemoglobin, not only fails to carry oxygen itself but also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin in the tetramer. This left shift increases hemoglobin's affinity for oxygen and impairs oxygen release to tissues, creating a functional anemia even when total hemoglobin levels are normal or near-normal. When methemoglobin levels rise substantially, the resulting impairment of oxygen delivery causes tissue hypoxia, and symptoms progress from cyanosis to headaches, confusion, arrhythmias, and eventually coma as the percentage of methemoglobin increases.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobin, the ferric form of hemoglobin, not only fails to carry oxygen itself but also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin in the tetramer。This left shift increases hemoglobin's affinity for oxygen and impairs oxygen release to tissues, creating a functional anemia even when total hemoglobin levels are normal or near-normal。When methemoglobin levels rise substantially, the resulting impairment of oxygen delivery causes tissue hypoxia, and symptoms progress from cyanosis to headaches, confusion, arrhythmias, and eventually coma as the percentage of methemoglobin increases。

label: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase
description: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, also called cytochrome b5 reductase or diaphorase, is the primary enzyme that converts methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin by reducing ferric heme iron to the ferrous state. It keeps steady-state methemoglobin levels below 1-2% in healthy individuals despite the spontaneous oxidation of hemoglobin. Deficiency of this enzyme, due to autosomal recessive mutations, is the most common congenital cause of methemoglobinemia, with Type 1 affecting only erythrocytes and causing cyanosis while the rarer Type 2 systemic form is more severe and involves neurological problems.
description_zh_TW: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, also called cytochrome b5 reductase or diaphorase, is the primary enzyme that converts methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin by reducing ferric heme iron to the ferrous state。It keeps steady-state methemoglobin levels below 1-2% in healthy individuals despite the spontaneous oxidation of hemoglobin。Deficiency of this enzyme, due to autosomal recessive mutations, is the most common congenital cause of methemoglobinemia, with Type 1 affecting only erythrocytes and causing cyanosis while the rarer Type 2 systemic form is more severe and involves neurological problems。

label: Oxyhemoglobin
description: Oxyhemoglobin (HbO2) spontaneously autoxidizes to methemoglobin, a process that generates superoxide anion (O2-). These radicals, along with hydrogen peroxide, can co-oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome, a well-documented reaction historically used as an assay for superoxide production. Methemoglobin is the form of hemoglobin in which the heme iron is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state, and it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen. This autoxidation links red blood cell chemistry to catecholamine oxidation and provides a route for adrenochrome formation in blood under oxidative conditions.
description_zh_TW: Oxyhemoglobin (HbO2) spontaneously autoxidizes to methemoglobin，a process that generates superoxide anion (O2-)。These radicals，along with hydrogen peroxide，can co-oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome，a well-documented reaction historically used as an assay for superoxide production。Methemoglobin is the form of hemoglobin in which the heme iron is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state，and it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen。This autoxidation links red blood cell chemistry to catecholamine oxidation and provides a route for adrenochrome formation in blood under oxidative conditions。

label: MitoQ
description: MitoQ reduces mitochondrial ROS as a mitochondria-targeted ubiquinone derivative that accumulates in the matrix and chain-breaks peroxyl radicals at their source. By concentrating antioxidant capacity inside mitochondria, it limits the downstream damage from leaked electrons. The directionality is targeted antioxidant to lowered mitochondrial oxidant burden. A caveat is that high doses of MitoQ can accumulate and potentially act as a pro-oxidant by virtue of its redox-cycling quinone structure. MitoQ has shown benefit in models of ischemia-reperfusion, neurodegeneration, and age-related vascular dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: MitoQ 將 mitochondrial ROS 還原為 mitochondria 靶向泛醌衍生物，該衍生物在基質中積累，並在其源頭斷鏈過氧自由基。透過將抗氧化能力集中在 mitochondria 內部，它限制了洩漏電子對下游的損害。方向性是靶向抗氧化劑以降低mitochondria1氧化劑負荷。需要注意的是，高劑量的 MitoQ 可能會積累，並可能因其氧化還原循環醌結構而充當促氧化劑。 MitoQ 在缺血再灌注、neurodegeneration 和年齡相關血管功能障礙模型中顯示出益處。

label: JNK Activation
description: Mitochondrial ROS are required for JNK activation downstream of TNFR1, representing an obligatory event in sustained JNK signaling that drives apoptosis and inflammation. The oxidants act as upstream amplifiers of the kinase cascade. The directionality is mtROS to JNK activation. A caveat is that JNK can also be activated by non-mitochondrial ROS and by MAPKKK upstream of mitochondria, so the requirement is context-dependent. Persistent JNK activation downstream of mitochondrial ROS promotes apoptosis and is implicated in stress-induced tissue injury.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial ROS 是 TNFR1 的 JNK activation 下游所必需的，代表驅動 apoptosis 和發炎的持續 JNK 訊號傳導中的必然事件。氧化剂充当激酶级联的上游放大器。方向性是mtROS 到JNK activation。需要注意的是，JNK 也可以由非 mitochondrial ROS 和 mitochondria 上游的 MAPKKK 激活，因此該要求取決於上下文。 mitochondrial ROS 下游持續存在的 JNK activation 會促進 apoptosis，並參與壓力誘發的組織損傷。

label: SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling
description: Mitochondrial ROS are required for SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling, as mtROS promote removal of this negative feedback inhibitor, permitting full Smad2/3 activation. This embeds mitochondria within the TGF-beta pathway. The directionality is mtROS to loss of SMAD7 restraint. A caveat is that SMAD7 is also regulated by ubiquitination and other mechanisms, so ROS modulates rather than exclusively controls it. This places mitochondria as regulators of TGF-beta signaling strength and explains why mitochondrial antioxidants blunt fibrosis in some models.
description_zh_TW: SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling 需要 Mitochondrial ROS，因為 mtROS 促進去除這種負回饋抑制劑，從而允許完全活化 Smad2/3。這將 mitochondria 嵌入到 TGF-beta 路徑中。方向性是 mtROS 到 SMAD7 失去約束。需要注意的是，SMAD7 也受到泛素化和其他機制的調節，因此 ROS 調節而不是專門控制它。這使得 mitochondria 成為 TGF-beta 訊號強度的調節器，並解釋了為什麼 mitochondrial antioxidants 在某些模型中會鈍化 fibros。

label: TNFR1 signaling
description: TNFR1 signaling generates mitochondrial ROS when TRAF2 recruits TRIM21, causing electron leak at Complex I and raising mtROS. These ROS then propagate the TNFR1 pro-inflammatory and pro-death program. The directionality is receptor signaling to mitochondrial oxidant production. A caveat is that TNFR1 also engages cytosolic NOX and other ROS sources, so mitochondria are one node in the oxidative response. This mitochondrial ROS signal contributes to necroptosis and inflammatory gene induction downstream of TNF-alpha, and can be suppressed by mitochondrial-targeted antioxidants.
description_zh_TW: 當 TRAF2 招募 TRIM21 時，TNFR1 signaling 產生 mitochondrial ROS，導致複合物 I 處的電子洩漏併升高 mtROS。然後，這些 ROS 傳播 TNFR1 促發炎和促死亡程序。方向性是針對mitochondria1氧化劑所產生的受體訊號傳導。需要注意的是，TNFR1 也參與胞質 NOX 和其他 ROS 來源，因此 mitochondria 是氧化反應中的一個節點。此mitochondrial ROS訊號有助於necroptosis和TNF-alpha下游的發炎基因誘導，並且可以被靶向mitochondria1的antioxidants抑制。

label: Succinate
description: Succinate oxidation at Complex II drives reverse electron transport at Complex I, bursting mitochondrial ROS that stabilize HIF-1alpha and interleukin-1beta. Metabolite oxidation signals immune activation.
description_zh_TW: Complex II 的琥珀酸氧化驅動 Complex I 逆向電子傳遞，爆發粒線體 ROS 以穩定 HIF-1alpha 與 interleukin-1beta。代謝物氧化傳遞免疫活化訊號。

label: Prodrug
description: For adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine to act as an active AGE inhibitor despite its hydrazine group being locked in a hydrazone bond, it must either retain sufficient nucleophilicity through its remaining guanidine nitrogens, act as a prodrug that undergoes controlled in vivo hydrolysis to slowly release free aminoguanidine, or work via alternative pathways such as chelating transition metals that catalyze glycoxidation. The prodrug hypothesis is plausible because the conjugate is stable for clinical use yet could hydrolyze to release aminoguanidine over time. Whether the bound aminoguanidine retains dicarbonyl-scavenging activity remains unresolved.
description_zh_TW: 儘管 adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 的肼基被鎖定在腙鍵中，要作為活性 AGE 抑制劑，它必須透過剩餘的胍氮保留足夠的親核性、作為前藥在體內經受控水解以緩慢釋出游離 aminoguanidine，或經由螯合催化糖氧化的過渡金屬等替代途徑作用。前藥假說是合理的，因為該共軛物在臨床上穩定可用，但隨時間可能水解釋出 aminoguanidine。被結合的 aminoguanidine 是否保留二羰基清除活性仍懸而未決。

label: Guanylhydrazone
description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine is the concrete carbonyl plus aminoguanidine condensation embodiment of the class. Membership instantiates the reaction product.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 是羰基加 aminoguanidine 縮合的具體體現。成員關係實例化反應產物。

label: Down Syndrome
description: Full trisomy 21 causes Down syndrome, the prototypical viable trisomy.
description_zh_TW: 完全 21 三體導致唐氏症，為典型的可存活三體。

label: Autoimmune Disease
description: Protein citrullination links to autoimmune disease beyond rheumatoid arthritis as a broader class relationship. Association generalizes the tolerance-break mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白瓜氨酸化超越類風濕關節炎連結自體免疫疾病，作為更廣的類別關係。關聯概化耐受打破機制。

label: N-Formylkynurenine
description: N-formylkynurenine is the immediate product of IDO1's oxidative cleavage of the tryptophan indole ring at the 2,3-position; it is then rapidly converted to kynurenine (Kyn). Kynurenine is the central metabolite of the kynurenine pathway from which downstream neuroactive and NAD+-linked metabolites are derived. The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+, and accounts for roughly 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production.
description_zh_TW: N-甲酰犬尿氨酸是IDO1氧化裂解色氨酸吲哚環2,3位的直接產物；隨後快速轉化為犬尿氨酸（Kyn）。犬尿氨酸是犬尿氨酸通路的中心代謝物，下游神經活性和NAD+相關代謝物由此衍生。犬尿氨酸通路導致代謝物包括犬尿喹啉酸、3-羥基犬尿氨酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素和NAD+前體），最終產生NAD+，佔蛋白質合成和血清素產生以外約95%的色氨酸降解。

label: Microbial Exposure
description: Per the 'Old Friends' hypothesis, commensal bacteria, saprophytic mycobacteria and helminths calibrate immune tolerance by inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs); farm exposure and gut Bacteroides/Clostridium pools promote tolerogenic dendritic cells → Treg differentiation, so removing microbial training signals is linked to rising allergy and autoimmunity.
description_zh_TW: 依「老友」假說，共生菌、腐生分枝桿菌與蠕蟲透過誘導調節性 T 細胞（Tregs）校準免疫耐受；農場暴露與腸道 Bacteroides/Clostridium 族群促進耐受性樹突細胞 → Treg 分化，因此移除微生物訓練訊號與過敏及自體免疫增加相關。

label: Mitochondrial Quality Control
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Mitochondrial dynamics, the balance of fusion and fission, is a central component of mitochondrial quality control. Through fission, damaged portions of the network are segregated into smaller units; through fusion, functional mitochondria exchange and dilute damaged components; and through the interplay of these processes, mitochondria destined for mitophagy are identified and eliminated. The degradation of damaged mitochondria by mitophagy, and the biogenesis of new mitochondria through PGC-1alpha-driven pathways, complete a quality-control cycle that maintains a healthy mitochondrial population. Disruption of any step, as in Parkinson's disease with PINK1 and Parkin mutations, leads to accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria and cellular damage.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics, the balance of fusion and fission, is a central component of mitochondrial quality control。Through fission, damaged portions of the network are segregated into smaller units；through fusion, functional mitochondria exchange and dilute damaged components；and through the interplay of these processes, mitochondria destined for mitophagy are identified and eliminated。The degradation of damaged mitochondria by mitophagy, and the biogenesis of new mitochondria through PGC-1alpha-driven pathways, complete a quality-control cycle that maintains a healthy mitochondrial population。Disruption of any step, as in Parkinson's disease with PINK1 and Parkin mutations, leads to accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria and cellular damage。

label: Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia
description: Bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) is a chronic lung disease of premature infants in which dysregulated mitochondrial fission and fusion contribute to lung cell injury. Impaired mitochondrial dynamics and mitophagy are implicated in the arrested alveolar and vascular development of BPD.
description_zh_TW: 支氣管肺發育不良（BPD）是早產兒的慢性肺病，其中失調的粒線體分裂與融合造成肺細胞損傷。粒線體動態與 mitophagy 受損與 BPD 中肺泡與血管發育停滯有關。

label: Cellular Homeostasis
description: Mitochondrial dynamics refers to the continuous processes of fusion and fission that regulate mitochondrial morphology, number, and function. These processes maintain cellular homeostasis by exchanging components, diluting damage, and enabling mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體動態指調控粒線體形態、數量與功能的持續融合與分裂過程。這些過程透過交換成分、稀釋損傷與促成 mitophagy 來維持細胞恆定。

label: Green tea
description: Green tea is rich in polyphenols, especially the catechin epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), which constitutes a major fraction of its antioxidant and bioactive content. EGCG is subsequently metabolized by COMT, linking green tea consumption to COMT-dependent pharmacokinetics, with slow genotypes clearing it more slowly. The high EGCG content is the basis for many of green tea's studied health effects, including antioxidant, metabolic, and neuroprotective actions. At dietary intake levels it does not significantly inhibit COMT in humans.
description_zh_TW: Green tea 富含多酚，尤其是兒茶素表沒食子兒茶素沒食子酸酯 (EGCG)，它構成了其抗氧化劑和生物活性成分的主要部分。 EGCG 隨後被 COMT 代謝，將綠茶攝取與 COMT 依賴性藥物動力學聯繫起來，而慢基因型清除它的速度更慢。 EGCG 的高含量是綠茶許多健康功效研究的基礎，包括抗氧化、代謝和神經保護作用。在飲食攝取量下，它不會顯著抑制 COMT in humans。

label: COMT at supplement doses
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Although animal and cell studies show EGCG to be an inhibitor of COMT, studies in humans give a different result. A study involving people with both fast and slow COMT variants showed that 750 mg of supplemental EGCG did not impair COMT activity. Research does show that people with slow COMT break down EGCG more slowly than people with fast COMT.
description_zh_TW: 雖然動物和細胞研究顯示 EGCG 是 COMT 的抑制劑，但人體研究給出不同的結果。一項涉及快速和緩慢 COMT 變異個體的研究顯示，750 毫克的補充 EGCG 不會損害 COMT activity。研究確實顯示緩慢 COMT 個體分解 EGCG 的速度比快速 COMT 個體慢。

label: Non-amyloidogenic APP Processing
description: EGCG from green tea enhances alpha-secretase (TACE/ADAM17) activity, shifting APP processing toward the non-amyloidogenic pathway with increased sAPPalpha. This reduces Abeta generation and plaques while modulating tau phosphorylation and improving cognition in APPsw transgenic mice.
