This selectivity is considered advantageous because it can halt the inflammatory overproduction of nitric oxide - which causes excessive vasodilation, vascular leakage, and tissue damage - without completely shutting down normal blood-pressure regulation maintained by eNOS-derived NO. This contrasts with non-selective NOS inhibition, making aminoguanidine a theoretically more targeted anti-inflammatory intervention.
description_zh_TW: 氨基胍具有选择性地抑制诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）而非健康型内皮型一氧化氮合酶（eNOS）。这种选择性被认为是具有优势的，因为它能够阻止一氧化氮的过度产生（导致过度血管舒张、血管渗漏和组织损伤）而不完全关闭由eNOS衍生的正常血压调节。这与非选择性NOS抑制剂不同，使得氨基胍成为一种理论上更具针对性的抗炎干预措施。

label: Hypotension
description: Massive nitric oxide release during septic shock, anaphylaxis, or post-cardiopulmonary bypass vasoplegia causes excessive vasodilation and life-threateningly low blood pressure (hypotension). NO overproduction is driven largely by the inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) enzyme during the inflammatory response. Therapeutic strategies target this cascade at different levels: aminoguanidine inhibits iNOS to block NO synthesis upstream, while methylene blue inhibits soluble guanylyl cyclase to block NO signaling downstream and restore blood pressure when vasopressors fail.
description_zh_TW: 在敗血症性休克、過敏反應或心肺分流術後血管麻痺期間，大量一氧化氮釋放導致過度血管舒張和危及生命的低血壓（低血壓）。NO過度產生主要由誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）在炎症反應期間驅動。治療策略在不同層面靶向此級聯：氨基胍抑制iNOS以在上游阻斷NO合成，而亞甲藍抑制可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶以在下游阻斷NO信號並在血管加壓素失效時恢復血壓。

label: Very Low Density Lipoprotein
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Studies conducted at the University of Milan over 25 years showed that aminoguanidine reduces the ability of very low density lipoprotein (VLDL), the bad form of cholesterol, to bind itself to blood vessel walls, in tests on animals. In turn, blood platelets are less likely to coagulate and form dangerous clots. Aminoguanidine's role in reducing VLDL cholesterol and its ability to stabilize glucose metabolism indicate it has a wide-reaching ability to help prevent and treat a number of aging disorders.
description_zh_TW: 米蘭大學二十五年來的研究表明，氨基胍降低非常低密度脂蛋白 (VLDL)，即壞膽固醇的形式，與血管壁結合的能力，在動物實驗中有效。 此外，血小板更不活躍，也更不容易形成危險血栓。 氨基胍在降低 VLDL 膽固醇和穩定葡萄糖代謝方面的作用，以及其穩定代謝的能力，表明它具有廣泛的抗衰老和治療多種衰老疾病的能力。

label: Albuminuria
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Trials conducted by the Alteon Corporation indicate that aminoguanidine can significantly reduce albuminuria, proteins present in urine usually as a result of kidney disease, delay the onset of end-stage renal disease, and improve the cholesterol profiles of diabetic patients. Diabetic clinical trials have also highlighted aminoguanidine's ability to prevent oxidative modification of LDL and inhibit the formation of atherosclerotic plaques. A number of studies with diabetic rats indicate that aminoguanidine-administered rats have significantly superior survival rates than untreated animals.
description_zh_TW: 由 Alteon Corporation 進行的臨床試驗顯示，氨基胍可以顯著降低尿素氮，這是通常由腎臟疾病引起的蛋白質，延遲末期腎臟疾病的發病，並改善糖尿病患者的膽固醇型態。糖尿病臨床試驗也突顯了氨基胍預防氧化修飾 LDL 以及抑制動脈粥樣性變性斑塊的功效。多項關於糖尿病大鼠的研究表明，給予氨基胍的實驗鼠與未經治療的動物相比，存活率顯著更高。

label: Guanidines
description: Aminoguanidine is a formal guanidine family member carrying the guanidinium pharmacophore. Membership records the structural class.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是攜帶胍基藥效團的正式 guanidine 家族成員。成員關係記錄結構類別。

label: Guanidine
description: Aminoguanidine is a guanidine derivative by parent-to-derivative classification. Derivation records the chemical lineage.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 依母體到衍生物歸類是 guanidine 衍生物。衍生記錄化學譜系。

label: SYK Kinase Signaling
description: Heme triggers a characteristic TRIM response with H3K27ac remodeling through SYK-dependent ROS generation rather than oxidative chemistry alone. Unlike oxLDL or HMGB1 training, heme training is mTOR-independent: rapamycin has no effect, while SYK inhibition with R406 blocks training. It defines an alternative DAMP-to-chromatin route.
description_zh_TW: Heme 透過 SYK-dependent ROS generation 而非僅靠氧化化學性質，觸發帶有 H3K27ac 重塑的典型 TRIM 反應。與 Oxidized LDL 或 HMGB1 訓練不同，Heme 訓練是 mTOR-independent：rapamycin 無效，而以 R406 抑制 SYK 可阻斷訓練。它定義了一條替代性的 DAMP-to-chromatin 路徑。

label: Hematopoietic Stem and Progenitor Cells
description: Systemic heme reaches the bone marrow and activates hematopoietic stem cells, increasing myeloid-lineage frequency and imprinting TRIM-related epigenetic changes. Adoptive progeny show in vivo resistance to bacterial sepsis. This is a central-training mechanism linking hemolysis/tissue damage to durable innate memory.
description_zh_TW: 全身性 Heme 可達骨髓並活化 hematopoietic stem cells，增加 myeloid-lineage 比例並印記 TRIM-related epigenetic changes。其子代細胞在 in vivo 對 bacterial sepsis 具抵抗力。這是將溶血／組織損傷與持久性先天記憶連結起來的 central-training 機制。

label: Ischemic preconditioning cardioprotection
description: In ischemic-preconditioning models, Splitomicin reverses protective lysine deacetylation and abolishes preconditioning-induced cardioprotection. Directionally, Splitomicin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of lost cardiac protection. This indicates that sirtuin deacetylase activity is required for ischemic tolerance, and it argues that sirtuin activation, not inhibition, protects the heart. The cardioprotective effect of preconditioning is thought to involve SIRT1-dependent stress adaptation, and its loss upon sirtuin inhibition confirms this mechanism. These findings support the development of sirtuin activators for ischemic heart disease.
description_zh_TW: 在缺血預適應模型中，Splitomicin 逆轉保護性的賴氨酸去乙醯化並廢除預適應誘導的心臟保護。在方向性上，Splitomicin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於心臟保護喪失的上游。這表明 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性是缺血耐受所必需的，並主張 sirtuin 活化（而非抑制）才能保護心臟。預適應的心臟保護效應被認為涉及 SIRT1 依賴性的壓力適應，其在 sirtuin 抑制後的喪失確認了此機制。這些發現支持開發用於缺血性心臟病的 sirtuin 活化劑。

label: Sir2 in S. cerevisiae (weakly inhibits human SIRT1)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Splitomicin inhibits Sir2 in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, but showed weaker inhibition on human SIRT1. Yeast Sir2 and human SIRT2 are inhibited by sirtinol. Directionally, these small-molecule sirtuin inhibitors (STICs) sit upstream of reduced sirtuin catalytic activity, with species- and isoform-selective potencies. Sirtuin inhibitors have also been considered for the treatment of Parkinson's disease, in addition to cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: Splitomicin 抑制釀酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中的 Sir2，但對人類 SIRT1 的抑制作用較弱。酵母 Sir2 和人類 SIRT2 均可被 sirtinol 抑制。從作用方向而言，這些小分子 sirtuin 抑制劑（STICs）位於降低 sirtuin 催化活性的上游，具有物種和亞型選擇性效能。除了癌症治療之外，sirtuin 抑制劑也被考慮用於帕金森氏症的治療。

label: LIPL-1
description: LIPL-1 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2, confirming its residence within the lysosomal lumen where it hydrolyzes stored triglycerides. Its expression is induced by HLH-30 during fasting, supporting lipophagy-mediated lipid mobilization. LIPL-1 is part of a family of lysosomal lipases (lipl-1 through lipl-5) that together govern organismal lipid turnover. Loss or reduction of these lipases impairs the ability to survive nutrient scarcity.
description_zh_TW: LIPL-1 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，確認其位於溶酶體腔內，在此水解儲存的甘油三酯。其表現在禁食期間受 HLH-30 誘發，支持脂噬介導的脂質動員。LIPL-1 是溶酶體脂肪酶家族（lipl-1 至 lipl-5）的一員，共同掌管生物體的脂質週轉。這些脂肪酶的缺失或減少會損害在營養匱乏中存活的能力。

label: LIPL-3
description: LIPL-3 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that, like LIPL-1, co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2 and contributes to intralysosomal lipid hydrolysis. It is transcriptionally induced by HLH-30 under fasting conditions, enabling the breakdown of lipid droplets delivered via lipophagy. Together with other lipl family members, LIPL-3 is required for efficient energy mobilization during starvation. Its lysosomal localization anchors it within the autophagy-lysosomal degradative system.
description_zh_TW: LIPL-3 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，如同 LIPL-1，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，並有助於溶酶體內的脂質水解。它在禁食條件下受 HLH-30 轉錄誘發，使得經由脂噬遞送的脂滴得以分解。與其他 lipl 家族成員一起，LIPL-3 是飢餓期間有效能量動員所必需的。其溶酶體定位將它錨定於自噬—溶酶體降解系統中。

label: LMO2 deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Inhibition of SIRT2 suppresses the in vitro growth and in vivo engraftment of T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells through diminished deacetylation of LIM domain only 2 (LMO2). Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of LMO2-dependent leukemia suppression. LMO2 is a key oncogenic transcription factor in T-ALL, and its activity depends on deacetylation by SIRT2. Blocking SIRT2 reduces LMO2 function, impairing both the expansion of leukemic cells in culture and their ability to engraft in vivo. This identifies SIRT2 inhibition as a promising approach for T-ALL therapy, targeting a central oncogenic driver in this disease.
description_zh_TW: 抑制SIRT2透過減少LIM domain only 2（LMO2）的去乙醯化來抑制T細胞急性淋巴性白血病細胞的體外生長和體內植入。方向上，SIRT2抑制位於LMO2依賴性白血病抑制的上游。LMO2是T-ALL中的關鍵致癌轉錄因子，其活性依賴SIRT2的去乙醯化。阻斷SIRT2降低LMO2功能，損害白血病細胞在培養中的擴增和在體內的植入能力。這將SIRT2抑制確定為T-ALL治療的有前景方法，靶向此疾病中的核心致癌驅動因子。

label: Resistance to microtubule inhibitors
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2 inhibition or downregulation appears counterproductive in certain cancer contexts, particularly when combined with microtubule inhibitors, because loss of SIRT2 prolongs chronic mitotic arrest and makes cancer cells resistant to these agents. The enzyme normally helps cells exit mitosis cleanly; without it, cells linger in a prolonged arrested state that selects for survival. Directionally, low SIRT2 activity sits upstream of this resistance phenotype. This caveat limits the general anticancer rationale for SIRT2 inhibition and argues for careful context- and regimen-specific use.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 抑制或下調在某些癌症情境中看似適得其反，特別是在與微管抑制劑合併使用時，因為 SIRT2 的缺失延長了慢性有絲分裂停滯，使癌細胞對這些藥物產生抗性。該酵素正常情況下幫助細胞順利退出有絲分裂；沒有它時，細胞會停留在延長的停滯狀態中，有利於存活。方向性上低 SIRT2 活性位於此抗性表型的上游。這一注意事項限制了 SIRT2 抑制的通用抗癌依據，並主張在使用時需謹慎考慮具體情境和治療方案。

label: Lymphopenia
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: SARS-CoV-2 infection triggers a maladaptive immune response, notably an exaggerated proinflammatory response leading to a cytokine storm in lung tissue, and lymphopenia with a drastic decline of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells. Upon activation of the adaptive immune response, the overexpression of CD38 in both CD4+ and CD8+ lymphocytes further exaggerates NAD+ depletion, leading to increased production and release of proinflammatory cytokines, reactive oxygen species, and macrophage infiltration. Drastic NAD+ depletion impairs sirtuin function, and replenishment of NAD+ body content could restore energy levels and impaired sirtuin function, possibly rebalancing the maladaptive immune response to
description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 感染觸發適應不良的免疫反應，特別是誇大的促發炎反應導致肺組織中的細胞激素風暴，以及淋巴球減少伴隨 CD4+ 與 CD8+ T 細胞的急劇下降。在適應性免疫反應活化後，CD38 在 CD4+ 與 CD8+ 淋巴球中的過度表現進一步加劇 NAD+ 耗竭，導致促發炎性細胞激素、活性氧與巨噬細胞浸潤的產生與釋放增加。急劇的 NAD+ 耗竭損害 sirtuin 功能，而補充體內 NAD+ 含量可恢復能量水平與受損的 sirtuin 功能，可能重新平衡此適應不良免疫反應至

label: NAD+ Metabolism
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: The combined layer carries the single typed edge 'sars_cov_2 —[disrupts]→ NAD+_metabolism', which pulls the virus into the CD38/PARP/sirtuin/inflammaging attribute space; severe COVID-19 drives CD38-NADase-mediated NAD+ depletion confirmed in 2020–21 literature (Heer et al., JBC 2020) — a mechanistic corridor the triples layer still lacks.
description_zh_TW: combined 層攜帶單一類型邊「sars_cov_2 —[disrupts]→ NAD+_metabolism」，把病毒拉入 CD38/PARP/sirtuin/inflammaging 屬性空間；重症 COVID-19 驅動的 CD38-NADase 介導 NAD+ 耗竭已由 2020–21 文獻證實（Heer et al., JBC 2020），是 triples 層仍缺乏的機制走廊。

label: S100A4
description: In a multi-DAMP TRIM screen including HMGB1, fibrinogen, and HSP90, only oligomeric S100A4 reached beta-glucan-level trained responses via TLR4/RAGE-MyD88 signaling. It upregulates IL-1/IL-6 programs and bypasses tolerance to subsequent LPS. Whether this reflects classical TRIM or prolonged priming remains unresolved.
description_zh_TW: 在包含 HMGB1、fibrinogen 與 HSP90 的多 DAMP TRIM 篩選中，只有 oligomeric S100A4 經由 TLR4/RAGE-MyD88 signaling 達到 beta-glucan 等級的訓練反應。它上調 IL-1/IL-6 程式並 bypass 對後續 LPS 的 tolerance。究屬 classical TRIM 或延長的 priming 仍未定論。

label: Soluble Urate
description: Soluble urate induces H3K27ac and H3K4me3 reprogramming in monocytes, and uric-acid priming followed by LPS restimulation boosts IL-1beta production. Methyltransferase inhibitors reverse this primed output. HDAC inhibition likewise modulates MSU-induced proinflammatory cytokines, tying urate training to histone control.
description_zh_TW: Soluble Urate 可在單核球中誘導 H3K27ac 與 H3K4me3 重編程，且 uric-acid priming 後再以 LPS 再刺激可提升 IL-1beta 產量。Methyltransferase inhibitors 可逆轉此 primed 輸出。HDAC inhibition 同樣調節 MSU 誘導的促發炎細胞激素，將 urate training 與 histone control 連結起來。

label: OAADPr (2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose)
description: During the sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation of a lysine, NAD+ is cleaved between its nicotinamide and ADP-ribose moieties, and the acetyl group is transferred to the ADP-ribose to generate 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose (OAADPr) plus free nicotinamide. OAADPr is a stoichiometric by-product, released in equimolar amounts with the deacetylated substrate on every catalytic cycle. This molecule is not merely waste: it binds and activates the TRPM2 cation channel, linking sirtuin activity to calcium signaling and cellular stress responses. A caveat is that OAADPr accumulation can itself feed back on cellular metabolism, and its levels reflect the integrated deacetylase flux of the cell.
description_zh_TW: 在 sirtuin 催化的離胺酸去乙醯化過程中，NAD+ 在菸鹼醯胺和 ADP-核糖基團之間被裂解，乙醯基被轉移到 ADP-核糖上，生成 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose（OAADPr）和游離的菸鹼醯胺。OAADPr 是化學計量的副產物，在每個催化週期中以等摩爾量與去乙醯化的受質一起釋放。這個分子不僅僅是廢物：它能結合並活化 TRPM2 陽離子通道，將 sirtuin 活性與鈣離子訊號傳導和細胞壓力反應聯繫起來。需要注意的是，OAADPr 的積累本身可以反饋影響細胞代謝，其水平反映了細胞整體的去乙醯酶通量。

label: NAM (nicotinamide) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation couples the cleavage of NAD+ to the removal of acetyl groups from lysine residues. Each round of deacetylation converts one molecule of NAD+ into nicotinamide (NAM) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. NAM then acts as an end-product inhibitor of sirtuins by binding to a conserved pocket adjacent to the NAD+ site, thereby blocking further NAD+ hydrolysis. This product-based feedback links cellular NAD+ status and NAM levels directly to sirtuin enzymatic output.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin催化的去乙醯化反應將NAD+的裂解與賴氨酸殘基上乙醯基的移除耦合。每輪去乙醯化將一分子NAD+轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM）和O-乙醯-ADP-核糖。NAM隨後作為sirtuin的末端產物抑制劑，結合到與NAD+位點相鄰的保守口袋，從而阻斷進一步的NAD+水解。這種基於產物的反饋直接將細胞NAD+狀態和NAM水平與sirtuin酵素輸出聯繫起來。

label: RANKL
description: Monocyte/macrophage lineage derives into osteoclasts under RANKL plus M-CSF. Induction is the differentiation drive.
description_zh_TW: 單核/巨噬細胞譜系在 RANKL 加 M-CSF 下分化為蝕骨細胞。誘發是分化驅動。

label: V-ATPase
description: V-ATPase acidifies the resorption lacuna near pH 4.5 for matrix degradation. Requirement is the acidification dependency.
description_zh_TW: V-ATPase 酸化吸收陷窩至約 pH 4.5 以降解基質。必要性是酸化依賴。

label: p53 (via hyperacetylation)
description: By inhibiting SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation, Tenovins promote p53 hyperacetylation and reactivation of p53-dependent transcriptional networks. Directionally, Tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation. This restores p53 tumor-suppressive function in cells where sirtuins silence it, and it is the basis for Tenovins' anticancer activity. Because p53 is a central tumor suppressor, its reactivation by sirtuin inhibition represents a compelling strategy for p53-wild-type tumors. The hyperacetylation increases p53 stability and transcriptional potency, driving cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 透過抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的去乙醯化，Tenovin 促進 p53 超乙醯化和 p53 依賴性轉錄網路的重新活化。在方向性上，Tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化的上游。這在 sirtuin 沉默 p53 的細胞中恢復其腫瘤抑制功能，是 Tenovin 抗癌活性的基礎。由於 p53 是核心腫瘤抑制因子，透過 sirtuin 抑制重新活化它是 p53 野生型腫瘤的引人注目策略。超乙醯化增加 p53 穩定性和轉錄效力，驅動細胞週期阻滯和凋亡。

label: Xenograft models
description: Tenovin-1 and Tenovin-6 significantly delay tumor growth in human cancer mouse xenografts at single-digit micromolar concentrations. Directionally, Tenovin treatment sits upstream of reduced tumor growth. This effect is attributed to p53 reactivation and sirtuin inhibition, and it validates sirtuin inhibition as an anticancer strategy in p53-wild-type tumors. The xenograft data demonstrate that sirtuin inhibitors can exert anti-tumor efficacy in vivo, complementing the extensive in vitro evidence. These results support the continued development of sirtuin inhibitors for oncology, particularly in combination with DNA-damaging agents.
description_zh_TW: Tenovin-1 和 Tenovin-6 在個位數微摩爾濃度下顯著延緩人腫瘤小鼠異種移植模型中的腫瘤生長。在方向性上，Tenovin 治療位於減少腫瘤生長的上游。此效應歸因於 p53 重新活化和 sirtuin 抑制，驗證了 sirtuin 抑制作為 p53 野生型腫瘤抗癌策略。異種移植數據表明 sirtuin 抑制劑可以在體內發揮抗腫瘤療效，與大量體外證據互補。這些結果支持繼續開發用於腫瘤學的 sirtuin 抑制劑，特別是與 DNA 損傷藥物的組合使用。

label: PEX gene mutations
description: Zellweger syndrome, the most severe form of the Zellweger spectrum of peroxisome biogenesis disorders, is caused by mutations in PEX genes required for peroxisome assembly and matrix protein import. Affected individuals lack functional peroxisomes, leading to accumulation of very-long-chain fatty acids, bile acid intermediates, and pipecolic acid, with profound neurologic, hepatic, and skeletal abnormalities. The spectrum's severity correlates with the degree of residual peroxisomal function. These disorders highlight the non-redundant essentiality of peroxisomes in human development.
description_zh_TW: Zellweger 症候群是 Zellweger 譜系過氧化體生物發生障礙中最嚴重的形式，由組裝過氧化體和基質蛋白輸入所需的 PEX 基因突變所引起。患者缺乏功能性過氧化體，導致極長鏈脂肪酸、膽汁酸中間物和哌可酸（pipecolic acid）累積，伴隨嚴重的神經、肝臟和骨骼異常。此譜系的嚴重程度與殘餘過氧化體功能程度相關。這些障礙凸顯了過氧化體在人類發育中非冗余的必要性。

label: PEX1 mutation
description: Mutations in PEX genes, which encode peroxisomal membrane proteins required for biogenesis, account for over 80% of autosomal recessive peroxisomal biogenesis disorders. Loss of PEX1, essential for assembly of the peroxisomal membrane and import of other PEX proteins, results in a complete absence of peroxisomes — the most severe Zellweger spectrum presentation with profound neurological impairment.
description_zh_TW: 編碼過氧化物體膜蛋白（生物生成所需）的 PEX 基因突變，佔體染色體隱性過氧化物體生成疾病的 80% 以上。PEX1 對過氧化物體膜組裝與其他 PEX 蛋白的輸入至關重要，其缺失會導致過氧化物體完全缺失，造成最嚴重、伴隨深度神經損傷的 Zellweger 光譜疾病表現。

label: Chronic SASP
description: Chronic SASP, through IL-6 and IL-8 via JAK/STAT3, promotes cancer stem-cell traits and expands the CSC pool in neighbouring epithelial and tumour cells, enhancing tumour initiation and relapse potential. By driving stemness and survival, the persistent secretome fosters malignant progression and therapy resistance. The relationship is a key mechanism by which senescence can become tumor-promoting and is supported by cancer-stemness and senescence co-culture studies. It motivates the one-two punch strategy of senescence induction followed by senolytic clearance.
description_zh_TW: 慢性 SASP 透過 IL-6 與 IL-8 經 JAK/STAT3 促進癌症幹細胞特性，並擴張鄰近上皮與腫瘤細胞中的 CSC 池，增強腫瘤起始與復發潛力。透過驅動幹性與存活，持續分泌組助長惡性進展並削弱治療。此促進將衰老與治療誘發衰老連結到腫瘤幹性，說明 SASP 在慢性脈絡中的雙重、促腫瘤面。它是年齡相關癌症的關鍵機制。

label: Temozolomide
description: MGMT expression confers temozolomide resistance in a subset of GBM.
description_zh_TW: MGMT 表達在部分 GBM 中賦予 temozolomide 抗藥性。

label: glioma sensitivity to temozolomide via ROS
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 inhibition increases the sensitivity of glioma cells to temozolomide through facilitation of intracellular reactive oxygen species generation. Directionally, SIRT1 inhibition sits upstream of elevated ROS and enhanced drug-induced cell death in glioma. By blocking SIRT1's protective anti-oxidant activity, glioma cells accumulate ROS that sensitize them to temozolomide, the standard chemotherapy for glioblastoma. Combining SIRT1 inhibition with temozolomide may therefore improve treatment efficacy in malignant glioma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1抑制透過促進細胞內活性氧的產生來增加膠質瘤細胞對替莫唑胺的敏感性。方向上，SIRT1抑制位於膠質瘤中ROS升高和藥物誘導的細胞死亡增強的上游。透過阻斷SIRT1的保護性抗氧化活性，膠質瘤細胞積累ROS，使其對替莫唑胺（膠質母細胞瘤的標準化療藥物）敏感。因此將SIRT1抑制與替莫唑胺結合可能改善惡性膠質瘤的治療效果。

label: Mitochondrial Membrane
description: Ivermectin directly depolarizes mitochondrial membranes, raising Bax, lowering Bcl-2 and releasing cytochrome c. Distinct from fenbendazole's HK2-VDAC detachment route.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 直接去極化粒線體膜，升高 Bax、降低 Bcl-2 並釋放 cytochrome c。不同於 fenbendazole 的 HK2-VDAC 脫離路徑。

label: Nuclear Transport
description: Importin-beta1 KPNB1 mediates NLS-dependent nuclear import as its primary function.
description_zh_TW: Importin-β1 KPNB1 以 NLS 依賴核輸入為主要功能。

label: Antibody
description: Trastuzumab is a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody.
description_zh_TW: trastuzumab 是人源化 IgG1 單株抗體。

label: 14-3-3 protein
description: Once TFEB is phosphorylated at serine 211 by mTORC1, 14-3-3 proteins bind the phosphorylated motif and mask the transcription factor's nuclear localization signal. This cytosolic sequestration prevents TFEB from accessing CLEAR elements in the nucleus, thereby suppressing expression of lysosomal and autophagic genes. The 14-3-3 interaction thereby converts a single phosphorylation event into a durable spatial exclusion of TFEB. Disruption of this complex is a key step in starvation- and drug-induced TFEB activation.
description_zh_TW: 一旦 TFEB 被 mTORC1 在 serine 211 磷酸化，14-3-3 蛋白即結合該磷酸化基序並遮蔽轉錄因子的核定位信號。這種細胞質隔離阻止 TFEB 接近核內的 CLEAR 元件，從而抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表現。14-3-3 的交互作用因此將單一磷酸化事件轉化為對 TFEB 的持久空間排除。此複合體的破壞是飢餓和藥物誘導 TFEB 活化中的關鍵步驟。

label: 20% of human cancers
description: The human SIRT3 gene is deleted in up to 20% of all human cancers analyzed overall, and in up to 40% of breast and ovarian cancers. This frequent deletion establishes SIRT3 as a tumor suppressor that acts through reactive oxygen species suppression and metabolic regulation. Directionally, SIRT3 loss sits upstream of increased tumorigenesis susceptibility. By removing mitochondrial antioxidant protection, deletion of SIRT3 raises oxidative stress that can drive oncogenic signaling and genomic damage. The high deletion frequency, especially in breast and ovarian cancer, suggests SIRT3 status is an important determinant of cancer risk and may have prognostic value.
description_zh_TW: 人類SIRT3基因在所分析的所有人類癌症中高達20%被刪除，在乳腺癌和卵巢癌中高達40%被刪除。這種高頻率的刪除確立了SIRT3作為透過活性氧抑制和代謝調節發揮作用的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT3缺失位於腫瘤發生易感性增加的上游。透過移除粒線體抗氧化保護，SIRT3的刪除增加了可驅動致癌訊號和基因組損傷的氧化壓力。高頻率的刪除，特別是在乳腺癌和卵巢癌中，表明SIRT3狀態是癌症風險的重要決定因素，可能具有預後價值。

label: 20S Proteasome
description: Carbonylated proteins are degraded by the 20S proteasome, which recognizes their unfolded, oxidized structure and degrades them independently of ubiquitin. This removes damaged proteins before they aggregate or lose function. The directionality is oxidized protein to proteasomal clearance. A caveat is that severe oxidation can form cross-links that resist degradation and instead promote aggregates, especially in aging and neurodegeneration. Because 20S degradation is ATP- and ubiquitin-independent, it provides a rapid, energy-sparing route for clearing mildly oxidized proteins.
description_zh_TW: Carbonylated proteins 被 20S proteasome 降解，20S proteasome 識別其未折疊的氧化結構並獨立於泛素進行降解。這可以在損壞的 proteins 聚集或失去功能之前將其刪除。方向性是氧化蛋白到蛋白酶體清除。需要注意的是，嚴重氧化會形成 cross 連接，從而抵抗降解並促進聚集，特別是在 aging 和 neurodegeneration 中。由於 20S 降解不依賴 ATP 和泛素，因此它提供了一個快速、節能的途徑來清除輕度氧化的 proteins。

description: Ubiquitous overexpression of the Drosophila Sir2 ortholog (dSir2) extends female lifespan by about 29%, with a more modest or absent effect in males. The sexually dimorphic response reflects differences in nutrient sensing and reproductive physiology between the sexes, and it mirrors the pattern seen in worm and yeast models. Directionally, increased dSir2 acts upstream to produce the longevity phenotype, consistent with a conserved sirtuin-caloric-restriction axis. As in C. elegans and S. cerevisiae, the effect depends on genetic background, dietary conditions, and the level of expression achieved.
description_zh_TW: 果蠅 Sir2 直系同源物（dSir2）的全表達過量表達可延長雌性壽命約 29%，對雄性則效果較為溫和或無效。這種性別二態性反應反映了兩性之間營養感知和生殖生理學的差異，並且與線蟲和酵母模型中看到的模式相呼應。在方向性上，dSir2 增加在上游作用產生長壽表型，與保守的 sirtuin-熱量限制軸一致。與在 C. elegans 和 S. cerevisiae 中一樣，該效應取決於遺傳背景、飲食條件和所達到的表達水平。

label: dSir2 overexpression (Drosophila)
description: Ubiquitous overexpression of the Drosophila Sir2 ortholog (dSir2) extends female lifespan by about 29%, with a more modest or absent effect in males. The sexually dimorphic response reflects differences in nutrient sensing and reproductive physiology between the sexes, and it mirrors the pattern seen in worm and yeast models. description: Integration of an extra SIR2 copy in yeast increases replicative lifespan by up to about 30%, implicating Sir2 dosage directly in longevity. The mechanism involves reinforced silencing at rDNA repeats, which reduces spurious recombination and the accumulation of extrachromosomal rDNA circles that drive aging. This is a gain-of-function, directional relationship: more Sir2 yields longer lifespan, though the effect saturates and very high doses can be detrimental. The finding established the foundational idea that boosting sirtuin activity can extend lifespan in a simple eukaryote.
description_zh_TW: 在酵母中整合額外的 SIR2 拷貝可使複製性壽命延長約 30%，直接將 Sir2 劑量與長壽聯繫起來。其機制涉及加強 rDNA 重複序列的沉默，減少異常重複組合和推動衰老的染色體外 rDNA 環的累積。這是一種功能增強的、方向性的關係：更多的 Sir2 產生更長的壽命，但這種效應會飽和，過高劑量可能有害。這一發現確立了增強 sirtuin 活性可以在簡單真核生物中延長壽命的基本理念。

label: 35% of cancer cell lines
description: A survey of approximately one thousand human cancer cell lines revealed that the SIRT6 locus was deleted in 35% of the samples. This high deletion frequency supports SIRT6's role as a tumor suppressor that acts through repression of HIF-1alpha and c-MYC and suppression of glycolytic metabolic reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of enhanced oncogenic metabolism and tumor growth. Without SIRT6, the brakes on aerobic glycolysis and proliferation are released, promoting the metabolic phenotype that sustains cancer. The prevalence of SIRT6 deletion across diverse cancer cell lines underscores its broad importance in restraining malignancy.
description_zh_TW: 對約一千種人類癌症細胞系的調查顯示，SIRT6基因座在35%的樣本中被刪除。這種高頻率的刪除支持SIRT6作為透過抑制HIF-1alpha和c-MYC以及抑制糖解代謝重編程來發揮作用的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於致癌代謝增強和腫瘤生長的上游。沒有SIRT6，對有氧糖解和增殖的制動被釋放，促進維持癌症的代謝表型。SIRT6刪除在不同癌症細胞系中的普遍性突顯了其在抑制惡性腫瘤方面的廣泛重要性。

label: 40% of methyl groups
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Creatine synthesis consumes approximately 40% of the body's methyl groups because the biosynthesis of creatine from glycine and arginine requires three S-adenosylmethionine-dependent methylation steps. This large demand makes creatine biosynthesis a dominant sink for the methyl pool, rivaling other methylation needs such as DNA, protein, and catechol methylation. Supplementing preformed creatine can therefore spare methyl groups for COMT and other methyltransferases by reducing endogenous synthesis demand. This metabolic arithmetic is why creatine supplementation is recommended in methyl-cycle support strategies.
description_zh_TW: Creatine synthesis 消耗體內 methyl groups 的大約 40%，因為從甘胺酸和精胺酸生物合成肌酸需要三個 S-adenosylmethionine 依賴性甲基化步驟。這種巨大的需求使得肌酸生物合成成為甲基池的主要匯，與其他甲基化需求（例如 DNA、蛋白質和兒茶酚甲基化）相提並論。因此，補充預製肌酸可以透過減少內源合成需求，為 COMT 和其他甲基轉移酶節省 methyl groups。這種代謝算術就是為什麼在甲基循環支持策略中推薦補充肌酸的原因。

description: A chromosomal duplication that increases sir-2.1 dosage in C. elegans extends lifespan by up to approximately 50%, paralleling the yeast finding in a multicellular organism. The longevity effect depends on intact insulin/IGF-1-like signaling, because sir-2.1 acts downstream of the DAF-2 pathway to promote stress resistance. The relationship is directional: elevated sir-2.1 produces the lifespan gain. A key caveat is that the requirement for DAF-16 (FOXO) ties sirtuin longevity to the conserved FOXO transcription-factor network.
description_zh_TW: 在秀丽隱桿線蟲（C. elegans）中，增加 sir-2.1 劑量的染色體複製可延長壽命約 50%，在多細胞生物中與酵母的發現相呼應。這種長壽效應依賴於完整的胰島素/IGF-1 類似信號通路，因為 sir-2.1 在 DAF-2 通路下游作用以促進壓力抗性。其方向性為：sir-2.1 升高產生壽命延長。一個關鍵的注意事項是，對 DAF-16（FOXO）的需求將 sirtuin 長壽與保守的 FOXO 轉錄因子網絡聯繫起來。

label: sir-2.1 overexpression (C. elegans)
description: A chromosomal duplication that increases sir-2.1 dosage in C. elegans extends lifespan by up to approximately 50%, paralleling the yeast finding in a multicellular organism. The longevity effect depends on intact insulin/IGF-1-like signaling, because sir-2.1 acts downstream of the DAF-2 pathway to promote stress resistance. The relationship is directional: elevated sir-2.1 produces the lifespan gain. A key caveat is that the requirement for DAF-16 (FOXO) ties sirtuin longevity to the conserved FOXO transcription-factor network.
description_zh_TW: 在秀丽隱桿線蟲（C. elegans）中，增加 sir-2.1 劑量的染色體複製可延長壽命約 50%，在多細胞生物中與酵母的發現相呼應。這種長壽效應依賴於完整的胰島素/IGF-1 類似信號通路，因為 sir-2.1 在 DAF-2 通路下游作用以促進壓力抗性。其方向性為：sir-2.1 升高產生壽命延長。一個關鍵的注意事項是，對 DAF-16（FOXO）的需求將 sirtuin 長壽與保守的 FOXO 轉錄因子網絡聯繫起來。

label: 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation
description: MTH1 prevents 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation by hydrolyzing the oxidized nucleotide triphosphate to 8-oxo-dGMP, sanitizing the dNTP pool before DNA polymerase can insert it. This provides a front-line defense that complements OGG1's post-replicative repair. The directionality is sanitization to mutation prevention. A caveat is that MTH1 knockout is tolerated in many contexts because backup repair exists, though cancer cells can become dependent on it (synthetic lethal vulnerability). Because DNA polymerases preferentially misinsert the oxidized nucleotide opposite adenine, MTH1 action is essential for maintaining replication fidelity in oxidatively stressed cells.
description_zh_TW: MTH1 透過將氧化的核苷酸三磷酸水解為 8-oxo-dGMP 來防止 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation，在 DNA 聚合酶插入之前對 dNTP 池進行消毒。這提供了前線防禦，補充了OGG1的複製後修復。方向性是淨化到突變預防。需要注意的是，由於存在備份修復，MTH1 敲除在許多情況下都是可以容忍的，儘管 cancer 細胞可能會依賴它（合成致命漏洞）。由於 DNA 聚合酶優先錯誤地將氧化核苷酸插入腺嘌呤對面，因此 MTH1 作用對於維持氧化壓力細胞中的複製保真度至關重要。

label: MTH1
description: MTH1 prevents 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation by hydrolyzing the oxidized nucleotide triphosphate to 8-oxo-dGMP, sanitizing the dNTP pool before DNA polymerase can insert it. This provides a front-line defense that complements OGG1's post-replicative repair. The directionality is sanitization to mutation prevention. A caveat is that MTH1 knockout is tolerated in many contexts because backup repair exists, though cancer cells can become dependent on it (synthetic lethal vulnerability). Because DNA polymerases preferentially misinsert the oxidized nucleotide opposite adenine, MTH1 action is essential for maintaining replication fidelity in oxidatively stressed cells.
description_zh_TW: MTH1 透過將氧化的核苷酸三磷酸水解為 8-oxo-dGMP 來防止 8-oxo-dGTP incorporation，在 DNA 聚合酶插入之前對 dNTP 池進行消毒。這提供了前線防禦，補充了OGG1的複製後修復。方向性是淨化到突變預防。需要注意的是，由於存在備份修復，MTH1 敲除在許多情況下都是可以容忍的，儘管 cancer 細胞可能會依賴它（合成致命漏洞）。由於 DNA 聚合酶優先錯誤地將氧化核苷酸插入腺嘌呤對面，因此 MTH1 作用對於維持氧化壓力細胞中的複製保真度至關重要。

label: non-methylated B12 alternative
description: Adenosylcobalamin is a non-methylated, non-methyl-donating form of vitamin B12, in contrast to methylcobalamin which directly supplies a methyl group to the methylation cycle via methionine synthase. Its primary biological role is as the cofactor for mitochondrial methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, which converts methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA for energy production. Because it bypasses direct methyl donation, it avoids contributing to the methyl load that can accumulate when COMT activity is genetically slow. It is therefore frequently recommended as a safer B12 source for slow COMT individuals who are sensitive to methylated vitamins and may react with anxiety, irritability, or insomnia.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 是維生素 B12 的非甲基化、非甲基供給形式，與甲鈷胺相反，甲鈷胺透過蛋氨酸合成酶直接向 methylation cycle 提供甲基。其主要生物學作用是作為線粒體甲基丙二酰輔酶A變位酶的輔因子，該酶將甲基丙二酰輔酶A轉化為琥珀酰輔酶A以產生能量。因為它繞過了直接的甲基捐贈，所以它避免了 COMT activity 基因緩慢時可能累積的甲基負荷。因此，經常建議將其作為對 methylated vitamins 敏感並可能出現焦慮、煩躁或失眠反應的緩慢 COMT 個體的更安全的 B12 來源。

label: active coenzyme form of B12
description: Adenosylcobalamin is one of two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12 (cobalamin), alongside methylcobalamin, serving as an essential cofactor for mitochondrial enzymes in the methionine and methylmalonyl-CoA metabolic pathways. Unlike methylcobalamin, it does not donate a methyl group directly to the methylation cycle, so it does not contribute to the body's methyl burden. This distinction makes adenosylcobalamin particularly relevant for individuals with slow COMT activity, who may be sensitive to methyl-donating B12 forms.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 是維生素 B12（鈷胺素）的兩種活性輔酶形式之一，與甲鈷胺一起，作為蛋氨酸和甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 代謝途徑中線粒體酶的重要輔助因子。與甲鈷胺不同，它不會直接向 methylation cycle 提供甲基，因此不會增加人體的甲基負擔。這種區別使得腺苷鈷胺素對於 COMT activity 緩慢的個體特別重要，他們可能對甲基供體 B12 形式敏感。

label: mitochondrial health
description: Adenosylcobalamin supports mitochondrial health by acting as the required cofactor for methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, an enzyme in the mitochondrial matrix that converts methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA within the citric acid cycle. Efficient function of this pathway sustains cellular energy (ATP) production and prevents accumulation of methylmalonic acid. Because mitochondrial dysfunction is linked to numerous age-related and neurological conditions, maintaining adequate adenosylcobalamin status is important for bioenergetic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 透過充當甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 變位酶所需的輔助因子來支持 mitochondrial health，甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 變位酶是線粒體基質中的一種酶，可在檸檬酸循環中將甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 轉化為琥珀酰輔酶 A。此途徑的有效功能可維持細胞能量 (ATP) 的產生並防止甲基丙二酸的累積。由於粒線體功能障礙與許多年齡相關和神經系統疾病有關，因此維持足夠的腺苷鈷胺狀態對於生物能穩態非常重要。

label: homocysteine to methionine
description: Betaine (trimethylglycine) converts homocysteine to methionine via the enzyme betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase (BHMT), providing one of its three methyl groups in a folate-independent remethylation pathway. This reaction lowers circulating homocysteine, a cardiovascular and neurotoxic risk factor, and supports methionine and subsequently SAMe availability for methyltransferases including COMT. Because it bypasses the folate cycle and MTHFR, betaine is a useful remethylation option when folate-dependent remethylation is impaired. However, its methyl-donating nature means it adds to the methyl load and must be used cautiously in slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸）透過甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶 (BHMT) 轉化 homocysteine to methionine，在獨立於 folate 的再甲基化途徑中提供其三個 methyl groups 之一。此反應降低了循環同型半胱氨酸（一種心血管和神經毒性危險因子），並支持蛋氨酸以及隨後的 SAMe 對甲基轉移酶（包括 COMT）的可用性。由於甜菜鹼繞過了 folate 循環和 MTHFR，因此當 folate 依賴性再甲基化受損時，甜菜鹼是一種有用的再甲基化選項。然而，其提供甲基的性質意味著它會增加甲基負荷，因此在緩慢的 COMT 個體中必須謹慎使用。

label: two forms
description: COMT exists in two major isoforms produced by alternative translation initiation: a soluble form (S-COMT) found predominantly in peripheral tissues such as liver, kidney, and erythrocytes, and a membrane-bound form (MB-COMT) anchored to the Golgi that predominates in the brain. MB-COMT has higher affinity for catechol substrates and is the principal neuronal isoform. This tissue-specific distribution explains why central and peripheral catechol metabolism are differentially affected by COMT genotype and inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: COMT 存在於由替代翻譯起始產生的兩種主要異構體中：主要存在於 peripheral tissues（如肝、腎和紅血球）中的可溶形式 (S-COMT)，以及錨定在高爾基體上的膜結合形式 (MB-COMT)，主要存在於 brain 中。 MB-COMT 對兒茶酚底物具有較高的親和力，是主要的神經元亞型。這種組織特異性分佈解釋了為什麼 COMT genotype 和抑制劑對中樞和周邊兒茶酚代謝的影響不同。

label: Epinephrine levels
description: COMT inhibition increases epinephrine (adrenaline) levels because O-methylation to metanephrine is blocked, prolonging epinephrine signaling and allowing accumulation of the parent catecholamine. Clinically, COMT inhibitors such as entacapone and opicapone used as adjuncts to levodopa in Parkinson's disease raise circulating catecholamines, which is therapeutically useful for motor symptoms but can cause adrenergic side effects. The directionality is straightforward: less enzymatic inactivation yields higher epinephrine. This relationship also connects COMT blockade to downstream oxidative products such as adrenochrome.
description_zh_TW: COMT 抑制會增加腎上腺素（腎上腺素）水平，因為 O-甲基化為變腎上腺素被阻斷，從而延長腎上腺素信號傳導並允許母體兒茶酚胺積累。臨床上，COMT 抑制劑（例如恩他卡朋和阿匹卡朋）用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，可提高循環 catecholamines，這對運動症狀有治療作用，但可能引起腎上腺素能副作用。方向性很簡單：較少的酵素失活會產生較高的腎上腺素。這種關係也將 COMT 阻斷與下游氧化產物（例如腎上腺素紅）聯繫起來。

label: striatal dopamine release
description: COMT overexpression increases striatal dopamine release capacity, observed in COMT-OE mice as enhanced phasic dopamine signaling in the striatum. The mechanism is thought to involve homeostatic upregulation of dopamine synthesis and release in response to chronically low extracellular dopamine tone produced by excess clearance. This contrasts with the cognitive deficits also seen in these mice, illustrating region-specific effects of COMT activity on striatal versus prefrontal dopamine systems. The finding helps dissociate the motor and cognitive consequences of COMT excess.
description_zh_TW: COMT 過度表現增加了 striatal dopamine release 的能力，在 COMT-OE 小鼠中觀察到，紋狀體中的階段性多巴胺訊號傳導增強。該機制被認為涉及多巴胺合成和釋放的穩態上調，以響應因過度清除而產生的長期較低的細胞外多巴胺張力。這與這些小鼠中也觀察到的認知缺陷形成鮮明對比，說明 COMT activity 對紋狀體多巴胺系統與前額葉多巴胺系統的區域特異性影響。這項發現有助於區分 COMT 過量對運動和認知的影響。

label: methyl groups from SAMe
description: COMT requires methyl groups derived from S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe), the universal methyl donor generated by the methionine cycle, to methylate catechol substrates. Each catalytic turnover consumes one SAMe molecule, coupling COMT flux tightly to the cellular methyl budget and to folate- and B12-dependent remethylation that regenerates methionine and SAMe. This dependence means COMT activity is sensitive to overall methyl donor availability, including diet, supplementation, and genetic variants affecting one-carbon metabolism. It also explains why excess methyl donors can be poorly tolerated when COMT activity is already slow.
description_zh_TW: COMT 需要源自 S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe) 的 methyl groups（由蛋胺酸循環產生的通用 methyl donor）來甲基化兒茶酚底物。每次催化轉換消耗一個 SAMe 分子，將 COMT 通量與細胞甲基預算以及 folate 和 B12 依賴性再甲基化緊密耦合，從而再生蛋氨酸和 SAMe。這種依賴性意味著 COMT activity 對 methyl donor 的整體可用性敏感，包括飲食、補充劑和影響一碳代謝的遺傳變異。這也解釋了為什麼當 COMT activity 已經很慢時，過量的甲基供體的耐受性很差。

label: increased compulsive behavior
description: COMT-OE mice show increased compulsive behavior, reflected in more perseverative responses, indicating that excess COMT activity shifts the impulsive-compulsive balance toward perseveration. This suggests COMT tone influences the tuning of habit and repetitive-behavior circuits, particularly in the striatum and prefrontal cortex. The observation extends the behavioral phenotyping of COMT overexpression beyond cognition and impulsivity. It is relevant to disorders characterized by compulsivity and rigid behavioral patterns.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 increased compulsive behavior，反映在更堅持不懈的反應中，顯示過量的 COMT activity 會使衝動-強迫平衡轉向堅持。這表明 COMT 音調影響習慣和重複行為迴路的調節，特別是在紋狀體和前額葉皮質。此觀察結果將 COMT 過度表現的行為表型擴展到認知和 impulsivity 之外。它與以強迫性和僵化行為模式為特徵的疾病有關。

label: increased impulsive behavior
description: COMT-OE mice show increased impulsive behavior, quantified as more premature responses in timed operant tasks, consistent with catecholaminergic perturbation of inhibitory control circuits in prefrontal and striatal regions. This mirrors impulsivity-related traits linked to fast COMT in humans, such as risk-taking and rapid decision-making under time pressure. The phenotype is reversible by manipulations that restore dopamine signaling, supporting causality rather than confounded effects. It extends the COMT-OE behavioral profile beyond cognition into impulse control.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 increased impulsive behavior，量化為定時操作任務中更多的過早反應，與前額葉和紋狀體區域抑制控制迴路的兒茶酚胺能擾動一致。這反映了與快速 COMT in humans 相關的 impulsivity 相關特徵，例如在時間壓力下承擔風險和快速決策。透過恢復多巴胺訊號傳導的操作，表型是可逆的，支持因果關係而不是混雜效應。它將 COMT-OE 行為特徵從認知擴展到衝動控制。

label: specific cognitive deficits
description: COMT-OE mice show specific cognitive deficits, particularly in stimulus-response learning and working memory, attributable to excess catecholamine clearance that reduces dopamine availability in prefrontal and striatal circuits. These deficits model the cognitive endophenotype associated with fast human COMT genotypes, providing a causal link between enzyme activity and cognition. The specificity, rather than global impairment, supports a circuit-level rather than generalized effect of COMT overexpression. Such models are central to translating COMT genetics into mechanistic understanding.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 specific cognitive deficits，特別是 stimulus-response learning 和工作記憶，這是由於兒茶酚胺清除過多，減少了前額葉和紋狀體迴路中多巴胺的可用性。這些缺陷模擬了與快速人類 COMT 基因型相關的認知內表型，提供了酶活性和認知之間的因果關係。 COMT 過度表現的特異性（而不是全局損傷）支持電路水平而非普遍效應。這些模型對於將 COMT 遺傳學轉化為機械理解至關重要。

label: Entacapone
description: Entacapone is a peripherally acting COMT inhibitor used as an adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease to block the O-methylation of levodopa, prolonging its plasma half-life and brain availability. By inhibiting COMT, it raises levodopa and catecholamine levels, improving motor fluctuations and reducing off time. Unlike tolcapone, entacapone has minimal central nervous system penetration, which reduces the risk of hepatotoxicity. It exemplifies the therapeutic use of peripheral COMT blockade in dopaminergic therapy.
description_zh_TW: Entacapone 是一種外周作用的 COMT 抑制劑，用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，阻斷左旋多巴的 O-甲基化，延長其血漿半衰期和 brain 的可用性。透過抑制 COMT，它可以提高左旋多巴和兒茶酚胺水平，改善運動波動並減少休息時間。與託卡朋不同，恩他卡朋具有最小的中樞神經系統滲透性，從而降低了肝毒性的風險。它例證了外周 COMT 阻斷在多巴胺能治療中的治療用途。

label: brain
description: MB-COMT (membrane-bound COMT) predominates in the brain, where its membrane-anchored localization near catechol release sites allows efficient perisynaptic O-methylation of dopamine and norepinephrine. This makes MB-COMT the major determinant of central COMT activity and of the genotype-dependent cognitive effects associated with Val158Met. Peripheral tissues instead rely more on the soluble S-COMT isoform, which has lower substrate affinity. This regional isoform distribution explains why COMT genotype affects brain and periphery differently.
description_zh_TW: MB-COMT（膜結合型 COMT）在 brain 中占主導地位，其在兒茶酚釋放位點附近的膜錨定定位允許多巴胺和 norepinephrine 進行有效的突觸周圍 O-甲基化。這使得 MB-COMT 成為中樞 COMT activity 以及與 Val158Met 相關的基因型依賴性認知效應的主要決定因素。相反，週邊組織更依賴可溶性 S-COMT 亞型，其底物親和力較低。這種區域亞型分佈解釋了為什麼 COMT genotype 對 brain 和周邊細胞的影響不同。

label: cofactor for COMT
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Magnesium is a required cofactor for COMT, with the enzyme's catalytic activity depending on divalent cations, magnesium prominently, to coordinate SAMe and the catechol substrate during methyl transfer. Magnesium deficiency can reduce COMT efficiency and impair catecholamine clearance, compounding the effects of genetically slow COMT variants. Ensuring magnesium adequacy is a common recommendation for supporting healthy COMT activity in personalized protocols. It is a nutritional lever that directly affects enzyme catalysis.
description_zh_TW: Magnesium 是必需的 cofactor for COMT，該酶的催化活性取決於二價陽離子（主要是鎂），以在甲基轉移過程中協調 SAMe 和兒茶酚底物。 Magnesium 缺乏會降低 COMT 效率並損害兒茶酚胺清除率，加劇了遺傳性緩慢的 COMT variants 的影響。確保鎂充足是在個人化方案中支援健康 COMT activity 的常見建議。它是直接影響酵素催化作用的營養槓桿。

label: EGCG more slowly
description: Slow COMT individuals metabolize EGCG more slowly because their reduced COMT activity delays O-methylation and excretion of this catechin, prolonging its plasma and tissue exposure. This altered pharmacokinetics can enhance both beneficial antioxidant effects and any inhibitory competition with endogenous catechols at the enzyme. Genotype thus modulates the dose-response of EGCG supplementation, with slow individuals potentially experiencing greater exposure. It is a clear example of COMT-dependent polyphenol disposition.
description_zh_TW: COMT 個體代謝 EGCG more slowly 較慢，因為 COMT activity 的減少會延遲兒茶素的 O-甲基化和排泄，延長其血漿和組織暴露時間。這種改變的藥物動力學可以增強有益的抗氧化作用以及與內源性兒茶酚在酵素上的任何抑制性競爭。因此，基因型調節 EGCG supplementation 的劑量反應，緩慢的個體可能會經歷更大的暴露。這是 COMT 依賴的多酚配置的明顯例子。

label: estrogen metabolite clearance
description: Slow COMT slows the clearance of certain estrogen metabolites, specifically catecholestrogens such as 2- and 4-hydroxyestrogens, because COMT O-methylation is the key detoxification step converting them to less genotoxic methoxyestrogens. Impaired clearance may increase exposure to reactive catecholestrogen quinones, a hypothesized risk factor for hormone-sensitive cancers. This links COMT genotype to estrogen-related disease susceptibility and to interactions with compounds like vitamin E. It is among the most clinically relevant consequences of slow COMT.
description_zh_TW: 緩慢的 COMT 會減慢某些雌激素代謝物的清除，特別是兒茶酚雌激素，如 2- 和 4- 羥基雌激素，因為 COMT O-甲基化是將它們轉化為遺傳毒性較小的甲氧基雌激素的關鍵解毒步驟。清除受損可能會增加活性兒茶酚雌激素醌的暴露，這是激素敏感癌症的假設危險因子。這將 COMT genotype 與雌激素相關疾病的易感性以及與維生素 E 等化合物的相互作用聯繫起來。這是緩慢的 COMT 與臨床最相關的後果之一。

label: chromosome 22q11.21
description: The COMT gene is located on chromosome 22 at band q11.21, a locus also associated with the 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, which presents with cardiac, craniofacial, and psychiatric features. Its genomic position places it within a region subject to copy-number variation that can affect COMT dosage and enzyme levels, with hemizygosity influencing catecholamine metabolism in deletion carriers. The well-characterized Val158Met polymorphism (rs4680) at this locus is among the most studied functional variants in neuropsychiatry and pharmacogenetics. The locus therefore links structural chromosomal variation to catecholamine physiology.
description_zh_TW: COMT 基因位於 22 號染色體 q11.21 條帶上，該位點也與 22q11.2 缺失症候群相關，該症候群表現為心臟、顱顏和精神特徵。它的基因組位置將其置於一個受拷貝數變異影響的區域內，該變異可以影響 COMT 劑量和酶水平，其半合性影響缺失載體中的兒茶酚胺代謝。該位點的充分錶徵的 Val158Met 多態性 (rs4680) 是神經精神病學和藥物遺傳學中研究最多的功能變異之一。因此，該基因座將結構染色體變異與兒茶酚胺生理學連結起來。

label: Tolcapone
description: Tolcapone is a potent COMT inhibitor used as an adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease, blocking peripheral and central O-methylation of levodopa to extend its half-life and brain penetration. Its central activity improves motor fluctuations but carries a risk of rare, sometimes fatal hepatotoxicity, requiring liver enzyme monitoring. It exemplifies the therapeutic use of COMT blockade in dopaminergic therapy. Its central penetration distinguishes it from peripherally restricted inhibitors such as entacapone and opicapone.
description_zh_TW: Tolcapone 是一種有效的 COMT 抑制劑，用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，阻斷左旋多巴的周邊和中樞 O-甲基化，以延長其半衰期和 brain 滲透。其中樞活性可改善運動波動，但有罕見甚至致命的肝毒性風險，需要監測肝臟酵素。它例證了 COMT 阻斷劑在多巴胺能治療的治療用途。其中樞滲透使其有別於恩他卡朋和阿匹卡朋等周邊限制性抑制劑。

label: Magnesium as cofactor
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Reactions using COMT include magnesium as a cofactor, so it is important to get plenty of magnesium in the diet or through a mineral supplement to support COMT function. Magnesium stabilizes the SAMe-substrate complex for efficient methyl transfer. This makes magnesium a practical nutritional lever for maintaining healthy COMT activity.
description_zh_TW: 使用 COMT 的反應包含鎂作為輔因子，因此在飲食中攝取足量鎂或透過礦物質補充劑來支持 COMT 功能很重要。鎂穩定 SAMe-受質複合物以實現有效的甲基轉移。這使鎂成為維持健康 COMT activity 的實用營養槓桿。

label: COMT inhibitor
description: Opicapone belongs to the COMT-inhibitor drug class as its third-generation peripherally restricted member. Classification groups it with entacapone and tolcapone.
description_zh_TW: Opicapone 屬於 COMT 抑制劑藥物類別，為第三代周邊限制性成員。歸類將它與 entacapone 和 tolcapone 並列。

label: AAV-CentSIRT6
description: AAV-mediated delivery of centenarian SIRT6 reduces LINE-1 ORF1p and ORF2p protein levels in HGPS patient-derived fibroblasts, validating the variant's silencing function in progeria. Directionally, CentSIRT6 expression sits upstream of LINE-1 reduction. This is a proof-of-concept gene-therapy approach to laminopathy, and it extends the SIRT6/LINE-1 axis to a treatable model. By restoring SIRT6 function in progeria cells through gene delivery, the approach reproduces the LINE-1-suppressing effect of the centenarian variant. These results support the feasibility of SIRT6-based gene therapy for progeroid syndromes.
description_zh_TW: AAV 介導的百歲人瑞 SIRT6 遞送在 HGPS 患者來源的成纖維細胞中降低 LINE-1 ORF1p 和 ORF2p 蛋白水平，驗證了該變異體在早衰症中的沉默功能。在方向性上，CentSIRT6 表達位於 LINE-1 減少的上游。這是針對核纖層蛋白病的概念驗證基因治療方法，並將 SIRT6/LINE-1 軸線延伸到可治療的模型。透過基因遞送恢復早衰症細胞中的 SIRT6 功能，該方法重現了百歲人瑞變異體的 LINE-1 抑制效應。這些結果支持基於 SIRT6 的基因治療用於早衰症候群的可行性。

label: ABCA1 mutations
description: ABCA1 mutations cause Tangier disease, a rare disorder in which loss-of-function ABCA1 alleles lead to extremely low HDL and accumulation of cholesteryl esters in macrophages and other tissues. The defect blocks cholesterol efflux, producing enlarged orange tonsils and neuropathy. The directionality is transporter loss to lipid accumulation. A caveat is that incomplete versus complete loss of function yields a spectrum of severity, and modifier genes influence phenotype. Heterozygotes show intermediate HDL reduction, illustrating a gene-dosage effect and the clinical spectrum between Tangier disease and familial HDL deficiency.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 mutations 導致 Tangier disease，這是一種罕見的疾病，其中 ABCA1 等位基因功能喪失導致 HDL 極低以及巨噬細胞和其他組織中膽固醇酯的累積。此缺陷阻礙了 cholesterol 的流出，導致橙色扁桃體增大和神經病變。方向性是轉運蛋白損失導致脂質累積。需要注意的是，不完全與完全功能喪失會產生一系列嚴重程度，且修飾基因會影響表型。雜合子表現出中等程度的 HDL 降低，說明了基因劑量效應以及 Tangier disease 和家族性 HDL 缺乏症之間的臨床光譜。

label: Acetylated alpha-tubulin
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The cell-based ELISA-type assay, adapted from histone acetyltransferase inhibitor assays, confirms SIRT2 inhibitors such as 3-arylideneindolin-2-ones: cells seeded in 96-well plates are treated with compounds, fixed, permeabilized, and probed with antibody against acetylated alpha-tubulin, with fluorescence measured after enhancement solution addition. This format is well suited for high-throughput screenings. Directionally, the acetylated tubulin signal directly reflects SIRT2 deacetylase inhibition in cells. It complements Western blot with quantitative, plate-based throughput.
description_zh_TW: 基於細胞的 ELISA 型測定改編自組蛋白乙醯轉移酶抑制劑測定，用於確認 SIRT2 抑制劑如 3-亞苄基吲哚酮-2-酮：將細胞接種於 96 孔板中，經化合物處理、固定、透化後，使用抗乙醯化 α-tubulin 的抗體探測，在加入增強溶液後測量螢光。此格式非常適合高通量篩選。方向性上乙醯化 tubulin 訊號直接反映細胞中的 SIRT2 去乙醯酶抑制。它以定量、微孔板兼容的通量補充了西方墨點法。

label: Acetylated p53, histone 3 and gamma-tubulin
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Western blot is the most commonly used cell-based analysis to evaluate sirtuin inhibition: cells are exposed to putative inhibitors, lysed, and probed with antibodies against acetylated lysine on known sirtuin substrates, typically p53, histone 3, or gamma-tubulin. Increased acetylation indicates reduced sirtuin activity. Directionally, the acetylation state of these substrates reports the functional outcome of inhibitor treatment in intact cells. Because it measures endogenous substrates rather than artificial fluorophores, it is a key confirmatory readout after fluorescent screening.
description_zh_TW: 西方墨點法是最常用的基於細胞的分析方法，用於評估 sirtuin 抑制：將細胞暴露於推定的抑制劑後裂解，並使用抗已知 sirtuin 受質上乙醯化離胺酸的抗體進行探測，通常為 p53、組蛋白 H3 或 γ-tubulin。乙醯化增加表示 sirtuin 活性降低。方向性上這些受質的乙醯化狀態報告了抑制劑在完整細胞中的功能結果。由於其測量的是內源性受質而非人工螢光基團，它是螢光篩選後的關鍵確認性讀取。

label: Vitamin B3
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: High efficiency of vitamin B3 (niacin or nicotinamide) in preventing lung tissue damage was confirmed in several animal models with bleomycin- and LPS-induced lung injury, and considering this strong lung-protective effect, vitamin B3 has been proposed as an early treatment-supporting agent against COVID-19, which otherwise causes a maladaptive hyperinflammatory response with a cytokine storm in lung tissue. Nicotinamide riboside (NR), as a vitamin B3 derivative, is therefore considered a potential therapeutic or supporting agent to reduce hyperinflammation and regenerate damaged lung tissue during SARS-CoV-2 infection, where excess leucocyte infiltration causes extensive tissue damage
description_zh_TW: 維生素 B3（niacin 或 nicotinamide）在預防肺組織損傷方面的高效性已在數種 bleomycin（博萊黴素）與 LPS 誘發肺損傷的動物模型中獲得證實，且考量到此強效的肺保護效果，維生素 B3 已被提議作為對抗 COVID-19 的早期治療支援劑，否則 COVID-19 會在肺組織中引發伴隨細胞激素風暴的適應不良過度發炎反應。因此，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）作為維生素 B3 的衍生物，被視為在 SARS-CoV-2 感染期間減少過度發炎並再生受損肺組織的潛在治療或支援劑，在此感染中過量的白血球浸潤造成廣泛的組織損傷。

label: Adenine, nicotinamide-ribose and nicotinamide pockets
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The sirtuin NAD+ binding site is divisible into an adenine binding pocket (pocket A), a nicotinamide ribose pocket (pocket B), and a nicotinamide binding pocket (pocket C), formed by the large Rossmann domain and the cofactor binding loop. NAD+ enters a non-productive conformation outside the C pocket until an acetyl-lysine substrate is present, at which point a productive arrangement engages the C pocket. Directionally, this topology defines how inhibitors such as nicotinamide (pocket C) and suramin (pockets B, C, and substrate site) act, and frames structure-based design of sirtuin modulators.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin NAD+ 結合位點可分為腺嘌呤結合口袋（口袋 A）、尼可醯胺核糖口袋（口袋 B）和尼可醯胺結合口袋（口袋 C），由大型 Rossmann 結構域和輔因子結合環形成。在沒有乙醯-離胺酸受質存在時，NAD+ 以非生產性構象進入 C 口袋以外的區域；當受質存在時，產生性構象才會與 C 口袋結合。方向性上此拓撲結構定義了抑制劑如尼可醯胺（口袋 C）和 Suramin（口袋 B、C 和受質位點）的作用方式，並為 sirtuin 調節劑的結構導向設計提供了框架。

label: AGE burden
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: A diet restricting advanced glycation end products can effectively reduce the AGE burden in the human body. In renal failure patients, a low-AGE diet produced a 34% reduction in blood CML levels, while an AGE-rich diet increased CML by 29%. Because significant AGE generation occurs when sugars are cooked with proteins, dietary intake is an important exogenous source of glycotoxins. Restricting dietary AGEs is therefore proposed as an effective way to reduce circulating AGE levels and protect against AGE-related organ dysfunction and tissue aging.
description_zh_TW: 限制晚期糖化終產物（advanced glycation end products，AGE）的飲食能有效降低人體內的 AGE 負擔。在腎衰竭患者中，低 AGE 飲食使血液 CML 濃度下降 34%，而富含 AGE 的飲食則使 CML 上升 29%。由於糖類與蛋白質共同烹煮時會產生大量 AGE，飲食攝取是 glycotoxins 的重要外源性來源。因此，限制飲食中的 AGE 被視為降低循環 AGE 濃度、防護 AGE 相關器官功能障礙與組織老化的有效方式。

label: Age-related Hearing Loss
description: AHL is the most prevalent auditory impairment in older adults, tightly correlated with cumulative oxidative stress. Caloric restriction alleviates AHL by reducing oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protection is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice; SIRT3-driven IDH2/NADPH activity preserves cochlear hair cells.
description_zh_TW: AHL 是老年人中最普遍的聽覺障礙，與累積性氧化壓力密切相關。熱量限制透過減少耳蝸細胞中的氧化損傷緩解 AHL，但此保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中被消除；SIRT3 驅動的 IDH2/NADPH 活性維護耳蝸毛細胞。

label: SIRT3-dependent CR protection

label: AGO2
description: AGO2 (Argonaute 2) is the catalytic core of RISC executing microRNA-guided silencing. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity through modulation of the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway; SIRT3 loss breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression.
description_zh_TW: AGO2（Argonaute 2）是 RISC 的催化核心，執行 microRNA 引導的基因沉默。在糖尿病心肌病變中，SIRT3 活化透過調節 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力；SIRT3 缺失打破此軸線，損害 ETC 活性並加速 DCM 進展。

label: microRNA silencing
description: AGO2 (Argonaute 2) is the catalytic core of RISC executing microRNA-guided silencing. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity through modulation of the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway; SIRT3 loss breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression.

label: Aldosterone
description: Aldosterone trains human monocytes via the mineralocorticoid receptor by upregulating fatty-acid-synthesis enzymes with H3K4me3 enrichment at lipid-metabolism promoters. Blocking fatty acid synthesis abrogates aldosterone training without altering glycolysis or OXPHOS, unlike beta-glucan. It reveals an anabolic-lipid route to innate memory.
description_zh_TW: Aldosterone 經由 mineralocorticoid receptor，上調 fatty-acid-synthesis enzymes，並在 lipid-metabolism 啟動子處富集 H3K4me3，以訓練人類單核球。阻斷 Fatty Acid Synthesis 可消除 Aldosterone 訓練，但不改變 glycolysis 或 OXPHOS，這與 beta-glucan 不同。它揭示了一條 anabolic-lipid 通往先天記憶的路徑。

label: Fatty Acid Synthesis
description: Aldosterone trains human monocytes via the mineralocorticoid receptor by upregulating fatty-acid-synthesis enzymes with H3K4me3 enrichment at lipid-metabolism promoters. Blocking fatty acid synthesis abrogates aldosterone training without altering glycolysis or OXPHOS, unlike beta-glucan. It reveals an anabolic-lipid route to innate memory.
description_zh_TW: Aldosterone 經由 mineralocorticoid receptor，上調 fatty-acid-synthesis enzymes，並在 lipid-metabolism 啟動子處富集 H3K4me3，以訓練人類單核球。阻斷 Fatty Acid Synthesis 可消除 Aldosterone 訓練，但不改變 glycolysis 或 OXPHOS，這與 beta-glucan 不同。它揭示了一條 anabolic-lipid 通往先天記憶的路徑。

label: Vascular Dementia
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Accumulation of advanced glycation end products in aging persons is associated not only with diabetes complications but also with chronic diseases including vascular dementia. Bar and colleagues demonstrated differential increases of AGE products in Alzheimer's dementia and vascular dementia compared with controls. Because vascular dementia is driven by cerebrovascular dysfunction and impaired perfusion, the ability of AGEs to stiffen vessels, drive endothelial dysfunction, and promote inflammation offers a plausible mechanistic link. These findings place glycation among the modifiable biochemical processes associated with cognitive decline in the elderly.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products在aging persons中的accumulation不僅與diabetes complications有關，也與包括vascular dementia在內的chronic diseases相關。Bar及其colleagues demonstrated differential increases of AGE products in Alzheimer's dementia與vascular dementia compared with controls。由於vascular dementia是由cerebrovascular dysfunction與impaired perfusion所driven，AGEs使vessels stiffen、drive endothelial dysfunction並promote inflammation的能力，提供了一個plausible mechanistic link。這些findings place glycation among the modifiable biochemical processes associated with cognitive decline in the elderly。

label: ECM
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix (ECM), such as in collagen and elastic fibers, and cross-link with ECM components. This accumulation and cross-linking cause a decrease in connective tissue elasticity, alter ECM structure and function, and impair vascular function, facilitating plaque formation and basement membrane hyperplasia. AGE accumulation in the ECM is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs contribute to aging, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated signaling. ECM glycation is strongly implicated in arterial stiffening, skin aging, and age-related stiffness of tendons and cartilage.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM，如 collagen 與 elastic fibers）內，並與 ECM components 交聯。此 accumulation 與 cross-linking 導致 connective tissue 彈性下降、改變 ECM structure 與 function，並損害 vascular function，促進 plaque formation 與 basement membrane hyperplasia。ECM 中的 AGE accumulation 是 AGEs 促成 aging 的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated signaling。ECM glycation 與 arterial stiffening、skin aging 以及 tendons 與 cartilage 的年齡相關 stiffness 密切相關。

label: Elastin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix and cross-link elastic fibers as well as collagen. This cross-linking of extracellular proteins reduces the elasticity of connective tissues such as blood vessels, skin, and tendons, affecting especially vascular function. Glycated modifications alter the balance between ECM synthesis and degradation, accelerating skin aging and increasing skin stiffness. AGE-elastin cross-linking is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs injure tissues, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM）內，並使 elastic fibers 與 collagen 交聯。這種 extracellular proteins 的交聯降低了 blood vessels、skin 與 tendons 等結締組織的彈性，尤其影響 vascular function。Glycated modifications 改變 ECM synthesis 與 degradation 之間的平衡，加速 skin aging 並增加皮膚僵硬。AGE-elastin cross-linking 是 AGEs 傷害組織的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling。

label: Schiff base
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: During the second phase of the Maillard reaction, the initially reversible Schiff base undergoes a chemical rearrangement over a period of days to form Amadori products, also known as early glycation products. Amadori products are more stable than the Schiff base but the reaction remains reversible; hemoglobin A1c is the most widely recognized Amadori product and serves as an indicator of blood glucose management. If Amadori products accumulate, they undergo further oxidations, reductions, and hydrations over weeks or months to form irreversibly crosslinked proteins and ultimately advanced glycation end products.
description_zh_TW: 在Maillard reaction的second phase，最初reversible的Schiff base在days期間undergoes a chemical rearrangement，形成Amadori products，亦稱early glycation products。Amadori products比Schiff base更stable但reaction remains reversible；hemoglobin A1c是最widely recognized Amadori product，並serves as an indicator of blood glucose management。若Amadori products accumulate，它們會在weeks或months內undergo further oxidations、reductions與hydrations，形成irreversibly crosslinked proteins，ultimately advanced glycation end products。

label: glycated serum albumin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Epicatechin, a flavanol, demonstrates potent AGE-breaking properties in vitro and in vivo. It destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin in vitro and decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. Mechanistically, side chains attached to the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures are susceptible to nucleophilic attack, and because C6 and C8 on the A-ring of epicatechin are nucleophilic, epicatechin can attack and destroy AGE cross-links. These findings position epicatechin as a naturally occurring AGE breaker with potential for preventing AGE-mediated tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種 flavanol，在體外與體內展現 potent AGE-breaking properties。它在體外 destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin，並降低了注射 exogenous AGE 的 rats retinal tissues 中的 AGE accumulation。在機制上，連接於 AGE structures pyrrole ring carbons 上的 side chains 易受 nucleophilic attack，而由於 epicatechin A-ring 上的 C6 與 C8 具有 nucleophilic，epicatechin 可 attack 並 destroy AGE cross-links。這些 findings 將 epicatechin 定位為一種 naturally occurring AGE breaker，具有預防 AGE-mediated tissue damage 的潛力。

label: protein function
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Glycation is a spontaneous non-enzymatic reaction of reducing sugars with free amino groups of proteins, DNA, and lipids that leads to loss of protein function and impaired elasticity of tissues such as blood vessels, skin, and tendons. The process is highly accelerated in the presence of hyperglycemia and tissue oxidative stress, implicating it in diabetic complications and aging. Intracellular AGE modification of signaling molecules can impair cellular functions and gene expression, and glycation of antioxidant enzymes such as catalase, glutathione peroxidase, and glutathione reductase reduces their activity, further increasing cellular oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: Glycation 是 reducing sugars 與蛋白質、DNA 和脂質的游離 amino groups 自發性非酵素反應，會導致蛋白質功能喪失以及 blood vessels、skin 與 tendons 等組織彈性受損。此過程在 hyperglycemia 與組織 oxidative stress 存在下大幅加速，使其涉及 diabetic complications 與 aging。細胞內 signaling molecules 的 intracellular AGE modification 會損害細胞功能與 gene expression，而 catalase、glutathione peroxidase 與 glutathione reductase 等 antioxidant enzymes 的 glycation 會降低其活性，進一步增加細胞 oxidative stress。

label: Hemoglobin A1c
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Hemoglobin A1c is the most widely recognized early glycation product, an Amadori product formed when glucose attaches non-enzymatically to the amino terminus of hemoglobin in red blood cells. It is used clinically as an indicator of blood glucose management in people with diabetes because its level reflects average glycemia over the preceding weeks. As an Amadori product, hemoglobin A1c is a reversible early intermediate on the pathway to irreversible advanced glycation end products. Its clinical utility demonstrates that even early, reversible glycation products are valuable biomarkers of glycation burden.
description_zh_TW: 糖化血色素 A1c（Hemoglobin A1c）是最廣為人知的早期糖化產物，是一種當葡萄糖非酵素性地附著於紅血球中血紅素的胺基端時所形成的阿馬多里產物（Amadori product）。它在臨床上用作糖尿病患者血糖控制的指標，因為其濃度反映前幾週的平均血糖狀態。作為一種阿馬多里產物，糖化血色素 A1c 是通往不可逆晚期糖化終產物路徑上的一個可逆早期中間產物。其臨床效用證明，即使是早期、可逆的糖化產物也是糖化負擔的有價值生物標記。

label: AGER1
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Several enzymes, including glyoxalase I, glyoxalase II, and carbonyl reductase, together with the receptor AGER1, have been shown to be part of a detoxification and counterregulation system against the prooxidant effects of glycation. AGER1 helps oppose the pro-inflammatory actions of advanced glycation end products, functioning as an endogenous check on AGE-mediated signaling. With aging and in some pathological conditions, there is an imbalance in this steady state, due to increased endogenous production or increased exogenous intake combined with lower renal AGE clearance, leading to the AGE accumulation observed in older populations.
description_zh_TW: 數種酵素，包括 glyoxalase I、glyoxalase II 與 carbonyl reductase，以及受體 AGER1，已被證實是對抗糖化促氧化效應之解毒與反向調節系統的一部分。AGER1 有助於對抗晚期糖化終產物的促發炎作用，作為 AGE 介導訊號的內生性制衡。隨著老化與在某些病理狀況下，此恆定狀態出現失衡，起因於內生性產生增加或外源性攝取增加，加上腎臟 AGE 清除率下降，導致在老年族群中觀察到的 AGE 堆積。

label: HemF-like
description: Through functional metagenomics, researchers identified soil bacteria enzymes capable of utilizing synthetic glucosepane as a nutrient source, including the biocatalysts HemF-like (coproporphyrinogen III oxidase-like), BluB-like (5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole synthase-like), and QueE-like (7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine synthase-like). Remarkably, the human homolog of HemF, alongside homologous bacterial proteins found in the human microbiome, was shown to catalyze the cleavage of glucosepane in vitro, releasing citrulline as a byproduct. These glucosepane-cleaving enzymes represent a promising frontier for therapeutic interventions against age-related vascular stiffness and diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: 透過功能性元基因體學，研究人員鑑定出能夠以合成 glucosepane 作為營養來源的土壤細菌酶，包括生物催化劑 HemF-like（coproporphyrinogen III oxidase-like）、BluB-like（5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole synthase-like）與 QueE-like（7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine synthase-like）。值得注意的是，HemF 的人類同源蛋白，連同在人類微生物群中發現的同源細菌蛋白，被證實能在體外催化 glucosepane 的裂解，釋出瓜胺酸作為副產物。這些可裂解 glucosepane 的酶代表了對抗年齡相關血管僵硬與糖尿病併發症療法介入的極具前景的前沿。

label: Alpha-tocopherol
description: Alpha-tocopherol is the primary, most biologically active form of vitamin E retained and utilized by the human body, owing to its selective binding by the hepatic alpha-tocopherol transfer protein while other tocopherols are preferentially metabolized and excreted. It functions as a lipid-soluble chain-breaking antioxidant protecting polyunsaturated fatty acids in cell membranes, and it also modulates cell signaling and immune function. Its metabolism involves catecholic intermediates that are substrates for COMT. Its cancer-prevention outcomes with supplementation differ by COMT genotype, protective in slow and potentially harmful in fast COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-tocopherol 是人體保留和利用的維生素 E 的主要、最俱生物活性的形式，因為它與肝臟 α-生育酚轉移蛋白選擇性結合，而其他生育酚則優先代謝和排泄。它作為脂溶性斷鍊抗氧化劑，保護細胞膜中的多元不飽和脂肪酸，也調節細胞訊號傳導和免疫功能。其代謝涉及作為 COMT 底物的兒茶酚中間體。 COMT genotype 的補充劑預防癌症的效果有所不同，對緩慢的 COMT 個體具有保護作用，但對快速的 COMT 個體可能有害。

label: Alternative Splicing
source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md
description: PTBP1 regulates alternative splicing as a broadly acting repressive factor: it binds polypyrimidine-rich elements near splice sites and competes with core spliceosome components such as U2AF65, biasing exons toward skipping. The SASP-induction scheme places PTBP1 in the nuclear control layer under alternative splicing of trafficking genes, proposing that splicing of genes governing vesicular trafficking shapes whether a transcriptional SASP programme can be exported as protein. This is a schematic placement identifying the regulatory layer rather than an established dedicated role for PTBP1 in the SASP.
description_zh_TW: PTBP1 以廣泛作用的抑制型因子調控替代剪接：它結合剪接位點附近富含聚嘧啶的元件，與 U2AF65 等核心剪接體組分競爭，使外顯子偏向跳過。SASP 誘導架構圖將 PTBP1 置於細胞核調控層的「運輸基因替代剪接」之下，提出管控囊泡運輸的基因剪接會決定轉錄型 SASP 程序能否以蛋白形式輸出。此為示意性配置，指出的是調控層級，而非 PTBP1 在 SASP 中已確立的專一角色。

label: Alzheimers Disease
description: Dietary zinc (10 ppm) worsened spatial memory in CRND8/E4 late-onset AD mice carrying ApoE epsilon4, increasing soluble and insoluble Abeta via altered metal-amyloid interactions and zinc transporter expression. This genotype-dependent harm contrasts with zinc's canonical antioxidant role in SOD and membrane stabilization. It shows antioxidant efficacy depends on ApoE genotype, baseline redox status, and disease biology.
description_zh_TW: 飲食鋅 (10 ppm) 在攜帶 ApoE epsilon4 的 CRND8/E4 晚發型 AD 小鼠中惡化空間記憶，經由改變的金屬-類澱粉交互作用與鋅轉運體表現增加可溶性與不可溶性 Abeta。此基因型依賴性傷害與鋅在 SOD 與膜穩定中的典型抗氧化角色形成對比。顯示抗氧化療效取決於 ApoE 基因型、基礎氧化還原狀態與疾病生物學。

label: Amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion
description: By inhibiting GDH, SIRT4 blunts the ability of amino acids such as leucine to stimulate insulin release from pancreatic β-cells, because less α-ketoglutarate is generated to elevate ATP and trigger secretion. The relationship is directional: SIRT4-mediated GDH inhibition reduces amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion, restraining the nutrient-dependent arm of insulin release. This positions SIRT4 as a physiological negative regulator of nutrient-stimulated insulin secretion, complementary to SIRT1's positive effects on glucose-stimulated secretion.
description_zh_TW: 通過抑制 GDH，SIRT4 削弱胺基酸（如白胺酸）刺激胰腺 β 細胞釋放胰島素的能力，因為產生的 α-酮戊二酸減少，無法提升 ATP 並觸發分泌。其方向性為：SIRT4 介導的 GDH 抑制減少胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌，限制胰島素釋放的營養物依賴性分支。這使 SIRT4 成為營養物刺激胰島素分泌的生理性負調節因子，與 SIRT1 對葡萄糖刺激分泌的正向效應互補。

label: AMPK/SIRT3 hormetic axis
description: Stanniocalcin-1 is a glycoprotein hormone orchestrating a hormetic AMPK/SIRT3 axis that mitigates oxidative stress and apoptosis. It inhibits BNIP3 expression through the AMPK/SIRT3 pathway, ameliorating renal injury in diabetic murine models.
description_zh_TW: Stanniocalcin-1 是一種編排激效性 AMPK/SIRT3 軸線的糖蛋白激素，以減輕氧化壓力和凋亡。它透過 AMPK/SIRT3 途徑抑制 BNIP3 表現，改善糖尿病小鼠模型中的腎損傷。

label: AMT-130
description: AMT-130 is a one-time AAV5-microRNA gene therapy delivered by MRI-guided convection-enhanced infusion into the striatum to silence mutant huntingtin (HTT); its pivotal Phase I/II result showed 75% slowing of cUHDRS decline at 36 months (p=0.003) — the first disease-slowing HD therapy (uniQure, Sep 2025).
description_zh_TW: AMT-130 是單次 AAV5-microRNA 基因治療，經 MRI 引導對流增強灌注注入紋狀體以沉默突變 huntingtin（HTT）；其關鍵 Phase I/II 結果在 36 個月時顯示 cUHDRS 衰退速度減緩 75%（p=0.003）——第一個減緩 HD 病程的療法（uniQure, Sep 2025）。

label: HTT
description: AMT-130 is a one-time AAV5-microRNA gene therapy delivered by MRI-guided convection-enhanced infusion into the striatum to silence mutant huntingtin (HTT); its pivotal Phase I/II result showed 75% slowing of cUHDRS decline at 36 months (p=0.003) — the first disease-slowing HD therapy (uniQure, Sep 2025).

label: Anti-hypertensive effects
description: SIRT1-mediated downregulation of AT1R expression produces antihypertensive effects; in vivo, resveratrol-driven SIRT1 elevation reduces angiotensin-II-induced hypertension. Directionally, SIRT1-mediated AT1R suppression sits upstream of lower blood pressure. This couples SIRT1 activation to vascular tone control, since reduced AT1R diminishes angiotensin-II-driven vasoconstriction and sodium retention. It is a mechanistic basis for resveratrol's antihypertensive actions, and it parallels the therapeutic strategy of AT1R blockade used clinically. By targeting the same receptor the drugs block, SIRT1 provides an endogenous route to restrain the renin-angiotensin system.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 介導的 AT1R 表達下調產生降血壓效應；在體內，resveratrol 驅動的 SIRT1 上調減少血管張力素 II 誘導的高血壓。在方向性上，SIRT1 介導的 AT1R 抑制位於降低血壓的上游。這將 SIRT1 活化與血管張力控制偶聯，因為減少的 AT1R 減弱血管張力素 II 驅動的血管收縮和鈉滯留。這是 resveratrol 降血壓作用的機制性基礎，與臨床使用的 AT1R 阻斷治療策略相似。透過靶向與藥物阻斷的相同受體，SIRT1 提供了抑制腎素-血管張力素系統的內源性途徑。

This couples SIRT1 activation to vascular tone control, since reduced AT1R diminishes angiotensin-II-driven vasoconstriction and sodium retention. It is a mechanistic basis for resveratrol's antihypertensive actions, and it parallels the therapeutic strategy of AT1R blockade used clinically. By targeting the same receptor the drugs block, SIRT1 provides an endogenous route to restrain the renin-angiotensin system.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 介導的 AT1R 表達下調產生降血壓效應；在體內，resveratrol 驅動的 SIRT1 上調減少血管張力素 II 誘導的高血壓。在方向性上，SIRT1 介導的 AT1R 抑制位於降低血壓的上游。這將 SIRT1 活化與血管張力控制偶聯，因為減少的 AT1R 減弱血管張力素 II 驅動的血管收縮和鈉滯留。這是 resveratrol 降血壓作用的機制性基礎，與臨床使用的 AT1R 阻斷治療策略相似。透過靶向與藥物阻斷的相同受體，SIRT1 提供了抑制腎素-血管張力素系統的內源性途徑。

label: Anti-TNF therapy
description: Anti-TNF therapy reduces oxidative stress markers by breaking the TNF-alpha to ROS feed-forward loop, lowering serum MDA and raising glutathione in treated patients. This reflects successful suppression of inflammasome and NOX-driven oxidants. The directionality is TNF blockade to lowered oxidant burden. A caveat is that the magnitude of biomarker change varies among patients and that anti-TNF also has immunosuppressive trade-offs. These biomarker improvements parallel clinical response and support the idea that TNF blockade restores redox balance in chronic inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Anti-TNF therapy 透過打破 TNF-alpha 至 ROS 前饋循環來降低 oxidative stress markers，降低治療患者的血清 MDA 並提高 glutathione。這反映了發炎體和氮氧化物驅動的氧化劑的成功抑制。方向性是 TNF 阻斷以降低氧化劑負荷。需要注意的是，生物標記變化的程度因患者而異，且抗 TNF 藥物也具有免疫抑制權衡。這些生物標記的改善與臨床反應平行，並支持 TNF 阻斷可恢復慢性發炎中氧化還原平衡的觀點。

label: Antibiotics
description: Human and veterinary antibiotics released into the environment through animal feces can induce hormesis in plants, activating defense mechanisms and enhancing adaptability at biochemical, growth, physiological, and production levels. This cross-kingdom stimulation aligns with the xenohormesis hypothesis of Howitz and Sinclair, reframing antibiotic residues from pure ecotoxic pollutants into dose-dependent biological regulators.
description_zh_TW: 經由動物糞便進入環境的人用與獸用 Antibiotics 可在植物中誘發 hormesis，活化防禦機制並在生化、生長、生理與產量層面增強環境適應力。此跨界刺激符合 Howitz 與 Sinclair 的 xenohormesis hypothesis，將抗生素殘留從純粹的生態毒性污染物重新定義為劑量依賴的生物調節因子。

This cross-kingdom stimulation aligns with the xenohormesis hypothesis of Howitz and Sinclair, reframing antibiotic residues from pure ecotoxic pollutants into dose-dependent biological regulators.

label: AP-1 complex
description: FOS (c-Fos) is an immediate-early bZIP transcription factor that heterodimerizes with JUN family members to form AP-1 complexes regulating proliferation, inflammation, and matrix remodeling genes. SIRT3 attenuates fibrosis in cardiomyocytes by inhibiting FOS/AP-1 (and STAT3/NFATc2) signaling, restraining pathological cardiac remodeling.
description_zh_TW: FOS（c-Fos）是一種即早 bZIP 轉錄因子，與 JUN 家族成員異二聚體化形成 AP-1 複合物，調節增殖、發炎和基質重塑基因。SIRT3 透過抑制 FOS/AP-1（和 STAT3/NFATc2）訊號在心肌細胞中減輕纖維化，抑制病理性心臟重塑。

label: FOS
description: FOS (c-Fos) is an immediate-early bZIP transcription factor that heterodimerizes with JUN family members to form AP-1 complexes regulating proliferation, inflammation, and matrix remodeling genes. SIRT3 attenuates fibrosis in cardiomyocytes by inhibiting FOS/AP-1 (and STAT3/NFATc2) signaling, restraining pathological cardiac remodeling.
