label: MHC Class Ib
description: HLA-E is a non-classical (class Ib) major histocompatibility complex molecule with limited polymorphism, presenting a restricted set of peptides, often leader peptides derived from other MHC class I molecules, to innate lymphoid receptors. Its classification distinguishes it from classical MHC class Ia molecules and underpins its specialized ligand-receptor interactions with NKG2A/CD94. In senescence, HLA-E upregulation becomes a mechanism of immune evasion that protects arrested cells from cytotoxic lymphocytes. The class Ib identity enables the checkpoint-like function central to its role in senescence surveillance.
description_zh_TW: HLA-E 是一種低多態性的非典型（class Ib）主要組織相容性複合體分子，呈現一組受限的肽，常為來自其他 MHC class I 分子的導肽，給先天淋巴受體。其分類區分它與典型 MHC class Ia 分子，並支撐其與 NKG2A/CD94 的特化配體—受體交互作用。在衰老中，HLA-E 上升成為保護停滯細胞對抗細胞毒性淋巴球的免疫逃脫機制。此 class Ib 身分啟用對其在衰老監視中角色至為核心的檢查點樣功能。

label: NKG2A
description: HLA-E is the ligand for the inhibitory receptor NKG2A/CD94 heterodimer expressed on NK cells and CD8+ T cells. This binding delivers a cognate inhibitory signal upon engagement, dampening the cytotoxic activity of the receptor-bearing lymphocyte. The interaction is a canonical innate immune checkpoint, analogous to PD-1/PD-L1 but restricted to the NKG2A-CD94 axis. In senescence, HLA-E-NKG2A engagement becomes a route by which arrested cells dampen their own immune clearance, contributing to their persistence.
description_zh_TW: HLA-E 是表達於 NK 細胞與 CD8+ T 細胞的抑制性受體 NKG2A/CD94 異二聚體的配體。此結合在參與時傳遞同源抑制訊號，減弱攜帶受體的淋巴球的細胞毒性活性。此交互作用是典型的先天免疫檢查點，類似 PD-1/PD-L1 但限於 NKG2A-CD94 軸。在衰老中，HLA-E-NKG2A 參與成為停滯細胞減弱其自身免疫清除的途徑，貢獻其持續。

label: Serum Cholesterol
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinic acid (niacin) at pharmacological doses reduces serum cholesterol levels in humans, but its clinical use is limited by a side effect of skin flushing accompanied by an unpleasant warmth sensation and often itching. Niacin, together with tryptophan and nicotinamide, is one of the classic NAD+ biosynthesis precursors historically used to prevent and treat pellagra, a disease characterized by dermatitis, diarrhea, and dementia. Tryptophan alone is not sufficient to sustain cellular NAD+ levels because it participates in other metabolic pathways such as serotonin, melatonin, and picolinic acid synthesis, making nicotinic acid an important dietary NAD+ precursor with distinct pharmacological actions.
description_zh_TW: Nicotinic acid (niacin) 在藥理劑量下可降低人類的血清膽固醇水平，但其臨床使用受限於皮膚潮紅的副作用，伴隨令人不適的溫熱感，且常伴隨搔癢。Niacin 與 tryptophan 及 nicotinamide 同為歷來用於預防和治療 pellagra 的經典 NAD+ 生合成前驅物，該疾病以皮膚炎、腹瀉和癡呆為特徵。單靠 tryptophan 不足以維持細胞內 NAD+ 水平，因為它參與其他代謝途徑，如 serotonin、melatonin 和 picolinic acid 的合成，使得 nicotinic acid 成為一種具有獨特藥理作用的重要膳食 NAD+ 前驅物。

label: Sphingosine-1-phosphate
description: ACase overexpression raises sphingosine/S1P levels, which is classically anti-apoptotic and helps senescent cells resist apoptosis via SCAP pathways.
description_zh_TW: ACase 過度表現提高 sphingosine/S1P 水平，此在經典上為抗凋亡，並透過 SCAP 路徑幫助衰老細胞抵抗凋亡。

label: ASAH1
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase, aCDase) is encoded by ASAH1. It is a lysosomal hydrolase that cleaves ceramide into sphingosine and a free fatty acid.
description_zh_TW: 酸性神經醯胺酶（ACase、aCDase）由 ASAH1 編碼。它是一種溶酶體水解酶，可將神經醯胺裂解為鞘氨醇與游離脂肪酸。

label: Carmofur
description: Carmofur has IC50 29 nM against acid ceramidase, is clinically approved in Japan, crosses the BBB, and is a repurposing candidate for senolytic therapy.
description_zh_TW: Carmofur 對酸性神經醯胺酶的 IC50 為 29 nM，已在日本獲臨床核准，可穿過血腦屏障（BBB），是去衰老（senolytic）治療的再利用候選藥物。

label: ARN14794
description: ARN14794 has IC50 ~100 nM against acid ceramidase and was specifically used in the Soriano-Castell 2026 ferroptosis study to reduce membrane PL-PUFA content.
description_zh_TW: ARN14794 對酸性神經醯胺酶的 IC50 約為 100 nM，並在 Soriano-Castell 2026 年的鐵蛋白死亡研究中被專門用於降低膜磷脂中 PL-PUFA 的含量。

label: PUFA
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase) over-expression increases the polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) content of membrane phospholipids, promoting a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile. Mechanistically, ACase-mediated ceramide breakdown releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that, via the Lands cycle, are exchanged into sn-2 PUFA-containing phospholipids (PL-PUFAs) - the substrates of lipid peroxidation. ACase knockdown in senescent cells decreased the most abundant PL-PUFA species (including PC-AA, PG-DHA, PG-DPA), thereby reducing the lipid peroxidation substrate pool and conferring ferroptosis resistance.
description_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶 (ACase) 過表達增加了膜磷脂中的不飽和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 含量，促進了促進焦蛋白死亡的脂類型態。從機制上講，ACase 介導的絲胺類分解釋放了自由飽和和一元飽和脂肪酸，透過 Lands 循環轉化為 sn-2 PUFA 含有磷脂 (PL-PUFAs) - 這是脂質過氧化反應的底物。在老化的細胞中，ACase 下調降低了最豐富的 PL-PUFA 物種（包括 PC-AA、PG-DHA、PG-DPA），從而降低了脂質過氧化反應底物池，並賦予了焦蛋白死亡的抵抗力。

label: Sphingosine
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Acid ceramidase catalyzes the breakdown of ceramides into sphingosine and free fatty acids, directly producing sphingosine in the cell. This enzymatic hydrolysis is a key branch point in sphingolipid metabolism, and in senescent cells the resulting reshaping of membrane lipid composition pushes membranes toward a pro-ferroptotic profile rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), the preferred substrates for lipid peroxidation. Because the excess sphingosine and free fatty acids generated by elevated acid ceramidase feed the lipid-peroxidation cascade, the enzyme serves as a mechanistic link between the cellular programs of senescence and ferroptosis, and its removal protects cells from ferroptotic death.
description_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶催化絲胺類分解成腎上腺素和自由脂肪酸，直接在細胞中產生腎上腺素。這種酶促水解是腎上腺素脂質代謝中的一個關鍵分支點，在老化的細胞中，由此重塑的膜脂類組成推動膜朝向富含不飽和脂肪酸 (PUFAs) 的促進焦蛋白死亡的型態 - 這是脂質過氧化反應的理想底物。因為過量的腎上腺素和由升高後的酸陶瓷酶產生的自由脂肪酸餵養了脂質過氧化反應的過程，因此這種酶作為細胞衰老和焦蛋白死亡兩個程序之間的機制聯繫，並且去除這種酶可以保護細胞免受焦蛋白死亡的死亡。

label: Senolytic Drug Target
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Acid ceramidase is a druggable, near-term, testable senotherapeutic target for clearing senescent cells. Experimental drugs targeting acid ceramidase have already been developed for other therapeutic purposes, demonstrating that the enzyme is targetable and lighting the way toward future innovation that could extend healthspans. Because elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis, inhibitors of the enzyme could selectively eliminate senescent 'zombie' cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy. The Salk team calls this a big milestone in the public health effort to support healthy aging, with the next steps being pathway completion, animal translation, and clinical trials.
description_zh_TW: 酸甘油酯酶是一種可藥物標靶、近期且可測試的衰老細胞治療目標，用於清除衰老細胞。針對酸甘油酯酶的實驗性藥物已經針對其他治療目的而開發，證明該酶可標靶，為未來的創新開闢了道路，可能延長壽命。由於酸甘油酯酶升高會使衰老細胞更容易受到焦慮素突變的影響，因此抑制該酶可能能夠選擇性地消除衰老「殭屍」細胞，同時保持周圍細胞健康。沙鹿團隊將這歸結為公共衛生努力支持健康老齡化的重要里程碑，接下來的步驟包括通路完成、動物翻譯和臨床試驗。

label: Sphingomyelin
description: Sphingomyelin is a phosphosphingolipid composed of ceramide linked to phosphocholine and serves as a reservoir for ceramide generation. It is a major structural lipid of the plasma membrane and myelin, and sphingomyelinases convert it back to ceramide.
description_zh_TW: 神經鞘磷脂是由 ceramide 連接磷酸膽鹼組成的磷酸鞘脂，並作為 ceramide 生成的儲庫。它是質膜與髓鞘的主要結構脂質，神經鞘磷脂酶將其轉化回 ceramide。

label: CD94
description: HLA-E is the ligand for the inhibitory NKG2A/CD94 heterodimer on NK and CD8 T cells, contacting both subunits with NKG2A conferring specificity. Engagement delivers an inhibitory signal that blunts cytotoxic clearance of senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: HLA-E 是 NK 與 CD8 T 細胞上抑制性 NKG2A/CD94 異二聚體的配體，接觸兩個次單元並由 NKG2A 賦予特異性。結合傳遞抑制訊號，減弱對衰老細胞的細胞毒性清除。

label: gp130
description: IL-6 engages the IL-6R/gp130 co-receptor to activate JAK-STAT3, sustaining stemness factors OCT4, NANOG and SOX2. This canonical axis underlies SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming and cancer stemness.
description_zh_TW: IL-6 接合 IL-6R/gp130 共受體以活化 JAK-STAT3，維持幹性因子 OCT4、NANOG 與 SOX2。此典型軸構成 SASP 驅動的旁分泌重編程與癌症幹性的基礎。

label: ARN14974
description: ARN14974 is a brain-penetrant ACase inhibitor (IC50 79 nM) distinct from ARN14794, which already has a triple. Separate chemistry, separate edge.
description_zh_TW: ARN14974 是可入腦的 ACase 抑制劑（IC50 79 nM），不同於已有 triple 的 ARN14794。不同化學，獨立邊。

label: CXCR2
description: CXCR2 is the chemotaxis receptor transducing IL-8 signals. Binding is the signal-entry pairing.
description_zh_TW: CXCR2 是傳導 IL-8 訊號的趨化受體。結合是訊號進入配對。

label: as regulated by KLF10
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Upregulation of SIRT6 by the tumor suppressor KLF10 activity influences glycolysis, epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, and distant metastasis of pancreatic cancer cells. Directionally, KLF10-driven SIRT6 upregulation sits upstream of altered metabolic and invasive behaviors in pancreatic cancer. By modulating glycolysis and EMT, SIRT6 shapes the aggressiveness and metastatic capacity of pancreatic cancer cells, indicating that the KLF10-SIRT6 axis may serve as a therapeutic or prognostic target in pancreatic cancer.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤抑制因子KLF10活性上調的SIRT6影響胰腺癌細胞的糖解作用、上皮-間質轉化和遠端轉移。方向上，KLF10驅動的SIRT6上調位於胰腺癌中代謝和侵襲行為改變的上游。透過調節糖解作用和EMT，SIRT6塑造胰腺癌細胞的侵襲性和轉移能力，表明KLF10-SIRT6軸可能作為胰腺癌中的治療或預後靶點。

label: SIRT6 upregulation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Upregulation of SIRT6 by the tumor suppressor KLF10 activity influences glycolysis, epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, and distant metastasis of pancreatic cancer cells. label: aspirin cardiovascular response
description: COMT genotype determines the cardiovascular response to aspirin: slow (Met/Met) individuals gain protection against cardiovascular disease, whereas fast (Val/Val) individuals may see increased risk or no benefit. This pharmacogenetic effect arises from genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that modify aspirin's actions on platelets, vascular endothelium, and redox balance. Stratifying aspirin therapy by COMT status could improve risk-benefit profiling in primary and secondary cardiovascular prevention. The finding exemplifies how a common polymorphism can gate a widely used drug's efficacy.
description_zh_TW: COMT genotype 決定了阿斯匹靈的心血管反應：慢速 (Met/Met) 個體獲得預防心血管疾病的保護，而快速 (Val/Val) 個體可能會看到風險增加或沒有益處。這種藥物基因效應源自於兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，這些差異改變了阿斯匹靈對血小板、血管內皮和氧化還原平衡的作用。以 COMT 狀態對阿斯匹靈治療進行分層可以改善第一級和第二級心血管預防的風險效益分析。這項發現例證了常見的多態性如何控制廣泛使用的藥物的功效。

label: Axonal/Wallerian degeneration (via SIRT1)
description: Nmnat, the NAD+-biosynthetic enzyme, protects axons from Wallerian degeneration largely by raising NAD+ and thereby activating SIRT1, which supports axonal survival after injury. The protection is upstream of SIRT1-dependent maintenance of mitochondrial and chromatin function in neurons, preserving axon integrity when the soma is damaged. Directionally, Nmnat increases NAD+, which activates SIRT1 to provide axonal protection. This established a key NAD+/sirtuin axis in neuronal resilience, informed subsequent studies of SARM1-mediated NAD+ depletion in axonal degeneration, and helped motivate the use of NAD+ precursors such as NMN and NR to protect neurons.
description_zh_TW: NAD+ 生物合成酶 Nmnat 主要通過提高 NAD+ 並從而活化 SIRT1 來保護軸突免於 Wallerian 變性，SIRT1 支持損傷後的軸突存活。這種保護位於 SIRT1 依賴性維持神經元粒線體和染色質功能的上游，在胞體受損時保留軸突完整性。在方向性上，Nmnat 增加 NAD+，進而活化 SIRT1 以提供軸突保護。這確立了神經元韌性中一個關鍵的 NAD+/sirtuin 軸，為後續 SARM1 介導的軸突變性中 NAD+ 耗竭的研究提供了資訊，並推動了使用 NAD+ 前體（如 NMN 和 NR）來保護神經元的研究。

label: Nmnat (NAD+ biosynthetic enzyme)
description: Nmnat, the NAD+-biosynthetic enzyme, protects axons from Wallerian degeneration largely by raising NAD+ and thereby activating SIRT1, which supports axonal survival after injury. The protection is upstream of SIRT1-dependent maintenance of mitochondrial and chromatin function in neurons, preserving axon integrity when the soma is damaged. Directionally, Nmnat increases NAD+, which activates SIRT1 to provide axonal protection. This established a key NAD+/sirtuin axis in neuronal resilience, informed subsequent studies of SARM1-mediated NAD+ depletion in axonal degeneration, and helped motivate the use of NAD+ precursors such as NMN and NR to protect neurons.

label: Bax (pro-apoptotic)
description: Once deacetylated by SIRT1, Ku70 binds the BH3 domain of the pro-apoptotic protein Bax and retains it in the cytosol, preventing Bax translocation to and permeabilization of mitochondria. This sequestration blocks the intrinsic apoptosis cascade downstream of many stress signals, including DNA damage and oxidative stress. Directionally, deacetylated Ku70 is the binding partner that neutralizes Bax, converting a DNA-repair factor into an anti-apoptotic scaffold. The net effect is cytoprotection, though as with p53 suppression this can also shield damaged cells in oncogenic contexts, where the Ku70–Bax interaction becomes a target for restoring apoptosis in cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: Ku70 一旦被 SIRT1 去乙醯化，便結合促凋亡蛋白 Bax 的 BH3 結構域並將其保留在細胞質中，防止 Bax 轉位到粒線體並造成粒線體外膜通透化。這種封存阻斷了許多壓力信號（包括 DNA 損傷和氧化壓力）下游的內在凋亡級聯反應。在方向性上，去乙醯化的 Ku70 是中和 Bax 的結合夥伴，將 DNA 修復因子轉化為抗凋亡支架。淨效應是細胞保護，但與 p53 抑制一樣，在腫瘤情境中也可能保護受損細胞，使得 Ku70–Bax 相互作用成為癌症治療中恢復凋亡的靶點。

label: Bcl-2 anti-apoptotic proteins
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: The BH3 domain of Beclin1 binds anti-apoptotic Bcl-2/Bcl-xL proteins, which sequester it and inhibit autophagy, linking apoptosis and autophagy regulation. Directionally, Bcl-2 sits upstream of Beclin1 sequestration. SIRT1 deacetylation of Beclin1 modulates this interaction, illustrating the molecular crosstalk between cell-death and clearance pathways. When Bcl-2 sequesters Beclin1, autophagy is suppressed, but under stress signals that release Beclin1, autophagy proceeds. This interplay determines whether cells commit to apoptosis or to autophagic survival, and it is central to both normal physiology and cancer cell fate decisions.
description_zh_TW: Beclin1 的 BH3 結合域結合抗凋亡 Bcl-2/Bcl-xL 蛋白質，後者將其隔離並抑制自噬，將凋亡和自噬調控聯繫起來。在方向性上，Bcl-2 位於 Beclin1 隔離的上游。SIRT1 對 Beclin1 的去乙醯化調節此相互作用，說明了細胞死亡和清除途徑之間的分子串擾。當 Bcl-2 隔離 Beclin1 時，自噬被抑制，但在釋放 Beclin1 的壓力訊號下，自噬進行。這種相互作用決定細胞是承諾凋亡還是自噬性存活，在正常生理和癌細胞命運決定中都至關重要。

label: BDNF promoter
description: SIRT1 activates PGC-1α, which co-activates the BDNF promoter, linking mitochondrial biogenesis to neurotrophic support. Directionally, SIRT1/PGC-1α sits upstream of BDNF transcription. This couples energy metabolism to neuronal growth-factor expression, and it reinforces the metabolic-neurotrophic axis of SIRT1. By coordinating the activation of PGC-1α and the expression of BDNF, SIRT1 links mitochondrial function to neuronal survival and plasticity. This connection helps explain how sirtuin activation and caloric restriction benefit brain health.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 活化 PGC-1α，後者共同活化 BDNF 啟動子，將粒線體生物合成與神經營養支持聯繫起來。在方向性上，SIRT1/PGC-1α 位於 BDNF 轉錄的上游。這將能量代謝與神經元生長因子表達偶聯，強化了 SIRT1 的代謝-神經營養軸線。透過協調 PGC-1α 的活化和 BDNF 的表達，SIRT1 將粒線體功能與神經元存活和可塑性聯繫起來。此聯繫有助於解釋 sirtuin 活化和限制熱量如何有益於大腦健康。

label: beta-catenin deacetylation
description: MMP-7 (matrilysin) is a secreted metalloproteinase that degrades ECM components and mediates EMT and tissue remodeling. SIRT3 deacetylates beta-catenin, influencing MMP-7 and PAI-1 expression, two mediators implicated in ECM remodeling via EMT induction in renal fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: MMP-7（基質溶解素）是一種分泌性金屬蛋白酶，降解 ECM 成分並介導 EMT 和組織重塑。SIRT3 去乙醯化 β-catenin，影響 MMP-7 和 PAI-1 的表達，這兩種介導因子透過 EMT 誘導參與腎纖維化中的 ECM 重塑。

label: MMP-7
description: MMP-7 (matrilysin) is a secreted metalloproteinase that degrades ECM components and mediates EMT and tissue remodeling. SIRT3 deacetylates beta-catenin, influencing MMP-7 and PAI-1 expression, two mediators implicated in ECM remodeling via EMT induction in renal fibrosis.

label: Beta-glucan
description: Beta-glucan reverses the epigenetic program of LPS tolerization, restoring robust proinflammatory cytokine production upon LPS re-exposure in human cells. This demonstrates that training and tolerance use distinct but interconvertible epigenetic routes. It provides proof-of-principle for retraining a tolerized innate compartment.
description_zh_TW: Beta-glucan 可逆轉 LPS tolerization 的表觀遺傳程式，在人類細胞中恢復 LPS 再暴露時的強勁促發炎細胞激素產生。這顯示 training 與 tolerance 使用不同但可互換的表觀遺傳路徑。它為 retraining 已耐受的先天免疫區間提供了原理驗證。

label: LPS Tolerance
description: Beta-glucan reverses the epigenetic program of LPS tolerization, restoring robust proinflammatory cytokine production upon LPS re-exposure in human cells. This demonstrates that training and tolerance use distinct but interconvertible epigenetic routes. It provides proof-of-principle for retraining a tolerized innate compartment.

label: Betaine supplementation
description: Betaine (trimethylglycine, TMG) supplementation can cause mood sensitivity, including irritability, anxiety, or overstimulation, in slow COMT individuals because it increases methyl availability that these individuals clear more slowly. The resulting elevation in SAMe and the overall methyl burden can push catecholamine metabolism and mood regulation beyond the optimal range, particularly when combined with other methyl donors. Because slow COMT already processes catecholamines and methyl groups inefficiently, the added methyl load is poorly tolerated. Dose titration, monitoring, and low starting doses are advised when using betaine in this genetically defined subgroup.
description_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸，TMG）補充劑可能會導致緩慢的 COMT 個體情緒敏感，包括煩躁、焦慮或過度刺激，因為它增加了這些個體清除速度較慢的甲基可用性。由此產生的 SAMe 和整體甲基負擔的增加可以推動兒茶酚胺代謝和情緒調節超出最佳範圍，特別是與其他甲基供體結合時。因為緩慢的 COMT 已經低效地處理 catecholamines 和 methyl groups，所以添加的甲基負載的耐受性很差。在這個基因定義的亞群中使用甜菜鹼時，建議進行劑量滴定、監測和低起始劑量。

label: Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype
description: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) is the ensemble of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and matrix-remodeling enzymes secreted by senescent cells. Accumulation of senescent cells with age creates a chronic, low-grade inflammatory milieu that drives inflammaging—the sterile inflammation implicated in nearly all age-related diseases. SASP factors recruit immune cells, promote fibrosis, and induce paracrine senescence in neighboring cells, establishing feed-forward tissue deterioration. Targeting senescent cells or their SASP is a major therapeutic avenue to reduce inflammaging.
description_zh_TW: 衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）是衰老細胞分泌的促發炎細胞激素、趨化因子和基質重塑酵素之集合。衰老細胞隨年齡累積，創造出慢性、低度的發炎環境，驅動 inflammaging——一種與幾乎所有與年齡相關疾病有關的無菌性發炎。SASP 因子招募免疫細胞、促進纖維化，並誘發鄰近細胞的旁分泌性衰老，建立前饋式的組織惡化。標靶衰老細胞或其 SASP 是減少 inflammaging 的一個主要治療途徑。

label: Myeloid Differentiation
description: GM-CSF and CCL2 skew myeloid differentiation toward immunosuppressive MDSCs and specific macrophage phenotypes, reshaping the myeloid compartment in senescence and cancer. This biases haematopoiesis away from inflammatory resolution toward tolerance and suppression, exemplifying SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming of immune lineage fate. The relationship links SASP factors to myeloid lineage outcomes and is supported by myeloid-differentiation and tumor-immunology studies. Targeting these factors can restore protective myeloid responses.
description_zh_TW: GM-CSF 與 CCL2 將骨髓分化偏斜向免疫抑制性 MDSC 與特定巨噬細胞表型，重塑衰老與癌症中的骨髓區室。這將造血偏離發炎解決而朝向耐受與抑制，改變免疫景觀以利腫瘤進展與慢性發炎。在衰老中，此偏斜由 SASP 驅動，貢獻監視受損與免疫逃逸。它是連結分泌組到骨髓生成重塑的關鍵機制。

label: Immature Myeloid Cell
description: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are a heterogeneous population of immature myeloid cells with potent immunosuppressive activity, expanded under pathological stress including cancer and chronic inflammation. Their classification reflects an arrested differentiation state rather than a single lineage, with polymorphonuclear and monocytic subsets recognized. In senescence contexts, MDSCs are recruited by SASP factors and blunt anti-tumor and anti-senescence immunity, shifting the immune balance away from clearance. They represent a key immunosuppressive cell type bridging aging, inflammation, and cancer.
description_zh_TW: MDSCs（骨髓源性抑制細胞）是一群異質、未成熟骨髓細胞，在發炎與癌症中擴張並具免疫抑制功能。其歸類為未成熟骨髓細胞將其定位於骨髓生成與免疫調節的交會點，且其在衰老中重要性上升。在衰老脈絡中，MDSC 累積貢獻免疫抑制與監視受損。其未成熟本質使其對發炎細胞激素與趨化因子高度反應，成為衰老相關免疫逃脫的關鍵角色。

label: Alveolar Macrophages
description: Alveolar macrophages are tissue-resident lung macrophages that clear particulates and are key sources of inflammatory mediators. Their persistent activation contributes to chronic low-grade lung inflammation that feeds into systemic inflammaging with age.
description_zh_TW: 肺泡巨噬細胞是肺組織駐留的巨噬細胞，負責清除微粒並是發炎介質的重要來源。其持續活化促成慢性低度肺部發炎，隨年齡增長助長全身性的發炎老化（inflammaging）。

label: Argonaute
description: Argonaute proteins are the effector subunits of small-RNA silencing pathways. In the context of immune-aging literature they are linked to microRNA regulation that influences inflammatory programs, connecting RNA-silencing machinery to chronic inflammaging states.
description_zh_TW: Argonaute 蛋白是小 RNA 靜默途徑的效應亞基。在免疫老化文獻脈絡中，它們與調控發炎程式的 microRNA 調節相關，將 RNA 靜默機制與慢性的發炎老化狀態相連結。

label: Epigenetic Aging
description: Epigenetic aging reflects the accumulation of age-related chromatin changes integrated into epigenetic clocks. Epigenetic derepression of retroelements and heterochromatin loss fuels inflammaging, linking epigenetic age acceleration to chronic inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳老化反映累積的與年齡相關染色質變化，並整合入表觀遺傳時鐘。反轉錄轉座子的表觀去抑制與異染色質喪失助長發炎老化，將表觀遺傳年齡加速與慢性發炎相連結。

label: Herpes Zoster
description: Herpes zoster arises from reactivation of latent varicella zoster virus, and recurrent viral reactivation is a source of chronic antigenic and inflammatory stress. Vaccination reduces reactivation and is associated with lower inflammaging and slower biological aging.
description_zh_TW: 帶狀皰疹源於潛伏的水痘帶狀皰疹病毒再活化，而反覆的病毒再活化是慢性抗原與發炎壓力的來源。疫苗接種減少再活化，並與較低的發炎老化及較慢的生物老化相關。

label: Postherpetic Neuralgia
description: Postherpetic neuralgia is persistent neuropathic pain in the dermatome of a resolved herpes zoster rash, the most common complication of shingles. The shingles vaccine lowers the risk of herpes zoster and consequently of postherpetic neuralgia.
description_zh_TW: 帶狀皰疹後神經痛是帶狀皰疹皮疹消退後皮節區的持續神經病理性疼痛，是帶狀皰疹最常見的併發症。帶狀皰疹疫苗降低帶狀皰疹及其後神經痛的風險。

label: Health and Retirement Study
description: The Health and Retirement Study (HRS) is a longitudinal panel study of U.S. adults aged 50+ that collects health, economic, and biomarker data, enabling population-level analyses of biological aging. It was used to show shingles vaccination associates with slower biological aging.
description_zh_TW: 健康與退休研究（HRS）是針對 50 歲以上美國成人的縱向追蹤研究，收集健康、經濟與生物標記數據，使生物老化的族群層級分析成為可能。它被用於顯示帶狀皰疹疫苗接種與較慢的生物老化相關。

label: Epigenetic Alterations
description: The Horvath clock estimates chronological age from DNA methylation at 353 CpG sites with pan-tissue applicability. Its residuals reveal accelerated epigenetic aging in diseased tissues and associate with aging and epigenetic alterations.
description_zh_TW: Horvath 時鐘從 353 個 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化估算時間年齡，具有跨組織適用性。其殘差揭示疾病組織中的加速表觀遺傳老化，並與衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

label: Transcriptomic Aging
description: Transcriptomic aging describes the progressive remodeling of the transcriptome with age, reflecting dysregulated inflammatory and stress-response pathways. Slower transcriptomic aging implies dampened expression of inflammaging-associated gene programs.
description_zh_TW: 轉錄組老化描述轉錄組隨年齡的進行性重塑，反映失調的發炎與壓力反應途徑。較慢的轉錄組老化意味著發炎老化相關基因程式的表現被削弱。

label: Varicella Zoster Virus
description: Varicella zoster virus establishes lifelong latency and can reactivate, and recurrent subclinical reactivation contributes to chronic immune activation. Vaccination reduces reactivation and is associated with lower inflammaging and slower biological aging.
description_zh_TW: 水痘帶狀皰疹病毒建立終身潛伏並可再活化，反覆的亞臨床再活化促成慢性免疫活化。疫苗接種減少再活化，並與較低的發炎老化及較慢的生物老化相關。

label: Body Mass Index
description: Dietary isoleucine correlates with body mass index in humans, and increased circulating isoleucine is associated with increased mortality risk. In Western diet-fed mice, increasing dietary isoleucine promotes weight gain, fat accretion, glucose intolerance, and insulin resistance. In contrast, isoleucine restriction consistently improves metabolic health across dietary contexts and age groups, extends lifespan of both Drosophila and mice, reduces frailty and increases healthspan, rejuvenates aged mice at the molecular level, induces substantial epigenetic changes, and improves Alzheimer's disease outcomes in male mice. Isoleucine is described as an exceptionally powerful modifier of the hallmarks of protein restriction.
description_zh_TW: 飲食中的異白胺酸與人類身體質量指數相關，且循環異白胺酸升高與死亡風險增加有關。在西方飲食餵養的小鼠中，增加飲食異白胺酸會促進體重增加、脂肪累積、葡萄糖不耐受與胰島素抗性。相反地，限制異白胺酸在各種飲食情境與年齡層中一致地改善代謝健康、延長果蠅與小鼠的壽命、減少衰弱並延長健康壽命、在分子層面使老年小鼠年輕化、誘導顯著的表觀遺傳變化，並改善雄性小鼠的阿茲海默症結果。異白胺酸被描述為蛋白質限制標誌特徵的異常強大修飾因子。

label: BRCA1 deficiency
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Loss of BRCA1 triggers increased autophagy as a compensatory survival mechanism in breast and ovarian cancers, buffering the viability impact of defective homologous recombination. Directionally, BRCA1 deficiency sits upstream of autophagic upregulation. This metabolic rewiring can be co-opted by tumors to survive despite genome instability, and it connects genome-maintenance failure to lysosomal clearance pathways. Because autophagy supports the survival of BRCA-deficient cells, combining PARP inhibitors with autophagy inhibitors is being explored as a therapeutic strategy. The compensatory autophagy illustrates how cancer cells adapt to DNA-repair defects.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 的缺失觸發自噬增加作為乳腺和卵巢癌中的代償性存活機制，緩衝同源重組缺陷對細胞活性的影響。在方向性上，BRCA1 缺陷位於自噬上調的上游。這種代謝重編程可被腫瘤利用在基因組不穩定的情況下存活，將基因組維護失敗與溶酶體清除途徑聯繫起來。由於自噬支持 BRCA 缺陷細胞的存活，正在探索將 PARP 抑制劑與自噬抑制劑結合的治療策略。代償性自噬說明了癌細胞如何適應 DNA 修復缺陷。

label: BRCA1 mutation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: BRCA1-deficient tumors are exquisitely sensitive to PARP inhibitors because blocking base-excision (PARP) repair in the setting of defective homologous recombination causes catastrophic, lethal DNA damage through synthetic lethality. Directionally, BRCA1 mutation sits upstream of PARP-inhibitor vulnerability. This is a cornerstone of precision oncology, targeting the specific repair defect of the tumor. It illustrates how repair-pathway context determines therapeutic selectivity, and it has transformed the treatment of BRCA-mutated breast and ovarian cancer. Sirtuins that modulate repair pathways may influence sensitivity to such agents.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 缺陷型腫瘤對 PARP 抑制劑高度敏感，因為在同源重組缺陷的情況下阻斷鹼基切除（PARP）修復會透過合成致死導致災難性的致死 DNA 損傷。在方向性上，BRCA1 突變位於 PARP 抑制劑脆弱性的上游。這是精準腫瘤學的基石，靶向腫瘤的特定修復缺陷。它說明了修復途徑情境如何決定治療選擇性，並已改變了 BRCA 突變乳腺癌和卵巢癌的治療。調控修復途徑的 sirtuin 可能影響對此類藥物的敏感性。

label: Burn Injury
description: Burn injury induces a chronic mTOR-dependent hyper-responsive training state in innate immunity, with increased neutrophil recruitment to lungs and enhanced reactive oxygen and nitrogen species production upon rechallenge. Rapamycin administration reverses this hyperresponsiveness but impairs bacterial clearance and increases mortality, showing mTOR balances antimicrobial benefit against maladaptive inflammation after burns.
description_zh_TW: Burn Injury 可誘發先天免疫慢性 mTOR-dependent 過度反應訓練狀態，再刺激時肺部嗜中性球招募增加，活性氧與活性氮產量上升。Rapamycin 給藥可逆轉此過度反應，但同時損害細菌清除並增加死亡率，顯示 mTOR 在燒傷後需平衡抗菌效益與失調性發炎。

label: Polyphenol STAC
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Butein is a chalcone polyphenol that belongs to the first generation of natural sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs), reported to activate SIRT1 together with resveratrol, piceatannol, quercetin, and myricetin. These polyphenolic activators established the concept of pharmacological SIRT1 activation and served as the basis for later, more potent synthetic STACs such as SRT1460, SRT1720, and SRT2183. Directionally, butein's identification as a polyphenol STAC initiated the activator chemistry that progressed to synthetic scaffolds, though the direct activation mechanism remains controversial due to fluorescent-substrate artifacts.
description_zh_TW: Butein 是一種查爾酮多酚，屬於第一代天然 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），據報導與 resveratrol、piceatannol、quercetin 和 myricetin 一起活化 SIRT1。這些多酚類活化劑確立了藥理學 SIRT1 活化的概念，並作為後續更強效合成 STAC 如 SRT1460、SRT1720 和 SRT2183 的基礎。方向性上 Butein 作為多酚類 STAC 的鑑定啟動了從活化劑化學到合成骨架的發展，儘管由於螢光受質假象，直接活化機制仍存在爭議。

label: Butein, piceatannol and isoliquiritigenin
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Plant polyphenols notably butein, piceatannol, and isoliquiritigenin (ILQ) have been demonstrated to activate recombinant SIRT1, and are known as sirtuin activating compounds (STACs). Directionally, these natural polyphenols sit upstream of enhanced SIRT1 enzymatic activity. Together with resveratrol, these plant-derived compounds represent natural STACs, and synthetic STACs such as SRT1720 activate SIRT1 substantially more potently.
description_zh_TW: 植物多酚中較為突出的成分，包括紫檀芪（piceatannol）、丁香酚（butein）和異甘草素（ILQ），已被證實能夠活化重組 SIRT1，並被歸類為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STACs）。從作用方向而言，這些天然多酚位於增強 SIRT1 酶活性的上游。與白藜蘆醇一起，這些植物來源的化合物代表了天然 STACs，而合成 STACs 如 SRT1720 活化 SIRT1 的效力則顯著更強。

label: Ca2+ release (ER → cytoplasm)
description: Epac1 activation induces calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum into the cytoplasm, raising cytosolic Ca2+ that serves as a second messenger. Directionally, Epac1 sits upstream of cytoplasmic Ca2+ elevation. The Ca2+ surge then activates calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase β (CaMKKβ), bridging cAMP signaling to AMPK activation. This couples resveratrol's PDE4 inhibition to metabolic kinase activation, and it is the key branching point that converts a rise in cyclic AMP into a change in cellular energy sensing. Disrupting any step in this cascade attenuates resveratrol's indirect activation of SIRT1.
description_zh_TW: Epac1 活化誘導鈣離子從內質網釋放到細胞質中，提高作為第二信使的細胞質 Ca2+。在方向性上，Epac1 位於細胞質 Ca2+ 升高的上游。Ca2+ 激增然後活化鈣調蛋白依賴性蛋白激酶激酶 β（CaMKKβ），將 cAMP 信號橋接到 AMPK 活化。這將白藜蘆醇的 PDE4 抑制與代謝激酶活化偶聯起來，是將環磷酸腺苷升高轉化為細胞能量感知變化的關鍵分支點。破壞此級聯中的任何一步都會減弱白藜蘆醇的間接 SIRT1 活化。

label: Ca2+ surge (cytoplasmic)
description: The cytoplasmic calcium surge activates calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase β (CaMKKβ), which phosphorylates and activates AMPK, the central cellular energy sensor. Directionally, Ca2+ activates CaMKKβ, which in turn phosphorylates AMPK. Activated AMPK then induces NAMPT and raises NAD+, closing the loop on SIRT1 activation and promoting catabolic metabolism. This is a key branch point linking calcium flux to metabolic homeostasis, and it explains how agents that raise cytosolic calcium can indirectly boost sirtuin activity, complementing the direct actions of SIRT1 activators and integrating calcium signaling into energy metabolism.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質鈣離子激增活化鈣調蛋白依賴性蛋白激酶激酶 β（CaMKKβ），後者磷酸化並活化 AMPK——細胞的中心能量感測器。在方向性上，Ca2+ 活化 CaMKKβ，CaMKKβ 再磷酸化 AMPK。活化的 AMPK 然後誘導 NAMPT 並升高 NAD+，完成 SIRT1 活化的迴路並促進分解代謝。這是將鈣離子通量與代謝穩態聯繫起來的關鍵分支點，解釋了提高細胞質鈣離子的試劑如何能間接增強 sirtuin 活性，與 SIRT1 活化因子的直接作用互補，並將鈣離子信號整合到能量代謝中。

label: Calcium Signaling
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCs) act as regulatory hubs for calcium signaling, lipid exchange, mitochondrial dynamics, and stress adaptation. Impaired ER-to-mitochondria Ca2+ transfer through the IP3R-GRP75-VDAC1 axis can produce either insufficient mitochondrial Ca2+ (blunting ATP production) or pathological Ca2+ overload (sensitizing to permeability transition), both amplifying ROS and destabilizing membrane integrity. MERC disruption amplifies proteostatic and redox failure by coupling ER stress to mitochondrial decay, promoting chronic UPRER activation.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCs) 作為 calcium signaling、lipid exchange、mitochondrial dynamics 和 stress adaptation 的 regulatory hubs。Impaired ER-to-mitochondria Ca2+ transfer through the IP3R-GRP75-VDAC1 axis 可導致 either insufficient mitochondrial Ca2+（blunting ATP production）或 pathological Ca2+ overload（sensitizing to permeability transition），兩者都 amplifying ROS 和 destabilizing membrane integrity。MERC disruption amplifies proteostatic 和 redox failure by coupling ER stress to mitochondrial decay，promoting chronic UPRER activation。

label: CamKIIα promoter
description: The CaMKIIalpha promoter is used in COMT-OE mouse models to drive transgenic COMT overexpression selectively in forebrain, cortical and hippocampal neurons, mimicking the brain-specific isoform distribution of endogenous COMT. This restricts the genetic manipulation to regions relevant to cognition while sparing the periphery and cerebellum, which retain normal COMT activity. The approach yields a clean model for studying prefrontal and striatal COMT effects on learning and impulse control. Cerebellar function remains intact and serves as an internal control.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE mouse models 中使用 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子選擇性地驅動轉基因 COMT 在前腦、皮質和海馬神經元中過度表達，模仿內源性 COMT 的 brain 特異性亞型分佈。這將基因操作限制在與認知相關的區域，同時保留了保留正常 COMT activity 的周邊和小腦。此方法產生了一個乾淨的模型，用於研究前額葉和紋狀體 COMT 對學習和衝動控制的影響。小腦功能保持完整併作為內部控制。

label: Immunoglobulin G
description: Immunoglobulin G and Neuromelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Immunoglobulin G and Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Immunoglobulin G 和 Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Immunoglobulin G 和 Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Magnetic Resonance Imaging
description: Magnetic Resonance Imaging detects Neuromelanin using physical or chemical contrast properties specific to the pigment. Mechanistically, the technique reads signal generated by iron content, paramagnetism, or tracer binding to the pigment. This is significant because it enables non-invasive assessment of pigmented neuron integrity in health and Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that the signal is influenced by field strength, sequence, and confounders such as iron, requiring careful quantification.
description_zh_TW: Magnetic Resonance Imaging 使用顏料特有的物理或化學對比特性來檢測 Neuromelanin。從機制上講，該技術讀取由 iron 內容、順磁性或與顏料結合的示踪劑產生的訊號。這很重要，因為它可以對健康和 Parkinson's disease 中的色素神經元完整性進行非侵入性評估。需要注意的是，訊號受到場強、序列和 iron 等混雜因素的影響，需要仔細量化。

label: Flortaucipir
description: Flortaucipir binds to Neuromelanin through physicochemical affinity, forming a complex that modulates the local concentration or activity of the bound species. Mechanistically, Flortaucipir acts as the ligand or matrix and Neuromelanin as the binding partner, with the interaction often driven by catechol, quinone, or charge complementarity. This binding is significant because it can sequester toxins or metals, buffer neurotransmitters, or localize damage within pigmented neurons. A caveat is that the physiological magnitude, reversibility, and functional sequelae of the binding in vivo are not always fully quantified and may differ between intracellular and extracellular contexts.
description_zh_TW: Flortaucipir 透過物理化學親和力與 Neuromelanin 結合，形成複合物，調節結合物質的局部濃度或活性。從機制上講，Flortaucipir 作為配體或基質，Neuromelanin 作為結合伴侶，相互作用通常由兒茶酚、醌或電荷互補性驅動。這種結合很重要，因為它可以隔離毒素或金屬、緩衝 neurotransmitters 或定位色素神經元內的損傷。需要注意的是，體內結合的生理程度、可逆性和功能後遺症並不總是完全量化的，並且在細胞內和細胞外環境之間可能有所不同。

label: Erythrocyte Plasma Membrane
description: Studies have shown that the human erythrocyte plasma membrane can convert epinephrine (adrenaline) to aminochromes, including adrenochrome and further derivatives, in a two-phase reaction. Aminochromes are the cyclized oxidation products of catecholamines, and this membrane-associated conversion represents a route for adrenochrome formation in blood even though erythrocytes lack the organelles and oxidative enzymes that actively produce it. This makes the erythrocyte membrane a site where catecholamine oxidation products can form, with potential consequences for red blood cell membrane integrity.
description_zh_TW: 研究顯示，人類erythrocyte plasma membrane能在two-phase reaction中將epinephrine（adrenaline）轉化為aminochromes，包括adrenochrome及進一步的derivatives。Aminochromes是catecholamines的cyclized oxidation products，而這種membrane-associated conversion代表了一條血液中adrenochrome形成的途徑，儘管erythrocytes缺乏主動生成它的胞器與oxidative enzymes。這使得erythrocyte membrane成為catecholamine oxidation products可以形成的位置，並可能對red blood cell membrane integrity造成影響。

label: Dopaminergic Neurons
description: Dopaminergic neurons, particularly those in the substantia nigra, synthesize neuromelanin through oxidative polymerization of catecholamine-derived precursors, and adrenochrome or related aminochromes can form as intermediates in this process. Neuromelanin synthesis is a normal physiological process, though an excess of reactive oxidation intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in these neurons and to hypotheses about oxidative stress in dopaminergic neurodegeneration. This connects catecholamine oxidation chemistry to the biology of pigmented brain regions.
description_zh_TW: Dopaminergic neurons, particularly those in the substantia nigra, synthesize neuromelanin through oxidative polymerization of catecholamine-derived precursors, and adrenochrome or related aminochromes can form as intermediates in this process。Neuromelanin synthesis is a normal physiological process, though an excess of reactive oxidation intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in these neurons and to hypotheses about oxidative stress in dopaminergic neurodegeneration。This connects catecholamine oxidation chemistry to the biology of pigmented brain regions。

label: Quinone
description: Quinones are organic compounds with a conjugated cyclic dione structure. The formation of a quinone moiety is the first step in the oxidation of catecholamines to aminochromes, where catechol hydroxyls are oxidized to carbonyl groups.
description_zh_TW: 醌（quinone）是具有共軛環狀二酮結構的有機化合物。醌部分的形成是兒茶酚胺氧化為 aminochrome 的第一步，其中兒茶酚羥基被氧化為羰基。

label: Leukoaminochrome
description: Leukoaminochrome condenses into polymeric neuromelanin pigment. Conversion records the generic leuco-aminochrome to pigment route.
description_zh_TW: 無色胺色素縮合為聚合的神經黑素色素。轉換記錄通用無色胺色素到色素路徑。

label: Dolichol
description: Dolichol resides within neuromelanin pigment granules of the substantia nigra pars compacta. Presence records the isoprenoid component of granule matrix.
description_zh_TW: Dolichol 存在於黑質緻密部 neuromelanin 色素顆粒內。存在記錄顆粒基質的異戊二烯成分。

label: cAMP (elevated)
description: High intracellular cAMP activates Epac1 (Exchange Protein directly Activated by cAMP), a guanine-nucleotide-exchange factor that triggers downstream signaling independent of PKA. Directionally, cAMP sits upstream of Epac1 activation. Epac1 then stimulates calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum, linking cAMP to Ca2+-dependent kinases and propagating a metabolic signal. This step is pivotal in resveratrol's indirect SIRT1-activation cascade, bridging the PDE4/cAMP arm to AMPK and NAD+ metabolism. The pathway illustrates how a polyphenol can activate sirtuins through classical second-messenger signaling rather than direct enzyme binding alone.
description_zh_TW: 高濃度的細胞內 cAMP 活化 Epac1（直接被 cAMP 活化的交換蛋白），這是一種鳥嘌呤核苷酸交換因子，觸發不依賴 PKA 的下游信號。在方向性上，cAMP 位於 Epac1 活化的上游。Epac1 然後刺激內質網的鈣離子釋放，將 cAMP 與 Ca2+ 依賴性激酶聯繫起來並傳播代謝信號。這一步是白藜蘆醇間接 SIRT1 活化級聯中的關鍵樞紐，將 PDE4/cAMP 臂橋接到 AMPK 和 NAD+ 代謝。此通路說明了一種多酚如何通過經典的第二信使信號而非僅靠直接酶結合來活化 sirtuin。

label: Capillary electrophoresis-based sirtuin assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Recently, non-peptide substrates for SIRT1 have been synthesized, and two capillary electrophoresis assays were developed and validated to monitor the deacetylation of these substrates and to screen sirtuin inhibitor activity, complementing earlier CE assays using N-terminally fluorescence-labeled peptides. Directionally, CE separates substrate and product by their charge/mass differences without relying on fluorophore-release effects. The non-peptide substrates broaden the assay chemistry available for studying SIRT1 and its modulators.
description_zh_TW: 最近已合成非胜肽類 SIRT1 受質，並開發和驗證了兩種毛細管電泳測定來監測這些受質的去乙醯化及篩選 sirtuin 抑制劑活性，補充了早期使用 N 端螢光標記胜肽的毛細管電泳測定。方向性上毛細管電泳透過電荷/質量差異分離受質和產物，不依賴螢光基團釋放效應。非胜肽受質擴展了研究 SIRT1 及其調節劑的可用測定化學方法。

label: Capsaicin
description: Capsaicin from chili peppers induces a stimulatory hormetic response by activating transient receptor potential (TRP) channels. Downstream effects include increased thermogenesis, improved mitochondrial function and insulin sensitivity, and reduced risk of obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 來自辣椒的 Capsaicin 透過活化 transient receptor potential (TRP) channels 引發興奮性 hormesis 反應。下游效應包括產熱增加、粒線體功能與胰島素敏感性改善，以及肥胖、第二型糖尿病與心血管疾病風險降低。

label: SIRT1 deacetylation of H2A.Z
description: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation and degradation of H2A.Z helps protect the heart from failure by removing a histone variant that drives maladaptive cardiac hypertrophic gene programs. Deacetylated H2A.Z is targeted for proteasomal degradation, reducing its presence at promoters that would otherwise sustain pathological remodeling. Directionally, SIRT1 promotes H2A.Z loss, which attenuates hypertrophy. This is a mechanistically plausible explanation for why SIRT1 activation is cardioprotective, though the in vivo evidence carries moderate confidence.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 介導的 H2A.Z 去乙醯化和降解通過移除驅動適應不良心臟肥大基因程序的組蛋白變體，幫助保護心臟免於衰竭。去乙醯化的 H2A.Z 被標記進行蛋白酶體降解，減少其在否則會維持病理性重塑的啟動子處的存在。在方向性上，SIRT1 促進 H2A.Z 的缺失，從而減弱肥大。這是 SIRT1 活化具有心臟保護作用的一個機制上合理的解釋，儘管體內證據的信心程度為中等。

source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

label: Cardiovascular Events
description: IL-1beta inhibition with canakinumab reduces cardiovascular events, as the CANTOS trial showed fewer recurrent myocardial infarction, stroke, and cardiovascular death independent of lipid lowering. This validated inflammation (not just LDL) as a treatment target. The directionality is IL-1beta blockade to lower CVD events. A caveat is that the trial also showed increased infection risk and that not all patients benefited, indicating a selected responder population. The results of CANTOS established the inflammatory hypothesis of atherosclerosis and opened the door to targeted immunomodulation for CVD.
description_zh_TW: 卡那奴單抗抑制 IL-1beta 會降低 cardiovascular events，因為 CANTOS 試驗顯示，與降血脂無關的複發性心肌梗塞、中風和心血管死亡較少。這驗證了發炎（不僅僅是低密度脂蛋白）作為治療目標。方向性是IL-1beta封鎖以降低CVD事件。需要注意的是，該試驗還顯示感染風險增加，並且並非所有患者都受益，這表明特定的反應族群。 CANTOS的結果建立了atherosclerosis的發炎假說，為CVD的標靶免疫調節打開了大門。

label: Cardiovascular Risk
description: The L-arginine to ADMA ratio is a biomarker of cardiovascular risk because it reflects the balance between NOS substrate and the endogenous inhibitor ADMA. A low ratio predicts impaired NO bioavailability and endothelial dysfunction. The directionality is substrate-inhibitor balance to vascular risk. A caveat is that the ratio is one of several endothelial markers and is influenced by renal function and inflammation, which regulate ADMA clearance. The ratio has been proposed as a clinically accessible biomarker for monitoring NO-related vascular health in at-risk populations.
description_zh_TW: L-arginine 與 ADMA 的比率是 cardiovascular risk 的生物標記物，因為它反映了 NOS 底物和內源性抑制劑 ADMA 之間的平衡。低比率預示著 NO 生物利用度和 endothelial dysfunction 受損。方向性是血管風險的底物-抑制劑平衡。需要注意的是，該比率是幾種內皮標記物之一，並受到腎功能和發炎的影響，從而調節 ADMA 清除率。該比率已被提議作為臨床上可用的生物標記物，用於監測高風險族群中與一氧化氮相關的血管健康。

description: CD38 consumes NAD+; inhibiting it (apigenin, quercetin) boosts NAD+ availability, the obligate co-substrate for all sirtuins (and thus for SIRT1-SIRT7 activity).
description_zh_TW: CD38 消耗 NAD+；抑制它（芹菜素、槲皮素）可增強 NAD+ 的可用性，NAD+ 是所有 sirtuins 的必需共底物（因此影響 SIRT1-SIRT7 的活性）。

label: NAD+ (sirtuin co-substrate)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: CD38 consumes NAD+; inhibiting it (apigenin, quercetin) boosts NAD+ availability, the obligate co-substrate for all sirtuins (and thus for SIRT1-SIRT7 activity).
description_zh_TW: CD38 消耗 NAD+；抑制它（芹菜素、槲皮素）可增強 NAD+ 的可用性，NAD+ 是所有 sirtuins 的必需共底物（因此影響 SIRT1-SIRT7 的活性）。

label: CeTOR
description: CeTOR, the C. elegans ortholog of mTOR, controls HLH-30 at the transcriptional level; inactivation of CeTOR induces hlh-30 expression, increasing the abundance of the master degradative transcription factor. This upstream control parallels mammalian mTORC1's post-translational repression of TFEB, adding a transcriptional layer in worms. By inducing HLH-30, CeTOR inhibition engages the full lysosomal-autophagic and lipolytic program. The relationship confirms mTOR as an evolutionarily conserved suppressor of the TFEB/HLH-30 axis.
description_zh_TW: CeTOR（線蟲的 mTOR 同源物）在轉錄層次控制 HLH-30；CeTOR 失活會誘發 hlh-30 表現，增加這個主降解轉錄因子的豐度。此上游控制類似於哺乳動物 mTORC1 對 TFEB 的轉譯後抑制，在線蟲中增添了轉錄層次。透過誘發 HLH-30，CeTOR 抑制啟動了完整的溶酶體—自噬性和脂解性程序。此關係確認了 mTOR 是 TFEB/HLH-30 軸演化上保守的抑制者。

label: HLH-30 transcription
description: CeTOR, the C. elegans ortholog of mTOR, controls HLH-30 at the transcriptional level; inactivation of CeTOR induces hlh-30 expression, increasing the abundance of the master degradative transcription factor. This upstream control parallels mammalian mTORC1's post-translational repression of TFEB, adding a transcriptional layer in worms. By inducing HLH-30, CeTOR inhibition engages the full lysosomal-autophagic and lipolytic program. The relationship confirms mTOR as an evolutionarily conserved suppressor of the TFEB/HLH-30 axis.
description_zh_TW: CeTOR（線蟲的 mTOR 同源物）在轉錄層次控制 HLH-30；CeTOR 失活會誘發 hlh-30 表現，增加這個主降解轉錄因子的豐度。此上游控制類似於哺乳動物 mTORC1 對 TFEB 的轉譯後抑制，在線蟲中增添了轉錄層次。透過誘發 HLH-30，CeTOR 抑制啟動了完整的溶酶體—自噬性和脂解性程序。此關係確認了 mTOR 是 TFEB/HLH-30 軸演化上保守的抑制者。

label: Glutamate dehydrogenase
description: SIRT4 is the clearest anti-glutamine sirtuin: it mono-ADP-ribosylates glutamate dehydrogenase (GDH), limiting glutamate to alpha-ketoglutarate flux and restricting the anaplerotic carbon supply to the TCA cycle that glutamine-addicted cancers depend on. Loss of SIRT4 is common in HCC, gastric, CRC, bladder, and breast cancer, marking it a metabolic tumor suppressor.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 是最明確的抗麩醯胺 sirtuin：它單-ADP-核糖基化 glutamate dehydrogenase（GDH），限制麩胺酸至 alpha-ketoglutarate 的通量，並限制麩醯胺依賴癌細胞所依賴的 TCA 循環回補碳供應。SIRT4 缺失在 HCC、胃、CRC、膀胱與乳癌中常見，標記其為代謝腫瘤抑制因子。

label: insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: As an outcome of cellular stresses, SIRT4 controls PTEN stability via the insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE). Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of PTEN protein abundance through IDE-mediated degradation. Because PTEN is a key tumour suppressor and negative regulator of PI3K/Akt signalling, SIRT4-dependent control of PTEN stability links mitochondrial sirtuin activity to oncogenic signalling under stress conditions.
description_zh_TW: 作為細胞壓力的結果，SIRT4透過胰島素降解酶（IDE）控制PTEN的穩定性。方向上，SIRT4透過IDE介導的降解位於PTEN蛋白豐度的上游。由於PTEN是關鍵的腫瘤抑制因子和PI3K/Akt訊號的負向調節因子，SIRT4依賴性的PTEN穩定性控制將粒線體sirtuin活性與壓力條件下的致癌訊號聯繫起來。

label: hepatocellular carcinoma and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Expression of SIRT4 is considerably downregulated in hepatocellular carcinoma tumour tissues and in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Lower expression of SIRT4 promotes esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma development. Directionally, loss of SIRT4 sits upstream of tumorigenic progression in these cancers, and its reduced expression is associated with poorer outcomes, supporting SIRT4 as a biomarker and tumor suppressor in HCC and esophageal cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4的表達在肝細胞癌腫瘤組織和食道鱗狀細胞癌中顯著下調。SIRT4的較低表達促進食道鱗狀細胞癌和肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT4缺失位於這些癌症中腫瘤發生進展的上游，其降低的表達與較差的預後相關，支持SIRT4作為HCC和食道癌中的生物標誌物和腫瘤抑制因子。

label: Malonyl-CoA decarboxylase
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: In hepatocytes, SIRT4 represses PPARalpha signaling and inhibits malonyl-CoA decarboxylase, shifting liver metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization and toward anabolic lipid conservation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed fatty acid oxidation. This metabolic brake counterbalances SIRT3, which promotes beta-oxidation, so the relative activity of the two mitochondrial sirtuins determines whether the liver oxidizes or stores fat. Under chronic nutrient surplus, sustained SIRT4 activity contributes to hepatic steatosis, whereas conditions that shift the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance toward SIRT3 favor fat burning.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，SIRT4抑制PPARalpha訊號並抑制丙二醯CoA脫羧酶，將肝臟代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成代謝的脂質保存。方向上，SIRT4位於脂肪酸氧化抑制的上游。這種代謝制動器平衡了促進β-氧化的SIRT3，因此這兩個粒線體sirtuin的相對活性決定了肝臟是氧化還是儲存脂肪。在慢性營養過剩下，持續的SIRT4活性促進肝脂肪變性，而將SIRT3/SIRT4平衡轉向SIRT3的條件則有利於脂肪燃燒。

label: endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and osteoarthritis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In humans, SIRT4 inhibits inflammation in endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and in osteoarthritis. SIRT4 suppresses the inflammatory response and oxidative stress in osteoarthritis. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of dampened inflammatory signalling in vascular endothelium and joint tissue. By restraining inflammation and oxidative stress, SIRT4 exerts protective effects in osteoarthritis and may help preserve endothelial function.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT4抑制臍靜脈內皮細胞和骨關節炎中的發炎。SIRT4在骨關節炎中抑制發炎反應和氧化壓力。方向上，SIRT4位於血管內皮和關節組織中發炎訊號減弱的上游。透過抑制發炎和氧化壓力，SIRT4在骨關節炎中發揮保護作用，可能有助於維持內皮功能。

label: PDH (Pyruvate Dehydrogenase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 (as a lipoamidase) inhibits the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, modulating glucose-derived acetyl-CoA entry into the TCA cycle.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4（作為硫辛酰胺酶）抑制丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體，調節葡萄糖衍生的乙醯輔酶 A 進入 TCA 循環。

label: Tumour suppressor (glutamine metabolism)
description: SIRT4 acts as a tumor suppressor by inhibiting GDH and restricting glutamine-derived anaplerosis into the TCA cycle, starving cancer cells of carbon for proliferation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed glutamine metabolism. This limits the glutamine addiction of tumors, which rely on glutamine for both energy and biosynthesis, and it is a context where SIRT4 opposes rather than promotes growth. By restraining glutamine utilization, SIRT4 reduces the metabolic support for rapid proliferation, and its loss in some cancers relieves this brake. SIRT4's tumor-suppressive role is thus tied to its regulation of mitochondrial metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制 GDH 並限制穀氨醯胺衍生的回補作用進入 TCA 循環來發揮腫瘤抑制因子的作用，使癌細胞缺乏增殖所需的碳源。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於抑制穀氨醯胺代謝的上游。這限制了腫瘤對穀氨醯胺的成癮性——腫瘤依賴穀氨醯胺同時提供能量和生物合成原料——在這個情境下 SIRT4 對抗而非促進生長。透過限制穀氨醯胺利用，SIRT4 減少了快速增殖的代謝支持，其在某些癌症中的缺失解除了此制動。SIRT4 的腫瘤抑制角色因此與其對粒線體代謝的調控相關。

label: AMPK retrograde signaling
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) to mediate retrograde signalling. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cellular energy sensing and mitochondrial-to-nuclear communication. By modulating ATP levels and engaging AMPK-mediated retrograde signalling, SIRT4 helps the cell adapt its nuclear gene expression to mitochondrial metabolic status under conditions of energy stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4控制ATP恆定並使用AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）來介導逆行訊號。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞能量感知和粒線體到核通訊的上游。透過調節ATP水平並參與AMPK介導的逆行訊號，SIRT4幫助細胞在能量壓力條件下根據粒線體代謝狀態調整其核基因表達。

label: ATP homeostasis
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMPK-mediated retrograde signaling to couple mitochondrial metabolic status to nuclear gene expression under energy stress, influencing cellular fuel choice and bioenergetic balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 控制 ATP 恆定，並利用 AMPK 介導的逆行信號將粒線體代謝狀態與能量壓力下的核基因表達耦合，影響細胞燃料選擇和生物能量平衡。

label: breast cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 enhances the tamoxifen sensitivity of breast cancer cells by inhibiting the STAT3 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restored endocrine responsiveness in breast cancer. By suppressing STAT3 signaling, SIRT4 makes breast cancer cells more vulnerable to tamoxifen, in contrast to SIRT3 overexpression, which reduces tamoxifen sensitivity. This positions SIRT4 as a potential enhancer of anti-estrogen therapy efficacy in breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制STAT3訊號通路增強乳腺癌細胞的Tamoxifen敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於乳腺癌中內分泌反應性恢復的上游。透過抑制STAT3訊號，SIRT4使乳腺癌細胞更容易受到Tamoxifen的影響，與降低Tamoxifen敏感性的SIRT3過表達形成對比。這將SIRT4定位為乳腺癌中抗雌激素療法效果的潛在增強因子。

label: SIRT1 (via glutamine metabolism)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 exerts tumor-suppressive activity in breast cancer by negatively regulating expression of SIRT1, and this suppression occurs through repression of glutamine metabolism. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced SIRT1 expression via metabolic regulation. This reveals cross-talk between mitochondrial and nuclear sirtuin proteins in cancer progression, where mitochondrial SIRT4 restrains nuclear SIRT1-dependent growth programs. By limiting glutamine utilization and, consequently, SIRT1 levels, SIRT4 curbs the metabolic and survival advantages that SIRT1 confers on tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制穀氨醯胺代謝在乳腺癌中發揮腫瘤抑制活性，負向調節SIRT1的表達。方向上，SIRT4透過代謝調節位於SIRT1表達降低的上游。這揭示了粒線體和核sirtuin蛋白在癌症進展中的交互作用，其中粒線體SIRT4抑制核SIRT1依賴性的生長程序。透過限制穀氨醯胺利用以及隨之而來的SIRT1水平，SIRT4抑制了SIRT1賦予腫瘤細胞的代謝和存活優勢。

label: 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 increases the sensitivity of colorectal cancer cells to the chemotherapeutic drug 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cell-cycle arrest, which primes CRC cells for 5-fluorouracil-induced killing. By restraining proliferation, SIRT4 enhances the cytotoxic effect of the drug, suggesting that SIRT4 expression status could predict or improve responses to 5-fluorouracil-based therapy in colorectal cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制細胞週期來增加大腸直腸癌細胞對化療藥物5-氟尿嘧啶的敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞週期停滯的上游，使CRC細胞為5-氟尿嘧啶誘導的殺傷做好準備。透過抑制增殖，SIRT4增強了藥物的細胞毒作用，表明SIRT4表達狀態可能預測或改善大腸直腸癌中5-氟尿嘧啶基治療的反應。

label: NSCLC, colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 is an effective tumour suppressor in non-small cell lung cancer cells, human colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restrained tumour growth across multiple cancer types, in part by inhibiting glutamine metabolism and modulating mitochondrial dynamics. Low SIRT4 expression thereby permits tumorigenic behaviour, and SIRT4 represents a prognostic and therapeutic target in these cancers.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4在非小細胞肺癌細胞、人類大腸直腸癌、神經母細胞瘤和胃癌中是有效的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT4位於多種癌症類型中腫瘤生長抑制的上游，部分透過抑制穀氨醯胺代謝和調節粒線體動力學。因此低SIRT4表達允許致瘤行為，SIRT4在這些癌症中代表了預後和治療靶點。

label: Phylogenetic Class II (evolutionarily ancient)
description: SIRT4 is classified in phylogenetic Class II, which includes sirtuins from bacteria, insects, nematodes, mould, and protozoa—among the most ancient sirtuin lineages. Directionally, this is an evolutionary placement rather than a causal pathway. This antiquity implies conserved mitochondrial metabolic roles, and it situates SIRT4 early in sirtuin evolution. Because Class II sirtuins predate the divergence of major eukaryotic lineages, SIRT4's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase function likely represents an ancestral enzymatic activity. Understanding SIRT4's phylogenetic position helps contextualize its metabolic-brake functions relative to the more derived deacetylases.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 被分類為系統發育 II 類，包括來自細菌、昆蟲、線蟲、黴菌和原生動物的 sirtuin——是最古老的 sirtuin 譜系之一。在方向性上，這是演化定位而非因果途徑。這種古老性暗示保守的粒線體代謝角色，並將 SIRT4 置於 sirtuin 演化的早期。由於 II 類 sirtuin 先於主要真核生物譜系的分化，SIRT4 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶功能可能代表一種通過演化保留的祖先酶活性。理解 SIRT4 的系統發育位置有助於將其代謝制動功能置於更衍生的去乙醯酶的背景中。

label: tumor suppressor (downregulated in cancers)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 is described as tumor suppressor (downregulated in cancers); it is a tumor suppressor downregulated in multiple cancers (Wu et al., 2022).
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 被描述為腫瘤抑制因子（在癌症中下調）；它是在多種癌症中下調的腫瘤抑制因子（Wu et al., 2022）。

label: mitotic cell division regulation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 plays a crucial role in mitotic cell division regulation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of proper cell cycle progression and mitotic fidelity. In addition to its roles in glutamine metabolism and tumor suppression, SIRT4 contributes to the orderly execution of mitosis, extending the functional repertoire of this mitochondrial sirtuin beyond metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4在有絲分裂細胞分裂調節中發揮關鍵作用。方向上，SIRT4位於正常的細胞週期進展和有絲分裂保真度的上游。除了其在穀氨醯胺代謝和腫瘤抑制中的角色外，SIRT4還有助於有絲分裂的有序執行，將此粒線體sirtuin的功能譜擴展到代謝之外。

label: E-cadherin promotion
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 suppresses epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) by promoting expression of the epithelial marker E-cadherin in gastric cancer cells. This maintains an epithelial phenotype and inhibits cancer cell proliferation, migration, and invasion. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of maintained epithelial phenotype and suppressed metastasis. By preventing the loss of E-cadherin that characterizes EMT, SIRT4 blocks a key step in the acquisition of invasive and migratory behavior. This supports SIRT4's role as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer, where its downregulation may allow tumors to progress toward metastatic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過促進上皮標記E-cadherin在胃癌細胞中的表達來抑制上皮-間質轉化（EMT）。這維持了上皮表型並抑制癌細胞增殖、遷移和侵襲。方向上，SIRT4位於上皮表型維持和轉移抑制的上游。透過阻止EMT特徵性的E-cadherin喪失，SIRT4阻斷了獲得侵襲和遷移行為的關鍵步驟。這支持SIRT4作為胃癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，其下調可能使腫瘤向轉移性疾病進展。

label: MTPα (fatty acid oxidation)
description: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid oxidation in liver by inhibiting the mitochondrial trifunctional protein α subunit (MTPα), promoting lipid accumulation under nutrient-replete conditions. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced β-oxidation. This contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5, which support fat oxidation, and it positions SIRT4 as a mitochondrial anabolic brake that conserves lipids when nutrients are abundant. The inhibition of MTPα and of PPARα signaling shifts metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization toward lipid storage. SIRT4's opposition to oxidative metabolism is central to the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制粒線體三功能蛋白 α 亞基（MTPα）來抑制肝臟中的脂肪酸氧化，在營養充足條件下促進脂質積累。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於減少 β-氧化的上游。這與支持脂肪氧化的 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，將 SIRT4 定位為在營養豐富時保存脂質的粒線體合成代謝制動器。對 MTPα 和 PPARα 訊號的抑制使代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向脂質儲存。SIRT4 對氧化代謝的對抗是拮抗性 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的核心。

label: MTPα (mitochondrial trifunctional protein α)
description: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid oxidation in liver by inhibiting the mitochondrial trifunctional protein α subunit (MTPα), promoting lipid accumulation under nutrient-replete conditions. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced β-oxidation. This contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5, which support fat oxidation, and it positions SIRT4 as a mitochondrial anabolic brake. By inhibiting MTPα, SIRT4 conserves fatty acids for storage when nutrients are abundant. This opposition to oxidative metabolism is central to the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance that determines mitochondrial metabolic state.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制粒線體三功能蛋白 α 亞基（MTPα）來抑制肝臟中的脂肪酸氧化，在營養充足條件下促進脂質積累。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於減少 β-氧化的上游。這與支持脂肪氧化的 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，將 SIRT4 定位為粒線體合成代謝制動器。透過抑制 MTPα，SIRT4 在營養豐富時保存脂肪酸以供儲存。這種對氧化代謝的對抗是決定粒線體代謝狀態的拮抗性 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的核心。

label: p16 and p21
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 upregulates expression of the cell-cycle inhibitor genes p16 and p21, while suppressing CyclinB1/Cdc2 and Cdc25c, and this cell-cycle blockade induces apoptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis induction. By enforcing these checkpoints, SIRT4 functions as a tumor suppressor in liver cancer, limiting proliferation and promoting death of transformed cells. The coordinated upregulation of p16 and p21 with suppression of cell-cycle drivers reflects SIRT4's broad influence on the machinery that governs entry into mitosis. This supports interest in SIRT4 as a therapeutic target for hepatocellular carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4上調細胞週期抑制因子p16和p21的表達，同時抑制CyclinB1/Cdc2和Cdc25c，這種細胞週期阻斷誘導肝細胞癌細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞週期停滯和凋亡誘導的上游。透過強制執行這些檢查點，SIRT4在肝癌中作為腫瘤抑制因子發揮作用，限制增殖並促進轉化細胞的死亡。p16和p21的協調上調與細胞週期驅動因子的抑制反映了SIRT4對控制有絲分裂進入機制的廣泛影響。這支持了SIRT4作為肝細胞癌治療靶點的興趣。

label: Charcoal Binding Assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The charcoal binding assay measures sirtuin activity by quantifying 3H-labeled OAADPr released as free acetate: incubation of recombinant sirtuins with a 3H-acetylated peptide and NAD+ produces 3H-OAADPr, which binds activated charcoal, but the 3H-acetate hydrolyzed from OAADPr remains in the supernatant and is counted. This method was used to screen nicotinamide analogs and NAD+ metabolites as inhibitors of SIRT2. Directionally, the assay traces sirtuin catalytic flux through its unique OAADPr by-product rather than through fluorophore release, giving an artifact-free alternative to fluorescent assays.
description_zh_TW: 活性炭結合測定透過量化釋放為游離乙酸的 3H 標記 OAADPr 來測量 sirtuin 活性：將重組 sirtuin 與 3H-乙醯化胜肽和 NAD+ 孵育產生 3H-OAADPr，其與活化活性炭結合，而從 OAADPr 水解的 3H-乙酸留在上清液中並被計數。此方法被用於篩選尼可醯胺類似物和 NAD+ 代謝物作為 SIRT2 的抑制劑。方向性上該測定透過其獨特的 OAADPr 副產物而非螢光基團釋放來追溯 sirtuin 催化通量，提供了無假象的螢光測定替代方案。

label: OAADPr formation
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The charcoal binding assay measures sirtuin activity by quantifying 3H-labeled OAADPr released as free acetate: incubation of recombinant sirtuins with a 3H-acetylated peptide and NAD+ produces 3H-OAADPr, which binds activated charcoal, but the 3H-acetate hydrolyzed from OAADPr remains in the supernatant and is counted. This method was used to screen nicotinamide analogs and NAD+ metabolites as inhibitors of SIRT2. Directionally, the assay traces sirtuin catalytic flux through its unique OAADPr by-product rather than through fluorophore release, giving an artifact-free alternative to fluorescent assays.

label: Chlorpromazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Chlorpromazine, a phenothiazine carrying an amine side chain on its 10-nitrogen, was the only compound among those tested that failed to protect HT-22 cells in the rotenone neurotoxicity model. The 10-N substitution causes a roughly 1000-fold loss of potency relative to methylene blue in glutamate, IAA, and rotenone assays, and abolishes the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt, oxygen consumption enhancement, and glycolysis suppression. In the lysate oxidation assay chlorpromazine increased DCF fluorescence with or without mitochondria and NADH, behaving as a pro-oxidant and explaining its weak neuroprotection.
description_zh_TW: 氯丙嗪（chlorpromazine）是在其10-氮上帶有胺側鏈的吩噻嗪（phenothiazine），是受測化合物中唯一無法在魚藤酮（rotenone）神經毒性模型中保護HT-22細胞的化合物。與亞甲藍（methylene blue）相比，10-N取代在麩胺酸（glutamate）、IAA與魚藤酮試驗中造成約1000倍的效力損失，並消除複合體I至細胞色素c的電子分流、耗氧量增強與糖解抑制。在裂解液氧化試驗中，氯丙嗪在有或無粒線體與NADH的情況下皆增加DCF螢光，表現出促氧化劑（pro-oxidant）行為，這解釋了其微弱的神經保護作用。

label: Chromatin modifiers (SIRT1, SIRT6, HDAC1, PARP1)
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: Chromatin modifiers including sirtuins like SIRT1 and SIRT6, as well as HDAC1 and PARP1, normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain proper gene expression patterns that define cell identity. When DNA damage, especially double-strand breaks, occurs, these proteins are recruited to damage sites to assist in repair. This temporarily disrupts their original positions, altering local gene expression, and repeated relocalization over a lifetime contributes to the progressive loss of epigenetic information.
description_zh_TW: 包括 SIRT1 和 SIRT6 等 sirtuins 在內的染色質修飾因子，以及 HDAC1 和 PARP1，通常位於特定的基因組位點以維持定義細胞身分的正確基因表達模式。當 DNA 損傷（特別是雙股斷裂）發生時，這些蛋白質被招募到損傷位點以協助修復。這暫時破壞了它們的原始位置，改變局部基因表達，而在一生中反覆的再定位則導致表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失。

label: cisplatin nephrotoxicity
description: Silybin is the principal flavonolignan of milk thistle. It attenuates cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity by preserving renal tubular integrity and mitochondrial bioenergetics, likely via SIRT3-mediated mechanisms, placing it among natural compounds engaging the mitochondrial deacetylase axis in kidney injury.
description_zh_TW: Silybin 是水飛薊的主要黃酮木脂素。它透過維護腎小管完整性和粒線體生物能學，可能透過 SIRT3 介導的機制，減輕 Cisplatin 誘導的腎毒性，將其定位為在腎損傷中參與粒線體去乙醯酶軸線的天然化合物之一。

label: cisplatin sensitivity in NSCLC
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Upregulation of SIRT2 in non-small-cell lung cancer cells increases their sensitivity to cisplatin treatment, while the opposite modulation reduces responsiveness. Directionally, SIRT2 levels sit upstream of platinum chemosensitivity in NSCLC. Higher SIRT2 expression renders tumor cells more vulnerable to cisplatin-induced killing, suggesting that SIRT2 activity could be exploited to improve the efficacy of platinum-based therapy in lung cancer.
description_zh_TW: 非小細胞肺癌細胞中SIRT2的上調增加了它們對順鉑治療的敏感性，而相反的調節則降低反應性。方向上，SIRT2水平位於NSCLC鉑化療敏感性的上游。較高的SIRT2表達使腫瘤細胞更容易受到順鉑誘導的殺傷，表明SIRT2活性可以被利用來提高肺癌中鉑基治療的效果。

source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

label: cisplatin sensitivity via autophagy suppression
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Silencing of SIRT1 enhances the cisplatin sensitivity of H1299/cisplatin non-small-cell lung cancer cells by suppressing autophagy. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of reduced autophagic survival signaling and increased susceptibility to cisplatin. Because autophagy can protect cancer cells from chemotherapy-induced damage, its suppression re-sensitizes resistant NSCLC cells to cisplatin. This identifies SIRT1 inhibition as a potential strategy to overcome platinum resistance in lung cancer.
description_zh_TW: 沉默SIRT1透過抑制自噬來增強H1299/順鉑非小細胞肺癌細胞的順鉑敏感性。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於自噬性存活訊號減少和順鉑敏感性增加的上游。由於自噬可以保護癌細胞免受化療誘導的損傷，其抑制使耐藥NSCLC細胞對順鉑重新敏感。這將SIRT1抑制確定為克服肺癌鉑耐藥的潛在策略。

label: clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis
community_name: clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5-mediated desuccinylation of succinate dehydrogenase A (SDHA) promotes clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis. Directionally, SIRT5 desuccinylation of SDHA sits upstream of increased growth of clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumours. By activating SDHA and thereby modulating the TCA cycle, SIRT5 supports the metabolic reprogramming that drives this kidney cancer, identifying SIRT5 as a potential target in ccRCC.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5介導的琥珀酸脫氫酶A（SDHA）去琥珀醯化促進透明細胞腎細胞癌的腫瘤發生。方向上，SIRT5對SDHA的去琥珀醯化位於透明細胞腎細胞癌腫瘤生長增加的上游。透過活化SDHA從而調節TCA循環，SIRT5支持驅動此腎癌的代謝重編程，將SIRT5確定為ccRCC中的潛在靶點。

label: cleaved SIRT1
source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md
description: Cleaved SIRT1 binds TRIM28 more strongly, accelerating its own destruction. The DeltaC703 cleavage-mimic shows the highest ubiquitination of all constructs and enhanced TRIM28 binding, while D707A shows reduced binding, so the two PTMs are mutually reinforcing.
description_zh_TW: 被裂解的 SIRT1 與 TRIM28 結合更強，加速其自身的破壞。裂解模擬物 ΔC703 在所有構建體中顯示最高的泛素化並增強 TRIM28 結合，而 D707A 顯示結合減少，因此這兩種翻譯後修飾相互強化。

label: CobB
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The first bacterial sirtuin was found in Salmonella enterica and was named CobB due to its involvement in cobalamin biosynthesis and propionic catabolism. CobB demonstrates that sirtuins are not restricted to eukaryotes but are also present in prokaryotes, where they regulate various metabolic pathways. In bacteria one or two sirtuins are typically found, and CobB serves as the founding example of prokaryotic sirtuin biology.
description_zh_TW: 第一個細菌sirtuin在腸炎沙門氏菌中被發現，由於其參與鈷胺素生物合成和丙酸分解代謝而被命名為CobB。CobB證明了sirtuin並非僅限於真核生物，也存在於原核生物中，在那裡它們調節各種代謝途徑。在細菌中通常發現一到兩個sirtuin，CobB作為原核sirtuin生物學的奠基範例。

label: Cochlea
description: The cochlea is the auditory organ where cumulative oxidative damage drives age-related hearing loss. Caloric restriction reduces oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protection is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice, making SIRT3 indispensable for CR-induced auditory resilience and a candidate therapeutic target in AHL.
description_zh_TW: 耳蝸是聽覺器官，累積的氧化損傷驅動年齡相關性聽力損失。熱量限制減少耳蝸細胞中的氧化損傷，但此保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中被消除，使 SIRT3 成為 CR 誘導聽覺韌性不可或缺的因子和 AHL 的候選治療靶標。

label: SIRT3 under caloric restriction
