label: MTHFR function
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Creatine supports MTHFR function indirectly by lowering the methyl-group demand of endogenous creatine synthesis, which consumes a substantial share of the body's methyl budget, thereby easing reliance on folate-dependent remethylation. For slow MTHFR variants that generate methylfolate less efficiently, supplemental creatine can reduce the metabolic pressure on an already constrained methylation cycle and help preserve SAMe availability. The benefit is supportive rather than direct enzymatic rescue, but it relieves a major competing methyl sink. This makes creatine a useful adjunct in methylation-support protocols.
description_zh_TW: Creatine 透過降低內源性肌酸合成的甲基需求（消耗人體甲基預算的很大一部分）來間接支持 MTHFR function，從而減輕對 folate 依賴性再甲基化的依賴。對於緩慢生成甲基葉酸效率較低的 MTHFR variants，補充肌酸可以降低已經受限的 methylation cycle 的代謝壓力，並有助於維持 SAMe 的可用性。其好處是支持性的，而不是直接的酶救援，但它緩解了主要的競爭性甲基匯。這使得肌酸成為甲基化支持方案中有用的輔助劑。

label: Cancer Metabolism
description: Creatine and the creatine kinase system are increasingly studied in the context of cancer metabolism. Some cancer types, particularly those with a poor prognosis, upregulate creatine kinase isoenzymes, and creatine metabolism has been reported to support the growth and invasiveness of certain tumors, whereas in other contexts creatine appears to restrain tumor growth, possibly through effects on energy homeostasis and AMPK. The trace explicitly notes that creatine's relationship to cancer is context-dependent and that current evidence is insufficient to recommend creatine as an anti-cancer intervention, underscoring the need for direct experimental studies.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸與肌酸激酶系統在癌症代謝的脈絡中日益受到研究。某些癌症類型，尤其是預後不佳者，會上調肌酸激酶同功酶，且據報導肌酸代謝可支持某些腫瘤的生長與侵襲性；而在其他情境中，肌酸似乎能抑制腫瘤生長，可能透過對能量恆定與 AMPK 的影響。該追蹤明確指出，肌酸與癌症的關係取決於情境，且目前的證據不足以推薦肌酸作為抗癌介入措施，並強調需要直接的實驗研究。

label: Methylglyoxal (MG)
description: Creatine augments the anticancer efficacy of the metabolite methylglyoxal (MG). Creatine content and energy availability are low in several types of malignant cells and in the T cells that mediate immune responses against cancer, and the creatine transporter SLC6A8 is markedly increased in tumor-infiltrating immune cells. Patra et al. reported that MG efficacy is significantly augmented in the presence of creatine, and combined administration of creatine, methylglyoxal, and ascorbic acid provided greater efficacy and eliminated visible signs of tumor growth. Creatine and creatine kinase, very low in sarcoma tissue, were significantly elevated with concomitant regression of tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸可增強代謝物甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal，MG）的抗癌療效。多種惡性細胞以及介導抗癌免疫反應的T細胞中，肌酸含量與能量可用性均偏低；而腫瘤浸潤免疫細胞中的肌酸轉運蛋白SLC6A8則顯著增加。Patra等人報告，在肌酸存在下MG的療效顯著增強；合併投予肌酸、甲基乙二醛與抗壞血酸（ascorbic acid）可提供更大的療效，並消除可見的腫瘤生長跡象。肉瘤組織中原本極低的肌酸與肌酸激酶顯著升高，伴隨腫瘤細胞的消退。

label: Pro-inflammatory Cytokines
description: Creatine has immunomodulatory effects that include reducing pro-inflammatory cytokines such as IL-6 and other inflammatory markers like TNF-alpha and PGE2. A creatine-induced reduction of these inflammatory mediators may help explain some of the neuroprotective benefits observed in patients with central nervous system diseases and the attenuation of inflammatory and muscle damage markers after intense exercise. Creatine also down-regulates expression of toll-like receptors (TLR-2, TLR-3, TLR-4, TLR-7) in a mouse macrophage cell line and may influence cytokines through the NF-kB signaling pathway, with potential consequences for immune response and, notably, for TLR-4-mediated pathology in Parkinson's disease progression.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸具有免疫調節作用，包括降低 IL-6 等促發炎細胞激素，以及 TNF-alpha 與 PGE2 等其他發炎指標。肌酸引起的這些發炎介質降低，可能有助於解釋在中樞神經系統疾病患者身上觀察到的部分神經保護效益，以及劇烈運動後發炎與肌肉損傷指標的減弱。肌酸也會在小鼠巨噬細胞株中下調類鐸受體（TLR-2、TLR-3、TLR-4、TLR-7）的表現，並可能透過 NF-kB 訊息傳導途徑影響細胞激素，對免疫反應具有潛在影響，尤其是對帕金森氏症病程中 TLR-4 媒介的病理機制。

label: Nutraceuticals
description: Creatine is a naturally occurring nitrogen-containing compound that is synthesized endogenously in the liver, kidney, and pancreas and is also obtained from dietary sources, particularly red meat and fish. Around 95 percent of the body's creatine is stored in skeletal muscle, approximately one-third of it in the phosphorylated form creatine phosphate. In the muscle it is converted to creatine phosphate, which donates its high-energy phosphate group to regenerate ATP from ADP, supporting short-duration, high-intensity exercise. Because of its role in ATP regeneration, creatine is one of the most widely used sports supplements and is increasingly examined for additional therapeutic effects, including possible anti-cancer properties.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸是一種天然存在的含氮化合物，在體內由肝臟、腎臟與胰臟內源性合成，也可從飲食來源獲得，尤其是紅肉與魚類。人體約 95% 的肌酸儲存於骨骼肌，其中約三分之一以磷酸化形式（磷酸肌酸）存在。在肌肉中，肌酸被轉化為磷酸肌酸，後者提供其高能磷酸基團，從 ADP 再生 ATP，以支持短時間、高強度的運動。由於其在 ATP 再生中的角色，肌酸是最廣泛使用的運動補充品之一，並日益被研究是否具有額外的治療效應，包括可能的抗癌特性。

label: Amino Acids
description: Creatine is synthesized endogenously from the amino acids arginine, glycine, and methionine in a two-step pathway. The first step, catalyzed by arginine:glycine amidinotransferase (AGAT), takes place primarily in the kidney and pancreas and produces guanidinoacetate; the second step, catalyzed by guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase (GAMT), transfers a methyl group from S-adenosylmethionine to guanidinoacetate in the liver, producing creatine. This biosynthetic origin connects creatine metabolism to the methylation cycle and one-carbon metabolism, a connection relevant to hypotheses linking creatine status to epigenetic regulation and cancer risk.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸由胺基酸精胺酸、甘胺酸與甲硫胺酸經由兩步驟途徑內源性合成。第一步由精胺酸：甘胺酸脒基轉移酶（AGAT）催化，主要發生在腎臟與胰臟，產生胍基乙酸；第二步由胍基乙酸 N-甲基轉移酶（GAMT）催化，在肝臟中將 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸的甲基轉移至胍基乙酸，產生肌酸。這種生合成來源將肌酸代謝與甲基化循環及一碳代謝連結起來，此關聯與將肌酸狀態連結至表觀遺傳調控與癌症風險的假說相關。

label: Dietary Supplement
description: Creatine monohydrate is among the most extensively studied dietary supplements and is generally regarded as safe when used at recommended doses over periods of many years. Long-term supplementation studies report no consistent adverse effects on renal, hepatic, or cardiovascular function in healthy individuals, and creatine is approved for use by many sports organizations. Common minor side effects include water retention and occasional gastrointestinal discomfort. This favorable safety profile is noted in the trace as relevant to the potential evaluation of creatine as an adjunct in oncology settings, where tolerability is a central concern.
description_zh_TW: 一水肌酸是研究最廣泛的膳食補充品之一，在建議劑量下長期使用多年，一般被認為是安全的。長期補充研究報告指出，健康個體的腎臟、肝臟或心血管功能並未出現一致的不良影響，且肌酸已獲許多運動組織核准使用。常見的輕微副作用包括水分滯留與偶發的腸胃不適。該追蹤指出，這種良好的安全性資料與肌酸在腫瘤科情境中作為輔助治療的潛在評估相關，因為耐受性是其中的核心考量。

label: ADP
description: Creatine provides the immediate phosphate group needed to recycle ADP back into ATP, the cellular energy currency, keeping cellular energy pools saturated and reducing metabolic stress, which protects HRV from plunging during hard training. It is recommended daily at 3-5 grams, ideally post-workout or with the largest carbohydrate meal, because creatine uptake is enhanced by insulin. Pairing creatine with carbohydrates and protein helps drive it into muscle and brain cells more efficiently, with consistency mattering more than exact timing.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸提供將 ADP 回收為 ATP（細胞的能量貨幣）所需的即時磷酸基團，使細胞能量池保持飽和並降低代謝壓力，從而保護 HRV 在艱苦訓練期間不致驟降。建議每日攝取 3–5 公克，理想上在訓練後或搭配最大的一餐碳水化合物，因為胰島素可增強肌酸攝取。將肌酸與碳水化合物和蛋白質搭配，有助於更有效地將其送入肌肉與腦細胞，而持續性比精確的時機更重要。

label: Homocysteine
description: Creatine supplementation has been reported to lower plasma homocysteine, an effect that may reduce cardiovascular disease risk. Because homocysteine is methylated back to methionine by enzymes that require the same methyl-donor pool (S-adenosyl methionine) used for creatine synthesis, supplying exogenous creatine spares methyl groups that would otherwise be consumed in endogenous creatine formation, thereby lowering homocysteine production. Studies in individuals adhering to vegan diets (who tend to have elevated homocysteine) reported that creatine supplementation reduced homocysteine levels and improved systemic microvascular endothelial function, supporting creatine's role in cardiovascular health beyond its direct effects on muscle bioenergetics.
description_zh_TW: 據報導，肌酸補充可降低血漿同半胱胺酸（homocysteine），此效果可能降低心血管疾病風險。由於同半胱胺酸需由酵素甲基化轉回甲硫胺酸（methionine），而這些酵素所需的甲基供體池（S-腺苷甲硫胺酸）與肌酸合成所用者相同，補充外源性肌酸可節省否則將消耗於內源性肌酸形成的甲基，從而降低同半胱胺酸的產生。針對遵循純素飲食（其同半胱胺酸往往較高）之個體的研究報告指出，肌酸補充可降低同半胱胺酸濃度並改善全身微血管內皮功能，支持肌酸在肌肉生物能量學直接效應之外對心血管健康的貢獻。

label: Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI)
description: Creatine supplementation has shown neuroprotective potential in traumatic brain injury. In animal models, providing creatine in the diet for 5 days prior to TBI decreased cortical brain damage by 36% in rats and 50% in mice, an effect attributed to improved energy availability in the injured brain. Creatine also reduces the severity of mild concussions and ischemic brain damage and improves learning and memory during recovery in neonatal mice. While these preclinical studies cannot be replicated in humans, they support the contention that creatine supplementation may reduce the severity of TBI and serve as an adjunctive strategy in individuals at risk of head injury, complementing its established role in muscle and rehabilitation settings.
description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸在創傷性腦損傷中已顯示出神經保護潛力。在動物模型中，於 TBI 前以飲食提供肌酸 5 天，可使大鼠的皮質腦損傷減少 36%、小鼠減少 50%，此效應歸因於受損腦部能量可用性的改善。肌酸也能減輕輕度腦震盪與缺血性腦損傷的嚴重程度，並改善新生小鼠恢復期間的學習與記憶。雖然這些臨床前研究無法在人體中複製，但它們支持肌酸補充可能減輕 TBI 嚴重程度、並作為頭部損傷高風險個體的輔助策略之論點，補足其在肌肉與復健領域中已確立的角色。

label: GLUT4
description: Creatine supplementation influences glucose handling in skeletal muscle, in part by upregulating the GLUT4 glucose transporter. Creatine prevents declines in GLUT4 during immobilization and increases GLUT4 by about 40% during rehabilitation after atrophy, and co-ingestion with carbohydrate and protein enhances creatine uptake and muscle glycogen. In type 2 diabetic patients, 12 weeks of creatine supplementation during training improved glucose tolerance, increased GLUT4 translocation, and significantly reduced HbA1c, with changes in AMPK signaling related to GLUT4 translocation and HbA1c. These findings indicate creatine enhances glucose uptake and supports glucose management, especially when combined with exercise.
description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸會影響骨骼肌的葡萄糖處理，部分機制是透過上調 GLUT4 葡萄糖轉運蛋白。肌酸可防止固定不動期間 GLUT4 的下降，並在萎縮後的復健期間使 GLUT4 增加約 40%，而與碳水化合物和蛋白質併服可增強肌酸攝取與肌肉肝醣。在第二型糖尿病患者中，訓練期間補充肌酸 12 週可改善葡萄糖耐受度、增加 GLUT4 轉位，並顯著降低 HbA1c，其中 AMPK 訊息傳導的變化與 GLUT4 轉位及 HbA1c 相關。這些發現顯示肌酸能增強葡萄糖攝取並支持血糖管理，尤其是與運動結合時。

label: Exercise Performance
description: Creatine supplementation is one of the most effective and best-documented ergogenic aids for improving performance in high-intensity, short-duration activities. By increasing muscle phosphocreatine stores, creatine enhances the capacity to regenerate ATP during repeated bouts of maximal exercise, increasing power output, strength gains during resistance training, and work performed in repeated sprint protocols. Meta-analyses consistently show moderate improvements in measures such as maximal strength, sprint performance, and lean body mass, with benefit most pronounced in activities relying on the phosphocreatine energy system. These well-established performance effects are the context in which the trace asks whether creatine also influences cancer outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸是改善高強度、短時間運動表現最有效且文獻記載最完整的增能劑之一。透過增加肌肉磷酸肌酸儲備，肌酸可提升反覆最大強度運動期間再生 ATP 的能力，進而增加功率輸出、阻力訓練中的肌力增長，以及反覆衝刺訓練中的做功量。統合分析一致顯示，肌酸在最大肌力、衝刺表現與去脂體重等指標上帶來中等程度的改善，其效益在依賴磷酸肌酸能量系統的活動中最為顯著。這些確立已久的表現效益，正是該追蹤探討肌酸是否也影響癌症結果的背景脈絡。

label: Red Meat
description: Dietary creatine is obtained almost exclusively from animal-derived foods, with red meat and fish being the richest sources. Cooking does not destroy creatine, and an omnivorous diet typically supplies one to two grams of creatine per day, which complements the roughly one gram synthesized endogenously per day. Vegetarians have lower muscle creatine stores and show larger increases in response to supplementation than meat-eaters, reflecting the lower baseline intake. This dietary origin is relevant to epidemiologic questions about meat consumption and cancer risk, because creatine is often discussed alongside other meat-derived compounds when considering diet-cancer associations.
description_zh_TW: 飲食中的肌酸幾乎完全來自動物性食物，其中紅肉與魚類是最豐富的來源。烹調不會破壞肌酸，雜食性飲食每天通常可提供一至兩公克肌酸，補足體內每天約一公克的內源性合成量。素食者的肌肉肌酸儲備較低，且對補充的反應比肉食者更明顯，反映出其較低的基線攝取量。這種飲食來源與肉類攝取和癌症風險的流行病學問題相關，因為在考量飲食與癌症的關聯時，肌酸常與其他肉類來源化合物一起被討論。

label: Creatine Synthesis Deficiency
description: High-dose, long-term creatine supplementation is a nutritional strategy for creatine synthesis deficiencies caused by mutations in AGAT, GAMT, or the creatine transporter (SLC6A8), which reduce endogenous creatine synthesis or cellular uptake and result in low brain creatine and phosphocreatine. Supplementation at 0.3-0.8 g/kg/day increases brain creatine and PCr levels and improves or stabilizes clinical symptoms including intellectual disability, epilepsy, and movement disorders. Patients with GAMT or AGAT deficiency treated early (e.g., starting at four months of age) can experience normal psychomotor development, and such therapy is well tolerated and may also benefit ornithine aminotransferase deficiency causing gyrate atrophy.
description_zh_TW: 高劑量、長期的肌酸補充是針對 AGAT、GAMT 或肌酸轉運蛋白（SLC6A8）突變所致肌酸合成缺乏症的營養策略，這些突變會降低內源性肌酸合成或細胞攝取，導致腦部肌酸與磷酸肌酸偏低。以每日 0.3–0.8 公克/公斤補充可提高腦部肌酸與 PCr 濃度，並改善或穩定臨床症狀，包括智能障礙、癲癇與動作障礙。早期治療（例如從四個月大開始）的 GAMT 或 AGAT 缺乏症患者可獲得正常的心理動作發展，此療法耐受性良好，且可能對導致迴旋狀萎縮的鳥胺酸胺基轉移酶缺乏症也有益。

label: Spinal Cord Injury (SCI)
description: Preclinical studies suggest creatine supplementation can reduce the severity of spinal cord injury. Rats fed creatine before and after moderate spinal cord contusion developed less scar tissue and performed better on locomotor function tests than controls, and rats fed a 2% creatine diet before and after injury experienced less loss of gray matter. In humans with cervical spinal cord injury, creatine supplementation enhanced aerobic exercise capacity, ventilatory anaerobic threshold, and, combined with vitamin D and resistance training, improved arm muscle area, strength, and functional capacity. These findings support creatine as an adjunct that may reduce injury severity and enhance rehabilitation outcomes after spinal cord injury.
description_zh_TW: 臨床前研究顯示，補充肌酸可減輕脊髓損傷的嚴重程度。在中度脊髓挫傷前後餵食肌酸的大鼠，其疤痕組織較少，且在運動功能測試中的表現優於對照組；在損傷前後餵食 2% 肌酸飲食的大鼠，其灰質流失較少。在頸椎脊髓損傷的人類患者中，補充肌酸可增強有氧運動能力與換氣無氧閾值，而與維生素 D 及阻力訓練結合時，可改善手臂肌肉面積、肌力與功能能力。這些發現支持肌酸作為可能減輕損傷嚴重程度並增進脊髓損傷後復健成果的輔助措施。

label: Creatine Phosphate
description: Within cells, creatine is phosphorylated by the enzyme creatine kinase to form creatine phosphate (phosphocreatine), which serves as a rapidly mobilizable reserve of high-energy phosphate. The reaction creatine plus ATP yields creatine phosphate plus ADP, and the reverse reaction regenerates ATP during bursts of high energy demand, such as muscle contraction. The phosphocreatine pool is the immediate energy buffer that sustains ATP levels for the first several seconds of maximal effort, before glycolysis and oxidative metabolism fully contribute. This conversion of creatine to creatine phosphate is the mechanistic heart of the creatine-phosphocreatine energy system.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞內，肌酸由肌酸激酶磷酸化形成磷酸肌酸（phosphocreatine），作為可快速動用的高能磷酸儲備。肌酸加 ATP 的反應產生磷酸肌酸加 ADP，而逆反應則在肌肉收縮等高能量需求爆發期間再生 ATP。磷酸肌酸池是即時的能量緩衝，在糖解作用與氧化代謝完全投入之前，於最大努力的頭幾秒內維持 ATP 濃度。肌酸轉化為磷酸肌酸的過程，正是肌酸—磷酸肌酸能量系統的機制核心。

label: Creatine Supplementation
description: Oral creatine monohydrate — typically 3-5 g/day maintenance or 20 g/day loading — raises total muscle and brain creatine stores by roughly 20-40%, enlarging the phosphocreatine buffer that the creatine phosphate shuttle uses to spatially buffer ATP. The largest responses occur in individuals with low baseline stores (vegetarians, low meat intake), and the ergogenic and neuroprotective effects follow from the widened energy buffer rather than from any direct receptor action.
description_zh_TW: 口服肌酸單水合物——通常每日 3-5 克維持劑量或每日 20 克負荷期——可使肌肉與腦部的總肌酸儲量提升約 20-40%，擴大肌酸磷酸穿梭用以空間性緩衝 ATP 的磷肌酸緩衝庫。基線儲量較低者（素食者、少肉飲食）反應最大，而其增補運動表現與神經保護的效應正是來自加寬的能量緩衝，而非任何直接的受體作用。

label: ATP Synthase
description: Complex V synthesizes ATP using the proton motive force at roughly 32 to 34 ATP per glucose. Synthesis is the oxidative-phosphorylation output.
description_zh_TW: 複合體 V 利用質子動力以每葡萄糖約 32 至 34 ATP 合成 ATP。合成是氧化磷酸化輸出。

label: Photobiomodulation
description: Photobiomodulation, applied as daily morning sunlight or targeted red and near-infrared light therapy, directly stimulates cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV) in the mitochondria, enhancing ATP production. It is listed among the light, temperature, and environmental exposures that act as mitohormetic stressors. Cold exposure similarly activates brown adipose tissue and induces uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1) leading to increased mitochondrial density, while sauna heat exposure induces heat shock proteins that repair misfolded proteins and support mitochondrial function.
description_zh_TW: 光生物調節，作為每日早晨陽光或靶向紅光和近紅外光療法施用，直接刺激粒線體中的細胞色素c氧化酶（複合物IV），增強ATP產生。它被列為作為線粒體興奮壓力源的光、溫度和環境暴露之一。冷暴露同樣激活棕色脂肪組織並誘導解偶聯蛋白1（UCP1），導致粒線體密度增加，而桑拿熱暴露誘導熱休克蛋白，修復錯誤折疊的蛋白質並支持粒線體功能。

label: COMT activity in humans
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: EGCG supplementation at doses up to 750 mg does not impair COMT activity in humans in controlled studies, indicating that realistic supplemental levels do not meaningfully inhibit the enzyme. This reassures that moderate EGCG intake is safe with respect to catecholamine metabolism and COMT function. Higher experimental doses, however, can inhibit COMT, so the conclusion is dose-dependent. Slow COMT individuals in particular benefit from knowing that typical EGCG supplements are unlikely to perturb catechol clearance.
description_zh_TW: 在對照研究中，EGCG supplementation 劑量高達 750 mg 時不會損害 COMT activity in humans，這表明實際的補充水平不會有意義地抑制該酶。這確保了適量的 EGCG 攝取對於兒茶酚胺代謝和 COMT 功能是安全的。然而，較高的實驗劑量可以抑制 COMT，因此結論是劑量依賴性的。慢速 COMT 個體特別受益於了解典型的 EGCG 補充劑不太可能幹擾兒茶酚清除。

label: COVID-19 clinical outcome
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Serum SIRT3 levels are markedly lower in severe COVID-19 patients compared with those with mild or moderate disease, indicating a positive role of SIRT3 in alleviating COVID-19. Directionally, SIRT3 levels sit upstream of clinical outcome and prognosis. Because SIRT3 supports mitochondrial antioxidant defense and dampens inflammation, its reduction in severe cases may permit greater oxidative stress and inflammatory damage. SIRT3 levels therefore serve as an indicator of disease severity and associate with prognosis.
description_zh_TW: 與輕度或中度疾病患者相比，重症COVID-19患者的血清SIRT3水平顯著較低，表明SIRT3在緩解COVID-19中具有正面作用。方向上，SIRT3水平位於臨床結局和預後的上游。因為SIRT3支持粒線體抗氧化防禦並抑制發炎，其在重症中的降低可能允許更大的氧化壓力和發炎損傷。因此SIRT3水平作為疾病嚴重程度的指標，並與預後相關。

label: COVID-19 lymphocyte homeostasis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: The unbalanced p53/SIRT1 axis may impact lymphocyte homeostasis in COVID-19 patients. COVID-19 is characterized by increased p53 transcription in circulating lymphocytes and a persistently activated form of p53, possibly due to low SIRT1 levels. Directionally, low SIRT1 and elevated p53 activity sit upstream of disturbed lymphocyte homeostasis. Because SIRT1 normally deacetylates p53 and restrains its pro-apoptotic activity, its deficiency could leave lymphocytes vulnerable to p53-driven apoptosis and contribute to the lymphopenia seen in severe disease. Increased SIRT1 expression might therefore help alleviate COVID-19 pathogenesis by restoring the balance of this axis.
description_zh_TW: 失衡的p53/SIRT1軸可能影響COVID-19患者的淋巴細胞恆定。COVID-19的特徵是循環淋巴細胞中p53轉錄增加和p53持續活化形式，可能源於低SIRT1水平。方向上，低SIRT1和升高的p53活性位於淋巴細胞恆定受擾的上游。因為SIRT1通常去乙醯化p53並抑制其促凋亡活性，其缺乏可能使淋巴細胞容易受到p53驅動的凋亡，並促成重症中可見的淋巴細胞減少症。因此增加SIRT1表達可能透過恢復此軸的平衡來幫助緩解COVID-19的發病機制。

description_zh_TW: 失衡的p53/SIRT1軸可能影響COVID-19患者的淋巴細胞恆定。COVID-19的特徵是循環淋巴細胞中p53轉錄增加和p53持續活化形式，可能源於低SIRT1水平。方向上，低SIRT1和升高的p53活性位於淋巴細胞恆定受擾的上游。因為SIRT1通常去乙醯化p53並抑制其促凋亡活性，其缺乏可能使淋巴細胞容易受到p53驅動的凋亡，並促成重症中可見的淋巴細胞減少症。因此增加SIRT1表達可能透過恢復此軸的平衡來幫助緩解COVID-19的發病機制。

label: CRC radioresistance via β-catenin
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: FoxQ1-mediated SIRT1 upregulation augments the expression and nuclear translocation of β-catenin and benefits CRC-related intestinal pathological bacteria, thereby enhancing the radioresistance of colorectal cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT1 upregulation sits upstream of β-catenin-driven survival and radiation resistance in CRC. By promoting β-catenin signaling, SIRT1 helps colorectal cancer cells survive ionizing radiation, which has implications for combining SIRT1 inhibition with radiotherapy to improve treatment outcomes.
description_zh_TW: FoxQ1介導的SIRT1上調增強了β-catenin的表達和核轉位，並有利於CRC相關的腸道致病菌，從而增強大腸直腸癌細胞的放射抗性。方向上，SIRT1上調位於CRC中β-catenin驅動的存活和輻射抗性的上游。透過促進β-catenin訊號，SIRT1幫助大腸直腸癌細胞在電離輻射中存活，這對於將SIRT1抑制與放療結合以改善治療結果具有意義。

label: DAF-16 (FOXO)
description: The lifespan extension produced by sir-2.1 overexpression in C. elegans is strictly dependent on the forkhead transcription factor DAF-16, the worm FOXO ortholog. DAF-16 is the downstream effector that induces stress-resistance and xenobiotic-detoxification genes once sir-2.1 releases it from repression. Mechanistically, sir-2.1 deacetylates and cooperates with DAF-16 to drive the longevity transcriptional program. Thus the directionality is sir-2.1 → DAF-16 → lifespan, and removing DAF-16 abolishes the benefit.
description_zh_TW: sir-2.1 過量表達在 C. elegans 中產生的壽命延長嚴格依賴於叉頭轉錄因子 DAF-16，即線蟲的 FOXO 直系同源物。DAF-16 是下游效應因子，一旦 sir-2.1 將其從抑制中釋放，它便誘導壓力抗性和外源物質解毒基因。在機制上，sir-2.1 去乙醯化並與 DAF-16 協同驅動長壽轉錄程序。因此方向性為 sir-2.1 → DAF-16 → 壽命，去除 DAF-16 則消除此益處。

label: DAF-2
description: DAF-2, the C. elegans insulin/IGF-1 receptor ortholog, partially regulates MXL-3 expression such that impaired insulin signaling leads to modest repression of mxl-3 transcription. This places MXL-3 downstream of the insulin-signaling axis that broadly controls metabolism and longevity in worms. The partial effect indicates that additional nutrient and developmental inputs also govern mxl-3, consistent with its role as a multifactorial repressor. The linkage reinforces the canonical insulin→autophagy/lipid regulatory cascade.
description_zh_TW: DAF-2 是線蟲的胰島素/IGF-1 受體同源物，部分調節 MXL-3 表現，使得胰島素信號受損會導致 mxl-3 轉錄的適度抑制。這將 MXL-3 置於廣泛控制線蟲代謝和長壽的胰島素信號軸下游。此部分效應表明額外的營養和發育輸入也控制 mxl-3，與其作為多因子抑制因子的角色一致。此連結強化了典型的胰島素→自噬/脂質調節級聯。

label: Deptor
description: Deptor is an endogenous inhibitor that binds both mTORC1 and mTORC2, suppressing the catalytic activity of each complex. By dampening both arms of mTOR signaling, Deptor broadly restrains anabolic growth, survival, and autophagy suppression. Its expression is itself feedback-regulated by mTORC1/mTORC2 activity, forming part of a homeostatic loop. Reduced Deptor levels in certain cancers correlate with hyperactive mTOR signaling, highlighting its tumor-suppressive potential.
description_zh_TW: Deptor 是一種內生抑制劑，結合 mTORC1 和 mTORC2 兩者，抑制各複合物的催化活性。透過阻尼 mTOR 信號的兩條臂，Deptor 廣泛地約束合成代謝生長、存活和自噬抑制。其表現本身受 mTORC1/mTORC2 活性回饋調節，構成恆定性迴圈的一部分。某些癌症中 Deptor 水平降低與過度活化的 mTOR 信號相關，凸顯了其腫瘤抑制潛力。

label: SIRT3 loss
description: SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity and suppresses oxidative stress in DCM primarily through the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway. SIRT3 downregulation breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression; melatonin protects via Mst1 inhibition and SIRT3 upregulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 活化主要透過 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力並在 DCM 中抑制氧化壓力。SIRT3 下調打破此軸線，損害 ETC 活性並加速 DCM 進展；melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 和上調 SIRT3 發揮保護作用。

label: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera)
description: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) activates the NRF2 pathway in MS therapy by modifying KEAP1 cysteines, inducing HO-1, NQO1, and GPx to bolster antioxidant defense in glia and neurons. This is a registered disease-modifying treatment for relapsing MS. The directionality is fumarate to NRF2-dependent cytoprotection. A caveat is that dimethyl fumarate also shifts lymphocyte subsets and can cause flushing and GI effects, so NRF2 activation is one of several mechanisms. Clinical trials show reduced relapses and disability progression, though the precise contribution of NRF2 versus other fumarate actions remains debated.
description_zh_TW: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) 透過修飾 KEAP1 半胱氨酸活化 NRF2 pathway in MS therapy，誘導 HO-1、NQO1 和 GPx，以增強神經膠質和神經元的抗氧化防禦。這是一種針對復發性多發性硬化症的註冊疾病緩解治療方法。方向性為富馬酸鹽至 NRF2 依賴性細胞保護。需要注意的是，富馬酸二甲酯也會改變淋巴細胞亞群，並可能引起潮紅和胃腸道效應，因此 NRF2 活化是多種機制之一。臨床試驗顯示，儘管 NRF2 與其他富馬酸鹽藥物相比，其確切貢獻仍有爭議，但復發和殘疾進展有所減少。

label: Shinya Yamanaka
description: Shinya Yamanaka and colleagues discovered induced pluripotent stem cells in 2006, showing that somatic fibroblasts could be reprogrammed to pluripotency by the four transcription factors Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc. This landmark work, for which Yamanaka received the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2012, demonstrated that cell identity is not fixed and could be reset by defined factors. iPSC technology opened new avenues for disease modeling, drug discovery, and patient-specific regenerative medicine.
description_zh_TW: Shinya Yamanaka 及其同事於 2006 年發現了誘導多能幹細胞，顯示體細胞纖維母細胞可以透過四種轉錄因子 Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc 重新編程為多能性。山中伸彌憑藉這項具有里程碑意義的工作獲得了 2012 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎，它證明細胞身份不是固定的，可以透過確定的因素進行重置。 iPSC 技術為疾病建模、藥物發現和患者特異性再生醫學開闢了新途徑。

label: Immune Rejection
description: Major histocompatibility complex mismatch is the principal transplant-rejection determinant.
description_zh_TW: 主要組織相容複合體錯配是主要的移植排斥決定因子。

label: T Cell Receptor
description: T cell receptors recognize peptide complexes presented by the major histocompatibility complex.
description_zh_TW: T 細胞受體辨識主要組織相容複合體呈現的肽複合體。

label: Kazutoshi Takahashi
description: Takahashi is first author of the 2006 Cell paper demonstrating four-factor fibroblast reprogramming.
description_zh_TW: Takahashi 是 2006 Cell 論文證明四因子纖維母細胞重編程的第一作者。

label: drug response
description: SNPs can predict individual drug response by altering the structure or expression of drug-metabolizing enzymes, transporters, or drug targets, as exemplified by COMT Val158Met predicting aspirin and modafinil responses. Pharmacogenetic testing leverages such variants to personalize dosing and choice of therapy, improving efficacy and reducing adverse effects. The predictive power varies with the size and direction of each variant's effect and with gene-environment interactions. This approach is central to precision medicine.
description_zh_TW: SNPs 可以透過改變藥物代謝酶、轉運蛋白或藥物標靶的結構或表現來預測個別 drug response，例如 COMT Val158Met 預測阿斯匹靈和莫達非尼反應。藥物基因學測試利用這些變異來個人化劑量和治療選擇，提高療效並減少不良反應。預測能力隨每個變異效應的大小和方向以及基因-環境交互作用而變化。這種方法是精準醫學的核心。

label: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens, an Eggerthellaceae gut bacterium, is specifically characterized by producing Isourolithin A, the structural isomer of Urolithin A, from dietary Ellagic Acid; its activity defines urolithin metabotype B (urolithin B plus isourolithin A producers) as distinct from Urolithin A-predominant metabotype A.
description_zh_TW: Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens 為 Eggerthellaceae 腸道菌，其特徵是能由飲食 Ellagic Acid 產生 Isourolithin A（Urolithin A 的結構異構物）；其活性定義了 urolithin metabotype B（產 urolithin B 與 isourolithin A 者），有別於以 Urolithin A 為主的 metabotype A。

label: endothelial cell senescence
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Downregulation of SIRT1 was found to be important in the senescence of different types of endothelial cells. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of cellular senescence in the vascular endothelium. Because SIRT1 normally promotes stress resistance and genomic stability, its decline in endothelial cells is linked to the senescent phenotype. This positions SIRT1 as a potential target for preserving endothelial function and preventing vascular ageing.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1的下調在不同類型內皮細胞的衰老中被發現具有重要意義。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於血管內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT1通常促進壓力抗性和基因組穩定性，其在內皮細胞中的下降與衰老表型相關。這將SIRT1確定為維持內皮功能和預防血管老化的潛在靶點。

source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

label: Endothelial nitric oxide bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 plays a pivotal role in maintaining endothelial cell function by preserving mitochondrial integrity via the SIRT3/ATG5 axis, thereby reducing ROS levels and sustaining nitric oxide bioavailability. Directionally, the axis sits upstream of maintained endothelial NO signaling. Conversely, absence of SIRT3 in EC-specific knockout models leads to exaggerated NLRP3 inflammasome activation and endothelial dysfunction, fostering a pro-inflammatory, pro-atherogenic phenotype.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過 SIRT3/ATG5 軸保持粒線體完整性，從而降低 ROS 水平並維持一氧化氮生物利用度，從而在維持內皮細胞功能中發揮關鍵作用。從方向上看，該軸位於維持的內皮 NO 訊號傳導的上游。相反，EC特異性敲除模型中SIRT3的缺失會導致NLRP3發炎小體過度活化和內皮功能障礙，進而形成促發炎、促動脈粥狀硬化的表型。

label: endothelial senescence via oxidative stress
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Research has shown that senescence of endothelial cells is induced by oxidative stress due to SIRT6 downregulation. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of oxidative stress-driven endothelial senescence. Because SIRT6 normally supports antioxidant defences and DNA repair, its decline leaves endothelial cells vulnerable to oxidative damage and the senescent phenotype, linking SIRT6 to vascular ageing.
description_zh_TW: 研究表明，由於SIRT6下調導致的氧化壓力誘導了內皮細胞的衰老。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於氧化壓力驅動的內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT6通常支持抗氧化防禦和DNA修復，其下降使內皮細胞容易受到氧化損傷和衰老表型的影響，將SIRT6與血管老化聯繫起來。

Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of oxidative stress-driven endothelial senescence. Because SIRT6 normally supports antioxidant defences and DNA repair, its decline leaves endothelial cells vulnerable to oxidative damage and the senescent phenotype, linking SIRT6 to vascular ageing.
description_zh_TW: 研究表明，由於SIRT6下調導致的氧化壓力誘導了內皮細胞的衰老。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於氧化壓力驅動的內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT6通常支持抗氧化防禦和DNA修復，其下降使內皮細胞容易受到氧化損傷和衰老表型的影響，將SIRT6與血管老化聯繫起來。

label: Energy homeostasis and autophagy
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 and AMPK form a reciprocal regulatory loop in which each can activate the other, jointly promoting energy homeostasis and autophagic flux. Directionally, the interaction is bidirectional: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates LKB1 and PGC-1α while AMPK phosphorylates and activates SIRT1. This creates a self-reinforcing metabolic circuit, and it is a central node integrating nutrient sensing and clearance. By activating each other, SIRT1 and AMPK amplify catabolic and protective programs, including mitochondrial biogenesis and autophagy. This loop is a key target for interventions that aim to restore metabolic health in aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 和 AMPK 形成雙向調控迴路，兩者可以互相活化，共同促進能量恆定性和自噬通量。在方向性上，此相互作用是雙向的：SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 LKB1 和 PGC-1α，而 AMPK 磷酸化並活化 SIRT1。這創造了一個自強化的代謝迴路，是整合營養感知和清除的核心節點。透過互相活化，SIRT1 和 AMPK 放大分解代謝和保護程式，包括粒線體生物合成和自噬。此迴路是旨在恢復衰老代謝健康的干預措施的關鍵靶標。

label: Enzyme-coupled nicotinamide assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The enzyme-coupled assay for nicotinamide detection measures sirtuin activity continuously by coupling nicotinamidase (which hydrolyzes nicotinamide to nicotinic acid and ammonia) to glutamate dehydrogenase, which converts ammonia, alpha-ketoglutarate, and NAD(P)H to glutamate and NAD(P)+, quantified spectrophotometrically at 340 nm. It was developed in 2009 and, while not used yet on the scale of large screenings, could be adapted to a high-throughput format. Directionally, a continuous enzyme-coupled readout avoids the artifacts associated with fluorescent and end-point assays.
description_zh_TW: 用於尼可醯胺偵測的酵素偶聯測定透過將尼可醯胺酶（水解尼可醯胺為尼可酸和氨）與穀氨酸脫氫酶偶聯來連續測量 sirtuin 活性，後者將氨、α-酮戊二酸和 NAD(P)H 轉化為穀氨酸和 NAD(P)+，在 340 nm 處進行分光光度法定量。它於 2009 年開發，儘管尚未大規模應用於大型篩選，但可以改編為高通量格式。方向性上連續的酵素偶聯讀取避免了與螢光和終點測定相關的假象。

label: Nicotinamidase and glutamate dehydrogenase
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

label: Epstein-Barr virus
description: EBV is the established etiologic driver of nasopharyngeal carcinoma oncogenesis.
description_zh_TW: EBV 是鼻咽癌致癌的既定病因驅動。

label: Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
description: EBV is the established etiologic driver of nasopharyngeal carcinoma oncogenesis.
description_zh_TW: EBV 是鼻咽癌致癌的既定病因驅動。

label: ETS
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ETS is a large family of eukaryotic transcription factors sharing a conserved winged helix-turn-helix DNA-binding ETS domain that recognizes purine-rich GGAA/T core motifs and regulates proliferation, differentiation, and oncogenesis. The ETS-family member ELK4 plays a central role in sirtuin biology by stabilizing SIRT7 at target gene promoters, enabling H3K18 deacetylation and repression of tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, the ETS family provides the DNA-binding and promoter-targeting mechanisms that members such as ELK4 use to recruit chromatin-modifying enzymes such as SIRT7.
description_zh_TW: ETS 是一個大型真核轉錄因子家族，共享一個保守的翼狀螺旋-轉-螺旋 DNA 結合 ETS 結構域，識別富含嘌呤的 GGAA/T 核心基序並調節增殖、分化和腫瘤發生。ETS 家族成員 ELK4 在 sirtuin 生物學中扮演核心角色，透過將 SIRT7 穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 H3K18 去乙醯化和腫瘤抑制基因的抑制成為可能。方向性上 ETS 家族提供了 DNA 結合和啟動子靶向機制，使 ELK4 等成員能招募 SIRT7 等染色質修飾酶。

label: Transcription factor family
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ETS is a large family of eukaryotic transcription factors sharing a conserved winged helix-turn-helix DNA-binding ETS domain that recognizes purine-rich GGAA/T core motifs and regulates proliferation, differentiation, and oncogenesis.
