label: ETS1
description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 降低 ETS1 啟動子處的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化，限制腫瘤擴散。lncRNA LINC00922 將 SIRT3 誘離 ETS1 啟動子，上調 H3K27 巴豆醯基化並驅動大腸癌轉移（Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023）。

label: SIRT3 via H3K27 crotonylation
description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 降低 ETS1 啟動子處的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化，限制腫瘤擴散。lncRNA LINC00922 將 SIRT3 誘離 ETS1 啟動子，上調 H3K27 巴豆醯基化並驅動大腸癌轉移（Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023）。

label: Phosphoglycerate Mutase
description: SIRT2 promotes tumor glycolysis in some settings by deacetylating phosphoglycerate mutase at Lys100, channeling carbon into NADPH production and accelerating tumor growth in lung cancer. This illustrates SIRT2's context-dependent, often harmful, metabolic face versus the protective SIRT1/3/6 axis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在某些情境下透過在 Lys100 去乙醯化 phosphoglycerate mutase 促進腫瘤糖解，將碳引導至 NADPH 生成並加速肺癌中的腫瘤生長。這體現 SIRT2 相對於保護性 SIRT1/3/6 軸、常為有害的、情境依賴的代謝面貌。

label: AC93253
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: AC93253 is a small molecule that inhibits SIRT2 at micromolar concentrations. In leukemia cells, SIRT2 inhibition with AC93253 is accompanied by Akt acetylation, de-phosphorylation, and consequent inhibition, producing antileukemia effects. The directionality is that AC93253 blocks SIRT2, which then removes deacetylation-based control over Akt, shifting it toward an inactive state. This positions AC93253 as both a research tool for SIRT2 biology and an anticancer lead, and connects sirtuin inhibition to PI3K/Akt pathway suppression.
description_zh_TW: AC93253 是一種在微摩爾濃度下抑制 SIRT2 的小分子。在白血病細胞中，AC93253 伴隨 Akt 乙醯化、去磷酸化及隨後的抑制，產生抗白血病效果。方向性上 AC93253 阻斷 SIRT2，進而去除對 Akt 的去乙醯化控制，使其轉向非活化狀態。這使 AC93253 既作為 SIRT2 生物學的研究工具，也作為抗癌先導化合物，並將 sirtuin 抑制與 PI3K/Akt 途徑抑制聯繫起來。

label: induced pluripotency
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: By targeting glycolytic enzymes, SIRT2 controls metabolic reprogramming during induced pluripotency. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of the metabolic switch from oxidative to glycolytic metabolism that accompanies reprogramming of somatic cells toward pluripotency. This metabolic control is essential for the establishment and function of primed human pluripotent stem cells, linking sirtuin activity to cell fate determination and stem cell biology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過靶向糖解酶來控制誘導多能性期間的代謝重編程。方向上，SIRT2位於伴隨體細胞向多能性重編程的從氧化代謝到糖解代謝的代謝轉換的上游。這種代謝控制對於已啟動的人類多能幹細胞的建立和功能至關重要，將sirtuin活性與細胞命運決定和幹細胞生物學聯繫起來。

label: SIRT2 overactivity
description: Direct SIRT2 activation is generally avoided therapeutically because overactivity is linked to neurotoxicity in neurodegenerative contexts, where excessive deacetylation may impair microtubule and protein-homeostasis defenses. Directionally, SIRT2 overactivity is associated with neuronal damage. Consequently, SIRT2 inhibitors are pursued for Parkinsons and Huntingtons disease, where preserving α-tubulin acetylation protects neurons from aggregation toxicity. This therapeutic direction contrasts with SIRT2s tumor-suppressive functions in other tissues, illustrating how the same enzyme can be targeted in opposite directions depending on disease context.
description_zh_TW: 直接活化 SIRT2 通常在治療上被避免，因為其過度活性與神經退行性疾病背景下的神經毒性相關，過度去乙醯化可能損害微管和蛋白質穩態防禦。在方向性上，SIRT2 過度活性與神經元損傷相關。因此，SIRT2 抑制劑正在帕金森症和亨丁頓症的研究中被追求，保持 α-tubulin 乙醯化可以保護神經元免受聚集毒性。這種治療方向與 SIRT2 在其他組織中的腫瘤抑制功能形成對比，說明同一酶如何根據疾病情境被朝相反方向靶向。

label: TGF-β1-induced fibroblast activation
description: Genetic knockdown and chemical inhibition of SIRT2 attenuate TGF-β1-induced fibroblast activation and MDM2 expression, reducing fibrogenic responses. Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition leads to less TGF-β1 fibroblast activation. This is unusual because it implies SIRT2 can promote, rather than suppress, fibrosis in this context, unlike the antifibrotic SIRT1, SIRT3, and SIRT6. It underscores the context-dependence of sirtuin-fibrosis relationships and suggests that SIRT2 inhibition might be antifibrotic in specific settings. The MDM2 connection links SIRT2 to p53 regulation during fibroblast activation, adding mechanistic depth to the observation.
description_zh_TW: 基因敲低和化學抑制 SIRT2 減弱 TGF-β1 誘導的纖維母細胞活化和 MDM2 表達，減少纖維化反應。在方向性上，SIRT2 抑制導致較少的 TGF-β1 纖維母細胞活化。這是不尋常的，因為它暗示 SIRT2 在此情境下可以促進而非抑制纖維化，不同於抗纖維化的 SIRT1、SIRT3 和 SIRT6。它強調了 sirtuin-纖維化關係的情境依賴性，並提示 SIRT2 抑制可能在特定環境中具有抗纖維化作用。MDM2 的聯繫將 SIRT2 與纖維母細胞活化期間的 p53 調節聯繫起來，為觀察結果增加了機制深度。

label: Slug (EMT transcription factor)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: In basal-like breast cancer, SIRT2 maintains the protein stability of Slug, an epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) transcription factor, through deacetylation. Stabilized Slug contributes to the robust tumorigenic activity of basal-like breast cancer, along with its enhanced invasive and metastatic capabilities. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of Slug-dependent EMT and tumor progression. By protecting Slug from degradation, SIRT2 sustains the mesenchymal program that drives invasion and metastasis in this aggressive breast cancer subtype.
description_zh_TW: 在基底樣乳腺癌中，SIRT2透過去乙醯化維持Slug（一種上皮-間質轉化EMT轉錄因子）的蛋白穩定性。穩定化的Slug與其增強的侵襲和轉移能力一起，促進了基底樣乳腺癌的強大致瘤活性。方向上，SIRT2位於Slug依賴性EMT和腫瘤進展的上游。透過保護Slug免受降解，SIRT2維持了驅動此侵襲性乳腺癌亞型侵襲和轉移的間質程序。

label: IDH1 (repressing CRC migration)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: In human colorectal cancer, SIRT2-dependent deacetylation of the metabolic enzyme IDH1 represses cancer cell migration and invasion both in vitro and in vivo. This regulation of IDH1 influences cellular metabolism and inhibits the formation of liver metastases. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic modification of IDH1 sits upstream of suppressed colorectal cancer metastasis. By modulating IDH1 and the metabolic state of the tumor cell, SIRT2 limits the invasive capacity that drives metastatic spread. This positions SIRT2 as a suppressor of colorectal cancer progression and indicates that preserving SIRT2 activity, or mimicking its effects, could restrain metastasis in this malignancy.
description_zh_TW: 在人類大腸直腸癌中，SIRT2依賴性的代謝酶IDH1去乙醯化在體外和體內抑制癌細胞遷移和侵襲。此IDH1的調節影響細胞代謝並抑制肝臟轉移瘤的形成。方向上，SIRT2對IDH1的酵素修飾位於大腸直腸癌轉移抑制的上游。透過調節IDH1和腫瘤細胞的代謝狀態，SIRT2限制了驅動轉移性擴散的侵襲能力。這將SIRT2定位為大腸直腸癌進展的抑制因子，並表明維持SIRT2活性或模擬其效果可能限制此惡性腫瘤的轉移。

label: cisplatin-resistant ovarian cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Overexpression of SIRT2 significantly enhances the sensitivity of cisplatin-resistant counterpart ovarian cancer cells to cisplatin. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of restored platinum sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells. By increasing the vulnerability of these cells to cisplatin, SIRT2 may help overcome platinum resistance, a major obstacle in ovarian cancer treatment. This suggests that strategies to augment SIRT2 activity could improve the efficacy of cisplatin-based therapy in resistant disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2的過表達顯著增強順鉑耐藥性對應卵巢癌細胞對順鉑的敏感性。方向上，SIRT2位於耐藥卵巢癌細胞中鉑敏感性恢復的上游。透過增加這些細胞對順鉑的脆弱性，SIRT2可能有助於克服鉑耐藥性，這是卵巢癌治療中的主要障礙。這表明增強SIRT2活性的策略可能提高耐藥性疾病中順鉑基治療的效果。

label: G6PD
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 activates G6PD via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 G6PD（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

label: PEPCK (gluconeogenesis)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 activates PEPCK (gluconeogenesis) via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 PEPCK（糖質新生）（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

label: PEPCK
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 activates PEPCK via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 PEPCK（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

label: FOXOs
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates FOXO1 and FOXO3a, promoting their nuclear accumulation and target-gene activation (e.g., stress resistance, gluconeogenesis, and cell survival) in a manner analogous to SIRT1-FOXO coupling, making FOXOs downstream effectors and listed positive regulators of the SIRT2 pathway (Wang et al., 2007, PMID 17521387).
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 FOXO1 和 FOXO3a，促進它們的核積累和靶基因活化（例如抗壓、糖質新生和細胞存活），類似於 SIRT1-FOXO 的耦合方式，使 FOXOs 成為 SIRT2 通路的下游效應因子和被列出的正向調節因子（Wang et al., 2007, PMID 17521387）。

label: PPP
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates G6PD in the pentose phosphate pathway (PPP) at Lys403, activating it to promote NADPH production and antioxidant defense; the PPP thus serves as a downstream effector of SIRT2 and is listed among its positive pathway regulators (Wang et al., 2014, Cell Metab, PMID 24769394).
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在磷酸戊糖途徑（PPP）中去乙醯化 G6PD 的 Lys403，活化它以促進 NADPH 產生和抗氧化防禦；因此 PPP 作為 SIRT2 的下游效應因子被列為其正向通路調節因子（Wang et al., 2014, Cell Metab, PMID 24769394）。

label: AKR1C1 (inhibiting STAT3 transactivation)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates aldo-keto reductase family 1 member C1 (AKR1C1), and this modification inhibits transactivation of STAT3 target genes, suppressing migration of non-small-cell lung cancer cells both in vitro and in xenograft models. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic modification of AKR1C1 sits upstream of reduced STAT3-driven metastasis. By restraining STAT3 transcriptional activity, SIRT2 limits the invasive and migratory phenotype that contributes to lung cancer progression. This tumor-suppressive axis contrasts with SIRT2's pro-tumorigenic stabilization of Myc in other settings, reinforcing the context-dependence of sirtuin biology in oncology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2去乙醯化醛酮還原酶家族1成員C1（AKR1C1），此修飾抑制STAT3靶基因的轉活化，在體外和異種移植模型中抑制非小細胞肺癌細胞的遷移。方向上，SIRT2對AKR1C1的酵素修飾位於STAT3驅動的轉移減少的上游。透過抑制STAT3轉錄活性，SIRT2限制了促進肺癌進展的侵襲和遷移表型。此腫瘤抑制軸與SIRT2在其他環境中對Myc的促腫瘤穩定化形成對比，強化了sirtuin生物學在腫瘤學中的環境依賴性。

label: H4K16ac
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates histone H4 Lys16 during the G2/M transition, promoting mitotic chromatin condensation (Vaquero et al., 2006, Genes Dev 20:1256-1261, PMID 16648462).
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 G2/M 轉換期間去乙醯化組蛋白 H4 Lys16，促進有絲分裂染色質凝縮（Vaquero et al., 2006, Genes Dev 20:1256-1261, PMID 16648462）。

label: phosphoglycerate mutase (K100)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates the K100 residue of the glycolytic enzyme phosphoglycerate mutase and facilitates its activation, which results in enhanced NADPH production and accelerated tumor growth in non-small-cell lung cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic modification of phosphoglycerate mutase sits upstream of increased glycolytic flux and anabolic support for tumor growth. This oncogenic action of SIRT2 in lung cancer contrasts with its tumor-suppressive deacetylation of AKR1C1 in the same disease, illustrating the context dependence of SIRT2's cancer-related functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2去乙醯化糖解酶磷酸甘油酸變位酶的K100殘基並促進其活化，導致NADPH產生增加和非小細胞肺癌細胞中腫瘤生長加速。方向上，SIRT2對磷酸甘油酸變位酶的酵素修飾位於糖解通量增加和腫瘤生長合成代謝支持的上游。SIRT2在肺癌中的此致癌作用與其在同一疾病中對AKR1C1的腫瘤抑制性去乙醯化形成對比，說明了SIRT2癌症相關功能的環境依賴性。

label: transcription factor deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates transcription factors including NF-kB/p65, p53, FOXO1, and FOXO3a, generally restraining their pro-inflammatory/apoptotic output while shaping metabolic and stress programs; this cytoplasmic transcription-factor control complements SIRT2's tubulin and mitotic functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化包括 NF-kB/p65、p53、FOXO1 和 FOXO3a 在內的轉錄因子，通常抑制其促發炎/凋亡輸出，同時塑造代謝和壓力反應程序；這種細胞質轉錄因子的控制補充了 SIRT2 的 tubulin 和有絲分裂功能。

label: Th2 responses and macrophage polarization
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 enhances allergic asthmatic inflammation by upregulating T-helper type 2 responses and macrophage polarization. Pharmacologic ablation of SIRT2 attenuates, while genetic SIRT2 overexpression exaggerates, the allergic asthmatic phenotype. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of Th2-driven allergic inflammation. By promoting the type 2 immune response characteristic of asthma, SIRT2 amplifies airway inflammation and the associated pathology. This makes SIRT2 inhibition a candidate therapeutic approach for allergic asthma, since reducing SIRT2 activity could dampen Th2 responses and macrophage-mediated inflammation, providing a potential strategy to modulate the severity of the disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過上調T輔助細胞第2型反應和巨噬細胞極化來增強過敏性氣喘發炎。藥理學消除SIRT2可減輕，而基因SIRT2過表達則加重過敏性氣喘表型。方向上，SIRT2位於Th2驅動的過敏性發炎的上游。透過促進氣喘特徵性的第2型免疫反應，SIRT2放大氣道發炎和相關病理。這使SIRT2抑制成為過敏性氣喘的候選治療方法，因為降低SIRT2活性可能抑制Th2反應和巨噬細胞介導的發炎，提供調節疾病嚴重程度的潛在策略。

label: N-Myc and c-Myc
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 enhances the protein stability of the oncogenic transcription factors N-Myc and c-Myc, promoting cancer cell proliferation. This represents an oncogenic function of SIRT2 that is distinct from its tumor-suppressive roles in other cellular contexts. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of Myc stabilization and enhanced proliferation. By protecting these potent oncogenes from degradation, SIRT2 can support the growth of Myc-driven tumors, complicating the simple view of sirtuins as universal tumor suppressors.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2增強致癌轉錄因子N-Myc和c-Myc的蛋白穩定性，促進癌細胞增殖。這代表了SIRT2的一個致癌功能，與其在其他細胞環境中的腫瘤抑制作用不同。方向上，SIRT2位於Myc穩定化和增殖增強的上游。透過保護這些強效癌基因免受降解，SIRT2可以支持Myc驅動的腫瘤生長，使sirtuin作為普遍腫瘤抑制因子的簡單觀點變得複雜。

label: Cervical cancer progression
description: SIRT2 expression is decreased in cervical cancer tissue versus adjacent normal tissue, and higher SIRT2 predicts favorable survival, indicating it suppresses cervical cancer progression. Directionally, SIRT2 loss is associated with, and putatively enables, tumor advancement. Its deacetylase actions on metabolic and mitotic substrates likely enforce differentiation and genome stability, restraining the aggressive features of cervical cancer. This adds to the context-dependent tumor-suppressor face of SIRT2, which can also promote tumors by stabilizing oncogenes such as c-Myc in other settings, underscoring the tissue- and context-specificity of SIRT2's role in cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在宮頸癌組織中與鄰近正常組織相比表達降低，較高的 SIRT2 預測良好的生存率，表明其抑制宮頸癌進展。在方向性上，SIRT2 的缺失與腫瘤進展相關，並推定為促進因素。其對代謝和有絲分裂受質的去乙醯酶作用可能實施分化和基因組穩定性，限制宮頸癌的侵襲性特徵。這增加了 SIRT2 情境依賴性腫瘤抑制的一面，SIRT2 也可以通過在其他情況下穩定 c-Myc 等癌基因來促進腫瘤，突顯 SIRT6 在癌症中作用的組織和情境特異性。

label: BubR1 progeroid mice
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 extends lifespan in BubR1 progeroid mice, as reported in the longevity/aging literature, supporting a role in cell-cycle and proteostatic regulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 BubR1 早衰小鼠中延長壽命，這在長壽/衰老文獻中已有報導，支持其在細胞週期和蛋白質恆定調節中的角色。

label: oxidative damage
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT2 has a role in neurodegeneration and protects neural cells from oxidative damage caused by ageing and disease. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of neuronal resilience against oxidative stress. Although SIRT2 is overexpressed in neurodegenerative disorders such as Parkinson's disease, its ability to shield neurons from oxidative injury suggests a protective function in specific contexts, and SIRT2 remains a candidate target for neuroprotective strategies.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2在神經退行性疾病中具有作用，並保護神經細胞免受衰老和疾病引起的氧化損傷。方向上，SIRT2位於神經元對氧化壓力的韌性的上游。儘管SIRT2在帕金森氏症等神經退行性疾病中過表達，但它保護神經元免受氧化損傷的能力表明在特定環境中的保護功能，SIRT2仍然是神經保護策略的候選靶點。

label: anti-inflammatory
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 has an anti-inflammatory role in myeloid and joint cells by deacetylating NF-kB/p65, reducing cytokines and ameliorating arthritis, though it promotes Th2 responses in allergic asthma; this context-dependence reflects SIRT2's diverse substrates and its differential expression across immune cell types.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在髓系和關節細胞中具有抗發炎作用，透過去乙醯化 NF-kB/p65 減少細胞因子並改善關節炎，但在過敏性氣喘中促進 Th2 反應；這種環境依賴性反映了 SIRT2 多樣化的底物及其在不同免疫細胞類型中的差異表達。

label: HOXA10 (homeobox transcription factor)
description: SIRT2 interacts with HOXA10, a conserved homeobox transcription factor critical for embryonic cell-type determination and adult tissue homeostasis, including reproductive and hematopoietic development. The interaction suggests SIRT2 influences HOXA10-dependent transcriptional programs, though the precise deacetylation outcome is less well characterized than for other SIRT2 substrates. Directionally, SIRT2 engages HOXA10 as a partner and potential substrate. This connection links SIRT2 to developmental regulation and possibly to differentiation defects in disease, and is consistent with SIRT2's broader roles in controlling transcription-factor activity and cell-fate decisions across tissues.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 與 HOXA10 相互作用，HOXA10 是一種保守的同源框轉錄因子，對胚胎細胞類型決定和成人組織穩態（包括生殖和造血發育）至關重要。這種相互作用表明 SIRT2 影響 HOXA10 依賴性的轉錄程序，儘管其確切的去乙醯化結果不如其他 SIRT2 受質那樣有充分描述。在方向性上，SIRT2 與 HOXA10 作為夥伴和潛在受質相互作用。這種聯繫將 SIRT2 與發育調節以及可能的疾病分化缺陷聯繫起來，與 SIRT2 在控制跨組織轉錄因子活性和細胞命運決定方面的更廣泛作用一致。

label: Cell cycle regulation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 is a cytoplasmic/mitotic deacetylase that regulates cytokinesis and the G2/M transition, supporting genomic stability and mitotic fidelity; age-related SIRT2 decline impairs these cell-cycle checkpoints (source review; North & Verdin review of SIRT2 mitotic roles).
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是一種細胞質/有絲分裂去乙醯酶，調節細胞質分裂和 G2/M 轉換，支持基因組穩定性和有絲分裂忠實度；與年齡相關的 SIRT2 下降損害這些細胞週期檢查點（文獻綜述；North & Verdin 關於 SIRT2 有絲分裂角色的綜述）。

label: Oligodendrocytes and Schwann cells
description: SIRT2 is expressed in oligodendrocytes and Schwann cells, the myelin-forming glia of the CNS and PNS respectively, where it deacetylates α-tubulin and regulates microtubule stability. Its presence in myelinating cells ties SIRT2 to axonal support, myelin integrity, and the cytoskeletal dynamics required for glial process extension. Directionally, SIRT2 acts within glia to control cytoskeletal organization. Dysregulation of SIRT2 is implicated in demyelinating and neurodegenerative conditions, and because α-tubulin acetylation is protective in axons, the balance of SIRT2 activity in myelinating glia is thought to influence both myelination and axonal health.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在寡突膠質細胞和雪旺細胞（分別為中樞和周圍神經系統的髓鞘形成膠質細胞）中表達，在此處去乙醯化 α-tubulin 並調節微管穩定性。其在髓鞘形成細胞中的存在將 SIRT2 與軸突支持、髓鞘完整性和膠質突起延伸所需的細胞骨架動態聯繫起來。在方向性上，SIRT2 在膠質細胞內控制細胞骨架組織。SIRT2 的失調與脫髓鞘和神經退行性疾病有關，且由於 α-tubulin 乙醯化在軸突中具有保護作用，髓鞘形成膠質中 SIRT2 活性的平衡被認為影響髓鞘形成和軸突健康。

label: Kinase-inhibitor scaffolds
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2 is inhibited by kinase-inhibitor scaffolds identified by screening known kinase inhibitors against the enzyme on the rationale that sirtuins and protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site. The bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 and the indolinone GW5074 showed SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory properties in the low micromolar range, alongside the general Kinase enzyme family that shares the adenosine pocket. Directionally, the shared adenosine-binding site of SIRT2 and protein kinases underlies this cross-inhibition. Because these scaffolds retain kinase activity, their cellular effects reflect a combination of kinase and sirtuin blockade.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 被激酶抑制劑骨架抑制，這些骨架透過篩選已知激酶抑制劑對該酵素的活性而被鑑定，其原理是 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點。雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮 GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制特性，與共享腺嘌呤口袋的激酶酶家族並列。方向性上 SIRT2 和蛋白激酶共享的腺嘌呤結合位點奠定了這種交叉抑制的基礎。由於這些骨架保留了激酶活性，其細胞效應反映了激酶和 sirtuin 阻斷的組合。

label: tubulin deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 is the first identified tubulin deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from alpha-tubulin to regulate microtubule stability and dynamics; this underlies SIRT2's mitotic roles and explains why SIRT2 inhibitors, by preserving tubulin acetylation, protect neurons in Parkinson's and Huntington's disease models.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是第一個被發現的 tubulin 去乙醯酶，它移除 α-tubulin 上的乙醯基團以調節微管穩定性和動態性；這構成了 SIRT2 有絲分裂功能的基礎，也解釋了為什麼 SIRT2 抑制劑透過保留 tubulin 乙醯化，在帕金森氏症和亨廷頓氏症模型中保護神經元。

label: Tubulin deacetylase
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2 is the predominantly cytoplasmic sirtuin that functions as a tubulin deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from alpha-tubulin to regulate microtubule dynamics and mitotic fidelity. Because it deacetylates tubulin and other mitotic regulators, SIRT2 loss impairs the control that normally keeps Aurora-A and Aurora-B in check during division, leading to aneuploidy and mitotic cell death. Directionally, SIRT2's tubulin deacetylase activity is an upstream determinant of normal chromosome segregation, linking sirtuin biology to mitotic stability and tumor suppression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是主要位於細胞質的 sirtuin，作為微管蛋白去乙醯酶功能，去除 α-tubulin 上的乙醯基以調節微管動態和有絲分裂精準度。由於其去乙醯化 tubulin 和其他有絲分裂調節因子，SIRT2 缺失損害了正常情況下在細胞分裂期間控制 Aurora-A 和 Aurora-B 的機制，導致非整倍體和有絲分裂細胞死亡。方向性上 SIRT2 的微管蛋白去乙醯酶活性是正常染色體分離的上游決定因素，將 sirtuin 生物學與有絲分裂穩定性和腫瘤抑制聯繫起來。

label: cell-cycle control
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 peaks at the G2/M transition and deacetylates H4K16, alpha-tubulin, and mitotic regulators, promoting chromatin condensation and mitotic fidelity; its loss raises Aurora-A/B and causes aneuploidy, linking SIRT2 to cell-cycle control and genomic stability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 在 G2/M 轉換期達到高峰，並去乙醯化 H4K16、α-tubulin 和有絲分裂調節因子，促進染色質凝縮和有絲分裂忠實度；其缺失會增加 Aurora-A/B 水平並導致非整倍體，將 SIRT2 與細胞週期控制和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

label: HNF4α
description: SIRT2 prevents liver steatosis and lipid metabolic disorders by deacetylating hepatocyte nuclear factor 4α (HNF4α), a master regulator of hepatic lipid and drug-metabolizing genes. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatically activates HNF4α. This maintains lipid homeostasis and protects against fatty liver, with SIRT2 knockdown promoting steatosis and lipid accumulation. It adds a hepatic metabolic function to SIRT2's repertoire, complementing its roles in mitosis and cytoskeletal regulation. The HNF4α connection also links SIRT2 to bile-acid and xenobiotic metabolism, broadening the metabolic consequences of SIRT2 activity in the liver.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 通過去乙醯化肝細胞核因子 4α（HNF4α）——肝臟脂質和藥物代謝基因的主要調節因子——來預防肝脂肪變性和脂質代謝障礙。在方向性上，SIRT2 在酶學上活化 HNF4α。這維持脂質穩態並保護對抗脂肪肝，SIRT2 敲低促進脂肪變性和脂質堆積。這為 SIRT2 的能力增加了肝臟代謝功能，與其在有絲分裂和細胞骨架調節中的作用互補。HNF4α 的聯繫也將 SIRT2 與膽汁酸和外源物質代謝聯繫起來，擴展了肝臟中 SIRT2 活性的代謝後果。

label: BRCA1 deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 promotes BRCA1-BARD1 heterodimerization through deacetylation of BRCA1, facilitating assembly of the repair complex required for homologous recombination. This supports genome maintenance and tumor suppression by enabling high-fidelity repair of DNA double-strand breaks. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatic licensing of BRCA1 sits upstream of repair complex formation. By promoting homologous recombination, SIRT2 helps cells repair potentially oncogenic DNA damage accurately rather than through error-prone pathways. This links SIRT2 to DNA repair fidelity and explains part of its tumor-suppressive activity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過去乙醯化BRCA1促進BRCA1-BARD1異源二聚化，促進同源重組所需的修復複合物組裝。這透過實現DNA雙鏈斷裂的高保真修復來支持基因組維護和腫瘤抑制。方向上，SIRT2對BRCA1的酵素許可位於修復複合物形成的上游。透過促進同源重組，SIRT2幫助細胞準確修復潛在致癌的DNA損傷，而非透過易錯途徑。這將SIRT2與DNA修復保真度聯繫起來，並解釋了其部分腫瘤抑制活性。

label: endometrial cancer stemness and chemoresistance via MEK/ERK
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 promotes cell stemness and activates the MEK/ERK signaling pathway while repressing chemosensitivity in endometrial cancer. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of stem-like phenotypes and MEK/ERK-dependent survival in endometrial cancer cells. By enhancing stemness and ERK signaling, SIRT2 supports tumor self-renewal and reduces responsiveness to chemotherapy. This makes SIRT2 inhibition a potential strategy to sensitize endometrial cancer to treatment.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2促進細胞幹性並活化MEK/ERK訊號通路，同時抑制子宮內膜癌的化療敏感性。方向上，SIRT2位於子宮內膜癌細胞中幹細胞樣表型和MEK/ERK依賴性存活的上游。透過增強幹性和ERK訊號，SIRT2支持腫瘤自我更新並降低對化療的反應性。這使SIRT2抑制成為使子宮內膜癌對治療敏感的潛在策略。

label: HIF-1 activity
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT2 regulates HIF-1 activity, which is important for tumour hypoxia responses. HIF-1 protein stability and transcriptional activity are both negatively influenced by SIRT2, with SIRT2-mediated deacetylation necessary for HIF-1α destabilisation and the tumour cell hypoxia response. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of reduced HIF-1α abundance and activity, thereby restraining hypoxia-driven transcriptional programs in tumour cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2調節HIF-1活性，這對腫瘤缺氧反應很重要。HIF-1蛋白穩定性和轉錄活性都受到SIRT2的負向影響，SIRT2介導的去乙醯化對於HIF-1α不穩定化和腫瘤細胞缺氧反應是必要的。方向上，SIRT2位於HIF-1α豐度和活性降低的上游，從而抑制腫瘤細胞中的缺氧驅動的轉錄程序。

label: Glioma tumour formation
description: SIRT2 resides in a genomic region frequently deleted in human gliomas, and re-expression of SIRT2 markedly reduces colony formation by glioma cells, indicating tumor-suppressor function. Its activity deacetylates substrates such as α-tubulin and HNF4α that govern mitotic fidelity and metabolism, helping to preserve genomic stability during division. Directionally, SIRT2 loss permits gliomagenesis while SIRT2 restoration suppresses it. A caveat is that SIRT2 can act as either a tumor suppressor or a promoter depending on tissue and context—stabilizing oncogenes like c-Myc in some settings—so its role in cancer is highly context-dependent and cell-type-specific.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 位於人類膠質瘤中頻繁缺失的基因組區域，SIRT2 的重新表達顯著減少膠質瘤細胞的集落形成，表明其具有腫瘤抑制功能。其活性去乙醯化 α-tubulin 和 HNF4α 等受質，調節有絲分裂忠實度和代謝，有助於在細胞分裂期間維持基因組穩定性。在方向性上，SIRT2 的缺失允許膠質瘤的發生，而 SIRT2 的恢復則抑制它。需要注意的是，SIRT2 可以根據組織和情境充當腫瘤抑制因子或促進因子——在某些情況下穩定 c-Myc 等癌基因——因此其在癌症中的作用高度取決於情境和細胞類型。

label: FoxO1 deacetylation
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: SIRT2 suppresses adipocyte differentiation through deacetylation of the transcription factor FoxO1, which reinforces FoxO1-mediated repression of PPARgamma. Consistent with this, reduced SIRT1 and SIRT2 expression in visceral adipose stem cells from obese individuals correlates with enhanced adipogenic capacity and visceral fat expansion. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of FoxO1-dependent anti-adipogenic programs. By keeping FoxO1 active in repressing PPARgamma, SIRT2 restrains the conversion of precursor cells into mature adipocytes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過去乙醯化轉錄因子FoxO1來抑制脂肪細胞分化，這加強了FoxO1對PPARgamma的抑制。與此一致，肥胖者內臟脂肪幹細胞中SIRT1和SIRT2表達的降低與脂肪生成能力的增強和內臟脂肪擴張相關。方向上，SIRT2位於FoxO1依賴性抗脂肪生成程序的上游。透過保持FoxO1在抑制PPARgamma方面的活性，SIRT2限制了前體細胞向成熟脂肪細胞的轉化。

label: SirReal2
description: SirReal2 is a potent SIRT2 inhibitor, with an IC50 of 0.14 μM and minimal effects on SIRT1 and SIRT3, exploiting a SIRT2-specific binding pocket. Directionally, SirReal2 blocks SIRT2 deacetylase activity. It is a key chemical probe for SIRT2 biology in neurodegeneration and cancer, and its selectivity makes it valuable for isolating SIRT2-specific effects from the broader sirtuin family. Because SIRT2 inhibition protects neurons in Parkinson's and Huntington's models, SirReal2's selectivity positions it as a candidate scaffold for therapeutic development in neurodegenerative disease.
description_zh_TW: SirReal2 是一種強效的 SIRT2 抑制劑，IC50 為 0.14 μM，對 SIRT1 和 SIRT3 影響極小，利用 SIRT2 特異性結合口袋。在方向性上，SirReal2 阻斷 SIRT2 去乙醯酶活性。它是神經退行性疾病和癌症中 SIRT2 生物學的關鍵化學探針，其選擇性使其在區分 SIRT2 特異性效應與更廣泛 sirtuin 家族時具有價值。由於 SIRT2 抑制在帕金森症和亨丁頓症模型中保護神經元，SirReal2 的選擇性使其定位為神經退行性疾病治療開發的候選骨架。

label: NSCLC cell lines and metastatic melanoma
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The level of SIRT2 is upregulated in non-small cell lung cancer cell lines and in metastatic human melanoma tissues compared to healthy cells and tissues. Directionally, SIRT2 expression is increased in these aggressive cancer contexts. In metastatic melanoma, SIRT2 levels are increased compared to tumours of early stage, suggesting involvement of SIRT2 in the advancement of metastatic disease. SIRT2 therefore represents a potential biomarker and drug target in NSCLC and metastatic melanoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2在非小細胞肺癌細胞系和轉移性人類黑色素瘤組織中與健康細胞和組織相比表現為上調。方向上，SIRT2表達在這些侵襲性癌症環境中增加。在轉移性黑色素瘤中，SIRT2水平與早期腫瘤相比增加，表明SIRT2參與了轉移性疾病的進展。因此SIRT2在NSCLC和轉移性黑色素瘤中代表了潛在的生物標誌物和藥物靶點。

label: CDC14B
description: The phosphatase CDC14B dephosphorylates SIRT2, triggering its ubiquitination and 26S proteasomal degradation, which promotes exit from mitosis. Directionally, CDC14B sits upstream of SIRT2 destabilization. This couples SIRT2 turnover to cell-cycle progression, and it ensures SIRT2 levels fall as cells complete division. By dephosphorylating SIRT2 at mitotic exit, CDC14B inactivates and degrades the enzyme that was active during G2/M. This regulatory circuit links SIRT2 abundance to the cell cycle and explains the oscillation of SIRT2 levels during division.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸酶 CDC14B 去磷酸化 SIRT2，觸發其泛素化和 26S 蛋白酶體降解，促進有絲分裂退出。在方向性上，CDC14B 位於 SIRT6 不穩定化的上游。這將 SIRT6 周轉與細胞週期進程偶聯，並確保 SIRT6 水平在細胞完成分裂時下降。透過在有絲分裂退出時去磷酸化 SIRT6，CDC14B 使在 G2/M 期間活化的酶失活並降解。此調控迴路將 SIRT6 豐度與細胞週期聯繫起來，並解釋了 SIRT6 水平在分裂過程中的振盪。

label: NFATc2
description: SIRT2 deacetylates NFATc2, attenuating agonist-induced cardiac hypertrophy. Loss of SIRT2 reduces AMPK, promoting aging-related and angiotensin II-induced hypertrophy.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 NFATc2，減輕促效劑誘導的心臟肥大。SIRT2 缺失降低 AMPK，促成老化相關與血管緊張素 II 誘導的肥大。

label: GKRP
description: SIRT2 promotes glucose-dependent hepatic glucose uptake by deacetylating GKRP at K126. GKRP is an inhibitory binding partner of glucokinase, and its acetylation state modulates the threshold for hepatic glucose phosphorylation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過在 K126 去乙醯化 GKRP 來促進葡萄糖依賴的肝臟葡萄糖攝取。GKRP 是葡萄糖激酶的抑制性結合夥伴，其乙醯化狀態調控肝臟葡萄糖磷酸化的門檻。

label: AKR1C1
description: SIRT2 suppresses NSCLC migration by deacetylating AKR1C1 and thereby inhibiting STAT3. This positions AKR1C1 as a downstream sirtuin substrate linking deacetylation to cancer-cell motility control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化 AKR1C1 進而抑制 STAT3，來壓制 NSCLC 的遷移。這使 AKR1C1 成為下游的 sirtuin 受質，將去乙醯化與癌細胞運動控制相連結。

label: better Working Memory performance
description: The Met/Met (slow) COMT genotype is associated with better performance on complex working memory tasks, attributed to the elevated prefrontal dopamine tone produced by reduced enzyme activity. Under non-stressful conditions, this higher dopamine level falls near the peak of the inverted-U curve for cognition, favoring stability, accuracy, and maintenance of information. The association is robust at the group level but moderate in effect size and sensitive to task demands, sex, and environmental context such as stress. It is among the most replicated gene-cognition associations in humans.
description_zh_TW: Met/Met（慢）COMT genotype 與複雜工作記憶任務的較佳表現有關，這歸因於酵素活性降低產生的前額葉多巴胺張力升高。在無壓力的情況下，這種較高的多巴胺水平落在認知倒 U 曲線的峰值附近，有利於訊息的穩定性、準確性和維護。這種關聯在群體層面上很強，但效應大小適中，並且對任務要求、性別和壓力等環境背景敏感。它是人類複製最多的基因認知關聯之一。

label: higher anxiety
description: The Met/Met genotype is associated with higher anxiety traits, consistent with the worrier phenotype in which elevated prefrontal dopamine and norepinephrine promote heightened vigilance and emotional reactivity. Multiple studies report increased anxiety sensitivity in slow COMT individuals, though effect sizes are modest and context-dependent. The association follows from altered catecholamine tone rather than a direct anxietogenic mutation. It is frequently discussed in gene-environment and stress reactivity research.
description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型與 higher anxiety 性狀相關，與擔憂者表型一致，其中前額葉多巴胺升高和 norepinephrine 促進提高警覺性和情緒反應性。多項研究報告稱，慢速 COMT 個體的焦慮敏感性有所增加，但效果大小適中且取決於具體情況。這種關聯源自於兒茶酚胺音調的改變，而不是直接的焦慮突變。它在基因環境和壓力反應研究中經常被討論。

label: higher baseline dopamine
description: The Met/Met genotype is associated with higher baseline extracellular dopamine, because reduced COMT activity diminishes the primary route of cortical dopamine inactivation. This elevated tonic dopamine especially affects the prefrontal cortex, where DAT is sparse and COMT dominates clearance. The resulting dopamine surplus shapes cognition, anxiety, and reward sensitivity in slow COMT individuals, consistent with the worrier phenotype. It is the mechanistic link between COMT genotype and its behavioral correlates.
description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型與較高的基線細胞外多巴胺相關，因為減少的 COMT activity 減少了皮質多巴胺失活的主要途徑。這種升高的強直性多巴胺尤其影響前額葉皮質，該處 DAT 稀疏，而 COMT 主導清除。由此產生的多巴胺過剩影響了慢速 COMT 個體的認知、焦慮和 reward 敏感性，與憂慮者表型一致。它是 COMT genotype 與其行為相關物之間的機制連結。

label: Worrier phenotype
description: The Met/Met genotype is called the Worrier phenotype, a popularized label reflecting the tendency toward heightened anxiety, vigilance, and careful, deliberative cognitive processing linked to elevated catecholamine tone. The term contrasts with the Warrior label for fast (Val/Val) genotypes, who are described as stress-resilient and rapid processors. While useful heuristically, the phenotype oversimplifies a continuous, context-dependent trait influenced by stress and environment. It remains widely used in science communication about COMT genetics.
description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型被稱為 Worrier phenotype，這是一個流行的標籤，反映了與兒茶酚胺張力升高相關的焦慮、警覺性和仔細、深思熟慮的認知處理傾向。該術語與快速（Val/Val）基因型的戰士標籤形成鮮明對比，後者被描述為具有抗壓能力和快速處理能力。雖然啟發式有用，但表型過度簡化了受壓力和環境影響的連續的、依賴背景的特徵。它仍然廣泛用於有關 COMT 遺傳學的科學傳播。

label: low COMT activity
description: The Met/Met genotype produces low COMT enzyme activity, roughly three- to four-fold below Val/Val levels, due to the thermolabile methionine-containing protein that is degraded more readily at body temperature. This reduced activity slows elimination of catecholamines and catechol drugs, prolonging their action and raising extracellular dopamine, particularly in the prefrontal cortex. It is the defining biochemical feature of the slow COMT end of the spectrum. This biochemical phenotype underpins the associated cognitive, mood, and drug-response differences.
description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型產生較低的 COMT 酶活性，大約比 Val/Val 水平低三到四倍，這是因為含有不耐熱蛋氨酸的蛋白質在體溫下更容易降解。這種活性的降低減緩了 catecholamines 和兒茶酚藥物的消除，延長了它們的作用並提高了細胞外多巴胺，特別是在前額葉皮質。這是光譜中緩慢的 COMT 端的決定性生化特徵。這種生化表型是相關認知、情緒和藥物反應差異的基礎。

label: poorer Working Memory under stress
description: The Val/Val (fast) COMT genotype is associated with poorer working memory performance, especially under stress, because rapid dopamine clearance lowers prefrontal dopamine below the optimal range of the inverted-U curve. Stress-induced dopamine release is more quickly inactivated in fast genotypes, worsening cognitive efficiency precisely when performance matters most. This effect is most evident on demanding, load-bearing working memory tasks and under challenging conditions. The interaction between genotype and environmental stress is a hallmark finding in COMT research.
description_zh_TW: Val/Val（快速）COMT genotype 與較差的工作記憶表現相關，尤其是在壓力下，因為快速多巴胺清除會將前額葉多巴胺降低到倒 U 曲線的最佳範圍以下。在快速基因型中，壓力引起的多巴胺釋放會更快失活，從而在表現最重要的時候使認知效率惡化。這種效應在要求高、承載工作記憶任務和具有挑戰性的條件下最為明顯。基因型與環境壓力之間的相互作用是 COMT 研究的一個標誌性發現。

label: lower prefrontal dopamine
description: The Val/Val genotype is associated with lower prefrontal dopamine because rapid COMT-mediated clearance depletes the extracellular catecholamine pool in a region where DAT is sparse and COMT dominates inactivation. This reduced dopamine tone shifts working memory and executive function away from the inverted-U optimum, producing poorer performance on stability-dependent and load-heavy tasks. The relationship is a primary mechanism linking COMT genotype to cognition and behavior. It underlies the fast COMT cognitive phenotype and its stress-related trade-offs.
description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型與 lower prefrontal dopamine 相關，因為 COMT 介導的快速清除會耗盡 DAT 稀疏且 COMT 失活占主導地位的區域中的細胞外兒茶酚胺庫。這種減少的多巴胺色調使工作記憶和 executive function 偏離倒 U 形最佳狀態，從而在依賴穩定性和負載繁重的任務中產生較差的性能。這種關係是將 COMT genotype 與認知和行為連結起來的主要機制。它是 COMT 快速認知表型及其與壓力相關的權衡的基礎。

label: stress resilience
description: The Val/Val genotype is associated with stress resilience, the Warrior phenotype, because fast COMT rapidly clears stress-evoked catecholamines, preventing excessive dopaminergic and noradrenergic buildup that could impair performance under pressure. This contrasts with slow COMT, which is linked to anxiety and the worrier phenotype. The label is heuristic, and effects depend on context and task, with the advantage most evident under demanding conditions. It is a widely cited example of gene-environment interaction.
description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型與 stress resilience、Warrior phenotype 相關，因為快速 COMT 可以快速清除壓力誘發的 catecholamines，防止多巴胺能和去甲腎上腺素能過度積聚，從而損害壓力下的表現。這與緩慢的 COMT 形成鮮明對比，COMT 與焦慮和擔憂表型有關。這個標籤是啟發式的，效果取決於上下文和任務，在苛刻的條件下優勢最為明顯。這是基因與環境相互作用的一個被廣泛引用的例子。

label: Warrior phenotype
description: The Val/Val genotype is called the Warrior phenotype, a popularized descriptor for the putative advantage in stress resilience and rapid processing conferred by fast COMT and lower baseline dopamine. It contrasts with the Worrier Met/Met label, which is associated with anxiety and careful, deliberative processing. While memorable and useful heuristically, the phenotype is an oversimplification of a continuous, context-dependent trait influenced by stress and environment. It remains widely used in science communication about COMT genetics.
description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型被稱為 Warrior phenotype，這是 stress resilience 的假定優勢以及快速 COMT 和較低基線多巴胺賦予的快速處理的流行描述符。它與“Worrier Met/Met”標籤形成鮮明對比，後者與焦慮和仔細、深思熟慮的處理有關。雖然令人難忘且啟發式地有用，但表型是受壓力和環境影響的連續的、依賴於背景的特徵的過度簡化。它仍然廣泛用於有關 COMT 遺傳學的科學傳播。

label: psychiatric disorder risk
description: Val158Met impacts risk for psychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia, with the Val allele associated with modestly increased risk through prefrontal dopaminergic dysregulation, though effects are modified by environment and other genes. The association is replicated but small in absolute terms, reflecting the polygenic architecture of psychiatric disorders. It illustrates how a single functional polymorphism can contribute to complex neuropsychiatric vulnerability. COMT remains a candidate gene of sustained interest in psychiatric genetics.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 影響精神分裂症等精神疾病的風險，Val 等位基因透過前額葉多巴胺能失調與適度增加的風險相關，儘管影響會受到環境和其他基因的影響。這種關聯是重複的，但絕對值很小，反映了精神疾病的多基因結構。它說明了單一功能多態性如何導致複雜的神經精神脆弱性。 COMT 仍然是精神遺傳學領域持續關注的候選基因。

label: response to methyl donor supplements
description: Val158Met impacts the response to methyl donor supplements because COMT activity determines how quickly an individual processes the added methyl load; slow (Met) carriers are more prone to mood side effects from methylfolate or methylB12, while fast (Val) carriers tolerate them better. This makes genotype relevant to personalizing methylation supplements, with slow individuals advised to use lower doses or non-methylated forms. The directionality is consistent with COMT's role in methyl clearance. It is a practical pharmacogenetic consideration in supplementation.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 影響 response to methyl donor supplements，因為 COMT activity 決定個體處理添加的甲基負載的速度；慢速（Met）攜帶者更容易受到甲基葉酸或甲基B12的情緒副作用的影響，而快速（Val）攜帶者則能更好地耐受它們。這使得基因型與個人化甲基化補充劑有關，建議慢速個體使用較低劑量或非甲基化形式。方向性與COMT在甲基清除中的作用一致。這是補充劑中實用的藥物基因考慮因素。

label: Valine to Methionine substitution
description: Val158Met involves a valine-to-methionine amino acid substitution at codon 158 of the COMT enzyme, replacing a hydrophobic residue with a polar one that destabilizes the protein and reduces its catalytic activity in the Met form. This single missense change is the molecular basis of the fast-slow COMT dichotomy and of the three- to four-fold differences in enzyme activity among genotypes. It is the defining feature of the rs4680 polymorphism. The substitution alters protein thermostability rather than substrate binding directly.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 涉及 COMT 酶密碼子 158 處的纈氨酸至甲硫氨酸氨基酸取代，以極性殘基取代疏水性殘基，從而使蛋白質不穩定並降低其 Met 形式的催化活性。這種單一的錯義變化是快慢 COMT 二分法以及基因型之間酵素活性三到四倍差異的分子基礎。這是 rs4680 多態性的定義特性。這種取代改變了蛋白質的熱穩定性，而不是直接改變底物結合。

label: SNP in COMT
description: Val158Met is a SNP in the COMT gene, specifically a missense variant that alters enzyme function rather than merely regulatory sequence, making it a functional polymorphism. Its location within the COMT coding region directly changes protein thermostability and activity, producing the fast-slow enzyme dichotomy. It is therefore both a marker and a mechanistic driver of COMT-related traits, including cognition, mood, and drug response. It exemplifies how a single coding variant can have broad biological consequences.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 是 COMT 基因中的 SNP，特別是一種錯義變異體，它改變酵素功能而不僅僅是調節序列，使其成為功能性多態性。它在 COMT 編碼區內的位置直接改變蛋白質的熱穩定性和活性，產生快慢酶二分法。因此，它既是 COMT 相關特徵（包括認知、情緒和 drug response）的標記，也是機械驅動因素。它舉例說明了單一編碼變體如何產生廣泛的生物學後果。

label: rs4680
description: Val158Met is also known as rs4680, the dbSNP reference identifier for the G-to-A single nucleotide change at this locus that produces the Val/Met amino acid polymorphism. This designation is used in genome-wide and candidate-gene studies to tag COMT function and to standardize reporting of COMT genotype across research. The rs4680 annotation allows results to be compared across studies and populations. It is one of the most frequently genotyped SNPs in neuropsychiatric and pharmacogenetic research.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 也稱為 rs4680，是產生 Val/Met 氨基酸多態性的該基因座上 G 至 A 單核苷酸變化的 dbSNP 參考標識符。此名稱用於全基因組和候選基因研究，以標記 COMT 功能並標準化整個研究中 COMT genotype 的報告。 rs4680 註釋允許跨研究和人群比較結果。它是神經精神病學和藥物遺傳學研究中最常見的基因分型 SNPs 之一。

label: vitamin E cancer prevention
description: Val158Met modulates the effect of vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) supplementation on cancer prevention, such that slow COMT individuals derive protective benefit whereas fast COMT individuals may experience increased cancer risk. The proposed mechanism involves COMT-dependent metabolism of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates and interactions with catecholestrogen handling, which differ by enzyme activity. This gene-nutrient interaction has emerged from genotype-stratified analyses of supplementation trials. It highlights the need for genotype-aware antioxidant recommendations.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節維生素 E（α-生育醇）補充劑對癌症預防的作用，使得行動緩慢的 COMT 個體獲得保護性益處，而行動快速的 COMT 個體可能會經歷更高的癌症風險。所提出的機制涉及維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體的 COMT 依賴性代謝以及與兒茶酚雌激素處理的相互作用，其因酶活性而異。這種基因與營養素的相互作用是從補充劑試驗的基因型分層分析中得出的。它強調了對基因型敏感的抗氧化劑建議的需求。

label: Aspirin response
description: Val158Met modulates the response to aspirin, determining whether cardiovascular outcomes are protective, as in slow/Met individuals, or neutral or harmful, as in fast/Val individuals, through genotype-dependent alterations in catecholamine and folate metabolism that modify aspirin's vascular effects. This interaction positions COMT as a biomarker for aspirin chemoprevention and cardiovascular risk stratification. The directionality is among the better-studied COMT-drug effects. It exemplifies pharmacogenetics in cardiovascular medicine.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節對阿斯匹靈的反應，透過兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性改變改變阿斯匹靈的血管效應，確定心血管結果是否具有保護性（如慢速/Met 個體）或中性或有害（如快速/Val 個體）。這種相互作用使 COMT 成為阿斯匹靈化學預防和心血管風險分層的生物標記。方向性是 COMT 藥物作用中研究得最好的之一。它體現了心血管醫學中的藥物遺傳學。

label: Modafinil response
description: Val158Met modulates the response to modafinil, with faster (Val) genotypes showing greater cognitive and wake-promoting benefit because modafinil's DAT inhibition raises dopamine from a lower COMT-set baseline, whereas slow (Met) carriers are nearer the optimum and gain less or may be over-stimulated. This pharmacogenetic interaction guides personalized stimulant use and has been demonstrated in cognitive and clinical studies. It is one of several COMT-dependent drug responses. Genotype-aware prescribing could optimize modafinil outcomes.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節對莫達非尼的反應，較快 (Val) 基因型顯示出更大的認知和喚醒促進益處，因為莫達非尼的 DAT 抑制使多巴胺從較低的 COMT 設定基線升高，而較慢 (Met) 基因型更接近最佳狀態，增益較少或可能被過度刺激。這種藥物基因交互作用指導個人化興奮劑的使用，並已在認知和臨床研究中得到證實。它是幾種 COMT 依賴性藥物反應之一。基因型感知處方可以優化莫達非尼的療效。

label: poorer Working Memory
source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md
description: COMT-overexpressing mice showed poorer performance on working memory tasks, tested by imposing a delay between the offset of the auditory cue and the availability of the response lever. This recapitulates the working memory deficits associated with the human Val158 allele. It supports the role of increased COMT activity in prefrontal dopamine-dependent cognition.
description_zh_TW: COMT 過度表現小鼠在工作記憶任務上表現較差，透過在聽覺線索結束與反應槓桿可用之間施加延遲來測試。這重現了與人類 Val158 等位基因相關的工作記憶缺陷。它支持增加的 COMT activity 在前額葉多巴胺依賴性認知中的作用。

label: increased Schizophrenia risk
source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md
description: In clinical studies, the Val158 allele has been linked with increased risk for schizophrenia in some populations, as well as a poorer response to antipsychotic treatment. The same polymorphism influences vulnerability to environmental risk factors, such as cannabis use increasing psychosis risk selectively in Val158 homozygotes. The effect is modest relative to overall genetic architecture.
description_zh_TW: 在臨床研究中，Val158 等位基因已在某些人群中與精神分裂症風險增加以及對抗精神病藥物治療反應較差相關。同一多態性影響對環境風險因素的脆弱性，例如在 Val158 純合子中，青春期使用大麻會選擇性地增加精神病風險。相對於整體遺傳結構，此效應不大。

label: poorer Cognitive Performance
source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md
description: In healthy subjects, the Val158 allele has been found to associate with poorer cognitive performance, specifically on tasks involving executive function. Transgenic COMT-overexpressing mice, equivalent to the relative increase in activity of the human Val158 allele, exhibit cognitive deficits in stimulus-response learning and working memory. This functionally validates the model of increased COMT activity.
description_zh_TW: 在健康受試者中，已發現 Val158 等位基因與較差的認知表現相關，尤其是在涉及 executive function 的任務上。與人類 Val158 等位基因活性相對增加等效的轉基因 COMT 過度表現小鼠，在 stimulus-response learning 和工作記憶上表現出認知缺陷。這在功能上驗證了 COMT activity 增加的模型。

label: nootropic response
description: Val158Met stratifies nootropic benefit because COMT-set cortical dopamine determines how much modafinil-class dopaminergic enhancement can help. Fast genotypes gain more from the same dose.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 分層 nootropic 效益，因 COMT 設定的皮質多巴胺決定多巴胺增強能幫多少。快速基因型從相同劑量獲益更多。

label: HDAC inhibitors
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: EX-527, the most potent and selective SIRT1 inhibitor identified from a large high-throughput screen, inhibits SIRT1 at nanomolar concentrations with remarkable selectivity over SIRT2 and SIRT3 and good pharmacokinetic properties. Its anticancer activity as a single agent is weak, but it cooperates with HDAC inhibitors to induce apoptosis in leukemia cells. Directionally, EX-527-mediated SIRT1 blockade combined with broad HDAC inhibition produces a synergistic lethal effect. This positions EX-527 as the standard pharmacological SIRT1 inhibitor and a component of combination anticancer strategies.
description_zh_TW: EX-527 是從大規模高通量篩選中鑑定出的最強效和最具選擇性的 SIRT1 抑制劑，在奈摩爾濃度下抑制 SIRT1，對 SIRT2 和 SIRT3 具有顯著的選擇性，且具有良好的藥代動力學特性。其作為單一藥物的抗癌活性較弱，但與 HDAC 抑制劑協同誘導白血病細胞凋亡。方向性上 EX-527 介導的 SIRT1 阻斷與廣泛的 HDAC 抑制結合產生協同致死效果。這使 EX-527 成為標準的藥理學 SIRT1 抑制劑和聯合抗癌策略的組成部分。

label: Excess Post-Exercise Oxygen Consumption
description: Excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), also known as the afterburn effect, is the elevated oxygen consumption that persists after an exercise session and represents the energy expended in excess of resting values during recovery. EPOC accounts for a portion of the total energy cost of exercise beyond the exercise itself, typically contributing an additional 7-15 percent of the exercise energy cost depending on intensity and duration. Because EPOC elevates the metabolic rate for hours after training, it is often cited to justify high-intensity training for weight management, although Speakman's analysis argues that the quantitative contribution to total daily expenditure is smaller than commonly claimed.
description_zh_TW: 運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），又稱後燃效應（afterburn effect），是指運動結束後持續存在的升高耗氧量，代表恢復期間超過靜止值的能量消耗。EPOC佔運動總能量成本中運動本身之外的一部分，依強度與持續時間不同，通常額外貢獻運動能量成本的7–15%。由於EPOC在訓練後數小時內會提升代謝率，常被引用來支持以高強度訓練進行體重管理，儘管Speakman的分析主張其對每日總能量消耗的量化貢獻比常見宣稱來得小。

label: Extensive myocardial fibrosis and cardiomyopathy
description: SIRT7-deficient mice show extensive myocardial fibrosis, high basal apoptosis, and cardiomyopathy, reflecting SIRT7's role in maintaining cardiac homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT7 loss leads to fibrotic cardiomyopathy. This contrasts with contexts where SIRT7 promotes fibrosis under stress, indicating that SIRT7 is overall required for myocardial integrity. The phenotype likely reflects SIRT7's contributions to ribosome biogenesis, mitochondrial function, and transcriptional regulation in cardiomyocytes, and it is consistent with SIRT7's deacetylation of GATA4 in stress-induced hypertrophy. SIRT7 thus has both protective and pathological cardiac roles depending on context.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 缺陷小鼠顯示廣泛的心肌纖維化、高基礎凋亡率和心肌病變，反映了 SIRT7 在維護心臟恆定性中的角色。在方向性上，SIRT7 的缺失導致纖維化性心肌病變。這與 SIRT7 在壓力下促進纖維化的情況形成對比，表明 SIRT7 整體上是心肌完整性所必需的。此表型可能反映了 SIRT7 對核糖體生物合成、粒線體功能和心肌細胞轉錄調控的貢獻，並與 SIRT7 在壓力誘導肥大中對 GATA4 的去乙醯化一致。因此，SIRT7 根據情境具有保護性和病理性心臟角色。

label: Fatty acid
description: Excess fatty acids drive cellular dysfunction termed lipotoxicity. Causation covers the overload pathology.
description_zh_TW: 過量脂肪酸驅動稱為脂毒性的細胞功能障礙。因果涵蓋超載病理。

label: Ferric Iron
description: Hemoglobin M (HbM) disease is an autosomal dominant condition caused by mutations in globin genes (alpha, beta, or gamma chains) that stabilize the ferric (Fe3+) state of heme iron. Patients with hemoglobin M disease often have lifelong cyanosis but are otherwise asymptomatic or mildly affected, because the stabilized ferric methemoglobin cannot carry oxygen yet the body compensates. This congenital cause of methemoglobinemia is distinct from the enzyme-deficiency form arising from cytochrome b5 reductase mutations, and both congenital forms are present from birth or appear in infancy and are rarer than acquired methemoglobinemia.

label: FGF21 signaling
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Restoring SIRT3 expression via lifestyle interventions or fibroblast growth factor-21 (FGF21) signaling improves mitochondrial integrity and myocardial function in diabetes. Directionally, FGF21 sits upstream of recovered SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial quality control. This points to metabolic reprogramming as a promising avenue for diabetic patients, coupling endocrine FGF21 biology to the mitochondrial deacetylase axis.
description_zh_TW: 透過生活方式介入或纖維母細胞生長因子 21 (FGF21) 訊號恢復 SIRT3 表現可改善糖尿病患者的粒線體完整性和心肌功能。從方向上看，FGF21 位於恢復的 SIRT3 依賴性粒線體品質控制的上游。這表明代謝重編程對於糖尿病患者來說是一條有前途的途徑，將內分泌 FGF21 生物學與粒線體去乙醯化酶軸結合起來。

label: Fisetin Bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Nano-sized formulations of fisetin, including polymeric nanoparticles, lipid nanoparticles, nanoemulsions, and nanocrystals, have been developed to overcome its poor solubility and low oral bioavailability. These systems increase fisetin's dissolution rate, protect it from degradation and first-pass conjugation, and can enable sustained release and improved tissue targeting, including brain delivery. Studies summarized in the review report several-fold increases in fisetin peak plasma concentration and area under the curve for nanoformulations compared with free fisetin suspension, and enhanced efficacy in tumor and neuroprotection models, although clinical data remain limited.
description_zh_TW: 非瑟酮的奈米製劑，包括聚合物奈米粒子、脂質奈米粒子、奈米乳液和奈米晶體，已被開發以克服其溶解度差和口服生物利用度低的問題。這些系統提高非瑟酮的溶解速率，保護其免受降解和首過結合，並可實現持續釋放和改善組織靶向，包括腦部遞送。綜述中總結的研究報告顯示，與游離非瑟酮懸浮液相比，奈米製劑的非瑟酮峰濃度和曲線下麵積增加數倍，並在腫瘤和神經保護模型中增強療效，但臨床數據仍然有限。

label: Fisetin Dissolution
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Solid dispersions of fisetin are prepared by dispersing the drug in a hydrophilic polymer matrix such as polyvinylpyrrolidone or hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, converting crystalline fisetin into an amorphous form that dissolves much faster. The review describes how fisetin solid dispersions markedly increase the dissolution rate and apparent solubility relative to the free drug, leading to improved oral absorption and higher plasma concentrations in pharmacokinetic studies. Because dissolution is the limiting step in fisetin absorption, solid dispersion technology is one of the most straightforward and widely explored macro- to micro-scale strategies for improving its bioavailability.
description_zh_TW: 非瑟酮的固體分散體通過將藥物分散在親水性聚合物基質（如聚乙烯吡咯烷酮或羥丙甲纖維素）中製備，將結晶非瑟酮轉化為溶解快得多的無定形形式。該綜述描述了非瑟酮固體分散體如何與游離藥物相比顯著增加溶出速率和表觀溶解度，從而在藥物動力學研究中改善口服吸收和更高的血漿濃度。由於溶出是非瑟酮吸收的限速步驟，固體分散體技術是改善其生物利用度的最直接和最廣泛探索的宏觀到微觀策略。

label: Food Matrix
description: The food matrix, the intricate assembly of nutrients, fiber, and other constituents in whole foods, significantly modulates the bioavailability, metabolism, and ultimate bioactivity of hormetins. Health effects of a diet rich in hormetic foods may therefore exceed and differ qualitatively from the sum of isolated compounds such as resveratrol or curcumin tested in controlled laboratory settings.
description_zh_TW: Food Matrix 即全食物中營養素、纖維與其他成分交織而成的複雜基質，可顯著調控 Hormetins 的生物可利用率、代謝與最終生物活性。因此富含 hormetic 食物的飲食，其健康效應可能超越並在性質上有別於受控實驗室條件下測試的單一分離化合物（如 resveratrol 或 curcumin）效應之總和。

label: SIRT6 deficiency (macrophages)
description: SIRT6 deficiency in macrophages increases acetylation and stability of FoxO1, leading to sustained FoxO1 protein and an inflammatory state. Directionally, SIRT6 loss leads to hyperacetylated, stabilized FoxO1. Because SIRT6 normally deacetylates FoxO1, its absence prolongs FoxO1 signaling and promotes inflammatory gene expression in macrophages. This reveals a macrophage-intrinsic mechanism linking SIRT6 to inflammation resolution, and it is relevant to atherosclerosis, where macrophage inflammation drives plaque progression. SIRT6's control of FoxO1 stability adds to its chromatin-based regulation of inflammatory genes.
description_zh_TW: 巨噬細胞中 SIRT6 的缺乏增加 FoxO1 的乙醯化和穩定性，導致持續的 FoxO1 蛋白和發炎狀態。在方向性上，SIRT6 的缺失導致超乙醯化的、穩定的 FoxO1。由於 SIRT6 通常去乙醯化 FoxO1，其缺失延長 FoxO1 信號並促進巨噬細胞中的發炎基因表達。這揭示了一種巨噬細胞固有機制，將 SIRT6 與發炎消退聯繫起來，與動脈粥樣硬化相關（其中巨噬細胞發炎驅動斑塊進展）。SIRT6 對 FoxO1 穩定性的控制增加了其基於染色質的發炎基因調節。

label: Blue-gray pigmentation of skin, eyes and mucous membranes
description: Argyria results in a blue-grayish pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes, caused by deposition of silver in body tissues after large doses of silver or its compounds are absorbed into the circulatory system. Argyria is rare, and although, so far as known, the condition does not otherwise harm a person's health, it is disfiguring and usually permanent. Mild forms of argyria are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis, which is clinically relevant because cyanosis signals hypoxemia while argyria simply reflects lifelong silver deposition.
description_zh_TW: Argyria導致皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的藍灰色色素沉著，由大劑量銀或其化合物吸收進入循環系統後在體組織中沉積引起。Argyria罕見，雖然據目前所知，該病變對健康無其他損害，但它會毀容且通常永久。輕度argyria有時被誤認為發紺，這在臨床上相關，因為發紺表示低氧血症，而argyria僅反映終身銀沉積。

label: DNA, RNA and proteins
description: Once absorbed, silver binds to amino or carboxyl groups in RNA, DNA, and proteins, which is the molecular basis of both its antimicrobial action and its toxicity. By coordinating thiol, amino, and carboxyl moieties, silver can disrupt enzyme active sites, nucleic acid structure, and protein folding. This promiscuous binding explains the broad-spectrum antibacterial effects of silver compounds as well as the tissue deposition, glutathione peroxidase and Na+,K+-ATPase inhibition, and genotoxic effects observed with chronic or high-level silver exposure.
description_zh_TW: 一旦吸收，銀與RNA、DNA和蛋白質中的氨基或羧基結合，這是其抗菌作用和毒性的分子基礎。通過配位硫醇、氨基和羧基部分，銀可破壞酶活性位點、核酸結構和蛋白質折疊。這種多效結合解釋了銀化合物的廣譜抗菌效果，以及慢性或高劑量銀暴露觀察到的組織沉積、穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶和Na+,K+-ATPase抑制和基因毒性效應。

label: Inhalation, oral and dermal routes
description: Silver and its compounds can be absorbed via inhalation, while silver compounds can also be absorbed orally and dermally. Once absorbed, silver distributes throughout the body in the blood, particularly to the liver, and is eliminated primarily in the faeces. The multiple absorption routes mean that occupational and consumer exposures, from airborne dusts, drinking water, and topical products, can all raise the body silver burden. In large doses this absorbed silver becomes deposited in various tissues, producing the blue-gray pigmentation of argyria and the enzyme inhibition described in silver toxicity summaries.
description_zh_TW: 銀及其化合物可通過吸入吸收，而銀化合物也可通過口服和皮膚吸收。一旦吸收，銀通過血液分布至全身，特別是肝臟，主要通過糞便排出。多種吸收途徑意味著職業和消費者暴露，來自空氣中的粉塵、飲用水和局部產品，都會增加體內銀負荷。大劑量吸收的銀會沉積在各種組織中，導致argyria的藍灰色色素沉著和銀毒性摘要中描述的酶抑制。

label: Selenium-catalyzed sulfhydryl oxidation-reduction reactions
description: Silver ion is reported to disrupt selenium-catalyzed sulfhydryl oxidation-reduction reactions by inhibiting glutathione peroxidase, a selenium-dependent enzyme. Because selenium is a cofactor in antioxidant redox systems, silver's interference with selenoenzymes tilts cellular redox balance toward oxidation. This mechanism helps explain how silver, despite being relatively inert as a bulk metal, exerts biological effects through disruption of thiol redox circuits in both microbial and mammalian cells.
description_zh_TW: 報導稱銀離子通過抑制穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶（一種硒依賴性酶）來干擾硒催化的硫氫基氧化還原反應。由於硒是抗氧化氧化還原系統中的輔因子，銀對硒酶的干擾使細胞氧化還原平衡向氧化傾斜。此機制有助於解釋銀如何作為塊狀金屬相對惰性，卻通過干擾微生物和哺乳動物細胞中的硫醇氧化還原電路發揮生物效應。

label: Metallic element
description: Silver is a metallic element with the chemical symbol Ag and atomic number 47. It occurs naturally in its pure, free form, as an alloy with gold and other metals, and in minerals such as argentite and chlorargyrite. Silver itself is generally not toxic to humans, although most silver salts are toxic, and chronic accumulation can deposit metallic silver in tissues, producing the permanent blue-gray condition known as argyria that is disfiguring but not otherwise harmful to health. The distinction between benign elemental silver and toxic ionic silver salts is fundamental to understanding silver exposure.
description_zh_TW: 銀是一種金屬元素，化學符號為Ag，原子序數47。它自然存在於純淨游離形式、與金及其他金屬的合金中，以及如argentite和chlorargyrite等礦物中。銀本身通常對人體無毒，但大多數銀鹽有毒，慢性積累可在組織中沉積金屬銀，導致稱為argyria的永久性藍灰色病變，雖毀容但對健康無其他損害。良性的元素銀與有毒的離子銀鹽之間的區別對理解銀暴露至關重要。

label: Electron Transport Chain
description: Silver nanoparticles are believed to disrupt the mitochondrial respiratory chain, causing oxidative stress, reduced ATP synthesis, and DNA damage. The mitochondrial electron transport chain is the major source of cellular energy, and its disruption collapses oxidative phosphorylation and elevates reactive oxygen production. This nanoparticle-specific toxicity is attributed to sustained release of silver ions and direct interaction with respiratory complexes, distinguishing it from the bulk-metal effects of larger silver particles.
description_zh_TW: 相信銀奈米粒子會干擾粒線體呼吸鏈，導致氧化應激、ATP合成減少和DNA損傷。粒線體電子傳遞鏈是細胞能量的主要來源，其干擾會使氧化磷酸化崩潰並增加活性氧產生。此奈米粒子特異性毒性歸因於銀離子的持續釋放和與呼吸複合物的直接相互作用，區別於較大銀粒子的塊狀金屬效應。

label: Gold
description: Silver occurs naturally in alloys with gold and other metals as well as in its free metallic form. Native silver-gold alloys are geologically important because they represent the metallic state of both precious metals outside of conventional ores. Understanding silver's alloying behavior matters toxicologically too: metallic silver that is oxidized in the body may be reduced back to the elemental state by ascorbic acid or catecholamines and deposited in tissues, driving the pigmentation seen in argyria.
description_zh_TW: 銀自然存在於與金及其他金屬的合金中，以及其游離金屬形式。天然銀金合金在地質學上很重要，因為它們代表了傳統礦石外兩種貴金屬的金屬狀態。理解銀的合金行為在毒理學上也很重要：在體內被氧化的金屬銀可能被抗壞血酸或兒茶酚胺還原回元素狀態並沉積在組織中，導致argyria中見到的色素沉著。

label: Argentite and chlorargyrite minerals
description: Silver occurs naturally in minerals such as argentite (silver sulfide) and chlorargyrite (silver chloride), which are among the primary silver ores. These mineral forms connect silver's environmental chemistry to its biology: insoluble silver salts absorbed into the body are transformed into soluble silver sulfide albuminates that bind to biomolecules. The sulfide chemistry of argentite mirrors the silver sulfide albuminates formed when silver is absorbed and distributed through the bloodstream to the liver.
description_zh_TW: 銀自然存在於如argentite（硫化銀）和chlorargyrite（氯化銀）等礦物中，這些是主要的銀礦石。這些礦物形式將銀的環境化學與其生物學聯繫起來：吸收體內的不溶性銀鹽被轉化為可溶性硫化銀白蛋白酸鹽，與生物分子結合。argentite的硫化物化學反映了銀吸收後通過血流分布至肝臟時形成的硫化銀白蛋白酸鹽。

label: 1027 mg/kg
description: Silver(I) oxide is acutely toxic in animal studies, with a reported LD50 of 1027 mg/kg by the oral route in mice and 2820 mg/kg orally in rats; intraperitoneal LD50 values are 37 mg/kg in mice and 70 mg/kg in rats. The much lower intraperitoneal threshold reflects efficient absorption of silver ions directly into the circulation, whereas oral silver is less bioavailable. These data establish silver oxide as a moderate acute hazard requiring careful handling in laboratory, industrial, and battery-manufacturing settings.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)在動物研究中具有急性毒性，報導的小鼠口服LD50為1027 mg/kg，大鼠口服為2820 mg/kg；腹腔注射LD50值小鼠為37 mg/kg，大鼠為70 mg/kg。低得多的腹腔注射閾值反映了銀離子直接吸收進入循環的效率，而口服銀的生物利用度較低。這些數據將氧化銀確立為中等急性危害，需要在實驗室、工業和電池製造環境中謹慎處理。

label: Silver oxide battery
description: Silver(I) oxide is used in the silver oxide battery, where the oxide serves as the cathode material. Silver oxide batteries deliver high energy density in compact zinc-silver(oxide) cells and are widely used in small devices such as watches, hearing aids, and cameras. The electrochemical application exploits the reduction of Ag(I) to metallic silver, linking the compound's utility directly to the redox chemistry of silver that also underlies its antimicrobial action and its tissue-staining properties.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)用於銀氧化物電池，其中氧化物作為正極材料。銀氧化物電池在緊湊的鋅-銀(氧化物)電池中提供高能量密度，廣泛用於手錶、助聽器和相機等小型設備。該電化學應用利用Ag(I)還原為金屬銀，將化合物的實用性直接與銀的氧化還原化學聯繫起來，這也奠定了其抗菌作用和組織染色特性。

label: French Paradox
description: The French paradox describes lower cardiovascular-disease incidence in some French populations despite high-fat diets, often attributed in part to moderate wine and resveratrol consumption. Directionally, moderate wine intake sits upstream of reduced CVD in this epidemiological observation. Causality is debated, with diet and lifestyle confounders complicating the interpretation, and the wine matrix and polyphenol content may contribute. Resveratrol's vascular actions provide a plausible, but not proven, mechanism, and the concept has driven considerable research into wine polyphenols, sirtuins, and cardiovascular health.
description_zh_TW: 法國悖論描述了某些法國人群中儘管高脂飲食但心血管疾病發生率較低的現象，部分歸因於適度的葡萄酒和 resveratrol 消費。在方向性上，適度的葡萄酒攝入在此流行病學觀察中位於降低心血管疾病的上游。因果關係存在爭議，飲食和生活方式混雜因素使解釋複雜化，葡萄酒基質和多酚含量可能有所貢獻。resveratrol 的血管作用提供了一個合理的但尚未被證實的機制，此概念已推動了大量關於葡萄酒多酚、sirtuin 和心血管健康的研究。

label: Fumarate
description: In beta-glucan-trained monocytes, glutaminolysis drives fumarate accumulation, which inhibits KDM5 demethylases and preserves activating histone methylation. Exogenous fumarate alone can imprint a trained phenotype, while blocking glutaminolysis impairs training. It directly couples TCA-cycle remodeling to chromatin memory.
description_zh_TW: 在 beta-glucan 訓練的單核球中，glutaminolysis 驅動 Fumarate 累積，進而抑制 KDM5 Histone Demethylases 並保留活化型組蛋白甲基化。單獨給予外源性 Fumarate 即可印記 trained phenotype，而阻斷 glutaminolysis 則損害訓練。它直接將 TCA-cycle remodeling 與 chromatin memory 耦合。

label: GADD45 expression
description: FOXO4 deacetylation by SIRT1 enhances expression of GADD45 and suppresses caspase-3/7 activity, promoting DNA repair over apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT1 activates FOXO4, which induces GADD45. This biases cells toward damage repair rather than death, and it is a further example of SIRT1 steering stress responses toward survival and genome maintenance. By inducing GADD45, FOXO4 supports nucleotide-excision repair and cell-cycle arrest, giving cells time to repair damage. This survival-oriented program is central to SIRT1's cytoprotective functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1對FOXO4的去乙醯化增強了GADD45的表達並抑制caspase-3/7活性，促進DNA修復而非細胞凋亡。方向上，SIRT1活化FOXO4，後者誘導GADD45。這使細胞傾向於損傷修復而非死亡，是SIRT1將壓力反應引導至存活和基因組維護的又一例證。透過誘導GADD45，FOXO4支持核苷酸切除修復和細胞週期停滯，為細胞提供修復損傷的時間。這種以存活為導向的程序是SIRT1細胞保護功能的核心。

label: gastric cancer progression via STAT3/MMP-13
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 depletion promotes gastric cancer progression through activation of the STAT3/MMP-13 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of STAT3- and MMP-13-driven tumor progression in gastric cancer. Because SIRT1 normally restrains this pathway, its depletion unleashes STAT3 activation and MMP-13 expression, accelerating GC growth and invasion. This positions SIRT1 as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer and identifies STAT3/MMP-13 signaling as a downstream mediator of SIRT1's protective effect.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1的耗竭透過活化STAT3/MMP-13訊號通路促進胃癌的進展。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於胃癌中STAT3和MMP-13驅動的腫瘤進展的上游。因為SIRT1通常抑制此通路，其耗竭釋放STAT3活化和MMP-13表達，加速胃癌生長和侵襲。這將SIRT1定位為胃癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，並將STAT3/MMP-13訊號確定為SIRT1保護效果的下游介導因子。

label: Gender-specific tumorigenesis
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2-deficient mice develop gender-specific tumors, with females acquiring mammary tumors and males developing hepatocellular carcinoma, matching the mitotic instability produced by elevated Aurora-A/Aurora-B. Consistent with a tumor-suppressor role, human breast cancers and hepatocellular carcinomas often show reduced SIRT2 relative to normal tissue. The relationship is directional: loss of SIRT2 predisposes to these malignancies, whereas SIRT2 expression restrains them. This positions SIRT2 among the sirtuins that act as tumor suppressors in genetic mouse models.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 缺陷小鼠發展出性別特異性的腫瘤，雌性獲得多發性乳腺腫瘤，雄性則發展為肝細胞癌，這與 Aurora-A/Aurora-B 升高所產生的有絲分裂不穩定性相符。與腫瘤抑制角色一致的是，人類乳癌和肝細胞癌相較於正常組織常表現出 SIRT2 降低。關係具有方向性：SIRT2 的缺失促使這些惡性腫瘤的發生，而 SIRT2 的表現則抑制它們。這將 SIRT2 定位為在基因工程小鼠模型中具有腫瘤抑制功能的 sirtuin 之一。

label: Glioblastoma growth
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of p21-activated kinase 1 (PAK1) at lysine 420 hinders autophagy and glioblastoma growth, establishing SIRT1 as a tumor suppressor in this context. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic inhibition of PAK1 sits upstream of suppressed glioblastoma progression. By restraining PAK1 activity, SIRT1 limits the autophagy that glioblastoma cells rely on to survive under metabolic stress. This impairs tumor growth and positions SIRT1 as a brake on an aggressive brain malignancy. The finding illustrates that the same sirtuin can exert opposite effects in different cancers, and it suggests SIRT1 activation as a therapeutic direction for glioblastoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1介導的p21活化激酶1（PAK1）第420位賴氨酸去乙醯化阻碍自噬和膠質母細胞瘤生長，確立SIRT1在此環境中作為腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT1對PAK1的酵素抑制位於膠質母細胞瘤進展抑制的上游。透過限制PAK1活性，SIRT1限制了膠質母細胞瘤細胞在代謝壓力下存活所依賴的自噬。這損害了腫瘤生長，並將SIRT1定位為對侵略性腦部惡性腫瘤的制動器。此發現說明了同一sirtuin可以在不同癌症中產生相反效果，並建議SIRT1活化作為膠質母細胞瘤的治療方向。

label: GLO1
description: GLO1 (glyoxalase I) is the rate-limiting enzyme of the glyoxalase system. It catalyzes the conversion of hemithioacetals, formed spontaneously from methylglyoxal and glutathione, into S-D-lactoylglutathione. Because methylglyoxal is one of the most reactive dicarbonyl precursors of advanced glycation end products, GLO1 activity is critical for preventing dicarbonyl stress from damaging proteins. Enhancing or maintaining GLO1 function is considered a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation and for protecting against age-related pathologies in which glycation plays a role.
description_zh_TW: GLO1（glyoxalase I）是乙二醛酶系統的速率限制酶。它催化由甲基乙二醛與麩胱甘肽（glutathione）自發形成的半硫縮醛（hemithioacetals）轉化為 S-D-lactoylglutathione。由於甲基乙二醛是晚期糖化終產物最具反應性的二羰基前驅物之一，GLO1 活性對於防止二羰基壓力損害蛋白質至關重要。增強或維持 GLO1 功能被視為減少內生性 AGE 堆積與保護對抗涉及糖化的年齡相關病理的主要標的。

Because methylglyoxal is one of the most reactive dicarbonyl precursors of advanced glycation end products, GLO1 activity is critical for preventing dicarbonyl stress from damaging proteins. Enhancing or maintaining GLO1 function is considered a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation and for protecting against age-related pathologies in which glycation plays a role.
description_zh_TW: GLO1（glyoxalase I）是乙二醛酶系統的速率限制酶。它催化由甲基乙二醛與麩胱甘肽（glutathione）自發形成的半硫縮醛（hemithioacetals）轉化為 S-D-lactoylglutathione。由於甲基乙二醛是晚期糖化終產物最具反應性的二羰基前驅物之一，GLO1 活性對於防止二羰基壓力損害蛋白質至關重要。增強或維持 GLO1 功能被視為減少內生性 AGE 堆積與保護對抗涉及糖化的年齡相關病理的主要標的。

label: Glucose-stimulated insulin secretion
description: Repression of UCP2 by SIRT1 preserves mitochondrial membrane potential and ATP synthesis in pancreatic β-cells, which raises the ATP/ADP ratio and closes KATP channels to trigger insulin release. Mice overexpressing SIRT1 in β-cells show enhanced glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, while SIRT1 loss elevates UCP2 and impairs the response. Directionally, SIRT1-mediated UCP2 downregulation leads to stronger insulin secretion. This links SIRT1 to improved glucose homeostasis and protection against diabetes, and it is consistent with the observation that caloric restriction, which raises SIRT1, preserves β-cell function and insulin sensitivity in aging organisms.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 對 UCP2 的抑制維持了胰腺 β 細胞的粒線體膜電位和 ATP 合成，從而提高 ATP/ADP 比值並關閉 KATP 通道以觸發胰島素釋放。在 β 細胞中過量表達 SIRT1 的小鼠表現出增強的葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌，而 SIRT1 的缺失升高 UCP2 並損害此反應。在方向性上，SIRT1 介導的 UCP2 下調導致更強的胰島素分泌。這將 SIRT1 與改善的葡萄糖穩態和對糖尿病的保護聯繫起來，與熱量限制（提高 SIRT1）在衰老機體中保留 β 細胞功能和胰島素敏感性的觀察一致。

label: Glycated proteins
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Glycated proteins are normally removed from cells via ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis, an important quality control pathway for damaged proteins. AGE modifications can disturb this proteolytic degradation, contributing to a further increase in the cellular content of glycated proteins. The resulting accumulation of glycated proteins is a hallmark of aging and is associated with loss of cellular function. Proteasomal degradation of glycated proteins is thus a key cellular defense against glycation stress, and its impairment creates a feed-forward loop of AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: Glycated proteins 通常經由 ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis 從細胞中移除，這是 damaged proteins 的重要 quality control pathway。AGE modifications 會 disturb 此 proteolytic degradation，導致細胞內 glycated proteins 含量進一步增加。由此產生的 glycated proteins accumulation 是 aging 的標誌，並與 loss of cellular function 相關。因此，glycated proteins 的 proteasomal degradation 是對抗 glycation stress 的關鍵細胞防禦，而其 impairment 會創造 AGE accumulation 的 feed-forward loop。

label: glycolysis and proliferation in breast cancer cells
community_name: glycolysis and proliferation in breast cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Upregulation of SIRT3 in breast cancer cells suppresses glycolysis and proliferation, offering a metabolic pathway for tumour suppression. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced glycolytic metabolism and growth in breast cancer cells. By suppressing glycolysis, SIRT3 limits the Warburg-like metabolic program that supports breast cancer proliferation, identifying SIRT3 activation as a potential tumour-suppressive strategy in breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在乳腺癌細胞中的上調可抑制糖酵解和細胞增殖，為腫瘤抑制提供了一條代謝途徑。從作用方向而言，SIRT3 位於降低乳腺癌細胞糖酵解代謝和生長的上游。透過抑制糖酵解，SIRT3 限制了支持乳腺癌增殖的類沃伯格（Warburg）代謝程序，從而確立 SIRT3 活化作為乳腺癌中潛在的腫瘤抑制策略。

community_name: glycolysis and proliferation in breast cancer cells
