label: Adrenaline catabolism
description: Adrenaline catabolism in the presence of stimulated neutrophils is driven largely by the ROS these cells release. Studies from the 1980s showed that this ROS-mediated oxidation is the major catabolic pathway for adrenaline in neutrophils, accounting for over 80% of oxidation at low micromolar adrenaline concentrations, compared with the usual COMT/MAO pathways. Stimulated neutrophils (e.g., with latex beads or chemotactic peptides such as fMLP) rapidly oxidize adrenaline to adrenochrome, and cell-free medium from activated neutrophils retains this oxidizing ability, indicating that released factors drive the conversion.
description_zh_TW: Adrenaline catabolism in the presence of stimulated neutrophils is driven largely by the ROS these cells release。Studies from the 1980s showed that this ROS-mediated oxidation is the major catabolic pathway for adrenaline in neutrophils, accounting for over 80% of oxidation at low micromolar adrenaline concentrations, compared with the usual COMT/MAO pathways。Stimulated neutrophils (e.g., with latex beads or chemotactic peptides such as fMLP) rapidly oxidize adrenaline to adrenochrome, and cell-free medium from activated neutrophils retains this oxidizing ability, indicating that released factors drive the conversion。

label: Pro-oxidants
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: Flavonoids can act as pro-oxidants at high concentrations because, in the presence of transition metals, they undergo autoxidation that generates semiquinone radicals and subsequently superoxide and H2O2. This biphasic behavior underlies their hormetic profile. The directionality is high-dose flavonoid to radical generation. A caveat is that pro-oxidant effects are favored by metal abundance and high dose, whereas low doses are generally antioxidant. This pro-oxidant behavior is implicated in their anticancer effects, where selective ROS generation can drive apoptosis in malignant cells.
description_zh_TW: Flavonoids 在高濃度下可以充當 pro-oxidants，因為在過渡金屬存在的情況下，它們會發生 autoxidation，生成半醌自由基，隨後生成超氧化物和 H2O2。这种双相行为是其毒物兴奋效应的基础。方向性是大剂量黄酮类物质向自由基生成。需要注意的是，金属丰度和高剂量有利于促氧化作用，而低剂量通常具有抗氧化作用。这种促氧化行为与它们的抗 cancer 作用有关，其中选择性 ROS 生成可以在恶性细胞中驱动 apoptosis。

label: Nitric Oxide bioavailability
description: Genistein enhances nitric oxide bioavailability by upregulating eNOS expression and scavenging superoxide that would otherwise consume NO. The combined effect improves endothelial NO signaling. The directionality is isoflavone to increased bioavailable NO. A caveat is that genistein can also bind estrogen receptors, so part of its vascular benefit may be receptor-mediated rather than purely redox-based. Clinical studies report improved flow-mediated dilation after soy isoflavone intake, consistent with enhanced NO-dependent vasorelaxation in vivo.
description_zh_TW: Genistein 透過上調 eNOS 表現並清除超氧化物來增強 nitric oxide bioavailability，否則超氧化物會消耗 NO。綜合作用可改善內皮 NO 訊號傳導。異黃酮的方向性是增加生物可利用的一氧化氮。需要注意的是，genistein 還可以結合雌激素受體，因此其部分血管益處可能是受體介導的，而不是純粹基於氧化還原的。臨床研究報告稱，攝取大豆異黃酮後血流介導的擴張得到改善，這與體內 NO 依賴性血管舒張作用的增強一致。

label: Angiotensin II
description: NADPH oxidase is activated by angiotensin II via the AT1 receptor, which triggers assembly of NOX isoforms (especially NOX1) in vascular smooth muscle and endothelial cells. This couples the renin-angiotensin system to vascular oxidative stress and hypertension. The directionality is hormone to enzyme activation. A caveat is that AT1 signaling also activates other ROS sources and inflammatory pathways, so NOX is a major but not sole mediator of angiotensin-II effects. Angiotensin-II-driven NOX activation is a well-established mechanism in hypertension, contributing to vascular remodeling and target-organ damage.
description_zh_TW: NADPH oxidase 被 angiotensin II 透過 AT1 受體激活，從而觸發血管平滑肌和內皮細胞中 NOX 同工型（尤其是 NOX1）的組裝。這將腎素-血管緊張素系統與血管 oxidative stress 和高血壓聯繫起來。方向性是荷爾蒙到酵素的活化。需要注意的是，AT1 訊號傳導也會活化其他 ROS 來源和發炎途徑，因此 NOX 是血管張力素 II 效應的主要但不是唯一的介質。血管張力素 II 驅動的 NOX 活化是高血壓的一種成熟機制，有助於血管重塑和目標器官損傷。

label: Nucleic Acids
description: Nucleic acids are prone to damage by reactive oxygen species, particularly hydroxyl radicals, which attack both the sugar-phosphate backbone and nucleobases. Guanine is the most readily oxidized base, yielding 8-oxo-dG and strand lesions. The directionality is ROS to nucleic-acid modification. A caveat is that DNA is partly protected by histones, repair enzymes, and metal sequestration, so damage is non-uniform across the genome. Oxidative lesions accumulate with age and in numerous diseases, and their levels are widely used as biomarkers of oxidative exposure and damage.
description_zh_TW: Nucleic acids 很容易被 reactive oxygen species，特別是 hydroxyl radicals 損壞，hydroxyl radicals 會攻擊糖磷酸主鏈和核鹼基。鳥嘌呤是最容易被氧化的鹼基，產生 8-oxo-dG 和鏈損傷。方向性是ROS到核酸修飾。需要注意的是，DNA 部分受到組蛋白、修復酵素和金屬隔離的保護，因此基因組中的損傷是不均勻的。氧化損傷隨著年齡的增長和在許多疾病中積累，其水平被廣泛用作氧化暴露和損傷的生物標記。

label: Phagocytes
description: Phagocytes use the respiratory burst to produce high concentrations of ROS and RNS via NOX2 and inducible NOS, creating an antimicrobial environment in the phagosome and extracellular space. This oxidant surge kills engulfed pathogens but also risks collateral tissue damage. The directionality is immune activation to oxidant deployment. A caveat is that the burst is tightly compartmentalized and regulated; failure (CGD) causes infection, while excess causes inflammatory injury. The burst is also coordinated with phagosome maturation, degranulation, and acidification, ensuring oxidants act where pathogens are contained.
description_zh_TW: Phagocytes 使用 respiratory burst 透過 NOX2 和誘導型 NOS 產生高濃度的 ROS 和 RNS，在吞噬體和細胞外空間中創建抗菌環境 ironment。這種氧化激增會殺死被吞噬的病原體，但也有可能造成組織損傷。方向性是對氧化劑部署的免疫活化。需要注意的是，爆發是嚴格劃分和監管的。失敗（CGD）會導致感染，而過量則會導致發炎損傷。這種爆發也與吞噬體的成熟、脫粒和酸化相協調，確保氧化劑在病原體所在的地方發揮作用。

label: Pyridoxamine
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Pyridoxamine is a synthetic AGE inhibitor that prevents AGE accumulation by interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and acting as a carbonyl trap, similar to aminoguanidine. By scavenging carbonyl intermediates, pyridoxamine blocks the formation of advanced glycation end products and is considered a candidate for preventing glycation-mediated pathology. Unlike aminoguanidine, pyridoxamine (a vitamin B6 derivative) has a more favorable safety profile. AGE inhibitors and carbonyl-trapping agents remain an active area of research for reducing AGE burden in diabetes and aging.
description_zh_TW: Pyridoxamine 是一種 synthetic AGE inhibitor，透過與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並作為 carbonyl trap 來防止 AGE accumulation，類似於 aminoguanidine。透過 scavenging carbonyl intermediates，pyridoxamine 阻斷 advanced glycation end products 的形成，並被視為預防 glycation-mediated pathology 的 candidate。不同於 aminoguanidine，pyridoxamine（一種 vitamin B6 derivative）具有更有利的 safety profile。AGE inhibitors 與 carbonyl-trapping agents 仍是減少 diabetes 與 aging 中 AGE burden 的活躍研究領域。

label: 2-Chlorophenothiazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: 2-Chlorophenothiazine, which consists of the phenothiazine nucleus without the amine side chains of methylene blue, acts as a direct free-radical scavenger independent of mitochondria and NADH. In the cell-free mitochondrial lysate oxidation assay it significantly reduced DCF fluorescence both with and without mitochondria/NADH, unlike MB which required both. Despite potent nanomolar neuroprotection against glutamate, IAA, and rotenone toxicity, it had no effect on oxygen consumption, anaerobic glycolysis, or the complex I-III electron shunt, and it did not upregulate complex IV expression, revealing a mechanism distinct from MB.
description_zh_TW: 2-Chlorophenothiazine 由吩噻嗪（phenothiazine）核心組成，不含亞甲藍（methylene blue）的胺側鏈，可作為直接的自由基清除劑，其作用不依賴粒線體與 NADH。在無細胞的粒線體裂解液氧化試驗中，無論有無粒線體/NADH，它皆能顯著降低 DCF 螢光，與必須同時具備兩者的 MB 不同。儘管對麩胺酸（glutamate）、IAA 與魚藤酮（rotenone）毒性具有強效的奈莫耳濃度神經保護作用，它對耗氧量、無氧糖解或複合體 I–III 電子分流皆無影響，也未上調複合體 IV 的表現，顯示其機制與 MB 截然不同。

label: 350 to 450 mg per 100g
description: Black elderberries provide roughly 350-450 mg cyanidin-3-glucoside per 100 g of fresh fruit, with about 70-85 g reaching a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, berry content sits upstream of anthocyanin intake. Cyanidin is a powerful natural SIRT6 activator, and this positions elderberry as a dietary SIRT6-modulating food. The high anthocyanin content makes elderberry one of the richest natural sources of cyanidin, and its traditional use for immune support is consistent with the bioactivity of these compounds. Understanding the dose achievable from food is essential for interpreting dietary studies.
description_zh_TW: 黑接骨木莓每 100 克新鮮果實含有約 350-450 mg 花青素-3-葡萄糖苷，約 70-85 克即可達到 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，莓果含量位於花青素攝入量的上游。花青素是強效的天然 SIRT6 活化劑，這使接骨木莓成為飲食中的 SIRT6 調節食物。高花青素含量使接骨木莓成為花青素最豐富的天然來源之一，其傳統用於免疫支持與這些化合物的生物活性一致。理解從食物可達的劑量對於詮釋飲食研究至關重要。

label: Pattern Recognition Receptors
description: Toll-like receptors are the membrane-spanning class of pattern recognition receptors that sense PAMPs and DAMPs and, via TRIF/RIPK3 in the TLR3/4 arm, can trigger necroptosis.
description_zh_TW: Toll 樣受體為辨識 PAMP 與 DAMP 的跨膜模式識別受體；經 TLR3/4 臂的 TRIF/RIPK3 可觸發 necroptosis。

label: GOT1 acetylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 expression is directly correlated with favorable prognosis in pancreatic cancer, as SIRT5 loss promotes glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase 1 acetylation, thus promoting cell proliferation by enhancing glutamine and glutathione metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of GOT1 deacetylation that restrains pancreatic cancer growth. When SIRT5 is lost, GOT1 acetylation rises, boosting glutamine and glutathione metabolism to drive proliferation. This identifies SIRT5 as a tumor suppressor in pancreatic cancer whose levels could inform prognosis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5表達與胰腺癌的良好預後直接相關，因為SIRT5缺失促進穀草轉氨酶1（GOT1）乙醯化，從而透過增強穀氨醯胺和穀胱甘肽代謝促進細胞增殖。方向上，SIRT5位於抑制胰腺癌生長的GOT1去乙醯化的上游。當SIRT5缺失時，GOT1乙醯化升高，促進穀氨醯胺和穀胱甘肽代謝以驅動增殖。這將SIRT5確定為胰腺癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，其水平可能為預後提供資訊。

label: SIRT5 loss
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 expression is directly correlated with favorable prognosis in pancreatic cancer, as SIRT5 loss promotes glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase 1 acetylation, thus promoting cell proliferation by enhancing glutamine and glutathione metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of GOT1 deacetylation that restrains pancreatic cancer growth. When SIRT5 is lost, GOT1 acetylation rises, boosting glutamine and glutathione metabolism to drive proliferation. This identifies SIRT5 as a tumor suppressor in pancreatic cancer whose levels could inform prognosis.

label: GRP75
description: GRP75 (mortalin/HSPA9) links the ER IP3R to the mitochondrial VDAC1 channel at mitochondria-associated ER membranes, gating calcium transfer. SIRT3 overexpression inhibits the VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex, reducing MAM formation and protecting hippocampal neurons from hyperglycemia-induced mitochondrial calcium overload and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: GRP75（mortalin/HSPA9）在粒線體相關內質網膜上將內質網 IP3R 與粒線體 VDAC1 通道連接，調控鈣離子傳遞。SIRT3 的過量表現抑制 VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R 複合物，減少 MAM 形成，保護海馬神經元免受高血糖誘導的粒線體鈣超載和凋亡。

label: VDAC1 and IP3R at MAMs
description: GRP75 (mortalin/HSPA9) links the ER IP3R to the mitochondrial VDAC1 channel at mitochondria-associated ER membranes, gating calcium transfer. SIRT3 overexpression inhibits the VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex, reducing MAM formation and protecting hippocampal neurons from hyperglycemia-induced mitochondrial calcium overload and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: GRP75（mortalin/HSPA9）在粒線體相關內質網膜上將內質網 IP3R 與粒線體 VDAC1 通道連接，調控鈣離子傳遞。SIRT3 的過量表現抑制 VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R 複合物，減少 MAM 形成，保護海馬神經元免受高血糖誘導的粒線體鈣超載和凋亡。

label: HAF-1
description: HAF-1 is an inner mitochondrial membrane ABC-transporter family protein in C. elegans that exports matrix-derived peptides into the cytosol to signal mitochondrial stress. Proteins degraded by matrix proteases generate peptides that exit the mitochondria through HAF-1 (analogous to the yeast Mdl1 transporter), and this peptide release triggers a nuclear transcriptional response involving the ubiquitin-like protein UBL-5, the homeobox transcription factor DVE-1, and ATFS-1. The mechanism is reminiscent of peptide-based quorum sensing in gram-positive bacteria, where peptides exported via ABC transporters activate two-component histidine kinase sensors.

label: Hair Cells
description: Cochlear hair cells are mechanosensory receptors that cannot regenerate once lost. Under caloric restriction, SIRT3-driven IDH2 activation boosts mitochondrial NADPH and ROS clearance, preserving cochlear hair cell integrity — protection completely lost in SIRT3-deficient mice.
description_zh_TW: 耳蝸毛細胞是機械感測受體，一旦喪失無法再生。在熱量限制下，SIRT3 驅動的 IDH2 活化促進粒線體 NADPH 和活性氧清除，維護耳蝸毛細胞完整性——這種保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中完全喪失。

description_zh_TW: 口腔鱗癌屬於解剖學頭頸癌母類。

label: heart hypertrophy, fibrosis, inflammatory cardiomyopathy
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deletion leads to heart hypertrophy, fibrosis, lipofuscin accumulation, and inflammatory cardiomyopathy that worsens with age.

label: Hepatic steatosis (fatty liver)
description: Through the AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α pathway, resveratrol reduces hepatic steatosis in diet-induced obesity models by enhancing fatty-acid oxidation and mitochondrial function while limiting lipogenesis. Directionally, SIRT1 activation sits upstream of reduced liver fat accumulation. This demonstrates a translational metabolic benefit of sirtuin activation and is consistent with SIRT1s repression of lipogenic transcription factors such as SREBP-1c and PPAR-γ in the liver. By both increasing lipid catabolism and suppressing de novo lipogenesis, the pathway corrects the imbalance that drives non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
description_zh_TW: 通過 AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α 通路，白藜蘆醇在飲食誘導肥胖模型中通過增強脂肪酸氧化和粒線體功能同時限制脂肪生成來減少肝脂肪變性。在方向性上，SIRT1 活化位於減少肝臟脂肪堆積的上游。這展示了 sirtuin 活化的轉化代謝益處，與 SIRT1 在肝臟中抑制 SREBP-1c 和 PPAR-γ 等脂肪生成轉錄因子一致。通過同時增加脂質分解代謝並抑制新生脂肪合成，該通路糾正了驅動非酒精性脂肪肝病的不平衡。

label: Herbicides
description: Herbicides and paraquat were among the earliest artificial chemical stressors found to induce hormesis in plants, stimulating growth or defense at low doses while causing phytotoxicity at high doses. This biphasic logic is now applied to develop novel herbicides, optimize insecticide dosing via sublethal effects, and eradicate cancer cells by exploiting the high-dose inhibitory limb.
description_zh_TW: Herbicides 與 paraquat 是最早被發現可在植物中誘發 Hormesis 的人工化學壓力源之一，低劑量刺激生長或防禦，高劑量則產生植物毒性。此雙相邏輯現已應用於開發新型除草劑、經由亞致死效應優化殺蟲劑劑量，以及利用高劑量抑制支來清除癌細胞。

label: HIC1
description: HIC1 (hypermethylated in cancer 1) is a tumor suppressor that binds the SIRT1 promoter via its POZ domain and directly represses SIRT1 transcription. Because p53 transactivates HIC1, a negative feedback loop exists: p53 induces HIC1, which then restrains SIRT1, preventing excessive p53 deacetylation and preserving p53 tumor-suppressive capacity. The directionality is HIC1 → SIRT1 repression, upstream of SIRT1's inhibition of p53. Disruption of this loop in cancer can unleash SIRT1 to silence p53.
description_zh_TW: HIC1（hypermethylated in cancer 1）是一種腫瘤抑制因子，通過其 POZ 結構域結合 SIRT1 啟動子並直接抑制 SIRT1 轉錄。由於 p53 反式活化 HIC1，存在一個負回饋迴路：p53 誘導 HIC1，HIC1 反過來限制 SIRT1，防止過度的 p53 去乙醯化並維持 p53 的腫瘤抑制能力。其方向性為 HIC1 → SIRT1 抑制，位於 SIRT1 對 p53 的抑制上游。此迴路在癌症中的中斷可以釋放 SIRT1 來沉默 p53。

label: High dietary AGE intake
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Sebekova and colleagues found that long-term consumption of advanced glycation end products in rats leads to a dose-dependent increase in proteinuria that over time could induce renal damage. High long-term consumption of AGEs has also been associated with higher levels of fasting glucose, insulin, and serum AGEs, as well as increased AGE localization and RAGE staining in the ovarian tissue of rats. These results show that chronic dietary AGE excess can reproduce in animals some of the renal and metabolic features seen in aging and diabetes, supporting the toxicity of a high-AGE diet.
description_zh_TW: Sebekova 及其同事發現，大鼠長期攝取晚期糖化終產物會導致蛋白尿呈劑量依賴性增加，隨時間可能誘發腎損傷。長期高量攝取 AGE 也與較高的空腹血糖、胰島素與血清 AGE 濃度，以及大鼠卵巢組織中 AGE 定位與 RAGE 染色增加有關。這些結果顯示，慢性飲食性 AGE 過量能在動物中重現老化與糖尿病中見到的部分腎臟與代謝特徵，支持高 AGE 飲食的毒性。

label: SASP Enhancers
description: H3K27ac marks senescence-activated super-enhancers that drive SASP expression, identifying the enhancer landscape licensed during the senescent response. These acetylated, transcriptionally active enhancers recruit BRD4 and transcription factors such as AP-1 and NF-kB to SASP loci, enabling robust and sustained secretome transcription. The mark thus charts the chromatin basis of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype and distinguishes active SASP enhancers from repressed loci. Targeting these enhancers with BET inhibitors such as JQ1 suppresses SASP expression, revealing the enhancer landscape as a therapeutic vulnerability in senescence.
description_zh_TW: H3K27ac 標記驅動 SASP 表現的衰老活化超級增強子，辨識衰老反應中許可的增強子景觀。這些乙醯化、轉錄活化的增強子招募 BRD4 與 AP-1、NF-κB 等轉錄因子至 SASP 基因座，促成強健且持續的分泌組轉錄。此標記因此描繪衰老相關分泌表型的染色質基礎，並區分活化的 SASP 增強子與受抑制基因座。以 BET 抑制劑如 JQ1 標靶這些增強子抑制 SASP 表現，揭示增強子景觀作為衰老中治療脆弱性。

label: Histone
description: A nucleosome, the fundamental repeating unit of chromatin, is composed of a histone octamer around which DNA is wrapped. The octamer contains two copies each of the core histones H2A, H2B, H3, and H4, and approximately 147 base pairs of DNA wind around this protein core in a left-handed superhelix. Nucleosomes package the genome into chromatin, and their positioning and modification regulate access to DNA for transcription, replication, and repair. Linker histone H1 associates with the DNA between nucleosomes and helps fold the fiber into higher-order structures.
description_zh_TW: 核小體是染色質的基本重複單位，由 DNA 包覆的組蛋白八聚體組成。此八聚體包含核心組蛋白 H2A、H2B、H3 和 H4 各兩個拷貝，約 147 個鹼基對的 DNA 以左手超螺旋纏繞在該蛋白質核心周圍。核小體將基因組包裝成染色質，它們的定位和修飾調節 DNA 的轉錄、複製和修復。連接組蛋白 H1 與核小體之間的 DNA 結合，幫助將纖維折疊成更高階的結構。

label: CXCL5
description: AP-1 transactivates CXCL5 (a SASP chemokine), which feeds inflammaging. Caloric restriction suppresses inflammaging and activates autophagy via mTOR/AMPK.
description_zh_TW: AP-1 轉活化 CXCL5（一種 SASP 趨化因子），促成發炎性老化（inflammaging）。熱量限制可抑制發炎性老化，並透過 mTOR/AMPK 活化自噬。

label: ACLY
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: ACLY (ATP-citrate lyase) catalyzes the downstream conversion of mitochondria-derived citrate exported to the cytosol into acetyl-CoA, the principal substrate for cytosolic acetyl-CoA production and histone acetylation. ACLY expression is increased across multiple senescence models, and its silencing reduces both H3K27ac levels and SASP gene expression in irradiation-induced and replicative senescence. Conversely, citrate supplementation increases histone acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory gene expression in proliferating cells, confirming that increasing citrate availability is sufficient to drive the acetylation-dependent inflammatory programme.
description_zh_TW: ACLY（ATP-西妥環酶）催化由線粒體釋放至細胞質的檸檬酸下游轉化為乙酰-CoA，這是細胞質內乙酰-CoA的主要底物，以及組蛋白乙酰化。ACLY的表達在多個衰老模型中均增加，並且抑制其會降低H3K27ac的水平和輻射誘導和代數衰老引起的SASP基因表達。相反，檸檬酸補充會增加組蛋白乙酰化並誘導增生細胞中的促炎基因表達，這證實增加檸檬酸的供應足夠驅動乙酰化依賴的炎症程序。

label: Citrate
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: SLC25A1, the mitochondrial citrate carrier, exports citrate from the mitochondrial matrix to the cytosol, where it can be converted to acetyl-CoA. SLC25A1 expression is significantly increased at both mRNA and protein levels in multiple senescence contexts, and this citrate export sustains the nucleocytosolic acetyl-CoA pool required for histone acetylation. Genetic ablation of SLC25A1 does not alter CDK inhibitor expression or cell cycle arrest but markedly reduces SASP gene expression, and inhibition with the third-generation inhibitor CTPI2 selectively suppresses SASP-associated inflammation without clearing senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: SLC25A1，線粒體枸櫞酸載體，將枸櫞酸從線粒體基質輸出到細胞質，在那裡可以轉化為乙酰輔酶A。SLC25A1表達在多種衰老背景下在mRNA和蛋白質水平上都顯著增加，這種枸櫞酸輸出維持組蛋白乙酰化所需的核質乙酰輔酶A池。SLC25A1的基因消融不改變CDK抑製劑表達或細胞週期停滯，但顯著減少SASP基因表達，使用第三代抑製劑CTPI2的抑製選擇性地抑制SASP相關炎症而不清除衰老細胞。

label: MEF2D (at Lys424)
description: HDAC4 possesses SUMO E3 ligase activity and sumoylates MEF2D at Lys424, locking it into an inactive, transcription-repressing state. Directionally, HDAC4 sits upstream of MEF2D inactivation. This regulates muscle-gene expression independently of sirtuins, and it is included as a parallel chromatin regulatory mechanism contextualizing SIRT1's muscle actions. By sumoylating MEF2D, HDAC4 represses its transcriptional activity and the muscle genes it controls. This regulation is distinct from the acetylation-deacetylation balance that sirtuins influence, illustrating the diversity of muscle-gene control.
description_zh_TW: HDAC4 具有 SUMO E3 連接酶活性，在 Lys424 位點 SUMO 化 MEF2D，將其鎖定在不活化的轉錄抑制狀態。在方向性上，HDAC4 位於 MEF2D 失活的上游。這獨立於 sirtuin 調控肌肉基因表達，被納入作為將 SIRT1 肌肉作用置於背景中的平行染色質調控機制。透過 SUMO 化 MEF2D，HDAC4 抑制其轉錄活性和它所控制的肌肉基因。此調控不同於 sirtuin 影響的乙醯化-去乙醯化平衡，說明了肌肉基因控制的多樣性。

label: HIV-1 viral transcription
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Because deacetylated Tat is a more potent transactivator, SIRT1-mediated deacetylation at Lys50 boosts HIV-1 transcription from the proviral LTR. The relationship is directional: SIRT1 acts on Tat to amplify viral gene expression and reactivate latent proviruses. This positions host SIRT1 as a cofactor that HIV exploits, a caveat to the generally beneficial reputation of SIRT1 activation. Targeting this interaction is of interest for antiviral strategies, particularly for the shock-and-kill approach to HIV latency, where compounds that modulate the SIRT1–Tat axis could either silence or purge the latent reservoir depending on the therapeutic goal.
description_zh_TW: 由於去乙醯化的 Tat 是更強的轉錄活化因子，SIRT1 介導的 Lys50 去乙醯化增強了 HIV-1 從前病毒 LTR 的轉錄。其方向性為：SIRT1 作用於 Tat 以放大病毒基因表達並重新活化潛伏的前病毒。這將宿主 SIRT1 定位為 HIV 利用的輔因子，是 SIRT1 活化普遍有益聲譽的一個注意事項。靶向此相互作用對抗病毒策略具有意義，特別是針對 HIV 潜伏的「震驚與清除」方法，調節 SIRT1–Tat 軸的化合物可以根據治療目標沉默或清除潛伏儲存庫。

label: hnRNP A1 to suppress glycolysis and growth in HCC
community_name: hnRNP A1 to suppress glycolysis and growth in HCC
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 and SIRT6 deacetylate the RNA-binding protein hnRNP A1 to suppress glycolysis and growth in hepatocellular carcinoma. Directionally, SIRT1 and SIRT6 sit upstream of hnRNP A1 deacetylation, which curtails glycolytic gene expression and tumor growth. By restraining the glycolytic program through hnRNP A1, these nuclear sirtuins act as metabolic tumor suppressors in HCC, opposing the aerobic glycolysis that supports cancer cell proliferation.

label: Homogeneous fluorescent deacetylase assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The homogeneous fluorescent deacetylase assay, which uses the fluorescent acetyl-lysine substrate ZMAL and NAD+ followed by trypsin treatment to release the AMC fluorophore, was used to screen several compound families as sirtuin inhibitors, including adenosine mimetics, inhibitors of kinases or phosphatases, suramin analogs, splitomicin derivatives, thiobarbiturates, and 3-arylideneindolin-2-ones. Directionally, the assay's ZMAL-ZML trypsin-coupled readout provides a plate-compatible screen for sirtuin inhibition. Its utility explains the breadth of scaffolds identified across independent discovery programs.

label: Hormetic Zone
description: The hormetic stimulatory zone typically spans 0.1 to 10 times the No-Observed-Adverse-Effect Level (NOAEL), with large-scale analyses indicating approximately 40% of chemical substances exhibit hormetic characteristics. This low-dose stimulation window is evolutionarily conserved from bacteria to mammals and defines where mild stressors build resilience rather than cause inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Hormetic Zone 的刺激窗通常橫跨 No-Observed-Adverse-Effect Level (NOAEL) 的 0.1 至 10 倍，大規模分析顯示約 40% 化學物質具有 hormetic 特徵。此低劑量刺激窗從細菌到哺乳類高度保守，界定了輕度壓力源建立韌性而非造成抑制的範圍。

label: HP1alpha (to LINE-1 heterochromatin)
description: SIRT6-mediated mono-ADP-ribosylation of KAP1 recruits HP1α to package LINE-1 retrotransposons into heterochromatin, silencing their expression. Directionally, SIRT6/KAP1 sits upstream of HP1α tethering. This protects genome stability by containing mobile elements, and it explains how SIRT6 loss derepresses LINE-1. By maintaining heterochromatic silencing of retrotransposons, SIRT6 prevents the insertional mutations and genomic instability caused by active LINE-1 elements. The KAP1-HP1α axis is thus a critical effector of SIRT6's genome-protective function, and its disruption contributes to the instability seen in SIRT6-deficient cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 介導的 KAP1 單 ADP-核糖基化招募 HP1α 將 LINE-1 逆轉座子包裝成異染色質，沉默其表達。在方向性上，SIRT6/KAP1 位於 HP1α 拴繫的上游。這透過限制可動元件保護基因組穩定性，並解釋了 SIRT6 缺失如何解除 LINE-1 的抑制。透過維護逆轉座子的異染色質沉默，SIRT6 防止了活性 LINE-1 元件引起的插入突變和基因組不穩定性。KAP1-HP1α 軸線因此是 SIRT6 基因組保護功能的關鍵效應器，其破壞導致 SIRT6 缺陷細胞中所見的不穩定性。

label: hPEPT1
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Pyrraline is an advanced glycation end product that is absorbed by the peptide transporter hPEPT1, according to the first study addressing the absorption mechanism of individual AGEs. In a bioavailability study, pretzel sticks were found to be a rich source of pyrraline and pentosidine; after ingestion of these foods, urinary excretion of pyrraline and pentosidine increased, with recovery in urine of about 50% for pyrraline and 60% for pentosidine. Although the metabolic fate of these compounds is unknown, their absorption via peptide transporters such as hPEPT1 explains how dietary AGEs enter the circulation.
description_zh_TW: Pyrraline 是一種晚期糖化終產物，根據首項探討個別 AGE 吸收機制的研究，它經由胜肽轉運蛋白 hPEPT1 被吸收。在一項生物可利用性研究中，發現椒鹽捲餅棒（pretzel sticks）是 pyrraline 與 pentosidine 的豐富來源；攝取這些食物後，尿液中 pyrraline 與 pentosidine 的排泄增加，尿中回收率約為 pyrraline 50%、pentosidine 60%。儘管這些化合物的代謝命運未知，它們經由如 hPEPT1 等胜肽轉運蛋白的吸收解釋了飲食性 AGE 如何進入循環。

label: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome
description: Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome is a rare premature aging disorder caused by mutations in the LMNA gene, which encodes lamin A. A silent point mutation (c.1824C>T) activates a cryptic splice site that produces progerin, a permanently farnesylated, toxic form of lamin A that accumulates at the nuclear membrane. Progerin causes nuclear blebbing, loss of heterochromatin, genomic instability, and premature senescence, producing the accelerated aging features of the disease. The disease demonstrates how defective nuclear envelope proteins disrupt chromatin organization and accelerate aging.
description_zh_TW: Hutchinson-Gilford 早衰症是一種罕見的過早老化疾病，由編碼核纖層蛋白 A 的 LMNA 基因突變引起。沉默點突變 (c.1824C>T) 會活化一個神秘的剪接位點，產生早老素，這是核纖層蛋白 A 的一種永久法呢基化的有毒形式，在核膜上積聚。早老蛋白會導致核起泡、異染色質流失、基因組不穩定和過早衰老，從而產生該疾病的加速衰老特徵。這種疾病顯示了有缺陷的核膜蛋白如何破壞染色質組織並加速老化。

label: Hyperactivation of autophagy
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Deacetylation of LDHB by SIRT5 hyperactivates autophagy, accelerating cellular self-digestion and influencing tumor cell survival and metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5-mediated LDHB deacetylation sits upstream of autophagic hyperactivation. This can support tumor-cell fitness under stress by recycling nutrients, but it may also provoke cell-death programs when excessive. It exemplifies SIRT5's role at the autophagy-metabolism interface, where the same enzyme coordinates both fuel utilization and the clearance of cellular components. Understanding this axis is relevant to cancer therapy, where modulating autophagy can either sensitize or protect tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 介導的 LDHB 去乙醯化使自噬過度活化，加速細胞自我消化並影響腫瘤細胞的存活和代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 介導的 LDHB 去乙醯化位於自噬過度活化的上游。這可以透過回收營養物質在壓力下支持腫瘤細胞的適應性，但當過度活化時也可能引發細胞死亡程式。這體現了 SIRT5 在自噬—代謝交界處的角色，同一種酶同時協調燃料利用和細胞組件的清除。理解這一軸線與癌症治療相關，因為調控自噬可以增敏或保護腫瘤細胞。

label: Hypoxia-reoxygenation
description: Hypoxia-reoxygenation produces a ROS burst in rheumatoid arthritis synovium analogous to ischemia-reperfusion, as restored oxygen fuels mitochondrial and enzymatic ROS after hypoxic epochs. This oxidant surge perpetuates synovial inflammation and joint damage. The directionality is reoxygenation to ROS burst in joint tissue. A caveat is that RA synovium is also hypoxic because of high metabolic and infiltrating-cell demand, so the cycle is sustained rather than episodic. This mechanism may explain the vulnerability of the inflamed joint to intermittent blood flow and oxidative injury.
description_zh_TW: Hypoxia-reoxygenation 在類風濕性關節炎滑膜中產生 ROS 爆發，類似於缺血再灌注，因為缺氧時期後恢復的氧氣為 mitochondria1 和酶促 ROS 提供燃料。這種氧化劑激增會導致滑膜發炎和關節損傷持續存在。方向性是關節組織中ROS爆發的再氧合。需要注意的是，由於高代謝和浸潤細胞的需求，RA 滑膜也會缺氧，因此循環是持續的而不是間歇性的。這種機制可以解釋發炎關節對間歇性血流和氧化損傷的脆弱性。

label: SIRT3 for osteoprotection
description: Irisin, the exercise-induced FNDC5 cleavage product, exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects in diabetic periodontitis models that require SIRT3: lentiviral SIRT3 silencing abolishes its protection against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction, establishing SIRT3 as the obligatory signaling node.
description_zh_TW: Irisin 是運動誘導的 FNDC5 裂解產物，在糖尿病牙周炎模型中發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用需要 SIRT3：慢病毒 SIRT3 沉默消除其對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的保護，確立 SIRT3 為必要訊號節點。

label: FNDC5
description: Irisin is cleaved from the membrane protein FNDC5 during exercise. In the hippocampus, FNDC5-derived irisin stimulates BDNF and downstream mediators of hippocampal function including Npas4, c-Fos, and Arc, forming the irisin-BDNF axis that mediates exercise benefits on cognition.
description_zh_TW: Irisin 在運動期間從膜蛋白 FNDC5 上被剪切產生。在海馬體中，源自 FNDC5 的 irisin 刺激 BDNF 以及 Npas4、c-Fos 和 Arc 等海馬功能下游介導因子，形成介導運動對認知益處的 irisin–BDNF 軸。

label: Acute Inflammation
description: Exercise-induced muscle damage signals via TNF-alpha/IL-6 to proliferate satellite cells; NSAIDs block the adaptation (Mikkelsen 2009). Acute inflammatory signaling as repair trigger.
description_zh_TW: 運動誘發的肌肉損傷經由 TNF-alpha/IL-6 訊號增生衛星細胞；NSAID 阻斷此適應（Mikkelsen 2009）。急性發炎訊號作為修復觸發。

label: Collagen IV
description: Collagen IV forms the network scaffold of basal lamina sheets. Containment records the scaffold.
description_zh_TW: Collagen IV 形成基底膜片的網絡支架。包含記錄支架。

label: Immunomodulation
description: Immunomodulation is central to MSC therapeutic action on inflammation. Regulation is the immunological output.
description_zh_TW: 免疫調節是 MSC 對發炎治療作用的核心。調節是其免疫學輸出。

label: Receptor Tyrosine Kinase
description: c-Met is definitionally a receptor tyrosine kinase. Classification is textbook.
description_zh_TW: c-Met 定義上是受體酪胺酸激酶。歸類為教科書等級。

label: I-PpoI
description: I-PpoI recognizes and cleaves a specific 15-20 base-pair sequence within rRNA gene repeats, generating sequence-specific double-strand breaks. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of targeted double-strand-break formation. Its specificity makes it ideal for the ICE Mouse's controlled damage, and this enables reproducible epigenetic-aging studies. Because I-PpoI cleaves at a defined sequence, researchers can induce breaks at known genomic loci in a controlled manner. This precision distinguishes the ICE Mouse from treatments that cause random DNA damage, allowing the isolation of repair-driven effects.
description_zh_TW: I-PpoI 識別並切割 rRNA 基因重複序列中的特定 15-20 基鹼對序列，產生序列特異性的雙鏈斷裂。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於靶向雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。其特異性使其成為 ICE 小鼠受控損傷的理想工具，實現可重複的表觀遺傳衰老研究。由於 I-PpoI 在確定的序列處切割，研究人員可以在已知的基因組位點以受控方式誘導斷裂。這種精確性區別了 ICE 小鼠與造成隨機 DNA 損傷的處理，允許分離修復驅動的效應。

Because I-PpoI cleaves at a defined sequence, researchers can induce breaks at known genomic loci in a controlled manner. This precision distinguishes the ICE Mouse from treatments that cause random DNA damage, allowing the isolation of repair-driven effects.
description_zh_TW: I-PpoI 識別並切割 rRNA 基因重複序列中的特定 15-20 基鹼對序列，產生序列特異性的雙鏈斷裂。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於靶向雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。其特異性使其成為 ICE 小鼠受控損傷的理想工具，實現可重複的表觀遺傳衰老研究。由於 I-PpoI 在確定的序列處切割，研究人員可以在已知的基因組位點以受控方式誘導斷裂。這種精確性區別了 ICE 小鼠與造成隨機 DNA 損傷的處理，允許分離修復驅動的效應。

label: IGF1R-mTOR Signaling
description: Cholesterol-biosynthesis-derived mevalonate activates IGF1R and downstream PI3K-mTOR, promoting histone modifications at inflammatory loci. Statins prevent trained immunity induction, whereas mevalonate kinase deficiency yields a constitutively trained state. oxLDL engages this mevalonate/IGF1R feedback loop via HIF-1alpha.
description_zh_TW: 源自 cholesterol-biosynthesis 的 Mevalonate 活化 IGF1R 及下游 PI3K-mTOR，促進發炎基因座的 histone modifications。Statins 可阻止 trained immunity 的誘導，而 mevalonate kinase deficiency 則產生組成型 trained state。Oxidized LDL 經由 HIF-1alpha 接合此 mevalonate/IGF1R feedback loop。

label: SIRT3 expression
description: The gut-microbiota metabolite indole-3-propionic acid binds the aryl hydrocarbon receptor, translocates to the nucleus, and restores cardiac SIRT3 transcription, with Sirt3 knockdown abolishing its protective effect. IPA also suppresses NNMT, preserving nicotinamide and boosting the NAD+ salvage pathway that feeds SIRT3 activity, protecting against HFpEF.
description_zh_TW: 腸道微生物代謝物吲哚-3-丙酸結合芳香烴受體，轉位至細胞核並恢復心臟 SIRT3 轉錄，Sirt3 敲低會消除其保護作用。IPA 還抑制 NNMT，保留菸鹼醯胺並增強供應 SIRT3 活性的 NAD+ 回收途徑，從而對抗 HFpEF。

label: Infantile Refsum Disease
description: Neonatal adrenoleukodystrophy (NALD) is an intermediate form of Zellweger spectrum disorders, less severe than Zellweger syndrome but more severe than infantile Refsum disease. All arise from autosomal recessive mutations in PEX genes essential for peroxisome biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 新生兒腎上腺腦白質失養症（NALD）是 Zellweger 譜系障礙的中間形式，比 Zellweger 症候群輕微但比嬰兒型 Refsum 病嚴重。兩者皆源於對過氧化體生合成必需的 PEX 基因自體隱性突變。

source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 and its activators prevent/reverse insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes by enhancing deacetylation of metabolic regulators (e.g., PGC-1α, FOXO; Rodgers 2005 PMID 15931387).

label: mitochondrial bioenergetics
description: Intermedin (adrenomedullin 2) enhances mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity via AMPK/SIRT3-mediated cristae remodeling in vascular calcification models, opposing the calcific phenotype driven by mitochondrial dysfunction in advanced chronic kidney disease.
description_zh_TW: Intermedin（腎上腺髓質素 2）在血管鈣化模型中透過 AMPK/SIRT3 介導的嵴重塑增強粒線體生物能容量，對抗進階慢性腎臟病中粒線體功能障礙驅動的鈣化表型。

label: Intestinal Absorption
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Orlistat, a lipase inhibitor, reduced serum AGEs after a high-AGE meal in 21 women with polycystic ovary disease compared with 15 women without PCOS, by decreasing AGE absorption. A six-month study evaluating the effect of calorie restriction and orlistat found serum AGE reductions in both PCOS and obese groups, independent of changes in body mass index. By interfering with lipid absorption, orlistat also reduces the absorption of fat-associated dietary AGEs, since foods rich in protein and fat have the highest AGE content. Orlistat therefore illustrates how modulating intestinal absorption can lower postprandial glycation load.
description_zh_TW: Orlistat 是一種脂解酶抑制劑（lipase inhibitor），在 21 名多囊性卵巢疾病女性與 15 名無 PCOS 女性相比，於高 AGE 餐後降低了血清 AGE，方式是減少 AGE 吸收。一項評估熱量限制與 orlistat 效果為期六個月的研究發現，PCOS 與肥胖組的血清 AGE 均下降，且獨立於身體質量指數的變化。透過干擾脂質吸收，orlistat 也減少與脂肪相關的飲食性 AGE 吸收，因為富含蛋白質與脂肪的食物 AGE 含量最高。因此，orlistat 說明了調節腸道吸收如何能降低餐後糖化負載。

label: intracellular cAMP
description: Inhibiting PDE4 prevents cAMP degradation, so intracellular cAMP accumulates after resveratrol exposure. Directionally, PDE4 inhibition leads to elevated cAMP. Elevated cAMP then activates the exchange protein Epac1, propagating a calcium and AMPK signal that ultimately boosts NAD+ and SIRT1. This pathway explains how resveratrol can activate SIRT1 even through non-allosteric means, and it connects resveratrol's pharmacology to the broader cAMP signaling network. Because PDE4 is a validated therapeutic target, this arm also links resveratrol's metabolic and anti-inflammatory effects to a well-characterized drug target.
description_zh_TW: 抑制 PDE4 阻止 cAMP 降解，因此在白藜蘆醇暴露後細胞內 cAMP 累積。在方向性上，PDE4 抑制導致 cAMP 升高。升高的 cAMP 然後活化交換蛋白 Epac1，傳播鈣離子和 AMPK 信號，最終提升 NAD+ 和 SIRT1。此通路解釋了白藜蘆醇如何能通過非變構方式活化 SIRT1，將白藜蘆醇的藥理學與更廣泛的 cAMP 信號網絡聯繫起來。由於 PDE4 是一個已驗證的治療靶點，這個臂也將白藜蘆醇的代謝和抗發炎效應與一個特徵明確的藥物靶點聯繫起來。

label: Irisin via SIRT3
description: Periodontitis is a chronic inflammatory disease of tooth-supporting tissues driven by dysbiotic biofilm and host responses, with diabetes as a major risk modifier. In diabetic periodontitis models, irisin's SIRT3-dependent osteoprotection prevents alveolar bone resorption, identifying SIRT3 as a host-modulatory target.
description_zh_TW: 牙周炎是由失調的生物膜和宿主反應驅動的牙齒支持組織慢性發炎疾病，糖尿病是主要的風險修飾因子。在糖尿病牙周炎模型中，Irisin 的 SIRT3 依賴性骨保護防止牙槽骨吸收，將 SIRT3 識別為宿主調節靶標。

label: Cardiac Function
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: A strong beneficial effect of nicotinamide riboside (NR) was discovered in mouse models of heart failure, with preservation of cardiac function and limitation of cardiac remodeling, effects that were associated with maintained NAD+ levels in the heart. NR supplementation normalizes the myocardial NAD+/NADH ratio and, by improving NAD+ homeostasis and activating NMRK2, can prevent the deterioration of cardiac function and adverse remodeling in a mouse model of dilated cardiomyopathy leading to heart failure.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠心力衰竭模型中發現菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）具有強大的有益效果，可維持心臟功能並限制心臟重塑，這些效應與心臟中維持的 NAD+ 水平相關。NR 補充能使心肌 NAD+/NADH 比值正常化，並透過改善 NAD+ 恆定與活化 NMRK2，可預防導致心力衰竭的擴張型心肌病小鼠模型中心臟功能惡化與不良重塑。

label: CD157
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: CD157, also called bone marrow stromal cell antigen 1 (BST1), is a glycohydrolase that participates in NAD+ precursor metabolism. It hydrolyzes nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which is then further metabolized by gut microbiota into nicotinic acid and routed through the Preiss-Handler pathway to NAD+. In addition, CD157 displays base-exchange activity against both NR and niacin riboside (NAR), interconverting amidated and deamidated precursor pathways. This dual activity means CD157 not only diverts NR toward the deamidated route but also links the two branches of NAD+ biosynthesis, providing alternative substrates that maintain intracellular NAD+ levels depending on tissue and dietary context.
description_zh_TW: CD157，又稱骨髓基質細胞抗原1（BST1），是一種參與NAD+前體代謝的糖水解酶。它將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）水解為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），隨後由腸道微生物群進一步代謝為菸鹼酸，並經由Preiss-Handler途徑進入NAD+。此外，CD157對NR與菸鹼酸核糖苷（NAR）均展現鹼基交換活性，使醯胺化與去醯胺化的前體途徑相互轉換。這種雙重活性意味著CD157不僅將NR導向去醯胺化路線，也連結NAD+生合成的兩個分支，提供替代受質，依組織與飲食背景維持細胞內NAD+水平。

label: CD38 knockdown
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: CD38 knockdown in mice suppressed axon degeneration, demyelination, and immune cell infiltration after facial nerve axotomy compared with wild-type mice, identifying CD38 as a candidate molecule for regulating neurodegeneration. Correspondingly, intraperitoneal injection of NR at 400 mg/kg once daily for 1 week prior to facial nerve axotomy delayed axon degeneration and demyelination and significantly increased NAD+ levels in the facial nucleus and facial nerve of wild-type mice. These findings connect the age-related rise in CD38 activity to NAD+ depletion and axonal vulnerability, and show that NAD+ precursor supplementation can mimic the protection achieved by CD38 deletion.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠中 CD38 敲低與野生型小鼠相比，抑制了面神經軸突切斷後的軸突退化、髓鞘脫失與免疫細胞浸潤，將 CD38 確認為調節神經退化的候選分子。相應地，在面神經軸突切斷前，以 400 mg/kg 的 NR 每日一次腹腔注射一週，延遲了軸突退化與髓鞘脫失，並顯著提升野生型小鼠面神經核與面神經中的 NAD+ 水平。這些發現將年齡相關的 CD38 活性上升與 NAD+ 耗竭及軸突脆弱性相連結，並顯示 NAD+ 前體補充能模擬 CD38 缺失所達成的保護作用。

label: Glucose Tolerance
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: In mouse models, nicotinamide riboside (NR) increases NAD+ metabolism and thereby improves glucose tolerance, reduces weight gain, and exhibits neuroprotective effects against diabetic neuropathy and liver steatosis. NR also restores the significantly decreased hepatic NADP+ and NADPH levels seen in prediabetic and type 2 diabetic mice, both of which are important for resistance to oxidative stress. These benefits are mediated in part through activation of SIRT1, which promotes glucose-stimulated insulin secretion from pancreatic beta-cells and protects against insulin resistance in peripheral tissues.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠模型中，菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）可提升 NAD+ 代謝，進而改善葡萄糖耐受性、減少體重增加，並對糖尿病神經病變與肝臟脂肪變性展現神經保護作用。NR 亦能恢復糖尿病前期與第二型糖尿病小鼠中顯著下降的肝臟 NADP+ 與 NADPH 濃度，兩者皆對抵抗氧化壓力至關重要。這些益處部分透過活化 SIRT1 所介導，SIRT1 可促進胰島 beta 細胞的葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌，並保護周邊組織免於胰島素抗性。

label: Hepatocyte Replication
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: In the regenerating liver, nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces lipid accumulation, promotes hepatocyte replication, and increases hepatic ATP content, leading to a faster regaining of liver weight in mice. This hepatoprotective and regenerative effect is tied to NAD+ biosynthesis, which supports the energy-producing and biosynthetic demands of liver regeneration. In addition, dietary NR supplementation restored NAD+ levels that were depressed by impaired biosynthesis in a mouse model of hepatocellular carcinoma, preventing both DNA damage and tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: 在再生肝臟中，菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）減少脂質堆積、促進肝細胞複製，並增加肝臟 ATP 含量，使小鼠更快恢復肝臟重量。這種肝保護與再生作用與 NAD+ 生物合成有關，後者支持肝臟再生所需的能量產生與生物合成需求。此外，飲食補充 NR 恢復了因生物合成受損而下降的 NAD+ 水平，在肝細胞癌小鼠模型中同時防止了 DNA 損傷與腫瘤發生。

label: GPR109A
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) administration can elevate NAD+ levels in mammalian cells and tissues without activating GPR109A, the receptor that mediates nicotinic acid-induced flushing, which is why NR is not associated with the painful flushing side effect seen with niacin. Although nicotinic acid (NA) and nicotinamide (NAM) can enter the NAD+ salvage pathway, several preclinical studies have confirmed that both can cause painful flushing sensations at therapeutic doses or other toxic effects. NR, in contrast, was confirmed across a number of studies as well-tolerated up to 2 g of a daily dose, with no flushing or severe side effects reported.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）給藥能提升哺乳動物細胞與組織中的 NAD+ 水平，而無須活化 GPR109A（介導 nicotinic acid 誘發潮紅的受體），這就是為何 NR 與 niacin（菸鹼酸）所見的疼痛性潮紅副作用無關。儘管 nicotinic acid（NA）與 nicotinamide（NAM）能進入 NAD+ 回收路徑，數項臨床前研究已確認兩者皆可在治療劑量下造成疼痛性潮紅感或其他毒性作用。相對地，NR 在眾多研究中被確認每日劑量高達 2 g 仍耐受良好，且無潮紅或嚴重副作用的報告。

label: Lactobacillus
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) can selectively stimulate the growth of beneficial gut bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus. These bacteria are associated with improved gut health, including prevention of diarrhea, improved gut barrier function, reduced inflammation, and immune support. NR also modulates gut microbiota in ways protective against high-fat diet-induced weight gain: mice fed 60% HFD with 0.4% NR for 168 days had nearly 16% less weight gain and lower fasting blood glucose, and fecal transfer from NR-treated donors reproduced the protective effect with a microbiota enriched in butyrate-producing Firmicutes. NR thus reshapes the microbiome to favor metabolically beneficial bacteria.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）能選擇性地刺激有益腸道細菌如 Bifidobacterium 和 Lactobacillus 的生長。這些細菌與改善腸道健康相關，包括預防腹瀉、改善腸道屏障功能、減少發炎以及免疫支持。NR 也以對抗高脂飲食誘發體重增加的方式調節腸道菌叢：以含 0.4% NR 的 60% HFD 餵食 168 天的小鼠，體重增加減少近 16% 且空腹血糖較低，而來自 NR 處理供體的糞便移植重現了此保護效應，其菌叢富含產丁酸的 Firmicutes。NR 因此重塑微生物組以偏好代謝有益的細菌。

label: NAD+ Precursor
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is one of the most studied nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) precursors, and it is the third NAD+ precursor discovered, naturally occurring in milk and already commercially available as a nutraceutical. Alongside nicotinamide (NAM), nicotinic acid (NA), and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), NR feeds into NAD+ biosynthetic salvage pathways and is regarded as a favorable precursor because it lacks the serious side effects and flushing attributed to other NAD+ precursors, and because its chloride salt has been granted GRAS (generally regarded as safe) status.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）是研究最廣泛的菸鹼醯胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD+）前驅物之一，也是被發現的第三種 NAD+ 前驅物，天然存在於牛奶中，且已作為營養補充品商業化供應。與菸鹼醯胺（NAM）、菸鹼酸（NA）以及菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）並列，NR 進入 NAD+ 生物合成補救途徑，被視為一種理想的前驅物，因為它沒有歸因於其他 NAD+ 前驅物的嚴重副作用與潮紅反應，且其氯化物鹽已被授予 GRAS（generally regarded as safe）地位。

label: Milk
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is the third discovered NAD+ precursor and naturally occurs in milk, and it is already available as a nutraceutical, with its chloride salt given GRAS (generally regarded as safe) status. NAD+ intermediates such as NR are found in a wide variety of foods, including meat, eggs, dairy, certain vegetables, and whole wheat, and high availability of NR has been observed in the normal human diet. Oral supplementation with NR has been shown to increase NAD+ levels in multiple tissues along with increased sirtuin activity, improved mitochondrial function, and regenerative potential of stem cells, making NR a leading candidate among NAD+ precursors.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）是第三個被發現的 NAD+ 前驅物，天然存在於牛奶中，且已作為營養補充品可供使用，其氯化鹽被授予 GRAS（generally regarded as safe，一般認為安全）地位。諸如 NR 之類的 NAD+ 中間產物存在於多種食物中，包括肉類、蛋、乳製品、某些蔬菜與全麥，且在正常人類飲食中觀察到 NR 的高可用性。口服 NR 補充已被證實能提升多種組織中的 NAD+ 水平，同時伴隨 sirtuin 活性增加、粒線體功能改善與幹細胞的再生潛力，使 NR 成為 NAD+ 前驅物中的領先候選者。

label: Hepatic Steatosis
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md

label: Cardiac Remodeling
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation exhibits protective effects in adverse cardiac remodeling and prevents the deterioration of cardiac function and adverse remodeling in a mouse model of dilated cardiomyopathy leading to heart failure. NR normalizes the myocardial NAD+/NADH ratio, and long-term supplementation increases nucleocytoplasmic protein acetylation by stimulating citrate and acetyl-CoA metabolism and antioxidant gene expression. NAD+ precursor supplementation also protects against adverse cardiac remodeling by activating sirtuins and maintaining Ca2+ homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充在不良心臟重塑中展現保護作用，並在導致心衰竭的擴張型心肌病小鼠模型中預防心臟功能惡化與不良重塑。NR 使心肌 NAD+/NADH 比值正常化，而長期補充透過刺激檸檬酸與 acetyl-CoA 代謝以及抗氧化基因表現，增加核質蛋白乙醯化。NAD+ 前驅物補充亦透過活化 sirtuins 與維持 Ca2+ 恆定，保護免受不良心臟重塑。

label: Systolic Blood Pressure
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation reduces systolic blood pressure (SBP) and aortic stiffness, two clinically important risk indicators of cardiovascular function and health. These effects may occur through nuclear and cytosolic SIRT1 activation, since NAD+ is an obligate substrate for the deacetylase SIRT1, which has been implicated in the maintenance of healthy vascular function, including endothelium-dependent vascular relaxation. In mouse models, NR-induced reduction of SBP and aortic stiffness was documented alongside improved NAD+ homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充可降低收縮壓（SBP）與主動脈僵硬程度，這兩者是心血管功能與健康的臨床重要風險指標。這些效應可能經由核內與胞質中的 SIRT1 活化而發生，因為 NAD+ 是去乙醯酶 SIRT1 的必需受質，而 SIRT1 已被認為參與維持健康的血管功能，包括內皮依賴性血管舒張。在小鼠模型中，NR 誘發的 SBP 與主動脈僵硬程度降低，伴隨 NAD+ 恆定性的改善而被記錄下來。

label: Bovine Milk
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) was first discovered in milk and, until recently, had only been measured there. Bovine milk contains the highest NR content among milk sources at 0.5-3.6 uM, while human milk is the richest source of nicotinamide mononucleotide at 2.1-9.8 uM. NR and NMN are also determined in different species of milk and beer. The niacin quantified by microbiological assay (AOAC Method 944.13) actually includes NR and NMN, because hot acid or alkaline extraction hydrolyzes these molecules into nicotinic acid, meaning NR and NMN contribute to the measured niacin content of milk and other foods.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）最早在牛奶中被發現，且直到最近都只在那裡被測得。牛乳在乳源中 NR 含量最高，達 0.5-3.6 uM，而人乳是菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸最豐富的來源，達 2.1-9.8 uM。NR 和 NMN 也在不同物種的乳汁與啤酒中被測定。以微生物分析法（AOAC Method 944.13）定量出的菸鹼酸實際上包含 NR 和 NMN，因為熱酸或鹼性萃取會將這些分子水解為菸鹼酸，意味著 NR 和 NMN 貢獻了牛奶與其他食物中測得的菸鹼酸含量。

label: Macrophage Infiltration
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Preclinical studies have reported that nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces macrophage infiltration in damaged muscles and attenuates plasma TNF-alpha in models of fatty liver disease. These anti-inflammatory effects contribute to the improvement of metabolism and the decrease in chronic inflammation, a hallmark of aging, that underlie the life-prolonging benefits attributed to NR supplementation. Macrophage infiltration into injured tissue promotes inflammation and fibrosis, and its reduction by NR supports the management of muscular dystrophy and age-related tissue degeneration.
description_zh_TW: 臨床前研究報導，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）減少受損肌肉中的巨噬細胞浸潤，並在脂肪肝疾病模型中減弱血漿 TNF-alpha。這些抗發炎效果有助於代謝改善與慢性發炎（老化的標記）的降低，而後者構成了歸因於 NR 補充的延壽益處的基礎。巨噬細胞浸潤受傷組織會促進發炎與纖維化，而 NR 對其的減少支持了肌肉營養不良與年齡相關組織退化的管理。

label: Alcohol-Induced Depression
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: In mice, 10 weeks of nicotinamide riboside protected against alcohol-induced depression-like behavior via gut-microbiota shifts raising brain BDNF. FMT from treated donors reproduced protection, qualifying this as a model-organism edge.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠中十週 nicotinamide riboside 經由改變腸道菌群提高腦 BDNF，預防酒精誘發的憂鬱樣行為。受治供體的 FMT 重現保護，使此為模式生物邊。

label: Excitotoxicity
description: Excitotoxicity is a primary trigger causing axonal degeneration in part through calcium overload and energetic collapse. Overactivation converts signaling into structural destruction.
description_zh_TW: 興奮毒性是經由鈣超載與能量崩潰部分導致軸突退化的主要觸發。過度活化將訊號轉為結構破壞。

label: JAK
description: JAK (Janus kinase) phosphorylates latent cytoplasmic STAT transcription factors on tyrosine residues, triggering their dimerization and nuclear translocation.
description_zh_TW: JAK（Janus 激酶）對潛伏於胞質的 STAT 轉錄因子進行酪胺酸磷酸化，促使其二聚化並轉位入核。

label: Keap1-NRF2-ARE Pathway
description: In mitohormesis, elevated ROS activates the Keap1/NRF2/ARE pathway, driving transcription of cytoprotective vitagenes. This increases antioxidant enzymes, Hsp70, heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), neurotrophic factors, plus sirtuin and glutathione redox systems. The resulting adaptive stress response has longer-lasting protection than conventional antioxidants, especially in neurons.
description_zh_TW: 在 mitohormesis 中，升高的 ROS 會活化 Keap1/NRF2/ARE Pathway，驅動細胞保護性 Vitagenes 的轉錄。此過程增加抗氧化酶、Hsp70、heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1)、神經營養因子，以及 sirtuin 與穀胱甘肽氧化還原系統。所產生的適應性壓力反應比傳統抗氧化劑具有更持久的保護作用，尤其在神經元中。

label: SIRT3 via Nrf2
description: Liquiritigenin is a licorice-derived flavanone that induces Nrf2 translocation, thereby potentiating SIRT3 activity and facilitating mitochondrial biogenesis while suppressing apoptosis in acute kidney injury models, mitigating oxidative stress injury and cell death.
description_zh_TW: Liquiritigenin 是源自甘草的黃烷酮，誘導 Nrf2 轉位，從而增強 SIRT3 活性並促進粒線體生成，同時在急性腎損傷模型中抑制凋亡，減輕氧化壓力損傷和細胞死亡。

label: Locked Nucleic Acid
description: Locked nucleic acid (LNA) is a synthetic RNA analog that can be incorporated into antisense oligonucleotides and siRNAs to hybridize to target messenger RNA. Hybridizing an LNA raises melting temperature and protects against nucleases for potent silencing.
description_zh_TW: 鎖核酸（LNA）是合成 RNA 類似物，可整合入反義寡核苷酸與 siRNA 以雜交至目標信使 RNA。雜交 LNA 可提高熔解溫度並抵抗核酸酶，實現強效靜默。

label: lung cancer patients from healthy individuals
community_name: lung cancer patients from healthy individuals
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Serum SIRT3 distinguishes lung cancer patients from healthy individuals with an area under the curve of 0.918, an optimal cutoff value of 3.12, a sensitivity of 86.4%, and a specificity of 94%. Directionally, serum SIRT3 levels serve as a diagnostic biomarker for lung cancer. The high accuracy of SIRT3 in discriminating cancer patients supports its use as a blood-based marker for lung cancer screening or early detection, complementing SIRT expression differences observed between tumor and non-tumor lung tissue.
description_zh_TW: 血清SIRT3以0.918的曲線下面積、3.12的最佳截斷值、86.4%的靈敏度和94%的特異度區分肺癌患者與健康個體。方向上，血清SIRT3水平作為肺癌的診斷生物標誌物。SIRT3在區分癌症患者方面的高準確度支持其作為肺癌篩檢或早期偵測的血液標誌物的用途，補充了在腫瘤和非腫瘤肺組織之間觀察到的SIRT表達差異。

label: LXR Activation
description: Liver X receptor activation augments oxLDL-induced trained immunity, while LXR inhibition reduces the trained IL-6 and TNF-alpha cytokine response and H3K4me3-H3K27ac enrichment at inflammatory promoters. LXR thus acts as a nuclear-receptor amplifier of the CD36-TLR4 to mTOR-HIF-1alpha training circuit, linking sterol sensing to innate memory.
description_zh_TW: Liver X receptor 活化可增強 oxLDL 誘發的 trained immunity，而抑制 LXR 則降低訓練後的 IL-6 與 TNF-alpha 細胞激素反應及發炎啟動子上的 H3K4me3-H3K27ac 富集。因此 LXR 作為 CD36-TLR4 至 mTOR-HIF-1alpha 訓練迴路的核受體放大器，將固醇感測與先天記憶連結起來。

label: Lys68-acetylated MnSOD
description: Acetylation of MnSOD at Lys68 destabilizes the homotetramer, shifting it to a monomeric form that gains roughly 40-fold increased peroxidase activity instead of dismutase activity. This Lys68-acetylation switch converts MnSOD from a superoxide scavenger into a pro-oxidant that generates H2O2 via peroxidase chemistry, driving HIF2-alpha stabilization and cancer stemness.
description_zh_TW: MnSOD 在 Lys68 的乙醯化會破壞同源四聚體，使其轉變為單體形式，獲得約 40 倍的過氧化酶活性而非歧化酶活性。此 Lys68 乙醯化開關將 MnSOD 從超氧陰離子清除劑轉變為透過過氧化酶化學生成 H2O2 的促氧化劑，驅動 HIF2-alpha 穩定化和癌症幹性。

label: Lysosomal and autophagy genes
description: ZKSCAN3 is a zinc-finger transcription factor that represses the expression of lysosomal and autophagy genes, acting in opposition to TFEB/TFE3. Under basal conditions it limits autophagic and lysosomal capacity, and its inhibition or loss enhances cellular clearance. ZKSCAN3 thereby functions as a transcriptional brake on the degradative network, complementary to the post-translational repression by mTORC1. Targeting ZKSCAN3 has been proposed as a strategy to boost autophagy in disease.
description_zh_TW: ZKSCAN3 是一種鋅指轉錄因子，抑制溶酶體和自噬基因的表現，作用與 TFEB/TFE3 相反。在基礎條件下它限制自噬和溶酶體能力，其抑制或缺失則增強細胞清除。因此 ZKSCAN3 作為降解網絡的轉錄性制動，補充了 mTORC1 的轉譯後抑制。標靶 ZKSCAN3 已被提議作為在疾病中提升自噬的策略。

label: Male longevity beyond 90 years
description: A polymorphism in an intron-5 enhancer of the SIRT3 gene is associated with exceptional longevity, specifically survival beyond 90 years in men. The variant is thought to alter SIRT3 expression or regulation, conferring enhanced mitochondrial stress resistance and antioxidant capacity. Directionally, the genetic variation is associated with, and putatively causal of, prolonged lifespan. As a correlation it supports—but does not prove—that higher SIRT3 activity promotes human longevity, and it is consistent with separate findings linking SIRT3 single-nucleotide polymorphisms to longevity in other cohorts, including the TRELONG study, reinforcing SIRT3 as a candidate human longevity gene.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 基因內含子 5 增強子中的一個多態性與非凡長壽相關，具體為男性存活超過 90 年。該變異被認為改變 SIRT3 的表達或調節，賦予增強的粒線體壓力抗性和抗氧化能力。在方向性上，這種遺傳變異與延長的壽命相關，並推定為因果關係。作為相關性，它支持但並未證明更高的 SIRT3 活性促進人類長壽，與其他研究組（包括 TRELONG 研究）將 SIRT3 單核苷酸多態性與長壽聯繫起來的發現一致，強化了 SIRT3 作為人類長壽候選基因的地位。

label: SIRT3 gene variant (intron 5 enhancer)
description: A polymorphism in an intron-5 enhancer of the SIRT3 gene is associated with exceptional longevity, specifically survival beyond 90 years in men. The variant is thought to alter SIRT3 expression or regulation, conferring enhanced mitochondrial stress resistance and antioxidant capacity. Directionally, the genetic variation is associated with, and putatively causal of, prolonged lifespan. As a correlation it supports—but does not prove—that higher SIRT3 activity promotes human longevity, and it is consistent with separate findings linking SIRT3 single-nucleotide polymorphisms to longevity in other cohorts, including the TRELONG study, reinforcing SIRT3 as a candidate human longevity gene.

label: Manganese
description: Manganese is an essential trace metal required for enzymes such as MnSOD, but chronic overexposure is neurotoxic and produces a Parkinsonian-like disorder called manganism. Manganese preferentially accumulates in mitochondria and inhibits complex II.
description_zh_TW: 錳是 MnSOD 等酶所需的必需微量元素，但慢性過度暴露具有神經毒性，會產生稱為錳中毒（manganism）的帕金森樣疾病。錳優先累積於粒線體並抑制 complex II。

label: Manganism
description: Manganese is an essential trace metal required for enzymes such as MnSOD, but chronic overexposure is neurotoxic and produces a Parkinsonian-like disorder called manganism. Manganese preferentially accumulates in mitochondria and inhibits complex II.
description_zh_TW: 錳是 MnSOD 等酶所需的必需微量元素，但慢性過度暴露具有神經毒性，會產生稱為錳中毒（manganism）的帕金森樣疾病。錳優先累積於粒線體並抑制 complex II。

label: TFEB at S122/S109/S114
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: Protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A) dephosphorylates TFEB at serines 122, 109, and 114, removing repressive mTORC1 and other kinase marks to permit TFEB nuclear translocation. By counteracting the multiple N-terminal phosphorylations that enforce cytosolic retention, PP2A acts as a key permissive switch for TFEB activation. Its activity is regulated by nutrient state and by regulatory subunits that target it to TFEB. Through this dephosphorylation, PP2A enables the rapid engagement of lysosomal biogenesis when mTORC1 is inhibited.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白磷酸酶 2A（PP2A）在 serine 122、109 和 114 去磷酸化 TFEB，移除抑制性的 mTORC1 及其他激酶標記，以許可 TFEB 核轉運。透過對抗強制細胞質保留的多重 N 端磷酸化，PP2A 充當 TFEB 活化的關鍵許可開關。其活性受營養狀態以及將其標靶至 TFEB 的調節次單元所控制。透過此去磷酸化，PP2A 使得在 mTORC1 受抑制時能快速啟動溶酶體生物發生。

label: TSC1/TSC2
description: The TSC1-TSC2 tumor-suppressor complex acts as a GTPase-activating protein (GAP) for the small G protein Rheb, converting active GTP-bound Rheb to its inactive GDP-bound form. Because only GTP-Rheb directly activates mTORC1, TSC1/TSC2 functions as a critical upstream brake on mTORC1 in response to energy, oxygen, and growth-factor signals. Loss-of-function mutations in TSC1 or TSC2 cause tuberous sclerosis complex, characterized by constitutive mTORC1 activation, hamartoma formation, and autophagy suppression. The complex is therefore a major gatekeeper of mTORC1 and cellular growth.
description_zh_TW: TSC1-TSC2 腫瘤抑制複合物作為小 G 蛋白 Rheb 的 GTP 酶活化蛋白（GAP），將活化的 GTP 結合態 Rheb 轉化為其失活的 GDP 結合態。由於只有 GTP-Rheb 直接活化 mTORC1，TSC1/TSC2 在回應能量、氧氣和生長因子信號時，作為 mTORC1 關鍵的上游制動。TSC1 或 TSC2 的功能缺失突變導致結節性硬化症複合體，其特徵為 mTORC1 組成型活化、錯構瘤形成和自噬抑制。因此該複合物是 mTORC1 與細胞生長的主要守門者。

label: mTOR, Raptor, mLST8, PRAS40, Deptor
description: mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) is composed of five core subunits: the catalytic kinase mTOR, the scaffold Raptor (which binds substrates and Rag GTPases), mLST8 (stabilizing the kinase domain), the inhibitory subunit PRAS40, and the negative regulator Deptor. This stoichiometric assembly defines mTORC1's substrate specificity and its sensitivity to upstream inputs such as amino acids and insulin. Raptor is essential for recruitment of mTORC1 to lysosomes and for phosphorylation of canonical substrates like S6K1 and 4E-BP1. The composition distinguishes mTORC1 from mTORC2, which shares mTOR, mLST8, and Deptor but includes Rictor instead of Raptor.
description_zh_TW: mTOR 複合物 1（mTORC1）由五個核心次單元組成：催化激酶 mTOR、支架蛋白 Raptor（結合受質和 Rag GTPases）、mLST8（穩定激酶結構域）、抑制性次單元 PRAS40，以及負向調節者 Deptor。此化學計量組裝決定了 mTORC1 的受質專一性及其對胺基酸和胰島素等上游輸入的敏感性。Raptor 對於將 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體以及磷酸化 S6K1 和 4E-BP1 等典型受質至關重要。此組成將 mTORC1 與 mTORC2 區分開來，後者共享 mTOR、mLST8 和 Deptor，但包含 Rictor 而非 Raptor。

label: Lysosomal surface
description: mTORC1 is recruited to the lysosomal surface, where it encounters its activator Rheb and receives upstream amino-acid and growth-factor inputs necessary for full activation. This spatial recruitment, mediated by Rag GTPases and the Ragulator scaffold, converts the lysosome into the signaling platform for mTORC1. Only when docked at the lysosome can mTORC1 efficiently phosphorylate its substrates, including TFEB and ULK1. Thus lysosomal localization is essential for mTORC1 function and for its inhibition of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 被招募至溶酶體表面，在此它遇到其活化劑 Rheb，並接收上游胺基酸和生長因子輸入以達到完全活化。這種由 Rag GTPases 和 Ragulator 支架介導的空間招募，將溶酶體轉化為 mTORC1 的信號平台。唯有停靠於溶酶體時，mTORC1 才能有效磷酸化其受質，包括 TFEB 和 ULK1。因此溶酶體定位對 mTORC1 功能及其對自噬的抑制至為關鍵。

label: TFE3 at S321
description: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFE3 at serine 321, an analog of the TFEB S211 site, thereby promoting cytosolic retention and inhibiting TFE3's transcriptional activity under nutrient-replete conditions. This parallel modification ensures that both MiT/TFE family master regulators are coordinately repressed by mTORC1. Upon starvation or mTORC1 inhibition, dephosphorylation permits TFE3 nuclear entry and activation of lysosomal genes. The conserved regulatory logic highlights the unified control of the degradative program.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 321 磷酸化 TFE3，此位點是 TFEB S211 位點的類似物，從而在營養充足條件下促進細胞質保留並抑制 TFE3 的轉錄活性。此平行修飾確保 MiT/TFE 家族的兩個主調節者都被 mTORC1 協調抑制。在飢餓或 mTORC1 抑制時，去磷酸化允許 TFE3 核進入和溶酶體基因的活化。保守的調節邏輯凸顯了對降解程序的統一控制。

label: TFEB at Ser142/Ser211
description: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at both serine 142 and serine 211, two residues whose combined modification enforces 14-3-3 binding and robust cytosolic retention of the transcription factor. These sites act synergistically to prevent TFEB nuclear entry and thus block activation of the autophagy-lysosomal program under nutrient-replete conditions. Dephosphorylation of both marks is required for full TFEB activation during starvation. The dual-site control exemplifies the redundancy mTORC1 employs to firmly suppress degradative transcription.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 142 和 serine 211 兩處磷酸化 TFEB，這兩個殘基的聯合修飾強制了 14-3-3 結合以及該轉錄因子穩健的細胞質保留。這些位點協同作用以防止 TFEB 核進入，從而在營養充足條件下阻斷自噬—溶酶體程序的活化。飢餓期間必須將這兩個標記都去磷酸化，TFEB 才能完全活化。雙位點控制具體體現了 mTORC1 用以牢牢抑制降解轉錄的冗餘機制。

label: TFEB at S122
description: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 122, an additional N-terminal regulatory site that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor under nutrient-rich conditions. Alongside S142 and S211, S122 forms part of the multi-site phosphorylation code through which mTORC1 enforces TFEB exclusion from the nucleus. Dephosphorylation of these sites by phosphatases such as PP2A is required for nuclear translocation. The multiplicity of mTORC1 sites provides tunable, robust control of lysosomal gene transcription.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 122 磷酸化 TFEB，這是營養豐裕條件下促進該轉錄因子細胞質保留的額外 N 端調節位點。與 S142 和 S211 並列，S122 構成 mTORC1 用以將 TFEB 排除於核外之多位點磷酸化密碼的一部分。這些位點經 PP2A 等磷酸酶去磷酸化，是核轉運所必需的。mTORC1 多重位點的設計提供了對溶酶體基因轉錄可調、穩健的控制。

label: TFEB at S138
description: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 138, a residue also modified by GSK3β, and this phosphorylation promotes nuclear export of TFEB, complementing the cytosolic retention imposed at other sites. The accumulation of phosphates across the N-terminal regulatory region collectively suppresses TFEB transcriptional activity. Relief of S138 phosphorylation facilitates nuclear accumulation and activation of the autophagy-lysosomal program. This site therefore participates in the coordinated mTORC1 restraint of cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 138 磷酸化 TFEB，此殘基亦受 GSK3β 修飾，此磷酸化促進 TFEB 的核輸出，補足其他位點施加的細胞質保留。N 端調節區磷酸根的增加共同抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。S138 磷酸化的解除有利於自噬—溶酶體程序的核累積與活化。因此此位點參與了 mTORC1 對細胞清除的協調性約束。

label: Protein synthesis
description: mTORC1 promotes cap-dependent protein synthesis by phosphorylating the eukaryotic initiation factor 4E-binding protein 1 (4E-BP1), releasing eIF4E to initiate translation, and by phosphorylating S6 kinase 1 (S6K1), which enhances ribosome biogenesis and translational capacity. These outputs prioritize anabolic processes when nutrients and growth factors are plentiful. The stimulation of protein synthesis is a major consumer of cellular energy and amino acids, balanced against the catabolic program of autophagy. Dysregulated mTORC1-driven translation contributes to hypertrophy and malignancy.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 透過磷酸化真核起始因子 4E 結合蛋白 1（4E-BP1）促進帽依賴性蛋白質合成，釋放 eIF4E 以起始轉譯，並透過磷酸化 S6 激酶 1（S6K1）增強核醣體生物發生和轉譯能力。這些輸出在營養和生長因子充裕時優先安排合成代謝過程。蛋白質合成的刺激是細胞能量和胺基酸的主要消耗者，需與自噬的分解代謝程序取得平衡。失調的 mTORC1 驅動轉譯促成肥大和惡性腫瘤。

label: Lipid synthesis
description: mTORC1 promotes lipid and cholesterol synthesis by activating the sterol regulatory element-binding proteins (SREBP1) and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ), transcription factors that drive expression of lipogenic and adipogenic enzymes. This anabolic output supports membrane biogenesis and energy storage during growth. The lipid-synthetic program is coordinated with mTORC1's stimulation of protein and nucleotide synthesis to build cellular mass. Its dysregulation contributes to hepatic steatosis and metabolic syndrome.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 透過活化固醇調節元件結合蛋白（SREBP1）和過氧化物酶體增殖物活化受體 gamma（PPARγ）——驅動脂肪生成和成脂酵素表現的轉錄因子——來促進脂質和膽固醇合成。此合成代謝輸出在生長期間支持膜生物發生和能量儲存。脂質合成程序與 mTORC1 對蛋白質和核苷酸合成的刺激協調，以建構細胞質量。其失調促成肝臟脂肪變性和代謝症候群。

label: Benign Tumor
description: Benign tumors are dual-natured: OIS-type arrested lesions (nevi) are longevity-positive cancer barriers, whereas growth-signal-driven benign growths such as TSC1/TSC2-loss mTORC1 hamartomas are themselves disease (Tuberous Sclerosis, angiomyolipoma, epilepsy). Arrested growth is good; ongoing growth is bad.
description_zh_TW: 良性腫瘤具有雙重本質：OIS 型停滯病灶（痣）是長壽正向的癌症屏障，而由生長訊號驅動的良性生長（如 TSC1/TSC2 缺失 mTORC1 錯構瘤）本身即是疾病（結節性硬化症、血管肌脂肪瘤、癲癇）。停滯的生長是好的；持續的生長是壞的。

label: TSC1
description: Loss of TSC1 or TSC2 removes the GAP that restrains Rheb, causing constitutive mTORC1 hyperactivation that drives benign hamartomas (Tuberous Sclerosis, renal angiomyolipoma, epilepsy, autism). Here benign growth is itself the disease, contrasting with the protective OIS-type benign lesion.
description_zh_TW: TSC1 或 TSC2 缺失移除抑制 Rheb 的 GAP，造成組成性 mTORC1 過度活化，驅動良性錯構瘤（結節性硬化症、腎血管肌脂肪瘤、癲癇、自閉症）。此處良性生長本身就是疾病，與保護性 OIS 型良性病灶形成對比。

label: ULK1 (at Ser757)
description: Under nutrient-rich conditions, mTORC1 phosphorylates ULK1 at Ser757, disrupting its interaction with AMPK and suppressing autophagy. Directionally, mTORC1 sits upstream of ULK1 inhibition. This couples nutrient abundance to autophagic restraint, and it is the basis for rapamycin's autophagy-promoting effects. Sirtuin and AMPK activation opposes mTORC1 to relicense ULK1, connecting sirtuin biology to the nutrient-sensing control of autophagy. The AMPK-mTORC1-ULK1 network is a central regulatory circuit that determines autophagic flux in response to energy and growth signals.
description_zh_TW: 在營養豐富條件下，mTORC1 在 Ser757 位點磷酸化 ULK1，破壞其與 AMPK 的相互作用並抑制自噬。在方向性上，mTORC1 位於 ULK1 抑制的上游。這將營養豐富與自噬抑制偶聯，也是 rapamycin 促自噬效應的基礎。Sirtuin 和 AMPK 活化反對 mTORC1 以重新啟用 ULK1，將 sirtuin 生物學與自噬的營養感知控制聯繫起來。AMPK-mTORC1-UNK1 網絡是決定自噬通量的核心調控迴路，回應能量和生長訊號。

label: Amino Acid Sensing
description: The lysosomal amino-acid sensing axis regulates mTORC1 recruitment and activation. Regulation is the hub triple.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體胺基酸感知軸調節 mTORC1 招募與活化。調節是樞紐 triple。

label: SLC38A9
description: The lysosomal arginine transporter SLC38A9 is required for arginine-dependent mTORC1 activation. Activation is the transporter input.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體精胺酸轉運體 SLC38A9 為精胺酸依賴 mTORC1 活化所需。活化是轉運體輸入。

label: MAP4K3
description: MAP4K3 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 3, an N-terminal modification that primes TFEB for subsequent phosphorylation at S211 by mTORC1. This hierarchical phosphorylation reveals that TFEB regulation involves ordered, multi-site modification in which upstream kinases license downstream ones. By enabling the mTORC1 repressive mark, MAP4K3 integrates amino-acid and growth-factor inputs into TFEB control. The finding adds a further layer of complexity to the kinase network governing lysosomal gene transcription.
description_zh_TW: MAP4K3 於 serine 3 磷酸化 TFEB，這是一種使 TFEB 為後續 mTORC1 在 S211 的磷酸化做準備的 N 端修飾。這種階層性磷酸化顯示 TFEB 調節涉及有序的多位點修飾，其中上游激酶許可下游激酶。透過啟用 mTORC1 抑制性標記，MAP4K3 將胺基酸和生長因子輸入整合進 TFEB 控制中。此發現為控制溶酶體基因轉錄的激酶網絡增添了進一步的複雜層次。

label: TFEB at S3
description: MAP4K3 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 3, an N-terminal modification that primes TFEB for subsequent phosphorylation at S211 by mTORC1. This hierarchical phosphorylation reveals that TFEB regulation involves ordered, multi-site modification in which upstream kinases license downstream ones. By enabling the mTORC1 repressive mark, MAP4K3 integrates amino-acid and growth-factor inputs into TFEB control. The finding adds a further layer of complexity to the kinase network governing lysosomal gene transcription.
description_zh_TW: MAP4K3 於 serine 3 磷酸化 TFEB，這是一種使 TFEB 為後續 mTORC1 在 S211 的磷酸化做準備的 N 端修飾。這種階層性磷酸化顯示 TFEB 調節涉及有序的多位點修飾，其中上游激酶許可下游激酶。透過啟用 mTORC1 抑制性標記，MAP4K3 將胺基酸和生長因子輸入整合進 TFEB 控制中。此發現為控制溶酶體基因轉錄的激酶網絡增添了進一步的複雜層次。

label: Matrine
description: Matrine is a quinolizidine alkaloid from Sophora flavescens. It protects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway and confers cardiovascular benefits via the SIRT3/AMPK pathway, preserving cardiomyocyte viability and limiting cell death.
description_zh_TW: Matrine 是來自苦參的喹諾里西啶生物鹼。它透過 SIRT3/OPA1 途徑調節粒線體膜動態對抗 Cisplatin 誘導的 AKI 發揮保護作用，並透過 SIRT3/AMPK 途徑賦予心血管益處，維護心肌細胞存活率並限制細胞死亡。

label: SIRT3/OPA1 pathway
description: Matrine is a quinolizidine alkaloid from Sophora flavescens. It protects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway and confers cardiovascular benefits via the SIRT3/AMPK pathway, preserving cardiomyocyte viability and limiting cell death.
description_zh_TW: Matrine 是來自苦參的喹諾里西啶生物鹼。它透過 SIRT3/OPA1 途徑調節粒線體膜動態對抗 Cisplatin 誘導的 AKI 發揮保護作用，並透過 SIRT3/AMPK 途徑賦予心血管益處，維護心肌細胞存活率並限制細胞死亡。

label: MAVS
description: Cytosolic mitochondrial double-stranded RNA released through BAX/BAK pores binds RIG-I and MDA5, causing MAVS aggregation that induces a subset of SASP factors; MAVS signaling is milder than STING and converges on shared inflammatory pathways.
description_zh_TW: 經 BAX/BAK 孔釋放到胞質的粒線體雙股 RNA 結合 RIG-I 與 MDA5，引起 MAVS 聚集並誘導部分 SASP 因子；MAVS 訊號較 STING溫和，並匯聚於共同的發炎路徑。

label: mt-dsRNA
description: Cytosolic mitochondrial double-stranded RNA released through BAX/BAK pores binds RIG-I and MDA5, causing MAVS aggregation that induces a subset of SASP factors; MAVS signaling is milder than STING and converges on shared inflammatory pathways.
description_zh_TW: 經 BAX/BAK 孔釋放到胞質的粒線體雙股 RNA 結合 RIG-I 與 MDA5，引起 MAVS 聚集並誘導部分 SASP 因子；MAVS 訊號較 STING溫和，並匯聚於共同的發炎路徑。

label: Melatonin in DCM
description: Mst1 (STK4) is a Hippo-pathway kinase that promotes apoptosis and suppresses protective autophagy. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin counteracts adverse left-ventricle remodeling by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, promoting autophagy, reducing apoptosis, and mitigating mitochondrial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Mst1（STK4）是一種 Hippo 途徑激酶，促進凋亡並抑制保護性自噬。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 對抗不良的左心室重塑，促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙。

label: Mst1
description: Mst1 (STK4) is a Hippo-pathway kinase that promotes apoptosis and suppresses protective autophagy. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin counteracts adverse left-ventricle remodeling by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, promoting autophagy, reducing apoptosis, and mitigating mitochondrial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Mst1（STK4）是一種 Hippo 途徑激酶，促進凋亡並抑制保護性自噬。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 對抗不良的左心室重塑，促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙。

label: PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis
description: Meteorin-like (Metrnl) activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, stimulating AMPK at Thr172 and increasing UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism in diabetic nephropathy.
description_zh_TW: Meteorin-like（Metrnl）活化 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線，在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，在糖尿病腎病變中維護粒線體超微結構完整性並調節能量代謝。

label: MHY2245
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: MHY2245, a new SIRT1 inhibitor, exerts antitumor activity against ovarian cancer cells by blocking the pyruvate kinase M2/mTOR pathway. Directionally, MHY2245 sits upstream of suppressed PKM2/mTOR signaling and reduced ovarian cancer cell survival. By inhibiting SIRT1 and consequently the PKM2/mTOR pathway, MHY2245 curbs tumor-cell metabolism and growth. This supports SIRT1 inhibition as a therapeutic strategy in ovarian cancer, where SIRT1 inhibition of HMGB1 also suppresses metastasis and angiogenesis.
description_zh_TW: MHY2245是一種新型SIRT1抑制劑，透過阻斷丙酮酸激酶M2/mTOR通路對卵巢癌細胞發揮抗腫瘤活性。方向上，MHY2245位於PKM2/mTOR訊號抑制和卵巢癌細胞存活降低的上游。透過抑制SIRT1及隨後的PKM2/mTOR通路，MHY2245限制腫瘤細胞的代謝和生長。這支持SIRT1抑制作為卵巢癌的治療策略，其中SIRT1對HMGB1的抑制也抑制了轉移和血管新生。

label: Microfluidic mobility shift assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The microfluidic mobility shift assay separates SIRT1 substrate and product peptides by differences in electrophoretic mobility caused by charge and mass changes upon lysine deacetylation, quantitating fluorescence of both peaks. The assay effectively separates neutral-acetylated substrate peptides from deacetylated products bearing an additional positive charge. Although it could support high-throughput screening, it is more suitable for hit confirmation and mechanistic studies. Directionally, it provides a label-based yet artifact-minimized readout of SIRT1 activity distinct from fluorophore-release assays.
description_zh_TW: 微流體遷移率位移測定透過離胺酸去乙醯化引起的電荷和質量變化所導致的電泳遷移率差異來分離 SIRT1 受質和產物胜肽，量化兩個峰的螢光。該測定有效地將中性乙醯化受質胜肽與帶有額外正電荷的去乙醯化產物分開。儘管它可用於高通量篩選，但更適合用於命中確認和機制研究。方向性上它提供了一種基於標記但假象最小化的 SIRT1 活性讀取方式，與螢光基團釋放測定不同。

label: Neutral Red
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Neutral red (NR), a phenazine formed by substituting nitrogen for the position-5 sulfur of the phenothiazine nucleus, retained the ability to increase cellular oxygen consumption (OCR) in Seahorse assays, similar to methylene blue and toluidine blue O, and these three compounds share similar negative redox potentials. However, NR had markedly weaker neuroprotective potency than MB in the glutamate, rotenone, and IAA assays and does not function as an alternative electron-transfer carrier in mitochondria, indicating that oxygen-consumption enhancement alone does not confer neuroprotection and that electron-shunt activity is the key protective feature.
description_zh_TW: 中性紅（NR）是一種由苯噻嗪核第5位硫被氮取代形成的吩嗪，在Seahorse分析中保留了增加細胞氧消耗率（OCR）的能力，類似於亞甲藍和甲苯胺藍O，這三種化合物具有相似的負氧化還原電位。然而，在麩氨酸、rotenone和IAA分析中，NR的神經保護效力明顯弱於MB，且不作為粒線體中的替代電子轉運載體發揮作用，表明僅增強氧消耗並不能賦予神經保護作用，而電子分流活性是關鍵的保護特徵。

label: Mitochondrial Uncoupling
description: Nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase (NNT) uses the proton gradient to drive NADPH production from NADP+ and NADH. By linking redox state to the proton motive force, NNT connects to mitochondrial uncoupling and the NADPH pools used by antioxidant systems.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核苷酸轉氫酶（NNT）利用質子梯度從 NADP+ 與 NADH 驅動 NADPH 生成。透過將氧化還原狀態與質子動力相連結，NNT 與粒線體解偶聯及抗氧化系統使用的 NADPH 池相關。

label: Mitosis (G2/M phase)
description: SIRT2 protein levels rise dramatically as cells enter mitosis, and the enzyme is hyperphosphorylated at the G2/M boundary, timing its activity to chromosome condensation and division. This cell-cycle coupling links SIRT2 to proper mitotic progression and genomic stability, with the enzyme regulating both tubulin dynamics and chromatin state during division. Directionally, the G2/M transition drives SIRT2 upregulation and activation, and at mitotic exit the phosphatase CDC14B dephosphorylates SIRT2 to trigger its degradation. Loss or dysregulation of this mitotic peak is associated with aneuploidy, mitotic defects, and, in some cancers, genomic instability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 蛋白水平在細胞進入有絲分裂時急劇上升，該酶在 G2/M 邊界處被超磷酸化，將其活性時間定在染色體凝縮和分裂時。這種細胞週期偶聯將 SIRT2 與正確的有絲分裂進展和基因組穩定性聯繫起來，該酶在分裂期間同時調節微管動態和染色質狀態。在方向性上，G2/M 轉變驅動 SIRT2 上調和活化，在有絲分裂退出時磷酸酶 CDC14B 去磷酸化 SIRT2 以觸發其降解。此有絲分裂高峰的缺失或失調與非整倍性、有絲分裂缺陷以及某些癌症中的基因組不穩定性相關。
