label: Signaling Molecules
description: Hydrogen peroxide acts as a signaling molecule, functioning as a second messenger in insulin signaling, growth-factor pathways, and immune responses. Its relatively long half-life and membrane permeability allow it to diffuse and oxidize specific targets reversibly. The directionality is H2O2 from enzyme or leak to signal propagation. A caveat is that the same molecule is toxic at higher concentrations, so concentration and compartmentalization determine whether H2O2 signals or damages. Reversible oxidation of target cysteines, such as those in PTP1B and PTEN, allows H2O2 to propagate kinase-dependent responses.
description_zh_TW: Hydrogen peroxide 作為訊號分子，在胰島素訊號、生長因子途徑和免疫反應中充當第二信使。其相對較長的半衰期和膜滲透性使其能夠可逆地擴散和氧化特定標靶。方向性是 H2O2 從酵素或洩漏到訊號傳播。需要注意的是，相同的分子在較高濃度下是有毒的，因此濃度和區室化決定了 H2O2 是否發出訊號或造成損害。目標半胱氨酸（例如 PTP1B 和 PTEN 中的半胱氨酸）的可逆氧化使 H2O2 能夠傳播激酶依賴性反應。

label: Cysteine Thiols
description: Hydrogen peroxide oxidizes cysteine thiols, transducing signals through reversible oxidation to sulfenic acid, disulfide, or higher oxides that alter protein activity. This post-translational modification is a core mechanism by which oxidants regulate phosphatases, kinases, and transcription factors. The directionality is oxidant to thiol modification to functional change. A caveat is that excessive or irreversible over-oxidation (sulfinic/sulfonic acid) leads to loss of function and damage rather than signaling.
description_zh_TW: Hydrogen peroxide 氧化 cysteine thiols，透過可逆氧化將訊號轉化成次磺酸、二硫化物或改變蛋白質活性的高級氧化物。這種翻譯後修飾是氧化劑調節磷酸酶、激酶和轉錄因子的核心機制。方向性是氧化劑到硫醇修飾到功能變化。需要注意的是，過度或不可逆的過度氧化（亞磺酸/磺酸）會導致功能喪失和損傷，而不是訊號傳導。

label: Oxidized Methionine
description: Methionine sulfoxide reductases repair oxidized methionine by reducing methionine sulfoxide back to methionine using the thioredoxin system. This restores protein function and acts as an antioxidant defense because methionine oxidation can be a benign, reversible sink for oxidants. The directionality is MsrA/MsrB-catalyzed reduction to repaired protein. A caveat is that repeated oxidation and repair of the same residue has a kinetic cost and is not unlimited, so chronic stress still accrues damage.
description_zh_TW: Methionine sulfoxide reductases 透過使用硫氧還蛋白系統將甲硫胺酸亞砜還原回甲硫胺酸來修復 oxidized methionine。這可以恢復蛋白質功能並起到抗氧化防禦作用，因為蛋氨酸氧化可以成為氧化劑的良性、可逆的吸收池。方向性是 MsrA/MsrB 催化還原為修復蛋白。需要注意的是，相同殘留物的重複氧化和修復會產生動力成本，而且不是無限的，因此慢性壓力仍然會造成損害。

label: Tetrahydrobiopterin
description: Peroxynitrite oxidizes tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) to BH2, depriving eNOS of its essential cofactor and thereby promoting eNOS uncoupling and superoxide production. This establishes a feed-forward loop of vascular oxidative stress. The directionality is nitration of cofactor to enzyme dysfunction. A caveat is that BH4 can be regenerated by dihydrofolate reductase, partially buffering peroxynitrite-driven loss. Restoring BH4 by supplementation or by dihydrofolate reductase-dependent recycling re-couples eNOS and improves endothelial function in experimental studies.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 將 tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) 氧化為 BH2，剝奪 eNOS 的必需輔助因子，進而促進 eNOS 解偶聯和超氧化物產生。這就建立了血管oxidative stress的前饋迴路。方向性是輔因子硝化導致酵素功能障礙。需要注意的是，BH4 可以透過二氫葉酸還原酶再生，部分緩衝 peroxynitrite 驅動的損失。在實驗研究中，透過補充或二氫葉酸還原酶依賴性回收來恢復 BH4 可重新偶聯 eNOS 並改善內皮功能。

label: Antioxidant
description: Melatonin is described as a critical, mitochondria-targeted antioxidant whose endogenous production is maximized by ensuring complete darkness during sleep. Circadian alignment and sleep hygiene are presented as high-impact behaviors supporting the mitohormesis protocol, since deep sleep is when cellular repair and neural recovery occur. The document ties melatonin production to sleep quality, which in turn determines overnight HRV and recovery capacity, completing the loop between circadian biology, antioxidant defenses, and mitochondrial adaptation.
description_zh_TW: 褪黑激素被描述為一種關鍵的、以粒線體為標靶的抗氧化劑，其內源性生成可藉由確保睡眠期間完全黑暗而最大化。晝夜節律對齊與睡眠衛生被呈現為支持粒線體毒物興奮效應（mitohormesis）方案的高影響力行為，因為深度睡眠是細胞修復與神經恢復發生的時刻。該文件將褪黑激素生成與睡眠品質連結，而睡眠品質又決定整夜 HRV 與恢復能力，在晝夜節律生物學、抗氧化防禦與粒線體適應之間完成迴路。

label: SIRT1 deacetylation of FOXO3a
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Deacetylated FOXO3a transcriptionally upregulates endogenous antioxidant enzymes, prominently mitochondrial MnSOD and catalase, bolstering ROS scavenging. Directionally, SIRT1 deacetylates FOXO3a to drive increased antioxidant capacity. This reduces oxidative damage in resveratrol-treated cells and animals, and it is a central mechanism for sirtuin-mediated protection against aging and metabolic disease. The same FOXO3a-dependent antioxidant program is engaged by SIRT3 in mitochondria and is complemented by FOXO1- and FOXO4-mediated stress responses, establishing the sirtuin-FOXO axis as a primary node coupling nutrient sensing to cellular redox defense.
description_zh_TW: 去乙醯化的 FOXO3a 在轉錄水平上調內源性抗氧化酶，特別是粒線體 MnSOD 和 catalase，增強 ROS 清除能力。在方向性上，SIRT1 去乙醯化 FOXO3a 以驅動增加的抗氧化能力。這減少白藜蘆醇處理的細胞和動物中的氧化損傷，是 sirtuin 介導的抗衰老和代謝疾病保護的核心機制。同樣的 FOXO3a 依賴性抗氧化程序在粒線體中被 SIRT3 啟動，並與 FOXO1 和 FOXO4 介導的壓力反應互補，確立 sirtuin-FOXO 軸作為將營養感知與細胞氧化還原防禦偶聯的主要節點。

label: DNA-binding domain
description: Not every CxxC sequence is redox-active: CxxC-type zinc-binding modules, such as the CFP1/MLL1 DNA-binding domains, coordinate zinc and recognize unmethylated CpG in chromatin and DNA recognition rather than catalyzing thiol-disulfide exchange. The variable residues between the cysteines tune the motif's redox potential and substrate selectivity.
description_zh_TW: 並非每個 CxxC 序列都具有氧化還原活性：CxxC 型鋅結合模組（如 CFP1/MLL1 的 DNA 結合域）配位鋅並辨識未甲基化的 CpG，用於染色質與 DNA 辨識，而非催化硫醇-雙硫交換。兩個半胱氨酸之間的變異殘基會調整基序的氧化還原電位與受質選擇性。

label: Cytochrome c Oxidase
description: Peroxynitrite inactivates cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV of the respiratory chain) through tyrosine nitration, contributing to bioenergetic failure. Among the 20-50 proteins preferentially nitrated in vivo are MnSOD, cytochrome c oxidase, aconitase, and glutamine synthetase. Tyrosine nitration typically inactivates these enzymes, causing loss of function.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過酪氨酸硝化使 cytochrome c oxidase（呼吸鏈的 Complex IV）失活，促成生物能量衰竭。在體內優先被硝化的 20-50 種蛋白質中，包括 MnSOD、cytochrome c oxidase、aconitase 與 glutamine synthetase。酪氨酸硝化通常使這些酵素失活，造成功能喪失。

label: Mitochondrial Catalase
description: Only mitochondria-targeted catalase (mCAT) extends median lifespan ~20% (Schriner 2005); cytosolic catalase is null (Perez 2009). Qualified subject replaces the overstated generic edge.
description_zh_TW: 僅粒線體標靶 catalase（mCAT）延長中位壽命約 20%（Schriner 2005）；胞質 catalase 無效（Perez 2009）。限定主詞取代誇大的通用邊。

label: mLST8
description: mLST8 loss abolishes AKT-S473, SGK1 and PKCalpha phosphorylation by mTORC2. Requirement is the assembly dependency.
description_zh_TW: mLST8 缺失廢除 mTORC2 對 AKT-S473、SGK1 與 PKCα 磷酸化。必要性是組裝依賴。

label: mTORC2 assembly
description: mLST8 loss abolishes AKT-S473, SGK1 and PKCalpha phosphorylation by mTORC2. Requirement is the assembly dependency.
description_zh_TW: mLST8 缺失廢除 mTORC2 對 AKT-S473、SGK1 與 PKCα 磷酸化。必要性是組裝依賴。

label: Model System
description: Sunflower (Helianthus annuus L.) microgreens are presented both as nutritious superfoods and as model systems for studying plant stress responses. The ten-day hydroponic root-dipping assay across 0-100 mM NaCl enabled parallel measurement of growth, stress biomarkers, and nutritional traits. This dual food-model role motivates salt eustress as an agronomic elicitor.
description_zh_TW: 向日葵（Helianthus annuus L.）苗菜同時被視為營養超級食物與研究植物壓力反應的 Model System。為期十天、0-100 mM NaCl 的水耕浸根試驗可平行量測生長、壓力生物標誌與營養性狀。這種食用與模式雙重角色使鹽 eustress 成為具吸引力的農藝誘導手段。

label: MPTP and kainic acid neuronal damage
community_name: MPTP and kainic acid neuronal damage
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Mice lacking PGC-1α are markedly more sensitive to neuronal loss induced by MPTP, a dopaminergic toxin, and kainic acid, an excitotoxin, revealing PGC-1αs role in neuronal stress resistance. Because SIRT1 activates PGC-1α by deacetylation, this sensitivity indirectly implicates the SIRT1/PGC-1α axis in neuroprotection. Directionally, PGC-1α deficiency heightens vulnerability to these insults, while its activation confers resistance. Since PGC-1α drives mitochondrial biogenesis and antioxidant gene expression, protecting neurons through this axis is a proposed strategy against Parkinsons disease and other neurodegenerative disorders.
description_zh_TW: 缺乏 PGC-1α 的小鼠對 MPTP（多巴胺能毒素）和 kainic acid（興奮性毒素）誘導的神經元損失明顯更敏感，揭示了 PGC-1α 在神經元壓力抗性中的作用。由於 SIRT1 通過去乙醯化活化 PGC-1α，這種敏感性間接將 SIRT1/PGC-1α 軸與神經保護聯繫起來。在方向性上，PGC-1α 缺乏增加了對這些損傷的脆弱性，而其活化賦予抗性。由於 PGC-1α 驅動粒線體生物合成和抗氧化基因表達，通過此軸保護神經元是針對帕金森症和其他神經退行性疾病的擬議策略。

community_name: MPTP and kainic acid neuronal damage

Directionally, PGC-1α deficiency heightens vulnerability to these insults, while its activation confers resistance. Since PGC-1α drives mitochondrial biogenesis and antioxidant gene expression, protecting neurons through this axis is a proposed strategy against Parkinsons disease and other neurodegenerative disorders.
description_zh_TW: 缺乏 PGC-1α 的小鼠對 MPTP（多巴胺能毒素）和 kainic acid（興奮性毒素）誘導的神經元損失明顯更敏感，揭示了 PGC-1α 在神經元壓力抗性中的作用。由於 SIRT1 通過去乙醯化活化 PGC-1α，這種敏感性間接將 SIRT1/PGC-1α 軸與神經保護聯繫起來。在方向性上，PGC-1α 缺乏增加了對這些損傷的脆弱性，而其活化賦予抗性。由於 PGC-1α 驅動粒線體生物合成和抗氧化基因表達，通過此軸保護神經元是針對帕金森症和其他神經退行性疾病的擬議策略。

label: mTORC1 under hypoxia
description: REDD1 (regulated in development and DNA damage responses 1) inhibits mTORC1 specifically under hypoxia by binding and releasing TSC2 from inhibitory 14-3-3 association, thereby activating the TSC GAP complex. This allows Rheb to be converted to its inactive GDP form and mTORC1 to be suppressed, conserving energy when oxygen is limiting. REDD1 thus provides a hypoxia-responsive brake that engages autophagy and limits anabolic consumption. Its induction is transcriptionally controlled by HIF-1α, integrating oxygen sensing with mTORC1 regulation.
description_zh_TW: REDD1（發育與 DNA 損傷反應中受調節者 1）在缺氧條件下特異性地抑制 mTORC1，透過結合並將 TSC2 從抑制性的 14-3-3 聯合中釋放出來，從而活化 TSC GAP 複合物。這使得 Rheb 被轉化為其失活的 GDP 形式，mTORC1 被抑制，以在氧氣受限時節省能量。因此 REDD1 提供了一個對缺氧有反應的制動，啟動自噬並限制合成代謝消耗。它的誘發受 HIF-1α 轉錄控制，將氧氣感知與 mTORC1 調節整合起來。

label: Mus musculus
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: P66shc knockout mice live about 30% longer than wild-type controls and show enhanced resistance to oxidative stress and age-related pathologies, indicating P66shc is a negative regulator of longevity. Directionally, loss of P66shc extends lifespan. This makes P66shc an attractive node, with SIRT1 as an upstream suppressor, for longevity interventions.
description_zh_TW: P66shc 基因敲除小鼠比野生型對照多活約 30%，並表現出對氧化壓力和年齡相關病變的增強抵抗力，表明 P66shc 是壽命的負向調節因子。方向性上 P66shc 的缺失延長壽命。這使 P66shc 成為一個有吸引力的節點，以 SIRT1 作為上游抑制因子，用於長壽介入措施。

label: PCAF/GCN5
description: The positive histone acetyltransferases PCAF and GCN5 acetylate the myogenic transcription factor MyoD, enhancing its DNA-binding and recruitment of transcriptional machinery. Directionally, PCAF/GCN5 sits upstream of MyoD activation. This promotes muscle differentiation, and SIRT1 opposes this by deacetylating both PCAF and MyoD. By acetylating MyoD, these HATs support the expression of muscle-specific genes during differentiation. The balance between PCAF/GCN5 acetylation and sirtuin deacetylation determines the timing and extent of myogenic commitment.
description_zh_TW: 正向組蛋白乙醯基轉移酶 PCAF 和 GCN5 乙醯化肌源性轉錄因子 MyoD，增強其 DNA 結合和轉錄機器的招募。在方向性上，PCAF/GCN5 位於 MyoD 活化的上游。這促進肌肉分化，而 SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 兩者來對抗。透過乙醯化 MyoD，這些 HAT 在分化期間支持肌肉特異性基因的表達。PCAF/GCN5 乙醯化和 sirtuin 去乙醯化之間的平衡決定了肌源性承諾的時間和程度。

label: NAD+ bioluminescence assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The NAD+ bioluminescence assay measures sirtuin activity by quantifying remaining NAD+ after a deacetylation reaction, coupling NAD+ consumption to bacterial luciferase-catalyzed oxidation of decanal via a NAD+/NADH reduction step. It uses a label-free peptide substrate and is applicable to sirtuins with any peptide substrate. Directionally, NAD+ depletion tracks sirtuin catalytic turnover. Its label-free nature and high amenability to high-throughput screening make it a useful complement to fluorescent substrate-based assays, whose artifacts affect STAC measurements.
description_zh_TW: NAD+ 生物發光測定透過量化去乙醯化反應後剩餘的 NAD+ 來測量 sirtuin 活性，將 NAD+ 消耗與細菌螢光素酶催化的癸醛氧化偶聯，透過 NAD+/NADH 還原步驟。它使用無標記的胜肽受質，適用於任何胜肽受質的 sirtuin。方向性上 NAD+ 耗竭追蹤 sirtuin 催化轉化。其無標記特性和高通量篩選的良好適應性使其成為螢光受質基測定的有用補充，後者的假象影響了 STAC 測量。

label: NAMPT targeting in AML
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT6 knockdown-induced DNA repair deficiencies are potently synergistic with NAMPT targeting in acute myeloid leukemia treatment, showing promising in vivo efficacy compared with monotherapy. Directionally, SIRT6 loss-driven DNA repair defects and NAMPT inhibition cooperate to kill AML cells. This dual strategy exploits two vulnerabilities, offering a rationale for combination-based treatments that outperform single-agent therapy in acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6敲低誘導的DNA修復缺陷在急性骨髓性白血病治療中與NAMPT靶向具有強大的協同作用，與單一療法相比顯示出有前景的體內療效。方向上，SIRT6缺失驅動的DNA修復缺陷和NAMPT抑制協同殺傷AML細胞。這種雙重策略利用兩個脆弱性，為在急性骨髓性白血病中優於單一藥物治療的組合治療提供了理論基礎。

label: Natalizumab (Tysabri)
description: Natalizumab (Tysabri) blocks the VCAM-1/VLA-4 interaction by antagonizing alpha4 integrin, reducing T-cell trafficking across the blood-brain barrier in multiple sclerosis. This dampens CNS inflammation but leaves patients susceptible to progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy. The directionality is integrin blockade to reduced leukocyte entry. A caveat is that broad alpha4 inhibition also affects gut homing, causing PML and other risks that limit use. The drug's efficacy in MS validates the VCAM-1/VLA-4 pathway as a driver of neuroinflammation, though its safety profile demands careful monitoring.
description_zh_TW: Natalizumab (Tysabri) 透過拮抗 α4 整合素來阻斷 VCAM-1/VLA-4 interaction，從而減少 ros 中 multiple sclerosis 中血腦障壁的 T 細胞運輸。這可以抑制中樞神經系統炎症，但使患者容易患上進行性多灶性白質腦病變。方向性是整合素阻斷以減少白血球進入。需要注意的是，廣泛的 alpha4 抑制也會影響腸道歸巢，導致 PML 和其他限制使用的風險。該藥物對多發性硬化症的療效證實了 VCAM-1/VLA-4 路徑作為神經發炎的驅動因素，但其安全性需要仔細監測。

label: NF-κB pro-inflammatory signalling
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Deacetylation of RelA/p65 by SIRT1 lowers NF-κB transactivation, thereby reducing expression of cytokines, chemokines, and adhesion molecules that propagate inflammation. This directly opposes the pro-inflammatory program and underlies many of SIRT1's protective effects in metabolic, cardiovascular, and neurodegenerative contexts. The directionality is SIRT1 deacetylation → suppressed NF-κB signaling. A caveat is that excessive NF-κB suppression could impair host defense, so the effect is beneficial within physiological ranges.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 對 RelA/p65 的去乙醯化降低 NF-κB 的轉錄活化，從而減少促進發炎的細胞因子、趨化因子和黏附分子的表達。這直接對抗促發炎程序，是 SIRT1 在代謝、心血管和神經退行性疾病背景下許多保護效應的基礎。其方向性為 SIRT1 去乙醯化 → 抑制 NF-κB 信號。需要注意的是，過度抑制 NF-κB 可能損害宿主防禦，因此其效應在生理範圍內是有益的。

label: 6-hydroxydopamine
description: 6-hydroxydopamine causes Parkinson's Disease by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
description_zh_TW: 6-hydroxydopamine 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Parkinson's Disease，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

label: Ambroxol
description: Ambroxol and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Ambroxol and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Ambroxol 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Ambroxol 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Ventral Tegmental Area
description: Ventral Tegmental Area is spared in Parkinson's Disease, contrasting with the pronounced loss of other dopaminergic populations. Mechanistically, relative sparing reflects differences in pigment load, connectivity, and vulnerability factors between nuclei. This is significant because the differential involvement helps define the anatomical selectivity of the disease. A caveat is that 'spared' is relative; these neurons may show milder or later changes rather than complete immunity.
description_zh_TW: Ventral Tegmental Area 在 Parkinson's Disease 中倖免於難，與其他 dopaminergic 族群的明顯損失形成鮮明對比。從機制上講，相對保留反映了細胞核之間色素負載、連接性和脆弱性因素的差異。這很重要，因為不同的受累情況有助於確定疾病的解剖選擇性。需要注意的是，「倖免」是相對的。這些神經元可能會表現出較輕微或較晚的變化，而不是完全免疫。

label: Bradykinesia
description: Bradykinesia and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Bradykinesia and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Bradykinesia 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Bradykinesia 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Levodopa
description: Levodopa is the standard dopamine-replacement therapy for Parkinson disease. Treatment is the clinical indication.
description_zh_TW: Levodopa 是帕金森病的標準多巴胺替代治療。治療是臨床適應症。

label: Tardive Dyskinesia
description: Delayed antipsychotic-induced persistent orofacial dyskinesia defines the tardive form.
description_zh_TW: 延遲的抗精神病藥誘發持續口顏面運動障礙定義遲發形式。

label: Nicotinamide released by sirtuins
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The radiochemical assay measures sirtuin deacetylase activity using an acetylated peptide substrate and [carbonyl-14C]-NAD+, detecting the release of 14C-nicotinamide. Unreacted NAD+ is captured by a boronic acid resin, and the unbound fraction containing released nicotinamide is counted in a scintillation counter, in a format compatible with 96-well high-throughput screening. Directionally, radiolabeled nicotinamide release directly quantifies catalytic rounds. This assay confirmed the identification of indoles as sirtuin inhibitors, although radioactive waste and safety considerations limit routine screening use.
description_zh_TW: 放射化學測定使用乙醯化胜肽受質和 [carbonyl-14C]-NAD+ 測量 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性，偵測 14C-尼可醯胺的釋放。未反應的 NAD+ 被硼酸樹脂捕獲，含有釋放的尼可醯胺的非結合部分在液體閃爍計數器中計數，格式相容於 96 孔高通量篩選。方向性上放射性標記尼可醯胺的釋放直接量化催化輪次。此測定確認了吲哚類作為 sirtuin 抑制劑的鑑定，儘管放射性廢物和安全考量限制了其在常規篩選中的使用。

label: NKX2-1
description: NKX2-1 (Nk2 homeobox 1) is deacetylated by SIRT1 in hypothalamic DMH/LH neurons; deacetylated NKX2-1 activates transcription of OX2R, the orexin receptor whose increased signaling recapitulates calorie restriction and extends lifespan in BRASTO mice. Thus NKX2-1 is the direct transcriptional relay between SIRT1 and OX2R. By linking SIRT1 activity to orexin-receptor expression, NKX2-1 connects sirtuin signaling to the neural circuits controlling arousal, activity, and energy expenditure. This pathway illustrates how a single transcription factor can mediate the longevity effects of sirtuin activation in the brain.
description_zh_TW: NKX2-1（Nk2 homeobox 1）在下丘腦DMH/LH神經元中被SIRT1去乙醯化；去乙醯化的NKX2-1啟動OX2R的轉錄，OX2R是食慾素受體，其訊號增強模擬了熱量限制並在BRASTO小鼠中延長壽命。因此NKX2-1是SIRT1和OX2R之間的直接轉錄中繼。透過將SIRT1活性與食慾素受體表達聯繫起來，NKX2-1將sirtuin訊號與控制覺醒、活動和能量消耗的神經迴路連接。此通路說明了單一轉錄因子如何能介導sirtuin活化在大腦中的長壽效應。

label: NLRP3-Dependent Trained Immunity
description: Short-term Western diet triggers NLRP3-dependent trained immunity with myelopoietic skewing in vivo, and it fails to induce training in Nlrp3-deficient mice. Transient Western diet exposure can imprint durable innate memory that reshapes subsequent inflammatory responses such as DSS colitis, framing diet as a sterile DAMP-like trainer.
description_zh_TW: 短期 Western Diet 可在 in vivo 觸發 NLRP3-dependent trained immunity 並造成 myelopoietic skewing，在 Nlrp3 缺陷小鼠則無法誘發訓練。短暫的西式飲食暴露可印記持久的先天記憶，重塑後續發炎反應如 DSS colitis，將飲食定位為類似無菌 DAMP 的訓練因子。

label: Nox4-derived H2O2
description: Nox4-derived H2O2 is required for TGF-beta-induced EMT, as Nox4 knockout blocks mesenchymal marker expression and cell migration during epithelial-mesenchymal transition. The oxidant thus serves as a necessary signal rather than mere byproduct. The directionality is Nox4 H2O2 to EMT execution. A caveat is that complete EMT also needs Smad and transcription-factor reprogramming, so H2O2 is necessary but not sufficient alone. Nox4 inhibitors are being evaluated as anti-fibrotic agents, underscoring the therapeutic relevance of this redox pathway.
description_zh_TW: Nox4-derived H2O2 是 TGF-beta-induced EMT 所必需的，因為 Nox4 敲除會阻斷上皮-間質轉化過程中的間質標記表達和細胞遷移。因此，氧化劑充當必要的信號而不僅僅是副產物。方向性是Nox4 H2O2到EMT執行。需要注意的是，完整的 EMT 還需要 Smad 和轉錄因子重編程，因此 H2O2 是必要的，但單獨使用還不夠。 Nox4 抑制劑正在作為抗纖維化藥物進行評估，強調了此氧化還原途徑的治療相關性。

label: Nuclear SIRT1 (enhanced by resveratrol)
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin System The Holy Grail of Resveratrol?.md
description: Nuclear SIRT1, enhanced by resveratrol, induces superoxide dismutase in cardiomyocytes, an antioxidant enzyme that suppresses cell death under stress. Directionally, nuclear SIRT1 sits upstream of SOD induction. This is a cardiomyoprotective output of resveratrol's SIRT1 activation, reducing oxidative damage and preserving cardiac cell viability during injury. It complements SIRT1's other cardiac actions, including SERCA2a deacetylation and PPARα activation, and it illustrates how resveratrol engages nuclear sirtuin activity to boost endogenous antioxidant defense. The SOD induction is part of the broader FOXO3a-dependent antioxidant program driven by SIRT1.
description_zh_TW: 核 SIRT1 在 resveratrol 增強下誘導心肌細胞中的超氧化物歧化酶，一種在壓力下抑制細胞死亡的抗氧化酶。在方向性上，核 SIRT1 位於 SOD 誘導的上游。這是 resveratrol SIRT1 活化的心肌保護輸出，在損傷期間減少氧化損傷並維護心臟細胞活性。這與 SIRT1 的其他心臟作用互補，包括 SERCA2a 去乙醯化和 PPARα 活化，並說明 resveratrol 如何利用核 sirtuin 活性來增強內源性抗氧化防禦。SOD 誘導是 SIRT1 驅動的更廣泛 FOXO3a 依賴性抗氧化程式的一部分。

label: Oleic acid accumulation
description: PERO1 functions as a sensor of oleic acid accumulation on damaged peroxisomes, triggering autophagic removal of these defective organelles. By detecting lipid imbalance indicative of peroxisomal dysfunction, PERO1 initiates quality-control degradation that prevents the propagation of impaired organelles. This lipid-sensing mechanism links metabolic state to organelle surveillance. The pathway exemplifies how selective autophagy integrates metabolic cues to maintain peroxisome integrity.
description_zh_TW: PERO1 作為受損過氧化體上油酸累積的感測器，觸發對這些缺陷胞器的自噬性移除。透過偵測指示過氧化體功能障礙的脂質失衡，PERO1 啟動品質控制降解，防止受損胞器的傳播。此脂質感測機制將代謝狀態與胞器監控連結起來。此途徑具體體現了選擇性自噬如何整合代謝線索以維持過氧化體完整性。

label: Oxidized Phospholipids
description: PON1 hydrolyzes oxidized phospholipids on HDL, preventing their transfer to LDL and thereby protecting against lipoprotein oxidation. This paraoxonase activity is a key anti-atherogenic function of HDL. The directionality is enzyme to lipid-peroxide detoxification. A caveat is that PON1 activity is highly polymorphic in humans and is also reduced by oxidative stress, creating a variable defensive capacity. PON1 also hydrolyzes lactones and specific organophosphates, and its activity is used as an index of HDL antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: PON1 水解 HDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，防止轉移為 LDL，從而防止脂蛋白氧化。這種對氧磷酶活性是 HDL 的關鍵抗動脈粥狀硬化功能。方向性是酵素到脂質過氧化物解毒。需要注意的是，PON1 活性在人類中具有高度多態性，並且也會被 oxidative stress 降低，從而產生可變的防禦能力。 PON1也能水解內酯和特定的有機磷酸酯，其活性被用作HDL抗氧化能力的指標。

label: p33ING1b
description: In hepatocarcinoma, p33ING1b binds SIRT1 and blocks its ability to deacetylate p53, thereby preserving p53's transcriptional activity, including repression of α-fetoprotein (AFP). This relieves SIRT1-mediated inhibition of p53 tumor suppression, restoring the p53-dependent checkpoint in liver cancer cells. Directionally, p33ING1b antagonizes SIRT1 at the p53 node. The interaction reveals a tissue-specific brake on SIRT1's pro-survival, potentially oncogenic action, and is consistent with p33ING1b's function as a tumor suppressor that cooperates with p53, highlighting how accessory proteins can redirect sirtuin activity toward anti-tumor outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 在肝癌中，p33ING1b 結合 SIRT1 並阻斷其去乙醯化 p53 的能力，從而保留 p53 的轉錄活性，包括對 α-胎兒蛋白（AFP）的抑制。這解除了 SIRT1 介導的對 p53 腫瘤抑制的抑制，恢復肝癌細胞中 p53 依賴性的檢查點。在方向性上，p33ING1b 在 p53 節點上拮抗 SIRT1。這種相互作用揭示了對 SIRT1 的促存活、潛在致癌作用的組織特異性制動，與 p33ING1b 作為與 p53 協同的腫瘤抑制因子的功能一致，突顯了輔助蛋白如何將 sirtuin 活性重新導向抗腫瘤結果。

label: p53 accumulation and cell cycle arrest
community_name: p53 accumulation and cell cycle arrest
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2 downregulation or chemical inhibition induces anticancer effects that include p53 accumulation, cell cycle arrest, and apoptosis, mirroring the tumor-suppressive functions of the enzyme. Loss of SIRT2 permits mitotic regulators such as Aurora-A/Aurora-B to accumulate, destabilizing division and forcing checkpoint engagement. The relationship is directional: reduced SIRT2 activity leads to p53 stabilization and arrest. A caveat is that SIRT2 inhibition can be counterproductive in some contexts, notably alongside microtubule inhibitors where it prolongs chronic mitotic arrest and confers resistance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 下調或化學抑制會產生抗癌效果，包括 p53 累積、細胞週期停滯和凋亡，反映了該酵素的腫瘤抑制功能。SIRT2 的缺失允許有絲分裂調節因子如 Aurora-A/Aurora-B 累積，使細胞分裂不穩定並強迫檢查點啟動。關係具有方向性：SIRT2 活性降低導致 p53 穩定化和停滯。但需要注意的是，SIRT2 抑制在某些情境下可能適得其反，特別是在與微管抑制劑合用時，會延長慢性有絲分裂停滯並賦予抗藥性。

label: p53 and SIRT1 to nuclear bodies
community_name: p53 and SIRT1 to nuclear bodies
description: Upon oncogenic stress, the PML-IV isoform recruits both p53 and SIRT1 into PML nuclear bodies, assembling a stress-responsive regulatory hub. Directionally, PML-IV sits upstream of p53/SIRT1 compartmentalization. Within these bodies, SIRT1 deacetylates p53 to shape the senescence/apoptosis decision, and it connects PML bodies to sirtuin-mediated tumor suppression. By concentrating p53 and SIRT1 at nuclear bodies, PML-IV ensures that stress responses are locally integrated. This compartmentalization is central to the tumor-suppressive functions of the PML pathway.
description_zh_TW: 在致癌壓力下，PML-IV 同型異構體將 p53 和 SIRT1 兩者招募到 PML 核體中，組裝壓力反應性調控樞紐。在方向性上，PML-IV 位於 p53/SIRT6 區室化的上游。在這些核體內，SIRT1 去乙醯化 p53 以塑造衰老/凋亡決定，並將 PML 核體與 sirtuin 介導的腫瘤抑制聯繫起來。透過在核體中濃縮 p53 和 SIRT1，PML-IV 確保壓力反應被局部整合。這種區室化對 PML 通路的腫瘤抑制功能至關重要。

label: PML-IV
community_name: p53 and SIRT1 to nuclear bodies
description: Upon oncogenic stress, the PML-IV isoform recruits both p53 and SIRT1 into PML nuclear bodies, assembling a stress-responsive regulatory hub. Directionally, PML-IV sits upstream of p53/SIRT1 compartmentalization. Within these bodies, SIRT1 deacetylates p53 to shape the senescence/apoptosis decision, and it connects PML bodies to sirtuin-mediated tumor suppression. By concentrating p53 and SIRT1 at nuclear bodies, PML-IV ensures that stress responses are locally integrated. This compartmentalization is central to the tumor-suppressive functions of the PML pathway.

label: AIF
description: Apoptosis-inducing factor translocates from mitochondria to the nucleus with MIF to execute large-scale DNA fragmentation in parthanatos. This caspase-independent route distinguishes parthanatos from classical apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis-inducing factor 與 MIF 從粒線體轉位至核，在 parthanatos 中執行大規模 DNA 片段化。此 caspase 非依賴途徑區分 parthanatos 與典型凋亡。

label: nNOS
description: In male ischemic neurons, nNOS-derived peroxynitrite drives the DNA damage that hyperactivates PARP1; nNOS blockade protects males by cutting off parthanatos at its source.
description_zh_TW: 在雄性缺血神經元中，nNOS 衍生的 peroxynitrite 造成 DNA 損傷並使 PARP1 過度活化；阻斷 nNOS 可從源頭切斷 parthanatos，保護雄性。

label: PJ-34
description: PJ-34 is a PARP inhibitor that blocks parthanatos by preventing PARP1 hyperactivation and downstream PAR/AIF/MIF signaling; in stroke models it protects males only.
description_zh_TW: PJ-34 是 PARP 抑制劑，透過阻止 PARP1 過度活化及下游 PAR/AIF/MIF 訊號來阻斷 parthanatos；在中風模型中僅保護雄性。

label: ARH1
description: ARH3 and ARH1 are 39-kDa paralogs with 41% similarity but distinct specificities: ARH1 cleaves arginine-linked MARylation while ARH3 cleaves serine-linked MARylation and PAR, with ARH1 showing under 1% of ARH3 PAR activity. ARH2 lacks demonstrated hydrolase activity.
description_zh_TW: ARH3 與 ARH1 為 39-kDa 旁系同源蛋白，相似度 41% 但專一性不同：ARH1 切除精氨酸連接的 MAR 化，ARH3 切除絲氨酸連接的 MAR 化與 PAR；ARH1 的 PAR 活性不及 ARH3 的 1%。ARH2 尚未證實具水解活性。

label: Mitochondrial Matrix
description: ARH3 carries an N-terminal mitochondrial-targeting sequence and is the only active PAR-degrading enzyme in the mitochondrial matrix, since short PARG55/60 splice forms lack exon 5 and are catalytically dead. It also degrades O-acetyl-ADP-ribose produced by SIRT3/SIRT5.
description_zh_TW: ARH3 帶有 N 端粒線體定位序列，是粒線體基質中唯一具活性的 PAR 降解酶，因為短型 PARG55/60 缺乏 exon 5 而無催化活性。它亦降解 SIRT3/SIRT5 產生的 O-acetyl-ADP-ribose。

label: O-acetyl-ADP-ribose
description: ARH3 hydrolyzes O-acetyl-ADP-ribose, the sirtuin deacetylation byproduct that regulates SIRT activity, TRPM2 gating and redox, using the same Mg2+-dependent alpha-anomer stereospecific mechanism as for PAR and serine-ADPr.
description_zh_TW: ARH3 以與 PAR 及絲氨酸 ADPr 相同的 Mg2+ 依賴、alpha-anomer 立體專一機制，水解 sirtuin 去乙醯化副產物 O-acetyl-ADP-ribose，該分子調控 SIRT 活性、TRPM2 通道與氧化還原。

label: MMS
description: MMS is a direct-acting methylating agent whose DNA lesions (mainly N3-methyladenine and N7-methylguanine, repaired by base excision repair) activate PARP1 and can trigger PARP1-dependent parthanatos, alongside apoptosis at other doses (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: MMS 是直接作用的甲基化劑，其 DNA 損傷（主要為 N3-methyladenine 與 N7-methylguanine，經鹼基切除修復）會活化 PARP1，並可觸發依賴 PARP1 的 parthanatos，於其他劑量下亦可引發 apoptosis（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: PARG53
description: PARG53 is a catalytically active ~53-kDa splice isoform of PARG (exons 1-8) described in 2026; its existence revises the prior PARG55/60 annotation and explains why exon 2-7 knockout clones can retain PAR-hydrolytic activity and still die, confounding knockout-versus-inhibitor comparisons (bioRxiv 2026.05.12.724507).
description_zh_TW: PARG53 是 2026 年描述的 PARG 具催化活性之約 53 kDa 剪接異構體（外顯子 1-8）；其存在修正了先前的 PARG55/60 註解，並解釋為何外顯子 2-7 敲除株仍可保留 PAR 水解活性並死亡，因而混淆了敲除與抑制劑的比較（bioRxiv 2026.05.12.724507）。

label: P-TEFb
description: P-TEFb (CDK9/Cyclin T1) phosphorylates the Pol II CTD to release promoter-proximal pausing. Activation is the elongation checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: P-TEFb（CDK9/Cyclin T1）磷酸化 Pol II CTD 以釋放啟動子近端暫停。活化是延伸檢查點。

label: RNA Polymerase II
description: P-TEFb (CDK9/Cyclin T1) phosphorylates the Pol II CTD to release promoter-proximal pausing. Activation is the elongation checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: P-TEFb（CDK9/Cyclin T1）磷酸化 Pol II CTD 以釋放啟動子近端暫停。活化是延伸檢查點。

label: PACAP (pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 modulates neuropeptide signaling pathways: its interaction with pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide (PACAP) enhances neuroprotective effects by alleviating amyloid-beta toxicity. Directionally, the SIRT3-PACAP interaction sits upstream of reduced Aβ-mediated neuronal injury. This indicates that SIRT3 can bridge neurotrophic and metabolic signaling in the aging brain, extending its neuroprotective repertoire beyond mitochondrial homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 調節神經肽訊號通路：它與垂體腺苷酸環化酶激活多肽 (PACAP) 的相互作用可透過減輕澱粉樣蛋白 - β 的毒性來增強神經保護作用。從方向上看，SIRT3-PACAP 相互作用位於減少 Aβ 介導的神經元損傷的上游。這表明 SIRT3 可以在老化大腦中橋接神經營養和代謝信號傳導，將其神經保護功能擴展到粒線體穩態之外。

label: SIRT3 (neuroprotection against amyloid-beta)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

label: Parkinson's and Huntington's disease
description: Selective SIRT2 inhibitors such as AGK2, AK-7, and SirReal2 are investigated in neurodegenerative disease models because blocking SIRT2 preserves α-tubulin acetylation and protects neurons from aggregation toxicity. Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition promotes microtubule stability and neuroprotection. These agents rescue dopaminergic neurons from α-synuclein toxicity, reduce huntingtin aggregation in models of Huntington's disease, and confer protection in ischemic stroke. The approach exploits the inverse therapeutic logic of SIRT2 versus other sirtuins: while most sirtuin biology supports activation for healthspan, SIRT2 inhibition appears beneficial in specific neurodegenerative contexts.
description_zh_TW: 選擇性 SIRT2 抑制劑（如 AGK2、AK-7 和 SirReal2）正在神經退行性疾病模型中進行研究，因為阻斷 SIRT2 保持 α-tubulin 乙醯化並保護神經元免受聚集毒性。在方向性上，SIRT2 抑制促進微管穩定性和神經保護。這些藥劑從 α-synuclein 毒性中拯救多巴胺能神經元，在亨丁頓症模型中減少 huntingtin 聚集，並在缺血性中風中賦予保護。此方法利用了 SIRT2 與其他 sirtuin 的反向治療邏輯：雖然大多數 sirtuin 生物學支持活化以促進健康壽命，SIRT2 抑制在特定神經退行性疾病背景下似乎是有益的。

label: Parkinson's disease motor symptoms
description: Striatum dysfunction causes the motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease because degeneration of nigrostriatal dopamine input deprives striatal medium spiny neurons of dopaminergic tone, disrupting the basal ganglia motor loop. The resulting imbalance between the D1-mediated direct and D2-mediated indirect pathways produces bradykinesia, rigidity, and tremor. COMT inhibitors indirectly help by preserving peripheral levodopa for central conversion to dopamine. This dopaminergic model underpins the standard treatment of Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: Striatum dysfunction 會導致巴金森氏症的運動症狀，因為黑質紋狀體多巴胺輸入的退化剝奪了紋狀體中型多巴胺能神經元的多巴胺能張力，從而破壞了 basal ganglia 運動迴路。由此產生的 D1 介導的直接通路和 D2 介導的間接通路之間的不平衡會導致運動遲緩、僵硬和震顫。 COMT 抑制劑透過保留週邊左旋多巴以促進中樞轉化為多巴胺間接提供幫助。這種多巴胺能模型是帕金森氏症標準治療的基礎。

label: PARPs
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: As the innate immune response activates to fight infection, the activation of PARPs increases due to extensive DNA damage and IFN-induced MARylation (mono-ADP-ribosylation) of target SARS-CoV-2 proteins, and this PARP response is required for inhibition of viral replication. However, this antiviral effect is reversed by the ADP-ribosylhydrolase macrodomain of the viral nonstructural protein nsp3, whose activity is required for virulence. These findings indicate that key events in the innate immune response to viral infections occur within the infected cell's NAD+ metabolome, and boosting NAD+ content through NAM and NR kinase pathways may restore antiviral PARP functions to support
description_zh_TW: 當先天免疫反應活化以對抗感染時，由於廣泛的 DNA 損傷與 IFN 誘發的目標 SARS-CoV-2 蛋白 MARylation（單-ADP-核糖基化）作用，PARPs 的活化增加，而此 PARP 反應是抑制病毒複製所必需的。然而，此抗病毒效果被病毒非結構蛋白 nsp3 的 ADP-ribosylhydrolase（ADP-核糖水解酶）macrodomain 所逆轉，其活性為毒力所必需。這些發現指出，對病毒感染的先天免疫反應中的關鍵事件發生在被感染細胞的 NAD+ 代謝組內，而透過 NAM 與 NR 激酶路徑提升 NAD+ 含量可能恢復抗病毒 PARP 功能以支援

label: Pentosidine
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Pentosidine is a cross-linking advanced glycation end product that accumulates in skin with age, together with argpyrimidine. It is also found to increase with age in the lamina cribrosa, lung collagen, patellar tendon, vitreous body, oocytes, intervertebral disk, and cartilage. Pentosidine is formed from the reaction of sugars with lysine and arginine residues and functions as a fluorescent AGE marker of cumulative glycation. Its age-dependent accumulation in skin and other connective tissues reflects the progressive cross-linking and stiffening of the extracellular matrix during aging.
description_zh_TW: Pentosidine 是一種 cross-linking advanced glycation end product，會隨年齡與 argpyrimidine 一起堆積於 skin 中。它也發現會隨年齡在 lamina cribrosa、lung collagen、patellar tendon、vitreous body、oocytes、intervertebral disk 與 cartilage 中增加。Pentosidine 由 sugars 與 lysine 和 arginine residues 反應形成，並作為 cumulative glycation 的 fluorescent AGE marker。其在 skin 與其他 connective tissues 中隨年齡的 accumulation 反映了 aging 過程中 extracellular matrix 的漸進 cross-linking 與 stiffening。

label: peripheral tissues
description: S-COMT (soluble COMT) predominates in peripheral tissues such as liver, kidney, and erythrocytes, where it handles the bulk of systemic catechol and catechol-drug metabolism. Unlike MB-COMT, it lacks a membrane anchor and is freely cytosolic, with lower affinity but higher capacity for catechol substrates. Its peripheral dominance means COMT genotype strongly affects systemic catechol disposition and drug responses, such as levodopa metabolism. This isoform distribution underpins the peripheral effects of COMT inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: S-COMT（可溶性 COMT）在 peripheral tissues 中占主導地位，例如肝臟、腎臟和紅血球，它處理大量的全身兒茶酚和兒茶酚藥物代謝。與 MB-COMT 不同，它缺乏膜錨並自由地存在於胞質中，對兒茶酚底物的親和力較低，但容量較高。其周邊優勢意味著 COMT genotype 強烈影響全身兒茶酚處置和藥物反應，例如左旋多巴代謝。這種異構體分佈支撐了 COMT 抑制劑的周邊作用。

label: Peroxisome membrane assembly
description: PEX1 is an ATPase essential for peroxisome membrane assembly and matrix protein import, operating as part of the peroxisomal AAA (ATPases associated with diverse cellular activities) machinery. Loss of PEX1 causes a complete lack of functional peroxisomes, as import and biogenesis cannot proceed. This essential role makes PEX1 mutations among the most common causes of peroxisome biogenesis disorders. The gene thus sits at the foundation of peroxisome formation and metabolic competence.
description_zh_TW: PEX1 是一種對過氧化體膜組裝和基質蛋白輸入至關必要的 ATPase，作為過氧化體 AAA（與多樣細胞活動相關的 ATPase）機械的一部分運作。PEX1 的缺失導致功能性過氧化體完全缺乏，因為輸入和生物發生無法進行。此必要角色使 PEX1 突變成為過氧化體生物發生障礙最常見的原因。因此該基因位居過氧化體形成和代謝能力的基礎。

label: PKCβ
description: Protein kinase C beta (PKCβ) phosphorylates TFEB at a cluster of C-terminal serines (461, 462, 466, 468), modifications that promote TFEB stability rather than suppressing it. Enhanced stability increases the available pool of TFEB that can be activated when nuclear entry is permitted. This contrasts with the predominantly inhibitory phosphorylations at N-terminal mTORC1 sites, illustrating that C-terminal modifications can be activatory. The PKCβ-TFEB relationship adds nuance to the site-specific regulatory code governing the transcription factor.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C beta（PKCβ）在 C 端絲胺酸簇（461、462、466、468）磷酸化 TFEB，這些修飾促進 TFEB 穩定性而非抑制它。增強的穩定性增加了在核進入被許可時可被活化的 TFEB 可用庫。這與 N 端 mTORC1 位點主要為抑制性磷酸化形成對比，說明 C 端修飾可以是活化性的。PKCβ-TFEB 關係為控制該轉錄因子的位點特異性調節密碼增添了細微差別。

label: TFEB at S461/S462/S466/S468
description: Protein kinase C beta (PKCβ) phosphorylates TFEB at a cluster of C-terminal serines (461, 462, 466, 468), modifications that promote TFEB stability rather than suppressing it. Enhanced stability increases the available pool of TFEB that can be activated when nuclear entry is permitted. This contrasts with the predominantly inhibitory phosphorylations at N-terminal mTORC1 sites, illustrating that C-terminal modifications can be activatory. The PKCβ-TFEB relationship adds nuance to the site-specific regulatory code governing the transcription factor.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C beta（PKCβ）在 C 端絲胺酸簇（461、462、466、468）磷酸化 TFEB，這些修飾促進 TFEB 穩定性而非抑制它。增強的穩定性增加了在核進入被許可時可被活化的 TFEB 可用庫。這與 N 端 mTORC1 位點主要為抑制性磷酸化形成對比，說明 C 端修飾可以是活化性的。PKCβ-TFEB 關係為控制該轉錄因子的位點特異性調節密碼增添了細微差別。

label: Premature aging phenotype
description: Mice lacking SIRT6 develop a striking premature-aging syndrome with reduced size, loss of subcutaneous fat, lymphopenia, colitis, and spinal curvature, dying early in life. The phenotype reflects defective base-excision repair, genomic instability, and metabolic and inflammatory dysregulation, demonstrating that SIRT6 is essential for maintaining genome integrity and metabolic homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT6 deficiency produces multisystem premature aging. This makes SIRT6 one of the clearest single-gene links between sirtuins and mammalian longevity, and it positions SIRT6 among the strongest candidates for translating sirtuin biology into interventions that delay age-related decline.
description_zh_TW: 缺乏 SIRT6 的小鼠發展出顯著的早衰症候群，表現為體型縮小、皮下脂肪減少、淋巴細胞減少症、結腸炎和脊柱彎曲，並在生命早期死亡。該表型反映了鹼基切除修復缺陷、基因組不穩定性以及代謝和發炎調節失常，證明 SIRT6 對維持基因組完整性及代謝穩態至關重要。在方向性上，SIRT6 缺乏導致多系統早衰。這使 SIRT6 成為 sirtuin 與哺乳動物長壽之間最明確的單基因聯繫之一，並將 SIRT6 定位為將 sirtuin 生物學轉化為延緩衰老相關退化干預措施的最有力候選者之一。

label: SIRT6 knockout mice
description: Mice lacking SIRT6 develop a striking premature-aging syndrome with reduced size, loss of subcutaneous fat, lymphopenia, colitis, and spinal curvature, dying early in life. The phenotype reflects defective base-excision repair, genomic instability, and metabolic and inflammatory dysregulation, demonstrating that SIRT6 is essential for maintaining genome integrity and metabolic homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT6 deficiency produces multisystem premature aging. This makes SIRT6 one of the clearest single-gene links between sirtuins and mammalian longevity, and it positions SIRT6 among the strongest candidates for translating sirtuin biology into interventions that delay age-related decline.
description_zh_TW: 缺乏 SIRT6 的小鼠發展出顯著的早衰症候群，表現為體型縮小、皮下脂肪減少、淋巴細胞減少症、結腸炎和脊柱彎曲，並在生命早期死亡。該表型反映了鹼基切除修復缺陷、基因組不穩定性以及代謝和發炎調節失常，證明 SIRT6 對維持基因組完整性及代謝穩態至關重要。在方向性上，SIRT6 缺乏導致多系統早衰。這使 SIRT6 成為 sirtuin 與哺乳動物長壽之間最明確的單基因聯繫之一，並將 SIRT6 定位為將 sirtuin 生物學轉化為延緩衰老相關退化干預措施的最有力候選者之一。

label: CDK5
description: CDK5 phosphorylates NOXA at Ser13, causing inactivation in metabolically regulated T-cell leukemia cells.
description_zh_TW: CDK5 在 Ser13 磷酸化 NOXA，在代謝調節的 T 細胞白血病細胞中造成不活化。

label: K-RAS
description: In K-RAS mutated cancers, hyperactive ERK1/2 phosphorylates and inactivates PTPN5, locking BAK in its inactive phosphorylated state and providing resistance to apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 在 K-RAS 突變的癌症中，過度活化的 ERK1/2 磷酸化並使 PTPN5 失活，將 BAK 鎖定於其不活化的磷酸化狀態，從而產生對凋亡的抗性。

label: PTPN5
description: PTPN5 (STEP), along with PTPN2 and PTPN23, dephosphorylates BAK at Tyr108, licensing it for mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: PTPN5（STEP）與 PTPN2、PTPN23 一起，在 Tyr108 去磷酸化 BAK，使其獲得粒線體外膜通透化與凋亡的許可。

label: Pin1
description: Pin1 binding to phosphorylated BAX (Thr167) catalyzes a conformational change that locks Bax in an inactive state, preventing mitochondrial translocation and MOMP.
description_zh_TW: Pin1 與磷酸化的 BAX（Thr167）結合，催化構形變化，將 Bax 鎖定於不活化狀態，阻止粒線體轉位與 MOMP。

label: IKKbeta
description: IKKbeta (IKK2) is the principal catalytic subunit of the IKK complex activated by inflammatory stimuli such as TNF-alpha and IL-1. It is phosphorylated by TAK1 at Ser177/Ser181 during canonical activation. IKKbeta is frequently required for tumor initiation and maintenance in cancer models.
description_zh_TW: IKKbeta（IKK2）是 IKK 複合體的主要催化亞基，由 TNF-alpha 和 IL-1 等發炎刺激激活。在經典激活期間，它會被 TAK1 在 Ser177/Ser181 磷酸化。IKKbeta 在癌症模型中常為腫瘤起始與維持所需。

label: UBX1325
description: UBX1325 is a Bcl-xL-inhibitor senolytic with randomized phase-2 data in diabetic macular edema (Klier 2025). It extends the navitoclax-class SCAP strategy to an ophthalmic indication.
description_zh_TW: UBX1325 是具糖尿病黃斑水腫隨機二期數據（Klier 2025）的 Bcl-xL 抑制劑 senolytic。它將 navitoclax 類 SCAP 策略擴展至眼科適應症。

label: RAF1
description: Active Ras-recruited RAF1 phosphorylates MEK1/2, relaying Ras signals through the MAPK/ERK cascade.
description_zh_TW: 被 Ras 招募激活的 RAF1 磷酸化 MEK1/2，經 MAPK/ERK 級聯傳遞 Ras 訊號。

label: CK1
description: CK1 phosphorylates Bid at Thr58/Ser61/64, blocking caspase-8 cleavage.
description_zh_TW: CK1 在 Thr58/Ser61/64 磷酸化 Bid，阻斷 caspase-8 切割。

label: Cyclin E
description: Cyclin E accumulates on FBW7 loss, marking it as a canonical substrate.
description_zh_TW: Cyclin E 在 FBW7 缺失累積，標記其為典型受質。

label: PAK4
description: PAK4 phosphorylates Bad at Ser112, inactivating the BH3-only protein.
description_zh_TW: PAK4 在 Ser112 磷酸化 Bad，使 BH3-only 蛋白失活。

label: PAK5
description: PAK5 phosphorylates Bad at Ser112, paralleling the PAK4 edge.
description_zh_TW: PAK5 在 Ser112 磷酸化 Bad，與 PAK4 邊平行。

label: c-CBL
description: Phospho-Bim is recognized by the E3 ligase c-CBL for proteasomal degradation.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸化 Bim 被 E3 連接酶 c-CBL 辨識以蛋白酶體降解。

label: DUB
description: USP9X is a deubiquitinase reversing substrate ubiquitination.
description_zh_TW: USP9X 是逆轉受質泛素化的去泛素酶。

label: Adaptor Protein
description: MyD88 is a cytoplasmic adaptor protein serving as the central hub of Toll-like receptor (TLR) and IL-1R signaling, linking receptor engagement to downstream kinase cascades. Its classification as an adaptor reflects its role in assembling signaling complexes rather than performing enzymatic catalysis, and it does so through death domain and TIR domain interactions. In senescence, MyD88 transduces IL-1alpha signals that sustain the SASP, placing it at the interface of innate immunity and senescence. It is a foundational innate immune signaling scaffold conserved across species.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 是一種銜接蛋白（adaptor protein），將先天免疫受體如 IL-1R 與 TLR 的胞質訊號域連結到下游 IRAK 激酶與 TRAF6。作為 Toll/IL-1R（TIR）訊號的主要轉接器，其歸類為銜接蛋白反映其在組裝訊號複合體中的支架角色。在衰老中，MyD88 是將 IL-1alpha 頂層放大器連結到 NF-κB 與 SASP 的核心節點。其銜接功能使其成為衰老發炎級聯的中央中樞。

label: Senescent Cells to Macrophages
description: Senescent-cell surface IL-1alpha engages IL-1R on macrophages, recruiting MyD88 to activate NF-kB and amplify SASP both in the sender cell through autocrine signaling and in recruited immune cells through paracrine signaling. This bridges the senescent cell and the macrophage through IL-1R/MyD88 signaling, propagating inflammation across the tissue. The relationship situates MyD88 at the interface of senescence and innate immunity and explains how local senescence ignites broader inflammatory responses. It is a key mechanism of SASP-driven immune amplification.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 橋接衰老細胞與巨噬細胞，使巨噬細胞中的 IL-1R 訊號感知源自衰老細胞的 IL-1alpha 並引發其對衰老細胞的發炎反應。此橋接將分泌組連結到免疫效應器，促進清除但也發炎，並使 MyD88 成為衰老—巨噬細胞交互作用的關鍵介體。透過將 SASP 轉化為巨噬細胞活化，MyD88 同時支持監視與潜在的 chronic inflammaging。其必要角色在 MyD88 缺失模型中顯示。

label: Bortezomib
description: Bortezomib blocks NF-kappaB by inhibiting the proteasome, preventing degradation of IkappaB and thus trapping NF-kappaB in the cytoplasm. This therapeutic strategy exploits the dependence of many cancers on NF-kappaB survival signaling. The directionality is proteasome inhibition to transcriptional blockade. A caveat is that bortezomib also inhibits degradation of many other proteins, causing toxicity such as peripheral neuropathy. The drug is used in multiple myeloma and mantle-cell lymphoma, where its NF-kappaB blockade and proteotoxic stress together induce myeloma cell death.
description_zh_TW: Bortezomib 透過抑制蛋白酶體來阻斷 NF-kappaB，防止 IkappaB 降解，從而將 NF-kappaB 捕獲在細胞質中。這種治療策略利用了許多 cancer 對 NF-kappaB 生存訊號的依賴。方向性是蛋白酶體抑制轉錄阻斷。需要注意的是，bortezomib 也會抑制許多其他 proteins 的降解，進而導致周邊神經病變等毒性。該藥物用於治療多發性骨髓瘤和套細胞淋巴瘤，其 NF-kappaB 阻斷和蛋白毒性壓力共同誘導骨髓瘤細胞死亡。

label: Antioxidant Gene Program
description: NF-kappaB upregulates an antioxidant gene program as a negative feedback that limits TNF-alpha-induced tissue damage, inducing enzymes such as MnSOD, ferritin, and heme oxygenase. This self-limiting loop tempers the oxidative consequences of inflammatory signaling. The directionality is NF-kappaB to adaptive antioxidant transcription. A caveat is that the same factor also drives pro-oxidant enzymes (NOX, iNOS), so the net redox outcome depends on stimulus and cell type. This protective arm tempers the tissue damage caused by TNF and other inflammatory mediators.
description_zh_TW: NF-kappaB 上調 antioxidant gene program 作為負回饋，限制 TNF-alpha 誘導的組織損傷，誘導 MnSOD、ferritin 和血紅素加氧酶等酵素。這種自我限制循環可以緩和發炎訊號傳導的氧化後果。方向性是 NF-kappaB 到適應性抗氧化轉錄。需要注意的是，同一因素也會驅動促氧化酶（NOX、iNOS），因此淨氧化還原結果取決於刺激和細胞類型。這個保護臂可以緩和 TNF 和其他發炎介質造成的組織損傷。

label: S-Nitrosylation
description: S-nitrosylation inhibits NF-kappaB when NO-derived S-nitrosothiols modify key cysteines (p50 Cys-62 and RelA Cys-38), disrupting DNA binding and transcriptional activity. This provides a redox-based brake on inflammatory signaling. The directionality is NO-mediated modification to transcriptional repression. A caveat is that the effect is reversible and concentration-dependent, and high NO can also paradoxically promote NF-kappaB under some conditions. This mechanism contributes to NO's ability to restrain inflammatory gene expression and may explain some anti-inflammatory actions of nitrosating agents.
description_zh_TW: 當 NO 衍生的 S-nitrosothiols 修飾關鍵半胱氨酸（p50 Cys-62 和 RelA Cys-38）時，S-nitrosylation 會抑制 NF-kappaB，從而破壞 DNA 結合和轉錄活性。这提供了基于氧化还原的炎症信号传导制动。方向性是 NO 介導的轉錄抑制修飾。需要注意的是，该效应是可逆的且依赖于浓度，并且在某些条件下，高 NO 也会相反地促进 NF-κB。这种机制有助于 NO 抑制 inflammatory gene expression 的能力，并可能解释 nitrosating 药物的一些抗炎作用。

label: SIRT7-kidney-specific knockout
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Kidney-specific SIRT7 knockout mice show diminished inflammation with reduced TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6 and suppressed nuclear NF-κB p65 accumulation, indicating SIRT7 normally promotes renal NF-κB activation. Directionally, SIRT7 loss leads to less nuclear p65 and lower inflammation. This is somewhat counterintuitive given SIRT7's anti-inflammatory action in other contexts, underscoring the cell-type and context dependence of sirtuin function. It suggests SIRT7 can be pro-inflammatory in specific renal settings, and highlights that the same sirtuin can promote or suppress NF-κB signaling depending on the tissue environment, kinase signaling, and the balance of its interacting partners.
description_zh_TW: 腎臟特異性 SIRT7 敲除小鼠顯示發炎減輕，TNF-α、IL-1β 和 IL-6 減少，核 NF-κB p65 累積被抑制，表明 SIRT7 通常促進腎臟 NF-κB 活化。在方向性上，SIRT7 的缺失導致較少的核 p65 和較低的發炎。鑑於 SIRT7 在其他情境下的抗發炎作用，這有些違反直覺，強調了 sirtuin 功能的細胞類型和情境依賴性。它提示 SIRT7 在特定腎臟環境中可以是促發炎的，並強調同一 sirtuin 可以根據組織環境、激酶信號和其相互作用夥伴的平衡來促進或抑制 NF-κB 信號。

label: Telomerase
description: Estrogen directly stimulates telomerase transcription via estrogen-responsive elements in the TERT promoter and protects telomeres from oxidative damage, contributing to the female telomere advantage (longer telomeres, slower attrition).
description_zh_TW: 雌激素經 TERT 啟動子中的雌激素反應元件直接刺激端粒酶轉錄，並保護端粒免受氧化損傷，促成女性端粒優勢（端粒較長、磨耗較慢）。

label: TNF Signaling
description: TNF signaling is the pathway activated by TNF family cytokines through TNFR1/2, converging on NF-kB, MAPK, and apoptosis pathways. Apigenin downregulates TNF signaling and NF-kB signaling to suppress the SASP in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: TNF 訊號是 TNF 家族細胞激素經由 TNFR1/2 活化的途徑，匯聚於 NF-κB、MAPK 與細胞凋亡途徑。Apigenin 下調 TNF 訊號與 NF-κB 訊號以壓制衰老細胞中的 SASP。

label: NEMO
description: NEMO (NF-κB essential modulator) is the regulatory subunit of the IKK complex; without NEMO the canonical IKKα/IKKβ activation that degrades IκB and liberates NF-κB cannot proceed.
description_zh_TW: NEMO（NF-κB 必需調控因子）為 IKK 複合體的調節亞基；缺乏 NEMO 時，降解 IκB 並釋放 NF-κB 的典型 IKKα/IKKβ 活化無法進行。

label: Pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: By deacetylating NF-κB, SIRT1 reduces transcription of TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6, dampening the inflammatory transcriptome. Directionally, SIRT1 deacetylation of NF-κB leads to lower cytokine output. This is mechanistically important in atherosclerosis, neurodegeneration, and metabolic inflammation, where sustained cytokine signaling drives tissue damage. Resveratrol leverages this axis to curb chronic low-grade inflammation, and SIRT6, SIRT2, and SIRT7 also restrain NF-κB through distinct mechanisms, making suppression of NF-κB-dependent cytokine production one of the most consistent anti-inflammatory actions across the sirtuin family.
description_zh_TW: 通過去乙醯化 NF-κB，SIRT1 降低 TNF-α、IL-1β 和 IL-6 的轉錄，抑制發炎轉錄組。在方向性上，SIRT1 對 NF-κB 的去乙醯化導致較低的細胞因子輸出。這在動脈粥樣硬化、神經退行性疾病和代謝性發炎中具有機制重要性，在這些疾病中持續的細胞因子信號驅動組織損傷。白藜蘆醇利用此軸來抑制慢性低度發炎，SIRT6、SIRT2 和 SIRT7 也通過不同機制限制 NF-κB，使抑制 NF-κB 依賴性細胞因子產生成為 sirtuin 家族中最一致的抗發炎作用之一。

label: SIRT1 deacetylation of NF-κB
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

label: prostate cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Lack of SIRT6 decreases the viability of prostate cancer cells while increasing chemotherapeutic sensitivity. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of reduced prostate cancer cell survival and heightened responsiveness to chemotherapy. This indicates that targeting SIRT6 could render prostate cancer cells more vulnerable to cytotoxic agents, supporting SIRT6 inhibition as an adjunct to prostate cancer treatment.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6的缺乏降低前列腺癌細胞的存活能力，同時增加化療敏感性。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於前列腺癌細胞存活降低和化療反應性增強的上游。這表明靶向SIRT6可能使前列腺癌細胞更容易受到細胞毒藥物的影響，支持SIRT6抑制作為前列腺癌治療的輔助手段。

label: SIRT6 deficiency
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of reduced prostate cancer cell survival and heightened responsiveness to chemotherapy. label: Quercetin and ethanol
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin System The Holy Grail of Resveratrol?.md
description: Quercetin and ethanol, red-wine constituents, augment resveratrol activity possibly by inhibiting its catabolic enzymes and improving exposure. Directionally, these co-compounds sit upstream of enhanced resveratrol effect. This helps explain the matrix/bioavailability phenomenon, whereby resveratrol shows efficacy within the whole-food matrix but not as an isolated compound. It suggests combination formulations could improve efficacy, and it is consistent with the idea that polyphenols act synergistically. The augmentation is particularly relevant to interpreting the French paradox and to designing resveratrol-based interventions that replicate the wine matrix.
description_zh_TW: 槲皮素和乙醇作為紅酒成分，增強 resveratrol 的活性，可能透過抑制其分解代謝酶並改善暴露量。在方向性上，這些共同化合物位於增強 resveratrol 效應的上游。這有助於解釋基質/生物利用度現象，即 resveratrol 在全食物基質中顯示療效但作為單獨化合物則不然。這暗示組合製劑可以提高療效，與多酚類物質协同作用的概念一致。這種增效作用對於詮釋法國悖論和設計複製葡萄酒基質的 resveratrol 干預措施特別相關。

It suggests combination formulations could improve efficacy, and it is consistent with the idea that polyphenols act synergistically. description_zh_TW: 槲皮素和乙醇作為紅酒成分，增強 resveratrol 的活性，可能透過抑制其分解代謝酶並改善暴露量。在方向性上，這些共同化合物位於增強 resveratrol 效應的上游。這有助於解釋基質/生物利用度現象，即 resveratrol 在全食物基質中顯示療效但作為單獨化合物則不然。這暗示組合製劑可以提高療效，與多酚類物質协同作用的概念一致。這種增效作用對於詮釋法國悖論和設計複製葡萄酒基質的 resveratrol 干預措施特別相關。

label: Red wine matrix
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin System The Holy Grail of Resveratrol?.md
description: Resveratrol achieves efficacious levels only when ingested within the red-wine matrix, which contains co-constituents that slow its metabolism and improve exposure. Directionally, matrix components sit upstream of better resveratrol bioavailability. This helps resolve discrepancies between in vitro potency and in vivo human trials, and it supports whole-food approaches over isolated-compound supplementation. Quercetin and ethanol in particular may inhibit resveratrol's catabolic enzymes, prolonging its presence. The matrix effect is a key consideration for designing resveratrol formulations and for interpreting epidemiological associations between wine consumption and health.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 只有在紅酒基質中攝入時才能達到有效水平，該基質含有共同成分可減緩其代謝並改善暴露量。在方向性上，基質成分位於改善 resveratrol 生物利用度的上游。這有助於解決體外效力和體內人體試驗之間的差異，並支持全食物方法而非單獨化合物補充。特別是槲皮素和乙醇可能抑制 resveratrol 的分解代謝酶，延長其存在時間。基質效應是設計 resveratrol 製劑和詮釋葡萄酒消費與健康之間流行病學關聯的關鍵考量。

label: Rifampicin
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Rifampicin is a hepatic enzyme inducer that can increase the activity of certain metabolic enzymes in the liver, potentially accelerating the metabolism of urolithin A and reducing its half-life in the body. This illustrates the broader principle that drugs interacting with cytochrome P450 enzymes in the liver can competitively inhibit or induce these enzymes, thereby disrupting the metabolism and clearance of urolithin A and altering its systemic exposure. Common antibiotics, antifungal drugs, and anticancer drugs have been reported to interact with CYP450 enzymes in this way.
description_zh_TW: Rifampicin 是一種肝臟酶誘導劑，可提升肝臟中某些代謝酶的活性，可能加速 urolithin A 的代謝並縮短其在體內的半衰期。這說明了更廣泛的原則：與肝臟中 cytochrome P450 酶交互作用的藥物，可競爭性抑制或誘導這些酶，從而干擾 urolithin A 的代謝與清除，並改變其全身暴露量。常見的抗生素、抗真菌藥物與抗癌藥物皆曾被報導以這種方式與 CYP450 酶交互作用。

label: Severe cardiac hypertrophy and interstitial fibrosis
community_name: Severe cardiac hypertrophy and interstitial fibrosis
description: SIRT3-deficient mice develop severe cardiac hypertrophy and interstitial fibrosis when challenged with a hypertrophic stimulus, revealing SIRT3's protective role in the heart. Directionally, SIRT3 loss leads to pathological cardiac remodeling. This is driven by elevated ROS and impaired mitochondrial function, which fuel the hypertrophic and fibrotic response. It mirrors the resistance seen when SIRT3 is overexpressed, confirming a causal protective role. The phenotype highlights the importance of mitochondrial sirtuin activity for cardiac health and supports SIRT3 activation as a therapeutic strategy to prevent maladaptive remodeling in heart disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 缺陷小鼠在受到肥大性刺激時會發展出嚴重的心臟肥大和間質纖維化，揭示了 SIRT3 在心臟中的保護角色。在方向性上，SIRT3 的缺失導致病理性心臟重塑。這由 ROS 升高和粒線體功能障礙所驅動，它們為肥大性和纖維化反應提供動力。這反映了 SIRT3 過度表達時所見的抗性，確認了因果保護角色。此表型突顯了粒線體 sirtuin 活性對心臟健康的重要性，並支持 SIRT3 活化作為預防心臟病中不良重塑的治療策略。

label: SIRT1 deacetylation of Smad7
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: By promoting degradation of Smad7, SIRT1 deacetylation tempers TGF-β signaling in glomerular mesangial cells and protects them from TGF-β-dependent apoptosis. The relationship is directional: SIRT1 acts on Smad7 to relieve a pro-apoptotic TGF-β output in the kidney. This renoprotective mechanism is relevant to diabetic nephropathy and other glomerulopathies, where excessive TGF-β drives mesangial injury and fibrosis. It illustrates how sirtuin control of a single substrate can determine cell fate during injury, and it complements SIRT1's broader antifibrotic actions that suppress TGF-β1-induced apoptosis, fibrosis, and CTGF expression in renal tissue.
description_zh_TW: 通過促進 Smad7 降解，SIRT1 去乙醯化調節腎小球系膜細胞中的 TGF-β 信號，保護它們免受 TGF-β 依賴性凋亡。其方向性為：SIRT1 作用於 Smad7 以減輕腎臟中促凋亡的 TGF-β 輸出。這種腎保護機制與糖尿病腎病和其他腎小球病變相關，其中過度的 TGF-β 驅動系膜損傷和纖維化。它說明了 sirtuin 對單一受質的控制如何在損傷期間決定細胞命運，並與 SIRT1 在腎組織中抑制 TGF-β1 誘導的凋亡、纖維化和 CTGF 表達的更廣泛抗纖維化作用互補。

label: SIRT1 knockdown
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Pharmacological targeting or RNAi-mediated knockdown of SIRT1 inhibits cell growth and sensitizes acute myeloid leukemia cells to tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of enhanced drug sensitivity in AML. By restraining SIRT1-driven survival, AML cells become more responsive to tyrosine kinase inhibitors, suggesting that combining SIRT1 inhibition with TKI therapy could improve leukemia treatment outcomes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1的藥理學靶向或RNAi介導的沉默抑制細胞生長並使急性骨髓性白血病細胞對酪氨酸激酶抑制劑治療敏感。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於AML中藥物敏感性增強的上游。透過抑制SIRT1驅動的存活，AML細胞對酪氨酸激酶抑制劑變得更加敏感，表明將SIRT1抑制與TKI治療結合可能改善白血病治療結果。

label: SIRT3 deacetylase activity
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The deacetylase activity of SIRT3 is required for viral suppression, and during infection SIRT3 keeps membrane potential and mitochondrial pH stable. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of mitochondrial homeostasis during viral infection, supporting antiviral defence. By maintaining mitochondrial function under infection-induced stress, SIRT3 protects cells from viral damage and restricts viral replication.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3的去乙醯酶活性對病毒抑制是必需的，在感染期間SIRT3保持膜電位和粒線體pH的穩定。方向上，SIRT3位於病毒感染期間粒線體恆定的上游，支持抗病毒防禦。透過在感染誘導的壓力下維持粒線體功能，SIRT3保護細胞免受病毒損傷並限制病毒複製。

label: Yeast
description: Overexpression of the sirtuin Sir2 extends lifespan in budding yeast by suppressing the formation of toxic extrachromosomal rDNA circles. Sir2 maintains silencing at the rDNA locus, and its activity prevents the homologous recombination events that generate these circles during aging. This early discovery established sirtuins as longevity regulators and motivated extensive study of their mammalian homologs, particularly SIRT1, in aging and age-related disease, including the search for small-molecule sirtuin activators.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin Sir2 的過度表現可透過抑制有毒染色體外 rDNA 環的形成來延長芽殖酵母的壽命。 Sir2 在 rDNA 基因座上保持沉默，其活性可防止在老化過程中產生這些環的同源重組事件。這項早期發現確立了去乙醯化酶作為長壽調節劑的地位，並推動了對其哺乳動物同源物（特別是 SIRT1）在衰老和年齡相關疾病中的廣泛研究，包括尋找小分子去乙醯化酶激活劑。

label: Viral Translation
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: PARPs play a critical antiviral role by inhibiting the translation of viral transcripts through ADP-ribosylation of the viral genome, a process requiring NAD+. However, several viral families including SARS-CoV encode a macrodomain protein that hydrolyses the ADPR units from proteins and nucleic acids, inhibiting this PARP protective effect and facilitating replication and virulence. Excessive PARP activation then occurs to compensate for ADPR hydrolysis, accompanied by NAD+ consumption. This suggests that increasing NAD+ levels may restore the antiviral functions of PARPs to support immunity against SARS-CoV-2, providing a rationale for NAD+ precursor supplementation in COVID-19.
description_zh_TW: PARPs 透過對病毒基因組進行 ADP-核糖基化以抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，發揮關鍵的抗病毒作用，此過程需要 NAD+。然而，包括 SARS-CoV 在內的數個病毒家族編碼一種 macrodomain 蛋白，可水解蛋白質與核酸上的 ADPR 單元，抑制此 PARP 保護效應並促進複製與毒力。隨後發生過度的 PARP 活化以補償 ADPR 水解，伴隨 NAD+ 消耗。這顯示提升 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARPs 的抗病毒功能以支持對抗 SARS-CoV-2 的免疫力，為 COVID-19 中 NAD+ 前驅物補充提供了理據。

label: Purine Nucleoside Phosphorylase
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Purine nucleoside phosphorylase (NP) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which can then be converted back to NAD+ via NMN through the NAMPT and NMNAT enzymes. This NP-mediated cleavage is believed to be the variable step that degrades NR to NAM in the gut, potentially explaining the low and interindividually variable oral bioavailability of NR. NAM is the most common NAD+ precursor in mammals, and when administered at higher doses it can exert sirtuin-inhibiting effects. The balance between the direct NMRK pathway and this NP/NAMPT route determines how efficiently supplemented NR is converted to NAD+ in different tissues.
description_zh_TW: 嘌呤核苷磷酸化酶（NP）將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），後者隨後可透過 NMN 經由 NAMPT 與 NMNAT 酵素轉回 NAD+。此種由 NP 介導的裂解被認為是在腸道中將 NR 降解為 NAM 的變異步驟，可能解釋了 NR 口服生體可用率偏低且在個體間存在差異的現象。NAM 是哺乳動物中最常見的 NAD+ 前體，當以較高劑量投予時，可產生抑制 sirtuin 的效應。直接 NMRK 路徑與此 NP/NAMPT 途徑之間的平衡，決定了補充的 NR 在不同組織中轉化為 NAD+ 的效率。

label: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: The SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain is a viral protein that hydrolyses the ADP-ribose (ADPR) units added by PARPs to proteins and nucleic acids, thereby inhibiting the protective antiviral effect of PARPs and facilitating viral replication and virulence. Because PARPs require NAD+ to ADP-ribosylate viral transcripts, this counteraction leads to excessive PARP activation and NAD+ consumption during infection, dysregulating the NAD+ metabolome. Restoring NAD+ levels with precursors may therefore restore PARP antiviral function and support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2, connecting NAD+ metabolism directly to COVID-19 severity and immune defense.
description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain 是一種病毒蛋白，可水解 PARPs 加到蛋白質與核酸上的 ADP-核糖（ADPR）單元，從而抑制 PARPs 的保護性抗病毒效應並促進病毒複製與毒力。由於 PARPs 需要 NAD+ 來對病毒轉錄本進行 ADP-核糖基化，此對抗作用導致感染期間過度的 PARP 活化與 NAD+ 消耗，使 NAD+ 代謝組失調。因此，以前驅物恢復 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARP 抗病毒功能並支持對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫，將 NAD+ 代謝直接連結到 COVID-19 嚴重程度與免疫防禦。

label: Amurensin G
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Amurensin G is a resveratrol tetramer natural product reported among compounds that inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations and endowed with anticancer activity. It belongs to a series that includes aristoforin, polyphenols, and tanikolide identified through general screens of structurally diverse natural products. Directionally, amurensin G suppresses sirtuin deacetylase activity. Its isoform selectivity and mechanism are incompletely characterized, and its anticancer effect may involve both sirtuin inhibition and additional natural-product bioactivities.
description_zh_TW: Amurensin G 是一種白藜蘆醇四聚體天然產物，據報導屬於在微摩爾濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的化合物，並具有抗癌活性。它屬於包括 aristoforin、多酚類和 tanikolide 在內的系列，透過對結構多樣化天然產物的廣泛篩選而鑑定。方向性上 amurensin G 抑制 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性。其同工型選擇性和作用機制尚未完全表徵，其抗癌效果可能同時涉及 sirtuin 抑制和天然產物的其他生物活性。

label: Aristoforin
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Aristoforin is one of several natural products reported to inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations, alongside amurensin G, polyphenols, and tanikolide. These compounds expand the chemical diversity of sirtuin inhibitors beyond synthetic scaffolds. Directionally, aristoforin blocks sirtuin deacetylase activity at micromolar potency. As with many natural-product sirtuin modulators, target selectivity, mechanism, and additional cellular targets are less characterized than for synthetic inhibitors, so the anticancer contributions of sirtuin inhibition versus other effects remain to be disentangled.
description_zh_TW: Aristoforin 是多種據報導在微摩爾濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的天然產物之一，與 amurensin G、多酚類和 tanikolide 並列。這些化合物擴展了 sirtuin 抑制劑超越合成骨架的化學多樣性。方向性上 aristoforin 以微摩爾活性阻斷 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性。與許多天然產物 sirtuin 調節劑一樣，其靶標選擇性、作用機制和額外的細胞靶標不如合成抑制劑那樣被充分表徵，因此 sirtuin 抑制與其他效應的抗癌貢獻仍有待釐清。

label: Mono-ADP-ribosyl transferases
description: Beyond deacetylation, several sirtuins catalyze mono-ADP-ribosylation, transferring the ADP-ribose moiety of NAD+ onto target proteins without removing an acetyl group. SIRT4 and SIRT6 prominently display this mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity, with SIRT6 using it to recruit heterochromatin proteins such as KAP1/HP1α. The directionality is that NAD+ is the donor and the target lysine (or other residue) is the acceptor, producing a mono-ADP-ribosylated product rather than free OAADPr. Biologically, ADP-ribosylation allows sirtuins to regulate processes—such as DNA repair and LINE-1 repression—distinct from their deacetylase functions.
description_zh_TW: 除了去乙醯化作用外，多種 sirtuin 還能催化單 ADP-核糖基化，將 NAD+ 的 ADP-核糖基團轉移到目標蛋白上，而不移除乙醯基。SIRT4 和 SIRT6 顯著表現出這種單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性，其中 SIRT6 利用該活性招募異染色質蛋白如 KAP1/HP1α。其方向性為 NAD+ 作為供體，目標離胺酸（或其他殘基）作為受體，產生單 ADP-核糖基化的產物而非游離的 OAADPr。在生物學上，ADP-核糖基化允許 sirtuin 調節 DNA 修復和 LINE-1 抑制等過程，這些功能與其去乙醯酶功能不同。

label: mTOR signaling
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: Nutrient abundance activates the mTOR pathway, which promotes anabolic processes such as protein synthesis and lipid accumulation while suppressing autophagy. Sirtuins counterbalance this anabolic state by favoring catabolic pathways that restore metabolic equilibrium. Directionally, sirtuins and mTOR act as opposed nutrient-sensing axes. This opposition is most evident during caloric restriction or fasting, when falling nutrient signals dampen mTOR while NAD+-sensitive sirtuins drive fatty-acid oxidation, mitochondrial maintenance, and autophagy.
description_zh_TW: 營養豐富活化mTOR通路，促進蛋白質合成和脂質積累等合成代謝過程，同時抑制自噬。Sirtuin透過有利於恢復代謝平衡的分解代謝途徑來平衡此合成代謝狀態。方向上，sirtuin和mTOR作為對立的營養感知軸。這種對抗在熱量限制或禁食時最為明顯，此時營養訊號下降抑制mTOR，而NAD+敏感的sirtuin驅動脂肪酸氧化、粒線體維護和自噬。

label: PARP1 and PARP2
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: PARP1 and PARP2 are major NAD+-consuming enzymes whose activity can deplete cellular NAD+ pools and compromise sirtuin function, creating competition for the same limited co-substrate. Directionally, PARP activity sits upstream of NAD+ consumption and reduced sirtuin availability. This competition is especially relevant during DNA damage, when PARP activation surges and rapidly consumes NAD+ to synthesize ADP-ribose polymers. Because both PARPs and sirtuins are essential for genome maintenance and stress responses, their shared dependence on NAD+ creates an intrinsic trade-off.
description_zh_TW: PARP1和PARP2是主要的NAD+消耗酶，其活性可以耗竭細胞NAD+池並損害sirtuin功能，造成對相同有限共同底物的競爭。方向上，PARP活性位於NAD+消耗和sirtuin可用性降低的上游。這種競爭在DNA損傷期間尤為重要，因為PARP活化急劇上升並迅速消耗NAD+以合成ADP-核糖聚合物。由於PARP和sirtuin都對基因組維護和壓力反應至關重要，它們對NAD+的共同依賴造成了一種內在的權衡。

label: Adenosine-binding site with kinases
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Sirtuins and protein kinases both contain an adenosine-binding pocket in their catalytic machinery, an overlap that allowed screening of known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2. This shared scaffold led to the discovery that bisindolylmaleimides such as Ro31-8220 and indolinones such as GW5074 inhibit SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range. Directionally, the shared adenosine site is the molecular basis for cross-inhibition between kinase inhibitors and sirtuins, but it also means these compounds retain kinase activity, complicating the attribution of cellular effects to sirtuin inhibition alone.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 和蛋白激酶在其催化機制中都包含一個腺嘌呤結合口袋，這種重疊使得已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的篩選成為可能。這種共享的骨架結構導致發現雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺如 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮如 GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2。方向性上共享的腺嘌呤位點是激酶抑制劑和 sirtuin 之間交叉抑制的分子基礎，但也意味著這些化合物保留了激酶活性，使將細胞效應歸因於單純 sirtuin 抑制變得複雜。

label: Deacetylases
description: Sirtuins are class III histone deacetylases whose catalytic mechanism absolutely requires NAD+ as a co-substrate, coupling deacetylation to the cellular redox and energy state. Each turnover hydrolyzes one NAD+ molecule into nicotinamide and 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose while removing an acetyl group from a lysine residue on the target protein. This strict NAD+ dependence means sirtuin activity rises when the NAD+/NADH ratio is high, as occurs during caloric restriction, exercise, or fasting, and falls when NAD+ is depleted. A caveat is that this dependency creates competition with other NAD+-consuming enzymes such as CD38 and PARPs for the same limited co-substrate pool.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 是第三類組蛋白去乙醯酶，其催化機制絕對需要 NAD+ 作為共同受質，將去乙醯化反應與細胞氧化還原狀態和能量狀態偶聯。每次催化週期水解一分子 NAD+，產生菸鹼醯胺和 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose，同時從目標蛋白的離胺酸殘基上移除一個乙醯基。這種嚴格的 NAD+ 依賴性意味著當 NAD+/NADH 比值升高時——例如在熱量限制、運動或禁食期間——sirtuin 活性會上升，而當 NAD+ 被消耗殆盡時則會下降。需要注意的是，這種依賴性使其與其他 NAD+ 消耗酶（如 CD38 和 PARP）競爭相同的有限共同受質庫。

label: Tanikolide
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Tanikolide is a natural product reported to inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations, grouped with aristoforin, amurensin G, and polyphenols as structurally diverse natural sirtuin inhibitors. Directionally, tanikolide blocks sirtuin deacetylase activity at micromolar potency. As with companion natural products, its selectivity and the biological significance of its sirtuin inhibition relative to other targets remain less well studied than for synthetic inhibitors such as EX-527 and the tenovins.
description_zh_TW: Tanikolide 是一種據報導在微摩爾濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的天然產物，與 aristoforin、amurensin G 和多酚類一起被歸類為結構多樣化的天然 sirtuin 抑制劑。方向性上 tanikolide 以微摩爾活性阻斷 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性。與伴隨的天然產物一樣，其選擇性及 sirtuin 抑制相對於其他靶標的生物學意義，仍不如合成抑制劑如 EX-527 和 tenovin 被研究得充分。

label: Rossmann fold domain
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The conserved catalytic core of sirtuins features a large Rossmann fold domain typical of NAD+ binding proteins, together with a small zinc-binding domain and flexible loops that bring the two domains together around an extended cleft for cofactor and substrate. The Rossmann domain contains six parallel beta-strands and a Gly-X-Gly phosphate-binding motif. Directionally, this architecture is intrinsic to the sirtuin family and explains their strict NAD+ dependence. Understanding the structure underscores why NAD+ analogs and pocket C binders act as sirtuin modulators.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 的保守催化核心具有大型 Rossmann 摺疊結構域，這是 NAD+ 結合蛋白的典型特徵，還有一個小型鋅結合結構域和柔性環，將兩個結構域圍繞在一個延伸的溝槽周圍以容納輔因子和受質。Rossmann 結構域包含六條平行 beta 鏈和一個 Gly-X-Gly 磷酸鹽結合基序。方向性上這種架構是 sirtuin 家族固有的，解釋了其嚴格的 NAD+ 依賴性。理解此結構凸顯了為何 NAD+ 類似物和口袋 C 結合分子可作為 sirtuin 調節劑。

label: NAD+-dependent enzyme
description: The sirtuin family comprises seven mammalian members (SIRT1–SIRT7) plus the ancestral yeast Sir2, all sharing an NAD+-dependent catalytic core that performs deacetylation and ADP-ribosylation. They differ in subcellular localization—nuclear (SIRT1, SIRT6, SIRT7), cytoplasmic (SIRT2), and mitochondrial (SIRT3, SIRT4, SIRT5)—which dictates their substrate portfolios. The directionality is that NAD+ is the obligate co-substrate for every family member. This unifying dependence ties sirtuin activity to the cellular energy and redox state.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 家族包含七個哺乳動物成員（SIRT1–SIRT7）加上祖先型酵母 Sir2，均共享一個 NAD+ 依賴性催化核心，執行去乙醯化和 ADP-核糖基化。它們在次細胞定位上有所不同——核內（SIRT1、SIRT6、SIRT7）、細胞質（SIRT2）和粒線體（SIRT3、SIRT4、SIRT5）——這決定了它們的受質譜。其方向性為 NAD+ 是每個家族成員的必需共同受質。這種統一的依賴性將 sirtuin 活性與細胞能量和氧化還原狀態聯繫起來。

label: five classes (I-IV and U)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The sirtuin family has been classified into five distinct classes (I-IV and U) based on a phylogenetic study of sirtuins from a wide range of prokaryotes and eukaryotes. SIR-2.1, Drosophila melanogaster Sir2 (D.mel1), Hst1, and SIRT1 all belong to subclass Ia. Subclass Ib includes Hst2, D.mel2, and various fungi and protozoa sirtuins along with SIRT2 and SIRT3. SIRT4 and SIRT5 belong to classes II and III, respectively. SIRT6 and SIRT7 belong to Class IV, which includes only eukaryotic sirtuins. Sir2 homologues from bacteria with undifferentiated motifs constitute class U.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin家族根據對廣泛原核和真核生物sirtuin的系統發育研究被分為五個不同的類別（I-IV和U）。SIR-2.1、黑腹果蠅Sir2（D.mel1）、Hst1和SIRT1都屬於Ia亞類。Ib亞類包括Hst2、D.mel2以及各種真菌和原生動物sirtuin，連同SIRT2和SIRT3。SIRT4和SIRT5分別屬於第II和第III類。SIRT6和SIRT7屬於第IV類，僅包括真核sirtuin。具有未分化基序的細菌Sir2同源物構成U類。

label: SIRT3 for anti-fibrotic effect
description: Withaferin A, a withanolide from Withania somnifera, mediates anti-fibrotic effects in hepatic fibrosis models through SIRT3; this effect is abolished in SIRT3-knockout mice, positioning SIRT3 as the indispensable molecular effector of this pharmacological anti-fibrotic agent.
description_zh_TW: Withaferin A 是來自南非醉茄的 withanolide，在肝纖維化模型中介導抗纖維化作用；此效果在 SIRT3 基因敲除小鼠中被消除，將 SIRT3 定位為此藥理學抗纖維化製劑不可或缺的分子效應器。

label: Withaferin A
description: Withaferin A, a withanolide from Withania somnifera, mediates anti-fibrotic effects in hepatic fibrosis models through SIRT3; this effect is abolished in SIRT3-knockout mice, positioning SIRT3 as the indispensable molecular effector of this pharmacological anti-fibrotic agent.
description_zh_TW: Withaferin A 是來自南非醉茄的 withanolide，在肝纖維化模型中介導抗纖維化作用；此效果在 SIRT3 基因敲除小鼠中被消除，將 SIRT3 定位為此藥理學抗纖維化製劑不可或缺的分子效應器。

label: SIRT3-overexpressing mice
description: Transgenic mice overexpressing SIRT3 are significantly resistant to stimuli-induced cardiac hypertrophy, the inverse of the SIRT3-null phenotype. Directionally, SIRT3 gain leads to hypertrophy resistance. This protection arises from better mitochondrial ROS control, antioxidant enzyme expression, and metabolic flexibility, which together blunt the growth signals that drive pathological remodeling. It validates SIRT3 as a cardiac therapeutic target and is consistent with SIRT3's regulation of MnSOD, catalase, and mitochondrial Complex I. The complementary loss- and gain-of-function phenotypes firmly establish SIRT3 as a central cardiac protector.
description_zh_TW: 過度表達 SIRT3 的轉基因小鼠對刺激誘導的心臟肥大具有顯著抗性，與 SIRT3 缺失表型相反。在方向性上，SIRT3 功能增強導致肥大抗性。這種保護源於更好的粒線體 ROS 控制、抗氧化酶表達和代謝靈活性，共同削弱驅動病理性重塑的生長訊號。它驗證了 SIRT3 作為心臟治療靶標，並與 SIRT3 對 MnSOD、過氧化氫酶和粒線體 Complex I 的調控一致。互補的功能缺失和功能增強表型確立了 SIRT3 作為核心心臟保護因子的地位。

label: SIRT3 overexpression
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 overexpression in the breast cancer cell line MTR-3 reduces the sensitivity of the resistant cells to tamoxifen. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of diminished responsiveness to endocrine therapy in breast cancer cells. By lowering tamoxifen sensitivity, SIRT3 may contribute to anti-estrogen resistance, complicating endocrine treatment of breast cancer. This is counterbalanced by SIRT4, which enhances tamoxifen sensitivity, highlighting opposing sirtuin functions in endocrine-resistant breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3在乳腺癌細胞系MTR-3中的過表達降低了耐藥細胞對Tamoxifen的敏感性。方向上，SIRT3位於乳腺癌細胞中內分泌療法反應性降低的上游。透過降低Tamoxifen敏感性，SIRT3可能促成抗雌激素耐藥性，使乳腺癌的內分泌治療變得複雜。這與增強Tamoxifen敏感性的SIRT4相平衡，突顯了內分泌耐藥性乳腺癌中sirtuin的對立功能。

label: tamoxifen sensitivity in MTR-3 breast cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
