label: SIRT3 proteolytic degradation
description: Soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH/EPHX2) hydrolyzes epoxy-fatty acids and modulates SIRT3 turnover via proteolytic degradation. sEH deficiency preserves SIRT3 bioavailability to fulfill bioenergetic demands and impedes renal vascular calcification progression, linking lipid-epoxide biology to SIRT3 stability.
description_zh_TW: 可溶性環氧化物水解酶（sEH/EPHX2）水解環氧化脂肪酸並透過蛋白水解降解調節 SIRT3 周轉。sEH 缺乏保留 SIRT3 的可用性以滿足生物能需求並阻礙腎血管鈣化進展，將脂質環氧化物生物學與 SIRT3 穩定性聯繫起來。

label: SIRT6 centenarian variants (N308K/A313S)
description: Centenarian-associated SIRT6 variants (N308K/A313S) elevate endogenous SIRT6 protein through a weakened interaction with vimentin, independent of mRNA changes. Directionally, the variant reduces vimentin binding, which raises SIRT6. This suggests protein stability, not expression, drives the longevity phenotype, and it links a human genetic finding to SIRT6 abundance. By escaping vimentin-mediated degradation, variant SIRT6 accumulates to higher levels in cells. This mechanism explains how a subtle coding change can increase SIRT6 output and is consistent with the variants' association with exceptional longevity.
description_zh_TW: 與百歲人瑞相關的 SIRT6 變異體（N308K/A313S）透過與 vimentin 的弱化相互作用（獨立於 mRNA 變化）提高內源性 SIRT6 蛋白水平。在方向性上，變異體減少 vimentin 結合，從而提高 SIRT6。這表明蛋白穩定性（而非表達）驅動長壽表型，並將人類遺傳學發現與 SIRT6 豐度聯繫起來。透過逃避 vimentin 介導的降解，變異體 SIRT6 在細胞中積累到更高水平。此機制解釋了微妙的編碼變化如何能增加 SIRT6 產出，與該變異體和非凡長壽的關聯一致。

label: SIRT7 inactivation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 inactivation reduces breast cancer metastasis by blocking TGF-β signalling. SIRT7 deacetylase activity inhibits metastasis of breast cancer by antagonising transforming growth factor-β signalling. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of TGF-β-driven metastasis in breast cancer. By promoting TGF-β signalling, SIRT7 supports the metastatic spread of breast cancer cells, and its inactivation curbs this process regardless of changes in original tumour development.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7失活透過阻斷TGF-β訊號來減少乳腺癌轉移。SIRT7去乙醯酶活性透過拮抗轉化生長因子-β訊號來抑制乳腺癌轉移。方向上，SIRT7位於乳腺癌中TGF-β驅動的轉移的上游。透過促進TGF-β訊號，SIRT7支持乳腺癌細胞的轉移性擴散，其失活無論原始腫瘤發展的變化如何都限制了此過程。

label: Sirtuin Fluorimetric Activity
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Sirtuin fluorimetric activity assays (e.g., the Fluor de Lys system) are the most commonly used methods to screen molecules as sirtuin inhibitors. Deacetylation of a fluorophore-decoupled substrate sensitizes it to a developer that releases a measurable fluorophore, and percent inhibition is calculated from fluorescence. These assays identified indoles (EX-527), tenovins, JGB1741, sirtinol analogues, and cambinol analogues. A key caveat is that the aminomethylcoumarin moiety of the fluorogenic substrates can affect binding of other small molecules to the enzyme, so confirmation with orthogonal assays is recommended.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 螢光活性測定（例如 Fluor de Lys 系統）是篩選分子作為 sirtuin 抑制劑最常用的方法。去乙醯化的螢光基團解偶聯受質經顯色劑處理後釋放出可量化的螢光基團，從螢光訊號計算抑制百分比。這些測定鑑定了吲哚類（EX-527）、tenovin、JGB1741、sirtinol 類似物和 cambinol 類似物。一個關鍵注意事項是螢光受質的氨基甲基香豆素部分可能影響其他小分子與酵素的結合，因此建議使用正交測定進行確認。

label: VCAM-1
description: VCAM-1 binds VLA-4 (alpha4beta1 integrin) on leukocytes, mediating firm adhesion and transendothelial migration during inflammation. This interaction is central to leukocyte trafficking into tissue. The directionality is endothelial ligand to leukocyte engagement. A caveat is that VCAM-1 also binds alpha4beta7 and other integrins, and competing ligands (e.g., fibronectin) modulate the interaction. This adhesion pathway is a validated drug target, with natalizumab blocking VLA-4 to reduce CNS inflammation in multiple sclerosis.
description_zh_TW: VCAM-1 結合 VLA-4 (alpha4beta1 integrin) on leukocytes，在發炎過程中介導牢固黏附和跨內皮遷移。這種相互作用對於白血球運輸到組織中至關重要。方向性是內皮配體與白血球的結合。需要注意的是，VCAM-1 還結合 alpha4beta7 和其他整合素，並且競爭性配體（例如纖維連接蛋白）調節相互作用。這種黏附途徑是經過驗證的藥物標靶，那他珠單抗可阻斷 VLA-4，從而減少 multiple sclerosis 的中樞神經系統發炎。

label: Pathological fibrosis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: TGF-β1 activates SMAD3-dependent transcription of pro-fibrotic genes including COL1A1, COL3A1, FN1, ACTA2, and TIMP1, driving collagen deposition and tissue scarring in multiple organs. Directionally, TGF-β1 sits upstream of fibrogenesis. This makes TGF-β1 a central target in fibrosis therapeutics, and sirtuins that inhibit SMAD3 signaling, such as SIRT6 and SIRT7, are antifibrotic. Because fibrosis is the common final pathway of chronic organ injury, understanding the TGF-β1/SMAD3 axis is central to developing treatments for heart, lung, kidney, and liver fibrosis. Sirtuin activation is emerging as one such strategy.
description_zh_TW: TGF-β1 活化 SMAD3 依賴性的促纖維化基因轉錄，包括 COL1A1、COL3A1、FN1、ACTA2 和 TIMP1，驅動多個器官的膠原沉積和組織疤痕形成。在方向性上，TGF-β1 位於纖維化生成的上游。這使 TGF-β1 成為纖維化治療的核心靶標，而抑制 SMAD3 訊號的 sirtuin（如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7）具有抗纖維化作用。由於纖維化是慢性器官損傷的共同最終通路，理解 TGF-β1/SMAD3 軸線對開發心臟、肺、腎臟和肝臟纖維化的治療至關重要。Sirtuin 活化正成為此類策略之一。

label: Osteogenesis
description: BMP2/4/7 drive osteoblast differentiation as the defining skeletal function of the pathway. Loss of signaling causes skeletal dysplasia.
description_zh_TW: BMP2/4/7 驅動造骨細胞分化，作為此路徑定義性的骨骼功能。訊號缺失導致骨骼發育不良。

label: Cell Sorting
description: Differential cadherin adhesion drives developmental cell sorting. Driving records the morphogenetic output.
description_zh_TW: 差異 cadherin 黏附驅動發育細胞分選。驅動記錄形態發生輸出。

label: Noggin
description: Noggin binds and sequesters BMP2/4/7 extracellularly to block signaling. This antagonism patterns embryonic and skeletal development.
description_zh_TW: Noggin 在胞外結合並隔離 BMP2/4/7 以阻斷訊號。此拮抗塑造胚胎與骨骼發育。

label: Adipose Tissue
description: Adipose tissue is a specialized connective tissue depot.
description_zh_TW: 脂肪組織是特化的結締組織庫。

label: Podocyte
description: Charge-based anti-adhesion maintains foot-process architecture.
description_zh_TW: 電荷型抗黏附維持足突架構。

label: Atrogin-1
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Atrogin-1 and MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1 and 2) are pivotal molecules involved in muscle protein synthesis and degradation, functioning as muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligases that drive protein breakdown during atrophy. Studies have shown that urolithin A can regulate muscle protein synthesis and degradation by inhibiting the activity of mTORC1 and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, thereby reducing atrophy signaling, attenuating protein degradation, and preserving muscle mass.
description_zh_TW: Atrogin-1 與 MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1 and 2) 是參與肌肉蛋白合成與降解的關鍵分子，作為肌肉特異性 E3 泛素連接酶，在萎縮期間驅動蛋白分解。研究顯示 urolithin A 可透過抑制 mTORC1 的活性與 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，來調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解，從而降低萎縮訊號、減緩蛋白降解，並保留肌肉量。

label: muscle fatigue
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Existing evidence suggests that urolithin A may have a positive role in improving endurance and delaying muscle fatigue, both of which are intricately linked to mitochondrial function. By enhancing mitochondrial activity and ATP synthesis, urolithin A provides sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise, and its anti-inflammatory properties alleviate tissue damage and muscle soreness caused by inflammation. Most studies have been conducted in vitro or on animals, so more human studies are needed to validate these effects.
description_zh_TW: 現有證據顯示 urolithin A 可能在改善耐力與延遲肌肉疲勞方面具有正面作用，兩者皆與粒線體功能密切相關。透過增強粒線體活性與 ATP 合成，urolithin A 在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持，且其抗發炎特性可減輕由發炎引起的組織損傷與肌肉痠痛。大多數研究為體外或動物實驗，因此需要更多人體研究來驗證這些效應。

label: MuRF1
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase that, together with Atrogin-1, marks muscle proteins for ubiquitin-proteasome degradation during atrophy. Studies have shown that urolithin A can regulate muscle protein synthesis and degradation by inhibiting the activity of mTORC1 and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, thereby reducing muscle protein degradation and supporting the maintenance of muscle mass under catabolic conditions. Suppressing this E3 ligase reduces ubiquitination of muscle proteins and complements urolithin A's anabolic effects on protein synthesis.
description_zh_TW: MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1) 是一種肌肉特異性 E3 泛素連接酶，與 Atrogin-1 共同在萎縮期間標記肌肉蛋白以供泛素-蛋白酶體降解。研究顯示 urolithin A 可透過抑制 mTORC1 的活性與 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，來調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解，從而減少肌肉蛋白降解，並在分解代謝條件下支持肌肉量的維持。抑制此 E3 連接酶可減少肌肉蛋白的泛素化，並補足 urolithin A 對蛋白質合成的合成代謝效應。

label: Pomegranate
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Pomegranate is cited as one of the primary and richest dietary sources of urolithin A. Pomegranate peel and seeds contain abundant polyphenolic compounds, including ellagitannins that are metabolized by the gut microbiota into urolithin A. Consequently, consuming pomegranate supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A, and pomegranate consumption is a standard dietary route to increase systemic urolithin A exposure alongside other sources such as walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry.
description_zh_TW: 石榴被引述為 urolithin A 的主要且最豐富的膳食來源之一。石榴皮與籽含有豐富的多酚類化合物，包括被腸道菌叢代謝為 urolithin A 的 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）。因此，食用石榴提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成，且食用石榴是增加全身性 urolithin A 暴露的標準膳食途徑，與核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓等其他來源並列。

label: muscle protein degradation
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The FoxO (forkhead box O) family is a group of transcription factors involved in regulating the synthesis and degradation of muscle proteins. Under catabolic conditions, nuclear FoxO drives expression of atrophy-related genes and activates specific protein degradation pathways that break down muscle proteins. Urolithin A suppresses FoxO activation, primarily by inhibiting its nuclear activity and reducing its regulation of these degradation pathways, thereby attenuating muscle protein degradation and helping to preserve muscle mass.
description_zh_TW: FoxO (forkhead box O) 家族是一群參與調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解的轉錄因子。在分解代謝條件下，核內 FoxO 驅動萎縮相關基因的表現，並活化分解肌肉蛋白的特定蛋白降解路徑。Urolithin A 抑制 FoxO 活化，主要是透過抑制其核活性並降低其對這些降解路徑的調節，從而減緩肌肉蛋白降解並有助於保留肌肉量。

label: TLR3/TRIF signaling
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The literature indicates that urolithin A blocks the NF-κB/STAT1 axis through the inactivation of TLR3/TRIF signaling, reducing inflammation and enhancing antioxidant defense. TLR3/TRIF is an upstream innate immune signaling route whose inactivation dampens downstream NF-κB activation and the production of inflammatory mediators. This mechanism contributes to urolithin A's anti-inflammatory activity in settings such as poly(I:C)-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages and supports its role in muscle recovery and protection from inflammation-induced damage.
description_zh_TW: 文獻指出 urolithin A 透過使 TLR3/TRIF 訊號失活來阻斷 NF-κB/STAT1 軸，從而減少發炎並增強抗氧化防禦。TLR3/TRIF 是一條上游先天免疫訊號路線，其失活會抑制下游 NF-κB 活化與發炎介質的產生。此機制有助於 urolithin A 在如 poly(I:C) 刺激的 RAW264.7 巨噬細胞等情境中的抗發炎活性，並支持其在肌肉恢復與免受發炎誘發損傷中的角色。

label: Urolithins
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A (UA) is a naturally occurring compound classified within the urolithins, a family of gut-microbiota-derived metabolites that form when dietary polyphenols are processed in the gastrointestinal tract. The review describes urolithins as compounds present in pomegranates and certain other fruits and nuts such as strawberries, walnut kernels, and peanuts, with ellagitannins serving as their precursors. As a member of this family, Urolithin A has attracted considerable research attention due to its pharmacological effects, encompassing anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, anti-tumor, and anti-aging properties, and it is a primary focus of research into muscle health and performance.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A（UA）是一種天然存在的化合物，歸類於 urolithins（尿石素）家族，這是一類當膳食多酚在胃腸道中被處理時所形成的腸道菌叢衍生代謝物。該綜述將 urolithins 描述為存在於石榴與某些其他水果和堅果（如草莓、核桃仁與花生）中的化合物，以 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）作為其前驅物。作為此家族的一員，Urolithin A 因其藥理作用（涵蓋抗發炎、抗氧化、抗腫瘤與抗衰老特性）而吸引了相當多的研究關注，且它是肌肉健康與表現研究的主要焦點。

label: ATP synthesis
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A can promote the formation and enhanced function of mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes, thereby improving the synthesis rate of ATP in muscle cells. ATP is the primary energy molecule for muscle cells and is crucial for muscle contraction and exercise performance. By promoting mitochondrial function and muscle energy metabolism, urolithin A increases the energy supply to muscle cells, improving endurance, strength, and recovery, and providing sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可促進粒線體呼吸鏈複合體的形成與功能增強，從而改善肌肉細胞中 ATP 的合成速率。ATP 是肌肉細胞的主要能量分子，對肌肉收縮與運動表現至關重要。透過促進粒線體功能與肌肉能量代謝，urolithin A 增加對肌肉細胞的能量供應，改善耐力、力量與恢復，並在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持。

label: CDK
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A can regulate the cell cycle by inhibiting the activity of cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) and reducing the expression of cell cycle proteins such as cyclin D1, leading to cell cycle arrest in the G1 phase. It also increases the levels of cell cycle inhibitory proteins such as p21 and p27. This cell-cycle control, achieved through modulation of CDK activity and cyclin expression, contributes to urolithin A's reported antiproliferative activity and to its effects on cell cycle-related protein kinase complexes.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可透過抑制 cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) 的活性並降低如 cyclin D1 等細胞週期蛋白的表現，來調節細胞週期，導致 G1 期細胞週期停滯。它亦提升如 p21 與 p27 等細胞週期抑制蛋白的水平。此透過調控 CDK 活性與 cyclin 表現而達成的細胞週期控制，有助於 urolithin A 被報導的抗增殖活性，以及其對細胞週期相關蛋白激酶複合體的效應。

label: Bax/Bcl-2 ratio
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A induces apoptosis by increasing the Bax/Bcl-2 ratio, which results in the loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, release of cytochrome c, and activation of the cascade of caspases, ultimately leading to cell apoptosis. Modulation of the pro-apoptotic to anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family ratio is a classical intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptosis trigger. It represents one of the several mechanisms through which urolithin A promotes programmed cell death, in addition to its activation of JNK and p38 MAPK signaling.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 透過提升 Bax/Bcl-2 比值誘導凋亡，此比值升高導致粒線體膜電位喪失、cytochrome c 釋出，以及 caspase 級聯反應活化，最終導致細胞凋亡。調節促凋亡與抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族比值，是經典的內在（粒線體）凋亡觸發因子。這代表了 urolithin A 促進程序性細胞死亡的數種機制之一，此外還包括其對 JNK 與 p38 MAPK 訊號的活化。

label: Ellagitannins
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A is a natural metabolite derived from ellagitannins, polyphenolic precursors found in pomegranate, walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry. During digestion, microbial enzymes in the colon convert ellagitannins through stepwise enzymatic and metabolic reactions to yield urolithin A. Because ellagitannin intake is a precondition for urolithin A formation, dietary consumption of ellagitannin-rich foods supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A and increasing its systemic availability.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 是一種源自 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）的天然代謝物，後者為存在於石榴、核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓中的多酚類前驅物。在消化期間，結腸中的微生物酵素透過逐步的酵素與代謝反應將 ellagitannins 轉化以產生 urolithin A。由於 ellagitannin 攝取是 urolithin A 形成的先決條件，飲食攝取富含 ellagitannin 的食物提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成並增加其全身性可用性。

label: Muscle Hypertrophy
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A may have a positive impact on muscle hypertrophy and maintenance of muscle mass through multiple pathways, including promotion of muscle cell repair and growth, enhancement of mitochondrial function and energy metabolism, and regulation of protein synthesis and degradation processes. It can increase the cross-sectional area of muscle fibers, muscle protein content, and muscle strength, thus promoting muscle hypertrophy. Current research is still limited and mostly conducted in vitro or in animal experiments, so human studies are needed.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可能透過多種路徑對肌肉肥大與肌肉量維持產生正面影響，包括促進肌肉細胞修復與生長、增強粒線體功能與能量代謝，以及調節蛋白質合成與降解過程。它可增加肌纖維橫截面積、肌肉蛋白含量與肌肉力量，從而促進肌肉肥大。目前研究仍有限且多為體外或動物實驗，因此需要人體研究。

label: Muscle Atrophy
description: Muscle atrophy is the progressive loss of skeletal muscle mass that arises when protein degradation outpaces synthesis. Urolithin A, a mitophagy-inducing metabolite, is studied for its capacity to preserve muscle by supporting mitochondrial health and function.
description_zh_TW: 肌肉萎縮是蛋白質降解超過合成時發生的骨骼肌質量進行性喪失。Urolithin A 是誘導 mitophagy 的代謝物，被研究其透過支持粒線體健康與功能來保存肌肉的能力。

label: Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens, an Eggerthellaceae gut anaerobe, metabolizes dietary Ellagic Acid as the principal upstream converter in the urolithin pathway, generating intermediate urolithins (M5/D/C) that downstream consortium members finish to Urolithin A; its carriage underpins metabotype A converter status.
description_zh_TW: Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 為 Eggerthellaceae 腸道厭氧菌，是 urolithin 途徑的主要上游轉換者，代謝飲食 Ellagic Acid 產生中間 urolithins（M5/D/C），再由下游菌叢完成為 Urolithin A；其攜帶與否決定 metabotype A 轉換者身分。

label: Enterocloster
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Select Enterocloster gut species contribute to the multi-step consortium conversion of Ellagic Acid toward Urolithin A alongside the principal converters Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens and Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens; as a minor contributor its presence modulates but does not alone determine urolithin metabotype.
description_zh_TW: 特定 Enterocloster 腸道菌種與主要轉換者 Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 及 Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens 共同參與 Ellagic Acid 往 Urolithin A 的多步菌叢轉換；作為次要貢獻者，其存在可調節但不足以單獨決定 urolithin metabotype。

label: Metabotypes
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Urolithin Metabotypes (A: Urolithin A producers, ~25-55%; B: urolithin B/isourolithin A producers; 0: non-producers) determine whether dietary ellagitannins yield systemic Urolithin A exposure: only metabotype A converts efficiently, so ellagitannin foods fail for most people while direct Urolithin A supplementation works across all metabotypes.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin Metabotypes（A：產 Urolithin A 者，約 25–55%；B：產 urolithin B/isourolithin A 者；0：非生產者）決定飲食 ellagitannins 能否帶來全身 Urolithin A 暴露：僅 A 型能有效轉換，故 ellagitannin 食物對多數人無效，而直接補充 Urolithin A 適用所有 metabotypes。

label: Innate Immune Defense
description: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
description_zh_TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

label: Lipids
description: Nitrative stress nitrates unsaturated fatty acids to yield nitrated lipids such as nitrolinoleic acid and nitro-oleic acid. Unlike the destructive protein modifications, nitrated lipids act as endogenous signaling molecules that activate PPARgamma and inhibit NF-kB signaling, representing a negative feedback loop in inflammation. They also undergo Michael addition with cysteine thiols to activate the Nrf2 antioxidant program.
description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 硝化不飽和脂肪酸，產生 nitrated lipids，例如 nitrolinoleic acid 和 nitro-oleic acid。與破壞性的蛋白質修飾不同，nitrated lipids 作為內源性 signaling molecules，活化 PPARgamma 並抑制 NF-kB 訊號，構成發炎中的負回饋迴路。它們也會與半胱胺酸硫醇進行 Michael addition，活化 Nrf2 抗氧化程序。

label: 3-Nitrotyrosine
description: Nitrative stress produces 3-nitrotyrosine (3-NT), the most characteristic and biomedically relevant protein modification of this pathway. 3-NT forms when peroxynitrite-derived radicals (NO2 and carbonate radical) oxidize tyrosine phenolate groups and couple with NO2. Because 3-NT is a stable, unrepairable post-translational modification, it serves as both a biomarker and a mediator of tissue injury in many diseases.
description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 產生 3-nitrotyrosine（3-NT），這是此途徑最具特徵性且與生物醫學最相關的蛋白質修飾。當 peroxynitrite 衍生的自由基（NO2 和 carbonate radical）氧化酪氨酸酚基並與 NO2 偶聯時，會形成 3-NT。由於 3-NT 是穩定且不可修復的轉譯後修飾，它在許多疾病中既是生物標記也是組織損傷的介導者。

label: Pro-oxidant Toxicity
description: At low doses polyphenols stimulate endogenous antioxidant defenses, but at high concentrations such as concentrated supplements they act as potent pro-oxidants causing oxidative damage. Examples include liver damage from high-dose green tea catechins, illustrating the biphasic benefit-to-harm transition.
description_zh_TW: 低劑量 Polyphenols 可刺激內源性抗氧化防禦，但在高濃度（如濃縮補充劑）下則成為強效促氧化劑並造成氧化損傷。例如高劑量綠茶兒茶素可能導致肝損傷，說明了從有益到有害的雙相轉換。

label: TNFR
description: TNFR1 is the death-domain-containing member of the TNF receptor family and the canonical necroptosis entry point; other TNFR-superfamily members lack the same direct necrosome coupling.
description_zh_TW: TNFR1 為 TNF 受體家族中具死亡結構域的成員，是 necroptosis 的經典入口；其他 TNFR 超家族成員無相同的直接 necrosome 偶聯。

label: Low-level oxidative stress
description: Low-level oxidative stress activates mitohormesis, a beneficial adaptive response in which transient ROS upregulate DNA repair, antioxidant defenses, and autophagy to improve resilience. This explains the paradoxical benefits of mild mitochondrial stress. The directionality is mild oxidant to adaptive reprogramming. A caveat is that the benefit is strictly dose-dependent; higher oxidative stress overwhelms the response and becomes damaging, the classic hormetic inverted-U. Exercise, caloric restriction, and some phytochemicals harness mitohormesis to improve metabolic and neurological health.
description_zh_TW: Low-level oxidative stress 活化 mitohormesis，這是一種有益的適應性反應，其中短暫的 ROS 上調 DNA 修復、抗氧化防禦和自噬，以提高恢復能力。這解釋了輕度 mitochondria1 壓力的矛盾好處。方向性是適應性重編程的溫和氧化劑。需要注意的是，其益處嚴格依賴劑量。更高的 oxidative stress 壓倒了反應並成為 damaging，經典的毒效劑倒 U 型。運動、熱量限制和一些植物化學物質利用 mitohormesis 來改善代謝和神經系統健康。

label: Endogenous Antioxidant Upregulation
description: Exogenous antioxidants prevent the upregulation of endogenous defense enzymes (SOD, GPx) that exercise normally induces via NRF2. The Ristow 2009 study showed antioxidant-supplemented subjects failed to upregulate endogenous SOD/GPx and lost the insulin-sensitizing benefit of exercise.
description_zh_TW: 外源性抗氧化劑防止運動通常經由 NRF2 誘發的內生防禦酵素（SOD、GPx）上調。Ristow 2009 研究顯示補充抗氧化劑的受試者未能上調內生 SOD/GPx，並喪失運動的胰島素增敏益處。

label: Integrated Stress Response
description: A major advance in mitohormesis research was the discovery that diverse mitochondrial stressors activate the ISR. The pathway is initiated when mitochondrial stress activates the OMA1 protease, which cleaves DELE1 to generate a cytosolic fragment (DELE1-S) that binds and activates HRI, one of the four eIF2alpha kinases. HRI then phosphorylates the translation initiation factor eIF2alpha, reducing global protein synthesis while allowing preferential translation of ATF4. This mitochondrial-ISR connection establishes a defined signaling axis by which mild mitochondrial dysfunction produces a protective transcriptional and metabolic response characteristic of mitohormesis.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應研究的一個重大進展是發現多種粒線體壓力源會活化整合壓力反應（ISR）。該途徑在粒線體壓力活化 OMA1 蛋白酶時啟動，OMA1 切割 DELE1 產生細胞質片段（DELE1-S），後者結合並活化 HRI（四個 eIF2alpha 激酶之一）。HRI 隨後磷酸化翻譯起始因子 eIF2alpha，減少整體蛋白質合成，同時允許 ATF4 的優先翻譯。這種粒線體-ISR 連結建立了一個明確的訊號軸，透過該軸，輕度粒線體功能障礙產生具有粒線體促效應特徵的保護性轉錄和代謝反應。

label: MTHFD2
description: Analysis of mice expressing a mutant mitochondrial helicase Twinkle, which develop progressive respiratory chain dysfunction and COX-deficient fibers in skeletal muscle, revealed coordinated induction of metabolic genes including MTHFD2, a mitochondrial one-carbon enzyme highly expressed during development and in tumors but normally low in adult tissues. This induction depended on a conserved amino acid response element (AARE) in the proximal promoter that binds C/EBP and ATF family transcription factors. MTHFD2 induction links mitochondrial dysfunction to serine-driven one-carbon and folate metabolism supporting purine and thymidine synthesis.
description_zh_TW: 對表達突變粒線體解旋酶 Twinkle 的小鼠的分析（這些小鼠會發展出進行性呼吸鏈功能障礙和骨骼肌中 COX 缺陷的纖維）顯示，包括 MTHFD2 在內的代謝基因被協調誘導，MTHFD2 是一種粒線體一碳酶，在發育和腫瘤中高表達，但在成人組織中通常低表達。這種誘導依賴於啟動子近端中保守的胺基酸反應元件（AARE），AARE 結合 C/EBP 和 ATF 家族轉錄因子。MTHFD2 誘導將粒線體功能障礙與絲氨酸驅動的一碳和葉酸代謝相連結，支持嘌呤和胸苷的合成。

label: Pathogen Infection
description: Bacteria secrete a wide array of diffusible proteinaceous toxins to fend off competing bacterial species, and a survey of over 500 bacterial species suggests a significant fraction secrete factors that influence host mitochondrial function. In organisms such as C. elegans, this mitochondrial dysfunction is sensed at least in part by the UPRmt, which activates a stress-induced pathway necessary for host defense. Widely used antibiotics like tetracyclines impose a low level of mitochondrial stress on eukaryotic cells, suggesting that hormetic mitochondrial stress responses can be employed for therapeutic benefit in pathogen challenge.
description_zh_TW: 細菌分泌各種各樣的可擴散蛋白質毒素來抵禦競爭的細菌物種，對超過 500 種細菌物種的調查表明，很大一部分分泌影響宿主粒線體功能的因子。在 C. elegans 等生物體中，這種粒線體功能障礙至少部分由 UPRmt 感知，UPRmt 活化宿主防禦所必需的壓力誘導途徑。廣泛使用的抗生素如四環素類對真核細胞施加低水平的粒線體壓力，表明促效應粒線體壓力反應可用於病原體挑戰中的治療益處。

label: Methionine Restriction
description: Methionine restriction extends lifespan in many species and, when initiated early or late in life, reduces body weight, increases lean mass, improves mitochondrial function and lipid metabolism, and reduces frailty in rodents. The metabolic response is partially dependent on FGF21 and also inhibits mTORC1. Methionine is the precursor of S-adenosyl-L-methionine, the universal methyl donor, so methionine deprivation may act through changes in histone methylation due to decreased methyl-donor availability. In humans, sulfur amino acid restriction increased FGF21, reduced leptin, and reduced body weight, and strict vegan diets reduce blood methionine and improve glucose homeostasis. Most methionine restriction studies require cysteine depletion for the metabolic benefits to manifest.
description_zh_TW: Methionine限制延長許多物種的壽命，無論是在生命早期還是晚期開始，都能減輕體重、增加瘦肉量、改善粒線體功能和脂質代謝，並減少囓齒類動物的虛弱。這種代謝反應部分依賴於FGF21，並且也抑制mTORC1。Methionine是S-adenosyl-L-methionine的前體，後者是通用的甲基供體，因此methionine缺乏可能通過甲基供體可用性減少導致的組蛋白甲基化變化來发挥作用。在人類中，硫氨基酸限制增加了FGF21，減少了瘦素，並減輕了體重，而嚴格的純素飲食降低了血液甲基丙氨酸並改善了葡萄糖穩態。大多數methionine限制研究需要半胱氨酸耗竭才能顯現代謝益處。

label: Mitochondrial protein import
description: The emerging theme from many studies is that protein import or processing is used as a readout of mitochondrial health and a signal to induce a hormetic response. Nuclear-encoded mitochondrial proteins enter through the TOM complex aided by cytosolic chaperones including HSP70 and HSP90, and impaired import can trigger quality control pathways such as mitoTAD, mitoCPR, and mitoRQC that extract, ubiquitinate, and degrade stalled precursor proteins via the proteasome, in a process coordinated by transcription factors HSF1, RPN4, and PDR3 in yeast. In mammals, defects in mitochondrial protein import can produce both protein and metabolic disruption, for instance non-imported citrate synthase functioning in the cytosol.
description_zh_TW: 許多研究的新興主題是，蛋白質輸入或加工被用作粒線體健康的讀數和誘導促效應反應的訊號。核編碼的粒線體蛋白透過 TOM 複合體進入，輔以包括 HSP70 和 HSP90 在內的細胞質分子伴護，受損的輸入可觸發品質控制途徑如 mitoTAD、mitoCPR 和 mitoRQC，這些途徑提取、泛素化並透過蛋白酶體降解停滯的前體蛋白，此過程在酵母中由轉錄因子 HSF1、RPN4 和 PDR3 協調。在哺乳動物中，粒線體蛋白輸入的缺陷可同時產生蛋白質和代謝紊亂，例如未輸入的檸檬酸合酶在細胞質中發揮功能。

label: EREG
description: EREG (epiregulin) is a transmembrane EGFR-family ligand secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP. It promotes cancer therapy resistance and immunosuppression, and apigenin treatment reverses the elevated circulating EREG induced by chemotherapy.
description_zh_TW: EREG（epiregulin）是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分分泌的穿膜 EGFR 家族配體。它促進癌症治療抗藥性與免疫抑制，而 apigenin 治療可逆转化療誘導升高的循環 EREG。

label: WNT16B
description: WNT16B is a Wnt family ligand induced and secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP, where it promotes paracrine therapy resistance in adjacent cancer cells. Apigenin treatment reduces WNT16B expression dose-dependently.
description_zh_TW: WNT16B 是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分誘導並分泌的 Wnt 家族配體，在相鄰癌細胞中促進旁分泌治療抗藥性。Apigenin 治療以劑量依賴方式降低 WNT16B 表現。

label: Heat Stress
description: Controlled heat stress induces HSP70/90 chaperones for proteostasis, with Finnish sauna cohort CVD/dementia benefit. XenohormesisESIS-grade evidence for thermal hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 受控熱壓力誘發 HSP70/90 伴侶以維持蛋白穩態，芬蘭桑拿隊列具 CVD/失智益處。熱荷爾蒙的 xenohormesis 級證據。

label: G6PD deficiency
description: G6PD deficiency is an inherited condition that impairs the pentose phosphate pathway and NADPH generation in erythrocytes. Because methylene blue's therapeutic effect in methemoglobinemia depends on the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, methylene blue should be avoided or used cautiously in G6PD-deficient patients, where it carries a risk of causing hemolysis. In such cases, ascorbic acid is an alternative treatment, and severe or refractory methemoglobinemia may require exchange transfusion or hyperbaric oxygen.
description_zh_TW: G6PD deficiency is an inherited condition that impairs the pentose phosphate pathway and NADPH generation in erythrocytes。Because methylene blue's therapeutic effect in methemoglobinemia depends on the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, methylene blue should be avoided or used cautiously in G6PD-deficient patients, where it carries a risk of causing hemolysis。In such cases, ascorbic acid is an alternative treatment, and severe or refractory methemoglobinemia may require exchange transfusion or hyperbaric oxygen。

label: Methemoglobin Reductase
description: Methylene blue, at low doses, serves as a cofactor that enhances the activity of the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, allowing it to reduce methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin. This mechanism is the basis for methylene blue's role as the first-line treatment for symptomatic methemoglobinemia. Because it relies on NADPH generated by the pentose phosphate pathway, methylene blue can be ineffective or dangerous in G6PD-deficient patients, where NADPH production is impaired and the drug instead risks precipitating hemolysis.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue, at low doses, serves as a cofactor that enhances the activity of the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, allowing it to reduce methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin。This mechanism is the basis for methylene blue's role as the first-line treatment for symptomatic methemoglobinemia。Because it relies on NADPH generated by the pentose phosphate pathway, methylene blue can be ineffective or dangerous in G6PD-deficient patients, where NADPH production is impaired and the drug instead risks precipitating hemolysis。

label: Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase
description: Due to the risk of hemolysis and worsening anemia, methylene blue is contraindicated in patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency. The hemolysis associated with methylene blue is mechanistically linked to its oxidative properties that overwhelm erythrocyte antioxidant defenses, and G6PD-deficient individuals have impaired NADPH generation that limits glutathione regeneration, rendering red blood cells unable to counteract oxidative stress and predisposing to rapid hemolysis. Methylene blue is also contraindicated in individuals with a known history of anaphylaxis or severe hypersensitivity to methylene blue or related thiazine dye products.
description_zh_TW: 由於溶血和貧血惡化的風險，methylene blue在葡萄糖-6-磷酸脫氫酶缺乏症患者中是禁忌的。與methylene blue相關的溶血在機制上與其氧化特性有關，這些特性壓倒紅血球的抗氧化防禦，而G6PD缺乏個體的NADPH生成受損，限制了谷胱甘肽再生，使紅血球無法對抗氧化應激，易於快速溶血。Methylene blue在已知有對methylene blue或相關噻嗪染料產品過敏或嚴重超敏反應病史的個體中也是禁忌的。

label: Mitochondrial Superoxide
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) attenuates mitochondrial superoxide production by acting as an alternative electron-transfer carrier that bypasses Complexes I-III, preventing electron backflow and premature electron leak to oxygen at these upstream sites. In HT-22 hippocampal neurons challenged with glutamate, MB dose-dependently suppressed the rise in mitochondrial ROS (EC50 ~20.37 nM), as measured by H2DCFDA, flow cytometry, and fluorescent microscopy. The reduced form leuco-MB can also directly scavenge superoxide and recycle back to oxidized MB, making MB a regenerable, mitochondria-specific antioxidant.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 通過作為替代電子傳遞載體，繞過複合體 I-III，減少線粒體超氧化物的產生，防止電子回流和提前洩漏到這些上游位點的氧氣。在 HT-22 海馬神經元中挑戰穀氨酸，MB 以劑量依賴方式抑制線粒體 ROS 的上升（EC50 ~20.37 nM），通過 H2DCFDA、流式細胞術和螢光顯微鏡測量。還原型 leuco-MB 也能直接清除超氧化物並回收為氧化型 MB，使 MB 成為可再生的、線粒體特異性抗氧化劑。

label: NADH
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) functions as an alternative mitochondrial electron-transfer carrier. It accepts electrons from NADH, likely via mitochondrial complex I, and is reduced to the leuco form (leuco-MB). It then donates those electrons onward to cytochrome c, bypassing the intermediate electron-transport chain complexes. This NADH-dependent reduction is what makes MB's mitochondrial antioxidant activity mitochondria-specific: in cell-free assays MB only reduces oxidative stress when both NADH and mitochondrial lysate are present, whereas classical chain-breaking antioxidants act independently of the electron transport chain.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)作為粒線體電子轉運的替代載體發揮作用。它從NADH接受電子，可能通過粒線體複合物I，並還原為無色形式（leuco-MB）。然後它將這些電子傳遞給細胞色素c，繞過中間的電子傳遞鏈複合物。這種NADH依賴性還原使得MB的粒線體抗氧化活性具有粒線體特異性：在無細胞測定中，只有當NADH和粒線體裂解液同時存在時，MB才能減少氧化應激，而經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑則獨立於電子傳遞鏈發揮作用。

label: LeucoMB
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) is reduced to its colorless leuco form, leuco-MB, upon accepting electrons from NADH via mitochondrial complex I. In this reduced state leuco-MB functions as a direct free-radical scavenger, capable of neutralizing superoxide generated by inhibition of the electron transport chain, and it then recycles back to the oxidized form of MB. This reduction-oxidation cycle makes MB a regenerable, mitochondria-specific antioxidant, distinct from one-use chain-breaking antioxidants. The requirement for NADH and mitochondria distinguishes MB's antioxidant action from that of simpler phenothiazine derivatives.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在通過粒線體複合物I從NADH接受電子後還原為其無色的leuco形式，leuco-MB。在這種還原狀態下，leuco-MB作為直接的自由基清除劑發揮作用，能夠中和由電子傳遞鏈抑制產生的超氧化物，然後它循環回MB的氧化形式。這種還原-氧化循環使MB成為一種可再生的、粒線體特異性的抗氧化劑，與一次性鏈斷裂抗氧化劑不同。對NADH和粒線體的要求將MB的抗氧化作用與更簡單的吩噻嗪衍生物區分開來。

label: Phenothiazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) is the first lead chemical structure of the phenothiazine class, the parent heterocyclic scaffold from which many other drugs derive. Structure-activity analysis showed that MB's distinctive neuroprotective and bioenergetic phenotype requires two structural features of the phenothiazine nucleus: a free (unsubstituted) 10-nitrogen and the position-5 sulfur of the thiazine ring. Adding an amine side chain to the 10-nitrogen (as in chlorpromazine or promethazine) produced roughly a 1000-fold loss of potency and abolished the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)是吩噻嗪類的第一個先導化學結構，是許多其他藥物衍生的母體雜環骨架。結構-活性分析表明，MB獨特的神經保護和生物能量表型需要吩噻嗪核的兩個結構特徵：游離（未取代的）10-氮和噻嗪環的5位硫。將胺側鏈添加到10-氮（如chlorpromazine或promethazine中）導致效力損失約1000倍，並廢除了複合物I到細胞色素c的電子分流。

label: Iodoacetic Acid
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) protects HT-22 cells against iodoacetic acid (IAA)-induced neurotoxicity. IAA is a toxic acetate derivative that inhibits glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate dehydrogenase and disrupts disulfide bonds, causing increased ROS and lipid peroxidation. MB increased cell viability against IAA at concentrations of 100 nM and 1 uM (though it lost protection at 10 uM), and all MB-related compounds tested were efficacious in this assay. MB's protection in the IAA model, together with the glutamate and rotenone models, demonstrates broad efficacy against mitochondrial and oxidative insults.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 可保護 HT-22 細胞免受碘乙酸 (IAA) 誘導的神經毒性。IAA 是一種有毒的醋酸鹽衍生物，可抑制甘油醛 3-磷酸脫氫酶並破壞二硫鍵，導致 ROS 和脂質過氧化增加。MB 在 100 nM 和 1 uM 濃度下可提高細胞對 IAA 的存活率（但在 10 uM 時失去保護作用），且所有測試的 MB 相關化合物在此檢測中均有效。MB 在 IAA 模型中的保護作用，加上穀氨酸和魚藤酮模型，證明其對線粒體和氧化損傷具有廣泛功效。

label: Glucose Oxidase
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) provides no protection against direct extracellular oxidative stress generated by glucose oxidase, which produces hydrogen peroxide in the culture medium. In HT-22 cells, glucose oxidase induced 80% cell death within 3 hours that was not attenuated by MB at any concentration tested, whereas the conventional antioxidant pyruvate (4 mM) provided robust protection. This distinguishes MB from classical chain-breaking antioxidants: MB acts upstream on mitochondrial electron flow rather than as a direct scavenger of extracellular hydrogen peroxide.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)對葡萄糖氧化酶產生的直接細胞外氧化應激沒有提供保護作用，葡萄糖氧化酶在培養基中產生過氧化氫。在HT-22細胞中，葡萄糖氧化酶在3小時內誘導80%的細胞死亡，這在任何測試濃度下都沒有被MB減弱，而傳統抗氧化劑丙酮酸（4 mM）提供了強大的保護作用。這將MB與經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑區分開來：MB在粒線體電子流的上游起作用，而不是作為細胞外過氧化氫的直接清除劑。

label: Complex III
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue can bypass dysfunctional Complex III in the mitochondrial electron transport chain, rerouting electron flow to maintain ATP production when normal respiratory chain pathways are impaired. Together with its ability to bypass Complex I, this makes methylene blue a molecular shunt that sustains oxidative phosphorylation and ATP output in compromised mitochondria. This effect is demonstrated in cellular and animal studies at sub-1 mg/kg doses (roughly 1-4 mg per dose in adults). The mitochondrial longevity data are largely from cells and mice, so human translation is not guaranteed, and most mechanistic evidence remains preclinical.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue可以繞過粒線體電子傳遞鏈中功能障礙的複合物III，在正常呼吸鏈路徑受損時重新引導電子流以維持ATP產生。與其繞過複合物I的能力結合，這使得methylene blue成為一種分子分流器，在受損的粒線體中維持氧化磷酸化和ATP輸出。這種效果在細胞和動物研究中以低於1 mg/kg的劑量（成人大約每次1-4毫克）得到證實。粒線體長壽數據主要來自細胞和小鼠，因此不能保證在人體中的轉化，大多數機制證據仍處於臨床前階段。

label: Dose-dependent Toxicity
description: Methylene blue demonstrates clear dose-dependent toxicity thresholds. At single doses of 3 mg/kg or more, hypotension, wheezing, and reduced oxygenation have been reported. Cumulative doses of 7 mg/kg or more can cause significant toxicity including nausea, vomiting, precordial pain, dyspnea, tachypnea, chest tightness, tachycardia, apprehension, tremor, mydriasis, abdominal pain, dizziness, paresthesia, headache, confusion, and mild methemoglobinemia up to 7 percent, with effects lasting 2 to 12 hours. Severe overdosage with a single dose of 20 mg/kg or more has caused severe intravascular hemolysis, hyperbilirubinemia, and death, and there is no specific antidote.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue顯示出明確的劑量依賴性毒性閾值。在單劑量3 mg/kg或更高時，已報告低血壓、喘鳴和氧合減少。累積劑量7 mg/kg或更高可能引起顯著毒性，包括毒性，包括噁心、嘔吐、心前區疼痛、呼吸困難、呼吸急促、胸緊、心動過速、焦慮、震顫、瞳孔散大、腹痛、頭暈、感覺異常、頭痛、意識模糊和輕度methemoglobinemia（高達7%），效果持續2至12小時。單劑量20 mg/kg或更嚴重的過量已導致嚴重的血管內溶血、高膽紅素血癥和死亡，並且沒有特異性解毒劑。

label: Intraoperative Staining
description: Methylene blue has several well-established off-label applications, including intraoperative staining to enhance visualization of structures such as the ureters, parathyroid glands, and sentinel lymph nodes during surgery, including sentinel lymph node mapping in breast cancer and other malignancies. For intraoperative lymph node mapping, 1 to 5 mL of 1 percent methylene blue is injected peritumorally, subareolarly, or pericervically depending on tumor type and anatomical site, and the dye migrates through lymphatic channels to allow visual identification of sentinel lymph nodes to guide surgical staging and resection.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue有幾個well-established的非標籤應用，包括術中染色以增強手術期間結構的可視化，如輸尿管、甲狀旁腺和前哨淋巴結，包括乳腺癌和其他惡性腫瘤中的前哨淋巴結定位。對於術中淋巴結定位，根據腫瘤類型和解剖部位，將1至5毫升1%的methylene blue注入瘤周、乳暈下或宮頸周圍，染料通過淋巴通道遷移，以實現前哨淋巴結的視覺識別，從而指導手術分期和切除。

label: Serotonin
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue increases synaptic serotonin by inhibiting monoamine oxidase enzymes, which normally break down serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine. Inhibiting these enzymes means more of these neurotransmitters remain in the synapse, which is how antidepressants like phenelzine work. This mechanism provides methylene blue's mild mood-lifting and anxiolytic effects at 0.5-2 mg doses, but it is also the source of its most serious safety concern: combining methylene blue with SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs can raise serotonin to dangerous levels and potentially trigger serotonin syndrome - a documented case-report-level interaction requiring physician involvement.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue通過抑制單胺氧化酶酶來增加突觸血清素，這些酶通常分解血清素、多巴胺和去甲腎上腺素。抑制這些酶意味著更多這些神經遞質留在突觸中，這就是phenelzine等抗抑鬱藥的作用方式。這種機制在0.5-2毫克劑量下提供methylene blue的輕度情緒提升和抗焦慮作用，但這也是其最嚴重安全問題的來源：將methylene blue與SSRIs、SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，並可能引發血清素症候群——這是一種已記錄的病例報告級別的相互作用，需要醫師參與。

label: Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue interacts dangerously with SSRIs and other serotonergic medications. As a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, methylene blue raises synaptic serotonin, and combining it with SSRIs (or SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs) can increase serotonin to dangerous levels, potentially causing serotonin syndrome. This interaction is a documented, case-report-level concern, and the article is emphatic that anyone on an antidepressant or serotonergic drug should not self-dose with methylene blue. If a person is on such medications, physician involvement is required before any dose, and the serotonin interaction screening is cited as a key reason to pursue a supervised protocol.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue與SSRIs和其他血清素能藥物危險地相互作用。作為單胺氧化酶抑制劑，methylene blue提高突觸血清素，將其與SSRIs（或SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物）結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，可能導致血清素症候群。這種相互作用是已記錄的、病例報告級別的關注點，文章強調任何服用抗抑鬱藥或血清素能藥物的人都不應自行服用methylene blue。如果一個人正在服用此類藥物，在任何劑量之前都需要醫師參與，並且血清素相互作用篩查被引用為追求監督方案的關鍵原因。

label: Vasoplegic Shock
description: Methylene blue is widely used off-label as adjunctive therapy for refractory vasoplegic shock, including septic and anaphylactic shock, to increase systemic vascular resistance in cases refractory to standard vasopressors, particularly in the setting of cardiac surgery such as coronary artery bypass grafting. It is commonly administered as a single intravenous bolus of 2 mg/kg over 20 to 30 minutes, with some protocols incorporating a bolus followed by continuous infusion. Evidence supporting routine preoperative or postoperative prophylactic use to reduce mortality remains limited, and this practice is not considered standard of care.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍廣泛用於治療 refractory 血管舒張性休克，包括敗血性和過敏性休克，以增加系統性血管阻力，適用於對標準血管加壓素 refractory 的病例，特別是在心臟手術如冠狀動脈繞道移植術中。通常以 2 mg/kg 劑量靜脈注射推注，持續 20 至 30 分鐘，有些方案包括推注後持續輸注。支持常規術前或術後預防性使用以降低死亡率的證據仍然有限，此實踐不被視為 standard of care。

label: Antimalarial Agent
description: Methylene blue was historically used as an antimalarial agent, though it is no longer considered standard therapy due to resistance and the availability of more effective agents. Its redox properties, which enable the restoration of functional hemoglobin and enhanced oxygen delivery, are the basis of its well-established FDA-approved role in toxicologic emergencies. Beyond this, the review catalogs off-label uses including intraoperative staining, ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy, refractory vasoplegic shock, neuroprotection, psychiatric disorders, cyanide poisoning adjunct, and proposed anti-inflammatory use in COVID-19 and ARDS.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue在歷史上曾用作抗瘧疾藥物，但由於耐藥性和更有效藥物的可用性，它不再被認為是標準治療。其氧化還原特性使得功能性血紅蛋白恢復和增強氧氣輸送成為可能，這是在毒理學緊急情況中其well-established的FDA批准角色的基礎。除此之外，該綜述還列出了非標籤用途，包括術中染色、ifosfamide誘導的腦病變、難治性血管痙攣性休克、神經保護、精神疾病、氰化物中毒輔助治療，以及在COVID-19和ARDS中提出的抗炎用途。

label: Serotonin Syndrome
description: Serotonin syndrome has been reported following administration of methylene blue, particularly when used concomitantly with medications that increase serotonergic activity, including selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors, and monoamine oxidase inhibitors, certain opioids, and dextromethorphan. The FDA labeling carries a boxed warning that methylene blue may cause serious or fatal serotonin syndrome when combined with serotonergic drugs and opioids, and recommends avoiding concomitant use entirely. Clinical manifestations include altered mental status, autonomic instability, neuromuscular abnormalities, seizures, and gastrointestinal symptoms.
description_zh_TW: 在施用methylene blue後已有血清素症候群的報告，特別是當與增加血清素能活性的藥物同時使用時，包括選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑、血清素-去甲腎上腺素再吸收抑制劑和單胺氧化酶抑制劑、某些鴉片類藥物和dextromethorphan。FDA標籤帶有方框警告，指出methylene blue與血清素能藥物和鴉片類藥物結合使用可能導致嚴重或致命的血清素症候群，並建議完全避免同時使用。臨床表現包括精神狀態改變、自主神經不穩定、神經肌肉異常、癲癇發作和胃腸道症狀。

label: Pulse Oximetry
description: The presence of methylene blue in the bloodstream can cause pulse oximetry to significantly underestimate true oxygen saturation by interfering with the device's measurement wavelengths. During and shortly after methylene blue infusion, arterial blood gas analysis with direct measurement of oxygen saturation (SaO2) should be used instead of pulse oximetry to accurately assess oxygenation. Methylene blue is also excreted in the urine and, because of its blue coloration, may interfere with urinalysis methods relying on colorimetric indicators such as dipstick testing for leukocyte esterase, potentially resulting in false-negative or uninterpretable results.
description_zh_TW: 血液中methylene blue的存在可能導致脈搏血氧儀通過干擾設備的測量波長而顯著低估真正的氧飽和度。在methylene blue輸注期間和之後不久，應使用直接測量氧飽和度（SaO2）的動脈血氣分析而不是脈搏血氧儀來準確評估氧合。Methylene blue也會在尿液中排泄，並且由於其藍色著色，可能干擾依賴比色指標的尿液分析方法，如白細胞酯酶的試紙檢測，可能導致假陰性或無法解釋的結果。

label: Global Hypomethylation
description: The best-characterized signature of epigenetic drift is global hypomethylation of repetitive elements and gene bodies coupled with site-specific hypermethylation of gene promoters. This age-related divergence of methylation patterns erodes the stability of the epigenome and contributes to the loss of cellular identity and transcriptional fidelity. Because drift accumulates with time and is modified by environment, lifestyle, and interventions such as caloric restriction, it underlies both biological aging and the age-associated increase in disease risk.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳漂變的最佳特徵是重複元件和基因體的整體低甲基化以及基因啟動子的位點特異性高甲基化。這種與年齡相關的甲基化模式的差異會侵蝕表觀基因組的穩定性，並導致細胞身份和轉錄保真度的喪失。由於漂移會隨著時間的推移而累積，並會受到環境、生活方式和熱量限制等乾預措施的改變，因此它是生物老化和與年齡相關的疾病風險增加的基礎。

label: TMG
description: TMG (trimethylglycine/betaine) is a methyl donor that, via betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase, converts homocysteine to methionine. By supporting remethylation it helps maintain a high SAM:SAH ratio, reducing SAH accumulation and preserving methylation capacity.
description_zh_TW: TMG（三甲基甘氨酸/betaine）是甲基供體，經由甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶將同型半胱氨酸轉化為甲硫氨酸。透過支持再甲基化，它有助於維持高 SAM:SAH 比例，減少 SAH 累積並保存甲基化能力。

label: Barr Body
description: The compacted silent X chromosome is the Barr body.
description_zh_TW: 緻密沉默的 X 染色體即 Barr body。

label: Dosage Compensation
description: X inactivation equalizes X-linked gene dosage between the sexes.
description_zh_TW: X 失活平衡兩性間 X 連鎖基因劑量。

label: benzene ring with two hydroxyl groups
description: Catechols contain a benzene ring bearing two adjacent (ortho) hydroxyl groups, a structural motif that is both chemically reactive and the specific recognition site for COMT. This vicinal diol is methylated at the meta position by COMT using SAMe, yielding O-methylated metabolites that are less reactive and more readily excreted. The presence of this group defines whether a molecule, endogenous or xenobiotic, is a COMT substrate or, at high concentrations, a competitive inhibitor. The motif also renders catechols prone to oxidation, linking them to reactive quinone chemistry.
description_zh_TW: Catechols 含有一個帶有兩個相鄰（鄰位）羥基的苯環，這是一種具有化學反應性的結構基序，也是 COMT 的特異性識別位點。這種鄰位二醇被 COMT 使用 SAMe 在間位甲基化，產生反應性較低且更容易排泄的 O-甲基化代謝物。該基團的存在決定了分子（內源性或外源性）是 COMT 底物還是高濃度的競爭性抑制劑。該基序也使兒茶酚易於氧化，將它們與反應性醌化學聯繫起來。

label: Estrogen metabolites
description: Estrogen metabolites, such as 2-hydroxyestrone and 4-hydroxyestrone, are catechols because they retain a catechol ring formed during hydroxylation, making them substrates for COMT. COMT O-methylates these metabolites into less genotoxic methoxyestrogens, a protective detoxification step that reduces exposure to reactive catecholestrogen quinones. Slow COMT can therefore slow the clearance of catecholestrogens, with implications for hormone-related cancer risk. This connection links COMT genotype to estrogen metabolism and cancer susceptibility hypotheses.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen metabolites，如 2-羥基雌酮和 4-羥基雌酮，是兒茶酚，因為它們保留了羥基化過程中形成的兒茶酚環，使其成為 COMT 的底物。 COMT 將這些代謝物 O-甲基化成遺傳毒性較小的甲氧基雌激素，這是一種保護性解毒步驟，可減少活性兒茶酚醌的暴露。因此，緩慢的 COMT 可以減緩兒茶酚雌激素的清除，進而影響荷爾蒙相關的癌症風險。這種關聯將 COMT genotype 與雌激素代謝和癌症易感性假設聯繫起來。

label: folate
description: MTHFD1 metabolizes folate as a trifunctional enzyme catalyzing NADP-dependent methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase, cyclohydrolase, and formyltetrahydrofolate synthetase reactions in the cytosolic folate cycle. These steps produce 10-formyl-THF used in purine synthesis and contribute to the one-carbon pool that supports methylation. Disruption of MTHFD1 perturbs nucleotide synthesis and the methyl donor supply downstream of folate, indirectly affecting COMT by limiting SAMe availability. It is a central node in cytosolic one-carbon metabolism.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 將 folate 代謝為三功能酶，催化細胞質 folate 循環中的 NADP 依賴性亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫酶、環化水解酶和甲醯四氫葉酸合成酶反應。這些步驟產生用於嘌呤合成的 10-甲醯基-THF，並有助於形成支持甲基化的一碳庫。 MTHFD1 的破壞會擾亂核苷酸合成和 folate 下游的 methyl donor 供應，透過限制 SAMe 的可用性來間接影響 COMT。它是細胞質一碳代謝的中心節點。

label: methionine synthase activity
description: MTRR maintains methionine synthase activity by reducing the enzyme's bound cobalamin (vitamin B12) cofactor back to its active form after oxidative inactivation, using FAD and NADPH. Without MTRR, methionine synthase loses function, halting homocysteine remethylation and depleting the methionine and SAMe pool. This positions MTRR as essential for methylation cycle continuity and for sustaining the methyl donor supply that COMT requires. Its activity links B12 status directly to one-carbon metabolism.
description_zh_TW: MTRR 透過使用 FAD 和 NADPH 將酵素的結合鈷胺素（維生素 B12）輔因子還原至氧化失活後的活性形式來維持 methionine synthase activity。如果沒有 MTRR，蛋胺酸合成酶就會失去功能，停止同型半胱胺酸再甲基化並耗盡甲硫胺酸和 SAMe 池。這使得 MTRR 對於 methylation cycle 的連續性和維持 COMT 所需的 methyl donor 供應至關重要。其活性將 B12 狀態直接與一碳代謝連結起來。

label: mood side effects in slow COMT
description: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) can cause mood side effects, such as anxiety, irritability, or overstimulation, in slow COMT individuals because it is a direct methyl donor that adds to an already slowly processed methyl burden. The excess methyl groups can shift neurotransmitter and epigenetic methylation beyond the optimal range, producing emotional dysregulation. Slower COMT individuals are therefore often advised to use non-methylated B12 forms such as hydroxocobalamin or adenosylcobalamin. The effect is dose-dependent and genotype-specific.
description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) 可能會在緩慢的 COMT 個體中引起情緒副作用，例如焦慮、易怒或過度刺激，因為它是直接的 methyl donor，會增加已經緩慢處理的甲基負擔。過量的 methyl groups 可以使神經傳導物質和表觀遺傳甲基化超出最佳範圍，從而產生情緒失調。因此，速度較慢的 COMT 個體通常被建議使用非甲基化 B12 形式，例如羥鈷胺或腺苷鈷胺。其作用具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性。

label: active B12 form
description: Methylcobalamin is an active coenzyme form of vitamin B12 that serves directly as a methyl donor, functioning as the cofactor for methionine synthase in homocysteine remethylation to methionine. By supplying methyl groups it supports SAMe generation and the methylation cycle, positioning it upstream of COMT's methyl donor supply. Its methyl-donating nature distinguishes it from adenosylcobalamin, which supports mitochondrial energy metabolism instead. It is a common supplement, though its methyl load requires caution in slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin 是維生素 B12 的活性輔酶形式，直接充當 methyl donor，在同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸過程中充當蛋氨酸合成酶的輔因子。透過供應 methyl groups，它支援 SAMe 世代和 methylation cycle，將其定位在 COMT 的 methyl donor 供應的上游。其提供甲基的性質使其與腺苷鈷胺素不同，腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。它是一種常見的補充劑，但其甲基負荷對於緩慢的 COMT 個體需要謹慎。

label: Methylfolate production
description: By channeling one-carbon units toward 5-methyl-THF via MTHFR, MTHFD1 indirectly supports the methylation cycle and methylfolate production. Because methylfolate feeds SAMe production for COMT, MTHFD1 activity influences the availability of methyl donors consumed by COMT. Inefficient MTHFD1 therefore potentially compounds slow-COMT phenotypes.
description_zh_TW: 透過將一碳單元經 MTHFR 導向 5-甲基-THF，MTHFD1 間接支援 methylation cycle 和 methylfolate 產生。由於 methylfolate 供應 COMT 所消耗的 SAMe 產生，MTHFD1 活性影響 COMT 消耗的 methyl donor 可用性。因此低效的 MTHFD1 可能加重緩慢-COMT 表型。

label: 10-formyl-THF
description: MTHFD1 is a trifunctional cytosolic enzyme that catalyzes NADP+-dependent reactions interconverting folate-bound one-carbon units, including dehydrogenation of 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate to 10-formyl-THF. 10-formyl-THF supplies carbons for de novo purine ring formation. A mitochondrial paralog, MTHFD2, performs analogous reactions during proliferation.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 是三功能細胞質酶，催化 NADP+ 依賴性反應，在葉酸結合的一碳單元之間進行互換，包括將 5,10-亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫為 10-formyl-THF。10-formyl-THF 為 de novo 嘌呤環形成提供碳。粒線體旁系同源物 MTHFD2 在增殖期間執行類似的反應。

label: purine synthesis
description: MTHFD1 produces 10-formyl-THF, which supplies carbons for de novo purine ring formation, and the methylene form feeds thymidylate synthase for DNA replication. Thus MTHFD1 links nucleotide biosynthesis with the methyl-donor economy. This dual role makes it important for cell proliferation and DNA synthesis.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 產生 10-formyl-THF，後者為 de novo 嘌呤環形成提供碳，而亞甲基形式則為 DNA 複製提供胸苷酸合成酶。因此 MTHFD1 將核苷酸生物合成與甲基供體經濟連結起來。這種雙重角色使其對細胞增殖和 DNA 合成很重要。

label: Methionine Synthase
description: MTRR (methionine synthase reductase) is a flavoprotein reductase that sustains the activity of methionine synthase by reducing its oxidized cobalt center back to the active Co1+ state. Without continuous reduction by MTRR, the cobalt center becomes oxidized to an inactive form, halting methyl transfer. This reductase step preserves methylation flux.
description_zh_TW: MTRR（methionine synthase reductase）是黃素蛋白還原酶，透過將其氧化的鈷中心還原回活性的 Co1+ 狀態來維持 methionine synthase 的活性。若沒有 MTRR 的持續還原，鈷中心會氧化為不活躍形式，停止甲基轉移。此還原步驟維持甲基化通量。

label: Vitamin B12 cofactor
description: MTRR maintains the Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) cofactor of methionine synthase in its active reduced state, preventing the futile cycling that would halt methyl transfer. Every catalytic cycle of MTR carries a risk of oxidative inactivation of the B12 cofactor. MTRR preserves methylation flux by reducing the cobalt center.
description_zh_TW: MTRR 將 methionine synthase 的 Vitamin B12（鈷胺素）輔因子維持在活性的還原狀態，防止會停止甲基轉移的無效循環。MTR 的每個催化循環都有 B12 輔因子氧化失活的風險。MTRR 透過還原鈷中心來維持甲基化通量。

label: oxidized cobalamin cofactor
description: MTRR uses FAD and NADPH to reduce the oxidized (Co2+/Co3+) form of methionine synthase's methylcobalamin cofactor back to its active Co1+ state. This allows the enzyme to accept a methyl group from methylfolate and transfer it to homocysteine. MTRR rescues the enzyme from oxidative inactivation after each catalytic cycle.
description_zh_TW: MTRR 使用 FAD 和 NADPH 將 methionine synthase 的甲基鈷胺素輔因子氧化（Co2+/Co3+）形式還原回其活性的 Co1+ 狀態。這使酶能從 methylfolate 接受甲基並將其轉移至同型半胱氨酸。MTRR 在每個催化循環後將酶從氧化失活中救回。

label: cofactor for Methionine Synthase
description: MethylB12 (methylcobalamin) functions as the prosthetic group of methionine synthase (MTR), which remethylates homocysteine to methionine using the methyl group supplied by methylfolate. The cobalt-carbon bond is labile, enabling direct transfer of the methyl group to homocysteine. This reaction simultaneously regenerates tetrahydrofolate for nucleotide synthesis.
description_zh_TW: MethylB12（甲鈷胺）充當 methionine synthase (MTR) 的輔助基團，後者使用 methylfolate 提供的甲基將同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸。鈷-碳鍵不穩定，能直接將甲基轉移至同型半胱氨酸。此反應同時再生四氫葉酸以供核苷酸合成。

label: 900 mg per day
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: A sub-chronic 90-day toxicity study in rats established that repeated oral administration of synthetic NMN at doses up to 1500 mg/kg/day appears safe and did not promote toxic effects on body weight, food and water consumption, feed conversion efficiency, or biochemical and blood parameters, although higher doses increased kidney, liver, and adrenal gland weights and elevated hepatic enzymes such as alkaline phosphatase, alanine aminotransferase, and aspartate aminotransferase. Based on these findings, the established upper intake level of NMN for a 60 kg individual was set at 900 mg per day. Human studies at 100-500 mg single doses and 250-300 mg/day over weeks to months reported no adverse effects.
description_zh_TW: 一項大鼠亞慢性 90 天毒性研究確立，重複口服高達 1500 mg/kg/天的合成 NMN 似乎安全，且未對體重、食物與水分攝取、飼料轉換效率或生化與血液參數產生毒性效應，儘管較高劑量增加了腎臟、肝臟與腎上腺重量，並提升了鹼性磷酸酶、丙胺酸轉胺酶與天門冬胺酸轉胺酶等肝酶。基於這些發現，60 kg 個體的 NMN 既定上限攝取量設定為每天 900 mg。人體研究中，100-500 mg 單次劑量以及 250-300 mg/天持續數週至數月均未報告不良反應。

label: Combined Metabolic Activators
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Combined metabolic activators (CMAs), consisting of NR (1 g), l-carnitine tartrate (3.73 g), N-acetylcysteine (2.55 g), and serine (12.35 g), improved COVID-19 outcomes in clinical trials. Patients taking the mixture orally for 14 days had significantly faster complete recovery times than placebo (6.6 vs 9.3 days in a phase 2 study and 5.7 vs 9.2 days in a phase 3 study). CMAs were found to reinforce the immune response and regulate amino acid and lipid metabolism, and patients showed improvements in plasma levels of inflammation and antioxidant metabolism-related biomarkers including alanine aminotransferase, lactate dehydrogenase, creatinine, glucose, and proteins. NR within the mixture contributes NAD+ restoration supporting antiviral PARP function.
description_zh_TW: 合併代謝活化劑（CMAs）由 NR（1 g）、酒石酸左旋肉鹼（3.73 g）、N-乙醯半胱胺酸（2.55 g）和絲胺酸（12.35 g）組成，在臨床試驗中改善了 COVID-19 結果。口服此混合物 14 天的患者，其完全康復時間顯著快於安慰劑組（第二期研究為 6.6 對 9.3 天，第三期研究為 5.7 對 9.2 天）。CMAs 被發現能強化免疫反應並調節胺基酸與脂質代謝，且患者的發炎與抗氧化代謝相關生物標記血漿水平有所改善，包括丙胺酸轉胺酶、乳酸脫氫酶、肌酸酐、葡萄糖與蛋白質。混合物中的 NR 有助於 NAD+ 恢復，支持抗病毒 PARP 功能。

label: Acute Pancreatitis
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) derived from the gut microbiota ameliorates acute pancreatitis injury. In acute pancreatitis mouse models, NMN increased NAD+ levels and activated the SIRT3-PRDX5 pathway, mitigating pancreatic mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative damage, and inflammation in a partially SIRT3-dependent manner. Acute pancreatitis is exacerbated by gut microbiota dysbiosis, and normobiotic fecal microbiota transplantation induced higher serum NMN levels, enhancing NAD+ biosynthesis in the pancreas. This makes NMN an important mediator of the protective effects of fecal microbiota transplantation and highlights the role of gut microbiota-produced NAD+ precursors in pathological outcomes of the host.
description_zh_TW: 源自腸道菌叢的菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）改善急性胰臟炎損傷。在急性胰臟炎小鼠模型中，NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平並活化 SIRT3-PRDX5 路徑，以部分依賴 SIRT3 的方式減輕胰臟粒線體功能障礙、氧化損傷與發炎。急性胰臟炎會因腸道菌叢失調而惡化，而正常菌叢糞便微生物移植誘導了較高的血清 NMN 水平，增強胰臟中的 NAD+ 生合成。這使 NMN 成為糞便微生物移植保護效應的重要介導者，並凸顯腸道菌叢產生的 NAD+ 前驅物在宿主病理結果中的作用。

label: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is an effective intervention against the pathophysiology of type 2 diabetes in both diet-induced and age-induced mouse models. Intraperitoneal administration at 500 mg/kg body weight per day for 11 days substantially ameliorated impaired glucose tolerance and enhanced hepatic insulin sensitivity, with the reversal of gene expression changes related to oxidative stress, inflammatory response, and circadian rhythm partly resulting from SIRT1 activation. NMN also restored glucose-stimulated insulin secretion in aged beta-cell-specific SIRT1-overexpressing (BESTO) mice and aged wild-type mice, and in postmenopausal women with prediabetes, 250 mg/day for 10 weeks increased NAD+ in PBMCs and improved insulin signaling and sensitivity in skeletal muscle.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）是針對第2型糖尿病病理生理學的有效介入手段，適用於飲食誘發與年齡誘發的小鼠模型。以500 mg/kg體重每日腹腔注射、持續11天，可顯著改善受損的葡萄糖耐受性並增強肝臟胰島素敏感性；其對氧化壓力、發炎反應與晝夜節律相關基因表現變化的逆轉，部分源自SIRT1的活化。NMN亦能恢復老年β細胞專一性SIRT1過度表現（BESTO）小鼠與老年野生型小鼠，以及患有糖尿病前期的停經後婦女之葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌；在後者中，每日250 mg、持續10週可提升PBMC中的NAD+，並改善骨骼肌的胰島素訊號傳遞與敏感性。

label: Edamame
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is found in a range of foods including edamame beans, avocado, broccoli, cucumber, cabbage, and tomato, according to the first evidence published by Mills et al. (2016). Among the investigated sources, the highest NMN content was found in edamame at 0.47-1.88 mg/100 g and avocado at 0.36-1.60 mg/100 g, with smaller amounts in seafood and raw meats (0.06-0.42 mg/100 g). Milk also contains NMN, with human milk the richest source at 2.1-9.8 uM. These natural occurrences support the idea that a normal diet can contribute to NAD+ precursor intake, though optimal sources remain to be established.
description_zh_TW: 根據 Mills 等人（2016）發表的首批證據，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）存在於一系列食物中，包括毛豆、酪梨、花椰菜、小黃瓜、高麗菜和番茄。在受調查的來源中，NMN 含量最高的是毛豆（0.47-1.88 mg/100 g）和酪梨（0.36-1.60 mg/100 g），海鮮與生肉中含量較少（0.06-0.42 mg/100 g）。牛奶也含有 NMN，其中人乳是最豐富的來源，達 2.1-9.8 uM。這些天然存在支持正常飲食可貢獻 NAD+ 前驅物攝取的概念，儘管最佳來源仍有待確立。

label: Gut Dysbiosis
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) reverses gut dysbiosis and protects the intestinal tract. In an experimental mouse model of colitis induced by dextran sodium sulfate, NMN given by gavage at 1 mg/g body weight increased microbial abundance and diversity, improved mucus secretion and tight-junction protein expression, and attenuated intestinal mucosal permeability, protecting against inflammatory bowel disease. Long-term NMN treatment modulated gut microbiota diversity and composition, increasing butyric acid-producing bacteria such as Ruminococcaceae UCG-014 and Prevotellaceae NK3B31 as well as Akkermansia muciniphila, while decreasing harmful bacteria like Bilophila and Oscillibacter. NMN thereby restores intestinal homeostasis and barrier integrity through microbiota remodeling.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）逆轉腸道失調並保護腸道。在硫酸葡聚醣誘發的實驗性小鼠結腸炎模型中，以 1 mg/g 體重灌胃給予 NMN 增加了微生物豐度與多樣性，改善黏液分泌與緊密連接蛋白表現，並減輕腸黏膜通透性，防護發炎性腸道疾病。長期 NMN 處理調節腸道菌叢多樣性與組成，增加產丁酸細菌如 Ruminococcaceae UCG-014 和 Prevotellaceae NK3B31 以及 Akkermansia muciniphila，同時減少 Bilophila 和 Oscillibacter 等有害細菌。NMN 因此透過菌叢重塑恢復腸道恆定與屏障完整性。

label: SLC12A8
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SLC12A8 is a transporter encoded by the gene SLC12A8 that has been proposed to mediate cellular uptake of nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), in addition to the CD73-mediated dephosphorylation route in which NMN is converted extracellularly to nicotinamide riboside for uptake. The expression of a gut transporter reinforces that NMN could be made bioavailable through oral delivery, and the presence of such a transporter in the intestine supports the idea that dietary NMN can enter the circulation. These uptake mechanisms complement each other and explain how orally administered NMN is rapidly absorbed from the intestine into the bloodstream and converted to NAD+ in tissues.
description_zh_TW: SLC12A8 是由基因 SLC12A8 編碼的轉運蛋白，被認為除了 CD73 介導的去磷酸化途徑（NMN 在細胞外轉化為菸鹼醯胺核糖以供吸收）之外，還介導菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）的細胞攝取。腸道轉運蛋白的表現強化了 NMN 可透過口服遞送達成生物可利用性的觀點，而此類轉運蛋白在腸道中的存在支持膳食性 NMN 能進入循環的構想。這些攝取機制互補，並解釋了口服給予的 NMN 如何從腸道快速吸收進入血流並在組織中轉化為 NAD+。

label: Intestinal Stem Cell
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), an NAD+ precursor, restores NAD+ in intestinal stem cells and reverses mtDNA-mutation-driven dysfunction via UPRmt, linking the NAD+ fuel line to stem-cell resilience.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）作為 NAD+ 前體，可恢復腸道幹細胞的 NAD+，並經 UPRmt 逆轉 mtDNA 突變驅動的功能障礙，將 NAD+ 燃料線與幹細胞韌性連結。

label: Adiponectin
description: Administration of adiponectin to obese, high-fat-fed mice improves insulin sensitivity and lowers blood glucose, reflecting its role as an insulin-sensitizing adipokine. It acts through the AdipoR1/2 receptors to activate AMPK and PPAR-α pathways that enhance fatty-acid oxidation and glucose uptake. Directionally, adiponectin sits upstream of improved insulin action in peripheral tissues. Because SIRT1 raises adiponectin via the FOXO1–C/EBPα axis, this forms part of SIRT1's anti-diabetic circuitry, and declining adiponectin with obesity contributes to the insulin resistance that sirtuin-activating interventions aim to reverse.
description_zh_TW: 向肥胖的高脂飲食小鼠施用脂聯素可改善胰島素敏感性並降低血糖，反映其作為胰島素增敏脂肪因子的作用。它通過 AdipoR1/2 受體活化 AMPK 和 PPAR-α 通路，增強脂肪酸氧化和葡萄糖攝取。在方向性上，脂聯素位於周圍組織改善胰島素作用的上游。由於 SIRT1 通過 FOXO1–C/EBPα 軸提高脂聯素，這構成 SIRT1 抗糖尿病電路的一部分，肥胖伴隨的脂聯素下降導致胰島素抵抗，sirtuin 活化干預旨在逆轉這一過程。

label: NMN
description: NMN supplementation raised aerobic capacity in an amateur-runner RCT and mitochondrial respiratory ability in aged mice. Enhancement is attributed to NAD+ restoration feeding sirtuin-driven oxidative metabolism.
description_zh_TW: NMN 補充在業餘跑者 RCT 提高有氧能力，在老年小鼠提高粒線體呼吸能力。增強歸因於 NAD+ 恢復供養 sirtuin 驅動的氧化代謝。

label: TFEB for CLEAR element
description: The oncogenic transcription factor MYC competes with TFEB for binding to CLEAR elements in the promoters of lysosomal and autophagy genes. By occupying these sites, MYC represses the TFEB-driven transcriptional program while simultaneously driving its own proliferative gene network. This competitive binding creates a molecular antagonism between growth-promoting and degradative transcriptional programs. The interplay explains how MYC-high tumors suppress autophagy-lysosomal capacity even as they increase metabolic demand.
description_zh_TW: 致癌轉錄因子 MYC 與 TFEB 競爭結合溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的 CLEAR 元件。透過佔據這些位點，MYC 抑制 TFEB 驅動的轉錄程序，同時驅動其自身的增生基因網絡。這種競爭性結合在促生長和降解的轉錄程序之間創造了分子拮抗。此交互作用解釋了 MYC 高表現的腫瘤如何抑制自噬—溶酶體能力，即使它們增加了代謝需求。

label: Glutathione Depletion
description: Asthma is associated with glutathione depletion, as the GSH/GSSG ratio is markedly decreased in asthmatic airways, weakening local antioxidant defense. This sensitizes the airway to oxidant triggers and allergen-induced inflammation. The directionality is disease to lowered thiol buffer. A caveat is that glutathione changes vary by asthma phenotype and severity, and some patients show different redox patterns. Replenishing airway GSH with N-acetylcysteine has been explored as an adjunctive strategy to restore antioxidant capacity in asthmatic airways.
description_zh_TW: Asthma 與 glutathione depletion 相關，因為 asthmatic 氣道中的 GSH/GSSG 比率顯著降低，削弱了局部抗氧化防禦。這會使氣道對氧化劑觸發物和過敏原引起的發炎變得敏感。方向性是降低硫醇緩衝液的疾病。需要注意的是，glutathione 的變化因 asthma 表型和嚴重程度而異，並且一些患者表現出不同的氧化還原模式。人們已經探索以 N-乙醯半胱氨酸補充氣道 GSH 作為恢復 asthmatic 氣道抗氧化能力的輔助策略。

label: Eosinophil Peroxidase
description: Eosinophil peroxidase produces hypobromous acid (HOBr) by using bromide and H2O2 to generate the brominating oxidant in eosinophilic inflammation such as allergic asthma. HOBr is the eosinophil analog of neutrophil HOCl. The directionality is EPO catalysis to HOBr formation. A caveat is that HOBr is less studied than HOCl, and bromination biomarkers are less established, though it is similarly reactive toward proteins. Bromotyrosine adducts are elevated in allergic airway disease and serve as specific markers of eosinophil-mediated oxidant damage.
description_zh_TW: 在過敏性asthma等嗜酸性粒細胞發炎中，Eosinophil peroxidase透過使用溴化物和H2O2生成溴化氧化劑來產生hypobromous acid(HOBr)。 HOBr 是中性粒細胞 HOCl 的嗜酸性粒細胞類似物。方向性是 EPO 催化 HOBr 形成。需要注意的是，雖然 HOBr 對 proteins 具有類似的反應性，但與 HOCl 相比，對 HOBr 的研究較少，並且溴化生物標誌物的建立也較少。 Bromotyrosine 加合物在過敏性氣道疾病中升高，並作為嗜酸性粒細胞介導的氧化損傷的特異性標記。

label: Ribosome Biogenesis
description: SIRT7 drives ribosome biogenesis by activating RNA Pol I at rDNA and suppresses p21 via H3K18 deacetylation, fueling the biosynthetic capacity tumors need; it is overexpressed in breast, thyroid, and HCC. This proliferative, biosynthetic driver role makes SIRT7 an oncogenic sirtuin.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過在 rDNA 活化 RNA Pol I 並經由 H3K18 去乙醯化抑制 p21，驅動核糖體生成，供應腫瘤所需的生物合成能力；它在乳癌、甲狀腺與 HCC 中過度表現。此增生性、生物合成驅動角色使 SIRT7 成為致癌 sirtuin。

label: ELK1
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ELK1 is the founding member of the ternary complex factor subfamily of ETS-domain transcription factors, alongside ELK3 and ELK4 (SAP-1), and is a major nuclear target of the RAS-MAPK/ERK cascade that controls immediate-early gene expression. In the context of sirtuin biology it serves as the canonical reference for the ETS-TCF family whose member ELK4 stabilizes SIRT7 at target promoters. Directionally, ELK1's ETS DNA-binding domain and SRF-coupling architecture are shared by the TCF family, informing how ELK4 anchors SIRT7 to chromatin for H3K18 deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: ELK1 是 ETS 結構域轉錄因子三元複合物因子亞家族的創始成員，與 ELK3 和 ELK4（SAP-1）並列，是 RAS-MAPK/ERK 細胞階級傳導路徑的主要細胞核靶標，控制即早基因表達。在 sirtuin 生物學的背景下，它作為 ETS-TCF 家族的標準參考，其成員 ELK4 將 SIRT7 穩定於靶啟動子處。方向性上 ELK1 的 ETS DNA 結合結構域和 SRF 偶聯架構為 TCF 家族所共享，闡明了 ELK4 如何將 SIRT7 錨定到染色質上進行 H3K18 去乙醯化。

label: colorectal, gastric, and luminal breast cancer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In humans, SIRT7 takes part in the genesis of colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, and luminal breast cancer. SIRT7 is overexpressed in multiple cancer tissues, promoting the survival of cancer cells and the maintenance of a transformed state. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of tumorigenesis in these cancer types, and its overexpression supports the transformed phenotype across a broad range of tumours.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT7參與大腸直腸癌、胃癌和管腔型乳腺癌的發生。SIRT7在多種癌症組織中過表達，促進癌細胞的存活和轉化狀態的維持。方向上，SIRT7位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤發生的上游，其過表達在廣泛的腫瘤中支持轉化表型。

label: Replicative lifespan
description: Overexpression of SIRT7 extends the replicative lifespan of primary human cells by maintaining rDNA stability and reducing mitochondrial dysfunction. Directionally, SIRT7 gain sits upstream of prolonged cellular lifespan. This mirrors the pro-longevity roles of other sirtuins and supports a broadly conserved lifespan-promoting function for the family. The mechanism likely involves preservation of ribosomal DNA repeats, maintenance of heterochromatin, and support of mitochondrial gene expression through GABPβ1. SIRT7's ability to extend replicative lifespan is consistent with the theme that sirtuin activity generally counteracts cellular senescence.
description_zh_TW: 過度表達 SIRT7 透過維護 rDNA 穩定性和減少粒線體功能障礙來延長原代人類細胞的複製壽命。在方向性上，SIRT7 功能增強位於延長細胞壽命的上游。這反映了其他 sirtuin 的促長壽角色，支持該家族具有廣泛保守的壽命促進功能。其機制可能涉及核糖體 DNA 重複序列的保存、異染色質的維護以及透過 GABPβ1 對粒線體基因表達的支持。SIRT7 延長複製壽命的能力與 sirtuin 活性普遍對抗細胞衰老的主題一致。

label: rDNA transcription
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 activates RNA polymerase I transcription of ribosomal DNA and is required for pre-rRNA cleavage, driving ribosome biogenesis and protein synthetic capacity; this nucleolar function supports growth and, in cancer, tumor proliferation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 活化 RNA 聚合酶 I 對核糖體 DNA 的轉錄，並為前 rRNA 切割所需，驅動核糖體生物合成和蛋白質合成能力；這種核仁功能支持生長，在癌症中支持腫瘤增殖。

label: RNA Polymerase I transcription
description: SIRT7 activates RNA polymerase I-mediated transcription of ribosomal DNA, driving ribosome biogenesis and protein synthetic capacity in proliferating cells. It does so in part through deacetylation of histone H3K18 at rDNA loci and by stabilizing the Pol I transcriptional apparatus, ensuring sufficient ribosome output for growth. Directionally, SIRT7 acts upstream to enhance rRNA production and ribosome biogenesis. By sustaining this biosynthetic capacity, SIRT7 supports cell growth and proliferation, which underlies its roles in development and in cancer, where ribosome biogenesis is frequently upregulated.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 活化 RNA 聚合酶 I 介導的核糖體 DNA 轉錄，驅動增殖細胞中的核糖體生物合成和蛋白質合成能力。它部分通過去乙醯化 rDNA 基因座處的組蛋白 H3K18 以及穩定 Pol I 轉錄裝置來實現，確保足夠的核糖體產出以支持生長。在方向性上，SIRT7 在上游增強 rRNA 產生和核糖體生物合成。通過維持這種生物合成能力，SIRT7 支持細胞生長和增殖，這是其在發育和癌症中作用的基礎，在癌症中核糖體生物合成經常被上調。

label: ERK and STAT3 signaling
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT7 affects the malignancy of glioma cells mainly by promoting glioma proliferation and invasion through the ERK and STAT3 signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of ERK- and STAT3-driven glioma progression. By sustaining these proliferative and invasive signaling cascades, SIRT7 supports the aggressive growth and spread characteristic of glioma. This identifies SIRT7 as a pro-tumorigenic factor in this brain cancer and suggests that SIRT7 inhibition could suppress glioma progression. The finding adds to the emerging picture of SIRT7 as an oncogenic sirtuin in certain malignancies, where its functions diverge from the longevity-promoting roles of other family members.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7主要透過ERK和STAT3訊號通路促進膠質瘤增殖和侵襲來影響膠質瘤細胞的惡性程度。方向上，SIRT7位於ERK和STAT3驅動的膠質瘤進展的上游。透過維持這些增殖性和侵襲性訊號級聯，SIRT7支持膠質瘤特徵性的侵略性生長和擴散。這將SIRT7確定為此腦癌中的促腫瘤因子，並表明SIRT7抑制可以抑制膠質瘤進展。此發現增加了SIRT7作為某些惡性腫瘤中致癌sirtuin的新興圖景，其功能與其他家族成員的促長壽角色不同。

label: human stem cell aging as a heterochromatin stabilizer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 antagonizes human stem cell aging as a heterochromatin stabiliser and safeguards chromatin structure. As a heterochromatin stabiliser, SIRT7 counteracts human stem cell ageing. SIRT7 also regulates innate immune modulation and ensures geroprotection during stem cell ageing. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of heterochromatin maintenance and stem cell rejuvenation, protecting stem cells from age-related chromatin deterioration.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7作為異染色質穩定劑對抗人類幹細胞老化並維護染色質結構。作為異染色質穩定劑，SIRT7對抗人類幹細胞老化。SIRT7也調節先天免疫調節並在幹細胞老化期間確保老年保護。方向上，SIRT7位於異染色質維護和幹細胞回春的上游，保護幹細胞免受與年齡相關的染色質惡化。

label: glucose availability with mitochondrial biogenesis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 arginine methylation maintains energy balance by coordinating glucose availability with mitochondria biogenesis. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of the coupling between nutrient (glucose) status and mitochondrial mass. By linking glucose sensing to mitochondrial biogenesis, SIRT7 helps the cell match energy production to substrate availability, contributing to metabolic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7精氨酸甲基化透過協調葡萄糖可用性與粒線體生成來維持能量平衡。方向上，SIRT7位於營養（葡萄糖）狀態與粒線體質量之間耦合的上游。透過將葡萄糖感知與粒線體生成聯繫起來，SIRT7幫助細胞使能量產生與底物可用性匹配，有助於代謝恆定。

label: GABPβ1
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates GA-binding protein beta1 (GABPbeta1), a subunit of the GABP transcription factor complex that controls expression of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes. Deacetylation facilitates GABP complex formation and transcriptional activation of these genes, supporting mitochondrial biogenesis and function. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of GABP-dependent mitochondrial gene expression. SIRT7 deficiency accordingly causes systemic mitochondrial dysfunction, manifesting as lactate accumulation and cardiac abnormalities.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7去乙醯化GA結合蛋白beta1（GABPbeta1），這是控制核編碼粒線體基因表達的GABP轉錄因子複合物的一個亞基。去乙醯化促進GABP複合物的形成和這些基因的轉錄活化，支持粒線體生成和功能。方向上，SIRT7位於GABP依賴性粒線體基因表達的上游。因此SIRT7缺乏會導致全身粒線體功能障礙，表現為乳酸積累和心臟異常。

label: Epigenetic regulation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates H3K18 on promoters (Barber et al., 2012, Nature, PMID 22722849) and associates with chromatin remodelers (including PAF1 complex) to regulate rDNA transcription, ribosomal biogenesis, and global gene expression; age-related SIRT7 decline perturbs these epigenetic landscapes (source review; Vakhrusheva et al., 2008).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化啟動子上的 H3K18（Barber et al., 2012, Nature, PMID 22722849），並與染色質重塑因子（包括 PAF1 複合物）結合，以調節 rDNA 轉錄、核糖體生成和整體基因表現；與年齡相關的 SIRT7 下降會擾亂這些表觀遺傳景觀（來源文獻; Vakhrusheva et al., 2008）。

label: RNA Polymerase I
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates and regulates RNA Polymerase I transcription at rDNA, controlling ribosome biogenesis (Ford et al., 2006).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化並調節 RNA 聚合酶 I 在 rDNA 上的轉錄，控制核糖體生物合成（Ford et al., 2006）。
