label: H2A
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histone H2A, contributing to its nucleolar/chromatin regulatory program.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H2A，有助於其核仁/染色質調控程序。

label: H2B
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histone H2B as part of its chromatin modification repertoire.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H2B，作為其染色質修飾 repertoire 的一部分。

label: Histone H3
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histone H3 at K18 (and H2A/H2B), an activity associated with repression of tumor-suppressor genes; SIRT7 thereby helps sustain the cancer phenotype without driving transformation. Directionally, SIRT7 enzymatically remodels chromatin to favor oncogenic transcription. This links nucleolar SIRT7 to tumor biology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的 K18（以及 H2A/H2B），此活性與腫瘤抑制基因的抑制相關；因此 SIRT7 有助於維持癌症表型而不驅動轉化。方向性上 SIRT7 以酵素方式重塑染色質以有利於致癌性轉錄。這將核仁 SIRT7 與腫瘤生物學聯繫起來。

label: histone desuccinylation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 functions as a histone desuccinylase that links chromatin compaction to genome stability, deacetylating H3K18 at promoters and desuccinylating histones to maintain heterochromatic state and suppress DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 作為組蛋白去琥珀酰酶，將染色質凝縮與基因組穩定性聯繫起來，去乙醯化啟動子上的 H3K18 並去琥珀酰化組蛋白以維持異染色質狀態並抑制 DNA 損傷。

label: aging and lifespan of hematopoietic cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 has deacetylase activity and plays a critical role in ageing and lifespan of hematopoietic cells in humans. SIRT7 is an influence factor in healthy aging and the development of age-dependent myeloid stem-cell disorders. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of haematopoietic stem cell maintenance and healthy aging, with dysregulation linked to age-dependent blood disorders.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7具有去乙醯酶活性，在人類造血細胞的老化和壽命中發揮關鍵作用。SIRT7是健康老化和年齡依賴性骨髓幹細胞疾病發展的影響因子。方向上，SIRT7位於造血幹細胞維護和健康老化的上游，其失調與年齡依賴性血液疾病相關。

label: oncogene (upregulated in cancers)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 is described as oncogene (upregulated in cancers); it is upregulated in cancers and acts as an oncogene in several contexts (Barber 2012 PMID 22722849).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 被描述為癌基因（在癌症中上調）；它在癌症中上調，並在多種環境中作為癌基因（Barber 2012 PMID 22722849）。

label: Stress resistance
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 promotes cellular stress resistance by suppressing ER stress and reactive-ROS programs via Myc-linked silencing of ribosomal protein genes and by stabilizing DNA repair; SIRT7-depleted cells show increased apoptosis and metabolic stress (Shin et al., 2013, PMID 24210820; source review).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過抑制內質網壓力和活性氧自由基程式（經由 Myc 連結的核糖體蛋白基因沉默）以及穩定 DNA 修復，促進細胞抗壓力能力；SIRT7 缺失的細胞表現出凋亡增加和代謝壓力上升（Shin et al., 2013, PMID 24210820; 來源文獻）。

label: H3K18ac (histone H3 lysine 18)
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT7 promotes tumorigenesis by deacetylating lysine 18 of histone H3, thereby repressing genes with tumor-suppressor function. SIRT7 is stabilized at target promoters through interaction with the ETS-family transcription factor ELK4, and the resulting H3K18 deacetylation is necessary to maintain features such as anchorage-independent growth and loss of contact inhibition. Directionally, SIRT7 activity at H3K18 sits upstream of tumor suppressor gene repression. Loss of SIRT7 reduces the tumorigenicity of human cancer xenografts, making it the clearest pro-oncogenic sirtuin and positioning SIRT7 inhibition as the therapeutic direction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的第 18 位離胺酸促進腫瘤發生，從而抑制具有腫瘤抑制功能的基因。SIRT7 透過與 ETS 家族轉錄因子 ELK4 的相互作用穩定於靶啟動子處，產生的 H3K18 去乙醯化對於維持锚定非依賴性生長和接觸抑制喪失等特徵是必要的。方向性上 SIRT7 在 H3K18 上的活性位於腫瘤抑制基因抑制的上游。SIRT7 的缺失降低人類癌症異種移植的致瘤性，使其成為最明確的促致癌 sirtuin，並將 SIRT7 抑制定位為治療方向。

label: rRNA transcription
description: SIRT7 regulates rRNA transcription by activating RNA polymerase I and deacetylating histone H3K18 at ribosomal DNA, controlling ribosome biogenesis and protein synthetic capacity. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of Pol I activity and ribosome production. Because excessive ribosome biogenesis fuels proliferation, this activity aligns SIRT7 with growth and, in cancer, with tumor promotion. It also ties SIRT7 to nucleolar stress responses and, through deacetylation of GABPβ1, to the transcriptional control of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes, such that SIRT7 deficiency causes systemic mitochondrial dysfunction with lactate accumulation and cardiac abnormalities.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 通過活化 RNA 聚合酶 I 並去乙醯化核糖體 DNA 處的組蛋白 H3K18 來調節 rRNA 轉錄，控制核糖體生物合成和蛋白質合成能力。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 Pol I 活性和核糖體產生的上游。由於過度的核糖體生物合成促進增殖，此活性使 SIRT7 與生長一致，在癌症中與腫瘤促進一致。它也將 SIRT7 與核仁壓力反應以及通過 GABPβ1 去乙醯化對核編碼粒線體基因的轉錄控制聯繫起來，使得 SIRT7 缺乏導致伴隨乳酸堆積和心臟異常的系統性粒線體功能障礙。

label: VSMC proliferation and migration
description: SIRT7 regulates vascular smooth-muscle cell (VSMC) proliferation and migration through the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway, limiting the neointimal hyperplasia that drives vascular disease. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of VSMC quiescence. By restraining VSMC activation, SIRT7 protects against atherosclerotic and restenotic remodeling after vascular injury. It adds a vascular-stability role to SIRT7, complementing its cardiac functions, and loss of SIRT7 permits excessive VSMC growth and migration. The Wnt/β-catenin pathway is a central driver of VSMC phenotypic switching, and SIRT7's regulation of it links sirtuins to vascular remodeling.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 通過 Wnt/β-catenin 信號通路調節血管平滑肌細胞（VSMC）的增殖和遷移，限制驅動血管疾病的新生內膜增生。在方向性上，SIRT7 位於 VSMC 靜止的上游。通過限制 VSMC 活化，SIRT7 保護對抗血管損傷後的動脈粥樣硬化和再狹窄重塑。這為 SIRT7 增加了血管穩定性角色，與其心臟功能互補，SIRT7 的缺失允許過度的 VSMC 生長和遷移。Wnt/β-catenin 通路是 VSMC 表型轉換的中心驅動因子，SIRT7 對其的調節將 sirtuin 與血管重塑聯繫起來。

label: rDNA transcription and pre-rRNA cleavage
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Sirtuin 7 is required not only for rDNA transcription but also for particular pre-rRNA cleavage. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of ribosomal RNA synthesis and processing in the nucleolus. By supporting both rDNA transcription and pre-rRNA cleavage, SIRT7 is essential for ribosome biogenesis, connecting SIRT7 to growth, protein synthesis, and cellular proliferation.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 7不僅是rDNA轉錄所必需的，也是特定pre-rRNA切割所必需的。方向上，SIRT7位於核仁中核糖體RNA合成和加工的上游。透過支持rDNA轉錄和pre-rRNA切割，SIRT7對核糖體生成至關重要，將SIRT7與生長、蛋白質合成和細胞增殖聯繫起來。

label: dependent on N- and C-terminal domains
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The DNA-activated deacetylase activity of SIRT7 is dependent on both the N- and C-terminal domains. The SIRT7 N-terminal domain (NTD) is made up of three helices, and according to the findings SIRT7-NTD has structural similarities to transcription factor regulators and may have a role in DNA binding. Directionally, the SIRT7 NTD sits upstream of DNA binding and enzymatic activation, connecting SIRT7 structure to its chromatin-associated functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7的DNA活化去乙醯酶活性依賴於N端和C端結構域。SIRT7 N端結構域（NTD）由三條螺旋組成，根據研究結果，SIRT7-NTD與轉錄因子調節器具有結構相似性，可能在DNA結合中具有作用。方向上，SIRT7 NTD位於DNA結合和酵素活化的上游，將SIRT7結構與其染色質相關功能聯繫起來。

label: SIRT7 at target gene promoters
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The ETS-family transcription factor ELK4 interacts with SIRT7 and stabilizes the deacetylase at target gene promoters, allowing SIRT7 to deacetylate histone H3 at lysine 18 and repress tumor-suppressor genes. This tethering is required to maintain cancer hallmarks such as anchorage-independent growth and loss of contact inhibition. Directionally, ELK4-bound promoter occupancy precedes SIRT7-dependent H3K18 deacetylation. SIRT7 depletion accordingly reduces the tumorigenicity of human cancer xenografts, highlighting the ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 axis as an oncogenic regulatory circuit.
description_zh_TW: ETS 家族轉錄因子 ELK4 與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 SIRT7 能去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。這種錨定對於維持锚定非依賴性生長和接觸抑制喪失等癌症特徵是必需的。方向性上 ELK4 結合的啟動子占據先於 SIRT7 依賴的 H3K18 去乙醯化。SIRT7 的耗竭相應地降低人類癌症異種移植的致瘤性，凸顯 ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 軸線作為致癌性調控迴路的重要性。

label: H3K18
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histones, in particular H3K18, whose deacetylation is associated with repression of tumor suppressor genes. SIRT7 can therefore support a cancer phenotype by inhibiting expression of tumor suppressors, though it is required only to sustain, not initiate, oncogenic transformation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白，尤其是 H3K18，其去乙醯化與腫瘤抑制基因的抑制相關。因此 SIRT7 可透過抑制腫瘤抑制因子的表達來支持癌症表型，但僅用於維持而非啟動致癌轉化。

label: OXPHOS
source_file: _document_ - Complex I drives glutamine-dependent TCA cycle to support viability of MYChigh breast cancer cells (NAD+).md
description: MYC induces elevated respiration, coupling oncogenic transcription to oxidative metabolism.
description_zh_TW: MYC 誘發升高的呼吸，將致癌轉錄耦合到氧化代謝。

label: Glutamine
source_file: _document_ - Complex I drives glutamine-dependent TCA cycle to support viability of MYChigh breast cancer cells (NAD+).md
description: MYC-high cells depend on glutamine as TCA carbon fuel.
description_zh_TW: MYC 高細胞依賴麩醯胺酸作為 TCA 碳燃料。

label: TRIAD
description: TRIAD (Test of Rapamycin In Aging Dogs) is a parallel-group, double-masked, randomized, placebo-controlled trial testing rapamycin's effect on lifespan and healthspan in companion dogs.
description_zh_TW: TRIAD（Test of Rapamycin In Aging Dogs）是一項平行分組、雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照的試驗，測試 rapamycin 對伴侶犬壽命與健康壽命的影響。

label: Hyperlipidemia
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: Chronic rapamycin or everolimus use is associated with elevated cholesterol and triglyceride levels (hyperlipidemia), alongside mucosal ulcers, impaired wound healing, delayed tissue repair, and increased infection risk. These metabolic disturbances were common in the EXIST-3 trial and other cohorts, along with stomatitis, infections, and cytopenias. The mechanisms are attributed to both mTORC1 inhibition and unintended mTORC2 suppression, which induces insulin resistance.
description_zh_TW: 慢性rapamycin或everolimus使用與膽固醇和甘油三酯水平升高（高脂血症）相關，並伴有黏膜潰瘍、傷口癒合受損、組織修復延遲和感染風險增加。這些代謝紊亂在EXIST-3試驗和其他隊列中很常見，並伴有口腔炎、感染和血細胞減少症。機制歸因於mTORC1抑制和意外mTORC2抑制，後者誘發胰島素阻抗。

label: Glucose Intolerance
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: Chronic rapamycin treatment is associated with metabolic disturbances including glucose intolerance and hyperlipidemia in both mice and humans administered rapamycin for prevention of immunosenescence. Mechanistically these effects are attributed not only to mTORC1 inhibition but also to unintended suppression of mTORC2, which induces insulin resistance - a mechanistic trade-off between metabolic side effects and longevity benefits. Houde et al. showed chronic rapamycin causes glucose intolerance and hyperlipidemia by upregulating hepatic gluconeogenesis and impairing lipid deposition in adipose tissue.
description_zh_TW: 慢性rapamycin治療與代謝紊亂相關，包括在rapamycin給藥以預防免疫老化的兩者小鼠和人類中的葡萄糖不耐症和高脂血症。從機制上講，這些效應不僅歸因於mTORC1抑制，還歸因於意外抑制mTORC2，這會誘發胰島素阻抗——這是代謝副作用和壽命益處之間的機制權衡。Houde等人顯示慢性rapamycin透過上調肝臟糖質新生和損害脂肪組織中的脂質沉積來引起葡萄糖不耐症和高脂血症。

label: mTORopathies
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: The success of rapamycin in mTORopathy models stems from clearly defined molecular etiology and robust biomarkers: highly penetrant mutations driving mTOR hyperactivation render the pathway an actionable target. In TSC and GATOR1-related models such as Nprl3 knockout mice, rapamycin prevented seizures, reduced mortality, and rescued neuropathology, including when delivered in utero or postnatally. Everolimus is used as precision therapy in GATOR1-related epilepsies.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin在mTOR病模型中的成功源於明確的分子病因學和強大的生物標誌物：驅動mTOR過度激活的高外顯率突變使該通路成為可操作的靶點。在TSC和GATOR1相關模型（如Nprl3敲除小鼠）中，rapamycin預防了癲癇、降低了死亡率並挽救了神經病理學，包括在子宮內或出生後給藥時。Everolimus被用作GATOR1相關癲癇的精準治療。

label: Stomatitis
description: While aspirin may cause gastric ulceration and bleeding, rapamycin may cause stomatitis and mucositis, ulceration of the mucous membranes of the mouth and digestive tract, when used at high doses or chronically. A rare side effect of rapamycin is noninfectious interstitial pneumonitis, and by inhibiting neutrophil function rapamycin may increase the severity of bacterial infections. These side effects require rapamycin's discontinuation, but for anti-aging purposes rapamycin may be used intermittently (e.g., once a week) or at low daily doses and can be discontinued if any unpleasant effects occur.
description_zh_TW: 雖然aspirin可能導致胃潰瘍和出血，rapamycin在高劑量或長期使用時可能導致口腔炎和黏膜炎，口腔和消化道黏膜的潰瘍。rapamycin的一個罕見副作用是非感染性間質性肺炎，透過抑制中性粒細胞功能，rapamycin可能增加細菌感染的嚴重性。這些副作用需要停止rapamycin，但為了抗老化目的，rapamycin可以間歇性使用（例如，每週一次）或低劑量每日使用，如果發生任何不適效應可以停止。

label: Pneumonitis
description: A rare side effect of rapamycin is noninfectious interstitial pneumonitis, which is not reliably reversible with continued dosing and mandates stopping therapy. It is listed among the serious adverse events of mTOR inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin 的罕見副作用是非感染性間質性肺炎，繼續給藥未必可逆，必須停藥。它被列為 mTOR 抑制劑的嚴重不良事件之一。

label: ACE Inhibitors
description: ACE inhibitors are proposed as components of a combined anti-aging formulation alongside rapamycin, metformin, aspirin, and PDE5 inhibitors. In this framework agents that address multiple age-related diseases are combined with mTOR inhibition so that they complement one another and mitigate respective side effects.
description_zh_TW: ACE 抑制劑被提出作為與 rapamycin、metformin、aspirin 及 PDE5 抑制劑並用的聯合抗衰老配方組成。在此框架下，針對多種老化相關疾病的藥物與 mTOR 抑制合併使用，以互補並減輕各自的副作用。

label: Anemia
description: Anemia is one of the hematological cytopenias that can accompany chronic mTOR inhibitor therapy. Rapamycin and rapalogs reduce blood cell counts by inhibiting cell proliferation, with mild reversible anemia among the common hematological side effects.
description_zh_TW: 貧血是慢性 mTOR 抑制劑治療可能伴隨的血液細胞減少症之一。Rapamycin 與 rapalog 透過抑制細胞增殖降低血球數量，輕度可逆的貧血是常見的血液學副作用之一。

label: Hallmarks of Aging
description: Geroprotectors are interventions that slow the rate of aging by modulating the conserved hallmarks of aging rather than treating a single disease. This geroscience strategy aims to compress morbidity and extend healthspan.
description_zh_TW: 延緩衰老劑（geroprotectors）是透過調控保守的衰老標誌而非治療單一疾病來減緩衰老速率的介入措施。此老年科學（geroscience）策略旨在壓縮疾病期並延長健康壽命。

label: Leukopenia
description: Leukopenia is a decrease in circulating white blood cells and one of the hematological cytopenias linked to chronic mTOR inhibitor use. Chronic high-dose rapamycin lowers blood cell counts, and mild reversible leukopenia is a common side effect.
description_zh_TW: 白血球減少症是循環白血球減少，是與慢性 mTOR 抑制劑使用相關的血液細胞減少症之一。慢性高劑量 rapamycin 降低血球數量，輕度可逆的白血球減少是常見副作用。

label: PDE5 Inhibitors
description: PDE5 inhibitors block phosphodiesterase type 5 and are cited as conventional agents that prevent or treat more than one disease, qualifying as somewhat anti-aging drugs. They are proposed components of a combined anti-aging formulation with rapamycin, metformin, aspirin, and ACE inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: PDE5 抑制劑阻斷第五型磷酸二酯酶，被引用為可預防或治療多種疾病的傳統藥物，具備某種抗衰老藥物資格。它們被提出作為與 rapamycin、metformin、aspirin 及 ACE 抑制劑並用的聯合抗衰老配方成分。

label: Oncogene Activation
description: Activated oncogenes such as RAS, BRAF, and MYC drive hyperproliferation and replication stress, which in turn elicit oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) as an intrinsic tumor-suppressive failsafe. The unscheduled S-phase entry generates DNA replication stress and DNA damage that stabilize p53 and derepress the CDKN2A/p16INK4a locus, locking cells in arrest. OIS is observed in benign lesions such as melanocytic nevi and is a major barrier to tumor progression. The paradox is that OIS cells secrete a SASP that, while recruiting immune clearance, can also promote tumorigenesis in neighboring cells.
description_zh_TW: 活化的致癌基因如 RAS、BRAF 與 MYC 驅動過度增殖與複製壓力，進而引發致癌基因誘發衰老（OIS），作為一種內在的腫瘤抑制失效安全機制。非預期的 S 期進入產生 DNA 複製壓力與 DNA 損傷，穩定 p53 並去抑制 CDKN2A/p16INK4a 位點，將細胞鎖定於停滯。OIS 見於如黑色素細胞痣等良性病灶，是腫瘤進展的主要屏障。其矛盾之處在於，OIS 細胞分泌 SASP，雖能招募免疫清除，也可能促進鄰近細胞的腫瘤發生。

label: p16/Rb Pathway
description: The p16INK4a/Rb pathway enforces the long-term, irreversible phase of senescence independently of p53. p16 inhibits CDK4 and CDK6, keeping Rb hypophosphorylated and bound to E2F, thereby preventing expression of S-phase genes; this locks in a durable growth arrest. Unlike the p53/p21 arm, which can be transient, p16/Rb-mediated arrest is typically sustained for the life of the cell and is the stronger correlate of in vivo senescent burden with age. Its engagement is a key determinant of why senescence is considered irreversible rather than a quiescent state.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4a/Rb 路徑獨立於 p53 地執行衰老的長期、不可逆階段。p16 抑制 CDK4 與 CDK6，使 Rb 維持低磷酸化並結合 E2F，從而阻止 S 期基因表現；這將持久的生長停滯鎖定。與可能短暫的 p53/p21 臂不同，p16/Rb 介導的停滯通常維持細胞終生，且是體內衰老負擔隨年齡更強的相關因子。其啟動是衰老被視為不可逆而非靜止狀態的關鍵決定因素。

label: p53/p21 Pathway
description: The p53/p21 axis is a primary enforcement mechanism of senescence, especially in damage- and stress-induced forms. DNA damage stabilizes p53, which transcriptionally induces the CDK inhibitor p21CIP1; p21 inhibits cyclin E/A-CDK2, preventing phosphorylation of Rb and blocking S-phase entry. This pathway provides a rapid, p53-dose-dependent G1/S arrest that can be engaged acutely after genotoxic insult. A caveat is that the p53 pathway is frequently disabled in cancer, and p53 also restrains the SASP, so its loss reshapes rather than simply abolishes senescence.
description_zh_TW: p53/p21 軸是衰老的主要執行機制，尤其在損傷與壓力誘發的形式中。DNA 損傷穩定 p53，後者轉錄誘導 CDK 抑制因子 p21CIP1；p21 抑制 cyclin E/A-CDK2，阻止 Rb 磷酸化並阻斷 S 期進入。此路徑提供快速、依賴 p53 劑量的 G1/S 停滯，可在基因毒性傷害後立即啟動。需注意，p53 路徑在癌症中常被失能，且 p53 也會抑制 SASP，因此其缺失是重塑而非單純廢除衰老。

label: Executioner Caspase
description: Executioner caspases are the terminal proteases of the apoptotic cascade that dismantle the cell. In aging, senescent-cell resistance to executioner-caspase killing via SCAPs is a barrier to senescent-cell clearance, linking executioner-caspase biology to senescence persistence.
description_zh_TW: 執行型 caspase 是分解細胞的細胞凋亡級聯末端蛋白酶。在衰老中，衰老細胞經由 SCAPs 對執行型 caspase 殺傷的抵抗是衰老細胞清除的障礙，將執行型 caspase 生物學與衰老持續相連結。

label: Coenzyme
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is an essential coenzyme that plays central roles in cellular oxidation-reduction reactions, including most catabolic and anabolic processes such as glycolysis, fatty acid beta-oxidation, the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and the synthesis of fatty acids, cholesterol, and steroids. Beyond its redox function, NAD+ is consumed by enzymes including sirtuins, poly-ADP-ribose polymerases (PARPs), CD38/CD157 ectoenzymes, and mono-ADP-ribose transferases, whose activity can deplete cellular NAD+ content.
description_zh_TW: NAD+（nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide）是一種必需的輔酶，在細胞氧化還原反應中扮演核心角色，包括大多數分解代謝與合成代謝過程，如 glycolysis、fatty acid beta-oxidation、tricarboxylic acid cycle，以及脂肪酸、膽固醇與類固醇的合成。除了其氧化還原功能外，NAD+ 會被包括 sirtuins、poly-ADP-ribose polymerases（PARPs）、CD38/CD157 ectoenzymes，以及 mono-ADP-ribose transferases 在內的酵素所消耗，這些酵素的活性可能耗竭細胞內的 NAD+ 含量。

label: NMNAT
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NMNAT (NMN/NaMN adenylyltransferases) catalyzes the final biosynthetic step in which nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is converted to the essential coenzyme NAD+. This step is shared by the salvage pathways from both nicotinamide riboside (NR) and nicotinamide (NAM): NR is first phosphorylated to NMN by NMRK1/NMRK2, while NAM is converted to NMN by NAMPT. NAD+ is required for glycolysis, fatty acid oxidation, and the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and it serves as the substrate for NAD+-consuming enzymes such as sirtuins and PARPs. Elevating NAD+ through precursor supplementation underlies the beneficial metabolic, cardiovascular, and neuroprotective effects attributed to NR.
description_zh_TW: NMNAT（NMN/NaMN adenylyltransferases）催化最後一個生物合成步驟，在此步驟中菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）被轉化為必需輔酶 NAD+。此步驟為來自菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）與菸鹼醯胺（NAM）兩者的補救途徑所共有：NR 先由 NMRK1/NMRK2 磷酸化為 NMN，而 NAM 則由 NAMPT 轉化為 NMN。NAD+ 為糖解作用、脂肪酸氧化與三羧酸循環所必需，並作為 NAD+ 消耗酶（如 sirtuins 與 PARPs）的受質。透過前驅物補充提升 NAD+，是歸因於 NR 的有益代謝、心血管與神經保護作用的基礎。

label: Quinolinic Acid
description: The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+. Because the pathway accounts for approximately 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production, its flux through IDO1 and TDO substantially shapes systemic NAD+ levels and neuroactive metabolite balance. KP dysregulation is implicated in neurodegeneration, depression, chronic inflammation, and infections (e.g., HIV modulates IDO1), in part because of the neuroactive and excitotoxic properties of kynurenine and quinolinic acid. This links IDO1 activity to both metabolic and neurological outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 犬尿胺酸途徑產生包括犬尿烯酸、3-羥基犬尿胺酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素與 NAD+ 前驅物）以及最終 NAD+ 在內的多種代謝物。由於該途徑佔蛋白質合成與血清素生成以外約 95% 的色胺酸分解，其經由 IDO1 與 TDO 的流量大幅塑造全身 NAD+ 濃度與神經活性代謝物平衡。KP 失調被認為與神經退化、憂鬱症、慢性發炎及感染（例如 HIV 調節 IDO1）有關，部分原因是犬尿胺酸與喹啉酸的神經活性與興奮毒性特性。這將 IDO1 活性同時連結至代謝與神經學結果。

label: Misfolded Proteins
description: The mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt) is activated by the accumulation of misfolded proteins within the mitochondrial matrix, analogous to the classic ER stress response. Expression of a misfolding-prone mutant of the matrix protein ornithine transcarbamylase induces a nuclear transcriptional response that upregulates mitochondrial-specific chaperones. In C. elegans, activation of UPRmt requires the transcription factor ATFS-1, and matrix-derived peptides exported through the ABC transporter HAF-1 signal mitochondrial stress to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）由粒線體基質中折疊錯誤蛋白的積累所活化，類似於經典的內質網壓力反應。基質蛋白鳥氨酸氨甲醯基轉移酶的易折疊突變體的表達，會誘導核轉錄反應，上調粒線體特異性分子伴護。在 C. elegans 中，UPRmt 的活化需要轉錄因子 ATFS-1，而基質衍生的肽段透過 ABC 轉運蛋白 HAF-1 輸出，將粒線體壓力訊號傳遞到細胞核。

label: Sirtuin activity (SIRT1, SIRT3)
description: 78c indirectly boosts SIRT1 and SIRT3 by maintaining NAD+ co-substrate availability, restoring their deacetylase function in aged tissue. Directionally, NAD+ preservation sits upstream of sirtuin reactivation. This is an indirect pan-sirtuin approach distinct from direct STACs, and it links CD38 pharmacology to longevity pathways. By preventing NAD+ consumption, 78c ensures that sirtuins have the co-substrate they require, effectively restoring the NAD+-dependent regulation that declines with age. This strategy is complementary to NAD+ precursor supplementation, and the two approaches are often combined.
description_zh_TW: 78c 透過維護 NAD+ 共同底物的可用性間接增強 SIRT1 和 SIRT3，恢復其在老年組織中的去乙醯酶功能。在方向性上，NAD+ 保存位於 sirtuin 重新活化的上游。這是與直接 STAC 不同的間接全 sirtuin 方法，將 CD38 藥理學與長壽途徑聯繫起來。透過防止 NAD+ 消耗，78c 確保 sirtuin 擁有所需的共同底物，有效恢復隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 依賴性調控。此策略與 NAD+ 前驅物補充互補，兩種方法經常結合使用。

label: CD38 (NAD+-glycohydrolase)
description: 78c is a highly potent, selective, orally bioavailable small-molecule inhibitor of CD38 NAD+-glycohydrolase activity. Directionally, 78c sits upstream of CD38 blockade. By stopping NAD+ consumption, it spares the co-substrate for sirtuins and other NAD+-dependent enzymes, and it is a leading age-reversal NAD+-preservation strategy. 78c's potency and oral bioavailability make it suitable for chronic in vivo studies, and its administration to aged mice restores NAD+ levels and sirtuin activity. These properties positioned 78c as the key pharmacological tool for validating CD38 as a longevity target.
description_zh_TW: 78c 是一種高效力、高選擇性、口服可利用的 CD38 NAD+ 糖水解酶活性小分子抑制劑。在方向性上，78c 位於 CD38 阻斷的上游。透過阻止 NAD+ 消耗，它節省了 sirtuin 和其他 NAD+ 依賴性酶的共同底物，是領先的衰老逆轉 NAD+ 保存策略。78c 的效力和口服可利用性使其適用於長期體內研究，其對老年小鼠的施用恢復了 NAD+ 水平和 sirtuin 活性。這些特性使 78c 成為驗證 CD38 作為長壽靶標的關鍵藥理學工具。

description: Administration of 78c to naturally aged male mice yields about a 14% lifespan extension, demonstrating in vivo geroprotective efficacy. Directionally, CD38 inhibition sits upstream of prolonged lifespan. This effect is attributed to restored NAD+ and sirtuin function, and it validates CD38 as a longevity drug target. The lifespan benefit in naturally aged animals, rather than in accelerated-aging models, provides particularly strong evidence for translational relevance. 78c's efficacy, combined with its NAD+-sparing mechanism, established CD38 inhibition as a leading pharmacological strategy in geroscience.
description_zh_TW: 對自然衰老雄性小鼠施用 78c 可獲得約 14% 的壽命延長，展示了體內抗衰老療效。在方向性上，CD38 抑制位於延長壽命的上游。此效應歸因於恢復的 NAD+ 和 sirtuin 功能，驗證了 CD38 作為長壽藥物靶標。在自然衰老動物（而非加速衰老模型）中的壽命益處提供了特別強的轉化相關性證據。78c 的療效結合其 NAD+ 節省機制，確立了 CD38 抑制作為老年科學中領先的藥理學策略。

label: NAD+ levels
description: By selectively inhibiting CD38, 78c prevents age-related NAD+ degradation, keeping cellular pools high in aged animals. Directionally, CD38 inhibition sits upstream of preserved NAD+. Higher NAD+ then fuels sirtuin and other NAD+-dependent enzymes, reversing a hallmark of aging. Because CD38 expression rises with age, its inhibition becomes increasingly important for maintaining NAD+ homeostasis in older organisms. 78c's NAD+-preserving effect underlies its ability to restore sirtuin activity and extend lifespan, and it established the concept that pharmacologically limiting NAD+ consumption can counteract age-related decline.
description_zh_TW: 透過選擇性抑制 CD38，78c 防止年齡相關的 NAD+ 降解，在老年動物中保持較高的細胞 NAD+ 池。在方向性上，CD38 抑制位於保存 NAD+ 的上游。較高的 NAD+ 隨後為 sirtuin 和其他 NAD+ 依賴性酶提供燃料，逆轉衰老的一個標誌。由於 CD38 表達隨年齡增長而升高，其抑制在維護老年機體的 NAD+ 恆定性方面變得越來越重要。78c 的 NAD+ 保存效應構成了其恢復 sirtuin 活性和延長壽命能力的基礎，並確立了藥理學限制 NAD+ 消耗可以對抗年齡相關退化的概念。

label: NAMPT upregulation
description: NAMPT is the rate-limiting enzyme in the NAD+ salvage pathway, so its upregulation raises cellular NAD+ levels and fuels sirtuin activity. Directionally, NAMPT increase leads to NAD+ increase, which enhances sirtuin function. This is the terminal step of resveratrol's indirect activation cascade and a central control point for NAD+ homeostasis more broadly. Preserving NAD+ via NAMPT induction, or by inhibiting NAD+ consumers such as CD38 and PARPs, is a common theme across sirtuin-activating strategies, and it reflects the fact that cellular NAD+ availability, rather than sirtuin protein abundance alone, often limits sirtuin activity.
description_zh_TW: NAMPT 是 NAD+ 回收代謝通路中的限速酶，因此其上調提高細胞 NAD+ 水平並為 sirtuin 活性提供燃料。在方向性上，NAMPT 增加導致 NAD+ 增加，進而增強 sirtuin 功能。這是白藜蘆醇間接活化級聯的終端步驟，也是更廣泛的 NAD+ 穩態的中心控制點。通過 NAMPT 誘導或抑制 CD38 和 PARP 等 NAD+ 消耗者來保留 NAD+，是 sirtuin 活化策略中的共同主題，反映了細胞 NAD+ 可用性（而非僅 sirtuin 蛋白表達量）通常限制 sirtuin 活性的事實。

label: NNMT
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: Nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT) methylates nicotinamide to 1-methylnicotinamide, diverting this precursor away from the NAMPT-dependent salvage pathway. By withdrawing nicotinamide from NAD+ regeneration, NNMT activity limits NAD+ biosynthesis and indirectly modulates the activity of NAD+-dependent sirtuins. Directionally, NNMT sits upstream of reduced NAD+ availability. This makes NNMT a metabolic competitor with the salvage pathway, and elevated NNMT in obesity and certain cancers contributes to NAD+ depletion and metabolic dysfunction. Modulating NNMT is therefore of interest as a strategy to preserve NAD+ pools and support sirtuin activity in disease states.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺N-甲基轉移酶（NNMT）將菸鹼醯胺甲基化為1-甲基菸鹼醯胺，將此前體從NAMPT依賴性的補救合成途徑中分流。透過將菸鹼醯胺從NAD+再生中撤出，NNMT活性限制了NAD+生物合成並間接調節NAD+依賴性sirtuin的活性。方向上，NNMT位於NAD+可用性降低的上游。這使NNMT成為補救合成途徑的代謝競爭者，肥胖和某些癌症中NNMT的升高導致NAD+耗竭和代謝功能障礙。因此調節NNMT作為保存NAD+池和支持疾病狀態下sirtuin活性的策略受到關注。

label: Histone Demethylase
description: Histone demethylases depend on metabolic cofactors such as alpha-ketoglutarate, NAD+, and FAD, linking epigenetic state to cellular metabolism. JmjC demethylases use Fe(II) and alpha-ketoglutarate to oxidatively remove methyl marks.
description_zh_TW: 組蛋白去甲基酶依賴 α-酮戊二酸、NAD+ 與 FAD 等代謝輔因子，將表觀遺傳狀態與細胞代謝相連結。JmjC 去甲基酶利用 Fe(II) 與 α-酮戊二酸氧化性地移除甲基標記。

label: TFEB at S467
description: Akt phosphorylates TFEB at serine 467, a C-terminal residue within the regulatory cluster that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor downstream of insulin and growth-factor signaling. By adding to the phosphorylation state of TFEB, Akt reinforces the anabolic, autophagy-suppressed state promoted by PI3K-Akt-mTOR signaling. This modification complements mTORC1-mediated marks and integrates proliferative cues with repression of degradative transcription. The Akt-TFEB link embeds TFEB within the canonical survival signaling network.
description_zh_TW: Akt 在 serine 467 磷酸化 TFEB，此 C 端殘基位於調節簇內，在胰島素和生長因子信號下游促進該轉錄因子的細胞質保留。透過增加 TFEB 的磷酸化狀態，Akt 強化了 PI3K-Akt-mTOR 信號所促進的合成代謝、自噬受抑制狀態。此修飾補充了 mTORC1 介導的標記，並將增生線索與降解轉錄的抑制整合起來。Akt-TFEB 連結將 TFEB 嵌入典型的存活信號網絡中。

label: Caspase-2 Ser135
source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md
description: 14-3-3-zeta binds caspase-2 in a phosphorylation-dependent manner, protecting Ser135 (phosphorylated by CaMKII) from dephosphorylation. Acetylation of 14-3-3-zeta disengages this shield, allowing dephosphorylation and activation of caspase-2.
description_zh_TW: 14-3-3ζ 以依賴磷酸化的方式結合 caspase-2，保護 Ser135（由 CaMKII 磷酸化）免受去磷酸化。14-3-3ζ 的乙醯化會解除此保護盾，允許去磷酸化和 caspase-2 活化。

label: Acetylated 14-3-3
source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md
description: Acetylation of 14-3-3-zeta triggers its dissociation from the initiator caspase-2, allowing caspase-2 activation. In contrast, SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of 14-3-3-zeta at K49 maintains its binding and keeps caspase-2 suppressed, so 14-3-3-zeta acetylation state controls apoptotic sensitivity.
description_zh_TW: 14-3-3ζ 的乙醯化觸發其與起始型 caspase-2 的解離，允許 caspase-2 活化。相反，SIRT1 在 K49 介導的 14-3-3ζ 去乙醯化維持其結合並使 caspase-2 保持受抑制，因此 14-3-3ζ 的乙醯化狀態控制凋亡敏感性。

label: PP1
description: PP1 opposes CaMKII by dephosphorylating caspase-2 at Ser164.
description_zh_TW: PP1 在 Ser164 去磷酸化 caspase-2，對抗 CaMKII。

label: Low pH
description: Acidic conditions strongly slow or prevent the cyclization step of adrenochrome formation, because at low pH the side-chain amine of the oxidized epinephrine intermediate is protonated and reduced in nucleophilicity, so it cannot easily attack the quinone ring. In highly acidic solutions the open-chain quinone form is favored and more stable, while neutral-to-alkaline pH accelerates cyclization and oxidation. This pH dependence explains why pharmaceutical epinephrine solutions are kept acidic (pH 3-5) with antioxidants to minimize oxidation and adrenochrome formation, and it is the most important factor in controlling the reaction rate.
description_zh_TW: 酸性條件會強烈減緩或阻止 adrenochrome 形成的 cyclization 步驟，因為在低 pH 下，氧化 epinephrine 中間產物的 side-chain amine 會被質子化且 nucleophilicity 降低，因此無法輕易攻擊 quinone ring。在強酸性溶液中，open-chain quinone 形式較受青睞且更穩定，而中性至鹼性 pH 則加速 cyclization 與氧化。這種 pH dependence 解釋了為何藥用 epinephrine 溶液需保持酸性（pH 3-5）並添加 antioxidants，以最小化氧化與 adrenochrome 形成，且這是控制反應速率最重要的因素。

label: Bisulfite
description: Bisulfite (sodium bisulfite or metabisulfite) is a reducing agent added to pharmaceutical epinephrine injections to prevent oxidation of the catechol and thereby inhibit adrenochrome formation. By scavenging oxygen and reactive oxygen species and reducing oxidized intermediates, bisulfite keeps adrenaline solutions stable and usable for extended periods, preventing the pink-to-red discoloration that signals adrenochrome accumulation. This practical application reflects the general principle that the epinephrine-to-adrenochrome oxidation can be slowed by antioxidants, acidic pH, low temperature, and protection from light. Without such stabilizers, adrenaline auto-oxidizes visibly within days to weeks.
description_zh_TW: Bisulfite（sodium bisulfite 或 metabisulfite）是一種 reducing agent，添加於藥用 epinephrine 注射劑中，以防止 catechol 氧化從而抑制 adrenochrome 形成。透過清除氧氣與 reactive oxygen species 並還原氧化的中間產物，bisulfite 使 adrenaline 溶液保持穩定且可長期使用，防止標示 adrenochrome 堆積的粉紅至紅色變色。此實際應用反映了一般原則：epinephrine-to-adrenochrome 氧化可透過 antioxidants、酸性 pH、低溫與避光而減緩。若無此類 stabilizers，adrenaline 會在數天至數週內明顯 auto-oxidizes。

label: Airway Inflammation
description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is characterized by persistent airway inflammation and poorly reversible airflow limitation driven by neutrophilic and macrophage inflammation. Oxidant-antioxidant imbalance in the lungs fuels this chronic inflammatory state. The directionality is inflammatory airway disease to oxidative burden. A caveat is that COPD heterogeneity means not all patients show the same oxidant signature, and smoking-independent forms exist. This inflammation is sustained by an oxidant-antioxidant imbalance that inactivates antiproteases and perpetuates tissue destruction.
description_zh_TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 的特徵是持續的 airway inflammation 和由中性粒細胞和巨噬細胞發炎驅動的可逆性差的氣流受限。肺部的氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡加劇了這種慢性發炎狀態。方向性是發炎性氣道疾病對氧化負擔的影響。需要注意的是，COPD 異質性意味著並非所有患者都表現出相同的氧化劑特徵，並且存在 smoking 獨立形式。這種發炎是由氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡所維持的，這種失衡會使抗蛋白酶失去活性並使組織破壞永久化。

label: Serum
description: Oxidase activity was found in the serum of patients following myocardial infarction, a finding that may be of importance in assessing the clinical and pathogenic significance of oxygen radicals in heart disease. Because stimulated neutrophils produce oxygen radicals and infiltrate the infarcted myocardium, the appearance of oxidase activity in the circulation after infarction reflects the systemic oxidative stress associated with cardiac damage. This serum marker complements the detection of a compound with the same HPLC retention time as adrenochrome in biological fluid rich in neutrophils, supporting the possibility that the adrenochrome pathway operates in vivo. Serum oxidase measurement is therefore proposed as a clinically accessible readout for the oxidant-driven conversion of adrenaline to cardiotoxic products in the setting of myocardial infarction.
description_zh_TW: 在心肌梗塞患者的血清中發現氧化酶活性，此發現對於評估氧自由基在心臟疾病中的臨床及發病意義可能具有重要性。由於受刺激的中性白血球會產生氧自由並浸潤梗塞的心肌，梗塞後血液中出現氧化酶活性反映了與心臟損傷相關的全身性氧化壓力。此血清標記物與在富含中性白血球的生物液體中，偵測到具有與adrenochrome相同HPLC保留時間之化合物的結果相互補充，支持adrenochrome代謝途徑在體內運作的可能性。因此，建議將血清氧化酶測量作為一種臨床上可取得的指標，用以反映心肌梗塞情境下，腎上腺素在氧化劑驅動下轉化為心臟毒性產物的程度。

label: Methyl donor supplements
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: People with slow COMT enzyme variants may find that supplements affecting the methylation cycle can affect their neurotransmitter levels. A sudden influx of methyl groups from high doses of methyl donor supplements can cause irritability, anger, or anxiety. Clinicians often recommend against taking methyl donor supplements for slow COMT (rs4680 A/A).
description_zh_TW: 具有緩慢 COMT 酶變異的人可能發現，影響 methylation cycle 的補充劑會影響其神經傳導物質水平。高劑量甲基供體補充劑帶來的甲基群突然湧入可能導致煩躁、憤怒或焦慮。臨床醫師常建議緩慢 COMT (rs4680 A/A) 者不要服用甲基供體補充劑。

label: Neurotransmitters
description: Neurotransmitters are endogenous chemical messengers that relay signals between neurons, and the catecholamines dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine are paramount in neuromelanin research. Their oxidative metabolism generates the aminochromes that polymerize into neuromelanin.
description_zh_TW: 神經傳導物質是神經元間傳遞訊號的內源性化學信使，而兒茶酚胺（dopamine、norepinephrine、epinephrine）在 neuromelanin 研究中至關重要。其氧化代謝產生聚合為 neuromelanin 的 aminochrome。

label: Cardiac arrest
description: Acute coronary syndromes account for the majority of sudden arrests with shockable rhythms. Causation is the lethal-complication direction.
description_zh_TW: 急性冠心症候群佔多數可電擊心律的猝死。因果是致死併發症方向。

label: Ischemia
description: Reduced perfusion from constriction directly causes ischemia. Causation is the flow to injury step.
description_zh_TW: 收縮減少灌流直接導致缺血。因果是血流到損傷步驟。

label: TFEB at S466/S467/S469
description: AMPK phosphorylates TFEB on a cluster of serine residues (S466, S467, S469) located in its C-terminal regulatory region in response to energy stress. These phosphorylations enhance TFEB transcriptional activity and promote its nuclear accumulation, synergizing with the relief of mTORC1 repression. The modification thereby directly couples low cellular energy status to activation of the autophagy-lysosomal transcriptional program. This AMPK-TFEB axis provides a transcription-level reinforcement of the rapid post-translational induction of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: AMPK 在能量壓力下，於其 C 端調節區的絲胺酸殘基簇（S466、S467、S469）磷酸化 TFEB。這些磷酸化增強 TFEB 轉錄活性並促進其核累積，與 mTORC1 抑制的解除產生協同。此修飾因此直接將低細胞能量狀態耦合到自噬—溶酶體轉錄程序的活化。此 AMPK-TFEB 軸提供了對自噬快速轉譯後誘導的轉錄層次強化。

label: CD36 expression
description: CD36 expression is induced by PPARgamma, which transcriptionally upregulates the receptor in macrophages, creating a feed-forward loop that amplifies oxLDL scavenging. ROS can further enhance this PPARgamma-dependent induction. The directionality is nuclear receptor to receptor upregulation. A caveat is that excessive CD36 induction promotes foam-cell formation, so the loop is maladaptive under chronic lipid stress. The PPARgamma-CD36 axis is also central to adipocyte lipid storage and to foam-cell pathology in atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: CD36 expression 是由 PPARgamma 誘導的，PPARgamma 會在轉錄上上調巨噬細胞中的受體，形成一個放大 oxLDL 清除的前饋環。 ROS 可以進一步增強這種 PPARgamma 依賴性誘導。方向性是核受體到受體的上調。需要注意的是，過度的 CD36 誘導會促進泡沫細胞的形成，因此循環在慢性脂質壓力下會出現適應不良。 PPARgamma-CD36 軸對於 atherosclerosis 中的脂肪細胞脂質儲存和泡沫細胞病理學也至關重要。

label: H19
source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic changes during aging and their reprogramming potential.md
description: H19 is a long non-coding RNA whose expression changes with age, and it functions to repress IGF-1 signaling. H19 associates with MBD1, a methyl-CpG-binding domain protein, to repress the expression of longevity genes including insulin-like growth factor 1, and loss of H19-dependent IGF-1 silencing may contribute to cellular senescence. Because IGF-1 signaling is a conserved regulator of the insulin/IGF-1 pathway that influences lifespan, the age-related deregulation of H19 has implications for both senescence and longevity.
description_zh_TW: H19 是一種長鏈非編碼 RNA，其表現隨年齡而變化，其功能是抑制 IGF-1 訊號傳導。 H19 與 MBD1（一種甲基 CpG 結合域蛋白）結合，抑制包括類胰島素生長因子 1 在內的長壽基因的表達，H19 依賴性 IGF-1 沉默的喪失可能導致細胞老化。由於 IGF-1 訊號傳導是影響壽命的胰島素/IGF-1 路徑的保守調節因子，因此 H19 與年齡相關的失調對老化和長壽都有影響。

label: Nitrated lipids
description: Nitrated lipids activate PPARgamma, as electrophilic nitrated fatty acids such as nitrolinoleic acid act as ligands that promote the receptor's transcriptional program. This redirects metabolism and induces anti-inflammatory and antioxidant genes. The directionality is lipid nitration product to nuclear receptor activation. A caveat is that nitrated lipids can also signal through PPARalpha and other targets, so PPARgamma is a major but not exclusive node. This pathway represents a feedback mechanism in which nitrative stress generates endogenous ligands that dampen inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Nitrated lipids 活化 PPARgamma，因為硝基亞麻油酸等親電子硝化脂肪酸充當配體，促進受體的轉錄程序。這會改變新陳代謝並誘導抗炎和抗氧化基因。方向性是脂質硝化產物對核受體的活化。需要注意的是，nitrated lipids 還可以透過 PPARalpha 和其他目標發出訊號，因此 PPARgamma 是一個主要但不是唯一的節點。該通路代表了一種反饋機制，其中 nitrative stress 生成抑制發炎的內源性配體。

label: SIRT1 (Ser27, Thr344)
description: Under low-energy conditions, AMPK directly phosphorylates SIRT1 at Ser27 and Thr344, enhancing its deacetylase activity and coupling energy deficit to sirtuin function. Directionally, AMPK sits upstream of SIRT1 activation. This closes the reciprocal loop with SIRT1, and it ensures sirtuin responses track cellular AMP/ATP state. By phosphorylating SIRT1, AMPK links the energy-sensing kinase network to sirtuin-dependent gene regulation. This mechanism explains how fasting, exercise, and caloric restriction, which activate AMPK, also engage SIRT1-dependent programs.
description_zh_TW: 在低能量狀態下，AMPK直接在Ser27和Thr344位點磷酸化SIRT1，增強其去乙醯酶活性，並將能量不足與sirtuin功能耦合起來。方向上，AMPK位於SIRT1活化的上游。這關閉了與SIRT1的雙向迴路，並確保sirtuin的反應追蹤細胞的AMP/ATP狀態。透過磷酸化SIRT1，AMPK將能量感知激酶網路與sirtuin依賴性基因調節聯繫起來。此機制解釋了為何禁食、運動和熱量限制（這些都能活化AMPK）也能啟動SIRT1依賴性的程序。

label: Vine Tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata)
description: Vine tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata) leaves contain 20-30% dihydromyricetin (DHM) by weight, so 1-1.5 g of dry leaf suffices for roughly a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, the botanical source sits upstream of DHM availability. DHM is a potent SIRT3 and AMPK activator, and this makes vine tea a practical natural source of the compound. The high DHM content distinguishes vine tea from most other botanical sources and supports its traditional use as a metabolic tonic. This abundance is a key practical advantage for studying and using DHM clinically.
description_zh_TW: 藤茶（Ampelopsis grossedentata）葉片含有 20-30% 的二氫楊梅素（DHM），因此 1-1.5 克乾葉即可提供約 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，植物來源位於 DHM 可用性的上游。DHM 是強效的 SIRT3 和 AMPK 活化劑，使藤茶成為該化合物的實用天然來源。高 DHM 含量使藤茶有別於大多數其他植物來源，並支持其作為代謝滋補品的傳統用途。這種豐度是研究和臨床使用 DHM 的關鍵實際優勢。

label: Tuberous Sclerosis Complex
description: Germline TSC2 loss causes the TSC hamartoma syndrome. Causation is the genetic etiology.
description_zh_TW: 生殖系 TSC2 缺失導致 TSC 錯構瘤症候群。因果是遺傳病因。

label: D-lactate
description: GLO2 (glyoxalase II) is the second enzyme of the glyoxalase system. It converts S-D-lactoylglutathione into D-lactate, regenerating glutathione in the process. Because glutathione is both the cofactor for GLO1 and a major cellular antioxidant, GLO2 activity sustains the capacity of the glyoxalase system to detoxify methylglyoxal and other dicarbonyls. The conversion of reactive dicarbonyl intermediates into lactate thereby prevents them from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on proteins, making GLO2 an integral component of the body's defense against glycation stress.
description_zh_TW: GLO2（glyoxalase II）是乙二醛酶系統的第二個酵素。它將 S-D-lactoylglutathione 轉化為 D-乳酸（D-lactate），過程中再生麩胱甘肽。由於麩胱甘肽既是 GLO1 的輔酶也是主要的細胞抗氧化劑，GLO2 活性維持了乙二醛酶系統解毒甲基乙二醛與其他二羰基物的能力。將反應性二羰基中間產物轉化為乳酸，從而防止它們在蛋白質上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯，使 GLO2 成為身體對抗糖化壓力防禦中不可或缺的組成部分。

label: T cell polarization
description: Glutathione determines T cell polarization because the GSH/GSSG redox state tunes the balance between pro-inflammatory Th1/Th17 and anti-inflammatory Th2/Treg responses. Oxidized extracellular glutathione can itself act as a danger signal influencing differentiation. The directionality is thiol redox to immune phenotype. A caveat is that glutathione is one of several metabolic and cytokine inputs to T-cell fate, so it biases rather than dictates polarization. Redox modulation of T cells is therefore being investigated as an adjunctive target in autoimmunity and chronic inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Glutathione 決定 T cell polarization，因為 GSH/GSSG 氧化還原狀態調節促發炎 Th1/Th17 和抗發炎 Th2/Treg 反應之間的平衡。氧化的細胞外glutathione本身可以作為影響分化的危險訊號。方向性是硫醇氧化還原至免疫表型。需要注意的是，glutathione 是 T 細胞命運的幾種代謝和細胞激素輸入之一，因此它會產生偏見，而不是決定極化。因此，T 細胞的氧化還原調節正在作為自體免疫和慢性發炎的輔助標靶進行研究。

label: Arachidonic acid
description: Through its phospholipase A2 (PLA2) activity, PRDX6 generates arachidonic acid from membrane phospholipids; arachidonic acid is a precursor of pro-inflammatory eicosanoids and is often a driver of inflammation. This places PRDX6's aiPLA2 activity at the interface between redox homeostasis and inflammatory signaling. Apigenin suppresses this activity, and the selective PRDX6 PLA2 inhibitor MJ33 lowers canonical SASP factor expression in a concentration-dependent manner, functionally linking the PLA2-dependent arachidonic acid axis to the senescent secretory phenotype. This mechanism is independent of PRDX6's peroxidase function, which is only modestly inhibited by apigenin.
description_zh_TW: 透過其磷脂酶A2（PLA2）活性，PRDX6從膜磷脂生成花生四烯酸；花生四烯酸是促發炎類花生酸的前體，通常是發炎的驅動因素。這將PRDX6的aiPLA2活性置於氧化還原平衡和發炎訊號的交界處。芹菜素抑制此活性，選擇性PRDX6 PLA2抑制劑MJ33以濃度依賴的方式降低典型SASP因子表達，功能性地將PLA2依賴的花生四烯酸軸與衰老分泌表型聯繫起來。此機制獨立於PRDX6的過氧化物酶功能，後者僅被芹菜素輕度抑制。

label: System Xc-
description: System Xc- (SLC7A11/SLC3A2 cystine/glutamate antiporter) imports cystine in exchange for glutamate; intracellular cystine is reduced to cysteine, the rate-limiting precursor for Glutathione synthesis. Its inhibition (e.g., by erastin) depletes GSH and is the classic trigger of GPX4-dependent ferroptosis, defining the upstream node of the parallel GPX4 axis.
description_zh_TW: System Xc-（SLC7A11/SLC3A2 胱氨酸/麩氨酸逆向轉運體）以麩氨酸交換導入胱氨酸；細胞內胱氨酸被還原為半胱氨酸，即 Glutathione 合成的速率限制前驅物。其抑制（例如被 erastin）會耗竭 GSH，是 GPX4 依賴性鐵死亡的典型觸發因子，界定了平行 GPX4 軸的上游節點。

label: RSL3
description: RSL3 is the prototype class-II ferroptosis inducer: it directly inhibits glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4), the only enzyme that can reduce lipid hydroperoxides inside membranes. GPX4 inhibition makes the cell unable to neutralize lipid peroxides regardless of GSH supply, committing it to ferroptotic death. RSL3 synergy with autophagic GPX4 degradation (Fin56, copper) and its use alongside system-xc- blockers like erastin represent the two supply-side and effector-side strategies for triggering ferroptosis in cancer.
description_zh_TW: RSL3 是第二類鐵死亡誘導劑的原型：它直接抑制麩胱甘肽過氧化物酶 4（GPX4）——唯一能在膜內還原脂質氫過氧化物的酶。GPX4 受抑制後，無論 GSH 供應如何，細胞都無法中和脂質過氧化物，注定走向鐵死亡。RSL3 與自噬介導的 GPX4 降解（Fin56、銅）之間的協同，以及與 system xc- 阻斷劑（如 erastin）的並用，代表觸發癌症鐵死亡的供給端與效應端兩大策略。

label: NAC
description: N-acetylcysteine (NAC) is a cysteine prodrug and antioxidant that acts as a selective inhibitor of the peroxidase activity of peroxiredoxin 6 (PRDX6). NAC markedly reduced PRDX6's H2O2-clearing peroxidase activity, in contrast to apigenin which targets its iPLA2 activity.
description_zh_TW: N-乙醯半胱氨酸（NAC）是半胱氨酸前藥與抗氧化劑，作為過氧化還原酶 6（PRDX6）過氧化酶活性的選擇性抑制劑。NAC 顯著降低 PRDX6 清除 H2O2 的過氧化酶活性，與靶向其 iPLA2 活性的 apigenin 形成對比。

label: Phospholipase A2
description: Phospholipase A2 enzymes hydrolyze phospholipids to release arachidonic acid and lysophospholipids. Peroxiredoxin 6 uniquely carries an iPLA2 (calcium-independent PLA2) activity whose suppression underlies apigenin's senomorphic SASP suppression.
description_zh_TW: 磷脂酶 A2（PLA2）水解磷脂以釋放花生四烯酸與溶血磷脂。過氧化還原酶 6（PRDX6）獨特地帶有 iPLA2（鈣非依賴 PLA2）活性，其抑制是 apigenin 的 senomorphic SASP 壓制基礎。

label: Acrolein
description: Electrophilic acrolein conjugates and sequesters glutathione, forming protein carbonyls in parallel with hypochlorous acid depletion. Conjugation drains the thiol buffer.
description_zh_TW: 親電子 acrolein 結合並隔離 glutathione，與次氯酸耗竭平行形成蛋白羰基。結合耗盡硫醇緩衝。

label: GPX4 inhibitor
description: Because many therapy-resistant cancers rely on FSP1 for ferroptosis resistance, iFSP1 is being explored to sensitize tumors (e.g., hepatocellular carcinoma) to ferroptosis-based therapy, often in combination with GPX4 or system Xc- inhibitors rather than as monotherapy, reflecting the two-pillar ferroptosis-defense model.
description_zh_TW: 由於許多治療抗性腫瘤依賴 FSP1 來抵抗鐵死亡，iFSP1 被探索用於使腫瘤（例如肝細胞癌）對鐵死亡療法增敏，通常與 GPX4 或 system Xc- 抑制劑合併使用而非單藥，這反映鐵死亡的雙支柱防禦模型。

label: Ferroptosis Suppressor
description: FSP1 (ferroptosis suppressor protein 1, encoded by AIFM2) is a plasma-membrane flavoprotein NAD(P)H:ubiquinone oxidoreductase that constitutes the second major, glutathione-independent brake on ferroptosis, acting in parallel to GPX4. It was identified independently in 2019 by Doll et al. (Nature 575:693) and Bersuker et al. (Cell 177:1264) as a gene capable of rescuing cells from GPX4 loss.
description_zh_TW: FSP1（ferroptosis suppressor protein 1，由 AIFM2 編碼）是一種位於質膜的黃素蛋白 NAD(P)H:泛醌氧化還原酶，構成第二個主要的、不依賴谷胱甘肽的鐵死亡抑制系統，與 GPX4 平行運作。Doll et al.（Nature 575:693）與 Bersuker et al.（Cell 177:1264）於 2019 年各自獨立發現它是一個能在 GPX4 缺失時挽救細胞的基因的。

label: Plasma Membrane
description: FSP1 carries an N-terminal N-myristoylation motif that recruits it to the inner leaflet of the plasma membrane, positioning the enzyme precisely where phospholipid peroxidation is initiated and propagated. Membrane association is essential for its ferroptosis-suppressive function.
description_zh_TW: FSP1 帶有 N 端 N-肉豆蔻酰化（myristoylation）基序，將其招募至質膜內葉，使酵素精確定位在磷脂過氧化起始與傳播的位置。膜結合對其抑制鐵死亡的功能不可或缺。

label: Vitamin K
description: FSP1 is a warfarin-resistant vitamin K reductase: it reduces vitamin K to its hydroquinone (VKH2), sustaining a non-canonical vitamin K redox cycle that also supplies a reduced radical-trapping antioxidant — explaining its ability to overcome warfarin poisoning (Mishima et al., Nature 2022).
description_zh_TW: FSP1 是抗 warfarin 的維生素 K 還原酶：它把 vitamin K 還原成氫醌（VKH2），維持供應還原態自由基捕捉抗氧化劑的非典型維生素 K 氧化還原循環——解釋其克服 warfarin 中毒的能力（Mishima et al., Nature 2022）。

label: AIFM2
description: AIFM2 is the human gene encoding FSP1 (ferroptosis suppressor protein 1). Although originally characterized as pro-apoptotic, AIFM2 was renamed FSP1 after 2019 studies showed its dominant cellular role is suppressing ferroptosis at the plasma membrane as a flavoprotein ubiquinone oxidoreductase.
description_zh_TW: AIFM2 是人類編碼 FSP1（ferroptosis 抑制蛋白 1）的基因。雖然最初被歸類為促凋亡蛋白，2019 年的研究顯示其主要的細胞角色是在質膜上抑制 ferroptosis，作為黃素蛋白泛醌氧化還原酶，因而更名為 FSP1。

label: Myristoylation
description: Myristoylation is the covalent attachment of a myristoyl group to FSP1's N-terminal glycine, anchoring the flavoprotein to the inner leaflet of the plasma membrane. This plasma-membrane localization places FSP1's ubiquinone-reductase activity where the ubiquinol radical trap is needed to suppress ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: 肉荳蔻醯化是將肉荳蔻醯基共價連接至 FSP1 的 N 端甘氨酸，將黃素蛋白錨定在質膜內葉。此質膜定位使 FSP1 的泛醌還原酶活性位於需要泛醇自由基捕捉以抑制 ferroptosis 之處。

label: FIN56
description: FIN56 engages squalene synthase to divert mevalonate flux away from CoQ10, starving FSP1 of substrate. This converges on the FSP1 brake from the metabolic side, like statins.
description_zh_TW: FIN56 結合 squalene synthase 使 mevalonate 流量偏離 CoQ10，剝奪 FSP1 受質。此從代謝側匯聚於 FSP1 煞車，與 statins 相同。

label: DHODH
description: Mitochondrial DHODH reduces CoQ10 in parallel to plasma-membrane FSP1 (Mao 2021), constituting the organellar arm of ubiquinol regeneration. The two enzymes divide ferroptosis defense by compartment.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體 DHODH 與質膜 FSP1 平行還原 CoQ10（Mao 2021），構成 ubiquinol 再生的胞器臂。兩酶按區室分工鐵死亡防禦。

label: Fenofibrate
description: Fenofibrate fibrate agonism activates PPAR-alpha. Activation is the pharmacological input.
description_zh_TW: Fenofibrate 貝特促效活化 PPAR-alpha。活化是藥理輸入。

label: Aldehyde Dehydrogenases
description: Aldehyde dehydrogenases (ALDHs), together with aldo-keto reductases, help neutralize reactive aldehydes and dicarbonyls such as 3-deoxyglucosone and methylglyoxal by oxidizing them into less toxic carboxylic acids. This prevents these highly reactive species from participating in glycation cascades that form advanced glycation end products. ALDH activity therefore contributes to the body's first line of enzymatic defense against dicarbonyl stress, operating alongside the glyoxalase system and PARK7. Reduced ALDH function would be expected to increase the pool of reactive dicarbonyls available to damage proteins, promoting AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 醛脫氫酶（ALDHs）與醛酮還原酶一起，透過將 3-deoxyglucosone 與甲基乙二醛等反應性醛與二羰基物氧化為較低毒性的羧酸，協助中和它們。這防止了這些高度反應性物種參與形成晚期糖化終產物的糖化級聯。因此，ALDH 活性有助於身體對抗二羰基壓力的第一道酵素防線，與乙二醛酶系統及 PARK7 並行運作。ALDH 功能降低預期會增加可用以損害蛋白質的反應性二羰基庫，促進 AGE 堆積。

label: Aldo-Keto Reductases
description: Aldo-keto reductases (AKRs) and aldehyde dehydrogenases (ALDHs) are enzyme families that assist in reducing or oxidizing reactive aldehydes and dicarbonyls, such as 3-deoxyglucosone and methylglyoxal, into less toxic alcohols or carboxylic acids. By converting these reactive species into less harmful products, AKRs prevent them from participating in glycation cascades that form advanced glycation end products. This enzymatic detoxification is one of the three lines of defense against AGE accumulation, operating alongside the glyoxalase system and PARK7. Impaired AKR or ALDH function would be expected to increase dicarbonyl burden and accelerate protein glycation.
description_zh_TW: 醛酮還原酶（Aldo-keto reductases, AKRs）與醛脫氫酶（aldehyde dehydrogenases, ALDHs）是協助將反應性醛與二羰基物（如 3-deoxyglucosone 與甲基乙二醛）還原或氧化為較低毒性的醇或羧酸的酵素家族。透過將這些反應性物種轉化為較無害的產物，AKR 防止它們參與形成晚期糖化終產物的糖化級聯。這種酵素解毒是對抗 AGE 堆積的三道防線之一，與乙二醛酶系統及 PARK7 並行運作。AKR 或 ALDH 功能受損預期會增加二羰基負擔並加速蛋白質糖化。

label: Amifostine
description: Amifostine scavenges hydroxyl radicals as a prodrug that is dephosphorylated to the active thiol WR-1065, which protects normal tissues during radiotherapy. By quenching OH* it spares DNA and proteins from radiation-induced damage. The directionality is radioprotectant to radical neutralization. A caveat is that amifostine preferentially protects some normal tissues over tumors, but it carries side effects (hypotension, nausea) that limit use. Selective uptake by normal tissues gives amifostine its cytoprotective profile during radiotherapy and chemotherapy.
description_zh_TW: Amifostine 作為前藥清除 hydroxyl radicals，此前藥被去磷酸化為活性硫醇 WR-1065，可在放射治療期間保護正常組織。透過淬滅 OH*，它可以使 DNA 和 proteins 免受輻射引起的損傷。方向性對於自由基中和具有輻射防護作用。需要注意的是，amifostine 優先保護一些正常組織而不是腫瘤，但它的副作用（低血壓、噁心）限制了使用。正常組織的選擇性攝取使 amifostine 在放射治療和化療期間具有細胞保護作用。

label: Redox-Active Metals
description: Amyloid-beta binds redox-active metals (Cu2+ and Fe3+), forming complexes that generate superoxide and H2O2 via Fenton-like chemistry at the metal site. This positions Abeta as a localized source of ROS in the Alzheimer brain. The directionality is metal binding to radical generation. A caveat is that metal-free Abeta aggregation also drives pathology, so redox activity is one of several toxic functions. Abeta is proposed to act as a redox-active metal chaperone, and metal chelators have been tested as candidate therapies to limit this pro-oxidant activity.
description_zh_TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白與 redox-active metals（Cu2+ 和 Fe3+）結合，形成複合物，透過金屬位點上的類芬頓化學反應生成超氧化物和 H2O2。這使得 Abeta 成為阿茲海默症大腦中 ROS 的局部來源。方向性是金属与自由基生成的结合。需要注意的是，不含金屬的 Abeta 聚集也會引發病理學，因此氧化還原活性是多種毒性功能之一。 Abeta 被提议充当氧化还原活性金属伴侣，金属螯合剂已作为限制这种促氧化活性的候选疗法进行了测试。

label: Mitochondrial Complex IV
description: Amyloid-beta impairs mitochondrial Complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase) after accumulating in mitochondria, depressing respiration and increasing electron leak. This links protein misfolding to bioenergetic failure and ROS. The directionality is Abeta mitochondrial localization to respiratory inhibition. A caveat is that Complex IV inhibition can be both a cause and consequence of oxidative damage in a feed-forward loop. The resulting energetic deficit may precede overt neurodegeneration and contributes to synaptic failure in Alzheimer's disease.
description_zh_TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白在 mitochondria 中累積後會損害 mitochondrial Complex IV（細胞色素 C 氧化酶），抑制呼吸並增加電子洩漏。這將蛋白質錯誤折疊與生物能量衰竭和 ROS 聯繫起來。方向性是Abeta mitochondria1定位於呼吸抑制。需要注意的是，複合物 IV 抑制既可能是前饋迴路中氧化損傷的原因，也可能是其結果。由此產生的能量缺乏可能先於明顯的 neurodegeneration 發生，並導致阿茲海默症的突觸衰竭。

label: Clustered DNA Damage
description: Ionizing radiation causes clustered DNA damage, defined as two or more lesions within one or two helical turns, a signature pattern that overwhelms repair and drives lethal or mutagenic breaks. This clustering distinguishes radiation from many chemical genotoxins. The directionality is radiation to locally concentrated lesions. A caveat is that clustering severity depends on radiation quality (LET) and oxygen enhancement, so not all exposures produce identical patterns. Clustered lesions are a hallmark of high-LET radiation and are repaired inefficiently, increasing the probability of mutation and cell death.
description_zh_TW: Ionizing radiation 導致 clustered DNA damage，定義為一兩個螺旋圈內的兩個或多個病變，這是一種壓倒修復並導致致命或誘變斷裂的特徵模式。这种聚类将辐射与许多化学基因毒素区分开来。方向性是局部集中病灶的輻射。需要注意的是，聚集的严重程度取决于辐射质量 (LET) 和氧气增强，因此并非所有暴露都会产生相同的模式。聚集性病变是高 LET 辐射的一个标志，修复效率低下，增加了突变和细胞死亡的可能性。

label: NAD+ Depletion
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NAD+ depletion was observed during the aging process in multiple animals, including humans, and is considered the major risk factor for Alzheimer's disease (AD). Neurodegenerative disorders such as AD are associated with DNA damage and oxidative stress, which accumulate with age and lead to impaired mitochondrial function, while excitotoxicity-driven axonal degeneration causes strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. When administered in AD mouse models, nicotinamide riboside (NR) displays beneficial effects on both oxidative stress and DNA repair by increasing NAD+ levels, and it improves pTau, amyloid-beta, neurogenesis, neuroinflammation, hippocampal synaptic plasticity, and cognition.
description_zh_TW: 在多種動物（包括人類）的老化過程中觀察到 NAD+ 耗竭，且被視為阿茲海默症（AD）的主要風險因子。諸如 AD 之類的神經退化性疾病與 DNA 損傷和氧化壓力相關，這些隨年齡累積並導致粒線體功能受損，而興奮毒性驅動的軸突退化則在神經元中造成強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。在 AD 小鼠模型中給予 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）時，NR 透過提升 NAD+ 水平對氧化壓力與 DNA 修復均展現有益效果，並改善 pTau、amyloid-beta（類澱粉乙型）、神經生成、神經發炎、海馬突觸可塑性與認知功能。

label: Lecanemab
description: Lecanemab (Leqembi) is an FDA-approved anti-amyloid monoclonal antibody for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease with confirmed amyloid; it clears parenchymal Aβ protofibrils and slows cognitive decline by roughly 25–35% while carrying ARIA (edema/microhemorrhage) risk.
description_zh_TW: Lecanemab（Leqembi）是獲 FDA 核准的抗類澱粉單株抗體，用於經確證類澱粉的早期症狀性阿茲海默症；它清除實質 Aβ 原纖維並減緩認知衰退約 25–35%，但帶有 ARIA（水腫／微出血）風險。

label: Oligodendrocytes
description: Oligodendrocytes are vulnerable to oxidative stress because they contain high iron, relatively low glutathione, and high ATP demand to support myelination, making them sensitive to ROS. Their damage contributes to demyelination in MS and other disorders. The directionality is oxidant burden to oligodendrocyte injury. A caveat is that oxidative vulnerability interacts with metabolic, inflammatory, and energetic stresses, so it is a contributor rather than the sole determinant of oligodendrocyte loss.
description_zh_TW: Oligodendrocytes 容易受到 oxidative stress 的影響，因為它們含有較高的 iron、相對較低的 glutathione，以及支持髓鞘形成的高 ATP 需求，使它們對 ROS 敏感。它們的損害會導致多發性硬化症和其他疾病的脫髓鞘。方向性是少突膠質細胞損傷的氧化負擔。需要注意的是，氧化脆弱性與代謝、發炎和能量壓力相互作用，因此它是少突膠質細胞損失的因素，而不是唯一的決定因素。

label: GSK-3beta
description: Oxidative stress activates GSK-3beta among other kinases, and the resulting hyperphosphorylation of tau promotes its dissociation from microtubules and aggregation. GSK-3beta is normally restrained by Akt but is released under oxidative and inflammatory conditions. The directionality is oxidant to kinase activation to tau modification. A caveat is that GSK-3beta has many substrates beyond tau, and its activity is regulated by phosphorylation independent of ROS. Because GSK-3beta is a central node in tau pathology, redox-driven kinase activation is considered an early event in Alzheimer's disease progression.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 活化其他激酶中的 GSK-3beta，由此產生的 tau 過度磷酸化促進其從微管解離和聚集。 GSK-3beta 通常受 Akt 抑制，但在氧化和發炎條件下釋放。方向性是氧化劑對激酶活化對tau修飾。需要注意的是，GSK-3beta 除了 tau 之外還有許多底物，且其活性受到磷酸化的調節，與 ROS 無關。由於 GSK-3beta 是 tau 病理學的中心節點，氧化還原驅動的激酶活化被認為是阿茲海默症進展的早期事件。

label: NF-kappaB enhancing VCAM-1 transcription
description: Oxidative stress activates NF-kappaB enhancing VCAM-1 transcription, as ROS activate the transcription factor to bind kappaB response elements in the VCAM-1 promoter. Elevated VCAM-1 then promotes leukocyte adhesion to endothelium. The directionality is oxidant to NF-kappaB to adhesion-molecule expression. A caveat is that many cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-1beta) also induce VCAM-1, so ROS is one of several upstream activators. VCAM-1 upregulation is a key early step in atherogenesis, and its redox-sensitive induction links oxidative stress to leukocyte infiltration.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 活化 NF-kappaB enhancing VCAM-1 transcription，因為 ROS 活化轉錄因子以結合 VCAM-1 啟動子中的 kappaB 反應元件。升高的 VCAM-1 會促進白血球與內皮細胞的黏附。 NF-κB 的方向性對黏附分子的表達具有氧化作用。需要注意的是，許多細胞激素（TNF-alpha、IL-1beta）也會誘導 VCAM-1，因此 ROS 是幾個上游活化劑之一。 VCAM-1 上調是動脈粥狀硬化形成的關鍵早期步驟，其氧化還原敏感誘導將 oxidative stress 與白血球浸潤聯繫起來。

label: Asthma severity
description: Oxidative stress correlates with asthma severity, with greater oxidant burden tracking with worse symptoms and higher exacerbation frequency. Biomarkers of lipid and protein oxidation rise during acute attacks. The directionality is oxidant load to clinical severity. A caveat is that correlation does not establish direction; severe asthma may also generate more ROS via eosinophil and NOX activity. These observations support the use of redox biomarkers in monitoring asthma control and evaluating antioxidant-based therapies.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 與 asthma severity 相關，氧化負荷追蹤更大，症狀更嚴重，惡化頻率更高。在急性發作期間，脂質和蛋白質氧化的生物標記會升高。方向性是氧化負荷與臨床嚴重程度的關係。需要注意的是，相關性並不能確定方向；嚴重的asthma也可能透過嗜酸性粒細胞和NOX活性產生更多的ROS。這些觀察結果支持使用氧化還原生物標記物來監測 asthma 控制和評估基於抗氧化劑的療法。

label: Redox Imbalance
description: Oxidative stress is a redox imbalance in which reactive oxygen (and nitrogen) species production exceeds the capacity to detoxify them or repair the resulting damage. This definition frames oxidative stress as a dynamic disequilibrium rather than a single molecule. The directionality is imbalance between oxidants and defenses. A caveat is that transient oxidative shifts are physiological signaling events, so 'stress' specifically denotes sustained or excessive imbalance. This framing emphasizes that redox biology is bidirectional and that the severity of stress is determined by the balance of generation, defense, and repair.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 是一種 redox imbalance，其中活性氧（和氮）物質的產生超過了其解毒或修復所造成損害的能力。這個定義將 oxidative stress 視為動態不平衡而不是單一分子。方向性是氧化劑和防禦之間的不平衡。需要注意的是，短暫的氧化轉變是生理訊號事件，因此「壓力」特別指持續或過度的不平衡。這個框架強調氧化還原生物學是雙向的，壓力的嚴重程度由生成、防禦和修復的平衡決定。

label: Deoxycholic Acid
description: Obesity alters the gut microbiota, leading to increased production of deoxycholic acid, a secondary bile acid metabolite. DCA induces cellular senescence and SASP factor production in hepatic stellate cells, promoting HCC development. Deoxycholic acid is therefore a gut-derived driver of obesity-associated HCC.
description_zh_TW: 肥胖會改變腸道微生物群，導致次級膽酸代謝物脫氧膽酸的產生增加。DCA 誘導肝星狀細胞中的細胞衰老與 SASP 因子產生，促進 HCC 發展。因此脫氧膽酸是肥胖相關 HCC 的腸道來源驅動因子。

label: Hepatic Stellate Cells
description: Senescent hepatic stellate cells produce SASP factors that drive obesity-associated hepatocellular carcinoma. HSC senescence, induced by deoxycholic acid from altered gut microbiota, creates a pro-inflammatory microenvironment. Hepatic stellate cells are therefore central to obesity-associated HCC.
description_zh_TW: 衰老的肝星狀細胞產生驅動肥胖相關肝細胞癌的 SASP 因子。由改變的腸道微生物群產生的脫氧膽酸誘導 HSC 衰老，創造促發炎微環境。因此肝星狀細胞對肥胖相關 HCC 至關重要。

label: Drug Resistance
description: GSTP1 overexpression in tumors detoxifies anticancer drugs, contributing to clinical drug resistance. Detoxification executes the resistant phenotype.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤 GSTP1 過度表現解毒抗癌藥，促成臨床藥物抗性。解毒執行抗性表型。

label: Catalase downregulation
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: Catalase downregulation contributes to cancer because reduced H2O2 clearance permits sustained oxidative stress that can drive DNA damage, genomic instability, and altered redox signaling favoring proliferation. Catalase is frequently downregulated in breast, prostate, and hepatocellular carcinomas relative to normal tissue. The directionality is loss-of-defense promoting tumorigenic oxidative damage. A caveat is that many tumors also exploit moderate ROS for survival signaling, so catalase levels represent a context-dependent balance rather than a simple tumor suppressor.
description_zh_TW: Catalase downregulation 有助於 cancer，因為減少的 H2O2 清除允許持續的 oxidative stress，從而驅動 DNA damage、基因組不穩定性和有利於增殖的氧化還原訊號傳導改變。相對於正常組織，Catalase 在乳癌、prostate 和肝細胞癌中經常下調。方向性是防禦喪失促進致瘤性氧化損傷。需要注意的是，許多腫瘤也利用適度的 ROS 來發出生存訊號，因此 catalase 水平代表了情境依賴性平衡，而不是簡單的腫瘤抑制因子。

label: Elevated 8-oxodG
description: Elevated 8-oxodG is associated with cancer, being increased in lung, breast, bladder, and colorectal cancers where it marks heightened oxidative DNA damage and genomic instability. Persistent oxidative lesions increase mutation burden that can drive oncogenesis. The directionality is oxidative damage to cancer risk or marker. A caveat is that elevated 8-oxodG may be a consequence of the tumor's metabolic and inflammatory state as much as a cause. Urinary and tissue 8-oxodG are frequently elevated in cancer patients and have been proposed as markers of exposure and disease burden.
description_zh_TW: Elevated 8-oxodG 與 cancer 相關，在肺、乳腺、膀胱和結直腸 cancer 中增加，標誌著氧化 DNA damage 和基因組不穩定性的增強。持續的氧化損傷會增加突變負擔，從而促進腫瘤發生。方向性是對cancer風險或標記的氧化損傷。需要注意的是，elevated 8-oxodG 可能是腫瘤代謝和發炎狀態的結果，也可能是原因。 cancer 患者的尿液和組織中 8-oxodG 經常升高，並已被提議作為暴露和疾病負擔的標記。

label: Cell Membrane
description: melittin disrupts Cell Membrane. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The cell membrane is the lipid bilayer whose integrity and receptor composition govern signaling, transport, and survival of tumor cells. The relationship is directional, with melittin acting as the operative agent upon Cell Membrane rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: melittin 擾亂 Cell Membrane。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。 Cell Membrane 是脂質雙層，其完整性和受體組成控制腫瘤細胞的訊號傳導、運輸和存活。這種關係是有方向的，melittin 充當 Cell Membrane 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: FTSJ1
description: Metastatic colonization by melanoma depends on FTSJ1 and the Um34 modification of tRNA[Ser]Sec, which supports translation of antioxidant selenoproteins. FTSJ1-deficient cells are oxidatively stressed and show reduced metastatic colonization. FTSJ1/Um34 is therefore necessary and sufficient for melanoma metastasis in vivo.
description_zh_TW: 黑色素瘤的轉移性定殖依賴 FTSJ1 以及 tRNA[Ser]Sec 的 Um34 修飾，後者支持抗氧化硒蛋白的轉譯。FTSJ1 缺陷細胞會受到氧化壓力，並表現出轉移性定殖減少。因此 FTSJ1/Um34 在體內對黑色素瘤轉移是必要且充分的。

label: Neuroendocrine
description: Small-cell lung cancer is classified as a high-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma expressing neuroendocrine markers including Synaptophysin, Chromogranin A, and CD56. These markers are used in SCLC diagnosis. The neuroendocrine phenotype defines SCLC biology.
description_zh_TW: Small-cell lung cancer 被歸類為高惡性度神經內分泌癌，表現包括 Synaptophysin、Chromogranin A 和 CD56 在內的神經內分泌標記。這些標記用於 SCLC 診斷。神經內分泌表型定義了 SCLC 的生物學。

label: BCG
description: Bladder Cancer is treated with BCG. BCG (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin) is a live attenuated mycobacterium delivered as intravesical immunotherapy for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, reducing recurrence and progression; it activates immune-mediated cytotoxicity against urothelial tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: 膀胱癌（Bladder Cancer）以 BCG 治療。BCG（卡介苗）是一種活的減毒分枝桿菌，以膀胱內灌注免疫療法用於非肌肉侵犯性膀胱癌，可降低復發與進展；它會啟動針對尿路上皮腫瘤細胞的免疫介導細胞毒性。

label: Neuroblastoma
description: Neuroblastoma is an embryonal malignancy arising from neural crest cells of the sympathetic nervous system and the most common extracranial solid tumor in children. Its aggressive forms exhibit excessive mitochondrial fission and high metabolic demands.
description_zh_TW: 神經母細胞瘤是源自交感神經系統神經嵴細胞的胚胎性惡性腫瘤，是兒童最常見的顱外實體腫瘤。其侵襲性形式表現過度的粒線體分裂與高代謝需求。

label: Amphiregulin
description: Amphiregulin is a canonical EGFR ligand within the SASP growth-factor arm that drives epithelial proliferation and reprogramming. EGFR engagement links senescent secretion to neighboring-stroma remodeling.
description_zh_TW: Amphiregulin 是 SASP 生長因子臂中典型的 EGFR 配體，驅動上皮增殖與重編程。EGFR 結合將衰老分泌連結到鄰近基質重塑。

label: Pycnodysostosis
description: CTSK loss-of-function causes the osteosclerotic dysplasia pycnodysostosis. Causation is the genetic etiology.
description_zh_TW: CTSK 功能缺失導致骨硬化發育不良緻密骨發育不全。因果是遺傳病因。

label: Odanacatib
description: Odanacatib is the selective cathepsin K inhibitor reaching Phase III for osteoporosis. Inhibition is the pharmacological edge.
description_zh_TW: Odanacatib 是進入骨質疏鬆 III 期選擇性組織蛋白酶 K 抑制劑。抑制是藥理邊。

label: PD-1
description: Checkpoint inhibitors prototypically block the PD-1 receptor to release T-cell brakes.
description_zh_TW: 檢查點抑制劑典型阻斷 PD-1 受體以釋放 T 細胞煞車。

label: cervical cancer
description: Cisplatin is the standard chemotherapy backbone for cervical cancer.
description_zh_TW: Cisplatin 是子宮頸癌標準化療主幹。

label: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB
description: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB shifts signaling to necroptosis, as loss of NF-kappaB-dependent survival genes leaves RIPK1 free to engage RIPK3 and MLKL in lytic, pro-inflammatory cell death. This explains toxicity when NF-kappaB is inhibited in TNF-exposed cells. The directionality is NF-kappaB blockade to necroptotic switch. A caveat is that caspase-8 can still divert cells to apoptosis, so the outcome depends on the full death-receptor complex composition. Necroptosis is highly inflammatory because lysed cells release damage-associated molecular patterns, amplifying tissue injury.
description_zh_TW: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB 將訊號傳導轉移至 necroptosis，因為 NF-kappaB 依賴性存活基因的缺失使 RIPK1 可以自由地與 RIPK3 和 MLKL 結合，參與裂解性促發炎細胞死亡。这解释了 TNF 暴露细胞中 NF-κB 受到抑制时的毒性。方向性是 NF-kappaB 阻断坏死性凋亡开关。需要注意的是，caspase-8 仍然可以將細胞轉移到 apoptosis，因此結果取決於完整的死亡受體複合物組成。 Necroptosis 具有高度發炎性，因為裂解的細胞會釋放與損傷相關的分子模式，從而放大組織損傷。

label: 24(S)-Hydroxycholesterol
source_file: _document_ - Necroptosis a regulated inflammatory mode of cell death.md
description: Ester-form 24(S)-hydroxycholesterol inhibits amyloid-beta production at physiological concentration, but at high concentration it induces non-apoptotic programmed death in neuronal cells with low caspase-8 expression; controlling its level may therefore prevent onset of progressive neurodegeneration, placing 24S-OHC at the apoptosis/necroptosis fate boundary (Dhuriya & Sharma 2018).
description_zh_TW: 酯化型 24(S)-羟基胆固醇在生理浓度抑制淀粉样β生成，但在高浓度对低 caspase-8 神经元诱导非凋亡性程序性死亡；控制其水平或可预防进行性神经退行性疾病，位于凋亡/necroptosis 命運分界。

label: Antitumor Immunity
source_file: _document_ - Regulatory complexity and therapeutic targeting of the necroptosis network.md
description: Necroptotic tumor cells release damage-associated molecular patterns that can promote immunogenic cell death and activate antitumor immunity; sustained necroptotic signaling may instead contribute to therapy resistance, giving necroptosis a dual, context-dependent role in cancer (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: necroptotic 腫瘤細胞釋放損傷相關分子模式，可促進免疫原性細胞死亡並活化抗腫瘤免疫；但持續的 necroptotic 訊號反而可能促成治療抗性，使 necroptosis 在癌症中具雙重且依情境而定的角色（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: HG-9-91-01
description: HG-9-91-01 is a salt-inducible kinase inhibitor that suppresses necroptosis by disrupting the RIPK3/MLKL interaction, demonstrating that the terminal necroptosis execution step is pharmacologically targetable independently of RIPK1 (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: HG-9-91-01 是 salt-inducible kinase 抑制劑，透過破壞 RIPK3/MLKL 交互作用而抑制 necroptosis，證明 necroptosis 的終端執行步驟可在不依賴 RIPK1 的情況下被藥理靶向（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Apelin
description: In streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats, apelin treatment reversed hippocampal necroptosis (RIPK3/MLKL axis), alleviated cognitive impairment, and preserved neuronal viability, evidence that endogenous peptides can restrain necroptosis in metabolic/neurological injury (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: 在鏈脲佐菌素誘導的糖尿病大鼠中，apelin 治療逆轉海馬 necroptosis（RIPK3/MLKL 軸）、改善認知障礙並維持神經元存活，證明內源性胜肽可在代謝/神經損傷中抑制 necroptosis（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: TRPM7
description: TRPM7 is a Mg2+/Ca2+-permeable cation channel proposed to mediate indirect/MLKL-independent membrane compromise during necroptosis; the review highlights such ion-channel routes as evidence that the terminal execution phase is more heterogeneous than a single pore mechanism (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: TRPM7 是可通透 Mg2+/Ca2+ 的陽離子通道，被提出在 necroptosis 中媒介間接/不依賴 MLKL 的膜損傷；該綜述以此類離子通道途徑說明終端執行階段比單一孔道機制更具異質性（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Acid Sphingomyelinase
description: Acid sphingomyelinase was listed among proposed regulators of necroptosis in the 2014 review, pending definitive confirmation.
description_zh_TW: 酸性鞘磷脂酶在 2014 年綜述中被列為 necroptosis 之候選調節者，尚待明確證實。

label: Inflammatory Bowel Disease
description: Deleting Caspase-8 or FADD from intestinal epithelium causes spontaneous necroptosis with pathology morphologically similar to inflammatory bowel disease, and RIPK3 deletion completely prevents it.
description_zh_TW: 從腸道上皮刪除 Caspase-8 或 FADD 會引起自發性 necroptosis，其病理形態類似發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），而 RIPK3 缺失可完全預防之。

label: Tau oligomerization
description: 4-hydroxynonenal promotes tau oligomerization by forming covalent Michael adducts with tau cysteine and lysine residues, altering its conformation and seeding oligomers. As a major lipid-peroxidation aldehyde, 4-HNE thus couples membrane oxidation to protein misfolding. The directionality is aldehyde adduct to tau aggregation propensity. A caveat is that 4-HNE at low levels can also induce adaptive responses, and other aldehydes (MDA, acrolein) modify tau similarly. Elevated 4-HNE and tau adducts colocalize in Alzheimer's disease brain, linking lipid peroxidation to neurofibrillary pathology.
description_zh_TW: 4-hydroxynonenal 透過與 tau 半胱胺酸和離胺酸殘基形成共價邁克爾加合物，改變其構象並播種寡聚物來促進 tau oligomerization。作为一种主要的脂质过氧化醛，4-HNE 将膜氧化与蛋白质错误折叠结合起来。方向性是醛加合物對tau聚集的傾向。需要注意的是，低水平的 4-HNE 也可以誘導適應性反應，其他醛（MDA、丙烯醛）也會類似地修飾 tau。升高的 4-HNE 和 tau 加合物共定位於阿茲海默症大腦中，將 lipid peroxidation 與神經纖維病理聯繫起來。

label: Free Iron
description: Ferritin sequesters free iron by storing up to roughly 4,500 Fe3+ atoms per molecule in a mineral core, keeping redox-active iron away from peroxide and the Fenton reaction. This buffering is a front-line antioxidant defense. The directionality is iron chelation to suppressed radical formation. A caveat is that ferritin can be released or degraded during inflammation and hemorrhage, liberating iron that then becomes pro-oxidant. Iron released from ferritin by ferritinophagy or by reduction is what fuels ferroptosis, so ferritin level is a determinant of ferroptosis sensitivity.
description_zh_TW: Ferritin 透過在礦物核心中每個分子儲存約 4,500 個 Fe3+ 原子來隔離 free iron，使具有氧化還原活性的 iron 遠離過氧化物和 Fenton reaction。這種緩衝是一種前線抗氧化防禦。方向性是iron螯合以抑制自由基的形成。需要注意的是，ferritin 在發炎和出血期間可能會釋放或降解，釋放出 iron，然後變成促氧化劑。透過ferritin自噬或還原從ferritin釋放的Iron是ferroptosis的燃料，因此ferritin水平是ferroptosis敏感性的決定因素。

label: Antioxidant Response
description: NRF2 is the master regulator of the antioxidant response, inducing more than 200 cytoprotective genes including those for glutathione synthesis, thioredoxin, heme oxygenase, and drug detoxification. It integrates signals from KEAP1, redox status, and electrophiles. The directionality is NRF2 activation to coordinated defense transcription. A caveat is that excessive or chronic NRF2 activation can support tumor cell survival, so its regulation is finely balanced. The NRF2-KEAP1 system is druggable, and activators such as dimethyl fumarate and sulforaphane are used or investigated in inflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases.
description_zh_TW: NRF2 是 antioxidant response 的主調節因子，誘導 200 多個細胞保護基因，包括用於 glutathione 合成、硫氧還蛋白、血紅素加氧酶和藥物解毒的基因。它整合了來自 KEAP1、氧化還原狀態和親電子試劑的訊號。方向性是NRF2活化以協調防禦轉錄。需要注意的是，過度或慢性 NRF2 活化可以支持腫瘤細胞存活，因此其調節是精細平衡的。 NRF2-KEAP1 系統是可藥物化的，富馬酸二甲酯和蘿蔔硫素等活化劑在發炎和 neurodegenerative diseases 中使用或研究。

label: Antioxidant Response Element
description: Nrf2 is the transcription factor that, upon release from Keap1, translocates to the nucleus and upregulates antioxidant response element (ARE) genes encoding detoxifying and antioxidant enzymes. In the senomorphic hypothesis, aminochrome-mediated Keap1 modification activates this Nrf2/ARE program. Because active Nrf2 signaling mutually antagonizes NF-κB and directly represses pro-inflammatory cytokine transcription, Nrf2 activation is proposed to enforce a quiescent, non-secretory phenotype in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: Nrf2是從Keap1釋放後轉位至細胞核並上調編碼解毒和抗氧化酶的抗氧化反應元件（ARE）基因的轉錄因子。在衰老模仿假說中，氨基色素介導的Keap1修改激活此Nrf2/ARE程序。由於活性Nrf2信號相互拮抗NF-κB並直接抑制促炎細胞因子轉錄，Nrf2激活被提出在衰老細胞中強制執行靜止、非分泌表型。

label: ML385
description: ML385 binds the NRF2 bZIP domain, blocking its heterodimerization with small Maf proteins and preventing ARE-driven antioxidant transcription. Directionally, ML385 sits upstream of NRF2 inhibition. Because SIRT1 activates NRF2, ML385 can be used to disrupt that axis experimentally, and it is a tool to dissect NRF2-dependent cytoprotection. By preventing NRF2 from binding antioxidant-response elements, ML385 reduces the expression of the protective enzyme battery. Its selectivity for NRF2 over other bZIP factors makes it a valuable pharmacological probe in oxidative-stress research.
description_zh_TW: ML385 結合 NRF2 bZIP 域，阻斷其與小 Maf 蛋白的異源二聚化並阻止 ARE 驅動的抗氧化轉錄。在方向性上，ML385 位於 NRF2 抑制的上游。由於 SIRT1 活化 NRF2，ML385 可用於實驗性地破壞該軸線，是剖析 NRF2 依賴性細胞保護的工具。透過阻止 NRF2 結合抗氧化反應元件，ML385 減少保護性酶組的表達。其對 NRF2 相較於其他 bZIP 因子的選擇性使其成為氧化壓力研究中有價值的藥理學探針。

label: ARE
description: The antioxidant response element (ARE) is a cis-acting promoter element through which NRF2 drives expression of over 200 cytoprotective antioxidant and detoxification genes. ARE is the primary DNA sequence effector of NRF2-mediated redox defense.
description_zh_TW: 抗氧化反應元件（ARE）是順式作用的啟動子元件，NRF2 透過它驅動超過 200 個細胞保護性抗氧化與解毒基因的表現。ARE 是 NRF2 介導之氧化還原防禦的主要 DNA 序列效應器。

label: Transferrin receptor
description: Iron Regulatory Protein 1 stabilizes transferrin receptor messenger RNA, increasing cellular iron uptake. Stabilization raises iron import when cytosolic iron is low.
description_zh_TW: Iron Regulatory Protein 1 穩定 transferrin receptor 信使 RNA，提高細胞鐵攝取。穩定在胞質鐵低時提高鐵輸入。

label: alternative to methylfolate
description: Folinic acid is an alternative to methylfolate, particularly for slow COMT individuals, because it delivers folate cofactors without directly adding the methyl burden that methylfolate contributes to the methylation cycle. It supports nucleotide synthesis and, indirectly, methylation without acutely raising SAMe as aggressively as methyl donors do. This makes it a gentler option in methyl-sensitive genotypes, where methylfolate can provoke irritability or anxiety. It provides a route to one-carbon support that is better tolerated in this population.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 是 alternative to methylfolate，特別是對於慢速 COMT 個體，因為它提供 folate 輔因子，而不直接添加甲基葉酸對 methylation cycle 貢獻的甲基負擔。它支持核苷酸合成，並間接支持甲基化，而不會像甲基供體那樣急劇升高 SAMe。這使得它成為甲基敏感基因型的更溫和的選擇，因為甲基葉酸會引起煩躁或焦慮。它提供了一種在該人群中更容易耐受的單碳支持途徑。

label: neuroprotective properties
description: Luteolin has neuroprotective properties, including suppression of neuroinflammation, reduction of oxidative stress, and modulation of microglial activation, which may protect neurons in models of neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation. These effects are mediated through pathways such as Nrf2 and NF-kappaB rather than through COMT. Its catechol structure, however, means high doses can interact with COMT as both substrate and competitive inhibitor. It is studied for potential benefit in cognitive decline and brain injury.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 neuroprotective properties，包括抑制神經發炎、減少氧化壓力和調節小膠質細胞活化，這可能會保護神經退化性和神經發炎模型中的神經元。這些作用是透過 Nrf2 和 NF-kappaB 等途徑介導的，而不是透過 COMT 介導的。然而，其茶酚結構意味著高劑量可以與作為底物和競爭性抑制劑的 COMT 相互作用。研究了它對認知能力下降和 brain 損傷的潛在益處。

label: active folate form
description: Methylfolate (5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the active, methylated circulating form of folate produced by MTHFR and absorbed directly from diet or supplements.
