description: Because the dopamine transporter is scarce in the prefrontal cortex, the region relies principally on COMT to methylate dopamine and norepinephrine at the synapse, making it the dominant clearance route. This dependence means genetic variation in COMT strongly influences PFC dopamine tone. The Met (slow) allele preserves higher dopamine while the Val (fast) allele lowers it.
description_zh_TW: 由於多巴胺轉運蛋白在前額葉皮質稀缺，該區域主要依賴 COMT 在突觸甲基化 dopamine 和 norepinephrine，使其成為主要的清除途徑。這種依賴意味著 COMT 的遺傳變異強烈影響 PFC 多巴胺張力。Met（慢）等位基因保留較高的多巴胺，而 Val（快）等位基因則降低它。

label: methyl donor availability
description: Prefrontal cortex function sits at the intersection of genetics and nutrition because COMT activity is itself modulated by methyl-donor availability such as Methylfolate, MethylB12, and SAMe. By supplying the methyl groups COMT consumes, methyl-donor status influences PFC dopamine tone. This links dietary and supplement choices to prefrontal cognition.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質功能位於遺傳和營養的交匯點，因為 COMT activity 本身會受到 Methylfolate、MethylB12 和 SAMe 等甲基供體可用性的調節。透過供應 COMT 消耗的甲基，甲基供體狀態影響 PFC 多巴胺張力。這將飲食和補充劑選擇與前額葉認知連結起來。

label: ADHD
description: Prefrontal dopamine dysregulation is central to ADHD, where deficits in executive function and attention arise from suboptimal PFC dopamine tone. Interventions such as NET-inhibiting drugs raise PFC dopamine and norepinephrine to improve attention. The PFC therefore sits at the intersection of genetics, cognition, and ADHD treatment.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉多巴胺失調是 ADHD 的核心，執行功能和注意力的缺陷源於次佳化的 PFC 多巴胺張力。抑制 NET 的藥物等介入措施會提高 PFC 的 dopamine 和 norepinephrine 以改善注意力。因此 PFC 位於遺傳、認知和 ADHD 治療的交匯點。

label: Norepinephrine transporter for dopamine clearance
description: The prefrontal cortex relies on the norepinephrine transporter (NET) to clear dopamine in this region because the dopamine transporter (DAT) is sparse. NET takes up both norepinephrine and a substantial fraction of extracellular dopamine. This makes NET a critical determinant of catecholamine tone in the frontal lobes.
description_zh_TW: 由於多巴胺轉運蛋白 (DAT) 稀疏，前額葉皮質依賴 norepinephrine transporter (NET) 清除該區域的 dopamine。NET 同時攝取 norepinephrine 和大量細胞外 dopamine。這使 NET 成為額葉兒茶酚胺張力的關鍵決定因素。

label: Gene Bodies
description: DNMT3a exhibits a preference for methylating gene bodies and intergenic regions, in contrast to DNMT3b, which preferentially targets repetitive elements and pericentromeric satellite DNA. Gene body methylation is associated with transcriptional regulation, alternative splicing, and suppression of spurious transcription initiation within genes. This differential targeting between the de novo methyltransferases helps shape the distinct compartmentalization of the methylome and influences patterns of gene expression, heterochromatin formation, and genomic stability.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3a 表現出對基因體和基因間區域甲基化的偏好，而 DNMT3b 則優先針對重複元件和著絲粒周圍衛星 DNA。基因體甲基化與基因內的轉錄調控、選擇性剪接和抑制虛假轉錄起始有關。從頭甲基轉移酶之間的這種差異靶向有助於形成甲基化組的獨特區室化，並影響 gene expression 的模式、異染色質形成和基因組穩定性。

label: Hematopoiesis
description: DNMT3a is essential for normal hematopoiesis, particularly for the differentiation and self-renewal of hematopoietic stem cells. It establishes DNA methylation patterns that restrict the expression of genes involved in stem cell maintenance and promotes commitment to the blood cell lineage. Loss or mutation of DNMT3a deregulates this epigenetic control, expanding self-renewal capacity and predisposing cells to clonal outgrowth, which underlies clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential and progression to acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3a對於正常造血，特別是造血幹細胞的分化和自我更新至關重要。它建立 DNA 甲基化模式，限制參與幹細胞維持的基因表達，並促進對血球譜系的承諾。 DNMT3a的缺失或突變會解除這種表觀遺傳控制的調節，擴大自我更新能力並使細胞易於克隆生長，這是不確定潛力的克隆造血和進展為急性髓系白血病的基礎。

label: PML-RARA
description: The PML-RARA fusion oncoprotein defines acute promyelocytic leukaemia.
description_zh_TW: PML-RARA 融合致癌蛋白定義急性前骨髓球白血病。

label: Chemotherapy sensitivity
description: Caloric restriction increases the sensitivity of tumor cells to chemotherapy by creating a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while cancer cells remain vulnerable. CR additionally stimulates CD8+ T cell-mediated anti-tumor immunity and enhances apoptotic priming of malignant cells. The improved therapeutic index allows lower effective doses and reduced toxicity. These effects position CR and its mimetics as adjuncts to conventional cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制透過創造差異性壓力抵抗來增加腫瘤細胞對化療的敏感性：正常細胞進入保護性、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而癌細胞仍保持脆弱。熱量限制還刺激 CD8+ T 細胞介導的抗腫瘤免疫，並增強惡性細胞的凋亡啟動。改善的治療指數允許更低的有效劑量和減少的毒性。這些效應將熱量限制及其擬似物定位為常規癌症治療的輔助手段。

label: Caloric Restriction Mimetics
description: Caloric restriction mimetics are pharmacological agents that reproduce the metabolic and autophagic benefits of caloric restriction without sustained food reduction. Representatives such as 2-deoxyglucose, metformin, and spermidine activate AMPK and/or inhibit mTORC1, recapitulating the low-energy signaling state that drives autophagy. By mimicking nutrient scarcity at the signaling level, these compounds induce lysosomal and autophagic gene programs similar to those engaged during DR. They are attractive translationally because they avoid the practical and compliance limitations of long-term dietary restriction in humans.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制擬似物是能再現熱量限制的代謝和自噬益處而無需持續減少食物的藥理劑。代表物如2-deoxyglucose、metformin和spermidine活化AMPK和／或抑制mTORC1，重現驅動自噬的低能量訊號狀態。透過在訊號層面模擬營養匱乏，這些化合物誘導與DR期間相似的溶酶體和自噬基因程序。它們在轉譯上具吸引力，因為它們避免了人類長期飲食限制的實際和依從性限制。

label: Adaptive autophagy
description: Moderate caloric restriction induces adaptive autophagy—a beneficial, hormetic form of the pathway that enhances cellular clearance and resilience without causing damage. This adaptive response, driven by AMPK activation and mTORC1 inhibition, contributes substantially to the lifespan and healthspan extension observed with CR. Unlike pathological autophagy, adaptive autophagy is precisely regulated and supports rather than threatens cell survival. It represents the mechanistic core of CR's pro-longevity effects.
description_zh_TW: 適度的熱量限制誘發適應性自噬——一種有益的、激效型（hormetic）的途徑形式，在不造成損傷的情況下增強細胞清除和韌性。此由 AMPK 活化和 mTORC1 抑制驅動的適應性反應，對熱量限制所觀察到的壽命和健康壽命延長貢獻良多。不同於病理性自噬，適應性自噬受到精確調節，支持而非威脅細胞存活。它代表了熱量限制促長壽效應的機制核心。

label: Excessive autophagy
description: Prolonged or severe caloric restriction can drive excessive autophagy that crosses into autophagic cell death, particularly when degradative flux outpaces biosynthetic capacity. This maladaptive extreme underscores the biphasic, hormetic nature of autophagy, where too little or too much is detrimental. The balance between adaptive and excessive autophagy determines whether CR is protective or harmful. Understanding this threshold is important for safely translating CR-mimetic strategies.
description_zh_TW: 長期或嚴重的熱量限制可能驅動過度的自噬，跨越到自噬性細胞死亡，特別是當降解流超越合成能力時。此適應不良的極端凸顯了自噬的雙相、激效型本質，即過少或過多都有害。適應性與過度自噬之間的平衡決定了熱量限制是有保護性還是有害。理解此閾值對於安全轉譯熱量限制擬似策略至為重要。

label: BDNF (via SIRT1/FoxO)
description: Caloric restriction and intermittent fasting elevate BDNF through SIRT1/FoxO-dependent pathways, contributing to cognitive resilience against aging. Directionally, caloric restriction sits upstream of BDNF elevation via SIRT1/FoxO. This neuroprotective adaptation complements CR's systemic benefits, and it motivates CR and fasting for brain health. By raising BDNF through sirtuin-dependent mechanisms, caloric restriction supports synaptic plasticity, neurogenesis, and neuronal survival. These effects contribute to the protection of cognitive function during aging.
description_zh_TW: 限制熱量和間歇性禁食透過 SIRT1/FoxO 依賴性途徑提高 BDNF，有助於對抗衰老的認知韌性。在方向性上，限制熱量位於透過 SIRT1/FoxO 提升 BDNF 的上游。這種神經保護適應與限制熱量的全身益處互補，並推動限制熱量和禁食對大腦健康的益處。透過透過 sirtuin 依賴性機制提高 BDNF，限制熱量支持突觸可塑性、神經新生和神經元存活。這些效應有助於在衰老過程中保護認知功能。

label: NAD+/nicotinamide ratio (brain)
description: Caloric restriction elevates the brain NAD+/nicotinamide ratio, which both supplies more co-substrate for sirtuins and relieves nicotinamide-mediated feedback inhibition of SIRT1. The resulting gain in sirtuin activity supports neuronal stress resistance, mitochondrial function, and suppression of neuroinflammatory signaling. The relationship is directional: CR shifts the ratio upward, which then potentiates sirtuin-dependent protective programs. This mechanism is frequently invoked to explain CR's protective effects against age-related cognitive decline and neurodegenerative pathology.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制提高大腦的 NAD+/菸鹼醯胺比值，這既為 sirtuin 提供了更多共同受質，又解除了菸鹼醯胺介導的 SIRT1 回饋抑制。由此產生的 sirtuin 活性增強支持神經元的壓力抗性、粒線體功能和抑制神經發炎信號。這種關係是方向性的：CR 使比值上升，然後增強 sirtuin 依賴性的保護程序。這種機制經常被用來解釋 CR 對抗年齡相關認知退化和神經退行性病變的保護效應。

label: SIRT3 (and downregulates SIRT4)
description: Caloric restriction upregulates SIRT3 and downregulates SIRT4, shifting the SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio toward a protective, oxidative-phosphorylation-promoting state. Directionally, caloric restriction sits upstream of the ratio shift. This counters the age-related pattern of declining SIRT3 and rising SIRT4, and it is a core mechanism of CR's metabolic benefits. By biasing the balance toward SIRT3, caloric restriction promotes mitochondrial oxidation, antioxidant defense, and metabolic flexibility. This ratio shift is a key molecular readout of the beneficial effects of dietary restriction.
description_zh_TW: 限制熱量上調 SIRT3 並下調 SIRT4，將 SIRT3/SIRT4 比率推向保護性的、促氧化磷酸化狀態。在方向性上，限制熱量位於比率變化的上游。這對抗了衰老相關的 SIRT3 下降和 SIRT4 上升模式，是限制熱量代謝益處的核心機制。透過使平衡傾向 SIRT3，限制熱量促進粒線體氧化、抗氧化防禦和代謝靈活性。這種比率變化是飲食限制有益效應的關鍵分子讀數。

label: Drosophila melanogaster
description: Dietary restriction in Drosophila extends lifespan and, as in yeast, this benefit requires the dSir2 (Sir2) gene, indicating evolutionary conservation of the sirtuin-mediated CR pathway. The effect is thought to operate through improved protein homeostasis, stress resistance, and metabolic efficiency rather than simple calorie shortage. Directionally, reduced nutrient signaling upstream engages dSir2 to produce the longevity phenotype. Caveats include that the magnitude and requirement vary with sex, genetic background, and the precise restriction paradigm used.
description_zh_TW: 在果蠅中，飲食限制延長壽命，且與酵母中一樣，這種益處需要 dSir2（Sir2）基因，表明 sirtuin 介導的 CR 通路具有演化保守性。該效應被認為是通過改善蛋白質穩態、壓力抗性和代謝效率，而非簡單的熱量不足來運作。在方向性上，減少的營養信號在上游啟動 dSir2，從而產生長壽表型。需要注意的是，該效應的強度和需求因性別、遺傳背景和所使用的具體限制方案而異。

label: β-amyloid neuropathology (Alzheimer's mouse model)
description: In mouse models engineered to develop Alzheimer's-like pathology, caloric restriction prevents accumulation of β-amyloid neuropathology, an effect consistent with SIRT1-driven reductions in neuroinflammation and oxidative stress. CR also preserves cognitive function and synaptic integrity in these models. Directionally, caloric restriction sits upstream of reduced amyloid burden. This supports the hypothesis that CR protects the brain through sirtuin-mediated resilience, and is consistent with SIRT1's promotion of the non-amyloidogenic α-secretase ADAM10. Human translation remains uncertain, but the findings motivate lifestyle interventions and NAD+-boosting strategies in neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: 在被設計發展出阿茲海默症樣病變的小鼠模型中，熱量限制防止 β-amyloid 神經病理學的累積，這種效應與 SIRT1 驅動的神經發炎和氧化壓力減少一致。CR 還在這些模型中保留認知功能和突觸完整性。在方向性上，熱量限制位於減少澱粉樣蛋白負擔的上游。這支持了 CR 通過 sirtuin 介導的韌性保護大腦的假說，與 SIRT1 促進非澱粉樣生成的 α-分泌酶 ADAM10 一致。人類轉化仍然不確定，但這些發現為神經退行性疾病中的生活方式干預和 NAD+ 提升策略提供了動力。

label: SIRT1 expression
description: In rodents, caloric restriction raises SIRT1 levels in multiple tissues, and this elevation is linked to reduced inflammatory and oxidative responses. Higher SIRT1 expression translates into enhanced deacetylation of targets such as NF-κB, FOXO, and PGC-1α, promoting stress resistance and metabolic health. The directionality is that CR is the upstream stimulus and increased SIRT1 abundance/activity the downstream mediator. This adaptation is considered a key explanation for the anti-aging and disease-protective effects of CR in mammals.
description_zh_TW: 在齧齒動物中，熱量限制在多個組織中提高 SIRT1 水平，這種升高與減少的發炎和氧化反應相關。更高的 SIRT1 表達轉化為對 NF-κB、FOXO 和 PGC-1α 等靶標的增強去乙醯化，促進壓力抗性和代謝健康。其方向性為 CR 是上游刺激，SIRT1 表達量/活性增加是下游介導因子。這種適應被認為是 CR 在哺乳動物中抗衰老和疾病保護效應的關鍵解釋。

label: 7-Ketocholesterol
description: 7-ketocholesterol induces apoptosis through ROS-dependent mitochondrial permeabilization and activation of caspase-3, contributing to death of macrophage foam cells in plaques. As a major oxysterol in oxidized LDL, it is implicated in plaque necrosis. The directionality is oxysterol to programmed cell death. A caveat is that 7-ketocholesterol effects are concentration-dependent and can also trigger inflammatory and autophagic responses before death. Plasma and lesion 7-KC levels correlate with plaque vulnerability, and its toxicity to vascular cells is a recognized contributor to plaque necrosis.
description_zh_TW: 7-ketocholesterol透過ROS依賴性mitochondria1透化和caspase-3的活化誘導apoptosis，導致斑塊中巨噬細胞泡沫細胞死亡。作為 oxidized LDL 中的主要氧甾醇，它與噬菌斑 necrosis 有關。方向性是氧甾醇到程序性細胞死亡。需要注意的是，7-ketocholesterol 的作用具有濃度依賴性，也可能在死亡前引發發炎和自噬反應。血漿和病變 7-KC 水平與斑塊脆弱性相關，其對血管細胞的毒性是斑塊 necQrosis 的公認貢獻者。

label: Toluidine Blue O
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Toluidine blue O (TB), the 3,7-dimethyl analog of methylene blue, is the most potent of the tested phenothiazine derivatives, with EC50s of 1.75 nM for viability, 0.11 nM for ROS reduction, and 1.54 nM for preserving mitochondrial membrane potential in the HT-22 glutamate assay. Like MB, TB significantly increased the rate of cytochrome c reduction in the complex I-III assay with NADH as electron donor, enhanced cellular oxygen consumption, and decreased lactate production, sharing MB's alternative electron-transfer-carrier function but with greater potency.
description_zh_TW: 甲苯胺藍 O（TB）是甲烯藍的 3,7-二甲基類似物，是已測試的吩噻嗪衍生物中最有效的，在 HT-22 谷氨酸測定中，其 EC50 分別為 viability 1.75 nM、ROS 減少 0.11 nM、保護線粒體膜電位 1.54 nM。與 MB 一樣，TB 在以 NADH 為電子供體的 complex I-III 測定中顯著增加了細胞色素 c 還原速率，增強了細胞氧消耗，降低了乳酸產生，共享 MB 的替代電子轉載體功能但效力更強。

label: SIRT1 deacetylation of p53
description: By deacetylating p53, SIRT1 lowers p53's transcriptional activation of BH3-only proteins and other apoptotic effectors, suppressing programmed cell death after oxidative or genotoxic stress. This creates a survival bias that helps cells tolerate damage but can also protect incipient cancer cells from elimination. The directionality is that SIRT1 activity on p53 is upstream of reduced apoptosis. A caveat is that chronic suppression of p53-dependent apoptosis is a double-edged sword: protective in normal tissue but potentially tumor-promoting.
description_zh_TW: 通過去乙醯化 p53，SIRT1 降低 p53 對 BH3-only 蛋白和其他凋亡效應因子的轉錄活化，在氧化或基因毒性壓力後抑制程序性細胞死亡。這創造了一種存活偏向，幫助細胞耐受損傷，但也可能保護早期癌細胞免於被清除。其方向性為 SIRT1 對 p53 的活性在減少凋亡的上游。需要注意的是，長期抑制 p53 依賴性凋亡是一把雙刃劍：在正常組織中具有保護作用，但可能促進腫瘤。

label: Cytoplasmic SIRT1
source_file: _document_ - Caspase-mediated changes in Sir2alpha during apoptosis.md
description: Cytoplasmic SIRT1 is pro-apoptotic (caspase-dependent, deacetylase-independent), flipping SIRT1 from a survival factor into a death promoter once it is cleaved and relocalized. In vivo, cells with cytoplasmic Sir2alpha were overwhelmingly dying, with over 130 of 150 such cells having pyknotic nuclei.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質 SIRT1 是促凋亡的（依賴 caspase、不依賴去乙醯化），一旦被裂解和重新定位，便將 SIRT1 從存活因子翻轉為死亡促進者。在體內，具有細胞質 Sir2α 的細胞絕大多數正在死亡，150 個此類細胞中超過 130 個具有固縮核。

label: Protein Kinase C
description: PKCζ is an atypical protein kinase C isoform.
description_zh_TW: PKCζ 是非典型蛋白激酶 C 亞型。

label: PKCδ
description: Caspase-3 cleavage generates a pro-apoptotic PKCδ fragment, amplifying death by feedback.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 切割產生促凋亡 PKCδ 片段，以回饋放大死亡。

label: PAK2
description: PAK2 phosphorylates caspase-7 at Ser30/Thr173/Ser239, suppressing executioner activity.
description_zh_TW: PAK2 在 Ser30/Thr173/Ser239 磷酸化 caspase-7，抑制劊子手活性。

label: Caspase-Activated DNase
description: ICAD binds and holds the Caspase-Activated DNase inactive until cleavage.
description_zh_TW: ICAD 結合並使 Caspase 活化 DNase 維持失活直到切割。

label: YAP
description: LATS1 and LATS2 phosphorylation excludes and degrades YAP.
description_zh_TW: LATS1 與 LATS2 磷酸化排除並降解 YAP。

label: Organ Size
description: Organ-size control is the core conserved Hippo pathway function.
description_zh_TW: 器官大小控制是核心保守的 Hippo 路徑功能。

label: Q-VD-OPh
description: Q-VD-OPh is a neuroprotective pan-caspase inhibitor that blocks executioner Caspase-3; in ischemia models it protects females only, consistent with female-preferential caspase apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Q-VD-OPh 是神經保護型泛 caspase 抑制劑，可阻斷執行者 Caspase-3；在缺血模型中僅保護雌性，與雌性偏好 caspase apoptosis 一致。

label: Environment
source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic alterations—The silent indicator for early aging and age‐associated health‐risks.md
description: Unlike the largely static genome, the epigenome is dynamic and responsive to diet, stress, exercise, toxins, and social environment. Environmental signals modify DNA methylation, histone modifications, and non-coding RNA expression, shaping gene expression over the lifespan and influencing the pace of biological aging. This responsiveness links lifestyle and environmental exposures to long-term health outcomes and provides a mechanistic basis for the effects of behavior and environment on aging.
description_zh_TW: 與基本上靜態的基因組不同，表觀基因組是動態的，並對飲食、壓力、運動、毒素和社會環境做出反應。環境訊號會改變 DNA 甲基化、組蛋白修飾和非編碼 RNA 表達，在整個生命週期中塑造 gene expression 並影響生物老化的速度。這種反應性將生活方式和環境暴露與長期健康結果聯繫起來，並為行為和環境對老化的影響提供了機制基礎。

label: Distal Tissues
description: Mitokines are soluble factors released by stressed mitochondria that communicate mitochondrial stress status to distal tissues, enabling cell-non-autonomous regulation of stress responses and lifespan. In C. elegans, knockdown of the cytochrome c oxidase component cco-1 in the brain activates the UPRmt response in the intestine and extends lifespan, implying that stressed mitochondria in the nervous system release signals that modulate stress defenses elsewhere in the soma. This allows mitochondria in one tissue to act as sensors of overall metabolic status for the entire organism.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體因子是由受壓粒線體釋放的可溶性因子，將粒線體壓力狀態傳遞給遠端組織，實現壓力反應和壽命的細胞非自主性調節。在 C. elegans 中，腦中細胞色素 c 氧化酶成分 cco-1 的敲低會在腸道活化 UPRmt 反應並延長壽命，暗示神經系統中受壓粒線體釋放的訊號在其他體細胞部位調節壓力防禦。這使得一個組織中的粒線體能夠作為整個生物體整體代謝狀態的感測器。

label: Glucose Homeostasis
description: Protein restriction improves glucose homeostasis and insulin sensitivity in both rodents and humans. In young and aged rodents, PR reduces body weight and fat mass, increases energy expenditure, and improves glucose handling even when initiated late in life. Randomized controlled trials in humans show low-protein diets reduce body weight, fat mass, and fasting blood glucose, improve insulin sensitivity, and lower hemoglobin A1C and kidney disease outcomes in diabetic patients. BCAA restriction similarly improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis in humans, and methionine restriction improves glucose homeostasis in humans on strict vegan diets. These metabolic benefits contrast with high-protein diets associated with increased diabetes risk.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制改善囓齒動物和人類的葡萄糖恆定性和胰島素敏感性。在年輕和年老的囓齒動物中，PR減少體重和脂肪量，增加能量消耗，並改善葡萄糖處理，即使在生命晚期開始。人類的隨機對照試驗顯示低蛋白飲食減少體重、脂肪量和空腹血糖，改善胰島素敏感性，並降低糖尿病患者的血紅素A1C和腎臟疾病結果。BCAA限制同樣改善人類的胰島素敏感性和葡萄糖/胰島素恆定性，甲硫氨酸限制改善嚴格素食者的人類葡萄糖恆定性。這些代謝益處與與糖尿病風險增加相關的高蛋白飲食形成對比。

label: SIRT1 allele variants
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Several single-nucleotide polymorphisms in the human SIRT1 gene are significantly associated with systemic energy expenditure in Finnish cohorts, suggesting that SIRT1 variation influences metabolic rate. These variants may alter SIRT1 expression or activity, shifting how individuals burn fuel at rest and during activity. Directionally, genetic SIRT1 variation is linked to an energy-expenditure phenotype. As with most genetic-association findings, effect sizes are modest and context-dependent, and replication in other populations is needed.
description_zh_TW: 人類 SIRT1 基因中的幾個單核苷酸多態性與芬蘭研究組的全身能量消耗顯著相關，表明 SIRT1 變異影響代謝率。這些變異可能改變 SIRT1 的表達或活性，改變個體在靜息和活動狀態下的燃料燃燒方式。在方向性上，遺傳性 SIRT1 變異與能量消耗表型相關。與大多數遺傳關聯研究一樣，效應量 modest 且取決於情境，需要在其他人群中進行複製驗證。

label: Inter-organ signaling
description: Mitokines are soluble factors secreted by cells undergoing mitochondrial stress that trigger stress responses in distal tissues or organs. They represent a form of cell non-autonomous, inter-organ signaling that extends longevity effects across the organism.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體動素（mitokines）是承受粒線體壓力的細胞分泌的可溶性因子，可在遠端組織或器官觸發壓力反應。它們代表一種細胞非自主、器官間訊號形式，將長壽效應擴展至整個生物體。

label: LKB1 deficiency
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Germline loss-of-function mutations in STK11 (LKB1) cause Peutz-Jeghers syndrome, characterized by hamartomatous polyps and elevated cancer risk. Directionally, LKB1 deficiency sits upstream of this cancer predisposition. This highlights LKB1 as a critical tumor suppressor and metabolic regulator, and its connection to AMPK and sirtuin axes explains the metabolic features of the syndrome. Because LKB1 loss compromises AMPK activation, cells fail to properly sense energy stress, promoting growth and genomic instability. The syndrome illustrates the clinical importance of the LKB1-AMPK-sirtuin network.
description_zh_TW: STK11（LKB1）的生殖系功能缺失突變導致 Peutz-Jeghers 綜合症，其特徵為錯構瘤性息肉和癌症風險增加。在方向性上，LKB1 缺陷位於此癌症易感性的上游。這突顯了 LKB1 作為關鍵腫瘤抑制因子和代謝調節因子的地位，其與 AMPK 和 sirtuin 軸線的聯繫解釋了該綜合症的代謝特徵。由於 LKB1 的缺失損害 AMPK 活化，細胞無法正確感知能量壓力，促進生長和基因組不穩定。該綜合症說明了 LKB1-AMPK-sirtuin 網絡的臨床重要性。

label: Thr172
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: LKB1 is the primary upstream kinase phosphorylating AMPK at Thr172 in the activation loop, increasing AMPK activity over a hundred-fold. Directionally, LKB1 sits upstream of AMPK activation. This couples energy sensing to metabolic reprogramming, since activated AMPK promotes catabolism and inhibits anabolism. Sirtuins feed into this node via LKB1 deacetylation and AMPK-dependent NAD+ elevation, creating a self-reinforcing circuit. The LKB1-AMPK pathway is a central regulator of cellular energy homeostasis, and its dysregulation contributes to metabolic disease and cancer.
description_zh_TW: LKB1 是磷酸化 AMPK 啟動迴路中 Thr172 位點的主要上游激酶，將 AMPK 活性提高百倍以上。在方向性上，LKB1 位於 AMPK 活化的上游。這將能量感知與代謝重編程偶聯，因為活化的 AMPK 促進分解代謝並抑制合成代謝。Sirtuin 透過 LKB1 去乙醯化和 AMPK 依賴性的 NAD+ 提升回饋到此節點，創造自強化的迴路。LKB1-AMPK 途徑是細胞能量恆定性的核心調節因子，其失調導致代謝疾病和癌症。

label: STRAD and MO25 for activity
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: LKB1 requires binding to STRAD and MO25 to exit the nucleus and gain full kinase activity; without this scaffold it remains inactive. Directionally, STRAD and MO25 sit upstream of LKB1 activation. This gating is essential for LKB1's role as the master upstream AMPK kinase, and SIRT1 and AMPK deacetylate and phosphorylate LKB1 to modulate its localization. The STRAD/MO25 scaffold both stabilizes LKB1 and directs it to the cytoplasm where it can activate AMPK. Mutations in LKB1, as in Peutz-Jeghers syndrome, disrupt this pathway and predispose to cancer.
description_zh_TW: LKB1 需要與 STRAD 和 MO25 結合才能離開細胞核並獲得完整的激酶活性；沒有這個支架它保持不活化。在方向性上，STRAD 和 MO25 位於 LKB1 活化的上游。這種門控機制對 LKB1 作為核心上游 AMPK 激酶的角色至關重要，SIRT1 和 AMPK 去乙醯化和磷酸化 LKB1 以調控其定位。STRAD/MO25 支架既穩定 LKB1 又將其導向細胞質，在那裡它可以活化 AMPK。LKB1 的突變，如 Peutz-Jeghers 綜合症，會破壞此途徑並增加癌症易感性。

label: Mitochondrial enzyme
description: Glutaminase (GLS) is a mitochondrial matrix enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolytic deamidation of glutamine to glutamate and ammonium, the committed first step of glutaminolysis. Both major isoforms (GLS1 and GLS2) require oligomerization for catalytic activity and are localized to the mitochondria. By linking amino acid catabolism to the TCA cycle and redox balance, glutaminase sits at the hub of cellular metabolism. Its mitochondrial localization is central to its role in fueling proliferating cells.
description_zh_TW: Glutaminase（GLS）是一種粒線體基質酵素，催化麩醯胺酸水解性去胺化為麩胺酸和銨，是麩醯胺分解的代謝第一步。兩種主要同型異構物（GLS1 和 GLS2）都需要寡聚化才具有催化活性，並定位於粒線體。透過將胺基酸分解代謝與 TCA 循環和氧化還原平衡連結，glutaminase 位居細胞代謝的核心。其粒線體定位對其供給增殖細胞的角色至關重要。

label: Glutamine deamidation
description: Glutaminase catalyzes the hydrolytic deamidation of glutamine to glutamate and ammonium, the rate-limiting first step of glutaminolysis. The glutamate produced is further transaminated to alpha-ketoglutarate, replenishing TCA-cycle intermediates (anaplerosis). This reaction is essential for glutamine-dependent cancers, which rely on glutamine as a major carbon and nitrogen source. The enzyme's activity is allosterically activated by inorganic phosphate and by its product glutamate at high concentrations.
description_zh_TW: Glutaminase 催化麩醯胺酸水解性去胺化為麩胺酸和銨，這是麩醯胺分解的限速第一步。所產生的麩胺酸進一步轉胺為 alpha-ketoglutarate，補充 TCA 循環中間物（anaplerosis）。此反應對依賴麩醯胺的癌症至關重要，因為它們以麩醯胺作為主要碳源和氮源。此酵素活性受無機磷酸以及高濃度產物麩胺酸的異位性活化。

label: Oxidative Stress buffering
description: Glutaminase-derived glutamate can be converted to glutathione, a key antioxidant that buffers reactive oxygen species and supports redox balance. Through this route, glutaminolysis ties into oxidative stress defense and cellular resilience. The glutamate also feeds NADPH production via malic enzyme, contributing to redox homeostasis. This antioxidant dimension links glutamine metabolism to protection against oxidative damage.
description_zh_TW: Glutaminase 衍生的麩胺酸可轉化為麩胱甘肽，一種緩衝活性氧並支持氧化還原平衡的關鍵抗氧化劑。透過此途徑，麩醯胺分解與氧化壓力防禦和細胞韌性相連。麩胺酸也經由蘋果酸酶供應 NADPH 生產，貢獻於氧化還原恆定性。此抗氧化面向將麩醯胺代謝與對抗氧化損傷的保護連結起來。

label: Ammonium
description: The deamination of glutamine by glutaminase releases ammonium, which raises cytosolic pH and acts as a signaling molecule. This ammonia signal induces cytoprotective autophagy as a response to nutrient and therapeutic stress. The ammonia-autophagy axis highlights glutaminase as a bridge between nutrient sensing and cellular resilience. Ammonium production thereby couples glutamine catabolism to the stress-response program.
description_zh_TW: Glutaminase 對麩醯胺酸的去胺化釋放銨，它提高細胞質 pH 並作為訊號分子。此氨訊號誘導保護性自噬，作為對營養和治療壓力的反應。氨—自噬軸凸顯 glutaminase 作為營養感知與細胞韌性之間的橋樑。因此銨的產生將麩醯胺分解代謝耦合到壓力反應程序。

label: GLS1 and GLS2
description: Two major glutaminase isoforms exist: kidney-type GLS1 (encoded by GLS, with alternatively spliced variants KGA and GAC) and liver-type GLS2 (encoded by GLS2). GLS1 is the predominant isoform in most proliferating cells and is allosterically activated by phosphate and glutamate. The tumor suppressor p53 transcriptionally induces GLS2. Both isoforms are mitochondrial matrix enzymes.
description_zh_TW: 存在兩種主要的 glutaminase 同型異構物：腎型 GLS1（由 GLS 編碼，具選擇性剪接變異 KGA 和 GAC）和肝型 GLS2（由 GLS2 編碼）。GLS1 是大多數增殖細胞中的主要同型異構物，受磷酸和麩胺酸異位性活化。腫瘤抑制因子 p53 轉錄誘導 GLS2。兩種同型異構物都是粒線體基質酵素。

label: CB-839
description: CB-839 blocks the first step of glutaminolysis at glutaminase.
description_zh_TW: CB-839 在麩醯胺酸酶阻斷麩醯胺酸分解第一步。

label: Beckwith-Wiedemann Syndrome
description: CDKN1C mutation or loss of imprinting causes Beckwith-Wiedemann overgrowth syndrome. The genotype-phenotype link makes CDKN1C a developmental disease gene.
description_zh_TW: CDKN1C 突變或銘印喪失導致 Beckwith-Wiedemann 過度生長症候群。此基因型—表型連結使 CDKN1C 成為發育疾病基因。

label: Glycolic acid
description: PARK7 (DJ-1) detoxifies the reactive dicarbonyl species glyoxal and methylglyoxal in a glutathione-independent manner, converting glyoxal into glycolic acid and methylglyoxal into L-lactate. This stereospecific conversion removes dicarbonyls before they can form irreversible AGE crosslinks on protein residues. Because glyoxal is a major product of glucose and lipid oxidation, PARK7-dependent conversion of glyoxal to glycolic acid is an important route for limiting dicarbonyl stress. Loss of PARK7 activity is associated with tissue-specific accumulation of novel AGEs and, in humans, is linked to early-onset Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: PARK7（DJ-1）以不依賴麩胱甘肽的方式解毒反應性二羰基物種乙二醛與甲基乙二醛，將乙二醛轉化為乙醇酸、將甲基乙二醛轉化為 L-乳酸。這種立體特異性轉化在這些二羰基物形成蛋白質殘基上不可逆的 AGE 交聯之前將其移除。由於乙二醛是葡萄糖與脂質氧化的主要產物，PARK7 依賴的乙二醛轉乙醇酸途徑是限制二羰基壓力的重要路線。PARK7 活性缺失與組織特異性新型 AGE 堆積有關，且在人類中與早發性帕金森氏症（Parkinson's disease）相關。

label: Glyoxalase System
description: The glyoxalase system, composed of GLO1 and GLO2, is the primary defense system against dicarbonyl stress. Methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone are highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediates generated during glycolysis and lipid peroxidation, and if left unchecked they form irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. The glyoxalase system neutralizes these precursors, and maintaining GLO1 activity is a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation. Dysfunction of this system is therefore linked to increased dicarbonyl stress and accelerated protein glycation, with consequences for aging, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 由 GLO1 與 GLO2 組成的乙二醛酶系統（glyoxalase system）是對抗二羰基壓力的主要防禦系統。甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal）、乙二醛（glyoxal）與 3-deoxyglucosone 是糖解與脂質過氧化過程中產生的高度反應性二羰基中間產物，若不加控制，它們會在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。乙二醛酶系統中和這些前驅物，而維持 GLO1 活性是減少內生性 AGE 堆積的主要標的。因此，此系統的功能障礙與二羰基壓力增加及蛋白質糖化加速有關，對老化、糖尿病與心血管疾病產生影響。

label: SIRT1 and RelA/p65
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Exposure to cigarette-smoke extract disrupts the SIRT1–RelA/p65 complex, diminishing deacetylation of RelA and leaving NF-κB in a more active, pro-inflammatory state. The consequence is heightened expression of inflammatory mediators in airway and other cells exposed to smoke. The directionality is that the environmental insult (smoke) reduces a protective protein–protein interaction, increasing inflammation. This provides a mechanistic link between smoking, impaired sirtuin function, and chronic inflammatory lung disease.
description_zh_TW: 暴露於香菸煙霧提取物會破壞 SIRT1–RelA/p65 複合體，削弱 RelA 的去乙醯化，使 NF-κB 處於更活躍的促發炎狀態。後果是在氣道和其他暴露於煙霧的細胞中發炎介質的表達增高。其方向性為：環境損害（煙霧）降低了一個保護性的蛋白-蛋白相互作用，增加發炎。這提供了吸煙、sirtuin 功能受損和慢性發炎性肺病之間的機制性聯繫。

label: DNAmGrimAge
description: DNAmGrimAge is a second-generation epigenetic clock trained to predict morbidity, mortality, and physiological decline rather than simply chronological age. It incorporates DNA methylation surrogates for plasma proteins and smoking exposure, producing a DNAm-based age estimate that is a robust predictor of lifespan and healthspan. As a stronger predictor of time-to-death than first-generation clocks such as the Horvath and Hannum clocks, GrimAge is widely used as an endpoint in aging and rejuvenation studies.
description_zh_TW: DNAmGrimAge 是第二代表觀遺傳時鐘，經過訓練可以預測發病率、死亡率和生理衰退，而不僅僅是實際年齡。它結合了血漿蛋白和吸煙暴露的 DNA 甲基化替代物，產生基於 DNAm 的年齡估計，這是壽命和健康壽命的強大預測因子。作為比第一代時鐘（例如 Horvath 和 Hannum 時鐘）更強大的死亡時間預測器，GrimAge 被廣泛用作衰老和復興研究的終點。

label: Histone Modification
description: Histone modification is a core epigenetic mechanism operating through covalent marks on the N-terminal tails of histone proteins, including acetylation, methylation, phosphorylation, ubiquitination, and SUMOylation. These modifications alter chromatin structure and recruit reader proteins that modulate gene expression; acetylation neutralizes lysine charge to open chromatin, whereas methylation at H3K9 or H3K27 typically condenses it into repressive heterochromatin. The marks are written, erased, and read by families of enzymes such as acetyltransferases, deacetylases, and methyltransferases, and their dynamic balance shapes gene expression and becomes progressively dysregulated with age.
description_zh_TW: Histone 修飾是一種核心表觀遺傳機制，透過組蛋白 N 端尾部的共價標記進行操作，包括乙醯化、甲基化、磷酸化、泛素化和 SUMO 化。這些修飾改變染色質結構並招募調節 gene expression 的讀取蛋白；乙醯化會中和賴氨酸電荷以打開染色質，而 H3K9 或 H3K27 的甲基化通常會將其凝結成抑制性異染色質。這些標記由乙醯轉移酶、去乙醯酶和甲基轉移酶等酵素家族書寫、擦除和讀取，它們的動態平衡塑造了 gene expression，並隨著年齡的增長而逐漸失調。

label: DSB repair and RCM
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: DSB repair and RCM may advance epigenetic clocks by affecting DNA methylation machinery (e.g., TET enzymes and DNMTs). Because the response to DNA damage follows conserved mechanisms, aging becomes somewhat predictable despite random damage, leading to consistent epigenetic drift. Directionally, DNA damage repair and the consequent relocalization of chromatin modifiers sit upstream of clock-measured epigenetic age acceleration, linking RCM to quantitative measures of biological aging.
description_zh_TW: 雙股斷裂（DSB）修復和 RCM 可能透過影響 DNA 甲基化機制（例如 TET 酶和 DNMTs）來推進表觀遺傳時鐘。由於 DNA 損傷反應遵循保守的機制，衰老因此具有一定的可預測性，儘管損傷是隨機的，導致一致的表觀遺傳漂移。從作用方向而言，DNA 損傷修復及隨後的染色質修飾因子再定位位於時鐘測量的表觀遺傳年齡加速的上游，將 RCM 與生物衰老的量化測量聯繫起來。

label: Th17 inflammatory profile
source_file: _document_ - Autophagy takes it all – autophagy inducers target immune aging.md
description: Metformin reverses the pro-inflammatory Th17 CD4+ T cell profile toward a more juvenile, balanced phenotype, an effect attributed to enhancement of autophagic flux within lymphocytes. By activating AMPK and inducing autophagy, metformin reduces the mitochondrial and metabolic perturbations that favor pathogenic Th17 differentiation. This phenotypic rebalancing may contribute to the drug's anti-inflammatory and immune-modulatory benefits beyond glycemic control. The observation links metformin's autophagy-inducing capacity to attenuation of age- and inflammation-associated T cell skewing.
description_zh_TW: Metformin 將促發炎的 Th17 CD4+ T 細胞譜系逆轉為更年輕、平衡的表型，此效應歸因於淋巴細胞內自噬流的增強。透過活化 AMPK 和誘導自噬，metformin 減少有利於致病性 Th17 分化的粒線體和代謝擾動。這種表型再平衡可能有助於該藥物超越血糖控制之外的抗發炎和免疫調節益處。此觀察將 metformin 誘導自噬的能力與減緩年齡和發炎相關的 T 細胞偏移聯繫起來。

label: TDP-43
description: TDP-43-driven mitochondrial rupture releases mtDNA that engages cGAS-STING interferon signaling. This organizes the tau/TDP-43/FTD disease community around innate immunity.
description_zh_TW: TDP-43 驅動的粒線體破裂釋放接合 cGAS-STING 干擾素訊號的 mtDNA。此圍繞先天免疫組織 tau/TDP-43/FTD 疾病群落。

label: Cytosolic DNA crosstalk
description: Cytosolic mtDNA, cytoplasmic chromatin fragments and LINE-1 cDNA crosstalk to amplify cGAS-STING signaling in senescence; removing any single DNA source often suppresses SASP, and blocking the mitochondrial source preserves acute immune responses better than direct cGAS or STING blockade.
description_zh_TW: 胞質 mtDNA、細胞質染色質片段與 LINE-1 cDNA 交互作用以放大衰老中的 cGAS-STING 訊號；去除任一 DNA 來源常可抑制 SASP，而阻斷粒線體來源比直接抑制 cGAS 或 STING 更能保留急性免疫反應。

label: Circulation
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: It was estimated using an AGE-specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that approximately 10% of ingested immunoreactive advanced glycation end products are transported into the circulation, two-thirds of which remain in the body and are incorporated covalently into tissues, while only one-third is excreted via the kidneys. Dietary intake is therefore an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and studies in healthy subjects, diabetic patients, and renal failure patients have found significant correlations between ingested AGEs and plasma AGE levels. Restricting dietary AGEs reduces circulating AGE concentrations, supporting the view that diet modulates systemic glycation burden.
description_zh_TW: 使用 AGE 專一的酵素連結免疫吸附分析法（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay）估計，約 10% 攝入的免疫反應性晚期糖化終產物被運輸進入循環，其中三分之二留在體內並共價地併入組織，僅三分之一經由腎臟排泄。因此，飲食攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且在健康受試者、糖尿病患者與腎衰竭患者中的研究發現攝入 AGE 與血漿 AGE 濃度之間有顯著相關。限制飲食中的 AGE 可降低循環 AGE 濃度，支持飲食會調節全身性糖化負擔的觀點。

label: Plasma AGEs
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Uribarri and colleagues estimated dietary AGE intake from three-day food records in 90 healthy subjects using a database of the AGE content of foods and found a significant correlation between ingested AGEs and plasma levels; a subgroup exposed to dietary restriction of AGEs showed decreased plasma levels as well. Similar results were reported in patients with diabetes and renal failure. These findings support the view that the intake of dietary AGEs is an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and that reducing dietary AGE intake lowers circulating AGE concentrations even in healthy individuals.
description_zh_TW: Uribarri 及其同事利用食物 AGE 含量資料庫，從 90 名健康受試者的三日飲食記錄估計飲食 AGE 攝取量，發現攝入 AGE 與血漿濃度之間有顯著相關；一組接受飲食 AGE 限制的亞組也顯示血漿濃度下降。糖尿病與腎衰竭患者中也報告了類似結果。這些發現支持飲食 AGE 攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且減少飲食 AGE 攝取可降低循環 AGE 濃度，即使在健康個體中亦然。

label: Heart disease
description: Atherosclerosis is the central mechanism of most cardiovascular events through endothelial injury to plaque. Causation records the etiology.
description_zh_TW: 動脈粥狀硬化經由內皮損傷到斑塊是多數心血管事件的中央機制。因果記錄病因。

label: NSAIDs
description: NSAIDs pharmacologically block prostaglandin E2 synthesis.
description_zh_TW: NSAID 藥理阻斷前列腺素 E2 合成。

label: Lipofuscin
description: Lipofuscin and Aging are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Lipofuscin and Aging may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Lipofuscin 和 Aging 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Lipofuscin 和 Aging 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Autophagic flux
description: Autophagic flux—the complete rate of cargo delivery to and degradation within lysosomes—declines progressively with age in many tissues. This decline stems from impaired initiation, reduced lysosomal proteolytic capacity, and accumulated lipofuscin that compromises lysosomal function, producing a state of proteostatic insufficiency. The resulting accumulation of damaged organelles and protein aggregates contributes centrally to the aging phenotype and to age-related diseases such as neurodegeneration and sarcopenia. Restoration of autophagic flux is therefore a major hypothesized mechanism through which longevity interventions exert their benefits.
description_zh_TW: 自噬流——即貨物遞送至溶酶體及在溶酶體內降解的完整速率——在許多組織中隨年齡漸進下降。此下降源於起始受損、溶酶體蛋白水解能力降低，以及累積的脂褐質損害溶酶體功能，產生蛋白質穩態不足的狀態。由此導致的受損胞器和蛋白聚集物累積，對老化表型和神經退化、肌肉減少症等與年齡相關疾病有核心貢獻。因此，恢復自噬流是長壽介入發揮其益處的一個主要假設機制。

label: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression
description: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression extends lifespan, as demonstrated by MCAT (mitochondrial catalase transgenic) mice showing roughly 20 percent increased median lifespan and delayed age-related pathology. By concentrating catalase in the mitochondrial matrix, H2O2 from Complex I or III leak is removed before it propagates damage. The directionality is targeted detoxification promoting longevity. A caveat is that lifespan extension is modest and tissue-specific, and overexpression does not abolish all aging phenotypes, indicating multiple parallel aging mechanisms.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression延長了壽命，正如MCAT（mitochondria1catalase轉基因）小鼠所證明的那樣，其顯示中位壽命延長了約20％並延遲了與年齡相關的病理。透過將catalase濃縮在mitochondria1基質中，來自複合物I或III洩漏的H 2 O 2 在其傳播損害之前被除去。方向性是針對性排毒延年益壽。需要注意的是，壽命延長是適度的且具有組織特異性，且過度表現並不能消除所有 aging 表型，表明存在多個並行的 aging 機制。

label: Nucleosome Remodeling
description: Nucleosome remodeling capacity decreases with age, accompanied by the loss of core histones and nucleosome occupancy. In aging yeast, nucleosome occupancy decreases by up to 50 percent and half the core histone proteins are lost, and similar chromatin decompaction occurs in worms and human cells. Reduced histone abundance and nucleosome loss decompact chromatin, increasing DNA accessibility and transcriptional noise while contributing to genomic instability in aging cells. These findings support the view that chromatin decompaction is a fundamental driver of age-related dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Nucleosome 重塑能力隨著年齡的增長而降低，伴隨著核心組蛋白和核小體佔據的損失。在老化的酵母菌中，核小體佔有率下降高達 50%，一半的核心組蛋白流失，蠕蟲和人類細胞中也會發生類似的染色質解壓縮。組蛋白豐度的減少和核小體的流失會使染色質解壓縮，增加 DNA 的可及性和轉錄噪音，同時導致老化細胞的基因組不穩定。這些發現支持這樣的觀點：染色質解壓縮是與年齡相關的功能障礙的根本驅動因素。

label: Declining SIRT3 and rising SIRT4
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Aging is associated with declining SIRT3 activity and rising SIRT4, which narrows the hormetic window and increases vulnerability to mitochondrial stressors. Directionally, aging sits upstream of the altered ratio. This shift favors oxidant stress and metabolic inflexibility, and restoring the ratio, for example via caloric restriction or NAD+ precursors, is a proposed anti-aging strategy. By reducing the protective SIRT3/SIRT4 balance, aging impairs mitochondrial quality control and stress adaptation. This association links mitochondrial sirtuin biology to the functional decline of aging tissues.
description_zh_TW: 衰老與 SIRT3 活性下降和 SIRT4 上升相關，這縮窄了激效窗口並增加對粒線體壓力源的脆弱性。在方向性上，衰老位於改變比率的上游。這種變化有利於氧化壓力和代謝不靈活性，恢復比率（例如透過限制熱量或 NAD+ 前驅物）是一種擬議的抗衰老策略。透過降低保護性的 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡，衰老損害粒線體品質控制和壓力適應。此關聯將粒線體 sirtuin 生物學與衰老組織的功能退化聯繫起來。

label: Endostatin
description: Endostatin is a 20 kDa collagen XVIII-derived fragment that acts as a potent endogenous inhibitor of angiogenesis, restraining tumor growth and metastasis. Its regulation and matrix-derived abundance change with tissue remodeling in aging.
description_zh_TW: Endostatin 是 20 kDa 的 XVIII 型膠原蛋白衍生片段，是抑制血管生成、約束腫瘤生長與轉移的強效內源性抑制劑。其調控與基質衍生豐度隨衰老的組織重塑而改變。

label: Gram-Negative Bacteria
description: Gram-negative bacteria release LPS that triggers NF-kB and inflammation, increasing mitochondrial ROS and oxidative stress. This links infection to the aging-associated inflammatory load (inflammaging), and gut gram-negative overgrowth contributes to metabolic endotoxemia.
description_zh_TW: 革蘭氏陰性菌釋放 LPS 觸發 NF-κB 與發炎，增加粒線體 ROS 與氧化壓力。這將感染與衰老相關的發炎負荷（inflammaging）相連結，而腸道革蘭氏陰性菌過度生長促成代謝性內毒素血症。

label: Insulin/IGF-1 Signaling
description: The conserved worm-to-mammal longevity axis dissected in model organisms. Regulation is the endocrine aging input.
description_zh_TW: 在模式生物解剖的保守蠕蟲到哺乳類長壽軸。調節是內分泌老化輸入。

label: -CH3
description: A methyl group is a covalent substituent consisting of one carbon atom bonded to three hydrogen atoms (-CH3), the smallest alkyl group and the universal currency of biological methylation. It is transferred by methyltransferases such as COMT from donors like SAMe to acceptors including DNA, proteins, phospholipids, and catechol rings. Methyl group flux is central to epigenetic regulation, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. Its availability is governed by the folate and methionine cycles, linking diet to methylation capacity.
description_zh_TW: 甲基是一種共價取代基，由一個碳原子與三個氫原子鍵結 (-CH3) 組成，是最小的烷基，也是生物甲基化的通用貨幣。它透過甲基轉移酶（例如 COMT）從 SAMe 等供體轉移到包括 DNA、蛋白質、磷脂質和兒茶酚環在內的受體。甲基通量對於表觀遺傳調節、神經傳導物質失活和解毒至關重要。其可用性受 folate 和蛋氨酸循環控制，將飲食與甲基化能力聯繫起來。

label: serotonin to melatonin
description: Methylation converts the neurotransmitter serotonin into the hormone melatonin via N-acetyltransferase- and methyltransferase (ASMT/HIOMT)-catalyzed steps in the pineal gland, with the methyl group donated by SAMe. This reaction is the final biosynthetic step producing melatonin, which regulates circadian rhythm and sleep. The process exemplifies SAMe-dependent methylation outside the catechol system and links methyl donor status to sleep-wake physiology. It highlights the broad metabolic reach of the methylation cycle.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 透過松果體中的 N-乙醯轉移酶和甲基轉移酶 (ASMT/HIOMT) 催化步驟將神經傳導物質血清素轉化為褪黑激素，甲基基團由 SAMe 提供。此反應是產生褪黑激素的最後生物合成步驟，褪黑激素調節晝夜節律和睡眠。此過程例證了兒茶酚系統外 SAMe 依賴性甲基化，並將 methyl donor 狀態與睡眠-覺醒生理學連結起來。它凸顯了 methylation cycle 廣泛的代謝範圍。

label: Catechols via COMT
description: Methylation neutralizes catechols via COMT by transferring a methyl group from SAMe to the catechol hydroxyls, converting reactive catecholamines and xenobiotics into stable, less active O-methylated metabolites for excretion. This detoxification limits oxidative catechol quinone formation and protects tissues from catechol-derived damage. COMT is thus the central catalyst of this neutralizing methylation, and its activity determines the efficiency of catechol clearance. The reaction consumes one SAMe per catechol, linking detoxification to methyl budget.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 透過 COMT 中和兒茶酚，將甲基從 SAMe 轉移到兒茶酚羥基，將反應性 catecholamines 和異生物質轉化為穩定的、活性較低的 O-甲基化代謝物進行排泄。這種解毒作用限制了氧化兒茶酚醌的形成，並保護組織免受兒茶酚衍生的傷害。因此，COMT 是這種中和甲基化的中心催化劑，其活性決定了兒茶酚清除的效率。該反應每種兒茶酚消耗一個 SAMe，將解毒與甲基預算聯繫起來。

label: mRNA
description: Messenger RNA provides the decoded template for protein synthesis.
description_zh_TW: 信使 RNA 提供蛋白合成的解碼模板。

label: Ribosome
description: Ribosomes synthesize proteins by decoding messenger RNA.
description_zh_TW: 核醣體經由解碼信使 RNA 合成蛋白。

label: Transcription
description: Transcription produces the messenger RNA template that translation decodes.
description_zh_TW: 轉錄產生轉譯解碼的信使 RNA 模板。

label: SNP
description: A SNP is a single nucleotide variation reaching one percent population frequency.
description_zh_TW: SNP 是達百分之一族群頻率的單核苷酸變異。

label: Early SASP
source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md
description: p21 supports an early secretory phenotype -- including factors such as CXCL14 and IGFBP3 -- that places stressed cells under immunosurveillance prior to full senescence. This early p21-associated secretome differs from the later NF-kB-dominated SASP, and it may help communicate cellular stress and recruit immune clearance. The relationship suggests p21 contributes to both arrest and the initial communicative state of stressed cells. It is more nuanced than simple arrest enforcement, giving moderate confidence.
description_zh_TW: p21 支持早期分泌表型——包括如 CXCL14 與 IGFBP3 等因子——使受壓細胞在完全衰老前處於免疫監視下。此早期 p21 相關分泌組不同於後期 NF-κB 主導的 SASP，且可能有助溝通細胞壓力並招募免疫清除。此關係顯示 p21 同時貢獻停滯與受壓細胞的初始溝通狀態。它比簡單的停滯執行更細微，信度中等。

label: Cyclin D
description: Cyclin D1 belongs to the D-type cyclin family governing G1 CDK4/6 activation.
description_zh_TW: Cyclin D1 屬於掌管 G1 CDK4/6 活化的 D 型 cyclin 家族。

label: TFEB expression
description: METTL3, the catalytic subunit of the m6A methyltransferase complex, methylates TFEB mRNA at N6-methyladenosine residues, a mark that targets the transcript for destabilization and degradation. By reducing TFEB mRNA stability, METTL3 negatively regulates TFEB protein abundance and consequently the autophagy-lysosomal program. This epitranscriptomic control links RNA methylation to degradative pathway output. The finding situates TFEB within the expanding regulatory influence of m6A modification on stress-response genes.
description_zh_TW: METTL3 是 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體的催化次單元，於 N6-甲基腺苷殘基甲基化 TFEB mRNA，此標記將轉錄本標定為不穩定和降解。透過降低 TFEB mRNA 穩定性，METTL3 負向調節 TFEB 蛋白豐度，進而影響自噬—溶酶體程序。此表觀轉錄組控制將 RNA 甲基化連結到降解途徑的輸出。此發現將 TFEB 置於 m6A 修飾對壓力反應基因日益擴大的調節影響中。

label: MMP-3
description: Matrix metalloproteinase-3 (MMP-3) is a SASP protease associated with extracellular matrix degradation, tissue remodeling, and, in tumor contexts, cancer cell invasion and metastasis. Its secretion reflects the matrix-remodeling arm of the secretome that supports wound healing acutely but pathological tissue breakdown chronically, and MMP-3 can activate other MMPs in a cascade, amplifying remodeling. This protease component distinguishes the SASP from a purely cytokine profile and contributes to fibrosis and basement-membrane disruption in aging tissues.
description_zh_TW: 基質金屬蛋白酶-3（MMP-3）是一種與細胞外基質降解、組織重塑以及腫瘤脈絡中癌細胞侵襲和轉移相關的 SASP 蛋白酶。其分泌反映支持急性傷口癒合但慢性病理性組織崩解的基質重塑臂，且 MMP-3 可在級聯中活化其他 MMP，放大重塑。此蛋白酶組成將 SASP 與純細胞激素輪廓區分，並貢獻老化組織中的纖維化與基底膜破壞。

label: Heterochromatin Decompaction
description: SADS (senescence-associated distal satellite) is a form of heterochromatin decompaction in senescent cells, specifically the relaxation of constitutive pericentromeric and pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin. Unlike SAHF (which compacts facultative heterochromatin), SADS decompacts constitutive repeats. This structural change alters the nuclear architecture and chromatin accessibility of repetitive regions. SADS represents a distinct, counterintuitive chromatin reorganization during senescence.
description_zh_TW: SADS（senescence-associated distal satellite，衰老相關遠端衛星）是衰老細胞中異染色質去緻密化的一種形式，具體為組成性著絲粒周與中心體周衛星異染色質的鬆弛。不同於 SAHF（緻密化兼性異染色質），SADS 去緻密化組成性重複序列。此結構改變改變重複區域的核架構與染色質可及性。SADS 代表衰老期間一種獨特、違反直覺的染色質重組。

label: HIRA/ASF1a
description: SAHF are assembled by the HIRA-ASF1a histone chaperone complex, which deposits macroH2A and core histones to establish H3K9me3-marked heterochromatin at the foci. This chaperone-driven deposition is required for the formation of the DAPI-dense nuclear bodies that characterize senescent cells, and it is coordinated with hypophosphorylated Rb. The process links histone dynamics directly to senescence-specific chromatin reorganization. HIRA/ASF1a thus provide the assembly machinery for the repressive structures that lock in the arrested state.
description_zh_TW: SAHF 由 HIRA-ASF1a 組蛋白伴護蛋白複合體組裝，該複合體沉積 macroH2A 與核心組蛋白以在焦點建立 H3K9me3 標記的異染色質。此伴護蛋白驅動的沉積對形成定義衰老細胞的 DAPI 緻密核體為必要，且與低磷酸化 Rb 協調。此過程將組蛋白動態直接連結到衰老特異性染色質重組。HIRA/ASF1a 因此提供將停滯狀態鎖入的抑制性結構的組裝機器。

label: METTL3/METTL14
description: The METTL3-METTL14 m6A methyltransferase complex promotes SASP factor expression by installing N6-methyladenosine marks on mRNA that facilitate enhancer-promoter looping and stabilize SASP transcripts. This epitranscriptomic layer adds post-transcriptional control to the secretome, coordinating the sustained expression of multiple SASP genes. The relationship is mechanistically plausible and supported by knockout studies showing reduced SASP, but the field is newer and less consolidated than the NF-kB/mTOR axes, so confidence is moderate.
description_zh_TW: METTL3-METTL14 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體透過在 mRNA 上安裝 N6-甲基腺苷標記，促進 SASP 因子表現，該標記促進增強子—啟動子環化並穩定 SASP 轉錄本。此表觀轉錄層次為分泌組添加轉錄後控制，協調多種 SASP 基因的持續表現。此關係在機制上合理且獲剔除研究（顯示 SASP 降低）支持，但此領域較新、較不如 NF-κB/mTOR 軸整合，故信度中等。

label: Secretory Phenotype
description: The SASP is a hypersecretory state -- a specialized secretory phenotype -- in which senescent cells upregulate and release hundreds of factors including interleukins, chemokines, growth factors, proteases, and extracellular vesicles. This secreted output contrasts with the quiescent, low-turnover secretome of non-senescent cells and is a defining non-cell-autonomous feature of the senescent state. The composition of the SASP is variable, shaped by the senescence inducer, cell type, and tissue context. Its classification as a secretory phenotype emphasizes that senescence exerts its effects largely through communication with the microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: SASP 是一種高分泌狀態——一種特化的分泌表型——衰老細胞在此狀態下上調並釋放數百種因子，包括介白素、趨化因子、生長因子、蛋白酶與細胞外囊泡。此分泌輸出與非衰老細胞靜止、低更新的分泌組形成對比，是衰老狀態定義性的非細胞自主性特徵。SASP 的組成是可變的，受衰老誘發因子、細胞類型與組織脈絡塑造。將其歸類為分泌表型，強調衰老主要透過與微環境的溝通發揮作用。

label: N6-methyladenosine
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: METTL3 is the catalytic subunit of the methyltransferase complex that deposits N6-methyladenosine (m6A), the most abundant internal modification of messenger RNA in mammalian cells. Together with the adaptor protein METTL14, METTL3 methylates the N6 position of adenosine in mRNA, and the resulting m6A mark regulates RNA stability, splicing, translation, and export. Beyond its RNA-methylation role, the METTL3-METTL14 complex also facilitates senescence-associated enhancer-promoter contacts and SASP expression in oncogene-induced senescence.
description_zh_TW: METTL3 是甲基轉移酶複合物的催化亞基，可沉積 N6-methyladenosine (m6A)，N6-methyladenosine (m6A) 是哺乳動物細胞中最豐富的信使 RNA 內部修飾。 METTL3 與接頭蛋白 METTL14 一起甲基化 mRNA 中腺苷的 N6 位點，產生的 m6A 標記可調節 RNA 穩定性、剪接、翻譯和輸出。除了其 RNA 甲基化作用外，METTL3-METTL14 複合物還促進衰老相關的增強子-啟動子接觸以及癌基因誘導衰老中的 SASP 表達。

label: Acetate
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Acetate is converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2 and is not membrane-permeable acetyl-CoA itself. Acetate supplementation increases global nuclear acetylation including H3K27ac and induces expression of pro-inflammatory genes including IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators p16 and p21. In mitochondria-depleted senescent cells, acetate increases histone acetylation and partially restores a subset of the mitochondrial-dependent SASP programme. However, acetate-induced SASP gene expression is suppressed by the STING inhibitor SN011, showing that chromatin accessibility alone cannot drive SASP transcription without innate immune activation.
description_zh_TW: 乙酸（acetate）在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA），其本身並非可通透細胞膜的乙醯輔酶A。補充乙酸可增加整體細胞核乙醯化（包括 H3K27ac），並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因的表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子 p16 與 p21。在缺乏粒線體的衰老細胞中，乙酸可增加組蛋白乙醯化，並部分恢復依賴粒線體的 SASP 程序中的一部分。然而，乙酸誘導的 SASP 基因表現會被 STING 抑制劑 SN011 所壓制，顯示若無先天免疫活化，僅靠染色質可及性無法驅動 SASP 轉錄。

label: Anti-CD38 mAbs
description: Anti-CD38 monoclonal antibodies eliminate CD38+ Tregs and MDSCs and reduce adenosine-mediated immunosuppression, restoring T- and NK-cell function in the tumor microenvironment. Directionally, anti-CD38 therapy sits upstream of tumor-microenvironment reprogramming. This is both an anticancer action and a means to spare NAD+ for sirtuins, and it illustrates the dual therapeutic logic of CD38 targeting. By depleting immunosuppressive cells and reducing adenosine, these antibodies restore effector immune responses. The resulting reshaping of the tumor microenvironment contributes to the efficacy of anti-CD38 antibodies in multiple myeloma and other cancers.
description_zh_TW: 抗 CD38 單克隆抗體消除 CD38+ 調節性 T 細胞和 MDSC，並減少腺苷介導的免疫抑制，恢復腫瘤微環境中 T 細胞和 NK 細胞的功能。在方向性上，抗 CD38 治療位於腫瘤微環境重編程的上游。這既是抗癌作用也是為 sirtuin 節省 NAD+ 的手段，說明了 CD38 靶向的雙重治療邏輯。透過清除免疫抑制細胞和減少腺苷，這些抗體恢復效應免疫反應。由此產生的腫瘤微環境重塑有助於抗 CD38 抗體在多發性骨髓瘤和其他癌症中的療效。

label: HGF
description: The SASP is composed of hepatocyte growth factor (HGF), which is secreted by senescent fibroblasts. HGF inhibits cell competition-mediated cancer suppression mechanisms, thereby promoting cancer cell proliferation. This makes HGF a pro-tumorigenic component of the SASP.
description_zh_TW: SASP 由 hepatocyte growth factor（HGF）組成，它由衰老纖維母細胞分泌。HGF 抑制細胞競爭介導的癌症抑制機制，從而促進癌細胞增殖。這使 HGF 成為 SASP 的促腫瘤組成之一。

label: MMP-9
description: The SASP is composed of matrix metalloproteinases, including MMP-1, MMP-3, MMP-9, and MMP-12, which are associated with detrimental effects on senescent dermal fibroblasts during tissue damage. These proteases contribute to skin ageing and cooperatively facilitate cancer cell metastasis. MMP-9 in particular degrades type IV collagen in basement membranes.
description_zh_TW: SASP 由 matrix metalloproteinases 組成，包括 MMP-1、MMP-3、MMP-9 與 MMP-12，它們在組織損傷期間與衰老皮膚纖維母細胞的有害效應相關。這些蛋白酶促成皮膚老化，並協同促進癌細胞轉移。尤其是 MMP-9 會降解基底膜中的 type IV collagen。

label: CXCL10
description: The SASP is composed of the chemokine CXCL10, which is secreted by ROS-induced senescent hepatocytes. CXCL10 enhances natural killer cell activity by binding to CXCR3. This positions CXCL10 as a SASP factor that links cellular senescence to innate immune surveillance.
description_zh_TW: SASP 由趨化因子 CXCL10 組成，它由 ROS 誘導的衰老肝細胞分泌。CXCL10 透過與 CXCR3 結合增強自然殺手細胞活性。這使 CXCL10 成為將 cellular senescence 與先天免疫監視連結起來的 SASP 因子。

label: CD206
description: CD206 (mannose receptor MRC1) is a canonical surface marker of alternatively activated (M2) macrophages. Its expression is induced by IL-4 and IL-13 and suppressed by inflammatory stimuli, making CD206 a defining M2 polarization marker.
description_zh_TW: CD206（甘露糖受體 MRC1）是交替活化（M2）巨噬細胞的典型表面標記。其表現由 IL-4 與 IL-13 誘導，並受發炎刺激抑制，使 CD206 成為 M2 極化的定義性標記。

label: CD9
description: CD9 is a tetraspanin surface marker used to define senescent and immune cell populations. It helps identify senescent cells and is discussed as a surface marker for ligand-conjugated nanoparticle delivery targeting senescent cells within the SASP context.
description_zh_TW: CD9 是 tetraspanin 表面標記，用於定義衰老與免疫細胞族群。它有助於辨識衰老細胞，並被討論作為在 SASP 脈絡下針對衰老細胞之配體共軛奈米顆粒遞送的表面標記。

label: Tumor Antigen
description: Tumor antigens are the molecular signatures by which the immune system distinguishes malignant cells, presented on MHC to cytotoxic T cells. Loss or down-regulation of antigen/MHC is a key route to immune evasion.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤抗原是免疫系統用以區分惡性細胞的分子特徵，在 MHC 上呈遞給細胞毒性 T 細胞。抗原/MHC 的喪失或下調是免疫逃逸的關鍵途徑。

label: CXCL12
description: CXCL12 is the most highly upregulated SASP factor in senescent endothelial cells with vascular aging, causally driving endothelial dysfunction via nitric-oxide suppression and ROS. The senolytic fisetin normalizes CXCL12 to rescue vascular function.
description_zh_TW: CXCL12 是血管老化中衰老內皮細胞上調幅度最高的 SASP 因子，透過抑制 nitric oxide 與促進 ROS 因果性驅動內皮功能障礙。Senolytic fisetin 使 CXCL12 正常化以挽救血管功能。

label: VDAC1
description: VDAC1 oligomerization mediates mtDNA release upstream of cGAS-STING and SASP induction (Li 2024). This positions the outer-membrane channel as a SASP-licensing pore.
description_zh_TW: VDAC1 寡聚化在 cGAS-STING 與 SASP 誘發上游介導 mtDNA 釋放（Li 2024）。此將外膜通道定位為 SASP 許可孔。

label: mtDNA ribonucleotide misincorporation
description: Senescent cells show an elevated rNTP/dNTP ratio with continued mtDNA replication, causing ribonucleotide misincorporation into mtDNA that promotes its cytosolic release and SASP; exogenous deoxyribonucleoside supplementation lowers this release and suppresses inflammatory SASP without affecting SA-beta-gal arrest.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞呈現升高的 rNTP/dNTP 比值且 mtDNA 持續複製，導致核糖核苷酸錯誤摻入 mtDNA，促進其胞質釋放與 SASP；補充外源去氧核糖核苷可降低釋放並抑制發炎性 SASP，且不影響 SA-beta-gal 停滯。

label: RIG-I
source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md
description: RIG-I senses cytosolic RNA and promotes the senescence-associated inflammatory programme. Its RNA ligands include retroelement-derived transcripts, which are de-repressed during senescence and deep senescence, and mitochondrial double-stranded RNA released when mitochondrial dynamics or quality control are impaired. RIG-I signals through MAVS to TBK1 and IRF3 as well as NF-kB, so its output overlaps the type I interferon and inflammatory arms of the SASP. In the SASP-induction scheme RIG-I occupies the RNA-sensing position, parallel to DNA sensing by cGAS.
description_zh_TW: RIG-I 感測胞質 RNA 並促進衰老相關發炎程序。其 RNA 配體包括在衰老與深度衰老中解除抑制的反轉錄元件來源轉錄本，以及粒線體動態或品質管制受損時釋出的粒線體雙股 RNA。RIG-I 經 MAVS 傳訊至 TBK1、IRF3 以及 NF-kB，因此其輸出與 SASP 的第一型干擾素臂及發炎臂重疊。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，RIG-I 佔據 RNA 感測位置，與 cGAS 的 DNA 感測平行。

label: Complex I and Complex IV
description: Complex I and Complex IV have reduced activity in multiple sclerosis, and the resulting electron leakage increases superoxide generation in affected CNS tissue. This bioenergetic defect is observed in lesions and normal-appearing white matter. The directionality is enzyme deficiency to increased mitochondrial ROS. A caveat is that reduced activity may be secondary to inflammation and demyelination as well as a primary driver, so causality is bidirectional. These defects are most pronounced in chronically demyelinated tissue and correlate with axonal loss and disability progression.
description_zh_TW: Complex I and Complex IV 降低了 multiple sclerosis 的活性，由此产生的电子泄漏增加了受影响中枢神经系统组织中超氧化物的生成。这种生物能缺陷在病变和正常的白质中观察到。方向性是酵素缺乏導致mitochondrial ROS增加。需要注意的是，活动减少可能是炎症和脱髓鞘的继发因素，也是主要驱动因素，因此因果关系是双向的。这些缺陷在慢性脱髓鞘组织中最为明显，并与轴突损失和残疾进展相关。

label: Topoisomerase II
description: Mitoxantrone inhibits topoisomerase II as its primary target, mirroring the FL118-Topo-I pattern. Target defines the drug.
description_zh_TW: Mitoxantrone 以拓樸異構酶 II 為主要標靶，呼應 FL118-Topo-I 模式。標靶定義藥物。

label: DLK1-DIO3 locus
description: In humans, miR-543 maps to the imprinted DLK1-DIO3 locus on chromosome 14q32, one of the largest mammalian miRNA megaclusters. Its expression is controlled by parent-of-origin DNA methylation, making it both an effector and a sensor of the epigenome.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，miR-543 定位於染色體 14q32 的基因銘印 DLK1-DIO3 基因座，這是哺乳動物最大的 miRNA 巨簇之一。其表現受親源 DNA 甲基化控制，使其既是表觀基因組的效應器也是感測器。

label: Mitochondrial Metabolism
description: miR-378 modulates mitochondrial energy metabolism through targets including ERRgamma (ESRRG), GABPA, and CRAT/MED13. It counterbalances PGC-1beta activity and is co-transcribed with its host gene PPARGC1B, tying its expression to mitochondrial biogenesis programs.
description_zh_TW: miR-378 透過包括 ERRgamma（ESRRG）、GABPA 和 CRAT/MED13 在內的靶標調節粒線體能量代謝。它平衡 PGC-1beta 的活性，並與宿主基因 PPARGC1B 共同轉錄，將其表現與粒線體生合成程式連結起來。

label: PGC-1beta
description: miR-378a is encoded within the first intron of the PPARGC1B gene (PGC-1beta) on chromosome 5q32. Because it sits inside the metabolic master regulator locus, its dysregulation couples mitochondrial metabolic decline with the SIRT1-NF-kB inflammatory axis.
description_zh_TW: miR-378a 編碼在染色體 5q32 的 PPARGC1B 基因（PGC-1beta）第一個內含子中。由於它位於代謝主調控基因座內，其失調將粒線體代謝衰退與 SIRT1-NF-kB 發炎軸耦合起來。

label: Exportin-5
description: Exportin-5 is a RanGTP-dependent nuclear export receptor that transports precursor microRNA (pre-miRNA) hairpins from the nucleus to the cytoplasm. There the pre-miRNA is matured by Dicer and loaded onto Argonaute in the RISC.
description_zh_TW: Exportin-5 是 RanGTP 依賴的核輸出受體，將 microRNA 前驅物（pre-miRNA）髮夾從細胞核運送至細胞質。在那裡 pre-miRNA 由 Dicer 成熟並裝載到 RISC 中的 Argonaute。

label: Ribonuclease III
description: Ribonuclease III (RNase III) is a family of enzymes that specifically cleave double-stranded RNA, including Drosha and Dicer that initiate and mature microRNA biogenesis. These RNase III enzymes process microRNA precursors into functional guides.
description_zh_TW: 核糖核酸酶 III（RNase III）是特異性剪切雙股 RNA 的酶家族，包括起始與成熟 microRNA 生合成的 Drosha 與 Dicer。這些 RNase III 酶將 microRNA 前驅物加工為功能性引導。

label: RISC
description: The RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC) is the effector machinery of small-RNA silencing, centered on an Argonaute protein loaded with a guide microRNA or siRNA. RISC directs sequence-specific translational repression or cleavage of target mRNAs.
description_zh_TW: RNA 誘導靜默複合體（RISC）是小 RNA 靜默的效應機制，以裝載引導 microRNA 或 siRNA 的 Argonaute 蛋白為中心。RISC 對目標 mRNA 進行序列特異的轉譯抑制或剪切。

label: Double-stranded RNA-binding domain
description: The double-stranded RNA-binding domain (dsRBD) binds double-stranded RNA in a structure-specific manner and positions RNA substrates for processing enzymes. DGCR8 and Dicer use tandem dsRBDs to recognize and process microRNA precursors.
description_zh_TW: 雙股 RNA 結合結構域（dsRBD）以結構特異方式結合雙股 RNA，並將 RNA 受質定位給加工酶。DGCR8 與 Dicer 利用串聯 dsRBD 來辨識與加工 microRNA 前驅物。

label: RCM (Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers)
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: RCM likely evolved as a beneficial short-term response: relocalizing modifiers to damage sites helps cells survive acute threats by prioritizing repair and survival over normal gene regulation. In youth this is advantageous, but over a lifetime the cumulative failure to reset becomes detrimental, contributing to aging. This trade-off, where a trait that benefits early survival becomes harmful later in life, is the classic signature of antagonistic pleiotropy.
description_zh_TW: RCM 可能作為有益的短期反應演化而來：將修飾因子再定位到損傷位點有助於細胞透過優先進行修復和存活來應對急性威脅，而非維持正常的基因調控。在年輕時這是有利的，但在一生中累積的重置失敗會變得有害，從而促成衰老。這種在早期生存有益但在晚年有害的權衡特徵，正是拮抗多效性的經典標誌。

label: aging results from progressive loss of epigenetic information
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: The Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis is a key framework in aging biology, primarily developed by David Sinclair and colleagues. It proposes that aging in eukaryotes results largely from the progressive loss of epigenetic information due to the repeated relocalization of chromatin-modifying proteins during DNA repair. Chromatin modifiers normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain gene expression patterns that define cell identity, but are recruited to damage sites during repair, temporarily disrupting their original positions and altering local gene expression.
description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子再定位（RCM）假說是衰老生物學中的關鍵框架，主要由 David Sinclair 及其同事發展。該假說提出，真核生物的衰老主要源於表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失，這是因為在 DNA 修復過程中染色質修飾蛋白質反覆再定位所致。染色質修飾因子通常定位於特定的基因組位點，以維持定義細胞身分的基因表達模式，但在修復期間被招募到損傷位點，暫時破壞其原始位置並改變局部基因表達。

label: Chromatin Modifiers
description: Chromatin modifiers are the central class of proteins in the Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis. They are recruited away from their native loci to DNA repair sites, and repeated relocalization with imperfect resetting erodes the epigenetic landscape and drives aging.
description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子是染色質修飾因子易位（RCM）假說中的核心蛋白類別。它們被招募離開原生基因座至 DNA 修復位點，反覆易位與不完美的重置會侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀並驅動衰老。

label: Epigenetic Landscape
description: The epigenetic landscape denotes the ensemble of chromatin states that establish cellular identity. In the RCM Hypothesis, repeated recruitment of chromatin modifiers to DNA repair sites causes gradual erosion of this landscape, leading to loss of cellular identity and aging phenotypes.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳景觀指建立細胞身分的染色質狀態總和。在 RCM 假說中，染色質修飾因子被反覆招募至 DNA 修復位點會造成此景觀的逐漸侵蝕，導致細胞身分喪失與衰老表現型。

label: Alu element transcripts
description: Alu elements are short interspersed nuclear elements that, when derepressed, produce transcripts that contribute to genomic instability. In aging and stressed cells, loss of epigenetic silencing permits Alu transcription, and the resulting double-stranded RNA and retrotransposition intermediates challenge genome integrity by promoting insertions and activating innate immune DNA and RNA sensing pathways. Aberrant Alu activity is therefore both a consequence and a driver of the accumulating genomic instability recognized as a hallmark of aging.
description_zh_TW: Alu 元件是短散佈的核元件，當去抑制時，會產生導致基因組不穩定的轉錄物。在老化和壓力的細胞中，表觀遺傳沉默的喪失允許 Alu 轉錄，由此產生的雙股 RNA 和逆轉錄轉座中間體透過促進插入和激活先天免疫 DNA 和 RNA 感測途徑來挑戰基因組完整性。因此，異常的 Alu 活性既是基因組不穩定性累積的結果，也是其驅動因素，而基因組不穩定性被認為是老化的標誌。

label: CHK1
description: Replication-stress-generated single-stranded DNA engages ATR, which phosphorylates and activates CHK1 to enforce the S-phase checkpoint. In oncogene-induced senescence this cascade stabilizes p53 and locks hyper-replicative cells into arrest.
description_zh_TW: 複製壓力產生的單股 DNA 接合 ATR，後者磷酸化並活化 CHK1 以執行 S 期檢查點。在致癌基因誘發衰老中，此級聯穩定 p53 並將過度複製的細胞鎖入停滯。

label: Tetraploidy
description: Fusion-generated tetraploid genomes trigger arrest as CFIS. Whole-genome doubling is the causal insult.
description_zh_TW: 融合產生的四倍體基因組觸發停滯成為 CFIS。全基因組加倍是因果傷害。

label: Nucleoside
description: Thymidine is a pyrimidine nucleoside and dTTP precursor. Basic chemical classification.
description_zh_TW: Thymidine 是嘧啶核苷與 dTTP 前驅物。基本化學歸類。

label: dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT
description: Oleacein is a dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT: its phenolic structure is O-methylated by COMT as a substrate while simultaneously competing for the active site and for SAMe as an inhibitor, reducing clearance of other catechols. This bifunctional interaction means oleacein both feeds and partially blocks the COMT pathway, with the net effect depending on dose and on the individual's COMT genotype. It is a notable example of dietary polyphenols modulating catechol metabolism. Its olive oil source links diet to COMT-related biochemistry.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是 dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT：其酚類結構被 COMT 作為底物 O-甲基化，同時競爭活性位點和 SAMe 作為抑制劑，減少其他兒茶酚的清除。這種雙功能交互作用意味著油酸素既供給又部分阻斷 COMT 途徑，淨效應取決於劑量和個體的 COMT genotype。這是膳食多酚調節兒茶酚代謝的一個顯著例子。其橄欖油來源將飲食與 COMT 相關的生物化學聯繫起來。

label: extra virgin olive oil
description: Oleacein is a phenolic secoiridoid compound found in extra virgin olive oil, where it contributes to the oil's characteristic bitterness and health-promoting profile. As a dietary polyphenol it is metabolized in part by COMT, linking olive oil consumption to COMT-dependent polyphenol disposition. It exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that underlie part of the Mediterranean diet's cardiovascular benefits. Its presence makes olive oil a significant dietary source of COMT-interacting phenolics.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是一種在 extra virgin olive oil 中發現的酚類環烯醚萜化合物，它賦予了油特有的苦味和促進健康的特性。作為一種膳食多酚，它部分由 COMT 代謝，將橄欖油消耗與 COMT 依賴性多酚處置聯繫起來。它所含的抗氧化劑和 anti-inflammatory properties 是地中海飲食對心血管的部分益處的基礎。它的存在使得橄欖油成為 COMT 相互作用酚類物質的重要飲食來源。

label: glycoside of quercetin
description: Rutin is a glycoside of quercetin, formed by rutinose, a disaccharide, attached to the quercetin aglycone, which modifies its solubility, absorption, and bioavailability in the gut. After deglycosylation, the quercetin backbone, a catechol flavonoid, is metabolized partly by COMT, linking rutin intake to COMT-dependent disposition. This structural relationship explains rutin's COMT-interacting potential once converted to quercetin. Found in buckwheat, apples, and citrus, it is a common dietary flavonoid glycoside.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 是 glycoside of quercetin，由芸香糖（一种二糖）形成，附着在槲皮素苷元上，改变其在肠道中的溶解度、吸收和生物利用度。去糖基化后，槲皮素骨架（catechol flavonoid）部分被 COMT 代谢，将芦丁摄入与 COMT 依赖性处置联系起来。這種結構關係解釋了蘆丁在轉化為槲皮素後具有 COMT 相互作用潛力。它存在於蕎麥、蘋果和柑橘中，是一種常見的膳食黃酮苷。

label: quercetin-3-rutinoside
description: Rutin is chemically quercetin-3-O-rutinoside, a glycosylated flavonol found in buckwheat, citrus peel, apples, and onions. It is used to support vascular integrity and is valued for antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its quercetin aglycone bears the catechol moiety that engages COMT.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 化學上為 quercetin-3-O-rutinoside，是一種糖基化黃酮醇，存在於蕎麥、柑橘皮、蘋果和洋蔥中。它用於支持血管完整性，並因其抗氧化和抗發炎特性而受重視。其槲皮素苷元帶有接合 COMT 的兒茶酚部分。

label: SAMe when methylated
description: Rutin, via its quercetin aglycone, is O-methylated by COMT, a reaction that consumes SAMe and methyl groups. At high supplemental doses it can competitively inhibit COMT, slowing methylation of endogenous catechols. This places rutin in the same COMT-modulating class as luteolin and oleacein.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 透過其槲皮素苷元被 COMT O-甲基化，此反應消耗 SAMe 和 methyl groups。在高補充劑量下，它可競爭性抑制 COMT，減緩內源性兒茶酚的甲基化。這使 rutin 與 luteolin 和 oleacein 屬於同一 COMT 調節類別。

label: Chronic venous insufficiency
description: Hesperidin, often with diosmin, is used in venous disorders for its venotonic and capillary-resistance effects, historically applied to chronic venous insufficiency. Endothelial and microcirculation benefits support this indication.
description_zh_TW: Hesperidin 常與 diosmin 合併用於靜脈疾病，憑其靜脈張力與微血管阻力效應，歷史上應用於慢性靜脈功能不全。內皮與微循環益處支持此適應症。

label: Cyclophilin A
description: Cyclophilin A is proposed to form an AIF-cyclophilin A-histone H2AX complex in which AIF provides nuclease activity for large-scale DNA fragmentation, an alternative to the MIF/PAAN nuclease model of AIF-dependent parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: Cyclophilin A 被提出與 AIF 及組蛋白 H2AX 形成複合體，其中由 AIF 提供核酸酶活性以進行大規模 DNA 斷裂，為 AIF 依賴性 parthanatos 中 MIF/PAAN 核酸酶模型之外的替代機制（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Mitochondrial Fission Sites
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: DRP1 is recruited from the cytosol to defined sites on the mitochondrial outer membrane, where division occurs. Its adaptor proteins, including MFF, FIS1, MID49, and MID51, serve as receptors that concentrate DRP1 at prospective fission sites, often at positions where mitochondria are already constricted or associated with the endoplasmic reticulum. In cultured cells, MFF recruits DRP1 to the majority of fission events, while MID49 and MID51 recruit DRP1 to mitochondria independently of MFF in certain conditions. Once concentrated, DRP1 oligomerizes into spirals that wrap around the tubule, and GTP hydrolysis drives the membrane constriction required for complete scission.
description_zh_TW: DRP1 從細胞質被招募至粒線體外膜上的特定位置，分裂即在此發生。其接合蛋白（包括 MFF、FIS1、MID49 與 MID51）作為受體，將 DRP1 集中於預定的分裂位點，這些位點通常位於粒線體已收縮或與內質網相關的位置。在培養細胞中，MFF 將 DRP1 招募至大多數的分裂事件，而在某些條件下，MID49 與 MID51 則獨立於 MFF 將 DRP1 招募至粒線體。一旦集中，DRP1 便寡聚化為環繞管狀結構的螺旋，而 GTP 水解驅動完成完全分裂所需的膜收縮。

label: FIS1
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: FIS1 is a tail-anchored outer mitochondrial membrane protein that functions as a receptor for DRP1, helping to recruit the fission machinery to mitochondria. In yeast, the FIS1 ortholog Fis1p is the main membrane anchor for the Dnm1p fission GTPase, whereas in mammalian cells FIS1 plays a more accessory role alongside MFF, MID49, and MID51, and may also mediate non-DRP1 functions such as recruiting proteasomal and autophagic machinery to mitochondria. Overexpression of FIS1 fragments mitochondria, whereas FIS1 knockdown produces elongated networks, confirming its pro-fission role, although its relative importance varies between cell types and conditions.
description_zh_TW: FIS1是一種錨定於粒線體外膜的蛋白質（tail-anchored protein），作為DRP1的受體，協助將分裂機製招募至粒線體。在酵母菌中，FIS1的直系同源物Fis1p是分裂GTP酶Dnm1p的主要膜錨點；而在哺乳類細胞中，FIS1則與MFF、MID49及MID51一同扮演較輔助性的角色，也可能中介非DRP1的功能，例如將蛋白酶體與自噬機製招募至粒線體。FIS1過度表現會使粒線體碎裂，而FIS1基因敲低則產生延長狀的網絡，證實其促分裂作用，儘管其相對重要性會因細胞類型與條件而異。

label: LRRK2
description: LRRK2 directly phosphorylates DRP1 to drive excess mitochondrial fission; since impaired mitophagy (PINK1/Parkin) is a PD mechanism, LRRK2-driven fission couples mitochondrial dynamics to Parkinson's pathology.
description_zh_TW: LRRK2 直接磷酸化 DRP1 以驅動過度的粒線體分裂；由於受損的 mitophagy（PINK1/Parkin）是帕金森氏症機制，LRRK2 驅動的分裂把粒線體動態學與帕金森氏症病理耦合。

label: Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
description: Pulmonary arterial hypertension involves excessive mitochondrial fission mediated by DRP1, contributing to pulmonary artery smooth muscle cell proliferation and vascular remodeling. DRP1-mediated fission has been implicated in PAH pathogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 肺動脈高壓涉及由 DRP1 介導的過度粒線體分裂，促成肺動脈平滑肌細胞增殖與血管重塑。DRP1 介導的分裂被認為與 PAH 致病機轉有關。

label: OPA1-mediated Fusion
description: Cardiolipin is required for OPA1-mediated inner-membrane fusion in liposome reconstitutions, dual to its pro-fission DRP1 stimulation. One lipid gates both fusion and fission.
description_zh_TW: Cardiolipin 在脂質體重構中為 OPA1 介導的內膜融合所必需，與其促分裂的 DRP1 刺激成雙。一種脂質門控融合與分裂兩者。

label: Mdivi-1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mdivi-1 is a putative DRP1 fission inhibitor with caveats: off-target L-OPA1 cleavage and OXPHOS effects plus translational failure in pig MI models. The triple carries the file's own caution.
description_zh_TW: Mdivi-1 是推定的 DRP1 分裂抑制劑但附帶注意：脫靶 L-OPA1 切割與 OXPHOS 效應，加上豬 MI 模型轉譯失敗。此 triple 承載檔案自身的警語。

label: IGFBP3
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: A second group cloned humanin using a yeast two-hybrid screen as a partner of IGFBP3, and demonstrated that humanin binds to IGFBP3 with high affinity and specificity. IGFBP3 regulates IGF bioactivity and also induces apoptosis and inhibits cell growth independently of IGFs, and humanin protects against IGFBP3-induced apoptosis. Humanin does not interfere with IGF-I/IGFBP-3 binding but appears to bind to the heparin-binding domain of IGFBP-3, and a single amino acid substitution of alanine for phenylalanine at position 6 (F6AHN) abrogates IGFBP-3 binding.
description_zh_TW: 第二個團隊以酵母雙雜交篩選將 humanin 選殖為 IGFBP3 的結合夥伴，並證明 humanin 以高親和力與特異性結合 IGFBP3。IGFBP3 調節 IGF 的生物活性，也獨立於 IGF 誘導凋亡並抑制細胞生長；而 humanin 可保護細胞免受 IGFBP3 誘導的凋亡。Humanin 不干擾 IGF-I/IGFBP-3 的結合，但似乎結合 IGFBP-3 的肝素結合域；第 6 位置苯丙胺酸取代為丙胺酸的單一胺基酸置換（F6AHN）會消除 IGFBP-3 的結合。

label: FPRL1
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: FPRL1, a seven-transmembrane G-protein-coupled receptor, was the first humanin receptor to be described. Humanin acts as an agonist for FPRL1 by inducing Ca2+ mobilization and rapid activation of ERK1/2 signaling, a commonly induced downstream pathway of G-protein-coupled receptors. In neuroblasts, both the 42-aa form of beta-amyloid peptide and humanin activate FPRL1, but only Abeta42 is cytotoxic, and this cytotoxicity is reversed by humanin, suggesting that the neuroprotective effects of humanin might be accomplished by competitively binding to FPRL1, which may contribute to its cytoprotective aspects.
description_zh_TW: FPRL1 是七次跨膜 G 蛋白偶聯受體，為第一個被描述的 humanin 受體。Humanin 作為 FPRL1 的促效劑，誘導 Ca2+ 動員及 ERK1/2 訊號的快速活化，此為 G 蛋白偶聯受體常見誘發的下游路徑。在神經母細胞中，42 個胺基酸形式的 β-類澱粉胜肽與 humanin 都會活化 FPRL1，但只有 Aβ42 具細胞毒性，且此毒性可被 humanin 逆轉，顯示 humanin 的神經保護作用可能是透過競爭性結合 FPRL1 達成，這可能構成其細胞保護特性的一部分。

label: Pancreatic Beta Cells
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Humanin improves glucose tolerance and delays the onset of diabetes in NOD mice, a model of type 1 diabetes involving progressive accumulation of lymphocytes within the pancreatic islets of Langerhans. In NOD mouse pancreata, humanin treatment dramatically suppressed inflammation and lymphocyte infiltration. Furthermore, humanin decreases serum starvation- and cytokine-induced apoptosis in the pancreatic beta-cell line NIT-1, protecting against the IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and IFN-gamma released by T cells and activated macrophages, in an ERK- and STAT3-dependent manner, suggesting it may be a therapeutic target for type 1 diabetes.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 改善 NOD 小鼠的葡萄糖耐受性並延遲糖尿病的發生；NOD 小鼠是第 1 型糖尿病模型，其特徵為淋巴球在胰臟蘭氏小島內逐漸累積。在 NOD 小鼠胰臟中，humanin 治療顯著抑制發炎與淋巴球浸潤。此外，humanin 降低胰臟 beta 細胞株 NIT-1 中血清剝奪與細胞激素誘導的細胞凋亡，以 ERK 與 STAT3 依賴的方式保護細胞免受 T 細胞與活化巨噬細胞釋放的 IL-1beta、TNF-alpha 與 IFN-gamma 傷害，顯示它可能是第 1 型糖尿病的治療標靶。

label: MOTS-c
description: MOTS-c is a 16 amino acid peptide encoded by the mitochondrial 12S rRNA gene, and is one of eight mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs) described to date along with humanin and small humanin-like peptides 1-6 (SHLPs 1-6). It is an exercise-induced factor that increases insulin sensitivity and visceral fat accumulation, with circulating levels rising acutely with exercise. The peptide has also been observed to translocate to the nucleus during energetic stress, suggesting both cell-autonomous and non-cell-autonomous functions.
description_zh_TW: MOTS-c是由粒線體12S rRNA基因編碼的16胺基酸肽，是迄今描述的八種粒線體衍生肽（MDPs）之一，與humanin和小型humanin類似肽1-6（SHLPs 1-6）並列。它是一種運動誘導因子，可增加胰島素敏感性和內臟脂肪堆積，其循環水平在運動後急性升高。該肽還被觀察到在能量應激時易位至細胞核，提示其具有細胞自主和非細胞自主功能。

label: Cells
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: The humanin peptide sequence has been proposed to contain a pseudo-signal peptide, and when transfected into neuronal cells humanin is detected in the culture medium, indicating a secretory capacity that is blocked by inhibition of ER-golgi transport processes. Humanin is secreted from cells and found in circulation (plasma) as well as bound to cellular membranes, and its actions are thought to be mediated by specific receptors. This endocrine mode of action distinguishes humanin from other stress-induced mitochondrial retrograde signals, which are cell-autonomous, and supports its role as a non-autonomous signaling factor.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 胜肽序列被提出含有一個偽訊息胜肽，當轉染進入神經元細胞後，humanin 可在培養基中偵測到，顯示其具有分泌能力，而此能力會被 ER-高基氏體運輸過程的抑制所阻斷。Humanin 從細胞分泌並存在於循環（血漿）中，也結合於細胞膜上，其作用被認為是由特定受體所媒介。這種內分泌作用模式使 humanin 有別於其他由壓力誘導、細胞自主性的粒線體逆向訊號，並支持其作為非自主性訊號因子的角色。

label: MAP2
description: MAP2 (microtubule-associated protein 2) is a high-molecular-weight protein abundant in neuronal dendrites that binds and stabilizes microtubules. MAP2 immunostaining is widely used as a dendritic marker to assess neuronal integrity and preservation.
description_zh_TW: MAP2（微管相關蛋白 2）是豐富存在於神經元樹突的高分子量蛋白，結合並穩定微管。MAP2 免疫染色被廣泛用作樹突標記，以評估神經元完整性與保存。

label: Synaptophysin
description: Neurons are the principal signaling cells of the nervous system, and synaptophysin is a synaptic-vesicle protein used as an immunohistochemical marker of synapses and neuronal connectivity. Synaptophysin marks presynaptic terminals within neurons.
description_zh_TW: 神經元是神經系統的主要訊號細胞，而 synaptophysin 是突觸囊泡蛋白，用作突觸與神經元連接性的免疫組織化學標記。Synaptophysin 標記神經元內的突觸前末端。

label: TLR9-STING-Autophagy Pathway
description: Cytosolic mtDNA engages TLR9/MyD88 and STING stress responses that intersect with autophagy and inhibit mTOR, favoring an autophagy-high, OXPHOS/FAO-biased tolerant state.
