Clinically, elevated circulating mtDNA after myocardial infarction or stroke associates with monocyte endotoxin tolerance and post-injury infection risk. It frames mitochondrial DAMPs as tolerogenic rather than classic trainers.
description_zh_TW: 胞質 Mitochondrial DNA 接合 TLR9/MyD88 與 STING stress responses，與 autophagy 交會並抑制 mTOR，偏向 autophagy-high、OXPHOS/FAO 為主的 tolerant state。臨床上，心肌梗塞或中風後循環中升高的 Mitochondrial DNA 與單核球 endotoxin tolerance 及傷後感染風險相關。這將 mitochondrial DAMPs 定位為 tolerogenic 而非典型 trainers。

label: Damaged peroxisomes
description: Selective autophagy targets damaged peroxisomes for degradation through a process termed pexophagy, in which ubiquitin tagging of peroxisomal proteins and recruitment of ESCRT (endosomal sorting complex required for transport) machinery mark the organelle for autophagic engulfment. This cargo-specific pathway contrasts with bulk autophagy by requiring receptor proteins that bridge the peroxisome to the autophagosomal membrane. Pexophagy protects cells from the oxidative and metabolic damage caused by defective peroxisomes. Its failure leads to accumulation of aberrant organelles and disease.
description_zh_TW: 選擇性自噬透過稱為 pexophagy 的過程，標靶受損過氧化體進行降解，其中過氧化體蛋白的泛素標記和 ESCRT（運輸所需內體分選複合物）機制的招募，將該胞器標定為自噬吞噬。此貨物特異性途徑不同於整體自噬之處，在於它需要受體蛋白將過氧化體橋接到自噬體膜。Pexophagy 保護細胞免於缺陷過氧化體造成的氧化和代謝損傷。其失敗導致異常胞器與疾病的累積。

label: Huntingtin
description: Mutant huntingtin (mHTT) uncouples fission from degradation while disrupting autophagic flux. Broad-spectrum autophagy activators like rapamycin may be insufficient if downstream transport remains blocked.
description_zh_TW: 突變 huntingtin（mHTT）使分裂與降解脫鉤，同時破壞自噬流。若下游運輸仍受阻，則 rapamycin 等廣譜自噬活化劑可能不足。

label: FUNDC1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: FUNDC1 (FUN14 domain containing 1) is an outer mitochondrial membrane protein that serves as a mitophagy receptor for hypoxia-induced mitophagy, interacting directly with LC3 after dephosphorylation by phosphoglycerate mutase 5. ULK1 interacts with FUNDC1 and phosphorylates it at serine 17, enhancing FUNDC1 binding to LC3, and FUNDC1 interacts with OPA1 and DRP1 in a manner regulated by serine 13 phosphorylation during hypoxia or membrane potential loss. DRP1 can interact with overexpressed FUNDC1 to facilitate mitochondrial fragmentation and Parkin-mediated mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: FUNDC1（FUN14 domain containing 1）是一種粒線體外膜蛋白，作為缺氧誘發粒線體自噬的受體，在經磷酸甘油酸變位酶5（phosphoglycerate mutase 5）去磷酸化後直接與LC3交互作用。ULK1與FUNDC1交互作用並在絲胺酸17（serine 17）處使其磷酸化，增強FUNDC1與LC3的結合；而在缺氧或膜電位喪失期間，FUNDC1與OPA1及DRP1的交互作用則受絲胺酸13磷酸化調節。DRP1可與過度表現的FUNDC1交互作用，以促進粒線體碎裂與Parkin介導的粒線體自噬。

label: Very Long Chain Fatty Acids
description: Peroxisomes are the primary site where very long chain fatty acids are shortened into shorter-chain products such as acetyl-CoA that can enter mitochondria for complete oxidation. Impaired peroxisomal beta-oxidation causes toxic VLCFA accumulation, the hallmark of Zellweger syndrome and adrenoleukodystrophy.
description_zh_TW: Peroxisome 是極長鏈脂肪酸進行縮短代謝的主要場所，產物如 acetyl-CoA 可進入粒線體完成氧化。過氧化物體 beta-oxidation 功能受損會導致有毒的 VLCFA 累積，這是 Zellweger syndrome 與 adrenoleukodystrophy 的標誌性特徵。

label: Neuronal survival
description: Mitophagy acts as a double-edged sword in neuronal survival. Insufficient clearance allows damaged mitochondria to accumulate, triggering inflammation and cell death, while excessive mitophagy depletes healthy mitochondria, causing bioenergetic failure. This bidirectional regulation means that both impairment and overactivation of mitophagy can precipitate neuronal damage. Striking the precise balance between removing dysfunctional and preserving healthy mitochondria is the central challenge for therapeutics.
description_zh_TW: Mitophagy 在神經元存活中扮演雙刃劍。清除不足使受損粒線體累積，觸發發炎和細胞死亡，而過度的 mitophagy 耗盡健康粒線體，造成生物能量衰竭。此雙向調節意味著 mitophagy 的受損和過度活化都可能引發神經元損傷。在移除功能失常與保留健康粒線體之間取得精確平衡是治療的核心挑戰。

label: USP30
description: USP30 is a mitochondrial deubiquitinase that opposes Parkin-mediated mitophagy by removing ubiquitin chains from outer mitochondrial membrane proteins. Its inhibition or loss enhances mitophagy, reduces alpha-synuclein pathology, and protects dopaminergic neurons in Parkinson's disease models. USP30 therefore acts as a negative regulator of mitophagy and a promising therapeutic target. Selective USP30 inhibitors such as MTX115325 have validated this approach in vivo.
description_zh_TW: USP30 是一種粒線體去泛素酶，透過移除粒線體外膜蛋白上的泛素鏈，拮抗 Parkin 介導的 mitophagy。其抑制或缺失增強 mitophagy、減少 alpha-synuclein 病理，並在帕金森氏症模型中保護多巴胺神經元。因此 USP30 作為 mitophagy 的負向調節者和有前景的治療標靶。MTX115325 等選擇性 USP30 抑制劑已在活體中驗證此方法。

label: Differential Stress Resistance
description: Short-term starvation or fasting combined with chemotherapy stimulates hormetic responses in normal cells, enhancing resilience, while cancer cells with mutations in Ras or Sch9/S6K cannot mount the same adaptation. This asymmetry is termed differential stress resistance (DSR) and protects normal but not cancer cells against high-dose chemotherapy. It exemplifies exploiting hormesis to widen the therapeutic window.
description_zh_TW: 短期飢餓或 Fasting 合併化療可在正常細胞中刺激 hormetic 反應並增強韌性，而帶有 Ras 或 Sch9/S6K 突變的癌細胞則無法產生相同適應。此不對稱現象稱為 Differential Stress Resistance，可保護正常細胞而不保護癌細胞免於高劑量化療損傷。這是利用 hormesis 擴大治療窗的典型例子。

label: Pexophagy
description: Pexophagy is the peroxisome-specific form of selective autophagy, mirroring mitophagy classification. Classification nests the cargo program.
description_zh_TW: Pexophagy 是過氧化物酶體特異的選擇性自噬形式，呼應粒線體自噬歸類。歸類嵌套貨物程序。

label: IL-22
description: Interleukin 22, an IL-10 gene family member produced by T helper 17 cells and innate lymphoid cell subsets, signals through the IL-22 receptor on the surface of thymic epithelial cells and promotes the proliferation and survival of thymocytes. Dudakov et al. showed that IL-22 administration to wild-type mice after total body irradiation significantly increases thymic cellularity, including both developing thymocytes and TEC subsets, and that immune recovery in irradiated IL-22-deficient mice is impaired.
description_zh_TW: 介白素 22（Interleukin 22）是 IL-10 基因家族成員，由 T 輔助 17 細胞與先天淋巴樣細胞亞群產生，透過胸腺上皮細胞表面的 IL-22 受體傳遞訊號，促進胸腺細胞的增生與存活。Dudakov 等人顯示，在全身照射後對野生型小鼠施用 IL-22 可顯著增加胸腺細胞數量，包括發育中的胸腺細胞與 TEC 亞群，而 IL-22 缺陷小鼠在照射後的免疫恢復則受損。

label: Keratinocyte Growth Factor
description: Keratinocyte growth factor (KGF, FGF7) signaling through FGFR2IIIb is critical for fetal thymus organogenesis and linked to proliferation and differentiation of fetal and postnatal thymic epithelial cells. KGF administration is well-documented to increase thymus size, TEC differentiation, and thymocyte production in aged animals. Min and colleagues showed that a single course of KGF treatment increases thymic cellularity in aged mice, maintained for two months, with restoration of cortical and medullary compartments, increased naive CD4 T cell output, and increased humoral responses to a T-dependent antigen.
description_zh_TW: 角質細胞生長因子（KGF，FGF7）透過 FGFR2IIIb 的訊息傳導對胎兒胸腺器官發生至關重要，並與胎兒及出生後胸腺上皮細胞的增生與分化有關。有充分文獻記載 KGF 施用可增加年老動物的胸腺大小、TEC 分化與胸腺細胞生成。Min 及其同事顯示，單一療程的 KGF 治療可增加老年小鼠的胸腺細胞數量，並維持兩個月，同時恢復皮質與髓質區室、增加初始 CD4 T 細胞輸出，並增加對 T 依賴性抗原的體液免疫反應。

label: LHRH
description: Luteinizing hormone releasing hormone (LHRH) analogues achieve pharmacological sex steroid ablation and are a clinically tolerable alternative to surgical castration. Agents such as Lupron (leuprolide) act on the pituitary gland, desensitizing LHRH receptors and thereby decreasing luteinizing hormone and follicle-stimulating hormone, leading to reduced estrogen and testosterone production. Human studies with LHRH analogues have resulted in increased thymic weight and reversal of age-related thymic structural defects.
description_zh_TW: 黃體生成激素釋放激素（LHRH）類似物可達成藥理性性類固醇消融，是外科去勢的臨床上可耐受之替代方案。諸如 Lupron（leuprolide）等藥物作用於腦下垂體，使 LHRH 受體去敏感化，從而減少黃體生成激素與濾泡刺激激素，導致雌激素與睪固酮生成減少。使用 LHRH 類似物的人類研究已導致胸腺重量增加及年齡相關胸腺結構缺陷的逆轉。

label: sjTREC
description: Single joint T cell receptor excision circle (sjTREC) analysis is a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis. Using sjTREC, researchers reported a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan, and a significant decrease of sjTREC per milligram of mouse thymus tissue with increasing age in BALB/c mice (6-90 weeks), demonstrating gradual decrease in thymopoiesis with age similar to humans. The sjTREC assay was also used to show that ghrelin administration to aged mice increases the number of recent thymic emigrants exported to the periphery. It is thus a quantitative readout of thymic output used across species.
description_zh_TW: 單關節T細胞受體刪除環（sjTREC）分析是活性胸腺生成的分子標誌物。使用sjTREC，研究人員報告了在80年人類壽命中循環初始T細胞穩步下降三個數量級，以及在BALB/c小鼠（6-90週）中隨著年齡增長，每毫克小鼠胸腺組織的sjTREC顯著減少，證明了與人類相似的隨著年齡增長胸腺生成逐漸減少。sjTREC測定也被用於證明ghrelin給藥老年小鼠增加了最近輸出到外周的胸腺遷出細胞的數量。因此，它是跨物種使用的胸腺輸出的定量讀數。

label: miR-34a
description: The 3'UTR of the SIRT1 transcript contains a miR-34a-responsive element; active miR-34a represses SIRT1 translation. Directionally, miR-34a sits upstream to lower SIRT1 protein. Because SIRT1 deacetylates and inhibits p53, this repression is part of a negative feedback loop that helps explain the drop in SIRT1 observed during senescence.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 轉錄本的 3'UTR 包含一個 miR-34a 響應元件；活性 miR-34a 抑制 SIRT1 的翻譯。方向性上 miR-34a 位於上游以降低 SIRT1 蛋白水平。由於 SIRT1 去乙醯化並抑制 p53，這種抑制是負回饋迴路的一部分，有助於解釋在衰老過程中觀察到的 SIRT1 下降。

label: Kidney Fibrosis
description: SIRT1 overexpression abolishes TGF-beta1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis through CTGF suppression, and SRT1720 attenuates UUO fibrosis, while SIRT1 represses HIF2alpha. However, SIRT1 downregulation may also inhibit fibroblast activation via EGFR/PDGFR-beta, creating therapeutic ambiguity. The dominant role is renoprotective, opposing tubulointerstitial fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過度表現透過抑制 CTGF 廢除 TGF-beta1 誘發的凋亡與纖維化，且 SRT1720 減弱 UUO 纖維化，而 SIRT1 抑制 HIF2alpha。然而，SIRT1 下調亦可經由 EGFR/PDGFR-beta 抑制纖維母細胞活化，造成治療上的曖昧。其優勢角色為腎保護，對抗小管間質纖維化。

label: Ku70
description: SIRT3 activates Ku70 via deacetylation, enhancing mitochondrial oxidative metabolism, ROS management, and ATP production (Ahn 2008 PMID 18794531).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化活化 Ku70，增強粒線體氧化代謝、ROS 管理和 ATP 產生（Ahn 2008 PMID 18794531）。

label: Intervertebral Disc Degeneration
description: SIRT3 expression is significantly reduced in degenerated intervertebral discs, and its knockdown further exacerbates deterioration of nucleus pulposus cells under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis, while SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo, and hydrogel microspheres upregulating both SIRT3 and SOD2 maintain NPC viability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 表現在退化的椎間盤中顯著降低，其進一步敲減在氧化壓力下加劇髓核細胞的退化。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化並促進鐵死亡，而 SIRT3 的過量表現在體內緩解 IDD 嚴重程度，同時上調 SIRT3 和 SOD2 的水凝膠微球維護 NPC 存活率。

label: Bleomycin
description: Bleomycin is a glycopeptide antibiotic that causes DNA double-strand breaks and is a standard tool for generating therapy-induced senescence (TIS) in vitro. Sub-lethal bleomycin treatment produces a canonical senescence phenotype with elevated SA-beta-gal and DNA-damage-response foci.
description_zh_TW: Bleomycin 是一種糖肽抗生素，會造成 DNA 雙股斷裂，是體外誘發治療誘導性衰老（TIS）的標準工具。次致死劑量的 bleomycin 處理會產生典型的衰老表現型，包括升高的 SA-β-gal 與 DNA 損傷反應焦點。

label: MAD2
description: Mad2 inhibits APC/C-CDC20 at unattached kinetochores until biorientation.
description_zh_TW: Mad2 在未附著動點抑制 APC/C-CDC20 直到雙定向。

label: Rheumatoid synovial fluid
description: Extracellular myeloperoxidase activity is detectable in rheumatoid synovial fluid as in plaque and ischemic myocardium. Localization records the inflammatory exudate.
description_zh_TW: 細胞外髓過氧化物酶活性可在類風濕滑液測得，如同斑塊與缺血心肌。定位記錄發炎滲出。

label: Monoamine oxidase B
description: Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: DAI
description: DAI (DNA-dependent activator of IRFs) is the original name of ZBP1 (Z-DNA binding protein 1); the molecules are identical, with ZBP1 now the canonical gene name.
description_zh_TW: DAI（IRF 的 DNA 依賴活化因子）為 ZBP1（Z-DNA 結合蛋白 1）的原名；兩者為同一分子，ZBP1 為現行規範基因名。

label: PANoptosis
description: The PANoptosome is the supramolecular platform that co-assembles pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis, incorporating RIPK1, RIPK3, FADD, caspase-8, and NLRP3; its defining property is non-redundancy, so blocking any single arm does not prevent death (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: PANoptosome 是共同組裝 pyroptosis、apoptosis 與 necroptosis 的超分子平台，包含 RIPK1、RIPK3、FADD、caspase-8 與 NLRP3；其定義特性為非冗餘性，故阻斷任一單一臂無法阻止死亡（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Glucose uptake
description: GLUT1 is the facilitative uniporter mediating tumor glucose uptake and FDG-PET signal.
description_zh_TW: GLUT1 是介導腫瘤葡萄糖攝取與 FDG-PET 訊號的易化單向轉運體。

label: TLR3
description: TLR3 is the receptor whose signaling is mediated solely by the TRIF adaptor; dsRNA (poly(I:C)) engagement under caspase inhibition can then drive a TRIF/RIPK3 necrosome (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: TLR3 是唯一完全經由 TRIF 接頭傳遞訊號的受體；在 caspase 受抑制時，dsRNA（poly(I:C)）接合可驅動 TRIF/RIPK3 necrosome（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: MiTF TFE family
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB belongs to the MiT/TFE family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors, which also includes TFE3, MITF, and TFEC. Members of this family share conserved DNA-binding and dimerization domains and regulate overlapping sets of lysosomal and autophagic target genes. The family's defining feature is responsiveness to nutrient and stress signals that control nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling. TFEB and TFE3 are the principal mediators of the coordinated lysosomal expression and regulation (CLEAR) network.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 屬於 MiT/TFE 家族的基礎螺旋-環-螺旋亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，該家族也包括 TFE3、MITF 和 TFEC。此家族成員共享保守的 DNA 結合和二聚化結構域，並調節重疊的一組溶酶體和自噬標的基因的轉錄。該家族的定義特徵是對控制核質穿梭的營養和壓力信號的反應性。TFEB 和 TFE3 是協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）網絡的主要介導者。

label: Parasympathetic Nervous System
description: The parasympathetic nervous system is the rest, digest, and repair branch of the autonomic nervous system, and the vagus nerve is its principal parasympathetic efferent to the heart. High vagal tone raises heart-rate variability and underlies a recovered, adaptable system.
description_zh_TW: 副交感神經系統是自主神經系統的休息、消化與修復分支，而迷走神經是它對心臟的主要副交感輸出。高迷走張力提高心率變異度，是恢復、可適應系統的基礎。

label: CREB
description: CREB is a transcription factor critical for BDNF expression. SIRT1-dependent signaling converges on CREB to drive BDNF production and support neurogenesis and memory.
description_zh_TW: CREB 是 BDNF 表現的關鍵轉錄因子。SIRT1 依賴性訊號匯聚於 CREB 以驅動 BDNF 產生，並支持神經新生與記憶。

label: Complex II
description: Complex II is embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane and is the only enzyme that participates in both the TCA cycle and the electron transport chain. It links carbon metabolism to mitochondrial redox signaling and oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: Complex II 嵌入粒線體內膜，是唯一同時參與 TCA 循環與電子傳遞鏈的酶。它將碳代謝與粒線體氧化還原訊號及氧化壓力相連結。

label: Arterial aging
description: Spermidine reverses features of arterial aging, including large elastic artery stiffening, and restores nitric-oxide-mediated endothelial function in aged vessels. These vascular benefits are linked to spermidine-induced autophagy, which clears damaged mitochondria and reduces vascular oxidative stress and inflammation. By improving endothelial-dependent vasodilation, spermidine counteracts the stiffening that drives systolic hypertension and cardiovascular risk with age. The findings support spermidine as a candidate intervention for vascular rejuvenation.
description_zh_TW: 精胺逆轉動脈老化的特徵，包括大彈性動脈僵硬化，並恢復老化血管中一氧化氮介導的內皮功能。這些血管益處與精胺誘發的自噬相關，後者清除受損粒線體並減少血管氧化壓力和發炎。透過改善內皮依賴性血管舒張，精胺抵消了隨年齡驅動收縮期高血壓和心血管風險的僵硬化。這些發現支持精胺作為血管回春的候選介入。

label: Trehalose
description: Trehalose acts as an autophagy inducer. Induction is mTORC1-independent.
description_zh_TW: 海藻糖作為自噬誘發因子。誘發不依賴 mTORC1。

label: Euchromatin
description: H4K16 acetylation by Sas2p marks open transcriptionally active chromatin.
description_zh_TW: Sas2p 的 H4K16 乙醯化標記開放的轉錄活性染色質。

label: Cell Proliferation
description: At high doses rapamycin and everolimus slow cell proliferation, which decreases blood cell counts and results in mild and reversible thrombocytopenia, anemia and leukopenia as their most common side effects. A mild reduction of platelets may actually be beneficial, since one of the intended effects of aspirin is a decrease in platelet function. These reversible side effects contrast with the irreversible and inevitable effects of aging such as cancer, stroke, infarction, blindness and premature death, and can be avoided by intermittent scheduling or low-dose administration.
description_zh_TW: 在高劑量下，rapamycin和everolimus減緩細胞增殖，導致血細胞計數減少，並產生輕微且可逆的血小板減少症、貧血和白血球減少症作為其最常見的副作用。血小板的輕微減少實際上可能是有益的，因為aspirin的其中一個預期效果是減少血小板功能。這些可逆的副作用與老化的不可逆和不可避免的效應形成對比，如癌症、中風、梗塞、失明和過早死亡，可以透過間歇性安排或低劑量給藥來避免。

label: Sanglifehrin A
description: Sanglifehrin A (SfA) blocks MPT; combination of Nec-1 + SfA gave significantly stronger protection in ischemia-reperfusion injury than either monotherapy, confirming MPT and necroptosis as independent programs.
description_zh_TW: Sanglifehrin A（SfA）阻斷 MPT；在缺血–再灌注損傷中 Nec-1 與 SfA 併用較任何單一療法提供顯著更強之保護，證實 MPT 與 necroptosis 為獨立程序。

label: Cyclophilin D
description: MPT is an independent regulated-necrosis program: cyclophilin D-dependent opening of the permeability transition pore; cyclophilin D-deficient mice are partially protected from organ ischemia-reperfusion injury.
description_zh_TW: MPT 是獨立的 regulated necrosis 程序：由 Cyclophilin D 依賴性之通透性轉換孔開啟所介導；Cyclophilin D 缺失小鼠在器官缺血–再灌注損傷中獲得部分保護。

label: A20
description: A20 is a RIPK1-deubiquitinase whose ablation sensitizes mice to lethal TNF-mediated colitis via intestinal epithelial cell death (interpreted as apoptosis, with possible necroptosis involvement).
description_zh_TW: A20 是 RIPK1 去泛素化酶，其缺失使小鼠對 TNF 媒介之致死性結腸炎敏感，機制為腸道上皮細胞死亡（被解讀為凋亡，可能牽涉 necroptosis）。

label: Ischemic Preconditioning
description: Preconditioning and postconditioning are described as clinical manifestations of hormesis, where a low-dose homologous or heterologous stimulus builds a biological protective barrier. Ischemic preconditioning reduces myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, and cerebral preconditioning or transient ischemic attacks induce tolerance that lessens subsequent stroke severity. Postconditioning applies a low-dose stimulus after a high-dose insult within a time window.
description_zh_TW: Preconditioning 與 postconditioning 被描述為 Hormesis 的臨床表現形式，即以低劑量同源或異源刺激建立生物保護屏障。Ischemic Preconditioning 可減輕心肌缺血再灌流損傷，而腦部 preconditioning 或短暫性腦缺血發作可誘發耐受性並減輕後續中風嚴重度。Postconditioning 則是在高劑量損傷後的時間窗內施加低劑量刺激。

label: TH17
description: IL-6, IL-1beta, and TGFbeta together drive naive T-cell differentiation toward the TH17 lineage, linking the SASP to adaptive immune reprogramming. TH17 cells recruited to senescent niches can amplify inflammation and promote autoimmunity-like responses. The relationship connects the secretome to a distinct effector T-cell subset with pro-inflammatory roles and is a well-established cytokine combination in TH17 biology. This illustrates how the SASP shapes not only innate but also adaptive immune responses.
description_zh_TW: IL-6、IL-1beta 與 TGFbeta 共同驅動初始 T 細胞朝 TH17 譜系分化，將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫重編程。被招募至衰老巢的 TH17 細胞可放大發炎並促進類自體免疫反應。此關係將分泌組連結到特定 T 細胞子集偏移，擴展 SASP 超越先天活化的免疫學後果。它是衰老與自體免疫樣發炎間的橋樑。

label: Glucose metabolism
description: SIRT1 governs glucose metabolism by deacetylating FOXO1, PGC-1alpha, and CRTC2 to promote gluconeogenic and oxidative programs, downregulates PTP1B to improve insulin sensitivity, and represses UCP2 in pancreatic beta-cells to support glucose-stimulated insulin secretion. SIRT1 is central to glucose homeostasis and to the insulin-sensitizing effects of caloric restriction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 FOXO1、PGC-1alpha 和 CRTC2 來調控葡萄糖代謝，促進糖質新生和氧化程序；下調 PTP1B 以改善胰島素敏感性；並抑制胰腺 β 細胞中的 UCP2 以支持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌。SIRT1 是葡萄糖恆定和熱量限制胰島素增敏效應的核心。

label: Melanins
description: Adrenolutin further polymerizes into melanin-like pigments. Polymerization extends the aminochrome to melanin route.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺素的光學異構體進一步聚合為類黑素色素。聚合延伸胺色素到黑素路徑。

label: executive function
description: The prefrontal cortex controls executive function, encompassing planning, decision-making, inhibition, and cognitive flexibility, through its extensive reciprocal connections with posterior cortex, striatum, and thalamus. Its operations depend critically on an optimal, COMT-genotype-sensitive level of dopamine, with both excess and deficiency degrading performance. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set the dopamine tone that governs these high-level functions. Dysregulation of prefrontal dopamine is implicated in numerous psychiatric and cognitive disorders.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質透過與後皮質、紋狀體和丘腦的廣泛相互連結來控制 executive function，包括計畫、決策、抑制和認知靈活性。其運作關鍵取決於 COMT 基因型敏感的最佳多巴胺水平，過量和缺乏都會降低表現。由於前額葉 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 設定了控制這些高階功能的多巴胺基調。前額葉多巴胺的失調與許多精神和認知障礙有關。

label: high COMT activity
description: Studies in COMT-overexpressing (COMT-OE) mice show that elevated COMT activity accelerates dopamine clearance and leads to slower acquisition of stimulus-response tasks. Proposed mechanisms include reduced dopamine availability at MSN synapses and poorer top-down control over response selection. This manifests as increased impulsivity or perseveration.
description_zh_TW: 對 COMT 過度表現（COMT-OE）小鼠的研究顯示，升高的 COMT activity 加速多巴胺清除並導致 stimulus-response 任務習得較慢。提出的機制包括 MSN 突觸的多巴胺可用性降低，以及對反應選擇的由上而下控制較差。這表現為衝動性或持續性增加。

label: Osteoporosis
description: SIRT1 is protective in osteoporosis: SIRT1 knockout mice have low bone mass, SIRT1 increases osteoblast osteogenesis via FoxO3a, and it deacetylates sclerostin to promote Wnt/beta-catenin signaling. Resveratrol restores alkaline phosphatase and osteocalcin via NF-kB. SIRT1 thus supports bone formation and opposes age-related bone loss.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在骨質疏鬆症中具保護性：SIRT1 基因敲除小鼠骨量低，SIRT1 透過 FoxO3a 增加造骨細胞成骨，且去乙醯化 sclerostin 以促進 Wnt/beta-catenin 訊號。Resveratrol 透過 NF-kB 恢復鹼性磷酸酶與骨鈣素。SIRT1 因此支持骨形成並對抗年齡相關骨流失。

label: PAI-1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: PAI-1, a senescence-associated secreted factor (SASP), suppresses SIRT1 expression, and SIRT1 reciprocally binds the PAI-1 promoter to deacetylate H4K16 and repress its transcription; elevation of PAI-1 with age thus contributes to SIRT1 decline and the senescence phenotype (Kortlever et al., 2006, Nat Cell Biol; Wan et al., 2014, Aging Cell, PMID 24649892).
description_zh_TW: PAI-1 是一種衰老相關的分泌因子（SASP），抑制 SIRT1 表達，而 SIRT1 相互結合 PAI-1 啟動子去乙醯化 H4K16 並抑制其轉錄；因此 PAI-1 隨年齡的升高促成 SIRT1 的下降和衰老表型（Kortlever et al., 2006, Nat Cell Biol; Wan et al., 2014, Aging Cell, PMID 24649892）。

label: Lifespan extension
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 is a central mediator of healthspan and longevity: its activity declines with age as NAD+ falls, and genetic/pharmacologic (resveratrol, NAD+ precursors) activation extends lifespan in model organisms; SIRT1-dependent deacetylation of p53, FOXOs, and NF-κB underpins these effects (Giblin et al., 2014, Sirtuins: Guardians of Mammalian Healthspan; Satoh et al., 2013 brain-specific SIRT1-overexpression lifespan extension, PMID 24011076).
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是健康跨度和長壽的核心中介因子：隨著 NAD+ 下降，其活性隨年齡增長而降低，而基因/藥物（白藜蘆醇、NAD+ 前體）活化可在模式生物中延長壽命；SIRT1 依賴性的 p53、FOXOs 和 NF-κB 去乙醯化構成了這些效應的基礎（Giblin et al., 2014, Sirtuins: Guardians of Mammalian Healthspan; Satoh et al., 2013 大腦特異性 SIRT1 過表達延長壽命，PMID 24011076）。

label: stress responses
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 is a central stress-response integrator that deacetylates p53, FOXO, NF-kB, and HIF to bias cells toward repair and survival, activates Nrf2 and antioxidant enzymes, and relocalizes to DNA-damage sites to support repair; these actions underpin SIRT1's stress resistance and longevity functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是一個核心的壓力反應整合因子，它去乙醯化 p53、FOXO、NF-kB 和 HIF，使細胞偏向修復和存活方向；活化 Nrf2 和抗氧化酶；並再定位至 DNA 損傷位點以支持修復；這些作用構成了 SIRT1 抗壓能力和長壽功能的基礎。

label: WRN
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates the Werner syndrome helicase WRN, linking SIRT1 to DNA repair and genomic stability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 Werner 氏症候群解旋酶 WRN，將 SIRT1 與 DNA 修復和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

label: H3K56
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K56 (Yang et al., 2009), a mark also touched by SIRT1; the node analysis flagged the missing direct SIRT6→H3K56 edge as a curation gap to fill in the next triples pass.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 H3K56（Yang et al., 2009），此標記亦受 SIRT1 作用；節點分析將缺失的 SIRT6→H3K56 直接邊標記為應補回的策展缺口。

label: ChREBP
description: SIRT6 deacetylates ChREBP (alongside SREBP-1c) to maintain hepatic lipid homeostasis and oppose fatty liver disease. Loss of SIRT6 elevates fibrosis and oxidative stress in NASH mice in part through loss of ChREBP/SREBP-1c control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 ChREBP（與 SREBP-1c 並行）以維持肝臟脂質恆定並對抗脂肪肝。在 NASH 小鼠中 SIRT6 缺失會部分因失去 ChREBP/SREBP-1c 控制而加重纖維化與氧化壓力。

label: Inducible Nitric Oxide Synthase
description: Aminoguanidine (Pimagedine) is primarily known as a selective inhibitor of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), the enzyme responsible for producing high levels of nitric oxide during inflammation. By blocking iNOS, aminoguanidine prevents the overproduction of nitric oxide from the start of the inflammatory cascade, acting upstream of NO signaling. Because it selectively targets the inducible form rather than the healthy endothelial form (eNOS), it is considered a way to halt the inflammatory cascade without completely shutting down normal blood pressure regulation.
description_zh_TW: 氨基胍丁 (Pimagedine) 主要已知作為 inducible 硝酸 synthase (iNOS) 的選擇性抑制劑，該酶負責在發炎期間產生高濃度的硝酸鹽。通過阻斷 iNOS，氨基胍丁可以從發炎遞濫的開始處阻止硝酸鹽的過度產生，在 NO 訊號之前起作用。因為它選擇性地針對 inducible 形式而非健康內皮細胞形式 (eNOS)，因此被認為是停止發炎遞濫的方法，而無需完全關閉正常的血壓調節。

label: Cataract
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Cross-linking may be responsible for many of the problems of old age, including senile cataract, thickening of the arteries, some cancers and damage to the immune system. A damaged immune system leads to increased susceptibility to infection, and some cancers may arise from the effects of glucose on DNA, which can react with glucose to produce damaged DNA that causes abnormal cells to be produced. Aminoguanidine's ability to prevent cross-linking may help alleviate or prevent senile cataract as well as arterial thickening, kidney failure, thinning bones, osteoarthritis and skin wrinkles.
description_zh_TW: 交聯作用可能是老年許多問題的成因，包括老年性白內障、動脈增厚、某些癌症與免疫系統損傷。受損的免疫系統會導致對感染的易感性增加，而某些癌症可能源於葡萄糖對 DNA 的影響——DNA 可與葡萄糖反應而產生受損的 DNA，進而導致異常細胞的生成。胺基胍防止交聯的能力，可能有助於緩解或預防老年性白內障，以及動脈增厚、腎衰竭、骨質變薄、骨關節炎與皮膚皺紋。

label: Hydrazines
description: Aminoguanidine is the principal nitrogen-nitrogen bond derivative used for adrenochrome stabilization. Membership marks the hydrazine pharmacophore.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是用於 adrenochrome 穩定的主要氮氮鍵衍生物。成員關係標記肼藥效團。

label: JAK2
description: JAK2 trans-phosphorylates downstream STAT factors, notably STAT3, coupling cytokine receptors to proliferation/survival transcription.
description_zh_TW: JAK2 反式磷酸化下游 STAT 因子（特別是 STAT3），將細胞激素受體與增殖/存活轉錄偶聯。

label: diabetic complications
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues and organs during diabetes and contribute to the pathogenesis of diabetic complications. AGE formation and accumulation in diabetic patients results in vascular alterations leading to diabetic vasculopathy, and glycation is implicated in diabetic renal, retinal, and neural complications. Because the glycation reaction is accelerated by hyperglycemia and oxidative stress, poor glycemic control exacerbates AGE burden. AGE inhibitors such as aminoguanidine were shown to prevent diabetic complications by inhibiting AGE formation, supporting the causal role of glycation in diabetic pathology.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 在 diabetes 期間堆積於組織與器官，並促成 diabetic complications 的 pathogenesis。Diabetic patients 中 AGE formation 與 accumulation 導致 vascular alterations，引發 diabetic vasculopathy，而 glycation 涉及 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。由於 glycation reaction 受 hyperglycemia 與 oxidative stress 加速，poor glycemic control 會加劇 AGE burden。Aminoguanidine 等 AGE inhibitors 已被證實能透過抑制 AGE formation 來預防 diabetic complications，支持了 glycation 在 diabetic pathology 中的因果角色。

label: Stemness
description: SASP IL-6/IL-8 signaling through JAK-STAT3 promotes dedifferentiation and stem-like states in recipient cells. This fate-modulating arm underlies both regenerative plasticity acutely and cancer stemness chronically.
description_zh_TW: SASP 的 IL-6/IL-8 經 JAK-STAT3 訊號促進受體細胞去分化與類幹細胞狀態。此命運調節臂構成急性期的再生可塑性與慢性期的癌症幹性。

label: Hannum Clock
description: The Hannum clock is a blood-based epigenetic age estimator whose blood-specific training makes it sensitive to immunosenescence and inflammatory states. Its age-acceleration correlates with aging and epigenetic alterations in the immune compartment.
description_zh_TW: Hannum 時鐘是基於血液的表觀遺傳年齡估算器，其血液特異訓練使其對免疫衰老與發炎狀態敏感。其年齡加速與免疫區室的衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

label: Senescent Cell Accumulation
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial dysfunction in cellular senescence a bridge to neurodegenerative disease.md
description: Age-related decline in NK, macrophage and T-cell clearance permits senescent cells to persist and accumulate. This failed-surveillance loop closes the circuit with aging-driven senescent-cell formation.
description_zh_TW: NK、巨噬細胞與 T 細胞清除的年齡相關衰退允許衰老細胞持續與累積。此監視失敗迴圈與老化驅動的衰老細胞形成構成迴路。

label: Quinones
description: Neuromelanin protects against Quinones by neutralizing, scavenging, or removing the threatening species or condition. Mechanistically, Neuromelanin acts as a sink or reductant that limits oxidative, toxic, or aggregate burden within catecholaminergic neurons. This protective role is significant because it may explain why pigmented neurons survive despite high metabolic stress, at least below a pathogenic threshold. A caveat is that the protection is conditional; under overload, redox perturbation, or iron release the same entity can contribute to damage rather than prevention.
description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 透過中和、清除或消除威脅物種或狀況來防禦 Quinones。從機制上講，Neuromelanin 充當水槽或還原劑，限制兒茶酚胺能神經元內的氧化、毒性或聚集負擔。這種保護作用很重要，因為它可以解釋為什麼色素神經元在高代謝壓力（至少低於致病閾值）下仍能存活。需要注意的是，這種保護是有條件的；在過載、氧化還原擾動或 iron 釋放同一實體的情況下，可能會造成損害而不是預防。

label: Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin
description: Neuromelanin and Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuromelanin and Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 和 Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuromelanin 和 Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: GDH (Glutamate Dehydrogenase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates GDH, promoting amino-acid-derived anaplerosis and gluconeogenesis (contrast SIRT4, which ADP-ribosylates and inhibits GDH).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化並活化 GDH（穀氨酸脫氫酶），促進氨基酸衍生的回補反應和糖質新生（與 SIRT4 形成對比，後者透過 ADP-核糖基化抑制 GDH）。

label: Muscle Mass
description: Creatine supplementation plus resistance training increases lean tissue mass and strength, confirmed by RCTs and meta-analyses in older adults. The effect combines expanded PCr energetics with protein-sparing action.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸補充加阻力訓練增加瘦組織量與肌力，老年人 RCT 與統合分析已確認。效應結合擴大的 PCr 能量學與保留蛋白作用。

label: Retinal Pigment Epithelium
description: Retinal pigment epithelium dysfunction and loss is the pathophysiologic center.
description_zh_TW: 視網膜色素上皮功能障礙與缺失是病理生理中心。

label: cognitive performance
description: COMT modulates cognitive performance through an inverted-U (or tonic-phasic) relationship in which intermediate dopamine levels in the prefrontal cortex optimize executive function, while both excessively high (slow COMT) and low (fast COMT) activity shift performance away from the optimum. Met-bearing (slow) genotypes favor stability and working memory under calm conditions, whereas Val-bearing (fast) genotypes favor rapid processing under stress. Thus COMT genotype is a major determinant of individual differences in cognition.
description_zh_TW: COMT 透過倒 U（或強直相位）關係調節 cognitive performance，其中前額葉皮質中的中間多巴胺水平優化 executive function，而過高（慢 COMT）和低（快 COMT）活動會使性能偏離最佳狀態。含有 Met 的（慢速）基因型有利於平靜條件下的穩定性和工作記憶，而含有 Val 的（快速）基因型則有利於在壓力下快速處理。因此，COMT genotype 是認知個體差異的主要決定因素。

label: Metallic silver
description: Metallic silver is oxidized and may deposit in the tissues, causing argyria, a permanent blue-gray pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Argyria results when large doses of silver are absorbed into the circulatory system and deposited in body tissues; although disfiguring and usually permanent, the condition does not otherwise harm health, and mild forms are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis. The pigmentation reflects reduced elemental silver and silver sulfide granules lodged in the tissues.
description_zh_TW: 金屬銀被氧化並可能沉積在組織中，導致argyria，一種皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的永久性藍灰色色素沉著。當大劑量銀吸收進入循環系統並沉積在體組織中時，會導致argyria；雖然毀容且通常永久，但該病變對健康無其他損害，輕度形式有時被誤認為發紺。色素沉著反映了還原的元素銀和硫化銀顆粒滯留在組織中。

label: ACSS2
description: ACSS2 (acetyl-CoA synthetase 2) is a nuclear-cytosolic enzyme that ligates acetate to coenzyme A to form acetyl-CoA, providing a mitochondrial-independent route of acetyl-CoA production that supports histone acetylation and gene expression.
description_zh_TW: ACSS2（acetyl-CoA synthetase 2）是一種核-胞質酵素，將乙酸（acetate）與輔酶 A 連接形成 acetyl-CoA，提供一條不依賴粒線體的 acetyl-CoA 生成路徑，以支持組蛋白乙醯化與基因表現。

label: H3K4me1
description: H3K4me1 is the canonical enhancer mark, and active enhancers are defined by the combination of H3K4me1 with H3K27ac. In senescence, super-enhancers are enriched in both H3K4me1 and H3K27ac to drive SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: H3K4me1 是典型的增強子標記，活性增強子由 H3K4me1 與 H3K27ac 的組合定義。在衰老中，超級增強子同時富集 H3K4me1 與 H3K27ac 以驅動 SASP 表現。

label: H4K5ac
description: H4K5ac is often co-acetylated with other marks and is enriched together with H3K27ac at senescence-activated super-enhancers. Both acetyl marks contribute to the open enhancer landscape driving SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: H4K5ac 常與其他標記共同乙醯化，並與 H3K27ac 一起富集於衰老活化的超級增強子。兩種乙醯標記皆促成驅動 SASP 表現的開放增強子景觀。

label: Hepatocyte
description: Mature quiescent hepatocytes are the dominant regenerative source after hepatectomy.
description_zh_TW: 成熟靜止肝細胞是肝切除後的主要再生來源。

label: PRAS40
description: Akt phosphorylation relieves PRAS40-mediated mTORC1 inhibition. Phosphorylation is the canonical release.
description_zh_TW: Akt 磷酸化解除 PRAS40 介導的 mTORC1 抑制。磷酸化是典型釋放。

label: Nutrient Availability
description: Nutrient levels dictate metabolic priorities and autophagic activity with scarcity activating clearance. Regulation is the supply-to-degradation coupling.
description_zh_TW: 營養水平決定代謝優先與自噬活性，匱乏活化清除。調節是供應到降解的耦合。

label: S6K1
description: S6K1 is the canonical T389 downstream effector of mTORC1. Relationship is the textbook kinase-substrate pair.
description_zh_TW: S6K1 是 mTORC1 典型的 T389 下游效應器。關係是教科書激酶—受質對。

label: Ribosomal Protein S6
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: S6K1 phosphorylation of ribosomal protein S6 defines its substrate. Phosphorylation is the translation-output step.
description_zh_TW: S6K1 磷酸化核糖體蛋白 S6 定義其受質。磷酸化是轉譯輸出步驟。

label: Cutaneous Melanoma
description: MC1R and Cutaneous Melanoma are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically MC1R and Cutaneous Melanoma may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: MC1R 和 Cutaneous Melanoma 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，MC1R 和 Cutaneous Melanoma 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Cytokines
description: Cytokines are small secreted signaling proteins that mediate communication between immune and resident cells. In the CNS, microglia and infiltrating lymphocytes release cytokines that coordinate neuroinflammation, a process implicated in Parkinson's disease progression.
description_zh_TW: 細胞激素是介導免疫細胞與駐留細胞溝通的小型分泌性訊號蛋白。在中樞神經系統中，微膠質細胞與浸潤淋巴球釋放細胞激素以協調神經發炎，此過程與帕金森氏症的進展有關。

label: MNNG
source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md
description: MNNG is a methylating alkylating agent that generates a high load of DNA strand breaks, hyperactivating PARP1 and driving the parthanatos cascade; PARP inhibitors (DPQ, PJ-34) but not z-VAD block MNNG-induced death (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: MNNG 是產生大量 DNA 斷裂的甲基化烷化劑，會過度活化 PARP1 並驅動 parthanatos 級聯；PARP 抑制劑（DPQ、PJ-34）而非 z-VAD 能阻斷 MNNG 誘導的死亡（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: IKKalpha
description: IKKα (IKK1, CHUK) functions in two NF-κB modes: within the IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO heterocomplex it contributes to IκBα phosphorylation and canonical NF-κB activation downstream of TNFα, IL-1, LPS, and DNA damage; released from NEMO it forms homodimers that — driven by NIK — phosphorylate p100 into p52, driving non-canonical NF-κB (RelB:p52) signaling for lymphoid development and B-cell survival. IKKα also has nuclear, NF-κB-independent roles such as histone H3 Ser10 phosphorylation in mitosis.
description_zh_TW: IKKα（IKK1，CHUK）在兩種 NF-κB 模式中運作：在 IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO 異源複合體中，它參與 IκBα 的磷酸化與 TNFα、IL-1、LPS 及 DNA 損傷下游的典型 NF-κB 活化；脫離 NEMO 後，它形成同源二聚體，在 NIK 驅動下將 p100 磷酸化為 p52，推動非典型 NF-κB（RelB:p52）訊號以支配淋巴器官發育與 B 細胞存活。IKKα 另有獨立於 NF-κB 的細胞核角色，例如有絲分裂中組蛋白 H3 Ser10 的磷酸化。

label: Glucocorticoids
description: The SASP is suppressed by glucocorticoids, which block the pro-inflammatory SASP by impairing IL-1alpha-mediated NF-kB activity. This senomorphic action modulates senescence-associated properties without cytotoxicity. Glucocorticoids thus represent a class of senomorphic therapy targeting the inflammatory arm of the SASP.
description_zh_TW: SASP 會被 glucocorticoids 抑制，它們透過損害 IL-1alpha 介導的 NF-kB 活性來阻斷促發炎性 SASP。這種 senomorphic 作用在不具細胞毒性的情況下調節衰老相關特性。因此 glucocorticoids 代表一類針對 SASP 發炎臂的 senomorphic 療法。

label: HDAC3
description: Estrogen signaling engages HDAC3 to repress STING transcription, dampening cGAS-STING output; loss of this axis derepresses innate DNA-sensing inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen 訊號透過 HDAC3 抑制 STING 轉錄，降低 cGAS-STING 輸出；此軸喪失將解除先天 DNA 感測發炎的抑制。

label: Blood
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is very unstable in the blood, which makes it difficult to measure and detect, and this instability is partially due to degradation of NR to nicotinamide (NAM), compromising its ability to reach peripheral tissues after oral administration. Despite this instability, the development of reliable methods for collection, processing, and measurement has enabled determination of the pharmacokinetic profile of orally administered NR, and the apparent oral bioavailability of a 1000 mg dose of NR is highly variable among individuals. The reduced form of NR, NRH, appears more stable than NR and does not undergo direct degradation in plasma.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）在血液中非常不穩定，使其難以測量與偵測，且此不穩定性部分源於 NR 降解為 nicotinamide（NAM，菸鹼醯胺），損害了其口服給藥後到達周邊組織的能力。儘管此不穩定性，可靠收集、處理與測量方法的發展已使得口服 NR 的藥物動力學特徵得以確定，且 1000 mg 劑量 NR 的表觀口服生體可用率在人與人之間差異極大。NR 的還原型 NRH 似乎比 NR 更穩定，且不會在血漿中發生直接降解。

label: Universal indirect pan-sirtuin activator
description: NMN is a direct NAD+ precursor that, once converted to NAD+, serves as a universal indirect pan-sirtuin activator by supplying the obligate co-substrate for all seven sirtuins. Directionally, NMN is converted to NAD+, which activates sirtuins. It raises NAD+ levels that decline with age, restoring sirtuin function systemically, and NMN repletion in mice reverses mitochondrial dysfunction and features of cellular senescence. NMN, together with NR, is a leading nutraceutical strategy to counteract age-related sirtuin attenuation, and its efficacy is enhanced when combined with agents that prevent NAD+ consumption, such as CD38 inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: NMN 是一種直接的 NAD+ 前體，一旦轉化為 NAD+，便通過為所有七種 sirtuin 提供必需的共同受質而充當通用的間接泛 sirtuin 活化因子。在方向性上，NMN 被轉化為 NAD+，NAD+ 活化 sirtuin。它提高隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 水平，恢復全身的 sirtuin 功能，小鼠中的 NMN 補充逆轉粒線體功能障礙和細胞衰老的特徵。NMN 與 NR 一起是對抗與年齡相關的 sirtuin 衰減的主要營養保健品策略，當與防止 NAD+ 消耗的藥劑（如 CD38 抑制劑）結合時，其功效增強。

label: HIF-2α
description: SIRT7 inhibits HIF-2α, similar to its HIF-1α opposition.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 抑制 HIF-2α，類似於其對 HIF-1α 的對抗作用。

label: Busulfan
description: Bifunctional busulfan forms guanine-N7 interstrand crosslinks triggering DDR. Damage is the upstream lesion.
description_zh_TW: 雙功能 busulfan 形成鳥嘌呤 N7 鏈間交聯觸發 DDR。損傷是上游病變。

label: Preiss-Handler Pathway
description: The Preiss-Handler pathway is the de novo biosynthesis route to NAD+, converting tryptophan or niacin into NAD+ through a sequence culminating in the ATP-dependent condensation of quinolinate with phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate. It provides the essential redox and signaling cofactor NAD+.
description_zh_TW: Preiss-Handler 途徑是到 NAD+ 的從頭生合成途徑，將色胺酸或菸鹼酸經由以喹啉酸與磷酸核糖焦磷酸之 ATP 依賴縮合告終的序列轉化為 NAD+。它提供必需的氧化還原與訊號輔因子 NAD+。

label: SLC25A51
source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md
description: Mitochondrial NAD+ is maintained separately from the rapidly equilibrating nuclear/cytosolic pool and can be imported via the SLC25A51 transporter. Together with a reported mitochondrial PARP1 pool, this suggests PARP1 hyperactivation may also deplete mitochondrial NAD+ and shape parthanatos execution (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: 粒線體 NAD+ 與快速平衡的核/胞質池分開維持，可經 SLC25A51 轉運蛋白輸入。加上據報導存在的粒線體 PARP1 池，這提示 PARP1 過度活化亦可能耗竭粒線體 NAD+ 並影響 parthanatos 執行（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Sotorasib
description: Sotorasib covalently occupies the KRAS G12C switch-II pocket, locking the GDP state.
description_zh_TW: Sotorasib 共價佔據 KRAS G12C switch-II 口袋，鎖定 GDP 狀態。

label: Starvation
description: Starvation is the strongest physiological inducer of autophagy. Induction is the fasting-to-clearance coupling.
description_zh_TW: 飢餓是最強的自噬生理誘發因子。誘發是禁食到清除的耦合。

label: Honeybee venom
description: Honeybee venom is a complex mixture whose major peptide component is melittin (~50% of dry weight), the principal anticancer effector.
description_zh_TW: Honeybee venom 是複雜混合物，其主要胜肽成分為 melittin（約佔乾重 50%），是主要的抗癌效應物。

label: Z-VAD-FMK
description: Necroptosis was first recognized when TNFα was given together with the pan-caspase inhibitor zVAD-fmk: eliminating the apoptosis branch unmasks RIPK3-dependent necrosis; in the TNF-shock model zVAD-fmk accelerates death from 48 h to 24 h.
description_zh_TW: Necroptosis 最初是在 TNFα 與廣效性 Caspase 抑制劑 zVAD-fmk 併用時被發現：消除凋亡分支後顯露 RIPK3 依賴性壞死；在 TNF 休克模型中 zVAD-fmk 將死亡時間由 48 小時縮短為 24 小時。

label: Sepsis
description: The role of necroptosis in sepsis remains open: cecal-ligation-and-puncture (CLP) studies conflict (Nec-1 protective in one report, accelerating in others) and RIPK3-/MLKL-deficient mice show no benefit.
description_zh_TW: Necroptosis 在敗血症之角色仍未有定論：盲腸結紮穿刺（CLP）模式之研究結果相互矛盾（一篇報告 Nec-1 具保護作用，其他則顯示加速），而 RIPK3/MLKL 缺失小鼠未見獲益。

label: Glutathione S-Transferase
description: Urolithin A, a gut-microbiome metabolite of ellagitannins, is associated with antioxidant responses that involve phase II enzymes including glutathione S-transferases. GST activity contributes to the detoxification and redox-buffering program engaged by such polyphenol metabolites.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 是鞣花單寧的腸道微生物代謝物，與涉及包括穀胱甘肽 S-轉移酶在內之第二相酶的抗氧化反應相關。GST 活性有助於此類多酚代謝物啟動的解毒與氧化還原緩衝程式。

label: MTHFR
description: Methylfolate is produced from reduced tetrahydrofolate by the final enzyme methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR), which adds a methyl group at the N5 position. Unlike folic acid, 5-MTHF requires no reductive activation and is directly usable. This is why it is the preferred supplemental form in individuals with MTHFR impairments.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate 由最終酶 methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR) 從還原的四氫葉酸產生，該酶在 N5 位置添加甲基。與葉酸不同，5-MTHF 不需要還原活化且可直接使用。這就是為什麼它是 MTHFR 功能受損個體的首選補充形式。

label: Cilengitide
description: Cilengitide antagonizes alphav-beta3/beta5 integrins at the ligand pocket.
description_zh_TW: Cilengitide 在配體口袋拮抗 αvβ3/β5 integrin。

label: VEGF Family
description: The VEGF family canonically drives blood-vessel formation.
description_zh_TW: VEGF 家族典型驅動血管形成。

label: Kinase Inhibitor
description: Because kinases sit inside densely wired signaling networks, kinase inhibition can produce non-monotonic (hormetic) dose responses rather than clean sigmoidal curves. The network-topology basis of an incoherent bivalent motif explains these inverted-U effects.
description_zh_TW: 由於激酶位於密集連接的訊號網路內，激酶抑制可產生非單調（毒物興奮）劑量反應，而非乾淨的 S 型曲線。不一致雙價模體的網路拓撲基礎解釋這些倒 U 型效應。

label: IC50
description: IC50 is defined for a monotonic sigmoidal dose-response curve as its inflection point, and is inapplicable to non-monotonic (hormetic) biphasic curves. In a hormetic curve the slope changes sign, so there is no single inflection point and IC50 is ill-defined.
description_zh_TW: IC50 是針對單調 S 型劑量-反應曲線定義為其反曲點，不適用於非單調（毒物興奮）雙相曲線。在毒物興奮曲線中斜率改變符號，因此沒有單一反曲點，IC50 無法明確定義。

label: FYN
description: FYN is a Src-family tyrosine kinase alongside SRC and LYN.
description_zh_TW: FYN 是與 SRC 和 LYN 並列的 Src 家族酪胺酸激酶。

label: c-FLIP
description: c-FLIP, structurally related to but catalytically inactive as a homodimer partner, pairs with Caspase-8 to block apoptosis; when Caspase-8 or c-FLIP is lost or its activation interrupted, RIPK1 complexes with RIPK3 to assemble the necrosome — the FADD–caspase-8–c-FLIP complex acts as the rheostat that suppresses RIPK3-mediated death.
description_zh_TW: c-FLIP 與 Caspase-8 結構相近但具催化惰性，與 Caspase-8 配對以阻斷凋亡；當 Caspase-8 或 c-FLIP 缺失、或其中斷活化時，RIPK1 與 RIPK3 複合組裝成 necrosome——FADD–caspase-8–c-FLIP 複合物即為抑制 RIPK3 媒介死亡的調節器。

label: Glycemic Control
description: Regular physical exercise has beneficial effects on glycemic control, and because AGE formation is accelerated by hyperglycemia, improved glycemic control attenuates the formation and accumulation of AGEs in tissues. Exercise benefits diabetic patients by improving glycemic control, and physical activity reduces AGE accumulation in diabetic patients and during aging. The higher energy demands of exercise may also reduce the pool of reactive intermediates available for glycation. Together with its antioxidant effects, glycemic control is a major mechanism by which exercise reduces AGE burden.
description_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動對血糖控制具有有益的效果，而由於高血糖會加速 AGE 的形成，改善血糖控制可減緩組織中 AGEs 的形成與堆積。運動透過改善血糖控制使糖尿病患者受益，且身體活動可減少糖尿病患者體內及老化過程中的 AGE 堆積。運動較高的能量需求也可能減少可用於糖化的反應性中間產物的庫存。結合其抗氧化作用，血糖控制是運動減輕 AGE 負擔的主要機制。

label: Total Daily Energy Expenditure
description: Resting metabolic rate (RMR) is the rate at which the body consumes energy while at rest, and it is the single largest component of total daily energy expenditure (TEE), typically accounting for about 60-70 percent of daily energy use. It is measured under standardized conditions of rest, thermal neutrality, and a fasting state. Because RMR dominates total daily energy expenditure, any change in RMR, such as the transient elevation caused by exercise, has a disproportionate impact on overall energy balance and, over time, on body weight regulation. The review by Speakman focuses on how exercise-induced alterations in RMR influence energy balance.
description_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率（RMR）是身體在休息時消耗能量的速率，它是每日總能量消耗（TEE）中最大的單一組成部分，通常佔每日能量使用量的約60-70%。它在休息、熱中性和禁食狀態的標準化條件下測量。由於RMR主導每日總能量消耗，RMR的任何變化，如運動引起的短暫升高，都會對整體能量平衡產生不相稱的影響，並隨時間影響體重調節。Speakman的綜述專注於運動引起的RMR變化如何影響能量平衡。

label: Epilepsy
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: SIRT3 protects against kainic acid excitotoxicity via miR-134-5p inhibition in epilepsy. Alongside SIRT1 and SIRT5, SIRT3 constitutes a neuroprotective axis against seizure-related neuronal damage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在癲癇中透過抑制 miR-134-5p 來保護海人酸（kainic acid）興奮毒性。與 SIRT1 及 SIRT5 並列，SIRT3 構成對抗癲癇相關神經元損傷的神經保護軸。

label: ASF1a
description: ASF1a is an upstream histone H3–H4 chaperone that hands off dimers to the HIRA complex for replication-independent deposition. Together with HIRA and UBN1 it is a core member of the chaperone complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci.
description_zh_TW: ASF1a 是上游的組蛋白 H3–H4 伴護蛋白，將二聚體交給 HIRA 複合體進行非複製依賴的沉積。它與 HIRA 及 UBN1 同為形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需的伴護蛋白複合體核心成員。

label: UBN1
description: UBN1 is an essential, dedicated subunit of the HIRA histone chaperone complex, with an N-terminal domain that binds HIRA. Together with HIRA and ASF1a, it mediates replication-independent deposition of H3.3.
description_zh_TW: UBN1 是 HIRA 組蛋白伴護蛋白複合體的必需專屬亞基，其 N 端結構域結合 HIRA。它與 HIRA 及 ASF1a 一起介導 H3.3 的非複製依賴沉積。

label: muscle protein synthesis
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Accumulating evidence suggests that urolithin A may promote muscle protein synthesis and muscle growth through various pathways. It can increase the rate of protein synthesis within muscle cells while inhibiting protein degradation processes, allowing muscle cells to more effectively synthesize new proteins and maintain muscle mass. This anabolic action, combined with enhanced mitochondrial function and energy metabolism, supports muscle hypertrophy, the maintenance of muscle mass, and improved recovery after exercise.
description_zh_TW: 累積證據顯示 urolithin A 可能透過多種路徑促進肌肉蛋白合成與肌肉生長。它可提升肌肉細胞內蛋白質合成速率，同時抑制蛋白降解過程，使肌肉細胞能更有效地合成新蛋白並維持肌肉量。此合成代謝作用，結合增強的粒線體功能與能量代謝，支持肌肉肥大、肌肉量的維持，以及運動後更佳的恢復。

label: Clonal Hematopoiesis
description: DNMT3a-mutant clones are frequently detectable in preleukemic states, linking age-associated clonal hematopoiesis to overt acute myeloid leukemia. These clones can persist in the bone marrow years before diagnosis and survive chemotherapy, seeding relapse. Clonal hematopoiesis is thus a precursor state for AML.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3a 突變克隆常在前白血病狀態中可被偵測到，將年齡相關的克隆性造血與明顯的急性骨髓性白血病連結起來。這些克隆可在診斷前數年持續存在於骨髓中，並在化療後存活，播下復發的種子。因此克隆性造血是 AML 的前驅狀態。

label: mTOR Inhibitor
description: Suppressed mTOR relieves inhibition of autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis via TFEB, promoting cellular cleanup. mTOR inhibition is thus a canonical inducer of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: 抑制的 mTOR 解除對自噬與溶酶體生合成的抑制（經由 TFEB），促進細胞清理。因此 mTOR 抑制是自噬的典型誘導者。

label: IGF-1
description: Caloric restriction lowers systemic IGF-1 growth signaling, an autophagy-independent longevity arm. Reduced IGF-1 relieves pro-growth drive across tissues.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制降低全身性 IGF-1 生長訊號，是不依賴自噬的長壽臂。降低的 IGF-1 緩解跨組織的促生長驅動。

label: Common Pathway
description: Apoptosis converges at Common Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The common execution phase of apoptosis is the point at which all initiation routes converge on effector caspases that proteolyze the cellular proteome. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Common Pathway rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 收斂於 Common Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的共同執行階段是所有起始途徑匯聚到效應器半胱天冬酶上的點，該效應器半胱天冬酶對細胞蛋白質組進行蛋白質分解。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Common Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: UHRF1
description: UHRF1 recognizes hemi-methylated CpG via its SRA domain to recruit DNMT1. Active-voice inverse of the existing recruited_by edge; novel pair.
description_zh_TW: UHRF1 經由 SRA 結構域辨識半甲基化 CpG 以招募 DNMT1。既有 recruited_by 邊的主動語態反向；新穎配對。

label: Biological Age
description: Epigenetic clocks are the operational estimator of biological age.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳時鐘是生物年齡的操作性估計器。

label: Lamin B1
description: Lamin B1 is lost in senescence as LMNB1 expression declines, detaching lamina-associated domains from the nuclear periphery and reorganizing chromatin architecture. This structural remodeling contributes to altered gene expression and the spatial redistribution of heterochromatin, including the formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci. Lamin B1 loss is a relatively conserved marker of senescence across species and cell types, and it correlates with persistent DNA damage and genomic instability in arrested cells. The decline is driven by both transcriptional repression and proteolytic degradation and precedes full establishment of the senescent phenotype.
description_zh_TW: Lamin B1 隨 LMNB1 表現下降而在衰老中喪失，使核膜相關區域從核周邊脫離並重組染色質架構。此結構重塑貢獻改變的基因表現與異染色質的空間重新分布，包括衰老相關異染色質焦點的形成。Lamin B1 喪失是跨物種與細胞類型相對保守的衰老標記，並與停滯細胞中持續 DNA 損傷與基因組不穩定相關。此下降由轉錄抑制與蛋白水解降解驅動，並先於衰老表型的完全建立。

label: H2A.X
description: DNA-SCARS are persistent nuclear foci of unresolved DNA damage that are enriched in phosphorylated gamma-H2A.X (H2A.X). They sustain the DNA-damage response that maintains senescence growth arrest and promotes SASP cytokine secretion.
description_zh_TW: DNA-SCARS 是未解決 DNA 損傷的持久性核焦點，富含磷酸化的 γ-H2A.X（H2A.X）。它們維持維持衰老生長停滯並促進 SASP 細胞激素分泌的 DNA 損傷反應。

label: Tyrosinase-related protein-1
description: Oculocutaneous Albinism type 3 (OCA3), also called rufous or red albinism, is due to mutations in TYRP1 (9p23) encoding Tyrosinase-related protein-1. This melanosomal enzyme is involved in eumelanin synthesis. It is most common in individuals of African or Puerto Rican descent.
description_zh_TW: Oculocutaneous Albinism 第 3 型（OCA3），也稱為紅褐色或紅色白化症，由編碼 Tyrosinase-related protein-1 的 TYRP1（9p23）突變引起。這種 melanosomal 酶參與 eumelanin 合成。它在非洲或波多黎各裔人群中最常見。

label: Tyrosinase-related protein-2
description: TRP-2 directs eumelanin synthesis as a dopachrome tautomerase family enzyme, paralleling the DCT production edge under its alias subject. Enzymatic activity channels pigment toward dark polymer.
description_zh_TW: TRP-2 作為 dopachrome tautomerase 家族酶指導 eumelanin 合成，在其別名主詞下與 DCT 產生邊平行。酶活性將色素導向深色聚合物。

label: Topoisomerase I
description: Camptothecin traps the Topo I-DNA cleavage complex as the class mechanism. Complements the existing FL118-Topo-I edge.
description_zh_TW: Camptothecin 捕獲 Topo I-DNA 切割複合體作為類別機制。補充既有的 FL118-Topo-I 邊。

label: Ryanodine Receptor
description: Chronic ryanodine receptor leak elevates cytosolic Ca2+ and can drive mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and opening of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. RyR thus sits upstream of mitochondrial calcium and redox balance linking to MPTP-mediated cell death.
description_zh_TW: 慢性 ryanodine 受體滲漏升高細胞質 Ca2+，可驅動粒線體 Ca2+ 超載與粒線體通透性轉換孔道開啟。因此 RyR 位於粒線體鈣與氧化還原平衡的上游，與 MPTP 介導的細胞死亡相連結。

label: MICU2
description: MICU1 and MICU2 are regulatory subunits of the mitochondrial calcium uniporter complex. MICU1 endows the uniporter with a steep threshold response, while MICU2 reinforces pore closure at rest, and they act cooperatively to prevent pathological matrix Ca2+ overload.
description_zh_TW: MICU1 與 MICU2 是粒線體鈣單向轉運體複合體的調控亞基。MICU1 賦予轉運體陡峭的閾值反應，MICU2 則在靜止時強化孔道關閉，兩者合作防止病理性基質 Ca2+ 超載。

label: MFF
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: MFF (mitochondrial fission factor) is an outer mitochondrial membrane adaptor protein that recruits DRP1 to the mitochondria to initiate fission. Its role is relatively simple: MFF overexpression enhances mitochondrial fragmentation, whereas low MFF expression inhibits DRP1 anchoring to the mitochondria and results in elongated mitochondria. MFF physically interacts with the MID proteins within a DRP1 complex, and MFF appears uniquely related to symmetrical mitochondrial fission, whereas FIS1 is involved in asymmetrical fission. MFF is upregulated in heart failure and pulmonary diseases where excessive fission predominates.
description_zh_TW: MFF（線粒體分裂因子）是一種外線粒體膜接頭蛋白，可招募 DRP1 到線粒體以啟動分裂。其作用相對簡單：MFF 過表達增強線粒體 fragment，而低 MFF 表達抑制 DRP1 錨定到線粒體，導致線粒體 elongated。MFF 與 DRP1 複合體中的 MID 蛋白 physically interacts，且 MFF 似乎 uniquely related to symmetrical mitochondrial fission，而 FIS1 參與 asymmetrical fission。MFF 在 heart failure 和 pulmonary diseases 中 upregulated，其中 excessive fission predominates。

label: T Lymphocyte
description: Thymopoiesis is the process by which T cell development, maturation and induction of self-tolerance occur in the thymic epithelial space. Lymphoid progenitors enter the thymus at the cortico-medullary junction, migrate to the outer cortex for early development and TCR gene rearrangement and positive selection, then return to the medulla for negative selection before export to the periphery. Reduction of functional thymopoiesis with aging results in loss of TCR gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺生成是 T 細胞發育、成熟和自身耐受誘導在胸腺上皮空間中發生的過程。淋巴祖細胞在皮髓交界處進入胸腺，遷移至外皮質進行早期發育和 TCR 基因重排及陽性選擇，然後返回髓質進行陰性選擇，最後輸出至外周。隨著年齡增長，功能性胸腺生成的減弱導致 TCR 基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。

label: Cholangiocarcinoma
description: Cholangiocarcinoma is a malignancy of the bile-duct epithelium (adenocarcinoma).
description_zh_TW: Cholangiocarcinoma 是膽管上皮的惡性腫瘤（腺癌）。

label: Biphasic Dose-Response Curve
description: IC50 is defined for a monotonic sigmoidal dose-response curve as its inflection point, and is inapplicable to non-monotonic (hormetic) biphasic curves. In a hormetic curve the slope changes sign, so there is no single inflection point and IC50 is ill-defined.
description_zh_TW: IC50 是針對單調 S 型劑量-反應曲線定義為其反曲點，不適用於非單調（毒物興奮）雙相曲線。在毒物興奮曲線中斜率改變符號，因此沒有單一反曲點，IC50 無法明確定義。

label: TSC
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: In tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC), where mTOR pathway hyperactivation is a hallmark due to variants in TSC1 or TSC2, rapamycin prevents seizures, reduces mortality, and rescues neuropathology including glial proliferation and disrupted cortical architecture in mouse models. In the EXIST-3 phase III trial, adjunctive everolimus significantly reduced seizure frequency in treatment-resistant epilepsy due to TSC, with about 40% of high-dose patients achieving at least 50% seizure reduction versus 15% placebo, leading to regulatory approval.
description_zh_TW: 在結節性硬化症（TSC）中，由於TSC1或TSC2變異，mTOR通路過度激活是一個標誌，rapamycin在小鼠模型中預防癲癇、降低死亡率並挽救神經病理學，包括膠質增生和皮質結構破壞。在EXIST-3 III期試驗中，輔助everolimus顯著降低了TSC引起的治療抵抗性癲癇的發作頻率，約40%的高劑量患者達到至少50%的癲癇減少，而安慰劑組為15%，從而獲得監管批准。

label: Xp11 translocation RCC
description: Xp11 translocation RCC is a renal cell carcinoma subtype.
description_zh_TW: Xp11 易位 RCC 是腎細胞癌亞型。

label: CDK4
description: Cyclin D1 is the catalytic partner of CDK4 driving Rb phosphorylation and G1 progression.
description_zh_TW: Cyclin D1 是 CDK4 的催化夥伴，驅動 Rb 磷酸化與 G1 進展。

label: DNA-PKcs
description: DNA-PKcs executes NHEJ repair downstream of SIRT6 mobilization. Maintenance is the end-joining output.
description_zh_TW: DNA-PKcs 在 SIRT6 動員下游執行 NHEJ 修復。維持是末端連接輸出。

label: Drosha
description: DGCR8 and Drosha are substrate-recognition and catalytic partners of the Microprocessor, documented by RNAi and co-IP. Interaction is the complex assembly.
description_zh_TW: DGCR8 與 Drosha 是 Microprocessor 的受質辨識與催化夥伴，RNAi 與 co-IP 已記載。交互作用是複合體組裝。

label: CYP3A4
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: Berberine is a clinically relevant inhibitor of the drug-metabolizing enzyme CYP3A4 (along with CYP2D6 and P-glycoprotein), elevating plasma levels of co-administered CYP3A4 substrates such as certain statins, cyclosporine, and warfarin; because Fisetin is itself a CYP3A4 substrate and partial inhibitor, berberine-fisetin co-administration may mutually raise exposure, warranting temporal dose separation pending dedicated interaction trials.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 是具臨床意義的藥物代謝酶 CYP3A4 抑制劑（兼抑制 CYP2D6 與 P-glycoprotein），會墊高併用 CYP3A4 受質（如特定 statins、cyclosporine、warfarin）的血漿濃度；因 Fisetin 本身亦為 CYP3A4 受質兼部分抑制劑，兩者併用可能相互墊高暴露量，在專門交互作用試驗完成前宜分時給藥。

label: Neural Stem Cell
description: Neural stem cells yield radial-glial and intermediate progenitors. Generation is the lineage output of the stem pool.
description_zh_TW: 神經幹細胞產生放射狀膠質與中間祖細胞。產生是幹細胞池的譜系輸出。

label: NAAD
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: In response to nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation, a remarkable increase (45-fold) in nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide (NAAD) was reported in a study with male human subjects and C57Bl6/J mice, indicating an additional conversion pathway of NR to NAD+. NAAD represents the most sensitive biomarker of effective NAD+ supplementation since it is undetectable in the blood prior to supplementation and its levels increase in the liver after orally administered NAD+ precursors. NR could also significantly elevate NAAD heart content, where the increase of NAD+ occurs in the absence of a steady-state NAD+ increase, and NR increased NAAD by at least 45-fold compared to baseline.
description_zh_TW: 在對 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充的反應中，一項針對男性人類受試者與 C57Bl6/J 小鼠的研究報導了 nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide（NAAD，菸鹼酸腺嘌呤二核苷酸）的顯著增加（45 倍），顯示 NR 轉化為 NAD+ 的額外路徑。NAAD 代表了有效 NAD+ 補充最敏感的生物標記，因為它在補充前於血液中無法偵測，且其水平在口服 NAD+ 前驅物後於肝臟中上升。NR 亦能顯著提升心臟中的 NAAD 含量，其中 NAD+ 的增加發生於缺乏穩態 NAD+ 增加的情況下，且 NR 相較於基線將 NAAD 提升了至少 45 倍。

label: Topologically Associating Domain
description: Cohesin-CTCF loop extrusion organizes TAD compartments. Full canonical name used to avoid a TAD node split.
description_zh_TW: Cohesin-CTCF 環擠出組織 TAD 區室。使用完整典型名稱以免 TAD 節點分裂。

label: Glycine
description: Glycine is the third residue of the gamma-glutamyl-cysteinyl-glycine tripeptide and becomes rate-limiting for glutathione synthesis under metabolic stress, aging, and methylglyoxal overload.
description_zh_TW: 甘胺酸是 γ-麩胺醯-半胱胺醯-甘胺酸三肽的第三個殘基，在代謝壓力、老化與甲基乙二醛過載下成為穀胱甘肽合成的限速因子。

label: Terminal Differentiation
description: Terminal identity opposes the undifferentiated pluripotent ground state. Opposition separates endpoints from origins.
description_zh_TW: 終末身份對立未分化的多能性基態。對立將終點與起源分開。

label: Mevalonate pathway
description: The substrate for FSP1 — ubiquinone/CoQ10 — is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway. Perturbations that suppress mevalonate output toward cholesterol (e.g., statins / HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, or squalene-synthase engagement by FIN56) starve FSP1 of its ubiquinone substrate, collapsing the FSP1 axis and predicting ferroptosis sensitivity. This makes the mevalonate pathway intersect ferroptosis at two nodes: selenocysteine-tRNA maturation for GPX4 and CoQ10 supply for FSP1.
description_zh_TW: FSP1 的受質——泛醌/CoQ10——是甲羥戊酸（mevalonate）路徑的非固醇產物。抑制甲羥戊酸流向膽固醇的擾動（例如 statins / 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，或 FIN56 啟動角鯊烯合酶）會使 FSP1 缺乏泛醌受質，瓦解 FSP1 軸並預示鐵死亡敏感性。這使甲羥戊酸路徑在兩個節點與鐵死亡交會：GPX4 所需的硒半胱氨酸-tRNA 成熟，以及 FSP1 所需的 CoQ10 供應。

label: PINK1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: PINK1 stabilization on depolarized mitochondria initiates Parkin-mediated mitophagy. Activation is the damage-sensing entry.
description_zh_TW: PINK1 在去極化粒線體穩定啟動 Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬。活化是損傷感知進入。

label: CD8 T cells
description: Low-dose mTORC1 inhibition by rapamycin increases CD8+ memory T-cell counts and dendritic cell activity, improving immune responses to infection and vaccination. This low-dose immunostimulatory effect contrasts with the immunosuppression seen at higher doses.
description_zh_TW: 低劑量 rapamycin 抑制 mTORC1 會增加 CD8+ 記憶 T 細胞數量與樹突細胞活性，改善對感染與疫苗的免疫反應。此低劑量免疫刺激作用與高劑量時的免疫抑制形成對比。

label: PGAM5
description: PGAM5 activated by RIPK3 phosphorylation dephosphorylates Drp1, promoting mitochondrial fission in ischemia-reperfusion and neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: 經RIPK3磷酸化活化的PGAM5去磷酸化Drp1，促進粒線體分裂，見於缺血再灌注損傷與神經退化性疾病。

label: Curcumin
description: Curcumin has below one percent oral bioavailability, mirroring the fisetin formulation problem. Low bioavailability gates translation.
description_zh_TW: Curcumin 口服生體可用率低於百分之一，呼應 fisetin 配方問題。低可用率門控轉譯。

label: GATA4
description: SIRT7 ameliorates stress-induced cardiac hypertrophy by deacetylating the transcription factor GATA4. This protective action contrasts with SIRT7's pro-fibrotic role in cardiac fibrosis, where enhanced expression promotes fibrosis via Smad2/ERK signaling. The same nucleolar sirtuin therefore has divergent, context-dependent cardiovascular effects.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過去乙醯化轉錄因子 GATA4 改善壓力誘發的心臟肥大。此保護作用與 SIRT7 在心臟纖維化中的促纖維化角色形成對比，後者中增強的表現透過 Smad2/ERK 訊號促進纖維化。同一核仁 sirtuin 因此具有分歧、情境依賴的心血管效應。

label: CDK2
source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md
description: SIRT1 promotes T-ALL progression by deacetylating CDK2, which drives p27 phosphorylation and degradation, and SIRT1 knockdown sensitizes AML to tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment. SIRT2 activation by NAMPT reduces proliferation and induces apoptosis in AML blasts via the Akt/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin axis, showing opposing leukemic roles for the two sirtuins.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 CDK2 促進 T-ALL 進展，後者驅動 p27 磷酸化與降解，且 SIRT1 敲低使 AML 對酪胺酸激酶抑制劑治療敏感。SIRT2 經由 NAMPT 活化透過 Akt/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin 軸減少增生並誘發 AML 母細胞凋亡，顯示兩個 sirtuin 相反的白血病角色。

label: Beta-Oxidation
description: PPAR-alpha is the master regulator of lipid beta-oxidation metabolism. Regulation is the lipid-program control.
description_zh_TW: PPAR-alpha 是脂質 β 氧化代謝的主調控者。調節是脂質程序控制。

label: Thioredoxin-2
description: Mitochondrial thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) donates electrons to reduce the oxidized (disulfide) form of peroxiredoxin 3 (Prx3), restoring its peroxide-scavenging activity. Trx2 is itself recycled to the reduced form by mitochondrial thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD2) using NADPH. Because Prx3 consumes the H2O2 generated by MnSOD, the Trx2/Prx3 arm is the water-evolving half of the mitochondrial peroxide-relay and a direct functional partner of MnSOD in the matrix.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體 thioredoxin-2（Trx2）捐贈電子以還原 peroxiredoxin 3（Prx3）的氧化態（雙硫）形式，恢復其過氧化物清除活性。Trx2 本身再由粒線體 thioredoxin reductase（TXNRD2）以 NADPH 回收為還原形式。由於 Prx3 消耗 MnSOD 所產生的 H2O2，Trx2/Prx3 分支是粒線體過氧化物接力中產生水的半段，也是 MnSOD 在基質中的直接功能夥伴。

label: LDHB
description: Hyperactivated LDHB shifts lactate/pyruvate balance into metabolic stress that drives excessive non-canonical autophagy feeding tumor cells. This SIRT5-LDHB axis output links glycolysis to tumor-supporting autophagy.
description_zh_TW: 過度活化的 LDHB 改變乳酸/丙酮酸平衡進入代謝壓力，驅動供養腫瘤細胞的過度非典型自噬。此 SIRT5-LDHB 軸輸出將糖解連結到促腫瘤自噬。

label: MAX
description: N-Myc obligately heterodimerizes with MAX for DNA binding.
description_zh_TW: N-Myc 與 MAX 專性異二聚化以結合 DNA。

label: Oxygen-Glucose Deprivation
description: OGD reduced retinal cell viability at 3, 6, and 24 h, modeling ischemia-induced oxidative stress. Co-treatment with 10 uM Brosimine B restored viability at 3 h (107%) and partially at 6 h, but not at 24 h. The protection is therefore time-limited to early hypoxia.
description_zh_TW: OGD 在 3、6、24 小時均降低視網膜細胞存活率，模擬缺血引起的氧化壓力。10 uM Brosimine B 共處理在 3 小時恢復存活率（107%），6 小時部分恢復，24 小時則無效。因此其保護作用僅限於早期缺氧階段。

label: NRK2
description: FOLFIRI downregulates muscle Nrk2 by 84 percent, detectable 24 hours post-dose.
description_zh_TW: FOLFIRI 下調肌肉 Nrk2 達 84%，給藥 24 小時可測。

label: A1-Bfl-1
description: A1-Bfl-1 is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member.
description_zh_TW: A1-Bfl-1 是抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族成員。

label: TGF-β
description: Beyond SIRT1, SMURF2's canonical function is negative regulation of TGF-β/BMP signaling: as a HECT-domain E3 ligase it ubiquitinates SMAD proteins and SMAD7-bound receptor complexes, shaping the strength and duration of the pathway. This dual identity — SMAD regulator and SIRT1 E3 — makes SMURF2 a node where developmental signaling and sirtuin-controlled stress metabolism intersect.
description_zh_TW: 除了 SIRT1 之外，SMURF2 的典型功能是對 TGF-β/BMP 訊號的負向調節：作為 HECT 結構域的 E3 連接酶，它會泛素化 SMAD 蛋白及與 SMAD7 結合的受體複合體，從而塑造路徑的強度與持續時間。這種雙重身份——SMAD 調節者與 SIRT1 的 E3——使 SMURF2 成為發育訊號與 sirtuin 控制的壓力代謝相互交會的節點。

label: SOX gene family
description: Sox2 is the prototypical pluripotency member of the SOX HMG-box family. Membership anchors the family to reprogramming.
description_zh_TW: Sox2 是 SOX HMG-box 家族典型的多能性成員。成員關係將家族錨定到重編程。

label: Pancreatic Cancer
description: PDAC is the dominant histology within the pancreatic cancer parent category.
description_zh_TW: PDAC 是胰臟癌母類中的主要組織學。

label: Glutamine metabolism
description: SIRT4 inhibits glutamine metabolism by suppressing GDH-dependent anaplerosis, acting as a tumor suppressor in colorectal and other cancers that depend on glutamine; this restrains the glutamine addiction of proliferating cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制 GDH 依賴性的回補反應來抑制穀胺酸代謝，在依賴穀胺酸的結直腸癌和其他癌症中作為腫瘤抑制因子；這抑制了增殖細胞對穀胺酸的成癮性。

label: Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Monoamine oxidase inhibitors block the intracellular mitochondrial enzyme that oxidatively deaminates dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine. Because MAO-mediated deamination is one of the dominant routes of catecholamine breakdown, inhibition raises catecholamine concentrations and can produce cardiovascular and autonomic effects such as higher blood pressure and heart rate. In combination with COMT inhibition, MAO inhibition strongly reduces overall catecholamine degradation, and the resulting excess epinephrine has more opportunity to undergo autoxidation or radical-mediated conversion to adrenochrome. Such combinations are used in Parkinson's disease under medical supervision but carry risks of hypertensive crisis with non-selective or high-dose use.
description_zh_TW: Monoamine oxidase 抑制劑阻斷氧化脫胺多巴胺、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 的細胞內粒線體酶。由於 MAO 介導的脫胺是兒茶酚胺分解的主要途徑之一，抑制會升高兒茶酚胺濃度，並可產生如血壓升高與心率加快等心血管與自主神經效應。與 COMT 抑制併用時，MAO 抑制強烈減少整體兒茶酚胺降解，所導致的過量 epinephrine 有更多機會經歷自氧化或自由基介導轉化為 adrenochrome。此類組合在醫療監督下用於帕金森氏症，但在非選擇性或高劑量使用時帶有高血壓危機的風險。

label: FOXO3
description: FOXO3 is a longevity-associated forkhead transcription factor regulated by acetylation. Note-canonical spelling kept; cross-file FOXO3a variance noted.
description_zh_TW: FOXO3 是受乙醯化調節的長壽相關叉頭轉錄因子。保留筆記典型拼寫；跨檔案 FOXO3a 差異已註記。

label: SMAD2
description: TGFBR1 phosphorylates receptor-SMAD SMAD2 as the primary transducer. Body text confirms this canonical activation.
description_zh_TW: TGFBR1 磷酸化受體 SMAD SMAD2 作為主要傳導器。內文確認此典型活化。

label: Diabetic Retinopathy
description: Diabetic retinopathy degeneration is linked to retinal NAD+ loss. Association records the metabolic retinopathy connection.
description_zh_TW: 糖尿病視網膜病變退化與視網膜 NAD+ 缺失相關。關聯記錄代謝性視網膜病變連結。

label: Trained Immunity
description: PI3K/Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling installs the aerobic-glycolysis (Warburg) program with increased glucose uptake and lactate that supports heightened cytokine output on rechallenge. Genetic or pharmacologic blockade of AKT, mTOR, or HIF-1alpha abrogates both the metabolic shift and trained cytokines in vitro and in vivo. BCG vaccination data corroborate elevated glycolytic flux under mTOR control.
description_zh_TW: PI3K/Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling 建立 aerobic-glycolysis（Warburg）程式，增加 glucose uptake 與 lactate，以支持再刺激時增強的細胞激素輸出。在 in vitro 與 in vivo 以基因或藥物阻斷 AKT、mTOR 或 HIF-1alpha，均可消除代謝轉換與訓練後的細胞激素。BCG vaccination 數據也證實在 mTOR 控制下 glycolytic flux 升高。

label: Chronic Kidney Disease
description: SIRT6 is markedly downregulated in chronic kidney disease and vascular calcification patients, and it suppresses osteogenic transdifferentiation of vascular smooth muscle cells via runt-related transcription factor 2. MSC exosomes inhibit high-phosphate aortic calcification through SIRT6-HMGB1 deacetylation, and proximal tubule-specific SIRT6 knockout aggravates UUO fibrosis. SIRT6 thereby protects the kidney and vasculature in CKD.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 在慢性腎病與血管鈣化患者中明顯下調，且它透過 runt-related transcription factor 2 抑制血管平滑肌細胞的成骨轉分化。MSC 外泌體透過 SIRT6-HMGB1 去乙醯化抑制高磷酸血 aortic 鈣化，且近曲小管專一性 SIRT6 基因敲除加劇 UUO 纖維化。SIRT6 因此保護 CKD 中的腎臟與血管。

label: Aminochrome
description: Aminochrome quinone-thiol chemistry depletes glutathione like the adrenochrome edge. Depletion is the thiol-drain mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 胺色素醌硫醇化學如腎上腺素邊耗竭穀胱甘肽。耗竭是硫醇流失機制。

label: Mesenchymal-to-Epithelial Transition
description: Mesenchymal fibroblasts must undergo epithelial transition to reach pluripotency.
description_zh_TW: 間質纖維母細胞必須經歷上皮轉換以達多能性。

label: Tau
description: SIRT1 reduces O-GlcNAcylation of tau via CREB in Alzheimer's disease, and SIRT3 plays a role in tau acetylation as a potential therapy target. SIRT2 affects tau phosphorylation and autophagic flux, and nuclear SIRT2 is hyperactivated in AD where FoxO1 recruits it to Fzd1/Fzd7 promoters to reduce H4K16ac.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在阿茲海默症中透過 CREB 減少 tau 的 O-GlcNAcylation，且 SIRT3 在 tau 乙醯化中扮演角色，作為潛在治療標的。SIRT2 影響 tau 磷酸化與自噬流，核 SIRT2 在 AD 中過度活化，其中 FoxO1 將其招募至 Fzd1/Fzd7 啟動子以降低 H4K16ac。

label: RRM2B
description: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM2B (p53R2) provides a p53-inducible small (beta-prime) subunit that partners with RRM1 to provision dNTPs for DNA repair and mitochondrial DNA synthesis. RRM2B mutations cause mitochondrial DNA depletion syndromes.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM2B（p53R2）提供受 p53 誘導的（beta-prime）小次單元，與 RRM1 配對以供應 DNA 修復與粒線體 DNA 合成所需的 dNTP。RRM2B 突變會導致粒線體 DNA 耗竭症候群。

label: Induced Neural Stem Cells
description: Direct lineage reprogramming converts somatic cells into induced neural stem cells.
description_zh_TW: 直接譜系重編程將體細胞轉化為誘導神經幹細胞。

label: Homologous Recombination
description: BRCA1 is essential for homologous-recombination repair of double-strand breaks via RAD51 loading. Requirement is the repair dependency.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 經由 RAD51 裝載為雙股斷裂同源重組修復所必需。必要性是修復依賴。

label: Nudix Hydrolases
source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md
description: Phosphodiesterases of the Nudix superfamily cleave free ADP-ribose at its phosphodiester bond, degrading it to AMP and ribose-5-phosphate; they can also leave a phosphoribose mark on ADP-ribosylated proteins in vitro (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: Nudix 超家族的磷酸二酯酶切割游離 ADP-ribose 的磷酸二酯鍵，將其降解為 AMP 與 ribose-5-phosphate；在體外亦可於 ADP-ribosylated 蛋白上留下 phosphoribose 標記（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Sas2p
description: Sas2p is a MYST-family histone acetyltransferase.
description_zh_TW: Sas2p 是 MYST 家族組蛋白乙醯轉移酶。

label: Chemical memory
description: Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Bik
description: Bik activates Bak. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. Bak is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector anchored at the mitochondrial outer membrane that cooperates with Bax to execute MOMP. The relationship is directional, with Bik acting as the operative agent upon Bak rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Bik 激活 Bak。 Bik 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，可直接活化 Bax/Bak，且本身受到致癌激酶訊號傳導的抑制。 Bak 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，錨定在粒線體外膜上，與 Bax 合作執行 MOMP。這種關係是有方向的，Bik 充當 Bak 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: DNA Replication
description: Sister chromatids are generated during S-phase genome duplication.
description_zh_TW: 姐妹染色單體在 S 期基因組複製產生。

label: Pembrolizumab
description: Pembrolizumab is the prototypical PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor.
description_zh_TW: Pembrolizumab 是典型的 PD-1 檢查點抑制劑。

label: Malondialdehyde
description: Lipid peroxidation produces malondialdehyde (MDA), a three-carbon dialdehyde arising from cyclization and fragmentation of peroxidized polyunsaturated fatty acids such as arachidonic acid. MDA is reactive and forms adducts with proteins and DNA, contributing to downstream toxicity. The directionality is membrane damage yielding a diffusible, immunogenic byproduct. A caveat is that MDA is one of many aldehyde products, so its measurement captures only part of the peroxidation burden. MDA forms under both physiological and pathological conditions and is the most commonly measured TBARS-based endpoint in redox research.
