description_zh_TW: Lipid peroxidation 產生 malondialdehyde (MDA)，一種三碳二醛，由過氧化 polyunsaturated fatty acids（例如花生四烯酸）環化和裂解產生。 MDA 具有反應性，可與 proteins 和 DNA 形成加合物，導致下游毒性。方向性是膜損傷，產生可擴散的免疫原性副產物。需要注意的是，MDA 是眾多醛類產品之一，因此其測量僅捕獲部分過氧化負擔。 MDA 在生理和病理條件下形成，是氧化還原研究中最常測量的基於 TBARS 的終點。

label: Reverse Electron Transport
description: Complex II (succinate dehydrogenase) oxidizes succinate and reduces ubiquinone; its product ubiquinol is the fuel that drives reverse electron transport when the membrane is highly polarized. Succinate accumulation during ischemia makes Complex II a key upstream driver of RET-derived ROS.
description_zh_TW: Complex II（琥珀酸脫氫酶）氧化琥珀酸並還原泛醌；其產物泛醇是膜高度極化時驅動反向電子傳遞（RET）的燃料。缺血期間的琥珀酸累積使 Complex II 成為 RET 來源 ROS 的關鍵上游驅動者。

label: Decitabine
description: Decitabine is a deoxyribose DNMT inhibitor in the same epidrug class as 5-Azacytidine. Classification parallels the 5-Azacytidine edge.
description_zh_TW: Decitabine 是與 5-Azacytidine 同屬表觀藥類別的去氧核糖 DNMT 抑制劑。歸類與 5-Azacytidine 邊平行。

label: PI3K/Akt
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: PI3K/AKT signaling regulates Sirt3 in various contexts, generally opposing SIRT3-mediated catabolic/mitochondrial programs (e.g., PI3K/AKT modulates Sirt3 in activated microglia); Table 3 lists PI3K/AKT among negative regulators of the SIRT3 pathway (PMID 37930585).
description_zh_TW: PI3K/AKT 信號在多種環境中調節 Sirt3，通常拮抗 SIRT3 介導的分解代謝/粒線體程序（例如 PI3K/AKT 在活化的小膠質細胞中調節 Sirt3）；表 3 將 PI3K/AKT 列為 SIRT3 通路的負向調節因子（PMID 37930585）。

label: Ribonucleotide Reductase
description: Reduced thioredoxin-1 regenerates ribonucleotide reductase each turnover for dNTP synthesis. This textbook electron flow links redox tone to DNA synthesis capacity.
description_zh_TW: 還原型 thioredoxin-1 在每次周轉再生 ribonucleotide reductase 以合成 dNTP。此教科書電子流將氧化還原張力連結到 DNA 合成能力。

label: CRISPR
description: Gene editing is widely used in stem-cell models and isogenic lines.
description_zh_TW: 基因編輯廣泛用於幹細胞模型與同基因系。

label: Noise-Induced Hearing Loss
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Acoustic trauma generates reactive oxygen species driving cochlear hair-cell death; nicotinamide riboside prevents loss via SIRT3 antioxidant support. Oxidative injury is the pathogenic trigger.
description_zh_TW: 聲創傷產生超量活性氧驅動耳蝸毛細胞死亡；nicotinamide riboside 經 SIRT3 抗氧化支持防止缺失。氧化損傷是致病觸發。

label: Blastocyst
description: Embryonic stem cells derive from the blastocyst inner cell mass. Product relation roots ESCs in preimplantation development.
description_zh_TW: 胚胎幹細胞源自囊胚內細胞團。產物關係將 ESC 根植於著床前發育。

label: PIDD
description: PIDD activates Caspase-2. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with PIDD acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: PIDD 啟動 Caspase-2。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。這種關係是有方向的，PIDD 充當 Caspase-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Retinoblastoma Protein
description: Hypophosphorylated RB1 binds and represses E2F transcription factors in G1. This suppression withholds S-phase genes until CDK phosphorylation releases them.
description_zh_TW: 低磷酸化 RB1 在 G1 結合並抑制 E2F 轉錄因子。此抑制扣留 S 期基因，直到 CDK 磷酸化釋放它們。

label: Necrostatin-1
description: Nec-1 was later found to be identical to a previously reported indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase inhibitor, i.e. it blocks both RIPK1 and IDO — a caveat for interpreting Nec-1-based disease studies.
description_zh_TW: Nec-1 後來被發現與先前報導的 indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 抑制劑為同一化合物，即其同時抑制 RIPK1 與 IDO——解讀以 Nec-1 為基礎之疾病研究時必須注意的警訊。

label: Multidrug Resistance
description: Ivermectin inhibits P-gp plus MRP1/2/3 efflux pumps (Didier & Loor 1996), reversing multidrug resistance broadly. Superset of the existing P-gp-only edge.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 抑制 P-gp 及 MRP1/2/3 外排泵（Didier & Loor 1996），廣泛逆轉多重抗藥性。是既有 P-gp 邊的超集。

label: Neurogenesis
description: Neural stem cells sustain developmental and adult neurogenesis. Promotion is their defining tissue function.
description_zh_TW: 神經幹細胞維持發育與成年神經生成。促進是其定義性組織功能。

label: Prostate Cancer
description: Enzalutamide is approved for castration-resistant prostate cancer.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 獲准用於去勢抵抗性前列腺癌。

label: Monoamine oxidase
description: Methylene blue is a potent inhibitor of monoamine oxidase, specifically MAO-A. This MAO-A inhibition means that combining methylene blue with serotonergic medications - such as selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), or certain pain relievers - can cause a life-threatening accumulation of serotonin (serotonin syndrome). This drug-interaction risk is a critical safety consideration when methylene blue is used clinically, particularly in the perioperative or critical-care setting.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue是單胺氧化酶的強效抑制劑，特別是MAO-A。這種MAO-A抑制意味著將methylene blue與血清素能藥物——如選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRIs）、血清素-去甲腎上腺素再吸收抑制劑（SNRIs）或某些止痛藥——結合使用可能導致危及生命的血清素積累（血清素症候群）。當methylene blue在臨床上使用時，這種藥物相互作用風險是關鍵的安全考慮因素，特別是在圍手术期或重症護理環境中。

label: Natural Killer Cells
description: SASP chemokines including CCL2, CCL5, CXCL1, and CXCL10 act as find-me signals that recruit NK cells to sites of senescence, where they then kill the arrested cells. This recruitment converts the SASP into an immune-clearance stimulus, and the engagement is enhanced by type-I interferons from cGAS-STING. Declining NK function with age weakens this recruitment and clearance, contributing to senescent-cell accumulation. Enhancing NK recruitment and activation is therefore a strategy to restore senescence surveillance.
description_zh_TW: SASP 趨化因子包括 CCL2、CCL5、CXCL1 與 CXCL10 作為 find-me 訊號，招募 NK 細胞至衰老部位，隨後殺死停滯細胞。此招募將 SASP 轉化為免疫清除刺激，且此參與被 cGAS-STING 的第一型干擾素增強。隨年齡下降的 NK 功能減弱此招募與清除，貢獻衰老細胞累積。因此增強 NK 招募與活化是恢復衰老監視的策略。

label: Proto-lysosomal Tubules
description: Proto-lysosomal tubules are dynamic membrane extensions arising from endolysosomes during lysosome reformation. They represent an intermediate stage in recycling lysosomal membrane and content, ultimately giving rise to new proto-lysosomes that mature into functional lysosomes.
description_zh_TW: 原溶酶體小管（proto-lysosomal tubules）是溶酶體再形成期間由內吞溶酶體產生的動態膜延伸。它們是回收溶酶體膜與內容物的中間階段，最終產生成熟為功能性溶酶體的新原溶酶體。

label: CLEAR Network
description: The CLEAR network drives a coordinated lysosomal-autophagic transcriptional program that expands lysosomal capacity and autophagic throughput during stress. By upregulating lysosomal hydrolases and biogenesis genes it supports proteostasis and clearance of damaged organelles.
description_zh_TW: CLEAR 網路驅動協調的溶酶體-自噬轉錄程式，在壓力期間擴增溶酶體容量與自噬通量。透過上調溶酶體水解酶與生合成基因，它支持蛋白質恆定與受損胞器的清除。

label: Immune Aging
description: Autophagy-inducing interventions have been shown to rejuvenate features of adaptive immune aging, a process characterized by thymic involution, reduced naïve T cell output, and diminished responses to vaccination and infection. By clearing damaged mitochondria and improving proteostasis in lymphocytes, autophagy inducers restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance memory CD8+ T cell generation. Pharmacological or dietary activation of autophagy counteracts the functional defects that accumulate in immune cells with age. These effects position autophagy enhancement as a plausible strategy to mitigate immunosenescence.
description_zh_TW: 誘導自噬的介入已被證明可恢復適應性免疫老化的特徵，此過程以胸腺退化、初始T細胞產出減少以及對疫苗和感染的反應減弱為特徵。透過清除受損粒線體並改善淋巴細胞中的蛋白質穩態，自噬誘導劑恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成。藥理或飲食性活化自噬可抵消免疫細胞隨年齡累積的功能缺陷。這些效應將增強自噬定位為減緩免疫老化的合理策略。

label: Ventricular arrhythmias
description: Oxidative stress is a stated pro-arrhythmic driver, with resveratrol's anti-arrhythmic effect attributed partly to antioxidant action. Redox injury destabilizes cardiac electrophysiology.
description_zh_TW: 氧化壓力是既定的促心律失常驅動，resveratrol 的抗心律失常效應部分歸因於抗氧化作用。氧化還原損傷破壞心臟電生理穩定。

label: Statins
description: Statins such as atorvastatin (CEV/ATR) enhance inflammation-induced angiogenesis at low doses but inhibit tumor angiogenesis via endothelial apoptosis at high doses, significantly reducing lung tumor development. This biphasic pattern parallels metformin, resveratrol, and ionizing radiation effects within specific dose ranges. It illustrates hormetic anticancer mechanisms categorized by ROS-level modulation.
description_zh_TW: Statins 如 atorvastatin (CEV/ATR) 在低劑量促進發炎誘導的血管新生，在高劑量則經由內皮細胞凋亡抑制腫瘤血管新生，並顯著減少肺腫瘤發展。此雙相模式與特定劑量範圍內的 metformin、resveratrol 及游離輻射效應相似。這說明了以 ROS 水平調控分類的 hormetic 抗癌機制。

label: Sulfiredoxin
description: Sulfiredoxin (Srx/SRXN1) is the ATP-dependent enzyme that rescues hyperoxidized (sulfinylated) peroxiredoxin back to the active state, directly Nrf2-induced as feed-forward. Together with glutaredoxin it constitutes the reversible-repair machinery that turns moderate ROS into hormetic adaptation (memory) rather than irreversible collapse.
description_zh_TW: Sulfiredoxin（Srx/SRXN1）是 ATP 依賴性酵素，可將過度氧化（亞磺醯化）的過氧化還原酶救回活性態，本身受 Nrf2 誘導而具前饋作用。它與 glutaredoxin 共同構成可逆修復機械，使中等量 ROS 轉為荷爾蒙適應（記憶）而非不可逆崩潰。

label: Toxicity Testing
description: Toxicity testing is the pipeline stage that de-risks drug candidates.
description_zh_TW: 毒性測試是為候選藥物去風險的管線階段。

label: Sirtuin-Caspase Crosstalk
description: AGK2 liberates caspase-2/3-dependent apoptosis in nucleated cells, engaging sirtuin-caspase crosstalk. In platelets it instead triggers caspase-independent calpain-mediated death.
description_zh_TW: AGK2 在有核細胞中釋放依賴 caspase-2/3 的細胞凋亡，啟動 sirtuin-caspase 交互作用；而在血小板中則改為觸發不依賴 caspase 的 calpain 介導細胞死亡。

label: TBK1
description: Activated STING recruits TBK1, which autophosphorylates and then phosphorylates downstream substrates to initiate interferon and inflammatory transcription. In the SASP-induction scheme this is the step linking cGAMP generation to cytokine output, and it is a therapeutically attractive node because STING inhibitors act upstream of both the IRF3 and NF-kB arms. The recruitment is part of the canonical STING trafficking itinerary: after cGAMP binding, STING moves from the endoplasmic reticulum through the ERGIC, where TBK1 engagement and downstream signalling occur.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 STING 招募 TBK1，後者自體磷酸化並磷酸化下游受質，啟動干擾素與發炎轉錄。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，這是連結 cGAMP 生成與細胞激素輸出的步驟，也是具治療吸引力的節點，因為 STING 抑制劑作用於 IRF3 與 NF-kB 兩臂的上游。此招募是典型 STING 運輸路徑的一部分：結合 cGAMP 後，STING 由內質網經 ERGIC 移動，TBK1 的接合與下游訊號即在該處發生。

label: Dasatinib
description: Dasatinib is a multitargeted Src-family inhibitor covering LYN.
description_zh_TW: Dasatinib 是涵蓋 LYN 的多標靶 Src 家族抑制劑。

label: Platelet aggregation
description: Platelet aggregation is the process whereby activated platelets bind to one another through fibrinogen bridging the integrin receptor, forming the terminal common pathway of primary hemostasis. Activated platelets aggregate to form thrombi and support coagulation.
description_zh_TW: 血小板凝集是活化的血小板透過纖維蛋白原橋接整合素受體而彼此結合的過程，是初級止血的終末共同途徑。活化的血小板凝集成血栓並支持凝血。

label: Enhancer-Promoter Looping
description: In cellular senescence, large-scale rewiring of the enhancer-promoter network is a primary mechanism by which the epigenetic landscape activates SASP genes. EP loops place senescence-activated enhancers in contact with SASP promoters to induce their secretion.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞衰老中，增強子-啟動子網路的大規模重組是表觀遺傳景觀活化 SASP 基因的主要機制。EP 環化使衰老活化的增強子與 SASP 啟動子接觸以誘導其分泌。

label: TGF-beta Signaling Pathway
description: TGFBR1 phosphorylates receptor-SMAD SMAD2 as the primary transducer. Body text confirms this canonical activation.
description_zh_TW: TGFBR1 磷酸化受體 SMAD SMAD2 作為主要傳導器。內文確認此典型活化。

label: Adiposity
description: Protein restriction lowers body fat in rodents and humans despite compensatory hyperphagia, via FGF21-driven thermogenesis. Fat loss independent of caloric intake is the defining phenotype.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制在代償性多食下仍降低囓齒類與人類體脂，經由 FGF21 驅動的產熱。不依賴熱量攝取的脂肪減少是定義表型。

label: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins
description: Survivin is a member of Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Survivin (BIRC5) is a bifunctional IAP that inhibits apoptosis and is required for chromosomal passenger complex function in mitosis, making it a tumor-selective antigen. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. The directionality runs from Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins toward Survivin, so Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins is the active agent and Survivin the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Survivin 是 的成員。 Survivin (BIRC5) 是一種雙功能 IAP，可抑制細胞凋亡，是有絲分裂中染色體過客複合體功能所必需的，使其成為腫瘤選擇性抗原。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。方向性從Survivin 走向Survivin，因此Survivin 是主動主體，Survivin 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Innate Immune System
description: Mitochondria act as platforms for orchestrating innate immune responses to external threats. The MAVS protein, an outer mitochondrial membrane adaptor, binds retinoic-acid-inducible gene I-like receptors (RLRs) that sense viral RNA, self-propagates in a prion-like fashion, and recruits TRAF2, TRAF6, and RIPK1 to activate antiviral signaling. Additionally, mitochondrial ROS prime the NLRP3 inflammasome, whose activation leads to caspase-1 activation and proteolytic cleavage of pro-interleukin-1beta, linking mitochondrial stress to the inflammatory response.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondria 作為 orchestrate innate immune responses to external threats 的平台。MAVS 蛋白是一種外線粒體膜 adaptor，結合 retinoic-acid-inducible gene I-like receptors (RLRs) 感測 viral RNA，以 prion-like fashion 自我增殖，並招募 TRAF2、TRAF6 和 RIPK1 激活 antiviral signaling。此外，mitochondrial ROS priming NLRP3 inflammasome，其 activation 導致 caspase-1 activation 和 proteolytic cleavage of pro-interleukin-1beta，將 mitochondrial stress 與 inflammatory response 連結。

label: PANoptosome
source_file: _document_ - Regulatory complexity and therapeutic targeting of the necroptosis network.md
description: ZBP1 senses viral Z-nucleic acids and nucleates a PANoptosome that simultaneously activates RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis, caspase-8-dependent apoptosis, and inflammasome-driven pyroptosis during viral infection or cytokine storm (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: ZBP1 感測病毒 Z-核酸並成核 PANoptosome，在病毒感染或細胞激素風暴中同時活化 RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis、caspase-8 依賴性 apoptosis 與發炎體驅動的 pyroptosis（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: IRAK1
description: IL-1R transduces signals through IRAK1, the kinase recruited to the receptor complex via the adaptor MyD88. IRAK1 activation leads to NF-kB-dependent transcription and, in the SASP-induction scheme, is also drawn feeding the STING axis, a link that connects receptor-level cytokine feedback to cytosolic DNA-sensing output. This makes IRAK1 a convergence point where autocrine IL-1 signalling and damage-sensing pathways are integrated before they act on the inflammatory transcriptional programme.
description_zh_TW: IL-1R 經 IRAK1 傳遞訊號，該激酶經銜接蛋白 MyD88 被招募至受體複合體。IRAK1 活化導致 NF-kB 依賴性轉錄，而在 SASP 誘導架構圖中亦被畫為供應 STING 軸，此連結將受體層級的細胞激素回饋接至胞質 DNA 感測輸出。這使 IRAK1 成為匯聚點，自泌 IL-1 訊號與損傷感測路徑在此整合後才作用於發炎轉錄程序。

label: Atg13
description: Fed-state mTORC1 phosphorylates Atg13 at Ser258/316/320 to hold the ULK1 complex inactive. No Atg13-phospho triple exists yet.
description_zh_TW: 進食狀態 mTORC1 在 Ser258/316/320 磷酸化 Atg13 以維持 ULK1 複合體失活。尚無 Atg13 磷酸化 triple。

label: RAS
description: Downstream of MET autophosphorylation, the multi-substrate docking site recruits GRB2/SOS, activating RAS-MAPK signaling. This contributes to proliferation and the invasive growth phenotype of MET-driven cells.
description_zh_TW: 在 MET 自磷酸化的下游，多受質停靠位點招募 GRB2/SOS，活化 RAS-MAPK 訊號。這有助於 MET 驅動細胞的增殖和侵入性生長表型。

label: Lipid Metabolism
description: SIRT2 prevents hepatic steatosis by deacetylating HNF4alpha, a master regulator of hepatic lipid genes, and suppresses adipocyte differentiation via FoxO1 deacetylation that restrains PPAR-gamma; reduced SIRT2 in obese adipose progenitors is linked to visceral fat expansion.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化肝臟脂質基因的主調控因子 HNF4α 來預防肝脂肪變性，並透過 FoxO1 去乙醯化抑制脂肪細胞分化（FoxO1 去乙醯化可抑制 PPAR-γ）；肥胖脂肪前體細胞中 SIRT2 的減少與內臟脂肪擴增相關。

label: Vitamin C
description: Gomez-Cabrera et al. (2008, PMID 18175748) showed oral vitamin C decreases muscle mitochondrial biogenesis and hampers training-induced endurance adaptations. This is among the cleanest human studies showing antioxidant interference with a hormetic stressor (exercise), blunting the necessary acute ROS signal.
description_zh_TW: Gomez-Cabrera 等人（2008，PMID 18175748）顯示口服維生素 C 降低肌肉粒線體生成並妨礙訓練誘發的耐力適應。這是最乾淨的人體研究之一，顯示抗氧化劑干擾促效應壓力源（運動），減弱必要的急性 ROS 訊號。

label: Hemolysis
description: Adrenochrome and related pathway intermediates can promote methemoglobin formation, hemolysis at high concentrations, and lipid peroxidation in erythrocyte membranes under oxidative conditions. Adrenochrome-induced hemolysis (rupture of red blood cells) has been observed in experimental settings, and older research from the 1960s-1970s examined whether erythrocytes from some patients were more susceptible to adrenochrome-induced lysis, though results were mixed and not strongly replicated. These effects position adrenochrome as a potential reactant that can damage red blood cells rather than a molecule normally stored or produced inside healthy erythrocytes.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome and related pathway intermediates can promote methemoglobin formation, hemolysis at high concentrations, and lipid peroxidation in erythrocyte membranes under oxidative conditions。Adrenochrome-induced hemolysis (rupture of red blood cells) has been observed in experimental settings, and older research from the 1960s-1970s examined whether erythrocytes from some patients were more susceptible to adrenochrome-induced lysis, though results were mixed and not strongly replicated。These effects position adrenochrome as a potential reactant that can damage red blood cells rather than a molecule normally stored or produced inside healthy erythrocytes。

label: SCAPs
description: SCAPs (senescence-cell anti-apoptotic pathways) are the ensemble of pro-survival mechanisms that allow senescent cells to persist despite SASP and DNA damage. Senolytic therapies kill senescent cells by targeting these anti-apoptotic pathways.
description_zh_TW: SCAPs（衰老細胞抗凋亡途徑）是讓衰老細胞儘管有 SASP 與 DNA 損傷仍能存續的促存活機制總和。Senolytic 療法透過靶向這些抗凋亡途徑殺死衰老細胞。

label: Polyol Pathway
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: The two-enzyme glucose to sorbitol to fructose route produces fructose, setting the advanced glycation feed rate. Sorbitol dehydrogenase closes the pathway output.
description_zh_TW: 葡萄糖到山梨醇到果糖的雙酶路徑產生果糖，設定晚期糖化供養速率。山梨醇脫氫酶關閉路徑輸出。

label: Silver sulfide albuminates
description: Insoluble silver salts transform into soluble protein-bound transport species, the gateway step of systemic handling. Transformation enables circulation.
description_zh_TW: 不溶性銀鹽轉化為可溶性蛋白結合運輸物種，是全身處理的門戶步驟。轉化促成循環。

label: Bcl-w
description: Bad binds Bcl-w. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. Bcl-w is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member overexpressed in several carcinomas and hematologic malignancies where it blunts chemotherapy-induced death. The relationship is directional, with Bad acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-w rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Bad 綁定 Bcl-w。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Bcl-w 是一種抗凋亡 Bcl-2 family 成員，在多種癌症和血液惡性腫瘤中過度表達，可減少化療引起的死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Bad 充當 Bcl-w 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: Aconitase
description: Superoxide oxidizes the [4Fe-4S] cluster of aconitase to [3Fe-4S], inactivating the tricarboxylic acid enzyme. Aconitase is the classic superoxide sensor of mitochondria.
description_zh_TW: 超氧化物氧化 aconitase 的 [4Fe-4S] 簇為 [3Fe-4S]，使三羧酸酶失活。Aconitase 是粒線體典型的超氧化物感測器。

label: Arrhythmias
description: Infarct scar creates reentry circuits for ventricular tachycardia as a common lethal complication. Causation is the substrate mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 梗塞疤痕為心室頻脈創造迴路，作為常見致死併發症。因果是基質機制。

label: Myddosome
description: The myddosome nucleated by MyD88 death domains first recruits the kinase IRAK4, initiating scaffold assembly after IL-1R/TLR engagement. IRAK4 then phosphorylates IRAK1 to propagate signaling toward TRAF6 and TAK1.
description_zh_TW: 由 MyD88 death 域成核的 myddosome 首先招募激酶 IRAK4，在 IL-1R/TLR 結合後啟動支架組裝。IRAK4 隨後磷酸化 IRAK1，向 TRAF6 與 TAK1 傳播訊號。

label: Aphidicolin
description: Aphidicolin competitively inhibits DNA polymerases alpha/delta at the dCTP site. This defines its fork-stalling pharmacology.
description_zh_TW: Aphidicolin 在 dCTP 位點競爭性抑制 DNA 聚合酶 alpha/delta。此定義其複製叉停滯藥理。

label: Antigen Presentation
description: Peptide loading and display is the defining mechanism of the complex.
description_zh_TW: 肽裝載與展示是此複合體的定義機制。

label: HER2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Trastuzumab binds the HER2 extracellular subdomain IV.
description_zh_TW: trastuzumab 結合 HER2 胞外第四次結構域。

label: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases are endoplasmic reticulum resident phase-two conjugation enzymes. Localization places the superfamily at the detoxification membrane.
description_zh_TW: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases 是內質網駐留的二相結合酶。定位將此超家族置於解毒膜。

label: Intrinsic Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Intrinsic Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Intrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑Intrinsic Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Intrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Kaempferol
description: Kaempferol, a flavonol (3,5,7,4'-tetrahydroxyflavone) and sister compound to quercetin/apigenin, directly activates SIRT1 as a natural polyphenol STAC via K-type allosteric Km lowering, and is frequently co-studied for anti-aging and cancer-risk reduction.
description_zh_TW: Kaempferol 是一種黄酮醇（3,5,7,4'-四羥基黄酮），是 quercetin/apigenin 的姊妹化合物，作為天然多酚類 STAC 透過 K 型別構降低 Km 直接活化 SIRT1，常與抗老化和降低癌症風險的研究並提。

label: Hallmarks of Cancer
description: Tumorigenesis proceeds through the acquisition of genetic and epigenetic alterations that confer the Hallmarks of Cancer. These enabling biological capabilities include sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The Hallmarks of Cancer framework describes the capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤發生透過獲得賦予癌症標誌的遺傳與表觀遺傳改變而進行。這些賦能生物學能力包括持續增生、逃避死亡與轉移。癌症標誌架構描述了腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的能力。

label: Clofarabine
description: Clofarabine received FDA accelerated approval in December 2004 for pediatric patients (ages 1-21) with relapsed or refractory acute lymphoblastic leukemia after at least two prior regimens. It was the first new drug approved for pediatric leukemia in over a decade.
description_zh_TW: Clofarabine 於 2004 年 12 月獲得 FDA 加速核准，用於至少接受過兩種先前療程後復發或難治型急性淋巴性白血病的兒童患者（1-21 歲）。它是十多年來第一個獲核准用於兒童白血病的藥物。

label: Obesity
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT3 suppresses obesity by activating macroautophagy through the AMPK-ULK1 pathway to produce smaller lipid droplets, and by inducing the perilipin-1-Hsc71-LAMP2 complex to drive chaperone-mediated autophagy. These mitochondrial-autophagy actions promote lipid catabolism and energy expenditure, opposing adipose accumulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過 AMPK-ULK1 路徑活化巨自噬以產生較小的脂滴，並誘發 perilipin-1-Hsc71-LAMP2 複合體以驅動伴侶介導的自噬，從而抑制肥胖。這些粒線體—自噬作用促進脂質分解與能量消耗，對抗脂肪堆積。

label: Chondrocytes
description: In osteoarthritis, SIRT3 preserves mitochondrial integrity by deacetylating cytochrome c oxidase subunit 4 isoform 2, and its deletion correlates with OA exacerbation in animal and human models. SIRT3 promotes mitophagy via the PINK1/Parkin axis, maintains mitochondrial health by regulating FOXO3a hyperacetylation, inhibits chondrocyte apoptosis through PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling, facilitates mitochondrial fusion for mtDNA complementation, and enhances cartilage resilience.
description_zh_TW: 在骨關節炎中，SIRT3 透過去乙醯化細胞色素 c 氧化酶亞基 4 異型 2 維護粒線體完整性，其缺失與動物和人類模型中的 OA 加劇相關。SIRT3 透過 PINK1/Parkin 軸線促進粒線體自噬，透過調節 FOXO3a 超乙醯化維護粒線體健康，透過 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 訊號抑制軟骨細胞凋亡，促進粒線體融合以進行 mtDNA 補償，並增強軟骨韌性。

label: Caspase-6
description: Caspase-6, though dispensable for canonical TNF-induced necroptosis, facilitates ZBP1/RIPK3 complex formation during influenza A virus infection, potentiating necroptosis signaling and NLRP3 inflammasome activation (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: Caspase-6 雖對典型 TNF 誘導的 necroptosis 非必需，卻在流感 A 病毒感染時促進 ZBP1/RIPK3 複合體形成，增強 necroptosis 訊號與 NLRP3 發炎體活化（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Reactive Species
description: Contrary to intuition, hypoxia shifts the mitochondrial electron transport system toward a reduced state, increasing electron availability and favoring superoxide formation. This hypoxic oxidant burst provides the redox signal that activates defenses before the larger reoxygenation insult.
description_zh_TW: 與直覺相反，Hypoxia 使粒線體電子傳遞系統偏向還原態，增加電子可利用性並促進超氧物生成。這波缺氧期間的氧化物爆發提供了氧化還原訊號，在更大的再氧合損傷之前活化防禦機制。

label: Histone Methylation
description: Histone methyltransferases deposit methyl groups on histone lysine and arginine residues.
description_zh_TW: 組蛋白甲基轉移酶在組蛋白離胺酸與精胺酸沉積甲基。

label: Fatty acid oxidation
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: SIRT4 inhibits fatty-acid oxidation at the mitochondria by suppressing malonyl-CoA decarboxylase (MCD) ADP-ribosylase activity and restraining oxidative fuel use, an adaptive suppression that rises under calorie restriction; during aging its dysregulation perturbs metabolic fuel selection (source review).
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制丙二醯輔酶 A 脫羧酶（MCD）ADP-核糖基酶活性並抑制氧化燃料使用來抑制粒線體中的脂肪酸氧化，這種適應性抑制在熱量限制下升高；在衰老過程中，其失調干擾代謝燃料選擇（文獻綜述）。

label: MET gene
description: The MET proto-oncogene encodes the receptor tyrosine kinase c-Met (hepatocyte growth factor receptor), synthesized as a precursor and cleaved into a disulfide-linked alpha/beta heterodimer. MET is the only known receptor gene for hepatocyte growth factor.
description_zh_TW: MET 原致癌基因編碼受體酪胺酸激酶 c-Met（肝細胞生長因子受體），先合成前體，再裂解為雙硫鍵連結的 alpha/beta 異二聚體。MET 是肝細胞生長因子唯一已知的受體基因。

label: Human Growth Hormone
description: Human growth hormone (HGH) is widely used for rejuvenation and longevity, yet it actually accelerates aging and shortens lifespan. Growth hormone is a pro-aging hormone because it indirectly activates mTOR, and the hype around growth hormone is based on a single publication that misinterpreted its acute effects. Unlike HGH, the anti-aging effects of rapamycin are not based on a single paper or a wild guess but on the work of thousands of scientists studying mTOR and its inhibitors in diverse organisms from yeast to humans.
description_zh_TW: 人類生長激素（HGH）被廣泛用於回春與長壽，但它實際上會加速衰老並縮短壽命。生長激素是促衰老激素，因為它會間接活化 mTOR；而生長激素的炒作源於單一出版物誤解了其急性效應。與 HGH 不同，雷帕黴素的抗衰老效果並非基於單一論文或隨意猜測，而是基於數千名科學家從酵母菌到人類等各種生物中研究 mTOR 及其抑制劑的成果。

label: p21
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: The CIP1 inhibitor p21 restrains CDK1 activity, enforcing checkpoint arrest.
description_zh_TW: CIP1 抑制因子 p21 約束 CDK1 活性，執行檢查點停滯。

label: Assembloids
description: Assembloids are built by fusing two or more region-specific organoids.
description_zh_TW: Assembloid 由融合兩個以上區域特異類器官建成。

label: Redox Homeostasis
description: The oxidation state of the CxxC motif is a direct readout of cellular redox status: its cysteines switch client proteins between reduced (active) and oxidized (inactive or chaperone-like) states. Over-oxidation of the nucleophilic cysteine disables antioxidant enzymes and contributes to oxidative-stress-linked pathology.
description_zh_TW: CxxC 基序的氧化狀態是細胞氧化還原狀態的直接讀數：其半胱氨酸使客戶蛋白在還原（活化）與氧化（不活化或類伴侶）狀態之間切換。親核半胱氨酸的過度氧化會使抗氧化酵素失能，並促成與氧化壓力相關的病理。

label: DNA Polymerase
description: DNA polymerases alpha/delta/epsilon perform the synthesis step of replication. No polymerase, no nascent strand.
description_zh_TW: DNA 聚合酶 alpha/delta/epsilon 執行複製的合成步驟。無聚合酶即無新生股。

label: NOX2
description: NOX2 deficiency causes chronic granulomatous disease, a group of genetic defects in NOX2 (gp91phox) subunits that abolish the phagocyte respiratory burst. Patients suffer recurrent, life-threatening bacterial and fungal infections due to failure to generate microbicidal ROS. The directionality is enzyme defect to immunodeficiency. A caveat is that the disease severity varies with the specific mutation and residual oxidase activity, and some organisms evade even normal ROS killing. X-linked CGD from CYBB mutations is most common, and patients show granuloma formation, colitis-like inflammation, and susceptibility to catalase-positive organisms.
description_zh_TW: NOX2 缺陷會導致 chronic granulomatous disease，這是 NOX2 (gp91phox) 亞基中的一組遺傳缺陷，可消除吞噬細胞 respiratory burst。由於無法產生殺菌劑 ROS，患者會重複遭受危及生命的細菌和真菌感染。方向性是酵素缺陷到免疫缺陷。需要注意的是，疾病的嚴重程度會隨著特定突變和殘留氧化酶活性的不同而變化，有些生物體甚至會逃避正常的 ROS 殺滅。 CYBB 突變導致的 X 連鎖 CGD 最為常見，患者表現出肉芽腫形成、結腸炎樣發炎以及對 catalase 陽性微生物的易感性。

label: NQO1
description: NQO1 uses NADH/NADPH as electron donor via FAD-mediated hydride transfer. Donor use defines the reductase mechanism.
description_zh_TW: NQO1 經由 FAD 介導的氫負離子轉移使用 NADH/NADPH 為電子供體。供體使用定義還原酶機制。

label: CaMKII
description: RIPK3-phosphorylated CaMKII drives mitochondrial dysfunction by promoting mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening, a RIPK3/CaMKII/mPTP axis implicated in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, heart failure, and neurological injury (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: 受 RIPK3 磷酸化的 CaMKII 透過促進粒線體通透性轉換孔開啟而驅動粒線體功能障礙，此 RIPK3/CaMKII/mPTP 軸與心肌缺血再灌注損傷、心衰竭與神經損傷相關（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: NADPH
description: NQO1 uses NADH/NADPH as electron donor via FAD-mediated hydride transfer. Donor use defines the reductase mechanism.
description_zh_TW: NQO1 經由 FAD 介導的氫負離子轉移使用 NADH/NADPH 為電子供體。供體使用定義還原酶機制。

label: CDKN2B
description: SMAD3/SMAD4 complexes bind SMAD-binding elements at the CDKN2B promoter to induce p15INK4b downstream of TGFbeta-family ligands. This direct transcriptional link couples Activin A and TGF-beta1 signaling to CDK4/6 inhibition and paracrine arrest.
description_zh_TW: SMAD3/SMAD4 複合體結合 CDKN2B 啟動子的 SMAD 結合元件，在 TGFbeta 家族配體下游誘發 p15INK4b。此直接轉錄連結將 Activin A 與 TGF-beta1 訊號耦合到 CDK4/6 抑制與旁分泌停滯。

label: Hemoglobin
description: Hemoglobin, which is abundant in erythrocytes, can catalyze the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome in blood. This is more of a chemical reaction occurring in the presence of oxygen or radicals than active production by red blood cells themselves, and it involves hemoglobin-catalyzed peroxidation/oxidation processes. As a result, adrenochrome can form in blood as a reactant or byproduct, but red blood cells do not actively produce it, since erythrocytes lack the organelles and major oxidative enzymes found in neutrophils or adrenal cells.
description_zh_TW: Hemoglobin在erythrocytes中含量豐富，能在血液中催化epinephrine氧化為adrenochrome。這更像是在氧氣或自由基存在下發生的化學反應，而非red blood cells本身主動生成的產物，且涉及hemoglobin所催化的peroxidation/oxidation過程。因此，adrenochrome可在血液中作為反應物或副產物形成，但red blood cells並不主動生成它，因為erythrocytes缺乏neutrophils或adrenal cells所具有的胞器與主要氧化酶。

label: Triapine
description: Triapine inhibits ribonucleotide reductase by iron-chelator destruction of the RRM2 radical cofactor. This pushes cells past the hormetic window into replication catastrophe.
description_zh_TW: Triapine 經由鐵螯合破壞 RRM2 自由基輔因子抑制 ribonucleotide reductase。此將細胞推過荷爾蒙窗口進入複製災難。

label: BRAF
description: BRAF phosphorylates MEK downstream of RAS, paralleling the covered RAF1 edge as a distinct entity.
description_zh_TW: BRAF 在 RAS 下游磷酸化 MEK，與已涵蓋的 RAF1 邊平行但為不同實體。

label: FOLFIRI
description: FOLFIRI downregulates muscle Nrk2 by 84 percent, detectable 24 hours post-dose.
description_zh_TW: FOLFIRI 下調肌肉 Nrk2 達 84%，給藥 24 小時可測。

label: Acute Stress-Associated Phenotype
description: Apigenin blocks the transition of the ASAP toward the SASP by disrupting ATM-HSPA8 and HSPA8-p38 MAPK crosstalk, preventing maturation of the secretome. As a flavonoid it also binds PRDX6 to inhibit its iPLA2 activity, further gatekeeping the transition between acute stress response and chronic secretion. This early intervention contrasts with agents that only suppress the established SASP, positioning apigenin as a candidate preventive senomorphic that acts at the ASAP stage. The mechanism highlights HSPA8 and PRDX6 as druggable nodes in senescence initiation.
description_zh_TW: Apigenin 透過破壞 ATM-HSPA8 與 HSPA8-p38 MAPK 交互作用阻斷 ASAP 朝向 SASP 的轉變，防止分泌組成熟。作為類黃酮它也結合 PRDX6 抑制其 iPLA2 活性，進一步守門急性壓力反應與慢性分泌間的轉變。此早期介入不同於僅抑制已建立 SASP 的藥劑，將 apigenin 定位為作用於 ASAP 階段的候選預防性 senomorphic。此機制凸顯 HSPA8 與 PRDX6 作為衰老起始中可藥物化的節點。

label: SMURF2
description: SMURF2, a HECT-domain E3 ubiquitin ligase, ubiquitinates SIRT1 and promotes its proteasomal degradation, suppressing proliferation and tumorigenesis in colorectal cancer (Yu et al., Oncogene 2020). Unlike TRIM28/KAP1 — whose SIRT1 degradation is ATM-dependent and DNA-damage-conditioned — SMURF2-mediated SIRT1 turnover was characterized outside DNA damage settings, making it a constitutive metabolic regulator of SIRT1 abundance rather than a DDR-specific one.
description_zh_TW: SMURF2 是一種 HECT 結構域的 E3 泛素連接酶，會泛素化 SIRT1 並促進其蛋白酶體降解，從而抑制大腸直腸癌的增殖與腫瘤生成（Yu 等人，Oncogene 2020）。有別於 TRIM28/KAP1——其對 SIRT1 的降解依賴 ATM 且限於 DNA 損傷情境——SMURF2 介導的 SIRT1 代謝是在非 DNA 損傷條件下被闡明的，因此它是 SIRT1 豐度的組成性代謝調節者，而非 DDR 專一性的調節者。

label: Streptomyces avermectinius
description: Avermectins are 16-membered macrocyclic lactones biosynthesized by the soil actinomycete Streptomyces avermectinius (formerly S. avermitilis).
description_zh_TW: 是由土壤放線菌（以前稱為除蟲鏈黴菌）生物合成的 16 元大環內酯。

label: Kitasato Institute
description: Satoshi Omura performed the soil-microbe screening that isolated Streptomyces avermectinius at the Kitasato Institute, Tokyo.
description_zh_TW: Satoshi Omura 在東京 Kitasato Institute 進行了土壤微生物篩選並分離出 Streptomyces avermectinius。

label: UV-induced photoaging
description: Ultraviolet reactive oxygen species drive the skin damage consequence of photoaging by definition, previously unrepresented as a triple. Causation names the definitional etiology.
description_zh_TW: 紫外線 reactive oxygen species 依定義驅動光老化的皮膚損傷後果，先前未以 triple 表示。因果命名定義性病因。

label: Peroxisome Biogenesis Network
description: The Peroxisome Biogenesis Network (PBN), a dynamic pool of pre-peroxisomal precursors residing in the cytosol, receives lipids and membrane material from the endoplasmic reticulum through direct ER-PBN contact sites. Pre-peroxisomal vesicles bud from the ER membrane and mature by importing peroxisomal proteins and lipids.
description_zh_TW: Peroxisome Biogenesis Network（PBN，位於細胞質的前過氧化物體前驅池）透過直接的 ER-PBN 接觸位点，自內質網獲得脂質與膜物質。前過氧化物體囊泡自內質網膜出芽，並藉由輸入過氧化物體蛋白與脂質而成熟。

label: DR5
description: DR5 is the primary TRAIL receptor; ligand binding nucleates the DISC to initiate extrinsic apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: DR5 是主要的 TRAIL 受體；配體結合使 DISC 成核以啟動外源性凋亡。

label: Iduna
description: Iduna (RNF146) is a PAR-dependent E3 ubiquitin ligase whose WWE domain binds the iso-ADP-ribose linkage of PAR; it ubiquitinates the PARylated linker histone H1.2, tagging this PAR carrier for proteasomal degradation and blocking poly(ADP-ribose) nuclear export (Andrabi 2011; Kang 2011).
description_zh_TW: Iduna（RNF146）是依賴 PAR 的 E3 泛素連接酶，其 WWE 結構域結合 PAR 的 iso-ADP-ribose 連結；它泛素化受 PAR 修飾的連結組蛋白 H1.2，將此 PAR 載體標記以進行蛋白酶體降解，並阻斷聚(ADP-核糖)的核輸出（Andrabi 2011；Kang 2011）。

label: Sodium Butyrate
description: Sodium butyrate inhibits class I/IIa HDACs, raising H3/H4 acetylation; mirrors the Trichostatin A edge. Consolidated single edge from two miners.
description_zh_TW: Sodium butyrate 抑制 I/IIa 類 HDAC，提高 H3/H4 乙醯化；呼應 Trichostatin A 邊。兩位礦工合併的單一邊。

label: Cyclophosphamide
description: Cyclophosphamide is the prototypical alkylator producing phosphoramide-mustard crosslinks. Classification defines the drug class.
description_zh_TW: Cyclophosphamide 是產生磷醯胺芥交聯的原型烷化劑。歸類定義藥物類別。

label: Mitomycin C
description: Mitomycin C is a prototypical intra- plus interstrand crosslinker. Classification defines the drug.
description_zh_TW: Mitomycin C 是原型的鏈內加鏈間交聯劑。歸類定義藥物。

label: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的內質網壓力途徑由未折疊蛋白累積啟動，並參與 CHOP 和 caspase-12。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Bifidobacterium
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) can selectively stimulate the growth of beneficial gut bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus. These genera are associated with improved gut health, including prevention of diarrhea, improved gut barrier function, reduced inflammation, and immune system support. NAD+ precursors modulate gut microbiota by providing an energy source for beneficial bacteria, activating sirtuins, and improving gut barrier function. NMN and NR thereby reverse gut dysbiosis and promote beneficial effects at both intestinal and extraintestinal levels, linking dietary NAD+ precursor intake to a healthier gut microbial community.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）能選擇性地刺激有益腸道細菌如 Bifidobacterium 和 Lactobacillus 的生長。這些屬與改善腸道健康相關，包括預防腹瀉、改善腸道屏障功能、減少發炎以及支持免疫系統。NAD+ 前驅物透過提供有益細菌的能量來源、活化去乙醯酶以及改善腸道屏障功能來調節腸道菌叢。NMN 和 NR 因此逆轉腸道失調，並在腸內與腸外層面促進有益效應，將膳食性 NAD+ 前驅物攝取與更健康的腸道微生物群落連結起來。

label: Diazepam
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Diazepam increases GABA-A chloride-channel opening frequency, potentiating fast inhibitory neurotransmission. Modulation is the allosteric enhancement relationship.
description_zh_TW: Diazepam 提高 GABA-A 氯通道開放頻率，增強快速抑制性神經傳導。調節是變構增強關係。

label: E-cadherin
description: CDH1 encodes the E-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
description_zh_TW: CDH1 編碼 E-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

label: alpha-Tubulin
description: SIRT1 deacetylates α-tubulin (alongside SIRT2), contributing to cytoskeletal/microtubule regulation and cytoplasmic deacetylase activity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 α-tubulin（與 SIRT2 協同），有助於細胞骨架/微管調控和細胞質去乙醯酶活性。

label: Carbazochrome
description: Carbazochrome is adrenochrome monosemicarbazone ('is_derivative_of', conf 0.95), formed by condensing adrenochrome's quinone carbonyl with semicarbazide to make a relatively chemically inactive derivative — resolving the Round-2 amplifier-conflict ticket as an evidence-based null for carbazochrome redox-cycling at Complex I.
description_zh_TW: Carbazochrome 是 adrenochrome 單縮氨基脲（「is_derivative_of」，conf 0.95），由 adrenochrome 的醌羰基與縮氨基脲縮合而成的一種相對化學惰性衍生物——把第二輪放大器衝突票裁定為 carbazochrome 在 Complex I 氧化還原循環的以證據為基礎的空結果。

label: Cell Cycle
description: Preferentially translated G1 and proliferation transcripts gate cycle progression.
description_zh_TW: 優先轉譯的 G1 與增殖轉錄本守衛週期進展。

label: Apaf-1
description: RSK phosphorylates Apaf-1 at Ser268, inhibiting the apoptosome scaffold.
description_zh_TW: RSK 在 Ser268 磷酸化 Apaf-1，抑制凋亡體支架。

label: MLL1
description: MLL1 (KMT2A) is a histone H3 lysine 4 methyltransferase and is grouped with HMGA1 and BRD4 in the SASP-induction scheme as an epigenetic regulator of SASP loci. MLL1 deposits H3K4me3, an active-promoter mark, and thereby contributes to the permissive chromatin state at inflammatory genes. The grouping reflects the broader finding that SASP expression is epigenetically licensed: chromatin modifiers determine the accessibility of SASP enhancers and promoters, which is the rationale for epigenetic-modulating drugs acting as senomorphics.
description_zh_TW: MLL1（KMT2A）是組蛋白 H3 離胺酸 4 甲基轉移酶，在 SASP 誘導架構圖中與 HMGA1、BRD4 同組，作為 SASP 基因座的表觀遺傳調控者。MLL1 沉積活化啟動子標記 H3K4me3，因而促進發炎基因的許可型染色質狀態。此分組反映了更廣泛的發現：SASP 表現受表觀遺傳許可控管，染色質修飾者決定 SASP 增強子與啟動子的可及性，這也是表觀遺傳調節藥物可作為 senomorphics 的理由。

label: TNF-alpha
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: SIRT1 suppresses TNF-α production/ signaling downstream of NF-κB deacetylation, blunting inflammation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 NF-κB 去乙醯化的下游抑制 TNF-α 的產生/信號傳導，減輕發炎反應。

label: SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio
description: The SIRT3/SIRT4 acetylation ratio is the mechanistic dial that sets the hormetic window for MnSOD-dependent redox tone ('SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio --determines--> Hormetic Window', conf 0.95): locked-off drives cancer/hypertension, locked-on drives cardiomyopathy — restored cycling is protective.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3/SIRT4 乙醯化比率是決定 MnSOD 依賴氧化還原張力荷爾蒙窗口的機制旋鈕（「SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio --determines--> Hormetic Window」，conf 0.95）：鎖定關閉驅動癌症／高血壓，鎖定開啟驅動心肌病變——恢復循環則具保護作用。

label: Androgen Receptor
description: Androgen receptor signaling drives MBOAT2 transcription, the male counterpart of the ER-to-MBOAT1 gate, conferring ferroptosis resistance through the same PE-MUFA remodeling logic.
description_zh_TW: Androgen receptor 訊號驅動 MBOAT2 轉錄，即 ER 至 MBOAT1 閘門的雄性對應物，透過相同的 PE-MUFA 重塑邏輯賦予 ferroptosis 抗性。

label: Faecalibacterium
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Faecalibacterium is a major butyrate producer depleted in the oldest-old; ties gut depletion to the butyrate-HDACi axis. Production is the microbiome link.
description_zh_TW: Faecalibacterium 是在最老人群減少的主要丁酸產生菌；將腸道耗竭連結到丁酸-HDACi 軸。產生是微生物組連結。

label: SRT1460
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SRT1460 is a potent, chemically diverse second-generation sirtuin-activating compound reported alongside SRT1720 and SRT2183 as more effective activators than the polyphenolic STACs. Most compounds of this class were also reported to have anticancer activity. A major caveat is that the mechanism of SRT1460 action remains unclear: activation could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, and the metabolic effects may reflect indirect actions (e.g., via the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK axis) rather than direct SIRT1 binding. Directionally, SRT1460 enhances SIRT1 activity in assay systems, but interpretation of in vivo effects requires caution.
description_zh_TW: SRT1460 是一種強效的、化學結構多樣的第二代 sirtuin 活化化合物，與 SRT1720 和 SRT2183 一起被報導為比多酚類 STAC 更有效的活化劑。此類化合物大多據報導具有抗癌活性。主要的注意事項是 SRT1460 的作用機制仍不清楚：活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，且代謝效果可能反映間接作用（例如透過 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 軸線）而非直接 SIRT1 結合。方向性上 SRT1460 在試驗系統中增強 SIRT1 活性，但對體內效果的詮釋需要謹慎。

label: SRT2183
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SRT2183 is a potent second-generation sirtuin-activating compound identified with SRT1720 and SRT1460 as chemically diverse, more potent activators than the initial polyphenolic STACs. These compounds were reported to have anticancer activity, but their mechanism is controversial: activation was frequently demonstrable only with fluorescently tagged substrates, and metabolic effects may be indirect (cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway) rather than direct SIRT1 activation. Directionally, SRT2183 stimulates SIRT1 deacetylase activity in biochemical assays. These caveats frame the ongoing debate about the physiological relevance of STAC-mediated SIRT1 activation.
description_zh_TW: SRT2183 是一種強效的第二代 sirtuin 活化化合物，與 SRT1720 和 SRT1460 一起被鑑定為化學結構多樣、比初始多酚類 STAC 更強效的活化劑。這些化合物據報導具有抗癌活性，但其機制存在爭議：活化經常只能在螢光標記的受質下驗證，且代謝益處可能反映間接作用（cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）而非直接 SIRT1 活化。方向性上 SRT2183 在生化試驗中刺激 SIRT1 去乙醯酶活性。這些注意事項構成了關於 STAC 介導的 SIRT1 活化生理相關性的持續爭論。

label: GW5074
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: GW5074 is an indolinone compound originally developed as a c-Raf kinase inhibitor; like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220, it was repurposed as a sirtuin inhibitor after screening known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 based on the shared adenosine-binding site between sirtuins and kinases. GW5074 shows SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory activity in the low micromolar range. Directionally, its identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold enables engagement of the sirtuin NAD+ pocket. Its continued kinase activity complicates interpretation in cells, highlighting the need for selectivity optimization in dual kinase/sirtuin inhibitor design.
description_zh_TW: GW5074 是一種最初作為 c-Raf 激酶抑制劑開發的吲哚啉酮化合物；與雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 類似，它在基於 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享腺嘌呤結合位點的原理篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的活性後被重新定位為 sirtuin 抑制劑。GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制活性。方向性上其作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份使其能夠與 sirtuin NAD+ 口袋結合。其持續的激酶活性使細胞內的詮釋複雜化，凸顯了在雙重激酶/sirtuin 抑制劑設計中選擇性優化的必要性。

label: Ro31-8220
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Ro31-8220 is a bisindolylmaleimide compound originally developed as a protein kinase C inhibitor; its adenosine-binding scaffold allowed it to be repurposed as an inhibitor of SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range. It belongs to the kinase-inhibitor scaffolds identified by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins, sharing this property with the indolinone GW5074. Directionally, Ro31-8220's identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold underlies its cross-reactivity with sirtuins through the shared adenosine-binding site. Because it retains potent kinase activity, cellular effects cannot be attributed solely to sirtuin inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Ro31-8220 是一種最初作為蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑開發的雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺化合物；其腺嘌呤結合骨架使其被重新定位為低微摩爾範圍內的 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 抑制劑。它屬於透過篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 活性而鑑定的激酶抑制劑骨架，與吲哚啉酮 GW5074 共享此特性。方向性上 Ro31-8220 作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份奠定了其透過共享腺嘌呤結合位點對 sirtuin 的交叉反應性。由於其保留強效激酶活性，細胞效應不能僅歸因於 sirtuin 抑制。

label: Atg14L
description: Atg14L promotes the fusion of mature autophagosomes with the lysosome by binding the tethering factor Syntaxin 17, completing autophagic flux. This positions Atg14L not only in initiation but also in the lysosomal degradation step of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: Atg14L 透過結合繫鏈因子 Syntaxin 17 促進成熟自噬體與溶酶體的融合，完成自噬流。這使 Atg14L 不僅參與起始，也參與自噬的溶酶體降解步驟。

label: UVRAG
description: Rubicon and UVRAG reciprocally regulate the Vps34 complex: Rubicon restrains Vps34 lipid kinase activity and endosomal maturation, while UVRAG promotes them. They compete within overlapping complexes to modulate autophagy and endocytic trafficking.
description_zh_TW: Rubicon 與 UVRAG 對 Vps34 複合體進行相互調控：Rubicon 抑制 Vps34 脂質激酶活性與內體成熟，UVRAG 則促進之。它們在重疊複合體中競爭以調控自噬與內吞運輸。

label: Type I Interferon
description: IRF3 drives transcription of type I interferon genes after being phosphorylated by TBK1 downstream of STING or MAVS. This is the branch of SASP regulation that produces the interferon component of the secretome and, in deep senescence, the late interferon-dependent reinforcement of the inflammatory programme. Interferon released from senescent cells can act on neighbouring cells through IFNAR-JAK-STAT signalling, reinforcing interferon-stimulated gene expression and contributing to paracrine senescence.
description_zh_TW: IRF3 在 STING 或 MAVS 下游被 TBK1 磷酸化後，驅動第一型干擾素基因轉錄。這是 SASP 調控中產生 secretome 干擾素成分的分支，並在深度衰老中形成晚期依賴干擾素的發炎程序強化。衰老細胞釋出的干擾素可經 IFNAR-JAK-STAT 訊號作用於鄰近細胞，強化干擾素刺激基因表現並促成旁分泌衰老。

label: COX-2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: COX-2 is the rate-limiting synthetic enzyme for prostaglandin E2.
description_zh_TW: COX-2 是前列腺素 E2 的速率限制合成酶。

label: H3K27me3
description: H3K4me3 and the repressive H3K27me3 reshape the promoter landscape in senescence, co-localizing in 'mesas' while H3K27me3 is depleted from 'canyons'. These bivalent states define transcriptional poise.
description_zh_TW: H3K4me3 與抑制性 H3K27me3 在衰老中重塑啟動子景觀，在「mesas」中共定位，而 H3K27me3 在「canyons」中被耗竭。這些雙價狀態定義轉錄準備狀態。

label: Pyruvate Dehydrogenase
description: RIPK3 phosphorylates threonine 135 on the E3 subunit of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, enhancing PDC activity in cancer.
description_zh_TW: RIPK3磷酸化丙酮酸去氫酶複合體E3次單元的蘇胺酸135，增強PDC催化活性，見於癌症。

label: SA-beta-gal
description: Lysosomal beta-galactosidase at pH 6.0 is the standard biomarker reporting replicative senescent burden. Characterization, not causation.
description_zh_TW: pH 6.0 的溶酶體 beta-galactosidase 是報告複製性衰老負擔的標準生物標記。是特徵描述而非因果。

label: Muscle Wasting
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reversed the progressive wasting syndrome in skeletal muscle in mice lacking Nampt while restoring endurance in as little as 1 week of treatment. Decreased NAD+ levels and Nampt expression were also observed in Duchenne's muscular dystrophy (DMD), a condition histologically and transcriptionally similar to progressive wasting syndrome and characterized by increased PARP activity, fibrosis, and muscular degeneration. NR was found to improve muscular function and heart pathology in mdx mouse models of DMD and to decrease PARylation, inflammation, and fibrosis. These findings support NR as an effective approach to managing muscular dystrophy and degeneration.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）逆轉了缺乏 Nampt 小鼠骨骼肌中的漸進性消耗症候群，同時在僅 1 週的治療內恢復耐力。在 Duchenne 肌肉營養不良（DMD）中也觀察到 NAD+ 水平與 Nampt 表現降低，此疾病在組織學與轉錄組學上類似於漸進性消耗症候群，並以 PARP 活性增加、纖維化與肌肉退化為特徵。NR 被發現能改善 DMD 的 mdx 小鼠模型中的肌肉功能與心臟病理，並降低 PARylation、發炎與纖維化。這些發現支持 NR 作為管理肌肉營養不良與退化的有效方法。

label: Mitochondrial Membrane Potential
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Signals that provide an assessment of mitochondrial health have expanded beyond ROS, calcium, and metabolites to include mitochondrial membrane potential, protease activity, and protein import. For example, FCCP reduces mitochondrial membrane potential as one of the diverse strategies used to invoke mitochondrial stress and ATF4 activation. This broadens the sensing repertoire for mitochondrial dysfunction, indicating that mitohormesis is triggered not by a single signal but by a panel of readouts reflecting organelle integrity, metabolic state, and protein homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 提供粒線體健康評估的訊號已擴展到 ROS、鈣和代謝物之外，包括粒線體膜電位、蛋白酶活性和蛋白質輸入。例如，FCCP 降低粒線體膜電位，作為用於引發粒線體壓力和 ATF4 活化的多樣策略之一。這擴展了粒線體功能障礙的感知範圍，表明粒線體促效應並非由單一訊號觸發，而是由反映胞器完整性、代謝狀態和蛋白質體恆定性的一系列讀數觸發。

label: Wnt4
description: Wnt4 is a niche-derived soluble factor enforcing quiescence (Eliazer 2019); mirrors the RB1-enforces edge. Enforcement is the niche signal.
description_zh_TW: Wnt4 是執行靜止的微環境衍生可溶因子（Eliazer 2019）；呼應 RB1 執行邊。執行是微環境訊號。

label: Mebendazole
description: Jaccard(Fenbendazole, Mebendazole) = 0.421 — shared Tubulin, Microtubule, Benzimidazole, Glycolysis, Apoptosis — marking the benzimidazoles as a bonded twin-pair whose mechanism claims should be presumed portable until dissociated; Ivermectin is mechanistically distinct (Jaccard 0.178, shared sets mostly indications).
description_zh_TW: Jaccard(Fenbendazole, Mebendazole) ＝ 0.421——共享 Tubulin、Microtubule、Benzimidazole、Glycolysis、Apoptosis——把苯並咪唑類標記為鍵合雙胞胎對，機制主張應推定可互通直到被區分；Ivermectin 機制上截然不同（Jaccard 0.178，共享集合多為適應症）。

label: MPP+
description: MPP+ causes Mitochondrial Dysfunction by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
description_zh_TW: MPP+ 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Mitochondrial Dysfunction，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

label: DNA Methyltransferase
description: DNMT1 copies methylation onto daughter strands behind the fork during replication. Replication couples synthesis to epigenetic maintenance.
description_zh_TW: DNMT1 在複製期間於複製叉後將甲基化複製到子鏈。複製將合成與表觀遺傳維持耦合。

label: APC-C
description: APC-C degrades CYCLIN B1 post-metaphase, the canonical mitotic-exit step.
description_zh_TW: APC-C 在中期後降解 CYCLIN B1，是典型的有絲分裂退出步驟。

label: Wound Healing
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Proliferative and remodeling phases of wound healing constitute repair.
description_zh_TW: 傷口癒合的增殖與重塑期構成修復。

label: DISC
description: DISC activates Caspase-8. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. The relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-8 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: DISC 啟動 Caspase-8。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 Caspase-8 是 Extrinsic Pathway 的起始半胱天冬酶，也透過 Bid 裂解對 Intrinsic Pathway 進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，DISC 充當 Caspase-8 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Benzothiazine
description: Benzothiazine rings have been identified within the heterogeneous core of Neuromelanin, reflecting its mixed eumelanic and pheomelanic chemistry. Solid-state NMR and X-ray spectroscopy reveal sulfur-containing benzothiazine-like moieties alongside indolic 5,6-indolequinone-derived units. The benzothiazine content may influence neuromelanin's paramagnetic and metal-binding properties.
description_zh_TW: 在 Neuromelanin 的異質核心中已鑑定出 benzothiazine 環，反映了其混合的 eumelanic 和 pheomelanic 化學特性。固態 NMR 和 X 射線光譜揭示了含硫的 benzothiazine 樣基團，以及源自 5,6-indolequinone 的吲哚類單元。benzothiazine 含量可能影響 neuromelanin 的順磁性和金屬結合特性。

label: GSK3
description: Akt negatively regulates GSK3, the switch deciding Mcl-1 T163 stabilization versus degradation.
description_zh_TW: Akt 負向調節 GSK3，此開關決定 Mcl-1 T163 穩定或降解。

label: FOLFOX
description: FOLFOX downregulates muscle Nrk2 by 92 percent with high significance.
description_zh_TW: FOLFOX 高顯著下調肌肉 Nrk2 達 92%。

label: β-catenin
description: Wnt/Frizzled inhibits the destruction complex so beta-catenin accumulates; core canonical mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Wnt/Frizzled 抑制破壞複合體使 β-catenin 累積；核心典型機制。

label: IL-1β
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Secreted IL-1beta acts on the interleukin-1 receptor, the receptor arm through which the inflammasome-IL-1 axis propagates inflammation. In the SASP-induction scheme both IL-1alpha and IL-1beta are shown engaging IL-1R, and IL-1beta is additionally the product of inflammasome-dependent cleavage of pro-IL-1beta. Because IL-1 signalling feeds back onto NF-kB and IRAK1, this connection closes the autocrine loop that sustains the inflammatory secretome and makes IL-1R a candidate point of senomorphic intervention.
description_zh_TW: 分泌的 IL-1beta 作用於介白素-1 受體，這是發炎體-IL-1 軸傳播發炎的受體臂。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，IL-1alpha 與 IL-1beta 皆顯示接合 IL-1R，而 IL-1beta 另外是發炎體依賴性切割 pro-IL-1beta 的產物。由於 IL-1 訊號回饋至 NF-kB 與 IRAK1，此連結封閉了維持發炎型 secretome 的自泌環路，也使 IL-1R 成為 senomorphic 干預的候選節點。

label: Sympathetic nerve endings
description: Sympathetic nerve endings provide dense innervation of the SA node, AV node, and ventricular myocardium of the heart. Sympathetic activation increases heart rate, conduction velocity, and contractile force. This innervation is a major determinant of cardiac chronotropy, dromotropy, and inotropy.
description_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 對心臟的 SA node、AV node 與心室 Myocardium 提供密集的神經支配。交感神經活化會增加心率、傳導速度與收縮力。這種神經支配是心臟變時性、變傳導性與變力性的主要決定因素。

label: Exosomes
description: Tumor exosomes traffic microRNA cargo between cells.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤外泌體在細胞間運送 microRNA 貨物。

label: Caenorhabditis elegans
description: The nematode worm is a premier animal model organism.
description_zh_TW: 線蟲是首屈一指的動物模式生物。

label: Superoxide anion
description: Superoxide dismutates to hydrogen peroxide with defined stoichiometry and kinetics. Conversion links the MPO substrate supply to HOCl production.
description_zh_TW: 超氧陰離子以確定化學計量與動力學歧化為過氧化氫。轉換將 MPO 受質供應連結到 HOCl 產生。

label: Melanocytes
description: Melanocytes synthesize Eumelanin, the black and brown protective melanin, within melanosomes via the pathway of Melanogenesis. Eumelanin acts as a broad-band radical scavenger and UV absorber. This dark pigment is exported to neighboring keratinocytes for photoprotection.
description_zh_TW: Melanocytes 透過 Melanogenesis 途徑在 melanosomes 內合成 Eumelanin，即黑色和棕色的保護性黑色素。Eumelanin 充當寬頻自由基清除劑和 UV 吸收劑。這種深色色素被輸出到鄰近的 keratinocytes 以提供光保護。

label: Smoking
description: Adrenochrome formation is promoted by smoking, which increases systemic oxidative stress and catecholamine levels. The resulting shift of more epinephrine toward the adrenochrome pathway elevates aminochrome generation. This links cigarette smoking to oxidative catecholamine metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的形成會因 smoking 而受到促進，smoking 會增加全身性氧化壓力與兒茶酚胺水平。由此使更多 epinephrine 轉向 adrenochrome 途徑，提高了 aminochrome 的生成。這將吸菸與氧化性兒茶酚胺代謝連結起來。

label: Hepatocyte Growth Factor
description: The HGF and cyclin-D1 proliferative phase drives regenerative outgrowth.
description_zh_TW: HGF 與 cyclin-D1 增殖期驅動再生性生長。

label: Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: PDAC is the dominant histology within the pancreatic cancer parent category.
description_zh_TW: PDAC 是胰臟癌母類中的主要組織學。

label: JNK
description: JNK phosphorylation at Thr112/Ser65 activates Bim pro-apoptotic function, opposing ERK.
description_zh_TW: JNK 在 Thr112/Ser65 的磷酸化活化 Bim 促凋亡功能，與 ERK 相反。

label: Ki-67
description: Ki-67 is the standard immunohistochemical proliferation biomarker.
description_zh_TW: Ki-67 是標準的免疫組織化學增殖生物標記。

label: NF-kB signaling
description: SIRT1 suppresses NF-kB (p65) signaling through deacetylation, dampening inflammatory gene expression. This anti-inflammatory action is central to SIRT1's protective role in metabolism, cardiovascular disease, and aging, though it also contributes to its tumor-suppressive arm.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化抑制 NF-kB（p65）信號，抑制發炎基因表達。此抗發炎作用是 SIRT1 在代謝、心血管疾病和衰老中保護作用的核心，同時也構成其腫瘤抑制臂。

label: Nucleus
description: After PARP1 hyperactivation AIF is often observed to translocate from mitochondria to the nucleus, where it is associated with large-scale DNA fragmentation. However some PARP1-dependent death models show no detectable AIF translocation, implying AIF-independent parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: PARP1 過度活化後常觀察到 AIF 自粒線體轉位至細胞核，並與大規模 DNA 斷裂相關。然而部分 PARP1 依賴性死亡模型未見 AIF 轉位，提示存在不依賴 AIF 的 parthanatos（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: FADD
description: Deleting FADD, c-FLIP, or Caspase-8 in mice is embryonic lethal at ~e10.5 and fully rescued on a RIPK3-deficient background; tissue-specific FADD loss likewise drives RIPK3-dependent necroptosis in keratinocytes and intestinal epithelium, establishing FADD as a suppressor of necroptosis.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠中敲除 FADD、c-FLIP 或 Caspase-8 約在胚胎 e10.5 致死，於 RIPK3 缺失背景下可被完全拯救；組織特異性 FADD 缺失同樣驅動角質細胞與腸道上皮之 RIPK3 依賴型 necroptosis，確立 FADD 為 necroptosis 抑制因子。

label: BRCA1
description: BRCA1 is essential for homologous-recombination repair of double-strand breaks via RAD51 loading. Requirement is the repair dependency.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 經由 RAD51 裝載為雙股斷裂同源重組修復所必需。必要性是修復依賴。

label: Thioredoxin reductase
description: Auranofin is a potent, irreversible covalent inhibitor of both cytosolic (TXNRD1) and mitochondrial (TXNRD2) thioredoxin reductase. Its gold(I) cation coordinates the catalytic C-terminal selenocysteine, blocking thioredoxin regeneration and converting the redox-balancing machinery into a source of lethal ROS.
description_zh_TW: Auranofin 是細胞質（TXNRD1）與粒線體（TXNRD2）硫氧還蛋白還原酶的強效、不可逆共價抑制劑。其金(I)陽離子配位催化所需的 C 端硒半胱氨酸，阻斷硫氧還蛋白再生成，並將氧化還原平衡機制轉變為致命 ROS 的來源。

label: Nucleoside Analog
description: Bromodeoxyuridine is a thymidine analog in the nucleoside-analog class with Gemcitabine and CPEC. Same antimetabolite family, tracer application.
description_zh_TW: Bromodeoxyuridine 是與 Gemcitabine 和 CPEC 同屬核苷類似物類別的胸苷類似物。相同抗代謝家族，追蹤應用。

label: 5-Azacytidine
description: Demethylation by 5-Azacytidine reactivates silenced CDH1; inference from drug listing, capped. Reactivation is the epidrug mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 5-Azacytidine 去甲基化重新活化沉默的 CDH1；自藥物列表的推斷，設上限。重新活化是表觀藥物機制。

label: Singlet Oxygen
description: Singlet oxygen from UVA photosensitizers activates MAPK signaling upstream of matrix metalloproteinase induction. Photochemical oxidant feeds kinase cascades.
description_zh_TW: UVA 光敏劑的 singlet oxygen 在基質金屬蛋白酶誘導上游活化 MAPK 訊號。光化學氧化劑供養激酶級聯。

label: Crohn's Disease
description: The intestinal-epithelial necroptosis driven by FADD/caspase-8 loss is morphologically most similar to Crohn's disease; high immunogenicity of necrotic cells plus loss of barrier function are implicated.
description_zh_TW: FADD/caspase-8 缺失所驅動之腸道上皮 necroptosis，其形態學最接近克隆氏症；壞死細胞之高度免疫原性加上屏障功能喪失被認為牽涉其中。

label: HMGA1
description: HMGA1 is grouped with MLL1 and BRD4 in the SASP-induction scheme as part of the epigenetic control of SASP loci. HMGA1 is a non-histone chromatin architectural protein upregulated in oncogene-induced senescence, where it promotes NAMPT expression and, through it, NAD+-mediated modulation of AMPK signalling; it also associates with senescence-associated heterochromatin foci. Its placement in the scheme indicates that chromatin-level remodelling, and not only transcription-factor availability, sets which SASP genes can be expressed.
description_zh_TW: 在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，HMGA1 與 MLL1、BRD4 同組，屬於 SASP 基因座的表觀遺傳調控。HMGA1 是一種非組蛋白染色質結構蛋白，在癌基因誘導衰老中上調，促進 NAMPT 表現並藉此調節 NAD+ 介導的 AMPK 訊號；它亦與衰老相關異染色質病灶相關。其在圖中的位置顯示，決定哪些 SASP 基因可被表現的是染色質層級的重塑，而不僅是轉錄因子的可用性。

label: DNA Damage Response
description: The DNA damage response engages the p38 MAPK cascade, providing the link between persistent double-strand breaks and SASP gene expression. In the SASP-induction scheme this is the first signalling step after damage sensing: unresolved breaks sustain DDR signalling, which in turn activates p38 MAPK. p38 then acts on two downstream arms, activating NF-kB and stabilising SASP transcripts through MAPKAPK2. Persistent DDR and sustained p38 activity are therefore coupled features of the senescent state, and interrupting either step reduces secretome output without reversing the growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: DNA 損傷反應活化 p38 MAPK 級聯，連結持續的雙股斷裂與 SASP 基因表現。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，這是損傷感測後的第一個訊號步驟：未修復的斷裂持續維持 DDR 訊號，進而活化 p38 MAPK。p38 接著作用於兩個下游臂，活化 NF-kB 並經 MAPKAPK2 穩定 SASP 轉錄本。因此持續的 DDR 與持續的 p38 活性是衰老狀態中相伴的特徵，阻斷任一步驟都能降低分泌輸出而不逆轉生長停滯。

label: Genome stability
description: SIRT6 maintains stability via telomeric H3K9 deacetylation and LINE-1 suppression. Maintenance is the guardian function.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 經由端粒 H3K9 去乙醯化與 LINE-1 抑制維持穩定。維持是守護功能。

label: Wnt Signaling
description: FRAT2 amplifies canonical beta-catenin signaling toward MYCN stabilization and DNMT3A. Promotion is the cascade input.
description_zh_TW: FRAT2 放大典型 beta-catenin 訊號朝向 MYCN 穩定與 DNMT3A。促進是級聯輸入。

label: Phagophore Assembly Site
description: The phagophore assembly site is the platform on which the phagophore is nucleated, elongated, and ultimately sealed into the mature autophagosome. The crescent-shaped isolation membrane formed at the PAS becomes the double-membraned autophagosome.
description_zh_TW: 吞噬泡組裝位點是吞噬泡形成、延伸並最終封閉為成熟自噬體的平台。在 PAS 形成的月牙形隔離膜成為雙膜自噬體。

label: P300
source_file: _document_ - The Beneficial and Adverse Effects of Autophagic Response to Caloric Restriction and Fasting.md
description: The acetyltransferase p300 acetylates ATG4B, an modification that inhibits its proteolytic activity required for LC3 lipidation and autophagosome formation, thereby restraining autophagy under normal conditions. This acetylation-dependent repression adds a transcriptional coactivator-derived control layer to core autophagy machinery beyond the well-studied phosphorylation circuits. Relief of p300-mediated acetylation during stress can de-repress ATG4B and facilitate autophagic flux. The finding situates autophagy regulation within the broader acetylome governed by p300/CBP.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯轉移酶 p300 乙醯化 ATG4B，此修飾抑制其為 LC3 脂化和自噬體形成所需的蛋白水解活性，從而在正常條件下約束自噬。此依賴乙醯化的抑制在眾所周知的磷酸化電路之外，為核心自噬機械增添了源自轉錄共活化因子的控制層次。在壓力期間 p300 媒介乙醯化的解除可解除 ATG4B 的抑制並促進自噬流。此發現將自噬調節置於 p300/CBP 所統轄的更廣泛乙醯體中。

label: Caspase-10
description: Caspase-10 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-10, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-10 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: ovarian cancer
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: KPNB1 is a druggable essential survival oncogene in ovarian cancer models.
description_zh_TW: KPNB1 在卵巢癌模型是可藥物化的必要存活致癌基因。

label: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
description: Alpha-lipoic acid improves endothelial dysfunction, as confirmed in meta-analyses showing improved flow-mediated dilation and markers of oxidative stress in diabetic and metabolic patients. By restoring GSH and reducing NF-kappaB, it ameliorates NO bioavailability. The directionality is antioxidant supplementation to vascular benefit. A caveat is that trial results are heterogeneous and benefits are most consistent in established endothelial dysfunction rather than primary prevention. Lipoic acid also chelates redox-active metals, which may reduce the metal-catalyzed generation of hydroxyl radicals in the vascular wall.
description_zh_TW: 統合分析證實，Alpha-lipoic acid 改善了 endothelial dysfunction，顯示糖尿病和代謝患者中血流介導的擴張和 oxidative stress 標記得到改善。透過恢復 GSH 和減少 NF-κB，它可以改善 NO 的生物利用度。方向性是補充抗氧化劑對血管有益。需要注意的是，試驗結果有差異，在已建立的 endothelial dysfunction 而非一級預防中，效果最一致。硫辛酸也螯合 redox-active metals，這可能會減少血管壁中金屬催化的 hydroxyl radicals 的生成。

label: PD-L1
description: Checkpoint inhibitors block the PD-L1 ligand, restoring T-cell function.
description_zh_TW: 檢查點抑制劑阻斷 PD-L1 配體，恢復 T 細胞功能。

label: RB1
description: RB1 is the Knudson two-hit archetype tumor suppressor. Classification is historical and textbook.
description_zh_TW: RB1 是 Knudson 二擊原型腫瘤抑制基因。歸類具歷史與教科書地位。

label: Acute Kidney Injury
description: SIRT3 is a pivotal coordinator of renal bioenergetics maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis, enhancing antioxidant defenses, and modulating ECM dynamics; its expression is reduced across nephropathies and negatively correlated with histological injury severity. SIRT3 overexpression alleviates AKI and CKD progression in multiple preclinical models, via Nrf2 pathway upregulation, NF-kappaB suppression through IkappaBalpha stabilization, and inhibition of NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 是腎臟生物能學的關鍵協調者，維護粒線體恆定、增強抗氧化防禦並調節 ECM 動態；其表現在腎病變中降低，且與組織學損傷嚴重程度呈負相關。SIRT3 的過量表現在多個臨床前模型中緩解 AKI 和 CKD 進展，透過 Nrf2 途徑上調、NF-kappaB 抑制（經由 IkappaBalpha 穩定化）和 NLRP3 炎症小體活化的抑制。

label: Lysosomal biogenesis
description: The family governs lysosomal biogenesis, autophagic flux, lipophagy and mitophagy. Regulation is the family-level program.
description_zh_TW: 家族掌管溶酶體生合成、自噬流、脂噬與粒線體自噬。調節是家族層級程序。

label: IKKepsilon
description: IKKepsilon is closely related to TBK1, its closest paralog, with which it shares overlapping substrates in the type I interferon response including IRF3 and IRF7. Both kinases contribute to innate antiviral immunity and oncogenic signaling. Their overlapping functions make them jointly attractive therapeutic targets.
description_zh_TW: IKKepsilon 與其最接近的旁系同源基因 TBK1 密切相關，兩者在第一型干擾素反應中共享重疊的受質，包括 IRF3 和 IRF7。兩種激酶都參與先天抗病毒免疫與致癌性訊號傳導。其重疊功能使它們共同成為具吸引力的治療靶點。

label: Cardiotoxicity
description: Cardiotoxicity is a key safety endpoint alongside drug-induced liver injury.
description_zh_TW: 心臟毒性是與藥物性肝損傷並列的關鍵安全終點。

label: IκBα
description: Estrogen induces IκBα expression, which sequesters NF-κB in the cytosol and suppresses inflammasome-priming transcription, a brake on pyroptotic output.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen 誘導 IκBα 表現，將 NF-κB 扣留在細胞質，抑制 inflammasome 啟動轉錄，作為 pyroptosis 輸出的煞車。

label: Cardiomyocytes
description: SIRT3 strengthens mitochondrial function by deacetylating key metabolic enzymes such as SOD2 and IDH2, optimizing TCA cycle efficiency and preserving cardiomyocyte viability under stress, particularly in hypertensive heart failure models. SIRT3 protects cardiomyocytes by modulating ROS levels, oxidative phosphorylation, and Ku70 expression, and suppresses pathological hypertrophy and apoptotic signaling via mitochondrial quality control through PINK1-mediated autophagic pathways.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化關鍵代謝酵素如 SOD2 和 IDH2 增強粒線體功能，優化 TCA 循環效率並在壓力下維護心肌細胞存活率，特別是在高血壓心臟衰竭模型中。SIRT3 透過調節活性氧水平、氧化磷酸化和 Ku70 表現保護心肌細胞，並透過 PINK1 介導的自噬途徑進行粒線體品質控制，抑制病理性肥厚和凋亡訊號。

label: Macroautophagy
description: Atg101 knockdown destabilizes Atg13, abolishes ULK1 integrity and blocks autophagosome formation; metazoan-specific with no yeast ortholog. Requirement is the integrity dependency.
description_zh_TW: Atg101 敲低使 Atg13 不穩定、廢除 ULK1 完整並阻斷自噬體形成；後生動物特異，無酵母同源。必要性是完整性依賴。

label: ADP-ribosylation
description: ARH3 is the only known hydrolase that removes serine-linked mono-ADP-ribose written by the PARP1/HPF1 complex, completing the ADP-ribosylation cycle after PARG removes bulk polymer. ARH3-KO cells accumulate serine-MAR while HPF1-KO cells lose it.
description_zh_TW: ARH3 是目前已知唯一可移除由 PARP1/HPF1 複合體寫入的絲氨酸單 ADP-核糖修飾的水解酶，在 PARG 移除大量聚合物後完成 ADP-ribosylation 循環。ARH3-KO 細胞堆積 serine-MAR，而 HPF1-KO 細胞則減少。

label: CDKN1A
description: CDKN1A (p21) is the key downstream effector of p53-mediated arrest; DNA damage stabilizes p53, which transactivates CDKN1A to block cyclin-CDK complexes. This axis is the rapid enforcement arm of senescence.
description_zh_TW: CDKN1A（p21）是 p53 介導停滯的關鍵下游效應器；DNA 損傷穩定 p53，後者轉活化 CDKN1A 以阻斷 cyclin-CDK 複合體。此軸是衰老的快速執行臂。

label: Mitochondrial Function
description: SIRT3 is the principal mitochondrial deacetylase, regulating the majority of the mitochondrial acetylome to sustain oxidative-phosphorylation enzymes, fatty-acid oxidation, and the TCA/mitochondrial electron transport chain; SIRT3 declines with age, impairing mitochondrial function (source review; Hebert et al., 2013).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 是主要的粒線體去乙醯酶，調節粒線體乙醯化組的大部分蛋白質以維持氧化磷酸化酶、脂肪酸氧化和 TCA/粒線體電子傳輸鏈；SIRT3 隨年齡下降，損害粒線體功能（文獻綜述；Hebert et al., 2013）。

label: Somatic Cell Nuclear Transfer
description: Oocyte factors reset the donor genome to a totipotent and pluripotent state.
description_zh_TW: 卵母細胞因子將供體基因組重置為全能與多能狀態。

label: BET inhibitors
description: BET inhibitors targets BRD4. BET inhibitors displace bromodomain proteins such as BRD4 from acetylated chromatin, silencing MYC and inflammatory transcription programs. BRD4 is a bromodomain-and-extra-terminal protein that binds acetylated histones at super-enhancers to sustain oncogenic transcription. The relationship is directional, with BET inhibitors acting as the operative agent upon BRD4 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: BET inhibitors目標BRD4。 BET inhibitors 取代乙醯化染色質中的溴結構域蛋白，例如 BRD4，沉默 MYC 和發炎轉錄程序。 BRD4 是一種溴結構域和額外末端蛋白，可在超級增強子處結合乙醯化組蛋白以維持致癌轉錄。這種關係是有方向的，BET inhibitors 充當 BRD4 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: SUV39H1
description: SUV39H1 deposits H3K9me3 as a family member enzyme.
description_zh_TW: SUV39H1 作為家族成員酶沉積 H3K9me3。

label: H4K16
description: Sas2p acetylates histone H4 at lysine 16, opening telomeric chromatin.
description_zh_TW: Sas2p 乙醯化組蛋白 H4 離胺酸 16，打開端粒染色質。

label: PAR
description: PARylated histone H1.2 carries poly(ADP-ribose) out of the nucleus during parthanatos, delivering the polymer to cytosolic and mitochondrial targets; PAR-dependent ubiquitination of H1.2 by Iduna blocks this export (Moura et al. 2024; Andrabi 2011).
description_zh_TW: 在 parthanatos 中，受 PAR 修飾的組蛋白 H1.2 將聚(ADP-核糖)攜出細胞核，將此聚合物遞送至胞質與粒線體標靶；Iduna 對 H1.2 的 PAR 依賴性泛素化會阻斷此輸出（Moura et al. 2024；Andrabi 2011）。

label: Mitochondrial Complex I
description: Metformin inhibits complex I to raise AMP:ATP and activate AMPK. Inhibition is the bioenergetic entry.
description_zh_TW: Metformin 抑制複合體 I 以提高 AMP:ATP 並活化 AMPK。抑制是生物能量進入。

label: Oncogene
description: N-Myc is a MYC-family oncogenic transcription factor.
description_zh_TW: N-Myc 是 MYC 家族致癌轉錄因子。

label: Macromolecular Crowding
description: Macromolecular crowding impedes vesicle and organelle diffusion, compromising autophagic flux in pigment-laden neurons. Crowding thus links pigment accumulation to degradative failure.
description_zh_TW: 大分子擁擠阻礙囊泡與胞器擴散，損害色素 laden 神經元的自噬通量。擁擠因而將色素累積與降解失敗連結。

label: ERK
description: RSK is the canonical ERK effector kinase transducing MAPK output to survival and death substrates.
description_zh_TW: RSK 是典型的 ERK 效應激酶，將 MAPK 輸出傳遞至存活與死亡受質。

label: p16
description: SQSTM1/p62-mediated selective autophagy directly degrades p16 and p21 (independent of UPS), reversing the senescent phenotype in canine MMVD valve cells. Qualification: evidence from Tang 2025 canine MMVD valve interstitial cells; tissue-specific, not yet generic mammalian.
description_zh_TW: SQSTM1/p62 介導的選擇性自噬直接降解 p16 與 p21（不依賴 UPS），逆轉犬隻 MMVD 瓣膜細胞中的衰老表型。 限定：證據來自 Tang 2025 犬 MMVD 瓣膜間質細胞；組織特異，尚未通用於哺乳類。

label: Ribociclib
description: Ribociclib is a selective CDK4/6 inhibitor blocking G1 progression. Same pharmacological class logic as palbociclib.
description_zh_TW: Ribociclib 是阻斷 G1 進展的選擇性 CDK4/6 抑制劑。與 palbociclib 相同的藥理類別邏輯。

label: Lipid peroxyl radical
description: Lipid peroxyl radical hydrogen abstraction from polyunsaturated fatty acids yields lipid hydroperoxide plus a new lipid radical; the rate-determining propagation step. Abstraction sustains the peroxidation chain.
description_zh_TW: 脂質過氧自由基從多元不飽和脂肪酸提取氫，產生脂質氫過氧化物加新脂質自由基；是速率決定傳播步驟。提取維持過氧化鏈。

label: DNMT3b
description: DNMT3a forms functional complexes with its paralog DNMT3b and with the accessory protein DNMT3L to deposit methylation at targeted loci. The two de novo methyltransferases share sequence homology but exhibit distinct genomic targeting preferences, with DNMT3b favoring repetitive elements while DNMT3a acts more broadly across gene bodies and intergenic regions. Their cooperative activity is critical during early embryogenesis for establishing the genome-wide methylation patterns that are subsequently maintained by DNMT1, and both are essential for normal development.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3a 與其旁系同源物 DNMT3b 和輔助蛋白 DNMT3L 形成功能複合物，在目標位點沉積甲基化。這兩種從頭甲基轉移酶具有序列同源性，但表現出不同的基因組靶向偏好，其中 DNMT3b 有利於重複元件，而 DNMT3a 在基因體和基因間區域中發揮更廣泛的作用。它們的合作活動在早期胚胎髮生過程中對於建立隨後由 DNMT1 維持的全基因組甲基化模式至關重要，並且兩者對於正常發育都是必需的。

label: BubR1
description: BUBR1 KEN-box sequesters CDC20 in the mitotic checkpoint complex.
description_zh_TW: BUBR1 KEN-box 在有絲分裂檢查點複合體隔離 CDC20。

label: Purkinje cell
description: Selective Purkinje and pontine neuronal death defines the pathology.
description_zh_TW: 選擇性 Purkinje 與橋腦神經元死亡定義病理。

label: Docetaxel
description: Docetaxel binds beta-tubulin, locking polymer assembly and arresting mitosis.
description_zh_TW: docetaxel 結合 β-tubulin，鎖定聚合物組裝並停滯有絲分裂。

label: Histone Methyltransferase
description: Histone methyltransferases deposit methyl groups on histone lysine and arginine residues.
description_zh_TW: 組蛋白甲基轉移酶在組蛋白離胺酸與精胺酸沉積甲基。

label: Arginine
description: Protein citrullination is definitionally arginine deimination to citrulline residues. Substrate identity anchors the modification.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白瓜氨酸化定義上即精胺酸脫亞胺為瓜氨酸殘基。底物身份錨定修飾。

label: erlotinib
description: Erlotinib selectively blocks the EGFR ATP pocket, mirroring the melittin edge.
description_zh_TW: erlotinib 選擇性阻斷 EGFR ATP 口袋，呼應 melittin 邊。

label: MC1R
description: MC1R regulates the melanogenic pathway by switching Melanocytes from pheomelanin to eumelanin synthesis. Upon binding alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone, MC1R signals via Gs to stimulate adenylyl cyclase and cAMP, activating the eumelanogenic program in Melanogenesis. Loss-of-function variants reduce signaling and shift synthesis toward Pheomelanin.
description_zh_TW: MC1R 透過將 Melanocytes 從 pheomelanin 合成切換為 eumelanin 合成來調節黑色素生成途徑。在結合 alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone 後，MC1R 透過 Gs 發出信號以刺激 adenylyl cyclase 和 cAMP，啟動 Melanogenesis 中的 eumelanogenic 程序。功能缺失變異會降低信號傳導並使合成轉向 Pheomelanin。

label: Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
description: SIRT1 protects against myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury: knockout increases infarct size while overexpression upregulates FoxO1 and MnSOD and downregulates caspase-3 and Bax.
