Signaling upstream of SIRT1 includes miR-132 inhibition leading to PGC-1alpha/Nrf2, and lncRNA Oip5-as1 acting through the SIRT1/AMPK/PGC-1alpha axis. SIRT1 is thus an endogenous cardioprotective factor against reperfusion damage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在心肌缺血—再灌流損傷中受保護：基因敲除增加梗塞面積，而過度表現上調 FoxO1 與 MnSOD 並下調 caspase-3 與 Bax。SIRT1 上游的訊號包括 miR-132 抑制導致 PGC-1alpha/Nrf2，以及 lncRNA Oip5-as1 經由 SIRT1/AMPK/PGC-1alpha 軸作用。SIRT1 因此是對抗再灌流損傷的內源性心臟保護因子。

label: Atg7
description: Atg7 is the E1-like enzyme that activates LC3-I for phosphatidylethanolamine conjugation to LC3-II, the lipidation step required for autophagosome elongation and closure.
description_zh_TW: Atg7 是 E1 樣酶，活化 LC3-I 以接合 phosphatidylethanolamine 形成 LC3-II，此脂化步驟是自噬體延長與閉合所必需。

label: Colorectal Cancer
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Irinotecan is a flagship colorectal cancer therapeutic.
description_zh_TW: irinotecan 是結直腸癌旗艦治療藥。

label: HMGB2
description: When chromatin-bound, HMGB2 actively shields SASP gene loci from the spread of repressive heterochromatin. Its depletion in senescence coincides with elevated expression of SASP genes in replicative senescence.
description_zh_TW: 當結合於染色質時，HMGB2 主動保護 SASP 基因座免受抑制性異染色質擴散。它在衰老中的耗竭與複製性衰老中 SASP 基因表現升高同時發生。

label: Immune System
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: In clinical settings, rapamycin's immunosuppressive mechanisms increase infection risk and impair wound healing, especially in otherwise healthy individuals without clinical manifestations that outweigh the risk of side effects. Some early clinical studies suggest short-term rapamycin or rapalogs may improve aspects of immune function in older adults, but these relied on serologic responses to influenza vaccination, a marker with limited predictive value for broader immunocompetence. Broader measures including T cell repertoire diversity, innate immune activity, and real-world infection resistance remain underexplored.
description_zh_TW: 在臨床環境中，rapamycin的免疫抑製機制增加感染風險並損害傷口癒合，特別是在其他方面健康、沒有臨床表現的個體中，其風險超過副作用的風險。一些早期臨床研究表明，短期rapamycin或rapalogs可能改善老年人免疫功能的某些方面，但這些研究依賴於對流感疫苗接種的血清學反應，這對更廣泛的免疫能力的預測價值有限。更廣泛的措施，包括T細胞庫多樣性、先天免疫活性和現實世界的感染抵抗力，仍然研究不足。

label: Wnt
description: Wnt/Frizzled inhibits the destruction complex so beta-catenin accumulates; core canonical mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Wnt/Frizzled 抑制破壞複合體使 β-catenin 累積；核心典型機制。

label: Regulated Cell Death
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Regulated necrosis — the lytic subset of regulated cell death — covers necroptosis, MPT, ferroptosis, pyroptosis, PARP-1-mediated and NADPH-oxidase-mediated regulated necrosis, lysosomal membrane permeabilization and others.
description_zh_TW: Regulated necrosis——regulated cell death 之裂解性子集——涵蓋 necroptosis、MPT、鐵死亡、焦亡、PARP-1 媒介與 NADPH 氧化酶媒介之 regulated necrosis、溶酶體膜通透化等。

label: Cyclin-Dependent Kinase
description: CDKN1A-encoded p21 inhibits cyclin-CDK enzymes, notably CDK2, enforcing G1/S blockade. This direct inhibition is shared with the Cip/Kip family mechanism.
description_zh_TW: CDKN1A 編碼的 p21 抑制 cyclin-CDK 酶（特別是 CDK2），執行 G1/S 封鎖。此直接抑制與 Cip/Kip 家族機制共享。

label: Oculocutaneous Albinism
description: All forms of Oculocutaneous Albinism result from defects in melanosome biogenesis, tyrosinase function, or downstream melanin synthesis enzymes, disrupting Melanogenesis. This leads to variable degrees of hypopigmentation of the skin, hair, and eyes. OCA is a group of autosomal recessive disorders affecting melanin biosynthesis.
description_zh_TW: 所有形式的 Oculocutaneous Albinism 都由 melanosome 生物發生、tyrosinase 功能或下游黑色素合成酶的缺陷引起，從而破壞 Melanogenesis。這導致皮膚、頭髮和眼睛不同程度的色素減退。OCA 是一組影響黑色素生物合成的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病。

label: TRIF
description: TRIF carries a RHIM domain that directly recruits and activates RIPK3 downstream of TLR3/TLR4, enabling RIPK1-bypassing necroptosis under caspase inhibition (poly(I:C) or LPS); this pathway is implicated in acute pancreatitis and immune dysregulation (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: TRIF 具 RHIM 結構域，可在 TLR3/TLR4 下游直接招募並活化 RIPK3，於 caspase 受抑制時（poly(I:C) 或 LPS）促成繞過 RIPK1 的 necroptosis；此路徑與急性胰臟炎及免疫失調相關（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Nitric Oxide Synthase
description: Aminoguanidine, the first AGE inhibitor, has a safety concern related to its inhibition of nitric oxide synthase. By blocking NOS, aminoguanidine can reduce nitric oxide production, which together with its pro-oxidant activities prevented its clinical use. This NOS inhibition is one of the adverse effects that emerged during evaluation of aminoguanidine as a therapeutic agent. Despite these limitations, aminoguanidine remains a key research compound that established the concept of AGE inhibition for preventing diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 作為首個 AGE inhibitor，其 safety concern 與抑制 nitric oxide synthase（NOS）有關。透過 blocking NOS，aminoguanidine 可減少 nitric oxide production，這與其 pro-oxidant activities 一起阻止了其 clinical use。此 NOS inhibition 是在評估 aminoguanidine 作為 therapeutic agent 期間出現的 adverse effects 之一。儘管有這些 limitations，aminoguanidine 仍是確立 AGE inhibition 以預防 diabetic complications 概念的關鍵 research compound。

label: Slug
description: Slug (SNAI2) is a core zinc-finger driver of EMT. Parallel driver to Snail.
description_zh_TW: Slug（SNAI2）是 EMT 的核心鋅指驅動者。與 Snail 平行的驅動者。

label: FOXO Transcription Factors
description: Akt phosphorylates FOXO, excluding it from the nucleus and silencing Bim/Puma transcription.
description_zh_TW: Akt 磷酸化 FOXO 將其排除於核外，沉默 Bim/Puma 轉錄。

label: Pentose Phosphate Pathway
source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md
description: As hexokinase-1 produces glucose-6-phosphate, its PAR-mediated inhibition also starves the pentose phosphate pathway, providing a mechanistic link to the NADPH and reduced-glutathione depletion observed during parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: 由於 hexokinase-1 產生 glucose-6-phosphate，其受 PAR 抑制亦使戊糖磷酸途徑缺乏底物，為 parthanatos 中觀察到的 NADPH 與還原態穀胱甘肽耗竭提供機制連結（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT2 prevents NAFLD by deacetylating hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha, but is deleterious in hepatic fibrosis through the SIRT2/ERK/c-Myc axis. SIRT4 upregulation inhibits high-fat-diet-induced lipid accumulation, inflammation, and fibrogenesis via the SIRT4/Smad4 axis, though SIRT4 is harmful in NAFLD by destabilizing mitochondrial trifunctional protein alpha.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化肝細胞核因子 4 alpha 防止 NAFLD，但在肝纖維化中透過 SIRT2/ERK/c-Myc 軸是有害的。SIRT4 上調透過 SIRT4/Smad4 軸抑制高脂飲食誘發的脂質堆積、發炎與纖維生成，儘管 SIRT4 在 NAFLD 中因不穩定粒線體三功能蛋白質 alpha 而有害。

label: Dendritic cells
description: Low-dose mTORC1 inhibition by rapamycin improves immune responses by increasing dendritic cell activity and CD8+ memory T-cell counts. This potentiation is dose-dependent and immunostimulatory at low dose while immunosuppressive at high dose.
description_zh_TW: 低劑量 rapamycin 抑制 mTORC1 可透過增加樹突細胞活性與 CD8+ 記憶 T 細胞數量來改善免疫反應。此增強作用具劑量依賴性，低劑量免疫刺激、高劑量免疫抑制。

label: Peroxiredoxin
description: Cytosolic thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) donates electrons to regenerate oxidized peroxiredoxins (Prx1/2 and the family generally) after they reduce hydrogen peroxide, sustaining cytosolic peroxide clearance. Trx1 is itself recycled by thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD1) using NADPH. This is the cytosolic mirror of the mitochondrial Trx2/Prx3 arm and involves the same peroxiredoxin family that consumes SOD-generated H2O2, tying Trx1 into the SOD-peroxide-thioredoxin relay in the cytoplasm.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質 thioredoxin-1（Trx1）捐贈電子以再生氧化態的 peroxiredoxins（一般指 Prx1/2 及該家族），使它們在還原過氧化氫後恢復活性，從而維持細胞質的過氧化物清除。Trx1 本身再由 thioredoxin reductase（TXNRD1）以 NADPH 回收。這是粒線體 Trx2/Prx3 分支的細胞質鏡像，涉及同一消耗 SOD 所產生 H2O2 的 peroxiredoxin 家族，因此將 Trx1 納入細胞質中的 SOD-過氧化物-thioredoxin 接力。

label: LINE-1
description: Derepressed LINE-1 retrotransposon cDNA drives interferon-mediated SASP reinforcement in deep senescence. This tasks-layer edge parallels the senescence-layer LINE-1 drive triple.
description_zh_TW: 去抑制的 LINE-1 逆轉錄轉座子 cDNA 在深層衰老驅動干擾素介導的 SASP 強化。此 tasks 層邊與衰老層的 LINE-1 驅動 triple 平行。

label: Maillard Reaction
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Terminal high molecular weight brown pigments of cooked foods are Maillard melanoidins. Polymerization ends the browning cascade.
description_zh_TW: 熟食的終末高分子量棕色色素即 Maillard melanoidins。聚合終止褐變級聯。

label: FL118
description: FL118 is a second-generation camptothecin analog that traps the covalent TOP1-DNA cleavage complex, preventing religation of single-strand breaks. Collision of the trapped complex with replicating DNA polymerases converts these breaks into lethal double-strand breaks.
description_zh_TW: FL118 是第二代喜樹鹼類似物，會捕獲共價的 TOP1-DNA 切割複合體，阻止單股斷裂的重新連結。被捕獲複合體與複製中的 DNA 聚合酶碰撞，會將這些斷裂轉化為致命的雙股斷裂。

label: Stress-Induced Premature Senescence
description: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide is a standard in-vitro premature senescence inducer via p53/p21 and p16/Rb.
description_zh_TW: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide 是經 p53/p21 與 p16/Rb 的標準體外早發衰老誘發劑。

label: Peroxiredoxin 3
description: Mitochondrial thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) donates electrons to reduce the oxidized (disulfide) form of peroxiredoxin 3 (Prx3), restoring its peroxide-scavenging activity. Trx2 is itself recycled to the reduced form by mitochondrial thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD2) using NADPH. Because Prx3 consumes the H2O2 generated by MnSOD, the Trx2/Prx3 arm is the water-evolving half of the mitochondrial peroxide-relay and a direct functional partner of MnSOD in the matrix.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體 thioredoxin-2（Trx2）捐贈電子以還原 peroxiredoxin 3（Prx3）的氧化態（雙硫）形式，恢復其過氧化物清除活性。Trx2 本身再由粒線體 thioredoxin reductase（TXNRD2）以 NADPH 回收為還原形式。由於 Prx3 消耗 MnSOD 所產生的 H2O2，Trx2/Prx3 分支是粒線體過氧化物接力中產生水的半段，也是 MnSOD 在基質中的直接功能夥伴。

label: Insulin Secretion
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT1 supports glucose-stimulated insulin secretion by transcriptionally repressing UCP2 in pancreatic beta-cells, preserving mitochondrial membrane potential and ATP synthesis; beta-cell SIRT1 overexpression enhances, while SIRT1 loss impairs, the insulin response, linking SIRT1 to beta-cell function and diabetes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過轉錄抑制胰腺 β 細胞中的 UCP2 來支持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌，維持粒線體膜電位和 ATP 合成；β 細胞 SIRT1 過表達可增強胰島素反應，而 SIRT1 缺失則損害胰島素反應，將 SIRT1 與 β 細胞功能和糖尿病聯繫起來。

label: Proteasome
description: DNA damage drives SIRT1 loss post-transcriptionally through the ubiquitin-proteasome system, not autophagy-lysosomes and not mRNA downregulation. Cycloheximide chase showed a shortened SIRT1 half-life under etoposide; qRT-PCR showed unchanged SIRT1 mRNA; and only the proteasome inhibitor MG132 — not bafilomycin A1 or chloroquine — restored SIRT1 levels while its K48-polyubiquitination rose. This establishes UPS-dependent turnover as the mechanism of SIRT1 downregulation in the DDR.
description_zh_TW: DNA 損傷透過泛素-蛋白酶體系統（而非自噬-溶酶體、也非 mRNA 下調）以轉錄後方式造成 SIRT1 減少。cycloheximide chase 顯示 etoposide 下 SIRT1 半衰期縮短；qRT-PCR 顯示 SIRT1 mRNA 不變；且只有蛋白酶體抑制劑 MG132——而非 bafilomycin A1 或 chloroquine——能恢復 SIRT1 水平，同時其 K48 多泛素化上升。這確立了依賴 UPS 的代謝是 DDR 中 SIRT1 下調的機制。

label: Cytochrome b5 reductase
description: Cytochrome b5 reductase is an in-range reductant of adrenochrome by redox-potential argument. Reduction adds a microsomal arm to aminochrome metabolism.
description_zh_TW: 細胞色素 b5 還原酶依氧化還原電位是腎上腺素的還原劑。還原為胺色素代謝增加微粒體分支。

label: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation
description: Failing lysosomes cannot clear α-synuclein oligomers, so aggregates accumulate into Lewy bodies — the hallmark of Parkinson's disease dopaminergic neurons. Lysosomal failure co-acts with Complex I defects, and dying neurons then release neuromelanin and aggregates as DAMPs that prime microglia. Because the lysosome is the terminal station of autophagy and mitophagy, its dysfunction converts otherwise-manageable protein load into lethal aggregation, and lipofuscin accumulation further buffers lysosomal pH upward.
description_zh_TW: 失能的溶酶體無法清除 α-synuclein 寡聚體，使聚集物累積成路易氏體——帕金森氏症多巴胺神經元的標誌。溶酶體失能與 Complex I 缺陷協同作用，垂死神經元隨後釋出神經黑色素與聚集物作為 DAMP 致敏小膠細胞。由於溶酶體是自噬與粒線體自噬的終點站，其失能會使原本可處理的蛋白負荷轉為致命聚集，而脂褐素的累積更進一步推高溶酶體的 pH。

label: BRCA
description: BRCA1/2 defects and homologous-recombination deficiency characterize the high-grade serous subtype of ovarian cancer. BRCA status is used to determine PARP-inhibitor eligibility. BRCA alterations are therefore central to ovarian cancer biology and targeted therapy.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1/2 缺陷與同源重組缺陷是高惡性度漿液性卵巢癌亞型的特徵。BRCA 狀態用於決定 PARP 抑制劑的適用資格。因此 BRCA 改變對卵巢癌生物學與靶向治療至關重要。

label: Roscovitine
description: Roscovitine is a pan-CDK pharmacological inhibitor. Broad-spectrum CDK blockade is its defining action.
description_zh_TW: Roscovitine 是泛 CDK 藥理抑制劑。廣譜 CDK 封鎖是其定義性作用。

label: KDM4
description: H3K36me3 is a gene-body trimethyl mark deposited co-transcriptionally by SETD2 and removed by KDM4 (JMJD2) JmjC demethylases. Its dynamics regulate transcribed gene bodies including SASP loci.
description_zh_TW: H3K36me3 是由 SETD2 共轉錄沉積、由 KDM4（JMJD2）JmjC 去甲基酶移除的基因體三甲基標記。其動態調控包括 SASP 基因座在內的轉錄基因體。

label: APE1
description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) reduces the redox-sensitive protein APE1/Ref-1, maintaining its critical cysteine residues in the reduced state. Reduced Ref-1 in turn activates redox-sensitive transcription factors such as AP-1 and NF-kappaB, coupling the thioredoxin system to transcriptional decisions.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 會還原氧化還原敏感的蛋白質 APE1/Ref-1，使其關鍵的半胱氨酸殘基維持在還原態。被還原的 Ref-1 進而活化 AP-1 和 NF-kappaB 等氧化還原敏感的轉錄因子，將硫氧還蛋白系統與轉錄決策連結起來。

label: Substantia Nigra
description: The striatum receives dopamine from the substantia nigra pars compacta via the nigrostriatal pathway, the loss of which characterizes Parkinson's disease. This dopaminergic input is terminated mainly by DAT reuptake and shaped by COMT, especially in lower-DAT compartments, and is essential for normal striatal and motor function. The integrity of this projection is required for coordinated movement and reward processing. Its degeneration produces the cardinal motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: 紋狀體透過黑質紋狀體途徑從黑質緻密部接收多巴胺，多巴胺的喪失是帕金森氏症的特徵。這種多巴胺能輸入主要由 DAT 再攝取終止，並由 COMT 塑造，特別是在低 DAT 區室中，對於正常紋狀體和運動功能至關重要。協調 movement 和 reward 處理需要此投影的完整性。它的退化產生了帕金森氏症的主要運動症狀。

label: Zeb1
description: Zeb1 is a core E-box-binding driver of EMT. Driving defines its transition role.
description_zh_TW: Zeb1 是 EMT 的核心 E-box 結合驅動者。驅動定義其轉換角色。

label: Lysosome biogenesis
description: MYC antagonizes TFEB and TFE3 transcriptional activities at lysosomal gene promoters, thereby repressing lysosome biogenesis in proliferating cells. Through direct competition for CLEAR elements and broader chromatin effects, MYC suppresses the degradative capacity that would otherwise constrain growth. This repression aligns cellular resources toward biosynthesis rather than turnover during oncogenic drive. The MYC-lysosome antagonism is a key axis by which cancer cells reshape their degradative landscape.
description_zh_TW: MYC 在溶酶體基因啟動子處拮抗 TFEB 和 TFE3 的轉錄活性，從而在增殖細胞中抑制溶酶體生物發生。透過對 CLEAR 元件的直接競爭以及更廣泛的染色質效應，MYC 抑制了本會限制生長的降解能力。此抑制將細胞資源在致癌驅動下導向生物合成而非更新。MYC-溶酶體拮抗作用是癌細胞重塑其降解景觀的關鍵軸。

label: XIAP
description: Akt phosphorylates XIAP at Ser87, preventing its ubiquitination and degradation.
description_zh_TW: Akt 在 Ser87 磷酸化 XIAP，防止其泛素化與降解。

label: Tyrosinase
description: Tyrosinase is the rate-limiting enzyme of eumelanin biosynthesis, paralleling the dopachrome tautomerase produces Eumelanin edge. Enzymatic oxidation initiates dark-pigment polymerization.
description_zh_TW: Tyrosinase 是 eumelanin 生物合成的限速酶，與 dopachrome tautomerase 產生 Eumelanin 邊平行。酶促氧化啟動深色素聚合。

label: Adenosine Triphosphate
description: NMRK2 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 2) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) using only a single molecule of ATP, whereas synthesis of NMN from nicotinamide by NAMPT requires more than three ATP equivalents. This makes the NMRK2 pathway an energy-sparing mechanism that may be favored in the failing heart, where the shift from NAMPT to NMRK2 for NAD+ synthesis represents a common adaptive response. NR is expressed and active mainly in cardiac and skeletal muscle, which may explain the better ability of these tissues to respond to NR. NR supplementation is therefore regarded as a powerful approach to preserve cardiac function in heart failure.
description_zh_TW: NMRK2（nicotinamide ribose kinase 2，菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 2）僅需單一分子的 ATP 即可將 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）轉化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸），而 NAMPT 由菸鹼醯胺合成 NMN 則需要超過三個 ATP 當量。這使得 NMRK2 路徑成為一種節能機制，可能在衰竭的心臟中受到偏好，因為在該處由 NAMPT 轉向 NMRK2 進行 NAD+ 合成代表一種常見的適應性反應。NR 主要在心肌與骨骼肌中表現並具活性，這或許解釋了這些組織對 NR 較佳的反應能力。因此，NR 補充被視為維持心衰竭中心臟功能的有力方法。

label: Radiosensitizer
description: Nitroimidazoles are investigated as hypoxic cell radiosensitizers that replace oxygen in the chemical reactions producing radiation-induced DNA damage. They increase cytotoxicity in hypoxic cells while having no effect on already-aerobic (maximally radiosensitive) cells.
description_zh_TW: 硝基咪唑被研究作為低氧細胞放射增敏劑，在產生輻射誘導 DNA 損傷的化學反應中取代氧氣。它們增加低氧細胞的細胞毒性，同時對已充氧（最大放射敏感）細胞無影響。

label: Pyruvate
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Pyruvate Kinase M2 catalyzes the final glycolytic step, PEP to pyruvate.
description_zh_TW: Pyruvate Kinase M2 催化最後糖解步驟，PEP 至 Pyruvate。

label: Cardiomyopathy
description: Keshan disease is an endemic nutritional cardiomyopathy by definition. Classification places the selenium-deficiency disorder among myocardial diseases.
description_zh_TW: Keshan disease 依定義是地方性營養性心肌病。歸類將硒缺乏症置於心肌疾病之中。

label: STUB1
description: The E3 ubiquitin ligase STUB1 ubiquitinates TFEB, and this ubiquitination enhances TFEB activity (PMID 28754656). Rather than simply marking TFEB for degradation, ubiquitination by STUB1 in this case increases the transcription factor's functional output, consistent with the growing appreciation that ubiquitination can serve non-proteolytic regulatory functions. This adds TFEB to the set of proteins whose activity is tuned by ubiquitin conjugation. The finding illustrates the diversity of post-translational modifications - including ubiquitination, PARsylation, and SUMOylation in addition to phosphorylation and acetylation - that regulate TFEB's localization, stability, and transcriptional activity in the control of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy.
description_zh_TW: E3 泛素連接酶 STUB1 泛素化 TFEB，此泛素化增強 TFEB 活性（PMID 28754656）。在此情況下，STUB1 的泛素化並非簡單地將 TFEB 標記為降解，而是增加該轉錄因子的功能輸出，這與日益增強的認識一致——泛素化可以發揮非蛋白水解的調節功能。這將 TFEB 加入活性通過泛素偶聯調節的蛋白質集合。此發現說明了翻譯後修飾的多樣性——包括泛素化、PARylation 和 SUMO 化，以及磷酸化和乙醯化——共同調節 TFEB 的定位、穩定性和轉錄活性，以控制溶酶體生物發生和自噬。

label: ACAT1
description: The acetyltransferase ACAT1 acetylates TFEB at multiple lysine residues with opposing functional outcomes: acetylation at K116 hinders TFEB binding to DNA (PMID 30059277), while acetylation at K91, K103, and K430 promotes nuclear translocation and DNA binding. These site-specific acetylation events modulate TFEB's ability to interact with chromatin and activate transcription of lysosomal and autophagic genes. The K116 acetylation that inhibits DNA binding is reversed by SIRT1 deacetylation, which enhances TFEB transcriptional activity. Together these marks show that acetylation acts as a dynamic post-translational switch controlling TFEB's DNA-binding capacity and thus its gene-regulatory output.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯基轉移酶 ACAT1 在多個賴氨酸殘基上乙醯化 TFEB，產生相反的功能結果：K116 的乙醯化阻礙 TFEB 與 DNA 的結合（PMID 30059277），而 K91、K103 和 K430 的乙醯化則促進核轉位與 DNA 結合。這些位點特異性的乙醯化事件調節 TFEB 與染色質相互作用並啟動溶酶體和自噬基因轉錄的能力。K116 的乙醯化抑制 DNA 結合，此作用可被 SIRT1 去乙醯化逆轉，進而增強 TFEB 的轉錄活性。這些修飾標記表明，乙醯化作為一個動態的翻譯後開關，控制 TFEB 的 DNA 結合能力及其基因調節輸出。

label: Cortisol
description: Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) released from the anterior pituitary under hypothalamic CRH stimulation binds the adrenal cortex to drive cortisol synthesis and release, forming the effector arm of the HPA-axis stress response. Chronic ACTH–cortisol activation suppresses heart-rate variability and impairs mitochondrial biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 促腎上腺皮質激素（ACTH）在下視丘 CRH 刺激下由腦下垂體前葉釋放，作用於腎上腺皮質以驅動 cortisol 的合成與釋放，構成 HPA 軸壓力反應的效應臂。慢性的 ACTH–cortisol 活化會抑制心率變異度並損害粒線體生合成。

label: Beta-hydroxybutyrate
description: In Abeta-induced AD rats with impaired hippocampal PKA-CREB-BDNF signaling, both intermittent fasting and exercise raised circulating beta-hydroxybutyrate, with the largest elevation in the combined fasted-exercise group. The beta-hydroxybutyrate surge paralleled the strongest rescue of PKA-CREB-BDNF activity and cognition, framing metabolic-neurotrophic coupling as a mediator of fasting-plus-exercise synergy.
description_zh_TW: 在海馬 PKA-CREB-BDNF 訊號受損的 Abeta 誘發 AD 大鼠中，間歇性禁食與運動均提升循環 Beta-hydroxybutyrate，其中禁食合併運動組升幅最大。此 βHB 上升與 PKA-CREB-BDNF 活性及認知的最強挽救平行，顯示代謝-神經營養耦合是禁食加運動協同效應的媒介。

label: Daratumumab
description: Daratumumab (Darzalex, first approved 2015) and isatuximab (Sarclisa, approved 2020/2021) are IgG1 monoclonal antibodies that bind distinct epitopes on CD38, a cell-surface ectoenzyme. By engaging CD38 on malignant plasma cells, daratumumab triggers antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity and complement-dependent killing. The directionality is the antibody acting on CD38-expressing cells. Although primarily an anticancer agent, depleting CD38 also reduces NAD+ consumption, indirectly favoring sirtuin activity.
description_zh_TW: Daratumumab（Darzalex，2015 年首次獲批）和 isatuximab（Sarclisa，2020/2021 年獲批）是 IgG1 單克隆抗體，結合 CD38（一種細胞表面外酶）的不同表位。通過結合惡性漿細胞上的 CD38，daratumumab 觸發抗體依賴性細胞毒性和補體依賴性殺傷。在方向性上，抗體作用於表達 CD38 的細胞。雖然主要是抗癌藥物，但耗竭 CD38 也減少 NAD+ 消耗，間接有利於 sirtuin 活性。

label: mTORC1 to lysosomes
description: Rag GTPases (RagA/B and RagC/D) function as heterodimers that bind the mTORC1 subunit Raptor and promote relocalization of mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface, where activator Rheb resides. Amino-acid sufficiency favors the active Rag conformation, positioning mTORC1 for activation; amino-acid starvation inactivates Rags and disperses mTORC1, de-repressing autophagy. The Rags therefore act as amino-acid sensors that bridge nutrient availability to mTORC1 spatial activation. Their regulation by the Ragulator and GAPs (e.g., GATOR complexes) is central to nutrient signaling.
description_zh_TW: Rag GTPases（RagA/B 和 RagC/D）作為異二聚體發揮功能，結合 mTORC1 次單元 Raptor，並促進 mTORC1 重新定位至活化劑 Rheb 所在的溶酶體表面。胺基酸充足有利於活化的 Rag 構象，將 mTORC1 定位以進行活化；胺基酸飢餓則使 Rags 失活並分散 mTORC1，解除對自噬的抑制。因此 Rags 作為胺基酸感測器，將營養可得性橋接到 mTORC1 的空間活化。它們受 Ragulator 和 GAPs（例如 GATOR 複合物）調節，是營養信號的核心。

label: nootropic
description: A nootropic is by definition a cognitive-enhancing agent targeting alertness, attention or executive function. Classification covers prescription repurposing like modafinil as well as supplements.
description_zh_TW: nootropic 依定義是針對警覺、注意或執行功能的認知增強劑。歸類涵蓋如 modafinil 的處方再利用與補充劑。

label: SOD1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: Tofersen (Qalsody) is an intrathecal antisense oligonucleotide against SOD1 mRNA, approved April 2023 on biomarker grounds (plasma NfL −55%) for SOD1-ALS and now tested presymptomatically in the ATLAS trial — the first precision neurodegenerative therapy.
description_zh_TW: Tofersen（Qalsody）是針對 SOD1 mRNA 的鞘內反義寡核苷酸，2023 年 4 月依生物標記（血漿 NfL −55%）獲准用於 SOD1-ALS，現於 ATLAS 試驗中做症狀前測試——是第一個精準神經退化療法。

label: Kinase
description: Kinases catalyze protein phosphorylation as their defining enzymatic act.
description_zh_TW: 激酶催化蛋白磷酸化作為其定義性酶作用。

label: LIR Motif
description: The LIR motif mediates direct binding to ATG8-family proteins, including LC3 and GABARAP, on the surface of the phagophore and mature autophagosome. This couples ubiquitylation to selective autophagy, enabling mitophagy and aggrephagy.
description_zh_TW: LIR 模體介導與 ATG8 家族蛋白（包括 LC3 與 GABARAP）在吞噬泡與成熟自噬體表面的直接結合。這將泛素化與選擇性自噬相耦合，使 mitophagy 與聚集體自噬成為可能。

label: DOT1L
description: Pinometostat inhibits DOT1L targeting H3K79 methylation in MLL leukemias. Drug-target edge of the methyltransferase axis.
description_zh_TW: Pinometostat 抑制 DOT1L，標靶 MLL 白血病的 H3K79 甲基化。甲基轉移酶軸的藥物—標的邊。

label: Kynurenine
description: N-formylkynurenine is the immediate product of IDO1's oxidative cleavage of the tryptophan indole ring at the 2,3-position; it is then rapidly converted to kynurenine (Kyn). Kynurenine is the central metabolite of the kynurenine pathway from which downstream neuroactive and NAD+-linked metabolites are derived. The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+, and accounts for roughly 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production.
description_zh_TW: N-甲酰犬尿氨酸是IDO1氧化裂解色氨酸吲哚環2,3位的直接產物；隨後快速轉化為犬尿氨酸（Kyn）。犬尿氨酸是犬尿氨酸通路的中心代謝物，下游神經活性和NAD+相關代謝物由此衍生。犬尿氨酸通路導致代謝物包括犬尿喹啉酸、3-羥基犬尿氨酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素和NAD+前體），最終產生NAD+，佔蛋白質合成和血清素產生以外約95%的色氨酸降解。

label: DELE1
description: OMA1 is a mitochondrial protease whose activity is markedly elevated following mitochondrial stress. Upon stress, OMA1 catalyzes the cleavage of DELE1 during the stage of mitochondrial protein import and processing, producing a smaller cytosolic form (DELE1-S) that accumulates in the cytosol. The OMA1-dependent cleavage is required for subsequent ISR activation. Notably, perturbations of protein import across the inner mitochondrial membrane produce cytosolic DELE1 accumulation independent of OMA1, and iron deficiency causes full-length DELE1 (DELE1-L) accumulation on the outer mitochondrial membrane that activates HRI without OMA1-mediated cleavage.
description_zh_TW: OMA1是一種粒線體蛋白酶，其活性在粒線體壓力後顯著升高。壓力下，OMA1在粒線體蛋白質輸入和加工階段催化DELE1裂解，產生一個較小的細胞質形式（DELE1-S），該形式在細胞質中積累。OMA1依賴性裂解是後續ISR啟動所必需的。值得注意的是，內粒線體膜蛋白質輸入的干擾會產生OMA1非依賴性的細胞質DELE1積累，而鐵缺乏導致全长DELE1（DELE1-L）在外粒線體膜上積累，在沒有OMA1介導裂解的情況下激活HRI。

label: NF675
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: NF675 is a suramin-derived small molecule that is the most potent and selective compound in its scaffold series, showing a 20-fold selectivity ratio for SIRT1 over SIRT2. It was obtained through optimization of the suramin scaffold, which itself is a nanomolar inhibitor of SIRT1/SIRT2. Directionally, NF675's identity as a suramin-derived, SIRT1-selective inhibitor illustrates scaffold engineering for isoform selectivity within the sirtuin inhibitor field. Its modest drug-likeness, stemming from high molecular weight and anionic character, limits therapeutic application despite good potency and selectivity.
description_zh_TW: NF675 是一種 Suramin 衍生的小分子，是其骨架系列中最具活性和選擇性的化合物，對 SIRT1 相較 SIRT2 顯示出 20 倍的選擇性比率。它透過優化 Suramin 骨架而獲得，Suramin 本身是 SIRT1/SIRT2 的奈摩爾級抑制劑。方向性上 NF675 作為 Suramin 衍生的 SIRT1 選擇性抑制劑的身份說明了 sirtuin 抑制劑領域中針對同工型選擇性的骨架工程。其由於高分子量和陰離子特性導致的中等類藥性限制了治療應用，儘管具有良好的活性和選擇性。

label: Phospholipid
description: ACSL4 localizes to the outer mitochondrial membrane and ER and supplies PUFA-CoA for phospholipid remodeling via the Lands cycle (with PLA2), enriching membrane phospholipids with oxidizable polyunsaturated fatty acids that become the substrates of lipid peroxidation and, consequently, ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: ACSL4 定位於粒線體外膜與內質網，透過 Lands cycle（與 PLA2 配合）提供 PUFA-CoA 進行磷脂重塑，使膜磷脂富含可氧化的多不飽和脂肪酸，這些脂肪酸隨即成為脂質過氧化乃至鐵死亡的受質。

label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
description: DLBCL is an aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtype.
description_zh_TW: DLBCL 是侵襲性 B 細胞非何杰金淋巴瘤亞型。

label: Aurora Kinase
description: Aurora kinase cooperates in PLK1 activation during mitotic entry.
description_zh_TW: Aurora kinase 在有絲分裂進入協作活化 PLK1。

label: DNA Ligase IV
description: DNA ligase IV (LIG4) catalyzes the final phosphodiester-bond sealing step of non-homologous end joining with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 promotes NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation and interacts with DNA repair proteins including DNA ligase 4 to repair mtDNA damage.
description_zh_TW: DNA ligase IV（LIG4）催化非同源末端接合與 XRCC4/XLF 一起的最終磷酸二酯鍵封口步驟。SIRT3 透過 53BP1 招募和 H3K56 去乙醯化促進 NHEJ 效率，並與 DNA 修復蛋白（包括 DNA ligase 4）互動以修復 mtDNA 損傷。

label: MDL-800
description: MDL-800 is a bis-benzenesulfonamide prodrug and potent, selective SIRT6 activator, with an EC50 of 10.3 μM, that stimulates SIRT6 deacetylase activity. Directionally, MDL-800 allosterically activates SIRT6. It mirrors UBCS039 but with greater potency and cell permeability, mitigating kidney fibrosis and tumor glycolysis in preclinical models. It is a lead chemical tool for SIRT6 biology, and its improved potency and selectivity make it well suited for in vivo studies of SIRT6 activation, supporting the therapeutic potential of pharmacologic SIRT6 engagement.
description_zh_TW: MDL-800 是一種雙苯磺酰胺前藥和強效選擇性 SIRT6 活化因子，EC50 為 10.3 μM，刺激 SIRT6 去乙醯酶活性。在方向性上，MDL-800 變構活化 SIRT6。它類似於 UBCS039 但具有更高的效力和細胞滲透性，在臨床前模型中減輕腎纖維化和腫瘤糖解。它是 SIRT6 生物學的先導化學工具，其改善的效力和選擇性使其非常適合 SIRT6 活化的體內研究，支持藥理性 SIRT6 參與的治療潛力。

label: SIRT1 inhibition
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: In breast tumor cell lines where SIRT1 is primarily cytoplasmic, SIRT1 inhibition causes rapid caspase-2/14-3-3-zeta dissociation and markedly enhances paclitaxel sensitivity. This is therapeutically relevant during mitotic arrest when transcription is not ongoing.
description_zh_TW: 在 SIRT1 主要位於細胞質的乳腺腫瘤細胞系中，抑制 SIRT1 會導致快速的 caspase-2/14-3-3ζ 解離，並顯著增強對太平洋紫杉醇（paclitaxel）的敏感性。這在有絲分裂停滯、轉錄不進行時具有治療相關性。

label: Betaine
description: Betaine (trimethylglycine) converts homocysteine to methionine via the enzyme betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase (BHMT), providing one of its three methyl groups in a folate-independent remethylation pathway. This reaction lowers circulating homocysteine, a cardiovascular and neurotoxic risk factor, and supports methionine and subsequently SAMe availability for methyltransferases including COMT. Because it bypasses the folate cycle and MTHFR, betaine is a useful remethylation option when folate-dependent remethylation is impaired. However, its methyl-donating nature means it adds to the methyl load and must be used cautiously in slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸）透過甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶 (BHMT) 轉化 homocysteine to methionine，在獨立於 folate 的再甲基化途徑中提供其三個 methyl groups 之一。此反應降低了循環同型半胱氨酸（一種心血管和神經毒性危險因子），並支持蛋氨酸以及隨後的 SAMe 對甲基轉移酶（包括 COMT）的可用性。由於甜菜鹼繞過了 folate 循環和 MTHFR，因此當 folate 依賴性再甲基化受損時，甜菜鹼是一種有用的再甲基化選項。然而，其提供甲基的性質意味著它會增加甲基負荷，因此在緩慢的 COMT 個體中必須謹慎使用。

label: Magnesium
description: COMT requires magnesium as a cofactor, because the enzyme's catalytic domain depends on divalent cations, magnesium in particular, to stabilize the SAMe-substrate complex and support efficient methyl transfer to the catechol ring. Magnesium deficiency can therefore impair COMT efficiency and slow catecholamine clearance, compounding the effects of genetic slow variants. Adequate magnesium status is frequently emphasized in protocols supporting slow or balanced COMT function, since the metal is essential for catalysis. This makes magnesium a practical nutritional lever for maintaining healthy COMT activity.
description_zh_TW: COMT 需要鎂作為輔助因子，因為該酶的催化結構域依賴二價陽離子，特別是鎂，以穩定 SAMe-底物複合物並支持有效的甲基轉移到兒茶酚環。因此，Magnesium 缺陷會損害 COMT 效率並減慢兒茶酚胺清除率，從而加劇遺傳慢變異的影響。在支援緩慢或平衡 COMT 功能的方案中經常強調充足的鎂狀態，因為金屬對於催化至關重要。這使得鎂成為維持健康的實用營養槓桿 COMT activity。

label: Acute Lung Injury
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: SIRT3 promotes MnSOD expression to protect against hyperoxia-induced acute lung injury, and SIRT3-deficient mice develop more severe ALI through NLRP3 activation in macrophages. SIRT3 therefore defends the lung epithelium against oxidative and inflammatory damage by sustaining mitochondrial antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 促進 MnSOD 表現以對抗高氧誘發的急性肺損傷，且 SIRT3 缺失小鼠透過巨噬細胞中 NLRP3 活化發展更嚴重的 ALI。SIRT3 因此透過維持粒線體抗氧化能力，防禦肺上皮免於氧化與發炎損傷。

label: Epicatechin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Epicatechin is a flavanol with potent anti-glycation and AGE-breaking properties. In vitro it destroys preformed glycated serum albumin, and in vivo it decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. The nucleophilic C6 and C8 carbons of epicatechin's A-ring can attack the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures, breaking AGE cross-links. Epicatechin's dual capacity to inhibit glycation and break existing AGEs makes it a promising natural agent for reducing AGE burden, and its effects are similar to or stronger than those of aminoguanidine.
description_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種具有強效抗糖化與 AGE 裂解特性的黃烷醇。在體外，它能破壞已形成的糖化血清白蛋白；在體內，它降低了注射外源性 AGE 之大鼠視網膜組織中的 AGE 累積。Epicatechin 之 A 環具親核性的 C6 與 C8 碳原子可攻擊 AGE 結構的吡咯環碳原子，切斷 AGE 交聯。Epicatechin 同時抑制糖化並裂解既有 AGE 的雙重能力，使其成為降低 AGE 負擔的極具潛力天然物質，且其效果與 aminoguanidine 相似或更佳。

label: Glucosepane
description: Glucosepane is the most abundant and stubborn protein-protein AGE crosslink in human structural tissues, driving the systemic stiffening associated with aging and diabetes. Humans lack endogenous enzymes capable of directly breaking the glucosepane ring without destroying the surrounding collagen. Because of its abundance and stability, glucosepane is considered a major molecular target for anti-glycation therapies. Its crosslinks accumulate in long-lived proteins such as collagen and elastin, and are a principal cause of the extracellular matrix stiffening that contributes to arterial stiffening and age-related loss of tissue compliance.
description_zh_TW: Glucosepane 是人體結構組織中最豐富且頑固的蛋白-蛋白 AGE 交聯，驅動與衰老及糖尿病相關的全身性僵硬。人類缺乏能夠在不破壞周圍膠原蛋白的情況下直接切斷 glucosepane 環的內源性酶。由於其豐富性與穩定性，glucosepane 被視為抗糖化療法的主要分子標靶。其交聯累積於膠原蛋白與彈力蛋白等長壽蛋白中，是導致細胞外基質僵硬的主因，進而促成動脈僵硬與年齡相關的組織順應性喪失。

label: Stanniocalcin-1
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Stanniocalcin-1, a glycoprotein hormone, orchestrates a hormetic AMPK/SIRT3 axis that mitigates oxidative stress and apoptosis, and inhibits BNIP3 expression through the AMPK/SIRT3 pathway to ameliorate renal injury in diabetic murine models. The hormetic description reflects STC1's pattern of effect: mild mitochondrial stress engages AMPK, supporting SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial quality control.
description_zh_TW: Stanniocalcin-1 是一種糖蛋白激素，編排了一個激效性 AMPK/SIRT3 軸線以減輕氧化壓力和凋亡，並透過 AMPK/SIRT3 途徑抑制 BNIP3 表現以改善糖尿病小鼠模型中的腎損傷。激效性描述反映了 STC1 的作用模式：輕度粒線體壓力啟動 AMPK，支持 SIRT3 依賴的粒線體品質控制。

label: Niacin
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Niacin was previously suggested as an anti-inflammatory therapy in a preclinical study as a potent agent to decrease proinflammatory cytokines, including IL-1, IL-6, and TNF-alpha, and it might also decrease neutrophil infiltration while exhibiting a prolonged anti-inflammatory effect during ventilator-induced lung injury. Nicotinamide riboside (NR) can similarly decrease IL-2, IL-5, IL-6, and TNF-alpha. Targeting IL-6 has been proposed as a promising treatment to block the inflammatory storm, especially in severe COVID-19 patients.
description_zh_TW: Niacin（菸鹼酸）先前在臨床前研究中被提議作為抗發炎療法，是一種能降低促發炎性細胞激素（包括 IL-1、IL-6 與 TNF-alpha）的有效藥劑，且其亦可能減少嗜中性球浸潤，同時在呼吸器誘發的肺損傷期間展現持久的抗炎效果。nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）同樣能降低 IL-2、IL-5、IL-6 與 TNF-alpha。針對 IL-6 已被提議為阻斷發炎風暴（尤其是重症 COVID-19 患者）的有前景療法。

label: Ceramide
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase, encoded by ASAH1) is the lysosomal enzyme that breaks down ceramide into sphingosine and free fatty acids. By controlling ceramide levels, ACase affects the abundance of many lipid species relevant to cell fate decisions, including sphingomyelin, ceramide-1-phosphate, and free fatty acids. In the context of replicative senescence, this ceramide catabolism releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that feed polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) and PUFA-phospholipid synthesis, remodeling the membrane lipid profile.
description_zh_TW: 酸甘油酯酶 (ACase, 编码基因 ASAH1) 是一种溶酶体酶，它将甘油酯分解为神经因子和游离脂肪酸。通过控制甘油酯水平，ACase 影响了许多与细胞命运决策相关的脂质物种的丰度，包括神经因子-1-磷酸酯和游离脂肪酸。在复制性衰老的情况下，这种甘油酯分解释放出饱和和单不饱和脂肪酸，这些脂肪酸为不饱和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 和 PUFA-磷脂合成提供营养，从而重塑膜脂质谱。

label: GM-CSF
description: GM-CSF and CCL2 skew myeloid differentiation toward immunosuppressive MDSCs and specific macrophage phenotypes, reshaping the myeloid compartment in senescence and cancer. This biases haematopoiesis away from inflammatory resolution toward tolerance and suppression, exemplifying SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming of immune lineage fate. The relationship links SASP factors to myeloid lineage outcomes and is supported by myeloid-differentiation and tumor-immunology studies. Targeting these factors can restore protective myeloid responses.
description_zh_TW: GM-CSF 與 CCL2 將骨髓分化偏斜向免疫抑制性 MDSC 與特定巨噬細胞表型，重塑衰老與癌症中的骨髓區室。這將造血偏離發炎解決而朝向耐受與抑制，改變免疫景觀以利腫瘤進展與慢性發炎。在衰老中，此偏斜由 SASP 驅動，貢獻監視受損與免疫逃逸。它是連結分泌組到骨髓生成重塑的關鍵機制。

label: Shingles Vaccine
description: Postherpetic neuralgia is persistent neuropathic pain in the dermatome of a resolved herpes zoster rash, the most common complication of shingles. The shingles vaccine lowers the risk of herpes zoster and consequently of postherpetic neuralgia.
description_zh_TW: 帶狀皰疹後神經痛是帶狀皰疹皮疹消退後皮節區的持續神經病理性疼痛，是帶狀皰疹最常見的併發症。帶狀皰疹疫苗降低帶狀皰疹及其後神經痛的風險。

label: Biological Aging
description: The Health and Retirement Study (HRS) is a longitudinal panel study of U.S. adults aged 50+ that collects health, economic, and biomarker data, enabling population-level analyses of biological aging. It was used to show shingles vaccination associates with slower biological aging.
description_zh_TW: 健康與退休研究（HRS）是針對 50 歲以上美國成人的縱向追蹤研究，收集健康、經濟與生物標記數據，使生物老化的族群層級分析成為可能。它被用於顯示帶狀皰疹疫苗接種與較慢的生物老化相關。

label: Horvath Clock
description: The Horvath clock estimates chronological age from DNA methylation at 353 CpG sites with pan-tissue applicability. Its residuals reveal accelerated epigenetic aging in diseased tissues and associate with aging and epigenetic alterations.
description_zh_TW: Horvath 時鐘從 353 個 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化估算時間年齡，具有跨組織適用性。其殘差揭示疾病組織中的加速表觀遺傳老化，並與衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

label: Butein
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Butein is a chalcone polyphenol that belongs to the first generation of natural sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs), reported to activate SIRT1 together with resveratrol, piceatannol, quercetin, and myricetin. These polyphenolic activators established the concept of pharmacological SIRT1 activation and served as the basis for later, more potent synthetic STACs such as SRT1460, SRT1720, and SRT2183. Directionally, butein's identification as a polyphenol STAC initiated the activator chemistry that progressed to synthetic scaffolds, though the direct activation mechanism remains controversial due to fluorescent-substrate artifacts.
description_zh_TW: Butein 是一種查爾酮多酚，屬於第一代天然 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），據報導與 resveratrol、piceatannol、quercetin 和 myricetin 一起活化 SIRT1。這些多酚類活化劑確立了藥理學 SIRT1 活化的概念，並作為後續更強效合成 STAC 如 SRT1460、SRT1720 和 SRT2183 的基礎。方向性上 Butein 作為多酚類 STAC 的鑑定啟動了從活化劑化學到合成骨架的發展，儘管由於螢光受質假象，直接活化機制仍存在爭議。

label: 5,6-indolequinone
description: 5,6-indolequinone is biochemically converted into Neuromelanin through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, 5,6-indolequinone acts as the substrate and Neuromelanin as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: 5,6-indolequinone 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Neuromelanin。從機制上講，5,6-indolequinone 作為底物，Neuromelanin 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: Aminochromes
description: Studies have shown that the human erythrocyte plasma membrane can convert epinephrine (adrenaline) to aminochromes, including adrenochrome and further derivatives, in a two-phase reaction. Aminochromes are the cyclized oxidation products of catecholamines, and this membrane-associated conversion represents a route for adrenochrome formation in blood even though erythrocytes lack the organelles and oxidative enzymes that actively produce it. This makes the erythrocyte membrane a site where catecholamine oxidation products can form, with potential consequences for red blood cell membrane integrity.
description_zh_TW: 研究顯示，人類erythrocyte plasma membrane能在two-phase reaction中將epinephrine（adrenaline）轉化為aminochromes，包括adrenochrome及進一步的derivatives。Aminochromes是catecholamines的cyclized oxidation products，而這種membrane-associated conversion代表了一條血液中adrenochrome形成的途徑，儘管erythrocytes缺乏主動生成它的胞器與oxidative enzymes。這使得erythrocyte membrane成為catecholamine oxidation products可以形成的位置，並可能對red blood cell membrane integrity造成影響。

label: Oxidation
description: Quinones are organic compounds with a conjugated cyclic dione structure. The formation of a quinone moiety is the first step in the oxidation of catecholamines to aminochromes, where catechol hydroxyls are oxidized to carbonyl groups.
description_zh_TW: 醌（quinone）是具有共軛環狀二酮結構的有機化合物。醌部分的形成是兒茶酚胺氧化為 aminochrome 的第一步，其中兒茶酚羥基被氧化為羰基。

label: Rotenone
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) protects HT-22 cells against rotenone-induced neurotoxicity. Rotenone inhibits mitochondrial complex I (NADH oxidase), reducing oxidative phosphorylation and generating excess ROS. When HT-22 cells were exposed to 5 uM rotenone for 24 hours, MB increased cell viability at concentrations from 10 nM to 10 uM, and MB-treated groups maintained significantly higher oxygen consumption even under rotenone challenge. This protection reflects MB's alternative electron-transfer shunt that bypasses the rotenone-blocked complex I, preserving electron flow to cytochrome c.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 可保護 HT-22 細胞免受魚藤酮誘導的神經毒性。魚藤酮抑制線粒體複合體 I（NADH 氧化酶），減少氧化磷酸化並產生過多的 ROS。當 HT-22 細胞暴露於 5 uM 魚藤酮 24 小時，MB 在 10 nM 至 10 uM 濃度下可提高細胞存活率，且 MB 處理組即使在魚藤酮挑戰下仍維持較高的氧氣消耗。這種保護作用反映了 MB 的替代電子傳遞旁路，可繞過被魚藤酮阻斷的複合體 I，維持電子流向細胞色素 c。

label: TRIM28
source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md
description: Cleaved SIRT1 binds TRIM28 more strongly, accelerating its own destruction. The DeltaC703 cleavage-mimic shows the highest ubiquitination of all constructs and enhanced TRIM28 binding, while D707A shows reduced binding, so the two PTMs are mutually reinforcing.
description_zh_TW: 被裂解的 SIRT1 與 TRIM28 結合更強，加速其自身的破壞。裂解模擬物 ΔC703 在所有構建體中顯示最高的泛素化並增強 TRIM28 結合，而 D707A 顯示結合減少，因此這兩種翻譯後修飾相互強化。

label: Complex IV
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Photobiomodulation, applied as daily morning sunlight or targeted red and near-infrared light therapy, directly stimulates cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV) in the mitochondria, enhancing ATP production. It is listed among the light, temperature, and environmental exposures that act as mitohormetic stressors. Cold exposure similarly activates brown adipose tissue and induces uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1) leading to increased mitochondrial density, while sauna heat exposure induces heat shock proteins that repair misfolded proteins and support mitochondrial function.
description_zh_TW: 光生物調節，作為每日早晨陽光或靶向紅光和近紅外光療法施用，直接刺激粒線體中的細胞色素c氧化酶（複合物IV），增強ATP產生。它被列為作為線粒體興奮壓力源的光、溫度和環境暴露之一。冷暴露同樣激活棕色脂肪組織並誘導解偶聯蛋白1（UCP1），導致粒線體密度增加，而桑拿熱暴露誘導熱休克蛋白，修復錯誤折疊的蛋白質並支持粒線體功能。

label: Diabetic Cardiomyopathy
description: SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity and suppresses oxidative stress in DCM primarily through the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway. SIRT3 downregulation breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression; melatonin protects via Mst1 inhibition and SIRT3 upregulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 活化主要透過 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力並在 DCM 中抑制氧化壓力。SIRT3 下調打破此軸線，損害 ETC 活性並加速 DCM 進展；melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 和上調 SIRT3 發揮保護作用。

label: Neurotoxicity
description: Direct SIRT2 activation is generally avoided therapeutically because overactivity is linked to neurotoxicity in neurodegenerative contexts, where excessive deacetylation may impair microtubule and protein-homeostasis defenses. Directionally, SIRT2 overactivity is associated with neuronal damage. Consequently, SIRT2 inhibitors are pursued for Parkinsons and Huntingtons disease, where preserving α-tubulin acetylation protects neurons from aggregation toxicity. This therapeutic direction contrasts with SIRT2s tumor-suppressive functions in other tissues, illustrating how the same enzyme can be targeted in opposite directions depending on disease context.
description_zh_TW: 直接活化 SIRT2 通常在治療上被避免，因為其過度活性與神經退行性疾病背景下的神經毒性相關，過度去乙醯化可能損害微管和蛋白質穩態防禦。在方向性上，SIRT2 過度活性與神經元損傷相關。因此，SIRT2 抑制劑正在帕金森症和亨丁頓症的研究中被追求，保持 α-tubulin 乙醯化可以保護神經元免受聚集毒性。這種治療方向與 SIRT2 在其他組織中的腫瘤抑制功能形成對比，說明同一酶如何根據疾病情境被朝相反方向靶向。

label: Respiratory Burst
description: NOX2-derived superoxide is the phagocyte respiratory burst itself; chronic granulomatous disease abolishes it. Requirement marks the oxidase as the burst effector.
description_zh_TW: NOX2 衍生超氧化物即吞噬細胞呼吸爆發本身；慢性肉芽腫病廢除之。必要性標記氧化酶為爆發效應器。

label: Oral squamous cell carcinoma
description: Oral SCC belongs to the anatomical head-and-neck cancer parent class.
description_zh_TW: 口腔鱗癌屬於解剖學頭頸癌母類。

label: Nucleosome
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Chromatin is composed of nucleosomes, the repeating structural units that package the genome within the nucleus. Each nucleosome consists of a histone octamer, with two copies each of H2A, H2B, H3, and H4, wrapped by approximately 147 base pairs of DNA. Nucleosomes are arranged along the DNA in a beads-on-a-string fashion and further compact into higher-order fibers, with their positioning and modification determining whether underlying DNA is accessible for transcription, replication, and repair.
description_zh_TW: Chromatin 由核小體組成，核小體是將基因組包裝在細胞核內的重複結構單元。每個核小體由一個組蛋白八聚體組成，其中 H2A、H2B、H3 和 H4 各有兩個拷貝，由大約 147 個鹼基對的 DNA 包裹。核小體以串珠的方式沿著 DNA 排列，並進一步壓縮成高級纖維，其定位和修飾決定了底層 DNA 是否可用於轉錄、複製和修復。

label: Indole-3-propionic acid
description: Indole-3-propionic acid is a gut microbiota-derived tryptophan metabolite. It potentiates SIRT3 to enhance myocardial bioenergetics and improve diastolic function in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, representing a microbiota-mitochondria axis with translational potential.
description_zh_TW: Indole-3-propionic acid 是一種腸道微生物群衍生的色氨酸代謝物。它增強 SIRT3 以改善心肌生物能學並改善射血分數保留性心臟衰竭的舒張功能，代表了一個具有轉化潛力的微生物群-粒線體軸線。

label: Intermedin
description: Intermedin (adrenomedullin 2) enhances mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity via AMPK/SIRT3-mediated cristae remodeling in vascular calcification models, opposing the calcific phenotype driven by mitochondrial dysfunction in advanced chronic kidney disease.
description_zh_TW: Intermedin（腎上腺髓質素 2）在血管鈣化模型中透過 AMPK/SIRT3 介導的嵴重塑增強粒線體生物能容量，對抗進階慢性腎臟病中粒線體功能障礙驅動的鈣化表型。

label: Liquiritigenin
description: Liquiritigenin is a licorice-derived flavanone that induces Nrf2 translocation, thereby potentiating SIRT3 activity and facilitating mitochondrial biogenesis while suppressing apoptosis in acute kidney injury models, mitigating oxidative stress injury and cell death.
description_zh_TW: Liquiritigenin 是源自甘草的黃烷酮，誘導 Nrf2 轉位，從而增強 SIRT3 活性並促進粒線體生成，同時在急性腎損傷模型中抑制凋亡，減輕氧化壓力損傷和細胞死亡。

label: Hamartoma
description: TSC1/2 loss removes Rheb restraint, causing constitutive mTORC1 hyperactivation that drives hamartomas in tuberous sclerosis. Here benign growth itself is the disease.
description_zh_TW: TSC1/2 缺失移除 Rheb 抑制，造成組成性 mTORC1 過度活化，在結節性硬化症驅動錯構瘤。此處良性生長本身即是疾病。

label: Meteorin-like protein
description: Meteorin-like (Metrnl) activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, stimulating AMPK at Thr172 and increasing UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism in diabetic nephropathy.
description_zh_TW: Meteorin-like（Metrnl）活化 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線，在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，在糖尿病腎病變中維護粒線體超微結構完整性並調節能量代謝。

label: Mitochondrial Respiration
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Neutral red (NR), a phenazine formed by substituting nitrogen for the position-5 sulfur of the phenothiazine nucleus, retained the ability to increase cellular oxygen consumption (OCR) in Seahorse assays, similar to methylene blue and toluidine blue O, and these three compounds share similar negative redox potentials. However, NR had markedly weaker neuroprotective potency than MB in the glutamate, rotenone, and IAA assays and does not function as an alternative electron-transfer carrier in mitochondria, indicating that oxygen-consumption enhancement alone does not confer neuroprotection and that electron-shunt activity is the key protective feature.
description_zh_TW: 中性紅（NR）是一種由苯噻嗪核第5位硫被氮取代形成的吩嗪，在Seahorse分析中保留了增加細胞氧消耗率（OCR）的能力，類似於亞甲藍和甲苯胺藍O，這三種化合物具有相似的負氧化還原電位。然而，在麩氨酸、rotenone和IAA分析中，NR的神經保護效力明顯弱於MB，且不作為粒線體中的替代電子轉運載體發揮作用，表明僅增強氧消耗並不能賦予神經保護作用，而電子分流活性是關鍵的保護特徵。

label: MyoD
description: The positive histone acetyltransferases PCAF and GCN5 acetylate the myogenic transcription factor MyoD, enhancing its DNA-binding and recruitment of transcriptional machinery. Directionally, PCAF/GCN5 sits upstream of MyoD activation. This promotes muscle differentiation, and SIRT1 opposes this by deacetylating both PCAF and MyoD. By acetylating MyoD, these HATs support the expression of muscle-specific genes during differentiation. The balance between PCAF/GCN5 acetylation and sirtuin deacetylation determines the timing and extent of myogenic commitment.
description_zh_TW: 正向組蛋白乙醯基轉移酶 PCAF 和 GCN5 乙醯化肌源性轉錄因子 MyoD，增強其 DNA 結合和轉錄機器的招募。在方向性上，PCAF/GCN5 位於 MyoD 活化的上游。這促進肌肉分化，而 SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 兩者來對抗。透過乙醯化 MyoD，這些 HAT 在分化期間支持肌肉特異性基因的表達。PCAF/GCN5 乙醯化和 sirtuin 去乙醯化之間的平衡決定了肌源性承諾的時間和程度。

label: Dyskinesia
description: Delayed antipsychotic-induced persistent orofacial dyskinesia defines the tardive form.
description_zh_TW: 延遲的抗精神病藥誘發持續口顏面運動障礙定義遲發形式。

label: OX2R
description: NKX2-1 (Nk2 homeobox 1) is deacetylated by SIRT1 in hypothalamic DMH/LH neurons; deacetylated NKX2-1 activates transcription of OX2R, the orexin receptor whose increased signaling recapitulates calorie restriction and extends lifespan in BRASTO mice. Thus NKX2-1 is the direct transcriptional relay between SIRT1 and OX2R. By linking SIRT1 activity to orexin-receptor expression, NKX2-1 connects sirtuin signaling to the neural circuits controlling arousal, activity, and energy expenditure. This pathway illustrates how a single transcription factor can mediate the longevity effects of sirtuin activation in the brain.
description_zh_TW: NKX2-1（Nk2 homeobox 1）在下丘腦DMH/LH神經元中被SIRT1去乙醯化；去乙醯化的NKX2-1啟動OX2R的轉錄，OX2R是食慾素受體，其訊號增強模擬了熱量限制並在BRASTO小鼠中延長壽命。因此NKX2-1是SIRT1和OX2R之間的直接轉錄中繼。透過將SIRT1活性與食慾素受體表達聯繫起來，NKX2-1將sirtuin訊號與控制覺醒、活動和能量消耗的神經迴路連接。此通路說明了單一轉錄因子如何能介導sirtuin活化在大腦中的長壽效應。

label: soluble epoxide hydrolase
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: A regulatory axis exists in which soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH) modulates SIRT3 turnover via proteolytic degradation, with sEH deficiency preserving SIRT3 bioavailability to fulfill bioenergetic demands and impede renal vascular calcification progression. sEH inhibition or deficiency therefore acts as an indirect SIRT3-stabilizing strategy in advanced CKD-associated vascular calcification.
description_zh_TW: 存在一個調控軸線，其中可溶性環氧化物水解酶（sEH）透過蛋白水解降解調節 SIRT3 的周轉，sEH 缺乏保留 SIRT3 的可用性以滿足生物能需求並阻礙腎血管鈣化的進展。因此 sEH 抑制或缺乏作為進階 CKD 相關血管鈣化中間接穩定 SIRT3 的策略。

label: Ellagic Acid
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens, an Eggerthellaceae gut anaerobe, metabolizes dietary Ellagic Acid as the principal upstream converter in the urolithin pathway, generating intermediate urolithins (M5/D/C) that downstream consortium members finish to Urolithin A; its carriage underpins metabotype A converter status.
description_zh_TW: Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 為 Eggerthellaceae 腸道厭氧菌，是 urolithin 途徑的主要上游轉換者，代謝飲食 Ellagic Acid 產生中間 urolithins（M5/D/C），再由下游菌叢完成為 Urolithin A；其攜帶與否決定 metabotype A 轉換者身分。

label: iNOS
description: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
description_zh_TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

label: Heat Shock Proteins
description: Controlled heat stress induces HSP70/90 chaperones for proteostasis, with Finnish sauna cohort CVD/dementia benefit. XenohormesisESIS-grade evidence for thermal hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 受控熱壓力誘發 HSP70/90 伴侶以維持蛋白穩態，芬蘭桑拿隊列具 CVD/失智益處。熱荷爾蒙的 xenohormesis 級證據。

label: ETS transcription factor
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ELK1 is the founding member of the ternary complex factor subfamily of ETS-domain transcription factors, alongside ELK3 and ELK4 (SAP-1), and is a major nuclear target of the RAS-MAPK/ERK cascade that controls immediate-early gene expression. In the context of sirtuin biology it serves as the canonical reference for the ETS-TCF family whose member ELK4 stabilizes SIRT7 at target promoters. Directionally, ELK1's ETS DNA-binding domain and SRF-coupling architecture are shared by the TCF family, informing how ELK4 anchors SIRT7 to chromatin for H3K18 deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: ELK1 是 ETS 結構域轉錄因子三元複合物因子亞家族的創始成員，與 ELK3 和 ELK4（SAP-1）並列，是 RAS-MAPK/ERK 細胞階級傳導路徑的主要細胞核靶標，控制即早基因表達。在 sirtuin 生物學的背景下，它作為 ETS-TCF 家族的標準參考，其成員 ELK4 將 SIRT7 穩定於靶啟動子處。方向性上 ELK1 的 ETS DNA 結合結構域和 SRF 偶聯架構為 TCF 家族所共享，闡明了 ELK4 如何將 SIRT7 錨定到染色質上進行 H3K18 去乙醯化。

label: Geroprotectors
description: Geroprotectors are interventions that slow the rate of aging by modulating the conserved hallmarks of aging rather than treating a single disease. This geroscience strategy aims to compress morbidity and extend healthspan.
description_zh_TW: 延緩衰老劑（geroprotectors）是透過調控保守的衰老標誌而非治療單一疾病來減緩衰老速率的介入措施。此老年科學（geroscience）策略旨在壓縮疾病期並延長健康壽命。

label: Kynurenine Pathway
description: Downstream of IDO1, the kynurenine pathway (KP) leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+. The KP accounts for about 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production, making it the dominant route of tryptophan-to-NAD+ flux. Both type 1 and type 2 diabetes show disrupted NAD+ homeostasis, with the KP (via IDO1/TDO) being a major Trp-to-NAD+ route. This positions IDO1 at the intersection of metabolism, immunity and inflammation, integrating tryptophan availability with immune modulation and NAD+ biosynthesis.
description_zh_TW: 在 IDO1 下游，犬尿胺酸途徑（KP）產生包括犬尿烯酸、3-羥基犬尿胺酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素與 NAD+ 前驅物）以及最終 NAD+ 在內的多種代謝物。KP 佔蛋白質合成與血清素生成以外約 95% 的色胺酸分解，使其成為色胺酸至 NAD+ 流量的主導途徑。第 1 型與第 2 型糖尿病皆顯示 NAD+ 恆定受到破壞，而 KP（經由 IDO1/TDO）是 Trp 至 NAD+ 的主要途徑。這使 IDO1 處於代謝、免疫與發炎的交會點，將色胺酸可用性與免疫調節及 NAD+ 生合成整合起來。

label: GLO2
description: GLO2 (glyoxalase II) is the second enzyme of the glyoxalase system. It converts S-D-lactoylglutathione into D-lactate, regenerating glutathione in the process. Because glutathione is both the cofactor for GLO1 and a major cellular antioxidant, GLO2 activity sustains the capacity of the glyoxalase system to detoxify methylglyoxal and other dicarbonyls. The conversion of reactive dicarbonyl intermediates into lactate thereby prevents them from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on proteins, making GLO2 an integral component of the body's defense against glycation stress.
description_zh_TW: GLO2（glyoxalase II）是乙二醛酶系統的第二個酵素。它將 S-D-lactoylglutathione 轉化為 D-乳酸（D-lactate），過程中再生麩胱甘肽。由於麩胱甘肽既是 GLO1 的輔酶也是主要的細胞抗氧化劑，GLO2 活性維持了乙二醛酶系統解毒甲基乙二醛與其他二羰基物的能力。將反應性二羰基中間產物轉化為乳酸，從而防止它們在蛋白質上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯，使 GLO2 成為身體對抗糖化壓力防禦中不可或缺的組成部分。

label: iFSP1
description: iFSP1 is the first-in-class FSP1 inhibitor (IC50 ~103 nM, human-specific F360 pocket) that synergizes with GPX4 inhibition to trigger ferroptosis. It is the pharmacological probe defining the FSP1 brake.
description_zh_TW: iFSP1 是首創 FSP1 抑制劑（IC50 約 103 nM，人類特異 F360 口袋），與 GPX4 抑制協同觸發鐵死亡。它是定義 FSP1 煞車的藥理探針。

label: Iron Regulatory Protein 1
description: Apo-aconitase is Iron Regulatory Protein 1, which binds the ferritin iron-responsive element repressing translation. Cluster loss switches enzyme to RNA regulator.
description_zh_TW: 脫輔基 aconitase 即 Iron Regulatory Protein 1，結合 ferritin 鐵反應元件抑制轉譯。簇缺失將酶切換為 RNA 調節因子。

label: NCOA4
description: NCOA4 mediates ferritinophagy, turning over ferritin to feed redox-active Fe2+ into Fenton chemistry. This iron-supply mechanism complements the lipid-substrate arm of ACSL4.
description_zh_TW: NCOA4 介導 ferritinophagy，周轉 ferritin 以供應具氧化還原活性 Fe2+ 進入 Fenton 化學。此鐵供應機制補充 ACSL4 的脂質受質臂。

label: Persulfates
description: Ammonium persulfate is one of the suitable persulfate oxidizing agents for converting adrenaline into adrenochrome, together with potassium persulfate and sodium persulfate. Sodium and ammonium persulfates are preferred over potassium persulfate for their good solubility in water. In the examples, ammonium persulfate (about 0.42 mole) is used with a sodium hydrogencarbonate buffer and a bismuth salt catalyst at 0 to 5 degrees C to produce adrenochrome in maximum yield within about 30 to 45 minutes.
description_zh_TW: 過硫酸銨是將腎上腺素轉化為腎上腺紅的適用過硫酸鹽氧化劑之一，與過硫酸鉀和過硫酸鈉並用。過硫酸鈉和過硫酸銨因在水中溶解度良好而優於過硫酸鉀。在實施例中，過硫酸銨（約0.42莫耳）與碳酸氫鈉緩衝液及鉍鹽催化劑在0至5°C下使用，於約30至45分鐘內以最大產率生產腎上腺紅。

label: Transition Metals
description: EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) is a chelating agent that binds transition metal ions such as iron and copper, making them inert and drastically slowing the autoxidation of epinephrine. Because these metals catalyze electron transfer from the catechol ring to oxygen, their removal suppresses the formation of the o-quinone intermediate that leads to adrenochrome. The strategy of metal chelation is therefore a key chemical defense against the oxidative conversion of adrenaline into its reactive oxidation product. EDTA exemplifies the broader class of chelating agents used to stabilize catecholamines in pharmaceutical and analytical settings, and it highlights the general principle that transition metal availability controls the rate at which the adrenochrome pathway can proceed in solution.
description_zh_TW: EDTA（乙二胺四乙酸）是一種螯合劑，可結合鐵、銅等過渡金屬離子，使其失去活性並大幅減緩 epinephrine 的自氧化。由於這些金屬催化電子從兒茶酚環轉移至氧氣，移除它們會抑制導致 adrenochrome 的鄰苯醌中間體的形成。因此，金屬螯合策略是對抗 adrenaline 氧化轉化為其反應性氧化產物的一項關鍵化學防線。EDTA 是藥用與分析環境中用於穩定兒茶酚胺的更廣泛螯合劑類的典型代表，並凸顯了過渡金屬可得性控制 adrenochrome 途徑在溶液中進行的速率這一普遍原則。

label: PML
description: HIRA relocalizes to promyelocytic leukemia (PML) nuclear bodies during senescence, and preventing HIRA translocation to PML bodies blocks SAHF formation. PML nuclear bodies are thus required for HIRA-mediated heterochromatin assembly.
description_zh_TW: HIRA 在衰老期間易位至前髓細胞白血病（PML）核體，而阻止 HIRA 轉位至 PML 核體會阻斷 SAHF 形成。因此 PML 核體是 HIRA 介導異染色質組裝所需。

label: Adrenochrome Hypothesis
description: The adrenochrome hypothesis is a largely discredited theory from the 1950s, associated with researchers such as Abram Hoffer and Humphry Osmond, proposing that the abnormal oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome produces hallucinogenic or psychotogenic compounds that cause schizophrenia. The hypothesis proposed that adrenochrome, an oxidation product of epinephrine, could be a psychotomimetic molecule. Subsequent research did not support a causal role for adrenochrome in schizophrenia, and the hypothesis is now viewed as historically significant but not mainstream. It contributed to the cultural fascination with adrenochrome, though the compound has no proven psychoactive or clinical use.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome hypothesis 是 1950 年代一個大致已被否定的理論，與 Abram Hoffer 和 Humphry Osmond 等研究者相關，主張 adrenaline 異常氧化成 adrenochrome 會產生致幻或致精神病的化合物，導致 schizophrenia。該假說主張，adrenochrome 作為 epinephrine 的氧化產物，可能是一種 psychotomimetic 分子。後續研究並未支持 adrenochrome 在 schizophrenia 中的因果角色，此假說現在被視為具有歷史意義但非主流。它助長了對 adrenochrome 的文化迷戀，儘管該化合物並無證實的 psychoactive 或臨床用途。

label: Epigenome
description: Protein restriction alters the epigenome, one of its six hallmarks. Aging is accompanied by erosion of the epigenetic landscape - DNA methylation and post-translational modifications of histone tails - that promotes hallmarks of aging including cellular senescence. PR in pregnant rodents leads to loci-specific changes in histone methylation and gene expression, and dietary levels of specific amino acids regulate histone post-translational modifications, linking nutrient sensing to the epigenome. Methionine is the precursor of S-adenosyl methionine, the universal methyl donor, so dietary methionine deprivation may affect physiology through changes in histone methylation due to decreased methyl-donor availability, with cells preserving heterochromatic stability through upregulation of H3K9 methylation in the liver.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制改變表觀基因組，這是其六個標誌之一。老化伴隨著表觀遺傳景觀的侵蝕——DNA甲基化和組蛋白尾部的轉錄後修飾——這促進了包括細胞衰老在內的老化標誌。懷孕囓齒動物中的PR導致組蛋白甲基化和基因表達的位點特異性變化，特定胺基酸的飲食水平調節組蛋白轉錄後修飾，將營養感知與表觀基因組聯繫起來。甲硫氨酸是S-腺苷甲硫氨酸的前體，S-腺苷甲硫氨酸是通用的甲基供體，因此飲食甲基剝奪可能透過組蛋白甲基化的變化影響生理，這是由於甲基供體可用性降低，細胞透過在肝臟中上調H3K9甲基化來保持異染色質穩定性。

label: Antagonistic Pleiotropy
description: Antagonistic pleiotropy is an evolutionary concept in which traits beneficial early in life become deleterious later. It provides a conceptual underpinning for aging mechanisms such as the Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis, which explains why selection does not eliminate aging-causing processes.
description_zh_TW: 拮抗多效性（antagonistic pleiotropy）是一個演化概念，指對生命早期有利的特徵在後期變得有害。它為老化機制（如染色質修飾因子易位（RCM）假說）提供了概念基礎，解釋為何天擇不消除造成老化的過程。

label: Cardiolipin
description: Cardiolipin is required for OPA1-mediated inner-membrane fusion in liposome reconstitutions, dual to its pro-fission DRP1 stimulation. One lipid gates both fusion and fission.
description_zh_TW: Cardiolipin 在脂質體重構中為 OPA1 介導的內膜融合所必需，與其促分裂的 DRP1 刺激成雙。一種脂質門控融合與分裂兩者。

label: Peroxisome
description: Peroxisomes are the primary site where very long chain fatty acids are shortened into shorter-chain products such as acetyl-CoA that can enter mitochondria for complete oxidation. Impaired peroxisomal beta-oxidation causes toxic VLCFA accumulation, the hallmark of Zellweger syndrome and adrenoleukodystrophy.
description_zh_TW: Peroxisome 是極長鏈脂肪酸進行縮短代謝的主要場所，產物如 acetyl-CoA 可進入粒線體完成氧化。過氧化物體 beta-oxidation 功能受損會導致有毒的 VLCFA 累積，這是 Zellweger syndrome 與 adrenoleukodystrophy 的標誌性特徵。

label: Sex Steroid Ablation
description: Sex steroid ablation (SSA), accomplished surgically or with LHRH analogue administration, is a long-standing strategy for thymic rejuvenation. Mice castrated before puberty show delayed thymic atrophy; removal of sex steroids after puberty restores thymic architecture, increases thymic cellularity and enhances thymopoiesis in aged mice and humans. The number of early thymic progenitors, which decrease with age, is normalized after surgical castration. Thymic regeneration following castration is reversed in a dose-dependent manner by administration of testosterone or estrogen, indicating that sex steroids are primary drivers of thymic involution.
description_zh_TW: 性類固醇消融（SSA），通過手術或LHRH類似物給藥實現，是胸腺rejuvenation的長期策略。青春期前閹割的小鼠顯示胸腺萎縮延遲；青春期後移除性類固醇可恢復胸腺結構，增加胸腺細胞密度，並增強老年小鼠和人類的胸腺生成。隨著年齡增長而減少的早期胸腺祖細胞的數量在手術閹割後恢復正常。閹割後的胸腺再生以劑量依賴性的方式被睾酮或雌激素給藥逆轉，表明性類固醇是胸腺退化的主要驅動因素。

label: HPP+
description: HPP+ accumulates in mitochondria via dopamine transporter uptake and inhibits complex I of the electron transport chain, mirroring MPP+ toxicity. Complex I blockade drives oxidative injury in nigral neurons.
description_zh_TW: HPP+ 經多巴胺轉運蛋白攝取累積於粒線體，抑制電子傳遞鏈複合體 I，呼應 MPP+ 毒性。複合體 I 阻斷驅動黑質神經元氧化損傷。

label: Follistatin
description: Follistatin is the canonical extracellular antagonist of myostatin (GDF8), sequestering the ligand and preventing ActRIIB-ALK4/5 engagement. This blockade underlies its muscle-growth and tissue-remodeling effects and extends the follistatin-activin checkpoint to myostatin within the TGFbeta superfamily.
description_zh_TW: Follistatin 是 myostatin（GDF8）的典型胞外拮抗劑，隔離配體並阻止 ActRIIB-ALK4/5 結合。此阻斷構成其肌肉生長與組織重塑效應，並將 follistatin-activin 檢查點擴展至 TGFbeta 超家族內的 myostatin。

label: Atg14
description: Atg14 targets complex I to the phagophore, directing PtdIns3P production for nucleation. Activation is the complex-I output.
description_zh_TW: Atg14 將複合體 I 標定到吞噬泡，指導 PtdIns3P 產生以供成核。活化是複合體 I 輸出。

label: ZCCHC11
description: ZCCHC11 is terminal uridylyltransferase 4, the Lin28-recruited enzyme.
description_zh_TW: ZCCHC11 是末端尿苷醯轉移酶 4，即 Lin28 招募的酶。

label: Paracrine Reprogramming
description: Paracrine reprogramming is the biological process by which SASP factors alter the differentiation status and fate of neighbouring cells, pushing them toward stemness, EMT, or altered lineage commitment. Distinct from paracrine senescence, which induces growth arrest, it remodels recipient identity and is dose- and time-dependent, with acute exposure promoting plasticity and chronic exposure driving fibrosis and cancer stemness. The process is mediated by cytokines such as IL-6, TGFbeta, and VEGF family members. It expands the non-cell-autonomous influence of senescent cells beyond growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: 旁分泌重編程是 SASP 因子改變鄰近細胞分化狀態與命運、將其推向幹性、EMT 或改變譜系承諾的生物學過程。不同於誘發生長停滯的旁分泌衰老，它重塑受體身分而非使其停滯。此過程將衰老分泌組定位為組織重塑的形態發生素來源，且其與旁分泌衰老的並存說明 SASP 具多重非細胞自主性後果。它是衰老相關組織重塑的核心機制。

label: L-arginine
description: Arginase competes with NOS for L-arginine, hydrolyzing arginine to ornithine and urea and thereby lowering substrate available for NO synthesis. In vascular and immune contexts this shifts the arginine pool away from NO toward polyamine and proline synthesis. The directionality is metabolic competition to reduced NO. A caveat is that arginase and NOS also compete for the same intracellular compartment, so local colocalization strongly influences the outcome. Arginase is induced by inflammatory cytokines and oxidants, so vascular arginase upregulation is a recognized mechanism of endothelial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Arginase 與 NOS 競爭 L-arginine，將精氨酸水解為鳥氨酸和尿素，從而降低可用於 NO 合成的底物。在血管和免疫環境中，這會將精胺酸池從一氧化氮轉向多胺和脯胺酸合成。方向性是代謝競爭以減少NO。需要注意的是，arginase 和 NOS 也會競爭相同的細胞內區室，因此局部共定位會強烈影響結果。 Arginase 是由發炎細胞因子和氧化劑誘導的，因此血管 arginase 上調是 endothelial dysfunction 的公認機制。

label: Locus Coeruleus
description: Locus Coeruleus degenerates in Parkinson's Disease, reflecting the selective loss of these neurons as the disease progresses. Mechanistically, degeneration follows the spread of alpha-synuclein pathology and the failure of protective systems in vulnerable circuits. This is significant because the lost population underlies the non-motor and motor features attributed to the affected region. A caveat is that the same neurons also decline in normal aging and other disorders, so magnitude and pattern must be interpreted in full context.
description_zh_TW: Locus Coeruleus 在 Parkinson's Disease 中退化，反映出隨著疾病的進展這些神經元選擇性缺失。從機制上講，退化是隨著 alpha-synuclein 病理學的傳播和脆弱電路中保護系統的失效而發生的。這很重要，因為人口的流失是受影響地區非運動和運動特徵的基礎。需要注意的是，在正常 aging 和其他疾病中，相同的神經元也會下降，因此必須在完整的背景下解釋幅度和模式。

label: EX-527
source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md
description: EX-527, the most potent and selective SIRT1 inhibitor identified from a large high-throughput screen, inhibits SIRT1 at nanomolar concentrations with remarkable selectivity over SIRT2 and SIRT3 and good pharmacokinetic properties. Its anticancer activity as a single agent is weak, but it cooperates with HDAC inhibitors to induce apoptosis in leukemia cells. Directionally, EX-527-mediated SIRT1 blockade combined with broad HDAC inhibition produces a synergistic lethal effect. This positions EX-527 as the standard pharmacological SIRT1 inhibitor and a component of combination anticancer strategies.
description_zh_TW: EX-527 是從大規模高通量篩選中鑑定出的最強效和最具選擇性的 SIRT1 抑制劑，在奈摩爾濃度下抑制 SIRT1，對 SIRT2 和 SIRT3 具有顯著的選擇性，且具有良好的藥代動力學特性。其作為單一藥物的抗癌活性較弱，但與 HDAC 抑制劑協同誘導白血病細胞凋亡。方向性上 EX-527 介導的 SIRT1 阻斷與廣泛的 HDAC 抑制結合產生協同致死效果。這使 EX-527 成為標準的藥理學 SIRT1 抑制劑和聯合抗癌策略的組成部分。

label: PP2A
description: The protein phosphatase PP2A dephosphorylates TFEB at S122 and at the cluster S109 and S114, promoting translocation of the transcription factor to the nucleus (PMID 29945972). Dephosphorylation of these sites reverses the cytoplasmic-retention effect of mTORC1-mediated phosphorylation at S122, releasing TFEB to enter the nucleus and activate lysosomal and autophagic gene transcription. This places protein phosphatase 2A as a counteracting force to nutrient-sensing kinase pathways, helping determine the net phosphorylation state of TFEB and thus its subcellular localization. Together with calcineurin, PP2A provides the dephosphorylation arm of TFEB's regulatory cycle.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白磷酸酶 PP2A 在 S122 以及 S109 和 S114 群簇上去磷酸化 TFEB，促進該轉錄因子轉位至細胞核（PMID 29945972）。這些位點的去磷酸化逆轉 mTORC1 介導的 S122 磷酸化所產生的胞質保留效應，釋放 TFEB 進入細胞核並啟動溶酶體和自噬基因轉錄。這使蛋白磷酸酶 2A 成為營養感知激酶通路的拮抗力量，有助於決定 TFEB 的淨磷酸化狀態及其亞細胞定位。與鈣調磷酸酶一起，PP2A 提供了 TFEB 調節週期的去磷酸化臂。

label: P66shc
description: P66shc knockout mice live about 30% longer than wild-type controls and show enhanced resistance to oxidative stress and age-related pathologies, indicating P66shc is a negative regulator of longevity. Directionally, loss of P66shc extends lifespan. This makes P66shc an attractive node, with SIRT1 as an upstream suppressor, for longevity interventions.
description_zh_TW: P66shc 基因敲除小鼠比野生型對照多活約 30%，並表現出對氧化壓力和年齡相關病變的增強抵抗力，表明 P66shc 是壽命的負向調節因子。方向性上 P66shc 的缺失延長壽命。這使 P66shc 成為一個有吸引力的節點，以 SIRT1 作為上游抑制因子，用於長壽介入措施。

label: Cadherin
description: Cadherin-mediated niche adhesion maintains stem-cell quiescence per the quiescence document. Maintenance is the niche signal.
description_zh_TW: Cadherin 介導的微環境黏附依靜止文獻維持幹細胞靜止。維持是微環境訊號。

label: Connective Tissue
description: Collagen types one to three are the dominant structural fibers.
description_zh_TW: 第一至三型膠原是主要的結構纖維。

label: Aerobic Capacity
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: NMN supplementation raised aerobic capacity in an amateur-runner RCT and mitochondrial respiratory ability in aged mice. Enhancement is attributed to NAD+ restoration feeding sirtuin-driven oxidative metabolism.
description_zh_TW: NMN 補充在業餘跑者 RCT 提高有氧能力，在老年小鼠提高粒線體呼吸能力。增強歸因於 NAD+ 恢復供養 sirtuin 驅動的氧化代謝。

description: SIRT1 deacetylates the scaffold protein 14-3-3ζ (lysine 49), identified by a biotin-switch proteomics screen for cytoplasmic SIRT1 substrates. Deacetylated 14-3-3ζ maintains its phosphorylation-dependent binding to caspase-2, shielding caspase-2 Ser135 (phosphorylated by CaMKII) from dephosphorylation. When SIRT1 activity drops, 14-3-3ζ becomes acetylated and dissociates from caspase-2, allowing the apical caspase to activate. This is the first demonstration of cytoplasmic 14-3-3 acetylation as a death-regulatory modification.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 會去乙醯化支架蛋白 14-3-3ζ（離胺酸 49），此為針對細胞質 SIRT1 受質之 biotin-switch 蛋白質體學篩選的發現。去乙醯化的 14-3-3ζ 維持其與 caspase-2 之磷酸化依賴性結合，保護 Caspase-2 Ser135（由 CaMKII 磷酸化）不被去磷酸化。當 SIRT1 活性下降時，14-3-3ζ 被乙醯化並與 caspase-2 解離，使這個頂端 caspase 得以活化。這是首次證明細胞質 14-3-3 乙醯化具有死亡調控功能。

label: Glutathione S-transferase π1
description: SIRT3 downregulates GSTP1 messenger RNA and protein, reducing chemotherapeutic detoxification capacity and enhancing sorafenib sensitivity in hepatocellular carcinoma. Suppression is the upstream regulatory act.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 下調 GSTP1 信使 RNA 與蛋白，降低化療解毒能力，在肝細胞癌增強 sorafenib 敏感性。抑制是上游調節作用。

label: Thymidine
description: Thymidine is a pyrimidine nucleoside and dTTP precursor. Basic chemical classification.
description_zh_TW: Thymidine 是嘧啶核苷與 dTTP 前驅物。基本化學歸類。

label: Mitochondrial-Derived Peptide
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: MOTS-c is a 16 amino acid peptide encoded by the mitochondrial 12S rRNA gene, and is one of eight mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs) described to date along with humanin and small humanin-like peptides 1-6 (SHLPs 1-6). It is an exercise-induced factor that increases insulin sensitivity and visceral fat accumulation, with circulating levels rising acutely with exercise. The peptide has also been observed to translocate to the nucleus during energetic stress, suggesting both cell-autonomous and non-cell-autonomous functions.
description_zh_TW: MOTS-c是由粒線體12S rRNA基因編碼的16胺基酸肽，是迄今描述的八種粒線體衍生肽（MDPs）之一，與humanin和小型humanin類似肽1-6（SHLPs 1-6）並列。它是一種運動誘導因子，可增加胰島素敏感性和內臟脂肪堆積，其循環水平在運動後急性升高。該肽還被觀察到在能量應激時易位至細胞核，提示其具有細胞自主和非細胞自主功能。

label: Thymus
description: The thymus is a vital organ for homeostatic maintenance of the peripheral immune system. Within its two compartments, the true thymic epithelial space (TES, comprising cortex and medulla) and the perivascular space (PVS), T cells develop, mature, and undergo induction of self-tolerance in a process called thymopoiesis. The cortex hosts early thymocyte development including T cell receptor gene rearrangement and positive selection, while the medulla carries out negative selection to remove autoreactive T cells. The perivascular space, composed of adipocytes, peripheral lymphocytes and stroma, is a non-thymopoietic component.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺是外周免疫系統穩態維持的重要器官。在其兩個隔室——真正的胸腺上皮空間（TES，包含皮質和髓質）和血管周圍空間（PVS）——中，T 細胞發育、成熟並經歷稱為胸腺生成的自身耐受誘導過程。皮質主持早期胸腺細胞發育，包括 T 細胞受體基因重排和陽性選擇，而髓質執行陰性選擇以清除自身反應性 T 細胞。血管周圍空間由脂肪細胞、外周淋巴細胞和基質組成，是非胸腺生成的成分。

label: Thymic Epithelial Cells
description: Thymic epithelial cells (TECs) in the cortex and medulla form a complex network that supports T cell differentiation, providing the essential microenvironment for productive thymopoiesis. The thymus consists of cells of stromal and hematopoietic origin, including TECs, mesenchymal cells (fibroblasts), endothelial cells and dendritic cells. Differentiating thymocytes migrate from the cortico-medullary junction through the cortex and back to the medulla, encountering functionally distinct microenvironments that regulate positive and negative selection.
description_zh_TW: 皮質和髓質中的胸腺上皮細胞（TECs）形成一個複雜的網絡，支持 T 細胞分化，為 productive thymopoiesis 提供必要的微環境。胸腺由基質和造血來源的細胞組成，包括 TECs、間充質細胞（成纖維細胞）、內皮細胞和樹突狀細胞。分化中的胸腺細胞從皮髓交界處遷移穿過皮質再回到髓質，遇到功能不同的微環境，調節陽性和陰性選擇。

label: Phosphocreatine (PCr)
description: Creatine kinase reversibly phosphorylates creatine with ATP to produce phosphocreatine, the muscle phosphagen store. This reaction is the mechanistic hub of the creatine-PCr energy buffer.
description_zh_TW: Creatine kinase 以 ATP 可逆磷酸化肌酸以產生磷酸肌酸，即肌肉磷酸原儲庫。此反應是肌酸-PCr 能量緩衝的機制樞紐。

label: ATR
description: RPA-coated single-stranded DNA at stalled forks activates the ATR-CHK1 checkpoint. This is the canonical replication-stress sensor.
description_zh_TW: 停滯叉上 RPA 包被的單股 DNA 活化 ATR-CHK1 檢查點。這是典型的複製壓力感受器。

label: NAD+ Biosynthesis
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: NMNH (dihydronicotinamide mononucleotide) is the reduced form of nicotinamide mononucleotide and has been shown to promote NAD+ synthesis. Together with NRH, the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside, NMNH adds to the set of NAD+ precursors available for cellular salvage and NAD+ replenishment. These reduced precursors demonstrate that the NAD+ metabolic cycle is more flexible than initially recognized, providing alternative routes to boost NAD+ levels beyond the classic precursors tryptophan, nicotinamide, nicotinic acid, NMN, and NR, and supporting efforts to develop effective strategies for preventing NAD+ decline in aging and disease.
description_zh_TW: NMNH（二氫菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸）是菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸的還原形式，已被證實能促進 NAD+ 生合成。與 NRH（菸鹼醯胺核糖的還原形式）一起，NMNH 加入了可供細胞回收與 NAD+ 補充的 NAD+ 前驅物組合。這些還原型前驅物顯示 NAD+ 代謝循環比最初所認知的更具彈性，提供了超越經典前驅物色胺酸、菸鹼醯胺、菸鹼酸、NMN 和 NR 之外提升 NAD+ 水平的替代途徑，並支持開發有效策略以預防老化與疾病中的 NAD+ 衰退。

label: SAH
description: SAH is the stoichiometric byproduct of SAM methyl transfer. Product relation records the reaction balance.
description_zh_TW: SAH 是 SAM 甲基轉移的化學計量副產物。產物關係記錄反應平衡。

label: VEGFR2
description: VEGFR2 transduces the blood-vascular angiogenic output.
description_zh_TW: VEGFR2 傳導血液血管生成輸出。

label: SADS
description: SADS (senescence-associated distal satellite) is a form of heterochromatin decompaction in senescent cells, specifically the relaxation of constitutive pericentromeric and pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin. Unlike SAHF (which compacts facultative heterochromatin), SADS decompacts constitutive repeats. This structural change alters the nuclear architecture and chromatin accessibility of repetitive regions. SADS represents a distinct, counterintuitive chromatin reorganization during senescence.
description_zh_TW: SADS（senescence-associated distal satellite，衰老相關遠端衛星）是衰老細胞中異染色質去緻密化的一種形式，具體為組成性著絲粒周與中心體周衛星異染色質的鬆弛。不同於 SAHF（緻密化兼性異染色質），SADS 去緻密化組成性重複序列。此結構改變改變重複區域的核架構與染色質可及性。SADS 代表衰老期間一種獨特、違反直覺的染色質重組。

label: PKCζ
description: PKCζ is an atypical protein kinase C isoform.
description_zh_TW: PKCζ 是非典型蛋白激酶 C 亞型。

label: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors
description: Checkpoint inhibitors prototypically block the PD-1 receptor to release T-cell brakes.
description_zh_TW: 檢查點抑制劑典型阻斷 PD-1 受體以釋放 T 細胞煞車。

label: Notch
description: MAML1 is the obligate transcriptional co-activator of Notch signalling. Its N-terminal domain binds the composite surface formed by the Notch intracellular domain (N1ICD) and the DNA-binding factor CSL/RBPJ, nucleating a ternary complex at Notch target promoters, while its C-terminal activation domain recruits p300/CBP to drive histone acetylation and transcriptional activation. Because Notch restrains the late pro-inflammatory SASP by repressing C/EBPbeta, MAML1 is the effector through which N1ICD executes that programme. The SASP-induction scheme groups MAML1 with N1ICD in the nuclear trafficking-gene control layer.
description_zh_TW: MAML1 是 Notch 訊號的必要轉錄共活化者。其 N 端結構域結合由 Notch 胞內結構域（N1ICD）與 DNA 結合因子 CSL/RBPJ 形成的複合表面，在 Notch 標的啟動子上成核三元複合體；其 C 端活化結構域則招募 p300/CBP 以驅動組蛋白乙醯化與轉錄活化。由於 Notch 藉抑制 C/EBPbeta 約束晚期促炎 SASP，MAML1 即為 N1ICD 執行該程序的效應者。SASP 誘導架構圖將 MAML1 與 N1ICD 同置於細胞核運輸基因調控層。

label: USP9X
