description: USP9X removes Mcl-1 polyubiquitin chains, blocking proteasomal degradation.
description_zh_TW: USP9X 移除 Mcl-1 多泛素鏈，阻斷蛋白酶體降解。

label: Fenton reaction
description: Ferrous iron liberated from oxidatively damaged aconitase feeds Fenton chemistry amplifying hydroxyl radical injury. Cluster disintegration links enzyme damage to radical burst.
description_zh_TW: 氧化損傷 aconitase 釋放的亞鐵餵養 Fenton 化學，放大羥基自由基損傷。簇解體將酶損傷與自由基爆發連結。

label: Epigenetic Inheritance
description: DNA methylation is the primary carrier of mitotically heritable epigenetic states. Mechanism edge parallels the Epigenetics parent.
description_zh_TW: DNA 甲基化是有絲分裂可遺傳表觀遺傳狀態的主要載體。機制邊與 Epigenetics 母項平行。

label: Cigarette Smoke
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Exposure to cigarette-smoke extract disrupts the SIRT1–RelA/p65 complex, diminishing deacetylation of RelA and leaving NF-κB in a more active, pro-inflammatory state. The consequence is heightened expression of inflammatory mediators in airway and other cells exposed to smoke. The directionality is that the environmental insult (smoke) reduces a protective protein–protein interaction, increasing inflammation. This provides a mechanistic link between smoking, impaired sirtuin function, and chronic inflammatory lung disease.
description_zh_TW: 暴露於香菸煙霧提取物會破壞 SIRT1–RelA/p65 複合體，削弱 RelA 的去乙醯化，使 NF-κB 處於更活躍的促發炎狀態。後果是在氣道和其他暴露於煙霧的細胞中發炎介質的表達增高。其方向性為：環境損害（煙霧）降低了一個保護性的蛋白-蛋白相互作用，增加發炎。這提供了吸煙、sirtuin 功能受損和慢性發炎性肺病之間的機制性聯繫。

label: KPNB1
description: Importin-beta1 KPNB1 mediates NLS-dependent nuclear import as its primary function.
description_zh_TW: Importin-β1 KPNB1 以 NLS 依賴核輸入為主要功能。

label: Atg8
description: Mammalian LC3A/B/C proteins are the Atg8 family members executing phagophore expansion. Homology anchors the yeast-to-mammal mapping.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳動物 LC3A/B/C 蛋白是執行吞噬泡擴展的 Atg8 家族成員。同源錨定酵母到哺乳動物的對應。

label: CxxC Motif
description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) contains the CxxC active-site motif (Cys-Gly-Pro-Cys, residues Cys32-Cys35), which forms the catalytic core of its oxidoreductase activity. The N-terminal Cys32 attacks substrate disulfides while Cys35 resolves the mixed disulfide.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 含有 CxxC 活性位點基序（Cys-Gly-Pro-Cys，殘基 Cys32-Cys35），構成其氧化還原酶活性的催化核心。N 端的 Cys32 攻擊受質雙硫鍵，而 Cys35 則解析混合雙硫鍵。

label: Immunosenescence
description: Age-related decline in NK, macrophage and T-cell clearance permits senescent cells to persist and accumulate. This failed-surveillance loop closes the circuit with aging-driven senescent-cell formation.
description_zh_TW: NK、巨噬細胞與 T 細胞清除的年齡相關衰退允許衰老細胞持續與累積。此監視失敗迴圈與老化驅動的衰老細胞形成構成迴路。

label: Microtubule
description: Microtubules are alpha/beta-tubulin polymers whose dynamics govern mitosis.
description_zh_TW: 微管是 α/β-tubulin 聚合物，其動態主導有絲分裂。

label: Axon Degeneration
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SARM1 NADase activity executes Wallerian axon degeneration and is a druggable ALS node. NAD+ depletion links SARM1 to the sirtuin-starvation corridor.
description_zh_TW: SARM1 NADase 活性執行 Wallerian 軸突退化，是可藥物化的 ALS 節點。NAD+ 耗竭將 SARM1 連結到 sirtuin 飢餓走廊。

label: MEK
description: MEK1/2 dual-specificity kinases phosphorylate the ERK Thr+Tyr activation loop, refining the existing is_activated_by edge.
description_zh_TW: MEK1/2 雙特異性激酶磷酸化 ERK Thr+Tyr 活化環，細化既有的 is_activated_by 邊。

label: IGF1
description: Intermittent fasting lowers circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), a potent mitogenic and pro-survival hormone whose signaling converges on the PI3K-Akt-mTOR axis to inhibit autophagy. In a breast cancer model, a 48-hour fasting period reduced IGF-1 levels by approximately 70%, dampening pro-tumorigenic IGF-1 receptor signaling. The resulting reduction in mTORC1 activity contributes to the fasting-induced activation of autophagy and the enhanced stress resistance of normal tissues. Lower IGF-1 during fasting is therefore a key endocrine mechanism linking IF to both tumor suppression and longevity.
description_zh_TW: 間歇性斷食降低循環的類胰島素生長因子1（IGF-1），這是一種強效的促有絲分裂和促存活激素，其訊號匯聚於PI3K-Akt-mTOR軸以抑制自噬。在乳腺癌模型中，48小時斷食使IGF-1水平降低約70%，減弱促腫瘤生成的IGF-1受體訊號。由此產生的mTORC1活性降低有助於斷食誘導的自噬活化和正常組織增強的壓力抵抗。因此，斷食期間較低的IGF-1是將IF與腫瘤抑制和長壽連結的關鍵內分泌機制。

label: Ionizing Radiation
description: Ionizing radiation causes DNA double-strand breaks that recruit and autophosphorylate ATM at the site of damage, converting it to an active monomer. This makes ionizing radiation a primary exogenous trigger for ATM activation. Activated ATM then coordinates cell-cycle arrest, repair, and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 游離輻射會造成 DNA 雙股斷裂，在損傷處招募並使 ATM 自體磷酸化，將其轉化為活化的單體。這使游離輻射成為 ATM 激活的主要外源性觸發因子。激活的 ATM 隨後協調細胞週期停滯、修復與細胞凋亡。

label: slow COMT
description: In slow COMT variants, catechol clearance is reduced so endogenous catecholamines may accumulate, enhancing stress reactivity. Exogenous catechols can further inhibit the already sluggish enzyme and add methyl-group demand on the methylation cycle. This underlies the stress sensitivity and supplement intolerance often reported by slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: 在緩慢的 COMT 變異中，兒茶酚清除減少，因此內源性 catecholamines 可能累積，增強壓力反應性。外源性兒茶酚可進一步抑制本已遲緩的酶，並增加對 methylation cycle 的甲基需求。這正是緩慢 COMT 個體常回報的壓力敏感性和補充劑不耐受的基礎。

label: Atg4B
source_file: _document_ - The Beneficial and Adverse Effects of Autophagic Response to Caloric Restriction and Fasting.md
description: The small-molecule ATG4B inhibitor S130 blocks the cysteine protease required for LC3 processing and autophagosome maturation; when combined with caloric restriction, this inhibition shifts the balance toward apoptotic death in colorectal cancer cells. By preventing autophagic protection of tumor cells while CR imposes metabolic stress, S130 sensitizes malignancy to cell death. The synergy illustrates a therapeutic strategy of pairing CR or CR-mimetics with targeted autophagy inhibition in cancer. The approach exploits the reliance of some tumors on basal autophagy for survival.
description_zh_TW: 小分子 ATG4B 抑制劑 S130 阻斷 LC3 處理和自噬體成熟所需的半胱氨酸蛋白酶；當與熱量限制結合時，此抑制在大腸癌細胞中將平衡推向凋亡性死亡。透過防止腫瘤細胞的自噬保護，同時熱量限制施加代謝壓力，S130 使惡性腫瘤對細胞死亡敏感化。此協同作用說明了一種將熱量限制或熱量限制擬似物與標靶性自噬抑制配對用於癌症的治療策略。此方法利用了某些腫瘤對基礎自噬存活的依賴。

label: CD36 Receptor
description: CD36 receptor mediates uptake of oxidized LDL as the principal scavenger receptor on macrophages, delivering oxLDL-derived lipid to form foam cells. This non-downregulated pathway drives cholesterol accumulation in the artery wall. The directionality is receptor to pathological lipid internalization. A caveat is that CD36 also handles fatty acids and other ligands, and other scavenger receptors (SR-A, LOX-1) contribute to oxLDL uptake. CD36 also recognizes oxidized phospholipids on oxLDL and, in combination with TLR signaling, links lipid uptake to sterile inflammation.
description_zh_TW: CD36 receptor 介導 oxidized LDL 作為巨噬細胞上主要清道夫受體的攝取，遞送 oxLDL 衍生的脂質以形成泡沫細胞。這種非下調途徑驅動 cholesterol 在動脈壁積聚。方向性是病理性脂質內化的受體。需要注意的是，CD36 也處理脂肪酸和其他配體，而其他清道夫受體（SR-A、LOX-1）有助於 oxLDL 的攝取。 CD36 也能辨識 oxLDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，並與 TLR 訊號傳導結合，將脂質攝取與無菌發炎聯繫起來。

label: Snail
description: Snail (SNAI1) is a core zinc-finger driver of EMT. Driving is the defining transcription program.
description_zh_TW: Snail（SNAI1）是 EMT 的核心鋅指驅動者。驅動是定義性轉錄程序。

label: ICAD
description: The principal executioner caspase cleaves ICAD to release DNase activity.
description_zh_TW: 主要劊子手 caspase 切割 ICAD 以釋放 DNase 活性。

label: Advanced Glycation End Products formation
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Genistein is an isoflavone flavonoid reported to possess anti-glycation properties. Together with other flavonoids such as kaempferol, quercitrin, and quercetin, genistein inhibits the glycation process in vitro. The anti-glycation activities of these polyphenols are similar to or even stronger than aminoguanidine, and they act in part through trapping reactive carbonyl species and antioxidant capacity. Herbal products and dietary plants containing these flavonoids are therefore considered promising, relatively safe agents for preventing glycation and AGE accumulation during aging.
description_zh_TW: Genistein 是一種異黃酮類黃酮，據報導具有抗糖化特性。與其他黃酮類如 kaempferol、quercitrin 與 quercetin 一起，Genistein 在體外抑制糖化過程。這些多酚的抗糖化活性與 aminoguanidine 相似甚至更強，且部分透過捕捉活性羰基物種與抗氧化能力來作用。因此，含有這些黃酮類的草藥產品與食用植物被視為在老化過程中預防糖化與 AGE 堆積的具潛力且相對安全的物質。

label: necrosome
description: RHIM-RHIM contacts between RIPK1/RIPK3 (classical TNFR1 necrosome) and ZBP1/TRIF-RIPK3 (non-classical, RIPK1-independent) nucleate the amyloid-like necrosome; caspase-8 cleavage of RHIM carriers dissolves the scaffold.
description_zh_TW: RHIM-RHIM contacts between RIPK1/RIPK3 (classical TNFR1 necrosome) and ZBP1/TRIF-RIPK3 (non-classical, RIPK1-independent) nucleate the amyloid-like necrosome; caspase-8 cleavage of RHIM carriers dissolves the scaffold.

label: Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Food is an important source of exogenous advanced glycation end products, since significant AGE generation occurs when sugars are cooked with proteins via the Maillard reaction. In a mouse model, feeding an AGE-rich diet for 16 weeks promoted a 53% increase in serum AGE levels. In renal failure patients, an AGE-rich diet produced a 29% increase in blood CML, while a low-AGE diet produced a 34% reduction. These findings suggest that a diet restricting AGEs is an effective way to reduce the AGE burden in the human body.
description_zh_TW: Food 是 exogenous advanced glycation end products 的重要來源，因為當 sugars 與 proteins 經由 Maillard reaction 一起 cooked 時，會產生顯著的 AGE。在 mouse model 中，餵食 AGE-rich diet 16 週使血清 AGE levels 增加 53%。在 renal failure patients 中，AGE-rich diet 使血液 CML 增加 29%，而 low-AGE diet 則使其降低 34%。這些 findings 顯示，限制 AGEs 的 diet 是降低人體 AGE burden 的有效方法。

label: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome
description: Germline LKB1/STK11 loss causes Peutz-Jeghers syndrome.
description_zh_TW: 生殖系 LKB1/STK11 缺失導致 Peutz-Jeghers 症候群。

label: Mesenchymal Stromal Cells
description: Mesenchymal and stromal cells synthesize pro-HGF for niche signaling.
description_zh_TW: 間質與基質細胞合成 pro-HGF 以供微環境訊號。

label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell
description: Acute myeloid leukemia arises through the sequential acquisition of mutations in hematopoietic stem cells, the cell of origin where DNMT3A mutations arise and persist as preleukemic clones. This origin in stem cells underlies the clonal expansion of immature myeloid blasts. Targeting the mutant clone rather than only the blast population is a key therapeutic rationale.
description_zh_TW: 急性骨髓性白血病透過造血幹細胞中突變的依序獲得而發生，造血幹細胞是 DNMT3A 突變產生並以白血病前克隆持續存在的起源細胞。這種起源於幹細胞的性質是不成熟骨髓母細胞克隆擴張的基礎。靶向突變克隆而非僅針對母細胞族群是關鍵的治療依據。

label: Parkin
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: The E3 ligase Parkin recruited by PINK1 is required to ubiquitinate outer-membrane proteins for clearance. Requirement records the effector dependency.
description_zh_TW: PINK1 招募的 E3 連接酶 Parkin 為泛素化外膜蛋白以供清除所需。必要性記錄效應器依賴。

label: Fibroblasts
description: HFF1 is a neonatal foreskin fibroblast line.
description_zh_TW: HFF1 是新生兒包皮纖維母細胞系。

label: Phenylbutyrate
description: Phenylbutyrate inhibits class I/IIA HDACs at stress-response promoters. Same inhibitor class as butyrate and valproate.
description_zh_TW: Phenylbutyrate 在壓力反應啟動子抑制 I/IIA 類 HDAC。與 butyrate 和 valproate 相同的抑制劑類別。

label: Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta
description: Dopamine is located in Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta, establishing the anatomical or subcellular compartment where the entity exerts its function. Mechanistically, this localization reflects biosynthesis, vesicular storage, or the selective vulnerability of that region's neurons. It is significant because the site of localization determines which circuits and symptoms are affected, particularly in Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that localization is often regionally predominant rather than exclusive, and other brain areas may contain smaller amounts of the same entity.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 位於 Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta 中，建立實體發揮其功能的解剖或亞細胞區室。從機制上講，這種定位反映了該區域神經元的生物合成、囊泡儲存或選擇性脆弱性。這很重要，因為本地化的位置決定了哪些電路和症狀受到影響，特別是在 Parkinson's disease 中。需要注意的是，定位通常是區域性的，而不是排他性的，而其他大腦區域可能包含少量的相同實體。

label: Prostaglandin E2
description: NSAIDs pharmacologically block prostaglandin E2 synthesis.
description_zh_TW: NSAID 藥理阻斷前列腺素 E2 合成。

label: ADP-Ribose
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: PARG hydrolyzes PAR chains, releasing free ADP-ribose monomers. This free ADP-ribose is the ligand that gates TRPM2 and the substrate for Nudix degradation, making PARG activity a determinant of the downstream Ca2+ and AMP arms of parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: PARG 水解 PAR 鏈釋出游離 ADP-ribose 單體。此游離 ADP-ribose 是開啟 TRPM2 的配體及 Nudix 降解的受質，使 PARG 活性成為 parthanatos 下游 Ca2+ 與 AMP 分支的決定因素（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Mice
description: Only mitochondria-targeted catalase (mCAT) extends median lifespan ~20% (Schriner 2005); cytosolic catalase is null (Perez 2009). Qualified subject replaces the overstated generic edge.
description_zh_TW: 僅粒線體標靶 catalase（mCAT）延長中位壽命約 20%（Schriner 2005）；胞質 catalase 無效（Perez 2009）。限定主詞取代誇大的通用邊。

label: Cell-to-Cell Fusion-Induced Senescence
description: CFIS produces a stable senescent phenotype withdrawn from the cycle. Classification places fusion arrest in the senescence family.
description_zh_TW: CFIS 產生退出週期的穩定衰老表型。歸類將融合停滯置於衰老家族。

label: SLC25A1
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: CTPI2 is a third-generation inhibitor of the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 with high binding affinity and specificity. CTPI2 treatment results in dose-dependent suppression of SASP components at transcript and protein levels without altering cell cycle regulators, HMGB1 localization, DNA damage foci or proliferation markers. It reduces global nuclear acetylation and H3K27ac at SASP loci and abolishes incorporation of glucose-derived carbon into histone acetylation, yet does not broadly impair mitochondrial function: OXPHOS gene expression, ATP production, coupling efficiency, mitochondrial ROS and morphology remain largely unchanged.
description_zh_TW: CTPI2 是粒線體檸檬酸載體 SLC25A1 的第三代抑制劑，具有高結合親和力與特異性。CTPI2 治療可在轉錄與蛋白質層面劑量依賴性地抑制 SASP 組成，同時不改變細胞週期調控因子、HMGB1 定位、DNA 損傷焦點或增殖標記。它可降低整體細胞核乙醯化及 SASP 基因座的 H3K27ac，並消除葡萄糖來源碳併入組蛋白乙醯化的現象，但不會廣泛損害粒線體功能：OXPHOS 基因表現、ATP 產生、偶聯效率、粒線體 ROS 與形態大多維持不變。

label: Warburg Effect
description: SIRT6 is the clearest anti-Warburg sirtuin: it corepresses HIF-1α and suppresses transcription of glycolytic enzymes (glucose transporters, Hexokinase 2), and its loss permits Warburg-like aerobic glycolysis. Restoration suppresses glycolysis in HCC/glioma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 是最明確的抗 Warburg sirtuin：它協同抑制 HIF-1α 並抑制糖酵解酶（葡萄糖轉運體、Hexokinase 2）的轉錄，其缺失會容許 Warburg 樣的有氧糖酵解。恢復 SIRT6 可抑制 HCC/神經膠質瘤中的糖酵解。

label: Norepinephrine
description: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) clears approximately 80-90 percent of released norepinephrine by high-affinity reuptake into the presynaptic varicosity at sympathetic nerve endings. The recaptured norepinephrine is either repackaged into vesicles or metabolized. NET-mediated reuptake is the dominant mechanism for terminating sympathetic neurotransmission.
description_zh_TW: Norepinephrine transporter（NET）透過高親和力再攝取，清除交感神經末梢突觸前膨體中約 80-90% 已釋放的 norepinephrine。被再攝取的 norepinephrine 會被重新包裝入囊泡或被代謝。NET 介導的再攝取是終止交感神經傳遞的主要機制。

label: Cytoplasmic Chromatin Fragments
description: DNA-SCARS may serve as precursors to cytoplasmic chromatin fragments (CCF) that trigger inflammation via cGAS-STING. CCF derived from DNA-SCARS are enriched in heterochromatin marks and activate the cGAS-STING-NF-kB axis.
description_zh_TW: DNA-SCARS 可能作為細胞質染色質片段（CCF）的前驅物，經由 cGAS-STING 觸發發炎。源自 DNA-SCARS 的 CCF 富含異染色質標記，並活化 cGAS-STING-NF-κB 軸。

label: Multiple Sclerosis
description: Mitoxantrone is an approved immunosuppressive therapy for multiple sclerosis. Indication mirrors the Hydroxyurea-SCD pattern.
description_zh_TW: Mitoxantrone 是多發性硬化症核准的免疫抑制治療。適應症呼應 Hydroxyurea-SCD 模式。

label: Hypobromous Acid
description: Hydrogen peroxide is the obligate co-substrate with bromide in eosinophil peroxidase catalysis of hypobromous acid. Co-substrate supply gates brominating output.
description_zh_TW: 過氧化氫是嗜酸性球過氧化物酶催化次溴酸時與溴化物並列的必要共底物。共底物供應守衛溴化輸出。

label: CDKN1C
description: CDKN1C (p57) is expressed from the maternal allele only under KvDMR1 imprinting control. This parent-of-origin regulation links cell-cycle control to epigenetic inheritance.
description_zh_TW: CDKN1C（p57）僅在 KvDMR1 銘印控制下從母系等位基因表現。此親源調節將細胞週期控制連結到表觀遺傳繼承。

label: Telomere
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 at telomeric regions in response to DNA damage and stabilizes the WRN helicase at telomeres, tightening telomere structure and preventing dysfunction during replication. Directionally, SIRT6 maintains telomere integrity. Loss of SIRT6 causes H3K9 hyperacetylation and chromatin relaxation at telomeres, tying it to genomic stability in ageing.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 在 DNA 損傷反應中去乙醯化端粒區域的 H3K9，並在端粒處穩定 WRN 解旋酶，緊密化端粒結構並防止複製過程中的功能障礙。方向性上 SIRT6 維護端粒完整性。SIRT6 的缺失導致端粒處 H3K9 超乙醯化和染色質鬆弛，將其與老化的基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

label: Trisomy
description: Trisomy is whole-chromosome aneuploidy with three copies.
description_zh_TW: 三體是具三拷貝的全染色體非整倍體。

label: Depression
description: NR-driven microbiota composition shifts causally modulate depressive behavior, proven by fecal transplant reproducing resilience in germ-free recipients. Modulation runs through the gut-brain axis to BDNF and microglia.
description_zh_TW: NR 驅動的菌群組成變化因果調節憂鬱行為，糞菌移植在無菌受體重現韌性已證明。調節經腸腦軸通往 BDNF 與小膠質細胞。

label: Necrosis
description: Although parthanatos shares loss of membrane integrity with necrosis, it is a regulated, strictly PARP1-dependent, caspase-independent death featuring PAR accumulation, AIF translocation and large-scale DNA fragmentation, distinguishing it from accidental necrosis (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: 雖然 parthanatos 與 necrosis 同樣失去膜完整性，但其為受調控、嚴格依賴 PARP1、caspase 非依賴的死亡，具 PAR 累積、AIF 轉位與大規模 DNA 斷裂特徵，與意外性 necrosis 有別（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
source_file: _document_ - Necroptosis a regulated inflammatory mode of cell death.md
description: SOD1-G93A transgenic ALS mice show reduced axonal degeneration and motor dysfunction upon RIPK3 silencing or Nec-1 treatment; OPTN mutation initiates RIPK1-dependent axonopathy and sporadic-ALS astrocytes kill neighboring motor neurons via RIPK1/MLKL necroptosis blocked by necrosulfonamide or RIPK1 knockdown (Dhuriya & Sharma 2018).
description_zh_TW: SOD1-G93A ALS 转基因小鼠经 RIPK3 沉默或 Nec-1 处理轴突变性与运动障碍减轻；OPTN 突变启动 RIPK1 依赖性轴突病变，散发 ALS 星形胶质细胞经 RIPK1/MLKL necroptosis 杀伤邻近运动神经元，可被 necrosulfonamide 或 RIPK1 敲低阻断。

label: HDAC4
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: HDAC4 buffers AP-1 activity in young cells and is degraded on senescence entry, licensing AP-1-driven SASP. Loss of the brake explains senescence-specific AP-1 activation.
description_zh_TW: HDAC4 在年輕細胞緩衝 AP-1 活性，並在衰老進入時降解，許可 AP-1 驅動的 SASP。煞車喪失解釋衰老特異的 AP-1 活化。

label: Noxa
description: Noxa selectively binds Mcl-1 and promotes its degradation, sensitizing cells to mitochondrial apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Noxa 選擇性結合 Mcl-1 並促進其降解，使細胞對粒線體凋亡敏感化。

label: Biphasic Dose Response
description: Varying hypoxia intensity or duration produces inverted-U or J-shaped responses in antioxidant enzymes, e.g. scallop SOD rising 15-50% at 12 h then falling 40-60% over days. Pacific white shrimp SOD and GPX show similar inverted-U curves, meeting quantitative hormesis criteria.
description_zh_TW: 改變 Hypoxia 強度或持續時間會在抗氧化酵素中產生倒 U 形或 J 形反應，例如扇貝 SOD 在 12 小時上升 15-50%，數天後下降 40-60%。太平洋白蝦的 SOD 與 GPX 也呈現類似倒 U 形曲線，符合定量的 hormesis 標準。

label: p62
description: Lipidated Atg8 on the phagophore is the binding site for the p62 cargo adapter linking ubiquitinated cargo to the membrane. Binding couples cargo to engulfment.
description_zh_TW: 吞噬泡上脂化的 Atg8 是 p62 貨物接合蛋白的結合位點，將泛素化貨物連結到膜。結合將貨物耦合到吞噬。

label: Fasting
description: Fasting-driven AMPK activates TFEB for lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy, overlapping UPRmt/mitophagy programs. Distinct subject from the existing Intermittent Fasting edges.
description_zh_TW: 禁食驅動的 AMPK 活化 TFEB 以進行溶酶體生成與自噬，與 UPRmt/mitophagy 程序重疊。主詞不同於既有的 Intermittent Fasting 邊。

label: acute promyelocytic leukaemia
description: APL is the M3 subtype of acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: APL 是急性骨髓性白血病的 M3 亞型。

label: FBW7
description: FBW7 recognizes the GSK3-primed S155/S159 phosphodegron on Mcl-1.
description_zh_TW: FBW7 辨識 Mcl-1 上經 GSK3 啟動的 S155/S159 磷酸降解子。

label: GDF15
description: GDF15 is a stress-induced cytokine classified as a mitokine. Classification groups it with FGF21 and Humanin.
description_zh_TW: GDF15 是歸類為 mitokine 的壓力誘發細胞激素。歸類將它與 FGF21 和 Humanin 並列。

label: Hesperidin
description: Hesperidin is the prototypical flavanone glycoside of citrus. Membership anchors the dietary example.
description_zh_TW: Hesperidin 是柑橘典型的 flavanone 糖苷。成員關係錨定膳食範例。

label: Dihydromyricetin
description: DHM activates AMPK, which synergistically raises NAD+ via NAMPT upregulation and thereby further potentiates SIRT3 activity. Directionally, DHM activates AMPK, which increases NAD+ to boost SIRT3. This dual SIRT3/AMPK engagement amplifies mitochondrial and metabolic defenses, protecting the liver and other tissues from metabolic and oxidative injury. It mirrors the indirect resveratrol cascade, suggesting convergent circuitry among polyphenols, and it illustrates how natural compounds often activate multiple, reinforcing pathways rather than a single target—an important consideration for interpreting their biological effects.
description_zh_TW: DHM 活化 AMPK，AMPK 協同性地通過 NAMPT 上調提高 NAD+，進而進一步增強 SIRT3 活性。在方向性上，DHM 活化 AMPK，AMPK 增加 NAD+ 以提升 SIRT3。這種 SIRT3/AMPK 的雙重參與放大粒線體和代謝防禦，保護肝臟和其他組織免受代謝和氧化損傷。它反映了白藜蘆醇的間接級聯反應，提示多酚之間的趨同電路，並說明天然化合物通常活化多個強化的通路而非單一靶點——這是解釋其生物學效應時的重要考量。

label: Epigenetic Modifiers
description: Plant compounds act as natural epigenetic modifiers of chromatin state.
description_zh_TW: 植物化合物充當染色質狀態的天然表觀遺傳修飾劑。

label: N-Acetylcysteine
description: In C. elegans, glucose restriction normally raises mitochondrial respiration and ROS, inducing catalase and extending lifespan; NAC pre-treatment completely abolished both the ROS rise and the longevity benefit. NAC is the strongest direct evidence that scavenging the ROS signal blocks mitohormesis.
description_zh_TW: 在 C. elegans 中，葡萄糖限制通常升高粒線體呼吸與 ROS，誘發 catalase 並延長壽命；NAC 預處理完全廢除 ROS 升高與長壽益處。NAC 是最強的直接證據，顯示清除 ROS 訊號會阻斷粒線體促效應。

label: TRAIL
description: TRAIL binding induces DR4 trimerization and DISC recruitment, initiating extrinsic apoptosis with tumor selectivity.
description_zh_TW: TRAIL 結合誘發 DR4 三聚化與 DISC 招募，啟動具腫瘤選擇性的外源性凋亡。

label: Auranofin
description: Auranofin is a potent, irreversible covalent inhibitor of both cytosolic (TXNRD1) and mitochondrial (TXNRD2) thioredoxin reductase. Its gold(I) cation coordinates the catalytic C-terminal selenocysteine, blocking thioredoxin regeneration and converting the redox-balancing machinery into a source of lethal ROS.
description_zh_TW: Auranofin 是細胞質（TXNRD1）與粒線體（TXNRD2）硫氧還蛋白還原酶的強效、不可逆共價抑制劑。其金(I)陽離子配位催化所需的 C 端硒半胱氨酸，阻斷硫氧還蛋白再生成，並將氧化還原平衡機制轉變為致命 ROS 的來源。

label: SMAD3
description: SMAD3 is the co-primary R-SMAD complexing with SMAD4 for nuclear action. Parallel edge to the SMAD2 activation.
description_zh_TW: SMAD3 是與 SMAD4 形成複合體入核作用的共同主要 R-SMAD。與 SMAD2 活化平行的邊。

label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is characterized by persistent airway inflammation and poorly reversible airflow limitation driven by neutrophilic and macrophage inflammation. Oxidant-antioxidant imbalance in the lungs fuels this chronic inflammatory state. The directionality is inflammatory airway disease to oxidative burden. A caveat is that COPD heterogeneity means not all patients show the same oxidant signature, and smoking-independent forms exist. This inflammation is sustained by an oxidant-antioxidant imbalance that inactivates antiproteases and perpetuates tissue destruction.
description_zh_TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 的特徵是持續的 airway inflammation 和由中性粒細胞和巨噬細胞發炎驅動的可逆性差的氣流受限。肺部的氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡加劇了這種慢性發炎狀態。方向性是發炎性氣道疾病對氧化負擔的影響。需要注意的是，COPD 異質性意味著並非所有患者都表現出相同的氧化劑特徵，並且存在 smoking 獨立形式。這種發炎是由氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡所維持的，這種失衡會使抗蛋白酶失去活性並使組織破壞永久化。

label: Satellite Cells
description: Muscle stem cells and satellite cells name the same Pax7+ population positionally. Single alias pair kept; mirror dropped on dedup.
description_zh_TW: 肌肉幹細胞與衛星細胞按位置命名同一 Pax7+ 群體。僅保留單一別名對；鏡像在去重中捨棄。

label: Melatonin
description: Melatonin upregulates SIRT3, which promotes mitophagy to mitigate oxidative stress-induced damage, and SIRT3 knockout completely abolishes melatonin's benefits against contrast-induced AKI. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin promotes autophagy, reduces apoptosis, and mitigates mitochondrial dysfunction by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, with SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of TFAM at Lys154 acting as a pivotal molecular switch for mitophagic flux.
description_zh_TW: Melatonin 上調 SIRT3，後者促進粒線體自噬以減輕氧化壓力誘導的損傷，且 SIRT3 基因敲除完全消除 melatonin 對比劑誘導 AKI 的保護益處。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙，其中 SIRT3 介導的 TFAM 在 Lys154 處的去乙醯化作為粒線體自噬通量的關鍵分子開關。

label: Tryptophan
description: Tryptophan (Trp) is the dietary precursor for de novo NAD+ biosynthesis, which proceeds through an eight-step pathway that passes through quinolinic acid before generating NAD+. This de novo route complements the salvage pathways, which recycle nicotinamide (NAM), nicotinic acid (NA), nicotinamide riboside (NR), and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) back into NAD+ in two or three steps. Dietary tryptophan, or less than 20 mg of niacin daily, is sufficient to meet baseline NAD+ synthesis requirements, although greater rates of NAD+ synthesis through precursor supplementation are required to achieve therapeutic effects.
description_zh_TW: 色氨酸（Trp）是從頭合成 NAD+ 的飲食前驅物，此途徑經過八個步驟，在生成 NAD+ 之前會通過喹啉酸。這條從頭合成路徑補充了補救途徑，後者將菸鹼醯胺（NAM）、菸鹼酸（NA）、菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）與菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）在兩到三個步驟內回收為 NAD+。飲食中的色氨酸，或每日少於 20 毫克的菸鹼酸，即足以滿足基礎 NAD+ 合成需求，然而要達到治療效果，則需透過前驅物補充來提高 NAD+ 合成速率。

label: Basal Lamina
description: Basal lamina is a specialized sheet form of extracellular matrix. Classification nests it in ECM.
description_zh_TW: 基底膜是細胞外基質的特化片狀形式。歸類將它嵌套於 ECM。

label: Skeletal Muscle
description: In the ATLAS RCT (n=88, 500/1000 mg/day, 4 months), Urolithin A improved hamstring strength ~12%, aerobic endurance (VO2), and 6-min walk distance with reduced acylcarnitines/CRP; muscle biopsies showed Parkin-mediated ubiquitin-proteasome enrichment (500 mg) and OXPHOS upregulation (1000 mg).
description_zh_TW: ATLAS RCT（n=88，500/1000 mg/天，4 個月）中，Urolithin A 提升腿後肌力約 12%、有氧耐力（VO2）與 6 分鐘步行距離，並降低 acylcarnitines/CRP；肌肉切片顯示 Parkin 相關泛素-蛋白酶體富集（500 mg）與 OXPHOS 上調（1000 mg）。

label: COVID-19
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Severe COVID-19 drives CD38-NADase-mediated NAD+ depletion (Heer 2020), feeding sirtuin loss and inflammaging. Systemic-viral arm of the NAD+ corridor.
description_zh_TW: 重症 COVID-19 驅動 CD38-NADase 介導的 NAD+ 耗竭（Heer 2020），供養 sirtuin 缺失與發炎老化。NAD+ 走廊的全身病毒臂。

label: HSPA8
description: TXNDC5 is an ER-localized thioredoxin-family chaperone that synergizes with HSPA8 (HSC70) to exacerbate the inflammatory phenotype of synovial fibroblasts via NF-kB signaling. Because HSPA8 is the bridge node apigenin disrupts, TXNDC5-HSPA8 cooperativity is relevant to SASP suppression.
description_zh_TW: TXNDC5 是 ER 定位的硫氧還蛋白家族伴護蛋白，與 HSPA8（HSC70）協同，經由 NF-κB 訊號加劇滑膜纖維母細胞的發炎表現型。由於 HSPA8 是 apigenin 破壞的橋接節點，TXNDC5-HSPA8 協同與 SASP 壓制相關。

label: MAPK
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Singlet oxygen from UVA photosensitizers activates MAPK signaling upstream of matrix metalloproteinase induction. Photochemical oxidant feeds kinase cascades.
description_zh_TW: UVA 光敏劑的 singlet oxygen 在基質金屬蛋白酶誘導上游活化 MAPK 訊號。光化學氧化劑供養激酶級聯。

label: TSC2
description: Germline TSC2 loss causes the TSC hamartoma syndrome. Causation is the genetic etiology.
description_zh_TW: 生殖系 TSC2 缺失導致 TSC 錯構瘤症候群。因果是遺傳病因。

label: Lewy Bodies
description: Crowding facilitates inclusion assembly, as modeled in vitro for Lewy body formation. Excluded volume lowers the barrier to protein deposition into inclusions.
description_zh_TW: 擁擠促進包涵體組裝，體外路易體形成模型已證實。排除體積降低蛋白沉積為包涵體的屏障。

label: Methionine sulfoxide reductases
description: Thioredoxin supplies electrons for the MsrA and MsrB catalytic cycle reducing methionine sulfoxide. Reductant supply gates enzymatic repair turnover.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin 為 MsrA 與 MsrB 催化循環供應電子，還原甲硫胺酸亞碸。還原劑供應守衛酶促修復週轉。

label: Benzimidazole
description: Benzimidazoles bind the beta-tubulin colchicine site, mirroring the mebendazole/albendazole edges.
description_zh_TW: 苯並咪唑結合 β-tubulin 秋水仙鹼位點，呼應 mebendazole/albendazole 邊。

label: ZBP1
description: ZBP1 senses viral or endogenous Z-nucleic acids and recruits RIPK3 via RHIM-RHIM interaction, driving RIPK3 autophosphorylation and MLKL activation; it is a central non-canonical necroptosis sensor in viral infection and genomic stress (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: ZBP1 感測病毒或內源性 Z-核酸，經 RHIM-RHIM 交互作用招募 RIPK3，驅動 RIPK3 自磷酸化與 MLKL 活化；是病毒感染與基因組壓力下核心的非經典 necroptosis 感測器（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: MIF
description: Cytoplasmic AIF binds macrophage migration inhibitory factor (MIF), which has nuclease activity, and the pair co-translocates to the nucleus to execute large-scale DNA fragmentation; a selective MIF-nuclease inhibitor protects in a mouse model of parkinsonism. An AIF-cyclophilin A-histone H2AX complex with intrinsic AIF nuclease activity is the alternative model (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: 胞質 AIF 結合具核酸酶活性的 MIF，兩者共同轉位至細胞核執行大規模 DNA 斷裂；選擇性 MIF 核酸酶抑制劑在帕金森氏症小鼠模型中具保護作用。具內在 AIF 核酸酶活性的 AIF-cyclophilin A-histone H2AX 複合體為替代模型（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Energy Expenditure
description: Raised energy expenditure from FGF21-UCP1 thermogenesis outpaces compensatory food intake, producing net fat loss. Expenditure exceeding intake is the arithmetic of the phenotype.
description_zh_TW: FGF21-UCP1 產熱提高的能量消耗超過代償性進食，產生淨脂肪減少。消耗超過攝取是此表型的算術。

label: macroH2A
description: macroH2A accumulates in senescent cells and contributes to the proper timing of SASP expression. Its repressive chromatin functions balance SASP output during senescence.
description_zh_TW: macroH2A 在衰老細胞中累積，並促成 SASP 表現的適當時序。其抑制性染色質功能在衰老期間平衡 SASP 輸出。

label: Enzalutamide
description: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

label: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy
description: LAMP-2A is the lysosomal receptor of chaperone-mediated autophagy, whose age-related loss collapses CMA. Restoring LAMP-2A rescues selective protein clearance in aging.
description_zh_TW: LAMP-2A 是伴侶介導自噬的溶酶體受體，其年齡相關喪失瓦解 CMA。恢復 LAMP-2A 挽救老化中的選擇性蛋白清除。

label: Lymphocyte
description: Naive lymphocytes rest metabolically restrained in quiescence until antigen activation.
description_zh_TW: 初始淋巴細胞在抗原活化前以代謝受限靜止休憩。

label: trastuzumab
description: Trastuzumab binds the HER2 extracellular subdomain IV.
description_zh_TW: trastuzumab 結合 HER2 胞外第四次結構域。

label: Neurodegenerative Diseases
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Alzheimer disease is the most common dementia and neurodegenerative disorder. Classification nests it in the disease family.
description_zh_TW: 阿茲海默病是最常見的失智與神經退化疾病。歸類將它嵌套於疾病家族。

label: Sarcopenia
description: In the Women's Health and Aging Study I, serum carboxymethyl-lysine (CML), the soluble receptor for advanced glycation end products (sRAGE), endogenous secretory RAGE (esRAGE), and grip strength were measured in 559 moderately to severely disabled women aged 65 and older. Women with higher concentrations of CML had less grip strength than women with lower CML concentrations, leading the authors to conclude that women with higher AGEs have more muscle weakness. These findings support a role for AGE accumulation in age-related muscle weakness and sarcopenia, although the studies are not conclusive of a causal relationship.
description_zh_TW: 在女性健康與老化研究 I（Women's Health and Aging Study I）中，於 559 名 65 歲及以上、中度至重度失能的女性中測量了血清羧甲基賴氨酸（CML）、晚期糖化終產物之可溶性受體（sRAGE）、內源性分泌型 RAGE（esRAGE）與握力。CML 濃度較高的女性比 CML 濃度較低的女性握力較差，使作者得出結論：AGE 較高的女性有較多的肌肉無力。這些發現支持 AGE 堆積在年齡相關肌肉無力與肌少症中的角色，儘管這些研究尚無法確立因果關係。

label: Cyclin D1
description: Cyclin D1 belongs to the D-type cyclin family governing G1 CDK4/6 activation.
description_zh_TW: Cyclin D1 屬於掌管 G1 CDK4/6 活化的 D 型 cyclin 家族。

label: Oncogene-Induced Senescence
description: OIS arrests via the p53/p21 axis; p53 loss is the canonical bypass to malignancy in the OIS-p53-cancer path. Requirement, not mere association.
description_zh_TW: OIS 經由 p53/p21 軸停滯；p53 缺失是 OIS-p53-癌症路徑中典型的惡性繞行。是必要性而非單純關聯。

label: c-Myc
description: High c-Myc expression carries tumorigenesis risk motivating 3-factor OSK clinical designs; mirrors the MET-gene edge. Promotion is the safety rationale.
description_zh_TW: 高 c-Myc 表現帶有致瘤風險，促使三因子 OSK 臨床設計；呼應 MET 基因邊。促進是安全依據。

label: irinotecan
description: SN-38 traps the topoisomerase I cleavage complex, causing fork-collision breaks.
description_zh_TW: SN-38 捕獲拓樸異構酶 I 切割複合體，導致複製叉碰撞斷裂。

label: PKC
description: PKC is a family of serine/threonine kinases that regulates autophagy, cell survival, differentiation, and immune responses. Through its control of survival pathways and Bcl-2-family regulation, PKC signaling modulates cell fate decisions relevant to apoptosis and autophagy.
description_zh_TW: PKC 是調控自噬、細胞存活、分化與免疫反應的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶家族。透過對存活途徑與 Bcl-2 家族調控的控制，PKC 訊號調節與細胞凋亡及自噬相關的細胞命運決定。

label: Methylation Cycle
description: Creatine synthesis consumes an estimated 40% of the body's daily methyl-group flux, making it the single largest sink in the methylation cycle. Endogenous creatine synthesis competes with other SAM-dependent reactions, and supplementing creatine spares methyl groups for other pathways.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸合成消耗身體每日甲基通量約 40%，是甲基化循環中最大的單一消耗端。內源性肌酸合成與其他 SAM 依賴反應競爭，而補充肌酸可為其他途徑節省甲基。

label: Xanthine Oxidase
description: Xanthine oxidase generates superoxide as a byproduct of hypoxanthine/xanthine to uric acid conversion, a major ischemia-reperfusion source. Production adds the purine-catabolism arm.
description_zh_TW: 黃嘌呤氧化酶在次黃嘌呤/黃嘌呤轉尿酸時副產超氧陰離子，是缺血再灌注的主要來源。產生增加嘌呤分解臂。

label: CDK1
description: The CDK1-cyclin B1 complex constitutes MPF driving G2/M entry; the cyclin box binds and activates CDK1.
description_zh_TW: CDK1-cyclin B1 複合體構成驅動 G2/M 進入的 MPF；cyclin box 結合並活化 CDK1。

label: Coronary artery constriction
description: Reduced perfusion from constriction directly causes ischemia. Causation is the flow to injury step.
description_zh_TW: 收縮減少灌流直接導致缺血。因果是血流到損傷步驟。

label: Extrinsic Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Extrinsic Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Extrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑Extrinsic Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Extrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Yamanaka Factors
description: Defined-factor reprogramming converts HFF1 fibroblasts to pluripotency.
description_zh_TW: 既定因子重編程將 HFF1 纖維母細胞轉為多能性。

label: Integrins
description: iRGD homes to alphav tumor vasculature via its RGD motif as step one.
description_zh_TW: iRGD 經 RGD 基序歸巢 αv 腫瘤血管作為第一步。

label: AMP
source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md
description: Nudix cleavage of ADP-ribose yields AMP, and the resulting ribose-5-phosphate can form PRPP for NAD+ salvage. The accumulating ADP and especially AMP may be an important death signal, and AMP can inhibit the mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocator (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: Nudix 切割 ADP-ribose 產生 AMP，所得 ribose-5-phosphate 可形成 PRPP 供 NAD+ 救援。蓄積的 ADP 與特別是 AMP 可能是重要死亡訊號，且 AMP 可抑制粒線體 adenine nucleotide translocator（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Macrophages
description: CD206 (mannose receptor MRC1) is a canonical surface marker of alternatively activated (M2) macrophages. Its expression is induced by IL-4 and IL-13 and suppressed by inflammatory stimuli, making CD206 a defining M2 polarization marker.
description_zh_TW: CD206（甘露糖受體 MRC1）是交替活化（M2）巨噬細胞的典型表面標記。其表現由 IL-4 與 IL-13 誘導，並受發炎刺激抑制，使 CD206 成為 M2 極化的定義性標記。

label: TLR2/6
description: TLR2/6 signalling activates the inflammasome, providing an innate-immune priming step for SASP induction. In oncogene-induced senescence this is triggered by acute-phase serum amyloid A1 and A2 acting at TLR2, and HMGB1 can act through the same receptor to induce the SASP. Inflammasome activation leads to caspase-1-dependent maturation of pro-IL-1beta, which is then secreted as a SASP factor and feeds back on IL-1R, closing the loop from tissue damage to inflammatory output.
description_zh_TW: TLR2/6 訊號活化發炎體，為 SASP 誘導提供先天免疫預處理步驟。在癌基因誘導衰老中，此由作用於 TLR2 的急性期血清澱粉樣蛋白 A1 與 A2 觸發，HMGB1 亦可經同一受體誘導 SASP。發炎體活化導致 caspase-1 依賴性 pro-IL-1beta 成熟，隨後以 SASP 因子分泌並回饋至 IL-1R，封閉由組織損傷到發炎輸出的環路。

label: Camptothecin
description: Camptothecin traps the Topo I-DNA cleavage complex as the class mechanism. Complements the existing FL118-Topo-I edge.
description_zh_TW: Camptothecin 捕獲 Topo I-DNA 切割複合體作為類別機制。補充既有的 FL118-Topo-I 邊。

label: Proteostasis
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: The proteostasis network is challenged by excluded-volume effects that perturb folding and clearance equilibria. Crowding connects pigment load to proteostatic collapse.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質穩態網絡受排除體積效應挑戰，擾亂折疊與清除平衡。擁擠將色素負荷與蛋白穩態崩潰連結。

label: Ubiquitin-Proteasome System
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The ubiquitin-proteasome system stands as one of the main pathways responsible for the degradation of intracellular proteins, including muscle proteins. Studies have found that urolithin A can attenuate the degradation of muscle proteins by inhibiting the activity of the ubiquitin-proteasome system, possibly by influencing the activity of specific ubiquitin ligases or proteasomes. This inhibition contributes to urolithin A's muscle-sparing and anti-atrophic effects, helping to preserve muscle mass during catabolic states.
description_zh_TW: 泛素-蛋白酶體系統（ubiquitin-proteasome system）是負責細胞內蛋白（包括肌肉蛋白）降解的主要路徑之一。研究發現 urolithin A 可透過抑制泛素-蛋白酶體系統的活性來減緩肌肉蛋白的降解，可能是透過影響特定泛素連接酶或蛋白酶體的活性。此抑制作用有助於 urolithin A 的肌肉保留與抗萎縮效應，在分解代謝狀態下幫助保留肌肉量。

label: NuRD complex
description: CHD4 is the essential ATPase remodeling subunit of NuRD. Containment records the complex composition.
description_zh_TW: CHD4 是 NuRD 必要的 ATPase 重塑次單元。包含記錄複合體組成。

label: ASK1
description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is the canonical high-affinity redox-dependent inhibitor of the stress kinase ASK1. In its reduced state Trx1 binds ASK1's N-terminal thioredoxin-binding domain and keeps the kinase inactive, targeting it for degradation; on oxidative stress Trx1 is oxidized and dissociates, de-repressing ASK1 to drive JNK/p38 MAPK apoptosis and senescence signaling.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 是壓力激酶 ASK1 的典型高親和力、依賴氧化還原狀態的抑制劑。在還原態下，Trx1 結合 ASK1 的 N 端硫氧還蛋白結合域並使激酶保持不活化，並使其被降解；在氧化壓力下，Trx1 被氧化並解離，解除對 ASK1 的抑制，驅動 JNK/p38 MAPK 的細胞凋亡與衰老訊息傳遞。

label: Gasdermin D
description: Disulfiram covalently modifies Gasdermin D to block its pore-forming activity, suppressing pyroptotic lysis and IL-1β release downstream of inflammasome activation.
description_zh_TW: Disulfiram 共價修飾 Gasdermin D 以阻斷其成孔活性，抑制 inflammasome 活化下游的 pyroptosis 裂解與 IL-1β 釋放。

label: Akkermansia
description: With only 1-5% systemic bioavailability, berberine reaches high intraluminal concentrations that reshape the microbiome — enriching Akkermansia muciniphila, Bifidobacterium, and SCFA-producing Lactobacillus — an effect linked to metabolic improvement in the PREMOTE trial independently of systemic absorption.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 全身生體可用率僅 1–5%，腸腔濃度高因而重塑菌相——增加 Akkermansia muciniphila、 Bifidobacterium 與產 SCFA 的 Lactobacillus；PREMOTE 試驗顯示此效應與代謝改善相關，且獨立於全身吸收。

label: Major histocompatibility complex class I
description: Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Macular Degeneration
description: Age is the dominant risk factor for macular degenerative blindness.
description_zh_TW: 年齡是黃斑部退化失明的主要危險因子。

label: Febuxostat
description: Febuxostat blocks oxidized and reduced xanthine oxidase forms, suppressing urate production more completely than allopurinol. Blockade lowers the gout mediator.
description_zh_TW: Febuxostat 阻斷氧化與還原態 xanthine oxidase，比 allopurinol 更徹底抑制尿酸鹽生成。阻斷降低痛風介體。

label: Bid
description: CK1 phosphorylates Bid at Thr58/Ser61/64, blocking caspase-8 cleavage.
description_zh_TW: CK1 在 Thr58/Ser61/64 磷酸化 Bid，阻斷 caspase-8 切割。

label: Cross-linking
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Alagebrium is an AGE breaker developed to destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links, following the first AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide, which was unstable in vitro and clinically unsuccessful. Alagebrium could reverse AGE accumulation in vivo, and AGE breakers of this class restored large artery properties in experimental diabetes. However, clinical studies on these compounds were terminated, and none of the known AGE breakers are currently in clinical use. AGE breakers represent a complementary therapeutic strategy to AGE inhibitors, targeting existing cross-links rather than preventing new AGE formation.
description_zh_TW: Alagebrium 是一種 AGE breaker，開發用於 destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links，繼首個 AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide 之後，後者在體外 unstable 且 clinically unsuccessful。Alagebrium 能在體內 reverse AGE accumulation，且此類 AGE breakers 在 experimental diabetes 中 restored large artery properties。然而，針對這些 compounds 的 clinical studies 已 terminated，且目前已知的所有 AGE breakers 均無 clinical use。AGE breakers 代表了與 AGE inhibitors 互補的 therapeutic strategy，針對 existing cross-links 而非 preventing new AGE formation。

label: Polyphenols
description: At low doses polyphenols stimulate endogenous antioxidant defenses, but at high concentrations such as concentrated supplements they act as potent pro-oxidants causing oxidative damage. Examples include liver damage from high-dose green tea catechins, illustrating the biphasic benefit-to-harm transition.
description_zh_TW: 低劑量 Polyphenols 可刺激內源性抗氧化防禦，但在高濃度（如濃縮補充劑）下則成為強效促氧化劑並造成氧化損傷。例如高劑量綠茶兒茶素可能導致肝損傷，說明了從有益到有害的雙相轉換。

label: Sulforaphane
description: Isothiocyanate sulforaphane inhibits histone deacetylases, reactivating silenced genes.
description_zh_TW: 異硫氰酸酯 sulforaphane 抑制組蛋白去乙醯化酶，重新活化沉默基因。

label: 4-Hydroxynonenal
description: Submicromolar 4-hydroxynonenal alkylates Keap1, inducing antioxidant response element genes including GPX2, NQO1 and heme oxygenase-1. Low-dose aldehyde triggers the hormetic arm.
description_zh_TW: 亞微莫耳 4-hydroxynonenal 烷基化 Keap1，誘導包括 GPX2、NQO1 與血紅素加氧酶-1 的抗氧化反應元件基因。低劑量醛觸發毒物興奮臂。

label: Embryonic Stem Cells
description: Embryonic stem cells are assayed via teratoma formation as gold-standard trilineage proof.
description_zh_TW: 胚胎幹細胞經由畸胎瘤形成測定，作為三胚層黃金標準證據。

label: CDC20
description: APC/C bound to CDC20 drives the metaphase-to-anaphase transition with defined specificity.
description_zh_TW: 與 CDC20 結合的 APC/C 以既定特異性驅動中期到後期轉換。

label: ABCA1
description: ABCA1 prevents atherosclerosis by driving cholesterol efflux from macrophages, which limits foam-cell formation and arterial lipid accumulation. Loss of this reverse-transport step tips the vessel wall toward retention of cholesterol. The directionality is efflux to reduced plaque initiation. A caveat is that ABCA1 is one of several anti-atherogenic mechanisms (e.g., ABCG1, SR-BI), so its deficiency increases but does not solely determine risk. ABCA1 expression is induced by LXR agonists, which are being explored as therapies that harness reverse cholesterol transport to retard plaque formation.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 透過驅動 cholesterol 從巨噬細胞流出來阻止 atherosclerosis，從而限制泡沫細胞的形成和動脈脂質累積。失去這個反向運輸步驟會使血管壁傾向於保留 cholesterol。方向性是流出以減少斑塊的形成。需要注意的是，ABCA1 是多種抗動脈粥狀硬化機制（例如 ABCG1、SR-BI）之一，因此其缺陷會增加，但並不僅僅決定風險。 ABCA1 表達由 LXR 激動劑誘導，目前正在探索如何利用 reverse cholesterol transport 來延緩斑塊形成的療法。

label: UCP1
description: UCP1 mediates inducible proton leak across the inner membrane in brown adipose tissue. Inducible uncoupling separates heat production from ATP demand.
description_zh_TW: UCP1 在棕色脂肪組織介導可誘發的質子漏。可誘發去偶聯將產熱與 ATP 需求分離。

label: TNFR1
description: Despite the in-vitro prominence of TNFR1 in necroptosis induction, TNFR1-deficient or TNFR1/2-double-deficient mice are not protected in renal ischemia-reperfusion injury — evidence that additional inducers matter in vivo.
description_zh_TW: 儘管 TNFR1 在體外 necroptosis 誘導中地位顯著，TNFR1 缺失或 TNFR1/2 雙缺失小鼠在腎缺血–再灌注損傷中並未受到保護——證明體內尚有其他誘導物扮演角色。

label: Interferon
description: ZBP1 (DAI) is an interferon-stimulated gene: type I/II IFN signaling induces ZBP1 expression, priming the ZBP1-RIPK3 necrosome for antiviral necroptosis (MURI-viable sensors; Malireddi et al.; Kuriakose et al., Cell Host Microbe 2016).
description_zh_TW: ZBP1（DAI）為干擾素刺激基因：第一/二型 IFN 訊號誘導 ZBP1 表現，啟動 ZBP1-RIPK3 necrosome 以執行抗病毒 necroptosis（Kuriakose et al., Cell Host Microbe 2016）。

label: GSK3β
description: FRAT2 binds GSK3β competing with Axin to disrupt the destruction complex. Inhibition releases beta-catenin signaling.
description_zh_TW: FRAT2 結合 GSK3β 與 Axin 競爭以破壞降解複合體。抑制釋放 beta-catenin 訊號。

label: NAD+ Salvage Pathway
description: Re-synthesizing NAD+ by the salvage pathway after PARP1 turnover is expensive: the complete cycle costs four high-energy phosphates per ADP-ribose unit. With NAD(H) around 0.3 mM versus ATP around 3-4 mM, full NAD+ turnover could itself contribute substantially to ATP depletion during parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: PARP1 周轉後經救援路徑重新合成 NAD+ 成本高昂：完整循環每單位 ADP-ribose 耗費四個高能磷酸鍵。NAD(H) 約 0.3 mM、ATP 約 3-4 mM，故 NAD+ 完全周轉本身即可顯著促成 parthanatos 中的 ATP 耗竭（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Argyria
description: Oxidized silver reduced in vivo to elemental deposits produces permanent pigmentation of argyria. Deposition executes the discoloration phenotype.
description_zh_TW: 氧化的銀在體內還原為元素沉積，產生 argyria 的永久性色素沉著。沉積執行變色表型。

label: Cardiovascular Disease
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Atherosclerosis is the underlying cause of most cardiovascular disease. Contribution records the etiologic direction.
description_zh_TW: 動脈粥狀硬化是多數心血管疾病的根本原因。貢獻記錄病因方向。

label: Cyanidin-3-glucoside
description: Cyanidin-3-glucoside is an anthocyanin member of the flavonoid class. Classification places the pigment glycoside.
description_zh_TW: Cyanidin-3-glucoside 是類黃酮類別的花青素成員。歸類定位此色素糖苷。

label: PARK7
description: PARK7 mutations (L166P, M26I) cause early-onset autosomal recessive Parkinson's disease. DJ-1-deficient neurons show fragmented mitochondria, Complex I impairment, and accelerated α-synuclein aggregation.
description_zh_TW: PARK7 突變（L166P、M26I）造成早發性體染色體隱性遺傳帕金森氏症。DJ-1 缺失的神經元呈現粒線體碎片化、Complex I 功能受損與 α-synuclein 聚集加速。

label: Phytochemicals
description: Plant polyphenols such as resveratrol activate the sirtuin longevity network.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇等植物多酚活化 sirtuin 長壽網絡。

label: Chemotherapy
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Docetaxel is a taxane chemotherapy agent.
description_zh_TW: docetaxel 是紫杉烷化療藥物。

label: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus
source_file: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus.md
description: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: GCN5
description: SIRT6 deacetylates the acetyltransferase GCN5, one of its direct non-histone substrates, altering the chromatin acetylation balance at metabolic and growth promoters and complementing SIRT6's histone deacetylation at H3K9/H3K56. In hepatocytes, SIRT6 also engages GCN5 to acetylate and inhibit PGC-1alpha and thereby restrain gluconeogenesis, so the same enzyme-substrate pair can be tuned in different directions depending on cellular context.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6去乙醯化乙醯轉移酶GCN5，這是其直接的非組蛋白底物之一，改變了代謝和生長啟動子上的染色質乙醯化平衡，並補充了SIRT6在H3K9/H3K56上的組蛋白去乙醯化。在肝細胞中，SIRT6也與GCN5相互作用以乙醯化並抑制PGC-1alpha，從而抑制糖質新生，因此相同的酶-底物對可以根據細胞環境以不同方向調節。

label: Gut Microbiome
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: The Gut Microbiome is the obligate producer of Urolithin A: colonic bacteria convert dietary ellagitannin-derived Ellagic Acid through urolithin M6/C to terminal Urolithin A, principally via Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens and Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens with Enterocloster contributions; because the converter consortium is absent in metabotype 0 individuals, direct Urolithin A supplementation bypasses microbiome dependency.
description_zh_TW: Gut Microbiome 是 Urolithin A 的必要生產者：結腸菌將飲食 ellagitannin 來源的 Ellagic Acid 經 urolithin M6/C 轉為終端 Urolithin A，主要經 Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 與 Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens，另有 Enterocloster 參與；因 metabotype 0 個體缺乏轉換菌叢，直接補充 Urolithin A 可繞過菌相依賴。

label: FOXO3a
description: SIRT1 deacetylates FOXO3a, driving MnSOD/catalase and BNIP3 selective-mitophagy programs (Kume 2010). This single edge consolidates the FOXO/FOXO3a proposals from two task files.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 FOXO3a，驅動 MnSOD/catalase 與 BNIP3 選擇性 mitophagy 程序（Kume 2010）。此單一邊合併兩個任務檔案的 FOXO/FOXO3a 提案。

label: p21 CIP1
description: p21CIP1 induction in recipient cells enforces CDK2 blockade during paracrine senescence; knockdown partially rescues arrest. Together with p15INK4b it provides the redundant INK4/CIP-KIP lock, mirroring the existing CDKN2B effector triple.
description_zh_TW: 受體細胞中 p21CIP1 誘發在旁分泌衰老期間執行 CDK2 封鎖；敲低部分拯救停滯。與 p15INK4b 一起提供冗餘的 INK4/CIP-KIP 鎖定，呼應既有的 CDKN2B 效應 triple。

label: Senomorphic Therapy
description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is suppressed by Senomorphic Therapy. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senomorphics suppress the SASP without killing senescent cells, dampening chronic inflammation and paracrine tumor promotion. The directionality runs from Senomorphic Therapy toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senomorphic Therapy is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 被 Senomorphic Therapy 抑制。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。它可以抑制衰老細胞而不殺死衰老細胞，從而抑制慢性發炎和旁分泌腫瘤的發生。方向性從 Senomorphic Therapy 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senomorphic Therapy 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: MFN2
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: RIPK3 phosphorylates mitofusin-2 (MFN2), promoting endoplasmic-reticulum-mitochondria tethering and mitochondrial Ca2+ overload that drives necroptotic death (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: RIPK3 磷酸化 mitofusin-2（MFN2），促進內質網-粒線體繫連與粒線體 Ca2+ 超載，進而驅動 necroptotic 死亡（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Adrenochrome Pathway
description: RAGE signaling intersects with the adrenochrome pathway through multiple mechanisms: adrenochrome-induced oxidative stress promotes AGE formation via glycolysis-derived dicarbonyls, activating the AGE-RAGE inflammatory axis. RAGE activation upregulates NF-kB targets including COX-2 and iNOS, amplifying catecholamine oxidation. RAGE-mediated inhibition of autophagy may also impair clearance of aminochrome-damaged mitochondria.
description_zh_TW: RAGE 訊號透過多種機制與 adrenochrome pathway 相交：adrenochrome 誘導的氧化壓力經由糖酵解衍生的 dicarbonyls 促進 AGE 形成，啟動 AGE-RAGE 發炎軸。RAGE 活化上調包括 COX-2 與 iNOS 在內的 NF-kB 標靶，放大兒茶酚胺氧化。RAGE 介導的 autophagy 抑制也可能損害受 aminochrome 損傷粒線體的清除。

label: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine
description: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine is the most abundant oxidative lesion in DNA, with roughly 10^3 to 10^6 lesions per cell per day arising from normal metabolism and extrinsic insults. Its prevalence reflects both high formation rate and efficient but imperfect repair. The directionality is oxidation of guanine to the dominant adduct. A caveat is that the steady-state level integrates formation and repair, so it is an indirect rather than instantaneous measure of ROS flux. The steady-state 8-oxodG level is influenced by both the rate of oxidation and the efficiency of OGG1-mediated repair, so it reflects the balance between insult and defense.
description_zh_TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 是 DNA 中最豐富的氧化損傷，每個細胞每天約有 10^3 至 10^6 個損傷，這些損傷是由正常代謝和外在損傷引起的。它的流行反映了高形成率和有效但不完善的修復。方向性是鳥嘌呤氧化成主要加合物。需要注意的是，穩態水平整合了形成和修復，因此它是 ROS 通量的間接而非瞬時測量。穩態8-oxodG水平受到氧化速率和OGG1介導的修復效率的影響，因此它反映了損傷和防禦之間的平衡。

label: Bladder Cancer
description: Bladder Cancer is treated with BCG. BCG (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin) is a live attenuated mycobacterium delivered as intravesical immunotherapy for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, reducing recurrence and progression; it activates immune-mediated cytotoxicity against urothelial tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: 膀胱癌（Bladder Cancer）以 BCG 治療。BCG（卡介苗）是一種活的減毒分枝桿菌，以膀胱內灌注免疫療法用於非肌肉侵犯性膀胱癌，可降低復發與進展；它會啟動針對尿路上皮腫瘤細胞的免疫介導細胞毒性。

label: N-Myc
description: N-Myc is a MYC-family oncogenic transcription factor.
description_zh_TW: N-Myc 是 MYC 家族致癌轉錄因子。

label: Glutaredoxin
description: Glutaredoxins use electrons from reduced glutathione (GSH) instead of thioredoxin reductase, passing them through a dithiol or monothiol mechanism to reduce protein disulfides and reverse protein S-glutathionylation. This makes glutaredoxin the GSH-coupled half of the cellular disulfide-reducing system.
description_zh_TW: Glutaredoxin 使用來自還原態麩胱甘肽（GSH）的電子而非硫氧還蛋白還原酶，透過雙硫醇或單硫醇機制還原蛋白質雙硫鍵並逆轉蛋白質的 S-麩胱甘肽化。這使 Glutaredoxin 成為細胞雙硫還原系統中與 GSH 偶聯的一半。

label: Immune Checkpoint
description: Immune Checkpoint is co-opted by Cancer. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Immune Checkpoint, so Cancer is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 被 Cancer 增選。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Immune Checkpoint，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Glioblastoma
description: Ivermectin carries the typed edge 'inhibits → Glioblastoma' (conf 0.8) together with lower-confidence inhibitory edges to Cholangiocarcinoma (0.7) and Renal Cell Carcinoma (0.7); all are multiplicity-1 claims on enormous Adamic–Adar headroom (Ivermectin→Cancer 9.68) — precise intervention statements and curation blind spots at once.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 帶「inhibits → Glioblastoma」類型邊（conf 0.8），另有對 Cholangiocarcinoma（0.7）與 Renal Cell Carcinoma（0.7）的低信度抑制邊；這些都是巨大 Adamic–Adar 空間（Ivermectin→Cancer 9.68）上的 multiplicity-1 主張——既是精準介入陳述也是策展盲點。

label: Genomic Instability
description: Stalled and collapsed forks are a major source of genomic instability. Fork failure converts transient stress into heritable lesions.
description_zh_TW: 停滯與崩塌的複製叉是基因組不穩定的主要來源。複製叉失敗將短暫壓力轉化為可遺傳損傷。

label: TRPM2
source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md
description: Free ADP-ribose binds the NUDT9-homology domain of the Ca2+-permeable channel TRPM2 to open it. In parthanatos this ADP-ribose-dependent gating requires PARG activity and links PAR turnover to Ca2+ influx (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: 游離 ADP-ribose 結合鈣通透通道 TRPM2 的 NUDT9 同源結構域使其開啟。在 parthanatos 中此依賴 ADP-ribose 的開啟需要 PARG 活性，將 PAR 周轉連結至 Ca2+ 內流（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: L-DOPA
description: Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase and L-DOPA are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase and L-DOPA may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 和 L-DOPA 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 和 L-DOPA 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: NRH
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NRH, the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside, is bioavailable in mice and increases NAD+ in both cultured cells (5-10-fold above the baseline) and in mice, in a more potent and faster manner than NR, and it is detectable in circulation after oral intake or intraperitoneal injection. A NMRK-independent pathway for the NRH-induced NAD+ increase has been demonstrated, consistent with the recent discovery of a novel biosynthetic route of NAD+ from NRH through the NMNH intermediate, where adenosine kinase (ADK) acts as an NRH kinase. The presence of endogenous NRH in the liver of mouse models was confirmed, establishing NRH as a valid natural precursor of NAD+.
description_zh_TW: NRH（nicotinamide riboside 的還原型）在小鼠中具有生物可用率，並以比 NR 更強效且更快速的方式提升培養細胞（高於基線 5-10 倍）與小鼠中的 NAD+，且在口服攝取或腹腔注射後可在循環中偵測到。NRH 誘發的 NAD+ 增加之 NMRK 非依賴性路徑已被證實，這與近期發現的從 NRH 經由 NMNH 中間產物生成 NAD+ 的新穎生物合成路徑一致，其中 adenosine kinase（ADK，腺苷激酶）作為 NRH 激酶。小鼠模型肝臟中內源性 NRH 的存在已獲確認，確立了 NRH 作為 NAD+ 的有效天然前驅物。

label: Axonal Degeneration
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: SARM1 is the NAD+-consuming executor of programmed axonal destruction downstream of injury and stress. Its activation depletes axonal NAD+ and drives fragmentation.
description_zh_TW: SARM1 是損傷與壓力下游程序性軸突破壞的 NAD+ 消耗執行者。其活化耗竭軸突 NAD+ 並驅動片段化。

label: H3K9me3
description: H3K9me3 globally decreases with aging, reflecting the progressive loss of constitutive heterochromatin. Reduced H3K9me3 is observed in aging flies, in progeria patient fibroblasts, and in aged mouse and human tissues, and it is accompanied by reduced HP1 and heterochromatin decompaction. This decline in the repressive mark permits derepression of transposable elements and aberrant gene expression, contributing to genomic instability and inflammation during aging. Restoring H3K9me3 levels is investigated as a means to stabilize the aging genome.
description_zh_TW: H3K9me3 隨著年齡的增長而整體下降，反映了組成型異染色質的逐漸喪失。在衰老果蠅、早衰症患者成纖維細胞以及衰老小鼠和人體組織中觀察到 H3K9me3 減少，並且伴隨著 HP1 減少和異染色質解壓縮。抑制標記的下降允許轉座元件和異常 gene expression 的去抑制，從而導致老化過程中基因組不穩定和發炎。研究恢復 H3K9me3 水平作為穩定老化基因組的一種方法。

label: Survivin
description: USP9X deubiquitination stabilizes Survivin alongside Mcl-1.
description_zh_TW: USP9X 去泛素化與 Mcl-1 並列穩定 Survivin。

label: Reprogramming
description: Direct lineage reprogramming converts somatic cells into induced neural stem cells.
description_zh_TW: 直接譜系重編程將體細胞轉化為誘導神經幹細胞。

label: Fructosamine
description: Amadori products of glucose-lysine binding are early reversible fructosamine intermediates. Binding yields the first stable adduct.
description_zh_TW: 葡萄糖-離胺酸結合的 Amadori 產物是早期可逆的 fructosamine 中間體。結合產生首個穩定加合物。

label: VEGF
description: The Neuropilin-1 b1/b2 domain binds VEGF165 as co-receptor.
description_zh_TW: Neuropilin-1 b1/b2 結構域結合 VEGF165 作為共受體。

label: ATF4
description: The ISR effector ATF4 directly transactivates FGF21 transcription. Induction is the stress-to-hormone coupling.
description_zh_TW: ISR 效應器 ATF4 直接轉活化 FGF21 轉錄。誘發是壓力到激素的耦合。

label: Liver
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Once absorbed into the circulation, urolithin A undergoes further metabolism through multiple metabolic pathways, with the liver playing a central role. Metabolic enzymes present in the liver convert urolithin A into its mercaptan and sulfate forms. Hepatic enzyme inducers such as rifampicin and carbamazepine can increase the activity of these metabolic enzymes, accelerating urolithin A metabolism and reducing its half-life in the body, whereas enzyme inhibitors such as clarithromycin slow its metabolism and clearance and can lead to accumulation of urolithin A.
description_zh_TW: 一旦吸收進入循環系統，urolithin A 會經由多條代謝途徑進一步代謝，其中肝臟扮演核心角色。肝臟中的代謝酶將 urolithin A 轉化為其硫醇（mercaptan）與硫酸鹽（sulfate）形式。肝臟酶誘導劑如 rifampicin 與 carbamazepine 可提升這些代謝酶的活性，加速 urolithin A 的代謝並縮短其在體內的半衰期；而酶抑制劑如 clarithromycin 則減緩其代謝與清除，可能導致 urolithin A 蓄積。

label: Blood-Brain Barrier
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol's small, aromatic, lipophilic structure allows it to cross the blood-brain barrier, enabling its CNS actions. This property underpins its neuroprotective, anxiolytic, and sleep-promoting effects and allows it to inhibit CNS tumor growth.
description_zh_TW: Honokiol 的小型芳香親脂結構使其能穿越血腦屏障，實現其中樞神經系統作用。此特性支撐其神經保護、抗焦慮和促進睡眠的作用，並使其能抑制中樞神經系統腫瘤生長。

label: Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces fat accumulation in the liver through a mechanism that involves induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt), which is elicited by NAD+ repletion and reverses fatty liver disease in mice. Through this pathway, as well as through activation of SIRT1 and factors associated with cholesterol homeostasis, NR can reduce cholesterol levels and improve liver health. In regenerating liver, NR reduces lipid accumulation, promotes hepatocyte replication, and increases hepatic ATP content, leading to faster recovery of liver weight.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）透過涉及誘導粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的機制減少肝臟中的脂肪堆積，此反應由 NAD+ 補充所引發，並在小鼠中逆轉脂肪肝疾病。透過此路徑，以及透過活化 SIRT1 與膽固醇恆定相關的因子，NR 能降低膽固醇水平並改善肝臟健康。在再生肝臟中，NR 減少脂質堆積、促進肝細胞複製，並增加肝臟 ATP 含量，導致肝臟重量更快恢復。

label: DNA Replication Stress
description: Stalled and collapsed forks are a major source of genomic instability. Fork failure converts transient stress into heritable lesions.
description_zh_TW: 停滯與崩塌的複製叉是基因組不穩定的主要來源。複製叉失敗將短暫壓力轉化為可遺傳損傷。

label: CDK4/6
description: Cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6 (CDK4/6), central drivers of G1 cell-cycle progression, phosphorylate TFEB at serine 142 and promote its nuclear export through a CRM1-dependent mechanism. This action sequesters TFEB in the cytoplasm during phases of active proliferation, when degradative programs are downregulated. Conversely, pharmacological CDK4/6 inhibition permits TFEB nuclear retention and enhances lysosome biogenesis and autophagy. The CDK4/6-TFEB link couples cell-cycle state to the metabolic and degradative status of the cell.
description_zh_TW: 細胞週期蛋白依賴型激酶 4 和 6（CDK4/6）是 G1 細胞週期進展的核心驅動者，於 serine 142 磷酸化 TFEB，並透過 CRM1 依賴機制促進其核輸出。此作用在降解程序下調的主動增殖階段，將 TFEB 隔離於細胞質中。相反地，藥理 CDK4/6 抑制允許 TFEB 核保留並增強溶酶體生物發生和自噬。CDK4/6-TFEB 連結將細胞週期狀態耦合到細胞的代謝和降解狀態。

label: MPTP
description: Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: DNA
description: Cytoplasmic AIF binds macrophage migration inhibitory factor (MIF), which has nuclease activity, and the pair co-translocates to the nucleus to execute large-scale DNA fragmentation; a selective MIF-nuclease inhibitor protects in a mouse model of parkinsonism. An AIF-cyclophilin A-histone H2AX complex with intrinsic AIF nuclease activity is the alternative model (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: 胞質 AIF 結合具核酸酶活性的 MIF，兩者共同轉位至細胞核執行大規模 DNA 斷裂；選擇性 MIF 核酸酶抑制劑在帕金森氏症小鼠模型中具保護作用。具內在 AIF 核酸酶活性的 AIF-cyclophilin A-histone H2AX 複合體為替代模型（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: miR-217
description: miR-217 is a senescence-associated microRNA whose canonical validated target is SIRT1. It binds the SIRT1 3'-UTR and suppresses translation, reducing NAD+-dependent deacetylase activity (Menghini et al., Circulation 2009; PMID 19188522).
description_zh_TW: miR-217 是一種與衰老相關的微 RNA，其經實驗驗證的經典靶標是 SIRT1。它結合 SIRT1 的 3'-UTR 並抑制轉譯，降低 NAD+ 依賴的去乙醯化酶活性（Menghini 等人，Circulation 2009；PMID 19188522）。

label: Mitoxantrone
description: Mitoxantrone inhibits topoisomerase II as its primary target, mirroring the FL118-Topo-I pattern. Target defines the drug.
description_zh_TW: Mitoxantrone 以拓樸異構酶 II 為主要標靶，呼應 FL118-Topo-I 模式。標靶定義藥物。

label: single nucleotide variation
description: A SNP is a single nucleotide variation reaching one percent population frequency.
description_zh_TW: SNP 是達百分之一族群頻率的單核苷酸變異。

label: Acetyl-CoA
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate donor for protein acetylation, including histone acetylation, a modification associated with chromatin relaxation and increased accessibility to transcriptional machinery. In senescent cells, acetyl-CoA availability determines H3K27ac deposition at SASP gene loci: enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression while depleting it limits the programme. Acetate supplementation, converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, increases nuclear acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory genes IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators, linking mitochondrial metabolism to the epigenetic regulation of inflammatory genes.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA）是蛋白質乙醯化（包括組蛋白乙醯化）的必然供體；此修飾與染色質鬆弛及轉錄機制可及性增加有關。在衰老細胞中，乙醯輔酶A的可用性決定了 SASP 基因座位的 H3K27ac 沉積：提高乙醯輔酶A濃度可促進 SASP 基因表現，而耗竭乙醯輔酶A則會限制此程序。補充乙酸（在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A）可增加細胞核乙醯化，並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子，將粒線體代謝與發炎基因的表觀遺傳調控連結起來。

label: HLA Haplobank
description: A haplobank curates HLA-homozygous induced pluripotent stem cell master lines.
description_zh_TW: 單倍庫策展 HLA 純合誘導多能幹細胞主系。

label: SAHF
description: SADS is distinct from SAHF in both substrate and direction: SADS decompacts constitutive pericentromeric heterochromatin, whereas SAHF compact facultative heterochromatin at E2F loci. The two processes can coexist in the same senescent nucleus, reflecting parallel, opposite chromatin rearrangements with different regulators and functional consequences. Recognizing the distinction is important because SADS connects to LINE-1 activation and innate immune signaling, while SAHF reinforce proliferative arrest. Together they illustrate the complexity of senescent chromatin remodeling.
description_zh_TW: SADS 在受質與方向上皆不同於 SAHF：SADS 去緻密化組成性著絲粒周異染色質，而 SAHF 在 E2F 基因座緻密化兼性異染色質。兩過程可在同一衰老細胞核共存，反映具不同調節者與功能後果的平行、相反染色質重排。辨識此區別很重要，因 SADS 連結到 LINE-1 活化與先天免疫訊號，而 SAHF 強化增殖停滯。它們共同說明衰老染色質重塑的複雜性。

label: SAM
description: SAM is the universal methyl donor for DNMT1-mediated 5mC synthesis. Classification defines its metabolic role.
description_zh_TW: SAM 是 DNMT1 介導 5mC 合成的通用甲基供體。歸類定義其代謝角色。

label: TGF-beta1
description: Niche-derived TGF-beta1 is listed as a quiescence-inducing soluble factor.
description_zh_TW: 微環境衍生的 TGF-beta1 列為靜止誘導可溶因子。

label: Neurodegeneration
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Biallelic ADPRHL2 loss causes CONDSIAS, a stress-induced childhood-onset neurodegeneration with ataxia and seizures, linking persistent serine-MARylation and PAR accumulation to neuronal death. PARP inhibition rescues PAR buildup and death in ARH3-deficient cells.
description_zh_TW: ADPRHL2 雙等位基因缺失導致 CONDSIAS，即壓力誘發的兒童期發病神經退化，伴隨共濟失調與癲癇，將持續性 serine-MAR 化與 PAR 堆積連結至神經元死亡。PARP 抑制可挽救 ARH3 缺陷細胞的 PAR 堆積與死亡。

label: CDK Inhibitor
description: Quiescence-inducing signals act by decreasing Cyclin/CDK activity or raising CDK inhibitor levels; p21/p27/p57 run high in quiescence.
description_zh_TW: 靜止誘導訊號經由降低 Cyclin/CDK 活性或提高 CDK 抑制因子水平作用；p21/p27/p57 在靜止高表現。

label: Immune Evasion
description: Immune evasion is a hallmark of cancer whereby cells subvert immune surveillance through checkpoint molecules and an immunosuppressive milieu. The tumor microenvironment is a constellation of elements that can exclude or tolerize cytotoxic lymphocytes, reinforcing evasion.
description_zh_TW: 免疫逃逸是癌症的特徵，細胞透過檢查點分子與免疫抑制環境規避免疫監視。腫瘤微環境是能排除或耐受化細胞毒性淋巴球的元素集合，強化逃逸。

label: SAMD
description: PINK1-dependent mitophagy clears damaged mitochondria and limits senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction. Loss of mitophagy drives SAMD with mtDNA leakage and ROS in senescence and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis models.
description_zh_TW: PINK1 依賴的 mitophagy 清除受損粒線體並限制衰老相關粒線體功能障礙。Mitophagy 缺失在衰老與特發性肺纖維化模型中驅動伴隨 mtDNA 滲漏與 ROS 的 SAMD。

label: NLRP3
description: RIPK3 directly activates inflammasome formation via caspase-8-mediated and NLRP3-mediated arms leading to caspase-1/11 cleavage of IL-1beta; whether MLKL is obligatory is contested since MLKL ablation preserves NLRP3 activation and cytokine production in some models (Dhuriya & Sharma 2018).
description_zh_TW: RIPK3 经 caspase-8 介导与 NLRP3 介导双臂直接激活炎症小体，导致 caspase-1/11 切割 IL-1beta；MLKL 是否必需存争议，因部分模型中 MLKL 缺失仍保留 NLRP3 活化与细胞因子产生。

label: Incoherent Bivalent Motif
description: The saturated enzymatic regime describes an interaction operating near its maximal velocity where the reaction rate is insensitive to substrate changes. When the backward link of an incoherent bivalent motif is deeply saturated, the fraction of parameter sets producing hormesis rises sharply.
description_zh_TW: 飽和酶學機制描述接近最大速度運作、反應速率對受質變化不敏感的交互作用。當不一致雙價模體的逆向連結深度飽和時，產生毒物興奮的參數組比例急遽上升。

label: Dopachrome tautomerase
description: Dopachrome tautomerase (DDT) is the historical enzyme name for Tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP-2), also known as DCT. Both names refer to the same melanosomal enzyme. It is a type I membrane glycoprotein related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1.
description_zh_TW: Dopachrome tautomerase（DDT）是 Tyrosinase-related protein-2（TRP-2，也稱為 DCT）的歷史性酶名稱。兩個名稱指的是同一種 melanosomal 酶。它是一種與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 相關的 I 型膜醣蛋白。

label: Alpha-synuclein
description: Excluded-volume effects raise association constants, driving alpha-synuclein oligomerization in crowded neuronal compartments. Crowding is a biophysical catalyst of synuclein aggregation.
description_zh_TW: 排除體積效應提高結合常數，在擁擠的神經元區室驅動 alpha-synuclein 寡聚化。擁擠是 synuclein 聚集的生物物理催化劑。

label: Sox2
description: Forced Sox2 expression is often necessary and sometimes sufficient for conversion to induced neural stem cells.
description_zh_TW: 強制 Sox2 表現對轉化為誘導神經幹細胞常必要、有時充分。

label: Bcl-2 family
description: A1-Bfl-1 is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member.
description_zh_TW: A1-Bfl-1 是抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族成員。

label: Contact Inhibition
description: Mechanical density cues act through Hippo to sequester YAP and TAZ.
description_zh_TW: 機械密度線索經 Hippo 隔離 YAP 與 TAZ。

label: Saccharomyces cerevisiae
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Budding yeast is a premier eukaryotic model organism.
description_zh_TW: 芽殖酵母是首屈一指的真核模式生物。

label: Senolytic
description: Senolytics selectively induce apoptosis in senescent cells by disabling SCAPs, clearing them from tissues while sparing healthy cells. This singular-subject form parallels the existing plural Senolytics clearance triple for graph canonicalization.
description_zh_TW: Senolytics 透過失能 SCAPs 選擇性誘發衰老細胞凋亡，將其從組織清除並保留健康細胞。此單數主詞形式與既有的複數 Senolytics 清除 triple 平行，以利圖譜正規化。

label: Diabetic nephropathy
description: SIRT1 is protective in diabetic kidney disease by deacetylating p53 and activating FoxO3a and Nrf2, and resveratrol promotes resistance to diabetic renal fibrosis via Nrf2. These antioxidant and anti-apoptotic actions defend podocytes and the renal tubulointerstitium against hyperglycemic damage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在糖尿病腎臟疾病中具保護性，透過去乙醯化 p53 並活化 FoxO3a 與 Nrf2，且 resveratrol 透過 Nrf2 促進對糖尿病腎纖維化的抗性。這些抗氧化與抗凋亡作用防禦足細胞與腎小管間質免於高血糖損傷。

label: Protein Citrullination
description: Protein citrullination is definitionally arginine deimination to citrulline residues. Substrate identity anchors the modification.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白瓜氨酸化定義上即精胺酸脫亞胺為瓜氨酸殘基。底物身份錨定修飾。

label: Integrin
description: Integrins are the primary receptors transducing laminin signals. Binding is the signal-entry pairing.
description_zh_TW: Integrin 是傳導 laminin 訊號的主要受體。結合是訊號進入配對。

label: Genistein
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Genistein is an isoflavone flavonoid reported to possess anti-glycation properties. Together with other flavonoids such as kaempferol, quercitrin, and quercetin, genistein inhibits the glycation process in vitro. The anti-glycation activities of these polyphenols are similar to or even stronger than aminoguanidine, and they act in part through trapping reactive carbonyl species and antioxidant capacity. Herbal products and dietary plants containing these flavonoids are therefore considered promising, relatively safe agents for preventing glycation and AGE accumulation during aging.
description_zh_TW: Genistein 是一種異黃酮類黃酮，據報導具有抗糖化特性。與其他黃酮類如 kaempferol、quercitrin 與 quercetin 一起，Genistein 在體外抑制糖化過程。這些多酚的抗糖化活性與 aminoguanidine 相似甚至更強，且部分透過捕捉活性羰基物種與抗氧化能力來作用。因此，含有這些黃酮類的草藥產品與食用植物被視為在老化過程中預防糖化與 AGE 堆積的具潛力且相對安全的物質。

label: XIST
source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic changes during aging and their reprogramming potential.md
description: XIST is a long non-coding RNA coating the inactive X chromosome.
description_zh_TW: XIST 是包被不活化 X 染色體的長非編碼 RNA。

label: PPAR-alpha
description: PPAR-alpha is the master regulator of lipid beta-oxidation metabolism. Regulation is the lipid-program control.
description_zh_TW: PPAR-alpha 是脂質 β 氧化代謝的主調控者。調節是脂質程序控制。

label: Ghrelin
description: The metabolic hormone ghrelin, a major regulator of food intake, also exerts immunomodulatory and thymopoietic effects. Ghrelin binds immune cell subsets via ghrelin-specific receptors and localizes to lipid rafts of activated T cells. Dixit et al. reported that ghrelin reduces age-associated inflammatory responses in mice, and in aged thymus both ghrelin and growth hormone levels decrease in correlation with functional thymic involution and elevated inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 代謝激素ghrelin（飢餓素）是食物攝取的主要調節者，也具有免疫調節與胸腺生成（thymopoietic）效應。Ghrelin透過ghrelin特異性受體與免疫細胞亞群結合，並定位於活化T細胞的脂筏。Dixit等人報告ghrelin可減少小鼠中年齡相關的發炎反應，而在老年胸腺中，ghrelin與生長激素水平均下降，與功能性胸腺退化及發炎升高相關。

label: Hexokinase 2
description: Hexokinase 2 catalyzes the first rate-limiting glycolytic step, glucose to glucose-6-phosphate.
description_zh_TW: Hexokinase 2 催化第一個速率限制糖解步驟，葡萄糖至葡萄糖-6-磷酸。

label: Epigenetics
description: Epigenetic dysregulation underlies cancer through silencing of tumor suppressors and global hypomethylation. Promoter hypermethylation silences genes that restrain proliferation, while global loss of methylation destabilizes the genome and activates transposable elements, and aberrant histone modifications reinforce these changes. These epigenetic alterations cooperate with genetic mutations to drive tumorigenesis and provide therapeutic targets for epigenetic drugs such as DNA methyltransferase inhibitors.
