description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳失調透過腫瘤抑制因子的沉默和整體低甲基化而成為癌症的基礎。啟動子高甲基化會沉默抑制增殖的基因，而甲基化的整體喪失會破壞基因組的穩定性並激活轉座元件，而異常的組蛋白修飾會強化這些變化。這些表觀遺傳學改變與基因突變共同驅動腫瘤發生，並為 DNA 甲基轉移酶抑制劑等表觀遺傳藥物提供治療標靶。

label: Healthspan
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Caloric restriction is the most robust healthspan-extending intervention across model organisms. Extension is the geroscience consensus.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制是跨模式生物最強健的健康壽命延長介入。延長是老年科學共識。

label: Histone Acetyltransferase
description: Sas2p is a MYST-family histone acetyltransferase.
description_zh_TW: Sas2p 是 MYST 家族組蛋白乙醯轉移酶。

label: Neuropilin-1
description: Cleaved CendR engages Neuropilin-1 for tumor penetration as step two.
description_zh_TW: 切割的 CendR 接合 Neuropilin-1 以腫瘤穿透作為第二步。

label: Gene Silencing
description: X-chromosome inactivation is the physiologic long-range silencing program.
description_zh_TW: X 染色體失活是生理性長程沉默程序。

label: STING
description: cGAS binds cytosolic double-stranded DNA and synthesises cyclic GMP-AMP, which binds and activates STING. In senescence the DNA ligands are predominantly endogenous: chromatin cytoplasmic foci blebbed from the nucleus, mitochondrial DNA released from damaged mitochondria, and retrotransposon-derived cDNA. This cGAS to STING step is the point at which nuclear and mitochondrial damage are converted into the interferon and NF-kB signalling that drives the SASP, which is why the axis is regarded as a central regulator of SASP induction rather than a peripheral pathway.
description_zh_TW: cGAS 結合胞質雙股 DNA 並合成 cyclic GMP-AMP，後者結合並活化 STING。在衰老中，DNA 配體主要為內源性：由細胞核起泡排出的染色質細胞質病灶、受損粒線體釋出的粒線體 DNA，以及反轉錄轉座子來源的 cDNA。此 cGAS 至 STING 步驟是細胞核與粒線體損傷轉換為驅動 SASP 的干擾素與 NF-kB 訊號之處，因此該軸被視為 SASP 誘導的中樞調控者而非周邊路徑。

label: BRD4
description: Bromodomain protein 4 positively regulates necroptosis by transcriptionally controlling MLKL expression.
description_zh_TW: 溴結構域蛋白4透過轉錄調控MLKL表現，正向調控necroptosis。

label: Cognition
description: Neurogenesis is the process by which neurons are produced from neural stem and progenitor cells, persisting in adult brain regions like the hippocampus. It is regulated by exercise, caloric restriction, and BDNF, and its decline with aging is associated with cognitive decline.
description_zh_TW: 神經新生是神經元由神經幹細胞與前驅細胞產生的過程，在海馬迴等成人大腦區域持續存在。它受運動、熱量限制與 BDNF 調控，其隨衰老的下降與認知衰退相關。

label: COPD
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: SIRT3 is critical in maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis and counteracting oxidative stress in COPD, where the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 pathway is pivotal for mitochondrial biogenesis and redox equilibrium. SIRT3 deficiency exacerbates alveolar destruction, increases airway inflammation, and accelerates pulmonary function decline; miR-494-3p targeting of SIRT3 in small airway epithelial cells accelerates senescence contributing to COPD pathophysiology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 COPD 中對維護粒線體恆定和對抗氧化壓力至關重要，其中 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 途徑對於粒線體生成和氧化還原平衡至關重要。SIRT3 缺乏加劇肺泡破壞、增加氣道發炎並加速肺功能衰退；miR-494-3p 在小氣道上皮細胞中靶向 SIRT3 加速衰老，促進 COPD 病理生理學。

label: Insulin Sensitivity
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: SIRT1 has a dual role in diabetes mellitus: overexpression improves insulin sensitivity while hepatic SIRT1 knockdown prevents fasting hyperglycemia by increasing hepatic insulin responsiveness. SIRT1 therefore both enhances systemic insulin action and constrains hepatic glucose output. This context-dependence is characteristic of SIRT1's master-regulator role in metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在糖尿病 mellitus 中具有雙重角色：過度表現改善胰島素敏感性，而肝 SIRT1 敲低透過增加肝臟胰島素反應性防止空腹高血糖。SIRT1 因此既增強全身性胰島素作用，又限制肝臟葡萄糖輸出。此情境依賴性是其作為代謝疾病主控調節因子的特徵。

label: GlyNAC
description: GlyNAC (glycine + N-acetylcysteine) increases glutathione and reduces oxidative stress (round-3 remediation, degree-10 node including 'increases → Glutathione' and 'activates → NRF2'), pulling the redox-buffer arm of the protocol into the glutathione synthesis subgraph.
description_zh_TW: GlyNAC（甘氨酸＋N-乙醯半胱氨酸）提高 glutathione 並降低氧化壓力（第三輪修復，degree-10 節點，含「increases → Glutathione」與「activates → NRF2」），把協定的氧化還原緩衝臂拉入 glutathione 生合成子圖。

label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
description: APL is the M3 subtype of acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: APL 是急性骨髓性白血病的 M3 亞型。

label: Frailty
description: CTPI2, a third-generation SLC25A1 inhibitor, delays the onset of frailty in aged mice as measured by a validated 31-parameter frailty index, alongside improvements in fur condition, coordination, balance and grip strength. In aged tissues, CTPI2 suppresses SASP-associated inflammatory gene expression across skeletal muscle, liver and heart while leaving p16 and p21 unchanged, and circulating inflammatory cytokines are reduced, indicating a systemic attenuation of inflammatory burden. These benefits arise without broad metabolic reprogramming: body weight, composition, metabolic rate, respiratory exchange ratio, activity and lipid metabolic pathways are largely unaffected.
description_zh_TW: CTPI2 是第三代 SLC25A1 抑制劑，可延緩老年小鼠衰弱症的發生，此結果以經驗證的 31 參數衰弱指數衡量，同時伴隨毛皮狀況、協調性、平衡感與握力的改善。在老年組織中，CTPI2 可抑制骨骼肌、肝臟與心臟中與 SASP 相關的發炎基因表現，同時不改變 p16 與 p21，且循環中的發炎細胞激素亦降低，顯示發炎負擔獲得全身性的減輕。這些效益的產生並未伴隨廣泛的代謝重編程：體重、身體組成、代謝率、呼吸交換比、活動量與脂質代謝途徑大多不受影響。

label: E2F
description: Hypophosphorylated RB1 binds and represses E2F transcription factors in G1. This suppression withholds S-phase genes until CDK phosphorylation releases them.
description_zh_TW: 低磷酸化 RB1 在 G1 結合並抑制 E2F 轉錄因子。此抑制扣留 S 期基因，直到 CDK 磷酸化釋放它們。

label: Cardiac Hypertrophy
description: SIRT1 has dose-dependent effects on cardiac hypertrophy: low (2.5-fold) or moderate (7.5-fold) overexpression attenuates hypertrophy, whereas high (12.5-fold) overexpression increases it. Directionally, SIRT1 expression level determines whether the outcome is protective or detrimental. This biphasic behavior explains conflicting reports in the literature on SIRT1's cardiac effects, which differ depending on the degree of overexpression studied. The finding underscores that more SIRT1 is not always better, and that therapeutic approaches must consider dosing windows.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1對心臟肥大具有劑量依賴性的效果：低（2.5倍）或中等（7.5倍）過表達可減輕肥大，而高（12.5倍）過表達則加重肥大。方向上，SIRT1表達水平決定了結果是保護性還是有害。這種雙相行為解釋了文獻中關於SIRT1心臟效果的矛盾報導，這些報導因研究的過表達程度不同而異。此發現強調更多的SIRT1並非總是更好，治療方法必須考慮劑量窗口。

label: FOXO1
description: Akt phosphorylates and inhibits the FOXO1/FOXO3 transcription factors, which normally promote autophagy and stress-resistance gene expression, thereby indirectly suppressing autophagy downstream of insulin/PI3K signaling. The reciprocal interaction reflects the broader antagonism between growth-factor-driven anabolism (via Akt-mTOR) and the autophagy-promoting FOXO program. When Akt is inactive during fasting, FOXO factors are de-repressed and contribute to autophagic and longevity pathways. This axis embeds autophagy control within the insulin-signaling network that also regulates mTORC1.
description_zh_TW: Akt 磷酸化並抑制 FOXO1/FOXO3 轉錄因子，後者通常促進自噬和壓力抵抗基因表現，從而在胰島素/PI3K 信號下游間接抑制自噬。此相互關係反映了生長因子驅動的合成代謝（經由 Akt-mTOR）與促自噬 FOXO 程序之間更廣泛的拮抗。當禁食期間 Akt 失活時，FOXO 因子被解除抑制並貢獻於自噬和長壽途徑。此軸將自噬控制嵌入同時調節 mTORC1 的胰島素信號網絡中。

label: Bim
description: ERK phosphorylates Bim at Ser69 and related sites, priming its ubiquitination and degradation.
description_zh_TW: ERK 在 Ser69 等位點磷酸化 Bim，促使其泛素化與降解。

label: Free Radicals
description: Cigarette smoke contains free radicals, including semiquinone radicals, hydroxyl radicals, and nitric oxide, plus a large burden of gaseous and particulate oxidants. These directly and indirectly raise lung oxidant load. The directionality is smoke-derived radicals to tissue oxidation. A caveat is that the tar-phase semiquinones can redox-cycle and generate sustained ROS long after exposure, so the effect outlasts the inhaled puff. Both the gas phase and tar phase carry oxidants, and the balance between oxidant load and lung antioxidant capacity determines tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: Cigarette smoke 包含 free radicals，包括半醌自由基、hydroxyl radicals 和 nitric oxide，以及大量氣態和顆粒氧化劑。這些直接和間接地增加了肺的氧化負荷。方向性是煙霧衍生的自由基對組織的氧化。需要注意的是，焦油相半醌在暴露後很長一段時間內可以進行氧化還原循環並產生持續的 ROS，因此其效果比吸入的煙霧更持久。氣相和焦油相均攜帶氧化劑，氧化劑負荷與肺抗氧化能力之間的平衡決定了組織損傷。

label: DJ-1
description: DJ-1 detoxifies glyoxal to glycolic acid GSH-independently, parallel to methylglyoxal-to-L-lactate conversion. Second substrate leg of the DJ-1 glyoxalase program.
description_zh_TW: DJ-1 不依賴 GSH 將 glyoxal 解毒為 glycolic acid，與 methylglyoxal 到 L-lactate 轉換平行。DJ-1 乙二醛酶程序的第二受質分支。

label: PODXL
description: PODXL is a canonical undifferentiated-state surface marker.
description_zh_TW: PODXL 是典型的未分化狀態表面標記。

label: EZH2
description: XIST recruits the Polycomb methyltransferase EZH2 to deposit H3K27me3.
description_zh_TW: XIST 招募 Polycomb 甲基轉移酶 EZH2 以沉積 H3K27me3。

label: HUWE1
description: HUWE1 is the primary E3 ubiquitin ligase for Mcl-1 turnover.
description_zh_TW: HUWE1 是 Mcl-1 週轉的主要 E3 泛素連接酶。

label: NMRK2
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NMRK2 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 2) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) using only a single molecule of ATP, whereas synthesis of NMN from nicotinamide by NAMPT requires more than three ATP equivalents. This makes the NMRK2 pathway an energy-sparing mechanism that may be favored in the failing heart, where the shift from NAMPT to NMRK2 for NAD+ synthesis represents a common adaptive response. NR is expressed and active mainly in cardiac and skeletal muscle, which may explain the better ability of these tissues to respond to NR. NR supplementation is therefore regarded as a powerful approach to preserve cardiac function in heart failure.
description_zh_TW: NMRK2（nicotinamide ribose kinase 2，菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 2）僅需單一分子的 ATP 即可將 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）轉化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸），而 NAMPT 由菸鹼醯胺合成 NMN 則需要超過三個 ATP 當量。這使得 NMRK2 路徑成為一種節能機制，可能在衰竭的心臟中受到偏好，因為在該處由 NAMPT 轉向 NMRK2 進行 NAD+ 合成代表一種常見的適應性反應。NR 主要在心肌與骨骼肌中表現並具活性，這或許解釋了這些組織對 NR 較佳的反應能力。因此，NR 補充被視為維持心衰竭中心臟功能的有力方法。

label: Pyruvate Kinase M2
description: Pyruvate Kinase M2 catalyzes the final glycolytic step, PEP to pyruvate.
description_zh_TW: Pyruvate Kinase M2 催化最後糖解步驟，PEP 至 Pyruvate。

label: Rag proteins
description: The DEPDC5-containing GATOR1 complex is the GAP converting RagA/B-GTP to GDP. Inhibition is the amino-acid-off switch.
description_zh_TW: 含 DEPDC5 的 GATOR1 複合體是將 RagA/B-GTP 轉 GDP 的 GAP。抑制是胺基酸關閉開關。

label: H3K79me2
description: H3K79me2 is a nucleosome-core methylation deposited by the methyltransferase DOT1L, the sole H3K79 methyltransferase. H3K79 methylation marks actively transcribed gene bodies and is elevated at SASP loci.
description_zh_TW: H3K79me2 是由甲基轉移酶 DOT1L（唯一的 H3K79 甲基轉移酶）沉積的核小體核心甲基化。H3K79 甲基化標記活躍轉錄的基因體，並在 SASP 基因座升高。

label: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor
description: Kynurenine and its derivatives activate the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), promoting regulatory T cell (Treg) differentiation and suppressing effector T/NK cells. This metabolite-driven AhR signaling is the second major mechanism of IDO1-mediated immunosuppression alongside local tryptophan depletion, and together they create an immunosuppressive microenvironment in tissues such as tumors, placenta and inflamed sites. The context-dependent nature of this pathway is notable: it is protective via tolerance induction in autoimmunity but potentially detrimental when overactive in metabolic inflammation, where elevated KP activity links to insulin resistance and chronic low-grade inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 犬尿胺酸及其衍生物活化芳香烴受體（AhR），促進調節性 T 細胞（Treg）分化並抑制效應 T/NK 細胞。此代謝物驅動的 AhR 訊息傳導是 IDO1 媒介免疫抑制的第二個主要機制，與局部色胺酸耗竭並行，兩者共同在腫瘤、胎盤與發炎部位等組織中創造免疫抑制微環境。此路徑的情境依賴性值得注意：它在自體免疫中經由耐受誘導具有保護作用，但在代謝性發炎中過度活化則可能有害，此時升高的 KP 活性與胰島素抗性及慢性低度發炎相關。

label: OMA1
description: The proteolytic processing of OPA1 is mediated by several mitochondrial proteases, including the metalloendopeptidase OMA1, the ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease YME1L1, the rhomboid protease PARL, paraplegin and the mAAA protease complex. Under stress conditions such as mitochondrial depolarization, the S1 site of OPA1 is cleaved by YME1L1 or OMA1 to produce the short form S-OPA1, which lacks a membrane anchor but can modulate fusion by complexing with membrane-bound L-OPA1. DRP1-mediated zinc influx into the matrix causes membrane depolarization, resulting in OMA1 activation and OPA1 inactivation to enable clearance of damaged mitochondrial fragments by mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: OPA1的蛋白水解加工由幾種粒線體蛋白酶介導，包括金屬內肽酶OMA1、ATP依賴性鋅金屬蛋白酶YME1L1、菱形蛋白酶PARL、paraplegin和mAAA蛋白酶複合物。在粒線體去極化等壓力條件下，OPA1的S1位點被YME1L1或OMA1裂解以產生短形式S-OPA1，該形式缺乏膜錨定但可通過與膜結合的L-OPA1形成複合物來調節融合。DRP1介導的鋅流入基質導致膜去極化，引起OMA1激活和OPA1失活，從而通過線粒體自噬清除受損的粒線體片段。

label: PLK1
description: PLK1 phosphorylates Bcl-xL at Ser62 together with CDK1/JNK2.
description_zh_TW: PLK1 與 CDK1/JNK2 在 Ser62 磷酸化 Bcl-xL。

label: Non-homologous End Joining
description: NHEJ directly ligates DNA double-strand breaks without a homologous template; DNA ligase IV performs the terminal sealing with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 enhances NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation, supporting genome stability and mtDNA repair.
description_zh_TW: NHEJ 在沒有同源模板的情況下直接連接 DNA 雙股斷裂；DNA ligase IV 與 XRCC4/XLF 一起執行最終封口。SIRT3 透過 53BP1 招募和 H3K56 去乙醯化增強 NHEJ 效率，支持基因組穩定性和 mtDNA 修復。

label: HSF1
description: Heat shock proteins are a conserved family of molecular chaperones induced by proteotoxic, thermal, oxidative, and exercise stress. Their expression is coordinated transcriptionally by heat shock factor HSF1, which binds heat-shock elements to drive HSP induction.
description_zh_TW: 熱休克蛋白是保守的分子伴護蛋白家族，由蛋白毒性、熱、氧化與運動壓力誘導。其表現由熱休克因子 HSF1 在轉錄層面協調，HSF1 結合熱休克元件驅動 HSP 誘導。

label: Acatalasemia
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: Necrotizing gingivitis and periodontal destruction are the classic presentation of acatalasemia from undegraded oral peroxide. Association records the mucosal hallmark.
description_zh_TW: 壞死性齦炎與牙周破壞是未降解口腔過氧化物導致 acatalasemia 的典型表現。關聯記錄黏膜標誌。

label: Autophagic Lysosome Reformation
description: PtdIns(3,5)P2-TRPML1 signaling is required for autophagic lysosome reformation. Regulation is the lipid-to-scission coupling.
description_zh_TW: PtdIns(3,5)P2-TRPML1 訊號為自噬性溶酶體重組所需。調節是脂質到分裂的耦合。

label: B18R
description: B18R is a vaccinia-encoded virulence factor secreted during infection.
description_zh_TW: B18R 是感染期間分泌的痘苗病毒編碼毒力因子。

label: TAK1
description: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol is a selective inhibitor of TAK1 (MAP3K7) used to probe the ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 axis that orchestrates SASP development after DNA damage. By restraining TAK1 activity it suppresses downstream p38 MAPK and PI3K/Akt/mTOR engagement that supports persistent SASP signaling.
description_zh_TW: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol 是 TAK1（MAP3K7）的選擇性抑制劑，用於探討 DNA 損傷後調控 SASP 發展的 ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 軸。透過抑制 TAK1 活性，它可壓制支撐持續 SASP 訊號的下游 p38 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 參與。

label: narcolepsy
description: Narcolepsy is a chronic neurological sleep disorder of excessive daytime sleepiness with disrupted nocturnal sleep. Classification anchors it in sleep medicine rather than psychiatry.
description_zh_TW: narcolepsy 是以日間過度嗜睡與夜間睡眠中斷為特徵的慢性神經性睡眠疾患。歸類將它錨定於睡眠醫學而非精神科。

label: Microglia
description: Iba1 is the standard immunohistochemical marker for microglia in the central nervous system. Its expression increases with microglial activation, and Iba1 immunostaining reveals microgliosis in neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation.
description_zh_TW: Iba1 是中樞神經系統微膠質細胞的標準免疫組織化學標記。其表現隨微膠質活化而增加，Iba1 免疫染色揭示神經退化與神經發炎中的微膠質增生。

label: Fucoidan
description: SIRT6-activating fucoidan extends healthspan and lifespan in aged wild-type mice, confirming in vivo geroprotection. Directionally, fucoidan sits upstream of improved survival and function. This mirrors the longevity association of centenarian SIRT6 variants and positions fucoidan as a natural SIRT6-targeted intervention. The benefit in naturally aged mice suggests that SIRT6 activation can counteract age-related decline even when initiated late in life. Fucoidan's dual activation of SIRT6 protein and ADP-ribosyltransferase activity is thought to mediate its healthspan effects.
description_zh_TW: 活化 SIRT6 的 fucoidan 延長老年野生型小鼠的健康壽命和壽命，確認了體內抗衰老保護。在方向性上，fucoidan 位於改善存活和功能的上游。這反映了百歲人瑞 SIRT6 變異體的長壽關聯，將 fucoidan 定位為天然的 SIRT6 靶向干預措施。在自然衰老小鼠中的益處表明，即使在生命後期才開始 SIRT6 活化也能對抗年齡相關退化。Fucoidan 對 SIRT6 蛋白和 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性的雙重活化被認為是其健康壽命效應的介導機制。

label: Cathepsin K
description: CTSK loss-of-function causes the osteosclerotic dysplasia pycnodysostosis. Causation is the genetic etiology.
description_zh_TW: CTSK 功能缺失導致骨硬化發育不良緻密骨發育不全。因果是遺傳病因。

label: Lipophagy
description: Lipid droplets are delivered to lysosomes for degradation via lipophagy, mirroring selective autophagy of peroxisomes. Targeting is the cargo direction.
description_zh_TW: 脂滴經由脂噬遞送到溶酶體降解，呼應過氧化物酶體的選擇性自噬。標定是貨物方向。

label: Dietary AGEs
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: It was estimated using an AGE-specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that approximately 10% of ingested immunoreactive advanced glycation end products are transported into the circulation, two-thirds of which remain in the body and are incorporated covalently into tissues, while only one-third is excreted via the kidneys. Dietary intake is therefore an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and studies in healthy subjects, diabetic patients, and renal failure patients have found significant correlations between ingested AGEs and plasma AGE levels. Restricting dietary AGEs reduces circulating AGE concentrations, supporting the view that diet modulates systemic glycation burden.
description_zh_TW: 使用 AGE 專一的酵素連結免疫吸附分析法（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay）估計，約 10% 攝入的免疫反應性晚期糖化終產物被運輸進入循環，其中三分之二留在體內並共價地併入組織，僅三分之一經由腎臟排泄。因此，飲食攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且在健康受試者、糖尿病患者與腎衰竭患者中的研究發現攝入 AGE 與血漿 AGE 濃度之間有顯著相關。限制飲食中的 AGE 可降低循環 AGE 濃度，支持飲食會調節全身性糖化負擔的觀點。

label: METTL3
description: METTL3, the catalytic subunit of the m6A methyltransferase complex, methylates TFEB mRNA at N6-methyladenosine residues, a mark that targets the transcript for destabilization and degradation. By reducing TFEB mRNA stability, METTL3 negatively regulates TFEB protein abundance and consequently the autophagy-lysosomal program. This epitranscriptomic control links RNA methylation to degradative pathway output. The finding situates TFEB within the expanding regulatory influence of m6A modification on stress-response genes.
description_zh_TW: METTL3 是 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體的催化次單元，於 N6-甲基腺苷殘基甲基化 TFEB mRNA，此標記將轉錄本標定為不穩定和降解。透過降低 TFEB mRNA 穩定性，METTL3 負向調節 TFEB 蛋白豐度，進而影響自噬—溶酶體程序。此表觀轉錄組控制將 RNA 甲基化連結到降解途徑的輸出。此發現將 TFEB 置於 m6A 修飾對壓力反應基因日益擴大的調節影響中。

label: Neuron
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: MAP2 (microtubule-associated protein 2) is a high-molecular-weight protein abundant in neuronal dendrites that binds and stabilizes microtubules. MAP2 immunostaining is widely used as a dendritic marker to assess neuronal integrity and preservation.
description_zh_TW: MAP2（微管相關蛋白 2）是豐富存在於神經元樹突的高分子量蛋白，結合並穩定微管。MAP2 免疫染色被廣泛用作樹突標記，以評估神經元完整性與保存。

label: Glutamate-gated Cl- channels
description: Avermectins are allosteric potentiators/agonists of invertebrate glutamate-gated chloride channels (GluCls); Cl- influx hyperpolarizes and paralyzes parasites.
description_zh_TW: 是無脊椎動物穀氨酸門控氯離子通道 (GluCls) 的變構增強劑/激動劑； Cl-流入使寄生蟲超極化並麻痺。

label: TRPML1
description: PtdIns(3,5)P2 directly binds and activates the TRPML1 calcium channel. Activation couples phosphoinositide to calcium release.
description_zh_TW: PtdIns(3,5)P2 直接結合並活化 TRPML1 鈣通道。活化將磷酸肌醇耦合到鈣釋放。

label: Ubiquinone
description: FIN56 engages squalene synthase to divert mevalonate flux away from CoQ10, starving FSP1 of substrate. This converges on the FSP1 brake from the metabolic side, like statins.
description_zh_TW: FIN56 結合 squalene synthase 使 mevalonate 流量偏離 CoQ10，剝奪 FSP1 受質。此從代謝側匯聚於 FSP1 煞車，與 statins 相同。

label: SLC7A11
description: p53 transcriptionally represses the cystine/glutamate antiporter, limiting GSH synthesis for ferroptosis execution. Erastin phenocopies this suppression pharmacologically.
description_zh_TW: p53 在轉錄抑制胱胺酸/麩胺酸反向轉運體，限制 GSH 合成以執行鐵死亡。Erastin 在藥理表型複製此抑制。

label: Methylation
description: Methylation is the biochemical transfer of a methyl group (-CH3) from a donor such as S-adenosylmethionine to an acceptor molecule, DNA, proteins, lipids, or small metabolites like catechols. This covalent modification alters the chemical properties, activity, or signaling of the target without changing its carbon skeleton, enabling regulation of gene expression, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. COMT-catalyzed catechol methylation is a classic example within neurotransmitter metabolism. Methylation is thus a universal regulatory and detoxifying mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 是甲基 (-CH3) 從 S-adenosylmethionine 等供體向受體分子、DNA、蛋白質、脂質或兒茶酚等小代謝物的生化轉移。這種共價修飾改變了標靶的化學性質、活性或訊號傳導，而不改變其碳骨架，從而能夠調節 gene expression、神經傳導物質失活和解毒。 COMT 催化的兒茶酚甲基化是神經傳導物質代謝的經典例子。因此，Methylation 是一種通用的調節和解毒機制。

label: Post-translational modification
description: Ubiquitination is a definitional post-translational protein modification.
description_zh_TW: 泛素化是定義性的轉譯後蛋白修飾。

label: Silver(I) Oxide
description: Silver(I) oxide is acutely toxic in animal studies, with a reported LD50 of 1027 mg/kg by the oral route in mice and 2820 mg/kg orally in rats; intraperitoneal LD50 values are 37 mg/kg in mice and 70 mg/kg in rats. The much lower intraperitoneal threshold reflects efficient absorption of silver ions directly into the circulation, whereas oral silver is less bioavailable. These data establish silver oxide as a moderate acute hazard requiring careful handling in laboratory, industrial, and battery-manufacturing settings.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)在動物研究中具有急性毒性，報導的小鼠口服LD50為1027 mg/kg，大鼠口服為2820 mg/kg；腹腔注射LD50值小鼠為37 mg/kg，大鼠為70 mg/kg。低得多的腹腔注射閾值反映了銀離子直接吸收進入循環的效率，而口服銀的生物利用度較低。這些數據將氧化銀確立為中等急性危害，需要在實驗室、工業和電池製造環境中謹慎處理。

label: BMP Signaling Pathway
description: BMP2/4/7 drive osteoblast differentiation as the defining skeletal function of the pathway. Loss of signaling causes skeletal dysplasia.
description_zh_TW: BMP2/4/7 驅動造骨細胞分化，作為此路徑定義性的骨骼功能。訊號缺失導致骨骼發育不良。

label: PPARγ
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A modulates the activity of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ), a crucial transcription factor involved in adipocyte differentiation, glucose metabolism, and cholesterol metabolism. Studies indicate that urolithin A can increase the expression of PPARγ and the transcription of its downstream target genes, thereby promoting fatty acid oxidation, improving insulin sensitivity, and reducing cholesterol synthesis and absorption. These metabolic regulatory effects position PPARγ signaling as a mediator of urolithin A's influence on energy metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 調節 peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ) 的活性，這是參與脂肪細胞分化、葡萄糖代謝與膽固醇代謝的重要轉錄因子。研究指出 urolithin A 可提升 PPARγ 的表現及其下游標的基因轉錄，從而促進脂肪酸氧化、改善胰島素敏感性，並降低膽固醇合成與吸收。這些代謝調節效應使 PPARγ 訊號成為 urolithin A 影響能量代謝的中介者。

label: Schizophrenia
description: Hippocampal-prefrontal network dysfunction is observed in schizophrenia, implicating hippocampal circuits alongside prefrontal COMT variation. This mirrors the existing Prefrontal Cortex is_affected_in Schizophrenia edge.
description_zh_TW: 精神分裂症可觀察到海馬—前額葉網絡功能障礙，將海馬迴路與前額葉 COMT 變異並列。此呼應既有的前額葉皮質受影響於精神分裂症邊。

label: MOMP
description: Oblimersen lowers the mitochondrial brake threshold, enabling MOMP.
description_zh_TW: Oblimersen 降低粒線體煞車閾值，促成 MOMP。

label: Mitokines
description: FGF21 is a primary stress-induced mitokine downstream of mitochondrial dysfunction. Classification places it in the inter-organ signaling family.
description_zh_TW: FGF21 是粒線體功能障礙下游的主要壓力誘發 mitokine。歸類將它置於器官間訊號家族。

label: Dicarbonyls
description: Aminoguanidine is an AGE inhibitor that acts as a carbonyl trap, interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and preventing them from reacting with proteins. These reactive carbonyls include dicarbonyls such as methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone, which are key intermediates in AGE formation. By trapping these dicarbonyl species, aminoguanidine blocks AGE accumulation and the downstream glycation damage. This mechanism is shared with other AGE inhibitors such as pyridoxamine, and underpins aminoguanidine's ability to prevent diabetic complications in animal models.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是一種 AGE inhibitor，作為 carbonyl trap，與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並防止其與蛋白質反應。這些 reactive carbonyls 包括 methylglyoxal、glyoxal 與 3-deoxyglucosone 等 dicarbonyls，它們是 AGE formation 的關鍵 intermediates。透過 trapping 這些 dicarbonyl species，aminoguanidine 阻斷 AGE accumulation 與 downstream glycation damage。此 mechanism 與 pyridoxamine 等其他 AGE inhibitors 共享，並構成 aminoguanidine 在 animal models 中預防 diabetic complications 能力的基礎。

label: PARP
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide (NAM), the amide form of vitamin B3 and a product released from NAD+-consuming reactions, inhibits PARP activity while being effective at increasing NAD+ levels in tissues. At high doses, NAM is metabolized by nicotinamide N-methyltransferase into N1-methylnicotinamide for urinary elimination, which can progressively lower the cellular methyl pool, potentially reducing DNA and protein methylation and altering gene expression and protein activity. This dual role as both NAD+ precursor and PARP/sirtuin inhibitor distinguishes NAM from NMN and NR, which elevate NAD+ without this inhibitory action, and may explain differences in their metabolic outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺（NAM）是維生素 B3 的醯胺形式，也是 NAD+ 消耗反應釋放的產物，它在有效提升組織 NAD+ 水平的同時抑制 PARP 活性。在高劑量下，NAM 被菸鹼醯胺 N-甲基轉移酶代謝為 N1-甲基菸鹼醯胺以經尿液排出，這可能逐步降低細胞甲基池，潛在減少 DNA 與蛋白質甲基化並改變基因表現與蛋白質活性。這種同時作為 NAD+ 前驅物與 PARP/去乙醯酶抑制劑的雙重角色，使 NAM 有別於 NMN 和 NR——後者提升 NAD+ 而不具此抑制作用，並可能解釋其代謝結果的差異。

label: Chemoresistance
description: EREG (epiregulin) is a transmembrane EGFR-family ligand secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP. It promotes cancer therapy resistance and immunosuppression, and apigenin treatment reverses the elevated circulating EREG induced by chemotherapy.
description_zh_TW: EREG（epiregulin）是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分分泌的穿膜 EGFR 家族配體。它促進癌症治療抗藥性與免疫抑制，而 apigenin 治療可逆转化療誘導升高的循環 EREG。

label: PPARα
description: SIRT4 represses signaling by the nuclear receptor PPARalpha and destabilizes the mitochondrial trifunctional protein alpha (MTPalpha) subunit in hepatocytes. Together these actions shift liver metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid oxidation and toward anabolic lipid conservation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed fatty-acid utilization, positioning it as a metabolic brake that opposes the fatty-acid-catabolic programs promoted by SIRT3 and SIRT5. In nutrient-replete conditions this restrains wasteful fat burning, but under energetic stress it can limit the capacity to oxidize fatty acids, and this SIRT3/SIRT4 balance governs mitochondrial fuel choice.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4抑制核受體PPARalpha的訊號並在肝細胞中使粒線體三功能蛋白α（MTPalpha）亞基不穩定。這些作用共同將肝臟代謝從粒線體脂肪酸氧化轉向合成代謝的脂質保存。方向上，SIRT4位於脂肪酸利用抑制的上游，將其定位為與SIRT3和SIRT5促進的脂肪酸分解程序相對抗的代謝制動器。在營養充足條件下，這限制了浪費性的脂肪燃燒，但在能量壓力下，它可能限制氧化脂肪酸的能力，這種SIRT3/SIRT4平衡控制粒線體燃料選擇。

label: Antioxidants
description: Antioxidant supplementation blunts the ROS pulse required for hormetic adaptation, mirroring the mitohormesis edge. Blockade is the paradox mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 抗氧化補充削弱激效適應所需的 ROS 脈衝，呼應 mitohormesis 邊。阻斷是矛盾機制。

label: TFE3
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: Rearranged TFE3 transcription factor defines Xp11 translocation RCC.
description_zh_TW: 重排的 TFE3 轉錄因子定義 Xp11 易位 RCC。

label: Working Memory
description: D1-mediated dopamine signaling gates working memory maintenance, paralleling the D2 working-memory edge. Prefrontal D1 occupancy depends on COMT-set dopamine tone where DAT is sparse.
description_zh_TW: D1 介導的多巴胺訊號守衛工作記憶維持，與 D2 工作記憶邊平行。前額葉 D1 佔據在 DAT 稀疏處依賴 COMT 設定的多巴胺張力。

label: CDH2
description: CDH2 encodes the N-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
description_zh_TW: CDH2 編碼 N-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

label: CCL20
description: CCL20 expression is driven by NF-kB and induced by IL-1alpha, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha, placing it downstream of the apical SASP amplifiers. This positions CCL20 within the IL-1alpha-centered feed-forward loop of senescence inflammation, in which a single upstream cytokine orchestrates a broad chemokine response. Its induction integrates the master inflammatory cytokines with chemokine output, ensuring immune recruitment is coordinated with secretome activation. The relationship is mechanistically coherent and well documented across senescence and inflammatory models. IL-1β acts through the same IL-1R-NF-kB route as a parallel inducer in fibroblasts and epithelial cells.
description_zh_TW: CCL20 表現由 NF-κB 驅動，並被 IL-1alpha、IL-1beta 與 TNF-alpha 誘發，將其置於頂層 SASP 放大器的下游。這將 CCL20 定位於 IL-1alpha 中心的衰老發炎正向迴圈中，其中單一上游細胞激素協調廣泛趨化因子反應。其誘發整合主發炎細胞激素與趨化因子輸出，確保免疫招募與分泌組活化協調。此關係在機制上連貫，並跨衰老與發炎模型良好記載。 IL-1β 在纖維母細胞與上皮細胞經由相同的 IL-1R-NF-κB 途徑作為平行誘發因子。

label: PhenoAge
description: DunedinPACE is a rate-based epigenetic estimator of the pace of aging, complementary to the level-based PhenoAge clock. Where PhenoAge estimates biological-age level, DunedinPACE estimates rate, so the two together describe both position and trajectory of aging.
description_zh_TW: DunedinPACE 是基於速率的表觀遺傳老化速度估算器，與基於水平的 PhenoAge 時鐘互補。PhenoAge 估算生物年齡水平，DunedinPACE 則估算速率，兩者共同描述老化的位置與軌跡。

label: G1 Phase
description: The restriction point operates late in G1 as its commitment substructure. This part-whole edge complements the existing G1-contains-Restriction-Point triple.
description_zh_TW: 限制點在 G1 後期作為其承諾子結構運作。此部分—整體邊補充既有的 G1 包含限制點 triple。

label: Toll-like Receptor
description: Beyond death receptors, Toll-like receptors and intracellular triggers such as DAI and Protein Kinase R were added as necroptosis inducers; TLR3/TLR4 signal via TRIF to the necrosome.
description_zh_TW: 除死亡受體外，Toll-like 受體及 DAI、Protein Kinase R 等胞內觸發物被加入為 necroptosis 誘導物；TLR3/TLR4 經 TRIF 向 necrosome 傳遞訊號。

label: Major Histocompatibility Complex
description: HLA-A/B/DRB1 matching determines transplant compatibility.
description_zh_TW: HLA-A/B/DRB1 配型決定移植相容性。

label: William C. Campbell
description: Campbell shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for developing avermectin into ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 坎貝爾分享了2015年將阿維菌素發展成伊維菌素的歷程。

label: Rectal Cancer
description: Rectal cancer is often grouped with colon cancer as colorectal cancer, but is managed distinctly due to pelvic anatomical constraints and differing treatment paradigms. Rectal cancer exhibits a higher propensity for locoregional recurrence while colon cancer more often recurs distantly. They are neighboring entities along the colorectal continuum with distinct biology.
description_zh_TW: 直腸癌常與結腸癌合稱為結直腸癌，但因骨盆解剖限制與不同的治療模式而治療方式不同。直腸癌具有較高的局部區域復發傾向，而結腸癌較常在遠端復發。它們是結直腸連續體上相鄰但生物學不同的實體。

label: Senescence Surveillance
description: The immune system clears oncogene-induced senescent cells in benign lesions; surveillance failure accelerates tumorigenesis. p16/p21 double-knockout raises cancer rates, evidencing that senescence in benign/premalignant lesions is tumor-suppressive and that retaining it is beneficial.
description_zh_TW: 免疫系統清除良性病灶中的致癌基因誘發衰老細胞；監測失敗加速腫瘤發生。p16/p21 雙重基因敲除提高癌症率，證明良性／癌前病灶中的衰老具腫瘤抑制性，且保留它是有益的。

label: Leuco-adrenochrome
description: One-electron oxidation of leuco-adrenochrome yields the semiquinone radical as a distinct pathway step from full oxidation to adrenochrome. Conversion records the radical-branch direction.
description_zh_TW: 無色腎上腺素的單電子氧化產生半醌自由基，與完全氧化為腎上腺素是不同的路徑步驟。轉換記錄自由基分支方向。

label: BH3 mimetics
description: A1 expression limits BH3-mimetic efficacy, mirroring the Mcl-1 resistance pattern.
description_zh_TW: A1 表現限制 BH3 模擬物效力，呼應 Mcl-1 抗性模式。

label: Hippo Signaling Pathway
description: Organ-size control is the core conserved Hippo pathway function.
description_zh_TW: 器官大小控制是核心保守的 Hippo 路徑功能。

label: Caspase-7
description: PAK2 phosphorylates caspase-7 at Ser30/Thr173/Ser239, suppressing executioner activity.
description_zh_TW: PAK2 在 Ser30/Thr173/Ser239 磷酸化 caspase-7，抑制劊子手活性。

label: X-Chromosome Inactivation
source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic changes during aging and their reprogramming potential.md
description: The XIST long non-coding RNA drives initiation of X inactivation.
description_zh_TW: XIST 長非編碼 RNA 驅動 X 失活起始。

label: Opicapone
description: Opicapone belongs to the COMT-inhibitor drug class as its third-generation peripherally restricted member. Classification groups it with entacapone and tolcapone.
description_zh_TW: Opicapone 屬於 COMT 抑制劑藥物類別，為第三代周邊限制性成員。歸類將它與 entacapone 和 tolcapone 並列。

label: Myocardial infarction
description: Acute coronary syndromes account for the majority of sudden arrests with shockable rhythms. Causation is the lethal-complication direction.
description_zh_TW: 急性冠心症候群佔多數可電擊心律的猝死。因果是致死併發症方向。

label: Osteoarthritis
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: SIRT1 is protective in osteoarthritis by reducing chondrocyte apoptosis and ECM degradation via Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, reversing homocysteine-induced changes through the PGC-1alpha/PPAR-gamma cascade, inhibiting EGFR ubiquitination, and inhibiting chondrocyte senescence. SIRT1 therefore maintains cartilage homeostasis on multiple axes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在骨關節炎中具保護性，透過 Wnt/beta-catenin 訊號減少軟骨細胞凋亡與 ECM 降解，經由 PGC-1alpha/PPAR-gamma 級聯逆轉同半胱氨酸誘發的變化，抑制 EGFR 泛素化，並抑制軟骨細胞衰老。SIRT1 因此在多軸線上維持軟骨穩態。

label: IKK
description: IKK phosphorylates Puma at Ser10, driving its ubiquitination and degradation under IL-3.
description_zh_TW: IKK 在 Ser10 磷酸化 Puma，在 IL-3 下驅動其泛素化與降解。

label: Oxidative Phosphorylation
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Silver nanoparticles collapse ATP synthesis through oxidative phosphorylation blockade. Blockade starves cellular energetics.
description_zh_TW: 銀奈米顆粒經由 oxidative phosphorylation 阻斷瓦解 ATP 合成。阻斷餓死細胞能量。

label: H3K27ac
description: ChIP-seq analysis of histone H3 acetylation at lysine 27 (H3K27ac) showed that loci gaining acetylation during senescence are markedly reduced following mitochondrial clearance, and these regions are enriched for inflammatory and interleukin signalling pathways central to the SASP. A 51-gene SASP signature induced during senescence is suppressed upon mitochondrial removal, with genes such as IL6 and CCL2 showing coordinated decreases in chromatin acetylation and mRNA expression. Multiple nodes of the mitochondrial citrate-acetyl-CoA axis converge to control H3K27ac at SASP loci, selectively modulating inflammatory gene expression without affecting the senescence-associated cell cycle arrest.
description_zh_TW: 對組蛋白H3在賴氨酸27處的乙酰化（H3K27ac）的ChIP-seq分析表明，在衰老過程中獲得乙酰化的位點在線粒體清除後顯著減少，並且這些區域富含與SASP核心相關的炎症和白細胞介素信號通路。在衰老過程中誘導的51個基因的SASP特徵在線粒體移除後被抑制，IL6和CCL2等基因顯示出染色質乙酰化和mRNA表達的協調減少。線粒體枸櫞酸-乙酰輔酶A軸的多個節點匯聚以控制SASP位點的H3K27ac，選擇性地調節炎症基因表達而不影響衰老相關的細胞週期停滯。

label: Hyperglycemia
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Transient hyperglycemia exacerbates immune training and alone induces low-level TRIM with glycolysis-gene transcription; inhibition of KMT2A histone writers curbs TNF training. Diabetic training is centrally imprinted and adoptively transferable through RUNX1-dependent myeloid reprogramming, promoting atherosclerosis. It underlies the concept of hyperglycemic memory.
description_zh_TW: 短暫 Hyperglycemia 可加劇 immune training，單獨即可誘導低程度 TRIM 並轉錄 glycolysis 基因；抑制 KMT2A histone writers 可減弱 TNF 訓練。糖尿病訓練是 centrally imprinted，可經由 RUNX1-dependent myeloid reprogramming 被 adoptively transfer，並促進 atherosclerosis。這是 hyperglycemic memory 概念的基礎。

label: Splitomicin
description: In ischemic-preconditioning models, Splitomicin reverses protective lysine deacetylation and abolishes preconditioning-induced cardioprotection. Directionally, Splitomicin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of lost cardiac protection. This indicates that sirtuin deacetylase activity is required for ischemic tolerance, and it argues that sirtuin activation, not inhibition, protects the heart. The cardioprotective effect of preconditioning is thought to involve SIRT1-dependent stress adaptation, and its loss upon sirtuin inhibition confirms this mechanism. These findings support the development of sirtuin activators for ischemic heart disease.
description_zh_TW: 在缺血預適應模型中，Splitomicin 逆轉保護性的賴氨酸去乙醯化並廢除預適應誘導的心臟保護。在方向性上，Splitomicin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於心臟保護喪失的上游。這表明 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性是缺血耐受所必需的，並主張 sirtuin 活化（而非抑制）才能保護心臟。預適應的心臟保護效應被認為涉及 SIRT1 依賴性的壓力適應，其在 sirtuin 抑制後的喪失確認了此機制。這些發現支持開發用於缺血性心臟病的 sirtuin 活化劑。

label: HIRA
description: ASF1a is an upstream histone H3–H4 chaperone that hands off dimers to the HIRA complex for replication-independent deposition. Together with HIRA and UBN1 it is a core member of the chaperone complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci.
description_zh_TW: ASF1a 是上游的組蛋白 H3–H4 伴護蛋白，將二聚體交給 HIRA 複合體進行非複製依賴的沉積。它與 HIRA 及 UBN1 同為形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需的伴護蛋白複合體核心成員。

label: Nanog
description: Nanog is the central guardian and hallmark of the pluripotent state. Its expression defines naive pluripotency maintenance.
description_zh_TW: Nanog 是多能性狀態的核心守護者與標誌。其表現定義初始多能性的維持。

label: Vimentin
description: Vimentin acting on Dectin-1 followed by HMGB1 restimulation creates a TRIM response comparable to beta-glucan, relevant to post-transplant ischemia-reperfusion injury. Myeloid-specific mTOR-inhibiting nanobiologics (mTORi-HDL/rapamycin) prevent this training and reduce graft-macrophage LPS recall. It links sterile transplant DAMPs to actionable mTOR-dependent memory.
description_zh_TW: 作用於 Dectin-1 的 Vimentin 接續 HMGB1 再刺激，可產生與 beta-glucan 相當的 TRIM 反應，與移植後 ischemia-reperfusion injury 相關。Myeloid-specific mTOR-inhibiting nanobiologics（mTORi-HDL/rapamycin）可阻止此訓練並降低 graft-macrophage 的 LPS recall。這將無菌移植 DAMPs 與可操作的 mTOR-dependent memory 連結起來。

label: Renal Cell Carcinoma
description: Xp11 translocation RCC is a renal cell carcinoma subtype.
description_zh_TW: Xp11 易位 RCC 是腎細胞癌亞型。

label: Caspases
description: Multiple caspases redundantly cleave SIRT1 at the C-terminal DEPDVP(704-709) motif under severe DNA damage. Only pan-caspase inhibitors (Q-VD-OPh, Boc-D-FMK, z-VAD) blocked cleavage, while individual knockdown of CASP1-9 failed — the cleavage is distributed across the cascade. The D707A point mutant resists cleavage and the ΔC703 truncation mimics the cleaved fragment. Caspase-mediated SIRT1 cleavage places it in the DDR-cleavage set alongside PARP, DNA-PKcs, and ATM itself — dismantling the repair machinery commits the cell to death.
description_zh_TW: 在嚴重 DNA 損傷下，多種 caspases 會以冗餘方式在 SIRT1 的 C 端 DEPDVP(704-709) 基序進行切割。只有廣效 caspase 抑制劑（Q-VD-OPh、Boc-D-FMK、z-VAD）能阻斷切割，個別沉默 CASP1-9 皆無效——切割分布在整個級聯中。D707A 點突變可抵抗切割，ΔC703 截斷則模擬被切割的片段。caspase 對 SIRT1 的切割使其與 PARP、DNA-PKcs 及 ATM 本身同列於 DDR 切割組——拆解修復機器等同讓細胞走向死亡。

label: Super-enhancer
description: Many SASP-associated genes are linked to super-enhancer-like regions that are particularly sensitive to changes in histone acetylation, and such loci probably require sustained acetyl-CoA availability to maintain high transcriptional output, rendering them especially vulnerable to interventions that limit acetyl-CoA supply. SLC25A1 inhibition reduces chromatin accessibility at these SASP loci both in vitro and in vivo, selectively suppressing inflammatory gene expression. This positions mitochondrial metabolism as an upstream determinant of chromatin accessibility in senescent cells, aligning with previous reports linking citrate metabolism to SASP regulation.
description_zh_TW: 許多與SASP相關的基因與超增強子樣區域相關，這些區域對組蛋白乙酰化變化特別敏感，並且這些位點可能需要持續的乙酰輔酶A可用性來維持高轉錄輸出，使其特別容易受到限制乙酰輔酶A供應的干預措施的影響。SLC25A1抑製在體外和體內都減少了這些SASP位點的染色質可及性，選擇性地抑制炎症基因表達。這將線粒體代謝定位為衰老細胞中染色質可及性的上游決定因素，與先前將枸櫞酸代謝與SASP調節相關聯的報告一致。

label: Mitochondrial Fusion
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through fusion and fission, two opposing yet coordinated processes that determine mitochondrial number, shape and function. Fusion joins two organelles into a tubular network, enabling content exchange, dilution of mutated mtDNA and superoxide, and maintenance of genetic and biochemical homogeneity; it proceeds through membrane tethering, outer membrane fusion and inner membrane fusion. Fusion is orchestrated by the dynamin-related GTPases MFN1 and MFN2 for the outer membrane and OPA1 for the inner membrane, and must be balanced with fission to sustain mitochondrial homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fusion and fission 兩個 opposing yet coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，determining mitochondrial number, shape and function。Fusion joins two organelles into a tubular network，enabling content exchange, dilution of mutated mtDNA and superoxide，and maintenance of genetic and biochemical homogeneity；it proceeds through membrane tethering, outer membrane fusion and inner membrane fusion。Fusion is orchestrated by the dynamin-related GTPases MFN1 and MFN2 for the outer membrane and OPA1 for the inner membrane，and must be balanced with fission to sustain mitochondrial homeostasis。

label: Epigenetic Remodeling
description: Yamanaka factors rewind developmental and aging methyl marks with demethylase dependence.
description_zh_TW: 山中因子回撥發育與老化甲基標記，依賴去甲基酶。

label: ATM
description: Replication-dependent DSBs recruit ATM signaling under camptothecin. Kinase activation is the damage readout.
description_zh_TW: 複製依賴的 DSB 在 camptothecin 下招募 ATM 訊號。激酶活化是損傷讀值。

label: Oct4
description: The pluripotency factor Oct4 represses XIST in stem cells.
description_zh_TW: 多能性因子 Oct4 在幹細胞抑制 XIST。

label: Irisin
description: Irisin, the exercise-induced FNDC5 cleavage product, exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects in diabetic periodontitis models that require SIRT3: lentiviral SIRT3 silencing abolishes its protection against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction, establishing SIRT3 as the obligatory signaling node.
description_zh_TW: Irisin 是運動誘導的 FNDC5 裂解產物，在糖尿病牙周炎模型中發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用需要 SIRT3：慢病毒 SIRT3 沉默消除其對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的保護，確立 SIRT3 為必要訊號節點。

label: ICE Mouse
description: Double-strand-break induction in the ICE Mouse shifts the epigenetic (DNA-methylation) clock, consistent with chromatin modifiers such as SIRT1 relocalizing away from native sites during repair. Directionally, double-strand-break repair sits upstream of clock acceleration. This provides a quantitative readout of epigenetic drift, and it links the RCM model to measurable aging biomarkers. By demonstrating that DNA damage alone can advance the epigenetic clock, the ICE Mouse connects the loss of epigenetic information to the rate of aging. This finding supports the use of DNA-methylation clocks as indicators of biological age.
description_zh_TW: ICE 小鼠中的雙鏈斷裂誘導改變了表觀遺傳（DNA 甲基化）時鐘，與染色質修飾因子如 SIRT1 在修復期間從原始位點重新定位一致。在方向性上，雙鏈斷裂修復位於時鐘加速的上游。這提供了表觀遺傳漂變的量化讀數，並將 RCM 模型與可測量的衰老生物標誌物聯繫起來。透過證明僅 DNA 損傷就能推進表觀遺傳時鐘，ICE 小鼠將表觀遺傳資訊的喪失與衰老速率聯繫起來。此發現支持使用 DNA 甲基化時鐘作為生物年齡的指標。

label: melittin
description: Honeybee venom is a complex mixture whose major peptide component is melittin (~50% of dry weight), the principal anticancer effector.
description_zh_TW: Honeybee venom 是複雜混合物，其主要胜肽成分為 melittin（約佔乾重 50%），是主要的抗癌效應物。

label: D1 receptor
description: D1 is a Gs-coupled excitatory dopamine receptor driving direct-pathway facilitation, the mirror of Gi-coupled inhibitory D2. This excitatory character explains its pro-movement and reward signaling.
description_zh_TW: D1 是 Gs 耦合的興奮性多巴胺受體，驅動直接路徑的促進，與 Gi 耦合的抑制性 D2 互為鏡像。此興奮特性解釋其促運動與獎賞訊號。

label: c-Met
description: HGF is the sole high-affinity ligand activating the c-Met receptor. Ligand-receptor exclusivity defines the module.
description_zh_TW: HGF 是活化 c-Met 受體的唯一高親和力配體。配體—受體專一性定義模組。

label: miR-543
description: DNA Methylation governs the expression of miR-543 through the imprinted DLK1-DIO3 cluster on chromosome 14q32 that hosts the microRNA; parent-of-origin methylation controls the locus, making miR-543 both an effector and a sensor of the epigenome and linking epigenetic drift to the SIRT1-NF-kB inflammatory axis.
description_zh_TW: DNA Methylation 透過位於染色體 14q32 上、帶有親源印記的 DLK1-DIO3 基因叢調控 miR-543 的表現；該基因座由親源甲基化控制，使 miR-543 既是表觀基因組的效應分子也是感應分子，並將表觀遺傳漂變與 SIRT1-NF-kB 發炎軸相連。

label: Neutrophils
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: IL-8 is the primary neutrophil chemoattractant acting through CXCR1/2. Recruitment is its defining immune function.
description_zh_TW: IL-8 是經由 CXCR1/2 作用的主要嗜中性球趨化因子。招募是其定義性免疫功能。

label: Methylglyoxal
description: The bifunctional hydrazine terminus of aminoguanidine scavenges dicarbonyl methylglyoxal. Scavenging intercepts the glycation intermediate.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 的雙功能肼末端清除二羰基 methylglyoxal。清除攔截糖化中間體。

label: Bak
description: A1-Bfl-1 sequesters the effector Bak, blocking MOMP execution.
description_zh_TW: A1-Bfl-1 隔離效應器 Bak，阻斷 MOMP 執行。

label: Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci
description: ASF1a is a core member of the HIRA chaperone complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). By delivering newly synthesized H3–H4 dimers to HIRA/UBN1, ASF1a supports the heterochromatic compaction that accompanies permanent growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: ASF1a 是形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需之 HIRA 伴護蛋白複合體的核心成員。透過將新合成的 H3–H4 二聚體交給 HIRA/UBN1，ASF1a 支持伴隨永久生長停滯的異染色質壓縮。

label: EMT
description: Constitutive Wnt sustains EMT, stemness and therapy resistance.
description_zh_TW: 持續性 Wnt 維持 EMT、幹性與治療抗性。

label: Vitamin E
description: Alpha-tocopherol donates phenolic hydrogen to lipid peroxyl radicals at near diffusion rates, terminating chain propagation. Scavenging is the chain-breaking antioxidant act.
description_zh_TW: α-生育酚以近擴散速率向脂質過氧自由基提供酚氫，終止鏈傳播。清除是斷鏈抗氧化作用。

label: Paclitaxel
description: Post-arrest death induction follows paclitaxel spindle stabilization.
description_zh_TW: paclitaxel 紡錘體穩定後接續停滯後死亡誘發。

label: PARG
description: PARG53 is a catalytically active ~53-kDa splice isoform of PARG (exons 1-8) described in 2026; its existence revises the prior PARG55/60 annotation and explains why exon 2-7 knockout clones can retain PAR-hydrolytic activity and still die, confounding knockout-versus-inhibitor comparisons (bioRxiv 2026.05.12.724507).
description_zh_TW: PARG53 是 2026 年描述的 PARG 具催化活性之約 53 kDa 剪接異構體（外顯子 1-8）；其存在修正了先前的 PARG55/60 註解，並解釋為何外顯子 2-7 敲除株仍可保留 PAR 水解活性並死亡，因而混淆了敲除與抑制劑的比較（bioRxiv 2026.05.12.724507）。

label: Chromatin
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: NuRD compacts chromatin substrate, paralleling the Deacetylation-condenses-Chromatin edge. Condensation is the structural output.
description_zh_TW: NuRD 壓縮染色質受質，與去乙醯化濃縮染色質邊平行。濃縮是結構輸出。

label: Ubiquitination
description: Ubiquitination is a definitional post-translational protein modification.
description_zh_TW: 泛素化是定義性的轉譯後蛋白修飾。

label: Mitochondrial DNA
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Cytosolic mtDNA engages TLR9/MyD88 and STING stress responses that intersect with autophagy and inhibit mTOR, favoring an autophagy-high, OXPHOS/FAO-biased tolerant state. Clinically, elevated circulating mtDNA after myocardial infarction or stroke associates with monocyte endotoxin tolerance and post-injury infection risk. It frames mitochondrial DAMPs as tolerogenic rather than classic trainers.
description_zh_TW: 胞質 Mitochondrial DNA 接合 TLR9/MyD88 與 STING stress responses，與 autophagy 交會並抑制 mTOR，偏向 autophagy-high、OXPHOS/FAO 為主的 tolerant state。臨床上，心肌梗塞或中風後循環中升高的 Mitochondrial DNA 與單核球 endotoxin tolerance 及傷後感染風險相關。這將 mitochondrial DAMPs 定位為 tolerogenic 而非典型 trainers。

label: Activin A
description: Activin A engagement of ALK4 with type II receptors drives phosphorylation of SMAD3 alongside SMAD2, which then complexes with SMAD4 for nuclear translocation. Phospho-SMAD3 directly transactivates CDKN2B/p15INK4b to enforce paracrine growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: Activin A 經 ALK4 與第二型受體結合，驅動 SMAD3 與 SMAD2 的磷酸化，隨後與 SMAD4 形成複合體轉位入核。磷酸化 SMAD3 直接轉活化 CDKN2B/p15INK4b 以執行旁分泌生長停滯。

label: Amadori products
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Fructosamine-3-kinase phosphorylates early Amadori products for deglycation, distinct from the existing fructosamine edge. Phosphorylation is the enzymatic removal route.
description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-3-激酶磷酸化早期 Amadori 產物以去糖化，不同於既有的果糖胺邊。磷酸化是酶促移除路徑。

label: Proton Leak
description: Proton leak is the passive return of protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane, bypassing ATP synthase. Localization defines the chemiosmotic short-circuit.
description_zh_TW: 質子漏是質子跨內粒線體膜的被動回流，繞過 ATP 合酶。定位定義化學滲透短路。

label: Pyroptosis
description: Gasdermin D pore execution downstream of caspase-1 induces pyroptosis. Induction is the lytic-death output.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-1 下游 Gasdermin D 孔道執行誘發焦亡。誘發是裂解死亡輸出。

label: Small-cell lung cancer
description: Small-cell lung cancer is treated with Chemotherapy. Platinum-based chemotherapy is the backbone of SCLC treatment: concurrent platinum plus etoposide with thoracic radiotherapy for limited-stage disease, and platinum-based chemotherapy combined with a PD-L1 inhibitor for extensive-stage disease.
description_zh_TW: 小細胞肺癌（Small-cell lung cancer）以化療（Chemotherapy）治療。含鉑化療是 SCLC 治療的骨幹：侷限期以含鉑加 etoposide 並合併胸部放射治療，廣泛期則以含鉑化療合併 PD-L1 抑制劑治療。

label: Asthma
description: Bromotyrosine adducts are elevated in allergic airway disease, marking eosinophil oxidant activity. Association records the airway biomarker link.
description_zh_TW: 過敏性氣道疾病中 bromotyrosine 加合物升高，標記嗜酸性球氧化劑活性。關聯記錄氣道生物標記連結。

label: Collagen
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Fibroblasts secrete collagen types one, three and five as structural matrix.
description_zh_TW: 纖維母細胞分泌第一、三、五型膠原作為結構基質。

label: Senomorphic
description: JAK-STAT3 signaling is a major driver of the pro-inflammatory SASP, and its inhibition is a senomorphic strategy that dampens SASP while sparing the growth arrest. This makes the JAK-STAT axis a target for senomorphic interventions.
description_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 訊號是促發炎 SASP 的主要驅動者，其抑制是壓制 SASP 同時保留生長停滯的 senomorphic（促衰老表型調節）策略。這使 JAK-STAT 軸成為 senomorphic 介入的標靶。

label: GATOR2
description: GATOR2 suppresses GATOR1 GAP activity when amino acids are abundant. Inhibition is the sufficiency release.
description_zh_TW: GATOR2 在胺基酸充足時抑制 GATOR1 GAP 活性。抑制是充足釋放。

label: SMAD Proteins
description: BMP signals transduce via SMAD1/5/8 plus SMAD4 central mediators. SMAD usage places BMP in the TGF-beta superfamily logic.
description_zh_TW: BMP 經由 SMAD1/5/8 加 SMAD4 中央介體傳訊。SMAD 使用將 BMP 置於 TGF-beta 超家族邏輯。

label: Females
description: Telomere length is sex-dimorphic from birth: females have longer telomeres at every age with a slower attrition rate (~26 bp/yr vs ~43 bp/yr in males; standardized sex difference +0.090 across 36 cohorts, n=36,230; Gardner et al., Exp Gerontol 2014). Mechanisms include pre-implantation biallelic expression of the X-linked telomerase component DKC1 (Lansdorp 2022), estrogen-driven TERT activation, and estrogen's antioxidant protection of telomeric DNA.
description_zh_TW: 端粒長度自出生即具性別雙型性：女性在每個年齡的端粒皆較長，磨耗率較慢（每年約 26 bp，男性約 43 bp；36 個世代、36,230 人標準化性別差異 +0.090；Gardner 等，Exp Gerontol 2014）。機制包括著床前 X 染色體連結端粒酶成分 DKC1 的雙對偶基因表現（Lansdorp 2022）、雌激素驅動的 TERT 活化，以及雌激素對端粒 DNA 的抗氧化保護。

label: Cytochrome c
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Cytosolic Cytochrome c binds Apaf-1 (with dATP/ATP), triggering the conformational change and oligomerization that assembles the apoptosome.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質 Cytochrome c 結合 Apaf-1（與 dATP/ATP），觸發構形改變與寡聚化以組裝 Apoptosome。

label: Oxidized LDL
description: Brief oxLDL exposure trains human monocytes so that TLR2/TLR4 restimulation elicits amplified TNF-alpha and IL-6. This training depends on Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling, since Torin1 or Raptor/Rictor silencing abolishes the trained cytokine response. It exemplifies DAMP-driven immunometabolic rewiring shared with beta-glucan training.
description_zh_TW: 短暫的 Oxidized LDL 暴露可訓練人類單核球，使 TLR2/TLR4 再刺激時產生放大的 TNF-alpha 與 IL-6。此訓練依賴 Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling，因為 Torin1 或 Raptor/Rictor 沉默可消除訓練後的細胞激素反應。這是與 beta-glucan 訓練共用的 DAMP-driven immunometabolic rewiring 範例。

label: let-7 microRNA
description: let-7 tunes translation efficiency through 3-prime UTR targeting.
description_zh_TW: let-7 經由 3' UTR 標靶調節轉譯效率。

label: EGFR
description: Erlotinib selectively blocks the EGFR ATP pocket, mirroring the melittin edge.
description_zh_TW: erlotinib 選擇性阻斷 EGFR ATP 口袋，呼應 melittin 邊。

label: Nigrostriatal System
description: PET is the primary in-vivo window into nigrostriatal integrity via presynaptic dopaminergic tracers. Association records the imaging-target relationship.
description_zh_TW: PET 經由突觸前多巴胺能追蹤劑成為黑質紋狀體完整性的主要體內窗口。關聯記錄影像與標的關係。

label: Senolytic Therapy
description: SCAPs (senescence-cell anti-apoptotic pathways) are the ensemble of pro-survival mechanisms that allow senescent cells to persist despite SASP and DNA damage. Senolytic therapies kill senescent cells by targeting these anti-apoptotic pathways.
description_zh_TW: SCAPs（衰老細胞抗凋亡途徑）是讓衰老細胞儘管有 SASP 與 DNA 損傷仍能存續的促存活機制總和。Senolytic 療法透過靶向這些抗凋亡途徑殺死衰老細胞。

label: FOXO
description: SIRT2 activates FOXO via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 FOXO（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

label: Minority MOMP
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: In senescent cells only fragmented mitochondria are BAX6A7-positive and release TFAM-bound mtDNA; DRP1-driven fission licenses this minority MOMP event, while hyperfusion protects by homogenizing Bcl-2 across the network.
description_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，只有片段化的粒線體呈 BAX6A7 陽性並釋放 TFAM 結合的 mtDNA；DRP1 驅動的分裂促使這種 minority MOMP，而高度融合則透過均質化 Bcl-2 來保護。

label: DNMT3a
description: miR-29b targets DNMT3a; its loss reinforces leukemic hypermethylation.
description_zh_TW: miR-29b 標靶 DNMT3a；其缺失強化白血病高甲基化。

label: GPX4
description: The catalytic selenocysteine is essential for GPX4 peroxidase activity. Requirement links mevalonate-pathway tRNA maturation to ferroptosis defense.
description_zh_TW: 催化性硒半胱胺酸對 GPX4 過氧化酶活性必要。必要性將甲羥戊酸路徑 tRNA 成熟連結到鐵死亡防禦。

label: Olivopontocerebellar Atrophy
description: Gait and limb ataxia is the cardinal manifestation of olivopontocerebellar atrophy.
description_zh_TW: 步態與肢體共濟失調是橄欖橋腦小腦萎縮的主要表現。

label: MXL-3
description: MXL-3 is the repressor arm limiting lipolysis under fed conditions. Repression is the fed-off direction.
description_zh_TW: MXL-3 是在進食下限制脂解的抑制臂。抑制是進食關閉方向。

label: FAK Signaling
description: FAK-dependent adhesion turnover is the core motility process. Promotion is the defining FAK output.
description_zh_TW: FAK 依賴的黏附更新是核心遷移過程。促進是定義性的 FAK 輸出。

label: Sister Chromatids
description: Sister chromatids are generated during S-phase genome duplication.
description_zh_TW: 姐妹染色單體在 S 期基因組複製產生。

label: VEGFc
description: VEGF-C is a lymphangiogenic member of the VEGF family.
description_zh_TW: VEGF-C 是 VEGF 家族的淋巴管生成成員。

label: Catechols
description: Catechols are inactivated by COMT-mediated O-methylation, a reaction that consumes one methyl group (transferred from SAMe) per catechol molecule. When exogenous catechols such as high-dose Quercetin, Fisetin, Luteolin, or green-tea EGCG are introduced in slow-COMT individuals, the added substrate load raises methyl-group demand on the Methylation Cycle, the pathway that regenerates SAMe from homocysteine remethylation. Sustained catechol load can therefore tax methylation capacity, linking catechol exposure to methyl-donor burden and explaining why catechol-rich supplements are often poorly tolerated in slow COMT carriers.
description_zh_TW: Catechols 藉由 COMT 催化的 O-甲基化反應被去活化，每個 catechol 分子消耗一個由 SAMe 轉移的甲基。當慢速 COMT 個體攝入外源性 catechols（如高劑量 Quercetin、Fisetin、Luteolin 或綠茶 EGCG）時，增加的受質負荷會提高 Methylation Cycle 的甲基需求，而 Methylation Cycle 是藉由 homocysteine 再甲基化再生 SAMe 的路徑。持續的 catechol 負荷因此可能耗損甲基化能力，將 catechol 暴露與甲基供體負擔連結起來，也解釋了為何富含 catechol 的補充劑在慢速 COMT 帶原者中常不易耐受。

label: Teratoma
description: Embryonic stem cells are assayed via teratoma formation as gold-standard trilineage proof.
description_zh_TW: 胚胎幹細胞經由畸胎瘤形成測定，作為三胚層黃金標準證據。

label: Iron
description: Eumelanin binds iron within neuromelanin granules, contributing to metal sequestration. Binding parallels the neuromelanin-iron chelation axis.
description_zh_TW: Eumelanin 在 neuromelanin 顆粒內結合鐵，促成金屬隔離。結合呼應 neuromelanin-鐵螯合軸。

label: miR-378
description: miR-378a is encoded within the first intron of the PPARGC1B gene (PGC-1beta) on chromosome 5q32. Because it sits inside the metabolic master regulator locus, its dysregulation couples mitochondrial metabolic decline with the SIRT1-NF-kB inflammatory axis.
description_zh_TW: miR-378a 編碼在染色體 5q32 的 PPARGC1B 基因（PGC-1beta）第一個內含子中。由於它位於代謝主調控基因座內，其失調將粒線體代謝衰退與 SIRT1-NF-kB 發炎軸耦合起來。

label: LC3
description: Atg7 is the E1-like enzyme that activates LC3-I for phosphatidylethanolamine conjugation to LC3-II, the lipidation step required for autophagosome elongation and closure.
description_zh_TW: Atg7 是 E1 樣酶，活化 LC3-I 以接合 phosphatidylethanolamine 形成 LC3-II，此脂化步驟是自噬體延長與閉合所必需。

label: Tissue Repair
description: Engineered constructs augment endogenous healing of damaged tissue.
description_zh_TW: 工程化構建體增強受損組織的內源癒合。

label: Caspase-1
description: ASC polymerizes into specks that recruit pro-Caspase-1 via CARD interactions, enabling proximity-induced activation that cleaves Gasdermin D and pro-IL-1β/IL-18.
description_zh_TW: ASC 聚合成 specks，透過 CARD 相互作用招募 pro-Caspase-1，促成鄰近誘導活化，進而切割 Gasdermin D 與 pro-IL-1β/IL-18。

label: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine
description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine is the concrete carbonyl plus aminoguanidine condensation embodiment of the class. Membership instantiates the reaction product.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 是羰基加 aminoguanidine 縮合的具體體現。成員關係實例化反應產物。

label: Transcription Factor
description: Transcription factors bind promoter/enhancer DNA to control gene output. Definitional regulator-to-process edge.
description_zh_TW: 轉錄因子結合啟動子/增強子 DNA 以控制基因輸出。定義性調節者到過程邊。

label: Beclin1
description: Beclin 1 is a core autophagy protein and a haploinsufficient tumor suppressor whose monoallelic deletion is frequently observed in human ovarian, breast, and prostate cancers. Loss of one BECN1 allele reduces autophagic flux, increasing susceptibility to oxidative damage, genomic instability, and inflammation that favor tumor initiation. Mechanistically, Beclin 1 functions as the scaffold of the PI3K III nucleation complex, and its interaction with Bcl-2 family members further couples autophagy to apoptotic regulation. Its frequent deletion in epithelial cancers established autophagy as a genuine tumor-suppression pathway.
description_zh_TW: Beclin 1是一種核心自噬蛋白和單倍體不足型腫瘤抑制因子，其單等位基因缺失常見於人類卵巢癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌。失去一個BECN1等位基因會降低自噬流，增加對氧化損傷、基因組不穩定和發炎的易感性，有利於腫瘤起始。在機制上，Beclin 1作為PI3K III成核複合體的支架，其與Bcl-2家族成員的交互作用進一步將自噬與凋亡調控耦合。它在上皮癌中的頻繁缺失確立了自噬作為一條真正的腫瘤抑制途徑。

label: AGK2
description: AGK2 liberates caspase-2/3-dependent apoptosis in nucleated cells, engaging sirtuin-caspase crosstalk. In platelets it instead triggers caspase-independent calpain-mediated death.
description_zh_TW: AGK2 在有核細胞中釋放依賴 caspase-2/3 的細胞凋亡，啟動 sirtuin-caspase 交互作用；而在血小板中則改為觸發不依賴 caspase 的 calpain 介導細胞死亡。

label: Complex I
description: HPP+ accumulates in mitochondria via dopamine transporter uptake and inhibits complex I of the electron transport chain, mirroring MPP+ toxicity. Complex I blockade drives oxidative injury in nigral neurons.
description_zh_TW: HPP+ 經多巴胺轉運蛋白攝取累積於粒線體，抑制電子傳遞鏈複合體 I，呼應 MPP+ 毒性。複合體 I 阻斷驅動黑質神經元氧化損傷。

label: Gemcitabine
description: Gemcitabine's diphosphate (dFdCDP) irreversibly inactivates the RRM1 subunit of ribonucleotide reductase and depletes dNTP pools, especially dCTP, self-potentiating its own incorporation into DNA. This makes RNR a central target of gemcitabine's anticancer action.
description_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 的二磷酸形式（dFdCDP）會不可逆地使核醣核苷酸還原酶的 RRM1 次單元失活，並耗竭 dNTP 池（尤其是 dCTP），自我增強其嵌入 DNA。這使 RNR 成為 Gemcitabine 抗癌作用的中心靶點。

label: NAMPT
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NAMPT (nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase) is the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway, converting nicotinamide into nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) in an energetically costly step. NAMPT activity therefore determines how much NAD+ precursor is available to fuel sirtuins and other NAD+-consuming enzymes such as CD38 and the poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases. Directionally, NAMPT sits upstream of NAD+ pool size and sirtuin activity. Because NAMPT couples cellular energy state to NAD+ biosynthesis, it is a primary node linking metabolism to sirtuin function and a key target for interventions aimed at restoring NAD+ during aging.
description_zh_TW: NAMPT（菸鹼醯胺磷酸核糖轉移酶）是NAD+補救合成途徑的限速酶，在一個耗能的步驟中將菸鹼醯胺轉化為菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）。因此NAMPT活性決定了有多少NAD+前體可用於驅動sirtuin和其他NAD+消耗酶（如CD38和多聚ADP-核糖聚合酶）。方向上，NAMPT位於NAD+池大小和sirtuin活性的上游。因為NAMPT將細胞能量狀態與NAD+生物合成耦合，它是連結代謝與sirtuin功能的主要節點，也是旨在恢復老化過程中NAD+的介入措施的關鍵靶點。

label: IL-8
description: IL-8 is the primary neutrophil chemoattractant acting through CXCR1/2. Recruitment is its defining immune function.
description_zh_TW: IL-8 是經由 CXCR1/2 作用的主要嗜中性球趨化因子。招募是其定義性免疫功能。

label: MITF
description: MITF induces CTSK along with CLCN7/OSTM1/ACP5 in osteoclasts. Regulation is the osteoclast program.
description_zh_TW: MITF 在蝕骨細胞誘發 CTSK 及 CLCN7/OSTM1/ACP5。調節是蝕骨程序。

label: Atg15
description: Yeast Atg15 lipase degrades autophagic-body and lipid-droplet lipids in the vacuole; loss causes droplet accumulation and starvation inviability. Promotion is the vacuolar lipase output.
description_zh_TW: 酵母 Atg15 脂肪酶在液泡降解自噬體與脂滴脂質；缺失導致脂滴累積與飢餓致死。促進是液泡脂肪酶輸出。

label: Innate Immunity
description: B18R creates an immunosuppressive microenvironment enabling viral spread.
description_zh_TW: B18R 創造免疫抑制微環境促成病毒擴散。

label: Lymphoma
description: DLBCL is an aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtype.
description_zh_TW: DLBCL 是侵襲性 B 細胞非何杰金淋巴瘤亞型。

label: ELK4
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ELK4 (SAP-1) belongs to the ETS-domain ternary complex factor (TCF) subfamily of transcription factors, defined by a conserved ETS DNA-binding domain. Within sirtuin biology, ELK4 is notable for interacting with SIRT7 and stabilizing the deacetylase at target gene promoters, where SIRT7 deacetylates lysine 18 of histone H3 and represses tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, ELK4's identity as an ETS factor underlies its promoter-targeting function. This links the ETS transcription factor family to the pro-oncogenic SIRT7-H3K18ac axis in cancer.
description_zh_TW: ELK4（SAP-1）屬於 ETS 結構域三元複合物因子（TCF）轉錄因子亞家族，其特徵是保守的 ETS DNA 結合結構域。在 sirtuin 生物學中，ELK4 因與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處而引人注目，在那裡 SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。方向性上 ELK4 作為 ETS 因子的身份奠定了其啟動子靶向功能。這將 ETS 轉錄因子家族與癌症中的促致癌 SIRT7-H3K18ac 軸線聯繫起來。

label: Ferritin
description: Apo-aconitase is Iron Regulatory Protein 1, which binds the ferritin iron-responsive element repressing translation. Cluster loss switches enzyme to RNA regulator.
description_zh_TW: 脫輔基 aconitase 即 Iron Regulatory Protein 1，結合 ferritin 鐵反應元件抑制轉譯。簇缺失將酶切換為 RNA 調節因子。

label: Phosphorylation
description: Phosphorylation is a definitional post-translational protein modification.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸化是定義性的轉譯後蛋白修飾。

label: SIRT3 deficiency
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: In mice and cultured cells, SIRT3 deficiency favors cell transformation in response to oncogenic Ras or Myc, and the same loss stabilizes HIF-1α with consequent induction of the glycolytic program of the Warburg effect. Because SIRT3 normally governs mitochondrial metabolism, ROS production, and genome stability, its absence releases a permissive environment for oncogenic signaling and metabolic reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT3 acts upstream: reduced SIRT3 allows transformation and Warburg metabolism to proceed, defining its tumor-suppressive role in this context.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠和培養細胞中，SIRT3 缺乏有利於致癌性 Ras 或 Myc 引起的細胞轉化，且同一缺失穩定 HIF-1α 並導致 Warburg 效應的糖酵解程序誘導。由於 SIRT3 正常情況下掌控粒線體代謝、活性氧生成和基因組穩定性，其缺失釋放了一個允許致癌訊號和代謝重編程的環境。方向性上 SIRT3 位於上游：SIRT3 降低允許轉化和 Warburg 代謝進行，定義了其在此情境下的腫瘤抑制角色。

label: Adenosylcobalamin
description: Adenosylcobalamin is one of two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12 (cobalamin), alongside methylcobalamin, serving as an essential cofactor for mitochondrial enzymes in the methionine and methylmalonyl-CoA metabolic pathways. Unlike methylcobalamin, it does not donate a methyl group directly to the methylation cycle, so it does not contribute to the body's methyl burden. This distinction makes adenosylcobalamin particularly relevant for individuals with slow COMT activity, who may be sensitive to methyl-donating B12 forms.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 是維生素 B12（鈷胺素）的兩種活性輔酶形式之一，與甲鈷胺一起，作為蛋氨酸和甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 代謝途徑中線粒體酶的重要輔助因子。與甲鈷胺不同，它不會直接向 methylation cycle 提供甲基，因此不會增加人體的甲基負擔。這種區別使得腺苷鈷胺素對於 COMT activity 緩慢的個體特別重要，他們可能對甲基供體 B12 形式敏感。

label: COMT Val158 allele
source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md
description: The COMT Val158 allele increases the thermostability of the enzyme, thereby increasing its level of activity compared to the 158 Met allele. This higher activity increases dopamine turnover in cortical synapses. A common polymorphism resulting in increased COMT activity has been associated with poorer cognitive performance and increased susceptibility to psychiatric disorders.
description_zh_TW: COMT Val158 等位基因增加酶的熱穩定性，從而相對於 158 Met 等位基因提高其活性水平。這種較高的活性增加皮質突觸的多巴胺代謝。導致 COMT activity 增加的常見多態性已與較差的認知表現和精神疾病易感性增加相關。

label: Physical Activity
description: The doubly labelled water (DLW) technique is the gold-standard method for measuring total daily energy expenditure and the physical activity component of the energy budget in free-living humans. Subjects drink water labeled with the stable isotopes deuterium and oxygen-18; carbon dioxide production is calculated from the differential loss rates of the two isotopes, and energy expenditure is derived using standard equations. In the studies reviewed by Speakman, DLW has been used to quantify total daily energy expenditure (TEE) over 7-14 day periods, showing that within-individual day-to-day variability of TEE is small even when physical activity varies.
description_zh_TW: 雙標記水（DLW）技術是測量自由生活人類每日總能量支出和能量預算中體力活動成分的黃金標準方法。受試者飲用含有穩定同位素氘和氧-18標記的水；二氧化碳產生量根據兩種同位素的差異損失率計算，能量支出使用標準方程式得出。在Speakman回顧的研究中，DLW被用於量化7-14天期間的每日總能量支出（TEE），顯示即使體力活動變化，個體內每日TEE變異性也很小。

label: LXRα
description: ABCA1 is regulated by LXRalpha, as the nuclear receptor directly drives ABCA1 transcription in response to oxysterol ligands, coordinating cholesterol efflux. This places ABCA1 downstream of LXR-controlled reverse-cholesterol-transport programs. The directionality is LXRalpha activation to ABCA1 expression. A caveat is that PPARgamma and other transcription factors also regulate ABCA1, so LXRalpha is a major but not exclusive controller. This LXR-ABCA1 axis is also redox-responsive, since oxidative modifications of LDL generate LXR ligands that upregulate the transporter as a protective response.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 受 LXRalpha 調節，因為核受體響應氧甾醇配體直接驅動 ABCA1 轉錄，協調 cholesterol 流出。這將 ABCA1 置於 LXR 控制的反向 cholesterol 傳輸程式的下游。方向性是LXRalpha活化至ABCA1表達。需要注意的是，PPARgamma 和其他轉錄因子也調節 ABCA1，因此 LXRalpha 是主要但不是唯一的控制者。此 LXR-ABCA1 軸也具有氧化還原反應性，因為 LDL 的氧化修飾會產生 LXR 配體，從而上調轉運蛋白作為保護性反應。

label: SIRT1 and SIRT2
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: GW5074, an indolinone compound originally developed as a c-Raf kinase inhibitor, was tested with other kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 because sirtuins and protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site. It showed SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory properties in the low micromolar range, placing it alongside the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 as a kinase-scaffold sirtuin inhibitor. Directionally, GW5074's scaffold enables engagement of the sirtuin NAD+ pocket. Its continued kinase activity complicates interpretation in cells, underscoring the value of structure-based follow-up for selectivity.
description_zh_TW: GW5074 最初是作為 c-Raf 激酶抑制劑開發的吲哚啉酮化合物，與其他激酶抑制劑一起被測試對 SIRT2 的活性，因為 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點。它在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制特性，與雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 一起被歸類為激酶骨架 sirtuin 抑制劑。方向性上 GW5074 的骨架結構使其能夠與 sirtuin NAD+ 口袋結合。其持續的激酶活性使細胞內的詮釋複雜化，凸顯了針對選擇性進行結構導向後續研究的價值。

label: Actin Cytoskeleton
description: Alpha-catenin mechanosensitively links the cadherin complex to actin filaments. Protein-level orphan edge, documented mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-catenin 以機械敏感方式將 cadherin 複合體連結到肌動蛋白絲。蛋白層級孤兒邊，機制有記載。

label: Mitochondrial Dynamics
description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through the two opposite but coordinated processes of fission and fusion, accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes. Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria and is driven by the dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by adaptor proteins. The balance between fission and fusion is tightly regulated by conserved GTPase proteins and must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fission and fusion 兩個相反但 coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes。Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria 並由 dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 driven，被 adaptor proteins recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane。Fission and fusion 之間的 balance 由 conserved GTPase proteins tightly regulated 且 must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function。

label: p16INK4A
description: p16INK4A binds CDK4 and prevents cyclin D association, blocking G1/S progression. This direct binding is the molecular basis of INK4-mediated arrest in senescence and quiescence.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4A 結合 CDK4 並阻止 cyclin D 結合，阻斷 G1/S 進展。此直接結合是衰老與靜止中 INK4 介導停滯的分子基礎。

label: ATM Kinase
description: Genotoxic stress signals through ATM to phosphorylate and activate c-ABL upstream of caspase-9.
description_zh_TW: 基因毒性壓力經 ATM 磷酸化並活化 c-ABL，位於 caspase-9 上游。

label: Cancer Stem Cells
description: Ivermectin preferentially targets and inhibits cancer stem cells, suppressing Nanog, Oct4, and Sox2 expression through the PAK1-STAT3 axis. This kills CSCs therapeutically in breast cancer but simultaneously lowers the reprogramming factors needed for Yamanaka-factor rejuvenation.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 優先標靶並抑制癌幹細胞，透過 PAK1-STAT3 軸抑制 Nanog、Oct4 與 Sox2 表現。這在乳癌中治療性地殺死 CSC，但同時降低 Yamanaka 因子回春所需的重編程因子。

label: Myeloid-Derived Suppressor Cells
description: SASP-derived GM-CSF, CCL2 and IL-6 jointly recruit and expand MDSCs in senescent and tumor tissue. This chemokine program links the secretome to immunosuppressive myeloid infiltration that blunts senescence surveillance.
description_zh_TW: SASP 衍生的 GM-CSF、CCL2 與 IL-6 共同在衰老與腫瘤組織招募並擴張 MDSC。此趨化因子程序將分泌組連結到削弱衰老監視的免疫抑制性骨髓浸潤。

label: PRDX6
description: Beyond ROS scavenging, NAC is a selective inhibitor of the peroxidase activity of PRDX6 (IC50 ~15.5 uM), a distinct antioxidant-enzyme interaction. This dual action underscores why NAC, used as a timed redox buffer in hormetic protocols, can also blunt adaptive signaling when taken chronically.
description_zh_TW: 除 ROS 清除外，NAC 是 PRDX6 過氧化物酶活性的選擇性抑制劑（IC50 ~15.5 uM），一種不同的抗氧化酵素交互作用。此雙重作用說明為何在促效應方案中使用作為定時 redox 緩衝的 NAC，長期服用時亦能減弱適應性訊號。

label: Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore
description: RIPK3-phosphorylated CaMKII drives mitochondrial dysfunction by promoting mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening, a RIPK3/CaMKII/mPTP axis implicated in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury, heart failure, and neurological injury (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: 受 RIPK3 磷酸化的 CaMKII 透過促進粒線體通透性轉換孔開啟而驅動粒線體功能障礙，此 RIPK3/CaMKII/mPTP 軸與心肌缺血再灌注損傷、心衰竭與神經損傷相關（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Extracellular Matrix
description: ECM-derived hydrogels provide scaffold and signaling context.
description_zh_TW: ECM 衍生水凝膠提供支架與訊號脈絡。

label: Resting Metabolic Rate
description: Proton leak accounts for roughly a fifth of resting oxygen consumption; as a component rather than a cause, association is the correct bucket. Leak sets basal metabolic floor.
description_zh_TW: 質子漏約佔靜息氧耗的五分之一；作為組分而非原因，關聯是正確的歸類。漏設定基礎代謝下限。

label: Rutin
description: Rutin is chemically quercetin-3-O-rutinoside, a glycosylated flavonol found in buckwheat, citrus peel, apples, and onions. It is used to support vascular integrity and is valued for antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its quercetin aglycone bears the catechol moiety that engages COMT.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 化學上為 quercetin-3-O-rutinoside，是一種糖基化黃酮醇，存在於蕎麥、柑橘皮、蘋果和洋蔥中。它用於支持血管完整性，並因其抗氧化和抗發炎特性而受重視。其槲皮素苷元帶有接合 COMT 的兒茶酚部分。

label: mTORC2
description: FKBP12 binds the FKBP12-FRB interface of mTOR and is the cofactor through which rapamycin-family drugs engage the mTOR complexes. While the canonical target is mTORC1, FKBP12-mediated engagement is also relevant to mTORC2 regulation by rapalogs.
description_zh_TW: FKBP12 結合 mTOR 的 FKBP12-FRB 介面，是 rapamycin 家族藥物參與 mTOR 複合體的輔因子。雖然典型目標是 mTORC1，FKBP12 介導的參與也與 rapalog 對 mTORC2 的調節相關。

label: Angiogenesis
description: The VEGF family canonically drives blood-vessel formation.
description_zh_TW: VEGF 家族典型驅動血管形成。

label: H3.3
description: H3.3 is a replication-independent histone variant deposited by dedicated chaperones, principally HIRA at gene bodies and enhancers. Because senescent cells have exited the cell cycle, H3.3 deposition becomes increasingly reliant on the HIRA complex.
description_zh_TW: H3.3 是非複製依賴的組蛋白變異體，由專屬伴護蛋白（主要是在基因體與增強子處的 HIRA）沉積。由於衰老細胞已退出細胞週期，H3.3 沉積日益依賴 HIRA 複合體。

label: Mitochondrial Permeability Transition
description: MPT is an independent regulated-necrosis program: cyclophilin D-dependent opening of the permeability transition pore; cyclophilin D-deficient mice are partially protected from organ ischemia-reperfusion injury.
description_zh_TW: MPT 是獨立的 regulated necrosis 程序：由 Cyclophilin D 依賴性之通透性轉換孔開啟所介導；Cyclophilin D 缺失小鼠在器官缺血–再灌注損傷中獲得部分保護。

label: DGCR8
description: DGCR8 and Drosha are substrate-recognition and catalytic partners of the Microprocessor, documented by RNAi and co-IP. Interaction is the complex assembly.
description_zh_TW: DGCR8 與 Drosha 是 Microprocessor 的受質辨識與催化夥伴，RNAi 與 co-IP 已記載。交互作用是複合體組裝。

label: Myeloperoxidase
description: Myeloperoxidase produces hypochlorous acid from hydrogen peroxide and chloride in activated neutrophils, mirroring the Eosinophil Peroxidase produces Hypobromous Acid pattern. Replacement for the malformed converts triple.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase 在活化嗜中性球由過氧化氫與氯化物產生次氯酸，呼應 Eosinophil Peroxidase 產生 Hypobromous Acid 模式。取代措辭不當的 converts triple。

label: Cyclopentenyl cytosine
description: Cyclopentenyl cytosine is a type of Antimetabolite: this synthetic cytidine nucleoside analog acts as a metabolic antagonist that depletes pyrimidine nucleotides, chiefly by inhibiting CTP synthetase, which underlies its candidate use in cancer chemotherapy and antiviral research.
description_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine 屬於 Antimetabolite（抗代謝物）的一種：此合成胞苷核苷類似物扮演代謝拮抗劑，主要透過抑制 CTP synthetase 耗竭嘧啶核苷酸，這是其在癌症化療與抗病毒研究中作為候選藥物的基礎。

label: Cerebellum
description: Cerebellar cortical output passes through the deep nuclei (dentate, interposed, fastigial) to shape motor commands. Containment records the output nuclei embedded within the cerebellum.
description_zh_TW: 小腦皮質輸出經深部核（齒狀、間位、頂核）以塑造運動指令。包含記錄嵌於小腦內的輸出核。

label: Catecholamines
description: Excess catecholamines drive beta-adrenergic calcium overload into delayed-afterdepolarization triggered activity. Contribution is the adrenergic arm.
description_zh_TW: 過量兒茶酚胺驅動 β 腎上腺素鈣超載進入延遲後去極化觸發活性。貢獻是腎上腺素分支。

label: HLA-E
description: SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8 jointly upregulate HLA-E, which engages NKG2A/CD94 to suppress NK and CD8 T-cell killing. This symmetric IL-8 leg mirrors the existing IL-6 triple and completes the SASP-driven immune-evasion loop.
description_zh_TW: SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8 共同上調 HLA-E，後者接合 NKG2A/CD94 以抑制 NK 與 CD8 T 細胞殺死。此對稱的 IL-8 路徑呼應既有 IL-6 triple，完整呈現 SASP 驅動的免疫逃脫迴圈。

label: ACSL4
description: ACSL4 loads polyunsaturated fatty acids into membrane phospholipids, the obligate peroxidation substrate of ferroptosis (Doll 2017). Without ACSL4 enrichment membranes resist iron-driven peroxidation.
description_zh_TW: ACSL4 將多元不飽和脂肪酸裝載入膜磷脂，即鐵死亡必要的過氧化受質（Doll 2017）。缺乏 ACSL4 富集，膜即抵抗鐵驅動的過氧化。

label: Metabolic Reprogramming
description: Cancer undergoes Metabolic Reprogramming. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Metabolic Reprogramming rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer經歷Metabolic Reprogramming。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Metabolic Reprogramming 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Metastasis
description: Integrins enable invasion and anchorage-independent survival.
description_zh_TW: Integrin 促成侵襲與非錨定依賴存活。

label: Sirtinol
description: Sirtinol, a hydroxynaphthaldehyde derivative discovered in a phenotypic screen, is active against multiple sirtuin isoforms and has cytotoxic activity against cancer cells of different origins, including breast, lung, prostate, and leukemia cell lines. This broad anticancer activity made sirtinol the founding member of the beta-naphthol inhibitor family and seeded structure-activity programs that produced salermide, cambinol, and splitomicin. Directionally, sirtinol-mediated inhibition of sirtuin activity sits upstream of its cytotoxic effects on malignant cells, though its full target spectrum extends beyond sirtuins.
