description_zh_TW: Sirtinol 是一種在表型篩選中發現的羥基萘醛衍生物，對多種 sirtuin 同工型具有活性，並對不同來源的癌細胞具有細胞毒活性，包括乳腺癌、肺癌、前列腺癌和白血病細胞系。這種廣泛的抗癌活性使 Sirtinol 成為 β-萘酚抑制劑家族的創始成員，並啟動了產生 salermide、cambinol 和 splitomicin 的構效關係研究。方向性上 Sirtinol 介導的 sirtuin 活性抑制位於其對惡性細胞細胞毒作用的上游，儘管其完整的作用靶標範圍超越了 sirtuin。

label: Cambinol
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In hepatocellular and lung cancer cells, Cambinol impairs migration and invasion in a dose-dependent manner, consistent with sirtuin inhibition reducing metastatic behaviors. Directionally, Cambinol sits upstream of suppressed motility. This suggests sirtuin blockers may limit metastasis, complementing Cambinol's chemotherapy-sensitizing effects. By inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2, Cambinol disrupts the survival and migration programs that cancer cells depend on. The anti-migratory effect adds a metastatic dimension to the anticancer profile of sirtuin inhibitors, supporting their evaluation as anti-metastatic agents.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞癌和肺癌細胞中，Cambinol 以劑量依賴方式損害遷移和侵襲，與 sirtuin 抑制減少轉移行為一致。在方向性上，Cambinol 位於抑制運動性的上游。這表明 sirtuin 阻斷劑可能限制轉移，與 Cambinol 的化療增敏效應互補。透過抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2，Cambinol 破壞癌細胞依賴的存活和遷移程式。抗遷移效應為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌特徵增添了轉移維度，支持其作為抗轉移藥物的評估。

label: Salermide
description: Salermide induces robust apoptosis in leukemia (MOLT4), breast (MDA-MB-231), and colon (RKO) cancer cells, validating broad antitumor activity. Directionally, Salermide treatment sits upstream of cancer-cell death. This is consistent with SIRT1/2 inhibition removing survival signaling, and it supports sirtuin blockers as anticancer agents. The activity across diverse cancer cell lines indicates that SIRT1/2 inhibition engages a general pro-apoptotic program rather than a tumor-type-specific mechanism. These results provided key evidence for the anticancer potential of sirtuin inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Salermide 在白血病（MOLT4）、乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231）和結腸癌（RKO）細胞中誘導顯著凋亡，驗證了廣泛的抗腫瘤活性。在方向性上，Salermide 治療位於癌細胞死亡的上游。這與 SIRT1/2 抑制移除存活訊號一致，支持 sirtuin 阻斷劑作為抗癌藥物。在多種癌細胞系中的活性表明 SIRT1/2 抑制啟動的是一般性的促凋亡程式而非腫瘤類型特異性的機制。這些結果為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌潛力提供了關鍵證據。

label: CDH1
description: CDH1 sustains APC-C activity post-anaphase through G1.
description_zh_TW: CDH1 在後期後經 G1 維持 APC-C 活性。

label: Bad
description: PKCι phosphorylates Bad at Ser112, inactivating it.
description_zh_TW: PKCι 在 Ser112 磷酸化 Bad 使其失活。

label: KRAS
description: Sotorasib covalently occupies the KRAS G12C switch-II pocket, locking the GDP state.
description_zh_TW: Sotorasib 共價佔據 KRAS G12C switch-II 口袋，鎖定 GDP 狀態。

label: ERK1_2
description: MEK1/2 dual-specificity kinases phosphorylate the ERK Thr+Tyr activation loop, refining the existing is_activated_by edge.
description_zh_TW: MEK1/2 雙特異性激酶磷酸化 ERK Thr+Tyr 活化環，細化既有的 is_activated_by 邊。

label: AIM2
description: Beyond ZBP1, the DNA sensor AIM2 can nucleate PANoptosomes in response to distinct pathogens, broadening the sensor repertoire that co-assembles the three death arms (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: 除 ZBP1 外，DNA 感測器 AIM2 可針對不同病原體成核 PANoptosome，擴展共同組裝三種死亡臂的感測器陣容（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Breast Cancer
description: TNBC is a breast cancer subtype defined by absent ER/PR/HER2 receptors.
description_zh_TW: TNBC 是以 ER/PR/HER2 受體缺失定義的乳癌亞型。

label: Leukemia
description: Cytarabine is the nucleoside-analog backbone of leukemia therapy, synergizing with ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: cytarabine 是白血病治療的核苷類似物主幹，與 ivermectin 協同。

label: Tumorigenicity
description: Fixed release-tested master lines mitigate undifferentiated-iPSC tumor risk.
description_zh_TW: 固定且經放行檢測的主系降低未分化 iPSC 腫瘤風險。

label: STAT3
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: JAK2 trans-phosphorylates downstream STAT factors, notably STAT3, coupling cytokine receptors to proliferation/survival transcription.
description_zh_TW: JAK2 反式磷酸化下游 STAT 因子（特別是 STAT3），將細胞激素受體與增殖/存活轉錄偶聯。

label: Superoxide Radicals
description: Superoxide oxidizes the [4Fe-4S] cluster of aconitase to [3Fe-4S], inactivating the tricarboxylic acid enzyme. Aconitase is the classic superoxide sensor of mitochondria.
description_zh_TW: 超氧化物氧化 aconitase 的 [4Fe-4S] 簇為 [3Fe-4S]，使三羧酸酶失活。Aconitase 是粒線體典型的超氧化物感測器。

label: Neuroinflammation
description: TSPO radioligands visualize activated microglia, making PET the in-vivo readout of neuroinflammation. Detection parallels the MRI-detects-neuromelanin precedent.
description_zh_TW: TSPO 放射配體顯影活化的小膠質細胞，使 PET 成為神經發炎的體內讀值。偵測呼應 MRI 偵測 neuromelanin 的先例。

label: ARH3
description: ARH3, the exo-PARase and serine-ADP-ribosylhydrolase partner of PARG, is dispensable for PARP1-dependent death in an RPE1/MNNG model, so its protective role is cell-type and insult dependent and contrasts with its sensitivity in ischemia and H2O2 systems (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: ARH3（PARG 的外切 PAR 酶與絲胺酸 ADP-ribosyl 水解酶夥伴）在 RPE1/MNNG 模型中對 PARP1 依賴性死亡並非必需，其保護作用取決於細胞類型與刺激，並與其在缺血與 H2O2 系統中的敏感性形成對比（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Striatum
description: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning depends on dopamine signaling within the Striatum, where dorsolateral and dorsomedial striatal circuits integrate cortical and dopaminergic input at medium spiny neurons and enable corticostriatal long-term potentiation. Because striatal dopamine tone is shaped locally by COMT given sparse dopamine transporter expression, COMT activity modulates how readily S-R associations are acquired: elevated COMT accelerates dopamine clearance and slows S-R learning, whereas slower COMT preserves dopamine and facilitates habit formation.
description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning 依賴 Striatum 內的多巴胺訊號傳遞，背外側與背內側紋狀體迴路在 medium spiny neurons 處整合皮質與多巴胺輸入，並促成皮質-紋狀體長期增益。由於紋狀體多巴胺張力在多巴胺轉運蛋白表現稀疏的情況下由 COMT 局部塑造，COMT 活性會調節 S-R 關聯習得的難易：COMT 升高會加速多巴胺清除並減緩 S-R 學習，而 COMT 較慢則保留多巴胺並促進習慣形成。

label: Sir2 (yeast)
description: Sir2p protects yeast from toxic accumulation of self-replicating extrachromosomal rDNA circles (ERCs); deletion of the replication-fork-blocking protein Fob1p rescues the short lifespan of sir2 mutants, establishing ERC suppression as the first mechanistic explanation for Sir2's longevity effect. Directionally, Sir2p suppresses ERC accumulation to extend lifespan. By preventing the toxic buildup of these circular DNA molecules, Sir2 preserves genome stability and replicative capacity. This was the first molecular mechanism linking Sir2 to longevity and remains a foundational finding in sirtuin research.
description_zh_TW: Sir2p保護酵母免受自我複製的染色體外rDNA環（ERC）毒性積累的損害；刪除複製叉阻斷蛋白Fob1p可挽救sir2突變體的短壽命，確立ERC抑制是Sir2長壽效應的第一個機制性解釋。方向上，Sir2p抑制ERC積累以延長壽命。透過防止這些環狀DNA分子的毒性積累，Sir2維持基因組穩定性和複製能力。這是第一個將Sir2與長壽聯繫的分子機制，至今仍是sirtuin研究的基礎性發現。

label: ATP
description: Re-synthesizing NAD+ by the salvage pathway after PARP1 turnover is expensive: the complete cycle costs four high-energy phosphates per ADP-ribose unit. With NAD(H) around 0.3 mM versus ATP around 3-4 mM, full NAD+ turnover could itself contribute substantially to ATP depletion during parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: PARP1 周轉後經救援路徑重新合成 NAD+ 成本高昂：完整循環每單位 ADP-ribose 耗費四個高能磷酸鍵。NAD(H) 約 0.3 mM、ATP 約 3-4 mM，故 NAD+ 完全周轉本身即可顯著促成 parthanatos 中的 ATP 耗竭（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Folinic acid
description: Folinic acid supports COMT function by feeding folate-derived one-carbon units into the Methylation Cycle and SAMe production without imposing the abrupt methyl load of high-dose Methylfolate. Since COMT consumes SAMe to O-methylate catecholamines, a steady but gentle supply of methyl capacity helps slow-COMT individuals maintain catecholamine clearance without overstimulation or 'overmethylation' side effects. This makes folinic acid a preferred folate support when COMT activity is genetically reduced.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 透過將葉酸來源的一碳單元送入 Methylation Cycle 與 SAMe 生成來支持 COMT 功能，而不像高劑量 Methylfolate 那樣造成突然的甲基負荷。由於 COMT 消耗 SAMe 對兒茶酚胺進行 O-甲基化，穩定而溫和的甲基能力供應有助於慢速 COMT 個體維持兒茶酚胺清除，同時避免過度刺激或「過度甲基化」副作用。因此在 COMT 活性基因性偏低時，folinic acid 是較受偏好的葉酸支持選項。

label: Noncanonical Inflammasome
description: Human caspase-4 is a cytosolic-LPS sensor and noncanonical effector alongside caspase-5, paralleling murine caspase-11. It cleaves gasdermin D and IL-1α to drive SASP and pyroptotic signaling.
description_zh_TW: 人類 caspase-4 是胞質 LPS 感受器與非典型效應因子，與 caspase-5 並列，對應小鼠 caspase-11。它切割 gasdermin D 與 IL-1α 以驅動 SASP 與 pyroptotic 訊號。

label: Mcl-1
description: USP9X removes Mcl-1 polyubiquitin chains, blocking proteasomal degradation.
description_zh_TW: USP9X 移除 Mcl-1 多泛素鏈，阻斷蛋白酶體降解。

label: Mitosis
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Sister chromatids congress and segregate during mitosis.
description_zh_TW: 姐妹染色單體在有絲分裂排列並分離。

label: Silver nanoparticles
description: Silver nanoparticles are a definitional nanoscale subtype of silver compounds. Classification nests the particulate form.
description_zh_TW: 銀奈米顆粒是銀化合物的定義性奈米亞型。歸類嵌套顆粒形式。

label: Apoptosis-Inducing Factor
description: Cyclophilin A is proposed to form an AIF-cyclophilin A-histone H2AX complex in which AIF provides nuclease activity for large-scale DNA fragmentation, an alternative to the MIF/PAAN nuclease model of AIF-dependent parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: Cyclophilin A 被提出與 AIF 及組蛋白 H2AX 形成複合體，其中由 AIF 提供核酸酶活性以進行大規模 DNA 斷裂，為 AIF 依賴性 parthanatos 中 MIF/PAAN 核酸酶模型之外的替代機制（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Epigenetic Drift
description: Epigenetic drift causes stochastic expression change and loss of cellular identity. Disruption is the transcriptional consequence of drift.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳漂移造成隨機表現變化與細胞身份喪失。破壞是漂移的轉錄後果。

label: MyD88
description: MyD88 is the central TIR-domain adaptor for all Toll-like receptors except TLR3, linking receptor engagement to IRAK4/IRAK1 and TRAF6. In senescence this couples DAMP sensing to NF-kB and SASP transcription.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 是除 TLR3 外所有 Toll-like 受體的核心 TIR 域銜接蛋白，將受體結合連結到 IRAK4/IRAK1 與 TRAF6。在衰老中，此將 DAMP 感知耦合到 NF-κB 與 SASP 轉錄。

label: Pluripotency
description: Oocyte factors reset the donor genome to a totipotent and pluripotent state.
description_zh_TW: 卵母細胞因子將供體基因組重置為全能與多能狀態。

label: Adrenochrome formation
description: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) acts as an antioxidant and reducing agent that inhibits the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome. It scavenges reactive oxygen species that drive catechol oxidation and reduces oxidized intermediates back to epinephrine, effectively reversing the early steps of the reaction. In laboratory settings vitamin C has been shown to inhibit the pink-to-red discoloration of adrenaline solutions caused by adrenochrome formation, and it is used as a stabilizing agent in pharmaceutical epinephrine preparations. Antioxidants such as ascorbic acid therefore represent a natural brake on the adrenochrome pathway in both formulations and biological systems.
description_zh_TW: Ascorbic acid（維生素 C）作為 antioxidant 與 reducing agent，抑制 epinephrine 氧化成 adrenochrome。它清除驅動兒茶酚氧化的 reactive oxygen species，並將氧化的中間產物還原回 epinephrine，有效逆轉反應的早期步驟。在實驗室環境中，維生素 C 已被證實能抑制 adrenaline 溶液因 adrenochrome 形成而產生的粉紅至紅色變色，並被用作藥用 epinephrine 製劑中的 stabilizing agent。因此，ascorbic acid 等 antioxidants 在製劑與生物系統中，都代表了對 adrenochrome pathway 的天然制動作用。

label: FGF21
description: FGF21 induced by low-protein feeding drives UCP1-dependent beiging thermogenesis that dissipates energy as heat. This endocrine signal is the primary mediator of restriction-associated fat loss.
description_zh_TW: 低蛋白飼養誘發的 FGF21 驅動 UCP1 依賴的米色化產熱，將能量以熱耗散。此內分泌訊號是限制相關脂肪減少的主要介體。

label: Silver compounds
description: Bioactivity of silver compounds stems from released silver ion, the core antimicrobial and toxicity mechanism. Ion release mediates the effect.
description_zh_TW: 銀化合物的生物活性源自釋放的銀離子，是核心抗菌與毒性機制。離子釋放介導效應。

label: Histone Acetylation
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate donor for protein acetylation, including histone acetylation, a modification associated with chromatin relaxation and increased accessibility to transcriptional machinery. In senescent cells, acetyl-CoA availability determines H3K27ac deposition at SASP gene loci: enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression while depleting it limits the programme. Acetate supplementation, converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, increases nuclear acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory genes IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators, linking mitochondrial metabolism to the epigenetic regulation of inflammatory genes.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA）是蛋白質乙醯化（包括組蛋白乙醯化）的必然供體；此修飾與染色質鬆弛及轉錄機制可及性增加有關。在衰老細胞中，乙醯輔酶A的可用性決定了 SASP 基因座位的 H3K27ac 沉積：提高乙醯輔酶A濃度可促進 SASP 基因表現，而耗竭乙醯輔酶A則會限制此程序。補充乙酸（在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A）可增加細胞核乙醯化，並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子，將粒線體代謝與發炎基因的表觀遺傳調控連結起來。

label: Hydroxyurea
description: Hydroxyurea quenches the ribonucleotide reductase tyrosyl radical, blocking dNTP supply. Same push-past-the-window logic as triapine in hormetic pharmacology.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 淬滅 ribonucleotide reductase 酪氨酸自由基，阻斷 dNTP 供應。在荷爾蒙藥理中與 triapine 同為推過窗口邏輯。

label: SREBP-1c
description: SIRT6 improves systemic insulin sensitivity and prevents ectopic lipid accumulation by repressing the lipogenic transcription factor SREBP-1c. Repression of SREBP-1c inhibits fatty-acid synthesis in the liver and promotes oxidative disposal of lipids rather than storage. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of suppressed lipogenic gene programs. This keeps hepatic triglyceride production in check and limits fat deposition in tissues such as the liver and muscle. By opposing de novo lipogenesis, SIRT6 protects against hepatic steatosis, insulin resistance, and the metabolic sequelae of a chronic nutrient surplus.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6透過抑制脂肪生成轉錄因子SREBP-1c來改善全身胰島素敏感性並防止異位脂質積累。SREBP-1c的抑制阻礙了肝臟中的脂肪酸合成，促進脂質的氧化處置而非儲存。方向上，SIRT6位於脂肪生成基因程序抑制的上游。這使肝臟三酸甘油酯的產生受到控制，並限制肝臟和肌肉等組織中的脂肪沉積。透過對抗從頭脂肪生成，SIRT6保護機體免受肝脂肪變性、胰島素阻抗和慢性營養過剩的代謝後果。

label: Ischemic Stroke
source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Andrabi 2006 PAR polymer death signal.md
description: Iduna protects the brain from glutamate excitotoxicity and ischemic stroke by interfering with PAR-induced cell death; conversely, loss of this PAR-dependent E3 ligase sensitizes neurons to parthanatos (Andrabi et al. 2011, Nat Med; Kang et al. 2011, PNAS).
description_zh_TW: Iduna 透過干擾 PAR 誘導的細胞死亡，保護大腦免受麩胺酸興奮性毒性與缺血性中風；反之，失去此依賴 PAR 的 E3 連接酶會使神經元對 parthanatos 更敏感（Andrabi et al. 2011, Nat Med；Kang et al. 2011, PNAS）。

label: Therapy-Induced Senescence
description: Cisplatin, a DNA cross-linking chemotherapeutic, induces therapy-induced senescence through persistent DNA damage and p53/p21 engagement. It belongs to the same genotoxic trigger class as the established doxorubicin and etoposide triples.
description_zh_TW: Cisplatin（一種 DNA 交聯化療藥）透過持續 DNA 損傷與 p53/p21 參與誘發治療誘發衰老。它與已確立的 doxorubicin 和 etoposide triple 同屬基因毒性觸發類別。

label: AP-1
description: AP-1 drives matrix metalloproteinase-1, -3 and -9 transcription in the textbook ultraviolet to collagen-degradation axis. Transcription factor output dissolves dermal matrix.
description_zh_TW: AP-1 在典型的紫外線到膠原降解軸驅動基質金屬蛋白酶-1、-3 與 -9 轉錄。轉錄因子輸出溶解真皮基質。

label: Tumorigenesis
description: Caspase-2 is a bona fide tumor suppressor: knockout mice develop centrosome excess, aneuploidy and carcinogen-hypersensitive tumorigenesis; it also cleaves Beclin-1, coupling tumor suppression, autophagy suppression and apoptosis upstream of p53 (PMID 19339967).
description_zh_TW: Caspase-2 是名副其實的腫瘤抑制子：剔除小鼠出現中心體過量、非整倍體與致癌物高敏感腫瘤生成；它也切割 Beclin-1，在 p53 上游耦合腫瘤抑制、自噬抑制與細胞凋亡（PMID 19339967）。

label: gene expression
description: Translation is the final protein-synthesis step of gene expression.
description_zh_TW: 轉譯是基因表現最後的蛋白合成步驟。

label: IL-1α
description: Inflammasome-processed IL-1alpha is the master upstream regulator of the SASP program. Drive records the apical cytokine position.
description_zh_TW: 發炎體處理的 IL-1α 是 SASP 程序的上游主調控者。驅動記錄頂端細胞激素位置。

label: MethylB12
description: MethylB12 (methylcobalamin) supports the Methylation Cycle as the methyl-group carrier for methionine synthase: it provides the methyl group that remethylates homocysteine to methionine, regenerating the SAMe pool that the cycle distributes to methyltransferases such as COMT. Together with Methylfolate, methylB12 is one of the two B-vitamin cofactors that keep homocysteine remethylation, and therefore SAMe-dependent catecholamine clearance, running efficiently.
description_zh_TW: MethylB12（甲基鈷胺）作為 methionine synthase 的甲基載體支持 Methylation Cycle：它提供將 homocysteine 再甲基化為 methionine 所需的甲基，再生該循環分配給 COMT 等甲基轉移酶的 SAMe 池。與 Methylfolate 一樣，methylB12 是維持 homocysteine 再甲基化（以及依賴 SAMe 的兒茶酚胺清除）順暢運作的兩種 B 群維生素輔因子之一。

label: MYC
description: MYC induces elevated respiration, coupling oncogenic transcription to oxidative metabolism.
description_zh_TW: MYC 誘發升高的呼吸，將致癌轉錄耦合到氧化代謝。

label: Endothelial Dysfunction
description: Endothelial dysfunction is the initiating lesion step of atherosclerosis. Involvement records the onset mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 內皮功能障礙是動脈粥狀硬化的起始病灶步驟。涉及記錄起始機制。

label: Keshan disease
description: Keshan disease is an endemic nutritional cardiomyopathy by definition. Classification places the selenium-deficiency disorder among myocardial diseases.
description_zh_TW: Keshan disease 依定義是地方性營養性心肌病。歸類將硒缺乏症置於心肌疾病之中。

label: DNA Repair
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Cohesin holds sister chromatids in proximity for homologous-recombination repair of breaks. Requirement serves genome integrity.
description_zh_TW: Cohesin 將姐妹染色單體保持鄰近以進行斷裂的同源重組修復。必要性服務基因組完整。

label: Thioredoxin-1
description: Reduced thioredoxin-1 regenerates ribonucleotide reductase each turnover for dNTP synthesis. This textbook electron flow links redox tone to DNA synthesis capacity.
description_zh_TW: 還原型 thioredoxin-1 在每次周轉再生 ribonucleotide reductase 以合成 dNTP。此教科書電子流將氧化還原張力連結到 DNA 合成能力。

label: Methyl groups
description: Methyl groups, the one-carbon units transferred by methylation reactions, are regenerated by the Methylation Cycle: after SAMe donates a methyl group (e.g., to COMT for catechol inactivation), the resulting homocysteine is remethylated back to methionine using Methylfolate and MethylB12, so the methyl-donor pool is continuously replenished. The Methylation Cycle is therefore the metabolic engine that sustains methyl-group supply for COMT and other methyltransferases.
description_zh_TW: Methyl groups 是甲基化反應所轉移的一碳單元，由 Methylation Cycle 再生：SAMe 捐出甲基（例如給 COMT 用於 catechol 去活化）後，產生的 homocysteine 會藉由 Methylfolate 與 MethylB12 再甲基化回 methionine，使甲基供體池持續補充。因此 Methylation Cycle 是維持 COMT 及其他甲基轉移酶甲基供應的代謝引擎。

label: Inflammasome
description: TLR2/6 signalling activates the inflammasome, providing an innate-immune priming step for SASP induction. In oncogene-induced senescence this is triggered by acute-phase serum amyloid A1 and A2 acting at TLR2, and HMGB1 can act through the same receptor to induce the SASP. Inflammasome activation leads to caspase-1-dependent maturation of pro-IL-1beta, which is then secreted as a SASP factor and feeds back on IL-1R, closing the loop from tissue damage to inflammatory output.
description_zh_TW: TLR2/6 訊號活化發炎體，為 SASP 誘導提供先天免疫預處理步驟。在癌基因誘導衰老中，此由作用於 TLR2 的急性期血清澱粉樣蛋白 A1 與 A2 觸發，HMGB1 亦可經同一受體誘導 SASP。發炎體活化導致 caspase-1 依賴性 pro-IL-1beta 成熟，隨後以 SASP 因子分泌並回饋至 IL-1R，封閉由組織損傷到發炎輸出的環路。

label: Mitochondrial Fission
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through the two opposite but coordinated processes of fission and fusion, accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes. Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria and is driven by the dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by adaptor proteins. The balance between fission and fusion is tightly regulated by conserved GTPase proteins and must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fission and fusion 兩個相反但 coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes。Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria 並由 dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 driven，被 adaptor proteins recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane。Fission and fusion 之間的 balance 由 conserved GTPase proteins tightly regulated 且 must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function。

label: stimulus-response learning
description: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning depends on dopamine signaling within the Striatum, where dorsolateral and dorsomedial striatal circuits integrate cortical and dopaminergic input at medium spiny neurons and enable corticostriatal long-term potentiation. Because striatal dopamine tone is shaped locally by COMT given sparse dopamine transporter expression, COMT activity modulates how readily S-R associations are acquired: elevated COMT accelerates dopamine clearance and slows S-R learning, whereas slower COMT preserves dopamine and facilitates habit formation.
description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning 依賴 Striatum 內的多巴胺訊號傳遞，背外側與背內側紋狀體迴路在 medium spiny neurons 處整合皮質與多巴胺輸入，並促成皮質-紋狀體長期增益。由於紋狀體多巴胺張力在多巴胺轉運蛋白表現稀疏的情況下由 COMT 局部塑造，COMT 活性會調節 S-R 關聯習得的難易：COMT 升高會加速多巴胺清除並減緩 S-R 學習，而 COMT 較慢則保留多巴胺並促進習慣形成。

label: Type 2 Diabetes
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Berberine holds the strongest clinical dataset of the four compounds: head-to-head equivalence with metformin (Yin 2008, 500 mg TID), a 46-RCT meta-analysis (HbA1c -0.73%, fasting glucose -0.86 mmol/L, LDL-C -0.86 mmol/L), and PREMOTE (HbA1c ~-1% with microbiome shifts); BUDCA salt extends efficacy to NASH liver fat.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 擁有四者中最強臨床證據：與 metformin 等效（Yin 2008，500 mg TID）、46 個 RCT 統合分析（HbA1c -0.73%、空腹血糖 -0.86 mmol/L、LDL-C -0.86 mmol/L）、PREMOTE（HbA1c 約 -1% 伴菌相變化）；BUDCA 鹽型更擴及 NASH 肝脂肪。

label: COMT activity
source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md
description: The COMT Val158 allele increases the thermostability of the enzyme, thereby increasing its level of activity compared to the 158 Met allele. This higher activity increases dopamine turnover in cortical synapses. A common polymorphism resulting in increased COMT activity has been associated with poorer cognitive performance and increased susceptibility to psychiatric disorders.
description_zh_TW: COMT Val158 等位基因增加酶的熱穩定性，從而相對於 158 Met 等位基因提高其活性水平。這種較高的活性增加皮質突觸的多巴胺代謝。導致 COMT activity 增加的常見多態性已與較差的認知表現和精神疾病易感性增加相關。

label: PtdIns(3,5)P2
description: PtdIns(3,5)P2 directly binds and activates the TRPML1 calcium channel. Activation couples phosphoinositide to calcium release.
description_zh_TW: PtdIns(3,5)P2 直接結合並活化 TRPML1 鈣通道。活化將磷酸肌醇耦合到鈣釋放。

label: GATOR1
description: The DEPDC5-containing GATOR1 complex is the GAP converting RagA/B-GTP to GDP. Inhibition is the amino-acid-off switch.
description_zh_TW: 含 DEPDC5 的 GATOR1 複合體是將 RagA/B-GTP 轉 GDP 的 GAP。抑制是胺基酸關閉開關。

label: Microgliosis
description: Microglia and Microgliosis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Microglia and Microgliosis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Microglia 和 Microgliosis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Microglia 和 Microgliosis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Suramin
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: NF675 is the product of optimizing the suramin scaffold and is the most potent and selective molecule in the series, showing a 20-fold selectivity ratio for SIRT1 over SIRT2. Suramin itself inhibits SIRT1/SIRT2 at nanomolar concentrations with apparent SIRT1 preference, has anticancer activity, and has been studied in clinical trials. Directionally, NF675 inherits suramin's binding mode while improving isoform selectivity. Despite good potency and selectivity, suramin-derived compounds have modest drug-likeness owing to high molecular weight and anionic character, limiting therapeutic translation.
description_zh_TW: NF675 是優化 Suramin 骨架的產物，是該系列中最具活性和選擇性的分子，對 SIRT1 相較 SIRT2 顯示出 20 倍的選擇性比率。Suramin 本身在奈摩爾濃度下抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2，具有明顯的 SIRT1 偏好性，具有抗癌活性，並已在臨床試驗中研究。方向性上 NF675 繼承了 Suramin 的結合模式同時提高了同工型選擇性。儘管具有良好的活性和選擇性，Suramin 衍生物由於高分子量和陰離子特性而具有中等的類藥性，限制了治療轉化。

label: Selective Autophagy
description: Pexophagy is the peroxisome-specific form of selective autophagy, mirroring mitophagy classification. Classification nests the cargo program.
description_zh_TW: Pexophagy 是過氧化物酶體特異的選擇性自噬形式，呼應粒線體自噬歸類。歸類嵌套貨物程序。

label: David Sinclair
description: The Sinclair lab developed the ICE Mouse to test the RCM hypothesis using mutation-free double-strand breaks. Directionally, the model enables tests of epigenetic aging. This provided key evidence for the Information Theory of Aging, and it is a methodological contribution alongside the theoretical framework. By engineering a system to induce faithful DNA breaks, Sinclair created a tool to separate epigenetic from genetic contributions to aging. The ICE Mouse's results have made it a centerpiece of the argument that aging results from loss of epigenetic information.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 實驗室開發了 ICE 小鼠來使用無突變的雙鏈斷裂測試 RCM 假說。在方向性上，該模型使得表觀遺傳衰老的測試成為可能。這為衰老資訊理論提供了關鍵證據，是與理論框架並列的方法學貢獻。透過設計一個誘導忠實 DNA 斷裂的系統，Sinclair 創造了一個工具來分離表觀遺傳和遺傳對衰老的貢獻。ICE 小鼠的結果使其成為衰老源於表觀遺傳資訊喪失這一論點的核心。

label: Sodium Chloride
description: Low-dose NaCl at 25 mM acts as eustress in hydroponically grown sunflower microgreens, stimulating rather than suppressing growth. Shoot fresh yield rose 58.7%, leaf area 81.4%, and root length 25.7% versus control. This stimulatory low-dose effect is the defining feature of eustress/hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 25 mM 低劑量 NaCl 在水耕向日葵苗菜中發揮 Eustress 作用，促進而非抑制生長。地上部鮮重增加 58.7%、葉面積增加 81.4%、根長增加 25.7%。這種低劑量刺激效應正是 eustress／hormesis 的定義特徵。

label: EGCG
description: Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) abundant in green tea inhibits DNA methyltransferases. This epigenetic modulation alters DNA methylation patterns governing stress resistance and inflammation genes, conferring long-lasting hormetic adaptation.
description_zh_TW: 綠茶中豐富的 Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) 可抑制 DNA Methyltransferases。這種表觀遺傳調控改變了控制壓力抗性與發炎基因的 DNA 甲基化模式，賦予持久的 hormesis 適應優勢。

label: Preparation for Oxidative Stress
description: POS has been documented as an adaptive physiological mechanism in 83 animal species from 8 different phyla under low-oxygen stress and estivation, with 60-70% of analyzed species POS-positive. Antioxidant enzymes rise during hypoxia and return to baseline upon reoxygenation or arousal, showing POS is a widespread cross-phylum conditioning strategy rather than a species-specific quirk.
description_zh_TW: Preparation for Oxidative Stress 已被記錄為 8 個不同門共 83 種動物在低氧壓力與夏眠下的適應性生理機制，受分析物種中約 60-70% 為 POS-positive。抗氧化酶在缺氧期間上升，並在再氧合或甦醒後回到基線，顯示 POS 是跨門的 conditioning 策略，而非物種特異的偶發現象。

label: CD38 inhibitor 78c
description: CD38 inhibitor 78c preserves and raises NAD+ with male-biased lifespan effects (Peclat 2022). Pharmacological counterpart to the CD38-consumes-NAD+ disease edge.
description_zh_TW: CD38 inhibitor 78c 保存並提高 NAD+，具雄性偏向的壽命效應（Peclat 2022）。CD38 消耗 NAD+ 疾病邊的藥理對應。

label: Ischemia-reperfusion Injury
description: RIPK3-deficient mice are protected from ischemia-reperfusion injury across models and Nec-1 adds nothing on top of the deficiency; glomerular endothelial cells (unlike tubular cells, mesangial cells, or podocytes) express the highest RIPK3, correlating with necroptosis propensity.
description_zh_TW: RIPK3 缺失小鼠在多個缺血–再灌注模型中受保護，且在此基礎上 Nec-1 不再增加效果；腎小球內皮細胞（與腎小管細胞、系膜細胞或足細胞不同）表現最高之 RIPK3，與 necroptosis 傾向相關。

label: PI3K
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Fisetin exerts senolytic activity by inhibiting the constitutively active PI3K/AKT pro-survival axis in senescent cells (reducing FOXO phosphorylation and NF-kB survival signaling) together with direct inhibition of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2/Bcl-xL proteins, lowering the mitochondrial apoptotic threshold selectively in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin 透過抑制老化細胞中持續活化的 PI3K/AKT 存活軸（降低 FOXO 磷酸化與 NF-kB 存活訊號），並直接抑制抗凋亡 Bcl-2/Bcl-xL 蛋白，選擇性降低老化細胞的粒線體凋亡閾值，發揮 senolytic 作用。

label: MTHFD1
description: MTHFD1 is a trifunctional cytosolic enzyme that catalyzes NADP+-dependent reactions interconverting folate-bound one-carbon units, including dehydrogenation of 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate to 10-formyl-THF. 10-formyl-THF supplies carbons for de novo purine ring formation. A mitochondrial paralog, MTHFD2, performs analogous reactions during proliferation.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 是三功能細胞質酶，催化 NADP+ 依賴性反應，在葉酸結合的一碳單元之間進行互換，包括將 5,10-亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫為 10-formyl-THF。10-formyl-THF 為 de novo 嘌呤環形成提供碳。粒線體旁系同源物 MTHFD2 在增殖期間執行類似的反應。

label: Glycolysis
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: SIRT6 suppresses glycolysis and metabolic reprogramming in hepatocellular carcinoma by deacetylating hnRNP A1, and USP48-stabilized SIRT6 further attenuates glycolysis. In lung cancer the same metabolic suppression enhances radiosensitivity, although SIRT6 has a pro-carcinogenic dual role there through snail-dependent transrepression of KLF4 that drives EMT and metastasis. Overall SIRT6 acts as a metabolic tumor suppressor across most cancers.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過去乙醯化 hnRNP A1 抑制肝細胞癌中的糖解與代謝重編程，且 USP48 穩定的 SIRT6 進一步減弱糖解。在肺癌中，相同的代謝抑制增強放射敏感性，儘管 SIRT6 在該處透過 snail 依賴的 KLF4 轉錄抑制（驅動 EMT 與轉移）具有促癌的雙重角色。整體而言，SIRT6 在多數癌症中作為代謝腫瘤抑制因子。

label: Silver ion
description: Silver ion directly inhibits selenoenzyme sulfhydryl redox catalysis, impairing hydroperoxide detoxification. Inhibition collapses the peroxidase defense.
description_zh_TW: 銀離子直接抑制硒酶巰基氧化還原催化，損害氫過氧化物解毒。抑制瓦解過氧化物酶防禦。

label: Avermectin
description: Ivermectin is the semi-synthetic dihydro derivative of avermectin from Streptomyces avermitilis (Nobel 2015 history). Definitional chemistry fact.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 是源自 Streptomyces avermitilis 的 avermectin 半合成二氫衍生物（Nobel 2015 歷史）。定義性化學事實。

label: Tumor Suppressor Gene
description: Promoter hypermethylation silences tumor suppressor genes in cancer.
description_zh_TW: 啟動子高甲基化在癌症沉默腫瘤抑制基因。

label: ULK1
description: ULK1 Ser14 phosphorylation of Beclin1 enhances Vps34 complex activity. Phosphorylation links initiation to nucleation.
description_zh_TW: ULK1 Ser14 磷酸化 Beclin1 增強 Vps34 複合體活性。磷酸化將起始連結到成核。

label: Brosimine B
description: Brosimine B shows an inverted U-shaped biphasic dose-response in retinal cell cultures, stimulating viability at low concentrations and becoming cytotoxic at higher ones. The fitted Gaussian hormetic model gives R2 = 0.984 with a peak response at 10.2 uM and hormetic zone width sigma = 6.5 uM. This confirms Brosimine B as a hormetic agent rather than a monotonic protectant.
description_zh_TW: Brosimine B 在視網膜細胞培養中呈現倒 U 形雙相劑量反應，低濃度促進存活率、高濃度則具細胞毒性。高斯 hormetic 模型配適 R2 = 0.984，峰值反應在 10.2 uM，hormetic zone 寬度 sigma = 6.5 uM。這證實 Brosimine B 是 hormetic 作用物，而非單調性保護劑。

label: Amyloid Beta
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Amyloid plaque pathology is central to Alzheimer disease. Involvement records the defining lesion.
description_zh_TW: 類澱粉斑塊病理是阿茲海默病的核心。涉及記錄定義性病灶。

label: TNFα
description: Intravenous TNFα causes acute TNFR1-dependent apoptotic detachment of enterocytes and kills mice within 48 h ('hyperacute TNF shock'); this is the default TNF response that pan-caspase inhibition redirects toward necroptosis.
description_zh_TW: 靜脈注射 TNFα 引起急性、依賴 TNFR1 之腸上皮細胞凋亡性剝離，並於 48 小時內致小鼠死亡（「超急性 TNF 休克」）；廣效性 Caspase 抑制可將此預設 TNF 反應改向為 necroptosis。

label: Glutamate Dehydrogenase (GDH)
description: The oxidative deamination of glutamate by GDH yields alpha-ketoglutarate, which feeds the tricarboxylic acid cycle as an anaplerotic substrate. This conversion is central to coupling amino-acid catabolism to energy production in liver, kidney, and brain.
description_zh_TW: GDH 對穀氨酸的氧化脫氨產生 α-酮戊二酸，作為回補受質供應三羧酸循環。此轉化是將胺基酸分解代謝與肝、腎和腦中的能量產生偶聯的核心。

label: Lifespan
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Rapamycin extends murine lifespan roughly 10 to 25 percent even with late-life start from the landmark Harrison 2009 study. Extension is the geroprotective outcome.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin 即使晚年開始仍延長小鼠壽命約 10 至 25%，源自里程碑 Harrison 2009。延長是老年保護結果。

label: Hypoxia
description: Autophagy is upregulated in response to hypoxia and HIF stress. Induction is the oxygen-stress route.
description_zh_TW: 自噬在缺氧與 HIF 壓力反應上調。誘發是氧壓力路徑。

label: Lysosomal Acid Lipase
description: Lysosomal acid lipase hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters and triglycerides delivered via lipophagy. Mediation is the enzymatic execution.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體酸性脂肪酶水解經由脂噬遞送的膽固醇酯與甘油三酯。媒介是酶促執行。

label: Regulatory T cells
description: Per the 'Old Friends' hypothesis, commensal bacteria, saprophytic mycobacteria and helminths calibrate immune tolerance by inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs); farm exposure and gut Bacteroides/Clostridium pools promote tolerogenic dendritic cells → Treg differentiation, so removing microbial training signals is linked to rising allergy and autoimmunity.
description_zh_TW: 依「老友」假說，共生菌、腐生分枝桿菌與蠕蟲透過誘導調節性 T 細胞（Tregs）校準免疫耐受；農場暴露與腸道 Bacteroides/Clostridium 族群促進耐受性樹突細胞 → Treg 分化，因此移除微生物訓練訊號與過敏及自體免疫增加相關。

label: Methemoglobin
description: Leuco-methylene blue reduces ferric Fe3+ in methemoglobin back to ferrous Fe2+, restoring hemoglobin function. Reduction is mechanistically exact and distinct from treats-Methemoglobinemia.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-methylene blue 將變性血紅素的 Fe3+ 還原回 Fe2+，恢復血紅素功能。還原在機制精確且不同於治療變性血紅素血症。

label: Hypochlorous acid
description: Myeloperoxidase produces hypochlorous acid from hydrogen peroxide and chloride in activated neutrophils, mirroring the Eosinophil Peroxidase produces Hypobromous Acid pattern. Replacement for the malformed converts triple.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase 在活化嗜中性球由過氧化氫與氯化物產生次氯酸，呼應 Eosinophil Peroxidase 產生 Hypobromous Acid 模式。取代措辭不當的 converts triple。

label: OPA1
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Dominant optic atrophy (DOA) is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene OPA1, which encodes the inner mitochondrial membrane fusion GTPase optic atrophy 1. OPA1 mutations and improper OPA1 processing induce mitochondrial fragmentation, resulting in severe cardiomyopathy and ultimately heart failure in addition to optic atrophy. In a mouse DOA model, adeno-associated virus delivery of wild-type OPA1 alleviates retinal ganglion cell degeneration, demonstrating the therapeutic potential of restoring fusion capacity in OPA1-mutant disease.
description_zh_TW: 顯性視神經萎縮（DOA）直接由粒線體融合相關基因OPA1的雜合突變引起，該基因編碼內粒線體膜融合GTP酶視神經萎縮1。OPA1突變和不當的OPA1加工誘導粒線體碎片化，導致嚴重心肌病和最終心力衰竭以及視神經萎縮。在小鼠DOA模型中，腺相關病毒遞送野生型OPA1可緩解視網膜神經節細胞退化，證明了在OPA1突變疾病中恢復融合能力的治療潛力。

label: ROS
description: ROS promote necroptosis by inducing RIPK1 autophosphorylation in septic cardiomyopathy and viral myocarditis.
description_zh_TW: ROS透過誘導RIPK1自身磷酸化來促進necroptosis，見於敗血性心肌病變與病毒性心肌炎。

label: Gastric Cancer
description: Trastuzumab is approved for HER2-positive gastric cancer, the second indication.
description_zh_TW: trastuzumab 核准用於 HER2 陽性胃癌，為第二適應症。

label: Translation
description: Translation is the final protein-synthesis step of gene expression.
description_zh_TW: 轉譯是基因表現最後的蛋白合成步驟。

label: Mitochondrial Biogenesis
description: PGC-1alpha is the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis downstream of exercise, fasting and cold stress. Textbook-level causation.
description_zh_TW: PGC-1alpha 是運動、禁食與冷壓力下游粒線體生成的主調節因子。教科書等級因果。

label: Intermittent Fasting
description: Fasting nutrient-deprivation signals act through mTORC1 inhibition to de-repress initiation. Inhibition is the fasting-off switch.
description_zh_TW: 禁食營養剝奪訊號經由 mTORC1 抑制解除起始抑制。抑制是禁食關閉開關。

label: Caspase-9
description: Atypical PKCζ phosphorylates caspase-9 at Ser144, inhibiting the initiator.
description_zh_TW: 非典型 PKCζ 在 Ser144 磷酸化 caspase-9，抑制起始者。

label: Glutathione Peroxidase
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Silver ion directly inhibits selenoenzyme sulfhydryl redox catalysis, impairing hydroperoxide detoxification. Inhibition collapses the peroxidase defense.
description_zh_TW: 銀離子直接抑制硒酶巰基氧化還原催化，損害氫過氧化物解毒。抑制瓦解過氧化物酶防禦。

label: Hydroxyl Radicals
description: UVB photolysis and Fenton hydroxyl radicals add a DNA and membrane damage arm to photoaging. Radical injury complements singlet oxygen pathways.
description_zh_TW: UVB 光解與 Fenton hydroxyl radicals 為光老化增添 DNA 與膜損傷臂。自由基損傷補充 singlet oxygen 途徑。

label: LKB1
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Germline LKB1/STK11 loss causes Peutz-Jeghers syndrome.
description_zh_TW: 生殖系 LKB1/STK11 缺失導致 Peutz-Jeghers 症候群。

label: Mitochondrial Dysfunction
description: The chloroacetaldehyde metabolite interferes with mitochondrial respiration, and methylene blue rescue is attributed to restoring mitochondrial function. Association is capped as borderline mechanistic evidence.
description_zh_TW: 氯乙醛代謝物干擾粒線體呼吸，而亞甲藍救援歸因於恢復粒線體功能。關聯因機制證據邊緣而設上限。

label: Caspase-2
description: PP1 opposes CaMKII by dephosphorylating caspase-2 at Ser164.
description_zh_TW: PP1 在 Ser164 去磷酸化 caspase-2，對抗 CaMKII。

label: MLKL
description: RIPK3 phosphorylates MLKL (human Thr357/Ser358) to license its oligomerization and membrane-pore formation, the terminal executor step of necroptosis.
description_zh_TW: RIPK3 磷酸化 MLKL（人類 Thr357/Ser358），准許其寡聚化並形成膜孔，為 necroptosis 的末端執行步驟。

label: MTRR
description: MTRR (methionine synthase reductase) is a flavoprotein reductase that sustains the activity of methionine synthase by reducing its oxidized cobalt center back to the active Co1+ state. Without continuous reduction by MTRR, the cobalt center becomes oxidized to an inactive form, halting methyl transfer. This reductase step preserves methylation flux.
description_zh_TW: MTRR（methionine synthase reductase）是黃素蛋白還原酶，透過將其氧化的鈷中心還原回活性的 Co1+ 狀態來維持 methionine synthase 的活性。若沒有 MTRR 的持續還原，鈷中心會氧化為不活躍形式，停止甲基轉移。此還原步驟維持甲基化通量。

label: Oocyte
description: Oocyte cytoplasm reprograms donor nuclei in SCNT. Enablement is the maternal-factor mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 卵母細胞質在 SCNT 重編程供體核。賦能是母系因子機制。

label: HMGB1
description: HMGB1 acts as a ligand at TLR2/6, in addition to its established interactions with TLR4 and RAGE. In the SASP-induction scheme HMGB1 is grouped with the acute-phase serum amyloids SAA1 and SAA2 as a damage-associated molecular pattern acting on TLR2, which in turn primes the inflammasome. This places a nuclear chromatin protein at the top of a receptor-to-inflammasome axis: HMGB1 released from damaged cells becomes an extracellular signal that sustains the inflammatory secretome.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 除了已知與 TLR4 及 RAGE 的交互作用外，亦作為 TLR2/6 的配體。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，HMGB1 與急性期血清澱粉樣蛋白 SAA1、SAA2 同組，作為作用於 TLR2 的損傷相關分子模式，進而預處理發炎體。這將一個細胞核染色質蛋白置於受體至發炎體軸的頂端：由受損細胞釋出的 HMGB1 成為維持發炎型 secretome 的細胞外訊號。

label: eNOS
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: eNOS-derived nitric oxide activates SIRT1, and SIRT1 deacetylates eNOS to maintain its activity, forming a reciprocal endothelial-protective loop that declines with age; this NO/SIRT1 axis supports cardiovascular healthspan (Mattagajasingh et al., 2007; listed as a positive regulator in the source review's Table 3).
description_zh_TW: eNOS 衍生的一氧化氮活化 SIRT1，而 SIRT1 去乙醯化 eNOS 以維持其活性，形成一個隨年齡衰退的內皮保護性互惠迴圈；這種 NO/SIRT1 軸支持心血管健康跨度（Mattagajasingh et al., 2007；在文獻綜述表 3 中列為正向調節因子）。

label: Cell Cycle Arrest
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: TGF-beta superfamily signaling enforces growth arrest in recipient cells.
description_zh_TW: TGF-β 超家族訊號在受體細胞執行生長停滯。

label: Oleacein
description: Oleacein carries a catechol (ortho-dihydroxyphenyl) moiety, making it a classic substrate for COMT O-methylation. It is itself O-methylated by the enzyme, consuming SAMe and methyl groups. This makes oleacein a catechol-bearing phenol that engages COMT as a substrate.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 帶有兒茶酚（鄰二羥苯基）部分，使其成為 COMT O-甲基化的典型受質。它本身會被酶 O-甲基化，消耗 SAMe 和 methyl groups。這使 oleacein 成為以受質身分接合 COMT 的含兒茶酚酚類。

label: Senolytics
description: Senolytic clearance of senescent cells extends longevity in aged models. Extension records the class outcome beyond fisetin alone.
description_zh_TW: Senolytic 清除衰老細胞延長老年模型壽命。延長記錄超越單一 fisetin 的類別結果。

label: Nitric Oxide
description: Superoxide reacts with nitric oxide at diffusion-limited rates near 1e10 to yield peroxynitrite. Reaction couples oxidative stress to endothelial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: 超氧陰離子以近 1e10 的擴散極限速率與一氧化氮反應產生過氧亞硝酸鹽。反應將氧化壓力耦合到內皮功能障礙。

label: D2 receptor
description: The D2 receptor modulates reward processing by inhibiting medium spiny neurons of the striatal indirect pathway, thereby shaping the salience and reinforcement of rewarding stimuli. Its activity integrates dopamine signals that govern motivated behavior, reward learning, and incentive motivation in the ventral striatum and nucleus accumbens. Dysregulation of D2 signaling, including reduced receptor availability, is implicated in addiction, obesity, and schizophrenia. Because dopamine availability is partly set by COMT, genotype can indirectly influence D2-mediated reward function.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制紋狀體間接路徑的中型多棘神經元來調節 reward 處理，從而塑造獎勵刺激的顯著性和強化。其活性整合了控制動機行為的多巴胺訊號，reward learning，以及腹側紋狀體和伏隔核的激勵動機。 D2 訊號傳導失調，包括受體可用性降低，與成癮、肥胖和精神分裂症有關。由於多巴胺的可用性部分由 COMT 決定，因此基因型可以間接影響 D2 介導的 reward 功能。

label: Luteolin
description: Luteolin is a naturally occurring flavone, a subclass of flavonoids, with the chemical structure 3',4',5,7-tetrahydroxyflavone. It is abundant in parsley, celery, broccoli, green peppers, thyme, and chamomile. It is among the most studied dietary polyphenols for anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective activities.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 是天然存在的黃酮（flavone），是 Flavonoids 的一個亞類，化學結構為 3',4',5,7-四羥基黃酮。它大量存在於歐芹、芹菜、綠花椰菜、青椒、百里香和洋甘菊中。它是研究最多的膳食多酚之一，具有抗發炎和神經保護活性。

label: Nitrative Stress
description: Nitrative stress produces 3-nitrotyrosine (3-NT), the most characteristic and biomedically relevant protein modification of this pathway. 3-NT forms when peroxynitrite-derived radicals (NO2 and carbonate radical) oxidize tyrosine phenolate groups and couple with NO2. Because 3-NT is a stable, unrepairable post-translational modification, it serves as both a biomarker and a mediator of tissue injury in many diseases.
description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 產生 3-nitrotyrosine（3-NT），這是此途徑最具特徵性且與生物醫學最相關的蛋白質修飾。當 peroxynitrite 衍生的自由基（NO2 和 carbonate radical）氧化酪氨酸酚基並與 NO2 偶聯時，會形成 3-NT。由於 3-NT 是穩定且不可修復的轉譯後修飾，它在許多疾病中既是生物標記也是組織損傷的介導者。

label: Glycation
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Amadori products of glucose-lysine binding are early reversible fructosamine intermediates. Binding yields the first stable adduct.
description_zh_TW: 葡萄糖-離胺酸結合的 Amadori 產物是早期可逆的 fructosamine 中間體。結合產生首個穩定加合物。

label: Eustress
description: Low-dose NaCl at 25 mM acts as eustress in hydroponically grown sunflower microgreens, stimulating rather than suppressing growth. Shoot fresh yield rose 58.7%, leaf area 81.4%, and root length 25.7% versus control. This stimulatory low-dose effect is the defining feature of eustress/hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 25 mM 低劑量 NaCl 在水耕向日葵苗菜中發揮 Eustress 作用，促進而非抑制生長。地上部鮮重增加 58.7%、葉面積增加 81.4%、根長增加 25.7%。這種低劑量刺激效應正是 eustress／hormesis 的定義特徵。

label: Hydroxocobalamin
description: Hydroxocobalamin is the antidote of choice for cyanide poisoning: its hydroxyl ligand exchanges for cyanide to form nontoxic cyanocobalamin, excreted renally. This is a distinct indication from B12 repletion.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是氰化物中毒的首選解毒劑：其羥基配體與氰化物交換形成無毒的 cyanocobalamin，經腎排出。這是與 B12 補充不同的適應症。

label: Lipid Peroxidation
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Non-enzymatic peroxidation of arachidonic acid yields 8-iso-prostaglandin-F2alpha, the gold-standard oxidative stress biomarker. Isoprostane formation marks membrane peroxidation burden.
description_zh_TW: 花生四烯酸的非酶促過氧化產生 8-iso-prostaglandin-F2alpha，即黃金標準 oxidative stress 生物標記。異前列腺素形成標記膜過氧化負荷。

label: Norepinephrine transporter
description: NET and COMT govern local catechol concentrations in a complementary manner, with NET performing uptake and COMT performing enzymatic inactivation. In the prefrontal cortex, NET clears dopamine that escapes reuptake while COMT methylates the remainder. Genetic variation in COMT shifts the balance between these two clearance routes.
description_zh_TW: NET 和 COMT 以互補方式調控局部兒茶酚濃度，NET 執行再攝取而 COMT 執行酶促失活。在前額葉皮質，NET 清除逃過再攝取的 dopamine，而 COMT 甲基化其餘部分。COMT 的遺傳變異改變這兩種清除途徑之間的平衡。

label: Methylfolate
description: Methylfolate (L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the primary methyl donor in the Methylation Cycle: it supplies the methyl group that methionine synthase transfers to homocysteine, using MethylB12 as cofactor, to regenerate methionine and ultimately SAMe. As the main circulating folate and the sole folate form that readily crosses the blood-brain barrier, methylfolate directly feeds the methyl pool consumed by COMT; in slow-COMT individuals, high doses can flood the cycle and provoke overmethylation symptoms such as anxiety, irritability, and insomnia.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate（L-5-甲基四氫葉酸）是 Methylation Cycle 中的主要甲基供體：它提供 methionine synthase 以 MethylB12 為輔因子轉移至 homocysteine 的甲基，以再生 methionine 並最終生成 SAMe。作為主要循環葉酸且是唯一容易通過血腦屏障的葉酸形式，methylfolate 直接補充 COMT 所消耗的甲基池；在慢速 COMT 個體中，高劑量可能使循環過載，引發焦慮、易怒與失眠等「過度甲基化」症狀。

label: Thymopoiesis
description: The thymus is a vital organ for homeostatic maintenance of the peripheral immune system. Within its two compartments, the true thymic epithelial space (TES, comprising cortex and medulla) and the perivascular space (PVS), T cells develop, mature, and undergo induction of self-tolerance in a process called thymopoiesis. The cortex hosts early thymocyte development including T cell receptor gene rearrangement and positive selection, while the medulla carries out negative selection to remove autoreactive T cells. The perivascular space, composed of adipocytes, peripheral lymphocytes and stroma, is a non-thymopoietic component.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺是外周免疫系統穩態維持的重要器官。在其兩個隔室——真正的胸腺上皮空間（TES，包含皮質和髓質）和血管周圍空間（PVS）——中，T 細胞發育、成熟並經歷稱為胸腺生成的自身耐受誘導過程。皮質主持早期胸腺細胞發育，包括 T 細胞受體基因重排和陽性選擇，而髓質執行陰性選擇以清除自身反應性 T 細胞。血管周圍空間由脂肪細胞、外周淋巴細胞和基質組成，是非胸腺生成的成分。

label: Lung Cancer
description: Serum SIRT3 distinguishes lung cancer patients from healthy controls with an AUC of 0.918, sensitivity of 86.4%, and specificity of 94%. High SIRT1-3 expression correlates with poor survival in NSCLC. In the tumor SIRT3 reduces cisplatin resistance through the FoxO3/CDT1 axis and promotes DNA repair and radioresistance via ATM-Chk2, illustrating how a single sirtuin affects both diagnosis and therapy response.
description_zh_TW: 血清 SIRT3 區分肺癌患者與健康對照，AUC 為 0.918，敏感度 86.4%，特異度 94%。SIRT1-3 高度表現與 NSCLC 不良存活相關。在腫瘤中 SIRT3 透過 FoxO3/CDT1 軸降低 cisplatin 抗性，並經由 ATM-Chk2 促進 DNA 修復與放射抗性，說明單一 sirtuin 如何同時影響診斷與治療反應。

label: IDO1
description: Nec-1 was later found to be identical to a previously reported indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase inhibitor, i.e. it blocks both RIPK1 and IDO — a caveat for interpreting Nec-1-based disease studies.
description_zh_TW: Nec-1 後來被發現與先前報導的 indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 抑制劑為同一化合物，即其同時抑制 RIPK1 與 IDO——解讀以 Nec-1 為基礎之疾病研究時必須注意的警訊。

label: Insulin Resistance
description: High circulating branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) levels - leucine, isoleucine, and valine - are associated with obesity, insulin resistance, and mortality in humans. High-BCAA diets promote obesity, insulin resistance, inflammation, and decreased lifespan in rodents, whereas dietary restriction of BCAAs promotes metabolic health, reduces frailty, and extends lifespan, recapitulating many benefits of protein restriction. BCAA restriction reduces mTORC1 signaling, induces Fgf21, reduces hepatic cellular senescence, and in human studies improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis while increasing circulating FGF21. Although BCAAs are often considered as a group, each individual BCAA plays distinct roles in aging.
description_zh_TW: 循環中高濃度的支鏈胺基酸（BCAA）——白胺酸（leucine）、異白胺酸（isoleucine）與纈胺酸（valine）——與人類的肥胖、胰島素阻抗及死亡率相關。高BCAA飲食會在囓齒類中促進肥胖、胰島素阻抗、發炎並縮短壽命；而膳食限制BCAA則可促進代謝健康、減少衰弱並延長壽命，重現蛋白質限制的許多益處。限制BCAA可降低mTORC1訊息傳導、誘導Fgf21、減少肝臟細胞衰老；在人體研究中則可改善胰島素敏感性與葡萄糖/胰島素恆定，同時提高循環中的FGF21。儘管BCAA常被視為一個群體，但每一種BCAA在衰老中都扮演著不同的角色。

label: Heart Failure
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Infarction drives remodeling and hypertrophy into progressive pump failure. Causation is the remodeling outcome.
description_zh_TW: 梗塞驅動重塑與肥大進入進行性幫浦衰竭。因果是重塑結果。

label: Anaphase Promoting Complex-Cyclosome
description: The APC/C is a massive multi-subunit E3 ubiquitin ligase ordering mitotic degradation.
description_zh_TW: APC/C 是編排有絲分裂降解的巨大多亞基 E3 泛素連接酶。

label: Methemoglobinemia
description: Pulse oximetry non-invasively estimates oxygen saturation, but methemoglobin (and methylene blue) artifactually lowers the reading. In methemoglobinemia, arterial blood gas with co-oximetry should be used instead to resolve the methemoglobin fraction.
description_zh_TW: 脈搏血氧儀非侵入性估算血氧飽和度，但變性血紅素（及 methylene blue）會人為地降低讀數。在變性血紅素血症中，應改用動脈血氣分析與 co-oximetry 以解析變性血紅素比例。

label: Partial Reprogramming
description: Partial reprogramming drives muscle, pancreatic and cardiac regrowth plus scar reduction in mice.
description_zh_TW: 部分重編程在小鼠驅動肌肉、胰臟與心臟再生長加疤痕減少。

label: cGAS-STING Pathway
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Cytosolic mtDNA, cytoplasmic chromatin fragments and LINE-1 cDNA crosstalk to amplify cGAS-STING signaling in senescence; removing any single DNA source often suppresses SASP, and blocking the mitochondrial source preserves acute immune responses better than direct cGAS or STING blockade.
description_zh_TW: 胞質 mtDNA、細胞質染色質片段與 LINE-1 cDNA 交互作用以放大衰老中的 cGAS-STING 訊號；去除任一 DNA 來源常可抑制 SASP，而阻斷粒線體來源比直接抑制 cGAS 或 STING 更能保留急性免疫反應。

label: CamKIIα
description: CamKIIα is abundantly expressed in hippocampal circuits where its autophosphorylation sustains LTP and memory consolidation. Hippocampal expression extends its forebrain cognitive role beyond prefrontal cortex.
description_zh_TW: CamKIIα 豐富表現於海馬迴路，其自磷酸化維持 LTP 與記憶鞏固。海馬表現將其前腦認知角色延伸至前額葉之外。

label: Cohesin
description: The cohesin ring holds sister chromatids until anaphase onset.
description_zh_TW: cohesin 環將姐妹染色單體繫在一起直到後期開始。

label: Protein Restriction
description: Protein restriction lowers body fat in rodents and humans despite compensatory hyperphagia, via FGF21-driven thermogenesis. Fat loss independent of caloric intake is the defining phenotype.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制在代償性多食下仍降低囓齒類與人類體脂，經由 FGF21 驅動的產熱。不依賴熱量攝取的脂肪減少是定義表型。

label: NLRP3 inflammasome
description: ASC-speck proximity induces caspase-1 activation as the canonical inflammasome output. Activation executes pyroptotic and cytokine processing.
description_zh_TW: ASC 斑點鄰近誘發 caspase-1 活化作為典型發炎體輸出。活化執行焦亡與細胞激素處理。

label: Nicotinamide
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide, a product of the sirtuin deacetylation reaction itself, is a micromolar non-competitive inhibitor of SIRT1 and SIRT2 that interacts with the C (nicotinamide) pocket of the catalytic site. It was one of the first endogenous compounds studied as a sirtuin inhibitor and inspired the search for NAD+ and nicotinamide analogs. SIRT1 inhibition with nicotinamide was reported to have anticancer activity in B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia and prostate cancer. Its limitations, and those of NAD+ analogs, lie in modest potency and limited therapeutic potential, which motivated development of more potent scaffolds.
description_zh_TW: 尼可醯胺是 sirtuin 去乙醯化反應本身的產物，是 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 的微摩爾級非競爭性抑制劑，與催化位點的 C（尼可醯胺）口袋相互作用。它是最早被研究作為 sirtuin 抑制劑的內源性化合物之一，並啟發了 NAD+ 和尼可醯胺類似物的搜索。利用尼可醯胺抑制 SIRT1 據報導在 B 細胞慢性淋巴性白血病和前列腺癌中具有抗癌活性。其局限性，以及 NAD+ 類似物的局限性，在於效能有限和治療潛力不足，這促進了更強效骨架結構的開發。

label: Heart Rate Variability
description: Chronically elevated cortisol, from stacked stressors or poor recovery, suppresses heart-rate variability (HRV) and impairs mitochondrial biogenesis. Acute cortisol release supports the fight-or-flight response, but sustained elevation undermines parasympathetic recovery and HRV rebound.
description_zh_TW: 長期升高的 cortisol（源自疊加壓力或恢復不足）會抑制心率變異度（HRV）並損害粒線體生合成。急性 cortisol 釋放支持戰或逃反應，但持續升高會破壞副交感恢復與 HRV 反彈。

label: PARP1
description: MNNG is a methylating alkylating agent that generates a high load of DNA strand breaks, hyperactivating PARP1 and driving the parthanatos cascade; PARP inhibitors (DPQ, PJ-34) but not z-VAD block MNNG-induced death (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: MNNG 是產生大量 DNA 斷裂的甲基化烷化劑，會過度活化 PARP1 並驅動 parthanatos 級聯；PARP 抑制劑（DPQ、PJ-34）而非 z-VAD 能阻斷 MNNG 誘導的死亡（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Mitochondrial ROS
description: Succinate oxidation at Complex II drives reverse electron transport at Complex I, bursting mitochondrial ROS that stabilize HIF-1alpha and interleukin-1beta. Metabolite oxidation signals immune activation.
description_zh_TW: Complex II 的琥珀酸氧化驅動 Complex I 逆向電子傳遞，爆發粒線體 ROS 以穩定 HIF-1alpha 與 interleukin-1beta。代謝物氧化傳遞免疫活化訊號。

label: synaptic plasticity
description: Dopamine governs striatal synaptic plasticity as a neuromodulator of strength changes. Regulation is the modulatory control relationship.
description_zh_TW: 多巴胺作為強度變化的神經調節劑掌管紋狀體突觸可塑性。調節是調節性控制關係。

label: Caspase-8
description: Caspase-8 activates Caspase-3: as the initiator caspase of the extrinsic (death receptor) pathway, DISC-assembled caspase-8 (with caspase-10) directly cleaves the executioner Caspase-3 in type I cells, while in type II cells it cleaves Bid to route through mitochondria. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Caspase-8 also sits at the crossroads of apoptosis, necroptosis, and pyroptosis — its active form cleaves RIPK1 and RIPK3, preventing necroptosis — so the caspase-8-to-Caspase-3 flow is simultaneously a death signal and a necroptosis suppressor.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-8 啟動 Caspase-3：作為外在（死亡受體）路徑之起始 caspase，經 DISC 組裝之 caspase-8（與 caspase-10）在 type I 細胞中直接切割執行者 Caspase-3；在 type II 細胞中則切割 Bid，改經粒線體路徑。Caspase-3 是 主要的執行者 caspase，可切割數百種受質以產生凋亡表型。Caspase-8 亦位於凋亡、necroptosis 與焦亡之十字路口——其活化 形式會切割 RIPK1 與 RIPK3 以阻止 necroptosis——因此 Caspase-8 至 Caspase-3 之流動既是死亡訊號，也是 necroptosis 之抑制者。

label: Cellular Reprogramming
description: Fibroblasts are the first and standard reprogramming starting material.
description_zh_TW: 纖維母細胞是最初且標準的重編程起始材料。

label: Hippocampus
description: The hippocampus has sparse dopamine transporter expression, so extracellular dopamine there is cleared mainly by COMT and NET uptake. This mirrors the prefrontal sparse-DAT architecture that makes COMT the dominant clearance route.
description_zh_TW: 海馬體的多巴胺轉運蛋白表現稀疏，因此該處細胞外多巴胺主要由 COMT 與 NET 攝取清除。此呼應前額葉稀疏 DAT 架構，使 COMT 成為主要清除路徑。

label: Colon Cancer
description: Inactivating APC mutation is the initiating event of the adenoma-carcinoma sequence, driving constitutive Wnt/beta-catenin signaling in most sporadic colon cancers.
description_zh_TW: APC 失活突變是腺瘤–癌序列的起始事件，在多數散發性結腸癌中驅動持續性 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號。

label: Modafinil
description: Modafinil is a wakefulness-promoting agent approved for narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea-related sleepiness, and shift-work sleep disorder, acting via dopamine transporter inhibition and orexin system modulation. It improves daytime alertness and reduces excessive sleepiness with a lower abuse liability than classical psychostimulants such as amphetamines. Its efficacy provides the clinical anchor for its off-label cognitive and nootropic uses. It is a key tool in sleep medicine and in performance-enhancement contexts.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 是一種覺醒促進劑，被批准用於治療 narcolepsy、阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症相關的嗜睡和輪班工作睡眠障礙，透過多巴胺轉運蛋白抑制和食慾素系統調節發揮作用。它可以提高白天的警覺性並減少過度嗜睡，並且比安非他明等經典精神興奮劑的濫用可能性更低。其功效為其標籤外認知和 nootropic 用途提供了臨床依據。它是睡眠醫學和提高表現的關鍵工具。

label: Longevity
description: Worm SIR-2.1 NAD-dependent deacetylase regulates lifespan and stress resistance. Regulation is the aging output.
description_zh_TW: 線蟲 SIR-2.1 NAD 依賴去乙醯酶調節壽命與壓力抗性。調節是老化輸出。

label: Diabetes Mellitus
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Hyperglycemia routes up to a third of glucose through the polyol pathway in susceptible tissues. Glucose overflow switches on the normally minor route.
description_zh_TW: 高血糖在易感組織將高達三分之一葡萄糖導入多元醇路徑。葡萄糖溢流開啟平時次要的路徑。

label: Neuroprotection
description: SIRT1 confers neuroprotection by deacetylating FOXO and PGC-1alpha to drive antioxidant and mitochondrial programs, suppressing NF-kB-mediated neuroinflammation, and promoting non-amyloidogenic APP processing via ADAM10; it protects against beta-amyloid toxicity and supports BDNF expression through Hes1 deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 FOXO 和 PGC-1alpha 來驅動抗氧化和粒線體程序，抑制 NF-kB 介導的神經發炎反應，並透過 ADAM10 促進非類澱粉樣 APP 處理，從而賦予神經保護作用；它保護免受 β-類澱粉毒性並透過 Hes1 去乙醯化支持 BDNF 表達。

label: Cisplatin
description: Cisplatin downregulates muscle Nrk2 by 93 percent with high significance.
description_zh_TW: Cisplatin 高顯著下調肌肉 Nrk2 達 93%。

label: DNMT1
description: UHRF1 recognizes hemi-methylated CpG via its SRA domain to recruit DNMT1. Active-voice inverse of the existing recruited_by edge; novel pair.
description_zh_TW: UHRF1 經由 SRA 結構域辨識半甲基化 CpG 以招募 DNMT1。既有 recruited_by 邊的主動語態反向；新穎配對。

label: Information Theory of Aging
description: The Information Theory of Aging posits that aging arises from the loss of epigenetic and nuclear-architectural information. The Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis is a mechanistic instantiation of this theory, in which repeated modifier relocalization erodes the epigenetic landscape.
description_zh_TW: 老化資訊理論主張老化源於表觀遺傳與核架構資訊的喪失。染色質修飾因子易位（RCM）假說是此理論的機制性落實，其中修飾因子反覆易位會侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀。

label: Silver
description: Oxidized silver reduced in vivo to elemental deposits produces permanent pigmentation of argyria. Deposition executes the discoloration phenotype.
description_zh_TW: 氧化的銀在體內還原為元素沉積，產生 argyria 的永久性色素沉著。沉積執行變色表型。

label: Glutaminase
description: CB-839 blocks the first step of glutaminolysis at glutaminase.
description_zh_TW: CB-839 在麩醯胺酸酶阻斷麩醯胺酸分解第一步。

label: Spermidine
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Under the autophagy-senescence threshold model, Spermidine-induced autophagic flux suppresses entry into Senescence while cellular damage stays below a critical threshold; once damage exceeds it, autophagy is reprogrammed to support senescent-cell survival and senolytics such as Fisetin are required, making spermidine and fisetin sequential non-redundant partners on the same continuum.
description_zh_TW: 在 autophagy–senescence 閾值模型下，Spermidine 誘導的自噬通量可在細胞損傷低於臨界閾值時抑制進入 Senescence；損傷超越閾值後，自噬被重編程以支持衰老細胞存活，此時需 Fisetin 等 senolytics 清除，使兩者在同一連續體上成為先後有序、非冗餘的搭檔。

label: Heterochromatin
description: XIST coating induces a repressive heterochromatin state on the coated X.
description_zh_TW: XIST 包被在包被的 X 誘發抑制性異染色質狀態。

label: Tubulin
description: Microtubules are alpha/beta-tubulin polymers whose dynamics govern mitosis.
description_zh_TW: 微管是 α/β-tubulin 聚合物，其動態主導有絲分裂。

label: Epigenetic Clock
description: Epigenetic clocks are the operational estimator of biological age.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳時鐘是生物年齡的操作性估計器。

label: Histone Deacetylase
description: Isothiocyanate sulforaphane inhibits histone deacetylases, reactivating silenced genes.
description_zh_TW: 異硫氰酸酯 sulforaphane 抑制組蛋白去乙醯化酶，重新活化沉默基因。

label: IL-6
description: IL-6 signals through the interleukin-6 receptor, the ligand-binding subunit that must associate with gp130 to transduce a signal. In the SASP this is the entry point of the autocrine amplification loop: secreted IL-6 acts on IL-6R in the same or neighbouring cells, which is one reason IL-6 is described as both an output and a driver of the senescent secretory programme. Soluble IL-6R generated by shedding or alternative splicing extends the loop to cells that lack membrane IL-6R, broadening the set of cells that can respond.
description_zh_TW: IL-6 經介白素-6 受體訊號，該受體為配體結合次單元，必須與 gp130 結合才能傳遞訊號。在 SASP 中，這是自泌放大環路的進入點：分泌的 IL-6 作用於同一或鄰近細胞的 IL-6R，這也是 IL-6 同時被描述為衰老分泌程序的輸出與驅動者的原因之一。由切割或替代剪接產生的可溶性 IL-6R 可將此環路延伸至缺乏膜性 IL-6R 的細胞，擴大可回應的細胞範圍。

label: Estrogen
description: Estradiol induces SmgGDS (RAP1GDS1) in the female heart, where it restrains ferritinophagy-mediated ferroptosis and contributes to cardiac protection.
description_zh_TW: Estradiol 在雌性心臟誘導 SmgGDS（RAP1GDS1），抑制 ferritinophagy 介導的 ferroptosis，參與心臟保護。

label: Ubiquitin Ligase
description: The APC/C is a massive multi-subunit E3 ubiquitin ligase ordering mitotic degradation.
description_zh_TW: APC/C 是編排有絲分裂降解的巨大多亞基 E3 泛素連接酶。

label: NADPH Oxidase
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: NOX2-derived superoxide is the phagocyte respiratory burst itself; chronic granulomatous disease abolishes it. Requirement marks the oxidase as the burst effector.
description_zh_TW: NOX2 衍生超氧化物即吞噬細胞呼吸爆發本身；慢性肉芽腫病廢除之。必要性標記氧化酶為爆發效應器。

label: Paracrine Senescence
description: SASP factors including IL-1, TGFb, VEGF and CCL2 spread senescence to neighboring cells. Induction is the paracrine transmission mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 包括 IL-1、TGFβ、VEGF 與 CCL2 的 SASP 因子將衰老傳播至鄰近細胞。誘發是旁分泌傳遞機制。

label: HLH-30
description: atg-16.2 is induced during fasting and starvation in an HLH-30-dependent manner. Regulation extends the HLH-30 program to the conjugation complex.
description_zh_TW: atg-16.2 在禁食與飢餓期間以 HLH-30 依賴方式誘發。調節將 HLH-30 程序延伸到接合複合體。

label: Bcl-xL
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: JNK2 phosphorylates Bcl-xL at Ser62, inactivating it during G2 arrest.
description_zh_TW: JNK2 在 Ser62 磷酸化 Bcl-xL，在 G2 停滯使其失活。

label: Senescent Cells
description: Fisetin was the most potent senolytic among ten flavonoids screened (1-10 uM clearing 25-50% of senescent fibroblasts); late-life administration extended median and maximum lifespan in mice, and intermittent dosing matched genetic p16+ clearance for frailty and grip strength (Yousefzadeh 2018; Murray 2025).
description_zh_TW: 在十種 flavonoid 篩選中，Fisetin 是最強 senolytic（1–10 uM 清除 25–50% 老化纖維母細胞）；老年給藥延長小鼠中位與最大壽命，間歇給藥在衰弱與握力改善上媲美基因清除 p16+ 細胞（Yousefzadeh 2018；Murray 2025）。

label: Tumor Microenvironment
description: Tumor assembloids fuse tumor organoids with immune and stromal cells.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤 assembloid 將腫瘤類器官與免疫及基質細胞融合。

label: RIPK3
description: Following the Nomenclature Committee on Cell Death 2012 recommendations, necroptosis is canonically defined as necrotic cell death dependent on RIPK3 — not synonymous with all active necrosis, and mechanistically distinct from other regulated-necrosis programs such as MPT (Linkermann & Green, NEJM 2014).
description_zh_TW: 依 Nomenclature Committee on Cell Death 2012 之建議，necroptosis 被規範性定義為依賴 RIPK3 的壞死性細胞死亡——不等同於所有活化性壞死，且在機制上與其他 regulated necrosis 程序（如 MPT）截然不同。

label: PGC-1α
description: PGC-1alpha is the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis downstream of exercise, fasting and cold stress. Textbook-level causation.
description_zh_TW: PGC-1alpha 是運動、禁食與冷壓力下游粒線體生成的主調節因子。教科書等級因果。

label: TGFβ
description: SIRT6 inactivates TGF-beta1/Smad2 signaling to prevent myofibroblast differentiation, inhibits TGF-beta-induced cellular senescence, and blocks EMT during IPF through TGF-beta1/Smad3. SIRT6 is thus a master suppressor of the fibrotic cascade in lung fibrosis, whereas SIRT7 decline has a profibrotic effect via Smad3 changes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 使 TGF-beta1/Smad2 訊號失效以阻止肌纖維母細胞分化，抑制 TGF-beta 誘發的細胞衰老，並在 IPF 中透過 TGF-beta1/Smad3 阻斷 EMT。SIRT6 因此是肺纖維化中纖維化級聯的主抑制因子，而 SIRT7 下降透過 Smad3 變化具有促纖維化效應。

label: Coenzyme Q10
description: HMG-CoA reductase inhibition by statins diverts mevalonate flux away from CoQ10, collapsing the ubiquinone pool; with no substrate to reduce, FSP1 cannot regenerate ubiquinol even with abundant NAD(P)H — so statins (like FIN56) sensitize to ferroptosis independently of GPX4 status.
description_zh_TW: Statins 對 HMG-CoA 還原酶的抑制使 mevalonate 流量偏離 CoQ10，使 ubiquinone 池崩潰；沒有受質可還原時，即使 NAD(P)H 充足 FSP1 也無法再生成 ubiquinol——因此 statins（如 FIN56）以不依賴 GPX4 狀態的方式使細胞對鐵死亡敏感。

label: HIF-1α
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Mitochondrial ROS stabilize HIF-1alpha in activated macrophages, licensing glycolytic and inflammatory transcription. Oxidant stabilization links metabolism to hypoxia signaling.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體 ROS 在活化巨噬細胞穩定 HIF-1alpha，許可糖解與發炎轉錄。氧化劑穩定將代謝與缺氧訊號連結。

label: Metformin
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Metformin inhibits complex I to raise AMP:ATP and activate AMPK. Inhibition is the bioenergetic entry.
description_zh_TW: Metformin 抑制複合體 I 以提高 AMP:ATP 並活化 AMPK。抑制是生物能量進入。

label: Peroxynitrite
description: Microglial nitric oxide plus superoxide forms peroxynitrite that tyrosine-nitrates alpha-synuclein into Lewy-body aggregates. ASCII spelling avoids a node split with the DJ-1 chaperone edge.
description_zh_TW: 微膠細胞 nitric oxide 加超氧形成 peroxynitrite，酪氨酸硝化 alpha-synuclein 為 Lewy 體聚集。ASCII 拼寫避免與 DJ-1 伴侶邊的節點分裂。

label: RAGE
description: RAGE binds HMGB1 (amphoterin), as well as members of the S100 protein family, amyloid beta oligomers, and other ligands, making it a multi-ligand pattern-recognition receptor. This broad ligand repertoire positions RAGE as a sensor for damage-associated molecular patterns in sterile inflammation. Each ligand class activates overlapping but distinct downstream signaling profiles.
description_zh_TW: RAGE 結合 HMGB1（amphoterin），以及 S100 protein family 成員、amyloid beta 寡聚體和其他配體，使其成為多配體模式識別受體。這種廣泛的配體庫使 RAGE 成為無菌性發炎中損傷相關分子模式的感測器。每一類配體都活化重疊但截然不同的下游訊號輪廓。

label: Hydrogen Peroxide
description: Hydrogen peroxide is the obligate co-substrate with bromide in eosinophil peroxidase catalysis of hypobromous acid. Co-substrate supply gates brominating output.
description_zh_TW: 過氧化氫是嗜酸性球過氧化物酶催化次溴酸時與溴化物並列的必要共底物。共底物供應守衛溴化輸出。

label: Thymic Involution
description: Age-associated thymic involution results in diminished thymopoiesis: reduction of the thymic epithelial space causes loss of T cell receptor gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery. Using single joint T cell receptor excision circle analysis (sjTREC), a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis, researchers measured a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan. Similar decreases in sjTREC per milligram of thymus tissue were observed in aging BALB/c mice from 6 to 90 weeks. Thus involution reduces both the quantity and quality of T cells exported across the lifespan.
description_zh_TW: 與年齡相關的胸腺退化導致胸腺生成減弱：胸腺上皮空間的縮減導致 T 細胞受體基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。研究人員使用單連結 T 細胞受體 excision circle 分析（sjTREC）——一種 active thymopoiesis 的分子標記——測量到在 80 年人類壽命中循環初始 T 細胞穩定下降三個數量級。在 6 至 90 週齡的老化 BALB/c 小鼠中也觀察到每毫克胸腺組織的 sjTREC 類似下降。因此，退化在整個壽命中降低了輸出 T 細胞的數量和質量。

label: Berberine
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Berberine is a clinically relevant inhibitor of the drug-metabolizing enzyme CYP3A4 (along with CYP2D6 and P-glycoprotein), elevating plasma levels of co-administered CYP3A4 substrates such as certain statins, cyclosporine, and warfarin; because Fisetin is itself a CYP3A4 substrate and partial inhibitor, berberine-fisetin co-administration may mutually raise exposure, warranting temporal dose separation pending dedicated interaction trials.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 是具臨床意義的藥物代謝酶 CYP3A4 抑制劑（兼抑制 CYP2D6 與 P-glycoprotein），會墊高併用 CYP3A4 受質（如特定 statins、cyclosporine、warfarin）的血漿濃度；因 Fisetin 本身亦為 CYP3A4 受質兼部分抑制劑，兩者併用可能相互墊高暴露量，在專門交互作用試驗完成前宜分時給藥。

label: Akt
description: Akt negatively regulates GSK3, the switch deciding Mcl-1 T163 stabilization versus degradation.
description_zh_TW: Akt 負向調節 GSK3，此開關決定 Mcl-1 T163 穩定或降解。

label: RIPK1
description: SHARPIN, a component of the linear ubiquitin chain assembly complex (LUBAC), is a RIPK1-regulator; SHARPIN deficiency causes chronic proliferative dermatitis in mice that is reversed on a TNFR1-deficient background.
description_zh_TW: SHARPIN 為線性泛素鏈組裝複合物（LUBAC）之組分，是 RIPK1 之調節者；SHARPIN 缺失在小鼠引起慢性增生性皮炎，並在 TNFR1 缺失背景下被逆轉。

label: MicroRNA
description: Tumor exosomes traffic microRNA cargo between cells.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤外泌體在細胞間運送 microRNA 貨物。

label: Hepatocellular Carcinoma
description: SIRT3 expression is lower in HCC tissue than in adjacent tissue. Modulating SIRT3 enhances sorafenib therapy, and SIRT3 downregulates GST-pi1 to enhance chemo- and sorafenib-induced apoptosis. Its loss therefore correlates with tumor aggressiveness and reduced treatment efficacy in hepatocellular carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 HCC 組織中的表現低於鄰近組織。調節 SIRT3 可增強 sorafenib 治療，且 SIRT3 下調 GST-pi1 以增強化療與 sorafenib 誘發的凋亡。因此，其缺失與肝細胞癌中的腫瘤侵襲性與治療效能降低相關。

label: p38 MAPK
description: p38 MAPK phosphorylates and activates MAPKAPK2 (MK2), making MK2 the principal effector through which p38 controls the stability of labile inflammatory transcripts. Active MK2 phosphorylates RNA-binding decay factors such as ZFP36L1/TTP, preventing them from recruiting deadenylation machinery to AU-rich elements in SASP mRNAs. The consequence is post-transcriptional prolongation of cytokine and chemokine transcripts, a control layer distinct from transcription-factor-driven expression. In the SASP-induction scheme the p38 to MK2 connection is drawn explicitly, separating transcriptional from post-transcriptional regulation of the secretome.
description_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 磷酸化並活化 MAPKAPK2（MK2），使 MK2 成為 p38 控制不穩定發炎轉錄本穩定性的主要效應者。活化的 MK2 磷酸化 ZFP36L1/TTP 等 RNA 結合衰變因子，阻止其招募去腺苷酸化機制至 SASP mRNA 的 AU-rich 元件。結果是細胞激素與趨化激素轉錄本的轉錄後延長，此調控層不同於轉錄因子驅動的表現。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，p38 至 MK2 的連結被明確畫出，區分了 secretome 的轉錄與轉錄後調控。

label: Phagocytic Lysosome Reformation
description: Phosphoinositide signaling drives phagocytic lysosome reformation membrane remodeling. Regulation parallels the ALR edge.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸肌醇訊號驅動吞噬性溶酶體重組膜重塑。調節與 ALR 邊平行。

label: Caspase-3
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Caspase-8 activates Caspase-3: as the initiator caspase of the extrinsic (death receptor) pathway, DISC-assembled caspase-8 (with caspase-10) directly cleaves the executioner Caspase-3 in type I cells, while in type II cells it cleaves Bid to route through mitochondria. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Caspase-8 also sits at the crossroads of apoptosis, necroptosis, and pyroptosis — its active form cleaves RIPK1 and RIPK3, preventing necroptosis — so the caspase-8-to-Caspase-3 flow is simultaneously a death signal and a necroptosis suppressor.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-8 啟動 Caspase-3：作為外在（死亡受體）路徑之起始 caspase，經 DISC 組裝之 caspase-8（與 caspase-10）在 type I 細胞中直接切割執行者 Caspase-3；在 type II 細胞中則切割 Bid，改經粒線體路徑。Caspase-3 是 主要的執行者 caspase，可切割數百種受質以產生凋亡表型。Caspase-8 亦位於凋亡、necroptosis 與焦亡之十字路口——其活化 形式會切割 RIPK1 與 RIPK3 以阻止 necroptosis——因此 Caspase-8 至 Caspase-3 之流動既是死亡訊號，也是 necroptosis 之抑制者。

label: Flavonoids
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Flavanone is the saturated C-ring flavonoid subclass lacking the catechol motif. Classification nests it in the flavonoid family.
description_zh_TW: flavanone 是飽和 C 環的類黃酮亞類，缺乏兒茶酚基序。歸類將其嵌套於類黃酮家族。

label: Aspirin
description: Aspirin suppresses thromboxane A2 synthesis in platelets, which cannot resynthesize COX, shifting hemostasis toward reduced clot formation at low doses. TXA2 suppression is the antiplatelet mechanism behind its cardiovascular prophylaxis.
description_zh_TW: Aspirin 抑制血小板中血栓素 A2 合成，血小板無法重新合成 COX，低劑量使止血傾向減少凝塊形成。TXA2 抑制是其心血管預防背後的抗血小板機制。

label: Differentiation
description: Differentiation requires DNA-methylation, histone and Polycomb/bivalent resetting. Requirement makes remodeling the gate of lineage commitment.
description_zh_TW: 分化需要 DNA 甲基化、組蛋白與 Polycomb/雙價重置。必要性使重塑成為譜系承諾的閘門。

label: Prefrontal Cortex
description: The COMT Val158Met polymorphism modulates Prefrontal Cortex dopamine tone because, in the PFC, dopamine clearance depends principally on COMT rather than the dopamine transporter. The Met (slow) allele preserves higher extracellular dopamine, which can benefit certain working-memory tasks but increases anxiety vulnerability, whereas the Val (fast) allele lowers PFC dopamine and reduces cognitive efficiency unless boosted. Val158Met is therefore a key genetic determinant of PFC-dependent cognition, stress reactivity, and neuropsychiatric risk.
description_zh_TW: COMT 的 Val158Met 多型性調節 Prefrontal Cortex 的多巴胺張力，因為在前額葉皮質中，多巴胺清除主要依賴 COMT 而非多巴胺轉運蛋白。Met（慢速）等位基因保留較高的細胞外多巴胺，可能有助於某些工作記憶任務，但也增加焦慮脆弱性；Val（快速）等位基因則降低前額葉多巴胺並減損認知效率（除非受到藥物增強）。因此 Val158Met 是依賴前額葉皮質的認知、壓力反應性與神經精神疾病風險的關鍵遺傳決定因素。

label: BDNF
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: In dose-response comparisons across low, moderate, and high exercise intensities, all intensities improved cognition and motor outcomes, but high-intensity exercise produced the greatest BDNF upregulation alongside the strongest behavioral gains. This intensity-dependent neurotrophic response supports prescribing higher-intensity modalities such as HIIT when tolerated to maximize BDNF-TrkB signaling in neurodegenerative models.
description_zh_TW: 在低、中、高運動強度的劑量反應比較中，所有強度均改善認知與運動結果，但 High-Intensity Exercise 產生最大的 BDNF 上調並伴隨最強的行為改善。此強度依賴的神經營養反應支持在可耐受時優先採用 HIIT 等高強度模式，以最大化神經退化模型中的 BDNF-TrkB 訊號。

label: Epithelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition
description: Upregulated PODXL drives pro-migratory transition in carcinoma metastasis.
description_zh_TW: 上調的 PODXL 在癌轉移驅動促遷移轉換。

label: Ascorbic Acid
description: Ascorbate reduces oxidized silver to elemental metallic deposits in tissues. Reduction drives the precipitation chemistry.
description_zh_TW: 抗壞血酸在組織將氧化的銀還原為元素金屬沉積。還原驅動沉澱化學。

label: DRP1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: In senescent cells only fragmented mitochondria are BAX6A7-positive and release TFAM-bound mtDNA; DRP1-driven fission licenses this minority MOMP event, while hyperfusion protects by homogenizing Bcl-2 across the network.
description_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，只有片段化的粒線體呈 BAX6A7 陽性並釋放 TFAM 結合的 mtDNA；DRP1 驅動的分裂促使這種 minority MOMP，而高度融合則透過均質化 Bcl-2 來保護。

label: FSP1
description: NADPH is the obligate electron donor for FSP1-mediated ubiquinone-to-ubiquinol regeneration at the plasma membrane. Without this reducing input the GPX4-independent ferroptosis brake collapses.
description_zh_TW: NADPH 是 FSP1 在質膜將 ubiquinone 再生為 ubiquinol 的必要電子供體。缺乏此還原輸入，不依賴 GPX4 的鐵死亡煞車即崩潰。

label: Alzheimer's Disease
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Early axonal pathology accompanies Alzheimer's Disease progression. Association records shared axonopathy across neurodegenerations.
description_zh_TW: 早期軸突病理伴隨 Alzheimer's Disease 進展。關聯記錄神經退化間共享的軸突病變。

label: CD38
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Inflammaging upregulates CD38 on neutrophils and macrophages, starving sirtuins of NAD+. Cellular-resolution leg of the established CD38-consumes-NAD+ triple.
description_zh_TW: 發炎老化在嗜中性球與巨噬細胞上調 CD38，使 sirtuins 缺乏 NAD+。已確立的 CD38 消耗 NAD+ triple 的細胞解析度分支。

label: Parthanatos
description: MMS is a direct-acting methylating agent whose DNA lesions (mainly N3-methyladenine and N7-methylguanine, repaired by base excision repair) activate PARP1 and can trigger PARP1-dependent parthanatos, alongside apoptosis at other doses (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: MMS 是直接作用的甲基化劑，其 DNA 損傷（主要為 N3-methyladenine 與 N7-methylguanine，經鹼基切除修復）會活化 PARP1，並可觸發依賴 PARP1 的 parthanatos，於其他劑量下亦可引發 apoptosis（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Medium spiny neurons
description: Medium spiny neurons constitute roughly 90-95% of the neuronal population in the striatum (the caudate nucleus and putamen). They are the principal integrators of cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic input within the basal ganglia. They form the major output pathways regulating voluntary movement and reward-based learning.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約占 striatum（尾狀核和殼核）神經元群的 90-95%。它們是基底神經節內皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的主要整合者。它們形成調節自主運動和獎賞學習的主要輸出途徑。

label: Melanoma
description: Oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) is the permanent cell-cycle arrest triggered in cells carrying BRAF/RAS/MYC mutations. The benign melanocytic nevus (mole) is the in-vivo embodiment of OIS and prevents melanoma; bypass of OIS via p53/PTEN loss or TERT activation is required for malignancy. Capped, arrested growth is therefore tumor-suppressive.
description_zh_TW: 致癌基因誘發衰老（OIS）是在帶有 BRAF/RAS/MYC 突變的細胞中觸發的永久性細胞週期停滯。良性黑色素細胞痣（痣）是 OIS 的體內體現，並防止黑色素瘤；經由 p53/PTEN 缺失或 TERT 活化繞過 OIS 是惡性化所必需的。受封頂、停滯的生長因此是腫瘤抑制性的。

label: Acid ceramidase
description: ARN14974 is a brain-penetrant ACase inhibitor (IC50 79 nM) distinct from ARN14794, which already has a triple. Separate chemistry, separate edge.
description_zh_TW: ARN14974 是可入腦的 ACase 抑制劑（IC50 79 nM），不同於已有 triple 的 ARN14794。不同化學，獨立邊。

label: Glutathione
description: Pathway NADPH consumption compromises glutathione regeneration; the effect is indirect and mediated through cofactor competition. Redox tradeoff weakens thiol defense.
description_zh_TW: 路徑 NADPH 消耗損害 glutathione 再生；效應間接，經由輔因子競爭介導。氧化還原權衡削弱硫醇防禦。

label: Humanin
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Humanin transgenic mice show 15 to 20 percent median lifespan extension. Extension records the geroprotective outcome.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 轉基因小鼠顯示 15 至 20% 中位壽命延長。延長記錄老年保護結果。

label: Quercetin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Quercetin directly scavenges ROS, chelates metals, activates Nrf2-mediated endogenous defense, and crosses the blood-brain barrier.
