In stress plus scopolamine rat models it reduced IL-6 and TNF-alpha, modulated APP/APLP2 expression toward non-amyloidogenic processing, and improved cognition and anxiety. Combined quercetin plus treadmill exercise was more effective than either alone in STZ-induced AD rats.
description_zh_TW: Quercetin 可直接清除 ROS、螯合金屬、活化 Nrf2 介導的內源性防禦，並穿越血腦屏障。在壓力合併 scopolamine 大鼠模型中，它降低 IL-6 與 TNF-alpha，調控 APP/APLP2 表現朝向非類澱粉生成處理，並改善認知與焦慮。在 STZ 誘發的 AD 大鼠中，Quercetin 合併跑步機運動比單一介入更有效。

label: Bcl-2
description: The antisense Oblimersen lowers Bcl-2 protein via RNase-H mRNA cleavage.
description_zh_TW: 反義 Oblimersen 經 RNase-H mRNA 切割降低 Bcl-2 蛋白。

label: Catalase
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Catalase is presented as an endogenous antioxidant defense that detoxifies hydrogen peroxide generated after ischemic events. Its activity falls during OGD and is restored by Brosimine B in parallel with reduced ROS and improved viability. The paper cites dose-dependent catalase protection in HT-1080 oxygen-deprivation cultures as precedent.
description_zh_TW: Catalase 被視為解毒缺血事件後生成之過氧化氫的內源性抗氧化防禦。其活性在 OGD 期間下降，並隨 Brosimine B 處理而恢復，同時伴隨 ROS 下降與存活率改善。本文引用 HT-1080 缺氧培養中 catalase 劑量依賴性保護作為先例。

label: BAX
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: BAX and BAK oligomerize into macropores in a subset of mitochondria during senescence, releasing mtDNA and mt-dsRNA into the cytosol; this sublethal minority MOMP drives SASP without causing cell death.
description_zh_TW: BAX 與 BAK 在衰老過程中於部分粒線體寡聚形成大孔，將 mtDNA 與 mt-dsRNA 釋放到胞質；這種亞致死性 minority MOMP 在不引起細胞死亡的情況下驅動 SASP。

label: Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis
description: Chromatin modifiers are the central class of proteins in the Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis. They are recruited away from their native loci to DNA repair sites, and repeated relocalization with imperfect resetting erodes the epigenetic landscape and drives aging.
description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子是染色質修飾因子易位（RCM）假說中的核心蛋白類別。它們被招募離開原生基因座至 DNA 修復位點，反覆易位與不完美的重置會侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀並驅動衰老。

label: Mitochondria
description: Photoreceptors pack mitochondria densely to power phototransduction. Containment records the organelle-rich anatomy.
description_zh_TW: 感光細胞密集填充粒線體以驅動光轉導。包含記錄富胞器的解剖。

label: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: NMN restores NAD+ co-substrate availability for sirtuins, distinct from allosteric STAC activation. Standard precursor biology paired with the existing NR-sirtuin edge.
description_zh_TW: NMN 恢復 sirtuins 的 NAD+ 輔受質可及性，不同於別構 STAC 活化。標準前驅物生物學，與既有的 NR-sirtuin 邊配對。

label: MnSOD
description: SIRT1 drives MnSOD expression via FOXO deacetylation (Lu 2014), feeding the mitochondrial antioxidant program. This transcriptional arm complements direct SIRT3-mediated MnSOD deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 經由 FOXO 去乙醯化驅動 MnSOD 表現（Lu 2014），供養粒線體抗氧化程序。此轉錄臂補充 SIRT3 介導的 MnSOD 去乙醯化。

label: Fibrosis
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Persistent fibroblast activation transitions to myofibroblasts driving scar formation.
description_zh_TW: 持續的纖維母細胞活化轉為肌纖維母細胞驅動疤痕形成。

label: DNA Damage
description: Base oxidation and single- and double-strand breaks follow peroxide exposure.
description_zh_TW: 鹼基氧化與單雙股斷裂隨過氧化物暴露而生。

label: Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells
description: Takahashi is first author of the 2006 Cell paper demonstrating four-factor fibroblast reprogramming.
description_zh_TW: Takahashi 是 2006 Cell 論文證明四因子纖維母細胞重編程的第一作者。

label: Cellular Senescence
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Cellular senescence is a key response to various cellular stresses characterized by a permanent cell cycle arrest and the secretion of a pro-inflammatory cocktail of factors known as the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). Senescence serves protective roles in embryonic development, tumour suppression and tissue repair, but persistent SASP activation leads to chronic inflammation contributing to tissue dysfunction, ageing and a broad spectrum of age-related diseases including cancer. This dual nature makes SASP a focal point for understanding both the protective and detrimental effects of senescence.
description_zh_TW: 細胞衰老是對各種細胞應激的關鍵反應，其特徵是永久性細胞週期停滯和分泌一組促炎因子混合物，稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）。衰老在胚胎發育、腫瘤抑制和組織修復中起保護作用，但持續的SASP激活導致慢性炎症，從而導致組織功能障礙、老化和包括癌症在內的廣泛年齡相關疾病。這種雙重性質使SASP成為理解衰老的保護性和有害性效應的焦點。

label: Quiescence
description: Quiescence-inducing signals act by decreasing Cyclin/CDK activity or raising CDK inhibitor levels; p21/p27/p57 run high in quiescence.
description_zh_TW: 靜止誘導訊號經由降低 Cyclin/CDK 活性或提高 CDK 抑制因子水平作用；p21/p27/p57 在靜止高表現。

label: Lysosome
description: Reformation rebuilds a fresh pool of functional lysosomes. Generation is the recycling output.
description_zh_TW: 重組重建新鮮功能性溶酶體池。產生是回收輸出。

label: Exercise
description: Exercise-generated ROS bursts drive PGC-1alpha-dependent mitochondrial biogenesis (Ristow reviews). ASCII spelling matches existing triples; post-workout antioxidants blunt this signal.
description_zh_TW: 運動產生的 ROS 爆發驅動 PGC-1alpha 依賴的粒線體生成（Ristow 回顧）。ASCII 拼寫沿用既有 triple；運動後抗氧化劑減弱此訊號。

label: Epinephrine
description: Reactive oxygen species steal catechol-hydroxyl electrons from epinephrine through an ortho-quinone intermediate. Oxidation initiates catecholamine pigment chemistry.
description_zh_TW: Reactive oxygen species 經由鄰醌中間體竊取 epinephrine 兒茶酚羥基電子。氧化啟動兒茶酚胺色素化學。

label: Atherosclerosis
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Lipid peroxyl radical driven low-density lipoprotein oxidation initiates oxidized-LDL formation and foam-cell pathology. Radical oxidation seeds atherogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 脂質過氧自由基驅動的低密度脂蛋白氧化啟動氧化 LDL 形成與泡沫細胞病理。自由基氧化播種動脈粥狀硬化發生。

label: DNA Methylation
description: Biological age is computed from CpG methylation measurements.
description_zh_TW: 生物年齡由 CpG 甲基化測量計算。

label: Inflammaging
description: Chronic SASP output is a major contributor to sterile age-related inflammation. Drive links the secretome to systemic inflammaging.
description_zh_TW: 慢性 SASP 輸出是無菌老化相關發炎的主要貢獻者。驅動將分泌組連結到全身發炎老化。

label: Fenbendazole
description: Fenbendazole binds tubulin, disrupting the tubulin-microtubule equilibrium toward arrest and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 結合 tubulin，擾亂 tubulin-微管平衡走向停滯與凋亡。

label: mTOR
description: mTOR is drawn upstream of MAPKAPK2 in the SASP-induction scheme, placing the growth-signalling pathway on the mRNA-stabilisation arm of SASP control. The mechanistic basis is less fully resolved than the p38 to MK2 connection: mTORC1 supports the translation and stability of a broad set of transcripts, and the figure abstracts this into a direct regulatory input to MK2. What the placement conveys is that SASP magnitude depends on both the transcriptional programme and the growth and metabolic state of the cell, consistent with the senomorphic activity of rapamycin and other mTOR inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: 在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，mTOR 被畫在 MAPKAPK2 上游，將生長訊號路徑置於 SASP 調控的 mRNA 穩定化臂上。其機制基礎不如 p38 至 MK2 的連結那樣明確：mTORC1 支持廣泛轉錄本的轉譯與穩定性，而原圖將其抽象為對 MK2 的直接調控輸入。此配置所傳達的是 SASP 強度同時取決於轉錄程序與細胞的生長及代謝狀態，這與 rapamycin 及其他 mTOR 抑制劑的 senomorphic 活性一致。

label: Mitophagy
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Urolithin A is a potent inducer of mitophagy, the clean-up process that recycles old, damaged mitochondria so new ones can take their place, and is described as a core mitohormetic mechanism. It is recommended to be taken with the first fat-containing meal of the day, as co-ingesting with healthy fats such as eggs, avocado, or yogurt can enhance its absorption. By supporting mitochondrial recycling, Urolithin A complements the energy production and renewal pathways targeted by the overall mitohormesis protocol. Rzeski 2026 adds the molecular anchor: PINK1 stabilization on depolarized mitochondria with Parkin-mediated ubiquitination, extending C. elegans median lifespan 45.4% via dct-1/bec-1-dependent mitophagy (Ryu 2016).
description_zh_TW: 尿石素 A 是一種有效的線粒體自噬誘導劑，該清理過程回收老舊受損的線粒體以便新線粒體取而代之，被描述為核心的 mitohormetic 機制。建議在一天中第一頓含脂肪的餐食中服用，因為與健康脂肪（如雞蛋、酪梨或優格）一起攝入可以增強其吸收。通過支持線粒體回收，尿石素 A 補充了整體 mitohormesis 方案所靶向的能量產生和更新通路。Rzeski 2026 補充分子機制：PINK1 穩定化與 Parkin 泛素化，線蟲中位壽命延長 45.4%（Ryu 2016）。

label: Inflammation
description: DAMPs released from necroptotic cells are heavy triggers of innate and adaptive immunity and plausibly drive allograft rejection — the rationale for necroptosis inhibition in solid-organ transplantation.
description_zh_TW: 由 necroptosis 細胞釋出之 DAMPs 是先天與適應性免疫之強力觸發物，很可能驅動移植物排斥——此為實體器官移植中抑制 necroptosis 之理論依據。

label: Honokiol
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol activates SIRT3 to increase ATP and reduce ROS/lipid peroxidation in kidney injury models. Supported pharmacology, kept at moderate confidence per file hypothesis framing.
description_zh_TW: Honokiol 活化 SIRT3，在腎損傷模型增加 ATP 並減少 ROS/脂質過氧化。藥理支持，依檔案假設框架維持中等信度。

label: Apigenin
description: Apigenin ATP-competitively inhibits CDK4, blocking cyclin association and G1 progression. Inhibition parallels the CDK6 edge.
description_zh_TW: Apigenin 以 ATP 競爭抑制 CDK4，阻斷 cyclin 結合與 G1 進展。抑制與 CDK6 邊平行。

label: Aminoguanidine
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Aminoguanidine is a formal guanidine family member carrying the guanidinium pharmacophore. Membership records the structural class.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是攜帶胍基藥效團的正式 guanidine 家族成員。成員關係記錄結構類別。

label: Advanced Glycation End Products
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Fructose is more reactive than glucose, so polyol flux feeds glycation and end-product accumulation. Reactivity differential drives the contribution.
description_zh_TW: 果糖比葡萄糖更具反應性，故多元醇通量供養糖化與終產物累積。反應性差異驅動貢獻。

label: Sirtuins
description: Plant polyphenols such as resveratrol activate the sirtuin longevity network.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇等植物多酚活化 sirtuin 長壽網絡。

label: Hormesis
description: Antioxidant supplementation blunts the ROS pulse required for hormetic adaptation, mirroring the mitohormesis edge. Blockade is the paradox mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 抗氧化補充削弱激效適應所需的 ROS 脈衝，呼應 mitohormesis 邊。阻斷是矛盾機制。

label: Mitohormesis
description: Mitohormesis describes hormetic effects of mitochondrial ROS (mtROS), where transient mtROS elevation triggers mitochondrial respiration, antioxidant enzyme activity, and preconditioning-like defense. This lowers long-term cellular ROS, maintains homeostasis, and delays aging phenotypes. The AMPK/HIF-1 feedback cascade regulating mtROS was shown to extend lifespan and immunity in C. elegans.
description_zh_TW: Mitohormesis 描述粒線體 ROS (mtROS) 的 hormetic 效應，短暫的 mtROS 上升會觸發粒線體呼吸、抗氧化酶活性與類似 preconditioning 的防禦。此過程長期可降低細胞 ROS、維持恆定並延緩 Aging 表型。在 C. elegans 中，調控 mtROS 的 AMPK/HIF-1 回饋級聯反應已被證實可延長壽命並增強免疫。

label: Reactive Oxygen Species
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Mitochondrial ROS can trigger MPT independently of necroptosis signaling; ROS can also promote RIPK1 autophosphorylation as a parallel upstream input. The two pathways (ROS→MPT and ROS→RIPK1) are distinct and context-dependent rather than a single linear chain.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體 ROS 可獨立於 necroptosis 訊號觸發 MPT；ROS 亦可促進 RIPK1 自磷酸化作為平行上游輸入。兩條路徑（ROS→MPT 與 ROS→RIPK1）為獨立且取決於情境，而非單一線性鏈。

label: Ivermectin
description: Ivermectin blocks KPNB1-dependent cell-cycle progression and survival.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 阻斷 KPNB1 依賴的細胞週期進展與存活。

label: Necroptosis
description: Following the Nomenclature Committee on Cell Death 2012 recommendations, necroptosis is canonically defined as necrotic cell death dependent on RIPK3 — not synonymous with all active necrosis, and mechanistically distinct from other regulated-necrosis programs such as MPT (Linkermann & Green, NEJM 2014).
description_zh_TW: 依 Nomenclature Committee on Cell Death 2012 之建議，necroptosis 被規範性定義為依賴 RIPK3 的壞死性細胞死亡——不等同於所有活化性壞死，且在機制上與其他 regulated necrosis 程序（如 MPT）截然不同。

label: SIRT4
description: In hepatocytes, SIRT4 represses PPARalpha signaling and inhibits malonyl-CoA decarboxylase, shifting liver metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization and toward anabolic lipid conservation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed fatty acid oxidation. This metabolic brake counterbalances SIRT3, which promotes beta-oxidation, so the relative activity of the two mitochondrial sirtuins determines whether the liver oxidizes or stores fat. Under chronic nutrient surplus, sustained SIRT4 activity contributes to hepatic steatosis, whereas conditions that shift the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance toward SIRT3 favor fat burning.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，SIRT4抑制PPARalpha訊號並抑制丙二醯CoA脫羧酶，將肝臟代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成代謝的脂質保存。方向上，SIRT4位於脂肪酸氧化抑制的上游。這種代謝制動器平衡了促進β-氧化的SIRT3，因此這兩個粒線體sirtuin的相對活性決定了肝臟是氧化還是儲存脂肪。在慢性營養過剩下，持續的SIRT4活性促進肝脂肪變性，而將SIRT3/SIRT4平衡轉向SIRT3的條件則有利於脂肪燃燒。

label: NAD+
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Because every ADP-ribose unit transferred consumes one NAD+, processive PARP1 hyperactivation rapidly and profoundly depletes cellular NAD+, accompanied by ATP loss that may drive energetic collapse during parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: 由於每轉移一個 ADP-ribose 即消耗一個 NAD+，持續的 PARP1 過度活化會迅速且大幅耗竭細胞 NAD+，並伴隨 ATP 下降，可能在 parthanatos 中驅動能量崩潰（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Urolithin A
description: The Gut Microbiome is the obligate producer of Urolithin A: colonic bacteria convert dietary ellagitannin-derived Ellagic Acid through urolithin M6/C to terminal Urolithin A, principally via Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens and Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens with Enterocloster contributions; because the converter consortium is absent in metabotype 0 individuals, direct Urolithin A supplementation bypasses microbiome dependency.
description_zh_TW: Gut Microbiome 是 Urolithin A 的必要生產者：結腸菌將飲食 ellagitannin 來源的 Ellagic Acid 經 urolithin M6/C 轉為終端 Urolithin A，主要經 Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 與 Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens，另有 Enterocloster 參與；因 metabotype 0 個體缺乏轉換菌叢，直接補充 Urolithin A 可繞過菌相依賴。

label: Val158Met
description: The rs4680 Val-to-Met change is a functional single nucleotide variation.
description_zh_TW: rs4680 Val 到 Met 變化是功能性單核苷酸變異。

label: NRF2
description: Itaconate alkylates Keap1 cysteines, releasing NRF2 as an endogenous anti-inflammatory feedback loop in activated macrophages. Electrophile signaling parallels fumarate action.
description_zh_TW: Itaconate 烷基化 Keap1 半胱胺酸，在活化巨噬細胞釋放 NRF2 作為內源抗發炎回饋。親電子訊號呼應富馬酸鹽作用。

label: Dopamine
description: Dopamine governs striatal synaptic plasticity as a neuromodulator of strength changes. Regulation is the modulatory control relationship.
description_zh_TW: 多巴胺作為強度變化的神經調節劑掌管紋狀體突觸可塑性。調節是調節性控制關係。

label: SIRT7
description: SIRT7 concentrates in the nucleolus where it deacetylates H3K18.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 集中於核仁，在該處去乙醯化 H3K18。

label: AMPK
description: Berberine activates AMPK via mitochondrial complex-I inhibition (elevated AMP:ATP, Thr172 phosphorylation), driving GLUT4 translocation, fatty-acid oxidation, SREBP-1c suppression, and mTORC1 inhibition — paralleling caloric-restriction and exercise metabolic adaptations.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 經粒線體 complex-I 抑制（AMP:ATP 上升、Thr172 磷酸化）活化 AMPK，促進 GLUT4 轉位、脂肪酸氧化，抑制 SREBP-1c 與 mTORC1，類似熱量限制與運動的代謝適應。

label: Neuromelanin
description: Dolichol resides within neuromelanin pigment granules of the substantia nigra pars compacta. Presence records the isoprenoid component of granule matrix.
description_zh_TW: Dolichol 存在於黑質緻密部 neuromelanin 色素顆粒內。存在記錄顆粒基質的異戊二烯成分。

label: mTORC1
description: AMPK activated downstream of PARP1 hyperactivation inhibits mTORC1 signaling, which regulates cell death/survival and energy metabolism; this predicts an autophagic response in parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: PARP1 過度活化下游活化的 AMPK 抑制 mTORC1 訊號，後者調控細胞死亡/存活與能量代謝；此預期 parthanatos 中會出現自噬反應（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Caloric Restriction
description: Caloric-restriction lifespan extension was first shown in yeast, Sir2-dependently.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制延長壽命首先在酵母證實，依賴 Sir2。

label: Creatine
description: Creatine supplementation plus resistance training increases lean tissue mass and strength, confirmed by RCTs and meta-analyses in older adults. The effect combines expanded PCr energetics with protein-sparing action.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸補充加阻力訓練增加瘦組織量與肌力，老年人 RCT 與統合分析已確認。效應結合擴大的 PCr 能量學與保留蛋白作用。

label: Methylene blue
description: Leuco-methylene blue reduces ferric Fe3+ in methemoglobin back to ferrous Fe2+, restoring hemoglobin function. Reduction is mechanistically exact and distinct from treats-Methemoglobinemia.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-methylene blue 將變性血紅素的 Fe3+ 還原回 Fe2+，恢復血紅素功能。還原在機制精確且不同於治療變性血紅素血症。

label: SIRT5
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates carnitine palmitoyltransferase 2 in diabetic cardiomyopathy (Wu 2024), regulating fatty-acid oxidation. The desuccinylates predicate matches existing SIRT5-LDHB usage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 在糖尿病心肌病中去琥珀醯化 carnitine palmitoyltransferase 2（Wu 2024），調節脂肪酸氧化。desuccinylates 謂詞沿用既有的 SIRT5-LDHB 用法。

label: Ferroptosis
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Deferoxamine chelates labile iron, starving the Fenton reaction of Fe2+ and blocking the lipid-peroxide amplification that executes ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: Deferoxamine 螯合不穩定鐵，使 Fenton 反應缺乏 Fe2+，阻斷執行 ferroptosis 的脂質過氧化物放大。

label: Rapamycin
description: Rapamycin is the prototypical mTORC1 inhibitor suppressing SASP translation and growth signaling. Inhibition is the defining pharmacology.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin 是抑制 SASP 轉譯與生長訊號的原型 mTORC1 抑制劑。抑制是定義性藥理。

label: Nicotinamide Riboside
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside restores mitochondrial NAD+ through salvage synthesis. Precursor conversion parallels the L-DOPA to dopamine precedent.
description_zh_TW: Nicotinamide riboside 經由挽救合成恢復粒線體 NAD+。前體轉化呼應 L-DOPA 到多巴胺的先例。

label: Resveratrol
description: Resveratrol from grapes and red wine is presented as a mitohormetic trigger that activates sirtuins and PGC-1alpha signaling. This cascade promotes mitochondrial biogenesis and energy-production efficiency, improving metabolic health and resilience.
description_zh_TW: 來自葡萄與紅酒的 Resveratrol 被視為可活化 Sirtuins 與 PGC-1alpha 訊號的 mitohormetic 觸發因子。此級聯反應促進粒線體新生與能量產生效率，改善代謝健康與韌性。

label: Fisetin
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin was the most potent senolytic among ten flavonoids screened (1-10 uM clearing 25-50% of senescent fibroblasts); late-life administration extended median and maximum lifespan in mice, and intermittent dosing matched genetic p16+ clearance for frailty and grip strength (Yousefzadeh 2018; Murray 2025).
description_zh_TW: 在十種 flavonoid 篩選中，Fisetin 是最強 senolytic（1–10 uM 清除 25–50% 老化纖維母細胞）；老年給藥延長小鼠中位與最大壽命，間歇給藥在衰弱與握力改善上媲美基因清除 p16+ 細胞（Yousefzadeh 2018；Murray 2025）。

label: Parkinson's Disease
description: HPP+ neurotoxicity produces a parkinsonian phenotype mimicking Parkinson's Disease without causing idiopathic disease. Association records the model relationship, weaker than causation.
description_zh_TW: HPP+ 神經毒性產生模仿 Parkinson's Disease 的帕金森表型，而非導致特發性疾病。關聯記錄模型關係，弱於因果。

label: TFEB
description: TFEB belongs to the MiT/TFE family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors, which also includes TFE3, MITF, and TFEC. Members of this family share conserved DNA-binding and dimerization domains and regulate overlapping sets of lysosomal and autophagic target genes. The family's defining feature is responsiveness to nutrient and stress signals that control nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling. TFEB and TFE3 are the principal mediators of the coordinated lysosomal expression and regulation (CLEAR) network.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 屬於 MiT/TFE 家族的基礎螺旋-環-螺旋亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，該家族也包括 TFE3、MITF 和 TFEC。此家族成員共享保守的 DNA 結合和二聚化結構域，並調節重疊的一組溶酶體和自噬標的基因的轉錄。該家族的定義特徵是對控制核質穿梭的營養和壓力信號的反應性。TFEB 和 TFE3 是協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）網絡的主要介導者。

label: Senescence
description: Under the autophagy-senescence threshold model, Spermidine-induced autophagic flux suppresses entry into Senescence while cellular damage stays below a critical threshold; once damage exceeds it, autophagy is reprogrammed to support senescent-cell survival and senolytics such as Fisetin are required, making spermidine and fisetin sequential non-redundant partners on the same continuum.
description_zh_TW: 在 autophagy–senescence 閾值模型下，Spermidine 誘導的自噬通量可在細胞損傷低於臨界閾值時抑制進入 Senescence；損傷超越閾值後，自噬被重編程以支持衰老細胞存活，此時需 Fisetin 等 senolytics 清除，使兩者在同一連續體上成為先後有序、非冗餘的搭檔。

label: SIRT2
description: The NAD-dependent deacetylase SIRT2, together with acid sphingomyelinase and PGAM5, was proposed in 2014 as an additional regulator of programmed necrosis awaiting confirmation.
description_zh_TW: NAD 依賴性去乙醯酶 SIRT2，連同酸性鞘磷脂酶與 PGAM5，於 2014 年被提出為程序性壞死之額外調節者，該角色尚待證實。

label: Autophagy
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Spermidine is a dietary caloric-restriction mimetic whose lifespan extension in yeast, worms, flies, and mice is abolished by atg-gene knockouts; it additionally supports mitochondrial function via eIF5A hypusination and suppresses NLRP3/NF-kB inflammaging signals.
description_zh_TW: Spermidine 為飲食性熱量限制模擬物，其在酵母、線蟲、果蠅與小鼠的延壽效應可被 atg 基因敲除消除；另經 eIF5A hypusination 支持粒線體功能，並抑制 NLRP3/NF-kB 炎性老化訊號。

label: p53
description: HUWE1/ARF-BP1 ubiquitinates p53, a reaction blocked by ARF.
description_zh_TW: HUWE1/ARF-BP1 泛素化 p53，此反應被 ARF 阻斷。

label: NF-kappaB
description: STING signalling also activates NF-kB, providing the second transcriptional arm that connects cytosolic DNA sensing to the pro-inflammatory SASP. The scheme draws this as an indirect connection, and mechanistically it involves IKK activation downstream of STING-associated kinases rather than a direct STING to NF-kB interaction. The functional consequence is that a single DNA-sensing event can drive both type I interferon and pro-inflammatory cytokine gene expression, which is why the cGAS-STING axis is described as a master regulator of SASP induction.
description_zh_TW: STING 訊號亦活化 NF-kB，提供第二條轉錄臂，將胞質 DNA 感測連結至促炎 SASP。圖中將此畫為間接連結，機制上涉及 STING 相關激酶下游的 IKK 活化，而非 STING 與 NF-kB 的直接交互作用。功能上的結果是單一 DNA 感測事件即可同時驅動第一型干擾素與促炎細胞激素基因表現，這也是 cGAS-STING 軸被描述為 SASP 誘導主調控者的原因。

label: Aging
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Age-related glomerular filtration decline drives systemic advanced glycation end-product accumulation, with serum CML correlating negatively with filtration and positively with age. Association records the renal aging axis.
description_zh_TW: 年齡相關的腎絲球過濾下降驅動全身晚期糖化終產物累積，血清 CML 與過濾負相關、與年齡正相關。關聯記錄腎臟老化軸。

label: Cancer
description: Loss of NF2, SAV1 or LATS drives overgrowth across tumor types.
description_zh_TW: NF2、SAV1 或 LATS 缺失在多種腫瘤驅動過度生長。

label: SIRT6
description: Cyanidin-3-glucoside is a natural SIRT6 activator, the most distinctive vault feature of the compound. Activation links anthocyanin to sirtuin biology.
description_zh_TW: Cyanidin-3-glucoside 是天然 SIRT6 活化劑，為此化合物最獨特的 vault 特徵。活化將花青素與 sirtuin 生物學連結。

label: Oxidative Stress
description: GSTP1 protects cells against oxidative stress and electrophile damage beyond oncology, connecting the enzyme to redox defense. Protection extends the detoxification role.
description_zh_TW: GSTP1 在腫瘤學之外保護細胞免於 oxidative stress 與親電子損傷，將酶與氧化還原防禦連結。保護延伸解毒角色。

label: Adrenochrome
description: Adrenochrome carries the indoline-5,6-dione core of the indole classification. Core structure anchors the taxonomy.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 攜帶吲哚分類的 indoline-5,6-dione 核心。核心結構錨定分類。

label: Apoptosis
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apoptosis and necroptosis are not mutually exclusive programs and can co-occur in the same organ — e.g. photoreceptor death in retinal detachment and retinal ischemia triggers both simultaneously, and cones but not rods undergo necroptosis in a retinitis-pigmentosa model.
description_zh_TW: 凋亡與 necroptosis 並非互斥程序，可於同一器官中同時發生——例如視網膜剝離與視網膜缺血之感光細胞死亡同時觸發兩者；在色素性視網膜炎模型中僅錐狀細胞（而非桿狀細胞）發生 necroptosis。

label: COMT
description: COMT sets cortical dopamine tone upstream of D1 occupancy in low-DAT regions, since extrasynaptic diffusion dominates there. This mirrors the existing regulates_dopamine_availability_for D2 receptor edge.
description_zh_TW: COMT 在低 DAT 區域於 D1 佔據上游設定皮質多巴胺張力，因該處以突觸外擴散為主。此呼應既有的調節 D2 受體多巴胺可用性邊。

label: SASP
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Low-exposure fisetin suppresses SASP and NF-kB output as a senomorphic action distinct from senolysis. No existing Fisetin-SASP edge covers this. Rzeski 2026 details effectors: IL-6, IL-8, MMP-1/MMP-3 down with NLRP3 inhibition and Nrf2/SIRT1 activation, dose/context-dependent senolytic versus senomorphic behavior.
description_zh_TW: 低暴露 fisetin 以 senomorphic 作用抑制 SASP 與 NF-κB 輸出，不同於 senolysis。既無 Fisetin-SASP 邊涵蓋此。Rzeski 2026 補充效應分子：IL-6、IL-8、MMP-1/MMP-3 下降，伴 NLRP3 抑制與 Nrf2/SIRT1 活化，依劑量與情境呈 senolytic 或 senomorphic。

label: SIRT3
description: Estrogen signaling boosts SIRT3 expression and mitochondrial targeting, strengthening MnSOD activation and mtROS control at the source of necroptosis/ferroptosis crosstalk.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen 訊號提升 SIRT3 表現與粒線體定位，強化 MnSOD 活化與 mtROS 控制，從源頭調節 necroptosis/ferroptosis 交互作用。

label: SIRT1
description: Estrogen receptor signaling increases SIRT1 transcription and activity, coupling hormonal status to deacetylation of p53, NF-κB, autophagy factors, and PARP1 survival signaling.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen receptor 訊號增加 SIRT1 轉錄與活性，將荷爾蒙狀態耦合至 p53、NF-κB、自噬因子去乙醯化及 PARP1 存活訊號。

label: Itaconate
description: Itaconate alkylates Keap1 cysteines, releasing NRF2 as an endogenous anti-inflammatory feedback loop in activated macrophages. Electrophile signaling parallels fumarate action.
description_zh_TW: Itaconate 烷基化 Keap1 半胱胺酸，在活化巨噬細胞釋放 NRF2 作為內源抗發炎回饋。親電子訊號呼應富馬酸鹽作用。

label: Platelets
description: Platelet aggregation is the process whereby activated platelets bind to one another through fibrinogen bridging the integrin receptor, forming the terminal common pathway of primary hemostasis. Activated platelets aggregate to form thrombi and support coagulation.
description_zh_TW: 血小板凝集是活化的血小板透過纖維蛋白原橋接整合素受體而彼此結合的過程，是初級止血的終末共同途徑。活化的血小板凝集成血栓並支持凝血。

label: Melanoidins
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Terminal high molecular weight brown pigments of cooked foods are Maillard melanoidins. Polymerization ends the browning cascade.
description_zh_TW: 熟食的終末高分子量棕色色素即 Maillard melanoidins。聚合終止褐變級聯。

label: Rheb
description: Tuberin TSC2 is the catalytic GAP for Rheb. Inhibition is the GTPase-off switch.
description_zh_TW: Tuberin TSC2 是 Rheb 的催化 GAP。抑制是 GTPase 關閉開關。

label: Rb
description: Dephosphorylated (hypophosphorylated) Rb maintains cell cycle arrest in its active, growth-suppressive form. Inhibition of Rb phosphorylation during arrest preserves this tumor-suppressive state. Rb is thus a central mediator of cell cycle arrest, particularly at the G1 checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: 去磷酸化的 Rb 以其活性、抑制生長的形式維持細胞週期停滯。在停滯期間抑制 Rb 磷酸化可保留此腫瘤抑制狀態。因此 Rb 是細胞週期停滯（尤其是 G1 檢查點）的核心媒介。

label: SMAD4
description: Phosphorylated SMAD2/3 obligatorily complex with the co-SMAD SMAD4 to regulate target-gene transcription downstream of Activin A-ALK4. This SMAD4-dependent step couples ligand binding to induction of cell-cycle inhibitors in recipient cells.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸化 SMAD2/3 必須與共 SMAD SMAD4 形成複合體，才能調節 Activin A-ALK4 下游的標的基因轉錄。此 SMAD4 依賴步驟將配體結合耦合到受體細胞中細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。

label: TLR4
description: TLR4 engages both MyD88 and TRIF adaptors; MyD88 drives early NF-kB and can feed forward via autocrine TNF to promote RIPK1/RIPK3 activation, while TRIF couples directly to RIPK3 and can be antagonized to reduce necroptosis in acute pancreatitis models (Niu et al. 2026).
description_zh_TW: TLR4 同時使用 MyD88 與 TRIF 接頭；MyD88 驅動早期 NF-kB，並可經自分泌 TNF 前饋促進 RIPK1/RIPK3 活化，而 TRIF 直接偶聯 RIPK3，且可被拮抗以減少急性胰臟炎模型中的 necroptosis（Niu et al. 2026）。

label: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatases
description: Oxidants reversibly oxidize and inhibit protein tyrosine phosphatases such as PTP1B and PTEN during POS-related redox imbalance. Phosphatase inhibition shifts signaling toward a higher phosphorylated state, promoting kinase cascades and redox-sensitive transcription factor activation.
description_zh_TW: 在 POS 相關的氧化還原失衡期間，氧化物可逆地氧化並抑制 Protein Tyrosine Phosphatases，如 PTP1B 和 PTEN。磷酸酶抑制使訊號傳導偏向高度磷酸化狀態，促進激酶級聯反應與氧化還原敏感轉錄因子的活化。

label: Deacetylation
description: Histone deacetylation condenses chromatin by restoring the positive charge of lysine residues on histone tails, strengthening their electrostatic interaction with DNA and promoting nucleosome compaction. This condenses the chromatin fiber, reducing the accessibility of DNA to transcription factors and repressing gene expression. Deacetylation is catalyzed by histone deacetylases, which counterbalance the chromatin-opening effects of histone acetyltransferases and are targets of HDAC-inhibitor drugs.
description_zh_TW: Histone 去乙醯化透過恢復組蛋白尾部離胺酸殘基的正電荷來濃縮染色質，加強其與 DNA 的靜電相互作用並促進核小體壓縮。這會壓縮染色質纖維，降低 DNA 對轉錄因子的可及性並抑制 gene expression。 Deacetylation 由組蛋白去乙醯化酶催化，可抵消組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的染色質打開作用，並且是 HDAC 抑制劑藥物的標靶。

label: DYRK1A
description: DYRK1A phosphorylates caspase-9 at Thr125, inhibiting the initiator.
description_zh_TW: DYRK1A 在 Thr125 磷酸化 caspase-9，抑制起始者。

label: Stem Cell Research
description: Gene editing is widely used in stem-cell models and isogenic lines.
description_zh_TW: 基因編輯廣泛用於幹細胞模型與同基因系。

label: Keap1
description: Basal Keap1-Cul3 K48 ubiquitination holds Nrf2 half-life near 20 minutes. Suppression is the resting-state brake.
description_zh_TW: 基礎 Keap1-Cul3 K48 泛素化將 Nrf2 半衰期維持約 20 分鐘。抑制是靜止煞車。

label: HERV
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Derepressed HERV amplifies the senescence secretome via cGAS-STING; mirrors the BRD4-drives-SASP edge. Drive is the retroelement input.
description_zh_TW: 去抑制的 HERV 經由 cGAS-STING 放大衰老分泌組；呼應 BRD4 驅動 SASP 邊。驅動是逆轉錄元件輸入。

label: Progenitor Cell
description: Neural stem cells yield radial-glial and intermediate progenitors. Generation is the lineage output of the stem pool.
description_zh_TW: 神經幹細胞產生放射狀膠質與中間祖細胞。產生是幹細胞池的譜系輸出。

label: Chemotherapy Resistance
description: Cancer Stem Cells drive Chemotherapy Resistance. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Chemotherapy resistance denotes the failure of cytotoxic drugs to kill tumor cells, arising through efflux, death-pathway suppression, and stem-cell states. The relationship is directional, with Cancer Stem Cells acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer Stem Cells 驅動Chemotherapy Resistance。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。抗藥性是指細胞毒性藥物無法殺死腫瘤細胞，這是由於外流、死亡途徑抑制和幹細胞狀態而產生的。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer Stem Cells 充當 Chemotherapy Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Redox Cycling
description: The semiquinone radical catalytically regenerates through the redox-cycling loop. Participation sustains superoxide production.
description_zh_TW: 半醌自由基經由氧化還原循環催化再生。參與維持超氧產生。

label: MMP
description: MMP promotes Metastasis. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. Metastasis is the multistep dissemination of tumor cells to distant organs and the principal cause of cancer mortality. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: MMP 促進Metastasis。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Metastasis 是腫瘤細胞向遠端器官的多步驟傳播，也是癌症死亡的主要原因。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Metastasis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Muscle Stem Cell
description: Muscle stem cells and satellite cells name the same Pax7+ population positionally. Single alias pair kept; mirror dropped on dedup.
description_zh_TW: 肌肉幹細胞與衛星細胞按位置命名同一 Pax7+ 群體。僅保留單一別名對；鏡像在去重中捨棄。

label: Glyoxal
description: The Maillard intermediate stage generates glyoxal alongside methylglyoxal. Parallel production of the dicarbonyl pair.
description_zh_TW: 梅納反應中間階段與甲基乙二醛並列產生乙二醛。二羰基對的平行產生。

label: Cathepsin D
description: Lysosomal proteases are responsible for degrading glycated proteins intracellularly. Cathepsin D, an aspartic protease, and Cathepsin B, a cysteine protease, are major enzymes that break down AGE-modified proteins after they are directed to lysosomes for degradation. A decrease in Cathepsin D expression or activity, which occurs during aging and UV exposure, directly correlates with the accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Cathepsin-dependent lysosomal degradation therefore represents the third line of defense against AGE accumulation, removing established glycated proteins that prevention and repair enzymes cannot handle.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體蛋白酶負責在細胞內降解糖化蛋白。組織蛋白酶 D（Cathepsin D，一種天冬胺酸蛋白酶）與組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B，一種半胱氨酸蛋白酶）是將 AGE 修飾蛋白在導向溶酶體降解後分解的主要酵素。組織蛋白酶 D 表現或活性在老化與紫外線暴露期間下降，直接與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，依賴組織蛋白酶的溶酶體降解代表對抗 AGE 堆積的第三道防線，移除預防與修復酵素無法處理的已建立糖化蛋白。

label: Cyclosporine A
description: Cyclosporine A inhibits MPT intracellularly via cyclophilin D and prevented ischemic myocardial damage in a human trial — an anti-regulate- necrosis effect beyond its immunosuppressive role.
description_zh_TW: Cyclosporine A（CsA）於胞內經由 Cyclophilin D 抑制 MPT，且在一項人體試驗中預防缺血性心肌損傷——此為超越其免疫抑制作用之抗 regulated necrosis 效應。

label: NRTI
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Lamivudine is a representative nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor drug. Classification anchors the member.
description_zh_TW: Lamivudine 是代表性的核苷逆轉錄酶抑制藥物。歸類錨定成員。

label: Saturated Enzymatic Regime
description: Michaelis-Menten kinetics describe enzyme-catalyzed reaction rate as a saturable function of substrate concentration. The saturated enzymatic regime occurs when the Michaelis-Menten constant is very small relative to substrate, making the reaction rate insensitive to substrate changes.
description_zh_TW: Michaelis-Menten 動力學將酶催化反應速率描述為受質濃度的飽和函數。當 Michaelis-Menten 常數遠小於受質時即為飽和酶學機制，使反應速率對受質變化不敏感。

label: NOX4
description: NOX4 produces hydrogen peroxide rather than superoxide because it is constitutively active and dismutates its product internally, releasing H2O2 as the main extracellular and matrix signaling oxidant. This makes NOX4 a major source of the diffusible second messenger in fibroblasts and the kidney. The directionality is enzyme activity to H2O2 signaling. A caveat is that NOX4's H2O2 output is context-dependent and can be both profibrotic via TGF-beta signaling and protective depending on tissue. NOX4 is unique among NOX isoforms in being constitutively active and regulated primarily at the transcriptional level, for instance by TGF-beta and hypoxia.
description_zh_TW: NOX4 產生 hydrogen peroxide 而不是超氧化物，因為它具有組成活性並在內部歧化其產物，釋放 H2O2 作為主要的細胞外和基質信號傳導氧化劑。這使得 NOX4 成為成纖維細胞和腎臟中可擴散第二信使的主要來源。方向性是酵素對 H2O2 訊號傳導的活性。需要注意的是，NOX4 的 H2O2 輸出是上下文相關的，並且可以透過 TGF-beta 訊號傳導促進纖維化，也可以根據組織提供保護作用。 NOX4 在 NOX 同工型中是獨特的，因為它具有組成型活性，並且主要在轉錄層面上受到調節，例如透過 TGF-beta 和缺氧調節。

label: IL-6R
source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md
description: IL-6 signals through the interleukin-6 receptor, the ligand-binding subunit that must associate with gp130 to transduce a signal. In the SASP this is the entry point of the autocrine amplification loop: secreted IL-6 acts on IL-6R in the same or neighbouring cells, which is one reason IL-6 is described as both an output and a driver of the senescent secretory programme. Soluble IL-6R generated by shedding or alternative splicing extends the loop to cells that lack membrane IL-6R, broadening the set of cells that can respond.
description_zh_TW: IL-6 經介白素-6 受體訊號，該受體為配體結合次單元，必須與 gp130 結合才能傳遞訊號。在 SASP 中，這是自泌放大環路的進入點：分泌的 IL-6 作用於同一或鄰近細胞的 IL-6R，這也是 IL-6 同時被描述為衰老分泌程序的輸出與驅動者的原因之一。由切割或替代剪接產生的可溶性 IL-6R 可將此環路延伸至缺乏膜性 IL-6R 的細胞，擴大可回應的細胞範圍。

label: ALIX
description: ALIX regulates Exosomes. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. Exosomes are nanovesicles shed by tumor cells that traffic immune-checkpoint ligands and growth signals within the microenvironment. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon Exosomes rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: ALIX 調節 Exosomes。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 Exosomes 是腫瘤細胞脫落的奈米囊泡，在微環境中傳遞免疫檢查點配體和生長訊號。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 Exosomes 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: SAMe production
description: By remethylating homocysteine to methionine, MethylB12 supports the production of methionine, the precursor of SAMe, the universal methyl donor consumed by COMT. MethylB12 therefore indirectly influences the rate of COMT-mediated methylation of catecholamines. Its status is coupled to overall methyl-group supply.
description_zh_TW: 透過將同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸，MethylB12 支持蛋氨酸的產生，蛋氨酸是 COMT 消耗的通用 methyl donor SAMe 的前驅物。因此 MethylB12 間接影響 COMT 介導的兒茶酚胺甲基化速率。其狀態與整體甲基供應相關。

label: S Phase
description: DNA replication occurs within S phase as its defining process. Part-whole timing edge of the cycle.
description_zh_TW: DNA 複製在 S 期內作為其定義過程發生。是週期的部分—整體時間邊。

label: Fructosamine-3-kinase
description: Fructosamine-3-kinase phosphorylates early Amadori products for deglycation, distinct from the existing fructosamine edge. Phosphorylation is the enzymatic removal route.
description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-3-激酶磷酸化早期 Amadori 產物以去糖化，不同於既有的果糖胺邊。磷酸化是酶促移除路徑。

label: Hexokinase-1
source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md
description: In cortical neurons and glioblastoma lines, free PAR released from target proteins binds the PAR-binding motif of hexokinase-1 and inhibits its catalytic activity, blocking the first step of glycolysis; pyruvate bypass restores survival while NAD+ restoration alone does not (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: 在皮質神經元與膠質母細胞瘤細胞中，自標靶蛋白釋出的游離 PAR 結合 hexokinase-1 的 PAR 結合模體並抑制其催化活性，阻斷糖解第一步；補充 pyruvate 可恢復存活，單純回復 NAD+ 則無效（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Fas
description: FasL binding induces Fas trimerization, the upstream trigger of FADD/DISC assembly.
description_zh_TW: FasL 結合誘發 Fas 三聚化，是 FADD/DISC 組裝的上游觸發。

label: Disease Modeling
description: Organoids are a central platform for monogenic, complex-disease and infection studies.
description_zh_TW: 類器官是單基因、複雜疾病與感染研究的核心平台。

label: DR4
description: TRAIL binding induces DR4 trimerization and DISC recruitment, initiating extrinsic apoptosis with tumor selectivity.
description_zh_TW: TRAIL 結合誘發 DR4 三聚化與 DISC 招募，啟動具腫瘤選擇性的外源性凋亡。

label: Cachexia
description: Chemotherapy alone induces cachexia-like signatures even without tumor.
description_zh_TW: 化療單獨即誘發惡病質樣特徵，無需腫瘤。

label: HAT
description: HAT is the standard abbreviation for histone acetyltransferase, a family of enzymes that transfer acetyl groups from acetyl-CoA to lysine residues on histone tails. These enzymes are grouped into families such as the GNAT, MYST, and p300/CBP families, and their activity is central to epigenetic control of gene expression. HATs oppose the action of histone deacetylases and are frequently deregulated in cancer and aging, where changes in acetylation contribute to aberrant gene silencing and loss of transcriptional fidelity.
description_zh_TW: HAT 是組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的標準縮寫，該酶是將乙醯基從乙醯輔酶 A 轉移到組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的酶家族。這些酵素分為 GNAT、MYST 和 p300/CBP 等家族，它們的活性對於 gene expression 的表觀遺傳控制至關重要。 HAT 對抗組蛋白去乙醯化酶的作用，並且在癌症和老化過程中經常失調，其中乙醯化的變化會導致異常基因沉默和轉錄保真度喪失。

label: Securin
description: APC/C degrades securin to release separase for sister separation.
description_zh_TW: APC/C 降解 securin 以釋放 separase 分離姐妹染色單體。

label: HFF1
description: HFF1 is a neonatal foreskin fibroblast line.
description_zh_TW: HFF1 是新生兒包皮纖維母細胞系。

label: Base Excision Repair
description: APE1 (apurinic/apyrimidinic endonuclease 1) cleaves the DNA backbone 5' to abasic (AP) sites generated by spontaneous base loss or by DNA glycosylases such as OGG1, initiating base excision repair. It also removes 3'-blocking groups, making it a rate-limiting hub in the repair of oxidative DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: APE1（無嘌呤/無嘧啶核酸內切酶 1）在自發性鹼基缺失或 OGG1 等 DNA 糖苷酶所產生的無鹼基（AP）位點 5' 端切割 DNA 主鏈，啟動鹼基切除修復。它也移除 3' 阻斷基團，使其成為氧化性 DNA 損傷修復中的速率限制樞紐。

label: miR-24
description: miR-24 tunes the death threshold in cancer cells via XIAP and related targets.
description_zh_TW: miR-24 經 XIAP 等標的調節癌細胞死亡閾值。

label: CCL2
description: CCL2-CCR2 signaling mediates paracrine arrest; CCR2 RNAi or inhibitors block senescence spread in Acosta 2013. Beyond myeloid recruitment, CCL2 thus directly transmits growth arrest to neighbors.
description_zh_TW: CCL2-CCR2 訊號介導旁分泌停滯；Acosta 2013 中 CCR2 RNAi 或抑制劑阻斷衰老擴散。除骨髓招募外，CCL2 因此直接向鄰近細胞傳遞生長停滯。

label: TGF-β3
description: TGF-beta3 is a ligand isoform of the TGF-beta superfamily.
description_zh_TW: TGF-β3 是 TGF-β 超家族的配體亞型。

label: Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors
description: Erlotinib is an anilinoquinazoline EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor.
description_zh_TW: erlotinib 是 anilinoquinazoline EGFR 酪胺酸激酶抑制劑。

label: Thioredoxin
description: Thioredoxin supplies electrons for the MsrA and MsrB catalytic cycle reducing methionine sulfoxide. Reductant supply gates enzymatic repair turnover.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin 為 MsrA 與 MsrB 催化循環供應電子，還原甲硫胺酸亞碸。還原劑供應守衛酶促修復週轉。

label: Drug Discovery
description: High-throughput screening is the primary engine of modern drug discovery campaigns.
description_zh_TW: 高通量篩選是現代藥物發現的主要引擎。

label: CTPI2
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: CTPI2 is a third-generation inhibitor of the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 with high binding affinity and specificity. CTPI2 treatment results in dose-dependent suppression of SASP components at transcript and protein levels without altering cell cycle regulators, HMGB1 localization, DNA damage foci or proliferation markers. It reduces global nuclear acetylation and H3K27ac at SASP loci and abolishes incorporation of glucose-derived carbon into histone acetylation, yet does not broadly impair mitochondrial function: OXPHOS gene expression, ATP production, coupling efficiency, mitochondrial ROS and morphology remain largely unchanged.
description_zh_TW: CTPI2 是粒線體檸檬酸載體 SLC25A1 的第三代抑制劑，具有高結合親和力與特異性。CTPI2 治療可在轉錄與蛋白質層面劑量依賴性地抑制 SASP 組成，同時不改變細胞週期調控因子、HMGB1 定位、DNA 損傷焦點或增殖標記。它可降低整體細胞核乙醯化及 SASP 基因座的 H3K27ac，並消除葡萄糖來源碳併入組蛋白乙醯化的現象，但不會廣泛損害粒線體功能：OXPHOS 基因表現、ATP 產生、偶聯效率、粒線體 ROS 與形態大多維持不變。

label: Restriction Point
description: The restriction point is gated by CDK4/6-cyclin D activity integrating mitogenic signals. Passage requires sufficient kinase output to phosphorylate RB1.
description_zh_TW: 限制點由整合促有絲分裂訊號的 CDK4/6-cyclin D 活性守衛。通過需要足夠的激酶輸出以磷酸化 RB1。

label: Atg101
description: Atg101 binds the Atg13 N-terminus and protects it against proteasomal turnover. Regulation is the stabilization mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Atg101 結合 Atg13 N 端並保護其免於蛋白酶體更新。調節是穩定機制。

label: Adrenoleukodystrophy
description: Mutations in ABCD1, an ATP-binding cassette transporter that exports very long chain fatty acids from peroxisomes, cause X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy. Defective VLCFA transport leads to lipid accumulation that primarily damages the brain and adrenal glands; gene therapy delivering functional ABCD1 via AAV9 vectors has shown early promise.
description_zh_TW: ABCD1 是將極長鏈脂肪酸自過氧化物體輸出的 ABC 轉運蛋白，其突變會導致 X 染色體連鎖腎上腺腦白質失養症。VLCFA 運輸缺陷造成脂質累積，主要傷害大腦與腎上腺；利用 AAV9 載體遞送功能性 ABCD1 的基因療法在早期試驗已展現潛力。

label: adrenochrome synthesis
description: Water-soluble salts of bismuth, such as bismuth nitrate, bismuth oxynitrate, bismuth oxycarbonate, and bismuth citrate, accelerate the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline into adrenochrome, producing high-quality adrenochrome in high yields in a short period of time (about 30 to 45 minutes). Bismuth salts are used in amounts of 0.001 to 0.01 mole per mole of adrenaline; amounts below this do not significantly increase the reaction rate, while amounts above 0.01 mole may cause excessive oxidation and decompose the adrenochrome into tar-like by-products.
description_zh_TW: 水溶性鉍鹽，如硝酸鉍、鹼式硝酸鉍、鹼式碳酸鉍和檸檬酸鉍，可加速過硫酸鹽將腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺紅的反應，在短時間內（約30至45分鐘）以高產率生產高品質的腎上腺紅。鉍鹽的使用量為每莫耳腎上腺素0.001至0.01莫耳；低於此量不會顯著提高反應速率，而高於0.01莫耳則可能導致過度氧化並使腎上腺紅分解為焦油狀副產物。

label: TCA cycle
description: Valine metabolism involves conversion to succinyl-CoA, which enters the TCA cycle to produce ATP, making valine a gluconeogenic and anaplerotic amino acid. Restricting valine alone reduces body weight, improves metabolic health, reduces hepatic senescence, and extends lifespan of male mice, while in female mice valine restriction is protective in Alzheimer's disease progression. Dysregulated valine catabolism (via 3-hydroxyisobutyrate) contributes to insulin resistance in diabetic rats. Human plasma analysis found reduced circulating valine is associated with aging and moderate cognitive impairment, but valine supplementation worsens glucose tolerance and induces gut inflammation and hepatic lipid deposition, suggesting the role of valine in healthy aging may vary between species.
description_zh_TW: 纈胺酸代謝涉及轉化為琥珀醯-CoA，後者進入 TCA 循環產生 ATP，使纈胺酸成為一種生糖和回補胺基酸。單獨限制纈胺酸可減輕體重、改善代謝健康、減少肝臟衰老並延長雄性小鼠壽命，而在雌性小鼠中纈胺酸限制對阿茲海默病進展具有保護作用。纈胺酸分解代謝失調（通過 3-羥基異丁酸）導致糖尿病大鼠的胰島素抵抗。人類血漿分析發現，循環纈胺酸降低與衰老和輕度認知障礙相關，但纈胺酸補充會惡化葡萄糖耐受性並誘發腸道炎症和肝臟脂質沉積，表明纈胺酸在健康衰老中的作用可能因物種而異。

label: SIRT1 overexpression
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 overexpression protects against obesity-associated metabolic derangement via deacetylation of metabolic transcription factors.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過表達透過去乙醯化代謝轉錄因子來保護免受肥胖相關的代謝紊亂。

label: SIRT3 activation
description: MIP-2 (CXCL2) is a CXC chemokine recruiting neutrophils via CXCR2. SIRT3 activation consistently correlates with reduced MIP-2 expression alongside TNF-alpha and IL-6, and diminished polymorphonuclear leukocyte infiltration in preclinical models, via NF-kappaB suppression.
description_zh_TW: MIP-2（CXCL2）是一種透過 CXCR2 招募嗜中性球的 CXC 趨化因子。SIRT3 活化與 TNF-alpha 和 IL-6 一起與 MIP-2 表現減少一致相關，以及臨床前模型中多形核白血球浸潤的減少，透過 NF-kappaB 抑制實現。

label: AMPK activation
description: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), a master energy sensor activated by rising AMP/ATP ratios, lipid stress, or low glucose, promotes peroxisome biogenesis by stimulating lipid synthesis and incorporation of lipids into developing peroxisomal membranes. In disorders like ALD, however, VLCFA-driven AMPK activation is overwhelmed by the massive lipid load.
description_zh_TW: AMPK（AMP-activated protein kinase）是主要的能量感測器，會因 AMP/ATP 比值上升、脂質壓力或低血糖而活化；它透過刺激脂質合成並促進脂質嵌入發育中的過氧化物體膜來促進過氧化物體生成。然而在 ALD 等疾病中，VLCFA 驅動的 AMPK 活化仍敵不過巨大的脂質負荷。

label: Atrial natriuretic peptide
description: Atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP) binds natriuretic peptide receptor-A, a membrane guanylyl cyclase, raising intracellular cGMP to drive natriuresis, diuresis, and vasodilation. cGMP is the second messenger mediating ANP's counter-regulatory cardiovascular actions.
description_zh_TW: 心房利鈉肽（ANP）結合利鈉肽受體-A（一種膜鳥苷酸環化酶），提高細胞內 cGMP 以驅動利鈉、利尿與血管舒張。cGMP 是介導 ANP 反向調節心血管作用的第二信使。

label: Esophageal Cancer
description: The metaplasia-dysplasia-carcinoma cascade from Barrett's esophagus to adenocarcinoma is textbook.
description_zh_TW: Barrett 食道至腺癌的化生—異生—癌級聯是教科書等級。

label: Bipolar II Disorder
description: Lamotrigine is a first-line mood stabilizer for bipolar depression maintenance, delaying depressive relapse in Bipolar II. Its indication covers the predominant depressive pole of the disorder.
description_zh_TW: Lamotrigine 是雙極憂鬱維持治療的第一線情緒穩定劑，延緩第二型雙極的憂鬱復發。其適應症涵蓋疾病主要的憂鬱極。

label: Dietary Hormesis
description: Dietary hormesis is framed as the cumulative, potentially synergistic adaptive response to a complex array of hormetins within whole-food matrices. This is distinguished from biphasic dose-responses of isolated compounds like resveratrol or curcumin studied in controlled laboratory settings.
description_zh_TW: Dietary Hormesis 被定義為對全食物基質中複雜 Hormetins 陣列產生的累積性、可能具協同作用的適應反應。這與在受控實驗室條件下研究的單一分離化合物（如 resveratrol 或 curcumin）的雙相劑量反應有所區別。

label: Nicotinic acid
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels, and it is used to treat dyslipidemia, although it is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day. In contrast, nicotinamide (NAM) does not affect lipid blood levels, yet it can exhibit sirtuin-inhibiting effects at higher doses, while nicotinamide riboside (NR) does not cause flushing because it does not activate GPR109A. The distinct physiological responses of the NAD+ precursors NA, NAM, and NR, despite all three raising NAD+ and NADP+ levels, are important for selecting the appropriate precursor for specific therapeutic indications.
description_zh_TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）展現降低血脂水平的效果，並被用於治療血脂異常，儘管其在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關。相對地，nicotinamide（NAM）不影響血脂水平，但其在較高劑量下可展現抑制 sirtuin 的效果，而 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）因不活化 GPR109A 而不會造成潮紅。NAD+ 前驅物 NA、NAM 與 NR 儘管三者皆提升 NAD+ 與 NADP+ 水平，其截然不同的生理反應對於選擇適當前驅物以用於特定治療適應症相當重要。

label: elevated homocysteine
description: Several MTHFD1 polymorphisms, such as the G1958A/R653Q missense variant, have been associated with altered enzyme kinetics and biomarkers of impaired folate metabolism. These variants are linked to elevated homocysteine and modified risk for neural tube defects and certain cancers. As with MTHFR, they can reduce the efficiency of methyl-group provision.
description_zh_TW: 若干 MTHFD1 多態性，例如 G1958A/R653Q 錯義變異，已與改變的酶動力學和葉酸代謝受損的生物標記相關。這些變異與 elevated homocysteine 以及神經管缺陷和某些癌症的風險改變有關。與 MTHFR 一樣，它們會降低甲基供給的效率。

label: Ferroptosis in IDD
description: Nucleus pulposus cells decline in intervertebral disc degeneration, exacerbated by SIRT3 knockdown under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis that accelerates NPC functional decline; SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo.
description_zh_TW: 髓核細胞在椎間盤退化中衰退，在氧化壓力下被 SIRT3 敲減加劇。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化並促進鐵死亡，加速 NPC 功能衰退；SIRT3 的過量表現在體內緩解 IDD 嚴重程度。

label: Heme
description: Heme triggers a characteristic TRIM response with H3K27ac remodeling through SYK-dependent ROS generation rather than oxidative chemistry alone. Unlike oxLDL or HMGB1 training, heme training is mTOR-independent: rapamycin has no effect, while SYK inhibition with R406 blocks training. It defines an alternative DAMP-to-chromatin route.
description_zh_TW: Heme 透過 SYK-dependent ROS generation 而非僅靠氧化化學性質，觸發帶有 H3K27ac 重塑的典型 TRIM 反應。與 Oxidized LDL 或 HMGB1 訓練不同，Heme 訓練是 mTOR-independent：rapamycin 無效，而以 R406 抑制 SYK 可阻斷訓練。它定義了一條替代性的 DAMP-to-chromatin 路徑。

label: LipA
description: LIPL-1 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2, confirming its residence within the lysosomal lumen where it hydrolyzes stored triglycerides. Its expression is induced by HLH-30 during fasting, supporting lipophagy-mediated lipid mobilization. LIPL-1 is part of a family of lysosomal lipases (lipl-1 through lipl-5) that together govern organismal lipid turnover. Loss or reduction of these lipases impairs the ability to survive nutrient scarcity.
description_zh_TW: LIPL-1 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，確認其位於溶酶體腔內，在此水解儲存的甘油三酯。其表現在禁食期間受 HLH-30 誘發，支持脂噬介導的脂質動員。LIPL-1 是溶酶體脂肪酶家族（lipl-1 至 lipl-5）的一員，共同掌管生物體的脂質週轉。這些脂肪酶的缺失或減少會損害在營養匱乏中存活的能力。

label: SIRT2 inhibition
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 inhibition or downregulation appears counterproductive in certain cancer contexts, particularly when combined with microtubule inhibitors, because loss of SIRT2 prolongs chronic mitotic arrest and makes cancer cells resistant to these agents. The enzyme normally helps cells exit mitosis cleanly; without it, cells linger in a prolonged arrested state that selects for survival. Directionally, low SIRT2 activity sits upstream of this resistance phenotype. This caveat limits the general anticancer rationale for SIRT2 inhibition and argues for careful context- and regimen-specific use.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 抑制或下調在某些癌症情境中看似適得其反，特別是在與微管抑制劑合併使用時，因為 SIRT2 的缺失延長了慢性有絲分裂停滯，使癌細胞對這些藥物產生抗性。該酵素正常情況下幫助細胞順利退出有絲分裂；沒有它時，細胞會停留在延長的停滯狀態中，有利於存活。方向性上低 SIRT2 活性位於此抗性表型的上游。這一注意事項限制了 SIRT2 抑制的通用抗癌依據，並主張在使用時需謹慎考慮具體情境和治療方案。

label: SARS-CoV-2
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: The combined layer carries the single typed edge 'sars_cov_2 —[disrupts]→ NAD+_metabolism', which pulls the virus into the CD38/PARP/sirtuin/inflammaging attribute space; severe COVID-19 drives CD38-NADase-mediated NAD+ depletion confirmed in 2020–21 literature (Heer et al., JBC 2020) — a mechanistic corridor the triples layer still lacks.
description_zh_TW: combined 層攜帶單一類型邊「sars_cov_2 —[disrupts]→ NAD+_metabolism」，把病毒拉入 CD38/PARP/sirtuin/inflammaging 屬性空間；重症 COVID-19 驅動的 CD38-NADase 介導 NAD+ 耗竭已由 2020–21 文獻證實（Heer et al., JBC 2020），是 triples 層仍缺乏的機制走廊。

label: Monocytes
description: Soluble urate induces H3K27ac and H3K4me3 reprogramming in monocytes, and uric-acid priming followed by LPS restimulation boosts IL-1beta production. Methyltransferase inhibitors reverse this primed output. HDAC inhibition likewise modulates MSU-induced proinflammatory cytokines, tying urate training to histone control.
description_zh_TW: Soluble Urate 可在單核球中誘導 H3K27ac 與 H3K4me3 重編程，且 uric-acid priming 後再以 LPS 再刺激可提升 IL-1beta 產量。Methyltransferase inhibitors 可逆轉此 primed 輸出。HDAC inhibition 同樣調節 MSU 誘導的促發炎細胞激素，將 urate training 與 histone control 連結起來。

label: Sirtuin deacetylation reaction
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: During the sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation of a lysine, NAD+ is cleaved between its nicotinamide and ADP-ribose moieties, and the acetyl group is transferred to the ADP-ribose to generate 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose (OAADPr) plus free nicotinamide. OAADPr is a stoichiometric by-product, released in equimolar amounts with the deacetylated substrate on every catalytic cycle. This molecule is not merely waste: it binds and activates the TRPM2 cation channel, linking sirtuin activity to calcium signaling and cellular stress responses. A caveat is that OAADPr accumulation can itself feed back on cellular metabolism, and its levels reflect the integrated deacetylase flux of the cell.
description_zh_TW: 在 sirtuin 催化的離胺酸去乙醯化過程中，NAD+ 在菸鹼醯胺和 ADP-核糖基團之間被裂解，乙醯基被轉移到 ADP-核糖上，生成 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose（OAADPr）和游離的菸鹼醯胺。OAADPr 是化學計量的副產物，在每個催化週期中以等摩爾量與去乙醯化的受質一起釋放。這個分子不僅僅是廢物：它能結合並活化 TRPM2 陽離子通道，將 sirtuin 活性與鈣離子訊號傳導和細胞壓力反應聯繫起來。需要注意的是，OAADPr 的積累本身可以反饋影響細胞代謝，其水平反映了細胞整體的去乙醯酶通量。

label: Osteoclast
description: Monocyte/macrophage lineage derives into osteoclasts under RANKL plus M-CSF. Induction is the differentiation drive.
description_zh_TW: 單核/巨噬細胞譜系在 RANKL 加 M-CSF 下分化為蝕骨細胞。誘發是分化驅動。

label: Tenovins
description: By inhibiting SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation, Tenovins promote p53 hyperacetylation and reactivation of p53-dependent transcriptional networks. Directionally, Tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation. This restores p53 tumor-suppressive function in cells where sirtuins silence it, and it is the basis for Tenovins' anticancer activity. Because p53 is a central tumor suppressor, its reactivation by sirtuin inhibition represents a compelling strategy for p53-wild-type tumors. The hyperacetylation increases p53 stability and transcriptional potency, driving cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 透過抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的去乙醯化，Tenovin 促進 p53 超乙醯化和 p53 依賴性轉錄網路的重新活化。在方向性上，Tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化的上游。這在 sirtuin 沉默 p53 的細胞中恢復其腫瘤抑制功能，是 Tenovin 抗癌活性的基礎。由於 p53 是核心腫瘤抑制因子，透過 sirtuin 抑制重新活化它是 p53 野生型腫瘤的引人注目策略。超乙醯化增加 p53 穩定性和轉錄效力，驅動細胞週期阻滯和凋亡。

label: Zellweger syndrome
description: Mutations in PEX genes, which encode peroxisomal membrane proteins required for biogenesis, account for over 80% of autosomal recessive peroxisomal biogenesis disorders. Loss of PEX1, essential for assembly of the peroxisomal membrane and import of other PEX proteins, results in a complete absence of peroxisomes — the most severe Zellweger spectrum presentation with profound neurological impairment.
description_zh_TW: 編碼過氧化物體膜蛋白（生物生成所需）的 PEX 基因突變，佔體染色體隱性過氧化物體生成疾病的 80% 以上。PEX1 對過氧化物體膜組裝與其他 PEX 蛋白的輸入至關重要，其缺失會導致過氧化物體完全缺失，造成最嚴重、伴隨深度神經損傷的 Zellweger 光譜疾病表現。

label: IL-7
description: Thymic epithelial cells produce a number of colony stimulating factors and hematopoietic cytokines, including IL-1, IL-3, IL-6, IL-7, TGF-β, oncostatin M, and leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF). Intrathymic and systemic production of these cytokines and growth factors regulates the complex process of thymopoiesis and is responsible for stromal cross-talk within the thymic microenvironment. IL-7 in particular is a crucial cytokine for thymocyte survival and T cell development, making the thymic cytokine milieu a candidate target for therapies aimed at reversing age-induced thymic involution. Loss of TEC-derived IL-7 production with age contributes to declining thymic output.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺上皮細胞產生多種集落刺激因子和造血細胞因子，包括 IL-1、IL-3、IL-6、IL-7、TGF-β、oncostatin M 和白血病抑制因子（LIF）。胸腺內和全身性的這些細胞因子和生長因子的產生調節胸腺生成的複雜過程，並負責胸腺微環境內的基質交談。IL-7 尤其是胸腺細胞存活和 T 細胞發育的關鍵細胞因子，使胸腺細胞因子環境成為旨在逆轉年齡相關胸腺退化的治療候選靶點。隨著年齡增長，TEC 來源的 IL-7 產生減少導致胸腺輸出下降。

label: LYN
description: LYN is a Src-family tyrosine kinase.
description_zh_TW: LYN 是 Src 家族酪胺酸激酶。

label: Vasodilation
description: Under normal conditions nitric oxide is a crucial signaling molecule that relaxes vascular smooth muscle via activation of soluble guanylyl cyclase and cGMP production. However, during severe inflammation, injury, or shock, overproduction of NO - primarily by inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) - leads to excessive vasodilation, vascular leakage, and tissue damage. This is the pathway targeted by both aminoguanidine, which blocks NO synthesis at iNOS (upstream), and methylene blue, which blocks NO action at sGC (downstream).
description_zh_TW: 正常情況下，一氧化氮是通過激活可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶和cGMP產生來放鬆血管平滑肌的關鍵信號分子。然而，在嚴重炎症、損傷或休克期間，NO的過度產生（主要由誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）產生）導致過度血管舒張、血管滲漏和組織損傷。這正是氨基胍（在iNOS水平阻斷NO合成，上游）和亞甲藍（在sGC水平阻斷NO作用，下游）共同靶向的通路。

label: Reactive Oxygen Species generation
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Regular physical exercise effectively inhibits reactive oxygen species generation and improves the activities of antioxidant enzymes. Because the protein glycation reaction is driven and accelerated by ROS, the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is considered the main mechanism of exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Exercise also reduces oxidative stress in rodent models and improves glycemic control, both of which limit AGE accumulation. These effects make physical exercise a non-pharmacological strategy for attenuating glycation stress during aging.
description_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動能有效抑制活性氧（ROS）的生成，並提升抗氧化酵素的活性。由於蛋白質糖化反應受 ROS 驅動並加速，因此規律運動抑制 AGE 形成被視為運動相關抗氧化活性的主要機制。運動亦能降低囓齒類動物模型的氧化壓力並改善血糖控制，兩者皆能限制 AGE 累積。這些效應使身體運動成為減緩老化過程中糖化壓力的非藥物策略。

label: Telomere Attrition
description: Progressive telomere shortening to critical length triggers replicative senescence at the Hayflick limit. The end-replication problem is the causal mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 漸進性端粒縮短至關鍵長度在 Hayflick 極限觸發複製性衰老。末端複製問題是因果機制。

label: non-small-cell lung cancer
description: Sotorasib is approved for KRAS G12C non-small-cell lung cancer.
description_zh_TW: Sotorasib 核准用於 KRAS G12C 非小細胞肺癌。

label: S6K1/2
description: S6K1/2 are primary downstream effectors of mTORC1, and rapamycin's inhibition of mTORC1 suppresses S6K1/2 activity. This places S6K1/2 on the rapamycin-sensitive axis regulating protein synthesis.
description_zh_TW: S6K1/2 是 mTORC1 的主要下游效應器，rapamycin 抑制 mTORC1 會壓制 S6K1/2 活性。這使 S6K1/2 位於調控蛋白質合成的 rapamycin 敏感軸上。

label: TXNIP
description: In pancreatic beta-cells, SIRT6 preserves glucose-stimulated insulin secretion (GSIS) and cell survival by repressing expression of TXNIP, a pro-oxidant and pro-apoptotic protein. This repression is achieved through histone deacetylation, with SIRT6 removing acetylation marks at H3K9 and H3K56 in the TXNIP regulatory region. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of TXNIP suppression via chromatin modification. By keeping TXNIP low, SIRT6 protects beta-cells from glucotoxic damage and maintains their capacity to secrete insulin in response to glucose. This links SIRT6's epigenetic function directly to pancreatic beta-cell health and the preservation of glucose homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 在胰島β細胞中，SIRT6透過抑制TXNIP的表達來維持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌（GSIS）和細胞存活，TXNIP是一種促氧化和促凋亡蛋白。此抑制透過組蛋白去乙醯化實現，SIRT6在TXNIP調控區域移除H3K9和H3K56的乙醯化標記。方向上，SIRT6透過染色質修飾位於TXNIP抑制的上游。透過保持TXNIP低水平，SIRT6保護β細胞免受葡萄糖毒性的損傷，並維持其對葡萄糖反應分泌胰島素的能力。這將SIRT6的表觀遺傳功能直接與胰島β細胞健康和葡萄糖恆定的維持聯繫起來。

label: cGAS
description: cGAS binds cytosolic double-stranded DNA and synthesises cyclic GMP-AMP, which binds and activates STING. In senescence the DNA ligands are predominantly endogenous: chromatin cytoplasmic foci blebbed from the nucleus, mitochondrial DNA released from damaged mitochondria, and retrotransposon-derived cDNA. This cGAS to STING step is the point at which nuclear and mitochondrial damage are converted into the interferon and NF-kB signalling that drives the SASP, which is why the axis is regarded as a central regulator of SASP induction rather than a peripheral pathway.
description_zh_TW: cGAS 結合胞質雙股 DNA 並合成 cyclic GMP-AMP，後者結合並活化 STING。在衰老中，DNA 配體主要為內源性：由細胞核起泡排出的染色質細胞質病灶、受損粒線體釋出的粒線體 DNA，以及反轉錄轉座子來源的 cDNA。此 cGAS 至 STING 步驟是細胞核與粒線體損傷轉換為驅動 SASP 的干擾素與 NF-kB 訊號之處，因此該軸被視為 SASP 誘導的中樞調控者而非周邊路徑。

label: Dopamine o-quinone
description: Dopamine is biochemically converted into Dopamine o-quinone through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, Dopamine acts as the substrate and Dopamine o-quinone as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Dopamine o-quinone。從機制上講，Dopamine 作為底物，Dopamine o-quinone 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: Adrenochrome Semiquinone Radical
description: The semiquinone radical catalytically regenerates through the redox-cycling loop. Participation sustains superoxide production.
description_zh_TW: 半醌自由基經由氧化還原循環催化再生。參與維持超氧產生。

label: Etoposide
description: Etoposide is a topoisomerase inhibitor used in small-cell lung cancer chemotherapy, combined with a platinum agent and, in limited-stage disease, thoracic radiotherapy. It is a backbone agent of SCLC treatment. Etoposide is therefore central to SCLC therapy.
description_zh_TW: Etoposide 是用於 Small-cell lung cancer 化療的拓撲異構酶抑制劑，與鉑類藥物聯用，並在局限性疾病中與胸部放療聯用。它是 SCLC 治療的主幹藥物。因此 Etoposide 對 SCLC 治療至關重要。

label: ICF Syndrome
description: Disrupted de novo methylation at satellites underlies ICF syndrome.
description_zh_TW: 衛星的從頭甲基化破壞是 ICF 症候群的基礎。

label: Alkylating agent
description: Cyclophosphamide is the prototypical alkylator producing phosphoramide-mustard crosslinks. Classification defines the drug class.
description_zh_TW: Cyclophosphamide 是產生磷醯胺芥交聯的原型烷化劑。歸類定義藥物類別。

label: Nucleolus
description: The nucleolus is the largest structure within the cell nucleus.
description_zh_TW: 核仁是細胞核內最大的結構。

label: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine
description: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine (CML) is a prominent advanced glycation end product formed from glycated proteins. There is a marked correlation between the serum concentration of CML and vessel stiffness in elderly individuals, reflecting the role of AGE accumulation and ECM cross-linking in arterial stiffening. CML also accumulates in heart tissue with age, and dietary CML-enriched protein induces functional arterial aging in a RAGE-dependent manner in mice. Serum CML is therefore used as a biomarker of glycation burden and age-related vascular pathology.
description_zh_TW: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine（CML）是由 glycated proteins 形成的重要 advanced glycation end product。Elderly individuals 血清 CML concentration 與 vessel stiffness 之間存在顯著相關性，反映了 AGE accumulation 與 ECM cross-linking 在 arterial stiffening 中的作用。CML 也隨年齡堆積於 heart tissue，而 dietary CML-enriched protein 在 mice 中以 RAGE-dependent manner 誘發 functional arterial aging。因此，血清 CML 被用作 glycation burden 與 age-related vascular pathology 的 biomarker。

label: Genotoxic Stress
description: Genotoxic insults directly produce DNA lesions as their defining consequence. Causation is definitional for the stress class.
description_zh_TW: 基因毒性傷害直接產生 DNA 病變作為其定義性後果。因果對此壓力類別是定義性的。

label: Adrenaline-quinone
description: Glutathione normally reduces adrenaline-quinone back to epinephrine as the first-line quinone defense. Reduction competes with cyclization to leuco-adrenochrome.
description_zh_TW: 穀胱甘肽通常將腎上腺素醌還原回腎上腺素，作為第一線醌防禦。還原與環化為無色腎上腺素競爭。

label: CD73
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: CD73, the rate-limiting ectonucleotidase that converts AMP to immunosuppressive adenosine in the tumor microenvironment, is downregulated following intermittent fasting. Reduced CD73 expression leads to diminished extracellular adenosine, which can relieve adenosine-mediated immune suppression and enhance anti-tumor immunity. The regulation is observed in vitro under fasting-mimetic conditions, linking IF to both metabolic and immunological remodeling. Because adenosine signaling promotes tumor evasion, CD73 downregulation represents a plausible mechanism by which fasting improves cancer therapy outcomes.
description_zh_TW: CD73是腫瘤微環境中將AMP轉化為免疫抑制性腺苷的限速胞外核苷酸酶，在間歇性斷食後下調。CD73表現降低導致細胞外腺苷減少，可緩解腺苷介導的免疫抑制並增強抗腫瘤免疫。此調節在體外斷食模擬條件下觀察到，將IF與代謝和免疫重塑連結。由於腺苷訊號促進腫瘤逃避免疫，CD73下調代表斷食改善癌症治療結果的一個合理機制。

label: FasL
description: FasL binding induces Fas trimerization, the upstream trigger of FADD/DISC assembly.
description_zh_TW: FasL 結合誘發 Fas 三聚化，是 FADD/DISC 組裝的上游觸發。

label: OSKM
description: Pluripotent reprogramming is induced by transient expression of the Yamanaka factors Oct4, Sox2, Klf4 and c-Myc (together OSKM). Reprogramming kinetics and barrier factors such as p53 shape the efficiency of OSKM-driven reset.
description_zh_TW: 多能性重編程由 Yamanaka 因子 Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc（合稱 OSKM）的短暫表現誘導。重編程動力學和 p53 等屏障因子決定 OSKM 驅動重置的效率。

label: Gasdermin E
description: Caspase-3 cleaves gasdermin E (DFNA5), switching apoptotic signaling toward pyroptotic pore formation. This apoptosis-to-pyroptosis crossover expands caspase-3 beyond its executioner role.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 切割 gasdermin E（DFNA5），將凋亡訊號切換為 pyroptotic 成孔。此凋亡到焦亡的跨界將 caspase-3 擴展至執行者角色之外。

label: Myocardium
description: Redox-cycling ROS plus complex I/II inhibition and glutathione depletion damage myocardial tissue with contraction-band necrosis in animal models. Damage is the tissue-level outcome.
description_zh_TW: 氧化還原循環 ROS 加複合體 I/II 抑制與穀胱甘肽耗竭損害心肌組織，在動物模型呈收縮帶壞死。損害是組織層級結果。

label: Kidney
description: The kidneys perform filtration, reabsorption, and endocrine functions, and chronic kidney disease accelerates vascular calcification, AGE accumulation, and cardiovascular risk. Renal dysfunction intersects with systemic aging through impaired clearance and glycation.
description_zh_TW: 腎臟執行過濾、再吸收與內分泌功能，而慢性腎病加速血管鈣化、AGE 累積與心血管風險。腎功能障礙透過清除與糖化受損與全身性衰老交織。

label: Caspase-5
description: Active caspase-4/5/11 cleave gasdermin D between its N-terminal pore-forming domain and C-terminal inhibitory domain, releasing the N-terminal fragment to form plasma-membrane pores. This drives inflammatory cell death (pyroptosis) and IL-1alpha release in senescent and responding cells, and the pores also permit release of IL-1beta and IL-18 prior to membrane rupture. The relationship is the canonical execution step of noncanonical inflammasome signaling and links the pathway to both cell death and SASP amplification, creating a feed-forward inflammatory loop in senescent tissue.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 caspase-4/5/11 切割 gasdermin D 其 N 端成孔域與 C 端抑制域之間，釋放 N 端片段形成質膜孔洞。這驅動發炎性細胞死亡（pyroptosis）與衰老及反應細胞中的 IL-1alpha 釋放，且孔洞允許 DAMPs 與細胞激素外逸以放大發炎。透過將非典型發炎體連結到膜透化，此切割將細胞死亡形態與 SASP 耦合，影響衰老細胞存留與免疫清除。

label: p15INK4b
description: p15INK4b binds and inhibits CDK6 as well as CDK4, preventing cyclin D-CDK complex formation and Rb phosphorylation. This dual INK4 blockade enforces G1 arrest in paracrine and oncogene-induced senescence, paralleling the established p16-CDK6 mechanism.
description_zh_TW: p15INK4b 結合並抑制 CDK6 與 CDK4，防止 cyclin D-CDK 複合體形成與 Rb 磷酸化。此雙重 INK4 封鎖在旁分泌與致癌基因誘發衰老中執行 G1 停滯，與已確立的 p16-CDK6 機制平行。

label: Sodium Valproate
description: Valproate promotes remodeling as an HDAC-inhibiting agent boosting reprogramming. Promotion covers its experimental modulator role.
description_zh_TW: 丙戊酸作為促進重編程的 HDAC 抑制劑推動重塑。促進涵蓋其實驗調節者角色。

label: PLK3
description: PLK3 phosphorylates and activates the p53 tumor suppressor.
description_zh_TW: PLK3 磷酸化並活化 p53 腫瘤抑制因子。

label: Neurotransmission
description: Diazepam increases GABA-A chloride-channel opening frequency, potentiating fast inhibitory neurotransmission. Modulation is the allosteric enhancement relationship.
description_zh_TW: Diazepam 提高 GABA-A 氯通道開放頻率，增強快速抑制性神經傳導。調節是變構增強關係。

label: CK2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Caspase-2 is phosphorylated at Ser157 by CK2, one of several kinase inputs that regulate this initiator caspase. Alongside CDK1/CYCLIN B1 (Ser308) and CaMKII (Ser164), CK2 contributes to the phosphorylation-dependent control of caspase-2. These modifications modulate its activity and its susceptibility to 14-3-3 binding.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-2 在 Ser157 被 CK2 磷酸化，這是調控此啟動型半胱天冬酶的幾個激酶輸入之一。與 CDK1/CYCLIN B1（Ser308）和 CaMKII（Ser164）並列，CK2 也參與對 caspase-2 的磷酸化依賴性調控。這些修飾調節其活性及其對 14-3-3 結合的敏感性。

label: SK61_2
description: S6K1/2 (SK61_2), activated by mTORC1 phosphorylation, inactivates IRS1 by phosphorylating it, forming the negative feedback loop that is central to the incoherent bivalent motif underlying rapamycin hormesis. This feedback arm is the backward reaction from the inhibited target (mTORC1) toward the Input node (IRS1, controlled by S6K1/2), and its low Michaelis-Menten constant in the saturated regime strongly increases the probability of biphasic dose-responses. S6K1/2 also deactivates mTORC2, and a significant negative correlation exists between the inhibition of the IRS1-insulin complex and mTORC2 deactivation by the same enzyme S6K1.
description_zh_TW: S6K1/2（SK61_2）被mTORC1磷酸化激活，通過磷酸化使IRS1失活，形成rapamycin hormesis基礎的incoherent bivalent motif核心的負反饋迴路。這個反饋臂是從被抑製的靶點（mTORC1）向輸入節點（IRS1，由S6K1/2控制）的backward reaction，並且其低Michaelis-Menten常數在飽和條件下強烈增加了雙相劑量反應的可能性。S6K1/2還使mTORC2失活，並且在IRS1-胰島素复合物的抑製和同一酶S6K1對mTORC2的失活之間存在顯著的負相關。

label: anti-inflammatory properties
description: Hesperidin contributes antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity as a citrus flavanone, consistent with the flavonoid class pattern. Its COMT neutrality makes it usable where catechol flavonoids are not.
description_zh_TW: Hesperidin 作為柑橘黃烷酮貢獻抗氧化與抗發炎活性，符合類黃酮類別模式。其 COMT 中性使其在兒茶酚類黃酮不適用處可用。

label: H1.2
description: Iduna (RNF146) is a PAR-dependent E3 ubiquitin ligase whose WWE domain binds the iso-ADP-ribose linkage of PAR; it ubiquitinates the PARylated linker histone H1.2, tagging this PAR carrier for proteasomal degradation and blocking poly(ADP-ribose) nuclear export (Andrabi 2011; Kang 2011).
description_zh_TW: Iduna（RNF146）是依賴 PAR 的 E3 泛素連接酶，其 WWE 結構域結合 PAR 的 iso-ADP-ribose 連結；它泛素化受 PAR 修飾的連結組蛋白 H1.2，將此 PAR 載體標記以進行蛋白酶體降解，並阻斷聚(ADP-核糖)的核輸出（Andrabi 2011；Kang 2011）。

label: Fructose
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: The two-enzyme glucose to sorbitol to fructose route produces fructose, setting the advanced glycation feed rate. Sorbitol dehydrogenase closes the pathway output.
description_zh_TW: 葡萄糖到山梨醇到果糖的雙酶路徑產生果糖，設定晚期糖化供養速率。山梨醇脫氫酶關閉路徑輸出。

label: ATFS-1
description: ATFS-1 is a basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor in C. elegans that serves as the primary regulator of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt). Under mitochondrial stress it translocates to the nucleus to drive the protective UPRmt gene program.
description_zh_TW: ATFS-1 是線蟲（C. elegans）中鹼性螺旋-環-螺旋轉錄因子，是粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的主要調控者。在粒線體壓力下它轉位至細胞核以驅動保護性的 UPRmt 基因程式。

label: DNA Hypomethylation
description: SIRT1 deacetylates histone H3 at lysine 79, and this modification promotes DNA hypomethylation and favors the formation of tightly compacted chromatin associated with gene silencing. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic modification of H3K79 sits upstream of altered DNA methylation patterns. This connects SIRT1's histone deacetylase activity to the epigenetic regulation of telomeric chromatin and gene expression. By influencing both histone acetylation and DNA methylation, SIRT1 can exert long-lasting effects on chromatin state that are relevant to aging and genomic stability. The interaction between histone and DNA modifications illustrates how a single sirtuin shapes the epigenetic landscape.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1去乙醯化組蛋白H3第79位賴氨酸，此修飾促進DNA低甲基化並有利於與基因沉默相關的緊密壓縮染色質的形成。方向上，SIRT1對H3K79的酵素修飾位於DNA甲基化模式改變的上游。這將SIRT1的組蛋白去乙醯酶活性與端粒染色質和基因表達的表觀遺傳調節聯繫起來。透過同時影響組蛋白乙醯化和DNA甲基化，SIRT1可以對染色質狀態產生與老化和基因組穩定性相關的持久影響。組蛋白與DNA修飾之間的相互作用說明了單一sirtuin如何塑造表觀遺傳景觀。

label: RNA Interference
description: RNA interference knockdown is a core worm genetics tool.
description_zh_TW: RNA 干擾敲低是核心的線蟲遺傳工具。

label: ABT-263
description: ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor of ABT-737, developed to overcome poor solubility. Both inhibit Bcl-2, Bcl-xL and Bcl-w; Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia.
description_zh_TW: ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物可利用後繼藥物，旨在克服溶解度差的問題。兩者皆抑制 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w；Bcl-xL 抑制會導致標靶性血小板減少。

label: GDH
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: GDH is the primary substrate through which SIRT4 suppresses glutamine metabolism, yet GDH is also listed among negative regulators in Table 3: high GDH activity can outpace SIRT4 ADP-ribosylation under energetic stress, switching cells toward glutaminolysis/fuel oxidation and away from SIRT4-mediated restraint.
description_zh_TW: GDH 是 SIRT4 抑制穀胺酸代謝的主要底物，但 GDH 也被列為表 3 中的負向調節因子：在能量壓力下，高 GDH 活性可能超過 SIRT4 的 ADP-核糖基化，使細胞轉向穀氨醯胺分解/燃料氧化，脫離 SIRT4 介導的限制。

label: Retinal Photoreceptors
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Photoreceptors pack mitochondria densely to power phototransduction. Containment records the organelle-rich anatomy.
description_zh_TW: 感光細胞密集填充粒線體以驅動光轉導。包含記錄富胞器的解剖。

label: Vagus Nerve
description: Heart rate variability (HRV) reflects the balance between sympathetic and parasympathetic branches of the autonomic nervous system. The parasympathetic branch, governed largely by the vagus nerve, allows greater beat-to-beat fluctuation and raises HRV.
description_zh_TW: 心率變異度（HRV）反映自主神經系統交感與副交感分支的平衡。主要由迷走神經（vagus nerve）主導的副交感分支允許更大的逐跳波動並提高 HRV。

label: Biomarker
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Ki-67 is the standard immunohistochemical proliferation biomarker.
description_zh_TW: Ki-67 是標準的免疫組織化學增殖生物標記。

label: FKBP12
description: Rapalogs inhibit mTORC1 by binding the FKBP12-FRB interface of the mTOR kinase. FKBP12 is therefore the essential cofactor through which rapamycin-family drugs engage and suppress mTORC1 signaling.
description_zh_TW: Rapalog 透過結合 mTOR 激酶的 FKBP12-FRB 介面來抑制 mTORC1。因此 FKBP12 是 rapamycin 家族藥物參與並抑制 mTORC1 訊號所需的必需輔因子。

label: Omi/HtrA2
description: Omi/HtrA2 promotes Apoptosis. Omi/HtrA2 is a mitochondrial serine protease released at MOMP that both antagonizes IAPs and degrades substrates to promote death. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Omi/HtrA2 acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Omi/HtrA2 促進 Apoptosis。 Omi/HtrA2 是一種在 MOMP 釋放的粒線體絲胺酸蛋白酶，它既可以拮抗 IAP，又可以降解底物以促進死亡。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，Omi/HtrA2 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Lamins
description: Executioner caspase-3 cleaves nuclear lamins during apoptosis, driving nuclear envelope breakdown and chromatin collapse. This canonical cleavage distinguishes apoptotic lamin loss from senescence-associated lamin B1 decline.
description_zh_TW: 執行者 caspase-3 在凋亡期間切割核 lamins，驅動核膜崩解與染色質塌陷。此典型切割區分凋亡性 lamin 喪失與衰老相關 lamin B1 下降。

label: Aneuploidy
description: Trisomy is whole-chromosome aneuploidy with three copies.
description_zh_TW: 三體是具三拷貝的全染色體非整倍體。

label: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain
description: Silver nanoparticles disrupt respiratory complexes of the electron transport chain. Disruption breaks energy transduction.
description_zh_TW: 銀奈米顆粒破壞電子傳遞鏈的呼吸複合體。破壞中斷能量轉導。

label: Zone 2 Cardio
