description: Zone 2 cardio is low-to-moderate intensity aerobic training at a conversational pace that builds the aerobic base and increases mitochondrial volume. It is the recovery-day complement to HIIT, sustaining metabolic stimulus without the sympathetic load of high-intensity work.
description_zh_TW: Zone 2 有氧是對話節奏的低至中度強度有氧訓練，建立有氧基礎並增加粒線體體積。它是 HIIT 的恢復日互補，在無高強度工作的交感負荷下維持代謝刺激。

label: Ifosfamide-induced Encephalopathy
description: The chloroacetaldehyde metabolite interferes with mitochondrial respiration, and methylene blue rescue is attributed to restoring mitochondrial function. Association is capped as borderline mechanistic evidence.
description_zh_TW: 氯乙醛代謝物干擾粒線體呼吸，而亞甲藍救援歸因於恢復粒線體功能。關聯因機制證據邊緣而設上限。

label: G0 Phase
description: G0 quiescence is reversible arrest while senescence is irreversible and inflammatory. The distinction separates protective stem-cell dormancy from pathological accumulation.
description_zh_TW: G0 靜止是可逆停滯，而衰老不可逆且發炎。此區別將保護性幹細胞休眠與病理性累積分開。

label: PARylation
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: PARP1 is the principal nuclear PARP executing poly-ADP-ribosylation; mirrors the HAT-catalyzes-acetylation edge. Catalysis defines the enzyme.
description_zh_TW: PARP1 是執行 poly-ADP-核糖基化的主要核 PARP；呼應 HAT 催化乙醯化邊。催化定義酶。

label: PARP inhibitors
description: PARP inhibitors prevent PAR accumulation and H2O2-induced death in ARH3-deficient cells, and are proposed as therapy for ARH3-dependent neurodegeneration; ARH3 inhibition is conversely explored to potentiate PARG inhibitors against short PAR oligomers.
description_zh_TW: PARP 抑制劑可阻止 ARH3 缺陷細胞的 PAR 堆積與 H2O2 誘發死亡，被提議用於 ARH3 相關神經退化的治療；反之，抑制 ARH3 被探索用於增強 PARG 抑制劑對短 PAR 寡聚體的效果。

label: Lipid hydroperoxide
description: Lipid peroxyl radical hydrogen abstraction from polyunsaturated fatty acids yields lipid hydroperoxide plus a new lipid radical; the rate-determining propagation step. Abstraction sustains the peroxidation chain.
description_zh_TW: 脂質過氧自由基從多元不飽和脂肪酸提取氫，產生脂質氫過氧化物加新脂質自由基；是速率決定傳播步驟。提取維持過氧化鏈。

label: miR-29b
description: miR-29b directly targets pro-survival Mcl-1.
description_zh_TW: miR-29b 直接標靶促存活 Mcl-1。

label: HIIT
description: High-intensity interval training (HIIT) is a cornerstone mitohormetic stimulus: brief maximal efforts generate an acute ROS spike and lactate accumulation that trigger PGC-1alpha, the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 高強度間歇訓練（HIIT）是核心的毒物興奮（mitohormetic）刺激：短暫的最大努力產生急性 ROS 峰值與乳酸累積，觸發粒線體生合成的總管 PGC-1α。

label: Foam Cells
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Glycated low-density lipoprotein is taken up by macrophages in the arterial wall, and this uptake of modified LDL leads to foam cell formation. Because glycation reduces LDL uptake by the normal cell receptor pathway, modified LDL accumulates, and its subsequent engulfment by macrophages produces lipid-laden foam cells, the hallmark cells of atherosclerotic plaques. The formation of foam cells from modified LDL represents an initiating step of atheroma development and explains why AGE-mediated modification of LDL is considered pro-atherogenic. This pathway links glycation chemistry directly to the cellular pathology of atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: Glycated low-density lipoprotein被arterial wall中的macrophages攝取，而此uptake of modified LDL leads to foam cell formation。由於glycation reduces LDL uptake by the normal cell receptor pathway，modified LDL accumulates，其subsequent engulfment by macrophages produces lipid-laden foam cells——atherosclerotic plaques的hallmark cells。由modified LDL形成foam cells represents an initiating step of atheroma development，並explains why AGE-mediated modification of LDL is considered pro-atherogenic。此pathway links glycation chemistry directly to the cellular pathology of atherosclerosis與cardiovascular disease。

label: SHP1
description: Tyrosine phosphatase-6 (SHP1/PTPN6) dephosphorylates tyrosine residues on the RIPK1 protein in tumors and inflammatory disease.
description_zh_TW: 酪胺酸磷酸酶-6（SHP1/PTPN6）可去磷酸化RIPK1蛋白上的酪胺酸殘基，調控腫瘤與發炎性疾病中的necroptosis。

label: Ruxolitinib
description: JAK-STAT3 is inhibited by ruxolitinib, a JAK1/2 inhibitor that reduces SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8 in senescent fibroblasts. By blocking JAK-STAT3 signaling downstream of SASP cytokines, it interrupts the inflammatory feed-forward loop that sustains the secretome, and its established clinical use in myelofibrosis supports its translational potential as a senomorphic. The inhibition is direct, well validated, and among the most clinically translatable senomorphic mechanisms. It positions ruxolitinib as a leading candidate for dampening senescence-associated inflammation.
description_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 被 ruxolitinib 抑制，ruxolitinib 是一種降低衰老纖維母細胞中 SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8 的 JAK1/2 抑制劑。透過阻斷 SASP 細胞激素下游的 JAK-STAT3 訊號，它中斷維持分泌組的發炎正向迴圈，且其於骨髓纖維化既有的臨床使用支持其作為 senomorphic 的轉譯潛力。此抑制直接、良好驗證，且是臨床上最易轉譯的 senomorphic 機制之一。它使 ruxolitinib 成為減弱衰老相關發炎的領先候選。

label: Endoplasmic Reticulum
description: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases are endoplasmic reticulum resident phase-two conjugation enzymes. Localization places the superfamily at the detoxification membrane.
description_zh_TW: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases 是內質網駐留的二相結合酶。定位將此超家族置於解毒膜。

label: addiction
description: Stimulus-response learning underlies both adaptive expertise and maladaptive habits, including addiction and compulsive behaviors. Its COMT dependence links genetic dopamine regulation to individual differences in habit formation. Understanding S-R mechanisms informs therapeutic approaches to compulsive and addictive disorders.
description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response learning 既構成適應性專長，也構成適應不良習慣，包括成癮和強迫行為。其對 COMT 的依賴將遺傳性多巴胺調節與習慣形成的個體差異連結起來。了解 S-R 機制有助於治療強迫性和成癮性疾病的介入方法。

label: Polycomb Group Proteins
description: XIST recruits Polycomb chromatin modifiers to the inactive X.
description_zh_TW: XIST 將 Polycomb 染色質修飾因子招募至不活化 X。

label: Creatine Kinase
description: Creatine kinase reversibly phosphorylates creatine with ATP to produce phosphocreatine, the muscle phosphagen store. This reaction is the mechanistic hub of the creatine-PCr energy buffer.
description_zh_TW: Creatine kinase 以 ATP 可逆磷酸化肌酸以產生磷酸肌酸，即肌肉磷酸原儲庫。此反應是肌酸-PCr 能量緩衝的機制樞紐。

label: Synaptic Vesicles
description: Dopamine is located in Synaptic Vesicles, establishing the anatomical or subcellular compartment where the entity exerts its function. Mechanistically, this localization reflects biosynthesis, vesicular storage, or the selective vulnerability of that region's neurons. It is significant because the site of localization determines which circuits and symptoms are affected, particularly in Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that localization is often regionally predominant rather than exclusive, and other brain areas may contain smaller amounts of the same entity.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 位於 Synaptic Vesicles 中，建立實體發揮其功能的解剖或亞細胞區室。從機制上講，這種定位反映了該區域神經元的生物合成、囊泡儲存或選擇性脆弱性。這很重要，因為本地化的位置決定了哪些電路和症狀受到影響，特別是在 Parkinson's disease 中。需要注意的是，定位通常是區域性的，而不是排他性的，而其他大腦區域可能包含少量的相同實體。

label: PIDDosome
description: PIDD forms PIDDosome. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with PIDD acting as the operative agent upon PIDDosome rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: PIDD 形式PIDDosome。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。這種關係是有方向的，PIDD 充當 PIDDosome 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: L-Tyrosine
description: Tyrosinase catalyzes the rate-limiting hydroxylation of L-Tyrosine to L-DOPA and the subsequent oxidation to dopaquinone. This is the first committed step of melanogenesis. The reaction is central to both cutaneous and neural pigment synthesis, linking skin and brain melanin biology.
description_zh_TW: Tyrosinase 催化 L-Tyrosine 羥化為 L-DOPA 的限速反應，以及隨後氧化為 dopaquinone。這是黑色素生成的第一個承諾步驟。該反應對皮膚和神經色素的合成都至關重要，連結了皮膚和大腦的黑色素生物學。

label: OGG1
description: APE1 processes abasic sites generated downstream of the DNA glycosylase OGG1 in base excision repair of oxidative DNA lesions such as 8-oxo-dG. The 3'-OH primer it creates is then processed by DNA polymerase beta and ligated by LIG3/XRCC1.
description_zh_TW: 在氧化性 DNA 病變（如 8-oxo-dG）的鹼基切除修復中，APE1 處理在 DNA 糖苷酶 OGG1 下游所產生的無鹼基位點。它所產生的 3'-OH 引子接著由 DNA 聚合酶 beta 處理，並由 LIG3/XRCC1 接合。

label: Beta-TrCP
description: Beta-TrCP ubiquitinates IkappaBalpha, whose destruction activates NF-kB.
description_zh_TW: Beta-TrCP 泛素化 IkappaBalpha，其破壞活化 NF-κB。

label: JAK-STAT3
description: The JAK-STAT3 signaling axis promotes a pro-inflammatory SASP by interacting with p38 MAPK and mTOR and by transducing cues from SASP cytokines such as IL-6. STAT3 activation contributes to age-related frailty and to the immune-modulatory and tumor-promoting facets of the secretome. JAK1/2 inhibitors (e.g., ruxolitinib) reduce SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8, validating the axis as a senomorphic target. The pathway is especially important for the feed-forward, self-reinforcing inflammation characteristic of chronic senescence.
description_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 訊號軸透過與 p38 MAPK 和 mTOR 交互作用，以及轉導來自 SASP 細胞激素如 IL-6 的訊號，促進促發炎性 SASP。STAT3 活化促成年齡相關衰弱，以及分泌組的免疫調節與促腫瘤面向。JAK1/2 抑制劑（如 ruxolitinib）降低 SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8，證實此軸作為 senomorphic 標靶。該路徑對慢性衰老特有的正向、自我強化發炎尤為重要。

label: Selenocysteine
description: The catalytic selenocysteine is essential for GPX4 peroxidase activity. Requirement links mevalonate-pathway tRNA maturation to ferroptosis defense.
description_zh_TW: 催化性硒半胱胺酸對 GPX4 過氧化酶活性必要。必要性將甲羥戊酸路徑 tRNA 成熟連結到鐵死亡防禦。

label: Rejuvenation
description: Partial reprogramming through short, cyclic OSKM pulses in vivo reverses epigenetic age without teratoma risk or identity loss, targeting rejuvenation rather than pluripotency. It is the translational arm linking reprogramming to rejuvenation and the information theory of aging.
description_zh_TW: 透過體內短暫、週期性的 OSKM 脈衝進行部分重編程，可在無畸胎瘤風險或身分喪失的情況下逆轉表觀遺傳年齡，目標是回春而非多能性。這是將重編程與回春及老化資訊理論連結起來的轉譯分支。

label: KAP1
source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md
description: The RING-domain E3 ligase TRIM28/KAP1 polyubiquitinates SIRT1 (K48-linked) and targets it for proteasomal degradation following severe DNA damage (doxorubicin, etoposide, camptothecin, UV). TRIM28 knockdown or CRISPR knockout stabilizes SIRT1 and reduces its ubiquitination; reconstitution of wild-type TRIM28 — but not the E3-dead C65/68A mutant — restores SIRT1 turnover in vivo and in a purified in vitro ubiquitination assay with UBE1/UBE2L6. TRIM28 is thus both necessary and sufficient as the damage-induced SIRT1 E3.
description_zh_TW: RING 結構域 E3 泛素連接酶 TRIM28/KAP1 會對 SIRT1 進行 K48 型多泛素化，並在嚴重 DNA 損傷（doxorubicin、etoposide、camptothecin、UV）後將其送往蛋白酶體降解。TRIM28 的 knockdown 或 CRISPR 基因敲除會穩定 SIRT1 並降低其泛素化；重新表達野生型 TRIM28——但不含 E3 失活的 C65/68A 突變株——可在體內與以 UBE1/UBE2L6 進行的試管內泛素化試驗中恢復 SIRT1 的代謝。因此 TRIM28 對損傷誘導的 SIRT1 E3 角色既必要且充分。

label: BNIP3
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: FOXO3a transactivates BNIP3 downstream of CR-SIRT1 signaling for selective mitophagy (Kume 2010). This effector leg completes the SIRT1-FOXO3a-BNIP3 cascade.
description_zh_TW: FOXO3a 在 CR-SIRT1 訊號下游轉活化 BNIP3 以進行選擇性 mitophagy（Kume 2010）。此效應腿完整呈現 SIRT1-FOXO3a-BNIP3 級聯。

label: catechol flavonoid
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Fisetin is a catechol-containing flavonoid, a flavonol found in fruits and vegetables such as strawberries and apples, and its catechol ring makes it both a substrate for and a potential inhibitor of COMT. As a dietary catechol, it is O-methylated by COMT during metabolism, linking its pharmacokinetics to COMT genotype. At high supplemental doses it can compete with endogenous catechols for the enzyme, though physiological dietary intake is generally modest. It is studied for its antioxidant, senolytic, and neuroprotective properties.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種含兒茶酚的黃酮類化合物，是一種存在於草莓和蘋果等水果和蔬菜中的黃酮醇，其兒茶酚環使其既是 COMT 的底物，又是 COMT 的潛在抑制劑。作為一種膳食兒茶酚，它在代謝過程中被 COMT O-甲基化，從而將其藥物動力學與 COMT genotype 聯繫起來。在高補充劑量下，它可以與內源性兒茶酚競爭酶，儘管生理飲食攝取量通常是適度的。人們對其抗氧化劑、senolytic 和 neuroprotective properties 進行了研究。

label: Estrogen Receptor
description: Estrogen receptor signaling drives MBOAT1 transcription; MBOAT1 remodels phospholipids toward PE-MUFA, suppressing ferroptosis independently of GPX4/FSP1 — the female remodeling gate.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen receptor 訊號驅動 MBOAT1 轉錄；MBOAT1 將磷脂重塑為 PE-MUFA，以 GPX4/FSP1 非依賴方式抑制 ferroptosis——即雌性重塑閘門。

label: Matrix Metalloproteinases
description: AP-1 drives matrix metalloproteinase-1, -3 and -9 transcription in the textbook ultraviolet to collagen-degradation axis. Transcription factor output dissolves dermal matrix.
description_zh_TW: AP-1 在典型的紫外線到膠原降解軸驅動基質金屬蛋白酶-1、-3 與 -9 轉錄。轉錄因子輸出溶解真皮基質。

label: IRS1
description: IRS1 is a signaling adaptor in insulin signaling whose phosphorylation by S6K provides negative feedback that dampens PI3K-Akt signaling. In the incoherent bivalent motif network model, such negative-feedback nodes underlie hormetic dose responses of pathway inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: IRS1 是胰島素訊號中的訊號銜接蛋白，其被 S6K 磷酸化提供抑制 PI3K-Akt 訊號的負回饋。在不一致雙價模體（incoherent bivalent motif）網路模型中，此類負回饋節點是途徑抑制劑毒物興奮劑量反應的基礎。

label: FAK
description: FAK promotes Angiogenesis. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Angiogenesis is the sprouting of new vessels from preexisting vasculature that tumors must recruit to grow beyond a few millimeters and to metastasize. The relationship is directional, with FAK acting as the operative agent upon Angiogenesis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: FAK 促進Angiogenesis。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。是指從先前存在的脈管系統長出新血管，腫瘤必須招募新血管才能生長超過幾毫米並發生轉移。這種關係是有方向的，FAK 充當 Angiogenesis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: CYCLIN B1
description: APC/C degrades cyclin B, inactivating CDK1 for mitotic exit.
description_zh_TW: APC/C 降解 cyclin B，使 CDK1 失活以退出有絲分裂。

label: Polyunsaturated fatty acids
description: Lipid peroxyl radicals abstract bis-allylic hydrogen with low bond energy, fastest for docosahexaenoic over arachidonic over linoleic acid. Abstraction selectivity follows unsaturation degree.
description_zh_TW: 脂質過氧自由基提取雙烯丙基氫，鍵能低，二十二碳六烯酸快於花生四烯酸快於亞麻油酸。提取選擇性追隨不飽和度。

label: flavanone
description: Flavanone is the saturated C-ring flavonoid subclass lacking the catechol motif. Classification nests it in the flavonoid family.
description_zh_TW: flavanone 是飽和 C 環的類黃酮亞類，缺乏兒茶酚基序。歸類將其嵌套於類黃酮家族。

label: Proteins
description: Protein carbonylation is an irreversible modification of proteins introduced by metal-catalyzed oxidation or by adduction of lipid-peroxidation products to susceptible residues. It marks severe, often non-repairable oxidative damage and is used as a biomarker. The directionality is oxidative insult to stable carbonyl formation. A caveat is that carbonylation can also arise from glycation and other non-ROS processes, so it is not exclusively an oxidative-stress marker. Carbonyls can be measured in plasma, tissues, and cell lysates, and their accumulation is a hallmark of aging and age-related disease.
description_zh_TW: Protein carbonylation 是 proteins 的不可逆修飾，透過金屬催化氧化或透過脂質過氧化產物與敏感殘基的加合引入。它標誌著嚴重的、通常不可修復的氧化損傷，並被用作生物標記。方向性是對穩定羰基形成的氧化損傷。需要注意的是，羰基化也可能由糖化和其他非 ROS 過程引起，因此它不僅僅是氧化壓力標記。可以在血漿、組織和細胞裂解物中測量羰基，它們的累積是 aging 和年齡相關疾病的標誌。

label: Adherens Junction
description: E-cadherin clustering at adherens junctions initiates inhibitory signaling.
description_zh_TW: 黏附連接的 E-cadherin 聚集啟動抑制訊號。

label: Dopamine Transporter
description: The hippocampus has sparse dopamine transporter expression, so extracellular dopamine there is cleared mainly by COMT and NET uptake. This mirrors the prefrontal sparse-DAT architecture that makes COMT the dominant clearance route.
description_zh_TW: 海馬體的多巴胺轉運蛋白表現稀疏，因此該處細胞外多巴胺主要由 COMT 與 NET 攝取清除。此呼應前額葉稀疏 DAT 架構，使 COMT 成為主要清除路徑。

label: Homologous recombination repair
description: High-fidelity homologous repair preserves integrity against breaks. Maintenance is the fidelity output.
description_zh_TW: 高保真同源修復保持對抗斷裂的完整。維持是保真輸出。

label: Cyclin
description: Cyclin-dependent kinases require cyclin regulatory subunits for activity; monomeric CDKs are inactive. Cyclin binding provides the obligatory activation step.
description_zh_TW: 週期蛋白依賴激酶需要 cyclin 調節次單元才有活性；單體 CDK 無活性。Cyclin 結合提供必要的活化步驟。

label: FRAT2
description: FRAT2 binds GSK3β competing with Axin to disrupt the destruction complex. Inhibition releases beta-catenin signaling.
description_zh_TW: FRAT2 結合 GSK3β 與 Axin 競爭以破壞降解複合體。抑制釋放 beta-catenin 訊號。

label: Tumor suppressor
description: Beclin 1 is a core autophagy protein and a haploinsufficient tumor suppressor whose monoallelic deletion is frequently observed in human ovarian, breast, and prostate cancers. Loss of one BECN1 allele reduces autophagic flux, increasing susceptibility to oxidative damage, genomic instability, and inflammation that favor tumor initiation. Mechanistically, Beclin 1 functions as the scaffold of the PI3K III nucleation complex, and its interaction with Bcl-2 family members further couples autophagy to apoptotic regulation. Its frequent deletion in epithelial cancers established autophagy as a genuine tumor-suppression pathway.
description_zh_TW: Beclin 1是一種核心自噬蛋白和單倍體不足型腫瘤抑制因子，其單等位基因缺失常見於人類卵巢癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌。失去一個BECN1等位基因會降低自噬流，增加對氧化損傷、基因組不穩定和發炎的易感性，有利於腫瘤起始。在機制上，Beclin 1作為PI3K III成核複合體的支架，其與Bcl-2家族成員的交互作用進一步將自噬與凋亡調控耦合。它在上皮癌中的頻繁缺失確立了自噬作為一條真正的腫瘤抑制途徑。

label: chromatin condensation
description: Chromatin compaction is a defining nuclear hallmark of apoptotic execution.
description_zh_TW: 染色質緻密是凋亡執行的定義性核標誌。

label: Silver salts
description: Insoluble silver salts transform into soluble protein-bound transport species, the gateway step of systemic handling. Transformation enables circulation.
description_zh_TW: 不溶性銀鹽轉化為可溶性蛋白結合運輸物種，是全身處理的門戶步驟。轉化促成循環。

label: Autophagosome
description: The Atg12-Atg5-ATG-16.2 complex is required for LGG-1/LGG-2 lipidation and autophagosome formation. Requirement is the conjugation dependency.
description_zh_TW: Atg12-Atg5-ATG-16.2 複合體為 LGG-1/LGG-2 脂化與自噬體形成所需。必要性是接合依賴。

label: Fructosyl-Amino Acid Oxidases
description: Fructosyl-amino acid oxidases (FAOD), also known as amadoriases, are enzymes found primarily in fungi and bacteria, such as Aspergillus species, that catalyze the oxidation of Amadori products. The reaction yields an unmodified amino acid, a glucosone, and hydrogen peroxide. Because they deglycate early glycation intermediates, FAOD are actively researched for therapeutic and cosmetic applications, and some research explores pairing FAOD with fructosamine-3-kinase to synergistically deglycate damaged structural proteins such as skin collagen. These enzymes represent a repair-based strategy for reducing AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-胺基酸氧化酶（Fructosyl-amino acid oxidases, FAOD），亦稱為 amadoriases，是主要存在於真菌與細菌（如麴菌屬 Aspergillus 物種）中的酵素，催化阿馬多里產物的氧化。此反應產生未修飾的胺基酸、葡萄糖酮（glucosone）與過氧化氫。由於它們使早期糖化中間產物去糖化，FAOD 被積極研究用於治療與美容應用，且部分研究探討將 FAOD 與果糖胺-3-激酶配對，以協同地去糖化受損的結構蛋白如皮膚膠原蛋白。這些酵素代表一種基於修復的減少 AGE 堆積策略。

label: MBOAT1
description: Estrogen receptor signaling drives MBOAT1 transcription; MBOAT1 remodels phospholipids toward PE-MUFA, suppressing ferroptosis independently of GPX4/FSP1 — the female remodeling gate.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen receptor 訊號驅動 MBOAT1 轉錄；MBOAT1 將磷脂重塑為 PE-MUFA，以 GPX4/FSP1 非依賴方式抑制 ferroptosis——即雌性重塑閘門。

label: Lactate
description: Lactate can downregulate SIRT3, which in turn increases acyl-CoA synthetase long chain family member 4 (ACSL4) lactylation, thereby promoting ferroptosis and accelerating the decline of nucleus pulposus cell functionality in intervertebral disc degeneration. This cascade connects disc metabolic dysregulation (hypoxia, lactate accumulation) to SIRT3 loss and ferroptotic cell death via the lactylation mark.
description_zh_TW: 乳酸可以下調 SIRT3，後者反過來增加脂肪醯-CoA 合酶長鏈家族成員 4（ACSL4）的乳醯化，從而促進鐵死亡並加速椎間盤退化中髓核細胞功能的衰退。此級聯將椎間盤代謝失調（低氧、乳酸累積）透過乳醯化標記與 SIRT3 缺失和鐵死亡性細胞死亡聯繫起來。

label: Methionine
description: Hypochlorous acid oxidizes methionine to methionine sulfoxide, a major protein target of neutrophil oxidants. Sulfur oxidation marks chlorinative protein damage.
description_zh_TW: 次氯酸氧化 methionine 為甲硫胺酸亞碸，是嗜中性球氧化劑的主要蛋白標的。硫氧化標記氯化性蛋白損傷。

label: Dicer
description: Dicer performs the canonical RNase III maturation of pre-let-7. Child edge of the existing Dicer-processes-MicroRNA triple.
description_zh_TW: Dicer 執行 pre-let-7 典型的 RNase III 成熟。是既有 Dicer 處理 MicroRNA triple 的子邊。

label: Calpain
description: Calpain I, a Ca2+-dependent protease, can cleave and release AIF from mitochondria (62 to 57 kDa) and cleaves BID to route Ca2+ signals through BAX, providing a candidate Ca2+-calpain-AIF route in parthanatos. However calpain inhibition or knockout does not prevent AIF release in some models, so its role is context dependent (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: 鈣依賴蛋白酶 calpain I 可切割並自粒線體釋放 AIF（62 至 57 kDa），並切割 BID 使 Ca2+ 訊號經 BAX 傳遞，為 parthanatos 中 Ca2+-calpain-AIF 的候選路徑。然而部分模型中 calpain 抑制或敲除無法阻止 AIF 釋放，故其角色取決於情境（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: JNK1
description: JNK1 is a stress-activated MAPK family member.
description_zh_TW: JNK1 是壓力活化的 MAPK 家族成員。

label: miR-7
description: EGFR is the principal directly-repressed RTK target restraining proliferation.
description_zh_TW: EGFR 是主要的直接抑制 RTK 標的以約束增殖。

label: SCF Complex
description: FBW7 confers substrate specificity on the SCF ubiquitin ligase.
description_zh_TW: FBW7 賦予 SCF 泛素連接酶受質特異性。

label: Cardiovascular System
description: The cardiovascular system is one of the domains affected by chronic low-grade inflammation (inflammaging), which contributes to arterial stiffening and cardiovascular disease with age. Interventions that lower background inflammation may preserve cardiovascular hemodynamic aging.
description_zh_TW: 心血管系統是受慢性低度發炎（inflammaging）影響的領域之一，發炎老化會隨年齡促成動脈硬化與心血管疾病。能降低背景發炎的介入措施可能有助於保存心血管血流動力老化。

label: movement
description: D1 activation on the direct pathway disinhibits thalamocortical output to facilitate movement initiation and smoothness. This mirrors the established D2-modulates-movement edge on the opposing pathway.
description_zh_TW: D1 在直接路徑的活化去抑制丘腦皮質輸出，以促進動作啟動與平滑。此呼應對側路徑既有的 D2 調節運動邊。

label: CHK2
description: Double-strand breaks from fork collapse engage ATM, which phosphorylates CHK2 to stabilize p53 in oncogene-induced senescence. Dual ATM-CHK2 and ATR-CHK1 engagement ensures robust arrest under oncogenic stress.
description_zh_TW: 叉崩塌產生的雙股斷裂接合 ATM，後者磷酸化 CHK2 以在致癌基因誘發衰老中穩定 p53。ATM-CHK2 與 ATR-CHK1 雙重接合確保致癌壓力下強健的停滯。

label: Doxorubicin
description: Doxorubicin single-dose ranks Nrk2 the top downregulated muscle transcript.
description_zh_TW: Doxorubicin 單劑使 Nrk2 居肌肉下調轉錄首位。

label: F2-Isoprostanes
description: Non-enzymatic peroxidation of arachidonic acid yields 8-iso-prostaglandin-F2alpha, the gold-standard oxidative stress biomarker. Isoprostane formation marks membrane peroxidation burden.
description_zh_TW: 花生四烯酸的非酶促過氧化產生 8-iso-prostaglandin-F2alpha，即黃金標準 oxidative stress 生物標記。異前列腺素形成標記膜過氧化負荷。

label: Genomic Imprinting
description: CDKN1C (p57) is expressed from the maternal allele only under KvDMR1 imprinting control. This parent-of-origin regulation links cell-cycle control to epigenetic inheritance.
description_zh_TW: CDKN1C（p57）僅在 KvDMR1 銘印控制下從母系等位基因表現。此親源調節將細胞週期控制連結到表觀遺傳繼承。

label: Necrostatin-1s
description: Necrostatin-1s (Nec-1s) is the second-generation allosteric RIPK1 inhibitor: the same mechanism as Necrostatin-1 with improved metabolic stability and kinase selectivity.
description_zh_TW: Necrostatin-1s（Nec-1s）為第二代 RIPK1 異位抑制劑：機制與 Nec-1 相同，但代謝穩定性與激酶選擇性更佳。

label: Embryonic Development
description: Gastrulation is the central germ-layer event included in embryonic development. Inclusion nests the phase in the program.
description_zh_TW: 原腸形成是包含於胚胎發育的中央胚層事件。包含將階段嵌套於程序。

label: iRGD peptide
description: iRGD homes to alphav tumor vasculature via its RGD motif as step one.
description_zh_TW: iRGD 經 RGD 基序歸巢 αv 腫瘤血管作為第一步。

label: Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns
description: DAMPs released from necroptotic cells are heavy triggers of innate and adaptive immunity and plausibly drive allograft rejection — the rationale for necroptosis inhibition in solid-organ transplantation.
description_zh_TW: 由 necroptosis 細胞釋出之 DAMPs 是先天與適應性免疫之強力觸發物，很可能驅動移植物排斥——此為實體器官移植中抑制 necroptosis 之理論依據。

label: Senotherapeutic
description: The term 'senotherapeutic' is an umbrella encompassing both senolytics (which eliminate senescent cells) and senomorphics (which suppress the SASP). Senolytics act on the cellular driver, while senomorphics act on the secretory effector, together spanning the intervention space against senescence. This inclusive definition reflects the field's two-pronged therapeutic philosophy and accommodates agents with dual activity, such as fisetin. Recognizing both under one term aids classification and communication of anti-senescence strategies.
description_zh_TW: 「senotherapeutic」一詞是涵蓋 senolytics（消除衰老細胞）與 senomorphics（抑制 SASP）的傘詞。Senolytics 作用於細胞驅動者，senomorphics 作用於分泌效應器，共同涵蓋對抗衰老的介入空間。此包容性定義反映該領域的雙管齊下治療哲學，並容納具雙重活性的藥劑如 fisetin。在單一詞下辨識兩者有助於抗衰老策略的分類與溝通。

label: Glucocerebrosidase
description: Glucocerebrosidase activation (ambroxol chaperone, ASPro-PD Phase 3) clears alpha-synuclein lysosomally. Lysosomal clearance is the therapeutic lever in GBA-Parkinson disease.
description_zh_TW: Glucocerebrosidase 活化（ambroxol 伴侶，ASPro-PD 三期）經溶酶體清除 alpha-synuclein。溶酶體清除是 GBA-帕金森的治療槓桿。

label: Chronic granulomatous disease
description: Sterile granulomas and colitis in chronic granulomatous disease resemble Crohn's disease, an established clinical overlap. Shared granulomatous pathology links the entities.
description_zh_TW: 慢性肉芽腫病的無菌肉芽腫與結腸炎類似 Crohn's disease，是既定的臨床重疊。共享的肉芽腫病理連結兩實體。

label: Isogenic Pair
description: Isogenic pairs are the gold standard for monogenic causal attribution.
description_zh_TW: 同基因對是單基因因果歸因的黃金標準。

label: Uric Acid
description: Febuxostat blocks oxidized and reduced xanthine oxidase forms, suppressing urate production more completely than allopurinol. Blockade lowers the gout mediator.
description_zh_TW: Febuxostat 阻斷氧化與還原態 xanthine oxidase，比 allopurinol 更徹底抑制尿酸鹽生成。阻斷降低痛風介體。

label: PAK1
description: PAK1 phosphorylates Bad at Ser111, inactivating the BH3-only protein.
description_zh_TW: PAK1 在 Ser111 磷酸化 Bad，使 BH3-only 蛋白失活。

label: Autophagy Inducer
description: Autophagy-inducing interventions have been shown to rejuvenate features of adaptive immune aging, a process characterized by thymic involution, reduced naïve T cell output, and diminished responses to vaccination and infection. By clearing damaged mitochondria and improving proteostasis in lymphocytes, autophagy inducers restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance memory CD8+ T cell generation. Pharmacological or dietary activation of autophagy counteracts the functional defects that accumulate in immune cells with age. These effects position autophagy enhancement as a plausible strategy to mitigate immunosenescence.
description_zh_TW: 誘導自噬的介入已被證明可恢復適應性免疫老化的特徵，此過程以胸腺退化、初始T細胞產出減少以及對疫苗和感染的反應減弱為特徵。透過清除受損粒線體並改善淋巴細胞中的蛋白質穩態，自噬誘導劑恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成。藥理或飲食性活化自噬可抵消免疫細胞隨年齡累積的功能缺陷。這些效應將增強自噬定位為減緩免疫老化的合理策略。

label: Somatic Cells
description: Oocyte SCNT reprograms somatic nuclei back to the blastocyst epigenome. Reset restores totipotency-grade plasticity.
description_zh_TW: 卵母細胞 SCNT 將體細胞核重編程回囊胚表觀基因組。重置恢復全能性級可塑性。

label: DunedinPACE
description: Because DunedinPACE captures the rate of aging, it is suited to testing whether interventions slow the aging process itself, linking directly to healthspan. It predicts later physical and cognitive functioning and incidence of multiple age-related diseases from a single blood sample.
description_zh_TW: 由於 DunedinPACE 捕捉老化速率，它適合測試介入措施是否減緩老化過程本身，直接與健康壽命（healthspan）相連結。它可從單一血液樣本預測後續身體與認知功能及多種年齡相關疾病的發生。

label: LDL
description: Oxidized LDL drives plaque formation and foam-cell generation. Contribution is the lipid-etiology edge.
description_zh_TW: 氧化 LDL 驅動斑塊形成與泡沫細胞生成。貢獻是脂質病因邊。

label: ABT-737
description: ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor of ABT-737, developed to overcome poor solubility. Both inhibit Bcl-2, Bcl-xL and Bcl-w; Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia.
description_zh_TW: ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物可利用後繼藥物，旨在克服溶解度差的問題。兩者皆抑制 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w；Bcl-xL 抑制會導致標靶性血小板減少。

label: H3K122ac
description: H3K122ac is a core-domain acetylation that destabilizes the nucleosome and is enriched at senescence-activated super-enhancers. Alongside H3K27ac and H3K18ac, it marks the open, transcriptionally competent state of SASP enhancers.
description_zh_TW: H3K122ac 是使核小體不穩定的核心結構域乙醯化，富集於衰老活化的超級增強子。與 H3K27ac 及 H3K18ac 並列，它標記 SASP 增強子的開放、轉錄勝任狀態。

label: 3-deoxyglucosone
description: Fructosamine-3-kinase phosphorylated fructosamine decomposes releasing 3-deoxyglucosone in a mediated step. Phosphorylation routes the intermediate to dicarbonyl.
description_zh_TW: Fructosamine-3-kinase 磷酸化的 fructosamine 分解釋放 3-deoxyglucosone，為介導步驟。磷酸化將中間體導入二羰基。

label: ERK2
description: ERK2 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 142, producing cytoplasmic retention and nuclear export of the transcription factor (PMID 21617040, 29992949). Phosphorylation at this site, shared with mTORC1 and CDK4/CDK6, keeps TFEB out of the nucleus and thereby represses its transcriptional program for lysosomal and autophagic genes. This places TFEB under the control of mitogen/extracellular-signal-regulated kinase (ERK) signaling in addition to nutrient sensing, integrating growth factor cues into the control of lysosome biogenesis and autophagy. Dephosphorylation of S142 by calcineurin reverses this effect and promotes TFEB translocation to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: ERK2 在絲氨酸 142 上磷酸化 TFEB，導致該轉錄因子的胞質保留和核輸出（PMID 21617040、29992949）。此位點的磷酸化與 mTORC1 和 CDK4/CDK6 共享，使 TFEB 保持在細胞核外，從而抑制其溶酶體和自噬基因的轉錄程序。這使 TFEB 除了營養感知外，還受到絲裂原/細胞外信號調節激酶（ERK）信號通路的控制，將生長因子線索整合到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的調節中。鈣調磷酸酶對 S142 的去磷酸化逆轉此效應，促進 TFEB 轉位至細胞核。

label: Cardiac fibrosis
description: SIRT4 contributes to cardiac fibrosis; global SIRT4 knockout in mice confers resistance to angiotensin-II infusion by suppressing fibrotic deposition. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of profibrotic signaling. This aligns with SIRT4's general tendency to promote pathological remodeling, contrasting with the antifibrotic SIRT1/SIRT3/SIRT6 members. SIRT4's profibrotic action likely reflects its inhibition of mitochondrial oxidative metabolism and promotion of oxidative stress. The opposing roles of SIRT4 versus the protective sirtuins in cardiac fibrosis illustrate the functional antagonism within the sirtuin family and the importance of the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 促進心臟纖維化；SIRT4 的全身敲除通過抑制纖維化沉積賦予對血管張力素 II 輸注的抗性。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於促纖維化信號的上游。這與 SIRT4 促進病理性重塑的總體趨勢一致，與抗纖維化的 SIRT1/SIRT3/SIRT6 成員形成對比。SIRT4 的促纖維化作用可能反映其對粒線體氧化代謝的抑制和對氧化壓力的促進。SIRT4 與保護性 sirtuin 在心臟纖維化中的對立角色說明了 sirtuin 家族內的功能拮抗以及 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的重要性。

label: Double-Strand Break
description: Topo II stabilization plus intercalation generates double-strand breaks. Breaks are the cytotoxic lesion.
description_zh_TW: Topo II 穩定加嵌入產生雙股斷裂。斷裂是細胞毒性病變。

label: Aldose reductase
description: Aldose reductase catalyzes the first rate-limiting glucose to sorbitol step opening the pathway. Initiation gates all downstream flux.
description_zh_TW: Aldose reductase 催化首個速率限制的葡萄糖到山梨醇步驟，開啟路徑。啟動守衛所有下游通量。

label: CASTOR2
description: Arginine-free CASTOR1-CASTOR2 heterodimer binds and represses GATOR2. Parallel inhibition to the CASTOR1 edge.
description_zh_TW: 無精胺酸 CASTOR1-CASTOR2 異二聚體結合並抑制 GATOR2。與 CASTOR1 邊平行的抑制。

label: Transcription factor EB
description: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at Ser142/Ser211 for 14-3-3 cytoplasmic retention. Phosphorylation is the nutrient gate on lysosomal biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 Ser142/Ser211 磷酸化 TFEB 以 14-3-3 胞質滯留。磷酸化是溶酶體生合成的營養閘門。

label: Laminin
description: Laminin is a major structural and signaling component of basal lamina. Containment records the sheet composition.
description_zh_TW: Laminin 是基底膜的主要結構與訊號成分。包含記錄片狀組成。

label: Lysosomal Lipolysis
description: Lysosomal acid lipase hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters and triglycerides delivered via lipophagy. Mediation is the enzymatic execution.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體酸性脂肪酶水解經由脂噬遞送的膽固醇酯與甘油三酯。媒介是酶促執行。

label: Pterostilbene
description: Pterostilbene is a calorie-restriction mimetic that directly activates SIRT1 and upstream energy sensors such as AMPK. It recapitulates the molecular signature of nutrient scarcity, enhancing fatty-acid oxidation and antioxidant defense.
description_zh_TW: 紫檀芪是熱量限制模擬劑，直接活化 SIRT1 與 AMPK 等上游能量感應器。它重現營養稀缺的分子特徵，增強脂肪酸氧化與抗氧化防禦。

label: Cyanosis
description: Methemoglobinemia produces cyanosis, a bluish-gray discoloration of the skin, lips, mucous membranes, and nail beds, typically once methemoglobin reaches 10-20% of total hemoglobin, at which point blood also appears 'chocolate brown'. Cyanosis in methemoglobinemia is notable because it does not improve with supplemental oxygen, since the problem is not oxygenation of hemoglobin but the oxidation state of its heme iron. Higher levels add headache, anxiety, dyspnea on exertion and fatigue (20-30%), progressing to more severe central nervous and cardiovascular symptoms at higher percentages.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobinemia produces cyanosis, a bluish-gray discoloration of the skin, lips, mucous membranes, and nail beds, typically once methemoglobin reaches 10-20% of total hemoglobin, at which point blood also appears 'chocolate brown'。Cyanosis in methemoglobinemia is notable because it does not improve with supplemental oxygen, since the problem is not oxygenation of hemoglobin but the oxidation state of its heme iron。Higher levels add headache, anxiety, dyspnea on exertion and fatigue (20-30%), progressing to more severe central nervous and cardiovascular symptoms at higher percentages。

label: Everolimus
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Everolimus, a rapamycin analog (rapalog), is FDA approved for anti-seizure therapy in tuberous sclerosis complex after many years of off-label use. The EXIST-3 multicenter phase III study evaluated adjunctive everolimus in patients with treatment-resistant epilepsy due to TSC and showed significant reduction in seizure frequency, with approximately 40% of patients in the high-dose group achieving at least a 50% reduction in seizures compared to only 15% in placebo. The success reflects TSC's clearly defined molecular etiology, with highly penetrant mutations driving mTOR hyperactivation making the pathway an actionable target.
description_zh_TW: Everolimus是雷帕黴素類似物（rapalog），在多年仿單外使用後，獲FDA核准用於結節性硬化症（tuberous sclerosis complex）的抗癲癇治療。EXIST-3多中心第三期研究評估everolimus作為輔助治療用於因TSC導致難治性癲癇的患者，結果顯示癲癇發作頻率顯著降低，高劑量組約有40%的患者癲癇發作減少至少50%，而安慰劑組僅15%。此成功反映了TSC明確的分子病因學，高外顯率的突變驅動mTOR過度活化，使該路徑成為可施作的治療標靶。

label: basal ganglia
description: The striatum is part of the basal ganglia, forming the principal input station that receives excitatory cortical and thalamic afferents and dopaminergic input from the substantia nigra pars compacta. Its output via the direct and indirect pathways regulates thalamocortical motor and associative loops, making it central to movement, habit, and reward. COMT and DAT modulate the dopamine that shapes this circuitry, with DAT dominating striatal clearance. This anatomical position underlies its broad functional significance in the brain.
description_zh_TW: 紋狀體是 basal ganglia 的一部分，形成主要輸入站，接收興奮性皮質和丘腦傳入神經以及來自黑質緻密部的多巴胺能輸入。它透過直接和間接途徑的輸出調節丘腦皮質運動和聯想環路，使其成為 movement、習慣和 reward 的核心。 COMT 和 DAT 調節形成此電路的多巴胺，其中 DAT 控制紋狀體間隙。這種解剖位置是其在 brain 中廣泛功能意義的基礎。

label: TGF-beta Receptor
description: TGF-beta receptors are the prototypical receptors for the TGF-beta1 ligand. This ligand-receptor pairing defines the signaling module.
description_zh_TW: TGF-beta 受體是 TGF-beta1 配體的典型受體。此配體—受體配對定義訊號模組。

label: Pioneer Factor
description: A pioneer factor can bind its motif within closed, nucleosome-occupied chromatin and initiate local chromatin opening. In senescence, pioneer factors such as AP-1 are the initial drivers that open enhancers at SASP and senescence genes.
description_zh_TW: 先驅因子能在封閉、核小體佔據的染色質內結合其模體並啟動局部染色質開啟。在衰老中，諸如 AP-1 等先驅因子是開啟 SASP 與衰老基因增強子的初始驅動者。

label: Michaelis-Menten Kinetics
description: Michaelis-Menten kinetics describe enzyme-catalyzed reaction rate as a saturable function of substrate concentration. The saturated enzymatic regime occurs when the Michaelis-Menten constant is very small relative to substrate, making the reaction rate insensitive to substrate changes.
description_zh_TW: Michaelis-Menten 動力學將酶催化反應速率描述為受質濃度的飽和函數。當 Michaelis-Menten 常數遠小於受質時即為飽和酶學機制，使反應速率對受質變化不敏感。

label: Thrombocytopenia
description: Thrombocytopenia is a reduction in circulating platelets and one of the hematological cytopenias linked to chronic mTOR inhibitor use. Mild, reversible thrombocytopenia is among the most common hematological side effects of chronic high-dose rapamycin.
description_zh_TW: 血小板減少症是循環血小板減少，是與慢性 mTOR 抑制劑使用相關的血液細胞減少症之一。輕度可逆的血小板減少是慢性高劑量 rapamycin 最常見的血液學副作用之一。

label: E3 ligase
description: HUWE1 is a HECT-domain E3 ubiquitin ligase.
description_zh_TW: HUWE1 是 HECT 結構域 E3 泛素連接酶。

label: Cell Migration
description: FAK-dependent adhesion turnover is the core motility process. Promotion is the defining FAK output.
description_zh_TW: FAK 依賴的黏附更新是核心遷移過程。促進是定義性的 FAK 輸出。

label: Non-Coding RNA
description: XIST is a long non-coding RNA coating the inactive X chromosome.
description_zh_TW: XIST 是包被不活化 X 染色體的長非編碼 RNA。

label: Smac DIABLO
description: MOMP releases Smac-DIABLO. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. The relationship is directional, with MOMP acting as the operative agent upon Smac-DIABLO rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: MOMP 發布 Smac-DIABLO。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。這種關係是有方向的，MOMP 充當 Smac-DIABLO 的操作代理，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Organoids
description: Assembloids are built by fusing two or more region-specific organoids.
description_zh_TW: Assembloid 由融合兩個以上區域特異類器官建成。

label: ROCK1
description: Caspase-3 removes the inhibitory C-terminal fragment of ROCK1, activating it.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 移除 ROCK1 抑制性 C 端片段以活化之。

label: Frontotemporal Dementia
description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia form a disease spectrum rather than fully separate disorders, since they share a common genetic basis and protein pathology. ALS is primarily a motor neuron disease, but the C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansion and TDP-43 pathology that cause familial ALS are also the most common hereditary causes of FTD, producing overlapping FTD-ALS syndromes. Thus ALS can give rise to frontotemporal dementia when the neurodegenerative process extends into the frontal and temporal lobes.
description_zh_TW: 肌萎縮側索硬化症和額顳葉失智症形成了一個疾病譜，而不是完全獨立的疾病，因為它們具有共同的遺傳基礎和蛋白質病理學。 ALS 主要是一種運動神經元疾病，但導致家族性 ALS 的 C9orf72 六核苷酸重複擴增和 TDP-43 病理也是 FTD 最常見的遺傳原因，產生重疊的 FTD-ALS 綜合徵。因此，當神經退化過程延伸到額葉和顳葉時，ALS 可能會導致額顳葉失智症。

label: Superoxide
description: MnSOD is the primary mitochondrial enzyme that dismutates superoxide (O2-) into hydrogen peroxide and oxygen, intercepting it at its site of generation in the electron transport chain. By converting the reactive superoxide radical into the less damaging hydrogen peroxide, MnSOD constitutes the first line of defense against mitochondrial oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: MnSOD 是主要的粒線體酶，將超氧陰離子（O2-）歧化為過氧化氫和氧氣，並在電子傳遞鏈的產生源頭將其攔截。透過將反應性強的超氧自由基轉化為傷害較小的過氧化氫，MnSOD 構成對抗粒線體氧化壓力的第一道防線。

label: DNA-SCARS
description: DNA-SCARS are persistent nuclear foci of unresolved DNA damage that are enriched in phosphorylated gamma-H2A.X (H2A.X). They sustain the DNA-damage response that maintains senescence growth arrest and promotes SASP cytokine secretion.
description_zh_TW: DNA-SCARS 是未解決 DNA 損傷的持久性核焦點，富含磷酸化的 γ-H2A.X（H2A.X）。它們維持維持衰老生長停滯並促進 SASP 細胞激素分泌的 DNA 損傷反應。

label: Lysosomal Membrane Permeabilization
description: Mild lysosomal membrane permeabilization releases cathepsins that cleave Bid and other apical caspases, engaging apoptosis. Extensive LMP floods the cytosol with hydrolases, causing necrosis-like death, while moderate LMP bridges to the apoptotic program.
description_zh_TW: 輕度溶酶體膜通透化釋放組織蛋白酶，剪切 Bid 與其他頂端 caspase 以啟動細胞凋亡。重度 LMP 以水解酶淹沒細胞質造成類壞死死亡，中度 LMP 則橋接至細胞凋亡程式。

label: Glomerular Filtration Rate
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Age-related glomerular filtration decline drives systemic advanced glycation end-product accumulation, with serum CML correlating negatively with filtration and positively with age. Association records the renal aging axis.
description_zh_TW: 年齡相關的腎絲球過濾下降驅動全身晚期糖化終產物累積，血清 CML 與過濾負相關、與年齡正相關。關聯記錄腎臟老化軸。

label: Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase
description: Methylene blue acts as an inhibitor of soluble guanylyl cyclase (sGC), the downstream receptor for nitric oxide. Even when nitric oxide has already been produced, methylene blue prevents NO from triggering sGC-mediated cyclic GMP production, thereby blocking the vasodilation and hypotension that result from excessive NO signaling in conditions such as septic shock. By acting downstream at sGC rather than at NOS enzymes, methylene blue can rescue blood pressure even when NO levels are already high.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue作為可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶（sGC）的抑制劑發揮作用，sGC是一氧化氮的下游受體。即使一氧化氮已經產生，methylene blue也能防止NO觸發sGC介導的環磷酸GMP產生，從而阻斷在敗血症等情況下過度NO信號傳導導致的血管舒張和低血壓。通過在sGC而不是NOS酶的下游起作用，methylene blue甚至在NO水平已經很高時也能挽救血壓。

label: Model Organisms
description: The nematode worm is a premier animal model organism.
description_zh_TW: 線蟲是首屈一指的動物模式生物。

label: SIRT6 overexpression
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Acute overexpression of SIRT6 in cancer cell lines of different histology induces apoptosis, supporting a tumor-suppressive role for this nuclear sirtuin. The pro-apoptotic activity appears linked to SIRT6's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase function rather than its deacetylase activity. Directionally, increasing SIRT6 abundance or enzymatic activity triggers cell death in tumor cells. This contrasts with SIRT1's context-dependent duality and stresses that sirtuin outputs in cancer depend on the specific isoform and its dominant catalytic modality.
description_zh_TW: 在不同組織學類型的癌細胞系中急性過量表現 SIRT6 可誘導凋亡，支持此核 sirtuin 具有腫瘤抑制功能。此促凋亡活性似乎與 SIRT6 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶功能而非去乙醯酶活性相關。方向性上，增加 SIRT6 的豐度或酵素活性會在腫瘤細胞中觸發細胞死亡。這與 SIRT1 因情境而異的雙重性形成對比，強調 sirtuin 在癌症中的輸出取決於特定的同工型及其主要的催化模式。

label: Mediterranean Diet
description: The PREDIMED trial showed that a Mediterranean diet supplemented with olive oil or nuts significantly reduced major cardiovascular events. Directionally, the dietary pattern sits upstream of lower CVD incidence. Polyphenols including resveratrol may engage SIRT1, but the effect is multifactorial, and it is a clinically validated dietary intervention. The trial provides the strongest evidence that a Mediterranean dietary pattern reduces cardiovascular risk. Its success supports the concept that whole-diet approaches, engaging multiple pathways including sirtuins, are effective for cardiovascular prevention.
description_zh_TW: PREDIMED 試驗顯示，補充橄欖油或堅果的地中海飲食顯著降低了主要心血管事件。在方向性上，飲食模式位於降低心血管疾病發生率的上游。包括 resveratrol 在內的多酚可能作用於 SIRT1，但此效應是多因素的，是一種經過臨床驗證的飲食干預。該試驗提供了最強的證據表明地中海飲食模式降低心血管風險。其成功支持了全飲食方法（涉及 sirtuin 等多種途徑）對心血管預防有效的概念。

label: SIRT7 depletion
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Global SIRT7 depletion contributes to premature ageing, especially in the backbone, white adipose tissue, and the heart.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 的全身性缺乏促成早衰，尤其是在脊柱、白色脂肪組織和心臟中。

label: STACs
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: A matter of controversy is that sirtuin activation by resveratrol and the SRT compounds could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, raising the possibility of assay artifacts. Alternative explanations invoke indirect activation: resveratrol activates SIRT1 in vivo through its effect on cAMP signaling, specifically the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway, and other STACs may act similarly given their analogous metabolic effects. Directionally, the claimed direct SIRT1 activation by STACs is questioned, and their in vivo benefits may be mediated by other pathways. This controversy shaped the rigorous characterization of STAC chemistry and calls for non-fluorescent assay confirmation.
description_zh_TW: 一個爭議問題是 resveratrol 和 SRT 化合物對 sirtuin 的活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，引發了試驗假象的可能性。替代解釋涉及間接活化：resveratrol 透過其對 cAMP 訊號的影響（特別是 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）在體內活化 SIRT1，而其他 STAC 由於相似的代謝效果可能以類似方式作用。方向性上 STAC 所聲稱的直接 SIRT1 活化受到質疑，其體內益處可能由其他途徑介導。此爭議塑造了對 STAC 化學的嚴謹表徵，並要求非螢光試驗確認。

label: P-gp
description: ABCB1/P-gp efflux is the canonical docetaxel resistance mechanism.
description_zh_TW: ABCB1/P-gp 外排是典型的 docetaxel 抗性機制。

label: Melanogenesis
description: MC1R regulates the melanogenic pathway by switching Melanocytes from pheomelanin to eumelanin synthesis. Upon binding alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone, MC1R signals via Gs to stimulate adenylyl cyclase and cAMP, activating the eumelanogenic program in Melanogenesis. Loss-of-function variants reduce signaling and shift synthesis toward Pheomelanin.
description_zh_TW: MC1R 透過將 Melanocytes 從 pheomelanin 合成切換為 eumelanin 合成來調節黑色素生成途徑。在結合 alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone 後，MC1R 透過 Gs 發出信號以刺激 adenylyl cyclase 和 cAMP，啟動 Melanogenesis 中的 eumelanogenic 程序。功能缺失變異會降低信號傳導並使合成轉向 Pheomelanin。

label: Lysosomal Dysfunction
description: Pigment-packed lysosomes worsen crowding and aggregation; the wording is strictly bidirectional, so association only without causal direction. Co-occurrence of granular load and lysosomal failure defines vulnerable neurons.
description_zh_TW: 色素填充的溶小體加重擁擠與聚集；措辭嚴格雙向，故僅為關聯而不帶因果方向。顆粒負荷與溶小體失敗的共現定義易損神經元。

label: Tumor-Suppressor Loss-Induced Senescence
description: Tumor-suppressor loss-induced senescence (TLS) is a cellular senescence program triggered when cells lose function of one or more tumor suppressor genes in the absence of full malignant transformation. The cells withdraw from the cycle into a stable, senescence-associated arrest.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤抑制因子缺失誘導的衰老（TLS）是一種細胞衰老程式，在未發生完全惡性轉化的情況下，細胞失去一個或多個腫瘤抑制基因功能時被觸發。細胞退出細胞週期，進入穩定的衰老相關停滯狀態。

label: Butyrate
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Faecalibacterium is a major butyrate producer depleted in the oldest-old; ties gut depletion to the butyrate-HDACi axis. Production is the microbiome link.
description_zh_TW: Faecalibacterium 是在最老人群減少的主要丁酸產生菌；將腸道耗竭連結到丁酸-HDACi 軸。產生是微生物組連結。

label: High-Throughput Screening
description: High-throughput screening is the primary engine of modern drug discovery campaigns.
description_zh_TW: 高通量篩選是現代藥物發現的主要引擎。

label: SRC kinase
description: FYN is a Src-family tyrosine kinase alongside SRC and LYN.
description_zh_TW: FYN 是與 SRC 和 LYN 並列的 Src 家族酪胺酸激酶。

label: MBOAT2
description: Androgen receptor signaling drives MBOAT2 transcription, the male counterpart of the ER-to-MBOAT1 gate, conferring ferroptosis resistance through the same PE-MUFA remodeling logic.
description_zh_TW: Androgen receptor 訊號驅動 MBOAT2 轉錄，即 ER 至 MBOAT1 閘門的雄性對應物，透過相同的 PE-MUFA 重塑邏輯賦予 ferroptosis 抗性。

label: MFN1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mitochondrial fusion is orchestrated by three main dynamin-related GTPases: mitofusin 1 (MFN1), mitofusin 2 (MFN2) and OPA1. MFN1 and MFN2 are outer mitochondrial membrane transmembrane GTPases required for outer membrane fusion, while OPA1 mostly mediates inner membrane fusion. When MFN1 binds and hydrolyzes GTP, conformational changes in its GTPase domains lead to oligomerization, promoting clustering of the two opposing outer membranes and subsequent fusion. MFN1 and MFN2 are highly homologous with redundant functions; low MFN1 expression can be compensated by MFN2, and knockout of either in mice leads to embryonic lethality.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體融合由三個主要的 dynamin 相關 GTP 酶協調：mitofusin 1（MFN1）、mitofusin 2（MFN2）和 OPA1。MFN1 和 MFN2 是位於粒線體外膜的跨膜 GTP 酶，是外膜融合所必需的，而 OPA1 主要介導內膜融合。當 MFN1 結合和水解 GTP 時，其 GTP 酶結構域的構象變化導致寡聚化，促進兩個對向外膜的聚集及後續融合。MFN1 和 MFN2 具有高度同源性和功能冗餘；低 MFN1 表達可由 MFN2 補償，而小鼠中任一基因的敲除會導致胚胎致死。

label: p70S6 kinase
description: mTORC1 is the upstream activator of p70S6 kinase.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 是 p70S6 kinase 的上游活化因子。

label: CML
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: CML (N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine) has been reported as one of the most abundant advanced glycation end products in vivo and was one of the first AGEs to be characterized in foods, particularly milk and milk products. Because of its abundance and relative ease of measurement, CML is chosen in most studies as a marker of AGEs in both foods and in vivo. It is a glycoxidation product of lysine residues and accumulates in long-lived proteins. CML is the basis of a food database of approximately 500 items and is widely used as a biomarker linking dietary and circulating AGE burden to health outcomes.
description_zh_TW: CML（N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine）被報導為體內最豐富的晚期糖化終產物之一，也是最早在食物中（特別是牛奶與乳製品）被表徵的 AGE 之一。由於其豐富性與相對容易測量，CML 在大多數研究中被選作食物與體內 AGE 的標記。它是賴氨酸殘基的糖氧化產物，並堆積於長壽命蛋白中。CML 是約 500 項食品資料庫的基礎，並被廣泛用作連結飲食與循環 AGE 負擔和健康結果的生物標記。

label: MKP-3
description: MKP-3 binds Bcl-2 and removes phosphate groups at Thr56, Thr74, and Ser87, which normally prime Bcl-2 for ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation. By dephosphorylating Bcl-2, MKP-3 prevents its turnover and elevates cellular Bcl-2 levels. This is the non-canonical apoptosis-relevant function of MKP-3.
description_zh_TW: MKP-3 結合 Bcl-2，並移除 Thr56、Thr74 和 Ser87 上的磷酸基團，這些位點的磷酸化通常會使 Bcl-2 準備進行泛素化與蛋白酶體降解。透過去磷酸化 Bcl-2，MKP-3 防止其周轉並提升細胞內 Bcl-2 水平。這是 MKP-3 與細胞凋亡相關的非經典功能。

label: Gastrulation
description: Gastrulation is the central germ-layer event included in embryonic development. Inclusion nests the phase in the program.
description_zh_TW: 原腸形成是包含於胚胎發育的中央胚層事件。包含將階段嵌套於程序。

label: Klf4
description: Klf4 is required for Nanog activation during reprogramming initiation. Upstream position in the pluripotency cascade.
description_zh_TW: Klf4 在重編程起始期間為 Nanog 活化所需。在多能性級聯的上游位置。

label: RRM1
description: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM1 provides the large catalytic (alpha) subunit carrying the active site and the allosteric specificity/activity sites. RRM1 assembles with either the RRM2 or RRM2B small subunit to form the active holoenzyme.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM1 提供大型催化（alpha）次單元，帶有活性位點以及別構特異性/活性位點。RRM1 與 RRM2 或 RRM2B 小次單元組裝形成活性全酶。

label: Hemostatics
description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine is a hemostatic agent formed by reacting aminoguanidine with adrenochrome, an unstable ortho-quinoid intermediate. Along with carbazochrome, it is one of the hydrazine derivatives of adrenochrome that serve as useful medicines with hemostatic activity. In the patented process, stabilization with aminoguanidine is carried out at pH 2 to 5, and the purified compound shows characteristic ultraviolet absorption maxima at 348 nm and 445 nm that confirm its identity. The product is isolated by filtration, washed and dried to a powder, and may be further purified by active carbon treatment and recrystallization.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅單胺基胍是由胺基胍與腎上腺紅（一種不穩定的鄰醌式中間體）反應形成的止血劑。與carbazochrome一起，它是腎上腺紅的肼衍生物之一，可作為具有止血活性的實用藥物。在該專利方法中，以胺基胍進行穩定化的操作在pH 2至5下進行，純化後的化合物呈現348 nm和445 nm的特徵紫外線吸收極大值，確認其身份。產物經過濾分離、洗滌並乾燥成粉末，並可進一步經活性碳處理和重結晶純化。

label: Eumelanin
description: Tyrosinase is the rate-limiting enzyme of eumelanin biosynthesis, paralleling the dopachrome tautomerase produces Eumelanin edge. Enzymatic oxidation initiates dark-pigment polymerization.
description_zh_TW: Tyrosinase 是 eumelanin 生物合成的限速酶，與 dopachrome tautomerase 產生 Eumelanin 邊平行。酶促氧化啟動深色素聚合。

label: NMRK1
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NR prevented nuclear condensation and axonal degeneration in neurons of Nmrk2-KO mice by inducing Nmrk1, which suggests that Nmrk1 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 1) might be the key mediator of the neuroprotective activity of nicotinamide riboside (NR). Two possible mechanisms of neuroprotection have been proposed: increasing mitochondrial NAD+ to support SIRT3 and preserving axonal NAD+ to supply damage-induced SARM1 activation. NMRK1 is expressed ubiquitously and converts NR to NMN in the salvage pathway for NAD+ synthesis. This neuroprotective role of NMRK1 supports the potential use of NR against excitotoxicity-induced axonal degeneration and neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: NR 透過誘導 Nmrk1 預防了 Nmrk2-KO 小鼠神經元的核濃縮與軸突退化，這顯示 Nmrk1（nicotinamide ribose kinase 1，菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 1）可能是 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）神經保護活性的關鍵介導者。已提出兩種可能的神經保護機制：提升粒線體 NAD+ 以支持 SIRT3，以及保留軸突 NAD+ 以供應損傷誘發的 SARM1 活化。NMRK1 廣泛表現，並在 NAD+ 合成的回收路徑中將 NR 轉化為 NMN。NMRK1 的此一神經保護角色支持了 NR 用於對抗興奮毒性誘發的軸突退化與神經退化的潛在用途。

label: Metabolism
description: Akkermansia is a genus of gut bacteria, notably A. muciniphila, associated with gut health, metabolic homeostasis, and longevity. Its presence supports metabolic balance and is linked to improved glucose and lipid handling.
description_zh_TW: Akkermansia 是腸道細菌的一個屬，尤以 A. muciniphila 與腸道健康、代謝恆定及長壽相關。其存在有助於代謝平衡，並與改善葡萄糖與脂質處理有關。

label: H3K18ac
description: H3K18ac is often co-deposited with other enhancer acetyl marks including H3K27ac at active regulatory elements. Both are enriched together with H3K4me1 at senescence-activated super-enhancers that drive SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: H3K18ac 常與包括 H3K27ac 在內的其他增強子乙醯標記在活性調控元件上共同沉積。兩者皆與 H3K4me1 一起富集於驅動 SASP 表現的衰老活化超級增強子。

label: CDKN1B
description: CDKN1B-encoded p27 inhibits CDK complexes including cyclin E/D assemblies. This inhibition enforces reversible arrest in quiescence and differentiation.
description_zh_TW: CDKN1B 編碼的 p27 抑制包括 cyclin E/D 複合體的 CDK 複合體。此抑制在靜止與分化中執行可逆停滯。

label: Navitoclax
description: Navitoclax inhibits BCL-2 and BCL-XL to push SCAP-dependent senescent cells into apoptosis. Inhibition is the senolytic mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Navitoclax 抑制 BCL-2 與 BCL-XL 以將 SCAP 依賴的衰老細胞推入凋亡。抑制是 senolytic 機制。

label: Nutlins
description: Cancer is treated by Nutlins. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. The directionality runs from Nutlins toward Cancer, so Nutlins is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由 Nutlins 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。方向性從 Nutlins 朝向 Cancer，因此 Nutlins 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: MAO
description: Graph node-analysis: MAO (degree 2, k-core 2) reaches Dopamine only through Epinephrine (no direct edge), with ~3–4× larger commute distance and near-null resistance z (Dopamine z = −0.70) — a peripheral metabolic spoke versus COMT's hub status.
description_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：MAO（degree 2、k-core 2）僅能透過 Epinephrine 到達 Dopamine（無直接邊），通勤距離約大 3–4 倍且阻力 z 近於零（Dopamine z = −0.70）——相對於 COMT 的樞紐地位，它是周邊的代謝輻條。

label: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine
description: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。

label: Adrenolutin
description: Adrenolutin forms covalent glutathione adducts about tenfold slower than adrenochrome. Reaction records the attenuated thiol reactivity.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺素的光學異構體以約慢十倍的速率形成穀胱甘肽共價加合物。反應記錄減弱的硫醇反應性。

label: Nutlin 3a
description: Nutlin 3a suppresses the pro-inflammatory SASP by inhibiting MDM2, the E3 ligase that marks p53 for degradation, thereby stabilizing the tumor suppressor; stabilized p53 in turn restrains NF-kB-driven expression of SASP cytokines and chemokines. This mechanism exploits the natural tumor-suppressive rheostat of p53 rather than broadly blocking inflammation, and it is consistent with the observation that loss of p53 dramatically amplifies secretome output. The compound is primarily a research tool with limited clinical development, which constrains its translational confidence, but mechanistically its SASP-suppressive action is well grounded in p53's restraint of the inflammatory secretome.
description_zh_TW: Nutlin 3a 透過抑制 MDM2（標記 p53 降解的 E3 連接酶）而穩定腫瘤抑制因子，從而抑制促發炎性 SASP；穩定的 p53 反過來抑制 NF-κB 驅動的 SASP 細胞激素與趨化因子表現。此機制利用 p53 天然的腫瘤抑制變阻器，而非廣泛阻斷發炎，且與 p53 缺失大幅放大分泌組輸出的觀察一致。此化合物主要是研究工具、臨床開發有限，限制了其轉譯信度，但在機制上其 SASP 抑制作用是立基於 p53 對發炎分泌組的抑制。

label: Leucine
description: Leucine is a potent activator of the master nutrient sensor mTORC1 and stimulates skeletal muscle anabolism. Leucine signals to mTORC1 in specific neurons by binding to and activating a voltage-gated calcium channel (Cav3.1). In humans, leucine supplementation increases muscle protein synthesis but does not improve muscle function, and its effects on fat mass are mixed. Leucine's cardiovascular effects are divergent: some studies show supplementation accelerates atherosclerotic plaque progression in an mTORC1-dependent manner and its metabolite isovaleric acid accelerates atrial fibrillation, while others report improved vascular function. Notably, leucine supplementation does not extend mouse lifespan, suggesting changes in leucine are unlikely to be responsible for protein restriction benefits.
description_zh_TW: 白胺酸是主要營養感測器 mTORC1 的強效活化劑，並刺激骨骼肌合成代謝。白胺酸在特定神經元中透過結合並活化電壓依賴性鈣通道（Cav3.1）向 mTORC1 傳遞訊號。在人體中，白胺酸補充增加肌肉蛋白質合成，但不會改善肌肉功能，其對脂肪量的影響則好壞參半。白胺酸的心血管效應存在分歧：一些研究顯示補充會以 mTORC1 依賴方式加速動脈粥狀硬化斑塊進展，其代謝物異戊酸會加速心房顫動，而其他研究則報導血管功能改善。值得注意的是，白胺酸補充不會延長小鼠壽命，顯示白胺酸的改變不太可能是蛋白質限制益處的原因。

label: Age-Related Diseases
description: Anti-aging drugs extend healthspan and are most effective before overt diseases cause organ damage and loss of function, so rapamycin is most effective when administered at the pre-disease or even pre-pre-disease stages of age-related diseases. It delays the onset of age-related diseases, which are manifestations of aging, and although rapamycin may reverse some manifestations of aging, it is more effective at slowing aging than reversing it. Rapalogs may slow atherosclerosis, preventing myocardial infarction, but are unlikely to help reverse an infarction, and rapamycin may be useful for osteoporosis though not for a broken hip after an osteoporotic fracture.
description_zh_TW: 抗衰老藥物延長健康壽命，並在明顯疾病導致器官損傷和功能喪失之前最有效，因此rapamycin在年齡相關疾病的疾病前期甚至疾病前期前期階段給藥時最有效。它延遲年齡相關疾病的發病，這些疾病是老化的表現，雖然rapamycin可能逆轉一些老化的表現，但它在減緩老化方面比逆轉更有效。rapalogs可能減緩動脈粥樣硬化，預防心肌梗塞，但不太可能幫助逆轉梗塞，rapamycin可能對骨質疏鬆症有用，但對骨質疏鬆性骨折後的髖部骨折無效。

label: o-quinone
description: Adrenochrome is very unstable due to its ortho-quinoid (o-quinone) structure, and is therefore usually stabilized by conventional derivatization with hydrazines such as aminoguanidine and semicarbazide to form hemostatic medicines. This instability also means that during the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline, the produced adrenochrome may be further oxidized and decompose to black by-products, so the reaction is monitored by sampling and measuring the absorbance at 495 nm, which is stopped at the point of maximum yield.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅因其鄰醌式（o-quinone）結構而極不穩定，因此通常透過與胺基胍和氨基硫脲等肼類的常規衍生化來穩定，以形成止血藥物。此不穩定性也意味著在腎上腺素的過硫酸鹽氧化過程中，生成的腎上腺紅可能進一步氧化並分解為黑色副產物，因此反應透過取樣並測量495 nm的吸光度來監控，並在產率最大時停止。

label: H2A.J
description: H2A.J is a vertebrate-specific H2A variant induced in senescent cells and at sites of persistent DNA damage, where it promotes an inflammatory gene-expression program. In radiation-induced senescence it decorates chronic damage foci and triggers the secretory phenotype.
description_zh_TW: H2A.J 是脊椎動物特異的 H2A 變異體，在衰老細胞與持續 DNA 損傷位點被誘導，並促進發炎基因表現程式。在輻射誘導衰老中它裝飾慢性損傷焦點並觸發分泌表現型。

label: Glutamate
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Glutamate dehydrogenase catalyzes the reversible oxidative deamination of L-glutamate to alpha-ketoglutarate, providing carbon intermediates for the TCA cycle and ATP production. In the brain it buffers neurotransmitter glutamate and guards against excitotoxicity, and in pancreatic beta-cells it provides an amino-acid-sensing branch of insulin secretion.
description_zh_TW: 穀氨酸脫氫酶催化 L-穀氨酸可逆地氧化脫氨為 α-酮戊二酸，為 TCA 循環和 ATP 產生提供碳中間體。在大腦中它緩衝神經傳遞物質穀氨酸並防止興奮性毒性，在胰腺 β 細胞中則提供胺基酸感應的胰島素分泌分支。

label: Lin28
description: ZCCHC11 is recruited to pre-let-7 by Lin28 for uridylation.
description_zh_TW: ZCCHC11 被 Lin28 招募至 pre-let-7 進行尿苷化。

label: ADAM10
description: SIRT1 induces expression of ADAM10, the principal alpha-secretase that cleaves APP away from amyloidogenic beta-secretase (BACE1) processing, reducing beta-amyloid production; this underlies SIRT1's protective role in Alzheimer's disease models. Directionally, SIRT1 upregulates ADAM10 to promote non-amyloidogenic APP processing. By shifting APP cleavage away from the amyloidogenic pathway, SIRT1 reduces the production of toxic beta-amyloid peptides. This mechanism, together with SIRT1's anti-inflammatory and antioxidant actions, underlies its protection in Alzheimer's models and supports the idea that sirtuin activation could delay amyloid pathology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1誘導ADAM10的表達，ADAM10是主要的α-分泌酶，將APP從澱粉樣β-分泌酶（BACE1）加工途径中切割，減少β-澱粉蛋白的產生；這構成了SIRT1在阿茲海默症模型中保護作用的基礎。方向上，SIRT1上調ADAM10以促進非澱粉樣的APP加工。透過將APP切割從澱粉樣途径轉移，SIRT1減少了有毒β-澱粉蛋白肽的產生。此機制加上SIRT1的抗發炎和抗氧化作用，構成了其在阿茲海默模型中的保護基礎，並支持sirtuin活化可能延緩澱粉樣病理的觀點。

label: Puma
description: FOXO transactivates PUMA independently of p53 after PI3K/Akt inhibition.
description_zh_TW: FOXO 在 PI3K/Akt 抑制後不依賴 p53 轉活化 PUMA。

label: JNK2
description: JNK2 is a stress-activated MAPK family member.
description_zh_TW: JNK2 是壓力活化的 MAPK 家族成員。

label: IRAK4
description: The myddosome nucleated by MyD88 death domains first recruits the kinase IRAK4, initiating scaffold assembly after IL-1R/TLR engagement. IRAK4 then phosphorylates IRAK1 to propagate signaling toward TRAF6 and TAK1.
description_zh_TW: 由 MyD88 death 域成核的 myddosome 首先招募激酶 IRAK4，在 IL-1R/TLR 結合後啟動支架組裝。IRAK4 隨後磷酸化 IRAK1，向 TRAF6 與 TAK1 傳播訊號。

label: c-ABL
description: c-ABL phosphorylates caspase-9 at Tyr153, promoting autocleavage in DNA-damage apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: c-ABL 在 Tyr153 磷酸化 caspase-9，在 DNA 損傷凋亡促進自我切割。

label: JAK-STAT Signaling
description: IL-6R activates JAK-STAT signalling after assembling with gp130: receptor-associated JAK kinases phosphorylate gp130 tyrosines, recruiting and activating STAT3 (and STAT1), which dimerise and translocate to the nucleus. In senescence, JAK-STAT activation downstream of IL-6R promotes SASP gene expression, and JAK inhibition with ruxolitinib suppresses the secretome without clearing senescent cells, establishing this arm as a validated senomorphic target. The scheme draws IL-6R feeding JAK and STAT, with STAT reaching the nuclear transcription-factor tier.
description_zh_TW: IL-6R 與 gp130 組裝後活化 JAK-STAT 訊號：與受體結合的 JAK 激酶磷酸化 gp130 酪胺酸，招募並活化 STAT3（及 STAT1），使其二聚化並入核。在衰老中，IL-6R 下游的 JAK-STAT 活化促進 SASP 基因表現，而 ruxolitinib 抑制 JAK 可壓制 secretome 而不清除衰老細胞，確立此臂為經驗證的 senomorphic 靶點。圖中顯示 IL-6R 供應 JAK 與 STAT，STAT 並到達細胞核轉錄因子層。

label: Senomorphics
description: Senotherapeutics encompass senomorphics as the SASP-suppressing arm of the anti-senescence strategy, complementary to senolytics. Senomorphics modulate rather than remove senescent cells, preserving beneficial acute senescence, and their inclusion under the senotherapeutic umbrella highlights the diversity of mechanisms (mTOR, NF-kB, JAK-STAT, BET, sirtuins). The term thus unifies elimination- and modulation-based approaches within a single conceptual framework. This classification supports the rational design and comparison of anti-aging interventions.
description_zh_TW: Senotherapeutics 涵蓋 senomorphics 作為抗衰老策略中抑制 SASP 的臂，與 senolytics 互補。Senomorphics 調節而非移除衰老細胞，保留有益的急性衰老，其納入於 senotherapeutic 傘下凸顯機制的多樣性（mTOR、NF-κB、JAK-STAT、BET、sirtuins）。此詞因此將消除與調節為本的途徑統一於單一概念框架。此分類支持抗老化介入的合理設計與比較。

label: SmgGDS
description: Estradiol induces SmgGDS (RAP1GDS1) in the female heart, where it restrains ferritinophagy-mediated ferroptosis and contributes to cardiac protection.
description_zh_TW: Estradiol 在雌性心臟誘導 SmgGDS（RAP1GDS1），抑制 ferritinophagy 介導的 ferroptosis，參與心臟保護。

label: Succinate Dehydrogenase
description: Itaconate is a competitive succinate dehydrogenase inhibitor limiting succinate oxidation and mitochondrial ROS. Inhibition rewires the tricarboxylic acid cycle of inflammatory macrophages.
description_zh_TW: Itaconate 是競爭性 succinate dehydrogenase 抑制劑，限制琥珀酸氧化與粒線體 ROS。抑制重接發炎巨噬細胞的三羧酸循環。

label: mtDNA
description: Cytosolic mtDNA released through BAX/BAK miMOMP pores binds cGAS, which synthesizes cGAMP to activate STING; this cGAS-STING axis is the dominant transcriptional driver of IL-6/IL-8/IL-1beta and interferon SASP factors.
description_zh_TW: 經 BAX/BAK miMOMP 孔釋放到胞質的 mtDNA 結合 cGAS，合成 cGAMP 以活化 STING；此 cGAS-STING 軸是 IL-6/IL-8/IL-1beta 與干擾素 SASP 因子的主要轉錄驅動者。

label: Caspase-12
description: Caspase-12 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-12 is an ER-localized protease that mediates apoptotic signaling arising specifically from endoplasmic-reticulum stress. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-12, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-12 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-12 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-12 是一種內質網定位的蛋白酶，可介導由內質網壓力引起的細胞凋亡訊號傳導。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-12，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-12 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Glucose
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Hexokinase 2 catalyzes the first rate-limiting glycolytic step, glucose to glucose-6-phosphate.
description_zh_TW: Hexokinase 2 催化第一個速率限制糖解步驟，葡萄糖至葡萄糖-6-磷酸。

label: Sodium Potassium ATPase
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Silver ion directly inhibits the sodium potassium pump, disrupting ion homeostasis. Inhibition breaks cellular electrochemical gradients.
description_zh_TW: 銀離子直接抑制鈉鉀泵，破壞離子恆定。抑制打破細胞電化學梯度。

label: PTEN
description: PTEN is the main phosphatase that indirectly inactivates PI3K in the mTOR-PI3K signaling cascade, providing the antagonistic deactivating arm that balances PI3K activation. Alongside PP2A, which counteracts the effect of mTORC1 in the activation of S6K1/2, PTEN is one of the two key phosphatases modeled as kinase-phosphatase opposing pairs. The balance between activating and deactivating reactions at key nodes, such as the positive correlation between activation and deactivation of mTORC2, is consistent with the requirement for opposite reactions to underlie biphasic dose-responses.
description_zh_TW: PTEN是mTOR-PI3K訊號級聯中主要的磷酸酶，間接使PI3K失活，提供平衡PI3K活化的拮抗性失活臂。與抵消mTORC1對S6K1/2活化影響的PP2A一起，PTEN是兩個關鍵磷酸酶之一，被建模為激酶-磷酸酶對抗對。關鍵節點上活化和失活反應之間的平衡，例如mTORC2活化和失活之間的正相關，與相反反應作為雙相劑量反應基礎的要求一致。

label: Glutaminolysis
source_file: _document_ - Complex I drives glutamine-dependent TCA cycle to support viability of MYChigh breast cancer cells (NAD+).md
description: MYC rewires TCA carbon dependence toward glutamine catabolism.
description_zh_TW: MYC 將 TCA 碳依賴重接往麩醯胺酸分解。

label: T Cell
description: The SASP recruits T cells along with macrophages, natural killer cells, and neutrophils to the tissue microenvironment. This immune-cell recruitment is beneficial for limiting tumorigenesis by promoting immune clearance of senescent cells. However, excessive SASP factors can also suppress clearance by impairing macrophage phagocytosis.
description_zh_TW: SASP 招募 T cells，以及巨噬細胞、自然殺手細胞與嗜中性球至組織微環境。這種免疫細胞招募透過促進衰老細胞的免疫清除，有利於限制腫瘤發生。然而，過量的 SASP 因子也可能透過損害巨噬細胞吞噬作用來抑制清除。

label: S-adenosylmethionine
description: Methionine is the precursor of S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAMe), the universal methyl donor used in methylation reactions throughout the body, including DNA and histone methylation. Dietary methionine deprivation may therefore impact physiology through changes in histone methylation resulting from decreased availability of methyl donors, providing a direct mechanistic link between dietary amino acid intake and the epigenome. Cells can preserve heterochromatic stability through upregulation of H3K9 methylation in the liver in response to methionine restriction. This methyl-donor pathway is a core mechanism by which methionine restriction recapitulates the benefits of protein restriction on metabolic health, frailty, and lifespan.
description_zh_TW: Methionine是S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAMe)的前體，SAMe是全身甲基化反應中使用的通用甲基供體，包括DNA和組蛋白甲基化。因此，飲食中methionine缺乏可能通過甲基供體可用性減少導致的組蛋白甲基化變化來影響生理功能，提供飲食氨基酸攝入與表觀基因組之間的直接機制聯繫。細胞可以通過在肝臟中上調H3K9甲基化來應對methionine限制，從而保持異染色質穩定性。這種甲基供體路徑是methionine限制重現蛋白質限制對代謝健康、虛弱和壽命益處的核心機制。

label: CDKN2A
description: The CDKN2A locus encodes p16INK4A, the INK4 CDK inhibitor that enforces Rb-dependent arrest. Derepression of this locus via loss of Polycomb H3K27me3 is a hallmark of senescence entry.
description_zh_TW: CDKN2A 基因座編碼 p16INK4A，即執行 Rb 依賴停滯的 INK4 CDK 抑制因子。經由喪失 Polycomb H3K27me3 去抑制此基因座是衰老進入的標誌。

label: calcineurin
description: Lysosomal calcium through MCOLN1 activates calcineurin to dephosphorylate TFEB for nuclear translocation. Activation is the calcium route.
description_zh_TW: 經由 MCOLN1 的溶酶體鈣活化鈣調磷酸酶，去磷酸化 TFEB 以核轉位。活化是鈣路徑。

label: GLUT1
description: GLUT1 is the facilitative uniporter mediating tumor glucose uptake and FDG-PET signal.
description_zh_TW: GLUT1 是介導腫瘤葡萄糖攝取與 FDG-PET 訊號的易化單向轉運體。

label: Replicative Senescence
description: Progressive telomere shortening to critical length triggers replicative senescence at the Hayflick limit. The end-replication problem is the causal mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 漸進性端粒縮短至關鍵長度在 Hayflick 極限觸發複製性衰老。末端複製問題是因果機制。

label: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide
description: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide is a potent oxidant tool compound for stress studies.
description_zh_TW: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide 是壓力研究的強效氧化劑工具化合物。

label: Brown Adipose Tissue
description: SIRT6 supports thermogenesis in brown and beige adipose tissue, which is induced under cold exposure, thereby contributing to energy expenditure and protection from obesity. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of thermogenic gene programs in brown adipose tissue. This pro-thermogenic role opposes SIRT7, which suppresses brown-adipose function, illustrating opposing actions within the sirtuin family on energy expenditure. By maintaining the capacity of brown and beige fat to burn calories, SIRT6 helps the body dissipate energy as heat rather than store it. Supporting SIRT6 activity is therefore considered a potential approach for counteracting weight gain and metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6支持棕色和米色脂肪組織中的生熱作用，該作用在冷暴露下被誘導，從而有助於能量消耗和對抗肥胖。方向上，SIRT6位於棕色脂肪組織中生熱基因程序的上游。此促生熱作用與抑制棕色脂肪功能的SIRT7相對抗，說明了sirtuin家族在能量消耗方面的對立作用。透過維持棕色和米色脂肪燃燒卡路里的能力，SIRT6幫助身體將能量以熱量形式散失而非儲存。因此支持SIRT6活性被認為是對抗體重增加和代謝疾病的潛在方法。

label: Protein Carbonylation
description: Aminochrome quinone alkylation promotes carbonyl load on proteins. Contribution places aminochrome chemistry in oxidative protein damage.
description_zh_TW: 胺色素醌烷基化促進蛋白質羰基負荷。貢獻將胺色素化學置於氧化蛋白損傷。

label: GCN2
description: Protein restriction activates GCN2, an evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase triggered by amino acid restriction through uncharged tRNAs as well as by ribosome stalling and collision. Activated GCN2 phosphorylates eIF2alpha, suppressing global protein synthesis while selectively promoting translation of ATF4, a key activator of stress response and autophagy genes. Drosophila lacking Gcn2 die when amino acids are restricted, and deletion of Gcn2 in yeast blocks dietary restriction lifespan extension, while overexpression extends lifespan. During PR, GCN2 is initially required for FGF21 induction and also activates hepatic gluconeogenesis in response to decreased amino acid availability.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制活化GCN2，這是一個 evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase，由胺基酸限制透過未充電的tRNAs以及核糖體停滯和碰撞觸發。活化的GCN2磷酸化eIF2alpha，抑制整體蛋白質合成，同時選擇性促進ATF4的翻譯，ATF4是壓力反應和自噬基因的關鍵活化因子。缺乏Gcn2的黑腹果蠅在胺基酸限制時死亡，酵母中Gcn2的缺失阻斷飲食限制壽命延長，而過表達則延長壽命。在PR期間，GCN2最初對FGF21誘導是必需的，並在胺基酸可用性降低時激活肝臟糖質新生。

label: Bromodeoxyuridine
description: Bromodeoxyuridine is a thymidine analog in the nucleoside-analog class with Gemcitabine and CPEC. Same antimetabolite family, tracer application.
description_zh_TW: Bromodeoxyuridine 是與 Gemcitabine 和 CPEC 同屬核苷類似物類別的胸苷類似物。相同抗代謝家族，追蹤應用。

label: Regenerative Medicine
description: Stem-cell research underpins development, disease modeling and drug screening for repair.
description_zh_TW: 幹細胞研究支撐修復的發育、疾病建模與藥物篩選。

label: Rapalogs
description: Rapalogs are analogs of rapamycin that inhibit mTORC1 by binding the FKBP12-FRB interface of the mTOR kinase. They share rapamycin's core pharmacology, including mTORC1 inhibition, autophagy induction, and lifespan effects.
description_zh_TW: Rapalog 是 rapamycin 的類似物，透過結合 mTOR 激酶的 FKBP12-FRB 介面抑制 mTORC1。它們共享 rapamycin 的核心藥理學，包括 mTORC1 抑制、自噬誘導與壽命效應。

label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
description: Citrullinated peptides are anti-citrullinated protein antibody autoantigens, the hallmark of rheumatoid arthritis. Autoantigen generation defines the disease link.
description_zh_TW: 瓜氨酸化肽是抗瓜氨酸蛋白抗體自身抗原，即類風濕關節炎的標誌。自身抗原生成定義疾病連結。

label: MYCN
description: MYCN is a canonically amplified oncogene driving neuroblastoma. Classification places it with MYC-family transforming genes.
description_zh_TW: MYCN 是驅動神經母細胞瘤的典型擴增致癌基因。歸類將它與 MYC 家族轉化基因並列。

label: Respiratory Chain Complex I
description: Literature adjudication (Genova et al. 2006, PMID 16487923; Bindoli et al. 1990): Complex I reduces adrenochrome to its semiquinone, which auto-oxidizes to superoxide — a redox cycle that amplifies ROS. Adrenochrome is therefore an electron acceptor at Complex I ('redox_cycles_at', conf 0.9).
description_zh_TW: 文獻裁決（Genova et al. 2006, PMID 16487923；Bindoli et al. 1990）：Complex I 把 adrenochrome 還原成半醌，半醌自氧化成超氧化物——一個放大 ROS 的氧化還原循環。因此 adrenochrome 是 Complex I 的電子受體（「redox_cycles_at」，conf 0.9）。

label: TGFβ Superfamily
description: TGF-beta3 is a ligand isoform of the TGF-beta superfamily.
description_zh_TW: TGF-β3 是 TGF-β 超家族的配體亞型。

label: MAPKAPK2
source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md
description: p38 MAPK phosphorylates and activates MAPKAPK2 (MK2), making MK2 the principal effector through which p38 controls the stability of labile inflammatory transcripts. Active MK2 phosphorylates RNA-binding decay factors such as ZFP36L1/TTP, preventing them from recruiting deadenylation machinery to AU-rich elements in SASP mRNAs. The consequence is post-transcriptional prolongation of cytokine and chemokine transcripts, a control layer distinct from transcription-factor-driven expression. In the SASP-induction scheme the p38 to MK2 connection is drawn explicitly, separating transcriptional from post-transcriptional regulation of the secretome.
description_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 磷酸化並活化 MAPKAPK2（MK2），使 MK2 成為 p38 控制不穩定發炎轉錄本穩定性的主要效應者。活化的 MK2 磷酸化 ZFP36L1/TTP 等 RNA 結合衰變因子，阻止其招募去腺苷酸化機制至 SASP mRNA 的 AU-rich 元件。結果是細胞激素與趨化激素轉錄本的轉錄後延長，此調控層不同於轉錄因子驅動的表現。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，p38 至 MK2 的連結被明確畫出，區分了 secretome 的轉錄與轉錄後調控。

label: Thermogenesis
description: Proton leak dissipates the mitochondrial gradient as heat, the mechanistic basis of brown-fat thermogenesis. Uncoupling converts respiratory energy to warmth.
description_zh_TW: 質子漏以熱耗散粒線體梯度，是棕色脂肪產熱的機制基礎。去偶聯將呼吸能量轉為熱。

label: Transposable Elements
description: Repeat silencing keeps transposable elements immobile.
description_zh_TW: 重複序列沉默使轉座元件保持不動。

label: Electrophile
description: Dopaminochrome carries the alpha,beta-unsaturated indoline-5,6-dione Michael-acceptor motif shared with adrenochrome. Classification groups the quinoid electrophiles.
description_zh_TW: 多巴胺色素帶有與腎上腺素共享的 α,β-不飽和吲哚醌 Michael 受體基序。歸類統合醌型親電子劑。

label: H3K36me3
description: H3K36me3 is a gene-body trimethyl mark deposited co-transcriptionally by SETD2 and removed by KDM4 (JMJD2) JmjC demethylases. Its dynamics regulate transcribed gene bodies including SASP loci.
description_zh_TW: H3K36me3 是由 SETD2 共轉錄沉積、由 KDM4（JMJD2）JmjC 去甲基酶移除的基因體三甲基標記。其動態調控包括 SASP 基因座在內的轉錄基因體。

label: Flavone
description: Luteolin is a naturally occurring flavone, a subclass of flavonoids, with the chemical structure 3',4',5,7-tetrahydroxyflavone. It is abundant in parsley, celery, broccoli, green peppers, thyme, and chamomile. It is among the most studied dietary polyphenols for anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective activities.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 是天然存在的黃酮（flavone），是 Flavonoids 的一個亞類，化學結構為 3',4',5,7-四羥基黃酮。它大量存在於歐芹、芹菜、綠花椰菜、青椒、百里香和洋甘菊中。它是研究最多的膳食多酚之一，具有抗發炎和神經保護活性。

label: YAP1
description: Node-analysis of the repurposing cluster lists Ivermectin's out-star broadcasting into signaling suppression — Akt, mTOR, Wnt, YAP1, STAT3, NF-kappaB, PAK1 — alongside cell-death induction, resistance reversal and stemness suppression; YAP1 is among the Hippo-pathway targets (conf 0.7).
description_zh_TW: 重新定位簇的節點分析把 Ivermectin 的出向之星列為廣播到訊號抑制——Akt、mTOR、Wnt、YAP1、STAT3、NF-kappaB、PAK1——同時包含細胞死亡誘發、抗藥性反轉與幹性抑制；YAP1 是 Hippo 路徑標靶之一（conf 0.7）。

label: miR-101
description: miR-101 directly targets anti-apoptotic Mcl-1.
description_zh_TW: miR-101 直接標靶抗凋亡 Mcl-1。

label: dNTP
