description: Ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) is the only enzyme that catalyzes the de novo conversion of ribonucleoside diphosphates (NDPs) into deoxyribonucleoside diphosphates (dNDPs), the immediate precursors of the dNTPs required for DNA replication and repair. It is the rate-limiting, allosterically regulated committed step of de novo dNTP synthesis.
description_zh_TW: 核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）是唯一能催化核醣核苷二磷酸（NDP）de novo 轉化為去氧核醣核苷二磷酸（dNDP）的酵素，dNDP 是 DNA 複製與修復所需 dNTP 的直接前驅物。它是 de novo dNTP 合成中受別構調控、速率限制的承諾步驟。

label: TRADD
description: TRADD is recruited by ligated TNFR1, placing the adaptor downstream of the receptor.
description_zh_TW: TRADD 被結合的 TNFR1 招募，將銜接蛋白置於受體下游。

label: SARM1
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: SARM1 is the NAD+-consuming executor of programmed axonal destruction downstream of injury and stress. Its activation depletes axonal NAD+ and drives fragmentation.
description_zh_TW: SARM1 是損傷與壓力下游程序性軸突破壞的 NAD+ 消耗執行者。其活化耗竭軸突 NAD+ 並驅動片段化。

label: Bmf
description: Bmf activates Bak. Bmf is a cytoskeleton-sequestered BH3-only protein that enforces anoikis and restrains dissemination of detached cells. Bak is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector anchored at the mitochondrial outer membrane that cooperates with Bax to execute MOMP. The relationship is directional, with Bmf acting as the operative agent upon Bak rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Bmf 活化 Bak。 Bmf 是一種細胞骨架隔離的 BH3 蛋白，可增強失巢凋亡並抑制脫落細胞的傳播。 Bak 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，錨定在粒線體外膜上，與 Bax 合作執行 MOMP。這種關係是有方向的，Bmf 充當 Bak 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: RSK
description: RSK is the canonical ERK effector kinase transducing MAPK output to survival and death substrates.
description_zh_TW: RSK 是典型的 ERK 效應激酶，將 MAPK 輸出傳遞至存活與死亡受質。

label: Tissue Engineering
description: Engineered constructs augment endogenous healing of damaged tissue.
description_zh_TW: 工程化構建體增強受損組織的內源癒合。

label: Cysteine
description: During pheomelanogenesis the amino acid Cysteine adds to dopaquinone, forming cysteinyldopas that cyclize and oxidize into benzothiazine intermediates. Sulfur incorporation during pigment polymerization depends on cysteine and glutathione present in dopamine neurons. Cysteine thus acts as the sulfur donor that enables benzothiazine formation.
description_zh_TW: 在 pheomelanogenesis 過程中，胺基酸 Cysteine 與 dopaquinone 結合，形成 cysteinyldopas，後者環化並氧化成 benzothiazine 中間體。色素聚合過程中硫的摻入取決於多巴胺神經元中存在的 cysteine 和 glutathione。因此 Cysteine 充當使 benzothiazine 形成成為可能的硫供體。

label: COMT Inhibitors
description: COMT inhibitors such as entacapone, tolcapone, and opicapone block catechol-O-methyltransferase, one of the principal enzymes that degrades catecholamines by methylation. Inhibiting COMT therefore increases synaptic and circulating levels of dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine, and this is exploited clinically in Parkinson's disease, often combined with MAO inhibitors and levodopa, to prolong dopaminergic effects and reduce off time. The resulting higher catecholamine levels, together with inhibition of MAO-mediated clearance, provide more substrate for oxidative conversion to adrenochrome, though this effect is mostly theoretical in clinical use and benefits are generally judged to outweigh risks.
description_zh_TW: COMT 抑制劑如 entacapone、tolcapone 與 opicapone 阻斷 catechol-O-methyltransferase，這是透過甲基化降解兒茶酚胺的主要酶之一。因此，抑制 COMT 會升高多巴胺、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 的突觸與循環濃度，這在臨床上用於帕金森氏症，常與 MAO 抑制劑及 levodopa 併用以延長多巴胺能效應並減少 off time。所導致的較高兒茶酚胺濃度，加上 MAO 介導清除的抑制，提供了更多氧化轉化為 adrenochrome 的受質，儘管此效應在臨床使用中多屬理論性，且效益通常被認為大於風險。

label: MDM2
description: MDM2 is amplified in Cancer. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward MDM2, so Cancer is the active agent and MDM2 the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
description_zh_TW: MDM2 在 Cancer 中被放大。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 MDM2，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，MDM2 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

label: Superoxide dismutase
description: Superoxide dismutase (SOD), along with catalase and azide, inhibits the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome in experiments with stimulated neutrophils, confirming that reactive oxygen species are responsible for the conversion. SOD specifically scavenges superoxide radicals generated by the neutrophil NADPH oxidase system, and because these radicals drive much of the adrenaline oxidation (over 80% at low micromolar concentrations), removing them blocks adrenochrome formation. This enzyme-based inhibition is key experimental evidence for the ROS-dependent mechanism of neutrophil-mediated adrenochrome production.
description_zh_TW: Superoxide dismutase（SOD）與catalase及azide一同，在stimulated neutrophils的experiments中inhibits adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome，confirming that reactive oxygen species are responsible for the conversion。SOD specifically scavenges由neutrophil NADPH oxidase system生成的superoxide radicals，而由於這些radicals驅動了大部分的adrenaline oxidation（在低micromolar concentrations下超過80%），removing them blocks adrenochrome formation。此enzyme-based inhibition是neutrophil-mediated adrenochrome production的ROS-dependent mechanism的key experimental evidence。

label: Reactive Nitrogen Species
description: Nitrative stress is caused by reactive nitrogen species when RNS production exceeds the capacity of detoxifying and repair systems to neutralize them. The condition reflects an imbalance between nitrating oxidants and endogenous defenses. The directionality is RNS excess to nitrative damage. A caveat is that transient, localized RNS signaling is physiological, so pathology depends on chronic overload or miscompartmentalization. The transition from beneficial to pathological RNS activity hinges on concentration, duration, and the tissue's antioxidant and repair capacity.
description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 是由 reactive nitrogen species 當 RNS 產生超過解毒和修復系統中和它們的能力時引起的。這種情況反映了硝化氧化劑和內源性防禦之間的不平衡。方向性是RNS過量對硝化損傷的影響。需要注意的是，短暫的、局部的 RNS 訊號傳導是生理性的，因此病理學取決於慢性超負荷或錯室化。 RNS 活性從有益到病理的轉變取決於濃度、持續時間以及組織的抗氧化和修復能力。

label: CDK6
description: Apigenin ATP-competitively inhibits CDK6 with the same G1-blockade mechanism as CDK4. Dual inhibition enforces arrest.
description_zh_TW: Apigenin 以與 CDK4 相同的 G1 封鎖機制抑制 CDK6。雙重抑制執行停滯。

label: H3K56ac
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates H3K56ac, contributing to mitotic chromatin organization and genome stability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 H3K56ac，有助於有絲分裂染色質組織和基因組穩定性。

label: carbohydrate metabolism
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 regulates carbohydrate metabolism by deacetylating G6PD (pentose phosphate pathway) and phosphoglycerate mutase (glycolysis) to influence NADPH production and glucose flux, and deacetylates PEPCK to support gluconeogenesis; these actions link SIRT2 to redox balance and metabolic control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化 G6PD（磷酸戊糖途徑）和磷酸甘油酸變位酶（糖酵解）來調節碳水化合物代謝，影響 NADPH 產生和葡萄糖通量；並去乙醯化 PEPCK 以支持糖質新生；這些作用將 SIRT2 與氧化還原平衡和代謝控制聯繫起來。

label: Tenovin-6
description: Tenovin-6 inhibits SIRT2 with an IC50 of 10 μM, making SIRT2 its more potent sirtuin target compared with SIRT1. Directionally, Tenovin-6 blocks SIRT2 catalysis. By inhibiting SIRT2 deacetylation, it can protect neurons and reactivate p53, and it also inhibits SIRT3 with an IC50 of 67 μM, so its effects span multiple sirtuins. It is a chemical probe distinguishing SIRT2 from other sirtuins, and its p53-reactivation activity underlies its anticancer phenotype. The moderate potency and limited selectivity require careful interpretation of Tenovin-6 studies.
description_zh_TW: Tenovin-6 以 IC50 10 μM 抑制 SIRT2，使其成為相較於 SIRT1 更強效的 sirtuin 靶標。在方向性上，Tenovin-6 阻斷 SIRT2 催化作用。透過抑制 SIRT2 去乙醯化，它可以保護神經元並重新活化 p53，同時也以 IC50 67 μM 抑制 SIRT3，因此其效應跨越多個 sirtuin。它是區分 SIRT2 與其他 sirtuin 的化學探針，其 p53 重新活化活性構成了其抗癌表型的基礎。中等效力和有限的選擇性需要謹慎詮釋 Tenovin-6 的研究。

label: Histone H4
description: Under stress the nuclear fraction of SIRT3 deacetylates H4K16 and H3K9, regulating expression of genes involved in mitochondrial biogenesis and metabolism. Directionally, SIRT3 acts enzymatically on chromatin in the nucleus. This reveals a nuclear, chromatin-level face of the otherwise mitochondrial sirtuin, complementing its metabolic roles.
description_zh_TW: 在壓力下，SIRT3 的細胞核部分去乙醯化 H4K16 和 H3K9，調節參與粒線體生成和代謝的基因表現。方向性上 SIRT3 在細胞核中以酵素方式作用於染色質。這揭示了 otherwise 為粒線體 sirtuin 的 SIRT3 的核、染色質層面，補充了其代謝功能。

label: Liver Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
description: SIRT3 is protective in liver ischemia-reperfusion injury: knockout of Takeda G protein-coupled receptor 5 suppresses SIRT3, driving proinflammatory macrophages and exacerbated injury. The protective SIRT1/SIRT3 axis is a targetable balance for organ protection.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 對肝臟缺血再灌注損傷具有保護作用：敲除 Takeda G 蛋白偶聯受體 5 會抑制 SIRT3，驅動促發炎巨噬細胞並加重損傷。保護性的 SIRT1/SIRT3 軸是器官保護的可靶向平衡。

label: Apoptosome
description: Intrinsic Pathway activates Apoptosome. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. The relationship is directional, with Intrinsic Pathway acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosome rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Intrinsic Pathway 啟動Apoptosome。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。這種關係是有方向的，Intrinsic Pathway 充當Apoptosome 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Oblimersen sodium
description: The antisense Oblimersen lowers Bcl-2 protein via RNase-H mRNA cleavage.
description_zh_TW: 反義 Oblimersen 經 RNase-H mRNA 切割降低 Bcl-2 蛋白。

label: Antioxidant Properties
description: Rutin scavenges free radicals, inhibits lipid peroxidation, and strengthens capillaries by supporting collagen cross-linking. It modulates oxidative stress and exhibits anti-inflammatory and mild antiplatelet effects. These actions contribute to cardiovascular protection and its use for vascular integrity.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 清除自由基、抑制脂質過氧化，並透過支持膠原蛋白交聯來強化微血管。它調節 oxidative stress，並表現出抗發炎和輕度抗血小板作用。這些作用有助於心血管保護及其用於血管完整性的用途。

label: Cerulein-Induced Pancreatitis
description: Despite RIPK3- and MLKL-deficiency protecting in the cerulein pancreatitis model, Nec-1 administration worsened histological damage and raised serum lipase/amylase — attributed by the authors to Nec-1's short half-life rather than genuine pathway agonism.
description_zh_TW: 儘管在雨蛙素（cerulein）胰臟炎模型中 RIPK3 與 MLKL 缺失具保護作用，Nec-1 給藥卻惡化組織學損傷並升高血清脂肪酶/澱粉酶——作者歸因於 Nec-1 半衰期過短，而非真正促進該路徑。

label: Selenium
description: Selenium supplementation and dietary intervention dramatically cut Keshan disease incidence. Nutrient repletion removes the deficiency cause.
description_zh_TW: 硒補充與飲食介入大幅削減 Keshan disease 發生率。營養補足移除缺乏病因。

label: Stroke
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) is neuroprotective in rodent models of stroke, reducing infarct volume and preserving neurological function. MB enhances cellular oxygen consumption in vivo and provides protection against hypoxia-induced injury, including in primary hepatocyte cultures. Its mechanism is distinct from conventional antioxidants: by acting as an alternative electron-transfer carrier that bypasses Complexes I-III and by upregulating complex IV activity and expression, MB sustains mitochondrial bioenergetics in ischemic tissue where electron transport is compromised.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在中風的囓齒類模型中具有神經保護作用，減少梗塞體積並保留神經功能。MB在體內增強細胞氧氣消耗，並提供對缺氧誘導損傷的保護，包括在原代肝細胞培養中。其機制與傳統抗氧化劑不同：通過作為繞過複合物I-III的替代電子轉運載體，並通過上調複合物IV活性和表達，MB在電子傳輸受損的缺血組織中維持粒線體生物能量學。

label: Neuromelanin synthesis
description: Adrenochrome, or related aminochromes, can form as an intermediate in neuromelanin synthesis, particularly in dopaminergic neurons such as those of the substantia nigra. In this context, oxidation of catecholamines and their cyclization products feed into the polymerization that produces neuromelanin, a normal physiological pigment. Excess accumulation of these reactive intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in catecholaminergic neurons, and this pathway connects adrenochrome chemistry to neurodegenerative processes involving oxidative stress in the brain.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome, or related aminochromes, can form as an intermediate in neuromelanin synthesis, particularly in dopaminergic neurons such as those of the substantia nigra。In this context, oxidation of catecholamines and their cyclization products feed into the polymerization that produces neuromelanin, a normal physiological pigment。Excess accumulation of these reactive intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in catecholaminergic neurons, and this pathway connects adrenochrome chemistry to neurodegenerative processes involving oxidative stress in the brain。

label: SIR-2.1
description: Worm SIR-2.1 NAD-dependent deacetylase regulates lifespan and stress resistance. Regulation is the aging output.
description_zh_TW: 線蟲 SIR-2.1 NAD 依賴去乙醯酶調節壽命與壓力抗性。調節是老化輸出。

label: Bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Extensive glucuronide conjugation is the primary cause of poor fisetin oral bioavailability and a general polyphenol bottleneck. Conjugation limits systemic exposure.
description_zh_TW: 廣泛的葡萄糖醛酸結合是 fisetin 口服生物利用度差的主因，也是一般多酚瓶頸。結合限制全身暴露。

label: Lysine
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Methylglyoxal modifies lysine to carboxyethyllysine and crosslinks. Modification is the second major AGE route.
description_zh_TW: 甲基乙二醛修飾離胺酸形成羧乙基離胺酸與交聯。修飾是第二主要 AGE 路徑。

label: Gossypol
description: Apoptosis is induced by Gossypol. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. The directionality runs from Gossypol toward Apoptosis, so Gossypol is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 Gossypol 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。方向性從 Gossypol 向 Apoptosis，因此 Gossypol 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: NF-kB
description: Curcumin modulates inflammatory pathways by inhibiting NF-kB signaling. Because turmeric contains only about 3% curcumin with low bioavailability, its in vivo efficacy often requires high doses or formulation strategies such as co-administration with piperine from black pepper.
description_zh_TW: Curcumin 透過抑制 NF-kB 訊號調控發炎路徑。由於薑黃僅含約 3% 的 Curcumin 且生物可利用率低，其在體內的功效常需高劑量或配方策略，例如與黑胡椒中的 piperine 併用。

label: Macrophage Polarization
description: SIRT6 regulates macrophage polarization to alleviate sepsis-induced acute respiratory distress syndrome through both autophagy-dependent and autophagy-independent mechanisms. This positions SIRT6 as a modulator of the M1/M2 inflammatory balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過自噬依賴與非依賴機制調控巨噬細胞極化，以減輕敗血症誘導的急性呼吸窘迫症候群。這使 SIRT6 成為 M1/M2 發炎平衡的調控者。

label: AGE-modified proteins
description: Cathepsin B is a lysosomal cysteine protease that, together with cathepsin D, is a major enzyme responsible for breaking down AGE-modified proteins. Glycated proteins are directed to lysosomes for degradation, and these cathepsins ensure that proteins damaged by non-enzymatic glycation are cleared rather than allowed to accumulate. The activity of such lysosomal proteases declines with age and under UV exposure, which correlates with accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Maintaining lysosomal cathepsin function is therefore important for proteolytic clearance of glycated material and limiting AGE burden.
description_zh_TW: 組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B）是一種溶酶體半胱氨酸蛋白酶，與組織蛋白酶 D 一起是負責分解 AGE 修飾蛋白的主要酵素。糖化蛋白被導向溶酶體進行降解，而這些組織蛋白酶確保因非酵素性糖化而受損的蛋白質被清除而非堆積。此類溶酶體蛋白酶的活性隨年齡增長與紫外線暴露而下降，這與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，維持溶酶體組織蛋白酶功能對於糖化物質的蛋白水解清除與限制 AGE 負擔十分重要。

label: Heart
description: Troponin is a heterotrimeric complex regulating striated muscle contraction, and cardiac troponin I and T are highly cardiac-specific gold-standard biomarkers of myocardial injury. Troponin release from the heart signals myocardial damage.
description_zh_TW: 肌鈣蛋白（troponin）是調控橫紋肌收縮的異三聚體複合體，而心肌肌鈣蛋白 I 與 T 是高度心臟特異的心肌損傷金標準生物標記。心臟釋放的肌鈣蛋白指示心肌損傷。

label: Lamivudine
description: Lamivudine is a representative nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor drug. Classification anchors the member.
description_zh_TW: Lamivudine 是代表性的核苷逆轉錄酶抑制藥物。歸類錨定成員。

label: RAIDD
description: PIDDosome is composed of RAIDD. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. RAIDD (CRADD) is the death-domain/CARD adaptor that bridges PIDD to procaspase-2 within the PIDDosome. The directionality runs from RAIDD toward PIDDosome, so RAIDD is the active agent and PIDDosome the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: PIDDosome 由 RAIDD 組成。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。 RAIDD (CRADD) 是死亡域/CARD 轉接器，將 PIDD 橋接到 PIDDosome 內的 procaspase-2。方向性從 RAIDD 朝向 PIDDosome，因此 RAIDD 是主動主體，PIDDosome 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: UV Light
description: Ultraviolet photochemistry generates reactive oxygen species driving catecholamine oxidation and skin damage. Photon energy converts to oxidant burden.
description_zh_TW: 紫外線光化學產生 reactive oxygen species，驅動兒茶酚胺氧化與皮膚損傷。光子能量轉為氧化劑負荷。

label: Liver Regeneration
description: Mature quiescent hepatocytes are the dominant regenerative source after hepatectomy.
description_zh_TW: 成熟靜止肝細胞是肝切除後的主要再生來源。

label: NMDA receptor
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Glutamate/NMDA-receptor overstimulation in neurons (glutamate excitotoxicity) hyperactivates PARP1 and triggers parthanatos, the neuronal excitotoxic route to the pathway (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: 神經元中麩胺酸/NMDA 受體過度刺激（麩胺酸興奮性毒性）過度活化 PARP1 並觸發 parthanatos，是此路徑的神經興奮性毒性途徑（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: Pericentromeric Satellite Repeats
description: Satellite hypomethylation drives centromere instability in ICF syndrome.
description_zh_TW: 衛星低甲基化在 ICF 症候群驅動著絲粒不穩定。

label: VDAC
description: N-terminal hexokinase 2 tethers to mitochondrial VDAC for preferential ATP access.
description_zh_TW: N 端 Hexokinase 2 繫於粒線體 VDAC 以優先取得 ATP。

label: Glycotoxins
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Exogenous food and smoke glycotoxins raise in-vivo end-product load. Intake adds to the endogenous glycation burden.
description_zh_TW: 外源食物與煙霧 glycotoxins 提高體內終產物負荷。攝入疊加內源糖化負擔。

label: Low-Density Lipoprotein
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Advanced glycation end products damage the cardiovascular system in part by glycating low-density lipoproteins (LDL) on both the apolipoprotein B and phospholipid components of the particle. Glycated LDL is more susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall than non-glycated LDL, and it is not taken up into cells through the normal receptor pathway, so it accumulates in the vessel wall. Macrophage uptake of these modified LDL particles leads to foam cell formation and the development of atheroma. This glycoxidative modification of LDL is thus a direct route through which AGEs promote atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products部分透過對low-density lipoproteins（LDL）顆粒上的apolipoprotein B與phospholipid components進行glycating，來damages the cardiovascular system。Glycated LDL比non-glycated LDL更susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall，且它not taken up into cells through the normal receptor pathway，因此accumulates in the vessel wall。Macrophage uptake of these modified LDL particles leads to foam cell formation與atheroma的development。因此，此glycoxidative modification of LDL是AGEs promote atherosclerosis的direct route。

label: BMAL1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: NAMPT, the rate-limiting NAD+ salvage enzyme, is regulated by the CLOCK:BMAL1 circadian complex, coupling NAD+ biosynthesis and thus sirtuin activity to the daily rhythm. Directionally, the CLOCK/BMAL1 loop drives rhythmic NAMPT and NAD+ levels. This explains the circadian gating of sirtuin-dependent processes and links clock disruption to altered sirtuin activity.
description_zh_TW: NAMPT 是限速的 NAD+ 補救酵素，受 CLOCK:BMAL1 昼夜節律複合物調節，將 NAD+ 生合成從而將 sirtuin 活性與每日節律偶聯。方向性上 CLOCK/BMAL1 迴路驅動節律性的 NAMPT 和 NAD+ 水平。這解釋了 sirtuin 依賴過程的晝夜節律調控，並將時鐘紊亂與 sirtuin 活性改變聯繫起來。

label: Diaziquone
description: Diaziquone is an aziridinylbenzoquinone crosslinker in the alkylator class. Classification by mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Diaziquone 是烷化劑類別中的 aziridinylbenzoquinone 交聯劑。依機制歸類。

label: LGG-1
description: LGG-1 lipidates into the autophagosome membrane as a structural component. Requirement is the membrane-integration dependency.
description_zh_TW: LGG-1 脂化進入自噬體膜作為結構成分。必要性是膜整合依賴。

label: ATG-16.2
description: The Atg12-Atg5-ATG-16.2 complex is required for LGG-1/LGG-2 lipidation and autophagosome formation. Requirement is the conjugation dependency.
description_zh_TW: Atg12-Atg5-ATG-16.2 複合體為 LGG-1/LGG-2 脂化與自噬體形成所需。必要性是接合依賴。

label: RRM2
description: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM2 provides the small (beta) subunit housing the diferric-tyrosyl radical cofactor. RRM2 is S-phase restricted and the primary target of hydroxyurea and triapine.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM2 提供容納雙鐵-酪胺醯自由基輔因子的（beta）小次單元。RRM2 局限於 S 期表現，並是 hydroxyurea 與 triapine 的主要靶點。

label: Dopaminochrome
description: Dopaminochrome carries the alpha,beta-unsaturated indoline-5,6-dione Michael-acceptor motif shared with adrenochrome. Classification groups the quinoid electrophiles.
description_zh_TW: 多巴胺色素帶有與腎上腺素共享的 α,β-不飽和吲哚醌 Michael 受體基序。歸類統合醌型親電子劑。

label: Satoshi Ōmura
description: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。

label: Systemic Inflammatory Response Syndrome
description: Massive necroptotic DAMP release from ruptured cells (e.g., in severe pancreatitis) contributes to SIRS by activating TLR and inflammasome cascades systemically, escalating local necrosis into whole-body inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 破裂細胞大量釋出的 necroptotic DAMP（如嚴重胰臟炎）經由全身性活化 TLR 與炎症小體級聯，促成 SIRS，使局部壞死升級為全身性發炎。

label: Cognitive Decline
description: Cognitive decline is the age-associated reduction in memory, processing speed, and executive function, linked to chronic inflammation and inflammaging. Persisting low-grade inflammation is implicated in cognitive decline and shares risk with frailty and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 認知衰退是與年齡相關的記憶、處理速度與執行功能下降，與慢性發炎及發炎老化相關。持續的低度發炎與認知衰退有關，並與衰弱及心血管疾病共享風險。

label: membrane blebbing
description: Active ROCK1 drives MLC phosphorylation and actomyosin contraction producing blebs.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 ROCK1 驅動 MLC 磷酸化與肌動球蛋白收縮產生泡。

label: Drug Repositioning
description: Drug repositioning includes fenbendazole, an established benzimidazole anthelmintic now studied for its interference with microtubules, glycolysis, and p53 in tumors. The approach aims to convert a safe veterinary/human agent into a cancer therapeutic. The relationship is directional and reflects the logic of repurposing known drugs. Clinical validation for fenbendazole in oncology is still lacking.
description_zh_TW: Drug Repositioning 包括芬苯達唑，一種成熟的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，目前正在研究其對腫瘤微管、糖酵解和 p53 的幹擾。該方法旨在將安全的獸醫/人類藥物轉化為癌症治療劑。這種關係是方向性的，反映了重新利用已知藥物的邏輯。芬苯達唑在腫瘤學的臨牀驗證仍缺乏。

label: Gut Microbiota
description: Flavonoids are metabolized by gut bacteria into protective phenolic acids, while seaweed-derived components shift Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes ratios and enrich Bacteroides and Lactobacillus. These dose-sensitive microbiota-host interactions link dietary hormetins to systemic physiology.
description_zh_TW: Flavonoids 經腸道菌代謝為具保護作用的酚酸，而海藻來源成分可改變 Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes 比例並增加 Bacteroides 和 Lactobacillus。這些劑量敏感的菌群-宿主交互作用將膳食 Hormetins 與全身生理連結起來。

label: Positron Emission Tomography
description: TSPO radioligands visualize activated microglia, making PET the in-vivo readout of neuroinflammation. Detection parallels the MRI-detects-neuromelanin precedent.
description_zh_TW: TSPO 放射配體顯影活化的小膠質細胞，使 PET 成為神經發炎的體內讀值。偵測呼應 MRI 偵測 neuromelanin 的先例。

label: fatty-acid metabolism
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 promotes fatty-acid metabolism by deacetylating and activating PGC-1alpha and PPARalpha to drive fatty-acid oxidation, represses lipogenesis via SREBP-1c, and mobilizes fat from white adipose tissue by repressing PPAR-gamma and aP2. This supports metabolic flexibility and the lean phenotype of caloric restriction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並活化 PGC-1alpha 和 PPARalpha 來促進脂肪酸氧化，透過 SREBP-1c 抑制脂肪生成，並透過抑制 PPAR-gamma 和 aP2 從白色脂肪組織中動員脂肪。這支持了代謝靈活性和熱量限制的精瘦表型。

label: Synthetic STAC
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SRT1460 is a second-generation synthetic sirtuin-activating compound (STAC) of the imidazothiazole class, developed with SRT1720 and SRT2183 as chemically diverse and more potent activators than the initial polyphenolic STACs. These compounds were reported to have anticancer activity, but their mechanism is controversial: activation could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, and in vivo effects may be indirect (e.g., via the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway) rather than direct SIRT1 binding. Directionally, SRT1460 belongs to the synthetic STAC class whose biology underlies the ongoing debate about STAC-mediated SIRT1 activation.
description_zh_TW: SRT1460 是一種咪唑噻唑類的第二代合成 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），與 SRT1720 和 SRT2183 一起作為化學結構多樣且比初始多酚類 STAC 更強效的活化劑而開發。這些化合物據報導具有抗癌活性，但其機制存在爭議：活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質驗證，且體內效果可能是間接的（例如透過 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）而非直接 SIRT1 結合。方向性上 SRT1460 屬於合成 STAC 類別，其生物學構成了關於 STAC 介導的 SIRT1 活化的持續爭論。

label: Kinase-inhibitor scaffold
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: GW5074 is an indolinone compound originally developed as a c-Raf kinase inhibitor; like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220, it was repurposed as a sirtuin inhibitor after screening known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 based on the shared adenosine-binding site between sirtuins and kinases. GW5074 shows SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory activity in the low micromolar range. Directionally, its identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold enables engagement of the sirtuin NAD+ pocket. Its continued kinase activity complicates interpretation in cells, highlighting the need for selectivity optimization in dual kinase/sirtuin inhibitor design.
description_zh_TW: GW5074 是一種最初作為 c-Raf 激酶抑制劑開發的吲哚啉酮化合物；與雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 類似，它在基於 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享腺嘌呤結合位點的原理篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的活性後被重新定位為 sirtuin 抑制劑。GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制活性。方向性上其作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份使其能夠與 sirtuin NAD+ 口袋結合。其持續的激酶活性使細胞內的詮釋複雜化，凸顯了在雙重激酶/sirtuin 抑制劑設計中選擇性優化的必要性。

label: Rubicon
description: Rubicon and UVRAG reciprocally regulate the Vps34 complex: Rubicon restrains Vps34 lipid kinase activity and endosomal maturation, while UVRAG promotes them. They compete within overlapping complexes to modulate autophagy and endocytic trafficking.
description_zh_TW: Rubicon 與 UVRAG 對 Vps34 複合體進行相互調控：Rubicon 抑制 Vps34 脂質激酶活性與內體成熟，UVRAG 則促進之。它們在重疊複合體中競爭以調控自噬與內吞運輸。

label: H3K4me3
description: H3K4me3 and the repressive H3K27me3 reshape the promoter landscape in senescence, co-localizing in 'mesas' while H3K27me3 is depleted from 'canyons'. These bivalent states define transcriptional poise.
description_zh_TW: H3K4me3 與抑制性 H3K27me3 在衰老中重塑啟動子景觀，在「mesas」中共定位，而 H3K27me3 在「canyons」中被耗竭。這些雙價狀態定義轉錄準備狀態。

label: MICU1
description: MICU1 and MICU2 are regulatory subunits of the mitochondrial calcium uniporter complex. MICU1 endows the uniporter with a steep threshold response, while MICU2 reinforces pore closure at rest, and they act cooperatively to prevent pathological matrix Ca2+ overload.
description_zh_TW: MICU1 與 MICU2 是粒線體鈣單向轉運體複合體的調控亞基。MICU1 賦予轉運體陡峭的閾值反應，MICU2 則在靜止時強化孔道關閉，兩者合作防止病理性基質 Ca2+ 超載。

label: Senolytic Drugs
description: High-throughput campaigns discovered senolytics such as the navitoclax class.
description_zh_TW: 高通量篩選發現 navitoclax 類等 senolytic 藥物。

label: Intestinal Barrier
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Butyrate, a short-chain fatty acid from microbial fermentation of dietary fiber, serves as a primary colonocyte energy source. It enhances barrier integrity by increasing expression of tight junction proteins like occludin, preventing systemic inflammation in a dose-sensitive hormetic manner.
description_zh_TW: Butyrate 是膳食纖維經微生物發酵產生的短鏈脂肪酸，也是結腸細胞的主要能量來源。它透過增加 tight junction 蛋白（如 occludin）的表現來強化屏障完整性，以劑量敏感的 hormesis 方式預防全身性發炎。

label: RGD peptide
description: iRGD is engineered from the parent RGD motif plus a CendR element.
description_zh_TW: iRGD 由母 RGD 基序加 CendR 元件工程化。

label: IRF3
description: TBK1 phosphorylates IRF3 on C-terminal serine residues, driving IRF3 dimerisation, nuclear translocation and transcription of type I interferon genes. In senescence this arm generates the interferon component of the secretome, which in turn reinforces the inflammatory programme through interferon-stimulated genes and autocrine interferon signalling. Because TBK1 is shared between the DNA-sensing and RNA-sensing pathways, its activity integrates cGAS-STING and RIG-I inputs before they diverge into interferon and NF-kB outputs.
description_zh_TW: TBK1 磷酸化 IRF3 的 C 端絲胺酸殘基，驅動 IRF3 二聚化、入核轉位與第一型干擾素基因轉錄。在衰老中，此臂產生 secretome 的干擾素成分，並經干擾素刺激基因與自泌干擾素訊號進一步強化發炎程序。由於 TBK1 為 DNA 感測與 RNA 感測路徑共用，其活性整合 cGAS-STING 與 RIG-I 的輸入，之後才分流為干擾素與 NF-kB 輸出。

label: PKCι
description: PKCι phosphorylates Bad at Ser112, inactivating it.
description_zh_TW: PKCι 在 Ser112 磷酸化 Bad 使其失活。

label: CEBPβ
source_file: _document_ - Birch and Gil 2020 - Senescence and the SASP many therapeutic avenues.md
description: C/EBPbeta is one of the two principal transcription factors driving the inflammatory SASP, cooperating with NF-kB to activate CXCR2-ligand genes including IL-8. Loss of C/EBPbeta together with NF-kB reduces IL-8 and other chemokine receptor ligands and also impairs the growth arrest that defines oncogene-induced senescence, indicating that this transcription factor sits at the intersection of the arrest and secretory programmes. In the SASP-induction scheme C/EBPbeta occupies the transcription-factor tier alongside NF-kB, STAT and GATA4, and it is the target through which Notch modulates the late SASP.
description_zh_TW: C/EBPbeta 是驅動發炎型 SASP 的兩大主要轉錄因子之一，與 NF-kB 協同活化包括 IL-8 在內的 CXCR2 配體基因。C/EBPbeta 與 NF-kB 同時缺失會降低 IL-8 及其他趨化激素受體配體，並損害定義癌基因誘導衰老的生長停滯，顯示此轉錄因子位於停滯與分泌程序的交會處。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，C/EBPbeta 與 NF-kB、STAT、GATA4 同處轉錄因子層，也是 Notch 調節晚期 SASP 的作用靶點。

label: Senescent cell anti-apoptotic pathways
description: Senescent cells are resistant to apoptosis because they upregulate Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways (SCAPs), including Bcl-2 family pro-survival proteins and the PI3K/Akt axis. Different senescent cell types rely on different SCAPs, which is why no single senolytic clears all senescent cells — and why SCAP-targeting drugs such as Fisetin, D+Q, and Navitoclax show cell-type selectivity.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞因上調 Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways（SCAPs，包括 Bcl-2 家族促存活蛋白與 PI3K/Akt 軸）而抵抗細胞凋亡。不同衰老細胞類型依賴不同的 SCAPs，因此沒有任何單一 senolytic 能清除所有衰老細胞——這也是為何攻擊 SCAPs 的藥物如 Fisetin、D+Q 與 Navitoclax 呈現細胞類型選擇性的原因。

label: Calcium
description: Calcium influx activates peptidylarginine deiminase enzymes executing arginine to citrulline conversion. Cation gating follows the oxidant to calcium to enzyme directionality.
description_zh_TW: 鈣流入活化肽基精胺酸脫亞胺酶，執行精胺酸到瓜氨酸轉換。陽離子門控追隨氧化劑到鈣到酶的方向性。

label: Hormetic Window
description: The SIRT3/SIRT4 acetylation ratio is the mechanistic dial that sets the hormetic window for MnSOD-dependent redox tone ('SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio --determines--> Hormetic Window', conf 0.95): locked-off drives cancer/hypertension, locked-on drives cardiomyopathy — restored cycling is protective.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3/SIRT4 乙醯化比率是決定 MnSOD 依賴氧化還原張力荷爾蒙窗口的機制旋鈕（「SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio --determines--> Hormetic Window」，conf 0.95）：鎖定關閉驅動癌症／高血壓，鎖定開啟驅動心肌病變——恢復循環則具保護作用。

label: Stem Cells
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Restoring NAD+ with nicotinamide riboside (NR) reactivated mitochondrial metabolism, upregulated prohibitin proteins, and induced UPRmt, delaying stem cell senescence and extending lifespan in aged contexts. In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence and diminished regenerative capacity, and NR treatment reverses this by restoring mitochondrial function. NR is a key NAD+ repletion strategy alongside NMN that restores sirtuin activity, enhances the mitochondrial unfolded protein response, and improves mitochondrial membrane potential, thereby supporting regeneration and resilience in aged stem cell c...
description_zh_TW: 使用煙醯胺核糖苷（NR）恢復NAD+重新激活粒線體代謝，上調prohibitin蛋白，並誘導UPRmt，延緩幹細胞衰老並延長老年環境中的壽命。在老年肌肉幹細胞、神經幹細胞和黑素細胞幹細胞中，NAD+耗竭導致衰老、靜止喪失和再生能力降低，NR治療透過恢復粒線體功能逆轉這一過程。NR是與NMN並列的關鍵NAD+補充策略，可恢復sirtuin活性，增強粒線體未折疊蛋白反應，並改善粒線體膜電位，從而支持老年幹細胞 compartment 的再生和恢復力。

label: Focal Adhesion
description: Integrins are the transmembrane ECM receptors of focal adhesions. Containment records the adhesion composition.
description_zh_TW: Integrin 是黏著斑的跨膜 ECM 受體。包含記錄黏附組成。

label: Protein Kinase R
description: In the viral PKR route, type I interferon drives JAK/STAT-dependent de novo synthesis of Protein Kinase R, which phosphorylates FADD; phosphorylated FADD interacts with RIPK1 to induce necrosome formation (as reviewed in 2014).
description_zh_TW: 在病毒 PKR 路徑中，第一型干擾素驅動 JAK/STAT 依賴性之 Protein Kinase R 新合成，PKR 隨後磷酸化 FADD；磷酸化的 FADD 與 RIPK1 交互作用誘導 necrosome 形成（依 2014 年綜述所述）。

label: triple-negative breast cancer
description: TNBC is a breast cancer subtype defined by absent ER/PR/HER2 receptors.
description_zh_TW: TNBC 是以 ER/PR/HER2 受體缺失定義的乳癌亞型。

label: HER2-enriched breast cancer
description: HER2-enriched cancer is a molecular subtype of breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: HER2 富集癌是乳癌的分子亞型。

label: HDAC
description: Histone deacetylases remove activating acetylation, favoring silent chromatin.
description_zh_TW: 組蛋白去乙醯化酶移除活化性乙醯化，，有利沉默染色質。

label: Cytoplasm
source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md
description: In breast tumor cell lines SIRT1 is found predominantly in the cytoplasm — very little nuclear signal — in contrast to the nuclear distribution seen in normal breast tissue. Cytoplasmic SIRT1 is the form that regulates the 14-3-3ζ-caspase-2 module, and cytoplasmic SIRT1 is also the form generated by caspase cleavage during apoptosis, where it behaves pro-apoptotically in a deacetylase-independent manner. Subcellular localization therefore flips SIRT1's functional valence: nuclear anti-apoptotic, cytoplasmic context-dependent.
description_zh_TW: 在乳腺癌細胞株中，SIRT1 主要分布於細胞質——核內訊號極少——與正常乳腺組織的細胞核分布形成對比。細胞質型 SIRT1 正是調控 14-3-3ζ-Caspase-2 模組的形式，也是細胞凋亡期間被 caspase 切割後產生的形式，此時它以不依賴去乙醯活性的方式促進凋亡。次細胞定位因此翻轉了 SIRT1 的功能極性：細胞核內抗凋亡，細胞質內則視情境而定。

label: Cholesterol
description: Cholesterol is oxidized by reactive oxygen species through non-enzymatic chemistry that yields more than 30 oxysterol species. These oxidized products have distinct biological activities compared with native cholesterol. The directionality is ROS to sterol oxidation. A caveat is that many oxysterols are also formed enzymatically by cytochrome P450s, so not all oxysterols indicate oxidative stress. Examples include 7-ketocholesterol and 7beta-hydroxycholesterol, which are cytotoxic and pro-inflammatory and accumulate in atherosclerotic plaques and oxidized LDL.
description_zh_TW: Cholesterol 被 reactive oxygen species 經由非酵素化學氧化，產生 30 多種氧甾醇。這些氧化產物與天然cholesterol相比具有明顯的生物活性。方向性是ROS至甾醇氧化。需要注意的是，許多 oxysterols 也是由細胞色素 P450 酶促形成的，因此並非所有 oxysterols 都表示 oxidative stress。例子包括7-ketocholesterol和7β-羥基cholesterol，它們具有細胞毒性和促炎性，並在atheros硬化斑塊和oxidized LDL中積聚。

label: UPRmt
description: ATFS-1 is a basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor in C. elegans that serves as the primary regulator of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt). Under mitochondrial stress it translocates to the nucleus to drive the protective UPRmt gene program.
description_zh_TW: ATFS-1 是線蟲（C. elegans）中鹼性螺旋-環-螺旋轉錄因子，是粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的主要調控者。在粒線體壓力下它轉位至細胞核以驅動保護性的 UPRmt 基因程式。

label: SAMe
description: Methyl groups are transferred by methyltransferases that use a high-energy methyl donor, the universal activated donor being SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine). After donating its methyl group, SAMe becomes S-adenosylhomocysteine, which is recycled back to methionine via the methylation cycle. This coupling links methyl-group supply directly to the methionine cycle.
description_zh_TW: Methyl groups 由使用高能量甲基供體的甲基轉移酶轉移，而通用的活化供體是 SAMe（S-腺苷甲硫氨酸）。捐贈其甲基後，SAMe 變成 S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸，並透過 methylation cycle 回收為蛋氨酸。這種耦合將甲基供應與蛋氨酸循環直接連結起來。

label: Tau Protein
description: Neurofibrillary tangles co-define Alzheimer pathology with amyloid. Involvement records the second lesion.
description_zh_TW: 神經纖維纏結與類澱粉共同定義阿茲海默病理。涉及記錄第二病灶。

label: Cell Adhesion
description: Sialylated glycocalyx prevents cell-to-cell and matrix adhesion.
description_zh_TW: 唾液酸化糖萼阻止細胞間與基質黏附。

label: IL-1R
description: Secreted IL-1beta acts on the interleukin-1 receptor, the receptor arm through which the inflammasome-IL-1 axis propagates inflammation. In the SASP-induction scheme both IL-1alpha and IL-1beta are shown engaging IL-1R, and IL-1beta is additionally the product of inflammasome-dependent cleavage of pro-IL-1beta. Because IL-1 signalling feeds back onto NF-kB and IRAK1, this connection closes the autocrine loop that sustains the inflammatory secretome and makes IL-1R a candidate point of senomorphic intervention.
description_zh_TW: 分泌的 IL-1beta 作用於介白素-1 受體，這是發炎體-IL-1 軸傳播發炎的受體臂。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，IL-1alpha 與 IL-1beta 皆顯示接合 IL-1R，而 IL-1beta 另外是發炎體依賴性切割 pro-IL-1beta 的產物。由於 IL-1 訊號回饋至 NF-kB 與 IRAK1，此連結封閉了維持發炎型 secretome 的自泌環路，也使 IL-1R 成為 senomorphic 干預的候選節點。

label: Dietary AGE Restriction
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Intervention studies in mice show that reduced dietary AGEs attenuate insulin resistance, increase prevention of diabetes, and, in diabetic mice, reduce diabetic vascular and renal complications and improve impaired wound healing. The positive outcomes of caloric restriction in mice may be explained in part by a decrease in AGE intake and a concomitant decrease in oxidative stress. These findings indicate that the glycation load of the diet is not merely a bystander but can modulate insulin sensitivity and metabolic health, reinforcing the idea that dietary AGE restriction is a viable intervention against metabolic dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠的介入研究顯示，減少飲食性 AGE 可減緩胰島素抗性、增加糖尿病預防，且在糖尿病小鼠中減少糖尿病血管與腎臟併發症並改善受損傷口癒合。小鼠中熱量限制（caloric restriction）的正面結果可能部分可由 AGE 攝取減少與伴隨的氧化壓力下降來解釋。這些發現指出，飲食的糖化負載不只是旁觀者，而是能調節胰島素敏感度與代謝健康，強化了飲食 AGE 限制是對抗代謝功能障礙之可行介入手段的觀念。

label: Vascular Calcification
description: SIRT3 counteracts vascular calcification via mitochondrial function preservation and oxidative stress mitigation, deacetylating proteins in the PGC-1alpha/TFAM pathway to promote mitochondrial biogenesis while attenuating vascular smooth muscle cell calcification. AMPK/SIRT3 axis activation attenuated mineralization through mitochondrial functional restoration, and sEH deficiency preserves SIRT3 bioavailability to impede VC progression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過維護粒線體功能和減輕氧化壓力來對抗血管鈣化，去乙醯化 PGC-1alpha/TFAM 途徑中的蛋白以促進粒線體生成同時減輕血管平滑肌細胞鈣化。AMPK/SIRT3 軸線活化透過粒線體功能恢復減輕礦化，sEH 缺乏保留 SIRT3 可用性以阻礙 VC 進展。

label: lipogenesis
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 inhibits lipogenesis (e.g., p53, ROS, lipogenesis) by deacetylating upstream regulators, protecting against damage and tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化上游調節因子抑制脂肪生成（例如 p53、ROS、脂肪生成），保護免受損傷和腫瘤發生。

label: H3K9
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 is the principal H3K9 deacetylase (Vaquero et al., 2007). The vault graph lacked a direct SIRT1→H3K9 edge, routing it through 19 three-hop paths; this triple fills that curation gap, consistent with the source review's substrate catalogue.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是主要的 H3K9 去乙醯酶（Vaquero et al., 2007）。vault 圖譜原本缺少直接的 SIRT1→H3K9 邊，需經 19 條三跳路徑繞行；此三元組填補該策展缺口，與來源回顧的受質目錄一致。

label: Senotherapy
description: Senotherapy encompasses senolytics, the cell-elimination arm that selectively induces apoptosis in senescent cells by disabling SCAPs. This is one of the two principal divisions of senotherapy, the other being senomorphics, and the term captures the spectrum of interventions aimed at the senescent cell. Encompassing senolytics underscores the elimination-based strategy's centrality to the field, given its strong preclinical and early clinical evidence. Senolytic agents range from navitoclax to the D+Q combination and fisetin.
description_zh_TW: Senotherapy 涵蓋 senolytics，即透過失能 SCAPs 選擇性誘發衰老細胞凋亡的細胞消除臂。這是 senotherapy 兩個主要分支之一，另一為 senomorphics，且此詞涵蓋針對衰老細胞的介入光譜。涵蓋 senolytics 強調消除為本策略對該領域的中心性，考量其強健的臨床前與早期臨床證據。Senolytic 藥劑從 navitoclax 到 D+Q 組合與 fisetin 皆有。

label: Vesicular Monoamine Transporter 2
description: VMAT2 ligands such as 18F-AV-133 are core presynaptic PET tracers of monoaminergic terminals. Association records the tracer-target pairing.
description_zh_TW: 18F-AV-133 等 VMAT2 配體是單胺能末梢的核心突觸前 PET 追蹤劑。關聯記錄追蹤劑與標的配對。

label: Males
description: SIRT6 overexpression extends median lifespan of male mice by 14.5% and 9.9% with no significant effect in females (Kanfi et al., Nature 2012); the male-specific benefit tracks reduced serum IGF-1 and IIS. In the inbred C57BL/6JOlaHsd background (Roichman et al., Nat Commun 2021) it extends lifespan in both sexes, but the effect remains strongest in males (~27% vs ~15%), gated by baseline IGF-1.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 過量表現使雄性小鼠中位壽命延長 14.5% 與 9.9%，對雌性無顯著效果（Kanfi 等，Nature 2012）；雄性特異獲益追蹤於血清 IGF-1 與 IIS 的降低。在近交 C57BL/6JOlaHsd 背景（Roichman 等，Nat Commun 2021）中於兩性皆延長壽命，但效應仍以雄性最強（約 27% 對 15%），受基礎 IGF-1 所調控。

label: Pheomelanin
description: Benzothiazine-derived units are the hallmark structural motifs of Pheomelanin, the sulfur-containing yellow-to-red melanin. The 1,4-benzothiazine system contains nitrogen and sulfur heteroatoms that confer redox activity and metal-binding capability. Pheomelanin is chemically defined by its benzothiazine units, which distinguish it from the indolic eumelanin.
description_zh_TW: Benzothiazine 衍生的單元是 Pheomelanin 的標誌性結構基序，Pheomelanin 是含硫的黃至紅色黑色素。1,4-benzothiazine 系統含有賦予氧化還原活性和金屬結合能力的氮和硫雜原子。Pheomelanin 在化學上由其 benzothiazine 單元所定義，這使它有別於吲哚類型的 eumelanin。

label: Chromatin Remodeling
description: Methylated DNA is recognized by methyl-CpG-binding domain (MBD) proteins that recruit chromatin remodeling factors and histone deacetylases to the site. These recruited complexes remove acetyl groups and deposit repressive histone modifications, promoting condensation of the chromatin into a transcriptionally inactive state. This cross-talk between DNA methylation and histone modification establishes a self-reinforcing repressive loop that maintains stable gene silencing across cell divisions, and it is a major route by which promoter methylation converts active genes into silenced heterochromatin.
description_zh_TW: 甲基化 DNA 被甲基 CpG 結合域 (MBD) 蛋白識別，將染色質重塑因子和組蛋白去乙醯化酶募集到該位點。這些招募的複合物去除乙醯基並沉積抑制性組蛋白修飾，促進染色質凝結成轉錄失活狀態。 DNA甲基化和組蛋白修飾之間的這種串擾建立了一個自我強化的抑制環，在細胞分裂過程中維持穩定的基因沉默，並且它是啟動子甲基化將活性基因轉化為沉默的異染色質的主要途徑。

label: mTOR-HIF-1alpha Axis
description: Brief oxLDL exposure trains human monocytes so that TLR2/TLR4 restimulation elicits amplified TNF-alpha and IL-6. This training depends on Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling, since Torin1 or Raptor/Rictor silencing abolishes the trained cytokine response. It exemplifies DAMP-driven immunometabolic rewiring shared with beta-glucan training.
description_zh_TW: 短暫的 Oxidized LDL 暴露可訓練人類單核球，使 TLR2/TLR4 再刺激時產生放大的 TNF-alpha 與 IL-6。此訓練依賴 Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling，因為 Torin1 或 Raptor/Rictor 沉默可消除訓練後的細胞激素反應。這是與 beta-glucan 訓練共用的 DAMP-driven immunometabolic rewiring 範例。

label: HSP27
description: Ivermectin inhibits HSP27 phosphorylation (Nappi 2020), enhancing anti-EGFR activity. Chaperone modulation adds a proteostasis arm to its anticancer out-star.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 抑制 HSP27 磷酸化（Nappi 2020），增強抗 EGFR 活性。伴侶調節為其抗癌出向之星增添蛋白穩態臂。
